w|anonim.text: Seorang pengulas anonim menulis pujian untuk masakan Siti.
w|anonim.en: An anonymous reviewer wrote praise for Siti's cooking.
w|anonim.ko: 익명의 평론가가 시티의 요리를 칭찬하는 글을 썼어요.

w|antartika.text: Bayu bercerita kepada murid-murid bahwa es di Antartika terus mencair.
w|antartika.en: Bayu told the students that the ice in Antarctica keeps melting.
w|antartika.ko: 바유는 학생들에게 남극의 얼음이 계속 녹고 있다고 이야기했어요.

w|antartika.text: Intan kagum pada pelari yang pernah ikut maraton di Antartika.
w|antartika.en: Intan admires runners who have done a marathon in Antarctica.
w|antartika.ko: 인탄은 남극에서 마라톤을 뛴 적이 있는 주자들을 존경해요.

w|anti.text: Obat anti nyeri itu cepat bekerja.
Anti korupsi menjadi fokus kampanye mereka.
w|anti.en: Anti-corruption became the focus of their campaign.

w|antibiotik.text: Dimas mengingatkan pasien untuk menghabiskan antibiotik sesuai resep.
w|antibiotik.en: Dimas reminded the patient to finish the antibiotics as prescribed.
w|antibiotik.ko: 디마스는 환자에게 항생제를 처방대로 끝까지 먹으라고 일렀어요.

w|antibiotik.text: Putri harus minum antibiotik setelah tangannya tertusuk paku berkarat.
w|antibiotik.en: Putri had to take antibiotics after her hand was pierced by a rusty nail.
w|antibiotik.ko: 푸트리는 녹슨 못에 손이 찔려서 항생제를 먹어야 했어요.

w|antik.text: Di ruang kepala sekolah ada jam dinding antik peninggalan zaman Belanda.
w|antik.en: In the principal's office there's an antique wall clock from the Dutch era.
w|antik.ko: 교장실에는 네덜란드 시대에 남겨진 골동품 벽시계가 있어요.

w|antik.text: Rina membungkus lemari antik warisan neneknya dengan selimut tebal.
w|antik.en: Rina wrapped the antique wardrobe inherited from her grandmother in a thick blanket.
w|antik.ko: 리나는 할머니께 물려받은 골동품 옷장을 두꺼운 담요로 쌌어요.

w|anting.text: Seekor anak kucing menarik anting pemiliknya saat diperiksa Rudi.
w|anting.en: A kitten tugged at its owner's earring while Rudi was examining it.
w|anting.ko: 루디가 진찰하는 동안 새끼 고양이가 주인의 귀걸이를 잡아당겼어요.

w|anting.text: Nenek Rina memberinya anting perak warisan keluarga.
w|anting.en: Rina's grandmother gave her silver earrings that are a family heirloom.
w|anting.ko: 리나의 할머니는 집안 대대로 내려온 은귀걸이를 리나에게 줬어요.

w|antrean.text: Agus penasaran melihat antrean panjang di depan lapak piringan hitam.
w|antrean.en: Agus was curious to see the long queue in front of the vinyl record stall.
w|antrean.ko: 아구스는 레코드판 노점 앞의 긴 줄을 보고 궁금해졌어요.

w|antrean.text: Menjelang musim liburan, antrean di toko kue langganan Wati memanjang.
w|antrean.en: Before the holiday season, the queue at Wati's favorite bakery gets longer.
w|antrean.ko: 휴가철이 다가오면 와티 단골 빵집의 줄이 길어져요.

w|antusias.text: Rudi antusias merencanakan kejutan ulang tahun untuk kakaknya.
w|antusias.en: Rudi is excited about planning a surprise birthday for his sister.
w|antusias.ko: 루디는 누나 생일 깜짝 파티를 신나게 준비하고 있어요.

w|antusias.text: Rina antusias mendaftar kelas menyelam untuk pertama kalinya.
w|antusias.en: Rina eagerly signed up for a diving class for the first time.
w|antusias.ko: 리나는 처음으로 다이빙 수업에 신나게 등록했어요.

w|anugerah.text: Guru favorit Eko menerima anugerah guru teladan dari pemerintah daerah.
w|anugerah.en: Eko's favorite teacher received a model teacher award from the local government.
w|anugerah.ko: 에코가 좋아하는 선생님은 지방 정부에서 모범 교사상을 받았어요.

w|anugerah.text: Ayu menerima anugerah pelukis muda berbakat dari dinas kebudayaan.
w|anugerah.en: Ayu received the talented young painter award from the culture office.
w|anugerah.ko: 아유는 문화청에서 재능 있는 젊은 화가상을 받았어요.

w|apa.en: What do you want to eat?

w|apabila.text: Siswa boleh pulang lebih awal apabila guru sedang rapat.
w|apabila.en: Students may go home early when the teachers have a meeting.
w|apabila.ko: 선생님들이 회의를 할 때는 학생들이 일찍 집에 가도 돼요.

w|apabila.text: Siti berjanji akan datang ke reuni berikutnya apabila tidak ada jadwal jaga.
w|apabila.en: Siti promised to come to the next reunion if she isn't on call.
w|apabila.ko: 시티는 당직이 없으면 다음 동창회에 오겠다고 약속했어요.

w|apalagi.text: Aku lelah, apalagi setelah berjalan jauh.
w|apalagi.en: I'm tired, especially after walking far.
The weather is bad, especially in the mountains.

w|aparat.text: Fajar meminta aparat keamanan berjaga di depan balai kota saat unjuk rasa.
w|aparat.en: Fajar asked security officers to stand guard in front of city hall during the protest.
w|aparat.ko: 파자르는 시위 동안 시청 앞에 경비 인력을 배치해 달라고 요청했어요.

w|aparat.text: Lestari melapor kepada aparat kelurahan soal parkir liar di depan gedung.
w|aparat.en: Lestari reported the illegal parking in front of the building to the village officials.
w|aparat.ko: 레스타리는 건물 앞 불법 주차를 동사무소 직원에게 신고했어요.

w|apartemen.en: His apartment is on the upper floor.
They moved to a new apartment.

w|apel.text: Dia membawa apel untuk bekal sekolah.
w|apel.en: She brought an apple for school lunch.

w|api.en: The stove fire is still on.

w|aplikasi.text: Andi memakai aplikasi kamus untuk mengerjakan tugas bahasa Jerman.
w|aplikasi.en: Andi uses a dictionary app to do his German homework.
w|aplikasi.ko: 안디는 독일어 숙제를 할 때 사전 앱을 써요.

w|aplikasi.text: Rumah sakit meluncurkan aplikasi untuk mendaftar antrean dokter.
w|aplikasi.en: The hospital launched an app for booking a place in the doctor's queue.
w|aplikasi.ko: 병원은 진료 대기 접수를 하는 앱을 내놓았어요.

w|apotek.text: Budi mengantar resep ke apotek rumah sakit di lantai dasar.
w|apotek.en: Budi took the prescription to the hospital pharmacy on the ground floor.
w|apotek.ko: 부디는 처방전을 일 층 병원 약국에 가져다줬어요.

w|apotek.text: Siti membeli obat antimabuk di apotek bandara.
w|apotek.en: Siti bought motion-sickness pills at the airport pharmacy.

w|arahan.text: Redaktur memberi Fajar arahan singkat sebelum rapat pagi dimulai.
w|arahan.en: The editor gave Fajar brief instructions before the morning meeting started.
w|arahan.ko: 편집장은 아침 회의가 시작되기 전에 파자르에게 짧은 지시를 했어요.

w|arahan.text: Lestari mengikuti arahan petugas untuk mengambil jalan memutar.
w|arahan.en: Lestari followed the officer's directions to take a detour.
w|arahan.ko: 레스타리는 담당자의 안내에 따라 우회로로 갔어요.

w|arak.text: Sesuai resep keluarga, Agus menambahkan sedikit arak beras ke isian kue bulan.
w|arak.en: Following the family recipe, Agus adds a little rice wine to the mooncake filling.
w|arak.ko: 아구스는 집안 레시피대로 월병 소에 쌀술을 조금 넣어요.

w|arak.text: Di acara perpisahan, Wati menolak arak dan memilih jus jeruk.
w|arak.en: At the farewell party, Wati turned down the liquor and chose orange juice.
w|arak.ko: 송별회에서 와티는 술을 사양하고 오렌지 주스를 골랐어요.

w|argumen.text: Dalam debat, argumen Dimas didukung data yang kuat.
w|argumen.en: In the debate, Dimas's argument was backed by strong data.
w|argumen.ko: 토론에서 디마스의 주장은 탄탄한 자료로 뒷받침됐어요.

w|argumen.text: Putri dan kakaknya sempat beradu argumen soal harga menu baru.
w|argumen.en: Putri and her brother had an argument about the price of the new menu.
w|argumen.ko: 푸트리와 오빠는 새 메뉴 가격을 두고 언쟁을 벌였어요.

w|arkeolog.text: Andi menghentikan penggalian ketika seorang arkeolog datang memeriksa pecahan gerabah kuno.
w|arkeolog.en: Andi stopped the digging when an archaeologist came to examine shards of ancient pottery.
w|arkeolog.ko: 고고학자가 옛 토기 조각을 살피러 오자 안디는 굴착을 멈췄어요.

w|arkeolog.text: Teman Dewi yang arkeolog bercerita tentang penggalian candi kuno.
w|arkeolog.en: Dewi's archaeologist friend talked about excavating an ancient temple.
w|arkeolog.ko: 고고학자인 데위의 친구는 옛 사원 발굴 이야기를 했어요.

w|arkeologi.text: Sejak kecil Dimas bermimpi kuliah di jurusan arkeologi.
w|arkeologi.en: Since childhood Dimas has dreamed of studying archaeology at university.
w|arkeologi.ko: 디마스는 어릴 때부터 고고학과에 가는 게 꿈이었어요.

w|arkeologi.text: Untuk perannya, Putri membaca banyak buku arkeologi tentang candi kuno.
w|arkeologi.en: For her role, Putri read many archaeology books about ancient temples.
w|arkeologi.ko: 푸트리는 배역을 위해 옛 사원에 관한 고고학 책을 많이 읽었어요.

w|arktik.text: Bayu pernah menonton film tentang rubah arktik yang bulunya berubah putih saat musim dingin.
w|arktik.en: Bayu once watched a film about the arctic fox whose fur turns white in winter.
w|arktik.ko: 바유는 겨울에 털이 하얗게 변하는 북극여우에 관한 영화를 본 적이 있어요.

w|arktik.text: Intan bermimpi suatu hari ikut maraton di kawasan arktik yang bersalju.
w|arktik.en: Intan dreams of one day running a marathon in the snowy arctic region.
w|arktik.ko: 인탄은 언젠가 눈 덮인 북극 지역에서 마라톤을 뛰는 꿈을 꿔요.

w|arloji.text: Bayu membersihkan arloji tua yang ia beli dari seorang kakek di pojok pasar.
w|arloji.en: Bayu cleaned the old wristwatch he bought from an old man in the corner of the market.
w|arloji.ko: 바유는 시장 구석 할아버지에게서 산 낡은 손목시계를 닦았어요.

w|arloji.text: Suami Intan memberinya arloji emas sebagai mahar.
w|arloji.en: Intan's husband gave her a gold wristwatch as the dowry.
w|arloji.ko: 인탄의 남편은 신부 지참금으로 금 손목시계를 줬어요.

w|armada.text: Eko meliput penambahan armada bus kota yang baru.
w|armada.en: Eko covered the addition of new buses to the city bus fleet.
w|armada.ko: 에코는 새로 들어온 시내버스 차량 취재를 맡았어요.

w|armada.text: Perusahaan ojek mengirim ponsel seluruh armada pengemudinya ke toko Ayu untuk diservis.
w|armada.en: A motorbike taxi company sent the phones of its whole fleet of drivers to Ayu's shop for servicing.
w|armada.ko: 오토바이 택시 회사가 기사 전원의 휴대폰을 아유 가게에 수리 맡겼어요.

w|arogan.text: Awalnya Bayu dikira arogan, padahal cuma pemalu.
w|arogan.en: At first people thought Bayu was arrogant, but he's just shy.
w|arogan.ko: 처음엔 다들 바유가 거만하다고 생각했지만 사실 수줍음이 많을 뿐이에요.

w|arogan.text: Ada anggota arogan yang suka memonopoli alat beban.
w|arogan.en: There's an arrogant member who likes to hog the weight machines.
w|arogan.ko: 웨이트 기구를 독차지하는 거만한 회원이 있어요.

w|aroma.text: Dari kantin tercium aroma nasi goreng yang bikin Budi lapar.
w|aroma.en: The smell of fried rice drifted from the canteen and made Budi hungry.
w|aroma.ko: 매점에서 볶음밥 냄새가 풍겨 와서 부디는 배가 고파졌어요.

w|aroma.text: Rumah baru itu masih menyimpan aroma cat yang tajam, jadi Siti membuka semua jendela.
w|aroma.en: The new house still had a sharp smell of paint, so Siti opened all the windows.
w|aroma.ko: 새집에 페인트 냄새가 아직 독하게 남아 있어서 시티는 창문을 다 열었어요.

w|arsip.text: Foto kelulusan angkatan pertama masih tersimpan di arsip sekolah.
w|arsip.en: The graduation photo of the first class is still kept in the school archive.
w|arsip.ko: 첫 졸업생들의 졸업 사진이 아직 학교 기록 보관실에 남아 있어요.

w|arsip.text: Rudi membawa arsip majalah sekolah dari tahun mereka lulus.
w|arsip.en: Rudi brought the archive of school magazines from the year they graduated.
w|arsip.ko: 루디는 졸업하던 해의 교지 묶음을 가져왔어요.

w|arsitek.text: Setiap Jumat, arsitek proyek itu datang untuk memeriksa hasil kerja Agus.
w|arsitek.en: Every Friday, the project's architect comes to check Agus's work.
w|arsitek.ko: 매주 금요일 그 프로젝트의 건축가가 아구스의 작업을 점검하러 와요.

w|arsitek.text: Rak buku yang dipesan Wati dirancang oleh seorang arsitek muda.
w|arsitek.en: The bookshelf Wati ordered was designed by a young architect.
w|arsitek.ko: 와티가 주문한 책장은 젊은 건축가가 디자인했어요.

w|arsitektur.text: Kakak Budi kuliah arsitektur dan pernah membuat maket gedung sekolah mereka.
w|arsitektur.en: Budi's older brother studies architecture and once made a model of their school building.
w|arsitektur.ko: 버디의 형은 건축을 전공하는데 예전에 학교 건물 모형을 만든 적이 있어요.

w|arsitektur.text: Rumah panggung adalah arsitektur tradisional yang cocok untuk musim banjir, jelas Siti kepada cucunya.
w|arsitektur.en: A stilt house is traditional architecture well suited to the flood season, Siti explained to her grandchild.
w|arsitektur.ko: 고상 가옥은 홍수철에 알맞은 전통 건축이라고 시티가 손주에게 설명했어요.

w|artefak.text: Properti panggung yang dipakai Eko adalah tiruan artefak dari zaman kerajaan.
w|artefak.en: The stage prop Eko uses is a replica of an artifact from the royal era.
w|artefak.ko: 에코가 쓰는 소품은 왕조 시대 유물의 모조품이에요.

w|artefak.text: Lemari kayu di toko Ayu sudah sangat tua, hampir seperti artefak.
w|artefak.en: The wooden cupboard in Ayu's shop is so old it's almost like an artifact.
w|artefak.ko: 아유 가게의 나무 찬장은 너무 오래돼서 거의 유물 같아요.

w|arteri.text: Dimas menjelaskan bahwa kolesterol tinggi bisa menyumbat arteri.
w|arteri.en: Dimas explained that high cholesterol can clog the arteries.
w|arteri.ko: 디마스는 콜레스테롤이 높으면 동맥이 막힐 수 있다고 설명했어요.

w|arteri.text: Putri menyebut jalan besar di depan rumah sebagai arteri utama kota.
w|arteri.en: Putri calls the big road in front of the house the city's main artery.
w|arteri.ko: 푸트리는 집 앞 큰길을 도시의 대동맥이라고 불러요.

w|arti.text: Apa arti kata itu dalam bahasa asing?
w|arti.en: What is the meaning of that word in the foreign language?

w|arti.text: Arti hidupnya berubah setelah kejadian itu.
w|arti.en: The meaning of his life changed after that incident.
w|arti.ko: 그 일 이후로 삶의 의미가 바뀌었어.

w|artikel.text: Dia menulis artikel untuk majalah ilmiah.
w|artikel.en: She wrote an article for a science magazine.

w|artileri.text: Bunyi artileri dalam adegan perang dibuat dari rekaman yang diputar keras.
w|artileri.en: The artillery sounds in the war scene come from a recording played loudly.
w|artileri.ko: 전쟁 장면의 포성은 녹음을 크게 틀어서 만든 거예요.

w|artileri.text: Di toko Ayu ada televisi tua yang sedang menayangkan film perang dengan suara artileri.
w|artileri.en: In Ayu's shop there's an old TV showing a war film with the sound of artillery.
w|artileri.ko: 아유 가게의 낡은 TV에서 포성이 울리는 전쟁 영화가 나오고 있었어요.

w|artis.text: Seorang artis terkenal datang ke sekolah Budi untuk acara pentas seni.
w|artis.en: A famous celebrity came to Budi's school for the arts festival.
w|artis.ko: 유명 연예인이 학예회를 맞아 부디네 학교에 왔어요.

w|artis.text: Kata tetangga, rumah di seberang Siti dulu milik seorang artis sinetron.
w|artis.en: According to the neighbors, the house across from Siti used to belong to a soap opera actor.
w|artis.ko: 이웃 말로는 시티네 맞은편 집이 예전에 드라마 배우 집이었대요.

w|artistik.text: Dimas mengatur cahaya ruang pamer supaya terlihat lebih artistik.
w|artistik.en: Dimas adjusted the gallery lighting so it would look more artistic.
w|artistik.ko: 디마스는 전시실이 더 예술적으로 보이도록 조명을 맞췄어요.

w|artistik.text: Pajangan etalase buatan Putri dipuji sangat artistik oleh manajer.
w|artistik.en: The manager praised Putri's window display as very artistic.
w|artistik.ko: 매니저는 푸트리가 꾸민 쇼윈도가 아주 예술적이라고 칭찬했어요.

w|arus.text: Polisi mengalihkan arus lalu lintas di depan balai kota karena ada pawai.
w|arus.en: The police diverted traffic in front of city hall because of a parade.
w|arus.ko: 행진 때문에 경찰이 시청 앞 차량을 우회시켰어요.

w|arus.text: Lampu ruang latihan mati karena arus listrik tiba-tiba putus.
w|arus.en: The practice room lights went out because the electric current suddenly cut off.
w|arus.ko: 갑자기 전기가 끊겨서 연습실 불이 꺼졌어요.

w|arwah.text: Anak-anak suka bercerita tentang arwah penunggu gedung sekolah tua.
w|arwah.en: The children love telling stories about the spirit said to haunt the old school building.
w|arwah.ko: 아이들은 오래된 학교 건물에 산다는 귀신 이야기를 즐겨 해요.

w|arwah.text: Sebelum makan, para alumni berdoa untuk arwah teman yang sudah tiada.
w|arwah.en: Before eating, the alumni prayed for the soul of a friend who had passed away.
w|arwah.ko: 식사 전에 동문들은 세상을 떠난 친구의 영혼을 위해 기도했어요.

w|asal.en: As long as he's kind, I agree.
Where does this fruit come from?

w|asal-usul.text: Untuk rubrik budaya, Bayu meneliti asal-usul nama setiap kampung di kota itu.
w|asal-usul.en: For the culture section, Bayu researched the origins of each neighborhood's name in the city.
w|asal-usul.ko: 문화면 기사를 위해 바유는 그 도시 동네 이름의 유래를 조사했어요.

w|asal-usul.text: Intan membaca asal-usul kopi yang ia pesan dari sebuah kebun di lereng gunung.
w|asal-usul.en: Intan read about the origins of the coffee she ordered from a farm on a mountain slope.
w|asal-usul.ko: 인탄은 산비탈 농장에서 주문한 커피의 원산지 이야기를 읽었어요.

w|asam.text: Fajar menambahkan sedikit air jeruk supaya rasa kuenya agak asam.
w|asam.en: Fajar added a little orange juice so the cake would taste slightly sour.
w|asam.ko: 파자르는 케이크 맛이 살짝 새콤하도록 오렌지 즙을 조금 넣었어요.

w|asam.text: Kaki Lestari terasa pegal karena asam laktat setelah lari jauh.
w|asam.en: Lestari's legs felt sore from lactic acid after the long run.
w|asam.ko: 오래 달린 뒤 레스타리의 다리는 젖산 때문에 뻐근했어요.

w|asap.text: Asap tebal keluar dari dapur itu.
w|asap.en: Thick smoke came out of that kitchen.

w|asap.text: Aku bisa mencium asap dari kebakaran.
w|asap.en: I can smell smoke from the fire.

w|asasi.text: Pengacara itu menegaskan bahwa hak asasi setiap terdakwa harus dihormati.
w|asasi.en: The lawyer stressed that every defendant's basic rights must be respected.
w|asasi.ko: 그 변호사는 모든 피고인의 기본권이 존중돼야 한다고 강조했어요.

w|asasi.text: Wati percaya makanan layak adalah kebutuhan asasi setiap orang.
w|asasi.en: Wati believes decent food is a basic need of every person.
w|asasi.ko: 와티는 괜찮은 음식이 모든 사람의 기본적인 필요라고 믿어요.

w|aset.text: Rumah itu adalah aset berharga bagi keluarganya.
w|aset.en: That house is a valuable asset for his family.

w|aset.text: Aset perusahaan terus bertambah tiap tahun.
w|aset.en: The company's assets keep growing every year.

w|asin.text: Instruktur bilang sup buatan Andi sedikit terlalu asin.
w|asin.en: The instructor said Andi's soup was a little too salty.
w|asin.ko: 강사는 안디가 만든 수프가 조금 짜다고 했어요.

w|asin.text: Rani menulis bahwa angin laut di kotanya terasa asin setiap pagi.
w|asin.en: Rani wrote that the sea breeze in her town tastes salty every morning.
w|asin.ko: 라니는 자기 동네 바닷바람이 아침마다 짭짤하다고 썼어요.

w|asisten.en: The doctor's assistant prepared the exam tools.

w|asisten.text: Dia bekerja sebagai asisten di kantor.
w|asisten.en: She works as an assistant in the office.

w|asmara.text: Rekan-rekan Dimas diam-diam bergosip soal kisah asmara di lantai tiga.
w|asmara.en: Dimas's coworkers quietly gossiped about a romance on the third floor.
w|asmara.ko: 디마스의 동료들은 삼 층의 연애 이야기를 몰래 수군거렸어요.

w|asmara.text: Sambil menunggu, Putri membaca novel asmara yang dibelinya di toko buku bandara.
w|asmara.en: While waiting, Putri read a romance novel she had bought at the airport bookshop.
w|asmara.ko: 기다리는 동안 푸트리는 공항 서점에서 산 연애 소설을 읽었어요.

w|asosiasi.text: Sekolah Dimas bergabung dengan asosiasi sekolah penggerak lingkungan.
w|asosiasi.en: Dimas's school joined an association of environmental pioneer schools.
w|asosiasi.ko: 디마스의 학교는 환경 선도 학교 협회에 가입했어요.

w|asosiasi.text: Putri bergabung dengan asosiasi pengusaha restoran di kotanya.
w|asosiasi.en: Putri joined the restaurant owners' association in her city.
w|asosiasi.ko: 푸트리는 자기 도시의 식당 경영자 협회에 가입했어요.

w|aspek.text: Bagi Budi, kebersihan kandang adalah aspek yang paling penting di klinik.
w|aspek.en: For Budi, cage cleanliness is the most important aspect of the clinic.
w|aspek.ko: 부디에게는 우리 청결이 병원에서 가장 중요한 부분이에요.

w|aspek.text: Siti memikirkan setiap aspek sebelum membuka penginapan kecil di desanya.
w|aspek.en: Siti thought through every aspect before opening a small guesthouse in her village.
w|aspek.ko: 시티는 마을에 작은 민박을 열기 전에 모든 면을 꼼꼼히 따져 봤어요.

w|asrama.text: Mahasiswa baru tinggal di asrama kampus.
w|asrama.en: New students live in the campus dormitory.

w|asrama.text: Asrama itu penuh selama musim ujian.
w|asrama.en: That dormitory is full during exam season.
w|asrama.ko: 그 기숙사는 시험 기간에 가득 차.

w|astaga.en: Oh no, I forgot the key!
Oh my, the rain is pouring.

w|astrologi.text: Ada naskah kuno tentang astrologi yang dipakai untuk menentukan hari baik.
w|astrologi.en: There is an ancient manuscript on astrology that was used to choose auspicious days.
w|astrologi.ko: 길일을 정하는 데 쓰인 점성술 고문서가 있어요.

w|astrologi.text: Rak dekat kasir penuh dengan buku astrologi dan ramalan bintang.
w|astrologi.en: The shelf near the checkout is full of astrology and horoscope books.
w|astrologi.ko: 계산대 옆 선반은 점성술과 별자리 운세 책으로 가득해요.

w|astronom.text: Andi bercanda bahwa butuh seorang astronom untuk menebak kapan proyek ini selesai.
w|astronom.en: Andi joked that it would take an astronomer to predict when this project will be finished.
w|astronom.ko: 안디는 이 공사가 언제 끝날지 맞히려면 천문학자가 필요하겠다고 농담했어요.

w|astronom.text: Di reuni itu, Dewi kaget mendengar teman sebangkunya kini jadi astronom.
w|astronom.en: At the reunion, Dewi was surprised to hear that her old deskmate is now an astronomer.
w|astronom.ko: 동창회에서 데위는 옛 짝꿍이 지금 천문학자가 됐다는 말에 깜짝 놀랐어요.

w|astronomi.text: Teman Eko yang suka astronomi menunjuk rasi bintang di langit malam.
w|astronomi.en: Eko's friend who loves astronomy pointed out constellations in the night sky.
w|astronomi.ko: 천문학을 좋아하는 에코의 친구가 밤하늘의 별자리를 가리켰어요.

w|astronomi.text: Ayu mendengarkan siniar tentang astronomi selama latihan lari jarak jauh.
w|astronomi.en: Ayu listens to a podcast about astronomy during long-distance training runs.
w|astronomi.ko: 아유는 장거리 달리기 훈련 중에 천문학 팟캐스트를 들어요.

w|astronot.text: Waktu kecil, Bayu ingin jadi astronot, bukan kepala gudang.
w|astronot.en: As a child, Bayu wanted to be an astronaut, not a warehouse chief.
w|astronot.ko: 어릴 때 바유는 창고장이 아니라 우주비행사가 되고 싶었어요.

w|astronot.text: Di toko buku bandara, Intan membeli buku biografi seorang astronot.
w|astronot.en: At the airport bookshop, Intan bought an astronaut's biography.
w|astronot.ko: 공항 서점에서 인탄은 한 우주비행사의 전기를 샀어요.

w|asuhan.text: Di lantai dasar ada tempat penitipan anak, dan anak asuhan Bu Rina ramah sekali.
w|asuhan.en: There is a daycare on the ground floor, and the children in Mrs. Rina's care are very friendly.
w|asuhan.ko: 일 층에 어린이집이 있는데, 리나 선생님이 돌보는 아이들이 아주 상냥해요.

w|asuhan.text: Intan berbincang dengan seorang perawat yang membawa bayi asuhan ke dokter.
w|asuhan.en: Intan chatted with a nurse who was taking a baby in her care to the doctor.
w|asuhan.ko: 인탄은 돌보는 아기를 데리고 병원에 가는 간호사와 이야기를 나눴어요.

w|asuransi.en: His car insurance has already expired.

w|asyik.text: Budi begitu asyik membaca surat itu sampai lupa makan malam.
w|asyik.en: Budi was so absorbed in reading the letter that he forgot dinner.
w|asyik.ko: 부디는 편지 읽기에 푹 빠져서 저녁 먹는 것도 잊었어요.

w|asyik.text: Siti asyik mendengarkan musik sampai tidak sadar sudah melewati sepuluh kilometer.
w|asyik.en: Siti was so into her music that she didn't notice she had passed ten kilometers.
w|asyik.ko: 시티는 음악에 빠져서 십 킬로미터를 지난 줄도 몰랐어요.

w|atap.text: Atap rumah bocor saat hujan deras.
w|atap.en: The house roof leaks during heavy rain.

w|atap.text: Mereka memperbaiki atap sebelum musim hujan.
w|atap.en: They repaired the roof before the rainy season.

w|atas.en: The book is on the table.

w|atasan.en: The boss asked for the report before noon.

w|atasan.text: Dia berbicara dengan atasan tentang cuti.
w|atasan.en: He spoke with his superior about leave.

w|atlet.text: Sepupu Fajar adalah atlet bulu tangkis yang baru pulang dari pertandingan.
w|atlet.en: Fajar's cousin is a badminton athlete who just returned from a tournament.
w|atlet.ko: 파자르의 사촌은 시합에서 막 돌아온 배드민턴 선수예요.

w|atlet.text: Saat musim hujan tiba, Lestari melihat para atlet tetap berlatih di stadion.
w|atlet.en: When the rainy season arrives, Lestari sees the athletes keep training at the stadium.
w|atlet.ko: 우기가 와도 레스타리는 선수들이 경기장에서 계속 훈련하는 모습을 봐요.

w|atletik.text: Ruang olahraga museum memamerkan sepatu lari juara atletik pertama di provinsi itu.
w|atletik.en: The museum's sports room displays the running shoes of the province's first athletics champion.
w|atletik.ko: 박물관 스포츠 전시실에는 그 주 첫 육상 챔피언의 운동화가 전시돼 있어요.

w|atletik.text: Sebelum menjadi aktris, Putri pernah ikut lomba atletik tingkat sekolah.
w|atletik.en: Before becoming an actress, Putri once competed in school-level athletics.
w|atletik.ko: 배우가 되기 전에 푸트리는 학교 육상 대회에 나간 적이 있어요.

w|atmosfer.text: Langit malam di sana sangat jernih karena atmosfer di pegunungan bebas polusi.
w|atmosfer.en: The night sky there is very clear because the mountain atmosphere is free of pollution.
w|atmosfer.ko: 그곳 밤하늘은 산의 대기에 오염이 없어서 아주 맑아요.

w|atmosfer.text: Sebelum konser dimulai, atmosfer di dalam stadion sudah sangat meriah.
w|atmosfer.en: Before the concert started, the atmosphere inside the stadium was already electric.
w|atmosfer.ko: 공연이 시작되기 전부터 경기장 안 분위기는 이미 아주 뜨거웠어요.

w|aturan.en: The new rules are already in effect.

w|audisi.text: Dia ikut audisi untuk peran utama.
w|audisi.en: She joined an audition for the lead role.

w|aula.text: Konferensi pers gubernur diadakan di aula kantor gubernuran.
w|aula.en: The governor's press conference was held in the hall of the governor's office.

w|aula.text: Ayu diundang mengisi pelatihan servis ponsel di aula balai desa.
w|aula.en: Ayu was invited to give a phone repair training session in the village hall.
w|aula.ko: 아유는 마을 회관 강당에서 휴대폰 수리 교육을 해 달라는 초대를 받았어요.

w|awak.en: The ship crew is ready to leave.
All the flight crew are safe.

w|awal.en: It was wrong from the start.

w|awam.text: Penjelasan di museum itu ditulis dengan bahasa sederhana supaya mudah dipahami orang awam.
w|awam.en: The explanations in the museum are written in simple language so laypeople can understand them easily.
w|awam.ko: 그 박물관 설명은 일반인도 쉽게 이해하도록 쉬운 말로 쓰여 있어요.

w|awam.text: Putri mengakui bahwa dulu ia masih awam soal teknik akting di depan kamera.
w|awam.en: Putri admits that she used to be a novice at acting techniques in front of the camera.
w|awam.ko: 푸트리는 예전엔 카메라 앞 연기 기술을 잘 몰랐다고 인정해요.

w|awan.en: Dark clouds covered the whole sky.

w|awan.text: Pesawat terbang di atas awan putih.
w|awan.en: The plane flew above white clouds.

w|awas.text: Dimas berseru kepada adiknya, "Hei, awas, tanah di sini licin!"
w|awas.en: Dimas called out to his little brother, "Hey, watch out, the ground here is slippery!"
w|awas.ko: 디마스가 동생에게 "야, 조심해, 여기 땅 미끄러워!" 하고 외쳤어요.

w|awas.text: Satpam berteriak kepada Putri, "Mbak, awas mobil!"
w|awas.en: The security guard shouted to Putri, "Miss, watch out for the car!"
w|awas.ko: 경비원이 푸트리에게 "아가씨, 차 조심해요!" 하고 소리쳤어요.

w|ayam.en: The fried chicken is really good.
He raises chickens in the yard.

w|ayat.text: Seorang pengacara dalam drama itu membacakan ayat kedua dari pasal undang-undang.
w|ayat.en: A lawyer in the play reads out the second paragraph of an article of the law.
w|ayat.ko: 연극 속 변호사가 법조문 제2항을 읽어요.

w|ayat.text: Kepala desa membacakan ayat dalam peraturan desa tentang pembagian air.
w|ayat.en: The village head reads out a clause in the village regulation on water sharing.
w|ayat.ko: 이장은 물 배분에 관한 마을 규정의 조항을 읽어요.

w|ayunan.text: Andi memperbaiki ayunan kayu di teras untuk anak-anaknya.
w|ayunan.en: Andi fixed the wooden swing on the porch for his children.
w|ayunan.ko: 안디는 아이들을 위해 현관 나무 그네를 고쳤어요.

w|ayunan.text: Gerakan kereta terasa seperti ayunan yang membuat Dewi mengantuk.
w|ayunan.en: The train's motion feels like a swing that makes Dewi sleepy.
w|ayunan.ko: 열차의 흔들림이 그네처럼 느껴져서 데위는 졸려요.

w|bab.text: Peraturan soal parkir dijelaskan di bab ketiga buku panduan warga.
w|bab.en: The parking rules are explained in the third chapter of the residents' handbook.
w|bab.ko: 주차 규정은 주민 안내서 셋째 장에 나와 있어요.

w|bab.text: Buku teori musik Wati baru sampai bab tentang akor.
w|bab.en: Wati's music theory book has only reached the chapter on chords.
w|bab.ko: 와티의 음악 이론 책은 이제 막 화음 장에 들어섰어요.

w|babak.en: The first round of the match was very exciting.

w|babak.text: Mereka menang di babak final kemarin.
w|babak.en: They won in the final round yesterday.

w|babak belur.text: Seorang pemuda datang dengan wajah babak belur setelah jatuh dari motor.
w|babak belur.en: A young man came in with a badly bruised face after falling off his motorbike.
w|babak belur.ko: 한 청년이 오토바이에서 넘어져 얼굴이 엉망이 된 채로 왔어요.

w|babak belur.text: Tim Lestari babak belur dalam presentasi pertama, tetapi rekan baru tetap semangat.
w|babak belur.en: Lestari's team got hammered in the first presentation, but the new coworker stayed upbeat.
w|babak belur.ko: 레스타리 팀은 첫 발표에서 완전히 깨졌지만 새 동료는 여전히 의욕이 넘쳤어요.

w|babi.text: Babi itu berlari di sekitar kandang.
w|babi.en: That pig is running around the pen.

w|babi.text: Petani memberi makan babi setiap pagi.
w|babi.en: The farmer feeds the pigs every morning.
w|babi.ko: 농부가 매일 아침 돼지에게 먹이를 줘.

w|bacaan.text: Budi meminjam buku bacaan ringan dari perpustakaan untuk liburan.
w|bacaan.en: Budi borrowed some light reading from the library for the holidays.
w|bacaan.ko: 버디는 방학 때 읽을 가벼운 책을 도서관에서 빌렸어요.

w|bacaan.text: Di musim hujan, Siti menghabiskan sore dengan buku bacaan di teras.
w|bacaan.en: In the rainy season, Siti spends her afternoons on the porch with a book.
w|bacaan.ko: 우기에 시티는 테라스에서 책을 읽으며 오후를 보내요.

w|badai.en: The storm destroyed the neighbor's roof.

w|badai.text: Kapal bertahan di tengah badai besar.
w|badai.en: The ship held on through a great storm.

w|badak.text: Anak Budi bertanya apakah badak pernah hidup di hutan dekat desa mereka.
w|badak.en: Budi's child asked whether rhinos had ever lived in the forest near their village.
w|badak.ko: 부디의 아이는 마을 근처 숲에 코뿔소가 산 적이 있냐고 물었어요.

w|badak.text: Di dinding dapur ada kalender bergambar badak bercula satu yang dipasang Siti.
w|badak.en: On the kitchen wall there is a calendar with a picture of a one-horned rhino that Siti put up.
w|badak.ko: 주방 벽에는 시티가 걸어 둔 외뿔코뿔소 그림 달력이 있어요.

w|badan.en: His body was shaking from the cold.

w|badan.text: Olahraga membuat badan menjadi lebih sehat.

w|badut.text: Badut di pesta ulang tahun membuat anak tertawa.
w|badut.en: The clown at the birthday party made the kids laugh.
w|badut.ko: 생일 파티 광대가 아이들을 웃게 했어.

w|badut.text: Seorang badut berjalan di tengah keramaian.
w|badut.en: A clown walked through the crowd.
w|badut.ko: 광대 한 명이 사람들 사이를 걸었어.

w|bagai.text: Ruang bawah tanah museum gelap dan sunyi bagai gua.
w|bagai.en: The museum's basement room is dark and quiet like a cave.
w|bagai.ko: 박물관 지하 전시실은 동굴처럼 어둡고 조용해요.

w|bagai.text: Menjelang Lebaran, pasar penuh sesak bagai lautan manusia.
w|bagai.en: Ahead of Eid, the market is packed like a sea of people.
w|bagai.ko: 르바란을 앞두고 시장은 인파로 바다를 이뤄요.

w|bagaikan.en: My heart is like a calm sea.
Time passed like a gentle breeze.

w|bagaimana.en: What else am I supposed to do?

w|bagasi.text: Agus menaruh tas besar dan tikar di bagasi mobil.
w|bagasi.en: Agus put the big bag and the mat in the car's trunk.
w|bagasi.ko: 아구스는 큰 가방과 돗자리를 자동차 트렁크에 넣었어요.

w|bagasi.text: Wati menawarkan koper dengan ruang bagasi tambahan kepada seorang turis.
w|bagasi.en: Wati offered a tourist a suitcase with extra luggage space.
w|bagasi.ko: 와티는 한 관광객에게 수납공간이 더 넓은 여행 가방을 권했어요.

w|bahtera.text: Lukisan bahtera kayu menghiasi dinding lobi hotel tempat Rudi bekerja.
w|bahtera.en: A painting of a wooden ark decorates the lobby wall of the hotel where Rudi works.
w|bahtera.ko: 루디가 일하는 호텔 로비 벽에는 나무 방주 그림이 걸려 있어요.

w|bahtera.text: Saat hujan tak kunjung berhenti, Rina bercanda bahwa kampungnya butuh bahtera.
w|bahtera.en: When the rain wouldn't stop, Rina joked that her village needed an ark.
w|bahtera.ko: 비가 그칠 줄 모르자 리나는 마을에 방주가 필요하겠다고 농담했어요.

w|bahu.text: Perawat menepuk bahu Agus supaya dia tidak tegang.
w|bahu.en: The nurse patted Agus on the shoulder so he wouldn't be tense.
w|bahu.ko: 간호사가 긴장하지 말라고 아구스의 어깨를 토닥였어요.

w|bahu.text: Wati memikul papan kayu di bahu menuju lantai atas.
w|bahu.en: Wati carried a wooden plank on her shoulder up to the top floor.
w|bahu.ko: 와티는 나무 판자를 어깨에 메고 위층으로 올라갔어요.

w|bahwa.en: They said the meeting was canceled.

w|baikan.en: They finally made up after arguing.

w|baikan.text: Baikan itu membuat suasana rumah lebih tenang.
w|baikan.en: That reconciliation made the home atmosphere calmer.
w|baikan.ko: 그 화해로 집 분위기가 더 편안해졌어.

w|baja.text: Jembatan itu dibuat dari baja kuat.
w|baja.en: That bridge is made of strong steel.

w|bajak.text: Petani memakai bajak untuk mengolah tanah.
w|bajak.en: The farmer uses a plow to work the soil.

w|bajak.text: Bajak itu tertinggal di gudang lama.
w|bajak.en: That plow was left in the old shed.

w|bakal.en: He is going to become a great leader.

w|bakal.text: Bakal hujan sore ini menurut ramalan.
w|bakal.en: It is going to rain this afternoon according to the forecast.
w|bakal.ko: 예보에 따르면 오늘 오후에 비가 올 거야.

w|bakat.text: Bakat menyanyinya sudah terlihat sejak kecil.
w|bakat.en: Her singing talent has shown since childhood.
w|bakat.ko: 그녀의 노래 재능은 어릴 때부터 보였어.

w|bakat.text: Dia punya bakat menggambar yang luar biasa.
w|bakat.en: He has an extraordinary talent for drawing.
w|bakat.ko: 그는 그림에 대한 뛰어난 재능이 있어.

w|bakteri.text: Luka yang tidak dibersihkan bisa terinfeksi bakteri, kata Budi.
w|bakteri.en: A wound that isn't cleaned can get infected by bacteria, Budi said.
w|bakteri.ko: 닦지 않은 상처는 세균에 감염될 수 있다고 부디가 말했어요.

w|bakteri.text: Siti selalu merebus air sungai dulu supaya bakteri di dalamnya mati.
w|bakteri.en: Siti always boils river water first so the bacteria in it die.
w|bakteri.ko: 시티는 강물 속 세균이 죽도록 늘 먼저 끓여요.

w|baku.text: Bu Guru meminta Rudi menulis karangan dalam bahasa Indonesia yang baku.
w|baku.en: The teacher asked Rudi to write the essay in standard Indonesian.
w|baku.ko: 선생님은 루디에게 작문을 표준 인도네시아어로 쓰라고 했어요.

w|baku.text: Petugas kelurahan meminta Rina mengisi formulir pindah yang baku.
w|baku.en: The village office clerk asked Rina to fill out the standard moving form.
w|baku.ko: 동사무소 직원은 리나에게 정해진 전출 양식을 채우라고 했어요.

w|balai.text: Pentas seni sekolah Dimas diadakan di balai desa.
w|balai.en: Dimas's school art show was held at the village hall.
w|balai.ko: 디마스 학교의 예술 공연은 마을 회관에서 열렸어요.

w|balai.text: Restoran Putri menerima pesanan katering untuk acara di balai kota.
w|balai.en: Putri's restaurant took a catering order for an event at city hall.
w|balai.ko: 푸트리네 식당은 시청 행사용 케이터링 주문을 받았어요.

w|balap.text: Teman sebangku Rudi bercita-cita jadi juara balap sepeda.
w|balap.en: Rudi's deskmate dreams of becoming a bicycle racing champion.
w|balap.ko: 루디의 짝꿍은 자전거 경주 챔피언이 되는 게 꿈이에요.

w|balap.text: Suara motor balap dari sirkuit dekat rumah baru membuat Rina sulit tidur.
w|balap.en: The noise of racing motorcycles from the track near the new house made it hard for Rina to sleep.
w|balap.ko: 새집 근처 서킷에서 나는 경주용 오토바이 소리 때문에 리나는 잠들기 힘들었어요.

w|balapan.en: The bicycle race started this morning.

w|balapan.text: Dia menang dalam balapan lari sekolah.
w|balapan.en: He won in the school running race.

w|balasan.text: Dia menunggu balasan pesan itu dengan cemas.
w|balasan.en: She anxiously waited for a reply to that message.
w|balasan.ko: 그녀는 그 메시지 답장을 초조하게 기다렸어.

w|balasan.text: Balasan marahnya membuat suasana semakin tegang.
w|balasan.en: His angry reply made the mood even tenser.
w|balasan.ko: 그의 화난 대답이 분위기를 더 긴장되게 만들었어.

w|balet.text: Bayu menonton pertunjukan balet anak-anak untuk rubrik budaya.
w|balet.en: Bayu watched a children's ballet performance for the culture section.
w|balet.ko: 바유는 문화면 기사를 위해 어린이 발레 공연을 봤어요.

w|balet.text: Adik Intan ikut kelas balet setiap Sabtu di dekat kantor.
w|balet.en: Intan's younger sister takes ballet class every Saturday near the office.
w|balet.ko: 인탄의 여동생은 토요일마다 사무실 근처에서 발레 수업을 들어요.

w|balistik.text: Ahli balistik menjelaskan arah tembakan kepada majelis hakim dengan bantuan gambar.
w|balistik.en: The ballistics expert explained the direction of the shot to the judges with the help of diagrams.
w|balistik.ko: 탄도 전문가가 그림을 써서 재판부에 총알이 날아간 방향을 설명했어요.

w|balistik.text: Suami Wati suka menonton film detektif yang penuh istilah balistik sambil menjaga kasir.
w|balistik.en: Wati's husband likes watching detective films full of ballistics terms while minding the till.
w|balistik.ko: 와티의 남편은 계산대를 지키면서 탄도 용어가 가득한 형사 영화를 즐겨 봐요.

w|balkon.text: Agus menanam cabai dalam pot di balkon apartemennya.
w|balkon.en: Agus grows chilies in pots on his apartment balcony.
w|balkon.ko: 아구스는 아파트 발코니 화분에 고추를 키워요.

w|balkon.text: Bunga kertas di balkon Wati mekar penuh di awal musim kemarau.
w|balkon.en: The bougainvillea on Wati's balcony blooms fully at the start of the dry season.
w|balkon.ko: 건기가 시작되면 와티네 발코니의 부겐빌레아가 활짝 펴요.

w|balok.text: Langit-langit unit Agus punya balok kayu yang sengaja dibiarkan terlihat.
w|balok.en: The ceiling of Agus's unit has wooden beams deliberately left exposed.
w|balok.ko: 아구스네 집 천장에는 일부러 드러나게 둔 나무 들보가 있어요.

w|balok.text: Angin kencang menjatuhkan balok kayu dari gudang tetangga Wati.
w|balok.en: Strong winds knocked a wooden beam off Wati's neighbor's shed.
w|balok.ko: 강풍에 와티 이웃집 창고에서 나무 들보가 떨어졌어요.

w|balon.text: Pojok anak di perpustakaan dihias balon warna-warni untuk hari dongeng.
w|balon.en: The children's corner of the library was decorated with colorful balloons for story day.
w|balon.ko: 동화의 날을 맞아 도서관 어린이 코너가 알록달록한 풍선으로 꾸며졌어요.

w|balon.text: Seorang anak kecil membawa balon merah naik ke gerbong Putri.
w|balon.en: A small child brought a red balloon onto Putri's carriage.
w|balon.ko: 어린아이가 빨간 풍선을 들고 푸트리네 칸에 탔어요.

w|bambu.en: Agus's house has walls of woven bamboo.
w|bambu.ko: 아구스의 집은 대나무를 엮어 만든 벽으로 되어 있어요.

w|bambu.text: Wati mengenang pondok bambu tempat mereka dulu belajar bersama.
w|bambu.en: Wati recalled the bamboo hut where they used to study together.
w|bambu.ko: 와티는 예전에 함께 공부하던 대나무 오두막을 떠올렸어요.

w|ban.text: Ban mobil itu kempes di jalan tol.
w|ban.en: The car tire went flat on the highway.
w|ban.ko: 그 차 타이어가 고속도로에서 바람 빠졌어.

w|ban.text: Montir mengganti ban belakang yang rusak.
w|ban.en: The mechanic replaced the damaged rear tire.

w|bandar.text: Fajar membaca berita bahwa polisi menangkap bandar narkoba yang memakai jasa kurir.
w|bandar.en: Fajar read news that the police caught a drug dealer who used courier services.
w|bandar.ko: 파자르는 경찰이 택배를 이용한 마약상을 잡았다는 기사를 읽었어요.

w|bandar.text: Guru bilang dulu kota itu adalah bandar dagang rempah yang ramai.
w|bandar.en: The teacher said that the city used to be a busy spice-trading port.
w|bandar.ko: 선생님은 그 도시가 예전에 향신료 무역으로 붐비던 항구였다고 했어요.

w|bandara.en: We arrived at the airport early in the morning.

w|bandara.text: Bandara itu sangat sibuk hari ini.
w|bandara.en: That airport is very busy today.

w|bandel.text: Anak tetangga yang bandel itu memanjat pagar rumah Andi lagi.
w|bandel.en: That naughty neighbor kid climbed over Andi's fence again.
w|bandel.ko: 그 말썽꾸러기 이웃집 아이가 또 안디네 담을 넘었어요.

w|bandel.text: Murid yang bandel itu sering memainkan lagu pop di tengah pelajaran Dewi.
w|bandel.en: That unruly student often plays pop songs in the middle of Dewi's lessons.
w|bandel.ko: 그 말썽꾸러기 학생은 데위의 수업 중에 자주 팝송을 연주해요.

w|banding.text: Sebagai banding, Bu Guru memperlihatkan nilai Andi semester lalu.
w|banding.en: For comparison, the teacher showed Andi's grades from last semester.
w|banding.ko: 비교하려고 선생님은 안디의 지난 학기 성적을 보여 줬어요.

w|banding.text: Harga daging tahun ini naik tajam bila dijadikan banding dengan tahun lalu.
w|banding.en: Meat prices this year rose sharply when compared with last year.
w|banding.ko: 올해 고기값은 작년과 비교하면 크게 올랐어요.

w|bang.text: Bang, tolong bantu angkat kotak ini.
w|bang.en: Bro, please help lift this box.
w|bang.ko: 형, 이 상자 드는 거 좀 도와줘.

w|bang.text: Aku kenal bang itu dari pasar.
w|bang.en: I know that guy from the market.

w|bangau.text: Seekor bangau putih berdiri diam di pematang sawah.
w|bangau.en: A white stork stood still on the rice-field dike.
w|bangau.ko: 흰 황새 한 마리가 논두렁에 가만히 서 있었어요.

w|bangau.text: Ayu melipat burung bangau dari kertas bekas saat istirahat.
w|bangau.en: Ayu folds paper cranes from scrap paper during her break.
w|bangau.ko: 아유는 쉬는 시간에 이면지로 종이학을 접어요.

w|banget.text: Aku senang banget bisa bertemu kamu.
w|banget.en: I'm really happy I could meet you.
w|banget.ko: 널 만날 수 있어서 정말 기뻐.

w|banget.text: Filmnya bagus banget dari awal sampai akhir.
w|banget.en: The movie was really good from start to finish.
w|banget.ko: 그 영화는 처음부터 끝까지 정말 좋았어.

w|bangkai.text: Bau busuk dari bangkai burung di semak-semak membuat Rudi menutup hidung.
w|bangkai.en: The stench of a dead bird in the bushes made Rudi hold his nose.
w|bangkai.ko: 덤불 속 새 사체에서 나는 악취 때문에 루디는 코를 막았어요.

w|bangkai.text: Lirik lagu itu menyamakan cinta lama dengan bangkai kapal di dasar laut.
w|bangkai.en: The song's lyrics compare an old love to a shipwreck on the seabed.
w|bangkai.ko: 그 노래 가사는 옛사랑을 바다 밑 난파선에 빗대요.

w|bangkit.text: Dia bangkit dari kursi dengan cepat.
w|bangkit.en: He rose from the chair quickly.
Rise up and face the new challenge.

w|bangkrut.text: Kontraktor lama proyek ini bangkrut, jadi pekerjaan sempat berhenti setahun.
w|bangkrut.en: The project's previous contractor went bankrupt, so the work stopped for a year.
w|bangkrut.ko: 이 공사의 예전 시공사가 파산해서 일이 일 년 동안 멈췄어요.

w|bangkrut.text: Rina pindah ke kantor ini karena perusahaan lamanya bangkrut.
w|bangkrut.en: Rina moved to this office because her old company went bankrupt.
w|bangkrut.ko: 리나는 전 회사가 파산해서 이 회사로 옮겼어요.

w|bangsa.en: This nation has a long history.
w|bangsa.ko: 이 나라는 긴 역사를 가지고 있어.

w|bangsa.en: National unity must be guarded together.

w|bangsal.text: Klinik Rudi punya bangsal kecil untuk hewan yang harus dirawat inap.
w|bangsal.en: Rudi's clinic has a small ward for animals that need to stay overnight.
w|bangsal.ko: 루디의 병원에는 입원해야 하는 동물을 위한 작은 병실이 있어요.

w|bangsal.text: Puskesmas di desa Rina hanya punya satu bangsal untuk pasien rawat inap.
w|bangsal.en: The health center in Rina's village has only one ward for inpatients.
w|bangsal.ko: 리나네 마을 보건소에는 입원 환자용 병실이 하나뿐이에요.

w|bangsawan.text: Bangsawan itu tinggal di istana lama.
w|bangsawan.en: That noble lived in an old palace.

w|bangsawan.text: Kisah bangsawan sering muncul di drama.
w|bangsawan.en: Stories of nobles often appear in dramas.

w|banjir.text: Warga desa pesisir itu masih ingat banjir rob tahun lalu.
w|banjir.en: The coastal villagers still remember last year's tidal flood.
w|banjir.ko: 그 해안 마을 주민들은 작년 밀물 홍수를 아직 기억해요.

w|banjir.text: Saat banjir datang, para tetangga membantu Ayu mengangkat lemari.
w|banjir.en: When the flood came, the neighbors helped Ayu lift her cupboard.
w|banjir.ko: 홍수가 났을 때 이웃들이 아유를 도와 장롱을 옮겼어요.

w|bank.text: Aku harus ke bank hari ini.
w|bank.en: I have to go to the bank today.
The bank is closed on Sunday.

w|bankir.text: Seorang bankir datang ke proyek untuk memastikan pinjaman dipakai sesuai rencana.
w|bankir.en: A banker came to the site to make sure the loan was used as planned.
w|bankir.ko: 은행원 한 명이 대출금이 계획대로 쓰이는지 확인하러 현장에 왔어요.

w|bankir.text: Kakak Wati yang bekerja sebagai bankir selalu mengingatkannya soal belanja berlebihan.
w|bankir.en: Wati's older sibling, who works as a banker, always warns her about overspending.
w|bankir.ko: 은행원으로 일하는 와티의 언니는 늘 과소비를 조심하라고 해요.

w|bantal.text: Eko memakai tas ranselnya sebagai bantal ketika tidur di bawah pohon.
w|bantal.en: Eko used his backpack as a pillow when he slept under a tree.
w|bantal.ko: 에코는 나무 아래서 잘 때 배낭을 베개로 썼어요.

w|bantal.text: Ayu meminjamkan bantal tambahan kepada tetangga yang kedatangan tamu.
w|bantal.en: Ayu lent an extra pillow to a neighbor who had guests.
w|bantal.ko: 아유는 손님이 온 이웃에게 베개를 하나 더 빌려줬어요.

w|bantalan.text: Agus memasang bantalan karet di kaki kursi agar lantai tidak tergores.
w|bantalan.en: Agus put rubber pads on the chair legs so the floor wouldn't get scratched.
w|bantalan.ko: 아구스는 바닥이 긁히지 않게 의자 다리에 고무 패드를 붙였어요.

w|bantalan.text: Wati menambahkan bantalan empuk di kursi kayu untuk tamu.
w|bantalan.en: Wati added soft cushions to the wooden chairs for the guests.
w|bantalan.ko: 와티는 손님용 나무 의자에 푹신한 방석을 깔았어요.

w|banteng.text: Dimas pelan-pelan mendekati banteng yang sedang makan rumput.
w|banteng.en: Dimas slowly approached the bull that was eating grass.
w|banteng.ko: 디마스는 풀을 뜯고 있는 들소에게 천천히 다가갔어요.

w|banteng.text: Di televisi ada film dokumenter tentang banteng liar di Jawa.
w|banteng.en: There was a documentary on TV about wild banteng in Java.
w|banteng.ko: 텔레비전에서 자와섬의 야생 들소에 관한 다큐멘터리를 했어요.

w|bapak.text: Bapak pulang lebih awal hari ini.
Saya berbicara dengan bapak di telepon.
w|bapak.en: I spoke with father on the phone.

w|barak.text: Para pemain berlatih di bekas barak tentara yang dijadikan studio.
w|barak.en: The actors rehearse in a former army barracks turned into a studio.
w|barak.ko: 배우들은 스튜디오로 바뀐 옛 군 막사에서 연습해요.

w|barak.text: Saat longsor, warga mengungsi sementara ke barak darurat di lapangan.
w|barak.en: During the landslide, residents temporarily evacuated to emergency barracks in the field.
w|barak.ko: 산사태 때 주민들은 운동장의 임시 막사로 잠시 대피했어요.

w|barangkali.text: Guru bilang barangkali ujian akhir akan diundur seminggu.
w|barangkali.en: The teacher said the final exam might be postponed by a week.
w|barangkali.ko: 선생님은 기말시험이 아마 일주일 미뤄질 거라고 했어요.

w|barangkali.text: Pasien di kamar sebelah barangkali bisa pulang besok pagi.
w|barangkali.en: The patient in the next room might be able to go home tomorrow morning.
w|barangkali.ko: 옆 병실 환자는 아마 내일 아침에 퇴원할 수 있을 거예요.

w|barat.en: The wind is blowing from the west.
That city is located in the west.

w|barbar.text: Guru menegur Budi karena menyebut perilaku temannya barbar.
w|barbar.en: The teacher scolded Budi for calling his friend's behavior barbaric.
w|barbar.ko: 선생님은 친구의 행동을 야만적이라고 한 부디를 나무랐어요.

w|barbar.text: Siti menganggap kebiasaan menyerobot antrean itu sungguh barbar.
w|barbar.en: Siti thinks the habit of cutting in line is truly barbaric.
w|barbar.ko: 시티는 새치기하는 버릇이 정말 야만적이라고 생각해요.

w|barbekyu.text: Agus menjual roti burger untuk pesta barbekyu akhir pekan.
w|barbekyu.en: Agus sells burger buns for weekend barbecue parties.
w|barbekyu.ko: 아구스는 주말 바비큐 파티용 햄버거 빵을 팔아요.

w|barbekyu.text: Tim Wati mengadakan barbekyu di atap gedung untuk merayakan pendanaan baru.
w|barbekyu.en: Wati's team held a barbecue on the roof to celebrate their new funding.
w|barbekyu.ko: 와티의 팀은 새 투자 유치를 축하하려고 옥상에서 바비큐를 했어요.

w|barel.text: Andi mencatat ada beberapa barel solar di gudang proyek.
w|barel.en: Andi noted that there were several barrels of diesel in the site storeroom.
w|barel.ko: 안디는 현장 창고에 경유 몇 통이 있다고 적어 뒀어요.

w|barel.text: Dewi bercanda bahwa teman-temannya bisa menghabiskan satu barel teh manis.
w|barel.en: Dewi joked that her friends could finish a whole barrel of sweet tea.
w|barel.ko: 데위는 친구들이 달콤한 차 한 통을 다 마셔 버릴 거라고 농담했어요.

w|bareng.text: Sore itu Agus dan teman-temannya mandi bareng di sungai.
w|bareng.en: That afternoon Agus and his friends bathed together in the river.
w|bareng.ko: 그날 오후 아구스는 친구들과 함께 강에서 멱을 감았어요.

w|bareng.text: Wati dan rekan kerjanya makan siang bareng di belakang apotek.
w|bareng.en: Wati and her coworker eat lunch together at the back of the pharmacy.
w|bareng.ko: 와티는 동료와 약국 뒤에서 함께 점심을 먹어요.

w|barikade.text: Andi membaca sejarah barikade yang dibangun mahasiswa di jalan-jalan kota.
w|barikade.en: Andi read the history of the barricades students built in the city streets.
w|barikade.ko: 안디는 대학생들이 도시 거리에 세운 바리케이드의 역사를 읽었어요.

w|barikade.text: Dewi menumpuk kardus di depan pintu seperti barikade supaya kucingnya tidak kabur.
w|barikade.en: Dewi stacked boxes in front of the door like a barricade so her cat wouldn't run away.
w|barikade.ko: 데위는 고양이가 도망가지 않게 문 앞에 상자를 바리케이드처럼 쌓았어요.

w|baris.en: Please queue in the right line.
The front row is already full.

w|barisan.text: Siswa berdiri di barisan depan lapangan.
w|barisan.en: The students stood in the front row of the field.

w|barisan.text: Barisan panjang membuat mereka menunggu lama.
w|barisan.en: The long line made them wait a long time.
w|barisan.ko: 긴 줄 때문에 그들은 오래 기다렸어.

w|baru-baru.text: Dia baru-baru ini pindah ke kota ini.
w|baru-baru.en: He recently moved to this city.

w|barusan.en: Just now he called from the station.
I saw her just now in the hallway.

w|basa-basi.text: Tanpa banyak basa-basi, Dimas langsung mengajak rombongan ke ruang utama.
w|basa-basi.en: Without much small talk, Dimas took the group straight to the main hall.
w|basa-basi.ko: 디마스는 별다른 인사치레 없이 단체 관람객을 곧장 본관으로 데려갔어요.

w|basa-basi.text: Setelah sedikit basa-basi, pembeli itu langsung menanyakan harga jas.
w|basa-basi.en: After a bit of small talk, the customer went straight to asking the price of the suit.
w|basa-basi.ko: 잠깐 인사말을 나눈 뒤 그 손님은 바로 정장 값을 물었어요.

w|basah.en: My clothes are wet from the heavy rain.
The floor is still wet after cleaning.

w|basi.text: Agus batal membeli kue karena baunya sudah basi.
w|basi.en: Agus decided not to buy the cake because it already smelled stale.
w|basi.ko: 아구스는 케이크에서 쉰 냄새가 나서 사지 않았어요.

w|basi.text: Di musim panas yang lembap, nasi cepat basi kalau Wati lupa menyimpannya.
w|basi.en: In the humid hot season, rice goes off quickly if Wati forgets to store it.
w|basi.ko: 습한 더운 철에는 와티가 밥을 잘 보관하지 않으면 금방 쉬어요.

w|basket.text: Eko meliput final basket antarsekolah untuk halaman olahraga.
w|basket.en: Eko covered the interschool basketball final for the sports page.
w|basket.ko: 에코는 스포츠면에 실을 학교 대항 농구 결승을 취재했어요.

w|basket.text: Anak Ayu menunggu di toko sambil memantulkan bola basket kecil.
w|basket.en: Ayu's child waits at the shop while bouncing a small basketball.
w|basket.ko: 아유 아이는 작은 농구공을 튀기며 가게에서 기다려요.

w|batal.text: Pesta kembang api batal karena angin terlalu kencang.
w|batal.en: The fireworks were cancelled because the wind was too strong.

w|batal.text: Wawancara Rina dengan bupati batal karena jadwalnya berubah mendadak.
w|batal.en: Rina's interview with the regent was cancelled because his schedule changed suddenly.
w|batal.ko: 군수 일정이 갑자기 바뀌어 리나의 인터뷰가 취소됐어요.

w|batalion.text: Saat banjir, satu batalion tentara datang membantu, dan Fajar mengatur tempat posko mereka.
w|batalion.en: During the flood, a battalion of soldiers came to help, and Fajar arranged a place for their post.
w|batalion.ko: 홍수 때 군인 한 대대가 도우러 왔고, 파자르가 그들의 본부 자리를 마련했어요.

w|batalion.text: Lestari bercerita bahwa sepupunya kini bertugas di sebuah batalion di perbatasan.
w|batalion.en: Lestari said her cousin is now stationed with a battalion at the border.
w|batalion.ko: 레스타리는 사촌이 지금 국경의 한 대대에서 복무한다고 했어요.

w|batalyon.text: Untuk mengamankan konser besar di stadion, satu batalyon tambahan dikirim ke kota itu.
w|batalyon.en: To secure the big concert at the stadium, an extra battalion was sent to the city.
w|batalyon.ko: 경기장 대형 콘서트의 안전을 위해 대대 하나가 그 도시에 추가로 보내졌어요.

w|batalyon.text: Dari atas jembatan, barisan pelari berkaus oranye tampak seperti satu batalyon yang sedang berbaris.
w|batalyon.en: From the bridge, the line of runners in orange shirts looked like a battalion on the march.
w|batalyon.ko: 다리 위에서 보니 주황색 티셔츠를 입은 주자들의 줄이 행진하는 대대 같았어요.

w|batang.text: Saat kerja bakti, Andi memotong batang pisang di belakang sekolah.
w|batang.en: During the clean-up day, Andi cut down a banana stem behind the school.
w|batang.ko: 안디는 대청소 날 학교 뒤에서 바나나 줄기를 잘랐어요.

w|batang.text: Dokter meminta pasien itu berhenti merokok meski hanya satu batang sehari.
w|batang.en: The doctor asked the patient to stop smoking, even if just one cigarette a day.
w|batang.ko: 의사는 그 환자에게 하루 한 개비라도 담배를 끊으라고 했어요.

w|batas.en: The national border is tightly guarded.

w|batasan.text: Ibu meminta Budi dan Rina membuat batasan soal barang pribadi.
w|batasan.en: Mom asked Budi and Rina to set boundaries about personal belongings.
w|batasan.ko: 엄마는 부디와 리나에게 개인 물건에 대한 선을 정하라고 했어요.

w|batasan.text: Pemilik rumah memberi batasan soal memaku dinding.
w|batasan.en: The landlord set limits on nailing things to the walls.
w|batasan.ko: 집주인은 벽에 못 박는 것에 제한을 뒀어요.

w|baterai.en: His phone battery is almost empty.

w|baterai.text: Ganti baterai senter sebelum malam tiba.
w|baterai.en: Replace the flashlight battery before night falls.
w|baterai.ko: 밤이 되기 전에 손전등 배터리를 갈아.

w|batin.text: Dalam surat panjang itu, Budi menceritakan pergulatan batin selama merantau.
w|batin.en: In that long letter, Budi described his inner struggles while living away from home.
w|batin.ko: 그 긴 편지에서 부디는 타지살이 동안 겪은 마음속 갈등을 털어놨어요.

w|batin.text: Siti merasa tertekan batin karena tetangga terus memutar musik keras.
w|batin.en: Siti feels mentally worn down because the neighbor keeps playing loud music.
w|batin.ko: 이웃이 계속 음악을 크게 틀어서 시티는 속이 많이 상해요.

w|batu.en: There's a big rock on the road.

w|batu bara.text: Agus bercerita bahwa desa di kaki gunung dulu punya tambang batu bara.
w|batu bara.en: Agus said that the village at the foot of the mountain used to have a coal mine.
w|batu bara.ko: 아구스는 산기슭 마을에 예전에 탄광이 있었다고 이야기했어요.

w|batu bara.text: Wati bercerita bahwa kota kecil tempat dia lahir dulu hidup dari tambang batu bara.
w|batu bara.en: Wati wrote that the small town where she was born used to live off coal mining.
w|batu bara.ko: 와티는 자기가 태어난 작은 도시가 예전에 탄광으로 먹고살았다고 적었어요.

w|batuan.text: Di pinggir ladang Budi ada lapisan batuan kapur yang keras.
w|batuan.en: At the edge of Budi's field there is a layer of hard limestone rock.
w|batuan.ko: 부디의 밭 가장자리에는 단단한 석회암 층이 있어요.

w|batuan.text: Siti memanggang roti pipih di atas lempengan batuan vulkanik yang panas.
w|batuan.en: Siti bakes flatbread on a hot slab of volcanic rock.
w|batuan.ko: 시티는 뜨거운 화산암 판 위에서 납작한 빵을 구워요.

w|batuk.text: Pasien di kursi sebelah terus batuk selama diperiksa.
w|batuk.en: The patient in the next chair kept coughing during the check-up.
w|batuk.ko: 옆 의자 환자는 진료 내내 기침을 했어요.

w|batuk.text: Wati terus batuk setiap kali menyapu loteng yang berdebu.
w|batuk.en: Wati keeps coughing every time she sweeps the dusty attic.
w|batuk.ko: 와티는 먼지 쌓인 다락방을 쓸 때마다 계속 기침을 해요.

w|baut.text: Agus mengencangkan baut rak buku yang mulai goyang.
w|baut.en: Agus tightened the bolts on the bookshelf that had started to wobble.
w|baut.ko: 아구스는 흔들리기 시작한 책장의 볼트를 조였어요.

w|baut.text: Wati mengencangkan baut meja yang goyang di pojok ruangan.
w|baut.en: Wati tightened the bolts on the wobbly table in the corner.
w|baut.ko: 와티는 구석에 있는 흔들리는 탁자의 볼트를 조였어요.

w|bawaan.text: Bagasi mobil Bayu penuh dengan barang bawaan teman-temannya.
w|bawaan.en: The trunk of Bayu's car was full of his friends' luggage.
w|bawaan.ko: 바유의 차 트렁크는 친구들의 짐으로 가득 찼어요.

w|bawaan.text: Bakat menggambar itu tampaknya bawaan dari ibu Intan.
w|bawaan.en: That drawing talent seems to have come from Intan's mother.
w|bawaan.ko: 그 그림 재능은 인탄의 어머니에게서 물려받은 것 같아요.

w|bawah.en: The key is under the table.

w|bawahan.text: Pemimpin redaksi itu dikenal adil kepada semua bawahan.
w|bawahan.en: The editor-in-chief is known for being fair to all his subordinates.
w|bawahan.ko: 그 편집장은 부하 직원 모두에게 공정하기로 유명해요.

w|bawahan.text: Siti kini punya dua bawahan yang mengurus bagian buku digital.
w|bawahan.en: Siti now has two subordinates who handle the digital books section.
w|bawahan.ko: 시티는 이제 전자책 부서를 맡은 부하 직원이 둘 있어요.

w|bawang.text: Fajar menggoreng bawang merah untuk taburan roti abon.
w|bawang.en: Fajar fried shallots to sprinkle on the shredded-beef bread.
w|bawang.ko: 파자르는 고기 플로스 빵 위에 뿌릴 샬롯을 튀겼어요.

w|bawang.text: Ibu Lestari menumis brokoli dengan bawang putih untuk makan malam.
w|bawang.en: Lestari's mother stir-fried broccoli with garlic for dinner.
w|bawang.ko: 레스타리의 어머니는 저녁으로 브로콜리를 마늘과 함께 볶았어요.

w|bayang.text: Budi melihat bayang seekor kucing melintas di balik tirai ruang periksa.
w|bayang.en: Budi saw the shadow of a cat passing behind the exam room curtain.
w|bayang.ko: 부디는 진료실 커튼 뒤로 고양이 그림자가 지나가는 걸 봤어요.

w|bayang.text: Siti memandangi bayang gunung yang terpantul di permukaan danau.
w|bayang.en: Siti gazed at the mountain's reflection on the surface of the lake.
w|bayang.ko: 시티는 호수 위에 비친 산 그림자를 바라봤어요.

w|bayangan.text: Bayangan pohon memanjang di sore hari.
w|bayangan.en: The tree's shadow stretches in the afternoon.

w|bayangan.text: Dia takut pada bayangan di dinding.
w|bayangan.en: She is afraid of the shadow on the wall.

w|bayaran.text: Bayaran untuk pekerjaan ini cukup adil.
w|bayaran.en: The pay for this job is fair enough.

w|bayaran.text: Dia menerima bayaran di akhir minggu.
w|bayaran.en: He receives his pay at the end of the week.

w|beasiswa.text: Rekan kerja Fajar menabung untuk sekolah masak karena tidak mendapat beasiswa.
w|beasiswa.en: Fajar's coworker is saving up for cooking school because he didn't get a scholarship.
w|beasiswa.ko: 파자르의 동료는 장학금을 못 받아서 요리 학교 갈 돈을 모으고 있어요.

w|beasiswa.text: Sambil menjaga lapak, Lestari bercerita tentang beasiswa yang membawanya kuliah di kota.
w|beasiswa.en: While minding her stall, Lestari talked about the scholarship that took her to university in the city.
w|beasiswa.ko: 노점을 보면서 레스타리는 도시에서 대학을 다니게 해 준 장학금 이야기를 했어요.

w|beban.text: Tanggung jawab itu menjadi beban berat.
w|beban.en: That responsibility became a heavy burden.
The load on his back feels painful.

w|bebas.text: Bebas memilih adalah hak setiap orang.
w|bebas.en: Freedom to choose is everyone's right.

w|bebatuan.text: Rudi melompati bebatuan besar di sungai yang licin karena lumut.
w|bebatuan.en: Rudi jumped across the big rocks in the river, slippery with moss.
w|bebatuan.ko: 루디는 이끼 때문에 미끄러운 강의 큰 바위들을 건너뛰었어요.

w|bebatuan.text: Panggung terbuka itu berdiri di antara bebatuan besar di tepi danau.
w|bebatuan.en: The open-air stage stood among big rocks at the edge of the lake.
w|bebatuan.ko: 그 야외 무대는 호숫가의 큰 바위들 사이에 세워져 있었어요.

w|bebek.text: Setiap pagi Dimas memberi makan bebek di kandang dekat kolam.
w|bebek.en: Every morning Dimas feeds the ducks in the pen near the pond.
w|bebek.ko: 디마스는 매일 아침 연못 옆 우리에서 오리에게 먹이를 줘요.

w|bebek.text: Di pasar, Putri membeli bebek panggang untuk makan malam.
w|bebek.en: At the market, Putri bought roast duck for dinner.
w|bebek.ko: 시장에서 푸트리는 저녁으로 먹을 오리구이를 샀어요.

w|beberapa.en: There are a few people out front.

w|beda.ko: 그 문제에 대해 우리 생각이 달라.

w|beda.en: It's a slim difference, but still important.

w|bedah.text: Dokter akan melakukan bedah pagi ini.
w|bedah.en: The doctor will perform surgery this morning.
w|bedah.ko: 의사가 오늘 아침 수술을 할 거야.

w|bedah.text: Bedah plastik membutuhkan waktu pemulihan panjang.
w|bedah.en: Plastic surgery needs a long recovery time.

w|begini.en: Why did you say it like this?

w|begitu.en: How did it end up like that?

w|bekas.text: Bekas luka itu masih terlihat di lengannya.
w|bekas.en: That scar is still visible on his arm.

w|bekas.text: Dia membeli mobil bekas yang masih bagus.
w|bekas.en: He bought a used car that is still good.

w|bekerjasama.text: Kontraktor itu bekerjasama dengan pemerintah daerah untuk membangun pasar baru.
w|bekerjasama.en: The contractor is working together with the local government to build a new market.
w|bekerjasama.ko: 그 시공사는 지방 정부와 손잡고 새 시장을 짓고 있어요.

w|bekerjasama.text: Tim Rina bekerjasama dengan universitas untuk riset baterai.
w|bekerjasama.en: Rina's team works together with a university on battery research.
w|bekerjasama.ko: 리나의 팀은 대학과 함께 배터리 연구를 해요.

w|bel.text: Bel pintu berbunyi saat tamu datang.
w|bel.en: The doorbell rang when guests arrived.

w|bel.text: Siswa masuk kelas setelah bel istirahat.
w|bel.en: Students entered class after the break bell.
w|bel.ko: 쉬는 시간 종이 친 뒤 학생들이 교실에 들어갔어.

w|bela.text: Teman-teman sekelas membela Budi waktu dia dituduh menyontek.
w|bela.en: His classmates defended Budi when he was accused of cheating.
w|bela.ko: 부디가 커닝했다는 의심을 받았을 때 반 친구들이 부디 편을 들어 줬어요.

w|bela.text: Siti membela adiknya yang disalahkan karena memecahkan vas.
w|bela.en: Siti stood up for her younger sibling, who was blamed for breaking the vase.
w|bela.ko: 꽃병을 깼다고 혼나는 동생을 시티가 감싸 줬어요.

w|belahan.text: Koran itu punya koresponden di berbagai belahan dunia.
w|belahan.en: The newspaper has correspondents in various parts of the world.
w|belahan.ko: 그 신문사는 세계 곳곳에 특파원이 있어요.

w|belahan.text: Pengguna aplikasi itu datang dari berbagai belahan Indonesia.
w|belahan.en: The app's users come from all parts of Indonesia.
w|belahan.ko: 그 앱의 사용자는 인도네시아 곳곳에서 와요.

w|belaka.text: Fajar bilang janjinya kepada calon mertua bukan omong kosong belaka.
w|belaka.en: Fajar said his promise to his future in-laws was not mere empty talk.
w|belaka.ko: 파자르는 예비 처가에 한 약속이 그냥 빈말이 아니라고 했어요.

w|belaka.text: Lestari menegaskan bahwa berita itu fakta, bukan gosip belaka.
w|belaka.en: Lestari stressed that the story was fact, not mere gossip.
w|belaka.ko: 레스타리는 그 기사가 단순한 소문이 아니라 사실이라고 강조했어요.

w|belakangan.text: Belakangan ini dia jarang muncul di kantor.
w|belakangan.en: Lately he rarely shows up at the office.
w|belakangan.ko: 요즘 그는 사무실에 잘 안 나타나.

w|belakangan.en: The recent heat has been really annoying.

w|belalang.text: Budi mengusir kawanan belalang yang mulai memakan daun padi.
w|belalang.en: Budi chased away a swarm of grasshoppers that had started eating the rice leaves.
w|belalang.ko: 부디는 벼 잎을 먹기 시작한 메뚜기 떼를 쫓아냈어요.

w|belalang.text: Koki tamu itu menawarkan belalang goreng sebagai camilan, dan Siti berani mencobanya.
w|belalang.en: The guest chef offered fried grasshoppers as a snack, and Siti dared to try them.
w|belalang.ko: 그 초청 셰프가 메뚜기 튀김을 간식으로 내놓았고, 시티는 용감하게 먹어 봤어요.

w|belanja.text: Dia pergi belanja kebutuhan rumah tangga.
w|belanja.en: She went shopping for household needs.

w|belanja.text: Belanja online membuat hidupnya lebih praktis.
w|belanja.en: Online shopping made her life more practical.
w|belanja.ko: 온라인 쇼핑이 생활을 더 편하게 만들었어.

w|belas.text: Belas kasihnya menyentuh hati banyak orang.
w|belas.en: His compassion touched many people's hearts.
w|belas.ko: 그의 연민이 많은 이의 마음을 울렸어.

w|belas.text: Dia bertindak dengan belas kepada yang lemah.
w|belas.en: She acted with compassion toward the weak.
w|belas.ko: 그는 약한 이들에게 연민을 갖고 행동했어.

w|belati.text: Di museum sekolah dipajang sebuah belati kuno peninggalan kerajaan.
w|belati.en: An ancient dagger from the kingdom era is displayed in the school museum.
w|belati.ko: 학교 박물관에는 왕국 시대의 옛 단검이 전시돼 있어요.

w|belati.text: Guru seni yang hadir dulu pernah mengajari mereka mengukir gagang belati dari kayu.
w|belati.en: The art teacher who attended once taught them to carve a wooden dagger handle.
w|belati.ko: 참석한 미술 선생님은 예전에 그들에게 나무로 단검 손잡이 깎는 법을 가르쳤어요.

w|belerang.text: Dari kawah di atas desa tercium bau belerang yang menyengat.
w|belerang.en: A pungent smell of sulfur drifts from the crater above the village.
w|belerang.ko: 마을 위 분화구에서 코를 찌르는 유황 냄새가 나요.

w|belerang.text: Pabrik pupuk itu membeli belerang dari tambang di daerah gunung api.
w|belerang.en: That fertilizer plant buys sulfur from mines in volcanic areas.
w|belerang.ko: 그 비료 공장은 화산 지대 광산에서 유황을 사요.

w|beliau.text: Kami menghormati beliau sebagai guru besar.
w|beliau.en: We respect him as a senior professor.

w|belok.en: Turn left after the small bridge.

w|belok.text: Mobil itu belok ke jalan sempit.
w|belok.en: That car turned onto a narrow street.

w|benang.text: Bayu menjahit kancing kemejanya dengan benang yang dipinjam dari tetangga.
w|benang.en: Bayu sewed on his shirt button with thread borrowed from a neighbor.
w|benang.ko: 바유는 이웃에게 빌린 실로 셔츠 단추를 달았어요.

w|benang.text: Intan menghabiskan waktu dengan merajut benang wol menjadi syal.
w|benang.en: Intan passed the time by knitting wool yarn into a scarf.
w|benang.ko: 인탄은 털실로 목도리를 뜨며 시간을 보냈어요.

w|bencana.en: The natural disaster destroyed several villages.

w|bencana.text: Warga bersiap menghadapi bencana musim hujan.

w|benci.en: I hate waiting a long time.

w|benci.text: Benci saja tidak akan mengubah apa-apa.

w|bendera.en: The flag was raised in the school yard.

w|bendera.text: Mereka menghormati bendera sebelum upacara dimulai.
w|bendera.en: They honored the flag before the ceremony began.
w|bendera.ko: 그들은 의식이 시작되기 전에 국기에 경례했어.

w|bendungan.text: Perkemahan Eko berada tidak jauh dari bendungan tua peninggalan zaman Belanda.
w|bendungan.en: Eko's campsite is not far from an old dam from the colonial era.
w|bendungan.ko: 에코의 캠프장은 식민지 시절에 지은 낡은 댐에서 멀지 않아요.

w|bendungan.text: Separuh rute maraton itu melintasi jalan di atas bendungan besar.
w|bendungan.en: Half of that marathon route crosses the road on top of a big dam.
w|bendungan.ko: 그 마라톤 코스의 절반은 큰 댐 위의 도로를 지나요.

w|bengkel.text: Mesin jahit yang rusak dibawa ke bengkel di sudut pabrik.
w|bengkel.en: The broken sewing machine was taken to the workshop in the corner of the factory.
w|bengkel.ko: 고장 난 재봉틀은 공장 구석의 작업장으로 옮겨졌어요.

w|bengkel.text: Ayah Sari dulu punya bengkel sepeda di ujung gang.
w|bengkel.en: Sari's father used to have a bicycle repair shop at the end of the alley.
w|bengkel.ko: 사리의 아버지는 예전에 골목 끝에 자전거 수리점을 했어요.

w|bengkok.text: Andi meluruskan sampul buku yang bengkok sebelum mengembalikannya.
w|bengkok.en: Andi straightened the bent book cover before returning it.
w|bengkok.ko: 안디는 책을 반납하기 전에 휘어진 표지를 폈어요.

w|bengkok.text: Salah satu kaki meja Dewi bengkok setelah diangkut ke truk.
w|bengkok.en: One of Dewi's table legs got bent after being loaded onto the truck.
w|bengkok.ko: 트럭에 실으면서 데위의 탁자 다리 하나가 휘었어요.

w|benih.text: Kelompok pecinta lingkungan mengajak Eko menanam benih bakau di pantai.
w|benih.en: An environmental group invited Eko to plant mangrove seedlings on the beach.
w|benih.ko: 환경 단체가 에코에게 해변에 맹그로브 묘목을 심자고 했어요.

w|benih.text: Ayu dan Bu Sri saling bertukar benih sayuran setiap musim hujan.
w|benih.en: Ayu and Mrs. Sri swap vegetable seeds every rainy season.
w|benih.ko: 아유와 스리 아주머니는 우기마다 채소 씨앗을 서로 바꿔요.

w|benjolan.text: Dokter meminta Budi menjadwalkan USG untuk benjolan di leher pasien.
w|benjolan.en: The doctor asked Budi to schedule an ultrasound for the lump on the patient's neck.
w|benjolan.ko: 의사는 부디에게 환자 목에 있는 혹을 초음파로 검사하도록 일정을 잡으라고 했어요.

w|benjolan.text: Siti panik karena ada benjolan di dahi setelah terbentur rak bagasi.
w|benjolan.en: Siti panicked when a bump appeared on her forehead after hitting the overhead bin.
w|benjolan.ko: 시티는 짐칸에 머리를 부딪친 뒤 이마에 혹이 나서 당황했어요.

w|bensin.en: The gasoline in the tank is almost gone.

w|bensin.text: Dia mengisi bensin sebelum perjalanan jauh.
w|bensin.en: He fills up on gas before a long trip.
w|bensin.ko: 그는 먼 길 전에 휘발유를 채워.

w|benteng.text: Benteng kuno berdiri di atas bukit.
w|benteng.en: The ancient fortress stands on the hill.
w|benteng.ko: 고대 요새가 언덕 위에 서 있어.

w|benteng.en: The enemy failed to capture that fortress.
w|benteng.ko: 적이 그 요새를 점령하는 데 실패했어.

w|bentuk.en: Change the shape of the letters.

w|benturan.text: Ada bekas benturan di sudut radio tua yang dibeli Agus.
w|benturan.en: There's a dent from a knock on the corner of the old radio Agus bought.
w|benturan.ko: 아구스가 산 낡은 라디오 모서리에 부딪힌 자국이 있어요.

w|benturan.text: Wati mendengar suara benturan keras ketika dahan jatuh menimpa atap.
w|benturan.en: Wati heard a loud crash when a branch fell onto the roof.
w|benturan.ko: 나뭇가지가 지붕에 떨어지자 와티는 큰 부딪힘 소리를 들었어요.

w|benua.text: Agus membaca bahwa burung itu terbang dari benua lain setiap musim dingin.
w|benua.en: Agus read that the bird flies in from another continent every winter.
w|benua.ko: 아구스는 그 새가 겨울마다 다른 대륙에서 날아온다는 걸 읽었어요.

w|benua.text: Wati pernah membaca bahwa obat kina dulu dibawa ke benua Eropa dari Amerika Selatan.
w|benua.en: Wati once read that quinine was brought to Europe from South America long ago.
w|benua.ko: 와티는 예전에 키니네가 남미에서 유럽 대륙으로 전해졌다는 걸 읽었어요.

w|bepergian.text: Mereka sering bepergian ke luar kota.
w|bepergian.en: They often travel out of town.
Traveling alone gave her a lot of experience.

w|berabad-abad.text: Konon gedung itu dibangun di atas tanah yang berabad-abad lalu adalah kebun raja.
w|berabad-abad.en: Supposedly the building was built on land that centuries ago was the king's garden.
w|berabad-abad.ko: 그 건물은 수백 년 전에 왕의 정원이던 땅 위에 지어졌다고 해요.

w|berabad-abad.text: Kota-kota kecil yang dilewati kereta Intan sudah berdiri berabad-abad.
w|berabad-abad.en: The small towns Intan's train passes through have stood for centuries.
w|berabad-abad.ko: 인탄이 탄 기차가 지나는 작은 도시들은 수백 년 동안 그 자리에 있었어요.

w|beracun.text: Jamur beracun itu berbahaya jika dimakan.
w|beracun.en: That poisonous mushroom is dangerous if eaten.

w|beracun.text: Beracun atau tidak, sampel harus diuji dulu.
w|beracun.en: Poisonous or not, the sample must be tested first.
w|beracun.ko: 독성이 있든 없든 시료는 먼저 검사해야 해.

w|beradab.text: Menurut Eko, turis yang beradab tidak meninggalkan sampah di pantai.
w|beradab.en: According to Eko, civilized tourists don't leave rubbish on the beach.
w|beradab.ko: 에코는 교양 있는 관광객이라면 해변에 쓰레기를 남기지 않는다고 생각해요.

w|beradab.text: Menurut Ayu, mengantre dengan tertib adalah tanda masyarakat yang beradab.
w|beradab.en: In Ayu's view, queuing in an orderly way is a sign of a civilized society.
w|beradab.ko: 아유는 질서 있게 줄 서는 것이 교양 있는 사회의 표시라고 생각해요.

w|beradaptasi.text: Koki baru dari kota lain butuh waktu untuk beradaptasi dengan dapur yang sempit.
w|beradaptasi.en: The new cook from another city needs time to adapt to the cramped kitchen.
w|beradaptasi.ko: 다른 도시에서 온 새 요리사는 좁은 주방에 적응할 시간이 필요해요.

w|beradaptasi.text: Lestari harus beradaptasi dengan pembeli muda yang suka menawar lewat pesan.
w|beradaptasi.en: Lestari has to adapt to young buyers who like to haggle by message.
w|beradaptasi.ko: 레스타리는 메시지로 흥정하기 좋아하는 젊은 손님들에게 적응해야 해요.

w|beragam.text: Rudi suka meracik beragam sambal dari berbagai daerah.
w|beragam.en: Rudi likes making all kinds of sambal from different regions.
w|beragam.ko: 루디는 여러 지역의 다양한 삼발을 만드는 걸 좋아해요.

w|beragam.text: Lapak Rina menjual beragam barang, dari lampu tua sampai kamera film.
w|beragam.en: Rina's stall sells all sorts of things, from old lamps to film cameras.
w|beragam.ko: 리나의 노점은 옛날 램프부터 필름 카메라까지 온갖 물건을 팔아요.

w|beragama.text: Pameran itu menceritakan warga yang beragama berbeda tetapi merayakan panen bersama.
w|beragama.en: The exhibition tells of residents of different religions who celebrated the harvest together.
w|beragama.ko: 그 전시는 종교가 다른 주민들이 함께 추수를 축하한 이야기를 들려줘요.

w|beragama.text: Pegawai toko yang beragama berbeda-beda saling menggantikan sif saat hari raya.
w|beragama.en: Store staff of different religions cover each other's shifts on holidays.
w|beragama.ko: 종교가 서로 다른 매장 직원들은 명절에 서로 근무를 바꿔 줘요.

w|berakibat.text: Menurut Agus, menawar terlalu rendah bisa berakibat penjual tersinggung.
w|berakibat.en: According to Agus, bargaining too low can end up offending the seller.
w|berakibat.ko: 아구스에 따르면 값을 너무 깎으면 장수가 기분 상할 수 있어요.

w|berakibat.text: Kemarau panjang tahun ini berakibat harga cabai melonjak, kata Wati.
w|berakibat.en: This year's long drought led to chili prices soaring, Wati said.
w|berakibat.ko: 올해 긴 가뭄 때문에 고춧값이 치솟았다고 와티가 말했어요.

w|beraksi.text: Klub teater sekolah akan beraksi di panggung aula hari Sabtu.
w|beraksi.en: The school drama club will perform on the hall stage on Saturday.
w|beraksi.ko: 학교 연극부가 토요일에 강당 무대에서 공연해요.

w|beraksi.text: Keponakan Ayu beraksi seperti pahlawan super dengan selimut di punggungnya.
w|beraksi.en: Ayu's nephew struck poses like a superhero with a blanket on his back.
w|beraksi.ko: 아유의 조카는 등에 담요를 두르고 슈퍼히어로처럼 폼을 잡았어요.

w|berakting.text: Adik Fajar yang suka berakting membuat video lucu untuk promosi toko.
w|berakting.en: Fajar's younger brother, who loves acting, made funny videos to promote the shop.
w|berakting.ko: 연기를 좋아하는 파자르의 동생은 가게 홍보용으로 웃긴 영상을 찍었어요.

w|berakting.text: Teman Lestari yang dulu berakting di teater sekarang jadi pembawa acara lomba.
w|berakting.en: Lestari's friend who used to act in theater is now the race's emcee.
w|berakting.ko: 예전에 연극을 했던 레스타리의 친구는 지금 대회 사회자예요.

w|beralasan.text: Pemilik anjing itu beralasan tidak sempat datang karena macet.
w|beralasan.en: The dog's owner gave traffic as the reason for not making it.
w|beralasan.ko: 그 개 주인은 차가 막혀서 못 왔다고 핑계를 댔어요.

w|beralasan.text: Siti menolak pindah ke kota, beralasan udara gunung lebih sehat untuk anaknya.
w|beralasan.en: Siti refused to move to the city, reasoning that the mountain air is healthier for her child.
w|beralasan.ko: 시티는 산 공기가 아이에게 더 좋다며 도시로 이사하기를 거절했어요.

w|beralih.text: Banyak layanan di balai kota sudah beralih ke sistem daring.
w|beralih.en: Many services at city hall have switched to an online system.

w|beralih.text: Wati awalnya belajar gitar, lalu beralih ke biola.
w|beralih.en: Wati first learned guitar, then switched to violin.
w|beralih.ko: 와티는 처음엔 기타를 배우다가 바이올린으로 바꿨어요.

w|berambut.text: Petugas loket yang berambut putih itu sudah bekerja di balai kota selama puluhan tahun.
w|berambut.en: The white-haired clerk at the counter has worked at city hall for decades.
w|berambut.ko: 그 창구의 백발 직원은 시청에서 수십 년 동안 일했어요.

w|berambut.text: Guru biola Wati adalah seorang perempuan berambut keriting yang sangat sabar.
w|berambut.en: Wati's violin teacher is a curly-haired woman who is very patient.
w|berambut.ko: 와티의 바이올린 선생님은 곱슬머리에 아주 참을성 있는 분이에요.

w|berandal.text: Dulu sekelompok berandal sering nongkrong di pos ronda dekat rumah Andi.
w|berandal.en: A gang of hooligans used to hang out at the night-watch post near Andi's house.
w|berandal.ko: 예전에는 불량배 무리가 안디네 집 근처 야경 초소에 자주 모여 있었어요.

w|berandal.text: Dewi melihat lukisan tentang berandal pelabuhan yang kemudian menjadi pahlawan.
w|berandal.en: Dewi saw a painting about a harbor hooligan who later became a hero.
w|berandal.ko: 데위는 나중에 영웅이 된 항구의 불량배를 그린 그림을 봤어요.

w|berandalan.text: Dulu Fajar dianggap berandalan di kampungnya, tapi sekarang ia guru yang dihormati.
w|berandalan.en: Fajar used to be considered a delinquent in his village, but now he's a respected teacher.
w|berandalan.ko: 예전에 파자르는 동네에서 불량배로 여겨졌지만 지금은 존경받는 선생님이에요.

w|berandalan.text: Lestari menulis laporan tentang anak-anak berandalan yang kini aktif di sanggar musik.
w|berandalan.en: Lestari wrote a report about former delinquent kids who are now active in a music studio.
w|berandalan.ko: 레스타리는 한때 불량했던 아이들이 이제 음악 교실에서 활동하는 이야기를 기사로 썼어요.

w|beranggapan.text: Banyak murid beranggapan pelajaran kimia itu sulit, padahal Andi menyukainya.
w|beranggapan.en: Many students assume chemistry is hard, but Andi likes it.
w|beranggapan.ko: 많은 학생들이 화학은 어렵다고 여기지만 안디는 화학을 좋아해요.

w|beranggapan.text: Nenek beranggapan tahun baru harus dirayakan bersama keluarga besar.
w|beranggapan.en: Grandma believes the new year must be celebrated with the extended family.
w|beranggapan.ko: 할머니는 새해는 온 집안이 함께 보내야 한다고 생각하세요.

w|beranjak.text: Agus enggan beranjak dari sofa karena hujan deras di luar.
w|beranjak.en: Agus was reluctant to get up from the sofa because of the heavy rain outside.
w|beranjak.ko: 밖에 비가 세차게 와서 아구스는 소파에서 일어나기 싫었어요.

w|beranjak.text: Pagi yang dingin membuat Wati malas beranjak dari tempat tidur.
w|beranjak.en: The cold morning made Wati reluctant to get out of bed.
w|beranjak.ko: 추운 아침이라 와티는 침대에서 일어나기 싫었어요.

w|berantakan.en: His room was messy after the small party.

w|berantakan.text: Meja kerja itu terlihat berantakan sekali.

w|berantem.text: Dua ekor kambing Budi berantem lagi di dekat pagar.
w|berantem.en: Two of Budi's goats were fighting again near the fence.
w|berantem.ko: 부디네 염소 두 마리가 울타리 옆에서 또 싸웠어요.

w|berantem.text: Dua juru masak berantem soal resep sambal, lalu Siti menengahi mereka.
w|berantem.en: Two cooks squabbled over a sambal recipe, and then Siti stepped in between them.
w|berantem.ko: 요리사 두 명이 삼발 조리법을 두고 다퉈서 시티가 말렸어요.

w|berarti.en: His silence doesn't mean he's angry.

w|beras.text: Selain tepung, Fajar juga memakai tepung beras untuk kue tradisional.
w|beras.en: Besides wheat flour, Fajar also uses rice flour for traditional cakes.
w|beras.ko: 파자르는 밀가루 말고도 전통 과자에 쌀가루를 써요.

w|beras.text: Ayah Lestari membawa sekarung beras dari kampung untuk anaknya.
w|beras.en: Lestari's father brought a sack of rice from the village for his daughter.
w|beras.ko: 레스타리의 아버지는 딸을 위해 고향에서 쌀 한 포대를 가져왔어요.

w|berasa.text: Kuah ini belum berasa, kata Eko sambil menambahkan garam.
w|berasa.en: This broth has no flavor yet, Eko said as he added salt.
w|berasa.ko: 에코는 국물이 아직 싱겁다며 소금을 넣었어요.

w|berasa.text: Pagi-pagi Ayu bilang angin mulai berasa dingin, tanda musim berganti.
w|berasa.en: Early in the morning Ayu said the wind was starting to feel cold, a sign the season was changing.
w|berasa.ko: 아유는 아침 일찍 바람이 차가워지기 시작했다며 계절이 바뀌는 신호라고 했어요.

w|berasumsi.text: Budi berasumsi hujan akan turun minggu ini karena langit sudah mendung.
w|berasumsi.en: Budi assumed it would rain this week because the sky was already cloudy.
w|berasumsi.ko: 하늘이 벌써 흐려서 부디는 이번 주에 비가 올 거라고 생각했어요.

w|berasumsi.text: Kru berasumsi lampu cadangan sudah dibawa, ternyata tertinggal di gudang.
w|berasumsi.en: The crew assumed the spare lights had been brought, but they were left in the storeroom.
w|berasumsi.ko: 제작진은 예비 조명을 가져온 줄 알았는데 창고에 두고 왔어요.

w|berawal.text: Kecintaan Eko pada laut berawal dari liburan masa kecil di desa nelayan ini.
w|berawal.en: Eko's love of the sea began with childhood holidays in this fishing village.
w|berawal.ko: 에코의 바다 사랑은 어린 시절 이 어촌에서 보낸 방학에서 시작됐어요.

w|berawal.text: Sakit gigi Ayu berawal dari kebiasaan makan permen sebelum tidur.
w|berawal.en: Ayu's toothache started from her habit of eating sweets before bed.
w|berawal.ko: 아유의 치통은 자기 전에 사탕을 먹는 습관에서 시작됐어요.

w|berayun.text: Lampu gantung di apotek Dimas berayun saat terjadi gempa kecil.
w|berayun.en: The hanging lamp in Dimas's pharmacy swung during a small earthquake.
w|berayun.ko: 작은 지진이 났을 때 디마스네 약국의 매달린 등이 흔들렸어요.

w|berayun.text: Pintu pagar tua itu berayun sambil berderit, jadi Putri meminyaki engsel.
w|berayun.en: The old gate swung and creaked, so Putri oiled the hinges.
w|berayun.ko: 낡은 대문이 삐걱거리며 흔들려서 푸트리는 경첩에 기름을 쳤어요.

w|berbagai.en: Various options are available on the menu.

w|berbagai.text: Dia mencoba berbagai cara untuk belajar.
w|berbagai.en: She tried various ways to study.

w|berbagi.en: Let's share food with the neighbors.

w|berbagi.text: Berbagi cerita membuat kami lebih dekat.

w|berbahagia.text: Budi ikut berbahagia atas kelahiran anak pertama Andi.
w|berbahagia.en: Budi shares in the happiness over the birth of Andi's first child.
w|berbahagia.ko: 부디는 안디의 첫아이 출생을 함께 기뻐해요.

w|berbahagia.text: Keluarga Siti berbahagia melihat medali pertamanya.
w|berbahagia.en: Siti's family was happy to see her first medal.
w|berbahagia.ko: 시티 가족은 그녀의 첫 메달을 보고 행복해했어요.

w|berbahasa.text: Sekolah Andi mewajibkan siswa berbahasa Inggris setiap hari Jumat.
w|berbahasa.en: Andi's school requires students to speak English every Friday.
w|berbahasa.ko: 안디의 학교는 금요일마다 학생들에게 영어로 말하게 해요.

w|berbahasa.text: Dewi sering membantu pasien asing yang tidak bisa berbahasa Indonesia.
w|berbahasa.en: Dewi often helps foreign patients who can't speak Indonesian.
w|berbahasa.ko: 데위는 인도네시아어를 못 하는 외국인 환자들을 자주 도와줘요.

w|berbahaya.en: It's so dangerous to play here.

w|berbaikan.text: Setelah salah paham soal laporan, Bayu dan rekan kerja akhirnya berbaikan.
w|berbaikan.en: After a misunderstanding over a report, Bayu and his coworker finally made up.
w|berbaikan.ko: 보고서 때문에 오해가 생긴 뒤 바유와 동료는 결국 화해했어요.

w|berbaikan.text: Intan dan pelatih lama akhirnya berbaikan setelah lama tidak saling sapa.
w|berbaikan.en: Intan and her old trainer finally made up after not speaking for a long time.
w|berbaikan.ko: 인탄과 예전 트레이너는 오랫동안 말도 안 하다가 결국 화해했어요.

w|berbaju.text: Pada upacara hari Senin, semua pegawai berbaju putih, termasuk Fajar.
w|berbaju.en: At the Monday ceremony, all the staff wore white shirts, including Fajar.
w|berbaju.ko: 월요일 조회 때 파자르를 포함한 모든 직원이 흰 옷을 입었어요.

w|berbaju.text: Seorang kurir berbaju oranye menunggu Lestari di depan lift.
w|berbaju.en: A courier in an orange shirt was waiting for Lestari in front of the elevator.
w|berbaju.ko: 주황색 옷을 입은 택배 기사가 엘리베이터 앞에서 레스타리를 기다렸어요.

w|berbakat.en: That child is talented in music.

w|berbakat.text: Berbakat saja tidak cukup tanpa latihan.
w|berbakat.en: Being talented alone is not enough without practice.

w|berbalik.en: The situation can reverse at any time.

w|berbaring.text: Dia berbaring di sofa setelah bekerja.
w|berbaring.en: He lay on the sofa after work.

w|berbaring.text: Pasien diminta berbaring di tempat tidur.
w|berbaring.en: The patient was asked to lie on the bed.

w|berbaris.text: Anak-anak sekolah berbaris di depan pintu museum sambil menunggu pemandu.
w|berbaris.en: Schoolchildren lined up in front of the museum entrance while waiting for the guide.
w|berbaris.ko: 학생들이 박물관 입구 앞에 줄을 서서 안내원을 기다렸어요.

w|berbaris.text: Pagi-pagi, para pembeli sudah berbaris di depan kios tahu yang terkenal itu.
w|berbaris.en: Early in the morning, shoppers were already lined up in front of the famous tofu stall.
w|berbaris.ko: 아침 일찍부터 그 유명한 두부 가게 앞에는 손님들이 줄을 섰어요.

w|berbasa-basi.text: Rudi sempat berbasa-basi dengan penjaga pos sebelum mulai mendaki.
w|berbasa-basi.en: Rudi made small talk with the post guard before starting the climb.
w|berbasa-basi.ko: 루디는 등산을 시작하기 전에 초소 경비원과 잠깐 인사말을 나눴어요.

w|berbasa-basi.text: Saat antre, Rina berbasa-basi dengan penonton di sebelahnya soal cuaca.
w|berbasa-basi.en: While waiting in line, Rina made small talk about the weather with the person next to her.
w|berbasa-basi.ko: 줄을 서는 동안 리나는 옆 사람과 날씨 이야기로 가볍게 말을 나눴어요.

w|berbasis.text: Gedung itu memakai sistem keamanan berbasis kartu akses.
w|berbasis.en: That building uses a security system based on access cards.
w|berbasis.ko: 그 건물은 출입 카드 방식의 보안 시스템을 써요.

w|berbasis.text: Intan memesan tiket lewat aplikasi berbasis daring.
w|berbasis.en: Intan booked her ticket through an online-based app.

w|berbau.text: Ruang laboratorium kimia selalu berbau cuka.
w|berbau.en: The chemistry lab always smells of vinegar.
w|berbau.ko: 화학 실험실에서는 늘 식초 냄새가 나요.

w|berbau.text: Kotak makanan dari katering berbau rendang yang harum.
