w|budi.en: Ayu's mother always teaches her children to repay the kindness of people who help them.
w|budi.ko: 아유의 어머니는 늘 아이들에게 도와준 사람의 은혜를 갚으라고 가르쳐요.

w|bugil.text: Dimas tersenyum melihat bayi yang hampir bugil di gendongan ibunya karena kepanasan.
w|bugil.en: Dimas smiled at the baby who was nearly naked in his mother's sling because of the heat.
w|bugil.ko: 디마스는 더워서 거의 벌거벗은 채 엄마 품에 안긴 아기를 보고 웃었어요.

w|bugil.text: Putri menemukan foto lama saat dia masih bayi dan bugil di bak mandi.
w|bugil.en: Putri found an old photo of herself as a naked baby in the bathtub.
w|bugil.ko: 푸트리는 아기 때 욕조에서 발가벗고 찍은 옛 사진을 찾았어요.

w|bujangan.text: Pak Joko, bujangan di rumah sebelah, sering memasak terlalu banyak dan membaginya kepada Andi.
w|bujangan.en: Mr. Joko, the bachelor next door, often cooks too much and shares it with Andi.
w|bujangan.ko: 옆집 총각 조코 씨는 음식을 너무 많이 해서 자주 안디에게 나눠 줘요.

w|bujangan.text: Dewi membaca surat-surat cinta seorang bujangan dari zaman kolonial.
w|bujangan.en: Dewi read the love letters of a bachelor from the colonial era.
w|bujangan.ko: 데위는 식민지 시대 한 총각의 연애편지를 읽었어요.

w|bukit.text: Kami mendaki bukit sebelum matahari terbit.
w|bukit.en: We climbed the hill before sunrise.
w|bukit.ko: 우리는 해 뜨기 전에 언덕을 올랐어.

w|bukit.text: Bukit hijau itu tampak dari jendela.
w|bukit.en: That green hill is visible from the window.

w|buku.en: I forgot to bring the book.

w|bulan.en: There are many events this month.
Look at the moon in the night sky.

w|bulat.text: Lubang untuk tiang itu harus benar-benar bulat agar pipa bisa masuk.
w|bulat.en: The hole for the pillar has to be perfectly round so the pipe can fit.
w|bulat.ko: 파이프가 들어가려면 기둥 구멍이 완전히 둥글어야 해요.

w|bulat.text: Rapat perkenalan Rina diadakan di meja bulat dekat jendela.
w|bulat.en: Rina's introduction meeting was held at the round table by the window.
w|bulat.ko: 리나의 첫인사 회의는 창가의 둥근 탁자에서 열렸어요.

w|bulu.en: That cat's fur is very soft.
There is fur on her black coat.

w|bumbu.text: Di pantri kantor, Dimas melihat rak penuh bumbu milik para karyawan.
w|bumbu.en: In the office pantry, Dimas saw a shelf full of the employees' spices.
w|bumbu.ko: 사무실 탕비실에서 디마스는 직원들의 양념으로 가득한 선반을 봤어요.

w|bumbu.text: Petugas bea cukai memeriksa bumbu rendang yang dibawa Putri.
w|bumbu.en: The customs officer checked the rendang spice paste Putri had brought.
w|bumbu.ko: 세관 직원이 푸트리가 가져온 른당 양념을 검사했어요.

w|bumi.en: We have to protect the earth.

w|bunda.text: Anak tetangga memanggil ibunya bunda, dan Andi menganggap itu manis sekali.
w|bunda.en: The neighbor's child calls his mother "bunda", and Andi finds it very sweet.
w|bunda.ko: 이웃집 아이는 엄마를 '분다'라고 불러서 안디는 그게 참 귀엽다고 생각해요.

w|bunda.text: Seorang anak kecil menarik tangan ibunya dan berkata, "Bunda, lihat kapal itu!" di dekat Dewi.
w|bunda.en: Near Dewi, a little child tugged at his mother's hand and said, "Mom, look at that ship!"
w|bunda.ko: 데위 근처에서 한 아이가 엄마 손을 잡아끌며 "엄마, 저 배 좀 봐!"라고 했어요.

w|bunga.en: The flowers in the garden bloomed.

w|bungsu.text: Bayu ternyata anak bungsu dari lima bersaudara.
w|bungsu.en: It turns out Bayu is the youngest of five siblings.
w|bungsu.ko: 알고 보니 바유는 오 남매 중 막내예요.

w|bungsu.text: Adik bungsu Intan ikut mendaftar di gym bulan ini.
w|bungsu.en: Intan's youngest sibling also signed up at the gym this month.
w|bungsu.ko: 인탄의 막냇동생도 이번 달에 헬스장에 등록했어요.

w|buntu.text: Diskusi kelompok Budi sempat buntu karena tidak ada yang mau mengalah.
w|buntu.en: Budi's group discussion hit a dead end because no one would give in.
w|buntu.ko: 아무도 양보하지 않아서 부디네 조 토론이 한동안 막혔어요.

w|buntu.text: Rumah lama Siti ada di ujung gang buntu dekat sekolah.
w|buntu.en: Siti's old house is at the end of a dead-end alley near the school.
w|buntu.ko: 시티의 옛집은 학교 근처 막다른 골목 끝에 있어요.

w|bunyi.en: The school bell sound rang loudly.

w|bunyi.text: Aku mendengar bunyi aneh dari dapur.
w|bunyi.en: I heard a strange sound from the kitchen.

w|buronan.text: Klub drama Eko memainkan cerita tentang seorang buronan yang akhirnya menyerah.
w|buronan.en: Eko's drama club performed a story about a fugitive who finally gives himself up.
w|buronan.ko: 에코네 연극부는 끝내 자수하는 도망자 이야기를 공연했어요.

w|buronan.text: Keluarga Ayu menonton film tentang detektif yang mengejar buronan.
w|buronan.en: Ayu's family watched a film about a detective chasing a fugitive.
w|buronan.ko: 아유네 가족은 탈주범을 쫓는 형사 영화를 봤어요.

w|bursa.text: Eko ikut bursa kerja untuk mencari juru masak baru.
w|bursa.en: Eko went to a job fair to look for new cooks.
w|bursa.ko: 에코는 새 요리사를 구하려고 채용 박람회에 갔어요.

w|bursa.text: Ayu membaca bahwa harga saham perusahaan pertanian di bursa naik saat musim hujan.
w|bursa.en: Ayu read that agricultural companies' share prices on the stock exchange rise in the rainy season.
w|bursa.ko: 아유는 우기에 증권 거래소에서 농업 회사 주가가 오른다는 글을 읽었어요.

w|buru-buru.text: Dia buru-buru pergi karena hampir terlambat.
w|buru-buru.en: He left in a hurry because he was almost late.
w|buru-buru.ko: 거의 늦을 뻔해서 그는 서둘러 떠났어.

w|buru-buru.text: Buru-buru saja, bus sebentar lagi datang.
w|buru-buru.en: Hurry up, the bus will arrive soon.

w|buruan.text: Dalam cerita rakyat yang dibaca Eko, rusa menjadi buruan raja.
w|buruan.en: In the folk tale Eko read, a deer became the king's prey.
w|buruan.ko: 에코가 읽은 민담에서 사슴은 왕의 사냥감이 됐어요.

w|buruan.text: Ayu menggambar harimau yang sedang mengintai buruan di balik semak.
w|buruan.en: Ayu drew a tiger stalking its prey behind the bushes.
w|buruan.ko: 아유는 덤불 뒤에서 사냥감을 노리는 호랑이를 그렸어요.

w|buruh.text: Ratusan buruh keluar dari gerbang pabrik saat sirene berbunyi.
w|buruh.en: Hundreds of laborers poured out of the factory gate when the siren sounded.
w|buruh.ko: 사이렌이 울리자 노동자 수백 명이 공장 문을 나섰어요.

w|buruh.text: Ayah Putri dulu buruh pelabuhan yang selalu pulang larut malam.
w|buruh.en: Putri's father was a dock worker who always came home late at night.
w|buruh.ko: 푸트리의 아버지는 늘 밤늦게 귀가하던 항구 노동자였어요.

w|burung.en: That bird sings early in the morning.
There's a bird in the tree.

w|bus.text: Kami naik bus ke pusat kota.
w|bus.en: We took the bus to downtown.
That bus is full of passengers.

w|busana.text: Agus melihat gaun pengantin dan busana pesta tahun delapan puluhan dijual di satu lapak.
w|busana.en: Agus saw wedding dresses and eighties party outfits sold at one stall.
w|busana.ko: 아구스는 한 노점에서 웨딩드레스와 80년대 파티 옷을 파는 걸 봤어요.

w|busana.text: Wati mengganti koleksi busana di lemarinya dengan pakaian yang lebih tipis saat kemarau.
w|busana.en: Wati swapped the clothes in her wardrobe for lighter ones in the dry season.
w|busana.ko: 와티는 건기가 되면 옷장의 옷을 더 얇은 것으로 바꿔요.

w|busuk.text: Buah itu sudah busuk di kulkas.
w|busuk.en: That fruit has already gone rotten in the fridge.

w|busuk.text: Bau busuk datang dari tempat sampah.
w|busuk.en: A rotten smell came from the trash.

w|busur.text: Untuk hobi memanah, Fajar membeli busur kayu dari penjual di Bandung.
w|busur.en: For his archery hobby, Fajar bought a wooden bow from a seller in Bandung.
w|busur.ko: 파자르는 활쏘기 취미 때문에 반둥의 판매자에게서 나무 활을 샀어요.

w|busur.text: Lestari menghias kue ulang tahun dengan bentuk busur dan panah dari cokelat.
w|busur.en: Lestari decorated the birthday cake with a bow and arrow made of chocolate.
w|busur.ko: 레스타리는 생일 케이크를 초콜릿 활과 화살로 장식했어요.

w|buta.en: He has been illiterate since childhood.

w|buta.text: Kucing itu hampir buta di malam hari.
w|buta.en: That cat is almost blind at night.
w|buta.ko: 그 고양이는 밤에 거의 안 보여.

w|butir.text: Dimas menemukan beberapa butir manik kaca di dasar kotak artefak.
w|butir.en: Dimas found a few glass beads at the bottom of the artifact box.
w|butir.ko: 디마스는 유물 상자 바닥에서 유리구슬 몇 알을 찾았어요.

w|butir.text: Putri memeriksa setiap butir mutiara pada kalung sebelum membungkusnya.
w|butir.en: Putri checked every pearl on the necklace before wrapping it.
w|butir.ko: 푸트리는 포장하기 전에 목걸이의 진주를 한 알 한 알 확인했어요.

w|buyut.text: Rumah tua di samping Andi dibangun oleh buyut tetangganya.
w|buyut.en: The old house next to Andi's was built by his neighbor's great-grandfather.
w|buyut.ko: 안디네 옆 오래된 집은 이웃의 증조할아버지가 지은 거예요.

w|buyut.text: Dewi menemukan foto buyut yang ikut membangun gedung museum itu.
w|buyut.en: Dewi found a photo of her great-grandfather, who helped build the museum building.
w|buyut.ko: 데위는 박물관 건물 짓는 데 참여한 증조할아버지의 사진을 찾았어요.

w|cabang.text: Museum nasional membuka cabang baru di kota pesisir.
w|cabang.en: The national museum opened a new branch in a coastal city.
w|cabang.ko: 국립 박물관이 해안 도시에 새 분관을 열었어요.

w|cabang.text: Toko kue langganan Rina sudah punya cabang di tiga pasar.
w|cabang.en: Rina's favorite cake shop already has branches in three markets.
w|cabang.ko: 리나가 단골인 과자 가게는 벌써 시장 세 곳에 지점이 있어요.

w|cacar.text: Dimas menjual bedak khusus untuk anak yang terkena cacar air.
w|cacar.en: Dimas sells a special powder for children with chickenpox.
w|cacar.ko: 디마스는 수두에 걸린 아이에게 쓰는 전용 파우더를 팔아요.

w|cacar.text: Putri menemukan surat lama yang menyebut nenek pernah terkena cacar.
w|cacar.en: Putri found an old letter mentioning that her grandmother once had smallpox.
w|cacar.ko: 푸트리는 할머니가 천연두를 앓았다는 내용의 옛 편지를 찾았어요.

w|cacat.text: Produk itu punya cacat kecil di sudut.
w|cacat.en: That product has a small defect in the corner.
w|cacat.ko: 그 제품은 모서리에 작은 흠이 있어.

w|cacat.en: A defect in the machine made it stop.

w|cacing.text: Cacing tanah membantu menyuburkan tanah kebun.
Anak itu takut memegang cacing basah.
w|cacing.en: That child is afraid to hold a wet worm.
w|cacing.ko: 그 아이는 젖은 지렁이 만지기를 무서워해.

w|cadangan.text: Bawa baterai cadangan untuk perjalanan jauh.
w|cadangan.en: Bring a spare battery for a long trip.
The food reserve is stored in the warehouse.

w|cairan.text: Cairan itu harus disimpan di tempat sejuk.
w|cairan.en: That liquid must be stored in a cool place.
w|cairan.ko: 그 액체는 서늘한 곳에 보관해야 해.

w|cairan.text: Dokter menyarankan minum cairan lebih banyak.
w|cairan.en: The doctor advised drinking more fluids.
w|cairan.ko: 의사가 수분을 더 많이 마시라고 했어.

w|cakap.text: Petugas jaga di kantor polisi itu cakap menenangkan warga yang panik.
w|cakap.en: The officer on duty at the police station is skilled at calming panicked residents.
w|cakap.ko: 그 경찰서 당직 경찰관은 겁먹은 주민을 잘 진정시켜요.

w|cakap.text: Dewi dikenal cakap membaca permainan lawan.
w|cakap.en: Dewi is known for being good at reading the opponent's game.
w|cakap.ko: 데위는 상대 팀 경기 흐름을 잘 읽기로 유명해요.

w|cakar.text: Seekor kepiting mengangkat cakar besarnya ketika Eko mendekat.
w|cakar.en: A crab raised its big claw when Eko came near.
w|cakar.ko: 에코가 다가가자 게 한 마리가 큰 집게발을 치켜들었어요.

w|cakar.text: Kucing tetangga meninggalkan bekas cakar di sofa Ayu.
w|cakar.en: The neighbor's cat left claw marks on Ayu's sofa.
w|cakar.ko: 이웃집 고양이가 아유의 소파에 발톱 자국을 남겼어요.

w|cakrawala.text: Dari atas bukit, Budi bisa melihat cakrawala yang memerah saat senja.
w|cakrawala.en: From the top of the hill, Budi can see the horizon turning red at dusk.
w|cakrawala.ko: 언덕 위에서 부디는 해 질 녘 붉게 물드는 지평선을 볼 수 있어요.

w|cakrawala.text: Siti ingin memperluas cakrawala rasa para pelanggan dengan menu baru.
w|cakrawala.en: Siti wants to broaden her customers' taste horizons with a new menu.
w|cakrawala.ko: 시티는 새 메뉴로 손님들의 입맛의 폭을 넓히고 싶어 해요.

w|calon.text: Calon ketua menyampaikan visi dengan jelas.
w|calon.en: The candidate for chair clearly presented a vision.

w|calon.text: Mereka mendukung calon dari daerah ini.
w|calon.en: They support the candidate from this area.

w|camar.text: Di muara, Bayu melihat burung camar menyambar ikan dari air.
w|camar.en: At the estuary, Bayu saw a seagull snatch a fish from the water.
w|camar.ko: 바유는 하구에서 갈매기가 물에서 물고기를 낚아채는 걸 봤어요.

w|camar.text: Rute di tepi pantai ramai oleh burung camar yang terbang di atas Intan.
w|camar.en: The beachside route was busy with seagulls flying over Intan.
w|camar.ko: 해변 코스에는 인탄 머리 위로 갈매기가 잔뜩 날아다녔어요.

w|camilan.text: Sepulang sekolah, anak-anak membeli camilan di toko roti Agus.
w|camilan.en: After school, the kids buy snacks at Agus's bakery.
w|camilan.ko: 아이들은 학교가 끝나면 아구스의 빵집에서 간식을 사요.

w|camilan.text: Lemari di kantor Wati selalu penuh camilan untuk para programmer.
w|camilan.en: The cupboard in Wati's office is always full of snacks for the programmers.
w|camilan.ko: 와티네 사무실 찬장은 프로그래머들을 위한 간식으로 늘 가득해요.

w|campuran.text: Andi diberi segelas teh campuran jahe sambil menunggu giliran.
w|campuran.en: Andi was given a glass of tea mixed with ginger while waiting his turn.
w|campuran.ko: 안디는 차례를 기다리는 동안 생강을 섞은 차 한 잔을 받았어요.

w|campuran.text: Seragam baru tim dibuat dari kain campuran yang cepat kering.
w|campuran.en: The team's new uniforms are made from a blended fabric that dries quickly.
w|campuran.ko: 팀의 새 유니폼은 빨리 마르는 혼방 원단으로 만들었어요.

w|candaan.text: Agus menahan tawa mendengar candaan petugas pengadilan di lorong.
w|candaan.en: Agus held back a laugh hearing the court officer's joke in the hallway.
w|candaan.ko: 아구스는 복도에서 법원 직원의 농담을 듣고 웃음을 참았어요.

w|candaan.text: Wati membalas candaan pelanggan tetap dengan senyum lebar.
w|candaan.en: Wati answered the regular customer's joke with a big smile.
w|candaan.ko: 와티는 단골손님의 농담에 활짝 웃으며 답했어요.

w|canggih.text: Teater itu baru memasang sistem tata cahaya yang canggih.
w|canggih.en: The theatre has just installed a sophisticated lighting system.
w|canggih.ko: 그 극장은 최첨단 조명 시스템을 새로 설치했어요.

w|canggih.text: Perusahaan membelikan Intan ponsel canggih untuk urusan kantor.
w|canggih.en: The company bought Intan an advanced phone for work.
w|canggih.ko: 회사가 업무용으로 인탄에게 최신 휴대폰을 사 줬어요.

w|canggung.text: Setelah sepuluh tahun tidak bertemu, Rudi takut pertemuan mereka nanti akan terasa canggung.
w|canggung.en: After ten years apart, Rudi was afraid their meeting would feel awkward.
w|canggung.ko: 십 년 동안 못 만나서 루디는 다시 만나면 어색할까 봐 걱정했어요.

w|canggung.text: Suasana rapat jadi canggung setelah dua programmer berdebat soal desain.
w|canggung.en: The meeting became awkward after two programmers argued about the design.
w|canggung.ko: 프로그래머 두 명이 디자인을 두고 다툰 뒤 회의 분위기가 어색해졌어요.

w|cangkang.text: Bayu menemukan cangkang kerang air tawar di pasir sungai.
w|cangkang.en: Bayu found a freshwater clam shell in the river sand.
w|cangkang.ko: 바유는 강 모래에서 민물조개 껍데기를 찾았어요.

w|cangkang.text: Intan mengupas cangkang telur rebus untuk sarapan sebelum lomba.
w|cangkang.en: Intan peeled the shell off a boiled egg for breakfast before the race.
w|cangkang.ko: 인탄은 경기 전 아침으로 삶은 달걀 껍데기를 깠어요.

w|cangkir.text: Pelanggan tetap Fajar selalu memesan secangkir kopi hitam bersama roti bakar.
w|cangkir.en: Fajar's regular customer always orders a cup of black coffee with toast.
w|cangkir.ko: 파자르의 단골손님은 늘 토스트와 함께 블랙커피 한 잔을 시켜요.

w|cangkir.text: Setelah mandi, Lestari minum secangkir teh jahe hangat.
w|cangkir.en: After showering, Lestari drank a cup of warm ginger tea.
w|cangkir.ko: 샤워하고 나서 레스타리는 따뜻한 생강차 한 잔을 마셨어요.

w|capek.text: Agus sudah capek menahan sakit gigi selama seminggu.
w|capek.en: Agus is tired of putting up with toothache for a week.
w|capek.ko: 아구스는 일주일 동안 치통을 참느라 지쳤어요.

w|capek.text: Wati sudah capek, tapi masih ingin menyelesaikan pintu dapur hari ini.
w|capek.en: Wati is tired, but she still wants to finish the kitchen door today.
w|capek.ko: 와티는 지쳤지만 오늘 부엌문까지는 끝내고 싶어요.

w|catur.text: Saat sidang diskors, Fajar bermain catur di ponselnya.
w|catur.en: While the hearing was adjourned, Fajar played chess on his phone.
w|catur.ko: 재판이 잠시 휴정하는 동안 파자르는 휴대폰으로 체스를 뒀어요.

w|catur.text: Bapak-bapak bermain catur di bangku depan warung Lestari.
w|catur.en: The men play chess on the bench in front of Lestari's shop.
w|catur.ko: 아저씨들이 레스타리 가게 앞 벤치에서 체스를 둬요.

w|cedera.text: Gigi depan Agus patah karena cedera saat bermain futsal.
w|cedera.en: Agus's front tooth broke from an injury while playing futsal.
w|cedera.ko: 아구스의 앞니는 풋살을 하다 다쳐서 부러졌어요.

w|cedera.text: Tukang itu memakai sarung tangan tebal untuk mencegah cedera saat memotong kaca.
w|cedera.en: The builder wore thick gloves to prevent injury while cutting glass.
w|cedera.ko: 그 인부는 유리를 자를 때 다치지 않으려고 두꺼운 장갑을 꼈어요.

w|cek.text: Cek lagi semua dokumen sebelum dikirim.
w|cek.en: Check all the documents again before sending.

w|cek.text: Dokter akan cek tekanan darahmu sebentar.
w|cek.en: The doctor will check your blood pressure shortly.
w|cek.ko: 의사가 곧 혈압을 재 볼 거야.

w|cekikikan.text: Budi mengenang masa ketika Budi dan Rudi cekikikan di bangku belakang kelas.
w|cekikikan.en: Budi remembered the days when he and Rudi giggled in the back row of the classroom.
w|cekikikan.ko: 부디는 루디와 교실 뒷자리에서 킥킥대던 시절을 떠올렸어요.

w|cekikikan.text: Anak-anak tetangga cekikikan di balik pagar setelah membunyikan bel.
w|cekikikan.en: The neighbors' kids giggled behind the fence after ringing the doorbell.
w|cekikikan.ko: 이웃집 아이들이 초인종을 누르고 담 뒤에서 킥킥거렸어요.

w|celah.text: Sinar matahari masuk lewat celah atap dan menyinari arca batu.
w|celah.en: Sunlight came in through a gap in the roof and lit up the stone statue.
w|celah.ko: 지붕 틈으로 햇빛이 들어와 돌 조각상을 비췄어요.

w|celah.text: Koin Rina jatuh ke celah papan kayu di bawah meja.
w|celah.en: Rina's coin fell into a gap in the wooden planks under the table.
w|celah.ko: 리나의 동전이 탁자 밑 나무판 틈으로 떨어졌어요.

w|celaka.text: Budi berseru, "Wah, celaka, buku PR-ku ketinggalan di rumah!"
w|celaka.en: Budi cried out, "Oh no, I left my homework book at home!"
w|celaka.ko: 부디가 외쳤어요. "아이고 큰일 났다, 숙제 공책을 집에 두고 왔어!"

w|celaka.text: Untung tidak ada yang celaka waktu lemari besar itu tergelincir di tangga.
w|celaka.en: Luckily no one got hurt when the big wardrobe slipped on the stairs.
w|celaka.ko: 큰 옷장이 계단에서 미끄러졌을 때 다행히 다친 사람은 없었어요.

w|cemas.en: Mother feels anxious waiting for news.
Don't be too anxious about the result.

w|cemberut.text: Budi masih ingat Rudi cemberut seharian karena kalah main kelereng.
w|cemberut.en: Budi still remembers Rudi sulking all day after losing at marbles.
w|cemberut.ko: 부디는 루디가 구슬치기에서 지고 하루 종일 뾰로통해 있던 걸 아직 기억해요.

w|cemberut.text: Anak Bu Ani cemberut karena tidak boleh main di rumah Siti.
w|cemberut.en: Mrs. Ani's child pouted because he wasn't allowed to play at Siti's house.
w|cemberut.ko: 아니 아주머니네 아이는 시티네 집에서 못 놀게 해서 입이 삐죽 나왔어요.

w|cemburu.en: Jealousy made it hard for her to sleep.

w|cemburu.text: Dia merasa cemburu tanpa alasan jelas.
w|cemburu.en: He felt jealous without a clear reason.

w|cemerlang.text: Para kritikus memuji penampilan cemerlang aktris muda itu.
w|cemerlang.en: The critics praised the young actress's brilliant performance.
w|cemerlang.ko: 비평가들은 그 젊은 여배우의 빛나는 연기를 칭찬했어요.

w|cemerlang.text: Dari puncak bukit, Ayu melihat bintang yang cemerlang di langit malam.
w|cemerlang.en: From the top of the hill, Ayu sees brilliant stars in the night sky.
w|cemerlang.ko: 언덕 꼭대기에서 아유는 밤하늘의 빛나는 별을 봐요.

w|cenayang.text: Bu Ratna di depan rumah Andi mengaku pernah datang ke seorang cenayang untuk mencari kucingnya.
w|cenayang.en: Mrs. Ratna across from Andi's house admits she once went to a psychic to find her cat.
w|cenayang.ko: 안디네 집 앞 라트나 아주머니는 고양이를 찾으려고 점쟁이에게 간 적이 있대요.

w|cenayang.text: Pemandu bercerita kepada Dewi tentang cenayang istana yang konon bisa meramal panen.
w|cenayang.en: The guide told Dewi about a palace psychic who could supposedly predict harvests.
w|cenayang.ko: 가이드는 데위에게 수확을 점칠 수 있었다는 궁중 점술가 이야기를 해 줬어요.

w|cenderung.text: Pengunjung perpustakaan cenderung memilih meja dekat jendela.
w|cenderung.en: Library visitors tend to choose the tables near the window.
w|cenderung.ko: 도서관 이용자들은 창가 자리를 고르는 경향이 있어요.

w|cenderung.text: Kereta malam cenderung lebih sepi daripada kereta siang.
w|cenderung.en: Night trains tend to be quieter than daytime trains.
w|cenderung.ko: 밤 기차는 낮 기차보다 한산한 편이에요.

w|cengeng.text: Fajar bilang dirinya bukan cengeng, tapi ia tetap menangis saat ayahnya memberi restu.
w|cengeng.en: Fajar said he's not a crybaby, but he still cried when his father gave his blessing.
w|cengeng.ko: 파자르는 자기가 울보는 아니라고 했지만 아버지가 축복해 줄 때 결국 울었어요.

w|cengeng.text: Lestari bukan wartawan cengeng, tapi kritik tajam dari pembaca kadang membuatnya sedih.
w|cengeng.en: Lestari isn't a thin-skinned reporter, but sharp criticism from readers sometimes makes her sad.
w|cengeng.ko: 레스타리는 여린 기자는 아니지만 독자의 날카로운 비판에 가끔 속상해요.

w|cerah.text: Langit cerah tanpa awan pagi ini.
w|cerah.en: The sky is clear without clouds this morning.
w|cerah.ko: 오늘 아침 하늘이 구름 없이 맑아.

w|cerah.en: The weather at the beach is so bright.

w|ceramah.text: Pagi ini Rudi mendengarkan ceramah kapolsek tentang cara melayani warga dengan ramah.
w|ceramah.en: This morning Rudi listened to the precinct chief's talk about how to serve residents kindly.
w|ceramah.ko: 오늘 아침 루디는 주민을 친절하게 응대하는 법에 관한 서장의 강연을 들었어요.

w|ceramah.text: Sehari sebelum lomba, Rina mengikuti ceramah singkat tentang pola makan pelari.
w|ceramah.en: The day before the race, Rina attended a short talk about runners' diets.
w|ceramah.ko: 경기 전날 리나는 주자 식단에 관한 짧은 강연을 들었어요.

w|cerdas.text: Anak itu sangat cerdas dan kreatif.
w|cerdas.en: That child is very smart and creative.

w|cerdas.text: Cerdas sekali solusi yang kau usulkan.
w|cerdas.en: The solution you proposed is so clever.

w|cerdik.text: Sepupu Rudi yang cerdik berhasil menyembunyikan sepatu pengantin pria.
w|cerdik.en: Rudi's clever cousin managed to hide the groom's shoes.
w|cerdik.ko: 루디의 꾀 많은 사촌이 신랑 신발을 숨기는 데 성공했어요.

w|cerdik.text: Rina harus cerdik mencari narasumber yang mau bicara terus terang.
w|cerdik.en: Rina has to be clever in finding sources who will speak frankly.
w|cerdik.ko: 리나는 솔직하게 말해 줄 취재원을 영리하게 찾아야 해요.

w|cerewet.text: Tante Fajar yang cerewet terus mengomentari warna baju para tamu.
w|cerewet.en: Fajar's chatty aunt kept commenting on the colors of the guests' clothes.
w|cerewet.ko: 말 많은 파자르의 이모는 손님들 옷 색깔에 대해 계속 한마디씩 했어요.

w|cerewet.text: Redaktur Lestari memang cerewet, tapi tulisannya jadi jauh lebih rapi.
w|cerewet.en: Lestari's editor is certainly fussy, but her writing has become much tidier.
w|cerewet.ko: 레스타리의 편집장은 잔소리가 많지만 덕분에 글이 훨씬 깔끔해졌어요.

w|ceri.text: Agus menaruh sebutir ceri merah di puncak setiap kue mangkuk.
w|ceri.en: Agus puts a red cherry on top of every cupcake.
w|ceri.ko: 아구스는 컵케이크마다 꼭대기에 빨간 체리를 하나씩 올려요.

w|ceri.text: Tim Wati merayakan rilis pertama dengan kue ceri.
w|ceri.en: Wati's team celebrated the first release with a cherry cake.
w|ceri.ko: 와티의 팀은 첫 출시를 체리 케이크로 축하했어요.

w|ceria.text: Rina yang biasanya ceria jadi diam seharian.
w|ceria.en: Rina, who is usually cheerful, was quiet all day.
w|ceria.ko: 평소에 명랑한 리나가 하루 종일 말이 없었어요.

w|ceria.text: Cat kuning membuat dapur Siti terlihat lebih ceria.
w|ceria.en: Yellow paint makes Siti's kitchen look more cheerful.
w|ceria.ko: 노란 페인트 덕분에 시티의 부엌이 더 화사해 보여요.

w|cermat.text: Tetangga Andi yang cermat selalu mencatat siapa yang meminjam alat-alatnya.
w|cermat.en: Andi's meticulous neighbor always writes down who borrows his tools.
w|cermat.ko: 꼼꼼한 안디의 이웃은 누가 연장을 빌려 갔는지 늘 적어 둬요.

w|cermat.text: Dewi kagum pada kerja cermat para ahli yang merestorasi naskah kuno.
w|cermat.en: Dewi admired the meticulous work of the experts restoring ancient manuscripts.
w|cermat.ko: 데위는 옛 필사본을 복원하는 전문가들의 꼼꼼한 작업에 감탄했어요.

w|cermin.en: She stares at her face in the mirror.

w|cermin.text: Cermin itu retak di sudut kanan.
w|cermin.en: That mirror is cracked at the right corner.
w|cermin.ko: 그 거울은 오른쪽 모서리가 금이 가 있어.

w|ceroboh.ko: 가스불을 켜 둔 채 나가다니 너무 부주의해.

w|cerutu.text: Kakek Rina suka duduk di beranda sambil mengisap cerutu daun jagung.
w|cerutu.en: Rina's grandfather likes to sit on the porch smoking a corn-husk cigar.
w|cerutu.ko: 리나의 할아버지는 옥수수 잎 시가를 피우며 툇마루에 앉아 있는 걸 좋아해요.

w|cetakan.text: Dimas membersihkan cetakan plastik itu sebelum dipakai lagi.

w|cetakan.ko: 디마스는 플라스틱 틀을 다시 쓰기 전에 깨끗이 닦아요.

w|cilik.ko: 와티는 어린 사용자를 위한 읽기 학습 앱을 설계했어요.

w|ciptaan.text: Puisi ciptaan Eko dimuat di majalah dinding sekolah.

w|ciptaan.en: The art teacher said every creation has a story behind it, Ayu's painting included.

w|ciri.text: Rudi mencatat ciri burung pipit untuk tugas biologi.

w|ciri.ko: 루디는 생물 과제로 참새의 특징을 적었어요.

w|ciri.en: Rina told the truck driver the features of her new house: a green fence and a guava tree.

w|citra.en: The small theater wants to improve the image of stage art in the eyes of young people.
w|citra.ko: 그 작은 극장은 젊은이들 사이에서 무대 예술의 이미지를 높이고 싶어 해요.

w|citra.text: Desa Ayu ingin membangun citra sebagai desa wisata yang bersih.
w|citra.en: Ayu's village wants to build an image as a clean tourist village.
w|citra.ko: 아유네 마을은 깨끗한 관광 마을이라는 이미지를 만들고 싶어 해요.

w|cobaan.ko: 바유는 집이 불탄 뒤에도 시련을 꿋꿋이 견딘 가족의 이야기를 썼어요.

w|cucian.ko: 아구스는 창가의 접이식 건조대에 빨래를 널어요.

w|cucian.en: In the rainy season, Wati's laundry takes three days to dry.
w|cucian.ko: 우기에는 와티의 빨래가 마르는 데 사흘이 걸려요.

w|cuma.en: I just want to say thank you.

w|cumi-cumi.ko: 와티는 사무실에서 먹을 저녁으로 오징어 볶음밥을 시켰어요.

w|cuplikan.en: The small screen in that room plays clips from a documentary about the temple excavation.

w|cuplikan.en: Putri uploaded a behind-the-scenes clip to her social media account.
w|cuplikan.ko: 푸트리는 촬영 뒷이야기 영상 일부를 자기 SNS 계정에 올렸어요.

w|curam.text: Jalan menuju rumah Eko sangat curam dan licin saat hujan.
w|curam.en: The road to Eko's house is very steep and slippery when it rains.
w|curam.ko: 에코네 집으로 가는 길은 아주 가파르고 비가 오면 미끄러워요.

w|curam.text: Tangga menuju gudang atas terlalu curam, jadi Ayu minta dipasangi pegangan.
w|curam.en: The stairs to the upper storeroom are too steep, so Ayu asked for a handrail.

w|curang.en: That player cheated in the match.

w|curang.text: Curang tidak akan membuatmu menang lama.
w|curang.en: Cheating will not make you win for long.

w|curian.text: Dalam drama kelas, Rudi berperan sebagai polisi yang menemukan barang curian.
w|curian.en: In the class play, Rudi played a police officer who finds stolen goods.
w|curian.ko: 반 연극에서 루디는 도난품을 찾아내는 경찰 역을 맡았어요.

w|curian.text: Pemilik toko barang bekas menolak membeli sepeda Rina karena mengira itu sepeda curian.
w|curian.en: The secondhand shop owner refused to buy Rina's bike because he thought it was stolen.
w|curian.ko: 중고 가게 주인은 도난 자전거인 줄 알고 리나의 자전거를 안 사려고 했어요.

w|curiga.text: Dia curiga ada yang menyembunyikan fakta.
w|curiga.en: She suspects someone is hiding the facts.

w|curiga.text: Curiga membuatnya sulit percaya orang baru.
w|curiga.en: Suspicion makes it hard for him to trust new people.
w|curiga.ko: 의심 때문에 새 사람을 믿기 어려워해.

w|cuti.en: She took leave for a week.

w|cuti.text: Cuti tahunan itu sudah disetujui atasan.
w|cuti.en: That annual leave has been approved by the boss.

w|dada.en: His chest felt tight after running.
He placed his hand on his chest.

w|dadah.text: Dimas membantu penyuluhan bahaya dadah di sekolah dekat apotek.
w|dadah.en: Dimas helps with talks on the dangers of drugs at the school near the pharmacy.
w|dadah.ko: 디마스는 약국 근처 학교에서 마약의 위험을 알리는 교육을 도와요.

w|dadah.text: Putri menemukan koran lama dengan berita tentang penangkapan pengedar dadah.
w|dadah.en: Putri found an old newspaper with a story about the arrest of drug dealers.
w|dadah.ko: 푸트리는 마약 밀매범 체포 기사가 실린 옛 신문을 찾았어요.

w|dadu.text: Halaman hiburan koran itu memuat permainan ular tangga lengkap dengan dadu kertas.
w|dadu.en: The paper's entertainment page includes a snakes-and-ladders game complete with a paper die.
w|dadu.ko: 그 신문 오락면에는 종이 주사위까지 딸린 뱀 사다리 게임이 실려요.

w|dadu.text: Untuk memilih siapa yang membeli kopi, tim Intan melempar dadu di meja rapat.
w|dadu.en: To decide who buys coffee, Intan's team rolls a die on the meeting table.
w|dadu.ko: 누가 커피를 살지 정하려고 인탄의 팀은 회의 탁자에서 주사위를 던져요.

w|daftar.en: My name is on the list.

w|dagu.text: Kucing oranye itu paling suka digaruk di bawah dagu.
w|dagu.en: That orange cat loves being scratched under the chin.
w|dagu.ko: 그 주황색 고양이는 턱 밑을 긁어 주는 걸 제일 좋아해요.

w|dagu.text: Siti menopang dagu sambil menatap puncak gunung dari jendela.
w|dagu.en: Siti rested her chin on her hand while gazing at the mountain peak from the window.
w|dagu.ko: 시티는 턱을 괴고 창밖으로 산꼭대기를 바라봤어요.

w|dahi.text: Budi mengusap dahi yang berkeringat setelah menenangkan anjing besar yang panik.
w|dahi.en: Budi wiped his sweaty forehead after calming a big panicking dog.
w|dahi.ko: 부디는 겁에 질린 큰 개를 진정시킨 뒤 땀 난 이마를 닦았어요.

w|dahi.text: Siti menempelkan tangan ke dahi anaknya untuk memeriksa demam.
w|dahi.en: Siti put her hand on her child's forehead to check for a fever.
w|dahi.ko: 시티는 열이 있는지 보려고 아이 이마에 손을 댔어요.

w|dahsyat.text: Bayu terdiam melihat ombak dahsyat menghantam batu karang.
w|dahsyat.en: Bayu fell silent watching the tremendous waves crash against the rocks.
w|dahsyat.ko: 바유는 거대한 파도가 바위에 부딪히는 걸 보고 말을 잃었어요.

w|dahsyat.text: Intan ingin melukis badai dahsyat seperti yang pernah ia lihat di film.
w|dahsyat.en: Intan wants to paint a tremendous storm like the one she once saw in a film.
w|dahsyat.ko: 인탄은 영화에서 본 것 같은 엄청난 폭풍을 그리고 싶어요.

w|dahulu.en: He used to live in a village.

w|dahulu.text: Saya mengenal dia dahulu di sekolah.
w|dahulu.en: I knew him long ago at school.

w|dakwaan.text: Fajar mengikuti berita sidang dan membaca dakwaan terhadap mantan pejabat itu.
w|dakwaan.en: Fajar followed the trial news and read the indictment against the former official.
w|dakwaan.ko: 파자르는 재판 소식을 따라가며 그 전직 공무원에 대한 공소장을 읽었어요.

w|dakwaan.text: Lestari menceritakan novel hukum yang dibacanya, tentang pengacara muda yang membantah dakwaan jaksa.
w|dakwaan.en: Lestari described the legal novel she was reading, about a young lawyer who refutes the prosecutor's charges.
w|dakwaan.ko: 레스타리는 검사의 공소에 맞서는 젊은 변호사에 관한 법정 소설 이야기를 했어요.

w|dalang.text: Keluarga Rudi mengundang seorang dalang untuk pertunjukan wayang semalam suntuk.
w|dalang.en: Rudi's family invited a puppet master for an all-night wayang performance.
w|dalang.ko: 루디네 가족은 밤새 와양 공연을 하려고 인형극 연출가를 초대했어요.

w|dalang.text: Rina menulis profil dalang muda yang memadukan wayang dengan musik rap.
w|dalang.en: Rina wrote a profile of a young puppeteer who blends wayang with rap music.
w|dalang.ko: 리나는 와양과 랩을 섞는 젊은 인형극 연출가의 인물 기사를 썼어요.

w|damai.text: Desa itu terasa tenang dan damai.
w|damai.en: That village feels calm and peaceful.

w|damai.text: Damai di hati membuat tidur nyenyak.
w|damai.en: Peace in the heart brings sound sleep.

w|dampak.text: Bayu ikut merasakan dampak penutupan gedung teater selama renovasi.
w|dampak.en: Bayu also felt the impact of the theatre closing for renovation.
w|dampak.ko: 바유도 공사로 극장이 문을 닫은 영향을 함께 받았어요.

w|dampak.text: Intan sedang menghitung dampak kenaikan harga bahan baku terhadap anggaran.
w|dampak.en: Intan is calculating the impact of rising raw material prices on the budget.
w|dampak.ko: 인탄은 원자재 가격 상승이 예산에 미치는 영향을 계산하고 있어요.

w|dan.en: We're out of tea and coffee.
Mom and Dad are already home.

w|dana.en: They raised funds for the school.

w|danau.en: We camped by the edge of the lake.

w|dangkal.text: Dari tepi danau yang dangkal, Rudi bisa melihat ikan-ikan kecil berenang.
w|dangkal.en: From the shallow edge of the lake, Rudi could see little fish swimming.
w|dangkal.ko: 얕은 호숫가에서 루디는 작은 물고기들이 헤엄치는 걸 볼 수 있었어요.

w|dangkal.text: Rina kesal pada orang yang menganggap musik itu dangkal hanya karena liriknya sederhana.
w|dangkal.en: Rina is annoyed with people who think the music is shallow just because the lyrics are simple.
w|dangkal.ko: 리나는 가사가 단순하다는 이유만으로 그 음악을 얕다고 여기는 사람들에게 짜증이 나요.

w|dansa.text: Pasangan itu menari dansa di aula.
w|dansa.en: That couple dances in the hall.

w|dapur.text: Dapur rumah ini sangat bersih dan luas.
w|dapur.en: This house's kitchen is very clean and spacious.
w|dapur.ko: 이 집 주방은 아주 깨끗하고 넓어.

w|dapur.en: A delicious aroma is coming from the kitchen.

w|darat.text: Pasukan tiba di darat setelah perjalanan laut.
w|darat.en: The troops arrived on land after the sea voyage.

w|darat.text: Darat di sekitar pantai itu berbatu.
w|darat.en: The land around that beach is rocky.

w|daratan.text: Dimas lebih suka bertani di daratan yang jauh dari sungai karena tidak kena banjir.
w|daratan.en: Dimas prefers farming on land far from the river because it doesn't flood.
w|daratan.ko: 디마스는 강에서 먼 땅에서 농사짓는 걸 더 좋아해요. 홍수가 안 나거든요.

w|daratan.text: Teman Putri yang bekerja di kapal senang sekali bisa kembali ke daratan.
w|daratan.en: Putri's friend who works on a ship was very happy to be back on land.
w|daratan.ko: 배에서 일하는 푸트리의 친구는 육지로 돌아와서 무척 기뻐했어요.

w|darurat.en: The emergency exit is in the back.

w|dasi.text: Fajar bingung memilih warna dasi yang cocok dengan kemejanya.
w|dasi.en: Fajar couldn't decide which tie color would match his shirt.
w|dasi.ko: 파자르는 셔츠에 어울리는 넥타이 색을 고르느라 고민했어요.

w|dasi.text: Seorang peserta pria melepas dasi sebelum mulai memotong bawang.
w|dasi.en: A male participant took off his tie before he started chopping onions.
w|dasi.ko: 한 남자 참가자는 양파를 썰기 전에 넥타이를 풀었어요.

w|data.en: Save the data in a safe place.

w|datar.text: Panggung pelaminan dipasang di atas tanah datar di halaman rumah Fajar.
w|datar.en: The wedding dais was set up on flat ground in Fajar's yard.
w|datar.ko: 혼례 단상은 파자르네 마당의 평평한 땅 위에 세워졌어요.

w|datar.text: Sawah di dataran rendah itu terlihat datar dan hijau setelah hujan pertama.
w|datar.en: The rice fields in the lowland look flat and green after the first rain.
w|datar.ko: 저지대의 논은 첫비가 온 뒤 평평하고 푸르러 보여요.

w|dataran.text: Malam itu Rudi dan teman-temannya mendirikan tenda di dataran tinggi yang sejuk.
w|dataran.en: That night Rudi and his friends pitched their tent on a cool highland plateau.
w|dataran.ko: 그날 밤 루디와 친구들은 서늘한 고원에 텐트를 쳤어요.

w|dataran.text: Panggung utama didirikan di dataran luas di pinggir kota.
w|dataran.en: The main stage was set up on a wide plain at the edge of town.
w|dataran.ko: 메인 무대는 도시 외곽의 넓은 평지에 세워졌어요.

w|daun.text: Daun hijau berguguran di musim gugur.
Angin menggoyang daun di pohon mangga.
w|daun.en: The wind shook the leaves on the mango tree.

w|daya.en: His memory power is still strong.

w|debu.text: Debu tebal menutupi meja tua itu.
w|debu.en: Thick dust covered that old table.
w|debu.ko: 짙은 먼지가 그 낡은 탁자를 덮었어.

w|debu.text: Dia membersihkan debu di rak buku.
w|debu.en: She cleaned the dust on the bookshelf.

w|dedaunan.text: Eko mengumpulkan dedaunan kering untuk dijadikan pupuk kompos.
w|dedaunan.en: Eko gathers dry leaves to turn into compost.
w|dedaunan.ko: 에코는 마른 낙엽을 모아 퇴비로 만들어요.

w|dedaunan.text: Dari jendela pabrik, Ayu bisa melihat dedaunan yang bergoyang tertiup angin.
w|dedaunan.en: From the factory window, Ayu can see the leaves swaying in the wind.
w|dedaunan.ko: 아유는 공장 창문으로 바람에 흔들리는 나뭇잎을 볼 수 있어요.

w|definisi.text: Andi mencari definisi kata "nostalgia" di kamus besar perpustakaan.
w|definisi.en: Andi looked up the definition of the word "nostalgia" in the library's big dictionary.
w|definisi.ko: 안디는 도서관의 큰 사전에서 "향수"라는 말의 정의를 찾아봤어요.

w|definisi.text: Bagi Dewi, definisi rumah adalah tempat keluarganya bisa berkumpul.
w|definisi.en: For Dewi, the definition of home is a place where her family can gather.
w|definisi.ko: 데위에게 집의 정의는 가족이 모일 수 있는 곳이에요.

w|deh.text: Sudah deh, kita tidak usah ribut lagi.
w|deh.en: Enough already, we don't need to argue anymore.
w|deh.ko: 됐어, 우리 더 이상 싸우지 말자.

w|deh.text: Pilih saja deh yang kamu suka.
w|deh.en: Just pick whatever you like then.

w|dehidrasi.text: Kata Budi, anak itu dirawat karena dehidrasi setelah diare berhari-hari.
w|dehidrasi.en: According to Budi, the child was admitted for dehydration after days of diarrhea.
w|dehidrasi.ko: 부디 말로는 그 아이가 며칠 동안 설사를 해서 탈수로 입원했어요.

w|dehidrasi.text: Siti minum banyak air karena udara kabin bisa menyebabkan dehidrasi.
w|dehidrasi.en: Siti drinks a lot of water because cabin air can cause dehydration.
w|dehidrasi.ko: 기내 공기가 탈수를 일으킬 수 있어서 시티는 물을 많이 마셔요.

w|dekade.text: Menurut kakek Budi, iklim di desa ini banyak berubah dalam satu dekade terakhir.
w|dekade.en: According to Budi's grandfather, the climate in this village has changed a lot in the last decade.
w|dekade.ko: 부디 할아버지 말로는 지난 십 년 사이 이 마을 기후가 많이 변했대요.

w|dekade.text: Sutradara film itu sudah berkarya lebih dari satu dekade.
w|dekade.en: The film's director has been working for more than a decade.
w|dekade.ko: 그 영화감독은 십 년 넘게 작품 활동을 해 왔어요.

w|dekan.text: Sebelum bekerja di kantor ini, Fajar pernah menjadi asisten seorang dekan di kampus.
w|dekan.en: Before working at this office, Fajar was once an assistant to a university dean.
w|dekan.ko: 이 회사에서 일하기 전에 파자르는 대학에서 학장의 조교였어요.

w|dekan.text: Lestari mendirikan perusahaan rintisan bersama mantan dekan fakultas ilmu komputer.
w|dekan.en: Lestari founded a startup together with a former dean of the computer science faculty.
w|dekan.ko: 레스타리는 컴퓨터공학부 전 학장과 함께 스타트업을 세웠어요.

w|deklarasi.text: Naskah deklarasi kemerdekaan desa itu disimpan dalam lemari kaca.
w|deklarasi.en: The manuscript of the village's declaration of independence is kept in a glass cabinet.
w|deklarasi.ko: 그 마을의 독립 선언문 원본은 유리장에 보관돼 있어요.

w|deklarasi.text: Adegan pembacaan deklarasi di lapangan harus diulang karena ada pesawat lewat.
w|deklarasi.en: The scene of reading out the declaration in the field had to be redone because a plane flew over.
w|deklarasi.ko: 들판에서 선언문을 낭독하는 장면은 비행기가 지나가서 다시 찍어야 했어요.

w|delapan.text: Delapan orang datang ke pesta itu.
w|delapan.en: Eight people came to that party.

w|delegasi.text: Hari ini delegasi dari kota kembar datang untuk melihat koleksi museum.
w|delegasi.en: Today a delegation from the sister city came to see the museum's collection.
w|delegasi.ko: 오늘 자매 도시 대표단이 박물관 소장품을 보러 왔어요.

w|delegasi.text: Kemarin delegasi dari dinas pariwisata datang melihat proses syuting di pantai.
w|delegasi.en: Yesterday a delegation from the tourism office came to watch the shooting at the beach.
w|delegasi.ko: 어제 관광청 대표단이 해변 촬영 현장을 보러 왔어요.

w|delusi.text: Kata Fajar, pasien dengan delusi berat biasanya mendapat obat dari psikiater.
w|delusi.en: Fajar says patients with severe delusions usually get medication from a psychiatrist.
w|delusi.ko: 파자르 말로는 망상이 심한 환자는 보통 정신과 의사에게서 약을 받는대요.

w|delusi.text: Lestari bilang target penjualan bos sudah seperti delusi.
w|delusi.en: Lestari says the boss's sales target is practically a delusion.
w|delusi.ko: 레스타리는 사장의 판매 목표가 거의 망상 수준이라고 해요.

w|demam.text: Anaknya demam tinggi sejak tadi malam.
w|demam.en: Her child has had a high fever since last night.

w|demam.text: Demam membuatnya tidak bisa masuk kerja.
w|demam.en: The fever kept him from going to work.
w|demam.ko: 열 때문에 그는 출근을 못 했어.

w|demi.en: I swear to God, I'm honest.

w|demikian.en: That concludes the announcement from the committee.

w|demikian.text: Jika demikian, kita harus pergi sekarang.
w|demikian.en: If so, we have to leave now.

w|demokrasi.text: Pemilihan ketua OSIS mengajarkan Agus tentang demokrasi.
w|demokrasi.en: The student council election taught Agus about democracy.
w|demokrasi.ko: 학생회장 선거를 통해 아구스는 민주주의를 배웠어요.

w|demokrasi.text: Klub renang Wati memilih ketua baru dengan cara demokrasi.
w|demokrasi.en: Wati's swimming club chose a new leader democratically.
w|demokrasi.ko: 와티의 수영 클럽은 민주적인 방식으로 새 회장을 뽑았어요.

w|demokrat.text: Dimas membaca surat seorang demokrat yang memperjuangkan pemilu bebas.
w|demokrat.en: Dimas read a letter by a democrat who fought for free elections.
w|demokrat.ko: 디마스는 자유 선거를 위해 싸운 한 민주주의자의 편지를 읽었어요.

w|demokrat.text: Pembeli tua itu menyebut dirinya demokrat sejati dan senang berdebat dengan Putri.
w|demokrat.en: The elderly customer calls himself a true democrat and loves debating with Putri.
w|demokrat.ko: 그 나이 든 손님은 자신을 진정한 민주주의자라 부르며 푸트리와 토론하길 좋아해요.

w|demonstrasi.text: Naskah Eko terinspirasi dari demonstrasi mahasiswa di masa lalu.
w|demonstrasi.en: Eko's script was inspired by student demonstrations of the past.
w|demonstrasi.ko: 에코의 대본은 과거 학생 시위에서 영감을 받았어요.

w|demonstrasi.text: Penyuluh kesehatan memberi demonstrasi cara mencuci tangan yang benar di balai desa.
w|demonstrasi.en: A health worker gave a demonstration of proper handwashing at the village hall.
w|demonstrasi.ko: 보건 요원이 마을 회관에서 올바른 손 씻기 시범을 보였어요.

w|denda.text: Penonton yang merokok di dalam gedung bisa kena denda.
w|denda.en: Audience members who smoke inside the building can be fined.
w|denda.ko: 건물 안에서 담배를 피우는 관객은 벌금을 낼 수 있어요.

w|denda.text: Siapa pun yang menebang pohon di hutan lindung harus membayar denda.
w|denda.en: Anyone who cuts down trees in the protected forest must pay a fine.
w|denda.ko: 보호림에서 나무를 베는 사람은 누구든 벌금을 내야 해요.

w|denyut.text: Dimas memeriksa denyut jantung kucing tua itu dengan stetoskop.
w|denyut.en: Dimas checked the old cat's heartbeat with a stethoscope.
w|denyut.ko: 디마스는 청진기로 늙은 고양이의 심장 박동을 확인했어요.

w|denyut.text: Alat sensor itu mencatat denyut jantung tikus percobaan setiap detik.
w|denyut.en: The sensor records the lab mouse's heartbeat every second.
w|denyut.ko: 그 센서는 실험용 쥐의 심장 박동을 매초 기록해요.

w|depan.en: Wait in front of the shop.
There's a car in front of the house.

w|depresi.text: Poster di dinding klinik menjelaskan bahwa depresi juga bisa membuat orang malas merawat gigi.
w|depresi.en: A poster on the clinic wall explains that depression can also make people neglect their teeth.
w|depresi.ko: 치과 벽 포스터에는 우울증 때문에 이 관리를 소홀히 할 수도 있다고 쓰여 있어요.

w|depresi.text: Pemilik lama rumah itu dulu pernah berjuang melawan depresi, kata tetangga.
w|depresi.en: According to the neighbours, the house's previous owner once struggled with depression.
w|depresi.ko: 이웃들 말로는 그 집 예전 주인이 한때 우울증과 싸웠대요.

w|deputi.text: Kemarin deputi manajer gedung datang sendiri untuk memeriksa kerusakan di unit Bayu.
w|deputi.en: Yesterday the deputy building manager came in person to check the damage in Bayu's unit.
w|deputi.ko: 어제 건물 부관리자가 바유네 집 고장 난 곳을 직접 보러 왔어요.

w|deputi.text: Di gerbong eksekutif, Intan duduk di samping deputi gubernur.
w|deputi.en: In the executive carriage, Intan sat next to the deputy governor.

w|derajat.text: Suhu naik beberapa derajat hari ini.
w|derajat.en: The temperature rose several degrees today.
His degree of patience is almost gone.

w|deras.text: Hujan deras turun tiba-tiba, dan Eko meniup peluit agar semua orang keluar dari air.
w|deras.en: Heavy rain suddenly fell, and Eko blew his whistle so everyone would get out of the water.
w|deras.ko: 갑자기 폭우가 쏟아지자 에코는 모두 물에서 나오라고 호루라기를 불었어요.

w|deras.text: Hujan deras membuat Ayu datang terlambat ke janji dengan dokter gigi.
w|deras.en: Heavy rain made Ayu late for her dentist appointment.
w|deras.ko: 폭우 때문에 아유는 치과 예약에 늦었어요.

w|dermaga.text: Agus dan teman-temannya menunggu kapal feri di dermaga Merak.
w|dermaga.en: Agus and his friends waited for the ferry at Merak pier.
w|dermaga.ko: 아구스와 친구들은 메락 부두에서 페리를 기다렸어요.

w|dermaga.text: Toko cabang baru tempat Wati bekerja ada di dekat dermaga.
w|dermaga.en: The new branch where Wati works is near the pier.
w|dermaga.ko: 와티가 일하는 새 지점은 부두 근처에 있어요.

w|dermawan.text: Pak Haji di sebelah rumah Andi terkenal dermawan kepada anak-anak yatim.
w|dermawan.en: Pak Haji next to Andi's house is known for being generous to orphans.
w|dermawan.ko: 안디네 옆집 하지 아저씨는 고아들에게 후하기로 유명해요.

w|dermawan.text: Nama-nama penyumbang dermawan terukir di dinding dekat pintu tempat Dewi berdiri.
w|dermawan.en: The names of generous donors are engraved on the wall by the door where Dewi stood.
w|dermawan.ko: 데위가 서 있던 문 옆 벽에는 후한 기부자들의 이름이 새겨져 있었어요.

w|desain.text: Rudi kagum pada desain gedung museum yang meniru rumah adat.
w|desain.en: Rudi admired the design of the museum building, which imitates a traditional house.
w|desain.ko: 루디는 전통 가옥을 본뜬 박물관 건물 디자인에 감탄했어요.

w|desain.text: Bangunan pasar yang baru punya desain terbuka supaya udara mengalir.
w|desain.en: The new market building has an open design so the air can flow.
w|desain.ko: 새 시장 건물은 바람이 잘 통하게 트인 구조로 설계됐어요.

w|desainer.text: Seorang desainer muda membantu Fajar merapikan tata letak artikelnya.
w|desainer.en: A young designer helped Fajar tidy up the layout of his article.
w|desainer.ko: 젊은 디자이너가 파자르의 기사 레이아웃 정리를 도와줬어요.

w|desainer.text: Di warung kopi, Lestari mengobrol dengan seorang desainer interior yang juga sedang berlibur.
w|desainer.en: At a coffee stall, Lestari chatted with an interior designer who was also on holiday.
w|desainer.ko: 커피 노점에서 레스타리는 마찬가지로 휴가 중인 인테리어 디자이너와 이야기를 나눴어요.

w|desas-desus.text: Di belakang panggung beredar desas-desus bahwa pemeran utama akan pindah ke film.
w|desas-desus.en: Rumors went around backstage that the lead actor would move to film.
w|desas-desus.ko: 무대 뒤에서는 주연 배우가 영화로 옮긴다는 소문이 돌았어요.

w|desas-desus.text: Para penumpang membicarakan desas-desus tentang kenaikan harga tiket kereta.
w|desas-desus.en: The passengers talked about rumors of a train fare increase.
w|desas-desus.ko: 승객들은 기차표 값이 오른다는 소문을 이야기했어요.

w|desember.text: Hujan paling deras biasanya terjadi pada bulan Desember.
w|desember.en: The heaviest rain usually comes in December.
w|desember.ko: 가장 센 비는 보통 십이월에 내려요.

w|desember.text: Syuting harus selesai sebelum bulan Desember karena aktor utama punya proyek lain.
w|desember.en: The shoot has to finish before December because the lead actor has another project.
w|desember.ko: 주연 배우가 다른 작품이 있어서 촬영은 십이월 전에 끝나야 해요.

w|deskripsi.text: Di brosur gym ada deskripsi singkat tentang setiap kelas.
w|deskripsi.en: The gym brochure has a short description of each class.
w|deskripsi.ko: 헬스장 안내서에는 수업마다 짧은 설명이 있어요.

w|deskripsi.text: Intan membaca deskripsi setiap hidangan sebelum memesan.
w|deskripsi.en: Intan reads the description of each dish before ordering.
w|deskripsi.ko: 인탄은 주문하기 전에 요리마다 설명을 읽어요.

w|detail.text: Rudi memakai kaca pembesar untuk melihat detail ukiran pada perahu miniatur.
w|detail.en: Rudi used a magnifying glass to see the detail of the carving on the miniature boat.
w|detail.ko: 루디는 돋보기로 미니어처 배에 새긴 조각을 자세히 봤어요.

w|detail.text: Rina memperhatikan setiap detail pada kain yang dijual, dari jahitan sampai warnanya.
w|detail.en: Rina pays attention to every detail of the cloth on sale, from the stitching to the color.
w|detail.ko: 리나는 파는 천의 바느질부터 색깔까지 하나하나 꼼꼼히 봐요.

w|detak.text: Agus bisa merasakan detak jantungnya makin cepat saat bor dinyalakan.
w|detak.en: Agus could feel his heartbeat getting faster when the drill was switched on.
w|detak.ko: 드릴이 켜지자 아구스는 심장 박동이 빨라지는 걸 느꼈어요.

w|detak.text: Di malam yang sepi, Wati bisa mendengar detak jam dinding tua dari dapur.
w|detak.en: On quiet nights, Wati can hear the ticking of the old wall clock from the kitchen.
w|detak.ko: 조용한 밤이면 와티는 부엌에서 낡은 벽시계 똑딱거리는 소리를 들을 수 있어요.

w|detektif.en: That detective is investigating the case.
He wants to become a detective.

w|detektor.text: Andi memakai detektor logam untuk mencari kabel di dalam tanah.
w|detektor.en: Andi uses a metal detector to look for cables underground.
w|detektor.ko: 안디는 금속 탐지기로 땅속 전선을 찾아요.

w|detektor.text: Di pintu masuk gedung, Dewi harus melewati detektor logam.
w|detektor.en: At the building entrance, Dewi had to go through a metal detector.
w|detektor.ko: 데위는 건물 입구에서 금속 탐지기를 통과해야 했어요.

w|dewa.en: That god is depicted as strong.

w|dewan.text: Dewan kota mengadakan rapat malam ini.
w|dewan.en: The city council is holding a meeting tonight.
He became a member of the school board.

w|dewasa.en: That child is already grown up.

w|dewi.text: Patung dewi berdiri di tengah taman.
w|dewi.en: A statue of a goddess stands in the middle of the park.
w|dewi.ko: 여신 조각상이 공원 한가운데 서 있어.

w|dewi.text: Dewi dalam mitos itu menjaga sungai suci.
w|dewi.en: The goddess in that myth guards the sacred river.
w|dewi.ko: 그 신화의 여신은 성스러운 강을 지켜.

w|dialog.text: Eko menulis dialog pendek untuk drama bahasa Indonesia.
w|dialog.en: Eko wrote a short dialogue for the Indonesian-language play.
w|dialog.ko: 에코는 인도네시아어 연극에 쓸 짧은 대화문을 썼어요.

w|dialog.text: Lewat dialog dengan gurunya, Ayu menemukan gaya melukis sendiri.
w|dialog.en: Through conversations with her teacher, Ayu found her own painting style.
w|dialog.ko: 선생님과 대화를 나누면서 아유는 자기만의 그림 스타일을 찾았어요.

w|diam.en: Please be quiet for a moment.

w|diam-diam.text: Dia diam-diam menyiapkan kejutan ulang tahun.
w|diam-diam.en: She secretly prepared a birthday surprise.
w|diam-diam.ko: 그녀는 몰래 생일 깜짝 선물을 준비했어.

w|diare.text: Oralit adalah obat pertama yang Fajar sarankan untuk diare.
w|diare.en: Oral rehydration salts are the first thing Fajar recommends for diarrhea.
w|diare.ko: 파자르가 설사에 가장 먼저 권하는 건 경구 수액염이에요.

w|diare.text: Rekan baru itu izin pulang lebih awal karena diare.
w|diare.en: The new coworker asked to go home early because of diarrhea.
w|diare.ko: 새 동료는 설사 때문에 일찍 퇴근하겠다고 했어요.

w|diatas.en: That book is lying on the table.
Above the mountain the air is very cold.

w|dibanding.text: Harga ini lebih murah dibanding toko lain.
w|dibanding.en: This price is cheaper compared to other stores.

w|dibanding.text: Dibanding kemarin, hari ini lebih sejuk.
w|dibanding.en: Compared to yesterday, today is cooler.

w|didalam.en: There's a letter inside the box.

w|diet.text: Dimas menyarankan diet rendah lemak untuk kucing yang terlalu gemuk.
w|diet.en: Dimas recommended a low-fat diet for the overweight cat.
w|diet.ko: 디마스는 너무 뚱뚱한 고양이에게 저지방 식단을 권했어요.

w|diet.text: Putri sedang menguji pengaruh diet tinggi gula pada lalat buah.
w|diet.en: Putri is testing the effect of a high-sugar diet on fruit flies.
w|diet.ko: 푸트리는 고당분 식단이 초파리에 미치는 영향을 실험하고 있어요.

w|dikarenakan.text: Pekerjaan atap ditunda dikarenakan hujan turun setiap sore.
w|dikarenakan.en: The roof work was postponed because it rained every afternoon.
w|dikarenakan.ko: 매일 오후 비가 와서 지붕 공사가 미뤄졌어요.

w|dikarenakan.text: Kereta terlambat satu jam dikarenakan ada perbaikan rel.
w|dikarenakan.en: The train was an hour late due to track repairs.
w|dikarenakan.ko: 선로 보수 때문에 열차가 한 시간 늦었어요.

w|diktator.text: Ruang sejarah menampilkan surat kabar lama yang mengkritik seorang diktator.
w|diktator.en: The history room displays old newspapers criticizing a dictator.
w|diktator.ko: 역사 전시실에는 한 독재자를 비판한 옛 신문이 전시돼 있어요.

w|diktator.text: Aktor yang memerankan diktator itu ternyata sangat ramah di luar kamera.
w|diktator.en: The actor playing the dictator turned out to be very friendly off camera.
w|diktator.ko: 독재자 역을 맡은 배우는 카메라 밖에서는 아주 다정했어요.

w|dilarang.en: Smoking is forbidden inside the building.

w|dilarang.text: Parkir di sini dilarang pada malam hari.
w|dilarang.en: Parking here is forbidden at night.

w|dimensi.text: Buku pop-up itu membuat gambar gedung terlihat tiga dimensi.
w|dimensi.en: The pop-up book makes the pictures of buildings look three-dimensional.
w|dimensi.ko: 그 팝업북은 건물 그림을 입체로 보이게 해요.

w|dimensi.text: Putri menonton film tentang perjalanan antar-dimensi di ponselnya.
w|dimensi.en: Putri watched a film about travelling between dimensions on her phone.
w|dimensi.ko: 푸트리는 휴대폰으로 차원을 넘나드는 여행 영화를 봤어요.

w|dinamit.text: Dalam pameran sejarah, Fajar melihat foto lama jembatan kota yang dulu diledakkan dengan dinamit.
w|dinamit.en: At the history exhibition, Fajar saw an old photo of the city bridge that was once blown up with dynamite.
w|dinamit.ko: 역사 전시회에서 파자르는 예전에 다이너마이트로 폭파된 시 다리의 옛 사진을 봤어요.

w|dinamit.text: Lestari menulis bahwa nelayan di desanya dulu menangkap ikan dengan dinamit sebelum hal itu dilarang keras.
w|dinamit.en: Lestari wrote that fishermen in her village used to fish with dynamite before it was strictly banned.
w|dinamit.ko: 레스타리는 마을 어부들이 엄격히 금지되기 전에는 다이너마이트로 고기를 잡았다고 썼어요.

w|dinas.text: Budi menelepon dinas kesehatan untuk memastikan jumlah pasien demam berdarah.
w|dinas.en: Budi called the health department to confirm the number of dengue patients.
w|dinas.ko: 부디는 뎅기열 환자 수를 확인하려고 보건소에 전화했어요.

w|dinas.text: Perpustakaan itu berada di bawah dinas pendidikan kota.
w|dinas.en: The library is under the city's education office.

w|dinasti.text: Dimas membuat garis waktu dinasti kerajaan Tiongkok untuk tugas sejarah.
w|dinasti.en: Dimas made a timeline of Chinese royal dynasties for a history assignment.
w|dinasti.ko: 디마스는 역사 과제로 중국 왕조 연표를 만들었어요.

w|dinasti.text: Dinding restoran Putri dihias lukisan raja-raja dari dinasti lama.
w|dinasti.en: The walls of Putri's restaurant are decorated with paintings of kings from old dynasties.
w|dinasti.ko: 푸트리네 식당 벽은 옛 왕조 왕들의 그림으로 꾸며져 있어요.

w|dinding.en: Hang the photo on the wall.

w|dingin.en: The weather today is very cold.

w|dini.text: Pada dini hari, udara di desa Budi terasa sangat dingin.
w|dini.en: In the early hours, the air in Budi's village feels very cold.
w|dini.ko: 새벽에는 부디네 마을 공기가 아주 차가워요.

w|dini.text: Siti sudah harus berdandan sejak dini hari untuk adegan matahari terbit.
w|dini.en: Siti had to get made up from the early hours for the sunrise scene.
w|dini.ko: 해돋이 장면 때문에 시티는 새벽부터 분장을 해야 했어요.

w|dinosaurus.text: Anak-anak membangun patung dinosaurus dari pasir di dekat Eko.
w|dinosaurus.en: The children built a sand dinosaur near Eko.
w|dinosaurus.ko: 아이들이 에코 근처에서 모래로 공룡 조각을 만들었어요.

w|dinosaurus.text: Ayu menghadiahi anak tetangga buku bergambar tentang dinosaurus.
w|dinosaurus.en: Ayu gave the neighbor's child a picture book about dinosaurs.
w|dinosaurus.ko: 아유는 이웃 아이에게 공룡 그림책을 선물했어요.

w|diperbolehkan.text: Pengunjung diperbolehkan masuk setelah jam buka.
w|diperbolehkan.en: Visitors are allowed in after opening time.
w|diperbolehkan.ko: 방문객은 개장 후에 들어갈 수 있어.

w|diperbolehkan.text: Anak-anak tidak diperbolehkan bermain di sini.
w|diperbolehkan.en: Children are not allowed to play here.

w|diplomatik.text: Bayu meliput pertemuan diplomatik antara dua menteri luar negeri di hotel pusat kota.
w|diplomatik.en: Bayu covered a diplomatic meeting between two foreign ministers at a downtown hotel.
w|diplomatik.ko: 바유는 도심 호텔에서 열린 두 외무장관의 외교 회담을 취재했어요.

w|diplomatik.text: Seorang tamu dari kedutaan menginap di desa Intan dengan paspor diplomatik.
w|diplomatik.en: A guest from an embassy stayed in Intan's village with a diplomatic passport.
w|diplomatik.ko: 대사관에서 온 손님이 외교 여권을 들고 인탄네 마을에 묵었어요.

w|dirawat.text: Teman Agus sempat dirawat di puskesmas karena keracunan makanan.
w|dirawat.en: Agus's friend was briefly treated at the community clinic for food poisoning.
w|dirawat.ko: 아구스의 친구는 식중독으로 보건소에서 잠깐 치료를 받았어요.

w|dirawat.text: Rekan kerja Wati sedang dirawat di rumah sakit, jadi Wati menggantikan jadwalnya.
w|dirawat.en: Wati's coworker is in the hospital, so Wati is covering her shifts.
w|dirawat.ko: 와티의 동료가 입원해 있어서 와티가 대신 근무하고 있어요.

w|direksi.text: Laporan kemajuan proyek dikirim Andi kepada direksi setiap akhir bulan.
w|direksi.en: Andi sends the project progress report to the board of directors at the end of every month.
w|direksi.ko: 안디는 매달 말 공사 진행 보고서를 경영진에게 보내요.

w|direksi.text: Teman lama Dewi sekarang duduk di jajaran direksi sebuah bank.
w|direksi.en: Dewi's old friend now sits on the board of directors of a bank.
w|direksi.ko: 데위의 옛 친구는 지금 한 은행의 이사진에 있어요.

w|direktur.text: Direktur memanggil seluruh staf ke ruang rapat.
w|direktur.en: The director called all staff to the meeting room.

w|direktur.text: Dia baru saja diangkat menjadi direktur.

w|disahkan.text: Rudi memberi tahu para pengendara bahwa aturan baru tentang helm sudah disahkan.
w|disahkan.en: Rudi told the riders that the new helmet rule had been passed.
w|disahkan.ko: 루디는 운전자들에게 헬멧에 관한 새 규정이 통과됐다고 알렸어요.

w|disahkan.text: Rina senang undang-undang perlindungan hewan akhirnya disahkan.
w|disahkan.en: Rina is glad the animal protection law was finally passed.
w|disahkan.ko: 리나는 동물 보호법이 마침내 통과돼서 기뻐요.

w|disengaja.text: Polisi masih menyelidiki apakah kebakaran pasar itu disengaja atau tidak.
w|disengaja.en: The police are still investigating whether the market fire was deliberate.
w|disengaja.ko: 경찰은 시장 화재가 고의였는지 아직 조사하고 있어요.

w|disengaja.text: Intan menegaskan bahwa bug itu tidak disengaja dan langsung diperbaiki.
w|disengaja.en: Intan made it clear that the bug wasn't intentional and was fixed right away.
w|disengaja.ko: 인탄은 그 버그가 고의가 아니었고 바로 고쳤다고 분명히 했어요.

w|disiplin.text: Pelatih pramuka sangat menekankan disiplin waktu.
w|disiplin.en: The scout leader puts a strong emphasis on punctuality.
w|disiplin.ko: 스카우트 지도자는 시간 규율을 아주 강조해요.

w|disiplin.text: Siti berterima kasih kepada guru yang dulu mengajarinya disiplin belajar.
w|disiplin.en: Siti thanked the teacher who once taught her study discipline.
w|disiplin.ko: 시티는 예전에 공부하는 습관을 길러 준 선생님께 감사 인사를 했어요.

w|disitu.en: There is an empty seat over there.

w|disitu.text: Kami menunggu disitu sampai hujan reda.
w|disitu.en: We waited over there until the rain stopped.
w|disitu.ko: 비가 그칠 때까지 우리는 저기서 기다렸어.

w|diskon.text: Menjelang sore, banyak pedagang memberi diskon supaya barangnya cepat habis.
w|diskon.en: Toward evening, many traders give discounts so their goods sell out quickly.
w|diskon.ko: 오후 늦게가 되면 많은 상인들이 물건을 빨리 팔려고 할인을 해 줘요.

w|diskon.text: Intan mendapat diskon besar karena memesan katering jauh-jauh hari.
w|diskon.en: Intan got a big discount because she booked the catering well in advance.
w|diskon.ko: 인탄은 케이터링을 일찍 예약해서 크게 할인받았어요.

w|diskors.text: Eko mendengar pelayan yang sering terlambat itu diskors seminggu.
w|diskors.en: Eko heard that the waiter who was often late had been suspended for a week.
w|diskors.ko: 에코는 자주 지각하던 종업원이 일주일 정직을 받았다고 들었어요.

w|diskors.text: Ayu kecewa pertandingan bola di kampus diskors karena lapangan tergenang.
w|diskors.en: Ayu was disappointed that the campus football match was suspended because the field was flooded.
w|diskors.ko: 아유는 운동장이 물에 잠겨 학교 축구 경기가 중단돼서 실망했어요.

w|distribusi.text: Andi mengatur distribusi semen ke setiap blok bangunan.
w|distribusi.en: Andi organizes the distribution of cement to each building block.
w|distribusi.ko: 안디는 동마다 시멘트를 나눠 보내는 일을 맡고 있어요.

w|distribusi.text: Teman Dewi yang bekerja di bagian distribusi sering pindah kota.
w|distribusi.en: Dewi's friend who works in distribution often moves from city to city.
w|distribusi.ko: 유통 부서에서 일하는 데위의 친구는 자주 다른 도시로 옮겨 다녀요.

w|distrik.text: Pengadilan distrik itu menangani ratusan perkara setiap tahun.
w|distrik.en: That district court handles hundreds of cases every year.
w|distrik.ko: 그 지방 법원은 해마다 수백 건의 사건을 처리해요.

w|distrik.text: Pemasok dari distrik sebelah datang mengantar telur dua kali seminggu.
w|distrik.en: A supplier from the next district comes to deliver eggs twice a week.
w|distrik.ko: 옆 지역 납품업자가 일주일에 두 번 달걀을 배달하러 와요.

w|ditakdirkan.text: Kisah itu seolah ditakdirkan berakhir bahagia.
w|ditakdirkan.en: That story seems destined to end happily.
w|ditakdirkan.ko: 그 이야기는 행복하게 끝나도록 운명인 듯해.

w|diundang.text: Kami diundang ke pernikahan teman lama.
w|diundang.en: We were invited to an old friend's wedding.

w|diundang.text: Dia diundang berbicara di konferensi itu.
w|diundang.en: He was invited to speak at that conference.

w|divisi.en: The sales division hit the monthly target.

w|divisi.text: Dia pindah ke divisi baru minggu ini.
w|divisi.en: She moved to a new division this week.
w|divisi.ko: 그녀는 이번 주에 새 부서로 옮겼어.

w|doa.text: Ibunya mengirim doa sebelum dia berangkat.
w|doa.en: His mother sent a prayer before he left.
w|doa.ko: 어머니가 그가 떠나기 전에 기도를 보냈어.

w|doa.en: That short prayer calmed her heart.
w|doa.ko: 그 짧은 기도가 마음을 가라앉혀 주었어.

w|dobel.text: Karena salah cetak, berita yang sama muncul dobel di halaman tiga.
w|dobel.en: Because of a printing error, the same story appeared twice on page three.
w|dobel.ko: 인쇄 실수로 같은 기사가 삼 면에 두 번 실렸어요.

w|dobel.text: Intan kaget karena tagihan kartunya terpotong dobel untuk satu pesanan.
w|dobel.en: Intan was shocked because her card was charged twice for one order.
w|dobel.ko: 인탄은 주문 하나에 카드 대금이 두 번 빠져나가서 놀랐어요.

w|dokter.en: I have to see a doctor.

w|doktor.text: Salah satu pelanggan tetap restoran itu seorang doktor ekonomi yang selalu memesan sup buntut.
w|doktor.en: One of the restaurant's regulars is a doctor of economics who always orders oxtail soup.
w|doktor.ko: 그 식당 단골 중 한 명은 늘 꼬리곰탕을 시키는 경제학 박사예요.

w|doktor.text: Di lapak jas bekas, Lestari menemukan toga doktor yang masih rapi.
w|doktor.en: At the used-suit stall, Lestari found a doctoral gown still in good shape.
w|doktor.ko: 중고 양복 노점에서 레스타리는 아직 깔끔한 박사 가운을 찾았어요.

w|dokumen.text: Dokumen itu hilang di meja kerja.
w|dokumen.en: That document went missing on the desk.

w|dokumen.text: Tolong simpan dokumen di folder aman.
w|dokumen.en: Please keep the document in a safe folder.
w|dokumen.ko: 그 문서를 안전한 폴더에 보관해 줘.

w|dokumenter.text: Sebuah tim film membuat dokumenter tentang pekerjaan Fajar dan rekan-rekannya di balai kota.
w|dokumenter.en: A film team made a documentary about the work of Fajar and his colleagues at city hall.
w|dokumenter.ko: 한 영화팀이 시청에서 일하는 파자르와 동료들에 대한 다큐멘터리를 만들었어요.

w|dokumenter.text: Lestari merekomendasikan sebuah dokumenter tentang penyu yang ditontonnya minggu lalu.
w|dokumenter.en: Lestari recommended a documentary about sea turtles she had watched last week.
w|dokumenter.ko: 레스타리는 지난주에 본 바다거북 다큐멘터리를 추천했어요.

w|dolar.en: The price is a hundred dollars.

w|domba.text: Domba itu makan rumput di padang.
w|domba.en: That sheep is eating grass in the field.
w|domba.ko: 그 양이 들판에서 풀을 먹고 있어.

w|domba.en: The farmer cares for a flock of sheep.

w|domestik.text: Sebagian besar pengunjung museum adalah wisatawan domestik dari kota-kota sekitar.
w|domestik.en: Most of the museum's visitors are domestic tourists from nearby cities.
w|domestik.ko: 박물관 관람객 대부분은 주변 도시에서 온 국내 관광객이에요.

w|domestik.text: Film ini akan tayang di bioskop domestik sebelum dibawa ke festival luar negeri.
w|domestik.en: This film will be shown in domestic cinemas before being taken to festivals abroad.
w|domestik.ko: 이 영화는 해외 영화제에 가기 전에 국내 극장에서 먼저 개봉해요.

w|dominan.text: Budi mencatat bahwa tangan kiri adalah tangan dominan pasien itu.
w|dominan.en: Budi noted that the left hand is that patient's dominant hand.

w|dominan.text: Siti memperhatikan warna biru yang dominan di desain terminal baru itu.
w|dominan.en: Siti noticed the blue that dominates the design of the new terminal.
w|dominan.ko: 시티는 새 터미널 디자인에 파란색이 두드러진다는 걸 알아챘어요.

w|dompet.text: Dia lupa membawa dompet ke kantor.
w|dompet.en: He forgot to bring his wallet to the office.
w|dompet.ko: 그는 지갑을 사무실에 가져가는 걸 잊었어.

w|dompet.text: Dompet hitam itu jatuh di bawah kursi.
w|dompet.en: That black wallet fell under the chair.
w|dompet.ko: 그 검은 지갑이 의자 아래로 떨어졌어.

w|donasi.text: Teater kecil itu bertahan berkat donasi dari para penonton setia.
w|donasi.en: The small theater survives thanks to donations from loyal audience members.
w|donasi.ko: 그 작은 극장은 충실한 관객들의 기부 덕분에 버티고 있어요.

w|donasi.text: Stasiun itu menyediakan kotak donasi untuk korban banjir.
w|donasi.en: The station provides a donation box for flood victims.
w|donasi.ko: 그 역에는 홍수 피해자를 위한 기부함이 있어요.

w|donat.text: Andi menaburkan gula halus di atas donat yang masih hangat.
w|donat.en: Andi sprinkled powdered sugar on the still-warm doughnuts.
w|donat.ko: 안디는 아직 따뜻한 도넛 위에 슈가파우더를 뿌렸어요.

w|donat.text: Rani bercerita bahwa toko donat langganan mereka sudah tutup.
w|donat.en: Rani wrote that their favorite doughnut shop has closed.
w|donat.ko: 라니는 둘이 자주 가던 도넛 가게가 문을 닫았다고 했어요.

w|dong.text: Ceritakan saja dong apa yang terjadi.
w|dong.en: Just tell me what happened, okay?

w|dongeng.en: Grandma reads a fairy tale before bedtime.
w|dongeng.ko: 할머니가 자기 전에 동화를 읽어 줘.

w|dongeng.text: Dongeng itu mengajarkan kejujuran kepada anak.
w|dongeng.en: That fairy tale teaches honesty to children.

w|dorongan.text: Berkat dorongan redakturnya, Eko berani menulis kolom opini pertamanya.
w|dorongan.en: Thanks to his editor's encouragement, Eko dared to write his first opinion column.
w|dorongan.ko: 편집장의 격려 덕분에 에코는 첫 칼럼을 쓸 용기를 냈어요.

w|dorongan.text: Ayu membuka toko sendiri berkat dorongan ayahnya.
w|dorongan.en: Ayu opened her own shop thanks to her father's encouragement.
w|dorongan.ko: 아유는 아버지의 응원 덕분에 자기 가게를 열었어요.

w|dosa.en: He feels he carries a great sin.
w|dosa.ko: 그는 큰 죄를 지고 있다고 느껴.

w|dosen.text: Dulu Rudi belajar memasak dari seorang dosen tata boga yang galak.
w|dosen.en: Rudi once learned to cook from a strict culinary arts lecturer.
w|dosen.ko: 루디는 예전에 엄격한 조리학과 교수에게 요리를 배웠어요.

w|dosen.text: Pelanggan setia Rina adalah seorang dosen sastra yang mencari buku langka.
w|dosen.en: Rina's loyal customer is a literature lecturer who hunts for rare books.
w|dosen.ko: 리나의 단골은 희귀본을 찾아다니는 문학 교수예요.

w|dosis.text: Dimas menghitung dosis obat berdasarkan berat badan kelinci itu.
w|dosis.en: Dimas calculated the dose of medicine based on the rabbit's weight.
w|dosis.ko: 디마스는 토끼 몸무게에 맞춰 약 용량을 계산했어요.

w|dosis.text: Tim Putri mencoba dosis yang lebih rendah pada percobaan berikutnya.
w|dosis.en: Putri's team tried a lower dose in the next experiment.
w|dosis.ko: 푸트리 팀은 다음 실험에서 더 낮은 용량을 시도했어요.

w|drama.en: They watched a Korean drama together.

w|dramatis.text: Adegan terakhir sangat dramatis sampai banyak penonton menangis.
w|dramatis.en: The final scene was so dramatic that many in the audience cried.
w|dramatis.ko: 마지막 장면이 너무 극적이어서 많은 관객이 울었어요.

w|dramatis.text: Penjualan kuartal ini naik secara dramatis berkat ide Intan.
w|dramatis.en: Sales this quarter rose dramatically thanks to Intan's idea.
w|dramatis.ko: 인탄의 아이디어 덕분에 이번 분기 매출이 크게 뛰었어요.

w|drastis.text: Kebiasaan tidur Dimas berubah drastis sejak ia mulai kerja kantoran.
w|drastis.en: Dimas's sleeping habits changed drastically once he started an office job.
w|drastis.ko: 디마스의 잠버릇은 회사에 다니기 시작하면서 확 바뀌었어요.

w|drastis.text: Harga tiket Putri naik drastis karena ia memesan di menit terakhir.
w|drastis.en: Putri's ticket price rose drastically because she booked at the last minute.
w|drastis.ko: 푸트리는 막판에 예약해서 표값이 크게 올랐어요.

w|drum.text: Andi menabuh drum di band sekolah saat pentas seni.
w|drum.en: Andi plays the drums in the school band at the arts show.
w|drum.ko: 안디는 예술제에서 학교 밴드의 드럼을 쳐요.

w|drum.text: Suara drum dari pawai di luar terdengar sampai ke bangsal.
w|drum.en: The sound of drums from the parade outside could be heard all the way to the ward.
w|drum.ko: 밖에서 열린 행진의 북소리가 병동까지 들렸어요.

w|dugaan.en: The police's initial suspicion turned out wrong.

w|dugaan.text: Menurut dugaan saya, dia akan terlambat.
w|dugaan.en: According to my guess, he will be late.

w|duit.text: Bayu bercanda bahwa duit di dompetnya selalu habis setiap kali ke pasar loak.
w|duit.en: Bayu joked that the cash in his wallet always runs out every time he goes to the flea market.
w|duit.ko: 바유는 벼룩시장에 갈 때마다 지갑 속 돈이 늘 바닥난다고 농담했어요.

w|duit.text: Tante Intan bilang tidak perlu repot, cukup kasih duit saja di amplop.
w|duit.en: Intan's aunt said there was no need to fuss; just put some cash in an envelope.
w|duit.ko: 인탄의 이모는 번거롭게 할 것 없이 봉투에 돈만 넣으면 된다고 했어요.

w|dukun.text: Nenek Fajar bercerita bahwa dulu orang sering bertanya pada dukun soal hari baik untuk menikah.
w|dukun.en: Fajar's grandmother says people used to ask a shaman about lucky days to marry.
w|dukun.ko: 파자르의 할머니는 옛날엔 결혼하기 좋은 날을 무당에게 묻곤 했다고 해요.

w|dukun.text: Dalam cerita rakyat, seorang dukun memanggil hujan setelah kemarau panjang.
w|dukun.en: In a folk tale, a shaman summons rain after a long drought.
w|dukun.ko: 민담에서 무당이 긴 가뭄 끝에 비를 불러요.

w|dukungan.ko: 가족의 지원이 그를 더 강하게 만들었어.

w|dukungan.text: Kami memberi dukungan penuh kepada tim.
w|dukungan.en: We give full support to the team.

w|duluan.text: Kamu duluan saja; aku menyusul nanti.
w|duluan.en: You go first; I'll follow later.
w|duluan.ko: 너 먼저 가; 나는 나중에 따라갈게.

w|duluan.text: Duluan dia sudah sampai di sana.

w|dungu.text: Dalam pidatonya, Fajar bercanda bahwa dulu ia merasa dungu setiap kali bicara dengan Rina.
w|dungu.en: In his speech, Fajar joked that he used to feel foolish every time he spoke to Rina.
w|dungu.ko: 파자르는 연설에서 예전엔 리나와 말할 때마다 바보가 된 기분이었다고 농담했어요.

w|dungu.text: Lestari merasa dungu karena lupa membawa payung di tengah musim hujan.
w|dungu.en: Lestari felt foolish for forgetting her umbrella in the middle of the rainy season.
w|dungu.ko: 레스타리는 한창 우기에 우산을 깜빡해서 바보가 된 기분이었어요.

w|duniawi.text: Lukisan itu menggambarkan seorang pertapa yang meninggalkan semua harta duniawi.
w|duniawi.en: The painting depicts a hermit who left behind all worldly possessions.
w|duniawi.ko: 그 그림은 세상의 모든 재물을 버린 수도자를 그렸어요.

w|duniawi.text: Film itu bercerita tentang biksu muda yang tergoda kesenangan duniawi.
w|duniawi.en: The film tells the story of a young monk tempted by worldly pleasures.
w|duniawi.ko: 그 영화는 세속의 즐거움에 끌리는 젊은 승려 이야기예요.

w|dupa.text: Asap dupa memenuhi panggung dalam adegan upacara di candi.
w|dupa.en: Incense smoke filled the stage in the temple ceremony scene.
w|dupa.ko: 사원 의식 장면에서 향 연기가 무대를 가득 채웠어요.

w|dupa.text: Dari jendela, Ayu mencium wangi dupa dari pura di dekat rel.
w|dupa.en: From the window, Ayu smelled incense from a temple near the tracks.
w|dupa.ko: 아유는 창문으로 선로 근처 사원에서 나는 향 냄새를 맡았어요.

w|duta.text: Sekolah Eko dikunjungi seorang duta besar yang bercerita tentang pekerjaannya.
w|duta.en: Eko's school was visited by an ambassador who talked about his work.
w|duta.ko: 에코네 학교에 대사 한 분이 와서 자기 일에 대해 이야기했어요.

w|duta.text: Waktu libur, Ayu menonton berita tentang duta lingkungan dari kampusnya.
w|duta.en: During the holiday, Ayu watched a news report about an environmental ambassador from her campus.
w|duta.ko: 방학 동안 아유는 자기 대학 출신 환경 홍보대사에 관한 뉴스를 봤어요.

w|edan.text: Dimas bilang antrean pameran baru itu benar-benar edan.
w|edan.en: Dimas said the line for the new exhibition was absolutely insane.
w|edan.ko: 디마스는 새 전시회 줄이 정말 미쳤다고 했어요.

w|edan.text: Harga tas kulit di lantai tiga itu edan, kata Putri sambil tertawa.
w|edan.en: The prices of the leather bags on the third floor are crazy, Putri said with a laugh.
w|edan.ko: 3층 가죽 가방 값이 미쳤다고 푸트리가 웃으며 말했어요.

w|efek.text: Obat itu punya efek samping ringan.
w|efek.en: That medicine has a mild side effect.

w|efek.text: Efek cahaya membuat foto lebih dramatis.
w|efek.en: The lighting effect makes the photo more dramatic.
w|efek.ko: 빛 효과가 사진을 더 극적으로 만들어.

w|efektif.text: Patroli malam terbukti efektif mengurangi pencurian di kampung Andi.
w|efektif.en: Night patrols have proven effective at reducing theft in Andi's neighborhood.
w|efektif.ko: 야간 순찰은 안디네 동네 도난을 줄이는 데 효과가 있었어요.

w|efektif.text: Pertahanan zona ternyata efektif menahan pemain tinggi lawan.
w|efektif.en: The zone defense turned out to be effective at stopping the opponent's tall players.
w|efektif.ko: 지역 방어가 상대 장신 선수를 막는 데 효과적이었어요.

w|efisien.text: Alat pengaduk semen yang baru jauh lebih efisien daripada yang lama.
w|efisien.en: The new cement mixer is much more efficient than the old one.
w|efisien.ko: 새 시멘트 믹서는 옛것보다 훨씬 효율적이에요.

w|efisien.text: Wati merasa belanja kebutuhan dapur secara daring lebih efisien daripada ke pasar.
w|efisien.en: Wati feels that buying kitchen supplies online is more efficient than going to the market.
w|efisien.ko: 와티는 부엌 살림을 온라인으로 사는 게 시장에 가는 것보다 효율적이라고 느껴요.

w|egois.text: Egois sekali kalau hanya memikirkan diri sendiri.
w|egois.en: It is so selfish to only think of yourself.

w|ejaan.text: Rudi memeriksa ejaan nama pelapor sebelum mencetak laporan.
w|ejaan.en: Rudi checked the spelling of the complainant's name before printing the report.
w|ejaan.ko: 루디는 신고서를 출력하기 전에 신고자 이름의 철자를 확인했어요.

w|ejaan.text: Rina membetulkan ejaan nama anjing di kartu pasien.
w|ejaan.en: Rina corrected the spelling of the dog's name on the patient card.
w|ejaan.ko: 리나는 진료 카드에 적힌 개 이름의 철자를 고쳤어요.

w|ejekan.text: Andi tidak peduli pada ejekan teman yang menyebutnya kutu buku.
w|ejekan.en: Andi doesn't care about the teasing from friends who call him a bookworm.
w|ejekan.ko: 안디는 자기를 책벌레라고 놀리는 친구들 말에 신경 쓰지 않아요.

w|ejekan.text: Dewi tidak menghiraukan ejekan kakaknya soal koleksi bonekanya yang dibawa pindah.
w|ejekan.en: Dewi ignored her brother's teasing about the doll collection she brought along.
w|ejekan.ko: 데위는 이삿짐에 넣은 인형 수집품을 두고 오빠가 놀려도 신경 쓰지 않았어요.

w|ekonomi.text: Ekonomi negara itu tumbuh stabil tahun ini.
w|ekonomi.en: That country's economy grew steadily this year.
w|ekonomi.ko: 그 나라 경제는 올해 안정적으로 성장했어.

w|ekonomi.text: Dia kuliah jurusan ekonomi di universitas.
w|ekonomi.en: She majors in economics at the university.

w|ekor.text: Kucing itu mengibas ekor dengan cepat.
w|ekor.en: That cat flicked its tail quickly.

w|ekor.text: Ekor ikan itu berwarna oranye cerah.
w|ekor.en: That fish's tail is bright orange.

w|eksekutif.text: Malam ini rombongan eksekutif bank memesan meja panjang di restoran tempat Fajar bekerja.
w|eksekutif.en: Tonight a group of bank executives booked a long table at the restaurant where Fajar works.
w|eksekutif.ko: 오늘 밤 은행 임원들이 파자르가 일하는 식당에 긴 테이블을 예약했어요.

w|eksekutif.text: Tas kulit yang dibeli Lestari tampaknya dulu milik seorang eksekutif.
w|eksekutif.en: The leather bag Lestari bought seems to have once belonged to an executive.
w|eksekutif.ko: 레스타리가 산 가죽 가방은 예전에 어느 임원의 것이었던 것 같아요.

w|eksklusif.text: Budi mengirim undangan eksklusif ke pameran lukisannya untuk Andi.
w|eksklusif.en: Budi sends Andi an exclusive invitation to his painting exhibition.
w|eksklusif.ko: 부디는 안디에게 자기 그림 전시회 특별 초대장을 보내요.

w|eksklusif.text: Pelari elite mendapat ruang istirahat eksklusif di dekat garis akhir.
w|eksklusif.en: Elite runners get an exclusive rest area near the finish line.
w|eksklusif.ko: 엘리트 주자들은 결승선 근처에 전용 휴게 공간을 받아요.

w|eksotis.text: Andi tertarik pada buku foto tentang pulau-pulau eksotis di Samudra Pasifik.
w|eksotis.en: Andi was drawn to a photo book about exotic islands in the Pacific Ocean.
w|eksotis.ko: 안디는 태평양의 이국적인 섬들을 담은 사진집에 끌렸어요.

w|eksotis.text: Dewi menggantung lukisan burung eksotis di ruang tamu rumah barunya.
w|eksotis.en: Dewi hung a painting of exotic birds in the living room of her new house.
w|eksotis.ko: 데위는 새집 거실에 이국적인 새 그림을 걸었어요.

w|ekspedisi.text: Teman-teman Bayu menyebut perjalanan mereka sebagai ekspedisi mencari sate terenak.
w|ekspedisi.en: Bayu's friends call their trip an expedition to find the tastiest satay.
w|ekspedisi.ko: 바유의 친구들은 이번 여행을 가장 맛있는 사테를 찾는 탐험이라고 불러요.

w|ekspedisi.text: Intan menggambar ulang foto ekspedisi lama ke kutub dari sebuah buku.
w|ekspedisi.en: Intan redrew an old photo of a polar expedition from a book.
w|ekspedisi.ko: 인탄은 책에 실린 옛 극지 탐험 사진을 다시 그렸어요.

w|eksperimen.text: Ahli forensik menjelaskan hasil eksperimen yang dilakukan di laboratorium.
w|eksperimen.en: The forensic expert explained the results of the experiment carried out in the lab.
w|eksperimen.ko: 법의학 전문가가 실험실에서 한 실험 결과를 설명했어요.

w|eksperimen.text: Anak Lestari membeli cuka dan soda kue untuk eksperimen di sekolah.
w|eksperimen.en: Lestari's child bought vinegar and baking soda for an experiment at school.
w|eksperimen.ko: 레스타리의 아이는 학교 실험에 쓸 식초와 베이킹소다를 샀어요.

w|ekspresi.text: Sutradara meminta Bayu memperbaiki ekspresi wajahnya di adegan sedih.
w|ekspresi.en: The director asked Bayu to work on his facial expression in the sad scene.
w|ekspresi.ko: 연출가는 바유에게 슬픈 장면에서 표정을 고치라고 했어요.

w|ekspresi.text: Dari ekspresi bosnya, Intan tahu rapat itu tidak berjalan lancar.
w|ekspresi.en: From her boss's expression, Intan knew the meeting hadn't gone well.
w|ekspresi.ko: 인탄은 상사의 표정을 보고 회의가 잘 안 풀렸다는 걸 알았어요.

w|ekstra.text: Menjelang tahun baru, polisi menambah penjagaan ekstra di jalan utama.
w|ekstra.en: Ahead of New Year, the police add extra guards on the main road.
w|ekstra.ko: 새해를 앞두고 경찰은 큰길에 경비를 더 세워요.

w|ekstra.text: Menjelang final, Dewi berlatih ekstra pada malam hari.
w|ekstra.en: Ahead of the final, Dewi does extra practice at night.
w|ekstra.ko: 결승을 앞두고 데위는 밤에 추가 훈련을 해요.

w|ekstradisi.text: Dimas membaca berita lama tentang ekstradisi pencuri yang menggondol lukisan museum.
w|ekstradisi.en: Dimas read an old news story about the extradition of the thief who made off with a museum painting.
w|ekstradisi.ko: 디마스는 박물관 그림을 훔쳐 간 도둑의 범죄인 인도에 관한 옛 기사를 읽었어요.

w|ekstradisi.text: Di ruang istirahat, Putri menonton berita tentang ekstradisi seorang pengusaha buronan.
w|ekstradisi.en: In the break room, Putri watched news about the extradition of a fugitive businessman.
w|ekstradisi.ko: 푸트리는 휴게실에서 도주한 사업가의 범죄인 인도 뉴스를 봤어요.

w|ekstraksi.text: Eko bereksperimen dengan ekstraksi rasa dari kulit udang untuk kaldu.
w|ekstraksi.en: Eko experiments with extracting flavor from shrimp shells for stock.
w|ekstraksi.ko: 에코는 새우 껍질에서 맛을 우려내 육수를 만드는 실험을 해요.

w|ekstraksi.text: Ayu belajar ekstraksi minyak dari daun cengkih di laboratorium.
w|ekstraksi.en: Ayu is learning to extract oil from clove leaves in the lab.
w|ekstraksi.ko: 아유는 실험실에서 정향 잎에서 기름을 추출하는 법을 배워요.

w|elang.text: Seekor elang terbang rendah mencari anak ayam di halaman Dimas.
w|elang.en: An eagle flew low looking for chicks in Dimas's yard.
w|elang.ko: 독수리 한 마리가 디마스네 마당에서 병아리를 찾으며 낮게 날았어요.

w|elang.text: Saat istirahat, Putri menonton video elang menangkap ikan.
w|elang.en: During her break, Putri watched a video of an eagle catching fish.
w|elang.ko: 쉬는 시간에 푸트리는 독수리가 물고기를 잡는 영상을 봤어요.

w|elegan.text: Kostum ratu dalam drama itu terlihat sangat elegan di bawah lampu panggung.
w|elegan.en: The queen's costume in the play looked very elegant under the stage lights.
w|elegan.ko: 그 연극의 여왕 의상은 무대 조명 아래에서 아주 우아해 보였어요.

w|elegan.text: Ayu menata etalase dengan rapi agar tokonya terlihat sedikit lebih elegan.
w|elegan.en: Ayu arranges the display case neatly so her shop looks a bit more elegant.
w|elegan.ko: 아유는 가게가 조금 더 고급스러워 보이도록 진열장을 깔끔하게 정리해요.

w|elektrik.text: Agus memainkan gitar elektrik dengan headphone agar tetangga tidak terganggu.
w|elektrik.en: Agus plays his electric guitar with headphones so the neighbors aren't disturbed.
w|elektrik.ko: 아구스는 이웃에게 방해가 안 되게 헤드폰을 끼고 일렉트릭 기타를 쳐요.

w|elektrik.text: Dapur Wati kini memakai panggangan elektrik agar tidak terlalu berasap.
w|elektrik.en: Wati's kitchen now uses an electric grill so it's not too smoky.
w|elektrik.ko: 와티네 주방은 연기가 덜 나도록 이제 전기 그릴을 써요.

w|elektronik.text: Musik pengiring drama itu dimainkan dengan alat musik elektronik.
w|elektronik.en: The play's accompanying music was performed on electronic instruments.
w|elektronik.ko: 그 연극의 반주는 전자 악기로 연주됐어요.

w|elektronik.text: Kantor Intan sekarang memakai tanda tangan elektronik untuk semua kontrak.
w|elektronik.en: Intan's office now uses electronic signatures for all contracts.
w|elektronik.ko: 인탄의 회사는 이제 모든 계약에 전자 서명을 써요.

w|elemen.text: Dimas mencari buku kimia tentang tabel elemen untuk tugas sekolah.
w|elemen.en: Dimas looked for a chemistry book about the table of elements for a school assignment.
w|elemen.ko: 디마스는 학교 숙제로 원소 주기율표에 관한 화학책을 찾았어요.

w|elemen.text: Lampu kereta mati karena salah satu elemen pemanas di gerbong terbakar.
w|elemen.en: The train lights went out because one of the heating elements in the carriage burned out.
w|elemen.ko: 객차의 전열 소자 하나가 타는 바람에 기차 불이 꺼졌어요.

w|elite.text: Bayu menulis tentang perumahan mewah yang hanya bisa dibeli kaum elite.
w|elite.en: Bayu wrote about luxury housing that only the elite can afford.
w|elite.ko: 바유는 상류층만 살 수 있는 고급 주택단지에 대해 썼어요.

w|elite.text: Intan tidak mau aplikasinya hanya dipakai kalangan elite di kota besar.
w|elite.en: Intan doesn't want her app to be used only by the elite in big cities.
w|elite.ko: 인탄은 자기 앱을 대도시 상류층만 쓰는 걸 원하지 않아요.

w|email.text: Saya mengirim email konfirmasi tadi pagi.
w|email.en: I sent a confirmation email this morning.
w|email.ko: 나는 오늘 아침 확인 이메일을 보냈어.

w|email.text: Email penting itu masuk ke folder spam.
w|email.en: That important email went into the spam folder.
w|email.ko: 그 중요한 이메일이 스팸 폴더로 들어갔어.

w|emas.en: That ring is made of gold.
The price of gold went up again.

w|ember.text: Saat hujan, Andi menaruh ember di bawah atap yang bocor.
w|ember.en: When it rains, Andi puts a bucket under the leaking roof.
w|ember.ko: 비가 오면 안디는 새는 지붕 아래에 양동이를 받쳐 둬요.

w|ember.text: Seorang ibu di peron membawa ember berisi ikan segar.
w|ember.en: A woman on the platform carries a bucket of fresh fish.
w|ember.ko: 승강장의 한 아주머니가 싱싱한 생선이 든 양동이를 들고 있어요.

w|embusan.text: Agus merapatkan jaket saat embusan angin dingin datang dari puncak.
w|embusan.en: Agus pulled his jacket tight when a gust of cold wind came down from the summit.
w|embusan.ko: 산꼭대기에서 찬바람이 불어오자 아구스는 재킷을 여몄어요.

w|embusan.text: Wati menulis bahwa setiap embusan angin laut mengingatkan dia pada sahabat lama.
w|embusan.en: Wati wrote that every breath of sea wind reminds her of her old friend.
w|embusan.ko: 와티는 바닷바람이 불 때마다 옛 친구가 생각난다고 썼어요.

w|emosi.en: He finds it hard to control his emotions.
Strong emotion showed on her face.

w|emosional.text: Pidato itu sangat emosional bagi para hadirin.
w|emosional.en: That speech was very emotional for the audience.

w|emosional.text: Dia menjadi emosional saat membaca surat itu.
w|emosional.en: She became emotional while reading that letter.
w|emosional.ko: 그는 그 편지를 읽으며 감정적이 됐어.

w|empuk.text: Perpustakaan kota baru saja mengganti kursi ruang baca dengan sofa empuk, dan Andi langsung betah.
