w|empuk.en: The city library has just replaced the reading-room chairs with soft sofas, and Andi felt at home right away.
w|empuk.ko: 시립 도서관이 열람실 의자를 푹신한 소파로 바꿔서 안디는 바로 편해졌어요.

w|empuk.text: Dewi membungkus vas bunga dengan kain empuk supaya tidak pecah di jalan.
w|empuk.en: Dewi wrapped the flower vase in soft cloth so it wouldn't break on the way.
w|empuk.ko: 데위는 꽃병이 가는 길에 깨지지 않게 푹신한 천으로 쌌어요.

w|enam.text: Ada enam kursi di ruangan itu.
w|enam.en: There are six chairs in that room.
w|enam.ko: 그 방에는 의자 여섯 개가 있어.

w|enam.text: Enam orang sudah menunggu di luar.
w|enam.en: Six people are already waiting outside.
w|enam.ko: 여섯 명이 이미 밖에서 기다리고 있어.

w|energi.text: Energi matahari bisa menghemat biaya listrik.
w|energi.en: Solar energy can save on electricity costs.
w|energi.ko: 태양 에너지로 전기세를 아낄 수 있어.

w|energi.text: Dia kehabisan energi setelah berlari jauh.
w|energi.en: He ran out of energy after running far.
w|energi.ko: 멀리 달린 뒤 그는 기운이 다 빠졌어.

w|enggan.text: Budi sempat enggan menulis karena takut surat itu tidak dibalas.
w|enggan.en: Budi was reluctant to write at first, afraid the letter wouldn't be answered.
w|enggan.ko: 부디는 답장이 안 올까 봐 처음엔 편지 쓰기를 망설였어요.

w|enggan.text: Tetangga baru itu enggan ikut kerja bakti.
w|enggan.en: The new neighbor is reluctant to join the community clean-up.
w|enggan.ko: 새 이웃은 동네 대청소에 나오기를 꺼려요.

w|engkau.text: Aku percaya engkau bisa menyelesaikan ini.
w|engkau.en: I believe you can finish this.
w|engkau.ko: 난 네가 이걸 해낼 수 있다고 믿어.

w|enkripsi.text: Bagian IT meminta Fajar memakai enkripsi saat mengirim data gaji karyawan.
w|enkripsi.en: The IT department asked Fajar to use encryption when sending employee salary data.
w|enkripsi.ko: IT 부서는 파자르에게 직원 급여 자료를 보낼 때 암호화를 쓰라고 했어요.

w|enkripsi.text: Pesan di aplikasi itu dilindungi enkripsi sehingga tidak bisa dibaca orang lain.
w|enkripsi.en: Messages in the app are protected by encryption so others can't read them.
w|enkripsi.ko: 그 앱의 메시지는 암호화돼 있어서 다른 사람이 읽을 수 없어요.

w|entah.en: I don't know why I'm sad.

w|enyah.text: Enyah dari sini sebelum masalah bertambah.
w|enyah.en: Get out of here before the problem grows.

w|enyah.text: Dia menyuruh burung itu enyah dari jendela.
w|enyah.en: She told the bird to go away from the window.
w|enyah.ko: 그는 새에게 창에서 저리 가라고 했어.

w|enzim.text: Fajar menjual tablet enzim untuk orang yang sulit mencerna susu.
w|enzim.en: Fajar sells enzyme tablets for people who have trouble digesting milk.
w|enzim.ko: 파자르는 우유를 잘 소화하지 못하는 사람을 위한 효소 알약을 팔아요.

w|enzim.text: Rekan baru itu bekerja di bagian riset enzim untuk deterjen.
w|enzim.en: The new coworker works in enzyme research for detergents.
w|enzim.ko: 새 동료는 세제용 효소 연구 부서에서 일해요.

w|epik.text: Menurut para tamu, pesta tahun baru di atap hotel itu benar-benar epik.
w|epik.en: According to the guests, the New Year's party on the hotel rooftop was truly epic.
w|epik.ko: 손님들 말로는 호텔 옥상에서 한 새해 파티가 정말 끝내줬대요.

w|epik.text: Video badai yang direkam Rina dari balkon terlihat epik sekali.
w|epik.en: The storm video Rina filmed from her balcony looks really epic.
w|epik.ko: 리나가 발코니에서 찍은 폭풍 영상은 정말 웅장해 보여요.

w|episode.text: Episode baru akan tayang malam ini.
w|episode.en: A new episode will air tonight.
I've already watched the last episode.

w|era.text: Kakek Budi bilang di era mudanya musim hujan datang lebih tepat waktu.
w|era.en: Budi's grandfather says that in his youth the rainy season came more on time.
w|era.ko: 부디의 할아버지는 젊었을 때는 우기가 더 제때 왔다고 해요.

w|era.text: Film itu bercerita tentang keluarga di era tahun tujuh puluhan.
w|era.en: The film tells the story of a family in the seventies era.
w|era.ko: 그 영화는 칠십 년대 시대의 한 가족 이야기를 담고 있어요.

w|erat.text: Dimas memegang erat buku langka itu supaya tidak jatuh.
w|erat.en: Dimas held the rare book tightly so it wouldn't fall.
w|erat.ko: 디마스는 그 희귀본이 떨어지지 않게 꼭 붙잡았어요.

w|erat.text: Putri memeluk erat ibunya sebelum naik ke gerbong.
w|erat.en: Putri hugged her mother tightly before boarding the carriage.
w|erat.ko: 푸트리는 기차에 오르기 전에 엄마를 꼭 안았어요.

w|eropa.text: Eropa menarik banyak wisatawan setiap musim.
w|eropa.en: Europe attracts many tourists every season.

w|eropa.text: Dia belajar sejarah eropa di kampus.
w|eropa.en: She studies European history on campus.

w|erotis.text: Eko membaca berita tentang film yang dipotong sensor karena adegan erotis.
w|erotis.en: Eko read news about a film that was cut by censors because of an erotic scene.
w|erotis.ko: 에코는 선정적인 장면 때문에 검열로 잘린 영화에 관한 뉴스를 읽었어요.

w|erotis.text: Ayu membaca ulasan tentang puisi lama yang dianggap terlalu erotis pada zamannya.
w|erotis.en: Ayu read a review of an old poem that was considered too erotic in its day.
w|erotis.ko: 아유는 그 시대에 너무 관능적이라고 여겨졌던 옛 시에 관한 평론을 읽었어요.

w|es.en: The ice on the road has melted.

w|esai.text: Rudi menulis esai tentang masakan neneknya untuk mendaftar ke sekolah kuliner.
w|esai.en: Rudi wrote an essay about his grandmother's cooking to apply to culinary school.
w|esai.ko: 루디는 요리 학교에 지원하려고 할머니의 요리에 관한 에세이를 썼어요.

w|esai.text: Rina menemukan buku kumpulan esai lama dengan tanda tangan penulis.
w|esai.en: Rina found an old essay collection signed by the author.
w|esai.ko: 리나는 작가 서명이 있는 오래된 에세이집을 찾았어요.

w|esok.text: Kata ramalan cuaca, esok pagi akan berkabut di daerah Budi.
w|esok.en: According to the forecast, tomorrow morning will be foggy in Budi's area.
w|esok.ko: 일기 예보에 따르면 내일 아침 부디네 지역에 안개가 낀대요.

w|esok.text: Sutradara bilang adegan di pasar akan diambil esok hari.
w|esok.en: The director said the market scene would be shot tomorrow.
w|esok.ko: 감독은 시장 장면을 내일 찍을 거라고 했어요.

w|etika.text: Eko mengajarkan etika panggung kepada pemain baru, misalnya datang tepat waktu.
w|etika.en: Eko teaches stage etiquette to new actors, such as arriving on time.
w|etika.ko: 에코는 신인 배우들에게 시간 지키기 같은 무대 예절을 가르쳐요.

w|etika.text: Para pemandu gunung punya etika untuk tidak meninggalkan sampah di jalur pendakian.
w|etika.en: Mountain guides have an ethic of not leaving trash on hiking trails.
w|etika.ko: 산악 가이드들은 등산로에 쓰레기를 남기지 않는다는 윤리가 있어요.

w|etis.text: Bayu menolak memuat foto korban karena menurutnya tidak etis.
w|etis.en: Bayu refused to publish the victim's photo because he thought it was unethical.
w|etis.ko: 바유는 비윤리적이라고 생각해서 피해자 사진을 싣지 않았어요.

w|etis.text: Intan menganggap tidak etis kalau penjual menghapus ulasan buruk dari pembeli.
w|etis.en: Intan considers it unethical for sellers to delete buyers' bad reviews.
w|etis.ko: 인탄은 판매자가 구매자의 나쁜 후기를 지우는 건 비윤리적이라고 생각해요.

w|evakuasi.text: Polisi memimpin evakuasi warga ketika sungai di dekat kantor meluap.
w|evakuasi.en: The police led the evacuation of residents when the river near the station overflowed.
w|evakuasi.ko: 경찰서 근처 강이 넘쳤을 때 경찰이 주민 대피를 이끌었어요.

w|evakuasi.text: Pertandingan dihentikan dan penonton menjalani evakuasi karena alarm kebakaran berbunyi.
w|evakuasi.en: The match was stopped and spectators were evacuated because the fire alarm went off.
w|evakuasi.ko: 화재경보가 울려서 경기가 중단되고 관중이 대피했어요.

w|fajar.text: Fajar merah mewarnai langit pagi itu.
w|fajar.en: A red dawn colored the morning sky.
w|fajar.ko: 붉은 새벽이 그날 아침 하늘을 물들였어.

w|faksi.text: Diorama itu menggambarkan dua faksi istana yang saling bersaing.
w|faksi.en: The diorama depicts two rival factions at the palace.
w|faksi.ko: 그 디오라마는 서로 경쟁하던 궁정의 두 파벌을 보여 줘요.

w|faksi.text: Di kantor, para pegawai terbagi menjadi dua faksi soal jadwal libur.
w|faksi.en: In the office, the staff split into two factions over the holiday schedule.
w|faksi.ko: 사무실 직원들은 휴가 일정을 두고 두 파벌로 갈렸어요.

w|fakta.text: Itu fakta yang tidak bisa dibantah.
w|fakta.en: That's a fact that can't be denied.

w|faktor.text: Menurut Agus, cuaca adalah faktor terbesar yang memperlambat pekerjaan di lapangan.
w|faktor.en: According to Agus, the weather is the biggest factor slowing down work on site.
w|faktor.ko: 아구스 말로는 날씨가 현장 작업을 늦추는 가장 큰 요인이에요.

w|faktor.text: Harga yang murah bukan satu-satunya faktor yang dipertimbangkan Wati.
w|faktor.en: A low price isn't the only factor Wati considers.
w|faktor.ko: 싼 가격만 와티가 고려하는 요인은 아니에요.

w|fakultas.text: Eko pernah kuliah di fakultas teknik sebelum memutuskan menjadi koki.
w|fakultas.en: Eko studied in the engineering faculty before deciding to become a chef.
w|fakultas.ko: 에코는 요리사가 되기로 하기 전에 공대에 다녔어요.

w|fakultas.text: Pohon flamboyan di depan fakultas Ayu berbunga merah saat kemarau.
w|fakultas.en: The flame tree in front of Ayu's faculty blooms red in the dry season.
w|fakultas.ko: 아유네 단과 대학 앞 봉황목은 건기에 빨간 꽃을 피워요.

w|fana.text: Dalam kolomnya, Bayu menulis bahwa ketenaran itu fana dan cepat dilupakan.
w|fana.en: In his column, Bayu wrote that fame is fleeting and quickly forgotten.
w|fana.ko: 바유는 칼럼에 명성이란 덧없고 금방 잊힌다고 썼어요.

w|fana.text: Nenek Intan sering berkata bahwa harta itu fana, yang abadi hanya kebaikan.
w|fana.en: Intan's grandmother often says that wealth is fleeting and only kindness lasts.
w|fana.ko: 인탄의 할머니는 재물은 덧없고 선행만 영원하다고 자주 말씀하세요.

w|fanatik.text: Tetangga Andi adalah suporter fanatik yang memasang bendera klub di atap.
w|fanatik.en: Andi's neighbor is a fanatical supporter who put the club flag on his roof.
w|fanatik.ko: 안디의 이웃은 지붕에 클럽 깃발을 단 열성 서포터예요.

w|fanatik.text: Dewi membaca tentang kolektor fanatik yang menghabiskan hartanya demi keris kuno.
w|fanatik.en: Dewi read about a fanatical collector who spent his fortune on ancient krises.
w|fanatik.ko: 데위는 옛 크리스 단검에 재산을 다 쓴 광적인 수집가에 대해 읽었어요.

w|fantasi.text: Cerpen Budi penuh fantasi tentang naga dan kerajaan di bawah laut.
w|fantasi.en: Budi's short story is full of fantasy about dragons and an undersea kingdom.
w|fantasi.ko: 부디의 단편 소설은 용과 바닷속 왕국에 관한 판타지로 가득해요.

w|fantasi.text: Siti bilang cita-citanya dulu menjadi astronaut hanyalah fantasi anak kecil.
w|fantasi.en: Siti said her old dream of becoming an astronaut was just a child's fantasy.
w|fantasi.ko: 시티는 어릴 때 우주 비행사가 되겠다던 꿈은 그냥 아이의 공상이었다고 했어요.

w|fantastis.en: The view from the summit is fantastic.
Their performance last night was fantastic.

w|farmasi.text: Rudi memesan salep khusus dari bagian farmasi rumah sakit hewan pusat.
w|farmasi.en: Rudi ordered a special ointment from the central animal hospital's pharmacy.
w|farmasi.ko: 루디는 중앙 동물병원 약제부에 특별한 연고를 주문했어요.

w|farmasi.text: Rina ingin kuliah di jurusan farmasi agar bisa membuka apotek di desa.
w|farmasi.en: Rina wants to study pharmacy so she can open a drugstore in the village.
w|farmasi.ko: 리나는 마을에 약국을 열려고 약학과에 가고 싶어요.

w|fasilitas.en: This hotel's facilities are very complete.
w|fasilitas.ko: 이 호텔 시설이 아주 잘 갖춰져 있어.

w|fasilitas.en: The school added new sports facilities.

w|favorit.text: Restoran favorit kami tutup hari ini.
w|favorit.en: Our favorite restaurant is closed today.

w|februari.text: Biasanya angin kencang mulai mereda pada akhir bulan Februari.
w|februari.en: The strong winds usually start to die down at the end of February.
w|februari.ko: 강한 바람은 보통 이월 말이면 잦아들기 시작해요.

w|februari.text: Tukang kayu berjanji menyelesaikan tangga baru sebelum akhir Februari.
w|februari.en: The carpenter promised to finish the new staircase before the end of February.
w|februari.ko: 목수는 이월 말 전에 새 계단을 끝내겠다고 약속했어요.

w|federasi.text: Kelompok teater Eko bergabung dengan federasi teater nasional.
w|federasi.en: Eko's theater group joined the national theater federation.
w|federasi.ko: 에코의 극단은 전국 연극 연맹에 가입했어요.

w|federasi.text: Kelompok tani desa itu kini menjadi anggota federasi petani kopi.
w|federasi.en: The village farmers' group is now a member of the coffee farmers' federation.
w|federasi.ko: 그 마을 농민 모임은 이제 커피 농민 연합의 회원이에요.

w|fenomena.text: Pemandu menjelaskan bahwa kabut tebal di pagi hari adalah fenomena biasa di lembah ini.
w|fenomena.en: The guide explained that thick morning fog is a common phenomenon in this valley.
w|fenomena.ko: 가이드는 아침의 짙은 안개가 이 골짜기에서는 흔한 현상이라고 설명했어요.

w|fenomena.text: Para kritikus menyebut popularitas penyanyi muda itu sebagai fenomena tahun ini.
w|fenomena.en: Critics call the young singer's popularity the phenomenon of the year.
w|fenomena.ko: 비평가들은 그 젊은 가수의 인기를 올해의 현상이라고 불러요.

w|feri.text: Rudi membelikan tiket feri untuk tamu yang ingin ke pulau seberang.
w|feri.en: Rudi bought ferry tickets for guests who wanted to go to the island across the water.
w|feri.ko: 루디는 건너편 섬에 가고 싶어 하는 손님을 위해 페리 표를 사 줬어요.

w|feri.text: Rina batal naik feri karena ombak sedang tinggi.
w|feri.en: Rina called off taking the ferry because the waves were high.
w|feri.ko: 파도가 높아서 리나는 페리를 타지 않기로 했어요.

w|festival.text: Festival musik itu menarik banyak pengunjung.
w|festival.en: That music festival attracts many visitors.
w|festival.ko: 그 음악 축제는 많은 방문객을 끌어들여.

w|festival.text: Kami menonton festival lampion di malam hari.
w|festival.en: We watched the lantern festival at night.

w|figur.text: Bayu menganggap kepala divisi sebagai figur panutan.
w|figur.en: Bayu sees the division head as a role model.
w|figur.ko: 바유는 부서장을 본받을 만한 인물로 여겨요.

w|figur.text: Intan ingin menjadi figur inspiratif bagi anggota yang baru mulai.
w|figur.en: Intan wants to be an inspiring figure for members who are just starting out.
w|figur.ko: 인탄은 이제 막 시작한 회원들에게 영감을 주는 사람이 되고 싶어요.

w|fiksi.text: Di perpustakaan sekolah, Rudi lebih suka meminjam buku fiksi daripada buku pelajaran.
w|fiksi.en: In the school library, Rudi prefers borrowing fiction to textbooks.
w|fiksi.ko: 학교 도서관에서 루디는 교과서보다 소설책 빌리는 걸 더 좋아해요.

w|fiksi.text: Rina menyumbangkan satu dus buku fiksi ke perpustakaan desa.
w|fiksi.en: Rina donated a box of fiction books to the village library.
w|fiksi.ko: 리나는 소설책 한 상자를 마을 도서관에 기증했어요.

w|film.en: Want to watch a movie tonight?

w|filosofi.text: Andi suka filosofi pustakawan itu: buku yang baik harus dibaca, bukan disimpan.
w|filosofi.en: Andi likes the librarian's philosophy: a good book should be read, not kept.
w|filosofi.ko: 안디는 좋은 책은 보관하는 게 아니라 읽어야 한다는 그 사서의 철학이 좋아요.

w|filosofi.text: Soal pindahan, filosofi Dewi sederhana: buang barang yang setahun tidak dipakai.
w|filosofi.en: When it comes to moving, Dewi's philosophy is simple: throw out anything you haven't used in a year.
w|filosofi.ko: 이사에 관한 데위의 철학은 간단해요. 일 년 동안 안 쓴 물건은 버리는 거예요.

w|filsafat.text: Andi meminjam buku pengantar filsafat Yunani untuk mata kuliah pilihannya.
w|filsafat.en: Andi borrowed an introduction to Greek philosophy for his elective course.
w|filsafat.ko: 안디는 교양 수업에 쓸 그리스 철학 입문서를 빌렸어요.

w|filsafat.text: Dewi menemukan buku filsafat milik ayahnya di antara tumpukan barang lama.
w|filsafat.en: Dewi found her father's philosophy book among the piles of old things.
w|filsafat.ko: 데위는 오래된 물건 더미 속에서 아버지의 철학책을 찾았어요.

w|final.text: Tim kami lolos ke babak final.
w|final.en: Our team advanced to the final round.
The match final was broadcast live.

w|finansial.text: Warung kelapa milik paman Eko sedang mengalami kesulitan finansial sejak musim hujan.
w|finansial.en: The coconut stall owned by Eko's uncle has been having financial trouble since the rainy season.
w|finansial.ko: 에코 삼촌의 코코넛 가게는 우기 이후로 재정난을 겪고 있어요.

w|finansial.text: Ayu sempat menunda perawatan gigi karena alasan finansial.
w|finansial.en: Ayu had put off dental treatment for financial reasons.
w|finansial.ko: 아유는 돈 문제 때문에 치과 치료를 미뤘었어요.

w|firasat.text: Dalam suratnya, Rudi menulis bahwa dia punya firasat buruk sebelum pindah kota.
w|firasat.en: In his letter, Rudi wrote that he had a bad feeling before moving to another city.
w|firasat.ko: 루디는 편지에 다른 도시로 이사하기 전에 불길한 예감이 들었다고 썼어요.

w|firasat.text: Rina punya firasat bahwa aplikasi baru mereka akan laku di kalangan mahasiswa.
w|firasat.en: Rina has a hunch that their new app will be popular among university students.
w|firasat.ko: 리나는 새 앱이 대학생들 사이에서 잘될 거라는 예감이 들어요.

w|firman.text: Di acara doa bersama, pemuka agama membacakan firman sebelum Fajar membuka rapat.
w|firman.en: At the joint prayer event, a religious leader read from scripture before Fajar opened the meeting.
w|firman.ko: 합동 기도 행사에서 파자르가 회의를 열기 전에 종교 지도자가 경전 말씀을 읽었어요.

w|firman.text: Lestari mengutip sebuah firman dari kitab suci yang dulu sering mereka baca bersama.
w|firman.en: Lestari quoted a verse from the holy book they used to read together.
w|firman.ko: 레스타리는 예전에 함께 자주 읽던 경전의 한 구절을 인용했어요.

w|fisik.en: That athlete's physique is very strong.

w|fisika.text: Ilmu fisika yang Bayu pelajari di kampus ternyata berguna untuk merawat mesin.
w|fisika.en: The physics Bayu studied at university turned out to be useful for maintaining machines.
w|fisika.ko: 바유가 대학에서 배운 물리학이 기계 정비에 쓸모가 있었어요.

w|fisika.text: Di ruang tunggu, Intan membaca buku fisika untuk persiapan ujian.
w|fisika.en: In the waiting room, Intan read a physics book to prepare for an exam.
w|fisika.ko: 대기실에서 인탄은 시험 준비로 물리학 책을 읽었어요.

w|fisikawan.text: Andi mewawancarai fisikawan muda yang meneliti panel surya.
w|fisikawan.en: Andi interviewed a young physicist who researches solar panels.
w|fisikawan.ko: 안디는 태양광 패널을 연구하는 젊은 물리학자를 인터뷰했어요.

w|fisikawan.text: Dewi menemukan buku biografi seorang fisikawan milik ayah.
w|fisikawan.en: Dewi found her father's biography of a physicist.
w|fisikawan.ko: 데위는 아버지가 갖고 있던 한 물리학자의 전기를 찾았어요.

w|fitur.text: Situs koran tempat Bayu bekerja baru menambahkan fitur komentar untuk pembaca.
w|fitur.en: The newspaper's website where Bayu works has just added a comment feature for readers.
w|fitur.ko: 바유가 일하는 신문사 웹사이트에 독자 댓글 기능이 새로 생겼어요.

w|fitur.text: Ponsel lama Intan tidak punya fitur kamera yang bagus untuk memotret gunung.
w|fitur.en: Intan's old phone doesn't have a good camera feature for photographing the mountain.
w|fitur.ko: 인탄의 오래된 휴대폰은 산을 찍을 만한 좋은 카메라 기능이 없어요.

w|flu.text: Agus sempat menunda jadwal periksa karena terkena flu.
w|flu.en: Agus postponed his appointment because he caught the flu.
w|flu.ko: 아구스는 독감에 걸려서 진료 날짜를 미뤘어요.

w|flu.text: Gara-gara tidur di rumah yang belum berjendela, Wati terserang flu.
w|flu.en: Because she slept in the house before it had windows, Wati came down with the flu.
w|flu.ko: 창문도 없는 집에서 자는 바람에 와티는 독감에 걸렸어요.

w|fokus.en: He lost focus for a moment.

w|forensik.text: Museum polisi punya ruang yang menjelaskan cara kerja tim forensik.
w|forensik.en: The police museum has a room that explains how forensic teams work.
w|forensik.ko: 경찰 박물관에는 법의학 팀이 어떻게 일하는지 설명하는 방이 있어요.

w|forensik.text: Penjual koran di pasar senang mengobrol dengan Rina soal sinetron forensik kesukaannya.
w|forensik.en: The newspaper seller at the market enjoys chatting with Rina about his favorite forensic drama.
w|forensik.ko: 시장 신문 장수는 즐겨 보는 법의학 드라마 이야기를 리나와 나누길 좋아해요.

w|formalitas.text: Pendaftaran kartu anggota perpustakaan hanya formalitas, kata petugas kepada Andi.
w|formalitas.en: Registering for a library card is just a formality, the clerk told Andi.
w|formalitas.ko: 도서관 회원증 등록은 형식일 뿐이라고 직원이 안디에게 말했어요.

w|formalitas.text: Bagi Dewi, lapor ke ketua RT baru terasa seperti formalitas saja.
w|formalitas.en: To Dewi, reporting to the new neighborhood head felt like a mere formality.
w|formalitas.ko: 데위에게 새 반장에게 신고하는 건 형식일 뿐인 것 같았어요.

w|formasi.text: Pelatih menyuruh Rudi berdiri di belakang dalam formasi barisan upacara.
w|formasi.en: The coach told Rudi to stand at the back of the ceremony line formation.
w|formasi.ko: 코치는 루디에게 행사 대열에서 뒤에 서라고 했어요.

w|formasi.text: Para pengangkut menyusun kardus Rina dalam formasi rapi di dalam truk.
w|formasi.en: The movers stacked Rina's boxes in a neat formation inside the truck.
w|formasi.ko: 이삿짐센터 직원들이 리나의 상자들을 트럭 안에 가지런히 쌓았어요.

w|formulir.text: Sebelum mulai kerja, Fajar mengisi formulir data karyawan di kantor manajer.
w|formulir.en: Before starting work, Fajar filled out an employee data form in the manager's office.
w|formulir.ko: 일을 시작하기 전에 파자르는 매니저 사무실에서 직원 정보 양식을 작성했어요.

w|formulir.text: Untuk membuka lapak, Lestari harus mengisi formulir pendaftaran dari panitia.
w|formulir.en: To open a stall, Lestari has to fill out a registration form from the organizers.
w|formulir.ko: 노점을 열려면 레스타리는 주최 측의 신청서를 작성해야 해요.

w|fosil.text: Eko menemukan fosil kerang di batu kapur dekat air terjun.
w|fosil.en: Eko found a shell fossil in the limestone near the waterfall.
w|fosil.ko: 에코는 폭포 옆 석회암에서 조개 화석을 발견했어요.

w|fosil.text: Medali maraton tahun ini berbentuk fosil ikan purba dari daerah setempat.
w|fosil.en: This year's marathon medal is shaped like a fossil of an ancient local fish.
w|fosil.ko: 올해 마라톤 메달은 그 지역 고대 물고기 화석 모양이에요.

w|foto.en: Our vacation photo is really nice.

w|fotografer.text: Seorang fotografer memotret proses produksi untuk katalog baru.
w|fotografer.en: A photographer took pictures of the production process for the new catalog.
w|fotografer.ko: 한 사진작가가 새 카탈로그에 쓸 생산 과정을 찍었어요.

w|fotografer.text: Kakak Sari dulu jadi fotografer di acara wisuda mereka.
w|fotografer.en: Sari's older sibling was the photographer at their graduation.
w|fotografer.ko: 사리의 언니는 둘의 졸업식에서 사진사를 맡았어요.

w|fotografi.text: Sebelum jadi wartawan, Bayu belajar fotografi di sebuah sanggar kecil.
w|fotografi.en: Before becoming a journalist, Bayu studied photography at a small studio.
w|fotografi.ko: 기자가 되기 전에 바유는 작은 공방에서 사진을 배웠어요.

w|fotografi.text: Seorang turis mengajari Intan dasar-dasar fotografi di puncak bukit.
w|fotografi.en: A tourist taught Intan the basics of photography on the hilltop.
w|fotografi.ko: 한 관광객이 언덕 꼭대기에서 인탄에게 사진의 기초를 가르쳐 줬어요.

w|fragmen.text: Dimas menyusun fragmen tembikar itu seperti sedang mengerjakan teka-teki.
w|fragmen.en: Dimas pieced the pottery fragments together as if doing a puzzle.
w|fragmen.ko: 디마스는 퍼즐을 맞추듯 토기 조각들을 맞췄어요.

w|fragmen.text: Putri hanya ingat fragmen lagu yang diputar di lantai mainan kemarin.
w|fragmen.en: Putri only remembers a fragment of the song that played on the toy floor yesterday.
w|fragmen.ko: 푸트리는 어제 장난감 층에서 나온 노래를 한 소절만 기억해요.

w|frekuensi.text: Radio balai kota mengudara pada frekuensi yang bisa didengar seluruh kota.
w|frekuensi.en: The city hall radio broadcasts on a frequency that can be heard across the whole city.
w|frekuensi.ko: 시청 라디오는 도시 전체에서 들을 수 있는 주파수로 방송해요.

w|frekuensi.text: Guru fisika musik menjelaskan bahwa nada tinggi punya frekuensi lebih besar.
w|frekuensi.en: The music physics teacher explained that high notes have a higher frequency.
w|frekuensi.ko: 음향 물리 선생님은 높은 음일수록 진동수가 크다고 설명했어요.

w|frustrasi.text: Rudi merasa frustrasi karena kakaknya terus memotong penjelasannya.
w|frustrasi.en: Rudi felt frustrated because his sister kept cutting off his explanation.
w|frustrasi.ko: 누나가 계속 말을 끊어서 루디는 답답했어요.

w|frustrasi.text: Rina mulai frustrasi karena layang-layangnya terus jatuh ke pasir.
w|frustrasi.en: Rina started getting frustrated because her kite kept falling onto the sand.
w|frustrasi.ko: 연이 자꾸 모래에 떨어져서 리나는 답답해지기 시작했어요.

w|fungsi.text: Fajar menjelaskan fungsi saksi ahli kepada kliennya.
w|fungsi.en: Fajar explained the role of an expert witness to his client.
w|fungsi.ko: 파자르는 의뢰인에게 전문가 증인의 역할을 설명했어요.

w|fungsi.text: Lestari masih memakai kulkas tua yang fungsi pendinginnya sudah lemah.
w|fungsi.en: Lestari still uses an old fridge whose cooling function is already weak.
w|fungsi.ko: 레스타리는 냉각 기능이 약해진 낡은 냉장고를 아직 써요.

w|fusi.text: Guru di sekolah desa menjelaskan bahwa matahari bersinar karena reaksi fusi.
w|fusi.en: The teacher at the village school explained that the sun shines because of fusion reactions.
w|fusi.ko: 마을 학교 선생님은 태양이 핵융합 반응으로 빛난다고 설명했어요.

w|fusi.text: Ayu membaca artikel tentang energi fusi yang mungkin dipakai pabrik masa depan.
w|fusi.en: Ayu read an article about fusion energy that factories might use in the future.
w|fusi.ko: 아유는 미래 공장이 쓸지도 모르는 핵융합 에너지에 관한 기사를 읽었어요.

w|gabungan.text: Pabrik itu dikelola oleh gabungan beberapa perusahaan lokal.
w|gabungan.en: The factory is run by a group of several local companies.
w|gabungan.ko: 그 공장은 여러 지역 회사의 연합이 운영해요.

w|gabungan.text: Hadiah untuk Sari adalah gabungan foto lama dan kartu pos dari kota-kota yang pernah Putri kunjungi.
w|gabungan.en: The gift for Sari is a mix of old photos and postcards from cities Putri has visited.
w|gabungan.ko: 사리에게 줄 선물은 옛 사진과 푸트리가 가 본 도시들의 엽서를 모은 거예요.

w|gagah.text: Dengan beskap hitam, pengantin pria tampak gagah di depan para tamu.
w|gagah.en: In his black beskap jacket, the groom looked dashing in front of the guests.
w|gagah.ko: 검은 베스캅을 입은 신랑은 손님들 앞에서 늠름해 보였어요.

w|gagah.text: Foto Rina menampilkan prajurit yang berdiri gagah saat upacara bendera.
w|gagah.en: Rina's photo shows soldiers standing proudly during the flag ceremony.
w|gagah.ko: 리나의 사진에는 국기 의식 때 늠름하게 선 군인들이 담겼어요.

w|gagak.text: Seekor gagak hinggap di dahan kering dan berkoak keras di atas kepala Agus.
w|gagak.en: A crow landed on a dry branch and cawed loudly above Agus's head.
w|gagak.ko: 까마귀 한 마리가 마른 가지에 앉아 아구스 머리 위에서 시끄럽게 울었어요.

w|gagak.text: Seekor gagak sering bertengger di atap apotek tempat Wati bekerja.
w|gagak.en: A crow often perches on the roof of the pharmacy where Wati works.
w|gagak.ko: 와티가 일하는 약국 지붕에 까마귀 한 마리가 자주 앉아 있어요.

w|gagang.text: Agus mengganti gagang pintu yang sudah longgar.
w|gagang.en: Agus replaced the door handle that had come loose.

w|gagang.text: Wati memegang gagang wajan erat-erat sambil membalik nasi goreng.
w|gagang.en: Wati gripped the wok handle tightly while tossing the fried rice.
w|gagang.ko: 와티는 웍 손잡이를 꽉 잡고 볶음밥을 뒤집었어요.

w|gagap.text: Seorang anak yang gagap menanyakan obat batuk, dan Dimas menunggu dengan sabar.
w|gagap.en: A child with a stutter asked about cough medicine, and Dimas waited patiently.
w|gagap.ko: 말을 더듬는 아이가 기침약을 묻자 디마스는 참을성 있게 기다려 줬어요.

w|gagap.text: Tukang kayu yang gagap itu ternyata paling teliti di antara pekerja Putri.
w|gagap.en: The carpenter with a stutter turned out to be the most careful of Putri's workers.
w|gagap.ko: 말을 더듬는 그 목수가 알고 보니 푸트리의 일꾼 중 가장 꼼꼼했어요.

w|gagasan.text: Kapolsek meminta gagasan warga untuk mengurangi pencurian di kompleks.
w|gagasan.en: The precinct chief asked residents for ideas to reduce theft in the housing complex.
w|gagasan.ko: 지구대장은 단지 안 도난을 줄일 방법을 주민들에게 물었어요.

w|gagasan.text: Pelatih menerima gagasan Dewi untuk bermain cepat di babak akhir.
w|gagasan.en: The coach accepted Dewi's idea of playing fast in the final quarter.
w|gagasan.ko: 마지막 쿼터에 빠르게 경기하자는 데위의 생각을 코치가 받아들였어요.

w|gaib.text: Eko tidak percaya cerita tentang makhluk gaib di gudang sekolah.
w|gaib.en: Eko doesn't believe the stories about supernatural beings in the school storeroom.
w|gaib.ko: 에코는 학교 창고에 귀신이 있다는 이야기를 믿지 않아요.

w|gaib.text: Ayu melukis hutan berkabut yang terasa gaib dan sunyi.
w|gaib.en: Ayu painted a misty forest that feels mystical and silent.
w|gaib.ko: 아유는 신비롭고 고요한 느낌의 안개 낀 숲을 그렸어요.

w|gairah.text: Waktu muda, Rudi punya gairah besar untuk menjadi penulis.
w|gairah.en: When he was young, Rudi had a great passion for becoming a writer.
w|gairah.ko: 젊었을 때 루디는 작가가 되고 싶은 열정이 컸어요.

w|gairah.text: Rina mencari karyawan yang punya gairah pada teknologi pendidikan.
w|gairah.en: Rina is looking for employees with a passion for education technology.
w|gairah.ko: 리나는 교육 기술에 열정이 있는 직원을 찾고 있어요.

w|gajah.text: Gajah itu berjalan pelan di kebun binatang.
w|gajah.en: That elephant walked slowly at the zoo.

w|gajah.text: Anak-anak senang melihat gajah mandi di sungai.
w|gajah.en: The children enjoyed watching the elephant bathe in the river.
w|gajah.ko: 아이들은 코끼리가 강에서 목욕하는 걸 좋아했어.

w|gaji.text: Gaji bulanan masuk ke rekening pagi ini.
w|gaji.en: The monthly salary entered the account this morning.

w|gaji.text: Dia meminta kenaikan gaji dengan sopan.
w|gaji.en: He politely asked for a salary raise.

w|galak.text: Bayu sempat takut pada manajer yang terkenal galak.
w|galak.en: Bayu was a bit scared of the manager, who is known for being fierce.
w|galak.ko: 바유는 무섭기로 소문난 매니저를 처음엔 겁냈어요.

w|galak.text: Pelatih tinju itu galak, tetapi murid-murid menyukainya.
w|galak.en: That boxing coach is fierce, but the students like him.
w|galak.ko: 그 권투 코치는 무섭지만 학생들은 그를 좋아해요.

w|galaksi.text: Galaksi Bima Sakti tampak indah malam ini.
w|galaksi.en: The Milky Way galaxy looks beautiful tonight.

w|galaksi.text: Ilmuwan menemukan galaksi baru yang jauh.
w|galaksi.en: Scientists discovered a new distant galaxy.

w|galeri.text: Lukisan Dimas dipajang di galeri kecil sekolah.
w|galeri.en: Dimas's painting is displayed in the school's small gallery.
w|galeri.ko: 디마스의 그림이 학교 작은 갤러리에 걸려 있어요.

w|galeri.text: Restoran Putri terletak di samping galeri seni.
w|galeri.en: Putri's restaurant is next to an art gallery.

w|galon.text: Di dekat pintu keluar museum ada galon air minum gratis untuk pengunjung.
w|galon.en: Near the museum exit there is a free drinking water jug for visitors.
w|galon.ko: 박물관 출구 근처에는 관람객이 마실 수 있는 무료 생수통이 있어요.

w|galon.text: Kru membawa beberapa galon air ke lokasi syuting di tengah sawah.
w|galon.en: The crew brought several water jugs to the shooting location in the middle of the rice fields.
w|galon.ko: 스태프들은 논 한가운데 촬영지로 물통 몇 개를 날랐어요.

w|gambar.en: That child drew a picture of a cat.

w|gambaran.text: Laporan itu memberi gambaran situasi lapangan.
w|gambaran.en: That report gives an overview of the field situation.
w|gambaran.ko: 그 보고서는 현장 상황의 개요를 줘.

w|gambaran.text: Gambaran awal proyek masih bisa berubah.
w|gambaran.en: The initial picture of the project can still change.
w|gambaran.ko: 프로젝트의 초기 윤곽은 아직 바뀔 수 있어.

w|gampang.text: Soal matematika hari ini ternyata gampang, jadi Budi selesai lebih cepat.
w|gampang.en: Today's math problems turned out to be easy, so Budi finished early.
w|gampang.ko: 오늘 수학 문제가 생각보다 쉬워서 부디는 일찍 끝냈어요.

w|gampang.text: Siti kira pindahan itu gampang, ternyata capek sekali.
w|gampang.en: Siti thought moving would be easy, but it turned out to be exhausting.
w|gampang.ko: 시티는 이사가 쉬울 줄 알았는데 막상 해 보니 엄청 힘들었어요.

w|ganas.text: Andi membaca buku kedokteran tentang sel ganas dan cara kerja kemoterapi.
w|ganas.en: Andi read a medical book about malignant cells and how chemotherapy works.
w|ganas.ko: 안디는 악성 세포와 항암 치료의 원리를 다룬 의학책을 읽었어요.

w|ganas.text: Persaingan di industri asuransi makin ganas, kata manajer Dewi.
w|ganas.en: Competition in the insurance industry is getting fiercer, says Dewi's manager.
w|ganas.ko: 디위의 매니저는 보험 업계 경쟁이 점점 치열해진다고 해요.

w|ganda.text: Harga tiket naik dua kali ganda.
Dia punya peran ganda di tim.
w|ganda.en: She has a dual role on the team.

w|gandum.text: Roti yang dibuat Andi memakai tepung gandum utuh.
w|gandum.en: The bread Andi made uses whole wheat flour.

w|gandum.text: Dalam suratnya, Rani bilang ladang gandum di desanya sudah menguning.
w|gandum.en: In her letter, Rani said the wheat fields in her village have turned golden.
w|gandum.ko: 라니는 편지에 마을 밀밭이 누렇게 익었다고 썼어요.

w|gangguan.text: Ada gangguan sinyal di daerah ini.
w|gangguan.en: There is a signal disruption in this area.

w|ganjaran.text: Rudi menerima ganjaran berupa piagam setelah menangkap pencopet di pasar.
w|ganjaran.en: Rudi received a reward in the form of a certificate after catching a pickpocket at the market.
w|ganjaran.ko: 루디는 시장에서 소매치기를 잡은 뒤 상장을 상으로 받았어요.

w|ganjaran.text: Medali emas itu menjadi ganjaran bagi kerja keras Rina selama setahun penuh.
w|ganjaran.en: The gold medal was the reward for Rina's hard work over an entire year.
w|ganjaran.ko: 그 금메달은 리나가 일 년 내내 노력한 대가였어요.

w|ganjil.text: Bayu merasa ada yang ganjil dengan angka-angka dalam laporan anggaran itu.
w|ganjil.en: Bayu felt there was something odd about the figures in that budget report.
w|ganjil.ko: 바유는 그 예산 보고서의 숫자들이 어딘가 이상하다고 느꼈어요.

w|ganjil.text: Suara burung di hutan malam itu terdengar ganjil bagi Intan.
w|ganjil.en: The bird sounds in the forest that night sounded strange to Intan.
w|ganjil.ko: 그날 밤 숲속 새소리가 인탄에게는 이상하게 들렸어요.

w|ganteng.text: Rekan-rekan menggoda Eko karena foto profilnya di koran terlihat ganteng.
w|ganteng.en: His colleagues teased Eko because his profile photo in the paper looked handsome.
w|ganteng.ko: 동료들은 신문에 실린 에코 프로필 사진이 잘생겼다며 놀렸어요.

w|ganteng.text: Ayu tertawa melihat wallpaper ponsel pelanggan: foto aktor ganteng berkacamata.
w|ganteng.en: Ayu laughed at the customer's phone wallpaper: a photo of a handsome actor in glasses.
w|ganteng.ko: 아유는 손님 휴대폰 배경 화면의 안경 쓴 잘생긴 배우 사진을 보고 웃었어요.

w|gantungan.text: Agus memasang gantungan baju di balik pintu kamar.
w|gantungan.en: Agus put up a clothes hanger rack behind the bedroom door.

w|gantungan.text: Wati menggantung lonceng angin di gantungan dekat jendela.
w|gantungan.en: Wati hung a wind chime on the hook near the window.

w|gara-gara.en: He was late because of a long traffic jam.
Because of heavy rain the event was canceled.

w|garam.text: Tambahkan sedikit garam ke dalam kuah.
w|garam.en: Add a little salt to the broth.

w|garam.text: Garam laut itu terasa lebih kuat.

w|garasi.en: His car is parked inside the garage.
w|garasi.ko: 그의 차는 차고 안에 세워져 있어.

w|garasi.text: Garasi itu penuh dengan peralatan lama.
w|garasi.en: That garage is full of old tools.

w|garda.text: Agus percaya pengadilan adalah garda terakhir bagi orang yang mencari keadilan.
w|garda.en: Agus believes the court is the last line of defense for people seeking justice.
w|garda.ko: 아구스는 법원이 정의를 찾는 사람들의 마지막 보루라고 믿어요.

w|garda.text: Kakak Wati yang bekerja di garda depan rumah sakit sering mampir untuk makan siang.
w|garda.en: Wati's older sister, who works on the hospital front line, often drops by for lunch.
w|garda.ko: 병원 최전선에서 일하는 와티 언니는 점심 먹으러 자주 들러요.

w|garis.en: Draw a straight line on the paper.
The lines on the road have faded.

w|garpu.text: Agus membeli satu set garpu perak tua dari lapak paling ujung.
w|garpu.en: Agus bought a set of old silver forks from the stall at the very end.
w|garpu.ko: 아구스는 맨 끝 노점에서 오래된 은포크 한 세트를 샀어요.

w|garpu.text: Saat musim hujan tiba, Wati makan mi kuah panas dengan garpu dan sendok.
w|garpu.en: When the rainy season arrives, Wati eats hot noodle soup with a fork and spoon.
w|garpu.ko: 우기가 오면 와티는 포크와 숟가락으로 뜨거운 국수를 먹어요.

w|gas.en: The gas stove in the kitchen is broken.
The car is almost out of gas.

w|gatal.text: Kulit Bayu terasa gatal setelah memakai matras yang jarang dibersihkan.
w|gatal.en: Bayu's skin felt itchy after using a mat that is rarely cleaned.
w|gatal.ko: 잘 안 닦은 매트를 쓰고 나서 바유의 피부가 가려웠어요.

w|gatal.text: Tenggorokan Intan terasa gatal setelah makan sambal terlalu banyak.
w|gatal.en: Intan's throat felt itchy after eating too much chili sauce.
w|gatal.ko: 인탄은 삼발을 너무 많이 먹어서 목이 간질거렸어요.

w|gaun.en: That white dress is very elegant.
She chose a dress for the party.

w|gawang.text: Perkara itu bermula dari bola yang memecahkan jendela tetangga, bukan masuk ke gawang.
w|gawang.en: The case began with a ball that broke a neighbor's window instead of going into the goal.
w|gawang.ko: 그 사건은 골대 대신 이웃집 창문으로 날아간 공에서 시작됐어요.

w|gawang.text: Para tamu bersorak ketika bola masuk ke gawang dalam siaran sepak bola di layar besar.
w|gawang.en: The guests cheered when the ball went into the goal in the football broadcast on the big screen.
w|gawang.ko: 큰 화면 축구 중계에서 공이 골대에 들어가자 손님들이 환호했어요.

w|gawat.text: Kata petugas, kondisi lukisan tua itu gawat karena jamur mulai tumbuh.
w|gawat.en: According to the staff, the old painting is in serious condition because mold has started to grow.
w|gawat.ko: 직원 말로는 곰팡이가 피기 시작해서 그 옛 그림 상태가 심각하대요.

w|gawat.text: Rina berteriak, "Wah, gawat, hujan turun dan terpal belum dipasang!"
w|gawat.en: Rina shouted, "Oh no, it's raining and the tarp isn't up yet!"
w|gawat.ko: 리나가 소리쳤어요. "큰일이다, 비가 오는데 방수포를 아직 안 쳤어!"

w|gaya.en: He has a unique speaking style.

w|gedung.en: We work in the building next door.

w|gegabah.text: Ayah Dimas bilang menyeberangi sungai saat banjir adalah tindakan gegabah.
w|gegabah.en: Dimas's father said crossing the river during a flood is reckless.
w|gegabah.ko: 디마스의 아빠는 홍수 때 강을 건너는 건 무모한 짓이라고 했어요.

w|gegabah.text: Tukang kayu menyarankan Putri agar tidak gegabah membongkar dinding penyangga.
w|gegabah.en: The carpenter advised Putri not to be hasty about tearing down the load-bearing wall.
w|gegabah.ko: 목수는 푸트리에게 내력벽을 섣불리 허물지 말라고 했어요.

w|gegar.text: Dimas menyuruh pemuda yang jatuh dari motor ke rumah sakit karena bisa saja kena gegar otak.
w|gegar.en: Dimas told the young man who fell off his motorbike to go to the hospital since he might have a concussion.
w|gegar.ko: 디마스는 오토바이에서 떨어진 청년에게 뇌진탕일 수도 있으니 병원에 가라고 했어요.

w|gegar.text: Putri hampir kena gegar otak karena papan jatuh dari loteng.
w|gegar.en: Putri nearly got a concussion when a board fell from the attic.
w|gegar.ko: 푸트리는 다락에서 떨어진 판자에 맞아 뇌진탕을 입을 뻔했어요.

w|gejala.text: Dokter bertanya kapan gejala ngilu pertama kali muncul.
w|gejala.en: The doctor asked when the aching symptoms first appeared.
w|gejala.ko: 의사는 시린 증상이 언제 처음 나타났는지 물었어요.

w|gejala.text: Retakan kecil di dinding bisa jadi gejala fondasi yang mulai turun.
w|gejala.en: Small cracks in the wall can be a sign that the foundation is starting to sink.
w|gejala.ko: 벽의 작은 금은 기초가 내려앉기 시작했다는 징후일 수 있어요.

w|gelandangan.text: Rina rutin membagikan nasi bungkus kepada gelandangan di dekat kantor.
w|gelandangan.en: Rina regularly hands out packed rice to homeless people near the office.
w|gelandangan.ko: 리나는 회사 근처 노숙인들에게 정기적으로 도시락을 나눠 줘요.

w|gelandangan.text: Satpam hotel memberi selimut kepada gelandangan yang tidur di halte depan.
w|gelandangan.en: The hotel security guard gave a blanket to a homeless man sleeping at the bus stop in front.
w|gelandangan.ko: 호텔 경비원이 앞 정류장에서 자는 노숙인에게 담요를 줬어요.

w|gelang.text: Dimas memasang gelang nama di kaki burung beo yang dirawat inap.
w|gelang.en: Dimas put a name band on the leg of the parrot staying at the clinic.
w|gelang.ko: 디마스는 입원한 앵무새 다리에 이름 고리를 달았어요.

w|gelang.text: Putri melepas gelang dan cincin sebelum memakai sarung tangan.
w|gelang.en: Putri took off her bracelet and ring before putting on gloves.
w|gelang.ko: 푸트리는 장갑을 끼기 전에 팔찌와 반지를 뺐어요.

w|gelanggang.text: Tahun depan, teater Eko akan pentas di gelanggang olahraga yang lebih besar.
w|gelanggang.en: Next year, Eko's theater will perform in a bigger sports arena.
w|gelanggang.ko: 내년에 에코의 극단은 더 큰 체육관에서 공연할 거예요.

w|gelanggang.text: Toko Ayu ramai setiap ada pertandingan di gelanggang olahraga sebelah.
w|gelanggang.en: Ayu's shop gets busy whenever there's a match at the sports arena next door.
w|gelanggang.ko: 옆 체육관에서 경기가 있을 때마다 아유의 가게는 붐벼요.

w|gelar.text: Dia meraih gelar sarjana tahun lalu.
w|gelar.en: She earned a bachelor's degree last year.
The champion title made him proud.

w|gelas.text: Gelas itu jatuh dan pecah di lantai.
w|gelas.en: That glass fell and broke on the floor.

w|gelas.text: Tolong isi gelas dengan air dingin.
w|gelas.en: Please fill the glass with cold water.

w|gelembung.text: Rudi mengamati gelembung kecil yang naik dari dasar kolam.
w|gelembung.en: Rudi watched the little bubbles rising from the bottom of the pond.
w|gelembung.ko: 루디는 연못 바닥에서 올라오는 작은 거품을 지켜봤어요.

w|gelembung.text: Mesin di panggung meniupkan gelembung sabun ke arah penonton.
w|gelembung.en: A machine on stage blew soap bubbles toward the audience.
w|gelembung.ko: 무대 위 기계가 관객 쪽으로 비눗방울을 불어 냈어요.

w|geli.text: Rudi merasa geli melihat foto masa kecilnya bersama kakak di album lama.
w|geli.en: Rudi found it amusing to see childhood photos of himself and his sister in the old album.
w|geli.ko: 루디는 옛 앨범에서 누나와 찍은 어릴 적 사진을 보고 웃음이 났어요.

w|geli.text: Rina merasa geli saat kepiting kecil merayap di atas kakinya.
w|geli.en: Rina felt ticklish when a little crab crawled over her foot.
w|geli.ko: 작은 게가 발 위로 기어가자 리나는 간지러웠어요.

w|gelisah.text: Dia merasa gelisah menunggu hasil ujian.
w|gelisah.en: He felt restless waiting for the exam results.

w|gelisah.text: Gelisah membuatnya sulit tidur malam ini.
w|gelisah.en: Anxiety made it hard for him to sleep tonight.

w|gelombang.en: High waves hit the rocky beach.
The children play in the small waves.

w|gembala.text: Kakek di ujung gang dulu seorang gembala kambing, cerita Andi.
w|gembala.en: The old man at the end of the alley used to be a goat herder, Andi says.
w|gembala.ko: 안디 말로는 골목 끝 할아버지가 예전에 염소 목동이었대요.

w|gembala.text: Dewi mengajarkan lagu daerah tentang seorang gembala dan seruling bambu.
w|gembala.en: Dewi teaches a folk song about a shepherd and a bamboo flute.
w|gembala.ko: 데위는 목동과 대나무 피리에 관한 민요를 가르쳐요.

w|gembira.text: Anak-anak tampak gembira di taman bermain.
w|gembira.en: The children looked happy at the playground.

w|gembira.text: Dia merasa gembira setelah mendapat kabar baik.
w|gembira.en: She felt joyful after getting good news.

w|gemetar.text: Tangan Andi gemetar waktu maju membaca puisi di depan kelas.
w|gemetar.en: Andi's hands trembled when he went up to read a poem in front of the class.
w|gemetar.ko: 앞에 나가 시를 읽을 때 안디의 손이 떨렸어요.

w|gemetar.text: Pasien tua itu gemetar kedinginan di ruang tunggu.
w|gemetar.en: The elderly patient was shivering with cold in the waiting room.
w|gemetar.ko: 그 나이 든 환자는 대기실에서 추위에 떨고 있었어요.

w|gemetaran.text: Tangan Budi gemetaran saat menulis kabar duka itu.
w|gemetaran.en: Budi's hands were trembling as he wrote that sad news.
w|gemetaran.ko: 그 슬픈 소식을 쓰는 동안 부디의 손이 떨렸어요.

w|gemetaran.text: Anak tetangga gemetaran kedinginan setelah kehujanan.
w|gemetaran.en: The neighbor's child was shivering with cold after getting caught in the rain.
w|gemetaran.ko: 이웃집 아이가 비를 맞고 추워서 덜덜 떨었어요.

w|gempa.text: Gempa kecil mengguncang kota tadi pagi.
w|gempa.en: A small earthquake shook the city this morning.
w|gempa.ko: 오늘 아침 작은 지진이 도시를 흔들었어.

w|gempa.en: Residents practice facing a major earthquake.

w|gemuk.text: Kucing itu tampak gemuk dan sehat.
w|gemuk.en: That cat looks plump and healthy.

w|gemuk.text: Gemuk sekali bayi di foto itu.
w|gemuk.en: The baby in that photo is so chubby.
w|gemuk.ko: 그 사진 속 아기가 정말 통통해.

w|genangan.text: Setelah hujan semalam, genangan air muncul di jalan desa.
w|genangan.en: After last night's rain, puddles appeared on the village road.
w|genangan.ko: 어젯밤 비가 온 뒤 마을 길에 물웅덩이가 생겼어요.

w|genangan.text: Ayu memasang tanda hati-hati di dekat genangan oli.
w|genangan.en: Ayu put a caution sign near the puddle of oil.
w|genangan.ko: 아유는 기름 웅덩이 옆에 주의 표지판을 세웠어요.

w|gencatan.text: Di pelajaran sejarah, Eko belajar bahwa gencatan senjata tidak selalu berarti perang berakhir.
w|gencatan.en: In history class, Eko learned that a ceasefire doesn't always mean the war is over.
w|gencatan.ko: 역사 시간에 에코는 휴전이 꼭 전쟁이 끝났다는 뜻은 아니라는 걸 배웠어요.

w|gencatan.text: Ayu melukis burung merpati sebagai simbol gencatan senjata untuk lomba poster perdamaian.
w|gencatan.en: Ayu painted a dove as a symbol of a ceasefire for a peace poster contest.
w|gencatan.ko: 아유는 평화 포스터 대회에 휴전의 상징으로 비둘기를 그렸어요.

w|gendang.text: Anak-anak boleh memukul gendang kayu di pojok musik tradisional.
w|gendang.en: Children may beat the wooden drum in the traditional music corner.
w|gendang.ko: 아이들은 전통 음악 코너에서 나무 북을 쳐 볼 수 있어요.

w|gendang.text: Di lantai mainan, Putri menjual gendang kecil untuk anak-anak.
w|gendang.en: On the toy floor, Putri sells small drums for children.
w|gendang.ko: 푸트리는 장난감 층에서 아이들용 작은 북을 팔아요.

w|gendut.text: Kucing gendut itu tidur di sofa.
w|gendut.en: That chubby cat is sleeping on the sofa.

w|gendut.text: Gendut tidak berarti dia tidak sehat.
w|gendut.en: Being chubby does not mean he is unhealthy.

w|generasi.en: The young generation brings new ideas.

w|generasi.text: Setiap generasi punya gaya hidup berbeda.
w|generasi.en: Every generation has a different lifestyle.

w|genetik.text: Menurut Dimas, penyakit mata anjing ras itu bersifat genetik.
w|genetik.en: According to Dimas, that purebred dog's eye disease is genetic.
w|genetik.ko: 디마스 말로는 그 순종견의 눈병은 유전이에요.

w|genetik.text: Tim Putri sedang memetakan faktor genetik penyebab penyakit langka itu.
w|genetik.en: Putri's team is mapping the genetic factors behind that rare disease.
w|genetik.ko: 푸트리 팀은 그 희귀병을 일으키는 유전 요인을 찾고 있어요.

w|genetika.text: Dimas pernah belajar genetika sebelum menjadi apoteker.
w|genetika.en: Dimas studied genetics before becoming a pharmacist.
w|genetika.ko: 디마스는 약사가 되기 전에 유전학을 공부했어요.

w|genetika.text: Putri bercanda bahwa bakat bertukang ada dalam genetika keluarga.
w|genetika.en: Putri joked that a knack for building runs in the family genetics.

w|geng.en: Police broke up a local thief gang.

w|geng.text: Geng remaja itu sering berkumpul di taman.
w|geng.en: That teen gang often gathers in the park.
w|geng.ko: 그 십대 무리는 자주 공원에 모여.

w|genggaman.text: Instruktur memperbaiki genggaman Andi pada pisau agar jarinya aman.
w|genggaman.en: The instructor corrected Andi's grip on the knife so his fingers would be safe.
w|genggaman.ko: 강사는 손가락이 안전하도록 안디의 칼 잡는 법을 고쳐 줬어요.

w|genggaman.text: Dewi ingat genggaman tangan Rani saat mereka berpisah di stasiun.
w|genggaman.en: Dewi remembers Rani's grip on her hand when they said goodbye at the station.
w|genggaman.ko: 데위는 역에서 헤어질 때 꼭 잡던 라니의 손을 기억해요.

w|genting.text: Situasi sempat genting saat listrik hotel padam di tengah pesta pernikahan.
w|genting.en: Things got tense when the hotel's power went out in the middle of a wedding party.
w|genting.ko: 결혼 피로연 도중 호텔 전기가 나가서 한때 상황이 아슬아슬했어요.

w|genting.text: Persediaan air di desa Rina mulai genting menjelang akhir kemarau.
w|genting.en: The water supply in Rina's village is getting critical toward the end of the dry season.
w|genting.ko: 건기가 끝나 갈 무렵 리나네 마을의 물 사정이 위태로워지기 시작해요.

w|geografi.text: Eko suka pelajaran geografi karena bisa mengenal gunung-gunung di negerinya.
w|geografi.en: Eko likes geography class because he gets to know the mountains of his country.
w|geografi.ko: 에코는 자기 나라의 산들을 알게 돼서 지리 수업을 좋아해요.

w|geografi.text: Ayu dulu kuliah geografi sebelum bekerja di bagian logistik pabrik.
w|geografi.en: Ayu studied geography before working in the factory's logistics department.
w|geografi.ko: 아유는 공장 물류팀에서 일하기 전에 대학에서 지리학을 공부했어요.

w|geologi.text: Seorang mahasiswa geologi datang meneliti tanah di ladang Budi.
w|geologi.en: A geology student came to study the soil in Budi's field.
w|geologi.ko: 지질학과 학생 한 명이 부디의 밭 흙을 조사하러 왔어요.

w|geologi.text: Seorang pelanggan tetap yang dosen geologi selalu memesan sup buatan Siti.
w|geologi.en: A regular customer who is a geology lecturer always orders Siti's soup.
w|geologi.ko: 지질학 강사인 단골손님은 늘 시티가 만든 수프를 주문해요.

w|gerak.text: Saat senam pagi, Budi selalu salah mengikuti gerak instruktur.
w|gerak.en: During morning exercises, Budi always gets the instructor's moves wrong.
w|gerak.ko: 아침 체조 때 부디는 늘 강사의 동작을 틀리게 따라 해요.

w|gerak.text: Para alumni tertawa melihat gerak tari Rudi yang kaku.
w|gerak.en: The alumni laughed at Rudi's stiff dance moves.
w|gerak.ko: 동문들은 루디의 뻣뻣한 춤 동작을 보고 웃었어요.

w|gerakan.en: His hand movements are very fast.

w|gerbang.en: The school gate is already closed.
Wait in front of the gate.

w|gerbong.text: Di perlintasan, Bayu menunggu kereta barang dengan puluhan gerbong lewat.
w|gerbong.en: At the level crossing, Bayu waited for a freight train with dozens of cars to pass.
w|gerbong.ko: 건널목에서 바유는 화차 수십 칸이 달린 화물 열차가 지나가길 기다렸어요.

w|gerbong.text: Intan membuat sketsa gerbong kereta tua di museum.
w|gerbong.en: Intan sketched an old train carriage at the museum.
w|gerbong.ko: 인탄은 박물관에서 낡은 기차 객차를 스케치했어요.

w|gereja.en: That church stands on the hill.
They go to church in the morning.

w|gergaji.text: Agus meminjam gergaji dari tetangga untuk memotong papan rak.
w|gergaji.en: Agus borrowed a saw from his neighbor to cut the shelf boards.
w|gergaji.ko: 아구스는 선반 판자를 자르려고 이웃에게 톱을 빌렸어요.

w|gergaji.text: Suami Wati memakai gergaji untuk memotong dahan yang patah karena badai.
w|gergaji.en: Wati's husband used a saw to cut the branch broken by the storm.
w|gergaji.ko: 와티의 남편은 폭풍에 부러진 가지를 톱으로 잘랐어요.

w|gerhana.text: Malam itu ada gerhana bulan, jadi Rudi bangun tengah malam untuk melihatnya.
w|gerhana.en: There was a lunar eclipse that night, so Rudi got up at midnight to watch it.
w|gerhana.ko: 그날 밤 월식이 있어서 루디는 그걸 보려고 한밤중에 일어났어요.

w|gerhana.text: Konser itu bertepatan dengan gerhana bulan, dan penonton bersorak saat bulan memerah.
w|gerhana.en: The concert coincided with a lunar eclipse, and the crowd cheered as the moon turned red.
w|gerhana.ko: 공연이 월식과 겹쳐서 달이 붉어지자 관객들이 환호했어요.

w|gerobak.text: Di luar stasiun, seorang bapak menjual jagung bakar dari gerobak kayu.
w|gerobak.en: Outside the station, a man was selling grilled corn from a wooden cart.
w|gerobak.ko: 역 밖에서 한 아저씨가 나무 수레에서 군옥수수를 팔고 있었어요.

w|gerobak.text: Aplikasi pertama Putri dibuat untuk pedagang gerobak yang ingin menerima pembayaran digital.
w|gerobak.en: Putri's first app was made for cart vendors who want to accept digital payments.
w|gerobak.ko: 푸트리의 첫 앱은 디지털 결제를 받고 싶어 하는 수레 상인들을 위해 만들었어요.

w|gerombolan.text: Dalam buku cerita, Eko membaca tentang gerombolan perampok di hutan.
w|gerombolan.en: In a storybook, Eko read about a band of robbers in the forest.
w|gerombolan.ko: 동화책에서 에코는 숲속 도적 떼 이야기를 읽었어요.

w|gerombolan.text: Ayu melukis gerombolan burung pipit di atas sawah.
w|gerombolan.en: Ayu painted a flock of sparrows over the rice fields.
w|gerombolan.ko: 아유는 논 위를 나는 참새 떼를 그렸어요.

w|gertakan.text: Fajar tahu ancaman pengusaha itu hanya gertakan belaka.
w|gertakan.en: Fajar knew the businessman's threat was nothing but a bluff.
w|gertakan.ko: 파자르는 그 사업가의 협박이 그저 엄포일 뿐이라는 걸 알았어요.

w|gertakan.text: Lestari tidak takut pada gertakan pemilik unit yang menolak membayar iuran.
w|gertakan.en: Lestari isn't scared of the bluster of the unit owner who refuses to pay dues.
w|gertakan.ko: 레스타리는 관리비를 안 내겠다는 집주인의 엄포가 무섭지 않아요.

w|getaran.text: Agus merasakan getaran tanah ketika pohon besar tumbang di seberang sungai.
w|getaran.en: Agus felt the ground shake when a big tree fell across the river.
w|getaran.ko: 강 건너편에서 큰 나무가 쓰러질 때 아구스는 땅의 진동을 느꼈어요.

w|getaran.text: Saat truk besar lewat, getaran jalan membuat botol-botol di rak bergoyang.
w|getaran.en: When big trucks pass, the road vibration makes the bottles on the shelves rattle.
w|getaran.ko: 큰 트럭이 지나가면 길의 진동 때문에 선반 위 병들이 흔들려요.

w|giat.text: Fajar dikenal sebagai wartawan yang giat mencari sumber baru.
w|giat.en: Fajar is known as a reporter who works hard to find new sources.
w|giat.ko: 파자르는 새 취재원을 부지런히 찾는 기자로 알려져 있어요.

w|giat.text: Lestari kagum melihat para petani yang giat bekerja sejak subuh.
w|giat.en: Lestari was impressed by the farmers working hard since dawn.
w|giat.ko: 레스타리는 새벽부터 부지런히 일하는 농부들을 보고 감탄했어요.

w|gigih.text: Bu Sari gigih menagih iuran sampah sampai Andi akhirnya membayar.
w|gigih.en: Bu Sari kept stubbornly collecting the trash fee until Andi finally paid.
w|gigih.ko: 사리 씨가 쓰레기 회비를 끈질기게 걷어서 안디가 결국 냈어요.

w|gigih.text: Dewi memuji murid yang gigih berlatih tangga nada setiap hari.
w|gigih.en: Dewi praised the student who persistently practices scales every day.
w|gigih.ko: 데위는 매일 꾸준히 음계를 연습하는 학생을 칭찬했어요.

w|gigitan.text: Lengan Budi merah karena gigitan nyamuk saat upacara pagi.
w|gigitan.en: Budi's arm is red from mosquito bites during the morning ceremony.
w|gigitan.ko: 아침 조회 때 모기에 물려서 부디 팔이 빨개요.

w|gigitan.text: Kucing Siti meninggalkan bekas gigitan di kardus berisi ikan asin.
w|gigitan.en: Siti's cat left bite marks on the box of salted fish.
w|gigitan.ko: 시티네 고양이가 자반 상자에 이빨 자국을 남겼어요.

w|giliran.en: It's your turn to speak now.

w|giliran.text: Kami menunggu giliran di antrian panjang.
w|giliran.en: We waited for our turn in a long line.

w|ginjal.text: Menurut Dimas, makanan yang terlalu asin sangat berpengaruh pada kesehatan ginjal kucing.
w|ginjal.en: According to Dimas, overly salty food has a big effect on a cat's kidney health.
w|ginjal.ko: 디마스 말로는 너무 짠 음식이 고양이 콩팥 건강에 큰 영향을 줘요.

w|ginjal.text: Putri meneliti bagaimana ginjal menyaring racun dari darah.
w|ginjal.en: Putri studies how the kidneys filter toxins from the blood.
w|ginjal.ko: 푸트리는 콩팥이 피에서 독소를 걸러 내는 방식을 연구해요.

w|gipsi.text: Bayu bercerita bahwa dulu hidup berpindah-pindah kota seperti gipsi.
w|gipsi.en: Bayu said he used to move from city to city like a gypsy.
w|gipsi.ko: 바유는 예전에 집시처럼 이 도시 저 도시를 떠돌며 살았다고 했어요.

w|gipsi.text: Musik gipsi diputar saat kelas dansa di gym itu.
w|gipsi.en: Gypsy music plays during the dance class at that gym.
w|gipsi.ko: 그 헬스장 댄스 수업 시간에는 집시 음악이 나와요.

w|gitar.text: Dimas meminjam buku belajar gitar untuk pemula.
w|gitar.en: Dimas borrowed a guitar book for beginners.

w|gitar.text: Pemuda di kursi depan memainkan gitar pelan-pelan untuk menghibur penumpang.
w|gitar.en: The young man in the seat in front played his guitar softly to entertain the passengers.
w|gitar.ko: 앞자리 청년이 승객들을 위해 기타를 조용히 쳤어요.

w|gitu.text: Kalau gitu kita bertemu besok saja.
w|gitu.en: If that's the case, let's just meet tomorrow.
Why did he act like that toward you?

w|gletser.text: Agus pernah menonton film tentang gletser yang mencair di kutub.
w|gletser.en: Agus once watched a film about glaciers melting at the poles.
w|gletser.ko: 아구스는 극지방 빙하가 녹는 영화를 본 적이 있어요.

w|gletser.text: Wati melampirkan kartu pos bergambar gletser dari perjalanan putranya.
w|gletser.en: Wati enclosed a postcard with a picture of a glacier from her son's trip.
w|gletser.ko: 와티는 아들이 여행에서 보낸 빙하 그림엽서를 동봉했어요.

w|global.en: Climate issues have become a global concern.
w|global.ko: 기후 문제가 전 세계적 관심사가 됐어.

w|global.text: Perusahaan itu punya jaringan global luas.
w|global.en: That company has a wide global network.
w|global.ko: 그 회사는 넓은 글로벌 네트워크를 갖고 있어.

w|godaan.text: Rudi menahan godaan untuk membalas sindiran kakaknya di media sosial.
w|godaan.en: Rudi resisted the temptation to respond to his sister's jab on social media.
w|godaan.ko: 루디는 소셜 미디어에서 누나의 비꼼에 맞받아치고 싶은 마음을 참았어요.

w|godaan.text: Deretan jajanan di sepanjang pantai menjadi godaan besar bagi Rina yang sedang diet.
w|godaan.en: The rows of snacks along the beach were a big temptation for Rina, who was on a diet.
w|godaan.ko: 해변을 따라 늘어선 간식들은 다이어트 중인 리나에게 큰 유혹이었어요.

w|gol.text: Budi mencetak gol kemenangan di pertandingan antarsekolah.
w|gol.en: Budi scored the winning goal in the interschool match.
w|gol.ko: 부디는 학교 대항 경기에서 결승골을 넣었어요.

w|gol.text: Rudi mengenang gol yang dia cetak di final kejuaraan sekolah.
w|gol.en: Rudi reminisced about the goal he scored in the school championship final.
w|gol.ko: 루디는 학교 대회 결승에서 넣은 골을 떠올렸어요.

w|golf.text: Golf dimainkan di lapangan yang luas.
w|golf.en: Golf is played on a wide course.

w|golf.text: Ayah bermain golf setiap akhir pekan.

w|golongan.text: Andi membaca bahwa masyarakat kerajaan dulu dibagi dalam beberapa golongan.
w|golongan.en: Andi read that the kingdom's society used to be divided into several classes.
w|golongan.ko: 안디는 옛 왕국 사회가 여러 계층으로 나뉘었다는 걸 읽었어요.

w|golongan.text: Gaji karyawan di kantor itu ditentukan oleh golongan dan masa kerja.
w|golongan.en: Salaries at that office are set by grade and length of service.
w|golongan.ko: 그 회사 직원 급여는 직급과 근속 기간으로 정해져요.

w|goreng.text: Goreng ayam itu harum di dapur.
w|goreng.en: That fried chicken smells good in the kitchen.

w|goreng.text: Dia suka makan pisang goreng di sore hari.
w|goreng.en: She likes eating fried bananas in the afternoon.
w|goreng.ko: 그는 오후에 바나나 튀김 먹기를 좋아해.

w|goresan.text: Ada goresan kecil di lengan Bayu karena tersangkut alat angkat beban.
w|goresan.en: There is a small scratch on Bayu's arm from catching it on the weight machine.
w|goresan.ko: 바유 팔에 웨이트 기구에 걸려서 생긴 작은 긁힌 자국이 있어요.

w|goresan.text: Ada goresan panjang di meja kayu tempat keluarga Intan duduk.
w|goresan.en: There is a long scratch on the wooden table where Intan's family sits.
w|goresan.ko: 인탄 가족이 앉은 나무 식탁에 긴 긁힌 자국이 있어요.

w|gosip.text: Menurut gosip para pegawai, lukisan di lorong itu sebenarnya tiruan.
w|gosip.en: According to staff gossip, the painting in the hallway is actually a copy.
w|gosip.ko: 직원들 사이 소문으로는 복도에 걸린 그림이 사실 모조품이래요.

w|gosip.text: Ibu-ibu di los ikan suka bertukar gosip sambil menunggu pembeli.
w|gosip.en: The women at the fish section like to swap gossip while waiting for customers.
w|gosip.ko: 생선 구역 아주머니들은 손님을 기다리며 수다 떠는 걸 좋아해요.

w|goyah.text: Kursi Budi sudah goyah, jadi ia minta ganti ke penjaga sekolah.
w|goyah.en: Budi's chair was wobbly, so he asked the school caretaker for a new one.
w|goyah.ko: 부디의 의자가 흔들거려서 학교 관리인에게 바꿔 달라고 했어요.

w|goyah.text: Roda koper Siti sudah goyah sejak keluar dari bagasi.
w|goyah.en: The wheel of Siti's suitcase has been wobbly since it came out of baggage claim.
w|goyah.ko: 시티의 캐리어 바퀴는 수하물 찾는 곳에서 나온 뒤로 흔들거려요.

w|grafik.text: Fajar menambahkan grafik harga beras supaya pembaca cepat paham.
w|grafik.en: Fajar added a chart of rice prices so readers would understand quickly.
w|grafik.ko: 파자르는 독자들이 빨리 이해하도록 쌀값 그래프를 넣었어요.

w|grafik.text: Lestari melihat grafik ketinggian jalan di aplikasi peta sebelum naik ke dataran tinggi.
w|grafik.en: Lestari checked the road elevation chart in the map app before heading up to the highlands.
w|grafik.ko: 레스타리는 고원으로 올라가기 전에 지도 앱에서 도로 고도 그래프를 봤어요.

w|granat.text: Di museum perang, Eko melihat granat tua di balik kaca.
w|granat.en: At the war museum, Eko saw an old grenade behind glass.
w|granat.ko: 전쟁 박물관에서 에코는 유리 뒤에 있는 오래된 수류탄을 봤어요.

w|granat.text: Dalam film yang ditonton keluarga Ayu, tentara melempar granat ke arah jembatan.
w|granat.en: In the film Ayu's family watched, a soldier threw a grenade toward the bridge.
w|granat.ko: 아유네 가족이 본 영화에서 군인이 다리 쪽으로 수류탄을 던졌어요.

w|gratis.en: Entry to this museum is free.

w|gratis.text: Mereka memberi sampel gratis di toko.
w|gratis.en: They give free samples at the store.

w|gravitasi.text: Gravitasi menarik benda jatuh ke bumi.
w|gravitasi.en: Gravity pulls objects down to Earth.

w|gravitasi.text: Astronaut merasakan gravitasi yang lemah di luar angkasa.
w|gravitasi.en: Astronauts feel weak gravity in outer space.

w|grup.text: Grup musik itu akan tampil malam ini.
w|grup.en: That music group will perform tonight.
w|grup.ko: 그 음악 그룹이 오늘 밤 공연할 거야.

w|grup.text: Kami bergabung dengan grup belajar baru.
w|grup.en: We joined a new study group.

w|gua.text: Mereka menemukan gua gelap di hutan.
w|gua.en: They found a dark cave in the forest.
That cave holds an ancient secret.

w|gubernur.en: The governor visited a remote village.
The people support the new governor's program.

w|gubuk.text: Di belakang gedung ada gubuk kecil tempat satpam beristirahat, kata Pak Budi kepada Dimas.
w|gubuk.en: Behind the building there's a small hut where the guards rest, Mr. Budi told Dimas.
w|gubuk.ko: 건물 뒤에 경비원들이 쉬는 작은 오두막이 있다고 부디 씨가 디마스에게 말했어요.

w|gubuk.text: Dari jendela pesawat, Putri melihat sebuah gubuk petani di pinggir sawah.
w|gubuk.en: From the plane window, Putri saw a farmer's hut at the edge of a rice field.
w|gubuk.ko: 비행기 창문으로 푸트리는 논 가장자리의 농부 오두막을 봤어요.

w|guci.text: Agus menaruh guci keramik pemberian ibunya di sudut ruangan.
w|guci.en: Agus placed the ceramic jar his mother gave him in the corner of the room.
w|guci.ko: 아구스는 어머니가 준 도자기 항아리를 방 구석에 두었어요.

w|guci.text: Wati menyimpan air minum dalam guci tanah liat agar tetap sejuk.
w|guci.en: Wati keeps drinking water in a clay jar so it stays cool.
w|guci.ko: 와티는 마실 물이 시원하게 유지되도록 흙 항아리에 담아 둬요.

w|gudang.text: Gudang itu penuh dengan kotak kayu.
w|gudang.en: That warehouse is full of wooden boxes.
The goods are stored in the back warehouse.

w|gugatan.text: Pemilik pabrik mengajukan gugatan kepada koran itu karena merasa difitnah.
w|gugatan.en: The factory owner filed a lawsuit against the newspaper because he felt defamed.
w|gugatan.ko: 공장 주인은 명예가 훼손됐다며 그 신문사에 소송을 냈어요.

w|gugatan.text: Startup itu menghadapi gugatan karena nama aplikasinya mirip merek lain.
w|gugatan.en: The startup faced a lawsuit because its app name was similar to another brand.
w|gugatan.ko: 그 스타트업은 앱 이름이 다른 상표와 비슷해서 소송을 당했어요.

w|gugup.en: He looked nervous before the interview.

w|gugup.text: Jangan gugup saat berbicara di depan umum.
w|gugup.en: Don't get nervous when speaking in public.
w|gugup.ko: 사람들 앞에서 말할 때 긴장하지 마.

w|gugur.text: Daun kering mulai gugur di musim gugur.
w|gugur.en: Dry leaves start to fall in autumn.

w|gugur.text: Gugur di medan perang dikenang setiap tahun.
w|gugur.en: Those who fell on the battlefield are remembered every year.

w|gula.text: Tambahkan sedikit gula ke dalam teh.
w|gula.en: Add a little sugar to the tea.

w|gula.text: Gula di stoples sudah hampir habis.
w|gula.en: The sugar in the jar is almost gone.
w|gula.ko: 통에 있는 설탕이 거의 다 떨어졌어.

w|gulma.text: Setiap pagi Eko mencabuti gulma di sela tanaman kentang.
w|gulma.en: Every morning Eko pulls the weeds between the potato plants.
w|gulma.ko: 에코는 매일 아침 감자 사이의 잡초를 뽑아요.

w|gulma.text: Pabrik kimia itu memproduksi obat pembasmi gulma untuk petani.
w|gulma.en: That chemical plant produces weed killer for farmers.
w|gulma.ko: 그 화학 공장은 농부들을 위한 제초제를 만들어요.

w|gulungan.text: Pak Guru membawa gulungan peta besar ke kelas Dimas.
w|gulungan.en: The teacher brought a big rolled-up map to Dimas's class.
w|gulungan.ko: 선생님이 디마스네 반에 커다란 두루마리 지도를 가져왔어요.

w|gulungan.text: Menu andalan restoran Putri adalah gulungan telur isi daging.
w|gulungan.en: The signature dish at Putri's restaurant is an egg roll filled with meat.
w|gulungan.ko: 푸트리네 식당의 대표 메뉴는 고기를 넣은 계란말이예요.

w|gumpalan.text: Jaksa menunjukkan foto gumpalan kertas yang ditemukan di tempat sampah kantor.
w|gumpalan.en: The prosecutor showed a photo of a wad of paper found in the office trash can.
w|gumpalan.ko: 검사는 사무실 쓰레기통에서 나온 종이 뭉치 사진을 보여 줬어요.

w|gumpalan.text: Wati menemukan gumpalan tepung di adonan dan mengaduknya sekali lagi.
w|gumpalan.en: Wati found lumps of flour in the batter and stirred it once more.
w|gumpalan.ko: 와티는 반죽에서 밀가루 덩어리를 발견하고 한 번 더 저었어요.

w|guna.text: Apa guna membawa payung kalau cuaca cerah?
w|guna.en: What's the use of bringing an umbrella if the weather is clear?
w|guna.ko: 날씨가 맑은데 우산을 가져가서 뭐 해?

w|guna.en: The use of this tool is very simple.

w|gunting.text: Fajar mengambil gunting untuk membuka kardus paket yang dilakban rapat.
w|gunting.en: Fajar grabbed scissors to open the tightly taped parcel box.
w|gunting.ko: 파자르는 테이프로 꽁꽁 싸맨 택배 상자를 열려고 가위를 집었어요.

w|gunting.text: Lestari memakai gunting dapur untuk memotong daun bawang.
w|gunting.en: Lestari used kitchen scissors to cut the spring onions.

w|guntur.text: Suara guntur di kejauhan membuat Eko buru-buru memasang terpal.
w|guntur.en: The sound of thunder in the distance made Eko hurry to put up a tarp.
w|guntur.ko: 멀리서 천둥소리가 들리자 에코는 서둘러 방수포를 쳤어요.

w|guntur.text: Lomba sempat dihentikan sebentar karena suara guntur terdengar sangat dekat.
w|guntur.en: The race was briefly stopped because the thunder sounded very close.
w|guntur.ko: 천둥소리가 아주 가까이 들려서 대회가 잠시 멈췄어요.

w|gunung.en: That mountain is covered in snow.

w|gurauan.text: Hakim menegur pengacara yang melontarkan gurauan di tengah sidang.
w|gurauan.en: The judge reprimanded the lawyer who cracked a joke in the middle of the hearing.
w|gurauan.ko: 판사는 재판 중에 농담을 던진 변호사를 꾸짖었어요.

w|gurauan.text: Pelayan restoran itu terkenal karena gurauan ramahnya kepada setiap tamu.
w|gurauan.en: The restaurant's waiter is known for his friendly jokes with every guest.
w|gurauan.ko: 그 식당 종업원은 손님마다 건네는 다정한 농담으로 유명해요.

w|gurita.text: Di kolam karang saat air surut, Eko melihat seekor gurita kecil bersembunyi.
w|gurita.en: In a rock pool at low tide, Eko saw a small octopus hiding.
w|gurita.ko: 썰물 때 바위 웅덩이에서 에코는 작은 문어가 숨어 있는 걸 봤어요.

w|gurita.text: Maskot lomba itu berupa gurita oranye yang menyemangati pelari di pinggir jalan.
w|gurita.en: The race mascot is an orange octopus that cheers on runners by the roadside.
w|gurita.ko: 그 대회 마스코트는 길가에서 주자들을 응원하는 주황색 문어예요.

w|guru.en: I want to be a teacher.

w|gurun.text: Gurun itu panas di siang hari.
w|gurun.en: That desert is hot in the daytime.
They crossed the desert with camels.

w|habis-habisan.text: Fajar dan seluruh tim bekerja habis-habisan menjelang tenggat malam itu.
w|habis-habisan.en: Fajar and the whole team worked flat out before that night's deadline.
w|habis-habisan.ko: 파자르와 팀 모두가 그날 밤 마감을 앞두고 온 힘을 다해 일했어요.

w|habis-habisan.text: Mobil tua Lestari menanjak habis-habisan di jalan pegunungan.
w|habis-habisan.en: Lestari's old car climbed the mountain road with everything it had.
w|habis-habisan.ko: 레스타리의 낡은 차는 산길을 젖 먹던 힘까지 다해 올라갔어요.

w|hadapan.text: Dia berdiri di hadapan pintu besar.
w|hadapan.en: He stood in front of the big door.
w|hadapan.ko: 그는 큰 문 앞에 서 있었어.

w|hadapan.text: Di hadapan umum dia tetap tenang.
w|hadapan.en: In front of the public he stayed calm.

w|hadiah.en: This is a gift for you.
His birthday gift was really nice.

w|hadir.text: Semua siswa harus hadir besok pagi.
w|hadir.en: All students must be present tomorrow morning.
w|hadir.ko: 모든 학생은 내일 아침 출석해야 해.

w|hadir.en: He attended even though he was sick.

w|hadirin.en: The audience is asked to sit quietly.
The speaker greeted the whole audience.

w|haji.text: Kakek Eko yang baru pulang haji datang menonton dengan mengenakan peci putih.
w|haji.en: Eko's grandfather, just back from the hajj, came to watch wearing a white cap.
w|haji.ko: 막 성지 순례에서 돌아온 에코의 할아버지가 흰 모자를 쓰고 공연을 보러 왔어요.

w|haji.text: Ayu duduk di samping rombongan jemaah haji yang akan menuju bandara.
w|haji.en: Ayu sat next to a group of hajj pilgrims heading to the airport.
w|haji.ko: 아유는 공항으로 가는 성지 순례단 옆에 앉았어요.

w|hakim.text: Hakim membacakan putusan dengan suara tegas.
w|hakim.en: The judge read the verdict in a firm voice.
The lawyer awaits the judge's decision.

w|hal.en: There's something I want to tell you.

w|halaman.en: The kids are playing in the yard.

w|halangan.text: Hujan deras bukan halangan bagi Budi untuk datang ke sekolah.
w|halangan.en: Heavy rain is no obstacle to Budi coming to school.
w|halangan.ko: 폭우도 부디가 학교에 오는 걸 막지 못해요.

w|halangan.text: Siti lega karena penerbangannya berangkat tanpa halangan.
w|halangan.en: Siti was relieved her flight took off without a hitch.
w|halangan.ko: 시티는 비행기가 아무 문제 없이 출발해서 안심했어요.

w|haleluya.text: Dari ruang musik museum terdengar paduan suara menyanyikan haleluya.
w|haleluya.en: From the museum's music room came the sound of a choir singing hallelujah.
w|haleluya.ko: 박물관 음악실에서 합창단이 할렐루야를 부르는 소리가 들렸어요.

w|haleluya.text: Dalam adegan pernikahan, paduan suara gereja menyanyikan haleluya dengan lantang.
w|haleluya.en: In the wedding scene, the church choir sang hallelujah loudly.
w|haleluya.ko: 결혼식 장면에서 교회 합창단이 할렐루야를 우렁차게 불렀어요.

w|halte.text: Rudi menunjukkan arah halte bus kepada tamu yang ingin ke museum.
w|halte.en: Rudi showed the way to the bus stop to a guest who wanted to go to the museum.
w|halte.ko: 루디는 박물관에 가려는 손님에게 버스 정류장 가는 길을 알려 줬어요.

w|halte.text: Rina berteduh di halte sambil menunggu hujan reda.
w|halte.en: Rina took shelter at the bus stop while waiting for the rain to ease.
w|halte.ko: 리나는 비가 그치기를 기다리며 정류장에서 비를 피했어요.

w|haluan.text: Rudi memesan tur perahu dengan tempat duduk di dekat haluan untuk pasangan bulan madu.
w|haluan.en: Rudi booked a boat tour with seats near the bow for the honeymoon couple.
w|haluan.ko: 루디는 신혼부부를 위해 뱃머리 가까운 자리로 보트 투어를 예약했어요.

w|haluan.text: Ombak musim hujan menghantam haluan perahu paman Rina.
w|haluan.en: The rainy-season waves slammed into the bow of Rina's uncle's boat.
w|haluan.ko: 우기의 파도가 리나 삼촌 배의 뱃머리를 때렸어요.

w|halus.en: Her skin was very smooth after the treatment.

w|halus.text: Dia berbicara dengan nada yang halus.
w|halus.en: He spoke in a gentle tone.

w|hama.text: Penjaga hutan memperingatkan Eko soal hama ulat di pohon-pohon pinus.
w|hama.en: The forest ranger warned Eko about caterpillar pests in the pine trees.
w|hama.ko: 산림 관리원은 에코에게 소나무의 애벌레 해충을 조심하라고 했어요.

w|hama.text: Lintasan maraton melewati kebun jeruk milik petani yang sedang berjuang melawan hama.
w|hama.en: The marathon course passed through orange orchards belonging to farmers fighting pests.
w|hama.ko: 마라톤 코스는 해충과 싸우는 농민들의 귤밭을 지나갔어요.

w|hamba.text: Dia merasa seperti hamba di rumah itu.
w|hamba.en: He felt like a servant in that house.

w|hamba.text: Hamba setia itu menunggu di pintu.
w|hamba.en: That loyal servant waited at the door.

w|hambatan.text: Jarak rumah yang jauh menjadi hambatan bagi Dimas untuk ikut les sore.
w|hambatan.en: The long distance from home is an obstacle for Dimas to attend afternoon tutoring.
w|hambatan.ko: 집이 멀어서 디마스는 오후 과외에 가기가 어려워요.

w|hambatan.text: Harga cabai yang naik menjadi hambatan besar bagi restoran Putri bulan ini.
w|hambatan.en: Rising chili prices became a big obstacle for Putri's restaurant this month.
w|hambatan.ko: 고추값이 올라서 이번 달 푸트리네 식당이 큰 어려움을 겪었어요.

w|hamil.en: She is pregnant with her first child.
Being pregnant makes her tire easily.

w|hampa.text: Rumah terasa hampa ketika Rudi dan kakaknya saling diam.
w|hampa.en: The house felt empty when Rudi and his sister stopped talking to each other.
w|hampa.ko: 루디와 누나가 서로 말을 안 하니 집이 텅 빈 것 같았어요.

w|hampa.text: Pantai terasa hampa setelah semua wisatawan pulang sore itu.
w|hampa.en: The beach felt empty after all the tourists went home that evening.
w|hampa.ko: 그날 저녁 관광객들이 다 돌아가자 해변이 텅 빈 느낌이었어요.

w|handuk.text: Eko menjemur handuk basah di pagar penginapan.
w|handuk.en: Eko hung his wet towel out to dry on the guesthouse fence.
w|handuk.ko: 에코는 젖은 수건을 숙소 울타리에 널었어요.

w|handuk.text: Gara-gara angin kencang, handuk Ayu terbang ke halaman sebelah.
w|handuk.en: Ayu's towel blew into the next-door yard because of the strong wind.
w|handuk.ko: 강한 바람 때문에 아유의 수건이 옆집 마당으로 날아갔어요.

w|hangat.en: The atmosphere of this house is so warm.

w|hangus.text: Sebagian dokumen di gudang belakang hangus setelah terjadi korsleting listrik semalam.
w|hangus.en: Some of the documents in the back storeroom were burnt after an electrical short circuit last night.
w|hangus.ko: 어젯밤 누전이 일어나서 뒤쪽 창고 서류 일부가 탔어요.

w|hangus.text: Pagi itu roti bakar Rina hangus karena ia sibuk menyiapkan perlengkapan lomba.
w|hangus.en: That morning Rina's toast got burnt because she was busy preparing her race gear.
w|hangus.ko: 그날 아침 리나는 경기 준비물을 챙기느라 토스트를 태웠어요.

w|hantu.en: That ghost is just a story.

w|hanyut.text: Jembatan bambu sempat hanyut terbawa arus sungai setelah hujan deras.
w|hanyut.en: The bamboo bridge was swept away by the river current after heavy rain.
w|hanyut.ko: 폭우가 내린 뒤 대나무 다리가 강물에 떠내려갔어요.

w|hanyut.text: Ayu hanyut dalam pekerjaan sampai lupa makan siang.
w|hanyut.en: Ayu got so absorbed in her work that she forgot to eat lunch.
w|hanyut.ko: 아유는 일에 푹 빠져서 점심 먹는 것도 잊었어요.

w|haram.text: Andi bilang mencontek itu haram baginya, apa pun alasannya.
w|haram.en: Andi said cheating is forbidden for him, whatever the reason.
w|haram.ko: 안디는 무슨 이유든 커닝은 절대 안 된다고 했어요.

w|haram.text: Dewi memastikan tidak ada makanan haram di meja karena beberapa tamunya Muslim.
w|haram.en: Dewi made sure there was no non-halal food on the table because some guests are Muslim.
w|haram.ko: 손님 중에 무슬림이 있어서 데위는 식탁에 할랄이 아닌 음식이 없는지 확인했어요.

w|harfiah.text: Redaktur menegur Budi karena menerjemahkan pernyataan menteri terlalu harfiah.
w|harfiah.en: The editor scolded Budi for translating the minister's statement too literally.
w|harfiah.ko: 편집자는 장관의 발언을 너무 직역했다고 부디를 나무랐어요.

w|harfiah.text: Siti menjelaskan arti harfiah nama kota itu kepada rombongan pelajar.
w|harfiah.en: Siti explained the literal meaning of the city's name to a group of students.
w|harfiah.ko: 시티는 학생 단체에게 그 도시 이름의 글자 그대로의 뜻을 설명했어요.

w|harga.en: The ticket price is very expensive.

w|harian.text: Budi mencatat suhu harian di buku kecil yang dia gantung di dapur.
w|harian.en: Budi records the daily temperature in a little book he hangs in the kitchen.
w|harian.ko: 부디는 부엌에 걸어 둔 작은 공책에 매일 기온을 적어요.

w|harian.text: Asisten sutradara membagikan jadwal harian kepada semua pemain.
w|harian.en: The assistant director handed out the daily schedule to all the actors.
w|harian.ko: 조감독이 모든 배우에게 하루 일정표를 나눠 줬어요.

w|harimau.text: Harimau itu berjalan diam di dalam hutan.
w|harimau.en: That tiger walked quietly in the forest.
w|harimau.ko: 그 호랑이가 숲 속을 조용히 걸었어.

w|harimau.text: Anak-anak takut melihat harimau di kebun binatang.
w|harimau.en: The children were scared seeing a tiger at the zoo.

w|harmoni.text: Kapolsek ingin menjaga harmoni antara polisi dan warga kampung.
w|harmoni.en: The precinct chief wants to keep harmony between the police and the villagers.
w|harmoni.ko: 서장은 경찰과 마을 주민 사이의 화합을 지키고 싶어 해요.

w|harmoni.text: Langkah kaki ratusan pelari terdengar seperti harmoni yang teratur.
w|harmoni.en: The footsteps of hundreds of runners sounded like a steady harmony.
w|harmoni.ko: 수백 명 주자의 발소리가 규칙적인 화음처럼 들렸어요.

w|harta.en: He lost all of his family's wealth.

w|harum.text: Agus mencium bau harum dari lapak penjual dupa dan minyak wangi.
w|harum.en: Agus caught a fragrant smell from the incense and perfume stall.
w|harum.ko: 아구스는 향과 향수 파는 노점에서 좋은 냄새를 맡았어요.

w|harum.text: Bau tanah yang harum setelah hujan pertama selalu membuat Wati tersenyum.
w|harum.en: The fragrant smell of earth after the first rain always makes Wati smile.
w|harum.ko: 첫비 뒤 흙냄새는 늘 와티를 미소 짓게 해요.

w|hasil.en: His exam result was very good.

w|hasil.text: Kita tunggu hasil dari rapat itu.
w|hasil.en: We'll wait for the result of that meeting.

w|hasrat.text: Di surat itu Rudi bercerita tentang hasrat lamanya untuk keliling Sumatra dengan motor.
w|hasrat.en: In that letter Rudi talked about his old desire to ride around Sumatra on a motorbike.
w|hasrat.ko: 그 편지에서 루디는 오토바이로 수마트라를 일주하고 싶던 오랜 바람을 이야기했어요.

w|hasrat.text: Rina menahan hasrat untuk menambah fitur baru sebelum yang lama stabil.
w|hasrat.en: Rina held back the urge to add new features before the old ones were stable.
w|hasrat.ko: 리나는 기존 기능이 안정되기 전에 새 기능을 넣고 싶은 마음을 참았어요.

w|haus.en: I am thirsty after running a long way.

w|haus.text: Haus akan ilmu membuatnya terus belajar.
w|haus.en: A thirst for knowledge keeps her studying.
w|haus.ko: 지식에 대한 갈증이 그녀를 계속 공부하게 해.

w|hawa.text: Eko tidak menyangka hawa malam di perkemahan bisa sedingin itu.
w|hawa.en: Eko didn't expect the night air at the campsite to be that cold.
w|hawa.ko: 에코는 캠프장의 밤공기가 그렇게 추울 줄 몰랐어요.

w|hawa.text: Ayu memilih berlari pagi agar tidak kepanasan karena hawa siang terlalu terik.
w|hawa.en: Ayu chose to run in the morning to avoid overheating because the midday heat is too fierce.
w|hawa.ko: 한낮 더위가 너무 심해서 아유는 더위 먹지 않으려고 아침에 뛰기로 했어요.

w|heboh.text: Ruang sidang mendadak heboh ketika terdakwa membantah semua tuduhan.
w|heboh.en: The courtroom suddenly went into an uproar when the defendant denied all the charges.
w|heboh.ko: 피고인이 모든 혐의를 부인하자 법정이 갑자기 술렁였어요.

w|heboh.text: Pesta ulang tahun di meja sudut berlangsung heboh dengan nyanyian dan tepuk tangan.
w|heboh.en: The birthday party at the corner table was a lively affair with singing and clapping.
w|heboh.ko: 구석 자리 생일 파티는 노래와 박수로 떠들썩했어요.

w|hektare.text: Proyek perumahan yang diawasi Andi luasnya hampir sepuluh hektare.
w|hektare.en: The housing project Andi supervises covers almost ten hectares.
w|hektare.ko: 안디가 감독하는 주택 단지는 면적이 거의 십 헥타르예요.

w|hektare.text: Teman Dewi yang petani kini punya kebun durian beberapa hektare.
w|hektare.en: Dewi's farmer friend now owns a durian orchard of several hectares.
w|hektare.ko: 농부인 데위의 친구는 지금 몇 헥타르짜리 두리안 농장을 갖고 있어요.

w|helikopter.text: Helikopter terbang rendah di atas kota.
w|helikopter.en: A helicopter flew low over the city.
The victims were evacuated by helicopter.

w|helm.text: Agus menyewa motor dan meminjam helm dari pemilik penginapan.
w|helm.en: Agus rented a motorbike and borrowed a helmet from the guesthouse owner.
w|helm.ko: 아구스는 오토바이를 빌리고 숙소 주인에게 헬멧도 빌렸어요.

w|helm.text: Anak laki-laki itu memilih helm sepeda berwarna merah.
w|helm.en: The boy chose a red bicycle helmet.
w|helm.ko: 그 남자아이는 빨간 자전거 헬멧을 골랐어요.

w|hendak.text: Dia hendak pulang ketika hujan mulai turun.
w|hendak.en: He was about to go home when rain started.
w|hendak.ko: 비가 내리기 시작할 때 그는 집에 가려 했어.

w|hendak.en: Wanting to ask, she raised her hand.

w|heran.en: I was surprised to see the result.

w|heran.text: Heran sekali dia bisa datang cepat.
w|heran.en: It is surprising he could arrive so fast.
w|heran.ko: 그가 그렇게 빨리 올 수 있다니 신기해.

w|heroik.text: Andi membaca kisah heroik seorang dokter yang menolong korban gempa.
w|heroik.en: Andi read the heroic story of a doctor who helped earthquake victims.
w|heroik.ko: 안디는 지진 피해자를 도운 의사의 영웅적인 이야기를 읽었어요.

w|heroik.text: Usaha kakak Dewi mengangkat lemari sendirian terasa heroik sekaligus konyol.
w|heroik.en: Dewi's brother's attempt to lift the wardrobe on his own was heroic and silly at the same time.
w|heroik.ko: 데위의 오빠가 혼자 옷장을 들려고 한 건 영웅적이면서도 우스웠어요.

w|hiasan.text: Meja Dimas masih kosong tanpa hiasan apa pun.
w|hiasan.en: Dimas's desk was still bare, without any decorations.
w|hiasan.ko: 디마스의 책상은 아직 장식 하나 없이 텅 비어 있었어요.

w|hiasan.text: Putri membeli hiasan dinding kecil sebagai oleh-oleh untuk ibunya.
w|hiasan.en: Putri bought a small wall decoration as a souvenir for her mother.
w|hiasan.ko: 푸트리는 엄마에게 줄 선물로 작은 벽 장식을 샀어요.

w|hibrida.text: Eko mencoba menanam jagung hibrida yang katanya lebih tahan hama.
w|hibrida.en: Eko is trying to grow hybrid corn that is said to resist pests better.
w|hibrida.ko: 에코는 병충해에 더 강하다는 교잡종 옥수수를 심어 보고 있어요.

w|hibrida.text: Pabrik itu mulai merakit mobil hibrida tahun ini.
w|hibrida.en: That factory started assembling hybrid cars this year.
w|hibrida.ko: 그 공장은 올해부터 하이브리드 자동차를 조립하기 시작했어요.

w|hiburan.text: Musik adalah hiburan favoritnya setelah kerja.
w|hiburan.en: Music is her favorite entertainment after work.
w|hiburan.ko: 음악은 퇴근 후 그녀가 가장 좋아하는 오락이야.

w|hidangan.text: Untuk acara pernikahan, Fajar menyiapkan hidangan penutup berupa kue sus.
w|hidangan.en: For a wedding, Fajar prepared cream puffs as dessert.
w|hidangan.ko: 결혼식을 위해 파자르는 디저트로 슈크림을 준비했어요.

w|hidangan.text: Setelah lomba, keluarga Lestari menyiapkan hidangan ayam bakar di rumah.
w|hidangan.en: After the race, Lestari's family prepared a grilled chicken dish at home.
w|hidangan.ko: 대회가 끝나고 레스타리네 가족은 집에서 닭구이 요리를 준비했어요.

w|hidrogen.text: Teman Eko menjelaskan bahwa matahari sebagian besar terdiri dari hidrogen.
w|hidrogen.en: Eko's friend explained that the sun is mostly made of hydrogen.
w|hidrogen.ko: 에코의 친구는 태양이 대부분 수소로 이루어져 있다고 설명했어요.

w|hidrogen.text: Salah satu sponsor lomba adalah perusahaan bus berbahan bakar hidrogen.
w|hidrogen.en: One of the race sponsors is a hydrogen-fueled bus company.
w|hidrogen.ko: 대회 후원사 가운데 하나는 수소 버스 회사예요.

w|hidung.en: His nose is stuffed from a cold.

w|hijau.en: Those tree leaves are fresh green.

w|hinaan.text: Rudi tetap tenang meski menerima hinaan dari pengendara yang ditilang.
w|hinaan.en: Rudi stayed calm even when a ticketed driver hurled insults at him.
w|hinaan.ko: 루디는 딱지를 뗀 운전자에게 모욕을 당해도 침착했어요.

w|hinaan.text: Rina tidak peduli pada hinaan orang yang menganggap merawat kucing liar itu membuang waktu.
w|hinaan.en: Rina ignores the insults of people who think caring for stray cats is a waste of time.
w|hinaan.ko: 리나는 길고양이를 돌보는 게 시간 낭비라는 사람들의 비난을 신경 쓰지 않아요.

w|hingga.en: Until now he still hasn't come.

w|hipotesis.text: Andi punya hipotesis bahwa retakan itu muncul karena tanah turun.
w|hipotesis.en: Andi has a hypothesis that the crack appeared because the ground sank.
w|hipotesis.ko: 안디는 땅이 꺼져서 금이 생겼다는 가설을 세웠어요.

w|hipotesis.text: Dewi punya hipotesis lucu tentang kenapa Rudi selalu datang terlambat.
w|hipotesis.en: Dewi has a funny theory about why Rudi always arrives late.
w|hipotesis.ko: 데위는 루디가 왜 늘 늦게 오는지에 대해 재밌는 가설이 있어요.

w|histeris.text: Budi mengenang Rudi yang pernah menjerit histeris saat melihat ular di kebun.
w|histeris.en: Budi recalled how Rudi once screamed hysterically at the sight of a snake in the garden.
w|histeris.ko: 부디는 루디가 밭에서 뱀을 보고 기겁하며 비명을 질렀던 일을 떠올렸어요.

w|histeris.text: Bu Ani menjerit histeris ketika melihat tikus di dapur.
w|histeris.en: Mrs. Ani screamed hysterically when she saw a rat in the kitchen.
w|histeris.ko: 아니 아주머니는 부엌에서 쥐를 보고 기겁하며 소리를 질렀어요.

w|hitungan.text: Menurut hitungan kami, stok masih cukup.
w|hitungan.en: By our count, stock is still enough.

w|hiu.text: Hiu besar berenang di dekat karang.
w|hiu.en: A large shark is swimming near the reef.
The diver saw a shark from afar.

w|hobi.text: Eko punya hobi mengoleksi perangko dari berbagai negara.
w|hobi.en: Eko's hobby is collecting stamps from various countries.
w|hobi.ko: 에코의 취미는 여러 나라 우표를 모으는 거예요.

w|hobi.text: Sejak pensiun, ayah Ayu punya hobi baru, yaitu merawat tanaman hias.
w|hobi.en: Since retiring, Ayu's father has a new hobby: looking after ornamental plants.
w|hobi.ko: 은퇴한 뒤로 아유의 아버지는 관상용 화초 가꾸기라는 새 취미가 생겼어요.

w|hoki.text: Di sekolah Eko, hoki lapangan mulai populer di kalangan murid perempuan.
w|hoki.en: At Eko's school, field hockey is becoming popular among the girls.
