w|hoki.ko: 에코의 학교에서는 필드하키가 여학생들 사이에서 인기를 얻고 있어요.

w|hoki.text: Adik Ayu minta dilukiskan pemain hoki es favoritnya.
w|hoki.en: Ayu's brother asked her to paint his favorite ice hockey player.
w|hoki.ko: 아유의 동생은 좋아하는 아이스하키 선수를 그려 달라고 했어요.

w|hore.text: Anak-anak berteriak “hore” waktu Pak Guru bilang ujian ditunda.
w|hore.en: The kids shouted "hooray" when the teacher said the exam was postponed.
w|hore.ko: 선생님이 시험이 미뤄졌다고 하자 아이들이 "만세" 하고 외쳤어요.

w|hore.text: Keponakan Dewi berteriak “hore” waktu kembang api pertama meletus.
w|hore.en: Dewi's nephew shouted "hooray" when the first firework burst.
w|hore.ko: 첫 불꽃이 터지자 데위의 조카가 "만세" 하고 외쳤어요.

w|hormat.text: Hormat kepada orang tua adalah kewajiban.
w|hormat.en: Respect for parents is a duty.
He paid respect to the teacher.

w|hormon.text: Menurut Budi, perubahan hormon membuat kucing betina gelisah saat musim kawin.
w|hormon.en: According to Budi, hormonal changes make female cats restless during mating season.
w|hormon.ko: 부디에 따르면 호르몬 변화 때문에 암고양이는 발정기에 안절부절못해요.

w|hormon.text: Dokter puskesmas bilang suasana hati Siti yang naik turun mungkin karena hormon selama hamil.
w|hormon.en: The health center doctor said Siti's mood swings might be due to hormones during pregnancy.
w|hormon.ko: 보건소 의사는 시티의 기분 변화가 임신 중 호르몬 때문일 수 있다고 했어요.

w|horor.text: Bayu menulis ulasan film horor lokal yang laris di bioskop.
w|horor.en: Bayu wrote a review of a local horror film that's a hit in cinemas.
w|horor.ko: 바유는 극장에서 흥행 중인 국내 공포 영화 리뷰를 썼어요.

w|horor.text: Pada malam Jumat, tim Intan menonton film horor bersama di kantor.
w|horor.en: On Thursday nights, Intan's team watches horror films together at the office.
w|horor.ko: 목요일 밤마다 인탄의 팀은 사무실에서 같이 공포 영화를 봐요.

w|hotel.en: That hotel is near the beach.

w|hukum.en: The law must be enforced fairly.
He studies law at the university.

w|hulu.text: Eko dan teman-temannya mendaki menyusuri sungai sampai ke hulu.
w|hulu.en: Eko and his friends hiked along the river all the way to its source.
w|hulu.ko: 에코와 친구들은 강을 따라 상류까지 올라갔어요.

w|hulu.text: Rute ultra maraton Ayu dimulai dari hulu sungai di kaki gunung.
w|hulu.en: Ayu's ultramarathon route starts from the river's source at the foot of the mountain.
w|hulu.ko: 아유의 울트라마라톤 코스는 산기슭의 강 상류에서 시작해요.

w|huruf.text: Anak itu belajar mengenal huruf Latin.
w|huruf.en: That child is learning Latin letters.
w|huruf.ko: 그 아이는 라틴 글자를 배우고 있어.

w|huruf.en: The first letter of her name is red.

w|hutan.en: That forest is dark and quiet.
They got lost in the forest.

w|hutang.text: Dia melunasi hutang sebelum akhir tahun.
w|hutang.en: He paid off the debt before year-end.
That debt made it hard for him to sleep.

w|ialah.text: Tujuan utama kita ialah belajar bersama.
w|ialah.en: Our main goal is to learn together.
w|ialah.ko: 우리 주된 목표는 함께 배우는 거야.

w|ialah.en: The problem is the lack of communication.

w|ibarat.text: Kabut pagi di desa itu ibarat selimut tebal yang menutupi sawah.
w|ibarat.en: The morning mist in that village is like a thick blanket covering the rice fields.
w|ibarat.ko: 그 마을의 아침 안개는 논을 덮은 두꺼운 이불 같아요.

w|ibarat.text: Bagi Ayu, mesin tua di pabrik ibarat teman lama yang rewel.
w|ibarat.en: To Ayu, the old machine at the factory is like a fussy old friend.
w|ibarat.ko: 아유에게 공장의 낡은 기계는 까다로운 오랜 친구 같아요.

w|ibu kota.text: Perjalanan Dimas dimulai dari stasiun besar di ibu kota.
w|ibu kota.en: Dimas's journey started from the big station in the capital.
w|ibu kota.ko: 디마스의 여행은 수도의 큰 역에서 시작됐어요.

w|ibu kota.text: Perusahaan Putri baru pindah dari Bandung ke ibu kota bulan lalu.
w|ibu kota.en: Putri's company just moved from Bandung to the capital last month.
w|ibu kota.ko: 푸트리의 회사는 지난달 반둥에서 수도로 막 옮겼어요.

w|identik.text: Guru curiga karena jawaban Budi dan teman sebangkunya identik sampai ke salah ketiknya.
w|identik.en: The teacher was suspicious because the answers of Budi and his deskmate were identical, down to the typos.
w|identik.ko: 버디와 짝꿍의 답이 오타까지 똑같아서 선생님이 의심했어요.

w|identik.text: Bagi Siti, pagi-pagi di musim kemarau terasa identik satu sama lain: panas dan berdebu.
w|identik.en: To Siti, mornings in the dry season feel identical to one another: hot and dusty.
w|identik.ko: 시티에게 건기의 아침은 하나같이 똑같이 느껴져요. 덥고 먼지가 많아요.

w|identitas.en: The victim's identity is still unknown.
Show your identity before entering the building.
w|identitas.ko: 건물에 들어가기 전에 신원을 보여 줘.

w|idola.text: Remaja di sebelah rumah Andi menempel poster idola di jendela kamarnya.
w|idola.en: The teenager next door to Andi stuck a poster of her idol on her bedroom window.
w|idola.ko: 안디네 옆집 십대는 방 창문에 아이돌 포스터를 붙였어요.

w|idola.text: Ada pameran khusus tentang idola musik pop tahun tujuh puluhan yang dikunjungi Dewi.
w|idola.en: There was a special exhibition on pop music idols of the seventies that Dewi visited.
w|idola.ko: 데위가 간 곳에는 70년대 팝 음악 스타에 관한 특별전이 있었어요.

w|iga.text: Bulan ini Agus membuat roti isi iga bakar sebagai menu spesial.
w|iga.en: This month Agus is making grilled-rib sandwiches as a special.
w|iga.ko: 이번 달 아구스는 특별 메뉴로 갈비구이 빵을 만들어요.

w|iga.text: Wati mentraktir tim makan sop iga setelah aplikasi berhasil dirilis.
w|iga.en: Wati treated the team to rib soup after the app launched successfully.
w|iga.ko: 앱 출시에 성공하자 와티는 팀원들에게 갈비탕을 샀어요.

w|ijazah.text: Andi membongkar kasus ijazah palsu di sebuah kampus swasta.
w|ijazah.en: Andi exposed a fake diploma case at a private university.
w|ijazah.ko: 안디는 한 사립대의 가짜 졸업장 사건을 파헤쳤어요.

w|ijazah.text: Dewi menyimpan ijazah dan akta rumah di map terpisah.
w|ijazah.en: Dewi keeps her diploma and the house deed in a separate folder.
w|ijazah.ko: 데위는 졸업장과 집문서를 따로 서류철에 보관해요.

w|ikan.en: The fish in the pond are big now.

w|ikat.text: Dia memakai ikat pinggang kulit coklat.
w|ikat.en: He wore a brown leather belt.

w|ikatan.en: Their bond of friendship is very strong.
The family keeps the bond even from afar.

w|iklan.text: Iklan itu muncul di setiap saluran.
w|iklan.en: That ad appears on every channel.

w|iklan.text: Dia mengabaikan iklan di situs web.
w|iklan.en: He ignored the ads on the website.

w|iklim.text: Rudi membawa jaket tebal karena iklim di pegunungan ini sejuk sepanjang tahun.
w|iklim.en: Rudi brought a thick jacket because the climate in these mountains is cool all year.
w|iklim.ko: 이 산악 지대는 일 년 내내 서늘한 기후라서 루디는 두꺼운 재킷을 가져왔어요.

w|iklim.text: Konser itu sekaligus menggalang dana untuk kampanye perubahan iklim.
w|iklim.en: The concert also raised money for a climate change campaign.
w|iklim.ko: 그 공연은 기후 변화 캠페인을 위한 모금도 함께 했어요.

w|ikon.text: Menurut Fajar, menara jam di depan balai kota sudah lama menjadi ikon kota.
w|ikon.en: According to Fajar, the clock tower in front of city hall has long been the city's icon.
w|ikon.ko: 파자르 말로는 시청 앞 시계탑이 오래전부터 도시의 상징이었어요.

w|ikon.text: Lestari mengetuk ikon kamera di ponsel untuk memotret retakan di dinding.
w|ikon.en: Lestari tapped the camera icon on her phone to photograph the crack in the wall.
w|ikon.ko: 레스타리는 벽의 금을 찍으려고 휴대폰의 카메라 아이콘을 눌렀어요.

w|ikut.en: She came along to the market earlier.

w|ikutan.text: Walau baru seminggu bekerja, Bayu ikutan lomba lari kantor.
w|ikutan.en: Even though he'd only worked there a week, Bayu joined in the office running race.
w|ikutan.ko: 일한 지 일주일밖에 안 됐지만 바유는 회사 달리기 대회에 끼었어요.

w|ikutan.text: Melihat Intan rajin berolahraga, ibu Intan ikutan mendaftar.
w|ikutan.en: Seeing Intan exercise so regularly, Intan's mother signed up too.
w|ikutan.ko: 인탄이 꾸준히 운동하는 걸 보고 인탄 어머니도 따라 등록했어요.

w|ilahi.text: Lagu penutup drama itu dinyanyikan dengan suasana yang hampir ilahi.
w|ilahi.en: The closing song of the play was sung in an almost divine atmosphere.
w|ilahi.ko: 그 연극의 마지막 노래는 거의 신성한 분위기 속에서 불렸어요.

w|ilahi.text: Nenek pelanggan Ayu percaya rezeki adalah pemberian ilahi.
w|ilahi.en: An elderly customer of Ayu's believes that one's fortune is a divine gift.
w|ilahi.ko: 아유 가게 단골 할머니는 생계가 신이 주신 선물이라고 믿어요.

w|ilegal.en: Those illegal goods were seized by the police.

w|ilmiah.en: That scientific article is hard to understand.

w|ilmu.text: Dia belajar ilmu politik di kampus.
w|ilmu.en: She studies political science at campus.

w|ilmuwan.en: That scientist explained the research results.
Many scientists gathered at the conference.

w|ilusi.text: Guru seni menunjukkan gambar ilusi yang membuat garis lurus tampak bengkok.
w|ilusi.en: The art teacher showed an illusion picture that makes straight lines look bent.
w|ilusi.ko: 미술 선생님은 직선이 휘어 보이는 착시 그림을 보여 줬어요.

w|ilusi.text: Dokter menjelaskan bahwa pasien itu melihat ilusi karena demam tinggi.
w|ilusi.en: The doctor explained that the patient was seeing illusions because of a high fever.
w|ilusi.ko: 의사는 그 환자가 고열 때문에 헛것을 본 거라고 설명했어요.

w|imajinasi.text: Guru bahasa bilang tulisan Eko penuh imajinasi.
w|imajinasi.en: The language teacher said Eko's writing is full of imagination.
w|imajinasi.ko: 국어 선생님은 에코의 글이 상상력으로 가득하다고 했어요.

w|imajinasi.text: Adik Ayu menggambar istana awan dengan imajinasi yang luar biasa.
w|imajinasi.en: Ayu's little sister drew a castle in the clouds with amazing imagination.
w|imajinasi.ko: 아유의 동생은 놀라운 상상력으로 구름 위의 성을 그렸어요.

w|iman.text: Pak Agus bilang, iman yang kuat membantunya tetap sabar menghadapi warga yang marah.
w|iman.en: Mr. Agus said a strong faith helps him stay patient with angry residents.
w|iman.ko: 아구스 경관은 굳은 믿음 덕분에 화난 주민 앞에서도 참을 수 있다고 했어요.

w|iman.text: Sebelum pertandingan, Dewi berdoa agar imannya kuat menghadapi tekanan.
w|iman.en: Before the match, Dewi prays that her faith will stay strong under pressure.
w|iman.ko: 경기 전에 데위는 부담감 속에서도 믿음이 흔들리지 않게 기도해요.

w|imbalan.text: Dia menerima imbalan atas kerja kerasnya.
w|imbalan.en: He received a reward for his hard work.
w|imbalan.ko: 그는 열심히 일한 대가로 보상을 받았어.

w|imbalan.en: The reward offered is quite attractive.

w|imigran.text: Keluarga imigran yang baru pindah mengajari Andi memasak roti pipih.
w|imigran.en: The immigrant family that just moved in taught Andi to cook flatbread.
w|imigran.ko: 새로 이사 온 이민자 가족이 안디에게 납작빵 만드는 법을 가르쳐 줬어요.

w|imigran.text: Satu ruangan menampilkan koper-koper tua milik para imigran yang tiba lewat pelabuhan.
w|imigran.en: One room displays old suitcases belonging to immigrants who arrived through the port.
w|imigran.ko: 한 전시실에는 항구로 들어온 이민자들의 낡은 가방들이 놓여 있어요.

w|imigrasi.text: Resepsionis memeriksa cap imigrasi di paspor tamu asing saat check-in.
w|imigrasi.en: The receptionist checks the immigration stamp in foreign guests' passports at check-in.
w|imigrasi.ko: 안내 직원은 체크인할 때 외국인 손님 여권의 출입국 도장을 확인해요.

w|imigrasi.text: Rina mengurus paspor di kantor imigrasi karena ingin melihat salju di luar negeri.
w|imigrasi.en: Rina got her passport at the immigration office because she wants to see snow abroad.
w|imigrasi.ko: 리나는 외국에서 눈을 보고 싶어서 출입국 사무소에서 여권을 만들었어요.

w|impas.text: Setelah tawar-menawar lama, Bayu dan penjual sepakat harganya impas.
w|impas.en: After a long haggle, Bayu and the seller agreed on a price that left them even.
w|impas.ko: 한참 흥정한 끝에 바유와 판매자는 서로 손해 없는 가격에 합의했어요.

w|impas.text: Ayah Intan menghitung bahwa uang dari tamu cukup untuk membuat biaya pesta impas.
w|impas.en: Intan's father calculated that the money from guests was enough to break even on the party.
w|impas.ko: 인탄의 아버지는 손님들 축의금이면 잔치 비용이 본전은 된다고 계산했어요.

w|impian.en: His dream is to become a doctor.

w|implan.text: Budi menjelaskan bahwa implan gigi perlu dirawat seperti gigi asli.
w|implan.en: Budi explained that dental implants need to be cared for like real teeth.
w|implan.ko: 부디는 임플란트도 자연 치아처럼 관리해야 한다고 설명했어요.

w|implan.text: Mesin pemindai berbunyi karena implan logam di bahu Siti.
w|implan.en: The scanner beeped because of the metal implant in Siti's shoulder.
w|implan.ko: 시티 어깨에 있는 금속 보형물 때문에 검색대가 울렸어요.

w|imut.text: Anak kecil di barisan depan memakai topi kelinci yang imut.
w|imut.en: The little child in the front row wore a cute bunny hat.
w|imut.ko: 맨 앞줄 꼬마가 귀여운 토끼 모자를 쓰고 있었어요.

w|imut.text: Di meja Intan ada boneka kucing imut hadiah dari keponakannya.
w|imut.en: On Intan's desk there's a cute cat doll, a gift from her niece.
w|imut.ko: 인탄의 책상에는 조카가 선물한 귀여운 고양이 인형이 있어요.

w|inci.text: Layar televisi itu berukuran empat puluh inci.
w|inci.en: That television screen measures forty inches.

w|inci.text: Inci tambahan membuat bingkai terlalu besar.
w|inci.en: The extra inch made the frame too large.
w|inci.ko: 추가 인치 때문에 액자가 너무 커졌어.

w|independen.text: Nenek di sebelah rumah Andi masih hidup independen walau usianya sudah lanjut.
w|independen.en: The grandmother next door to Andi still lives independently despite her age.
w|independen.ko: 안디네 옆집 할머니는 연세가 많은데도 여전히 혼자 힘으로 살아요.

w|independen.text: Museum kecil itu dikelola oleh yayasan independen tanpa dana pemerintah.
w|independen.en: That small museum is run by an independent foundation without government funding.
w|independen.ko: 그 작은 박물관은 정부 지원 없이 독립 재단이 운영해요.

w|indikasi.text: Tiket yang habis dalam sehari menjadi indikasi bahwa pentas itu akan sukses.
w|indikasi.en: Tickets selling out in a day were an indication that the show would be a success.
w|indikasi.ko: 표가 하루 만에 매진된 것은 그 공연이 성공할 거라는 신호였어요.

w|indikasi.text: Getaran aneh di gerbong bisa menjadi indikasi ada masalah pada rel.
w|indikasi.en: Strange shaking in the carriage can be an indication of a problem with the tracks.
w|indikasi.ko: 객차가 이상하게 흔들리는 건 선로에 문제가 있다는 신호일 수 있어요.

w|individu.text: Kata penghulu, setiap individu dalam keluarga ikut menjaga rumah tangga baru itu.
w|individu.en: The officiant said every individual in the family helps look after the new household.
w|individu.ko: 혼인 주례는 가족 한 사람 한 사람이 새 가정을 함께 지켜 준다고 했어요.

w|individu.text: Rina menulis bahwa setiap individu berhak tahu ke mana uang pajaknya dipakai.
w|individu.en: Rina wrote that every individual has the right to know where their tax money goes.
w|individu.ko: 리나는 모든 개인이 세금이 어디에 쓰이는지 알 권리가 있다고 썼어요.

w|indra.text: Menurut Budi, indra penciuman anjing jauh lebih tajam daripada manusia.
w|indra.en: According to Budi, a dog's sense of smell is far sharper than a human's.
w|indra.ko: 부디에 따르면 개의 후각은 사람보다 훨씬 예민해요.

w|indra.text: Udara gunung yang bersih membuat indra penciuman Siti lebih peka.
w|indra.en: The clean mountain air makes Siti's sense of smell sharper.
w|indra.ko: 깨끗한 산 공기 덕분에 시티의 후각이 더 예민해요.

w|induk.text: Anak kucing itu terus mengeong mencari induk yang hilang di kebun sekolah.
w|induk.en: The kitten kept meowing, looking for its mother lost in the school garden.
w|induk.ko: 새끼 고양이가 학교 정원에서 사라진 어미를 찾아 계속 울었어요.

w|induk.text: Rudi sekarang bekerja di perusahaan induk sebuah grup media besar.
w|induk.en: Rudi now works at the parent company of a large media group.
w|induk.ko: 루디는 지금 큰 미디어 그룹의 모회사에서 일해요.

w|industri.text: Industri lokal menyerap banyak tenaga kerja.
w|industri.en: Local industry absorbs a lot of labor.
She works in the food industry.

w|infanteri.text: Kakek Fajar dulu bertugas di pasukan infanteri, jadi Fajar selalu hadir pada hari veteran.
w|infanteri.en: Fajar's grandfather served in the infantry, so Fajar always attends Veterans' Day.
w|infanteri.ko: 파자르의 할아버지가 보병 부대에서 복무하셔서 파자르는 재향군인의 날에 꼭 참석해요.

w|infanteri.text: Ayah Lestari, mantan prajurit infanteri, masih bangun pukul lima setiap pagi.
w|infanteri.en: Lestari's father, a former infantry soldier, still gets up at five every morning.
w|infanteri.ko: 보병 출신인 레스타리의 아버지는 지금도 매일 아침 다섯 시에 일어나요.

w|infeksi.text: Dokter gigi bilang infeksi gusi bisa memengaruhi organ lain seperti jantung.
w|infeksi.en: The dentist said a gum infection can affect other organs like the heart.
w|infeksi.ko: 치과 의사는 잇몸 염증이 심장 같은 다른 장기에도 영향을 줄 수 있다고 했어요.

w|infeksi.text: Tangan Wati tergores paku berkarat, jadi dia cepat-cepat membersihkannya agar tidak infeksi.
w|infeksi.en: Wati scratched her hand on a rusty nail, so she cleaned it quickly to avoid infection.
w|infeksi.ko: 와티는 녹슨 못에 손이 긁혀서 덧나지 않게 얼른 소독했어요.

w|info.text: Info penting dikirim lewat pesan singkat.
w|info.en: Important info was sent via short message.

w|info.text: Tolong bagikan info jadwal kepada semua teman.
w|info.en: Please share the schedule info with all friends.
w|info.ko: 일정 정보를 모든 친구에게 공유해 줘.

w|informan.text: Dalam buku sejarah, Eko membaca tentang informan yang membantu para pejuang.
w|informan.en: In the history book, Eko read about an informant who helped the freedom fighters.
w|informan.ko: 에코는 역사책에서 독립투사들을 도운 정보원에 대해 읽었어요.

w|informan.text: Novel yang dibaca Ayu bercerita tentang informan polisi yang menyamar.
w|informan.en: The novel Ayu is reading is about an undercover police informant.
w|informan.ko: 아유가 읽는 소설은 신분을 숨긴 경찰 정보원 이야기예요.

w|informasi.en: That information has been widely shared.

w|infrastruktur.text: Fajar memimpin tim yang mengawasi pembangunan infrastruktur jalan dan jembatan.
w|infrastruktur.en: Fajar leads the team that supervises the building of road and bridge infrastructure.
w|infrastruktur.ko: 파자르는 도로와 다리 기반 시설 공사를 감독하는 팀을 이끌어요.

w|infrastruktur.text: Lestari mengeluh infrastruktur gedung tua itu sering rusak, terutama lift.
w|infrastruktur.en: Lestari complains that the old building's infrastructure often breaks down, especially the elevator.
w|infrastruktur.ko: 레스타리는 그 오래된 건물의 설비가 자주 고장 난다고, 특히 엘리베이터가 그렇다고 불평해요.

w|infus.text: Apotek itu juga menyediakan cairan infus untuk klinik di sebelah.
w|infus.en: The pharmacy also supplies IV fluids to the clinic next door.
w|infus.ko: 그 약국은 옆 병원에 수액도 공급해요.

w|infus.text: Rekan baru itu sempat dirawat dan dipasangi infus karena kelelahan.
w|infus.en: The new coworker was briefly hospitalized and put on an IV due to exhaustion.
w|infus.ko: 새 동료는 과로로 입원해 링거를 맞은 적이 있어요.

w|ingatan.text: Ingatan tentang masa kecilnya masih jelas.
w|ingatan.en: His memories of childhood are still clear.
w|ingatan.ko: 어린 시절에 대한 기억은 아직 선명해.

w|ingatan.en: That event is etched in his memory.
w|ingatan.ko: 그 사건은 그의 기억에 새겨져 있어.

w|ingin.en: I just want to go home.

w|inisial.text: Fajar membubuhkan inisial di pojok setiap halaman dokumen kontrak.
w|inisial.en: Fajar put his initials in the corner of every page of the contract.
w|inisial.ko: 파자르는 계약서 모든 페이지 구석에 이니셜을 적었어요.

w|inisial.text: Lestari menulis inisial di setiap paket agar tidak tertukar di lobi.
w|inisial.en: Lestari writes her initials on every package so they don't get mixed up in the lobby.
w|inisial.ko: 레스타리는 로비에서 바뀌지 않도록 택배마다 이니셜을 써요.

w|inisiatif.text: Manajer kantor memuji inisiatif Fajar membuat jadwal piket kebersihan.
w|inisiatif.en: The office manager praised Fajar's initiative in making a cleaning duty roster.
w|inisiatif.ko: 사무실 관리자는 청소 당번표를 스스로 만든 파자르를 칭찬했어요.

w|inisiatif.text: Ide fitur terbaru datang dari inisiatif seorang karyawan magang.
w|inisiatif.en: The idea for the newest feature came from an intern's initiative.
w|inisiatif.ko: 최신 기능 아이디어는 한 인턴이 스스로 낸 거였어요.

w|injil.text: Di rak agama, Andi melihat injil berbahasa Jawa yang dicetak seabad lalu.
w|injil.en: In the religion section, Andi saw a Javanese-language gospel printed a century ago.
w|injil.ko: 종교 책장에서 안디는 백 년 전에 찍은 자바어 복음서를 봤어요.

w|injil.text: Rekan Dewi membaca injil di pantri setiap pagi sebelum mulai kerja.
w|injil.en: Dewi's colleague reads the gospel in the pantry every morning before starting work.
w|injil.ko: 디위의 동료는 매일 아침 일을 시작하기 전에 탕비실에서 복음서를 읽어요.

w|insiden.text: Insiden itu terjadi di dekat stasiun.
w|insiden.en: That incident happened near the station.
The police are investigating yesterday's incident.

w|insinyur.text: Seorang insinyur muda datang memeriksa kekuatan tiang beton.
w|insinyur.en: A young engineer came to check the strength of the concrete pillars.
w|insinyur.ko: 젊은 엔지니어가 콘크리트 기둥의 강도를 점검하러 왔어요.

w|insinyur.text: Meja Rina berada di samping meja seorang insinyur listrik.
w|insinyur.en: Rina's desk is next to an electrical engineer's desk.
w|insinyur.ko: 리나의 자리는 전기 엔지니어 자리 옆이에요.

w|inspeksi.text: Eko membersihkan dapur sampai mengilap sebelum inspeksi dinas kesehatan.
w|inspeksi.en: Eko cleaned the kitchen until it gleamed before the health department inspection.
w|inspeksi.ko: 에코는 보건소 점검 전에 주방을 반짝반짝하게 닦았어요.

w|inspeksi.text: Petugas melakukan inspeksi tanggul sebelum musim hujan, dan Ayu ikut mencatat.
w|inspeksi.en: Officials inspected the embankment before the rainy season, and Ayu helped take notes.
w|inspeksi.ko: 우기 전에 직원들이 제방을 점검했고 아유도 같이 기록했어요.

w|inspektur.text: Minggu depan seorang inspektur keselamatan akan memeriksa pabrik.
w|inspektur.en: Next week a safety inspector will check the factory.
w|inspektur.ko: 다음 주에 안전 감독관이 공장을 점검하러 와요.

w|inspektur.text: Seorang inspektur bea cukai memeriksa koper Intan dengan teliti.
w|inspektur.en: A customs inspector checked Intan's suitcase carefully.
w|inspektur.ko: 세관 검사관이 인탄의 여행 가방을 꼼꼼히 검사했어요.

w|inspirasi.text: Bayu mendapat inspirasi naskah dari obrolan dengan penjual kopi.
w|inspirasi.en: Bayu got inspiration for the script from a chat with a coffee seller.
w|inspirasi.ko: 바유는 커피 장수와 나눈 이야기에서 대본 영감을 얻었어요.

w|inspirasi.text: Intan sering mencari inspirasi di kafe dekat kantor.
w|inspirasi.en: Intan often looks for inspiration at the café near the office.
w|inspirasi.ko: 인탄은 회사 근처 카페에서 자주 영감을 얻어요.

w|instan.text: Agus tidak pernah memakai ragi instan karena lebih suka ragi alami.
w|instan.en: Agus never uses instant yeast because he prefers natural starter.
w|instan.ko: 아구스는 천연 발효종을 더 좋아해서 인스턴트 이스트를 절대 쓰지 않아요.

w|instan.text: Menjelang peluncuran, Wati makan mi instan sambil lembur.
w|instan.en: Ahead of the launch, Wati ate instant noodles while working late.
w|instan.ko: 출시를 앞두고 와티는 야근하며 라면을 먹었어요.

w|insting.text: Menurut Rudi, insting Bayu tentang orang lain hampir selalu benar.
w|insting.en: According to Rudi, Bayu's instinct about other people is almost always right.
w|insting.ko: 루디 말로는 바유의 사람 보는 직감이 거의 늘 맞아요.

w|insting.text: Rina mengandalkan insting saat memilih desain logo perusahaan.
w|insting.en: Rina relied on instinct when choosing the company logo design.
w|insting.ko: 리나는 회사 로고 디자인을 고를 때 직감에 기댔어요.

w|institusi.text: Balai kota harus menjadi institusi yang dipercaya warga, tegas Fajar dalam pidatonya.
w|institusi.en: City hall must be an institution that residents trust, Fajar stressed in his speech.
w|institusi.ko: 시청은 주민이 믿는 기관이 되어야 한다고 파자르가 연설에서 강조했어요.

w|institusi.text: Lestari kini bekerja di sebuah institusi pendidikan untuk anak berkebutuhan khusus.
w|institusi.en: Lestari now works at an educational institution for children with special needs.
w|institusi.ko: 레스타리는 이제 특수 교육이 필요한 아이들을 위한 교육 기관에서 일해요.

w|institut.text: Eko lulus dari institut kuliner di ibu kota.
w|institut.en: Eko graduated from a culinary institute in the capital.
w|institut.ko: 에코는 수도에 있는 요리 학교를 졸업했어요.

w|institut.text: Ayu kuliah di institut pertanian yang kampusnya dikelilingi sawah.
w|institut.en: Ayu studies at an agricultural institute whose campus is surrounded by rice fields.
w|institut.ko: 아유는 논으로 둘러싸인 농업 대학에 다녀요.

w|instruksi.text: Para pemain mengikuti instruksi sutradara tanpa banyak protes.
w|instruksi.en: The actors followed the director's instructions without much protest.
w|instruksi.ko: 배우들은 큰 불평 없이 연출가의 지시를 따랐어요.

w|instruksi.text: Intan mengirim instruksi lengkap kepada karyawan baru lewat email.
w|instruksi.en: Intan sent full instructions to the new employee by email.
w|instruksi.ko: 인탄은 신입 사원에게 자세한 지시 사항을 이메일로 보냈어요.

w|instruktur.text: Fajar ikut kelas menulis cepat bersama instruktur dari kantor berita lain.
w|instruktur.en: Fajar took a fast-writing class with an instructor from another news agency.
w|instruktur.ko: 파자르는 다른 통신사에서 온 강사와 함께 빨리 쓰기 수업을 들었어요.

w|instruktur.text: Lestari ikut kelas selancar singkat dengan instruktur lokal.
w|instruktur.en: Lestari took a short surfing class with a local instructor.
w|instruktur.ko: 레스타리는 현지 강사와 함께 짧은 서핑 수업을 들었어요.

w|instrumen.text: Di lantai dua, Andi menemukan buku bergambar tentang instrumen musik tradisional.
w|instrumen.en: On the second floor, Andi found an illustrated book about traditional musical instruments.
w|instrumen.ko: 이 층에서 안디는 전통 악기에 관한 그림책을 찾았어요.

w|instrumen.text: Kuesioner itu menjadi instrumen utama Dewi untuk mengukur kepuasan pelanggan.
w|instrumen.en: The questionnaire is Dewi's main instrument for measuring customer satisfaction.
w|instrumen.ko: 그 설문지는 디위가 고객 만족도를 재는 주된 도구예요.

w|integritas.text: Agus suka belanja di lapak Bu Sri karena integritas penjualnya terjaga.
w|integritas.en: Agus likes shopping at Mrs. Sri's stall because the seller has integrity.
w|integritas.ko: 아구스는 장사가 정직한 스리 아주머니의 노점에서 사는 걸 좋아해요.

w|integritas.text: Wati menghormati integritas petani yang tidak menaikkan harga beras saat paceklik.
w|integritas.en: Wati respects the integrity of farmers who don't raise rice prices during lean times.
w|integritas.ko: 와티는 흉년에도 쌀값을 올리지 않는 농부들의 정직함을 존중해요.

w|intelektual.text: Rapat pertama Dimas terasa sangat intelektual dan penuh istilah asing.
w|intelektual.en: Dimas's first meeting felt very intellectual and full of foreign terms.
w|intelektual.ko: 디마스의 첫 회의는 아주 지적이고 낯선 용어로 가득했어요.

w|intelektual.text: Pria di sebelah Putri tampak sangat intelektual dengan kacamata dan buku filsafatnya.
w|intelektual.en: The man next to Putri looked very intellectual with his glasses and philosophy book.
w|intelektual.ko: 푸트리 옆의 남자는 안경과 철학책 때문에 아주 지적으로 보였어요.

w|intelijen.text: Laporan intelijen dikirim ke markas besar.
w|intelijen.en: The intelligence report was sent to headquarters.
National intelligence is monitoring new threats.

w|intens.text: Rapat anggaran di balai kota berlangsung sangat intens sampai larut malam, kata Fajar.
w|intens.en: The budget meeting at city hall was very intense until late at night, Fajar said.
w|intens.ko: 시청 예산 회의가 밤늦게까지 아주 치열했다고 파자르가 말했어요.

w|intens.text: Dalam suratnya, Lestari mengenang persahabatan mereka yang dulu begitu intens.
w|intens.en: In her letter, Lestari remembered their friendship, which used to be so intense.
w|intens.ko: 레스타리는 편지에서 예전에 그토록 끈끈했던 둘의 우정을 떠올렸어요.

w|internasional.en: An international conference is being held in Jakarta.

w|internasional.text: Dia punya pengalaman internasional yang luas.

w|intervensi.text: Kapolsek menolak intervensi dari orang berpengaruh dalam penyelidikan kasus itu.
w|intervensi.en: The precinct chief rejected interference from influential people in the investigation of the case.
w|intervensi.ko: 서장은 그 사건 수사에 영향력 있는 사람들이 끼어드는 것을 거절했어요.

w|intervensi.text: Petugas medis melakukan intervensi cepat ketika seorang pelari tiba-tiba pingsan.
w|intervensi.en: The medical staff stepped in quickly when a runner suddenly fainted.
w|intervensi.ko: 한 주자가 갑자기 쓰러지자 의료진이 재빨리 조치했어요.

w|inti.en: The core of the problem isn't that.
Explain the gist of the story.

w|intim.text: Pesta kecil itu terasa intim karena hanya keluarga dekat yang diundang.
w|intim.en: The small party felt intimate because only close family were invited.
w|intim.ko: 가까운 가족만 초대해서 그 작은 잔치는 아늑하게 느껴졌어요.

w|intim.text: Lestari menolak menulis tentang kehidupan intim artis itu.
w|intim.en: Lestari refused to write about that celebrity's intimate life.
w|intim.ko: 레스타리는 그 연예인의 사생활에 대해 쓰는 걸 거절했어요.

w|invasi.text: Di pelajaran sejarah, Dimas belajar tentang invasi pasukan asing ke Nusantara.
w|invasi.en: In history class, Dimas learned about foreign troops' invasion of the archipelago.
w|invasi.ko: 역사 시간에 디마스는 외국 군대의 군도 침략에 대해 배웠어요.

w|invasi.text: Paman Putri menonton film tentang invasi alien di televisi restoran.
w|invasi.en: Putri's uncle watched a film about an alien invasion on the restaurant TV.
w|invasi.ko: 푸트리의 삼촌은 식당 텔레비전으로 외계인 침공 영화를 봤어요.

w|investasi.text: Pemilik proyek menganggap gedung ini sebagai investasi jangka panjang.
w|investasi.en: The project owner sees this building as a long-term investment.
w|investasi.ko: 건축주는 이 건물을 장기 투자로 여겨요.

w|investasi.text: Bagian HR menjelaskan program investasi dana pensiun kepada Rina.
w|investasi.en: HR explained the pension fund investment programme to Rina.
w|investasi.ko: 인사팀이 리나에게 연금 투자 제도를 설명했어요.

w|investigasi.en: The investigation of that case is still ongoing.
w|investigasi.ko: 그 사건 수사는 아직 진행 중이야.

w|investigasi.text: Wartawan melakukan investigasi mendalam tentang skandal.
w|investigasi.en: The reporter conducted an in-depth investigation of the scandal.
w|investigasi.ko: 기자가 스캔들에 대해 심층 취재를 했어.

w|ipar.text: Ipar saya tinggal di kota sebelah.
w|ipar.en: My sibling-in-law lives in the next town.

w|ipar.text: Dia sering makan malam bersama ipar.
w|ipar.en: She often has dinner with her in-law.

w|iri.text: Jangan iri pada keberhasilan orang lain.

w|ironi.text: Ada ironi kecil di toko Agus: tukang roti di sana sendiri sedang diet.
w|ironi.en: There's a little irony at Agus's shop: the baker there is on a diet himself.
w|ironi.ko: 아구스의 가게에는 작은 아이러니가 있어요. 그곳 제빵사가 정작 다이어트 중이거든요.

w|ironi.text: Wati menertawakan ironi bahwa aplikasi pengatur waktu buatan timnya justru terlambat dirilis.
w|ironi.en: Wati laughed at the irony that her team's time-management app was released late.
w|ironi.ko: 와티는 자기 팀이 만든 시간 관리 앱이 오히려 늦게 출시된 아이러니에 웃었어요.

w|ironis.text: Bayu menulis bahwa situasinya ironis: kantor pajak sendiri telat membayar listrik.
w|ironis.en: Bayu wrote that the situation was ironic: the tax office itself paid its electricity bill late.
w|ironis.ko: 바유는 세무서가 정작 전기 요금을 늦게 냈다니 아이러니하다고 썼어요.

w|ironis.text: Agak ironis, aplikasi pengingat jadwal itu sendiri sering lupa dirilis tepat waktu.
w|ironis.en: Somewhat ironically, the scheduling reminder app itself often misses its release date.
w|ironis.ko: 좀 아이러니하게도 일정 알림 앱 자체가 출시일을 자주 놓쳐요.

w|iseng.text: Seorang rekan iseng menyembunyikan kursi Bayu di hari pertama.
w|iseng.en: A coworker playfully hid Bayu's chair on his first day.
w|iseng.ko: 한 동료가 장난으로 첫날 바유의 의자를 숨겼어요.

w|iseng.text: Intan iseng mencoba kelas yoga dan malah ketagihan.
w|iseng.en: Intan tried a yoga class on a whim and ended up hooked.
w|iseng.ko: 인탄은 심심해서 요가 수업을 해 봤다가 오히려 푹 빠졌어요.

w|isi.en: Read the contents of the letter.

w|islam.text: Pementasan itu menceritakan sejarah masuknya agama Islam ke sebuah kota pelabuhan.
w|islam.en: The production tells the history of how Islam arrived in a port town.
w|islam.ko: 그 공연은 이슬람교가 한 항구 도시에 들어온 역사를 다뤄요.

w|islam.text: Kantor Intan menyediakan ruang salat bagi karyawan yang beragama Islam.
w|islam.en: Intan's office provides a prayer room for Muslim employees.
w|islam.ko: 인탄의 회사는 이슬람교를 믿는 직원들을 위해 기도실을 마련해 뒀어요.

w|istana.text: Istana itu berdiri di atas bukit.
w|istana.en: That palace stands on a hill.
w|istana.ko: 그 궁전은 언덕 위에 서 있어.

w|istilah.text: Dia menjelaskan istilah baru kepada muridnya.
w|istilah.en: He explained the new term to his students.

w|istilah.text: Istilah teknis itu sulit dipahami pemula.
w|istilah.en: That technical term is hard for beginners to understand.
w|istilah.ko: 그 전문 용어는 초보자가 이해하기 어려워.

w|istimewa.en: This gift is very special for him.
The taste of her cooking is truly special.

w|istri.en: He brought his wife to the party.

w|isu.text: Agus memilih isu lingkungan sebagai tema lomba pidatonya.
w|isu.en: Agus chose an environmental issue as the theme of his speech contest.
w|isu.ko: 아구스는 웅변 대회 주제로 환경 문제를 골랐어요.

w|isu.text: Ada isu bahwa kolam renang favorit Wati akan ditutup tahun depan.
w|isu.en: There's a rumor that Wati's favorite pool will close next year.
w|isu.ko: 와티가 좋아하는 수영장이 내년에 문을 닫는다는 소문이 있어요.

w|isyarat.text: Bu Guru memberi isyarat kepada Andi untuk diam.
w|isyarat.en: The teacher gave Andi a signal to be quiet.
w|isyarat.ko: 선생님이 안디에게 조용히 하라는 신호를 보냈어요.

w|isyarat.text: Tepat tengah malam, Dewi memberi isyarat agar semua orang menyalakan kembang api.
w|isyarat.en: Exactly at midnight, Dewi gave the signal for everyone to light the fireworks.
w|isyarat.ko: 정확히 자정에 데위가 모두에게 불꽃을 켜라고 신호를 줬어요.

w|izin.en: His entry permit has been approved.

w|jabatan.text: Setelah lima tahun bekerja, jabatan Bayu naik menjadi kepala regu.
w|jabatan.en: After five years of work, Bayu was promoted to team leader.
w|jabatan.ko: 오 년을 일한 끝에 바유의 직급이 반장으로 올랐어요.

w|jabatan.text: Di formulir imigrasi, Intan menulis jabatan barunya di kantor.
w|jabatan.en: On the immigration form, Intan wrote her new job title at the office.
w|jabatan.ko: 출입국 신고서에 인탄은 회사에서의 새 직함을 적었어요.

w|jadi.en: I don't feel like it anymore.

w|jadwal.en: Please check the night train schedule.
The meeting schedule changed without notice.

w|jagal.text: Rudi memesan iga sapi segar dari jagal langganan di pasar.
w|jagal.en: Rudi orders fresh beef ribs from his regular butcher at the market.
w|jagal.ko: 루디는 시장 단골 정육점 주인에게 신선한 소갈비를 주문해요.

w|jagal.text: Rina menemukan pisau besar yang dulu dipakai seorang jagal di pasar daging.
w|jagal.en: Rina found a large knife once used by a butcher at the meat market.
w|jagal.ko: 리나는 예전에 고기 시장 도축업자가 쓰던 큰 칼을 찾았어요.

w|jago.text: Rudi jago menari dangdut, jadi tamu-tamu memintanya naik panggung.
w|jago.en: Rudi is great at dancing dangdut, so the guests asked him to get on stage.
w|jago.ko: 루디가 당둣 춤을 잘 춰서 손님들이 무대에 올라오라고 했어요.

w|jago.text: Fotografer koran itu jago memotret pertandingan bulu tangkis.
w|jago.en: The paper's photographer is skilled at shooting badminton matches.
w|jago.ko: 그 신문사 사진기자는 배드민턴 경기를 잘 찍어요.

w|jagoan.ko: 시티 삼촌은 무거운 짐 드는 데는 정말 선수예요.

w|jahitan.ko: 시티는 끝이 찢어진 양모 담요의 바느질을 다시 했어요.

w|jaket.text: Jaket tebal itu menjaga tubuhnya tetap hangat.
w|jaket.en: That thick jacket kept his body warm.
w|jaket.ko: 그 두꺼운 재킷이 몸을 따뜻하게 해 줬어.

w|jaket.en: He forgot to bring a jacket to school.
w|jaket.ko: 그는 학교에 재킷을 깜빡하고 안 가져갔어.

w|jaksa.en: That prosecutor delivered the charges firmly.
The hearing is waiting for the prosecutor.

w|jamuan.ko: 아구스의 가게는 시청 만찬에 낼 케이크를 대요.

w|jamuan.en: Wati's startup held a small reception to welcome new employees.
w|jamuan.ko: 와티의 스타트업은 신입 사원을 환영하는 작은 모임을 열었어요.

w|jamur.en: The mini pizzas at Fajar's shop are topped with mushrooms and cheese.
w|jamur.ko: 파자르네 가게의 미니 피자에는 버섯과 치즈가 올라가요.

w|jamur.text: Malam sebelum lomba, Lestari makan pasta dengan saus jamur.
w|jamur.en: The night before the race, Lestari ate pasta with mushroom sauce.
w|jamur.ko: 대회 전날 밤 레스타리는 버섯 소스 파스타를 먹었어요.

w|janda.text: Ibu Rina sudah lama menjadi janda dan membuka warung makan.
w|janda.en: Rina's mother has long been a widow and runs a small eatery.
w|janda.ko: 리나의 어머니는 오래전에 남편을 여의고 작은 식당을 해요.

w|janda.en: The guest in the top room is a wealthy widow who likes painting.
w|janda.ko: 맨 위층 방 손님은 그림 그리기를 좋아하는 부유한 미망인이에요.

w|janggal.text: Budi merasa ada yang janggal karena anjing terus menggonggong ke arah gudang.
w|janggal.en: Budi felt something was off because the dog kept barking toward the shed.
w|janggal.ko: 개가 계속 창고 쪽으로 짖어서 부디는 뭔가 이상하다고 느꼈어요.

w|janggal.text: Siti mencium bau janggal dari kulkas dan langsung memeriksa isinya.
w|janggal.en: Siti smelled something odd from the fridge and checked its contents right away.
w|janggal.ko: 시티는 냉장고에서 이상한 냄새가 나서 바로 안을 확인했어요.

w|jangka.text: Pemerintah desa membuat rencana jangka panjang untuk menghadapi kekeringan.
w|jangka.en: The village government made a long-term plan to deal with drought.
w|jangka.ko: 마을 정부는 가뭄에 대비해 장기 계획을 세웠어요.

w|jangka.text: Siti menandatangani kontrak jangka pendek dengan rumah produksi itu.
w|jangka.en: Siti signed a short-term contract with that production house.
w|jangka.ko: 시티는 그 제작사와 단기 계약을 맺었어요.

w|jangkar.text: Bayu memotret perahu nelayan yang sedang menurunkan jangkar di teluk.
w|jangkar.en: Bayu photographed a fishing boat dropping anchor in the bay.
w|jangkar.ko: 바유는 만에서 닻을 내리는 어선을 사진에 담았어요.

w|jangkar.text: Intan menggambar jangkar besar sebagai simbol keluarga nelayannya.
w|jangkar.en: Intan drew a big anchor as a symbol of her fishing family.
w|jangkar.ko: 인탄은 어부 집안을 상징하는 커다란 닻을 그렸어요.

w|jangkauan.text: Kantor baru Rina masih dalam jangkauan bus kota dari rumahnya.
w|jangkauan.en: Rina's new office is still within reach of the city bus from her house.
w|jangkauan.ko: 리나의 새 회사는 집에서 시내버스로 갈 수 있는 거리예요.

w|jangkauan.text: Wi-Fi hotel punya jangkauan sampai ke kolam renang.
w|jangkauan.en: The hotel Wi-Fi has a range that reaches the swimming pool.

w|jangkrik.text: Malam itu Bayu tertidur di tenda diiringi suara jangkrik.
w|jangkrik.en: That night Bayu fell asleep in his tent to the sound of crickets.
w|jangkrik.ko: 그날 밤 바유는 귀뚜라미 소리를 들으며 텐트에서 잠들었어요.

w|jangkrik.text: Intan berangkat ke lokasi start saat jangkrik masih berbunyi di semak-semak.
w|jangkrik.en: Intan set off for the start while the crickets were still chirping in the bushes.
w|jangkrik.ko: 인탄은 덤불에서 아직 귀뚜라미가 울 때 출발 장소로 나섰어요.

w|janin.text: Dokter memperlihatkan detak jantung janin di layar, dan Budi ikut tersenyum.
w|janin.en: The doctor showed the fetus's heartbeat on the screen, and Budi smiled too.
w|janin.ko: 의사가 화면으로 태아의 심장 박동을 보여 주자 부디도 따라 웃었어요.

w|janin.text: Siti membawa surat dokter yang menyatakan janin dalam kondisi sehat untuk terbang.
w|janin.en: Siti carried a doctor's letter stating the fetus was healthy enough for her to fly.
w|janin.ko: 시티는 태아가 비행해도 될 만큼 건강하다는 의사 소견서를 가지고 다녔어요.

w|jantan.text: Di kebun sekolah, murid-murid memelihara seekor ayam jantan yang rajin berkokok.
w|jantan.en: In the school garden, the students keep a rooster that crows a lot.
w|jantan.ko: 학교 텃밭에서 학생들은 부지런히 우는 수탉 한 마리를 길러요.

w|jantan.text: Siti membawa serta kucing jantan berbulu oranye ke rumah barunya.
w|jantan.en: Siti brought her orange male cat along to her new house.
w|jantan.ko: 시티는 주황색 수컷 고양이를 새집에 데려갔어요.

w|januari.text: Di kota Dimas, hujan paling deras biasanya turun pada bulan Januari.
w|januari.en: In Dimas's town, the heaviest rain usually falls in January.
w|januari.ko: 디마스네 도시에서는 보통 일월에 비가 가장 많이 와요.

w|januari.text: Putri mulai memperbaiki rumah tua warisan kakeknya pada bulan Januari.
w|januari.en: Putri started fixing up the old house inherited from her grandfather in January.
w|januari.ko: 푸트리는 일월에 할아버지가 물려준 낡은 집을 고치기 시작했어요.

w|jarak.en: The distance to the station is far.

w|jarang.text: Dia jarang makan makanan cepat saji.
Jarang sekali hujan di musim ini.
w|jarang.en: Rain is very rare this season.

w|jaring.text: Agus menebar jaring dari perahu kecil sebelum matahari terbit.
w|jaring.en: Agus casts a net from a small boat before sunrise.
w|jaring.ko: 아구스는 해 뜨기 전에 작은 배에서 그물을 던져요.

w|jaring.text: Wati memakai jaring rambut setiap kali meracik obat di belakang apotek.
w|jaring.en: Wati wears a hairnet every time she prepares medicine at the back of the pharmacy.
w|jaring.ko: 와티는 약국 뒤에서 약을 조제할 때마다 머리망을 써요.

w|jaringan.text: Jaringan internet di sini sangat lambat.
w|jaringan.en: The internet network here is very slow.
They are building a new communication network.

w|jarum.text: Jarum jam dinding sudah tidak bergerak.
w|jarum.en: The clock hand on the wall has stopped moving.
w|jarum.ko: 벽시계 바늘이 더 이상 움직이지 않아.

w|jarum.text: Ibu menjahit baju dengan jarum kecil.
w|jarum.en: Mother sewed the clothes with a small needle.

w|jas.text: Fajar memesan jas hitam secara daring untuk acara wisuda adiknya.
w|jas.en: Fajar ordered a black suit jacket online for his sister's graduation.
w|jas.ko: 파자르는 여동생 졸업식에 입으려고 검은 재킷을 온라인으로 주문했어요.

w|jas.text: Lestari datang ke kelas memasak memakai jas putih seperti koki sungguhan.
w|jas.en: Lestari came to the cooking class wearing a white jacket like a real chef.
w|jas.ko: 레스타리는 진짜 요리사처럼 흰 재킷을 입고 요리 수업에 왔어요.

w|jasa.text: Pabrik tempat Bayu bekerja memakai jasa angkutan dari perusahaan lain.
w|jasa.en: The factory where Bayu works uses a transport service from another company.
w|jasa.ko: 바유가 일하는 공장은 다른 회사의 운송 서비스를 이용해요.

w|jasa.text: Intan memakai jasa porter karena kopernya terlalu berat.
w|jasa.en: Intan used a porter service because her suitcase was too heavy.
w|jasa.ko: 인탄은 여행 가방이 너무 무거워서 짐꾼 서비스를 이용했어요.

w|jasad.en: Police found a body near the river.

w|jasad.en: That body has already been identified by the family.

w|jatah.text: Eko membagi jatah ikan hasil tangkapan dengan tetangganya.
w|jatah.en: Eko shared his portion of the catch with his neighbors.

w|jeli.ko: 에코는 상하기 시작한 채소를 아주 잘 알아봐요.

w|jeli.text: Ayu cukup jeli membaca tanda awan sebelum hujan turun.

w|jeli.ko: 아유는 비 오기 전 구름의 낌새를 꽤 잘 읽어요.

w|jembatan.ko: 그 다리가 두 마을을 이어 줘.

w|jembatan.ko: 우리는 낡은 나무 다리 위를 걸었어.

w|jempol.ko: 시티는 오솔길에서 엄지발가락을 돌에 찧어서 얼굴을 찡그렸어요.

w|jenazah.en: In religion class, Dimas learned how to care for a body according to tradition.
w|jenazah.ko: 종교 시간에 디마스는 전통에 따라 시신을 수습하는 법을 배웠어요.

w|jenazah.en: Putri's restaurant closed for a day because the family accompanied grandfather's body to the cemetery.
w|jenazah.ko: 할아버지 시신을 묘지까지 모시느라 푸트리네 식당은 하루 문을 닫았어요.

w|jerapah.text: Di kebun binatang kota, anak Bayu paling suka memberi makan jerapah.
w|jerapah.en: At the city zoo, Bayu's child likes feeding the giraffes best.
w|jerapah.ko: 시립 동물원에서 바유의 아이는 기린한테 먹이 주는 걸 제일 좋아해요.

w|jerapah.text: Teman-teman bilang langkah Intan panjang seperti jerapah.
w|jerapah.en: Her friends say Intan's strides are long like a giraffe's.
w|jerapah.ko: 친구들은 인탄의 보폭이 기린처럼 길다고 해요.

w|jeritan.text: Suara jeritan dari panggung membuat penonton ikut kaget.
w|jeritan.en: The sound of a scream from the stage startled the audience too.
w|jeritan.ko: 무대에서 나온 비명 소리에 관객들도 깜짝 놀랐어요.

w|jeritan.en: A shriek came from the pantry when Dodi saw a cockroach.
w|jeritan.ko: 도디가 바퀴벌레를 보자 탕비실에서 비명이 들렸어요.

w|jernih.text: Untuk praktik IPA, Agus membandingkan air keruh dengan air jernih.
w|jernih.en: For a science practical, Agus compared murky water with clear water.
w|jernih.ko: 과학 실습으로 아구스는 탁한 물과 맑은 물을 비교했어요.

w|jernih.text: Air di kolam renang itu jernih sekali sampai dasarnya kelihatan.
w|jernih.en: The water in that pool is so clear you can see the bottom.
w|jernih.ko: 그 수영장 물은 바닥이 보일 정도로 아주 맑아요.

w|jeruji.text: Jendela arsip lama di ruang bawah tanah masih dipasangi jeruji besi, cerita Fajar.
w|jeruji.en: The window of the old archive in the basement still has iron bars, Fajar said.
w|jeruji.ko: 지하의 옛 기록실 창문에는 아직 쇠창살이 달려 있다고 파자르가 이야기했어요.

w|jeruji.text: Lestari menulis bahwa kucingnya suka mengintip burung dari balik jeruji jendela.
w|jeruji.en: Lestari wrote that her cat likes to peek at birds through the window bars.
w|jeruji.ko: 레스타리는 고양이가 창살 사이로 새를 엿보는 걸 좋아한다고 썼어요.

w|jeruk.text: Fajar menambahkan sedikit air jeruk supaya rasa kuenya agak asam.
w|jeruk.en: Fajar added a little orange juice so the cake would taste slightly sour.

w|kaku.text: Tombol volume ponsel tua itu terasa kaku karena kotor.
w|kaku.en: The volume button on the old phone feels stiff because it's dirty.
w|kaku.ko: 그 오래된 휴대폰 음량 버튼은 때가 껴서 뻑뻑해요.

w|kala.text: Kakek Budi suka bercerita tentang kala desa ini masih dikelilingi hutan.
w|kala.en: Budi's grandfather likes talking about the time when this village was still surrounded by forest.
w|kala.ko: 부디의 할아버지는 이 마을이 아직 숲에 둘러싸여 있던 시절 이야기를 즐겨 해요.

w|kala.text: Siti memerankan seorang guru pada kala perang kemerdekaan.
w|kala.en: Siti plays a teacher in the time of the war of independence.
w|kala.ko: 시티는 독립 전쟁 시절의 교사 역할을 맡았어요.

w|kalajengking.text: Budi menemukan kalajengking di bawah tumpukan kayu bakar.
w|kalajengking.en: Budi found a scorpion under the pile of firewood.

w|kalajengking.text: Siti pernah mencicipi sate kalajengking di sebuah pasar malam.
w|kalajengking.en: Siti once tasted scorpion skewers at a night market.
w|kalajengking.ko: 시티는 야시장에서 전갈 꼬치를 맛본 적이 있어요.

w|kalangan.text: Budi cukup populer di kalangan murid kelas sepuluh.
w|kalangan.en: Budi is quite popular among the tenth-graders.
w|kalangan.ko: 부디는 10학년 학생들 사이에서 꽤 인기가 있어요.

w|kalangan.text: Siti mendengar kabar itu dari kalangan pilot yang ia kenal.
w|kalangan.en: Siti heard the news from pilots she knows.
w|kalangan.ko: 시티는 아는 조종사들 사이에서 그 소식을 들었어요.

w|kalau.en: If it rains, I'll stay home.
Let me know when you get there.

w|kalender.text: Dimas menandai hari pertama musim hujan di kalender dapur.
w|kalender.en: Dimas marked the first day of the rainy season on the kitchen calendar.
w|kalender.ko: 디마스는 부엌 달력에 우기 첫날을 표시했어요.

w|kalender.text: Putri menemukan kalender tahun lama yang masih tergantung di dapur.
w|kalender.en: Putri found a calendar from years ago still hanging in the kitchen.
w|kalender.ko: 푸트리는 부엌에 아직 걸려 있는 오래전 달력을 발견했어요.

w|kaleng.text: Di gudang ada beberapa kaleng susu kental untuk isian roti.
w|kaleng.en: In the storeroom there are several cans of condensed milk for bread fillings.
w|kaleng.ko: 창고에는 빵 속에 넣을 연유 캔이 몇 개 있어요.

w|kaleng.text: Di pos minum, relawan memberi Lestari minuman isotonik dalam kaleng.
w|kaleng.en: At the drinks station, a volunteer gave Lestari an isotonic drink in a can.
w|kaleng.ko: 급수대에서 자원봉사자가 레스타리에게 캔에 든 이온 음료를 줬어요.

w|kalimat.text: Kalimat itu terlalu panjang untuk dibaca.
w|kalimat.en: That sentence is too long to read.

w|kalimat.text: Guru meminta siswa menulis kalimat sederhana.
w|kalimat.en: The teacher asked students to write a simple sentence.
w|kalimat.ko: 선생님이 학생들에게 간단한 문장을 쓰라고 하셨어.

w|kalkun.text: Untuk kelas spesial akhir tahun, Andi belajar memanggang daging kalkun utuh.
w|kalkun.en: For the special year-end class, Andi learned to roast a whole turkey.
w|kalkun.ko: 연말 특별 수업에서 안디는 칠면조 한 마리를 통째로 굽는 법을 배웠어요.

w|kalkun.text: Rani menulis bahwa keluarga suaminya selalu makan kalkun panggang saat hari raya.
w|kalkun.en: Rani wrote that her husband's family always eats roast turkey on holidays.
w|kalkun.ko: 라니는 시댁에서 명절마다 칠면조 구이를 먹는다고 썼어요.

w|kalori.text: Agus mulai mencantumkan jumlah kalori di label setiap roti.
w|kalori.en: Agus started listing the calories on the label of every loaf.
w|kalori.ko: 아구스는 빵마다 라벨에 칼로리를 적기 시작했어요.

w|kalori.text: Aplikasi buatan Wati bisa menghitung kalori dari foto makanan.
w|kalori.en: The app Wati built can count calories from a photo of food.
w|kalori.ko: 와티가 만든 앱은 음식 사진으로 칼로리를 계산할 수 있어요.

w|kalung.en: That gold necklace belonged to her grandmother.

w|kalung.text: Dia memakai kalung mutiara ke pesta.
w|kalung.en: She wore a pearl necklace to the party.

w|kamar.en: She's waiting in the hotel room.

w|kambing.text: Kambing itu makan rumput di padang.
w|kambing.en: That goat ate grass in the field.

w|kambing.text: Petani memelihara kambing di belakang rumah.
w|kambing.en: The farmer keeps goats behind the house.

w|kambuh.text: Asma pasien di kamar sebelah kambuh lagi, jadi Budi segera membawa inhaler.
w|kambuh.en: The asthma of the patient next door flared up again, so Budi quickly brought an inhaler.
w|kambuh.ko: 옆 병실 환자의 천식이 또 도져서 부디가 얼른 흡입기를 가져갔어요.

w|kambuh.text: Sakit kepala Siti kambuh ketika penerbangannya ditunda lagi.
w|kambuh.en: Siti's headache came back when her flight was delayed again.
w|kambuh.ko: 비행기가 또 지연되자 시티의 두통이 다시 도졌어요.

w|kamerad.text: Pak Darmo menyebut Andi kamerad karena mereka sama-sama suka main catur.
w|kamerad.en: Pak Darmo calls Andi "comrade" because they both love playing chess.
w|kamerad.ko: 다르모 씨는 둘 다 체스를 좋아해서 안디를 동지라고 불러요.

w|kamerad.text: Dalam opera yang dilatih Dewi, para prajurit saling memanggil kamerad.
w|kamerad.en: In the opera Dewi is rehearsing, the soldiers call each other comrade.
w|kamerad.ko: 데위가 연습시키는 오페라에서 군인들은 서로를 동지라고 불러요.

w|kamis.text: Hujan pertama tahun ini turun pada hari Kamis sore.
w|kamis.en: The first rain of the year fell on Thursday afternoon.
w|kamis.ko: 올해 첫 비는 목요일 오후에 내렸어요.

w|kamis.text: Pada hari Kamis, Siti harus syuting adegan hujan buatan.
w|kamis.en: On Thursday, Siti has to shoot a scene with artificial rain.
w|kamis.ko: 목요일에 시티는 인공 비 장면을 찍어야 해요.

w|kamp.en: The refugee camp needs medical help.

w|kamp.text: Anak-anak belajar di kamp musim panas.
w|kamp.en: The children study at summer camp.

w|kampanye.text: Menjelang pemilu, redaksi sibuk meliput kampanye para calon.
w|kampanye.en: Ahead of the election, the newsroom is busy covering the candidates' campaigns.
w|kampanye.ko: 선거를 앞두고 편집국은 후보들의 선거 운동 취재로 바빠요.

w|kampanye.text: Ayu membuat kampanye diskon ganti baterai menjelang tahun ajaran baru.
w|kampanye.en: Ayu ran a battery replacement discount campaign ahead of the new school year.
w|kampanye.ko: 아유는 새 학기를 앞두고 배터리 교체 할인 행사를 열었어요.

w|kampung.text: Dalam perjalanan, Agus mampir ke kampung neneknya di Jawa Tengah.
w|kampung.en: On the way, Agus stopped by his grandmother's village in Central Java.
w|kampung.ko: 가는 길에 아구스는 중부 자와에 있는 할머니 마을에 들렀어요.

w|kampung.text: Setiap Lebaran, Wati pulang ke kampung halamannya di Solo.
w|kampung.en: Every Eid, Wati goes back to her hometown in Solo.
w|kampung.ko: 와티는 르바란마다 솔로에 있는 고향에 가요.

w|kampus.en: New students explore the campus together.
That campus is full of shady trees.

w|kamuflase.text: Rudi menjelaskan kepada wartawan bahwa toko itu hanya kamuflase untuk menyimpan barang curian.
w|kamuflase.en: Rudi told reporters that the shop was just a cover for storing stolen goods.
w|kamuflase.ko: 루디는 기자들에게 그 가게가 장물을 숨기려는 위장일 뿐이었다고 설명했어요.

w|kamuflase.text: Rina menunjukkan kepada anak-anak bagaimana bunglon memakai kamuflase.
w|kamuflase.en: Rina showed the children how a chameleon uses camouflage.
w|kamuflase.ko: 리나는 아이들에게 카멜레온이 어떻게 위장하는지 보여 줬어요.

w|kamus.text: Eko menyimpan kamus istilah masak Prancis di laci dapur.
w|kamus.en: Eko keeps a dictionary of French cooking terms in the kitchen drawer.
w|kamus.ko: 에코는 주방 서랍에 프랑스 요리 용어 사전을 넣어 둬요.

w|kamus.text: Ayu mencari arti kata "pancaroba" di kamus.
w|kamus.en: Ayu looked up the meaning of "pancaroba" in the dictionary.

w|kanal.text: Agus membuat kanal kecil untuk mengalirkan air dari mata air ke sawah.
w|kanal.en: Agus built a small canal to carry water from the spring to the rice field.
w|kanal.ko: 아구스는 샘물을 논으로 끌어오려고 작은 수로를 만들었어요.

w|kanal.text: Wati mengirim foto kanal tua di kota tempat dia sekarang tinggal.
w|kanal.en: Wati sent a photo of an old canal in the city where she now lives.
w|kanal.ko: 와티는 지금 사는 도시의 오래된 운하 사진을 보냈어요.

w|kancing.text: Bayu suka mengoleksi kancing kuningan dari seragam zaman dulu.
w|kancing.en: Bayu likes collecting brass buttons from old-time uniforms.
w|kancing.ko: 바유는 옛날 제복의 놋쇠 단추를 모으는 걸 좋아해요.

w|kancing.text: Satu kancing kebaya Intan lepas, jadi perias cepat menjahitnya.
w|kancing.en: One button came off Intan's kebaya, so the makeup artist quickly sewed it back on.
w|kancing.ko: 인탄의 크바야 단추가 하나 떨어져서 메이크업 담당이 재빨리 꿰매 줬어요.

w|kandang.en: The chicken coop is cleaned every morning.
The dog sleeps inside the kennel.

w|kandidat.text: Sutradara masih memilih kandidat pemeran utama dari lima orang.
w|kandidat.en: The director is still choosing the lead actor from five candidates.
w|kandidat.ko: 연출가는 아직 다섯 명 중에서 주연 후보를 고르고 있어요.

w|kandidat.text: Hari ini Intan mewawancarai tiga kandidat untuk posisi desainer.
w|kandidat.en: Today Intan interviewed three candidates for the designer position.
w|kandidat.ko: 인탄은 오늘 디자이너 자리에 지원한 후보 세 명을 면접했어요.

w|kandungan.text: Budi selalu membaca kandungan makanan kucing sebelum merekomendasikannya.
w|kandungan.en: Budi always reads the contents of cat food before recommending it.
w|kandungan.ko: 부디는 고양이 사료를 추천하기 전에 늘 성분을 읽어요.

w|kandungan.text: Saat kandungan Siti berumur tujuh bulan, keluarga mengadakan selamatan kecil.
w|kandungan.en: When Siti was seven months pregnant, the family held a small thanksgiving gathering.
w|kandungan.ko: 시티가 임신 일곱 달이 됐을 때 가족이 작은 감사 잔치를 열었어요.

w|kangen.text: Di akhir surat, Budi menulis bahwa ia kangen main bola bersama Andi.
w|kangen.en: At the end of the letter, Budi writes that he misses playing football with Andi.
w|kangen.ko: 편지 끝에 부디는 안디와 공 차던 게 그립다고 써요.

w|kangen.text: Siti kangen suasana lomba yang ramai setelah lama tidak ikut.
w|kangen.en: Siti misses the lively race atmosphere after not taking part for a long time.
w|kangen.ko: 오랫동안 대회에 안 나간 시티는 북적이는 대회 분위기가 그리워요.

w|kanibal.text: Di kelas sejarah, Budi membaca catatan penjelajah lama yang menulis tentang suku kanibal dalam dongeng pelaut.
w|kanibal.en: In history class, Budi read an old explorer's notes describing a cannibal tribe from sailors' tales.
w|kanibal.ko: 역사 시간에 버디는 뱃사람 이야기 속 식인 부족에 관해 쓴 옛 탐험가의 기록을 읽었어요.

w|kanibal.text: Cucu Siti menonton film horor tentang kanibal sehingga takut tidur sendiri malam itu.
w|kanibal.en: Siti's grandchild watched a horror film about cannibals and was scared to sleep alone that night.
w|kanibal.ko: 시티의 손주는 식인종이 나오는 공포 영화를 보고 그날 밤 혼자 자기를 무서워했어요.

w|kanji.text: Dimas mencoba membaca huruf kanji pada gulungan kertas dari Jepang.
w|kanji.en: Dimas tried to read the kanji characters on a paper scroll from Japan.
w|kanji.ko: 디마스는 일본에서 온 두루마리의 한자를 읽어 보려고 했어요.

w|kanji.text: Penata kostum menyemprotkan kanji supaya kerah baju Putri tetap kaku.
w|kanji.en: The costume designer sprayed starch so that Putri's shirt collar would stay stiff.
w|kanji.ko: 의상 담당은 푸트리 셔츠 깃이 빳빳하도록 풀을 뿌렸어요.

w|kanselir.text: Dalam drama itu, Eko berperan sebagai kanselir yang licik.
w|kanselir.en: In the play, Eko plays a cunning chancellor.
w|kanselir.ko: 그 연극에서 에코는 교활한 재상 역을 맡아요.

w|kanselir.text: Di televisi warung, Ayu menonton berita tentang kanselir baru di sebuah negara Eropa.
w|kanselir.en: On the stall's television, Ayu watches news about a new chancellor in a European country.
w|kanselir.ko: 아유는 가게 텔레비전에서 어느 유럽 나라의 새 총리 소식을 봐요.

w|kantin.text: Agus menemukan papan menu kantin sekolah zaman dulu di tumpukan barang bekas.
w|kantin.en: Agus found an old school canteen menu board in a pile of secondhand goods.
w|kantin.ko: 아구스는 중고품 더미에서 옛날 학교 매점 메뉴판을 찾았어요.

w|kantin.text: Saat musim hujan, kantin kantor Wati mulai menjual wedang ronde.
w|kantin.en: In the rainy season, the canteen at Wati's office starts selling wedang ronde.
w|kantin.ko: 우기가 되면 와티네 회사 구내식당은 웨당 론데를 팔기 시작해요.

w|kantong.en: That plastic bag is already torn.

w|kantong.text: Dia menyimpan kunci di kantong celana.
w|kantong.en: He keeps the key in his pants pocket.
w|kantong.ko: 그는 바지 주머니에 열쇠를 넣어 둬.

w|kantung.text: Bayu memasukkan uang receh ke kantung kecil di pinggangnya.
w|kantung.en: Bayu put the coins into the small pouch at his waist.
w|kantung.ko: 바유는 동전을 허리춤의 작은 주머니에 넣었어요.

w|kantung.text: Intan menyimpan amplop dari tamu di dalam kantung kain yang dijahit ibunya.
w|kantung.en: Intan kept the envelopes from guests in a cloth pouch her mother had sewn.
w|kantung.ko: 인탄은 손님들의 봉투를 엄마가 꿰매 준 천 주머니에 넣어 뒀어요.

w|kanvas.text: Latar belakang panggung dilukis di atas kanvas raksasa oleh siswa sekolah seni.
w|kanvas.en: The stage backdrop was painted on a giant canvas by art school students.
w|kanvas.ko: 무대 배경은 미술학교 학생들이 거대한 캔버스에 그렸어요.

w|kanvas.text: Seorang pelukis di gerbong sebelah menggambar pemandangan di atas kanvas kecil.
w|kanvas.en: A painter in the next carriage drew the scenery on a small canvas.
w|kanvas.ko: 옆 칸의 한 화가가 작은 캔버스에 풍경을 그렸어요.

w|kaos.text: Toko itu memberi bonus kaos gratis untuk setiap pembelian di atas dua ratus ribu.
w|kaos.en: That shop gives a free T-shirt for every purchase over two hundred thousand.
w|kaos.ko: 그 가게는 이십만 루피아 넘게 사면 티셔츠를 공짜로 줘요.

w|kaos.text: Saat menggoreng, kaos Lestari terkena cipratan saus sambal.
w|kaos.en: While frying, Lestari's T-shirt got splattered with chili sauce.
w|kaos.ko: 튀기는 동안 레스타리의 티셔츠에 칠리소스가 튀었어요.

w|kapak.text: Di samping alat pemadam api tersimpan sebuah kapak untuk keadaan darurat.
w|kapak.en: An axe is kept next to the fire extinguisher for emergencies.
w|kapak.ko: 소화기 옆에 비상용 도끼가 보관돼 있어요.

w|kapak.text: Di dinding gerbong ada kapak kecil untuk memecahkan kaca saat darurat.
w|kapak.en: On the carriage wall there is a small axe for breaking the glass in an emergency.
w|kapak.ko: 객차 벽에는 비상시 유리를 깨는 작은 도끼가 있어요.

w|kapas.text: Agus membungkus cangkir antik itu dengan kapas supaya tidak pecah.
w|kapas.en: Agus wrapped the antique cup in cotton so it wouldn't break.
w|kapas.ko: 아구스는 깨지지 않게 옛날 찻잔을 솜으로 쌌어요.

w|kapas.text: Saat kemarau, Wati lebih suka memakai kemeja kapas yang tipis.
w|kapas.en: In the dry season, Wati prefers wearing thin cotton shirts.
w|kapas.ko: 건기에는 와티가 얇은 면 셔츠를 즐겨 입어요.

w|kapasitas.text: Gedung teater kota itu punya kapasitas sekitar lima ratus penonton.
w|kapasitas.en: The city theater has a capacity of about five hundred spectators.
w|kapasitas.ko: 그 시립 극장은 관객을 오백 명쯤 수용할 수 있어요.

w|kapasitas.text: Kulkas di toko Ayu sudah penuh dan tidak ada kapasitas lagi untuk minuman baru.
w|kapasitas.en: The fridge in Ayu's shop is full and has no more capacity for new drinks.
w|kapasitas.ko: 아유 가게의 냉장고는 꽉 차서 새 음료를 넣을 자리가 없어요.

w|kapel.text: Sekolah Budi punya kapel kecil di samping aula untuk siswa Kristen.
w|kapel.en: Budi's school has a small chapel next to the hall for Christian students.
w|kapel.ko: 버디의 학교에는 기독교 학생들을 위한 작은 예배실이 강당 옆에 있어요.

w|kapel.text: Siti berteduh di sebuah kapel tua di pinggir jalan saat hujan turun tiba-tiba.
w|kapel.en: Siti took shelter in an old chapel by the roadside when the rain suddenly came.
w|kapel.ko: 갑자기 비가 내리자 시티는 길가의 오래된 예배당에서 비를 피했어요.

w|kapsul.text: Budi menyembunyikan kapsul obat di dalam sepotong sosis supaya anjingnya mau menelan.
w|kapsul.en: Budi hid the medicine capsule inside a piece of sausage so the dog would swallow it.
w|kapsul.ko: 부디는 개가 삼키도록 약 캡슐을 소시지 조각 안에 숨겼어요.

w|kapsul.text: Puskesmas desa memberi Siti kapsul vitamin untuk anak-anaknya.
w|kapsul.en: The village health center gave Siti vitamin capsules for her children.
w|kapsul.ko: 마을 보건소는 시티에게 아이들 먹일 비타민 캡슐을 줬어요.

w|kapur.text: Di ruang rapat masih ada papan tulis tua yang memakai kapur.
w|kapur.en: The meeting room still has an old blackboard that uses chalk.
w|kapur.ko: 회의실에는 아직 분필을 쓰는 낡은 칠판이 있어요.

w|kapur.text: Dinding kantor Lestari dicat dengan cat papan tulis sehingga bisa dicoret dengan kapur.
w|kapur.en: The walls of Lestari's office are painted with blackboard paint so they can be written on with chalk.
w|kapur.ko: 레스타리 사무실 벽은 칠판 페인트로 칠해서 분필로 쓸 수 있어요.

w|karakter.text: Karakter utama film itu sangat kuat.
w|karakter.en: The main character of that film is very strong.

w|karangan.text: Waktu SD, Agus pernah menulis karangan tentang cita-citanya menjadi insinyur.
w|karangan.en: In elementary school, Agus once wrote an essay about his dream of becoming an engineer.
w|karangan.ko: 초등학생 때 아구스는 엔지니어가 되는 꿈에 대해 작문을 쓴 적이 있어요.

w|karangan.text: Wati memesan kumpulan karangan penulis favoritnya dari toko buku daring.
w|karangan.en: Wati ordered a collection of essays by her favorite writer from an online bookstore.
w|karangan.ko: 와티는 온라인 서점에서 좋아하는 작가의 수필집을 주문했어요.

w|karantina.text: Kucing yang baru datang dari penampungan harus masuk karantina selama dua minggu.
w|karantina.en: Cats newly arrived from the shelter must go into quarantine for two weeks.
w|karantina.ko: 보호소에서 막 온 고양이는 두 주 동안 격리에 들어가야 해요.

w|karantina.text: Sapi baru yang dibeli Pak Lurah harus menjalani karantina sebelum digabung dengan sapi lain.
w|karantina.en: The new cow the village head bought has to go through quarantine before joining the other cows.
w|karantina.ko: 이장님이 산 새 소는 다른 소들과 합치기 전에 격리를 거쳐야 해요.

w|karbon.text: Guru Agus bilang hutan menyimpan banyak karbon dan membantu mendinginkan bumi.
w|karbon.en: Agus's teacher says forests store a lot of carbon and help cool the earth.
w|karbon.ko: 아구스의 선생님은 숲이 탄소를 많이 저장해서 지구를 식히는 데 도움이 된다고 해요.

w|karbon.text: Wati menjual masker berlapis karbon aktif untuk pengendara motor.
w|karbon.en: Wati sells activated carbon masks for motorbike riders.
w|karbon.ko: 와티는 오토바이 운전자용 활성탄 마스크를 팔아요.

w|kardinal.text: Rubrik dunia memuat berita tentang kardinal yang dipilih menjadi kepala gereja.
w|kardinal.en: The world section carried news about the cardinal chosen to lead the church.
w|kardinal.ko: 국제면에 교회 수장으로 뽑힌 추기경 소식이 실렸어요.

w|kardinal.text: Burung kardinal merah jadi maskot aplikasi baru buatan tim Intan.
w|kardinal.en: A red cardinal bird became the mascot of the new app made by Intan's team.
w|kardinal.ko: 빨간 홍관조가 인탄 팀이 만든 새 앱의 마스코트가 됐어요.

w|karena.en: I'm late because of the traffic.

w|karet.text: Ban sepeda itu terbuat dari karet tebal.
w|karet.en: That bicycle tire is made of thick rubber.
w|karet.ko: 그 자전거 타이어는 두꺼운 고무로 만들어졌어.

w|karet.text: Karet penghapus ini sudah aus dan kotor.
w|karet.en: This rubber eraser is already worn and dirty.
w|karet.ko: 이 고무 지우개는 이미 닳고 더러워졌어.

w|kargo.text: Di stasiun transit, Dimas melihat kereta kargo panjang yang membawa batu bara.
w|kargo.en: At the transit station, Dimas saw a long cargo train carrying coal.
w|kargo.ko: 환승역에서 디마스는 석탄을 실은 긴 화물 열차를 봤어요.

w|kargo.text: Aplikasi Putri membantu perusahaan logistik melacak kiriman kargo secara langsung.
w|kargo.en: Putri's app helps logistics companies track cargo shipments in real time.
w|kargo.ko: 푸트리의 앱은 물류 회사가 화물 배송을 실시간으로 추적하도록 도와줘요.

w|karier.text: Andi memulai karier jurnalistik dari koran kampus.
w|karier.en: Andi began his journalism career at the campus newspaper.
w|karier.ko: 안디는 대학 신문에서 기자 경력을 시작했어요.

w|karier.text: Dewi pindah kota demi mengejar karier di bidang desain.
w|karier.en: Dewi moved cities to pursue a career in design.
w|karier.ko: 데위는 디자인 분야 경력을 쌓으려고 도시를 옮겼어요.

w|karir.text: Dia membangun karir di bidang desain.
w|karir.en: She is building a career in design.
w|karir.ko: 그녀는 디자인 분야에서 경력을 쌓고 있어.

w|karir.text: Karir barunya membuatnya lebih percaya diri.
w|karir.en: His new career makes him more confident.
w|karir.ko: 새 경력이 그를 더 자신감 있게 해.

w|karnaval.text: Fajar sibuk mengatur rute karnaval yang akan melewati depan balai kota.
w|karnaval.en: Fajar was busy planning the route of the carnival that would pass in front of city hall.
w|karnaval.ko: 파자르는 시청 앞을 지나갈 카니발 경로를 짜느라 바빴어요.

w|karnaval.text: Lestari menggambarkan karnaval di kotanya yang penuh warna dan musik.
w|karnaval.en: Lestari described the carnival in her town, full of color and music.
w|karnaval.ko: 레스타리는 색과 음악으로 가득한 자기 동네 카니발을 묘사했어요.

w|karpet.text: Pasir dari kaki Eko mengotori karpet di ruang tamu penginapan.
w|karpet.en: Sand from Eko's feet dirtied the carpet in the guesthouse living room.
w|karpet.ko: 에코의 발에 묻은 모래가 숙소 거실 카펫을 더럽혔어요.

w|karpet.text: Ayu menjemur karpet di pagar sambil mengobrol dengan Bu Sri.
w|karpet.en: Ayu aired the carpet on the fence while chatting with Mrs. Sri.
w|karpet.ko: 아유는 스리 아주머니와 수다를 떨며 카펫을 울타리에 널었어요.

w|kartel.text: Di pelajaran ekonomi, Rudi belajar bahwa kartel bisa membuat harga barang naik.
w|kartel.en: In economics class, Rudi learned that a cartel can make prices go up.
w|kartel.ko: 경제 시간에 루디는 카르텔이 물건값을 올릴 수 있다는 걸 배웠어요.

w|kartel.text: Sambil berkemas, Rina menonton film tentang kartel narkoba di laptop.
w|kartel.en: While packing, Rina watched a film about a drug cartel on her laptop.
w|kartel.ko: 짐을 싸면서 리나는 노트북으로 마약 카르텔 영화를 봤어요.

w|kartu.en: I forgot to bring my ID card.
His credit card was declined at the register.

w|kartun.text: Adik Andi langsung lari ke rak kartun begitu masuk perpustakaan.
w|kartun.en: Andi's little brother ran straight to the cartoon shelf as soon as he entered the library.
w|kartun.ko: 안디의 동생은 도서관에 들어서자마자 만화 책장으로 달려갔어요.

w|kartun.text: Rekan Dewi menempelkan kartun lucu tentang rapat di papan pengumuman.
w|kartun.en: Dewi's colleague pinned a funny cartoon about meetings on the notice board.
w|kartun.ko: 디위의 동료가 회의에 관한 웃긴 만화를 게시판에 붙였어요.

w|karung.text: Seorang ibu menjual baju bekas yang ditumpuk di atas karung goni.
w|karung.en: A woman was selling used clothes piled on top of a burlap sack.
w|karung.ko: 한 아주머니가 마대 위에 쌓은 헌 옷을 팔고 있었어요.

w|karung.text: Keluarga suami Intan membawa sekarung beras sebagai seserahan.
w|karung.en: Intan's husband's family brought a sack of rice as a wedding gift.
w|karung.ko: 인탄 남편의 가족은 혼수로 쌀 한 자루를 가져왔어요.

w|karunia.text: Guru agama bilang kecerdasan adalah karunia yang harus dipakai untuk kebaikan.
w|karunia.en: The religion teacher said intelligence is a gift that should be used for good.
w|karunia.ko: 종교 선생님은 똑똑함은 좋은 일에 써야 하는 선물이라고 했어요.

w|karunia.text: Bagi keluarga itu, kesembuhan anak mereka adalah karunia yang luar biasa.
w|karunia.en: For that family, their child's recovery is an extraordinary blessing.
w|karunia.ko: 그 가족에게 아이가 나은 건 정말 큰 축복이에요.

w|karya.text: Karya seni itu dipajang di galeri.
w|karya.en: That artwork is displayed in the gallery.

w|karya.text: Dia menyelesaikan karya barunya minggu ini.
w|karya.en: She finished her new work this week.
w|karya.ko: 그녀는 이번 주에 새 작품을 끝냈어.

w|karyawan.text: Karyawan baru mulai bekerja hari ini.
w|karyawan.en: The new employee starts work today.

w|kasar.en: His language is too rough for children.
Your attitude earlier was so rude.

w|kaset.text: Bayu menemukan kaset lagu lama milik ayahnya di dalam kardus pindahan.
w|kaset.en: Bayu found his father's old music cassettes in a moving box.
w|kaset.ko: 바유는 이삿짐 상자에서 아버지의 옛 노래 카세트테이프를 찾았어요.

w|kaset.text: Bapak di kursi seberang masih mendengarkan kaset dangdut dengan walkman.
w|kaset.en: The man in the seat across still listens to dangdut cassettes on a walkman.
w|kaset.ko: 맞은편 아저씨는 아직도 워크맨으로 당둣 카세트를 들어요.

w|kasihan.text: Kasihan sekali anak itu menangis sendirian.
w|kasihan.en: What a pity that child is crying alone.
w|kasihan.ko: 그 아이가 혼자 울다니 참 안됐어.

w|kasihan.text: Aku merasa kasihan melihat hewan itu.
w|kasihan.en: I feel pity seeing that animal.

w|kasino.text: Koran itu memuat berita tentang kasino ilegal yang digerebek polisi.
w|kasino.en: The newspaper ran a story about an illegal casino raided by the police.
w|kasino.ko: 그 신문은 경찰이 급습한 불법 카지노 기사를 실었어요.

w|kasino.text: Gim kasino di ponsel itu ternyata berisi virus yang mencuri data.
w|kasino.en: The casino game on the phone turned out to contain a virus that steals data.
w|kasino.ko: 그 휴대폰의 카지노 게임에 데이터를 훔치는 바이러스가 들어 있었어요.

w|kasir.text: Tetangga Andi bekerja sebagai kasir di minimarket ujung gang.
w|kasir.en: Andi's neighbor works as a cashier at the minimarket at the end of the alley.
w|kasir.ko: 안디의 이웃은 골목 끝 편의점에서 계산원으로 일해요.

w|kasir.text: Dewi membayar tiket masuk museum kepada kasir yang ramah.
w|kasir.en: Dewi paid for her museum ticket to a friendly cashier.
w|kasir.ko: 데위는 친절한 계산원에게 박물관 입장권 값을 냈어요.

w|kastil.text: Adik Dimas meminjam buku dongeng tentang putri yang tinggal di kastil.
w|kastil.en: Dimas's younger sibling borrowed a fairy tale book about a princess who lives in a castle.
w|kastil.ko: 디마스 동생은 성에 사는 공주 동화책을 빌렸어요.

w|kastil.text: Dari kereta, Putri melihat reruntuhan bangunan tua yang mirip kastil.
w|kastil.en: From the train, Putri saw the ruins of an old building that looked like a castle.
w|kastil.ko: 기차에서 푸트리는 성처럼 생긴 오래된 건물 폐허를 봤어요.

w|kasur.text: Menurut Eko, kasur di rumah sewaan itu agak keras, tapi dia tetap tidur nyenyak.
w|kasur.en: According to Eko, the mattress in the rented house was a bit hard, but he still slept soundly.
w|kasur.ko: 셋집 매트리스가 좀 딱딱했지만 에코는 푹 잤어요.

w|kasur.text: Tetangga baru Ayu menurunkan kasur besar dari truk pindahan.
w|kasur.en: Ayu's new neighbor unloaded a big mattress from the moving truck.
w|kasur.ko: 아유의 새 이웃이 이삿짐 트럭에서 큰 매트리스를 내렸어요.

w|kata.en: He says it's going to rain.

w|katak.text: Kalau musim hujan, katak berbunyi ramai di parit dekat sawah.
w|katak.en: In the rainy season, frogs croak loudly in the ditch near the rice field.
w|katak.ko: 우기가 되면 논 옆 도랑에서 개구리가 시끄럽게 울어요.

w|katak.text: Malam itu, suara katak terdengar dari selokan depan rumah Putri.
w|katak.en: That night, the sound of frogs came from the gutter in front of Putri's house.
w|katak.ko: 그날 밤 푸트리네 집 앞 도랑에서 개구리 소리가 들렸어요.

w|katedral.text: Rudi berjaga di dekat katedral saat ada konser musik klasik.
w|katedral.en: Rudi stood guard near the cathedral during a classical music concert.
w|katedral.ko: 루디는 클래식 음악회가 열리는 동안 대성당 근처에서 경비를 섰어요.

w|katedral.text: Klinik Rina terletak di jalan kecil di belakang katedral tua.
w|katedral.en: Rina's clinic is on a small street behind the old cathedral.
w|katedral.ko: 리나의 동물병원은 오래된 대성당 뒤 작은 길에 있어요.

w|kategori.text: Sampah di apartemen itu dipilah menurut kategori organik dan anorganik.
w|kategori.en: Trash in that apartment is sorted into organic and inorganic categories.
w|kategori.ko: 그 아파트 쓰레기는 유기물과 무기물 종류로 나눠 버려요.

w|kategori.text: Di toko buku, Wati mencari novel dalam kategori sastra untuk dibaca saat hujan.
w|kategori.en: At the bookstore, Wati looked for a novel in the literature category to read on rainy days.
w|kategori.ko: 와티는 서점에서 비 오는 날 읽을 소설을 문학 분류에서 찾았어요.

w|katup.text: Teknisi gedung mengganti katup pipa air yang bocor di unit Agus.
w|katup.en: The building technician replaced the leaking water pipe valve in Agus's unit.
w|katup.ko: 건물 기사가 아구스네 집의 새는 수도관 밸브를 갈았어요.

w|katup.text: Wati memeriksa katup tabung gas sebelum menyalakan kompor di pagi yang dingin.
w|katup.en: Wati checked the gas cylinder valve before lighting the stove on the cold morning.
w|katup.ko: 추운 아침 와티는 가스레인지를 켜기 전에 가스통 밸브를 확인했어요.

w|kau.en: Where have you been all this time?

w|kaum.en: Young people need to be given a chance.
He spoke on behalf of the working class.

w|kaus.text: Adik Fajar minta dibelikan kaus bergambar tim sepak bola favoritnya.
w|kaus.en: Fajar's younger brother asked him to buy a T-shirt with his favorite football team on it.
w|kaus.ko: 파자르의 동생은 좋아하는 축구팀이 그려진 티셔츠를 사 달라고 했어요.

w|kaus.text: Semua peserta mendapat kaus bertuliskan nama sekolah masak itu.
w|kaus.en: All the participants got a T-shirt with the cooking school's name on it.
w|kaus.ko: 참가자 모두 요리 학교 이름이 적힌 티셔츠를 받았어요.

w|kavaleri.text: Untuk rubrik sejarah, Bayu menulis tentang pasukan kavaleri yang dulu bermarkas di kota ini.
w|kavaleri.en: For the history section, Bayu wrote about a cavalry unit once based in this city.
w|kavaleri.ko: 바유는 역사면에 예전에 이 도시에 주둔했던 기병대에 대해 썼어요.

w|kavaleri.text: Di museum kecil desa, Intan melihat pelana kuda dari pasukan kavaleri zaman Belanda.
w|kavaleri.en: At the village's small museum, Intan saw a saddle from a Dutch-era cavalry unit.
w|kavaleri.ko: 마을의 작은 박물관에서 인탄은 네덜란드 시대 기병대의 말안장을 봤어요.

w|kawah.text: Agus mengantar para pendaki ke tepi kawah saat subuh.
w|kawah.en: Agus guided the hikers to the edge of the crater at dawn.
w|kawah.ko: 아구스는 새벽에 등산객들을 분화구 가장자리까지 안내했어요.

w|kawah.text: Wati menyelipkan foto kawah gunung yang dia kunjungi bulan lalu.
w|kawah.en: Wati slipped in a photo of the volcanic crater she visited last month.
w|kawah.ko: 와티는 지난달에 다녀온 산 분화구 사진을 끼워 넣었어요.

w|kawan.en: He's an old friend of mine.

w|kawanan.text: Fotografer koran memotret kawanan burung yang bermigrasi di atas pantai.
w|kawanan.en: The newspaper photographer took pictures of a flock of birds migrating over the beach.
w|kawanan.ko: 신문사 사진기자가 해변 위로 이동하는 새 떼를 찍었어요.

w|kawanan.text: Ayu menemukan kawanan semut di dalam ponsel yang terkena tumpahan teh manis.
w|kawanan.en: Ayu found a swarm of ants inside a phone that had sweet tea spilled on it.
w|kawanan.ko: 아유는 단 차를 쏟은 휴대폰 안에서 개미 떼를 발견했어요.

w|kawasan.text: Kereta itu melewati kawasan pegunungan yang penuh kebun sayur.
w|kawasan.en: The train passed through a mountainous area full of vegetable gardens.
w|kawasan.ko: 그 기차는 채소밭이 가득한 산간 지역을 지나갔어요.

w|kawasan.text: Kantor Putri ada di kawasan bisnis yang penuh perusahaan rintisan.
w|kawasan.en: Putri's office is in a business district full of startups.
w|kawasan.ko: 푸트리의 사무실은 스타트업이 가득한 업무 지구에 있어요.

w|kawat.text: Barang bukti berupa segulung kawat dibawa ke depan meja hakim.
w|kawat.en: The evidence, a roll of wire, was brought to the front of the judge's bench.
w|kawat.ko: 증거물인 철사 한 뭉치가 판사석 앞으로 옮겨졌어요.

w|kawat.text: Lestari mengikat tumpukan kardus bekas dengan kawat.
w|kawat.en: Lestari tied the pile of old boxes with wire.
w|kawat.ko: 레스타리는 헌 상자 더미를 철사로 묶었어요.

w|kawin.text: Rina berencana kawin tahun depan setelah kontraknya diperpanjang.
w|kawin.en: Rina plans to get married next year after her contract is extended.
w|kawin.ko: 리나는 계약이 연장되면 내년에 결혼할 계획이에요.

w|kawin.text: Kakak Dewi akan kawin di aula hotel ini bulan depan.
w|kawin.en: Dewi's older sister will get married in this hotel's hall next month.
w|kawin.ko: 데위의 언니는 다음 달 이 호텔 연회장에서 결혼해요.

w|kayak.text: Cuacanya kayak mau hujan sebentar lagi.
w|kayak.en: The weather looks like it's about to rain.
w|kayak.ko: 날씨가 곧 비가 올 것 같아.

w|kayak.text: Dia bicara kayak orang yang tahu semuanya.
w|kayak.en: He talks like someone who knows everything.
w|kayak.ko: 그는 모든 걸 아는 사람처럼 말해.

w|kayu.text: Meja itu terbuat dari kayu jati.
w|kayu.en: That table is made of teak wood.
Wet wood is hard to burn.

w|keabadian.text: Dimas pernah membaca puisi tentang musim yang berganti dan keabadian alam.
w|keabadian.en: Dimas once read a poem about the changing seasons and the eternity of nature.
w|keabadian.ko: 디마스는 계절의 변화와 자연의 영원함에 관한 시를 읽은 적이 있어요.

w|keabadian.text: Kakek Putri dulu mengukir kata keabadian di atas pintu kayu rumah itu.
w|keabadian.en: Putri's grandfather once carved the word eternity above the house's wooden door.
w|keabadian.ko: 푸트리의 할아버지는 예전에 그 집 나무 문 위에 영원이라는 말을 새겼어요.

w|keadilan.text: Keadilan harus ditegakkan untuk semua orang.
w|keadilan.en: Justice must be upheld for everyone.

w|keagamaan.text: Fajar mengurus izin acara keagamaan yang akan digelar di alun-alun kota.
w|keagamaan.en: Fajar handles the permit for a religious event to be held in the town square.
w|keagamaan.ko: 파자르는 시내 광장에서 열릴 종교 행사 허가를 처리해요.

w|keagamaan.text: Lestari bilang ruang serbaguna di lantai dasar sering dipakai untuk kegiatan keagamaan.
w|keagamaan.en: Lestari says the multipurpose room on the ground floor is often used for religious activities.
w|keagamaan.ko: 레스타리는 일 층 다목적실이 종교 행사에 자주 쓰인다고 해요.

w|keagungan.text: Pengunjung terpukau oleh keagungan candi dalam foto besar di dinding.
w|keagungan.en: Visitors were awed by the grandeur of the temple in the large photo on the wall.
w|keagungan.ko: 방문객들은 벽에 걸린 큰 사진 속 사원의 웅장함에 넋을 잃었어요.

w|keagungan.text: Lampu gantung kristal di lobi memberi kesan keagungan pada toko itu.
w|keagungan.en: The crystal chandelier in the lobby gives the store an air of grandeur.
w|keagungan.ko: 로비의 크리스털 샹들리에가 그 매장에 웅장한 느낌을 줘요.

w|keahlian.text: Keahliannya di bidang memasak sangat terkenal.
w|keahlian.en: His skill in cooking is very well known.
w|keahlian.ko: 요리 분야에서의 그의 실력은 아주 유명해.

w|keahlian.text: Dia mengembangkan keahlian baru setiap tahun.
w|keahlian.en: She develops a new skill every year.

w|keajaiban.en: They believe in the wonders of nature.

w|keanehan.text: Agus melihat keanehan pada retakan dinding dan segera memanggil insinyur.
w|keanehan.en: Agus noticed something odd about the crack in the wall and called the engineer right away.
w|keanehan.ko: 아구스는 벽 균열에서 이상한 점을 발견하고 바로 엔지니어를 불렀어요.

w|keanehan.text: Wati merasa ada keanehan karena harga sepatu itu terlalu murah untuk barang asli.
w|keanehan.en: Wati sensed something odd because the price of the shoes was too cheap for genuine ones.
w|keanehan.ko: 와티는 그 신발 값이 정품치고 너무 싸서 이상하다고 느꼈어요.

w|keanggotaan.text: Fajar baru saja memperpanjang keanggotaan perpustakaan kota di lantai bawah.
w|keanggotaan.en: Fajar just renewed his membership at the city library downstairs.
w|keanggotaan.ko: 파자르는 막 아래층 시립 도서관 회원 자격을 연장했어요.

w|keanggotaan.text: Lestari membayar keanggotaan pusat kebugaran di lantai dasar setiap bulan.
w|keanggotaan.en: Lestari pays for a gym membership on the ground floor every month.
w|keanggotaan.ko: 레스타리는 일 층 헬스장 회원비를 매달 내요.

w|kebahagiaan.text: Kebahagiaan sederhana sering terasa lebih dalam.
w|kebahagiaan.ko: 소박한 행복이 종종 더 깊게 느껴져.

w|kebahagiaan.text: Dia menemukan kebahagiaan di desa kecil itu.
w|kebahagiaan.en: She found happiness in that small village.
w|kebahagiaan.ko: 그녀는 그 작은 마을에서 행복을 찾았어.

w|kebaikan.text: Balas kebaikan orang lain dengan tulus.

w|kebajikan.text: Fajar menulis kolom tentang kebajikan para relawan di kampungnya.
w|kebajikan.en: Fajar wrote a column about the kindness of the volunteers in his neighborhood.
w|kebajikan.ko: 파자르는 동네 자원봉사자들의 선행에 대한 칼럼을 썼어요.

w|kebajikan.text: Nenek Lestari suka bercerita tentang kebajikan orang-orang desa zaman dulu.
w|kebajikan.en: Lestari's grandmother likes to tell stories about the virtues of village folk in the old days.
w|kebajikan.ko: 레스타리의 할머니는 옛날 시골 사람들의 미덕에 대해 이야기하길 좋아해요.

w|kebakaran.ko: 그 화재로 집 몇 채가 망가졌어.

w|kebakaran.en: Residents fear another fire will break out.
w|kebakaran.ko: 주민들은 또 불이 날까 봐 두려워해.

w|kebal.text: Budi menjelaskan bahwa anak kucing yang sudah divaksin lebih kebal terhadap virus.
w|kebal.en: Budi explained that kittens that have been vaccinated are more immune to viruses.
w|kebal.ko: 부디는 백신을 맞은 새끼 고양이가 바이러스에 더 강하다고 설명했어요.

w|kebal.text: Warga desa bercanda bahwa Siti sudah kebal terhadap udara dingin pegunungan.
w|kebal.en: The villagers joke that Siti is already immune to the cold mountain air.
w|kebal.ko: 마을 사람들은 시티가 이제 산의 찬 공기에 끄떡없다고 농담해요.

w|kebalikan.text: Yang dimaksud Rudi justru kebalikan dari yang dipahami kakaknya.
w|kebalikan.en: What Rudi meant was actually the opposite of what his sister understood.
w|kebalikan.ko: 루디가 뜻한 건 오히려 누나가 이해한 것과 정반대였어요.

w|kebalikan.text: Udara pantai yang lembap adalah kebalikan dari udara kering di kota Rina.
w|kebalikan.en: The humid beach air is the opposite of the dry air in Rina's city.
w|kebalikan.ko: 해변의 습한 공기는 리나네 도시의 건조한 공기와 정반대예요.

w|kebanggaan.text: Rudi menulis dengan penuh kebanggaan tentang anak perempuannya yang baru lulus.
w|kebanggaan.en: Rudi wrote with great pride about his daughter who had just graduated.
w|kebanggaan.ko: 루디는 막 졸업한 딸에 대해 큰 자부심을 담아 썼어요.

w|kebanggaan.text: Rasa kebanggaan terlihat di wajah Rina saat aplikasi mereka masuk daftar terpopuler.
w|kebanggaan.en: Pride showed on Rina's face when their app made the most popular list.
w|kebanggaan.ko: 앱이 인기 순위에 오르자 리나의 얼굴에 자부심이 드러났어요.

w|kebangkitan.text: Pak Guru bercerita tentang kebangkitan semangat pemuda pada awal abad lalu.
w|kebangkitan.en: The teacher talked about the awakening of youth spirit at the start of the last century.
w|kebangkitan.ko: 선생님은 지난 세기 초 청년들의 의식이 깨어난 이야기를 해 줬어요.

w|kebangkitan.text: Pindah ke kota kecil terasa seperti kebangkitan semangat baru bagi Rina.
w|kebangkitan.en: Moving to a small town felt like a revival of fresh spirit for Rina.
w|kebangkitan.ko: 작은 도시로 이사한 건 리나에게 새 기운이 살아나는 느낌이었어요.

w|kebangsaan.text: Bayu menulis tajuk tentang rasa kebangsaan anak muda menjelang hari kemerdekaan.
w|kebangsaan.en: Bayu wrote an editorial about young people's sense of nationhood ahead of Independence Day.
w|kebangsaan.ko: 바유는 독립기념일을 앞두고 젊은이들의 민족의식에 관한 사설을 썼어요.

w|kebangsaan.text: Menjelang hari kemerdekaan, Intan memesan bendera dan pernak-pernik bertema kebangsaan.
w|kebangsaan.en: Ahead of Independence Day, Intan ordered flags and national-themed knick-knacks.
w|kebangsaan.ko: 독립기념일을 앞두고 인탄은 국기와 나라 기념 소품을 주문했어요.

w|kebanyakan.en: Most people have already gone home.

w|kebebasan.en: Freedom of speech is very important.
They fight for the people's freedom.

w|kebencian.en: Hatred only damages one's own heart.

w|kebencian.text: Mereka menolak menyebarkan kebencian di media.
w|kebencian.en: They refuse to spread hatred on media.

w|keberadaan.en: The existence of evidence changed the whole case.
They doubt the existence of that creature.

w|keberangkatan.text: Rudi mengingatkan tamu bahwa jadwal keberangkatan bus bandara dimajukan.
w|keberangkatan.en: Rudi reminded the guests that the airport bus departure time had been moved up.
w|keberangkatan.ko: 루디는 손님들에게 공항버스 출발 시간이 앞당겨졌다고 알려 줬어요.

w|keberangkatan.text: Hujan deras membuat keberangkatan kereta Rina tertunda dua jam.
w|keberangkatan.en: Heavy rain delayed the departure of Rina's train by two hours.
w|keberangkatan.ko: 폭우 때문에 리나가 탈 기차의 출발이 두 시간 늦어졌어요.

w|keberanian.en: His courage inspired the whole team.

w|keberanian.text: Dia menunjukkan keberanian di saat sulit.
w|keberanian.en: She showed courage in a difficult moment.
w|keberanian.ko: 그는 힘든 순간에 용기를 보여 줬어.

w|keberhasilan.text: Kepala koki bilang keberhasilan dapur bergantung pada kerja sama, bukan satu orang.
w|keberhasilan.en: The head chef says a kitchen's success depends on teamwork, not one person.
w|keberhasilan.ko: 주방장은 주방의 성공은 한 사람이 아니라 협력에 달려 있다고 말해요.

w|keberhasilan.text: Panitia senang dengan keberhasilan pasar loak minggu lalu dan ingin mengadakannya lagi.
w|keberhasilan.en: The organizers were happy with last week's flea market success and want to hold it again.
w|keberhasilan.ko: 주최 측은 지난주 벼룩시장이 잘된 데 기뻐하며 다시 열고 싶어 해요.

w|kebersamaan.text: Makan siang bersama membuat Bayu merasakan kebersamaan tim sejak minggu pertama.
w|kebersamaan.en: Eating lunch together let Bayu feel the team's togetherness from the first week.
w|kebersamaan.ko: 함께 점심을 먹으며 바유는 첫 주부터 팀의 끈끈함을 느꼈어요.

w|kebersamaan.text: Intan suka kelas senam karena ada rasa kebersamaan.
