w|kebersamaan.en: Intan likes the aerobics class because there's a sense of togetherness.
w|kebersamaan.ko: 인탄은 함께하는 느낌이 있어서 에어로빅 수업을 좋아해요.

w|kebersihan.text: Pengelola apartemen menempelkan pengumuman soal kebersihan di dekat lift.
w|kebersihan.en: The apartment management posted a notice about cleanliness near the elevator.
w|kebersihan.ko: 아파트 관리실은 엘리베이터 옆에 청결에 관한 공지를 붙였어요.

w|kebersihan.text: Saat musim hujan tiba, Wati makin rajin menjaga kebersihan selokan depan rumah.
w|kebersihan.en: When the rainy season arrives, Wati is more diligent about keeping the gutter in front of the house clean.
w|kebersihan.ko: 우기가 오면 와티는 집 앞 도랑 청소를 더 부지런히 해요.

w|keberuntungan.en: Luck was on his side that day.
He relies on sheer luck alone.

w|kebesaran.text: Bayu terdiam melihat kebesaran pohon beringin tua di tengah hutan.
w|kebesaran.en: Bayu fell silent at the sheer size of the old banyan tree in the middle of the forest.
w|kebesaran.ko: 바유는 숲 한가운데 있는 늙은 반얀나무의 웅장함에 말을 잃었어요.

w|kebesaran.text: Intan memakai kaus panitia yang kebesaran sampai menutupi lutut.
w|kebesaran.en: Intan wore the race shirt that was so oversized it reached her knees.
w|kebesaran.ko: 인탄은 무릎까지 내려올 만큼 큰 대회 티셔츠를 입었어요.

w|kebetulan.en: By chance I'm going there too.

w|kebiasaan.text: Kebiasaan baik perlu dijaga setiap hari.
w|kebiasaan.en: Good habits need to be kept every day.

w|kebiasaan.text: Dia mengubah kebiasaan makan yang buruk.
w|kebiasaan.en: He changed his bad eating habit.

w|kebijakan.text: Menurut kebijakan baru, laporan kehilangan bisa dibuat secara daring.
w|kebijakan.en: Under the new policy, loss reports can be filed online.
w|kebijakan.ko: 새 정책에 따라 분실 신고는 온라인으로도 할 수 있어요.

w|kebijakan.text: Klub punya kebijakan tegas: pemain yang terlambat tidak boleh ikut bertanding.
w|kebijakan.en: The club has a strict policy: players who are late can't play in the match.
w|kebijakan.ko: 클럽 방침은 엄해서 지각한 선수는 경기에 못 나가요.

w|kebijaksanaan.text: Rudi kagum pada kebijaksanaan kepala sekolah saat menengahi pertengkaran murid.
w|kebijaksanaan.en: Rudi admired the principal's wisdom in settling a quarrel between students.
w|kebijaksanaan.ko: 루디는 학생들 싸움을 중재하는 교장 선생님의 지혜에 감탄했어요.

w|kebijaksanaan.text: Dengan penuh kebijaksanaan, ayah Rina menyarankan agar dia tidak buru-buru membeli perabot baru.
w|kebijaksanaan.en: With great wisdom, Rina's father advised her not to rush into buying new furniture.
w|kebijaksanaan.ko: 리나의 아빠는 새 가구를 서둘러 사지 말라고 현명하게 조언했어요.

w|kebingungan.text: Ternyata ada kebingungan soal tanggal pada surat kontrak itu.
w|kebingungan.en: It turned out there was confusion about the date on the contract.
w|kebingungan.ko: 알고 보니 그 계약서의 날짜를 두고 혼란이 있었어요.

w|kebingungan.text: Lestari melihat kebingungan di wajah turis yang mencari air mineral.
w|kebingungan.en: Lestari saw the confusion on the face of a tourist looking for mineral water.
w|kebingungan.ko: 레스타리는 생수를 찾는 관광객 얼굴에 떠오른 당황한 기색을 봤어요.

w|kebisingan.text: Di hutan, Agus merasa lega jauh dari kebisingan jalan raya.
w|kebisingan.en: In the forest, Agus feels relieved to be far from the noise of the highway.
w|kebisingan.ko: 숲에 있으면 아구스는 큰길의 소음에서 벗어나 마음이 편해요.

w|kebisingan.text: Wati sulit mendengar pelanggan karena kebisingan proyek jalan di depan apotek.
w|kebisingan.en: Wati finds it hard to hear customers because of the noise from the roadworks in front of the pharmacy.
w|kebisingan.ko: 약국 앞 도로 공사 소음 때문에 와티는 손님 말을 듣기 힘들어요.

w|kebocoran.text: Ada kebocoran pipa di plafon kamar mandi Bayu.
w|kebocoran.en: There is a pipe leak in the ceiling of Bayu's bathroom.

w|kebocoran.text: Penumpang mengeluh karena ada kebocoran air dari atap gerbong.
w|kebocoran.en: Passengers complained because water was leaking from the carriage roof.
w|kebocoran.ko: 객차 지붕에서 물이 새서 승객들이 불평했어요.

w|kebodohan.text: Fajar menertawakan kebodohan dirinya sendiri karena salah menulis alamat.
w|kebodohan.en: Fajar laughed at his own foolishness for writing the wrong address.
w|kebodohan.ko: 파자르는 주소를 잘못 쓴 자기 실수에 웃음이 났어요.

w|kebodohan.text: Guru bercerita tentang kebodohan masa mudanya yang pernah memasukkan garam ke kue.
w|kebodohan.en: The teacher told about the foolishness of her youth when she once put salt in a cake.
w|kebodohan.ko: 선생님은 젊을 때 케이크에 소금을 넣었던 어리석은 실수를 이야기했어요.

w|kebudayaan.text: Fajar mengurus izin festival kebudayaan yang akan diadakan di alun-alun.
w|kebudayaan.en: Fajar handled the permit for the cultural festival to be held in the square.
w|kebudayaan.ko: 파자르는 광장에서 열릴 문화 축제 허가를 맡았어요.

w|kebudayaan.text: Lestari bercerita bahwa ia ikut kelas tari di pusat kebudayaan dekat rumahnya.
w|kebudayaan.en: Lestari said she was taking dance classes at the cultural center near her home.
w|kebudayaan.ko: 레스타리는 집 근처 문화 센터에서 춤 수업을 듣는다고 했어요.

w|kebun.en: Grandma waters the garden every afternoon.
w|kebun.ko: 할머니가 매일 오후에 텃밭에 물을 줘.

w|kebun.text: Kebun buah itu penuh aroma manis.
w|kebun.en: That fruit garden is full of sweet scent.

w|keburukan.text: Eko tahu keburukan pariwisata massal: sampah, macet, dan harga yang naik.
w|keburukan.en: Eko knows the downsides of mass tourism: litter, traffic jams, and rising prices.
w|keburukan.ko: 에코는 대규모 관광의 나쁜 점을 알아요. 쓰레기, 교통 체증, 오르는 물가요.

w|keburukan.text: Dokter menjelaskan keburukan minuman bersoda bagi email gigi Ayu.
w|keburukan.en: The dentist explained the harm fizzy drinks do to Ayu's tooth enamel.
w|keburukan.ko: 의사는 탄산음료가 아유의 치아 법랑질에 해로운 점을 설명했어요.

w|kebutuhan.en: Basic needs must be met first.
Clean water is an important need.

w|kecanduan.text: Dokter bilang kecanduan minuman manis membuat gigi Agus cepat berlubang.
w|kecanduan.en: The doctor said an addiction to sugary drinks makes Agus's teeth get cavities quickly.
w|kecanduan.ko: 의사는 단 음료에 빠진 습관 때문에 아구스의 이가 빨리 썩는다고 했어요.

w|kecanduan.text: Wati bercanda bahwa merenovasi rumah tua itu seperti kecanduan yang sulit dihentikan.
w|kecanduan.en: Wati jokes that renovating old houses is like an addiction that's hard to stop.
w|kecanduan.ko: 와티는 낡은 집 고치는 게 끊기 힘든 중독 같다며 농담해요.

w|kecantikan.text: Produk kecantikan itu laris di toko.
w|kecantikan.en: That beauty product sells well at the store.
w|kecantikan.ko: 그 미용 제품은 가게에서 잘 팔려.

w|kecelakaan.en: There's an accident on the road.

w|kecemasan.text: Ibu melihat kecemasan di mata Rudi setiap kali nama kakaknya disebut.
w|kecemasan.en: Mom saw worry in Rudi's eyes every time his sister's name came up.
w|kecemasan.ko: 엄마는 누나 이름이 나올 때마다 루디의 눈에서 걱정을 봤어요.

w|kecemasan.text: Ombak besar sempat menimbulkan kecemasan bagi para orang tua di pantai.
w|kecemasan.en: The big waves caused worry among the parents on the beach.
w|kecemasan.ko: 큰 파도에 해변의 부모들이 잠시 불안해했어요.

w|kecenderungan.text: Agus melihat kecenderungan anak muda sekarang menyukai barang antik.
w|kecenderungan.en: Agus has noticed a tendency among young people these days to love antiques.
w|kecenderungan.ko: 아구스는 요즘 젊은이들이 골동품을 좋아하는 경향을 느껴요.

w|kecenderungan.text: Wati punya kecenderungan malas berolahraga saat musim hujan.
w|kecenderungan.en: Wati has a tendency to skip exercise in the rainy season.
w|kecenderungan.ko: 와티는 우기가 되면 운동을 게을리하는 경향이 있어요.

w|kecepatan.en: Reduce your speed at the bend.
That car's speed is too high.

w|kecerdasan.text: Drama terbaru Bayu bercerita tentang robot dengan kecerdasan buatan.
w|kecerdasan.en: Bayu's latest play is about a robot with artificial intelligence.
w|kecerdasan.ko: 바유의 새 연극은 인공지능 로봇에 관한 이야기예요.

w|kecerdasan.text: Atasan Intan memuji kecerdasan Intan dalam membaca data penjualan.
w|kecerdasan.en: Intan's supervisor praised Intan's intelligence in reading the sales data.
w|kecerdasan.ko: 인탄의 상사는 판매 데이터를 읽어 내는 인탄의 똑똑함을 칭찬했어요.

w|kecewa.en: He is disappointed with the result.
Don't be disappointed if you fail once.

w|kecoak.text: Eko berteriak kaget saat seekor kecoak keluar dari sepatunya.
w|kecoak.en: Eko yelled in surprise when a cockroach came out of his shoe.
w|kecoak.ko: 에코는 신발에서 바퀴벌레가 나오자 놀라 소리쳤어요.

w|kecoak.text: Ayu menjerit saat melihat kecoak di kamar mandi hotel sebelum lomba.
w|kecoak.en: Ayu screamed when she saw a cockroach in the hotel bathroom before the race.
w|kecoak.ko: 아유는 대회 전 호텔 욕실에서 바퀴벌레를 보고 비명을 질렀어요.

w|kecocokan.text: Andi dan tetangga sebelah punya kecocokan dalam selera musik.
w|kecocokan.en: Andi and the neighbor next door have a lot in common in their taste in music.
w|kecocokan.ko: 안디와 옆집 사람은 음악 취향이 잘 맞아요.

w|kecocokan.text: Dewi memasangkan murid untuk duet berdasarkan kecocokan tempo dan gaya.
w|kecocokan.en: Dewi pairs students for duets based on how well their tempo and style match.
w|kecocokan.ko: 데위는 템포와 스타일이 잘 맞는지 보고 학생들을 이중주 짝으로 묶어요.

w|kecuali.text: Boleh makan apa saja kecuali itu.
w|kecuali.en: You can eat anything except that.

w|kecurangan.text: Guru menemukan kecurangan dalam ujian, tetapi Budi tidak terlibat.
w|kecurangan.en: The teacher found cheating in the exam, but Budi wasn't involved.
w|kecurangan.ko: 선생님이 시험 부정행위를 찾아냈지만 부디는 관련이 없었어요.

w|kecurangan.text: Siti melapor kepada maskapai karena curiga ada kecurangan dalam undian hadiah.
w|kecurangan.en: Siti reported to the airline because she suspected cheating in the prize draw.
w|kecurangan.ko: 시티는 경품 추첨에 부정이 있다고 의심해서 항공사에 신고했어요.

w|kecurigaan.text: Budi mengakui kecurigaan lamanya terhadap Andi ternyata salah.
w|kecurigaan.en: Budi admits his old suspicion of Andi turned out to be wrong.
w|kecurigaan.ko: 부디는 안디에 대한 예전의 의심이 틀렸다고 인정해요.

w|kecurigaan.text: Panitia menyelidiki kecurigaan bahwa seorang peserta naik ojek di tengah rute.
w|kecurigaan.en: The organizers investigated the suspicion that a participant took a motorbike taxi midway through the course.
w|kecurigaan.ko: 주최 측은 한 참가자가 코스 중간에 오토바이 택시를 탔다는 의혹을 조사했어요.

w|kedai.text: Sebelum punya toko sendiri, Fajar bekerja di kedai kopi di pinggir jalan.
w|kedai.en: Before having his own shop, Fajar worked at a roadside coffee stall.
w|kedai.ko: 자기 가게를 차리기 전에 파자르는 길가 커피 가게에서 일했어요.

w|kedai.text: Setelah finis, Lestari dan teman-temannya mampir ke kedai bubur.
w|kedai.en: After finishing, Lestari and her friends stopped by a porridge stall.
w|kedai.ko: 결승선을 통과한 뒤 레스타리와 친구들은 죽 가게에 들렀어요.

w|kedalaman.text: Malam itu Budi baru sadar kedalaman rasa kecewa adiknya.
w|kedalaman.en: That night Budi finally realized how deep his sister's disappointment was.
w|kedalaman.ko: 그날 밤에야 부디는 동생이 얼마나 깊이 실망했는지 깨달았어요.

w|kedalaman.text: Siti bertanya kepada tukang tentang kedalaman sumur di belakang rumah.
w|kedalaman.en: Siti asked the handyman about the depth of the well behind the house.
w|kedalaman.ko: 시티는 일꾼에게 집 뒤 우물의 깊이를 물어봤어요.

w|kedamaian.text: Kedamaian di desa itu sangat menenangkan.
w|kedamaian.en: The peace in that village is very soothing.
w|kedamaian.ko: 그 마을의 평화가 아주 마음을 놓이게 해.

w|kedap.text: Andi memasang lapisan kedap air di atap gedung.
w|kedap.en: Andi installed a waterproof layer on the building's roof.

w|kedap.text: Ruang karaoke itu kedap suara, jadi Dewi bisa bernyanyi sekeras-kerasnya.
w|kedap.en: The karaoke room is soundproof, so Dewi could sing as loud as she liked.
w|kedap.ko: 그 노래방은 방음이 돼서 데위는 마음껏 크게 노래할 수 있었어요.

w|kedatangan.en: The guests' arrival made the house lively.
They waited for the night train's arrival.

w|kedengaran.text: Dari dapur, nyanyian ulang tahun para tamu kedengaran sampai ke tempat cuci piring.
w|kedengaran.en: From the kitchen, the guests' birthday singing could be heard all the way to the sink.
w|kedengaran.ko: 손님들의 생일 축하 노래가 주방 설거지대까지 들렸어요.

w|kedengaran.text: Lagu dari piringan hitam itu kedengaran sampai ke ujung pasar loak.
w|kedengaran.en: The song from that vinyl record could be heard all the way to the far end of the flea market.
w|kedengaran.ko: 그 레코드판 노래가 벼룩시장 끝까지 들렸어요.

w|kediaman.text: Bayu baru pindah ke kediaman barunya di lantai sembilan.
w|kediaman.en: Bayu just moved into his new residence on the ninth floor.
w|kediaman.ko: 바유는 구 층에 있는 새 거처로 막 이사했어요.

w|kediaman.text: Intan naik kereta malam untuk pulang ke kediaman orang tuanya di Surabaya.
w|kediaman.en: Intan took the night train to go back to her parents' residence in Surabaya.
w|kediaman.ko: 인탄은 수라바야에 있는 부모님 댁에 가려고 야간열차를 탔어요.

w|kedinginan.text: Anak itu kedinginan di luar rumah.
w|kedinginan.en: The child was freezing outside the house.
w|kedinginan.ko: 그 아이는 집 밖에서 추위에 떨었어.

w|kedinginan.en: The cold made his hands tremble.

w|kedok.text: Topeng kayu di ruang itu dulu dipakai penari, bukan sebagai kedok untuk menipu orang.
w|kedok.en: The wooden masks in that room were once used by dancers, not as a disguise to fool people.
w|kedok.ko: 그 전시실의 나무 가면은 옛날 무용수들이 쓰던 것이지, 사람을 속이려는 가면이 아니었어요.

w|kedok.text: Tokoh jahat dalam film itu memakai kedok pengusaha dermawan.
w|kedok.en: The villain in the film hides behind the mask of a generous businessman.
w|kedok.ko: 그 영화의 악당은 너그러운 사업가라는 가면을 쓰고 있어요.

w|kedokteran.text: Rina sedang kuliah kedokteran, jadi uang itu untuk membeli buku.
w|kedokteran.en: Rina is studying medicine, so that money was for buying books.
w|kedokteran.ko: 리나는 의대에 다니고 있어서 그 돈은 책을 사려던 거였어요.

w|kedokteran.text: Tetangga sebelah Siti ternyata dosen fakultas kedokteran.
w|kedokteran.en: Siti's next-door neighbor turns out to be a lecturer at the medical school.
w|kedokteran.ko: 시티의 옆집 이웃은 알고 보니 의대 교수예요.

w|kedua.en: The second child has been born.

w|kedua-duanya.text: Budi mengirim foto dan kartu pos, berharap kedua-duanya sampai dengan selamat.
w|kedua-duanya.en: Budi sent a photo and a postcard, hoping both would arrive safely.
w|kedua-duanya.ko: 부디는 사진과 엽서를 보내며 둘 다 무사히 도착하길 바랐어요.

w|kedua-duanya.text: Siti menawari kue dan teh, dan tetangga itu mengambil kedua-duanya.
w|kedua-duanya.en: Siti offered cake and tea, and the neighbor took both.
w|kedua-duanya.ko: 시티가 과자와 차를 권하자 이웃은 둘 다 받았어요.

w|kedudukan.text: Dalam drama itu, Eko memerankan menteri yang takut kehilangan kedudukan.
w|kedudukan.en: In the play, Eko plays a minister who is afraid of losing his position.
w|kedudukan.ko: 그 연극에서 에코는 자리를 잃을까 봐 두려워하는 장관 역을 맡았어요.

w|kedudukan.text: Toko Ayu punya kedudukan penting bagi warga karena buka sampai tengah malam.
w|kedudukan.en: Ayu's shop has an important place for residents because it's open until midnight.
w|kedudukan.ko: 아유의 가게는 자정까지 열어서 주민들에게 중요한 자리를 차지해요.

w|kedutaan.text: Pameran tekstil kali ini didukung oleh beberapa kedutaan asing.
w|kedutaan.en: This textile exhibition is supported by several foreign embassies.
w|kedutaan.ko: 이번 직물 전시는 여러 외국 대사관이 후원해요.

w|kedutaan.text: Seorang pegawai kedutaan rutin membeli rempah-rempah dari Rina.
w|kedutaan.en: An embassy employee regularly buys spices from Rina.
w|kedutaan.ko: 한 대사관 직원이 리나에게서 꾸준히 향신료를 사요.

w|keempat.text: Dia finis di posisi keempat dalam balapan.
w|keempat.en: He finished in fourth place in the race.

w|keempat.text: Bab keempat novel itu sangat menegangkan.
w|keempat.en: The fourth chapter of that novel is very tense.
w|keempat.ko: 그 소설의 네 번째 장이 아주 긴장돼.

w|keenam.text: Ini sudah perjalanan berkemah keenam Rudi tahun ini.
w|keenam.en: This is already Rudi's sixth camping trip this year.
w|keenam.ko: 이번이 벌써 올해 루디의 여섯 번째 캠핑 여행이에요.

w|keenam.text: Lagu keenam malam itu adalah lagu favorit Rina sejak SMA.
w|keenam.en: The sixth song that night was Rina's favorite since high school.
w|keenam.ko: 그날 밤 여섯 번째 노래는 리나가 고등학교 때부터 좋아한 노래였어요.

w|keesokan.text: Badai reda malam itu, dan keesokan harinya Dimas membersihkan halaman.
w|keesokan.en: The storm died down that night, and the next day Dimas cleaned the yard.
w|keesokan.ko: 그날 밤 폭풍이 잦아들었고, 다음 날 디마스는 마당을 치웠어요.

w|keesokan.text: Putri memasang jendela baru, dan keesokan paginya kamar terasa lebih terang.
w|keesokan.en: Putri installed a new window, and the next morning the room felt brighter.
w|keesokan.ko: 푸트리가 새 창문을 달았더니 다음 날 아침 방이 더 환해졌어요.

w|kegagalan.en: That failure taught him many lessons.
w|kegagalan.ko: 그 실패가 그에게 많은 교훈을 줬어.

w|kegagalan.text: Dia tidak takut menghadapi kegagalan lagi.
w|kegagalan.en: She is not afraid to face failure again.
w|kegagalan.ko: 그녀는 다시 실패를 마주하는 걸 두려워하지 않아.

w|kegelapan.en: She is afraid of the dark.

w|kegembiraan.text: Budi tidak bisa menyembunyikan kegembiraan saat surat dari Andi akhirnya tiba.
w|kegembiraan.en: Budi couldn't hide his joy when the letter from Andi finally arrived.
w|kegembiraan.ko: 안디의 편지가 마침내 왔을 때 부디는 기쁨을 감출 수 없었어요.

w|kegembiraan.text: Pagi itu, kegembiraan para pelari terasa di sepanjang jalan kota.
w|kegembiraan.en: That morning, the runners' joy could be felt all along the city streets.
w|kegembiraan.ko: 그날 아침 도시 거리 곳곳에서 주자들의 기쁨이 느껴졌어요.

w|kegiatan.text: Kegiatan sekolah dimulai setelah libur panjang.
w|kegiatan.en: School activities started after the long break.
w|kegiatan.ko: 긴 방학 뒤에 학교 활동이 시작됐어.

w|kegiatan.text: Dia mengikuti kegiatan sukarela di desa.
w|kegiatan.en: She joined volunteer activities in the village.

w|kegilaan.en: That madness only lasted a moment.
They laughed at the madness of that idea.

w|keguguran.text: Fajar berbicara pelan dengan seorang ibu yang baru saja mengalami keguguran.
w|keguguran.en: Fajar spoke gently with a woman who had just had a miscarriage.
w|keguguran.ko: 파자르는 막 유산을 겪은 여성과 조용히 이야기를 나눴어요.

w|keguguran.text: Lestari membaca kebijakan cuti bagi karyawan yang mengalami keguguran.
w|keguguran.en: Lestari read the leave policy for employees who have had a miscarriage.
w|keguguran.ko: 레스타리는 유산을 겪은 직원을 위한 휴가 규정을 읽었어요.

w|kegunaan.text: Bayu menjelaskan kegunaan setiap tumbuhan obat kepada para relawan.
w|kegunaan.en: Bayu explained the use of each medicinal plant to the volunteers.

w|kegunaan.text: Intan baru paham kegunaan gel energi setelah kehabisan tenaga di tengah lomba.
w|kegunaan.en: Intan only understood the point of energy gels after running out of steam mid-race.
w|kegunaan.ko: 인탄은 경기 중간에 힘이 다 빠지고 나서야 에너지 젤의 쓸모를 알았어요.

w|kehabisan.en: Running out of ideas made him quiet.

w|kehadiran.text: Warga menyambut kehadiran wali kota di rapat dengan tepuk tangan.
w|kehadiran.en: Residents greeted the mayor's presence at the meeting with applause.
w|kehadiran.ko: 주민 회의에 시장이 나타나자 박수가 터졌어요.

w|kehadiran.text: Guru mencatat kehadiran murid sebelum kelas paduan suara dimulai.
w|kehadiran.en: The teacher records the students' attendance before choir class starts.
w|kehadiran.ko: 선생님은 합창 수업 전에 학생들 출석을 확인해요.

w|kehakiman.text: Kelas Budi berkunjung ke gedung kehakiman untuk melihat cara kerja pengadilan.
w|kehakiman.en: Budi's class visited the judiciary building to see how the courts work.
w|kehakiman.ko: 버디네 반은 법원이 어떻게 돌아가는지 보러 사법부 건물을 견학했어요.

w|kehakiman.text: Anak Siti bekerja di kementerian kehakiman dan jarang pulang kampung.
w|kehakiman.en: Siti's child works at the ministry of justice and rarely comes back to the village.
w|kehakiman.ko: 시티의 자녀는 법무부에서 일해서 고향에 잘 오지 않아요.

w|kehamilan.text: Gym itu punya kelas yoga khusus untuk ibu-ibu di masa kehamilan.
w|kehamilan.en: The gym has a yoga class specially for mothers during pregnancy.
w|kehamilan.ko: 그 헬스장에는 임신 중인 엄마들을 위한 요가 수업이 있어요.

w|kehamilan.text: Kakak ipar Intan mengumumkan kabar kehamilannya saat makan malam keluarga.
w|kehamilan.en: Intan's sister-in-law announced her pregnancy at the family dinner.
w|kehamilan.ko: 인탄의 올케가 가족 저녁 식사 자리에서 임신 소식을 알렸어요.

w|kehancuran.text: Kehancuran kota itu membuat warga sedih.
w|kehancuran.en: The city's destruction made residents sad.
w|kehancuran.ko: 그 도시의 파괴가 주민들을 슬프게 했어.

w|kehancuran.en: They prevented the destruction of the surrounding environment.

w|kehangatan.text: Rudi lupa semua rasa kesal begitu merasakan kehangatan pelukan kakaknya.
w|kehangatan.en: Rudi forgot all his annoyance as soon as he felt the warmth of his sister's hug.
w|kehangatan.ko: 루디는 누나 품의 따뜻함을 느끼자마자 짜증을 모두 잊었어요.

w|kehangatan.text: Rina merasakan kehangatan pasir di bawah telapak kakinya.
w|kehangatan.en: Rina felt the warmth of the sand under the soles of her feet.
w|kehangatan.ko: 리나는 발바닥 아래 모래의 따뜻함을 느꼈어요.

w|kehausan.text: Pasien yang baru dioperasi itu kehausan, tetapi Budi hanya boleh memberi sedikit air.
w|kehausan.en: The patient who had just been operated on was thirsty, but Budi could only give a little water.
w|kehausan.ko: 막 수술을 받은 환자가 목말라했지만 부디는 물을 조금밖에 줄 수 없었어요.

w|kehausan.text: Siti kehausan setelah berlari dari satu gerbang ke gerbang lain.
w|kehausan.en: Siti was parched after running from one gate to another.
w|kehausan.ko: 시티는 탑승구에서 탑승구로 뛰어다니느라 목이 바싹 말랐어요.

w|kehebatan.text: Andi kagum pada kehebatan tukang kayu yang membuat ulang jendela antik itu.
w|kehebatan.en: Andi admires the skill of the carpenter who remade the antique window.
w|kehebatan.ko: 안디는 그 옛날 창문을 다시 만든 목수의 솜씨에 감탄해요.

w|kehebatan.text: Dewi kagum pada kehebatan para insinyur yang membangun terowongan panjang itu.
w|kehebatan.en: Dewi admires the brilliance of the engineers who built that long tunnel.
w|kehebatan.ko: 데위는 그 긴 터널을 만든 기술자들의 솜씨에 감탄해요.

w|kehendak.text: Koran itu tidak mau tunduk pada kehendak pemasang iklan besar.
w|kehendak.en: The newspaper refuses to bow to the will of big advertisers.
w|kehendak.ko: 그 신문사는 큰 광고주의 뜻에 굴복하지 않으려 해요.

w|kehendak.text: Kata Ayu, kalau ponsel tiba-tiba mati sendiri, itu bukan kehendak hantu, tapi baterai rusak.
w|kehendak.en: According to Ayu, if a phone suddenly turns itself off, it isn't a ghost's will but a broken battery.
w|kehendak.ko: 아유 말로는 휴대폰이 갑자기 꺼지는 건 귀신 뜻이 아니라 배터리 고장이래요.

w|keheningan.text: Setelah mesin bor dimatikan, keheningan terasa aneh di lokasi proyek.
w|keheningan.en: After the drills were switched off, the silence felt strange on the construction site.
w|keheningan.ko: 드릴을 끄고 나니 공사 현장의 고요함이 낯설게 느껴졌어요.

w|keheningan.text: Di tengah keheningan malam, Wati masih sibuk membandingkan harga di tiga toko.
w|keheningan.en: In the silence of the night, Wati was still busy comparing prices at three shops.
w|keheningan.ko: 고요한 밤중에도 와티는 세 가게의 가격을 비교하느라 바빴어요.

w|kehidupan.en: Life in the city is busy.

w|kehilangan.en: He feels like he's lost his way.

w|kehormatan.en: This is a great honor for me.

w|keindahan.text: Dalam lomba puisi, Budi menggambarkan keindahan sawah di kampungnya.
w|keindahan.en: In the poetry contest, Budi described the beauty of the rice fields in his village.
w|keindahan.ko: 시 쓰기 대회에서 부디는 고향 논의 아름다움을 그렸어요.

w|keindahan.text: Dari balkon baru, Siti bisa menikmati keindahan matahari terbenam.
w|keindahan.en: From her new balcony, Siti can enjoy the beauty of the sunset.
w|keindahan.ko: 새 발코니에서 시티는 아름다운 노을을 즐길 수 있어요.

w|kejadian.en: Tell me what happened last night.

w|kejahatan.en: The police are investigating this crime.

w|kejaksaan.text: Kelas Eko berkunjung ke kantor kejaksaan untuk belajar tentang hukum.
w|kejaksaan.en: Eko's class visited the prosecutor's office to learn about the law.
w|kejaksaan.ko: 에코네 반은 법을 배우러 검찰청을 견학했어요.

w|kejaksaan.text: Ayah Ayu bekerja di kejaksaan, tapi Ayu lebih memilih jadi pelukis.
w|kejaksaan.en: Ayu's father works at the prosecutor's office, but Ayu would rather be a painter.
w|kejaksaan.ko: 아유의 아빠는 검찰청에서 일하지만 아유는 화가가 되고 싶어 해요.

w|kejam.text: Perlakuan itu sangat kejam terhadap hewan.
w|kejam.en: That treatment is very cruel to animals.
The words he spoke were so cruel.

w|kejang.text: Bayu terbangun malam-malam karena kejang di betisnya.
w|kejang.en: Bayu woke up in the night because of a cramp in his calf.
w|kejang.ko: 바유는 종아리에 쥐가 나서 한밤중에 깼어요.

w|kejang.text: Pelayan restoran itu pernah belajar cara menolong orang yang mengalami kejang.
w|kejang.en: The restaurant's waiter once learned how to help someone having a seizure.
w|kejang.ko: 그 식당 종업원은 발작을 일으킨 사람을 돕는 법을 배운 적이 있어요.

w|kejatuhan.text: Rudi menolong seorang pedagang yang kejatuhan papan reklame.
w|kejatuhan.en: Rudi helped a vendor who had been hit by a falling billboard.
w|kejatuhan.ko: 루디는 떨어진 광고판에 맞은 상인을 도와줬어요.

w|kejatuhan.text: Saat jam istirahat, Rina membaca buku tentang kejatuhan sebuah kerajaan kuno.
w|kejatuhan.en: During her break, Rina reads a book about the fall of an ancient kingdom.
w|kejatuhan.ko: 리나는 쉬는 시간에 한 고대 왕국의 몰락에 관한 책을 읽어요.

w|kejauhan.text: Dari balkon, Agus bisa melihat gunung di kejauhan saat cuaca cerah.
w|kejauhan.en: From the balcony, Agus can see the mountains in the distance when the weather is clear.
w|kejauhan.ko: 날이 맑으면 아구스는 발코니에서 멀리 산을 볼 수 있어요.

w|kejauhan.text: Wati mendengar suara guntur dari kejauhan sebelum hujan turun.
w|kejauhan.en: Wati heard thunder in the distance before the rain fell.
w|kejauhan.ko: 비가 오기 전에 와티는 멀리서 천둥소리를 들었어요.

w|kejayaan.text: Agus menulis makalah tentang kejayaan kerajaan maritim di Nusantara.
w|kejayaan.en: Agus wrote a paper about the glory of the maritime kingdoms in the archipelago.
w|kejayaan.ko: 아구스는 군도의 해양 왕국이 누린 영광에 대한 보고서를 썼어요.

w|kejayaan.text: Klub renang Wati pernah meraih masa kejayaan dua puluh tahun lalu.
w|kejayaan.en: Wati's swimming club had its days of glory twenty years ago.
w|kejayaan.ko: 와티의 수영 클럽은 이십 년 전에 전성기를 누렸어요.

w|kejelasan.text: Andi menuntut kejelasan dari narasumber soal anggaran proyek.
w|kejelasan.en: Andi demanded clarity from the source about the project budget.
w|kejelasan.ko: 안디는 취재원에게 사업 예산에 대해 명확한 설명을 요구했어요.

w|kejelasan.text: Dewi meminta kejelasan dari pemilik rumah soal tagihan listrik.
w|kejelasan.en: Dewi asked the landlord for clarity about the electricity bill.
w|kejelasan.ko: 데위는 집주인에게 전기 요금에 대해 확실히 해 달라고 했어요.

w|keji.text: Fajar membaca berita tentang penipu keji yang menjual minyak goreng palsu.
w|keji.en: Fajar read news about vicious swindlers selling fake cooking oil.
w|keji.ko: 파자르는 가짜 식용유를 판 악랄한 사기꾼들에 관한 기사를 읽었어요.

w|keji.text: Lestari membeli novel detektif tentang pembunuh keji di sebuah kota kecil.
w|keji.en: Lestari bought a detective novel about a cruel killer in a small town.
w|keji.ko: 레스타리는 작은 도시의 잔혹한 살인범을 다룬 탐정 소설을 샀어요.

w|kejiwaan.text: Dimas tidak boleh menjual obat kejiwaan tanpa resep dokter.
w|kejiwaan.en: Dimas isn't allowed to sell psychiatric medication without a doctor's prescription.
w|kejiwaan.ko: 디마스는 의사 처방 없이 정신과 약을 팔 수 없어요.

w|kejiwaan.text: Putri menemukan buku tua tentang kejiwaan di loteng.
w|kejiwaan.en: Putri found an old book about the human psyche in the attic.
w|kejiwaan.ko: 푸트리는 다락에서 정신에 관한 오래된 책을 찾았어요.

w|keju.text: Keju di atas pizza sudah meleleh.
w|keju.en: The cheese on the pizza has melted.
She added cheese to the sandwich.

w|kejuaraan.text: Lemari kaca di lobi berisi piala kejuaraan menembak antarpolsek.
w|kejuaraan.en: The glass cabinet in the lobby holds trophies from the inter-precinct shooting championship.
w|kejuaraan.ko: 로비 유리장에는 지구대 대항 사격 대회 트로피가 들어 있어요.

w|kejuaraan.text: Tim basket Dewi sedang bersiap untuk kejuaraan antarkampus bulan depan.
w|kejuaraan.en: Dewi's basketball team is getting ready for the intercollegiate championship next month.
w|kejuaraan.ko: 데위네 농구팀은 다음 달 대학 대항 선수권 대회를 준비하고 있어요.

w|kejujuran.text: Ibu selalu bilang kepada Budi dan Rina bahwa kejujuran lebih penting daripada menang debat.
w|kejujuran.en: Mom always tells Budi and Rina that honesty matters more than winning an argument.
w|kejujuran.ko: 엄마는 늘 부디와 리나에게 말다툼에서 이기는 것보다 정직이 더 중요하다고 해요.

w|kejujuran.text: Siti memilih jasa angkut itu karena terkenal dengan kejujuran para pekerjanya.
w|kejujuran.en: Siti chose that moving company because it's known for the honesty of its workers.
w|kejujuran.ko: 시티는 직원들이 정직하기로 유명해서 그 이삿짐 업체를 골랐어요.

w|kejutan.en: There's a surprise for you later.
w|kejutan.ko: 나중에 너를 위한 깜짝 선물이 있어.

w|kekacauan.en: Chaos broke out after that news.
She cleaned up the mess in the kitchen.

w|kekaisaran.text: Fajar suka membaca novel sejarah tentang kekaisaran Romawi.
w|kekaisaran.en: Fajar likes reading historical novels about the Roman Empire.
w|kekaisaran.ko: 파자르는 로마 제국에 관한 역사 소설을 즐겨 읽어요.

w|kekaisaran.text: Guru menjelaskan bahwa mi berasal dari dapur kekaisaran Tiongkok zaman dulu.
w|kekaisaran.en: The teacher explained that noodles came from the imperial kitchens of ancient China.
w|kekaisaran.ko: 선생님은 국수가 옛 중국 황실 부엌에서 왔다고 설명했어요.

w|kekal.text: Kata mandor, tidak ada pekerjaan yang kekal, jadi Dimas rajin menabung.
w|kekal.en: The foreman says no job lasts forever, so Dimas saves diligently.
w|kekal.ko: 반장 말로는 영원한 일자리는 없대서 디마스는 꾸준히 저축해요.

w|kekal.text: Putri menulis bahwa persahabatan mereka terasa kekal walau jarang bertemu.
w|kekal.en: Putri writes that their friendship feels everlasting even though they rarely meet.
w|kekal.ko: 푸트리는 자주 못 만나도 둘의 우정은 영원한 것 같다고 썼어요.

w|kekalahan.text: Fajar menerima kekalahan di pengadilan dengan kepala tegak.
w|kekalahan.en: Fajar accepted the defeat in court with his head held high.

w|kekalahan.text: Para pembeli ramai membicarakan kekalahan tim sepak bola kampung semalam.
w|kekalahan.en: The customers are busy talking about the village football team's defeat last night.
w|kekalahan.ko: 손님들은 어젯밤 마을 축구팀이 진 이야기로 떠들썩해요.

w|kekanak-kanakan.text: Kakak Fajar tertawa melihat tingkah kekanak-kanakan sang pengantin pria saat foto bersama.
w|kekanak-kanakan.en: Fajar's sibling laughed at the groom's childish antics during the group photo.
w|kekanak-kanakan.ko: 파자르의 형은 단체 사진을 찍을 때 신랑의 철없는 행동을 보고 웃었어요.

w|kekanak-kanakan.text: Lestari tahu sikap kekanak-kanakan adiknya muncul setiap kali hujan membatalkan rencana bermain.
w|kekanak-kanakan.en: Lestari knows her sibling's childish side shows up whenever rain cancels plans to play.
w|kekanak-kanakan.ko: 레스타리는 비 때문에 놀 계획이 취소될 때마다 동생이 떼를 쓴다는 걸 알아요.

w|kekasih.en: His sweetheart is waiting in the park.
She wrote a letter for her lover.

w|kekayaan.text: Kekayaan sejati bukan hanya soal uang.
w|kekayaan.en: True wealth is not only about money.
She inherited wealth from her grandfather.

w|kekebalan.text: Vaksin rutin membantu menjaga kekebalan tubuh anak anjing.
w|kekebalan.en: Regular vaccines help maintain a puppy's immunity.
w|kekebalan.ko: 정기 백신은 강아지의 면역력을 지키는 데 도움이 돼요.

w|kekebalan.text: Siti percaya jahe dan madu bisa menambah kekebalan tubuh di musim hujan.
w|kekebalan.en: Siti believes ginger and honey can boost immunity in the rainy season.
w|kekebalan.ko: 시티는 생강과 꿀이 우기에 면역력을 높여 준다고 믿어요.

w|kekecewaan.text: Dimas menyembunyikan kekecewaan saat tahu gajinya baru cair bulan depan.
w|kekecewaan.en: Dimas hid his disappointment when he found out his salary wouldn't be paid until next month.
w|kekecewaan.ko: 월급이 다음 달에야 나온다는 걸 알고 디마스는 실망을 감췄어요.

w|kekecewaan.text: Putri tidak bisa menutupi kekecewaan saat penerbangannya dibatalkan.
w|kekecewaan.en: Putri couldn't hide her disappointment when her flight was cancelled.
w|kekecewaan.ko: 항공편이 취소되자 푸트리는 실망을 감추지 못했어요.

w|kekejaman.text: Agus membaca buku sejarah tentang kekejaman penjajahan di masa lalu.
w|kekejaman.en: Agus read a history book about the cruelty of colonial rule in the past.
w|kekejaman.ko: 아구스는 과거 식민 지배의 잔혹함에 관한 역사책을 읽었어요.

w|kekejaman.text: Wati menonton dokumenter tentang kekejaman perang di televisi ruang tunggu.
w|kekejaman.en: Wati watched a documentary about the cruelty of war on the waiting room TV.
w|kekejaman.ko: 와티는 대기실 텔레비전으로 전쟁의 참혹함을 다룬 다큐멘터리를 봤어요.

w|kekeliruan.text: Agus meminta maaf atas kekeliruan pada pesanan kue ulang tahun.
w|kekeliruan.en: Agus apologized for the mistake in the birthday cake order.
w|kekeliruan.ko: 아구스는 생일 케이크 주문이 잘못된 것을 사과했어요.

w|kekeliruan.text: Wati menemukan kekeliruan kecil di kode yang membuat aplikasi macet.
w|kekeliruan.en: Wati found a small error in the code that made the app freeze.
w|kekeliruan.ko: 와티는 앱을 멈추게 한 코드의 작은 실수를 찾아냈어요.

w|kekerasan.en: They reject all forms of violence.

w|kekeringan.text: Agus menggali sumur baru untuk menghadapi kekeringan.
w|kekeringan.en: Agus dug a new well to cope with the drought.
w|kekeringan.ko: 아구스는 가뭄에 대비해 새 우물을 팠어요.

w|kekeringan.text: Wati bertanya apakah kebun sahabatnya selamat dari kekeringan tahun ini.
w|kekeringan.en: Wati asked whether her friend's garden had survived this year's drought.
w|kekeringan.ko: 와티는 친구의 밭이 올해 가뭄을 잘 넘겼는지 물었어요.

w|kekhawatiran.text: Rudi membagi kekhawatiran tentang anaknya yang akan kuliah jauh dari rumah.
w|kekhawatiran.en: Rudi shared his worries about his child who will study far from home.
w|kekhawatiran.ko: 루디는 집에서 멀리 대학에 갈 아이에 대한 걱정을 털어놓았어요.

w|kekhawatiran.text: Rina mencatat setiap kekhawatiran pengguna dalam rapat mingguan.
w|kekhawatiran.en: Rina writes down every concern from users in the weekly meeting.
w|kekhawatiran.ko: 리나는 주간 회의에서 사용자들의 걱정을 하나하나 적어요.

w|kekosongan.text: Setelah teman-temannya pindah, Dimas merasakan kekosongan di akhir pekan.
w|kekosongan.en: After his friends moved away, Dimas felt an emptiness on weekends.
w|kekosongan.ko: 친구들이 이사 간 뒤로 디마스는 주말마다 허전함을 느꼈어요.

w|kekosongan.text: Setelah lemari tua dikeluarkan, Putri merasakan kekosongan di kamar kakeknya.
w|kekosongan.en: After the old wardrobe was taken out, Putri felt an emptiness in her grandfather's room.
w|kekosongan.ko: 낡은 옷장을 내가자 푸트리는 할아버지 방에서 허전함을 느꼈어요.

w|kekuasaan.en: He abused the power of his position.

w|kekurangan.en: A water shortage has become a big problem.

w|kelahiran.en: They celebrated the birth of a baby boy.
A premature birth needs special care.

w|kelainan.text: Rudi menemukan kelainan pada detak jantung kucing persia itu.
w|kelainan.en: Rudi found an irregularity in the Persian cat's heartbeat.
w|kelainan.ko: 루디는 페르시안 고양이의 심장 박동에서 이상을 발견했어요.

w|kelainan.text: Bidan desa memeriksa apakah bayi tetangga Rina punya kelainan jantung.
w|kelainan.en: The village midwife checked whether Rina's neighbor's baby had a heart defect.
w|kelainan.ko: 마을 산파는 리나네 이웃 아기에게 심장 이상이 있는지 살펴봤어요.

w|kelak.text: Budi berharap kelak anaknya mau meneruskan sawah keluarga.
w|kelak.en: Budi hopes that someday his child will want to carry on the family rice field.
w|kelak.ko: 부디는 나중에 자식이 집안 논을 이어 주기를 바라요.

w|kelak.text: Anak Siti bilang kelak dia juga ingin main film seperti ibunya.
w|kelak.en: Siti's child says that one day she also wants to act in films like her mother.
w|kelak.ko: 시티의 아이는 나중에 엄마처럼 영화에 나오고 싶다고 해요.

w|kelam.text: Lampu panggung dibuat redup untuk menggambarkan masa kelam dalam sejarah desa itu.
w|kelam.en: The stage lights were dimmed to portray a dark period in the village's history.
w|kelam.ko: 그 마을 역사의 어두운 시절을 나타내려고 무대 조명을 어둡게 했어요.

w|kelam.text: Langit tampak kelam ketika kereta memasuki daerah pegunungan.
w|kelam.en: The sky looked gloomy when the train entered the mountain area.
w|kelam.ko: 열차가 산간 지역에 들어서자 하늘이 어두워 보였어요.

w|kelamin.text: Dimas memeriksa jenis kelamin anak kucing sebelum pemiliknya memberi nama.
w|kelamin.en: Dimas checked the kittens' sex before their owner named them.
w|kelamin.ko: 디마스는 주인이 이름을 짓기 전에 새끼 고양이들의 성별을 확인했어요.

w|kelamin.text: Putri mencatat jenis kelamin setiap lalat buah di bawah mikroskop.
w|kelamin.en: Putri records the sex of each fruit fly under the microscope.
w|kelamin.ko: 푸트리는 현미경으로 초파리의 성별을 하나하나 기록해요.

w|kelangsungan.text: Pemimpin redaksi khawatir soal kelangsungan koran cetak di era digital.
w|kelangsungan.en: The editor-in-chief worries about the survival of print newspapers in the digital era.
w|kelangsungan.ko: 편집장은 디지털 시대에 종이 신문이 살아남을지 걱정해요.

w|kelangsungan.text: Menurut Intan, kelangsungan startup itu bergantung pada pendanaan tahap berikutnya.
w|kelangsungan.en: According to Intan, the startup's survival depends on the next round of funding.
w|kelangsungan.ko: 인탄은 스타트업이 살아남느냐는 다음 투자 유치에 달려 있다고 해요.

w|kelapa.text: Andi memarut kelapa untuk membuat santan segar.
w|kelapa.en: Andi grated coconut to make fresh coconut milk.
w|kelapa.ko: 안디는 신선한 코코넛 밀크를 만들려고 코코넛을 갈았어요.

w|kelapa.text: Rani bilang pohon kelapa di halaman rumah lamanya masih berdiri.
w|kelapa.en: Rani said the coconut tree in the yard of her old house is still standing.
w|kelapa.ko: 라니는 옛집 마당의 야자나무가 아직 서 있다고 했어요.

w|kelaparan.text: Kelaparan membuat penduduk desa sangat lemah.
w|kelaparan.en: Starvation made the villagers very weak.
w|kelaparan.ko: 기근이 마을 사람들을 아주 약하게 만들었어.

w|kelaparan.text: Mereka hampir kelaparan setelah tersesat di hutan.
w|kelaparan.en: They nearly starved after getting lost in the forest.
w|kelaparan.ko: 그들은 숲에서 길을 잃은 뒤 거의 굶주렸어.

w|kelebihan.text: Salah satu kelebihan apartemen Bayu adalah dekat dengan stasiun.
w|kelebihan.en: One of the advantages of Bayu's apartment is that it's close to the station.
w|kelebihan.ko: 바유네 아파트의 장점 하나는 역에서 가깝다는 거예요.

w|kelebihan.text: Menurut Intan, kelebihan kereta adalah bisa tidur sambil berjalan.
w|kelebihan.en: According to Intan, the advantage of the train is that you can sleep while traveling.
w|kelebihan.ko: 인탄 말로는 기차의 장점은 이동하면서 잘 수 있다는 거예요.

w|keledai.text: Kakek Dimas masih memelihara seekor keledai tua untuk mengangkut karung padi.
w|keledai.en: Dimas's grandfather still keeps an old donkey to carry sacks of rice.
w|keledai.ko: 디마스의 할아버지는 아직도 볏자루를 나르려고 늙은 당나귀 한 마리를 길러요.

w|keledai.text: Putri tertawa melihat video keledai yang tidak mau berjalan.
w|keledai.en: Putri laughed at a video of a donkey that refused to walk.
w|keledai.ko: 푸트리는 걷지 않으려고 버티는 당나귀 영상을 보고 웃었어요.

w|kelelahan.text: Dokter gigi itu tampak kelelahan setelah menangani dua puluh pasien.
w|kelelahan.en: The dentist looked exhausted after treating twenty patients.
w|kelelahan.ko: 그 치과 의사는 환자 스무 명을 본 뒤 지쳐 보였어요.

w|kelelahan.text: Wati tertidur di sofa karena kelelahan mengecat dinding seharian.
w|kelelahan.en: Wati fell asleep on the sofa, exhausted from painting walls all day.
w|kelelahan.ko: 와티는 하루 종일 벽을 칠하느라 지쳐서 소파에서 잠들었어요.

w|kelelawar.text: Saat senja, kelelawar keluar dan memakan buah jambu di pohon Dimas.
w|kelelawar.en: At dusk, bats come out and eat the guavas on Dimas's tree.
w|kelelawar.ko: 해 질 녘이면 박쥐가 나와서 디마스네 나무의 구아바를 먹어요.

w|kelelawar.text: Putri kaget ketika seekor kelelawar masuk ke teras.
w|kelelawar.en: Putri was startled when a bat flew onto the porch.
w|kelelawar.ko: 박쥐 한 마리가 테라스로 들어오자 푸트리는 깜짝 놀랐어요.

w|kelemahan.en: His biggest weakness is getting angry easily.
w|kelemahan.ko: 그의 가장 큰 약점은 쉽게 화내는 거야.

w|kelemahan.en: The opposing team exploited a defensive weakness.

w|kelenjar.text: Dokter curiga kelenjar tiroid pasien itu bermasalah, jadi Fajar menyiapkan obat sesuai resep.
w|kelenjar.en: The doctor suspected a thyroid gland problem, so Fajar prepared the medicine as prescribed.
w|kelenjar.ko: 의사가 그 환자의 갑상샘을 의심해서 파자르는 처방대로 약을 지었어요.

w|kelenjar.text: Rekan baru itu izin ke dokter karena kelenjar di leher bengkak.
w|kelenjar.en: The new coworker took leave to see a doctor because a gland in the neck was swollen.
w|kelenjar.ko: 새 동료는 목의 림프샘이 부어서 병원에 간다고 했어요.

w|kelewatan.text: Budi mengakui leluconnya waktu SMA memang kelewatan.
w|kelewatan.en: Budi admits his joke back in high school really went too far.
w|kelewatan.ko: 부디는 고등학교 때 자기 농담이 정말 지나쳤다고 인정해요.

w|kelewatan.text: Siti menganggap harga pendaftaran tahun ini sudah kelewatan mahal.
w|kelewatan.en: Siti thinks this year's registration fee is way too expensive.
w|kelewatan.ko: 시티는 올해 참가비가 너무 지나치게 비싸다고 생각해요.

w|kelihatan.en: The house is already in sight.

w|kelima.text: Ini sudah tahun kelima Budi menanam padi di sawah warisan ayahnya.
w|kelima.en: This is already Budi's fifth year growing rice in the field he inherited from his father.
w|kelima.ko: 부디가 아버지께 물려받은 논에 벼를 심은 지 벌써 다섯 해째예요.

w|kelima.text: Sutradara meminta adegan itu diulang sampai kali kelima.
w|kelima.en: The director had the scene repeated up to the fifth time.
w|kelima.ko: 감독은 그 장면을 다섯 번째까지 다시 찍게 했어요.

w|kelinci.text: Kelinci kecil itu melompat di rumput.
w|kelinci.en: That little rabbit hopped on the grass.
w|kelinci.ko: 그 작은 토끼가 잔디 위에서 뛰었어.

w|kelinci.en: My child keeps a white rabbit.
w|kelinci.ko: 우리 아이가 흰 토끼 한 마리를 키워.

w|keliru.text: Jawaban itu keliru menurut kunci soal.
w|keliru.en: That answer is wrong according to the answer key.

w|keliru.text: Keliru alamat membuat paket kembali ke pengirim.
w|keliru.en: The wrong address made the package return to the sender.

w|kelopak.text: Angin kencang merontokkan kelopak bunga labu di kebun Budi.
w|kelopak.en: The strong wind knocked the petals off the pumpkin flowers in Budi's garden.
w|kelopak.ko: 거센 바람에 부디네 밭의 호박꽃 꽃잎이 떨어졌어요.

w|kelopak.text: Siti menghias kue dengan kelopak bunga mawar yang bisa dimakan.
w|kelopak.en: Siti decorated the cake with edible rose petals.
w|kelopak.ko: 시티는 먹을 수 있는 장미 꽃잎으로 케이크를 장식했어요.

w|keluar.en: Don't go out in the middle of the night.

w|keluarga.text: Setiap akhir pekan Rina pulang kampung untuk menengok keluarga.
w|keluarga.en: Every weekend Rina goes back to her hometown to visit her family.
w|keluarga.ko: 리나는 주말마다 가족을 보러 고향에 내려가요.

w|keluarga.text: Saat libur sekolah, banyak keluarga menginap di hotel tempat Dewi bekerja.
w|keluarga.en: During school holidays, many families stay at the hotel where Dewi works.
w|keluarga.ko: 방학 때면 많은 가족이 데위가 일하는 호텔에 묵어요.

w|keluhan.text: Kotak saran perpustakaan penuh keluhan soal wifi yang lambat.
w|keluhan.en: The library's suggestion box is full of complaints about slow wifi.
w|keluhan.ko: 도서관 건의함은 와이파이가 느리다는 불만으로 가득해요.

w|keluhan.text: Kondektur mencatat keluhan Putri soal toilet yang rusak.
w|keluhan.en: The conductor noted Putri's complaint about the broken toilet.
w|keluhan.ko: 차장은 화장실이 고장 났다는 푸트리의 불만을 적어 갔어요.

w|kelulusan.text: Untuk merayakan kelulusan adiknya, Fajar memasak rendang setelah restoran tutup.
w|kelulusan.en: To celebrate his younger sibling's graduation, Fajar cooked rendang after the restaurant closed.
w|kelulusan.ko: 동생 졸업을 축하하려고 파자르는 식당이 문을 닫은 뒤 른당을 만들었어요.

w|kelulusan.text: Lestari menemukan album foto kelulusan sebuah SMA dari zaman dulu.
w|kelulusan.en: Lestari found an old high school graduation photo album.
w|kelulusan.ko: 레스타리는 옛날 어느 고등학교의 졸업 앨범을 찾았어요.

w|kemacetan.text: Rudi menyarankan tamu berangkat lebih awal karena kemacetan menuju bandara.
w|kemacetan.en: Rudi advised the guests to leave early because of the traffic jams on the way to the airport.
w|kemacetan.ko: 루디는 공항 가는 길이 막히니 일찍 출발하라고 손님에게 권했어요.

w|kemacetan.text: Banjir di awal musim hujan menimbulkan kemacetan panjang di jalan utama.
w|kemacetan.en: Flooding at the start of the rainy season caused long traffic jams on the main road.
w|kemacetan.ko: 우기 초입의 홍수로 큰길에 긴 정체가 생겼어요.

w|kemajuan.en: Technological progress changes how we work.
The teacher sees her student's progress.

w|kemakmuran.text: Rudi percaya keamanan adalah syarat utama bagi kemakmuran sebuah kota.
w|kemakmuran.en: Rudi believes security is the main condition for a city's prosperity.
w|kemakmuran.ko: 루디는 치안이 도시 번영의 가장 중요한 조건이라고 믿어요.

w|kemakmuran.text: Pemerintah kota berharap maraton ini membawa kemakmuran bagi pedagang kecil di sepanjang rute.
w|kemakmuran.en: The city government hopes this marathon brings prosperity to small vendors along the route.
w|kemakmuran.ko: 시청은 이 마라톤이 코스를 따라 있는 작은 상인들에게 번영을 가져다주길 바라요.

w|kemalangan.text: Budi turut berduka atas kemalangan yang menimpa keluarga Rudi.
w|kemalangan.en: Budi offered his condolences for the misfortune that befell Rudi's family.
w|kemalangan.ko: 부디는 루디 가족에게 닥친 불행에 깊은 위로를 전했어요.

w|kemalangan.text: Seluruh tetangga datang membantu saat kemalangan menimpa keluarga Bu Ani.
w|kemalangan.en: All the neighbors came to help when misfortune struck Mrs. Ani's family.
w|kemalangan.ko: 아니 아주머니 가족에게 불행이 닥치자 온 이웃이 도우러 왔어요.

w|kemanusiaan.text: Perpustakaan mengadakan pameran foto tentang bantuan kemanusiaan di daerah bencana.
w|kemanusiaan.en: The library is holding a photo exhibition about humanitarian aid in disaster areas.
w|kemanusiaan.ko: 도서관이 재난 지역 인도적 지원을 다룬 사진전을 열어요.

w|kemanusiaan.text: Relawan kemanusiaan naik kereta yang sama dengan Putri menuju daerah banjir.
w|kemanusiaan.en: Humanitarian volunteers took the same train as Putri to the flooded area.
w|kemanusiaan.ko: 인도주의 자원봉사자들이 푸트리와 같은 기차를 타고 홍수 지역으로 갔어요.

w|kemarahan.en: The anger on his face was hard to hide.
He tried to hold back his anger.

w|kemari.en: Come here, I want to talk.

w|kemauan.text: Rina sebenarnya punya kemauan untuk minta maaf, tapi gengsinya terlalu besar.
w|kemauan.en: Rina actually had the will to apologize, but her pride was too big.
w|kemauan.ko: 리나는 사실 사과할 마음이 있었지만 자존심이 너무 셌어요.

w|kemauan.text: Pindah rumah butuh tenaga dan kemauan yang kuat, kata Siti sambil tertawa.
w|kemauan.en: Moving house takes energy and strong will, Siti said with a laugh.
w|kemauan.ko: 이사는 체력과 강한 의지가 필요하다고 시티가 웃으며 말했어요.

w|kembali.en: I just got back from the market.

w|kembang.text: Di kebun belakang, kembang labu sudah mulai mekar.
w|kembang.en: In the back garden, the pumpkin flowers have started to bloom.

w|kembang.text: Penjual bunga itu juga menawarkan kembang sedap malam.

w|kembar.text: Mereka adalah saudara kembar yang mirip.
w|kembar.en: They are twin siblings who look alike.

w|kembar.text: Kembar itu memakai baju yang sama.
w|kembar.en: Those twins are wearing the same clothes.
w|kembar.ko: 그 쌍둥이가 같은 옷을 입고 있어.

w|kembaran.text: Andi sering salah menyapa karena tetangganya punya kembaran yang mirip sekali.
w|kembaran.en: Andi often greets the wrong person because his neighbor has a twin who looks exactly alike.
w|kembaran.ko: 이웃에게 꼭 닮은 쌍둥이가 있어서 안디는 자주 사람을 착각해 인사해요.

w|kembaran.text: Dewi membawa kembaran laki-lakinya ke museum untuk melihat pameran robot.
w|kembaran.en: Dewi took her twin brother to the museum to see the robot exhibition.
w|kembaran.ko: 데위는 로봇 전시를 보러 쌍둥이 남동생을 데리고 박물관에 갔어요.

w|kemeja.text: Fajar mengembalikan kemeja biru karena kancingnya ada yang lepas.
w|kemeja.en: Fajar returned the blue shirt because one of its buttons had come off.
w|kemeja.ko: 파자르는 단추 하나가 떨어져서 파란 셔츠를 반품했어요.

w|kemeja.text: Lestari menggulung lengan kemeja supaya tidak kena tepung.
w|kemeja.en: Lestari rolled up her shirt sleeves so they wouldn't get floury.
w|kemeja.ko: 레스타리는 밀가루가 묻지 않게 셔츠 소매를 걷었어요.

w|kemenangan.en: The team earned a narrow victory.

w|kementerian.text: Perpustakaan itu mendapat sumbangan buku dari kementerian pendidikan, kata pustakawan kepada Andi.
w|kementerian.en: The library received a book donation from the ministry of education, the librarian told Andi.
w|kementerian.ko: 도서관이 교육부에서 책을 기증받았다고 사서가 안디에게 말했어요.

w|kementerian.text: Dewi pindah ke Jakarta karena suaminya dipindahtugaskan ke kementerian.
w|kementerian.en: Dewi moved to Jakarta because her husband was transferred to the ministry.
w|kementerian.ko: 남편이 부처로 발령이 나서 데위는 자카르타로 이사했어요.

w|kemerdekaan.text: Andi membaca puisi tentang perjuangan kemerdekaan di upacara sekolah.
w|kemerdekaan.en: Andi read a poem about the struggle for independence at the school ceremony.
w|kemerdekaan.ko: 안디는 학교 행사에서 독립 투쟁에 관한 시를 낭송했어요.

w|kemerdekaan.text: Dewi memakai lagi bendera merah putih dari perayaan kemerdekaan bulan Agustus.
w|kemerdekaan.en: Dewi reused the red-and-white flags from the August independence celebration.
w|kemerdekaan.ko: 데위는 팔월 독립 기념 행사 때 쓴 빨강·하양 깃발을 다시 썼어요.

w|kemewahan.text: Bagi Agus, kemewahan sejati adalah menemukan buku langka dengan harga murah.
w|kemewahan.en: For Agus, true luxury is finding a rare book at a low price.
w|kemewahan.ko: 아구스에게 진짜 사치는 희귀한 책을 싼값에 찾는 거예요.

w|kemewahan.text: Bagi Wati, kemewahan kecil di musim hujan adalah secangkir cokelat panas di bawah selimut.
w|kemewahan.en: For Wati, a small luxury in the rainy season is a cup of hot chocolate under a blanket.
w|kemewahan.ko: 와티에게 우기의 작은 사치는 이불 속에서 마시는 핫초코 한 잔이에요.

w|kemiripan.text: Agus melihat kemiripan antara batu di sungai dan batu di puncak.
w|kemiripan.en: Agus noticed a resemblance between the stones in the river and the stones on the summit.
w|kemiripan.ko: 아구스는 강가의 돌과 산꼭대기 돌이 닮았다는 걸 알아챘어요.

w|kemiripan.text: Wati menulis bahwa cucunya punya kemiripan wajah dengan sahabat mereka waktu kecil.
w|kemiripan.en: Wati wrote that her grandchild's face resembles their friend as a child.
w|kemiripan.ko: 와티는 손주 얼굴이 어릴 적 친구와 닮았다고 적었어요.

w|kemiskinan.text: Kelas Budi menggalang dana untuk keluarga yang hidup dalam kemiskinan.
w|kemiskinan.en: Budi's class raised money for families living in poverty.
w|kemiskinan.ko: 부디네 반은 가난하게 사는 가정들을 위해 모금했어요.

w|kemiskinan.text: Siti bekerja di lembaga yang membantu warga keluar dari kemiskinan.
w|kemiskinan.en: Siti works at an organization that helps people get out of poverty.
w|kemiskinan.ko: 시티는 사람들이 가난에서 벗어나도록 돕는 기관에서 일해요.

w|kemitraan.text: Restoran tempat Rudi bekerja menjalin kemitraan dengan petani sayur organik.
w|kemitraan.en: The restaurant where Rudi works has formed a partnership with organic vegetable farmers.
w|kemitraan.ko: 루디가 일하는 식당은 유기농 채소 농가와 협력 관계를 맺었어요.

w|kemitraan.text: Rina menawarkan kemitraan kepada teman yang pandai memperbaiki jam.
w|kemitraan.en: Rina offered a partnership to a friend who is good at fixing clocks.
w|kemitraan.ko: 리나는 시계를 잘 고치는 친구에게 동업을 제안했어요.

w|kemuliaan.text: Andi membaca kisah raja yang mencari kemuliaan lewat perang.
w|kemuliaan.en: Andi read the story of a king who sought glory through war.
w|kemuliaan.ko: 안디는 전쟁으로 영광을 좇던 왕의 이야기를 읽었어요.

w|kemuliaan.text: Pendeta di gereja Dewi berbicara tentang kemuliaan hidup sederhana.
w|kemuliaan.en: The pastor at Dewi's church spoke about the dignity of a simple life.
w|kemuliaan.ko: 데위가 다니는 교회 목사님은 소박한 삶의 고귀함에 대해 말씀하셨어요.

w|kemunduran.text: Agus khawatir jumlah wisatawan mengalami kemunduran karena jalan rusak.
w|kemunduran.en: Agus worries that the number of tourists will decline because of the damaged road.
w|kemunduran.ko: 아구스는 길이 망가져서 관광객 수가 줄어들까 봐 걱정해요.

w|kemunduran.text: Wati bercerita tentang kemunduran kesehatan ayahnya dengan nada tenang.
w|kemunduran.en: Wati wrote calmly about her father's declining health.
w|kemunduran.ko: 와티는 아버지의 건강이 나빠진 이야기를 담담하게 적었어요.

w|kemurahan.text: Andi berterima kasih atas kemurahan hati tetangga yang meminjamkan mobil.
w|kemurahan.en: Andi thanked his neighbor for the generosity of lending him a car.
w|kemurahan.ko: 안디는 차를 빌려준 이웃의 너그러움에 감사했어요.

w|kemurahan.text: Museum itu berdiri berkat kemurahan seorang saudagar kaya, kata papan yang dibaca Dewi.
w|kemurahan.en: The museum exists thanks to the generosity of a rich merchant, said the sign Dewi read.
w|kemurahan.ko: 데위가 읽은 안내판에는 그 박물관이 한 부유한 상인의 후원 덕분에 세워졌다고 적혀 있었어요.

w|kena.text: Dimas lebih suka bertani di daratan yang jauh dari sungai karena tidak kena banjir.
w|kena.en: Dimas prefers farming on land far from the river because it doesn't flood.
w|kena.ko: 디마스는 강에서 먼 땅에서 농사짓는 걸 더 좋아해요. 홍수가 안 나거든요.

w|kena.text: Sepatu Putri kena lumpur di jalan menuju halte.
w|kena.en: Putri's shoes got muddy on the way to the bus stop.
w|kena.ko: 정류장 가는 길에 푸트리의 신발에 진흙이 묻었어요.

w|kenangan.en: That photo holds a beautiful memory.
w|kenangan.ko: 그 사진에 아름다운 추억이 담겨 있어.

w|kenari.text: Bayu memungut buah kenari yang jatuh di jalan setapak hutan.
w|kenari.en: Bayu picked up the kenari nuts that had fallen on the forest path.
w|kenari.ko: 바유는 숲길에 떨어진 카나리 열매를 주웠어요.

w|kenari.text: Di sepanjang rute, deretan pohon kenari memberi keteduhan bagi Intan.
w|kenari.en: Along the route, rows of kenari trees gave Intan some shade.
w|kenari.ko: 코스를 따라 늘어선 카나리 나무가 인탄에게 그늘을 만들어 주었어요.

w|kencang.text: Angin kencang menjatuhkan spanduk besar di depan balai kota.
w|kencang.en: A strong wind knocked down the big banner in front of city hall.
w|kencang.ko: 센 바람에 시청 앞 큰 현수막이 떨어졌어요.

w|kencang.text: Drummer di kelas sebelah memukul drum dengan kencang sekali.
w|kencang.en: The drummer in the next classroom hits the drums really hard.
w|kencang.ko: 옆 반 드러머는 드럼을 엄청 세게 쳐요.

w|kencing.text: Kucing itu sering kencing di luar pasir, jadi Dimas memeriksa kandung kemihnya.
w|kencing.en: The cat often pees outside the litter, so Dimas examined its bladder.
w|kencing.ko: 고양이가 자주 모래 밖에 소변을 봐서 디마스가 방광을 검사했어요.

w|kencing.text: Dalam penelitian itu, tikus yang sering kencing diperiksa kadar gulanya.
w|kencing.en: In that study, mice that urinated often had their sugar levels checked.
w|kencing.ko: 그 연구에서는 소변을 자주 보는 쥐의 혈당을 검사했어요.

w|kendala.text: Dimas bilang kendala terbesar museum adalah biaya perawatan.
w|kendala.en: Dimas says the museum's biggest obstacle is maintenance costs.
w|kendala.ko: 디마스는 박물관의 가장 큰 어려움이 관리 비용이라고 해요.

w|kendala.text: Putri bilang kendala utama hari ini adalah mesin kasir yang macet.
w|kendala.en: Putri says today's main problem is the jammed cash register.
w|kendala.ko: 푸트리는 오늘 가장 큰 문제가 고장 난 계산기라고 해요.

w|kendali.en: He lost control of the car.
Full control is in your hands.

w|kendaraan.text: Kendaraan itu berhenti di lampu merah.
w|kendaraan.en: That vehicle stopped at the red light.

w|kendaraan.text: Parkirkan kendaraan di tempat yang aman.
w|kendaraan.en: Park the vehicle in a safe place.

w|kengerian.text: Budi menggambarkan kengerian malam ketika gempa mengguncang kota.
w|kengerian.en: Budi described the horror of the night the earthquake shook the city.
w|kengerian.ko: 부디는 지진이 도시를 뒤흔든 그날 밤의 공포를 묘사했어요.

w|kengerian.text: Siti tidak bisa melupakan kengerian malam ketika rumah di ujung gang terbakar.
w|kengerian.en: Siti can't forget the horror of the night the house at the end of the alley burned.
w|kengerian.ko: 시티는 골목 끝 집에 불이 났던 밤의 끔찍함을 잊을 수 없어요.

w|kenikmatan.text: Rudi tidak bisa merasakan kenikmatan makan malam karena kakaknya duduk berjauhan.
w|kenikmatan.en: Rudi couldn't enjoy dinner because his sister sat far away from him.
w|kenikmatan.ko: 누나가 멀리 떨어져 앉아서 루디는 저녁을 즐겁게 먹을 수 없었어요.

w|kenikmatan.text: Rina menikmati kenikmatan es kelapa muda di bawah pohon rindang.
w|kenikmatan.en: Rina savored the pleasure of iced young coconut under a shady tree.
w|kenikmatan.ko: 리나는 그늘진 나무 아래서 시원한 어린 코코넛 음료를 즐겼어요.

w|kentang.text: Ibu memasak kentang untuk makan malam.

w|kenyamanan.text: Pembaca mengeluhkan kenyamanan halte baru yang tidak punya atap.
w|kenyamanan.en: Readers complained about the comfort of the new bus stop, which has no roof.
w|kenyamanan.ko: 독자들은 지붕 없는 새 정류장이 불편하다고 불평했어요.

w|kenyamanan.text: Intan membeli kursi kerja baru demi kenyamanan para programmer.
w|kenyamanan.en: Intan bought new office chairs for the programmers' comfort.
w|kenyamanan.ko: 인탄은 프로그래머들이 편하도록 새 사무용 의자를 샀어요.

w|kenyang.text: Setelah mencicipi semua masakan teman sekelas, Andi sudah terlalu kenyang untuk makan siang.
w|kenyang.en: After tasting all his classmates' dishes, Andi was too full for lunch.
w|kenyang.ko: 반 친구들 요리를 다 맛본 뒤 안디는 너무 배불러서 점심을 못 먹었어요.

w|kenyang.text: Dewi ingat mereka pernah makan nasi goreng sampai terlalu kenyang untuk berjalan pulang.
w|kenyang.en: Dewi remembers once eating fried rice until they were too full to walk home.
w|kenyang.ko: 데위는 둘이 볶음밥을 너무 먹어서 집에 걸어갈 수 없을 만큼 배불렀던 걸 기억해요.

w|kepahlawanan.text: Fajar menyiapkan pameran tentang kisah kepahlawanan warga kota pada masa lalu.
w|kepahlawanan.en: Fajar is preparing an exhibition about stories of heroism by the city's residents in the past.
w|kepahlawanan.ko: 파자르는 옛 시민들의 영웅적인 이야기를 다룬 전시를 준비하고 있어요.

w|kepahlawanan.text: Lestari memuji kepahlawanan satpam yang menolong anak terjebak di lift.
w|kepahlawanan.en: Lestari praised the heroism of the guard who helped a child trapped in the elevator.
w|kepahlawanan.ko: 레스타리는 엘리베이터에 갇힌 아이를 구한 경비원의 용기를 칭찬했어요.

w|kepalan.text: Sebelum mengambil darah, Budi meminta pasien membuat kepalan tangan.
w|kepalan.en: Before drawing blood, Budi asked the patient to make a fist.
w|kepalan.ko: 피를 뽑기 전에 부디는 환자에게 주먹을 쥐어 달라고 했어요.

w|kepalan.text: Siti mengetuk pintu kantor imigrasi pelan-pelan dengan kepalan tangan.
w|kepalan.en: Siti knocked gently on the immigration office door with her fist.
w|kepalan.ko: 시티는 주먹으로 출입국 사무실 문을 살살 두드렸어요.

w|kepanasan.text: Rudi menyuruh pemilik membawa anjing yang kepanasan itu ke ruangan ber-AC.
w|kepanasan.en: Rudi told the owner to bring the overheated dog into the air-conditioned room.
w|kepanasan.ko: 루디는 더위 먹은 개를 에어컨 있는 방으로 데려오라고 주인에게 말했어요.

w|kepanasan.text: Turis dari kota tampak kepanasan meski udara di desa Rina sejuk.
w|kepanasan.en: The tourists from the city looked overheated even though the air in Rina's village was cool.
w|kepanasan.ko: 리나네 마을 공기가 서늘한데도 도시에서 온 관광객들은 더워 보였어요.

w|kepanikan.text: Dimas sempat dilanda kepanikan saat kartu aksesnya tidak bisa dipakai.
w|kepanikan.en: Dimas briefly panicked when his access card didn't work.
w|kepanikan.ko: 출입 카드가 안 돼서 디마스는 잠깐 당황했어요.

w|kepanikan.text: Terjadi kepanikan kecil ketika paspor Putri tidak ada di tasnya.
w|kepanikan.en: There was a small panic when Putri's passport wasn't in her bag.
w|kepanikan.ko: 푸트리의 여권이 가방에 없자 작은 소동이 일어났어요.

w|kepastian.text: Para pedagang kaki lima menuntut kepastian soal tempat berjualan, dan Fajar berjanji menjawab minggu depan.
w|kepastian.en: The street vendors demanded certainty about where they could sell, and Fajar promised to answer next week.
w|kepastian.ko: 노점상들이 장사할 자리를 확실히 해 달라고 하자 파자르는 다음 주에 답하겠다고 약속했어요.

w|kepastian.text: Lestari belum punya kepastian kapan bisa mengunjungi sahabatnya.
w|kepastian.en: Lestari isn't sure yet when she can visit her friend.
w|kepastian.ko: 레스타리는 언제 친구를 찾아갈 수 있을지 아직 확실하지 않아요.

w|kepemilikan.text: Andi menulis nama di bukunya supaya kepemilikan buku itu jelas.
w|kepemilikan.en: Andi wrote his name in his book so it was clear who owned it.
w|kepemilikan.ko: 안디는 책 주인이 누군지 알 수 있게 책에 이름을 썼어요.

w|kepemilikan.text: Surat kepemilikan rumah keluarga Dewi disimpan Ayah di lemari besi.
w|kepemilikan.en: Dad keeps the ownership papers for Dewi's family house in the safe.
w|kepemilikan.ko: 아빠는 데위네 집 소유 증서를 금고에 보관해요.

w|kepemimpinan.text: Di bawah kepemimpinan manajer baru, pabrik jadi lebih rapi.
w|kepemimpinan.en: Under the new manager's leadership, the factory became tidier.
w|kepemimpinan.ko: 새 관리자의 지휘 아래 공장이 더 깔끔해졌어요.

w|kepemimpinan.text: Sari dulu ketua OSIS, dan Putri selalu kagum pada jiwa kepemimpinan sahabatnya itu.
w|kepemimpinan.en: Sari used to be student council president, and Putri always admired her friend's leadership.
w|kepemimpinan.ko: 사리는 학생회장이었고 푸트리는 친구의 리더십에 늘 감탄했어요.

w|kepentingan.en: Shared interests must be put first.

w|kepentingan.text: Dia mengabaikan kepentingan pribadi demi tim.
w|kepentingan.en: He set aside personal interests for the team.
w|kepentingan.ko: 그는 팀을 위해 개인 이익을 내려놓았어.

w|keperawanan.text: Dalam kuliah etika, Budi belajar bahwa tes keperawanan tidak punya dasar medis.
w|keperawanan.en: In an ethics lecture, Budi learned that virginity tests have no medical basis.
w|keperawanan.ko: 윤리 강의에서 부디는 처녀성 검사에 의학적 근거가 없다는 것을 배웠어요.

w|keperawanan.text: Buku yang dibaca Siti di ruang tunggu membahas sejarah mitos keperawanan dalam berbagai budaya.
w|keperawanan.en: The book Siti read in the lounge discusses the history of virginity myths across cultures.
w|keperawanan.ko: 시티가 대합실에서 읽은 책은 여러 문화 속 처녀성 신화의 역사를 다뤄요.

w|kepercayaan.text: Kepercayaan di antara mereka sudah rusak.
w|kepercayaan.en: The trust between them is already broken.

w|kepergian.text: Ibu Dimas menangis sedikit saat melepas kepergian anaknya di peron.
w|kepergian.en: Dimas's mother cried a little as she saw her son off on the platform.
w|kepergian.ko: 디마스의 엄마는 승강장에서 아들을 떠나보내며 조금 울었어요.

w|kepergian.text: Setelah kepergian programmer senior ke perusahaan lain, Putri harus cepat merekrut pengganti.
w|kepergian.en: After a senior programmer left for another company, Putri had to hire a replacement quickly.
w|kepergian.ko: 시니어 개발자가 다른 회사로 떠나서 푸트리는 빨리 후임을 뽑아야 했어요.

w|keperluan.text: Bayu membawa tas berisi keperluan mandi setiap kali ke gym.
w|keperluan.en: Bayu brings a bag with toiletries every time he goes to the gym.
w|keperluan.ko: 바유는 헬스장에 갈 때마다 세면도구를 넣은 가방을 챙겨요.

w|keperluan.text: Intan membawa tas berisi keperluan bayi ke restoran.
w|keperluan.en: Intan brings a bag of baby supplies to the restaurant.
w|keperluan.ko: 인탄은 식당에 아기 용품을 담은 가방을 가져와요.

w|keping.text: Rekan kerja Dimas menyodorkan beberapa keping biskuit sebagai ucapan selamat datang.
w|keping.en: Dimas's coworker held out a few biscuits as a welcome.
w|keping.ko: 디마스의 동료가 환영 인사로 비스킷 몇 조각을 내밀었어요.

w|keping.text: Putri menemukan beberapa keping uang logam asing di saku jaketnya.
w|keping.en: Putri found a few foreign coins in her jacket pocket.
w|keping.ko: 푸트리는 재킷 주머니에서 외국 동전 몇 개를 찾았어요.

w|kepingan.text: Rudi mengumpulkan kepingan kaca dari lantai dengan sarung tangan karet.
w|kepingan.en: Rudi gathered the pieces of glass from the floor with rubber gloves.
w|kepingan.ko: 루디는 고무장갑을 끼고 바닥의 유리 조각을 모았어요.

w|kepingan.text: Medali lomba itu berupa kepingan logam yang diukir dengan gambar jembatan kota.
w|kepingan.en: The race medal is a piece of metal engraved with a picture of the city's bridge.
w|kepingan.ko: 그 대회 메달은 도시의 다리 그림이 새겨진 금속 조각이에요.

w|kepiting.text: Peserta kelas diajari cara membersihkan kepiting tanpa terjepit capitnya.
w|kepiting.en: The class was taught how to clean a crab without getting pinched by its claws.
w|kepiting.ko: 참가자들은 집게에 물리지 않고 게를 손질하는 법을 배웠어요.

w|kepiting.text: Dewi masih ingat makan kepiting saus padang bersama Rani di pantai.
w|kepiting.en: Dewi still remembers eating chili crab with Rani at the beach.
w|kepiting.ko: 데위는 라니와 해변에서 파당 소스 게를 먹던 걸 아직 기억해요.

w|kepolisian.en: The police force is investigating that case.
The report was sent to the local police.

w|keponakan.text: Keponakan saya datang berkunjung hari ini.
w|keponakan.en: My niece came to visit today.
He brought a gift for his nephew.

w|kepribadian.text: Andi suka kepribadian Rina yang ramah dan tenang.
w|kepribadian.en: Andi likes Rina's friendly and calm personality.
w|kepribadian.ko: 안디는 리나의 친절하고 차분한 성격이 좋아요.

w|kepribadian.text: Manajer hotel bilang kepribadian Dewi cocok untuk bagian resepsionis.
w|kepribadian.en: The hotel manager said Dewi's personality suits the reception desk.
w|kepribadian.ko: 호텔 매니저는 데위의 성격이 프런트 업무에 잘 맞는다고 했어요.

w|kepuasan.text: Rudi merasakan kepuasan kecil saat kakaknya akhirnya mau mendengarkan penjelasannya.
w|kepuasan.en: Rudi felt a small satisfaction when his sister finally agreed to hear his explanation.
w|kepuasan.ko: 루디는 누나가 마침내 설명을 들어 주자 작은 뿌듯함을 느꼈어요.

w|kepuasan.text: Rina tersenyum penuh kepuasan setelah berhasil berdiri di atas papan selancar.
w|kepuasan.en: Rina smiled with satisfaction after managing to stand up on the surfboard.
w|kepuasan.ko: 리나는 서핑보드 위에 서는 데 성공하고 만족스럽게 웃었어요.

w|kepulauan.text: Dari puncak gunung, Agus bisa melihat kepulauan kecil di kejauhan saat cuaca cerah.
w|kepulauan.en: From the mountaintop, Agus can see a small archipelago in the distance on clear days.
w|kepulauan.ko: 날씨가 맑으면 아구스는 산꼭대기에서 멀리 있는 작은 섬들을 볼 수 있어요.

w|kepulauan.text: Wati bermimpi berlibur bersama sahabatnya ke kepulauan di timur.
w|kepulauan.en: Wati dreams of a holiday with her friend to the islands in the east.
w|kepulauan.ko: 와티는 친구와 함께 동쪽 섬들로 여행 가는 꿈을 꿔요.

w|kepunahan.text: Budi pernah membaca bahwa banyak jenis lebah liar terancam kepunahan.
w|kepunahan.en: Budi once read that many kinds of wild bees are threatened with extinction.
w|kepunahan.ko: 부디는 많은 종류의 야생벌이 멸종 위기에 있다는 글을 읽은 적이 있어요.

w|kepunahan.text: Siti menolak memasak sirip hiu karena ikan itu terancam kepunahan.
w|kepunahan.en: Siti refuses to cook shark fin because the fish is threatened with extinction.
w|kepunahan.ko: 시티는 상어가 멸종 위기라서 상어 지느러미 요리를 거절해요.

w|kepunyaan.text: Perahu biru di ujung dermaga itu kepunyaan kakek Eko.
w|kepunyaan.en: The blue boat at the end of the pier belongs to Eko's grandfather.
w|kepunyaan.ko: 부두 끝의 파란 배는 에코 할아버지의 것이에요.

w|kepunyaan.text: Perawat bertanya apakah payung di kursi itu kepunyaan Ayu.
w|kepunyaan.en: The nurse asked whether the umbrella on the chair belonged to Ayu.
w|kepunyaan.ko: 간호사는 의자 위 우산이 아유 것인지 물었어요.

w|keputusan.en: The final decision has been made.

w|keputusasaan.text: Budi tidak menyembunyikan keputusasaan saat usaha pertama bangkrut.
w|keputusasaan.en: Budi didn't hide his despair when his first business went bankrupt.
w|keputusasaan.ko: 부디는 첫 사업이 망했을 때의 절망을 숨기지 않았어요.

w|keputusasaan.text: Siti melihat keputusasaan di wajah tetangga yang kehilangan pekerjaan.
w|keputusasaan.en: Siti saw despair on the face of the neighbor who had lost his job.
w|keputusasaan.ko: 시티는 일자리를 잃은 이웃의 얼굴에서 절망을 봤어요.

w|kera.text: Seekor kera dari hutan sering mencuri pisang di kebun Dimas.
w|kera.en: A monkey from the forest often steals bananas from Dimas's garden.
w|kera.ko: 숲에서 온 원숭이 한 마리가 디마스네 밭에서 자주 바나나를 훔쳐 가요.

w|kera.text: Adik Putri bercerita tentang kera yang dia lihat di kebun binatang.
w|kera.en: Putri's little sister talked about the monkey she saw at the zoo.
w|kera.ko: 푸트리의 동생은 동물원에서 본 원숭이 이야기를 했어요.

w|keracunan.text: Anjing Bu Sari dibawa ke klinik karena keracunan cokelat.
w|keracunan.en: Mrs. Sari's dog was brought to the clinic because of chocolate poisoning.
w|keracunan.ko: 사리 씨의 개는 초콜릿 중독으로 병원에 실려 왔어요.

w|keracunan.text: Beberapa warga keracunan jamur liar, jadi Siti melarang anaknya memetik jamur sembarangan.
w|keracunan.en: Several villagers were poisoned by wild mushrooms, so Siti forbade her child from picking mushrooms carelessly.
w|keracunan.ko: 주민 몇 명이 야생 버섯에 중독돼서 시티는 아이에게 아무 버섯이나 따지 말라고 했어요.

w|keraguan.en: That doubt held back his important decision.

w|keraguan.text: Dia menghilangkan keraguan dengan bukti kuat.
w|keraguan.en: She cleared the doubt with strong evidence.

w|kerahasiaan.text: Bayu selalu menjaga kerahasiaan narasumber yang tidak mau disebut namanya.
w|kerahasiaan.en: Bayu always protects the confidentiality of sources who don't want to be named.
w|kerahasiaan.ko: 바유는 이름을 밝히기 싫어하는 취재원의 비밀을 늘 지켜요.

w|kerahasiaan.text: Nenek Intan menjaga kerahasiaan resep jamu keluarga dengan sangat ketat.
w|kerahasiaan.en: Intan's grandmother keeps the family herbal tonic recipe strictly secret.
w|kerahasiaan.ko: 인탄의 할머니는 집안 약초 음료 비법을 아주 철저히 비밀로 해요.

w|kerajaan.en: He was born in a small kingdom.

w|kerajinan.text: Di pelajaran seni, Budi membuat kerajinan dari bambu dan tali rafia.
w|kerajinan.en: In art class, Budi made a craft from bamboo and plastic string.
w|kerajinan.ko: 미술 시간에 버디는 대나무와 비닐 끈으로 공예품을 만들었어요.

w|kerajinan.text: Saat kemarau, Siti mengisi waktu dengan membuat kerajinan anyaman pandan.
w|kerajinan.en: In the dry season, Siti fills her time making pandan-leaf weaving crafts.
w|kerajinan.ko: 건기에 시티는 판단 잎으로 짜는 공예품을 만들며 시간을 보내요.

w|kerak.text: Di dasar panci ada kerak nasi yang disukai adik Eko.
w|kerak.en: At the bottom of the pot is the rice crust that Eko's little sibling loves.
w|kerak.ko: 냄비 바닥에 에코 동생이 좋아하는 누룽지가 있어요.

w|kerak.text: Pekerja membersihkan kerak kapur di dalam pipa ketel uap.
w|kerak.en: The workers cleaned the limescale crust inside the boiler pipes.
w|kerak.ko: 직원들은 보일러 배관 안의 석회 찌꺼기를 청소했어요.

w|keramahan.text: Pelanggan memuji keramahan Eko saat dia keluar menyapa mereka.
w|keramahan.en: Customers praised Eko's friendliness when he came out to greet them.
w|keramahan.ko: 에코가 나와서 인사하자 손님들은 그의 친절함을 칭찬했어요.

w|keramahan.text: Ayu merindukan keramahan matahari pagi selama musim hujan.
w|keramahan.en: During the rainy season, Ayu misses the friendly warmth of the morning sun.
w|keramahan.ko: 아유는 우기 동안 아침 햇살의 다정함이 그리워요.

w|keramaian.text: Agus lebih suka bekerja pagi-pagi sebelum keramaian lalu lintas dimulai.
w|keramaian.en: Agus prefers to work early, before the traffic rush begins.
w|keramaian.ko: 아구스는 교통 혼잡이 시작되기 전 이른 아침에 일하는 걸 더 좋아해요.

w|keramaian.text: Wati lebih suka belanja daring karena malas menghadapi keramaian mal di akhir pekan.
w|keramaian.en: Wati prefers shopping online because she can't be bothered with the weekend crowds at the mall.
w|keramaian.ko: 와티는 주말 쇼핑몰 인파를 상대하기 귀찮아서 온라인 쇼핑을 더 좋아해요.

w|keramat.text: Sengketa ini berawal dari pohon keramat yang ditebang tanpa izin warga desa.
w|keramat.en: This dispute started with a sacred tree that was cut down without the villagers' permission.
w|keramat.ko: 이 분쟁은 마을 사람들 허락 없이 베어 낸 신성한 나무에서 시작됐어요.

w|keramat.text: Di dekat restoran ada makam keramat yang sering dikunjungi peziarah.
w|keramat.en: Near the restaurant there is a sacred tomb that pilgrims often visit.
w|keramat.ko: 식당 근처에는 순례자들이 자주 찾는 신성한 무덤이 있어요.

w|keran.text: Sepanjang malam keran kamar mandi Agus terus menetes.
w|keran.en: All night long the tap in Agus's bathroom kept dripping.
w|keran.ko: 밤새 아구스네 욕실 수도꼭지에서 물이 똑똑 떨어졌어요.

w|keran.text: Wati memasang keran baru di tempat cuci tangan.
w|keran.en: Wati installed a new tap at the handwashing station.
w|keran.ko: 와티는 손 씻는 곳에 새 수도꼭지를 달았어요.

w|kerangka.text: Tukang sudah memasang kerangka atap rumah baru di seberang rumah Andi.
w|kerangka.en: The builders have put up the roof frame of the new house across from Andi's.
w|kerangka.ko: 일꾼들이 안디네 맞은편 새 집의 지붕 뼈대를 세웠어요.

w|kerangka.text: Dewi terpukau melihat kerangka paus biru yang tergantung di aula utama.
w|kerangka.en: Dewi was amazed by the blue whale skeleton hanging in the main hall.
w|kerangka.ko: 데위는 중앙홀에 매달린 대왕고래 뼈대를 보고 넋을 잃었어요.

w|keranjang.text: Fajar memasukkan tiga buku ke keranjang belanja, lalu lupa membayarnya.
w|keranjang.en: Fajar put three books in the shopping cart and then forgot to pay for them.
w|keranjang.ko: 파자르는 책 세 권을 장바구니에 담아 놓고 결제하는 걸 잊었어요.

w|keranjang.text: Lestari menaruh sayuran yang sudah dicuci di keranjang plastik.
w|keranjang.en: Lestari put the washed vegetables in a plastic basket.
w|keranjang.ko: 레스타리는 씻은 채소를 플라스틱 바구니에 담았어요.

w|kerbau.text: Di pinggir sawah, Rudi melihat seekor kerbau berendam di lumpur.
w|kerbau.en: At the edge of the rice field, Rudi saw a water buffalo wallowing in the mud.
w|kerbau.ko: 논 가장자리에서 루디는 물소 한 마리가 진흙에 몸을 담그고 있는 걸 봤어요.

w|kerbau.text: Dalam perjalanan pulang, mobil Rina harus berhenti karena ada kerbau menyeberang jalan.
w|kerbau.en: On the way home, Rina's car had to stop because a water buffalo was crossing the road.
w|kerbau.ko: 집에 오는 길에 물소가 길을 건너서 리나의 차가 멈춰야 했어요.

w|kerdil.text: Di panggung belakang ada pohon kerdil dalam pot untuk dekorasi.
w|kerdil.en: Backstage there is a dwarf tree in a pot for decoration.
w|kerdil.ko: 무대 뒤에는 장식용 분재 나무가 있어요.

w|kerdil.text: Di puncak gunung hanya tumbuh pohon-pohon kerdil karena anginnya kencang.
w|kerdil.en: Only stunted trees grow on the mountaintop because the wind is strong.
w|kerdil.ko: 바람이 세서 산꼭대기에는 키 작은 나무만 자라요.

w|kereta.en: We took the train to Bandung.

w|keributan.text: Bu Rina keluar kelas sebentar karena ada keributan di lorong.
w|keributan.en: Ms. Rina stepped out of class for a moment because there was a commotion in the hallway.
w|keributan.ko: 복도에서 소란이 일어나서 리나 선생님이 잠깐 교실 밖으로 나갔어요.

w|keributan.text: Tetangga baru sempat mengira ada keributan saat lemari Siti jatuh dari tangga.
w|keributan.en: The new neighbors thought there was a fight when Siti's wardrobe fell down the stairs.
w|keributan.ko: 시티의 옷장이 계단에서 떨어졌을 때 새 이웃들은 무슨 소동이 난 줄 알았어요.

w|kerikil.text: Agus menaburkan kerikil di jalan setapak supaya tidak licin.
w|kerikil.en: Agus spread gravel on the footpath so it wouldn't be slippery.
w|kerikil.ko: 아구스는 미끄럽지 않게 오솔길에 자갈을 깔았어요.

w|kerikil.text: Wati menulis bahwa jalan di depan rumah orang tuanya masih berupa kerikil seperti dulu.
w|kerikil.en: Wati wrote that the road in front of her parents' house is still gravel, just like before.
w|kerikil.ko: 와티는 부모님 집 앞 길이 예전처럼 아직 자갈길이라고 썼어요.

w|kering.text: Tanah di kebun sudah sangat kering.
w|kering.en: The soil in the garden is already very dry.
w|kering.ko: 텃밭 흙이 이미 아주 말라 있어.

w|kering.en: My throat is so dry after running.

w|keripik.text: Sambil berkeliling, Agus mengunyah keripik singkong pedas.
w|keripik.en: As he walked around, Agus munched on spicy cassava chips.
w|keripik.ko: 아구스는 돌아다니며 매운 카사바 칩을 씹었어요.

w|keripik.text: Hujan seharian membuat Wati betah di rumah sambil makan keripik pisang.
w|keripik.en: The all-day rain kept Wati happily at home eating banana chips.
w|keripik.ko: 하루 종일 비가 와서 와티는 집에서 바나나 칩을 먹으며 뒹굴었어요.

w|keriput.text: Ibu-ibu sering menanyakan krim untuk mengurangi keriput di sekitar mata.
w|keriput.en: Women often ask about creams to reduce wrinkles around the eyes.
w|keriput.ko: 아주머니들이 눈가 주름을 줄이는 크림을 자주 물어봐요.

w|keriput.text: Senyum lebar manajer membuat keriput di sudut mata terlihat jelas.
w|keriput.en: The manager's broad smile made the wrinkles at the corners of the eyes clearly visible.
w|keriput.ko: 매니저가 활짝 웃자 눈가 주름이 또렷이 보였어요.

w|keriting.text: Seorang anak berambut keriting melambaikan boneka kepada Budi dari ranjang.
w|keriting.en: A curly-haired child waved a doll at Budi from the bed.
w|keriting.ko: 곱슬머리 아이가 침대에서 부디에게 인형을 흔들었어요.

w|keriting.text: Rambut keriting Siti jadi mengembang karena udara lembap di luar terminal.
w|keriting.en: Siti's curly hair frizzed up in the humid air outside the terminal.
w|keriting.ko: 터미널 밖의 습한 공기 때문에 시티의 곱슬머리가 부스스해졌어요.

w|kerja sama.text: Pabrik itu menjalin kerja sama dengan sekolah kejuruan di kota.
w|kerja sama.en: The factory formed a partnership with a vocational school in the city.
w|kerja sama.ko: 그 공장은 시내 직업학교와 협력 관계를 맺었어요.

w|kerja sama.text: Intan terbang ke Surabaya untuk membahas kerja sama dengan klien baru.
w|kerja sama.en: Intan flew to Surabaya to discuss a partnership with a new client.
w|kerja sama.ko: 인탄은 새 고객과 협력을 논의하러 수라바야로 날아갔어요.

w|kertas.en: Please get me a blank sheet of paper.

w|kerugian.text: Hujan deras menyebabkan kerugian besar karena fondasi harus digali ulang.
w|kerugian.en: The heavy rain caused a big loss because the foundation had to be dug again.
w|kerugian.ko: 폭우로 기초를 다시 파야 해서 손해가 컸어요.

w|kerugian.text: Rina diminta menganalisis penyebab kerugian proyek tahun lalu.
w|kerugian.en: Rina was asked to analyse the causes of last year's project losses.
w|kerugian.ko: 리나는 작년 프로젝트 손실 원인을 분석해 달라는 요청을 받았어요.

w|kerumunan.text: Andi menyelinap di antara kerumunan siswa di depan papan pengumuman.
w|kerumunan.en: Andi slipped through the crowd of students in front of the notice board.
w|kerumunan.ko: 안디는 게시판 앞에 몰린 학생들 사이를 비집고 들어갔어요.

w|kerumunan.text: Satpam meminta kerumunan wartawan menjauh dari pintu UGD.
w|kerumunan.en: The guard asked the crowd of reporters to move away from the ER door.
w|kerumunan.ko: 경비원이 응급실 문 앞에 몰린 기자들에게 물러나 달라고 했어요.

w|kerusakan.en: That car damage is quite severe.

w|kerusakan.text: Badai menyebabkan kerusakan besar di pantai.
w|kerusakan.en: The storm caused major damage on the coast.

w|kerusuhan.text: Di buku sejarah, Rudi membaca tentang kerusuhan di kota besar pada masa lalu.
w|kerusuhan.en: In his history book, Rudi read about riots in big cities in the past.
w|kerusuhan.ko: 루디는 역사책에서 예전에 대도시에서 일어난 폭동에 대해 읽었어요.

w|kerusuhan.text: Rina pindah karena kompleks lamanya sering jadi lokasi kerusuhan suporter bola.
w|kerusuhan.en: Rina moved because her old complex was often the site of football fan riots.
w|kerusuhan.ko: 리나는 예전 단지에서 축구 팬 소동이 자주 일어나서 이사했어요.

w|kesabaran.text: Mengajari aktor cilik butuh kesabaran ekstra, kata Bayu.
w|kesabaran.en: Teaching child actors takes extra patience, Bayu says.
w|kesabaran.ko: 아역 배우를 가르치려면 인내심이 훨씬 더 필요하다고 바유가 말해요.

w|kesabaran.text: Menghadapi klien yang suka berubah pikiran butuh kesabaran, kata Intan.
w|kesabaran.en: Dealing with clients who keep changing their minds takes patience, Intan says.
w|kesabaran.ko: 마음이 자꾸 바뀌는 고객을 상대하려면 인내심이 필요하다고 인탄이 말해요.

w|kesadaran.text: Hakim menghargai kesadaran terdakwa untuk mengakui kesalahannya.
w|kesadaran.en: The judge appreciated the defendant's awareness in admitting his mistake.
w|kesadaran.ko: 판사는 잘못을 인정한 피고인의 자각을 높이 평가했어요.

w|kesadaran.text: Lestari senang kesadaran warga untuk membawa tas belanja sendiri makin tinggi.
w|kesadaran.en: Lestari is glad that residents are increasingly aware of bringing their own shopping bags.
w|kesadaran.ko: 레스타리는 장바구니를 챙겨 오는 주민들의 의식이 높아져서 기뻐요.

w|kesakitan.text: Kesakitan di lutut membuatnya sulit berjalan.
w|kesakitan.en: Pain in the knee made it hard for him to walk.
She endured the pain without complaining.

w|kesaksian.text: Guru BK mendengarkan kesaksian dua siswa soal perkelahian di lapangan.
w|kesaksian.en: The counselling teacher listened to two students' accounts of the fight on the field.
w|kesaksian.ko: 상담 선생님은 운동장 싸움에 대한 두 학생의 진술을 들었어요.

w|kesaksian.text: Menurut kesaksian Rudi, Siti dulu yang memecahkan pot bunga di ruang guru.
w|kesaksian.en: According to Rudi's account, it was Siti who broke the flowerpot in the staff room.
w|kesaksian.ko: 루디의 말로는 예전에 교무실 화분을 깬 사람이 시티였어요.

w|kesal.en: I'm annoyed from waiting too long.
His face has looked annoyed since morning.

w|kesalahpahaman.text: Ada kesalahpahaman soal jadwal ujian, jadi separuh kelas datang terlambat.
w|kesalahpahaman.en: There was a misunderstanding about the exam schedule, so half the class came late.
w|kesalahpahaman.ko: 시험 일정을 잘못 알아서 반 학생 절반이 늦게 왔어요.

w|kesalahpahaman.text: Siti dan Rudi akhirnya menjernihkan kesalahpahaman lama soal surat cinta yang hilang.
w|kesalahpahaman.en: Siti and Rudi finally cleared up an old misunderstanding about a lost love letter.
w|kesalahpahaman.ko: 시티와 루디는 잃어버린 연애편지를 둘러싼 오랜 오해를 마침내 풀었어요.

w|kesamaan.text: Rudi melihat kesamaan antara topeng dari dua pulau yang berbeda.
w|kesamaan.en: Rudi noticed the similarity between masks from two different islands.
w|kesamaan.ko: 루디는 서로 다른 두 섬에서 온 가면이 닮았다는 걸 알아챘어요.

w|kesamaan.text: Rina dan pedagang di sebelahnya punya kesamaan: sama-sama dari keluarga petani.
w|kesamaan.en: Rina and the trader next to her have something in common: both come from farming families.
w|kesamaan.ko: 리나와 옆 가게 상인은 둘 다 농사짓는 집안 출신이라는 공통점이 있어요.

w|kesan.text: Pelayanan cepat di kantor polisi itu meninggalkan kesan baik bagi Andi.
w|kesan.en: The quick service at the police station left a good impression on Andi.
w|kesan.ko: 그 경찰서의 빠른 업무 처리는 안디에게 좋은 인상을 남겼어요.

w|kesan.text: Penampilan pertama Dewi di lapangan memberi kesan kuat kepada pelatih.
w|kesan.en: Dewi's first appearance on the court made a strong impression on the coach.
w|kesan.ko: 데위의 첫 출전은 코치에게 강한 인상을 남겼어요.

w|kesana.en: It's very far from here to there.

w|kesatria.text: Adik Andi suka buku tentang kesatria yang menolong desa dari naga.
w|kesatria.en: Andi's little brother loves books about a knight who saves a village from a dragon.
w|kesatria.ko: 안디의 동생은 용에게서 마을을 구하는 기사 이야기를 좋아해요.

w|kesatria.text: Dewi menyebut satpam kantor yang selalu sigap itu kesatria lobi.
w|kesatria.en: Dewi calls the always-alert office security guard the knight of the lobby.
w|kesatria.ko: 디위는 늘 재빠른 사무실 경비원을 로비의 기사라고 불러요.

w|kesatuan.text: Guru PKn menjelaskan pentingnya persatuan dan kesatuan bangsa.
w|kesatuan.en: The civics teacher explained the importance of national unity.
w|kesatuan.ko: 시민 교육 선생님은 국민 통합의 중요성을 설명했어요.

w|kesatuan.text: Seragam yang sama menumbuhkan rasa kesatuan di antara para alumni.
w|kesatuan.en: The matching uniforms built a sense of unity among the alumni.
w|kesatuan.ko: 똑같은 단체복 덕분에 동문들 사이에 하나 된 느낌이 생겼어요.

w|kesayangan.text: Rudi bercerita bahwa kucing kesayangan keluarganya baru melahirkan.
w|kesayangan.en: Rudi told him that his family's beloved cat has just given birth.
w|kesayangan.ko: 루디는 가족이 아끼는 고양이가 막 새끼를 낳았다고 이야기했어요.

w|kesayangan.text: Mode gelap adalah fitur kesayangan Rina di aplikasi itu.
w|kesayangan.en: Dark mode is Rina's favorite feature in that app.
w|kesayangan.ko: 다크 모드는 그 앱에서 리나가 가장 아끼는 기능이에요.

w|kesedihan.en: That sadness slowly began to ease.

w|kesedihan.text: Dia menahan kesedihan di depan teman.
w|kesedihan.en: She held back sadness in front of friends.

w|kesehatan.en: Health is more precious than wealth.

w|kesehatan.text: Dia menjaga kesehatan dengan olahraga rutin.
w|kesehatan.en: He maintains his health with regular exercise.

w|keseimbangan.text: Wali kota menekankan keseimbangan antara pembangunan dan ruang hijau.
w|keseimbangan.en: The mayor stressed the balance between development and green space.
w|keseimbangan.ko: 시장은 개발과 녹지 사이의 균형을 강조했어요.

w|keseimbangan.text: Guru menyuruh Wati menjaga keseimbangan suara tangan kanan dan kiri.
w|keseimbangan.en: The teacher told Wati to keep the sound of her right and left hands balanced.
w|keseimbangan.ko: 선생님은 와티에게 오른손과 왼손 소리의 균형을 맞추라고 했어요.

w|kesejahteraan.text: Hasil penjualan tiket malam itu disumbangkan untuk kesejahteraan seniman tua.
w|kesejahteraan.en: That night's ticket sales were donated for the welfare of elderly artists.
w|kesejahteraan.ko: 그날 밤 표 판매 수익은 원로 예술인들의 복지에 기부됐어요.

w|kesejahteraan.text: Koperasi desa didirikan untuk meningkatkan kesejahteraan para petani.
w|kesejahteraan.en: The village cooperative was founded to improve the farmers' welfare.
w|kesejahteraan.ko: 마을 협동조합은 농민들의 복지를 높이려고 세워졌어요.

w|keselamatan.en: Passenger safety is the top priority.

w|keselamatan.text: Ikuti aturan keselamatan di tempat kerja.
w|keselamatan.en: Follow the safety rules at the workplace.

w|keseluruhan.text: Dia menilai keseluruhan hasil dengan teliti.
