w|keseluruhan.en: She assessed the overall results carefully.

w|kesembilan.text: Tamu itu menginap di lantai kesembilan yang menghadap laut.
w|kesembilan.en: That guest is staying on the ninth floor facing the sea.
w|kesembilan.ko: 그 손님은 바다가 보이는 구 층에 묵고 있어요.

w|kesembilan.text: Ini sudah hari kesembilan hujan turun tanpa henti.
w|kesembilan.en: This is already the ninth day of nonstop rain.
w|kesembilan.ko: 비가 그치지 않고 내린 지 벌써 아흐레째예요.

w|kesempurnaan.text: Bu Ratna, atasan Dimas, terkenal menuntut kesempurnaan dalam setiap laporan.
w|kesempurnaan.en: Ms. Ratna, Dimas's boss, is known for demanding perfection in every report.
w|kesempurnaan.ko: 디마스의 상사 라트나 씨는 모든 보고서에 완벽함을 요구하기로 유명해요.

w|kesempurnaan.text: Putri mengagumi kesempurnaan desain atap terminal yang baru.
w|kesempurnaan.en: Putri admired the perfection of the new terminal's roof design.
w|kesempurnaan.ko: 푸트리는 새 터미널 지붕 디자인의 완벽함에 감탄했어요.

w|kesenangan.en: Small pleasures can cheer the heart.
w|kesenangan.ko: 작은 즐거움이 마음을 달래 줄 수 있어.

w|kesengsaraan.text: Rekan kerja Dimas bercerita tentang kesengsaraan naik kereta yang penuh setiap pagi.
w|kesengsaraan.en: Dimas's coworker talked about the misery of riding a packed train every morning.
w|kesengsaraan.ko: 디마스의 동료는 매일 아침 꽉 찬 기차를 타는 고생을 이야기했어요.

w|kesengsaraan.text: Bagi Putri, menunggu delapan jam di bandara terasa seperti kesengsaraan.
w|kesengsaraan.en: For Putri, waiting eight hours at the airport felt like misery.
w|kesengsaraan.ko: 푸트리에게 공항에서 여덟 시간을 기다리는 건 고역 같았어요.

w|kesenian.text: Rudi menjaga keamanan di acara kesenian rakyat di alun-alun.
w|kesenian.en: Rudi kept watch at the folk arts event in the town square.
w|kesenian.ko: 루디는 광장에서 열린 민속 예술 행사의 경비를 섰어요.

w|kesenian.text: Rina merawat burung merak milik sanggar kesenian.
w|kesenian.en: Rina looks after a peacock that belongs to an arts studio.
w|kesenian.ko: 리나는 예술 공방에서 키우는 공작새를 돌봐요.

w|kesenjangan.text: Dimas ingin pameran ini memperlihatkan kesenjangan antara bangsawan dan petani zaman dulu.
w|kesenjangan.en: Dimas wants this exhibition to show the gap between nobles and farmers in the old days.
w|kesenjangan.ko: 디마스는 이 전시가 옛날 귀족과 농민 사이의 격차를 보여 주길 바라요.

w|kesenjangan.text: Putri melihat kesenjangan harga yang besar antara merek lokal dan merek impor.
w|kesenjangan.en: Putri noticed a big price gap between local and imported brands.
w|kesenjangan.ko: 푸트리는 국산 브랜드와 수입 브랜드 사이의 큰 가격 차이를 봤어요.

w|kesepian.en: Loneliness made him want to call a friend.

w|kesepian.text: Dia merasakan kesepian di kota besar.
w|kesepian.en: She felt loneliness in the big city.

w|keserakahan.text: Dalam pelajaran sastra, Budi membahas tokoh yang hancur karena keserakahan.
w|keserakahan.en: In literature class, Budi discussed a character ruined by greed.
w|keserakahan.ko: 문학 시간에 부디는 탐욕 때문에 몰락한 인물에 대해 이야기했어요.

w|keserakahan.text: Siti membaca berita tentang keserakahan pejabat bandara di koran.
w|keserakahan.en: Siti read news about the greed of airport officials in the newspaper.
w|keserakahan.ko: 시티는 신문에서 공항 관리들의 탐욕에 관한 기사를 읽었어요.

w|kesetaraan.text: Pameran bulan ini mengangkat perjuangan perempuan untuk kesetaraan dalam pendidikan.
w|kesetaraan.en: This month's exhibition highlights women's struggle for equality in education.
w|kesetaraan.ko: 이번 달 전시는 교육 평등을 위한 여성들의 투쟁을 다뤄요.

w|kesetaraan.text: Serikat pramuniaga menuntut kesetaraan upah antara pegawai pria dan wanita.
w|kesetaraan.en: The salespeople's union is demanding equal pay for male and female staff.
w|kesetaraan.ko: 판매원 노조는 남녀 직원의 임금 평등을 요구해요.

w|kesetiaan.text: Dimas menangis membaca kisah kesetiaan seekor anjing kepada tuannya.
w|kesetiaan.en: Dimas cried reading the story of a dog's loyalty to its master.
w|kesetiaan.ko: 디마스는 주인에게 충성하는 개 이야기를 읽고 울었어요.

w|kesetiaan.text: Pelanggan setia kereta ini mendapat poin sebagai hadiah kesetiaan.
w|kesetiaan.en: Loyal customers of this train earn points as a loyalty reward.
w|kesetiaan.ko: 이 기차 단골은 충성 보상으로 포인트를 받아요.

w|kesialan.text: Pagi pertama kerja, Dimas sudah mengalami kesialan kecil: kopinya tumpah ke kemeja.
w|kesialan.en: On his first morning at work, Dimas already had a bit of bad luck: his coffee spilled on his shirt.
w|kesialan.ko: 출근 첫날 아침부터 디마스는 작은 불운을 겪었어요. 커피가 셔츠에 쏟아졌거든요.

w|kesialan.text: Koper rusak dan penerbangan tertunda, kesialan Putri hari itu seperti tidak ada habisnya.
w|kesialan.en: A broken suitcase and a delayed flight: Putri's bad luck that day seemed endless.
w|kesialan.ko: 가방은 망가지고 비행기는 늦어지고, 그날 푸트리의 불운은 끝이 없는 것 같았어요.

w|kesibukan.text: Di tengah kesibukan dapur, Rudi masih sempat mengajari koki magang.
w|kesibukan.en: Amid the kitchen's bustle, Rudi still finds time to teach the trainee cooks.
w|kesibukan.ko: 주방이 바쁜 와중에도 루디는 견습 요리사들을 가르쳐요.

w|kesibukan.text: Rina menikmati kesibukan pasar loak pada Minggu pagi.
w|kesibukan.en: Rina enjoys the bustle of the flea market on Sunday mornings.
w|kesibukan.ko: 리나는 일요일 아침 벼룩시장의 북적임을 즐겨요.

w|kesimpulan.text: Budi menulis kesimpulan laporan praktikum di halaman terakhir.
w|kesimpulan.en: Budi wrote the conclusion of the lab report on the last page.
w|kesimpulan.ko: 부디는 실험 보고서의 결론을 마지막 쪽에 썼어요.

w|kesimpulan.text: Setelah mengobrol semalaman, Siti sampai pada kesimpulan bahwa sahabat lama tidak pernah berubah.
w|kesimpulan.en: After talking all night, Siti came to the conclusion that old friends never change.
w|kesimpulan.ko: 밤새 이야기를 나눈 뒤 시티는 오랜 친구는 변하지 않는다는 결론을 내렸어요.

w|kesini.en: Come over here for a second.

w|kesombongan.text: Warga tidak suka kesombongan pemilik unit mewah yang suka parkir sembarangan.
w|kesombongan.en: Residents dislike the arrogance of the luxury unit owner who parks carelessly.
w|kesombongan.ko: 주민들은 아무 데나 주차하는 고급 세대 주인의 거만함이 싫어요.

w|kesombongan.text: Menurut Wati, alam selalu mengajarkan manusia untuk membuang kesombongan.
w|kesombongan.en: According to Wati, nature always teaches people to let go of arrogance.
w|kesombongan.ko: 와티는 자연이 늘 사람에게 교만을 버리라고 가르친다고 해요.

w|kesopanan.text: Fajar mengajari pegawai baru soal kesopanan saat melayani warga di loket.
w|kesopanan.en: Fajar taught new staff about courtesy when serving residents at the counter.
w|kesopanan.ko: 파자르는 신입 직원들에게 창구에서 주민을 대할 때의 예절을 가르쳤어요.

w|kesopanan.text: Lestari memuji kesopanan anak sahabatnya yang dulu membalas surat dengan tulisan rapi.
w|kesopanan.en: Lestari praised the politeness of her friend's child, who had once replied in neat handwriting.
w|kesopanan.ko: 레스타리는 예전에 단정한 글씨로 답장을 보냈던 친구 아이의 예의를 칭찬했어요.

w|kesucian.text: Saat perayaan hari besar, Rudi bertugas menjaga kesucian tempat ibadah dari keramaian pasar malam.
w|kesucian.en: During the holiday celebration, Rudi was on duty to keep the place of worship sacred from the night market crowds.
w|kesucian.ko: 명절 행사 때 루디는 야시장 인파로부터 예배 장소의 신성함을 지키는 일을 맡았어요.

w|kesucian.text: Pelari diminta menghormati kesucian kawasan pura di tepi rute dengan tidak membuang sampah.
w|kesucian.en: Runners were asked to respect the sanctity of the temple area along the route by not littering.
w|kesucian.ko: 주자들은 코스 옆 사원 구역의 신성함을 존중해 쓰레기를 버리지 말라는 요청을 받았어요.

w|kesukaan.text: Mereka saling menghargai kesukaan satu sama lain.

w|kesuksesan.text: Fajar tahu kesuksesan sebuah restoran tidak datang dalam semalam.
w|kesuksesan.en: Fajar knows a restaurant's success doesn't come overnight.
w|kesuksesan.ko: 파자르는 식당의 성공이 하룻밤에 오지 않는다는 걸 알아요.

w|kesuksesan.text: Bagi Lestari, kesuksesan hari ini berarti semua piring keramik terjual habis.
w|kesuksesan.en: For Lestari, success today means every ceramic plate is sold out.
w|kesuksesan.ko: 레스타리에게 오늘의 성공은 도자기 접시가 다 팔리는 거예요.

w|kesulitan.ko: 그 어려움이 그를 더 강하게 만들었어.

w|kesunyian.text: Setelah semua pegawai pulang, Fajar menikmati kesunyian kantor balai kota.
w|kesunyian.en: After all the staff went home, Fajar enjoyed the silence of the city hall office.
w|kesunyian.ko: 직원들이 모두 퇴근한 뒤 파자르는 시청 사무실의 고요함을 즐겼어요.

w|kesunyian.text: Lestari menyukai kesunyian lantai paling atas pada pagi hari.
w|kesunyian.en: Lestari loves the quiet of the top floor in the morning.
w|kesunyian.ko: 레스타리는 아침의 꼭대기 층 고요함을 좋아해요.

w|kesusahan.text: Budi menawarkan bantuan kalau Rudi sedang dalam kesusahan.
w|kesusahan.en: Budi offered help in case Rudi was going through hard times.
w|kesusahan.ko: 부디는 루디가 어려운 처지라면 돕겠다고 했어요.

w|kesusahan.text: Tetangga di kampung itu selalu saling menolong saat ada yang kesusahan.
w|kesusahan.en: The neighbors in that village always help each other when someone is in trouble.
w|kesusahan.ko: 그 동네 이웃들은 누가 어려움을 겪으면 늘 서로 도와요.

w|ketagihan.text: Fajar mengingatkan pembeli agar tidak sampai ketagihan obat tidur.
w|ketagihan.en: Fajar warned the customer not to get hooked on sleeping pills.
w|ketagihan.ko: 파자르는 손님에게 수면제에 중독되지 않도록 조심하라고 했어요.

w|ketagihan.text: Rekan baru Lestari mengaku ketagihan kopi susu sejak hari pertama kerja.
w|ketagihan.en: Lestari's new coworker admits to being hooked on milk coffee since the first day of work.
w|ketagihan.ko: 레스타리의 새 동료는 출근 첫날부터 밀크커피에 중독됐다고 털어놨어요.

w|ketahuan.en: His lie was found out by the class teacher.
He was caught copying a friend's answers.

w|ketakutan.en: That child is full of fear.
w|ketakutan.ko: 그 아이는 두려움에 가득 차 있어.

w|ketat.text: Ketat sekali aturan di asrama itu.
w|ketat.en: The rules in that dormitory are very strict.
Their training schedule is very tight.

w|ketawa.text: Membaca surat dari Rudi, Budi ketawa sampai sakit perut.
w|ketawa.en: Reading the letter from Rudi, Budi laughed until his stomach hurt.
w|ketawa.ko: 루디의 편지를 읽으며 부디는 배가 아플 만큼 웃었어요.

w|ketawa.text: Pak Darto ketawa keras setiap kali menonton bola bersama tetangga.
w|ketawa.en: Mr. Darto laughs loudly whenever he watches football with the neighbors.
w|ketawa.ko: 다르토 아저씨는 이웃들과 축구를 볼 때마다 크게 웃어요.

w|ketegangan.text: Budi menulis bahwa ketegangan di kantornya mulai mereda.
w|ketegangan.en: Budi writes that the tension at his office is starting to ease.
w|ketegangan.ko: 부디는 회사의 긴장감이 조금씩 풀리고 있다고 써요.

w|ketegangan.text: Siti merasakan ketegangan di garis start sebelum pistol dibunyikan.
w|ketegangan.en: Siti felt the tension at the starting line before the gun went off.
w|ketegangan.ko: 시티는 출발 총소리가 울리기 전 출발선에서 긴장감을 느꼈어요.

w|ketemu.text: Dimas akhirnya ketemu anak kambing yang hilang di balik semak.
w|ketemu.en: Dimas finally found the lost baby goat behind a bush.
w|ketemu.ko: 디마스는 마침내 덤불 뒤에서 잃어버린 새끼 염소를 찾았어요.

w|ketemu.text: Di minimarket, Putri ketemu teman lama dari SMA.
w|ketemu.en: At the convenience store, Putri ran into an old friend from high school.
w|ketemu.ko: 편의점에서 푸트리는 고등학교 옛 친구를 만났어요.

w|ketenangan.text: Kepala sekolah meminta ketenangan selama ujian berlangsung.
w|ketenangan.en: The principal asked for calm while the exam was in progress.
w|ketenangan.ko: 교장 선생님은 시험이 치러지는 동안 조용히 해 달라고 했어요.

w|ketenangan.text: Siti merindukan ketenangan desa tempat mereka bersekolah dulu.
w|ketenangan.en: Siti misses the peace of the village where they went to school.
w|ketenangan.ko: 시티는 예전에 학교를 다니던 마을의 고요함이 그리워요.

w|ketenaran.text: Artikel Bayu membahas penyanyi muda yang tidak siap menghadapi ketenaran.
w|ketenaran.en: Bayu's article discussed a young singer who wasn't ready to face fame.
w|ketenaran.ko: 바유의 기사는 유명세를 감당할 준비가 안 된 젊은 가수를 다뤘어요.

w|ketenaran.text: Intan tidak mengejar ketenaran; Intan hanya ingin aplikasinya berguna.
w|ketenaran.en: Intan isn't chasing fame; she just wants her app to be useful.
w|ketenaran.ko: 인탄은 유명해지고 싶은 게 아니라 앱이 쓸모 있기를 바랄 뿐이에요.

w|ketentuan.text: Budi membaca ketentuan lomba dengan teliti sebelum mendaftar.
w|ketentuan.en: Budi read the competition rules carefully before signing up.
w|ketentuan.ko: 버디는 신청하기 전에 대회 규정을 꼼꼼히 읽었어요.

w|ketentuan.text: Sesuai ketentuan desa, Siti dan tetangganya bergotong royong membersihkan sungai sebelum hujan.
w|ketentuan.en: In line with village rules, Siti and her neighbors work together to clean the river before the rains.
w|ketentuan.ko: 마을 규정에 따라 시티와 이웃들은 비가 오기 전에 함께 강을 청소해요.

w|keterampilan.text: Rudi belajar keterampilan mengelas dari mandor senior.
w|keterampilan.en: Rudi learned welding skills from a senior foreman.
w|keterampilan.ko: 루디는 선배 십장에게 용접 기술을 배웠어요.

w|keterampilan.text: Manajer bertanya keterampilan apa saja yang Rina kuasai.
w|keterampilan.en: The manager asked what skills Rina had.
w|keterampilan.ko: 매니저는 리나에게 어떤 기술을 가졌는지 물었어요.

w|keterangan.text: Wali kelas meminta keterangan dari Agus soal jendela yang pecah.
w|keterangan.en: The homeroom teacher asked Agus for an explanation about the broken window.
w|keterangan.ko: 담임 선생님은 깨진 유리창에 대해 아구스에게 설명을 요구했어요.

w|keterangan.text: Papan keterangan di pintu masuk menyebutkan kedalaman setiap bagian kolam.
w|keterangan.en: The information board at the entrance lists the depth of each section of the pool.
w|keterangan.ko: 입구 안내판에는 수영장 구역마다 깊이가 적혀 있어요.

w|keterlaluan.en: His behavior is way too much this time.

w|keterlaluan.text: Keterlaluan sekali memotong antrean orang lain.
w|keterlaluan.en: Cutting in front of others is really excessive.
w|keterlaluan.ko: 남 줄 새치기는 정말 너무한 일이야.

w|keterlibatan.text: Menurut wali kelas, keterlibatan orang tua sangat membantu Rudi dalam belajar.
w|keterlibatan.en: According to the homeroom teacher, parental involvement helps Rudi a lot in his studies.
w|keterlibatan.ko: 담임 선생님 말로는 부모님의 관심과 참여가 루디의 공부에 큰 도움이 돼요.

w|keterlibatan.text: Rina berterima kasih atas keterlibatan tetangga lama dalam acara pindahan.
w|keterlibatan.en: Rina was grateful for her old neighbors' involvement in the move.
w|keterlibatan.ko: 리나는 이사를 함께해 준 예전 이웃들에게 고마워했어요.

w|ketertarikan.text: Kakak Rudi salah paham dan mengira Rudi tidak punya ketertarikan pada acara wisudanya.
w|ketertarikan.en: Rudi's sister misunderstood and thought Rudi had no interest in her graduation.
w|ketertarikan.ko: 루디의 누나는 루디가 자기 졸업식에 관심이 없다고 오해했어요.

w|ketertarikan.text: Rina mulai punya ketertarikan pada biota laut sejak liburan di pantai ini.
w|ketertarikan.en: Rina became interested in marine life after a holiday at this beach.
w|ketertarikan.ko: 리나는 이 해변에서 보낸 휴가 때부터 바다 생물에 관심이 생겼어요.

w|ketertiban.text: Budi ditunjuk menjaga ketertiban barisan saat upacara bendera.
w|ketertiban.en: Budi was assigned to keep the lines in order during the flag ceremony.
w|ketertiban.ko: 버디는 국기 게양식 때 줄 질서를 맡게 됐어요.

w|ketertiban.text: Pak RT meminta warga menjaga ketertiban saat membagikan karung pasir sebelum musim banjir, dan Siti ikut membantu.
w|ketertiban.en: The neighborhood head asked residents to keep order while handing out sandbags before flood season, and Siti helped.
w|ketertiban.ko: 반장은 홍수철 전에 모래주머니를 나눌 때 질서를 지켜 달라고 했고, 시티도 거들었어요.

w|ketidakadilan.text: Fajar menerima laporan warga tentang ketidakadilan dalam pembagian bantuan.
w|ketidakadilan.en: Fajar received residents' reports about unfairness in the distribution of aid.
w|ketidakadilan.ko: 파자르는 지원금 배분이 불공평하다는 주민 신고를 받았어요.

w|ketidakadilan.text: Lestari menulis tentang ketidakadilan yang dialami para buruh di pabrik dekat rumahnya.
w|ketidakadilan.en: Lestari wrote about the injustice suffered by the workers at the factory near her home.
w|ketidakadilan.ko: 레스타리는 집 근처 공장 노동자들이 겪는 부당함에 대해 썼어요.

w|ketidaknyamanan.text: Budi menulis tentang ketidaknyamanan tinggal di kamar kos yang sempit.
w|ketidaknyamanan.en: Budi wrote about the discomfort of living in a cramped rented room.
w|ketidaknyamanan.ko: 부디는 비좁은 하숙방에서 사는 불편함에 대해 썼어요.

w|ketidaknyamanan.text: Pak RT meminta maaf atas ketidaknyamanan selama perbaikan saluran air.
w|ketidaknyamanan.en: The neighborhood head apologized for the inconvenience during the water pipe repairs.
w|ketidaknyamanan.ko: 반장님은 수도관 공사 동안의 불편에 대해 사과했어요.

w|ketiduran.text: Dimas ketiduran di kursi apotek saat jaga malam.
w|ketiduran.en: Dimas fell asleep in the pharmacy chair during the night shift.
w|ketiduran.ko: 디마스는 야간 근무 중에 약국 의자에서 깜빡 잠들었어요.

w|ketiduran.text: Putri ketiduran di lantai ruang tamu yang belum selesai dicat.
w|ketiduran.en: Putri fell asleep on the floor of the half-painted living room.
w|ketiduran.ko: 푸트리는 칠이 덜 끝난 거실 바닥에서 깜빡 잠들었어요.

w|ketiga.en: The third child has been born.

w|ketika.en: When it rained, I went home.
w|ketika.ko: 비 올 때 나 집에 갔어.

w|ketika.en: He came when I was sleeping.
w|ketika.ko: 내가 자고 있을 때 그가 왔어.

w|ketimbang.text: Andi lebih suka belajar di perpustakaan ketimbang di rumah.
w|ketimbang.en: Andi prefers studying in the library rather than at home.
w|ketimbang.ko: 안디는 집보다 도서관에서 공부하는 걸 더 좋아해요.

w|ketimbang.text: Dewi lebih memilih jaga malam ketimbang jaga pagi.
w|ketimbang.en: Dewi prefers night shifts to morning shifts.
w|ketimbang.ko: 데위는 아침 근무보다 밤 근무를 더 좋아해요.

w|ketinggalan.en: He is afraid of missing the morning train.
w|ketinggalan.ko: 그는 아침 기차를 놓칠까 봐 두려워해.

w|ketinggalan.en: Don't end up missing important news.

w|ketinggian.text: Ketinggian gunung itu menantang para pendaki.
w|ketinggian.en: The mountain's height challenges the climbers.

w|ketinggian.text: Pesawat terbang pada ketinggian yang aman.
w|ketinggian.en: The plane flies at a safe altitude.

w|ketujuh.text: Malam ini adalah pertunjukan ketujuh Eko sebagai pemeran utama.
w|ketujuh.en: Tonight is Eko's seventh performance as the lead actor.
w|ketujuh.ko: 오늘 밤은 에코가 주연으로 서는 일곱 번째 공연이에요.

w|ketujuh.text: Hari ini adalah hari ketujuh Ayu berjualan tanpa libur.
w|ketujuh.en: Today is Ayu's seventh day selling without a day off.
w|ketujuh.ko: 오늘은 아유가 쉬지 않고 장사한 지 일곱째 날이에요.

w|ketukan.text: Agus terbangun karena ketukan keras di pintu tengah malam.
w|ketukan.en: Agus woke up because of a loud knock on the door at midnight.
w|ketukan.ko: 아구스는 한밤중 문을 세게 두드리는 소리에 깼어요.

w|ketukan.text: Wati suka mendengar ketukan hujan di atap seng rumahnya.
w|ketukan.en: Wati likes hearing the tapping of rain on her house's tin roof.
w|ketukan.ko: 와티는 집 양철 지붕을 두드리는 빗소리를 좋아해요.

w|keturunan.en: He is a descendant of an artist family.

w|keturunan.text: Keturunan mereka tinggal di kota lain.
w|keturunan.en: Their descendants live in another city.

w|keuangan.text: Keuangan keluarga perlu diatur dengan hati-hati.
w|keuangan.en: Family finances need to be managed carefully.
He is learning to manage personal finances.
w|keuangan.ko: 그는 개인 재정을 관리하는 법을 배워.

w|keunggulan.text: Agus bilang keunggulan roti di tokonya ada pada ragi alami.
w|keunggulan.en: Agus says the strength of the bread at his shop lies in the natural yeast.
w|keunggulan.ko: 아구스는 자기 가게 빵의 장점이 천연 효모에 있다고 해요.

w|keunggulan.text: Wati menjelaskan keunggulan aplikasi itu dibanding produk pesaing.
w|keunggulan.en: Wati explained the app's advantages over competing products.
w|keunggulan.ko: 와티는 그 앱이 경쟁 제품보다 나은 점을 설명했어요.

w|keuntungan.en: The company made a large profit.
What's the benefit of learning a foreign language?

w|kewajiban.text: Menyapu kelas adalah kewajiban siswa yang piket hari itu.
w|kewajiban.en: Sweeping the classroom is the duty of the students on cleaning rota that day.
w|kewajiban.ko: 교실 청소는 그날 당번인 학생들의 의무예요.

w|kewajiban.text: Siti merasa menjaga silaturahmi dengan teman lama adalah sebuah kewajiban.
w|kewajiban.en: Siti feels that keeping in touch with old friends is a duty.
w|kewajiban.ko: 시티는 옛 친구들과 연락을 이어 가는 게 일종의 의무라고 느껴요.

w|kewalahan.text: Budi mengaku kewalahan mengurus bayi kembar.
w|kewalahan.en: Budi admitted he is overwhelmed looking after twin babies.
w|kewalahan.ko: 부디는 쌍둥이 아기를 돌보느라 감당이 안 된다고 털어놨어요.

w|kewalahan.text: Siti kewalahan menerima kiriman makanan dari para tetangga saat pindahan.
w|kewalahan.en: Siti was overwhelmed by all the food the neighbors sent over when she moved in.
w|kewalahan.ko: 이사 때 이웃들이 보내온 음식이 너무 많아서 시티는 감당하기 벅찼어요.

w|kewarganegaraan.text: Dimas menjelaskan dokumen kewarganegaraan yang dipakai pada awal kemerdekaan.
w|kewarganegaraan.en: Dimas explained the citizenship documents used in the early days of independence.
w|kewarganegaraan.ko: 디마스는 독립 초기에 쓰인 국적 서류를 설명했어요.

w|kewarganegaraan.text: Kasir meminta paspor untuk memastikan kewarganegaraan turis yang mengurus pengembalian pajak.
w|kewarganegaraan.en: The cashier asked for a passport to confirm the nationality of the tourist claiming a tax refund.
w|kewarganegaraan.ko: 계산원은 세금 환급을 신청한 관광객의 국적을 확인하려고 여권을 달라고 했어요.

w|kewenangan.text: Andi tidak punya kewenangan untuk menghentikan pekerjaan tanpa izin manajer.
w|kewenangan.en: Andi doesn't have the authority to stop the work without the manager's permission.
w|kewenangan.ko: 안디는 관리자 허락 없이 공사를 멈출 권한이 없어요.

w|kewenangan.text: Teman Dewi yang jadi kepala sekolah bercerita soal kewenangan yang dia punya sekarang.
w|kewenangan.en: Dewi's friend who became a principal talked about the authority she has now.
w|kewenangan.ko: 교장이 된 데위의 친구는 지금 가진 권한에 대해 이야기했어요.

w|keyakinan.text: Dia punya keyakinan pada dirinya sendiri.

w|khas.text: Malam itu Ibu memasak sayur lodeh khas resep Nenek supaya kedua anaknya mau duduk bersama.
w|khas.en: That night Mom cooked vegetable lodeh, Grandma's signature recipe, so both kids would sit together.
w|khas.ko: 그날 밤 엄마는 두 아이가 같이 앉도록 할머니 특유의 레시피로 채소 로데를 끓였어요.

w|khas.text: Rumah baru Siti punya aroma khas kayu jati.
w|khas.en: Siti's new house has the distinctive smell of teak wood.
w|khas.ko: 시티의 새집에서는 티크 나무 특유의 냄새가 나요.

w|khawatir.en: His mother has been worried since yesterday.

w|khayalan.text: Rudi menertawakan khayalan mereka dulu tentang membuka kafe di pinggir pantai.
w|khayalan.en: Rudi laughed at their old fantasy of opening a café by the beach.
w|khayalan.ko: 루디는 바닷가에 카페를 차리자던 둘의 옛 공상을 떠올리며 웃었어요.

w|khayalan.text: Dulu, punya perusahaan sendiri hanya khayalan bagi Rina.
w|khayalan.en: Having her own company used to be just a fantasy for Rina.
w|khayalan.ko: 예전에 리나에게 자기 회사를 갖는 건 공상일 뿐이었어요.

w|khusus.en: This is a special event for you.

w|khusus.text: Khusus hari ini, toko tutup lebih awal.
w|khusus.en: Especially today, the shop closes earlier.

w|kiamat.text: Kata Pak Agus sambil tertawa, antrean laporan pagi ini seperti mau kiamat.
w|kiamat.en: Mr. Agus said, laughing, that this morning's queue of reports looked like the end of the world.
w|kiamat.ko: 아구스 경관은 오늘 아침 신고 줄이 세상 종말 같다며 웃었어요.

w|kiamat.text: Waktu Dewi cedera, rasanya seperti kiamat bagi seluruh tim.
w|kiamat.en: When Dewi got injured, it felt like the end of the world for the whole team.
w|kiamat.ko: 데위가 다쳤을 때 팀 전체가 세상이 끝난 것 같았어요.

w|kiasan.text: Guru bahasa menjelaskan kiasan dalam puisi yang dibaca Budi.
w|kiasan.en: The language teacher explained the figure of speech in the poem Budi read.
w|kiasan.ko: 국어 선생님이 버디가 읽은 시의 비유를 설명해 주셨어요.

w|kiasan.text: "Hujan rezeki" adalah kiasan yang sering dipakai Siti saat panen melimpah.
w|kiasan.en: "A rain of blessings" is a figure of speech Siti often uses when the harvest is plentiful.
w|kiasan.ko: "복의 비"는 수확이 넉넉할 때 시티가 자주 쓰는 비유예요.

w|kidal.text: Andi baru tahu bahwa anak tetangga kidal saat mereka main bulu tangkis.
w|kidal.en: Andi only found out the neighbor's kid is left-handed when they played badminton.
w|kidal.ko: 안디는 배드민턴을 치다가 이웃집 아이가 왼손잡이라는 걸 알았어요.

w|kidal.text: Dewi mencarikan gitar khusus untuk murid yang kidal.
w|kidal.en: Dewi found a special guitar for the left-handed student.
w|kidal.ko: 데위는 왼손잡이 학생을 위해 전용 기타를 구해 줬어요.

w|kilang.text: Minyak kelapa yang dipakai Eko berasal dari kilang kecil di desa.
w|kilang.en: The coconut oil Eko uses comes from a small mill in a village.
w|kilang.ko: 에코가 쓰는 코코넛 기름은 시골의 작은 정제소에서 와요.

w|kilang.text: Ayu melihat asap dari kilang gula membubung di langit kemarau.
w|kilang.en: Ayu watched smoke from the sugar mill rising into the dry-season sky.
w|kilang.ko: 아유는 설탕 공장 연기가 건기 하늘로 피어오르는 걸 봤어요.

w|kilat.text: Saat badai, Agus melihat kilat menyambar pohon kelapa di seberang sungai.
w|kilat.en: During the storm, Agus saw lightning strike a coconut tree across the river.
w|kilat.ko: 폭풍이 칠 때 아구스는 번개가 강 건너 야자나무에 내리치는 걸 봤어요.

w|kilat.text: Begitu kilat menyambar, listrik apotek padam dan Wati menyalakan senter.
w|kilat.en: As soon as lightning struck, the pharmacy's power went out and Wati turned on a flashlight.
w|kilat.ko: 번개가 치자마자 약국 전기가 나가서 와티는 손전등을 켰어요.

w|kilatan.text: Tiba-tiba kilatan petir menerangi seluruh lembah.
w|kilatan.en: Suddenly a flash of lightning lit up the whole valley.
w|kilatan.ko: 갑자기 번갯불이 골짜기 전체를 환히 비췄어요.

w|kilatan.text: Ayu memakai kacamata pelindung karena kilatan api las bisa merusak mata.
w|kilatan.en: Ayu wears safety goggles because the flash from welding can damage the eyes.
w|kilatan.ko: 용접 불꽃의 섬광이 눈을 상하게 할 수 있어서 아유는 보안경을 써요.

w|kilometer.text: Masih ada sekitar dua ratus kilometer lagi sebelum Agus sampai di Yogyakarta.
w|kilometer.en: There were still about two hundred kilometers left before Agus reached Yogyakarta.
w|kilometer.ko: 아구스가 족자카르타에 닿으려면 아직 이백 킬로미터쯤 남았어요.

w|kilometer.text: Rumah Wati hanya berjarak tiga kilometer dari pusat perbelanjaan itu.
w|kilometer.en: Wati's house is only three kilometers from that shopping center.
w|kilometer.ko: 와티의 집은 그 쇼핑센터에서 삼 킬로미터밖에 안 떨어져 있어요.

w|kimia.text: Dia belajar kimia di laboratorium sekolah.
w|kimia.en: She studies chemistry in the school lab.

w|kimia.text: Pelajaran kimia hari ini cukup sulit.
w|kimia.en: Today's chemistry lesson was quite hard.

w|kincir.text: Budi membuat kincir angin dari bambu untuk mengusir burung.
w|kincir.en: Budi made a bamboo windmill to scare away the birds.
w|kincir.ko: 부디는 새를 쫓으려고 대나무로 바람개비를 만들었어요.

w|kincir.text: Tepung yang dipakai Siti digiling di kincir air milik keluarga petani.
w|kincir.en: The flour Siti uses is ground at a water mill owned by a farming family.
w|kincir.ko: 시티가 쓰는 밀가루는 한 농가의 물레방아에서 빻아요.

w|kinerja.text: Agus menilai kinerja tim baru cukup baik untuk bulan pertama.
w|kinerja.en: Agus thinks the new team's performance is quite good for the first month.
w|kinerja.ko: 아구스는 새 팀의 성과가 첫 달치고는 꽤 괜찮다고 평가해요.

w|kinerja.text: Wati menilai kinerja kurir di daerahnya sudah jauh lebih cepat tahun ini.
w|kinerja.en: Wati thinks the couriers in her area have become much faster this year.
w|kinerja.ko: 와티는 올해 동네 택배 기사들의 일 처리가 훨씬 빨라졌다고 생각해요.

w|kipas.text: Saat listrik padam, Agus mengipasi diri dengan kipas tangan dari kertas.
w|kipas.en: During the power cut, Agus fanned himself with a paper hand fan.
w|kipas.ko: 정전 때 아구스는 종이 부채로 부채질을 했어요.

w|kipas.text: Di puncak musim kemarau, kipas angin di kamar Wati menyala siang dan malam.
w|kipas.en: At the height of the dry season, the electric fan in Wati's room runs day and night.
w|kipas.ko: 건기가 한창일 때 와티 방의 선풍기는 밤낮으로 돌아가요.

w|kira-kira.en: About how long is this trip?

w|kira-kira.text: Dia akan datang kira-kira setelah makan siang.
w|kira-kira.en: He will come around after lunch.
w|kira-kira.ko: 그는 점심 뒤에 대략 올 거야.

w|kiriman.text: Pedagang itu baru menerima kiriman barang antik dari Surabaya.
w|kiriman.en: The trader had just received a shipment of antiques from Surabaya.
w|kiriman.ko: 그 상인은 수라바야에서 온 골동품 짐을 막 받았어요.

w|kiriman.text: Pintu masuk gedung penuh kiriman bunga dari teman-teman kuliah Intan.
w|kiriman.en: The hall's entrance was full of flower deliveries from Intan's college friends.
w|kiriman.ko: 인탄의 대학 친구들이 보낸 꽃이 식장 입구를 가득 채웠어요.

w|kitab.text: Pak Hadi bercerita tentang kitab kuno yang ditulis di atas daun lontar.
w|kitab.en: Mr. Hadi told the class about an ancient book written on palm leaves.
w|kitab.ko: 하디 선생님은 야자잎에 쓴 옛 경전 이야기를 해 주셨어요.

w|kitab.text: Siti membungkus kitab tua peninggalan kakeknya dengan kain agar tidak rusak.
w|kitab.en: Siti wrapped the old holy book her grandfather left her in cloth so it wouldn't get damaged.
w|kitab.ko: 시티는 할아버지가 남긴 오래된 경전이 상하지 않게 천으로 쌌어요.

w|klakson.text: Bayu membunyikan klakson pelan saat seekor kambing menyeberang jalan.
w|klakson.en: Bayu gave a light honk when a goat crossed the road.
w|klakson.ko: 염소가 길을 건너자 바유는 경적을 살짝 울렸어요.

w|klakson.text: Suara klakson dari jalan raya membuat Intan sulit berkonsentrasi.
w|klakson.en: The sound of car horns from the main road made it hard for Intan to concentrate.
w|klakson.ko: 큰길의 경적 소리 때문에 인탄은 집중하기 힘들었어요.

w|klasik.en: Classical music calms the mood of the room.

w|klasik.text: Film klasik itu masih layak ditonton.
w|klasik.en: That classic film is still worth watching.
w|klasik.ko: 그 고전 영화는 여전히 볼 만해.

w|klien.text: Klien baru akan datang siang ini.
w|klien.en: A new client will come this afternoon.
w|klien.ko: 새 고객이 오늘 오후에 올 거야.

w|klimaks.text: Ruang terakhir menjadi klimaks tur karena berisi mahkota emas.
w|klimaks.en: The last room is the climax of the tour because it holds a golden crown.
w|klimaks.ko: 마지막 방에는 금관이 있어서 투어의 절정이에요.

w|klimaks.text: Pengundian hadiah menjadi klimaks acara ulang tahun toko.
w|klimaks.en: The prize draw was the climax of the store's anniversary event.
w|klimaks.ko: 경품 추첨이 매장 창립 기념 행사의 하이라이트였어요.

w|klinik.text: Klinik desa buka setiap hari kerja.
w|klinik.en: The village clinic opens every weekday.

w|klinik.text: Dia berobat ke klinik dekat rumah.
w|klinik.en: She got treatment at the clinic near home.

w|klinis.text: Kata Fajar, obat baru itu sudah lolos uji klinis.
w|klinis.en: According to Fajar, the new drug has already passed clinical trials.
w|klinis.ko: 파자르 말로는 그 신약이 임상 시험을 이미 통과했대요.

w|klinis.text: Lestari bilang ruangan kantor yang serba putih terasa terlalu klinis.
w|klinis.en: Lestari says the all-white office feels too clinical.
w|klinis.ko: 레스타리는 온통 하얀 사무실이 너무 병원 같다고 해요.

w|klip.text: Bayu menyertakan klip video wawancara di versi daring artikelnya.
w|klip.en: Bayu included a video clip of the interview in the online version of his article.
w|klip.ko: 바유는 기사 온라인판에 인터뷰 동영상 클립을 넣었어요.

w|klip.text: Intan mengunggah klip pendek tentang matahari terbit di atas desanya.
w|klip.en: Intan uploaded a short clip of the sunrise over her village.
w|klip.ko: 인탄은 마을 위로 해가 뜨는 짧은 영상을 올렸어요.

w|klise.text: Agus menganggap pembelaan terdakwa terlalu klise dan sulit dipercaya.
w|klise.en: Agus thought the defendant's defense was too clichéd and hard to believe.
w|klise.ko: 아구스는 피고인의 변론이 너무 뻔해서 믿기 어렵다고 생각했어요.

w|klise.text: Wati tidak mau memasang slogan klise seperti "rasa bintang lima" di depan restorannya.
w|klise.en: Wati doesn't want to put up a clichéd slogan like "five-star taste" in front of her restaurant.
w|klise.ko: 와티는 식당 앞에 "오성급 맛" 같은 뻔한 문구를 걸고 싶지 않아요.

w|klon.text: Fajar membaca bahwa ilmuwan pernah membuat klon domba di laboratorium.
w|klon.en: Fajar read that scientists once made a clone of a sheep in a laboratory.
w|klon.ko: 파자르는 과학자들이 실험실에서 복제 양을 만든 적이 있다는 걸 읽었어요.

w|klon.text: Lestari bercanda bahwa rekan baru itu klon dari bos karena gaya bicara mereka mirip.
w|klon.en: Lestari joked that the new coworker is the boss's clone because they talk alike.
w|klon.ko: 레스타리는 새 동료가 말투가 비슷해서 사장 복제인간 같다고 농담했어요.

w|kloning.text: Dimas berdebat dengan temannya soal etika kloning hewan.
w|kloning.en: Dimas argued with his friend about the ethics of animal cloning.
w|kloning.ko: 디마스는 친구와 동물 복제의 윤리를 두고 논쟁했어요.

w|kloning.text: Putri bercanda ingin memakai teknologi kloning agar punya tiga pasang tangan.
w|kloning.en: Putri joked that she wanted to use cloning technology to have three pairs of hands.
w|kloning.ko: 푸트리는 복제 기술로 손이 세 쌍이었으면 좋겠다고 농담했어요.

w|klub.en: The soccer club practices in the afternoon.

w|kobra.text: Bayu selalu berhati-hati karena pernah melihat kobra di semak dekat sungai.
w|kobra.en: Bayu is always careful because he once saw a cobra in the bushes near the river.
w|kobra.ko: 바유는 강가 덤불에서 코브라를 본 적이 있어서 늘 조심해요.

w|kobra.text: Intan sempat berhenti karena warga berteriak ada kobra di pinggir jalan.
w|kobra.en: Intan stopped for a moment because locals shouted that there was a cobra by the road.
w|kobra.ko: 주민들이 길가에 코브라가 있다고 소리쳐서 인탄은 잠깐 멈췄어요.

w|kodok.text: Suara kodok bersahutan di rawa dekat perkemahan Eko.
w|kodok.en: Frogs croaked back and forth in the swamp near Eko's campsite.
w|kodok.ko: 에코의 캠프장 근처 늪에서 개구리들이 번갈아 울었어요.

w|kodok.text: Salah satu pelari memakai kostum kodok hijau yang mengundang tawa penonton.
w|kodok.en: One runner wore a green frog costume that made the crowd laugh.
w|kodok.ko: 한 주자가 초록 개구리 옷을 입어서 관중들이 웃었어요.

w|koin.text: Koin lama itu ditemukan di taman.
w|koin.en: That old coin was found in the park.

w|koin.text: Dia mengumpulkan koin dari berbagai negara.
w|koin.en: He collects coins from various countries.

w|kok.en: Somehow I don't remember his name.
w|kok.ko: 나 이상하게 그 이름이 기억 안 나.

w|koki.text: Koki itu memasak hidangan spesial malam ini.
w|koki.en: That chef cooked a special dish tonight.
w|koki.ko: 그 요리사가 오늘 밤 특별 요리를 만들었어.

w|koki.en: The new restaurant hired a talented chef.
w|koki.ko: 새 식당이 재능 있는 요리사를 고용했어.

w|kokoh.text: Meski sudah tua, gedung sekolah Budi masih kokoh berdiri.
w|kokoh.en: Although it's old, Budi's school building still stands sturdy.
w|kokoh.ko: 오래됐지만 버디의 학교 건물은 아직 튼튼하게 서 있어요.

w|kokoh.text: Suami Siti memasang tiang kokoh supaya atap teras tidak roboh diterpa angin.
w|kokoh.en: Siti's husband put up a sturdy pole so the porch roof wouldn't collapse in the wind.
w|kokoh.ko: 시티의 남편은 테라스 지붕이 바람에 무너지지 않게 튼튼한 기둥을 세웠어요.

w|kokpit.text: Pilot yang menginap bercerita kepada Rudi tentang suasana di kokpit.
w|kokpit.en: A pilot staying at the hotel told Rudi what it's like in the cockpit.
w|kokpit.ko: 묵고 있던 조종사가 루디에게 조종석 분위기를 이야기해 줬어요.

w|kokpit.text: Dari kokpit, pilot melihat awan hujan yang menggumpal di depan pesawat.
w|kokpit.en: From the cockpit, the pilot saw rain clouds massing ahead of the plane.
w|kokpit.ko: 조종석에서 조종사는 비행기 앞에 뭉쳐 있는 비구름을 봤어요.

w|koktail.text: Agus membeli gelas koktail bergaya lama untuk kafe adiknya.
w|koktail.en: Agus bought vintage cocktail glasses for his sister's café.
w|koktail.ko: 아구스는 여동생 카페에 쓸 옛날식 칵테일 잔을 샀어요.

w|koktail.text: Saat kemarau panjang, Wati membuat koktail buah tanpa alkohol untuk keluarganya.
w|koktail.en: During the long dry season, Wati makes non-alcoholic fruit cocktails for her family.
w|koktail.ko: 긴 건기에 와티는 가족을 위해 무알코올 과일 칵테일을 만들어요.

w|kolam.en: The kids are swimming in the pool.

w|kolam.text: Kolam di halaman belakang cukup dalam.
w|kolam.en: The pond in the backyard is quite deep.

w|kolega.text: Fajar meminta kolega di bagian olahraga memeriksa ejaan nama pemain.
w|kolega.en: Fajar asked a colleague in the sports section to check the spelling of the players' names.
w|kolega.ko: 파자르는 스포츠부 동료에게 선수 이름 철자를 확인해 달라고 했어요.

w|kolega.text: Lestari mengirim foto pantai kepada seorang kolega di kantor.
w|kolega.en: Lestari sent a photo of the beach to a colleague at the office.
w|kolega.ko: 레스타리는 회사 동료에게 해변 사진을 보냈어요.

w|koleksi.text: Di ruang kapolsek terpajang koleksi topi polisi dari berbagai negara.
w|koleksi.en: In the precinct chief's office there is a collection of police caps from various countries.
w|koleksi.ko: 지구대장실에는 여러 나라 경찰 모자가 진열돼 있어요.

w|koleksi.text: Dewi punya koleksi kaus tim basket dari berbagai kota.
w|koleksi.en: Dewi has a collection of basketball team jerseys from various cities.
w|koleksi.ko: 데위는 여러 도시 농구팀 유니폼을 모아요.

w|kolektor.text: Paman Fajar, seorang kolektor keris, memberikan hadiah keris tua kepada pengantin.
w|kolektor.en: Fajar's uncle, a kris collector, gave the couple an old kris as a gift.
w|kolektor.ko: 크리스 단검 수집가인 파자르의 삼촌은 신랑 신부에게 오래된 크리스를 선물했어요.

w|kolektor.text: Lestari mewawancarai kolektor perangko yang punya ribuan koleksi dari seluruh dunia.
w|kolektor.en: Lestari interviewed a stamp collector who has thousands of stamps from around the world.
w|kolektor.ko: 레스타리는 전 세계 우표 수천 장을 가진 우표 수집가를 인터뷰했어요.

w|kolom.text: Di buku tamu pernikahan Fajar, setiap tamu menulis nama di kolom yang sudah disediakan.
w|kolom.en: In Fajar's wedding guest book, each guest wrote their name in the column provided.
w|kolom.ko: 파자르 결혼식 방명록에 손님들은 마련된 칸에 이름을 적었어요.

w|kolom.text: Setiap Minggu, Lestari mengisi kolom opini di halaman belakang koran.
w|kolom.en: Every Sunday, Lestari writes the opinion column on the back page of the paper.
w|kolom.ko: 매주 일요일 레스타리는 신문 뒷면 오피니언 칼럼을 맡아 써요.

w|kolonel.en: The colonel gave a short briefing.

w|koloni.text: Rudi mengamati koloni semut di bawah pohon mangga sekolah.
w|koloni.en: Rudi observed an ant colony under the school's mango tree.
w|koloni.ko: 루디는 학교 망고나무 밑의 개미 군집을 관찰했어요.

w|koloni.text: Di loteng rumah baru, Rina menemukan koloni kelelawar kecil.
w|koloni.en: In the attic of the new house, Rina found a small colony of bats.
w|koloni.ko: 새집 다락에서 리나는 박쥐 무리를 발견했어요.

w|koma.text: Sambil menunggu, Agus membaca berita tentang pasien yang sadar dari koma setelah sebulan.
w|koma.en: While waiting, Agus read a news story about a patient who woke from a coma after a month.
w|koma.ko: 기다리는 동안 아구스는 한 달 만에 혼수상태에서 깨어난 환자 기사를 읽었어요.

w|koma.text: Wati menemukan tumpukan surat lama yang ditulis tanpa titik dan koma.
w|koma.en: Wati found a pile of old letters written without full stops or commas.
w|koma.ko: 와티는 마침표도 쉼표도 없이 쓴 옛 편지 더미를 찾았어요.

w|komandan.en: All the soldiers obey the commander.
The commander gave a clear order.

w|komando.text: Pasukan menunggu komando dari markas pusat.
w|komando.en: The troops await a command from central headquarters.

w|komando.text: Komando itu harus dipatuhi tanpa ragu.
w|komando.en: That command must be obeyed without hesitation.
w|komando.ko: 그 명령은 망설임 없이 따라야 해.

w|kombinasi.text: Guru memberi Budi tantangan menebak kombinasi angka di gembok lemari.
w|kombinasi.en: The teacher challenged Budi to guess the number combination on the locker padlock.
w|kombinasi.ko: 선생님은 부디에게 사물함 자물쇠 번호 조합을 맞혀 보라고 했어요.

w|kombinasi.text: Menu malam itu adalah kombinasi masakan Sunda dan Jawa.
w|kombinasi.en: That evening's menu was a combination of Sundanese and Javanese dishes.
w|kombinasi.ko: 그날 저녁 메뉴는 순다 음식과 자와 음식을 섞은 것이었어요.

w|komedi.text: Eko lebih suka memerankan komedi daripada drama yang serius.
w|komedi.en: Eko prefers acting in comedies over serious dramas.
w|komedi.ko: 에코는 진지한 드라마보다 코미디 연기를 더 좋아해요.

w|komedi.text: Sambil menjaga toko, Ayu menonton komedi lama di ponselnya.
w|komedi.en: While minding the shop, Ayu watches old comedies on her phone.
w|komedi.ko: 가게를 보면서 아유는 휴대폰으로 옛날 코미디를 봐요.

w|komentar.text: Di buku tamu, Dimas menulis komentar tentang koleksi komik yang kurang lengkap.
w|komentar.en: In the guestbook, Dimas wrote a comment about the incomplete comic collection.
w|komentar.ko: 방명록에 디마스는 만화책이 부족하다는 의견을 적었어요.

w|komentar.text: Putri menulis komentar positif tentang kebersihan kereta di aplikasi.
w|komentar.en: Putri wrote a positive comment about the train's cleanliness in the app.
w|komentar.ko: 푸트리는 앱에 기차가 깨끗하다는 좋은 후기를 남겼어요.

w|komersial.text: Gedung yang dibangun Agus nanti akan dipakai untuk kantor dan toko komersial.
w|komersial.en: The building Agus is constructing will be used for offices and commercial shops.
w|komersial.ko: 아구스가 짓는 건물은 나중에 사무실과 상가로 쓰일 거예요.

w|komersial.text: Dulu Wati hanya membeli dari toko komersial besar, sekarang dari penjual rumahan juga.
w|komersial.en: Wati used to buy only from big commercial stores, but now she buys from home sellers too.
w|komersial.ko: 와티는 예전엔 큰 상업 매장에서만 샀지만 이제는 집에서 파는 판매자에게서도 사요.

w|komet.text: Kata pemandu, komet terakhir terlihat dari bukit ini bertahun-tahun yang lalu.
w|komet.en: According to the guide, the last comet was seen from this hill years ago.
w|komet.ko: 가이드 말로는 이 언덕에서 마지막으로 혜성이 보인 건 몇 년 전이래요.

w|komet.text: Lagu penutup bercerita tentang komet yang hanya lewat sekali seumur hidup.
w|komet.en: The closing song is about a comet that passes only once in a lifetime.
w|komet.ko: 마지막 곡은 평생 한 번만 지나가는 혜성에 대한 노래예요.

w|komik.text: Andi suka menggambar komik di halaman belakang buku tulisnya.
w|komik.en: Andi likes drawing comics on the back pages of his notebook.
w|komik.ko: 안디는 공책 뒷장에 만화 그리는 걸 좋아해요.

w|komik.text: Dewi membelikan keponakannya komik baru sebagai hadiah tahun baru.
w|komik.en: Dewi bought her nephew a new comic as a New Year's gift.
w|komik.ko: 데위는 조카에게 새해 선물로 새 만화책을 사 줬어요.

w|komisaris.text: Ayah Budi, seorang komisaris perusahaan asuransi, datang memberi ceramah tentang karier.
w|komisaris.en: Budi's father, a commissioner at an insurance company, came to give a talk about careers.
w|komisaris.ko: 보험 회사 감사인 부디 아버지가 진로 강연을 하러 오셨어요.

w|komisaris.text: Pemilik rumah yang disewa Siti ternyata seorang komisaris bank yang ramah.
w|komisaris.en: The owner of the house Siti rented turned out to be a friendly bank commissioner.
w|komisaris.ko: 시티가 세 든 집의 주인은 알고 보니 친절한 은행 감사였어요.

w|komisi.text: Pelayan di restoran itu mendapat komisi kecil dari setiap botol jus yang terjual.
w|komisi.en: The waiters at that restaurant get a small commission on every bottle of juice sold.
w|komisi.ko: 그 식당 종업원들은 주스가 한 병 팔릴 때마다 작은 수수료를 받아요.

w|komisi.text: Teman Lestari menitipkan lukisan dan memberi Lestari komisi dari setiap penjualan.
w|komisi.en: Lestari's friend left paintings with her and gives Lestari a commission on every sale.
w|komisi.ko: 레스타리의 친구는 그림을 맡기고 팔릴 때마다 레스타리에게 수수료를 줘요.

w|komite.text: Laporan tentang pengacara itu akan diperiksa oleh komite etik.
w|komite.en: The report about that lawyer will be examined by the ethics committee.
w|komite.ko: 그 변호사에 대한 신고는 윤리 위원회가 조사할 거예요.

w|komite.text: Tahun ini Lestari diangkat menjadi anggota komite pedagang pasar.
w|komite.en: This year Lestari was appointed a member of the market traders' committee.
w|komite.ko: 레스타리는 올해 시장 상인 위원회 위원이 됐어요.

w|kompas.text: Kakek Dimas memberinya kompas tua sebagai kenang-kenangan perjalanan.
w|kompas.en: Dimas's grandfather gave him an old compass as a travel keepsake.
w|kompas.ko: 디마스의 할아버지는 여행 기념으로 낡은 나침반을 주셨어요.

w|kompas.text: Putri ingin visi perusahaan menjadi kompas bagi setiap keputusan tim.
w|kompas.en: Putri wants the company's vision to be a compass for every team decision.
w|kompas.ko: 푸트리는 회사 비전이 팀의 모든 결정에 나침반이 되기를 바라요.

w|kompensasi.text: Pekerja yang terluka di proyek berhak mendapat kompensasi dari perusahaan.
w|kompensasi.en: Workers injured on the project are entitled to compensation from the company.
w|kompensasi.ko: 현장에서 다친 인부는 회사로부터 보상을 받을 권리가 있어요.

w|kompensasi.text: Karena paketnya terlambat seminggu, Wati mendapat kompensasi berupa voucher belanja.
w|kompensasi.en: Because her package was a week late, Wati received compensation in the form of a shopping voucher.
w|kompensasi.ko: 택배가 일주일 늦어서 와티는 쇼핑 쿠폰으로 보상을 받았어요.

w|kompeten.text: Andi hanya mau bekerja dengan tukang las yang kompeten.
w|kompeten.en: Andi only wants to work with competent welders.
w|kompeten.ko: 안디는 실력 있는 용접공하고만 일하려고 해요.

w|kompeten.text: Dewi memuji Rudi sebagai dokter yang kompeten dan ramah.
w|kompeten.en: Dewi praised Rudi as a competent and friendly doctor.
w|kompeten.ko: 데위는 루디를 실력 있고 친절한 의사라고 칭찬했어요.

w|kompetisi.en: The cooking competition will be held next week.

w|kompetisi.text: Dia ikut kompetisi menulis di sekolah.
w|kompetisi.en: She joined a writing competition at school.

w|kompetitif.text: Harga menu di restoran Eko cukup kompetitif dibanding restoran lain di jalan itu.
w|kompetitif.en: The menu prices at Eko's restaurant are quite competitive compared to others on that street.
w|kompetitif.ko: 에코네 식당의 메뉴 가격은 그 거리의 다른 식당에 비해 꽤 경쟁력이 있어요.

w|kompetitif.text: Lomba foto musim hujan di kampus Ayu tahun ini sangat kompetitif.
w|kompetitif.en: The rainy-season photo contest at Ayu's campus is very competitive this year.
w|kompetitif.ko: 올해 아유네 학교 우기 사진 대회는 경쟁이 아주 치열해요.

w|kompleks.text: Soal matematika nomor terakhir terlalu kompleks untuk Budi.
w|kompleks.en: The last maths problem was too complex for Budi.
w|kompleks.ko: 마지막 수학 문제는 부디에게 너무 복잡했어요.

w|kompleks.text: Rudi menceritakan masalah keluarganya yang ternyata cukup kompleks.
w|kompleks.en: Rudi talked about his family problems, which turned out to be quite complicated.
w|kompleks.ko: 루디가 털어놓은 집안 문제는 꽤 복잡했어요.

w|komplikasi.text: Dokter mewaspadai komplikasi, sementara Budi mencatat tekanan darah setiap jam.
w|komplikasi.en: The doctor watched for complications while Budi recorded the blood pressure every hour.
w|komplikasi.ko: 의사는 합병증을 경계했고 부디는 매시간 혈압을 기록했어요.

w|komplikasi.text: Siti pulang lebih cepat karena ibunya mengalami komplikasi setelah operasi.
w|komplikasi.en: Siti went home early because her mother had complications after surgery.
w|komplikasi.ko: 어머니가 수술 후 합병증을 겪어서 시티는 일찍 돌아왔어요.

w|komplotan.text: Bayu menulis laporan tentang komplotan penipu yang menjual tiket konser palsu.
w|komplotan.en: Bayu wrote a report on a gang of swindlers selling fake concert tickets.
w|komplotan.ko: 바유는 가짜 콘서트 표를 판 사기단에 대한 기사를 썼어요.

w|komplotan.text: Dulu ada komplotan pencuri kayu di hutan, tapi warga desa Intan berhasil mengusir mereka.
w|komplotan.en: There used to be a gang of timber thieves in the forest, but Intan's villagers managed to drive them out.
w|komplotan.ko: 예전에 숲에 나무 도둑 무리가 있었지만 인탄네 마을 사람들이 쫓아냈어요.

w|komponen.text: Fajar menulis tentang pabrik yang kekurangan komponen elektronik.
w|komponen.en: Fajar wrote about factories that are short of electronic components.
w|komponen.ko: 파자르는 전자 부품이 부족한 공장들에 대해 썼어요.

w|komponen.text: Bengkel kecil itu tidak punya komponen yang dibutuhkan mobil Lestari.
w|komponen.en: The small repair shop didn't have the part Lestari's car needed.
w|komponen.ko: 그 작은 정비소에는 레스타리의 차에 필요한 부품이 없었어요.

w|kompor.text: Agus lupa mematikan kompor dan panci hampir gosong.
w|kompor.en: Agus forgot to turn off the stove and the pot nearly burned.
w|kompor.ko: 아구스는 가스레인지 끄는 걸 잊어서 냄비를 태울 뻔했어요.

w|kompor.text: Wati membeli kompor baru dengan empat tungku.
w|kompor.en: Wati bought a new stove with four burners.
w|kompor.ko: 와티는 화구가 네 개인 새 레인지를 샀어요.

w|komposisi.text: Hakim memeriksa komposisi bahan kimia dalam laporan laboratorium dengan teliti.
w|komposisi.en: The judge carefully examined the chemical composition in the lab report.
w|komposisi.ko: 판사는 실험실 보고서의 화학 성분 구성을 꼼꼼히 살폈어요.

w|komposisi.text: Wati mengubah komposisi bumbu soto agar rasanya tidak terlalu asin.
w|komposisi.en: Wati changed the spice mix of the soto so it wouldn't taste too salty.
w|komposisi.ko: 와티는 소토가 너무 짜지 않도록 양념 배합을 바꿨어요.

w|komunikasi.text: Komunikasi yang jelas mencegah salah paham.

w|komunikasi.en: They improved communication within the team.

w|komunis.text: Di pelajaran sejarah, Andi membaca tentang partai komunis yang pernah ada di banyak negara.
w|komunis.en: In history class, Andi read about the communist parties that once existed in many countries.
w|komunis.ko: 역사 시간에 안디는 한때 여러 나라에 있었던 공산당에 대해 읽었어요.

w|komunis.text: Paman Dewi bercerita tentang film lama berlatar negara komunis.
w|komunis.en: Dewi's uncle talked about an old film set in a communist country.
w|komunis.ko: 데위의 삼촌은 공산주의 국가를 배경으로 한 옛 영화 이야기를 했어요.

w|komunitas.en: The local community held a village cleanup.

w|komunitas.text: Dia aktif di komunitas pecinta buku.
w|komunitas.en: She is active in a book lovers' community.

w|konduktor.text: Budi mengamati gerakan konduktor saat paduan suara sekolah berlatih.
w|konduktor.en: Budi watched the conductor's movements while the school choir practiced.
w|konduktor.ko: 부디는 학교 합창단 연습 때 지휘자의 동작을 지켜봤어요.

w|konduktor.text: Siti meminta konduktor bus bandara menurunkannya di terminal dua.
w|konduktor.en: Siti asked the airport bus conductor to drop her off at terminal two.
w|konduktor.ko: 시티는 공항버스 차장에게 제2터미널에서 내려 달라고 했어요.

w|koneksi.text: Koneksi internet di rumah sangat lambat.
w|koneksi.en: The internet connection at home is very slow.

w|koneksi.text: Dia kehilangan koneksi saat rapat daring.
w|koneksi.en: He lost the connection during the online meeting.

w|konferensi.text: Konferensi internasional diadakan di hotel besar.
w|konferensi.en: The international conference was held at a large hotel.

w|konferensi.text: Pembicara utama membuka konferensi pagi ini.
w|konferensi.en: The keynote speaker opened the conference this morning.
w|konferensi.ko: 기조 연사가 오늘 아침 회의를 열었어.

w|konfirmasi.text: Rudi menunggu konfirmasi dari museum soal jadwal kunjungan rombongannya.
w|konfirmasi.en: Rudi is waiting for confirmation from the museum about his group's visit schedule.
w|konfirmasi.ko: 루디는 단체 방문 일정에 대해 박물관의 확인을 기다리고 있어요.

w|konfirmasi.text: Pemasok belum memberi konfirmasi apakah kiriman tomat datang besok.
w|konfirmasi.en: The supplier hasn't confirmed whether the tomato delivery is coming tomorrow.
w|konfirmasi.ko: 납품업자는 토마토가 내일 들어오는지 아직 확인해 주지 않았어요.

w|konflik.text: Inti cerita drama itu adalah konflik antara dua bersaudara.
w|konflik.en: The heart of that play is the conflict between two siblings.
w|konflik.ko: 두 형제 사이의 갈등이 그 연극의 중심이에요.

w|konflik.text: Intan berusaha menghindari konflik dengan bagian keuangan.
w|konflik.en: Intan tries to avoid conflict with the finance department.

w|konglomerat.text: Andi sedang menyelidiki konglomerat yang membeli banyak lahan di pesisir.
w|konglomerat.en: Andi is investigating a conglomerate that bought up lots of coastal land.
w|konglomerat.ko: 안디는 해안 땅을 대거 사들인 재벌 기업을 취재하고 있어요.

w|konglomerat.text: Rumah baru Dewi ada di kompleks milik konglomerat properti.
w|konglomerat.en: Dewi's new house is in a housing complex owned by a property conglomerate.
w|konglomerat.ko: 데위의 새 집은 부동산 재벌 그룹이 소유한 단지 안에 있어요.

w|kongres.text: Ketua OSIS mewakili sekolah di kongres pelajar tingkat nasional.
w|kongres.en: The student council president represented the school at the national student congress.
w|kongres.ko: 학생회장이 전국 학생 대회에 학교 대표로 나갔어요.

w|kongres.text: Di antara barang lama, Siti menemukan foto ayahnya saat menghadiri kongres guru.
w|kongres.en: Among her old things, Siti found a photo of her father attending a teachers' congress.
w|kongres.ko: 옛 물건 사이에서 시티는 아버지가 교사 대회에 참석했을 때 사진을 찾았어요.

w|konsekuensi.text: Setiap keputusan punya konsekuensi jangka panjang.

w|konsekuensi.en: The consequence of his lateness was quite serious.

w|konseling.text: Apotek tempat Fajar bekerja menyediakan konseling gratis soal penggunaan obat.
w|konseling.en: The pharmacy where Fajar works offers free counseling on how to use medicines.
w|konseling.ko: 파자르가 일하는 약국은 약 복용에 대한 무료 상담을 해 줘요.

w|konseling.text: Kantor menawarkan konseling bagi karyawan baru yang merasa tertekan.
w|konseling.en: The office offers counseling to new employees who feel stressed.
w|konseling.ko: 회사는 스트레스를 받는 신입 직원에게 상담을 제공해요.

w|konselor.text: Eko berbicara dengan konselor karier sebelum pindah ke dunia kuliner.
w|konselor.en: Eko talked to a career counselor before moving into the culinary world.
w|konselor.ko: 에코는 요리 업계로 옮기기 전에 진로 상담사와 이야기했어요.

w|konselor.text: Ayu bercerita kepada konselor kampus bahwa musim hujan membuatnya murung.
w|konselor.en: Ayu told the campus counselor that the rainy season makes her gloomy.
w|konselor.ko: 아유는 학교 상담사에게 우기만 되면 우울해진다고 털어놓았어요.

w|konsentrasi.text: Suara bor dari gedung sebelah mengganggu konsentrasi murid yang sedang ujian.
w|konsentrasi.en: The sound of a drill from the next building disturbed the concentration of the students taking an exam.
w|konsentrasi.ko: 옆 건물의 드릴 소리가 시험 보는 학생들의 집중을 방해했어요.

w|konsentrasi.text: Siti butuh konsentrasi penuh untuk merakit lemari baru tanpa petunjuk.
w|konsentrasi.en: Siti needed full concentration to assemble the new wardrobe without instructions.
w|konsentrasi.ko: 시티는 설명서 없이 새 옷장을 조립하느라 온 정신을 집중해야 했어요.

w|konsep.text: Pemimpin redaksi menjelaskan konsep rubrik baru tentang anak muda.
w|konsep.en: The editor-in-chief explained the concept of a new section about young people.
w|konsep.ko: 편집국장이 청년을 다룰 새 꼭지의 구상을 설명했어요.

w|konsep.text: Ayu ingin mengubah toko menjadi kafe servis, sebuah konsep yang belum ada di kotanya.
w|konsep.en: Ayu wants to turn the shop into a repair café, a concept that doesn't exist in her town yet.
w|konsep.ko: 아유는 가게를 수리 카페로 바꾸고 싶어 해요. 아직 그 동네엔 없는 개념이에요.

w|konser.text: Sekolah Budi mengadakan konser amal di aula hari Sabtu.
w|konser.en: Budi's school is holding a charity concert in the hall on Saturday.
w|konser.ko: 부디네 학교는 토요일에 강당에서 자선 콘서트를 열어요.

w|konser.text: Saat merapikan laci, Siti menemukan tiket konser lama dari masa kuliah.
w|konser.en: While tidying a drawer, Siti found an old concert ticket from her college days.
w|konser.ko: 서랍을 정리하다가 시티는 대학 시절 콘서트 표를 찾았어요.

w|konservatif.text: Pembaca koran itu kebanyakan orang tua yang punya pandangan konservatif.
w|konservatif.en: Most of the paper's readers are older people with conservative views.
w|konservatif.ko: 그 신문 독자는 대부분 보수적인 생각을 가진 어르신들이에요.

w|konservatif.text: Ibu Intan masih konservatif dan lebih percaya belanja langsung di pasar.
w|konservatif.en: Intan's mother is still conservative and trusts shopping in person at the market more.
w|konservatif.ko: 인탄의 엄마는 아직 보수적이라 시장에서 직접 사는 걸 더 믿어요.

w|konsisten.text: Kalau mau hasilnya bagus, ukuran potongan sayur harus konsisten, kata instruktur.
w|konsisten.en: If you want good results, the vegetable pieces have to be a consistent size, the instructor said.
w|konsisten.ko: 결과가 좋으려면 채소 크기가 일정해야 한다고 강사가 말했어요.

w|konsisten.text: Selama belasan tahun, Dewi konsisten membalas surat Rani setiap bulan.
w|konsisten.en: For more than ten years, Dewi has consistently replied to Rani's letters every month.
w|konsisten.ko: 십수 년 동안 데위는 매달 꾸준히 라니의 편지에 답장했어요.

w|konspirasi.text: Rina menuduh Budi dan Ibu membuat konspirasi untuk menyalahkannya.
w|konspirasi.en: Rina accused Budi and Mom of a conspiracy to blame her.
w|konspirasi.ko: 리나는 부디와 엄마가 자기를 탓하려고 짜고 있다고 몰아붙였어요.

w|konspirasi.text: Siti bercanda ada konspirasi kardus yang selalu hilang saat dicari.
w|konspirasi.en: Siti joked that there was a conspiracy of boxes that always vanish when you look for them.
w|konspirasi.ko: 시티는 찾을 때마다 사라지는 상자들의 음모가 있다고 농담했어요.

w|konstan.text: Angin laut yang konstan membuat layang-layang Eko terbang tinggi sepanjang sore.
w|konstan.en: The constant sea breeze kept Eko's kite flying high all afternoon.
w|konstan.ko: 꾸준한 바닷바람 덕분에 에코의 연이 오후 내내 높이 날았어요.

w|konstan.text: Suara bor yang konstan membuat Ayu memejamkan mata erat-erat.
w|konstan.en: The constant sound of the drill made Ayu squeeze her eyes shut.
w|konstan.ko: 계속되는 드릴 소리에 아유는 눈을 꼭 감았어요.

w|konstitusi.text: Budi harus menghafal pembukaan konstitusi untuk ujian lisan.
w|konstitusi.en: Budi has to memorize the preamble of the constitution for the oral exam.
w|konstitusi.ko: 부디는 구술시험을 위해 헌법 전문을 외워야 해요.

w|konstitusi.text: Siti membaca buku saku tentang konstitusi negara tujuan sebelum mendarat.
w|konstitusi.en: Siti read a pocket book about her destination country's constitution before landing.
w|konstitusi.ko: 시티는 착륙 전에 목적지 나라의 헌법에 관한 소책자를 읽었어요.

w|konstruksi.text: Rudi sudah bekerja di dunia konstruksi sejak umur belasan.
w|konstruksi.en: Rudi has worked in construction since he was a teenager.
w|konstruksi.ko: 루디는 십 대 때부터 건설 일을 해 왔어요.

w|konstruksi.text: Kantor Rina berada di gedung yang masih dalam tahap konstruksi di lantai atas.
w|konstruksi.en: Rina's office is in a building whose upper floors are still under construction.
w|konstruksi.ko: 리나의 사무실 건물은 위층이 아직 공사 중이에요.

w|konsul.text: Sidang itu juga dihadiri seorang konsul karena terdakwanya warga negara asing.
w|konsul.en: The hearing was also attended by a consul because the defendant was a foreign national.
w|konsul.ko: 피고인이 외국인이라서 그 재판에는 영사도 참석했어요.

w|konsul.text: Seorang konsul dan keluarganya pernah makan malam di restoran Wati.
w|konsul.en: A consul and his family once had dinner at Wati's restaurant.
w|konsul.ko: 한 영사와 가족이 와티네 식당에서 저녁을 먹은 적이 있어요.

w|konsulat.text: Seorang tamu meminta Rudi mencarikan alamat konsulat terdekat.
w|konsulat.en: A guest asked Rudi to find the address of the nearest consulate.
w|konsulat.ko: 한 손님이 루디에게 가장 가까운 영사관 주소를 찾아 달라고 했어요.

w|konsulat.text: Rina mengajukan visa di konsulat agar bisa melihat bunga sakura pada musim semi.
w|konsulat.en: Rina applied for a visa at the consulate so she could see the cherry blossoms in spring.
w|konsulat.ko: 리나는 봄에 벚꽃을 보려고 영사관에 비자를 신청했어요.

w|konsultan.text: Perusahaan media itu menyewa konsultan untuk merancang ulang situs berita.
w|konsultan.en: The media company hired a consultant to redesign the news website.
w|konsultan.ko: 그 언론사는 뉴스 사이트를 새로 설계하려고 컨설턴트를 고용했어요.

w|konsultan.text: Seorang konsultan arsitektur memeriksa gedung perpustakaan yang retak.
w|konsultan.en: An architectural consultant inspected the cracked library building.
w|konsultan.ko: 건축 컨설턴트가 금이 간 도서관 건물을 점검했어요.

w|kontainer.text: Truk kontainer yang berderet di jalan pelabuhan membuat Bayu terjebak macet.
w|kontainer.en: The container trucks lined up on the port road left Bayu stuck in traffic.
w|kontainer.ko: 항구 길에 줄지은 컨테이너 트럭 때문에 바유는 차가 막혀 꼼짝 못 했어요.

w|kontainer.text: Intan menyimpan sisa cat di kontainer plastik bertutup rapat.
w|kontainer.en: Intan keeps leftover paint in a tightly sealed plastic container.
w|kontainer.ko: 인탄은 남은 물감을 뚜껑을 꽉 닫은 플라스틱 통에 보관해요.

w|kontes.text: Museum mengadakan kontes menggambar fosil untuk anak-anak.
w|kontes.en: The museum is holding a fossil drawing contest for children.
w|kontes.ko: 박물관이 어린이 화석 그리기 대회를 열어요.

w|kontes.text: Rina ikut kontes menata lapak yang diadakan pengelola pasar.
w|kontes.en: Rina entered the stall-arranging contest held by the market management.
w|kontes.ko: 리나는 시장 관리소가 연 좌판 꾸미기 대회에 나갔어요.

w|kontestan.text: Rekan-rekan baru tahu bahwa Bayu dulu kontestan lomba menyanyi di televisi.
w|kontestan.en: The coworkers just found out that Bayu used to be a contestant on a TV singing contest.
w|kontestan.ko: 동료들은 바유가 예전에 TV 노래 대회 참가자였다는 걸 막 알았어요.

w|kontestan.text: Intan melatih kontestan lomba binaraga di gym itu.
w|kontestan.en: Intan trains bodybuilding contestants at that gym.
w|kontestan.ko: 인탄은 그 헬스장에서 보디빌딩 대회 참가자들을 지도해요.

w|kontrak.text: Kontrak kerja itu berakhir bulan depan.
w|kontrak.en: That work contract ends next month.
w|kontrak.ko: 그 근로 계약이 다음 달에 끝나.

w|kontrak.en: They signed a new contract yesterday.

w|kontraktor.text: Sebuah kontraktor sedang memperbaiki atap gudang yang bocor.
w|kontraktor.en: A contractor is repairing the leaking warehouse roof.
w|kontraktor.ko: 한 시공업체가 새는 창고 지붕을 고치고 있어요.

w|kontraktor.text: Suami Sari bekerja sebagai kontraktor yang membangun rumah-rumah di desa.
w|kontraktor.en: Sari's husband works as a contractor building houses in the village.
w|kontraktor.ko: 사리의 남편은 마을에 집을 짓는 시공업자로 일해요.

w|kontrol.en: He lost control of the car.
Quality control is done every day.

w|kontroversial.text: Rencana memindahkan pasar tradisional menjadi isu kontroversial di meja Fajar.
w|kontroversial.en: The plan to move the traditional market became a controversial issue on Fajar's desk.
w|kontroversial.ko: 전통 시장 이전 계획은 파자르의 책상 위에서 논란거리가 됐어요.

w|kontroversial.text: Kenaikan biaya pengelolaan jadi topik kontroversial di grup penghuni yang diikuti Lestari.
w|kontroversial.en: The rise in maintenance fees became a controversial topic in the residents' group Lestari is in.
w|kontroversial.ko: 관리비 인상은 레스타리가 있는 입주자 단톡방에서 논란이 됐어요.

w|konvensi.text: Budi menulis ringkasan tentang konvensi hak anak untuk tugas kewarganegaraan.
w|konvensi.en: Budi wrote a summary of the convention on children's rights for his civics assignment.
w|konvensi.ko: 부디는 시민 수업 과제로 아동권리협약 요약문을 썼어요.

w|konvensi.text: Siti terbang ke ibu kota untuk menghadiri konvensi dokter gigi.
w|konvensi.en: Siti flew to the capital to attend a dentists' convention.
w|konvensi.ko: 시티는 치과의사 대회에 참석하려고 수도로 날아갔어요.

w|konvoi.text: Sebuah konvoi motor dari kota datang ke pantai tempat Eko bertugas.
w|konvoi.en: A convoy of motorbikes from the city came to the beach where Eko works.
w|konvoi.ko: 도시에서 온 오토바이 행렬이 에코가 근무하는 해변에 왔어요.

w|konvoi.text: Perjalanan Ayu ke klinik tersendat karena ada konvoi pengantin di jalan.
w|konvoi.en: Ayu's trip to the clinic was held up by a wedding convoy on the road.
w|konvoi.ko: 길에 결혼식 차량 행렬이 있어서 아유는 병원 가는 길이 막혔어요.

w|koordinat.text: Agus memasukkan koordinat air terjun itu ke aplikasi peta.
w|koordinat.en: Agus entered the waterfall's coordinates into the map app.
w|koordinat.ko: 아구스는 폭포 좌표를 지도 앱에 입력했어요.

w|koordinat.text: Wati mengirim koordinat pintu belakang mal kepada kurir yang tersesat.
w|koordinat.en: Wati sent the coordinates of the mall's back door to a lost courier.
w|koordinat.ko: 와티는 길을 잃은 택배 기사에게 쇼핑몰 뒷문 좌표를 보냈어요.

w|koper.text: Koper itu terlalu berat untuk digotong sendiri.
w|koper.en: That suitcase is too heavy to carry alone.
w|koper.ko: 그 여행 가방은 혼자 들기엔 너무 무거워.

w|koper.en: She packed the suitcase before flying.
w|koper.ko: 그녀는 비행 전에 여행 가방을 쌌어.

w|koran.en: The morning newspaper carries big news.
Grandfather reads the newspaper on the porch.

w|korban.en: The police helped the victim quickly.

w|korek.text: Lampu mati, jadi Andi menyalakan lilin dengan korek api.
w|korek.en: The power went out, so Andi lit a candle with a match.
w|korek.ko: 전기가 나가서 안디는 성냥으로 촛불을 켰어요.

w|korek.text: Petugas kereta menyita korek gas milik penumpang yang mencoba merokok.
w|korek.en: The train officer confiscated the lighter of a passenger who tried to smoke.
w|korek.ko: 열차 직원이 담배를 피우려던 승객의 라이터를 압수했어요.

w|koridor.text: Andi mengecat koridor sempit di rumah itu dengan warna putih agar terlihat lebih luas.
w|koridor.en: Andi painted the narrow corridor in the house white to make it look more spacious.
w|koridor.ko: 안디는 집의 좁은 복도를 더 넓어 보이도록 하얗게 칠했어요.

w|koridor.text: Dewi berjalan di koridor kereta menuju gerbong makan.
w|koridor.en: Dewi walks along the train corridor to the dining car.
w|koridor.ko: 데위는 식당칸으로 가려고 열차 복도를 걸어요.

w|koroner.text: Ayah Agus berhenti jadi kuli bangunan setelah dokter menemukan penyakit jantung koroner.
w|koroner.en: Agus's father stopped working as a construction laborer after the doctor found coronary heart disease.
w|koroner.ko: 아구스의 아버지는 의사가 관상동맥 심장병을 발견한 뒤 건설 일을 그만뒀어요.

w|koroner.text: Wati membeli alat pengukur tekanan darah untuk ayahnya yang punya penyakit jantung koroner.
w|koroner.en: Wati bought a blood pressure monitor for her father, who has coronary heart disease.
w|koroner.ko: 와티는 관상동맥 심장병이 있는 아버지를 위해 혈압계를 샀어요.

w|korps.text: Budi bergabung dengan korps musik sekolah sebagai pemain drum.
w|korps.en: Budi joined the school marching band corps as a drummer.
w|korps.ko: 부디는 드럼 연주자로 학교 군악대에 들어갔어요.

w|korps.text: Siti melihat anggota korps diplomatik dijemput di pintu khusus.
w|korps.en: Siti saw members of the diplomatic corps being met at a special gate.
w|korps.ko: 시티는 외교단 일원들이 전용 출입구에서 영접받는 걸 봤어요.

w|korup.text: Dalam drama kelas, Dimas memerankan pejabat korup yang akhirnya ditangkap.
w|korup.en: In the class play, Dimas played a corrupt official who is eventually arrested.
w|korup.ko: 반 연극에서 디마스는 결국 체포되는 부패 관리를 연기했어요.

w|korup.text: Putri menolak menyuap petugas korup yang meminta uang izin tambahan.
w|korup.en: Putri refused to bribe a corrupt officer who asked for extra permit money.
w|korup.ko: 푸트리는 허가비를 더 요구한 부패 공무원에게 뇌물을 주지 않았어요.

w|korupsi.text: Dalam lomba pidato, Rudi membahas bahaya korupsi bagi generasi muda.
w|korupsi.en: In the speech contest, Rudi discussed the dangers of corruption for the young generation.
w|korupsi.ko: 웅변 대회에서 루디는 젊은 세대에게 부패가 얼마나 위험한지 이야기했어요.

w|korupsi.text: Rina lega karena kantor kelurahan barunya bebas pungli dan korupsi.
w|korupsi.en: Rina was relieved that her new village office was free of illegal fees and corruption.
w|korupsi.ko: 리나는 새 동사무소에 뒷돈이나 부패가 없어서 안심했어요.

w|kosmik.text: Di bawah langit tanpa polusi, Eko merasa kecil di hadapan debu kosmik yang berkilauan.
w|kosmik.en: Under the unpolluted sky, Eko felt small before the glittering cosmic dust.
w|kosmik.ko: 오염 없는 하늘 아래서 에코는 반짝이는 우주 먼지 앞에 자신이 작게 느껴졌어요.

w|kosmik.text: Penyelenggara memberi tema kosmik pada maraton malam itu, lengkap dengan lampu bintang.
w|kosmik.en: The organizers gave the night marathon a cosmic theme, complete with star lights.
w|kosmik.ko: 주최 측은 그 야간 마라톤을 별 조명까지 단 우주 테마로 꾸몄어요.

w|kosmos.text: Malam di desa terasa sunyi, dan Budi suka membaca buku tentang kosmos sambil berbaring di teras.
w|kosmos.en: Nights in the village are quiet, and Budi likes reading books about the cosmos while lying on the porch.
w|kosmos.ko: 마을의 밤은 고요하고, 부디는 테라스에 누워 우주에 관한 책 읽는 걸 좋아해요.

w|kosmos.text: Saat istirahat, Siti dan seorang pelayan mengobrol tentang film dokumenter soal kosmos.
w|kosmos.en: On their break, Siti and a waiter chatted about a documentary on the cosmos.
w|kosmos.ko: 쉬는 시간에 시티는 종업원과 우주에 관한 다큐멘터리 이야기를 나눴어요.

w|kostum.en: His stage costume is very colorful.
The children wore cute animal costumes.

w|kotak.en: That box is full of stuff.
Put the letter in the box.

w|kreatif.text: Kelas seni membuat Ayu jadi lebih kreatif dalam memecahkan masalah.
w|kreatif.en: Art class has made Ayu more creative at solving problems.
w|kreatif.ko: 미술 수업 덕분에 아유는 문제를 더 창의적으로 풀게 됐어요.

w|kredit.en: His bank loan is almost paid off.

w|kredit.text: Dia membayar belanja dengan kartu kredit.
w|kredit.en: She paid for shopping with a credit card.

w|kriket.ko: 한 장면에서는 두 청년이 공원에서 크리켓을 해요.

w|kriket.text: Anak-anak desa belajar main kriket dari relawan yang datang ke sekolah.
w|kriket.en: The village children learned to play cricket from volunteers who came to the school.
w|kriket.ko: 마을 아이들은 학교에 온 봉사자들에게 크리켓을 배웠어요.

w|krim.text: Oleskan krim ke kulit yang kering.
w|krim.en: Apply cream to the dry skin.
That chocolate cream is very sweet.

w|kriminal.en: The police arrested a dangerous criminal.

w|krisis.text: Guru ekonomi meminta murid menulis esai tentang krisis pangan.
w|krisis.en: The economics teacher asked the students to write an essay about the food crisis.
w|krisis.ko: 경제 선생님이 학생들에게 식량 위기에 관한 글을 쓰라고 했어요.

w|krisis.text: Siti sempat panik, tapi krisis selesai saat truk pindahan akhirnya datang.
w|krisis.en: Siti panicked for a while, but the crisis was over when the moving truck finally arrived.
w|krisis.ko: 시티는 잠깐 당황했지만 이삿짐 트럭이 마침내 오자 위기는 끝났어요.

w|kristal.text: Vas kristal itu berkilau di bawah lampu.
w|kristal.en: That crystal vase sparkles under the lamp.
w|kristal.ko: 그 크리스탈 꽃병이 조명 아래 반짝여.

w|kristal.text: Kristal es mulai terbentuk di jendela.
w|kristal.en: Ice crystals began to form on the window.

w|kristen.en: The Christian community held a charity event.

w|kristen.text: Temannya yang kristen mengajaknya ke kebaktian.
w|kristen.en: His Christian friend invited him to a service.

w|kritikus.text: Seorang kritikus film menulis kolom mingguan di koran tempat Andi bekerja.
w|kritikus.en: A film critic writes a weekly column in the newspaper where Andi works.
w|kritikus.ko: 한 영화 평론가가 안디가 일하는 신문에 주간 칼럼을 써요.

w|kritikus.text: Adik Dewi bertingkah seperti kritikus makanan saat mencoba warung baru di dekat rumah.
w|kritikus.en: Dewi's younger sibling acted like a food critic when trying the new stall near the house.
w|kritikus.ko: 데위 동생은 집 근처 새 식당에 가서 음식 평론가처럼 굴었어요.

w|kritis.text: Seorang kritikus menulis ulasan yang cukup kritis tentang naskah baru itu.
w|kritis.en: A critic wrote a rather critical review of the new script.
w|kritis.ko: 한 평론가가 그 새 대본에 대해 꽤 비판적인 평을 썼어요.

w|kritis.text: Intan selalu bersikap kritis saat membaca proposal dari vendor.
w|kritis.en: Intan is always critical when reading proposals from vendors.
w|kritis.ko: 인탄은 업체 제안서를 읽을 때 늘 꼼꼼하게 따져 봐요.

w|kru.en: The film crew is busy setting up cameras.
The captain spoke with the ship crew.

w|ksatria.text: Ksatria itu melindungi desa dari bahaya.
w|ksatria.en: That knight protected the village from danger.

w|ksatria.ko: 어린아이는 강한 기사가 되고 싶어 해.

w|kualifikasi.text: Fajar membaca daftar kualifikasi untuk posisi manajer yang baru dibuka.
w|kualifikasi.en: Fajar read the list of qualifications for the newly opened manager position.
w|kualifikasi.ko: 파자르는 새로 난 관리자 자리의 자격 요건을 읽었어요.

w|kualifikasi.text: Bagi Lestari, kemauan belajar lebih penting daripada kualifikasi di atas kertas.
w|kualifikasi.en: For Lestari, willingness to learn matters more than qualifications on paper.
w|kualifikasi.ko: 레스타리에게는 서류상 자격보다 배우려는 마음이 더 중요해요.

w|kualitas.text: Rekaman kamera itu kualitas gambarnya rendah, jadi wajah pelaku sulit dikenali.
w|kualitas.en: The camera footage had low image quality, so the suspect's face was hard to identify.
w|kualitas.ko: 그 카메라 영상은 화질이 낮아서 범인 얼굴을 알아보기 어려웠어요.

w|kualitas.text: Pelatih lebih mementingkan kualitas latihan daripada lamanya.
w|kualitas.en: The coach cares more about the quality of practice than its length.
w|kualitas.ko: 코치는 연습 시간보다 연습의 질을 더 중요하게 여겨요.

w|kuantum.text: Di depan api, teman Eko yang mahasiswa fisika bercerita tentang fisika kuantum.
w|kuantum.en: By the fire, Eko's friend, a physics student, talked about quantum physics.
w|kuantum.ko: 모닥불 앞에서 물리학과에 다니는 에코의 친구가 양자 물리 이야기를 했어요.

w|kuantum.text: Pelari di samping Ayu bekerja sebagai peneliti komputer kuantum.
w|kuantum.en: The runner next to Ayu works as a quantum computing researcher.
w|kuantum.ko: 아유 옆의 주자는 양자 컴퓨터 연구원이에요.

w|kuasa.text: Kuasa politiknya semakin kuat tahun ini.
w|kuasa.en: His political power grew stronger this year.
w|kuasa.ko: 그의 정치 권력이 올해 더 강해졌어.

w|kuasa.text: Dia menyalahgunakan kuasa untuk kepentingan pribadi.
w|kuasa.en: He abused power for personal gain.

w|kuburan.text: Mereka mengunjungi kuburan nenek setiap tahun.

w|kubus.ko: 부디는 꼬마 환자에게 알록달록한 큐브 장난감을 줬어요.

w|kubus.en: Siti brought cube-shaped layer cakes as souvenirs.
w|kubus.ko: 시티는 선물로 정육면체 모양의 층층 케이크를 가져왔어요.

w|kuda.en: She rode a horse on the beach.

w|kudeta.text: Andi membaca buku sejarah tentang kudeta yang terjadi di sebuah negara Amerika Latin.

w|kudeta.en: Dewi's father said his family once had to move after a coup in the country where they worked.

w|kursus.en: The library offers a free English course for seniors.
w|kursus.ko: 도서관은 어르신을 위한 무료 영어 강좌를 열어요.

w|kurungan.text: Kelinci peliharaan kelas Eko tinggal di kurungan kayu dekat taman sekolah.
w|kurungan.en: The class pet rabbit in Eko's class lives in a wooden hutch near the school garden.
w|kurungan.ko: 에코네 반 토끼는 학교 정원 근처 나무 우리에서 살아요.

w|kurungan.text: Ayu membuat patung burung dalam kurungan dari kawat bekas.
w|kurungan.en: Ayu made a sculpture of a bird in a cage out of scrap wire.
w|kurungan.ko: 아유는 버려진 철사로 새장 속 새 조각을 만들었어요.

w|kurus.text: Anaknya terlihat kurus setelah sakit lama.
w|kurus.en: Her child looked thin after a long illness.
w|kurus.ko: 아이가 오래 앓고 나서 야위어 보였어.

w|kurus.en: Being thin is not the only sign of health.
w|kurus.ko: 마른 게 건강의 유일한 신호는 아니야.

w|kusut.text: Dimas merapikan peta kuno yang kusut sebelum dipajang di vitrin.
w|kusut.en: Dimas smoothed out the crumpled old map before it was put on display.
w|kusut.ko: 디마스는 전시하기 전에 구겨진 옛 지도를 반듯하게 폈어요.

w|kusut.text: Putri menyetrika kemeja yang kusut sebelum dipasang di manekin.
w|kusut.en: Putri ironed the wrinkled shirt before putting it on the mannequin.
w|kusut.ko: 푸트리는 마네킹에 입히기 전에 구겨진 셔츠를 다렸어요.

w|kutipan.text: Andi mencatat kutipan dari buku filsafat ke dalam buku tulisnya.
w|kutipan.en: Andi copied a quotation from a philosophy book into his notebook.
w|kutipan.ko: 안디는 철학책의 인용구를 공책에 옮겨 적었어요.

w|kutipan.text: Di meja Dewi tertempel kutipan motivasi dari bekas dosennya.
w|kutipan.en: A motivational quote from Dewi's former lecturer is stuck on her desk.
w|kutipan.ko: 디위의 책상에는 옛 교수님의 동기 부여 글귀가 붙어 있어요.

w|kutu.text: Anjing itu digigit kutu di punggungnya.
w|kutu.en: That dog was bitten by fleas on its back.

w|kutu.text: Kutu rambut menyebar cepat di kelas.
w|kutu.en: Head lice spread quickly in the classroom.

w|kutub.text: Dimas tertawa ketika keponakannya bertanya apakah sapi bisa hidup di kutub.
w|kutub.en: Dimas laughed when his nephew asked whether cows could live at the North Pole.
w|kutub.ko: 조카가 소도 극지방에서 살 수 있냐고 묻자 디마스는 웃었어요.

w|kutub.text: Di dalam bus, Putri membaca artikel tentang beruang di kutub utara.
w|kutub.en: On the bus, Putri read an article about bears at the North Pole.
w|kutub.ko: 버스 안에서 푸트리는 북극곰에 관한 기사를 읽었어요.

w|kutukan.text: Kutukan kuno itu menakutkan penduduk desa.
w|kutukan.en: That ancient curse frightened the villagers.
w|kutukan.ko: 그 고대의 저주가 마을 사람들을 무섭게 했어.

w|kutukan.text: Mereka percaya kutukan akan segera berakhir.
w|kutukan.en: They believe the curse will soon end.
w|kutukan.ko: 그들은 저주가 곧 끝날 거라고 믿어.

w|kuyup.text: Budi tiba di sekolah basah kuyup karena lupa membawa jas hujan.
w|kuyup.en: Budi arrived at school soaking wet because he forgot his raincoat.
w|kuyup.ko: 버디는 비옷을 깜빡해서 흠뻑 젖은 채 학교에 도착했어요.

w|kuyup.text: Siti pulang dari pasar dalam keadaan kuyup karena hujan turun mendadak.
w|kuyup.en: Siti came home from the market drenched because the rain came suddenly.
w|kuyup.ko: 갑자기 비가 와서 시티는 흠뻑 젖어 시장에서 돌아왔어요.

w|lab.text: Lab sekolah bau kimia pagi ini.
w|lab.en: The school lab smells of chemicals this morning.
w|lab.ko: 오늘 아침 학교 실험실에서 화학 냄새가 나.

w|lab.text: Sampel itu disimpan di lab dingin.
w|lab.en: That sample is kept in the cold lab.

w|laba.text: Tahun ini laba pabrik naik berkat pesanan seragam sekolah.
w|laba.en: This year the factory's profit rose thanks to school uniform orders.
w|laba.ko: 올해 공장 이익은 교복 주문 덕분에 늘었어요.

w|laba.text: Kakak Intan bilang laba toko oleh-olehnya naik saat musim liburan.
w|laba.en: Intan's sister said her souvenir shop's profit goes up in the holiday season.
w|laba.ko: 인탄의 언니는 휴가철에 기념품 가게 이익이 오른다고 했어요.

w|laba-laba.text: Dimas menemukan sarang laba-laba besar di pojok lumbung.
w|laba-laba.en: Dimas found a big spider web in the corner of the barn.
w|laba-laba.ko: 디마스는 곳간 구석에서 커다란 거미줄을 발견했어요.

w|laba-laba.text: Ada laba-laba kecil di kaca jendela kantor Putri.
w|laba-laba.en: There's a little spider on the window of Putri's office.
w|laba-laba.ko: 푸트리의 사무실 유리창에 작은 거미가 있어요.

w|labirin.text: Agus menggambar labirin di buku tulisnya waktu pelajaran membosankan.
w|labirin.en: Agus drew a maze in his notebook when the lesson was boring.
w|labirin.ko: 아구스는 수업이 지루할 때 공책에 미로를 그렸어요.

w|labirin.text: Taman air di sebelah kolam punya labirin perosotan yang disukai anak-anak.
w|labirin.en: The water park next to the pool has a maze of slides that kids love.
w|labirin.ko: 수영장 옆 워터파크에는 아이들이 좋아하는 미끄럼틀 미로가 있어요.

w|laboratorium.text: Para ilmuwan bekerja di laboratorium baru.
w|laboratorium.en: The scientists work in the new laboratory.
The school laboratory needs modern equipment.

w|labu.text: Instruktur meminta Andi mengukus labu sampai empuk untuk sup.
w|labu.en: The instructor asked Andi to steam the pumpkin until soft for the soup.
w|labu.ko: 강사는 안디에게 수프용 호박을 부드러워질 때까지 찌라고 했어요.

w|labu.text: Dewi menulis resep kolak labu yang dulu sering mereka makan saat buka puasa.
w|labu.en: Dewi wrote down the pumpkin kolak recipe they often ate when breaking the fast.
w|labu.ko: 데위는 둘이 금식을 깰 때 자주 먹던 호박 콜락 요리법을 적었어요.

w|laci.text: Di dalam laci lemari tua, Andi menemukan surat-surat kakeknya.
w|laci.en: In the drawer of the old cupboard, Andi found his grandfather's letters.
w|laci.ko: 안디는 낡은 장롱 서랍에서 할아버지의 편지들을 찾았어요.

w|laci.text: Dewi menyimpan tiket di laci kecil di bawah meja lipat.
w|laci.en: Dewi keeps her ticket in the small drawer under the folding table.
w|laci.ko: 데위는 접이식 탁자 밑 작은 서랍에 표를 넣어 둬요.

w|ladang.text: Musim ini Dimas mau menanam jagung di ladang sebelah rumah.
w|ladang.en: This season Dimas wants to plant corn in the field next to the house.
w|ladang.ko: 이번 철에 디마스는 집 옆 밭에 옥수수를 심으려고 해요.

w|ladang.text: Dalam perjalanan pulang, kereta melewati ladang jagung yang luas.
w|ladang.en: On the way home, the train passed a wide cornfield.
w|ladang.ko: 집에 가는 길에 기차가 넓은 옥수수밭을 지나갔어요.

w|laga.text: Budi menonton laga final sepak bola antarsekolah dari tribun.
w|laga.en: Budi watched the inter-school football final from the stands.
w|laga.ko: 부디는 관중석에서 학교 대항 축구 결승전을 봤어요.

w|laga.text: Penumpang di ruang tunggu bersorak saat menonton laga bulu tangkis bersama Siti.
w|laga.en: Passengers in the waiting lounge cheered while watching the badminton match with Siti.
w|laga.ko: 대기실 승객들은 시티와 함께 배드민턴 경기를 보며 환호했어요.

w|lagipula.text: Dia sibuk, lagipula jauh dari sini.
w|lagipula.en: He's busy, and besides it's far from here.

w|lah.en: Just leave it; don't think about it anymore.
Just go now before it rains.
w|lah.ko: 비 오기 전에 지금 가 버려.

w|lahan.text: Sebagian lahan di dekat pantai dipakai warga untuk menanam kelapa.
w|lahan.en: Part of the land near the beach is used by residents to grow coconuts.
w|lahan.ko: 주민들은 바닷가 근처 땅 일부에 코코넛을 심어요.

w|lahan.text: Warga kompleks sepakat menjadikan lahan kosong itu taman bermain.
w|lahan.en: The residents of the housing complex agreed to turn the empty lot into a playground.
w|lahan.ko: 단지 주민들은 그 빈터를 놀이터로 만들기로 했어요.

w|lahir.en: That baby was born this morning.

w|lajang.text: Teman Fajar yang masih lajang berharap bisa menangkap buket bunga.
w|lajang.en: Fajar's still-single friend hopes to catch the bouquet.
w|lajang.ko: 아직 미혼인 파자르의 친구는 부케를 받고 싶어 해요.

w|lajang.text: Kakak Lestari masih lajang dan suka bepergian setiap musim liburan.
w|lajang.en: Lestari's older sibling is still single and likes to travel every holiday season.
w|lajang.ko: 레스타리의 언니는 아직 미혼이고 휴가철마다 여행하기를 좋아해요.

w|laki-laki.en: There's a man at the door.

w|laksamana.text: Fajar membeli buku biografi seorang laksamana dari zaman kerajaan Majapahit.
