w|laksamana.ko: 파자르는 마자파힛 왕국 시대 제독의 전기를 샀어요.

w|laksamana.text: Kata guru, resep rendang itu berasal dari keluarga seorang laksamana di Sumatra.
w|laksamana.en: According to the teacher, that rendang recipe came from the family of an admiral in Sumatra.
w|laksamana.ko: 선생님 말로는 그 른당 요리법은 수마트라의 한 제독 집안에서 전해졌대요.

w|lalat.text: Banyak lalat beterbangan di sekitar kandang sapi.
w|lalat.en: Lots of flies buzz around the cow shed.
w|lalat.ko: 소 외양간 주위에 파리가 많이 날아다녀요.

w|lalat.text: Seekor lalat terus hinggap di roti Putri waktu sarapan.
w|lalat.en: A fly kept landing on Putri's bread at breakfast.
w|lalat.ko: 아침을 먹는데 파리 한 마리가 계속 푸트리의 빵에 앉았어요.

w|lamaran.text: Setahun lalu, keluarga Fajar datang membawa lamaran ke rumah keluarga Rina.
w|lamaran.en: A year ago, Fajar's family came to Rina's family's home with a marriage proposal.
w|lamaran.ko: 일 년 전 파자르의 가족은 리나네 집에 청혼하러 갔어요.

w|lamaran.text: Lestari mengirim surat lamaran kerja ke kantor ramalan cuaca di kotanya.
w|lamaran.en: Lestari sent a job application to the weather forecasting office in her town.
w|lamaran.ko: 레스타리는 자기 도시의 기상 예보 사무소에 입사 지원서를 보냈어요.

w|lamban.text: Rudi menyesal karena terlalu lamban menjelaskan semuanya kepada kakaknya.
w|lamban.en: Rudi regrets being too slow to explain everything to his sister.
w|lamban.ko: 루디는 누나에게 모든 걸 너무 늦게 설명한 게 후회돼요.

w|lamban.text: Perahu tua milik Pak Darto bergerak lamban melawan arus.
w|lamban.en: Mr. Darto's old boat moved sluggishly against the current.
w|lamban.ko: 다르토 씨의 낡은 배는 물살을 거슬러 느릿느릿 움직였어요.

w|lambang.text: Topeng emas di poster itu menjadi lambang kelompok teater Eko.
w|lambang.en: The gold mask on the poster has become the emblem of Eko's theater group.
w|lambang.ko: 포스터의 금빛 가면은 에코 극단의 상징이 됐어요.

w|lambang.text: Pohon beringin di alun-alun dianggap lambang persatuan warga.
w|lambang.en: The banyan tree in the square is seen as a symbol of the villagers' unity.
w|lambang.ko: 광장의 반얀나무는 주민 화합의 상징으로 여겨져요.

w|lambat.text: Bus ini sangat lambat hari ini.
w|lambat.en: This bus is very slow today.

w|lampu.en: The lamp in the room is out.

w|lancang.text: Ada tamu lancang yang naik ke pelaminan tanpa diundang untuk berfoto.
w|lancang.en: There was a rude guest who climbed onto the dais uninvited to take photos.
w|lancang.ko: 초대받지도 않았는데 단상에 올라가 사진을 찍은 무례한 손님이 있었어요.

w|lancang.text: Lestari menganggap pertanyaan wartawan lain kepada korban itu terlalu lancang.
w|lancang.en: Lestari thought the other reporter's question to the victim was too impertinent.
w|lancang.ko: 레스타리는 다른 기자가 피해자에게 한 질문이 너무 무례하다고 생각했어요.

w|lancar.text: Perjalanan kami berjalan lancar hari ini.

w|lancar.en: His English is already quite fluent.

w|landasan.text: Pak Kepala Sekolah bilang kejujuran adalah landasan semua pelajaran.
w|landasan.en: The principal said honesty is the foundation of every lesson.
w|landasan.ko: 교장 선생님은 정직이 모든 배움의 바탕이라고 했어요.

w|landasan.text: Dewi meletakkan landasan kayu di bawah panggangan supaya rumput tidak terbakar.
w|landasan.en: Dewi put a wooden base under the grill so the grass wouldn't burn.
w|landasan.ko: 데위는 잔디가 타지 않게 그릴 밑에 나무 받침을 깔았어요.

w|langka.text: Burung itu sangat langka di daerah ini.
w|langka.en: That bird is very rare in this area.
w|langka.ko: 그 새는 이 지역에서 아주 드물어.

w|langka.en: An opportunity like this is indeed rare.

w|lanjutan.text: Budi menunggu cerita lanjutan dari novel yang dibacakan guru bahasa.
w|lanjutan.en: Budi is waiting for the continuation of the novel the language teacher reads aloud.
w|lanjutan.ko: 부디는 국어 선생님이 읽어 주는 소설의 다음 이야기를 기다려요.

w|lanjutan.text: Siti harus naik penerbangan lanjutan ke kota kecil di pegunungan.
w|lanjutan.en: Siti has to take a connecting flight to a small town in the mountains.
w|lanjutan.ko: 시티는 산속 작은 도시로 가는 연결편을 타야 해요.

w|lantai.en: The second floor is already full.

w|lantang.en: Rudi answered the phone in a loud voice because the lobby was busy.
w|lantang.ko: 로비가 시끄러워서 루디는 큰 목소리로 전화를 받았어요.

w|lantang.text: Suara katak terdengar lantang setiap malam di musim hujan.
w|lantang.en: The frogs' croaking sounds loud every night in the rainy season.
w|lantang.ko: 우기에는 밤마다 개구리 소리가 크게 들려요.

w|lantas.text: Dimas lupa membawa buku PR, lantas dia meminjam punya temannya.
w|lantas.en: Dimas forgot to bring his homework book, so he borrowed his friend's.
w|lantas.ko: 디마스는 숙제 공책을 깜빡해서 친구 걸 빌렸어요.

w|lantas.text: Putri mencicipi kuahnya, lantas menambahkan sedikit garam.
w|lantas.en: Putri tasted the broth, then added a little salt.
w|lantas.ko: 푸트리는 국물 맛을 보고 소금을 조금 넣었어요.

w|lapangan.text: Lapangan sepak bola basah karena hujan.
w|lapangan.en: The soccer field is wet from the rain.
The children play in the open field.

w|lapisan.text: Pemerintah kota ingin melayani semua lapisan masyarakat dengan adil.
w|lapisan.en: The city government wants to serve all layers of society fairly.
w|lapisan.ko: 시 정부는 사회 모든 계층을 공평하게 섬기고 싶어 해요.

w|lapisan.text: Suara Wati berlapis-lapis saat direkam, karena setiap lapisan dinyanyikan ulang.
w|lapisan.en: Wati's voice sounds layered on the recording, because each layer was sung again.
w|lapisan.ko: 녹음할 때 층마다 다시 불러서 와티 목소리가 겹겹이 들려요.

w|laptop.text: Bayu mencatat hasil produksi harian di laptop kantor.
w|laptop.en: Bayu records the daily production output on the office laptop.
w|laptop.ko: 바유는 하루 생산량을 사무실 노트북에 기록해요.

w|laptop.text: Petugas keamanan meminta Intan mengeluarkan laptop dari tas.
w|laptop.en: The security officer asked Intan to take her laptop out of her bag.
w|laptop.ko: 보안 요원이 인탄에게 가방에서 노트북을 꺼내 달라고 했어요.

w|larangan.text: Di pintu masuk teater ada larangan memotret selama pertunjukan.
w|larangan.en: At the theater entrance there's a ban on taking photos during the show.
w|larangan.ko: 극장 입구에 공연 중 사진 촬영 금지 안내가 있어요.

w|larangan.text: Sejak ada larangan kantong plastik, Ayu menjual tas belanja kain.
w|larangan.en: Since the plastic bag ban, Ayu has been selling cloth shopping bags.
w|larangan.ko: 비닐봉지 금지 이후로 아유는 천 장바구니를 팔아요.

w|laras.text: Setiap malam Minggu, hotel menampilkan gamelan dengan laras pelog.
w|laras.en: Every Saturday night, the hotel presents gamelan in the pelog scale.
w|laras.ko: 호텔은 매주 토요일 밤 펠로그 음계의 가믈란 공연을 열어요.

w|laras.text: Di pesta panen akhir kemarau, gamelan desa dimainkan dalam laras slendro.
w|laras.en: At the harvest festival at the end of the dry season, the village gamelan is played in the slendro scale.
w|laras.ko: 건기 끝 추수 잔치에서 마을 가믈란은 슬렌드로 음계로 연주돼요.

w|latar.en: The background of that story is rather dark.

w|latar.en: That photo has a blue sea background.

w|laut.en: We went to the sea yesterday.
The sea here is very blue.

w|lautan.en: The ship crosses the vast ocean.
The blue ocean is visible from the cliff.

w|lawan.text: Dia mengalahkan lawan di babak final.
w|lawan.en: He defeated his opponent in the final round.

w|layanan.en: The hotel offers friendly customer service.

w|layangan.ko: 루디는 서 앞 전깃줄에 걸린 연을 내려 줬어요.

w|layangan.text: Rina mengobati burung yang tersangkut benang layangan.
w|layangan.en: Rina treated a bird that got tangled in kite string.

w|lebar.en: A wide smile lit up her face this morning.

w|legenda.text: Dia menjadi legenda di dunia olahraga.
w|legenda.en: He became a legend in the sports world.

w|legendaris.text: Eko bangga bisa tampil di panggung legendaris tempat para aktor besar memulai karier.

w|legendaris.text: Toko Ayu menjual kerupuk dari pabrik legendaris yang sudah berdiri sejak zaman kakeknya.
w|legendaris.en: Ayu's shop sells crackers from a legendary factory that has been around since her grandfather's time.

w|legiun.text: Di pelajaran sejarah, Budi belajar tentang legiun tentara Romawi.
w|legiun.en: In history class, Budi learned about the Roman army legions.
w|legiun.ko: 역사 시간에 버디는 로마 군단에 대해 배웠어요.

w|legiun.text: Bagi Siti, nyamuk di musim hujan datang seperti legiun yang tak ada habisnya.
w|legiun.en: To Siti, mosquitoes in the rainy season come like an endless legion.
w|legiun.ko: 시티에게 우기의 모기는 끝없는 군단처럼 몰려와요.

w|leher.en: His neck is stiff after sitting for a long time.
Her scarf wraps neatly around her neck.

w|lekas.en: The nurse wished Agus a quick recovery after his wisdom tooth was pulled.
w|lekas.ko: 사랑니를 뽑은 아구스에게 간호사가 빨리 나으라고 인사했어요.

w|lekas.text: Wati ingin renovasi itu lekas selesai supaya bisa pindah sebelum Lebaran.
w|lekas.en: Wati wants the renovation to finish soon so she can move in before Eid.
w|lekas.ko: 와티는 르바란 전에 이사할 수 있게 공사가 빨리 끝나길 바라요.

w|lelah.en: Being tired isn't a reason to give up.

w|lelaki.text: Lelaki itu berdiri di depan pintu.
w|lelaki.en: That man is standing in front of the door.

w|lelang.text: Pengelola pasar mengadakan lelang kecil untuk barang-barang yang paling langka.
w|lelang.en: The market manager held a small auction for the rarest items.
w|lelang.ko: 시장 관리인은 가장 희귀한 물건들로 작은 경매를 열었어요.

w|lelang.en: Intan's wedding dress was bought at a charity auction.
w|lelang.ko: 인탄의 웨딩드레스는 자선 경매에서 산 거예요.

w|lelucon.en: Don't take that as a joke.

w|leluhur.text: Keluarga besar Rina setiap tahun berziarah ke makam leluhur di Toraja.
w|leluhur.en: Rina's extended family visits their ancestors' graves in Toraja every year.
w|leluhur.ko: 리나의 대가족은 해마다 토라자에 있는 조상 묘소를 찾아가요.

w|leluhur.text: Lukisan di lobi menggambarkan leluhur pemilik hotel yang dulu berdagang rempah.
w|leluhur.en: The painting in the lobby depicts the hotel owner's ancestors who once traded spices.
w|leluhur.ko: 로비의 그림은 예전에 향신료를 거래하던 호텔 주인의 조상을 그린 거예요.

w|lemak.text: Fajar mengurangi lemak di adonan supaya rotinya lebih sehat.
w|lemak.en: Fajar reduced the fat in the dough so the bread would be healthier.
w|lemak.ko: 파자르는 빵이 더 건강하도록 반죽의 지방을 줄였어요.

w|lemak.en: The coach said Lestari's body needs healthy fat from nuts and fish.

w|lemari.text: Lemari itu penuh dengan baju lama.

Keep the documents in the wooden cabinet.

w|lemas.ko: 한 아주머니가 기운 없이 들어와서 디마스는 의자와 물을 내드렸어요.

w|lemas.text: Setelah mengecat seharian, Putri merasa lemas.

w|lemas.ko: 하루 종일 페인트칠을 하고 나니 푸트리는 기운이 쭉 빠졌어요.

w|lembaga.en: The city library is working with a research institute to open a digital archive.
w|lembaga.ko: 시립 도서관이 연구 기관과 손잡고 디지털 자료실을 열어요.

w|lembaga.text: Survei kepuasan penumpang dilakukan oleh lembaga independen.
w|lembaga.en: The passenger satisfaction survey is carried out by an independent agency.
w|lembaga.ko: 승객 만족도 조사는 독립 기관이 맡아요.

w|lembah.text: Lembah itu hijau setelah musim hujan.

w|lembah.text: Mereka mendaki menuju lembah yang tenang.
w|lembah.en: They hiked toward a quiet valley.

w|level.text: Level kesulitan soal ini terlalu tinggi.
w|level.en: The difficulty level of this problem is too high.

w|level.text: Dia naik ke level berikutnya dengan cepat.

w|lho.en: Intan whispers to her husband, "The rendang here is really good, you know."

w|licik.text: Orang licik itu akhirnya ketahuan berbohong.
w|licik.en: That cunning person was finally caught lying.

w|licin.ko: 인공 비 장면이 끝나자 무대 바닥이 미끄러워졌어요.

w|licin.text: Setelah hujan, jalan setapak ke kebun Ayu menjadi licin.
w|licin.en: After the rain, the footpath to Ayu's garden becomes slippery.
w|licin.ko: 비가 그치면 아유네 밭으로 가는 오솔길이 미끄러워져요.

w|lidah.text: Lidah saya terbakar karena makanan pedas.
w|lidah.en: My tongue burned because of spicy food.

w|lidah.text: Jaga lidah saat berbicara di depan umum.
w|lidah.en: Watch your tongue when speaking in public.
w|lidah.ko: 사람들 앞에서 말할 때 혀를 조심해.

w|lift.text: Lift di gedung ini sering rusak.
w|lift.en: The elevator in this building often breaks.
w|lift.ko: 이 건물 엘리베이터는 자주 고장 나.

w|lift.text: Kami naik lift ke lantai atas.
w|lift.en: We took the elevator to the upper floor.

w|liga.text: Tim futsal sekolah Budi menjuarai liga pelajar se-kota.
w|liga.en: Budi's school futsal team won the citywide student league.
w|liga.ko: 부디네 학교 풋살팀이 시 학생 리그에서 우승했어요.

w|liga.text: Di rumah baru, tetangga mengajak Siti menonton pertandingan liga sepak bola di pos ronda.
w|liga.en: At the new house, a neighbor invited Siti to watch a football league match at the guard post.
w|liga.ko: 새집에서 이웃이 시티에게 경비 초소에서 축구 리그 경기를 같이 보자고 했어요.

w|lilin.text: Lilin di meja bergetar karena angin.
w|lilin.en: The candle on the table flickered because of the wind.
w|lilin.ko: 탁자 위 초가 바람 때문에 흔들렸어.

w|lilin.text: Dia menyalakan lilin di ruang gelap.
w|lilin.en: She lit a candle in the dark room.
w|lilin.ko: 그는 어두운 방에서 초에 불을 붙였어.

w|limbah.text: Warga desa Agus protes karena limbah pabrik membuat ikan sungai mati.
w|limbah.en: Agus's villagers protested because factory waste was killing the river fish.
w|limbah.ko: 공장 폐수 때문에 강의 물고기가 죽자 아구스네 마을 사람들이 항의했어요.

w|limbah.text: Apotek itu membuang limbah obat kedaluwarsa lewat petugas khusus.
w|limbah.en: The pharmacy disposes of expired medicine waste through special collectors.
w|limbah.ko: 그 약국은 유통기한 지난 약 폐기물을 전문 수거업체에 맡겨 버려요.

w|lincah.text: Kucing apotek yang lincah suka melompat ke atas etalase.
w|lincah.en: The pharmacy's nimble cat likes to jump onto the display counter.
w|lincah.ko: 약국의 날렵한 고양이는 진열대 위로 뛰어오르길 좋아해요.

w|lincah.text: Jari rekan baru itu lincah sekali saat mengetik.
w|lincah.en: The new coworker's fingers are very nimble when typing.
w|lincah.ko: 새 동료는 타자 칠 때 손가락이 아주 빨라요.

w|lingkaran.en: The children formed a circle on the field.

w|lingkaran.text: Gambarlah lingkaran besar di kertas itu.
w|lingkaran.en: Draw a big circle on that paper.

w|lingkungan.en: The surroundings around the house are very quiet.
We must protect the environment together.

w|lintas.text: Proyek lintas kota membutuhkan kerja sama.
Lintas budaya memperkaya sudut pandang kita.
w|lintas.ko: 문화 교류가 우리의 시각을 풍부하게 해.

w|lintasan.text: Dimas memotret lintasan kereta yang berkelok di antara sawah.
w|lintasan.en: Dimas photographed the railway line winding between the rice fields.
w|lintasan.ko: 디마스는 논 사이로 굽이치는 철길을 사진 찍었어요.

w|lintasan.text: Putri merancang lintasan karier yang jelas untuk setiap anggota tim.
w|lintasan.en: Putri designed a clear career path for every team member.
w|lintasan.ko: 푸트리는 팀원마다 분명한 경력 경로를 설계했어요.

w|liontin.text: Agus membelikan ibunya liontin kuno berbentuk bunga melati.
w|liontin.en: Agus bought his mother an antique pendant shaped like a jasmine flower.
w|liontin.ko: 아구스는 엄마에게 재스민꽃 모양의 옛 펜던트를 사 드렸어요.

w|liontin.text: Wati memakai kalung dengan liontin berbentuk daun untuk menyambut musim gugur di luar negeri.
w|liontin.en: Wati wore a necklace with a leaf-shaped pendant to welcome autumn abroad.
w|liontin.ko: 와티는 외국에서 가을을 맞으며 나뭇잎 모양 펜던트 목걸이를 했어요.

w|lipat.text: Tolong lipat baju yang sudah kering.
w|lipat.en: Please fold the clothes that are dry.
Fold that letter before putting it in.

w|lipstik.text: Agus menemukan tabung lipstik antik berlapis emas di dalam kotak perhiasan.
w|lipstik.en: Agus found an antique gold-plated lipstick case in a jewelry box.
w|lipstik.ko: 아구스는 보석함 안에서 금도금된 옛날 립스틱 케이스를 찾았어요.

w|lipstik.text: Bibir Wati kering di musim kemarau, jadi ia memakai lipstik yang melembapkan.
w|lipstik.en: Wati's lips get dry in the dry season, so she wears a moisturizing lipstick.
w|lipstik.ko: 건기에는 와티의 입술이 건조해져서 보습 립스틱을 발라요.

w|liputan.text: Setelah ada liputan televisi, jumlah pengunjung museum naik tajam.
w|liputan.en: After the television coverage, the number of museum visitors rose sharply.
w|liputan.ko: 텔레비전 보도가 나간 뒤 박물관 방문객 수가 크게 늘었어요.

w|liputan.text: Majalah mode menurunkan liputan khusus tentang koleksi baru toko itu.
w|liputan.en: A fashion magazine ran a special feature on the store's new collection.
w|liputan.ko: 패션 잡지가 그 매장의 신상품 특집 기사를 실었어요.

w|lisensi.text: Pabrik itu baru mendapat lisensi untuk memproduksi suku cadang mobil.
w|lisensi.en: The factory just got a license to produce car parts.
w|lisensi.ko: 그 공장은 자동차 부품을 생산할 수 있는 허가를 막 받았어요.

w|lisensi.text: Putri baru saja mendapat lisensi sebagai pemandu wisata.
w|lisensi.en: Putri has just received her license as a tour guide.
w|lisensi.ko: 푸트리는 막 관광 가이드 자격증을 받았어요.

w|listrik.en: The power went out last night.

w|liur.text: Fajar menjelaskan bahwa obat itu bisa membuat air liur berkurang dan mulut terasa kering.
w|liur.en: Fajar explained that the medicine can reduce saliva and make the mouth feel dry.
w|liur.ko: 파자르는 그 약이 침을 줄여 입이 마를 수 있다고 설명했어요.

w|liur.text: Bau rendang dari bekal rekan baru membuat air liur Lestari hampir menetes.
w|liur.en: The smell of rendang from the new coworker's lunch box almost made Lestari drool.
w|liur.ko: 새 동료 도시락에서 나는 른당 냄새에 레스타리는 침이 고일 뻔했어요.

w|lobak.text: Menjelang Imlek, Agus mencoba membuat kue lobak ala Tionghoa.
w|lobak.en: Before Chinese New Year, Agus tried making Chinese-style radish cake.
w|lobak.ko: 설 무렵 아구스는 중국식 무떡을 만들어 봤어요.

w|lobak.text: Wati tidak suka lobak, jadi selalu menyisihkan potongan itu dari sup.
w|lobak.en: Wati doesn't like radish, so she always sets those pieces aside from her soup.
w|lobak.ko: 와티는 무를 싫어해서 국에서 늘 무를 골라내요.

w|lobi.text: Seorang tamu menunggu Budi di lobi kantor sejak pukul tujuh.
w|lobi.en: A visitor has been waiting for Budi in the office lobby since seven o'clock.
w|lobi.ko: 손님 한 명이 일곱 시부터 사무실 로비에서 부디를 기다리고 있어요.

w|lobi.text: Di lobi perpustakaan ada papan pengumuman untuk lomba menulis.
w|lobi.en: In the library lobby there's a notice board for a writing contest.
w|lobi.ko: 도서관 로비에 글쓰기 대회 게시판이 있어요.

w|logam.text: Logam itu meleleh pada suhu tinggi.
w|logam.en: That metal melts at high temperature.

w|logam.text: Pagar itu terbuat dari logam kuat.
w|logam.en: That fence is made of strong metal.

w|logat.text: Bayu langsung mengenali logat Jawa narasumber yang ia telepon.
w|logat.en: Bayu immediately recognized the Javanese accent of the source he phoned.
w|logat.ko: 바유는 전화한 취재원의 자와 억양을 바로 알아챘어요.

w|logat.text: Kurir yang mengantar paket Intan berbicara dengan logat Sunda yang ramah.
w|logat.en: The courier who delivered Intan's package spoke with a friendly Sundanese accent.
w|logat.ko: 인탄의 택배를 가져온 기사는 다정한 순다 억양으로 말했어요.

w|logika.text: Menurut logika ayah Fajar, pesta kecil lebih baik daripada berutang.
w|logika.en: By the logic of Fajar's father, a small party is better than going into debt.
w|logika.ko: 파자르 아버지의 논리로는 빚지는 것보다 작은 잔치가 나아요.

w|logika.text: Dengan logika sederhana, Lestari menyimpan air hujan untuk musim kemarau.
w|logika.en: With simple logic, Lestari stores rainwater for the dry season.
w|logika.ko: 레스타리는 단순한 논리로 건기를 대비해 빗물을 모아 둬요.

w|logis.text: Kata ayah Agus, sangat logis kalau ikan berkurang setelah hutan ditebang.
w|logis.en: Agus's father says it makes perfect sense that fish declined after the forest was cut.
w|logis.ko: 아구스의 아버지는 숲을 베고 나서 물고기가 줄어든 건 당연하다고 해요.

w|logis.text: Wati memberi penjelasan yang logis tentang kenapa antibiotik harus dihabiskan.
w|logis.en: Wati gave a logical explanation of why antibiotics must be finished.
w|logis.ko: 와티는 항생제를 끝까지 먹어야 하는 이유를 논리적으로 설명했어요.

w|lokal.text: Lokal ini punya tradisi unik setiap musim.
w|lokal.en: This local area has a unique tradition each season.
w|lokal.ko: 이 지역은 계절마다 독특한 전통이 있어.

w|lokal.text: Mereka mendukung produk lokal dengan bangga.

w|loker.text: Penghuni bisa menitipkan paket di loker dekat pintu masuk.
w|loker.en: Residents can leave parcels in the lockers near the entrance.
w|loker.ko: 입주민은 입구 근처 사물함에 택배를 맡길 수 있어요.

w|loker.text: Sesampainya di stasiun, Intan menitipkan koper di loker penyimpanan.
w|loker.en: On arriving at the station, Intan left her suitcase in a storage locker.
w|loker.ko: 역에 도착하자 인탄은 여행 가방을 보관함에 맡겼어요.

w|lolos.en: Passing the selection made her happy.

w|lompat.text: Anak itu lompat dari batu kecil.
w|lompat.en: That child jumped from a small rock.
The cat jumped onto the table.

w|lompatan.text: Bayu menyebut aplikasi bus kota itu lompatan besar bagi transportasi umum.
w|lompatan.en: Bayu called the city bus app a big leap for public transport.
w|lompatan.ko: 바유는 그 시내버스 앱을 대중교통의 큰 도약이라고 불렀어요.

w|lompatan.text: Jumlah pengguna naik tiga kali lipat, sebuah lompatan yang tidak disangka Intan.
w|lompatan.en: The number of users tripled, a jump Intan hadn't expected.
w|lompatan.ko: 사용자 수가 세 배로 늘었는데, 인탄도 예상 못 한 도약이었어요.

w|lonceng.text: Begitu lonceng berbunyi, anak-anak berlarian ke kantin.
w|lonceng.en: As soon as the bell rang, the children ran to the canteen.

w|lonceng.text: Siti membunyikan lonceng tua sekolah sebagai tanda acara dimulai.
w|lonceng.en: Siti rang the school's old bell to signal the start of the event.
w|lonceng.ko: 시티는 행사 시작을 알리려고 학교의 옛 종을 울렸어요.

w|longgar.text: Celana jeans bekas itu agak longgar, jadi Bayu memakai ikat pinggang.
w|longgar.en: The secondhand jeans are a bit loose, so Bayu wears a belt.
w|longgar.ko: 그 중고 청바지가 좀 헐렁해서 바유는 벨트를 해요.

w|longgar.text: Kebaya sewaan Intan terlalu longgar, jadi penjahit harus mengecilkannya.
w|longgar.en: Intan's rented kebaya was too loose, so the tailor had to take it in.
w|longgar.ko: 인탄이 빌린 크바야가 너무 헐렁해서 재봉사가 줄여야 했어요.

w|lonjakan.text: Rudi kewalahan menghadapi lonjakan pesanan saat jam makan siang.
w|lonjakan.en: Rudi was overwhelmed by the surge in orders at lunchtime.
w|lonjakan.ko: 루디는 점심시간에 주문이 몰려들어 정신이 없었어요.

w|lonjakan.text: Ada lonjakan peminat piringan hitam, jadi Rina menaikkan harga.
w|lonjakan.en: There's been a surge of interest in vinyl records, so Rina raised her prices.
w|lonjakan.ko: 레코드판 찾는 사람이 확 늘어서 리나는 값을 올렸어요.

w|lorong.en: That hallway is dark and narrow.

w|lorong.text: Kami berjalan di sepanjang lorong hotel.
w|lorong.en: We walked along the hotel corridor.

w|loteng.text: Di atas loteng, Andi menemukan sarang burung dan kotak mainan lama.
w|loteng.en: In the attic, Andi found a bird's nest and an old toy box.
w|loteng.ko: 안디는 다락에서 새 둥지와 오래된 장난감 상자를 찾았어요.

w|loteng.text: Dari jendela, Dewi melihat rumah-rumah kayu dengan loteng tinggi.
w|loteng.en: From the window, Dewi sees wooden houses with high lofts.
w|loteng.ko: 데위는 창밖으로 다락이 높은 나무집들을 봐요.

w|lowongan.text: Fajar memberi tahu adiknya bahwa ada lowongan di bagian keuangan.
w|lowongan.en: Fajar told his younger brother that there was an opening in the finance department.
w|lowongan.ko: 파자르는 재무팀에 빈자리가 있다고 동생에게 알려 줬어요.

w|lowongan.text: Lestari memasang iklan lowongan untuk desainer di situs pencari kerja.
w|lowongan.en: Lestari posted a job ad for a designer on a job-search site.
w|lowongan.ko: 레스타리는 구직 사이트에 디자이너 채용 공고를 올렸어요.

w|loyalitas.text: Bayu memuji loyalitas sahabatnya yang selalu ikut setiap perjalanan.
w|loyalitas.en: Bayu praised the loyalty of his best friend, who joins every trip.
w|loyalitas.ko: 바유는 여행마다 늘 함께하는 친구의 의리를 칭찬했어요.

w|loyalitas.text: Guru lukis Intan menghargai loyalitas murid yang ikut kelasnya bertahun-tahun.
w|loyalitas.en: Intan's painting teacher values the loyalty of students who have attended for years.
w|loyalitas.ko: 인탄의 미술 선생님은 몇 년째 수업에 오는 학생들의 꾸준함을 소중히 여겨요.

w|luang.text: Di waktu luang, Dimas suka memotret langit yang berubah warna.
w|luang.en: In his free time, Dimas likes photographing the sky as it changes color.
w|luang.ko: 디마스는 쉬는 시간에 색이 바뀌는 하늘을 찍는 걸 좋아해요.

w|luang.text: Putri mengisi waktu luang dengan memilih ubin untuk kamar mandi.
w|luang.en: Putri fills her free time choosing tiles for the bathroom.
w|luang.ko: 푸트리는 여가 시간에 욕실 타일을 골라요.

w|luas.en: Their house yard is very wide.

w|luas.text: Luas sekali padang rumput di sana.
w|luas.en: The meadow there is so vast.

w|lubuk.text: Dari lubuk hati yang paling dalam, Rudi ingin kakaknya bahagia.
w|lubuk.en: From the bottom of his heart, Rudi wants his sister to be happy.
w|lubuk.ko: 루디는 마음 깊은 곳에서부터 누나가 행복하기를 바라요.

w|lubuk.text: Di lubuk hati Rina, pantai kecil ini selalu terasa seperti rumah.
w|lubuk.en: Deep in Rina's heart, this little beach always feels like home.
w|lubuk.ko: 리나의 마음 깊은 곳에서는 이 작은 해변이 늘 집처럼 느껴져요.

w|lugu.text: Anak tetangga Andi masih lugu dan percaya semua cerita kakaknya.
w|lugu.en: Andi's neighbor's kid is still naive and believes every story the older sibling tells.
w|lugu.ko: 안디네 이웃집 아이는 아직 순진해서 언니 오빠가 하는 이야기를 다 믿어요.

w|lugu.text: Kata Dewi, murid baru itu masih lugu dan mengira semua biola sama saja.
w|lugu.en: According to Dewi, the new student is still naive and thinks all violins are the same.
w|lugu.ko: 데위 말로는 새로 온 학생이 아직 순진해서 바이올린이 다 똑같은 줄 알아요.

w|luka.en: The wound on his hand is deep.

w|lukisan.en: That painting hangs on the wall.

w|lukisan.text: Dia membeli lukisan dari seniman lokal.
w|lukisan.en: She bought a painting from a local artist.

w|lulus.en: She successfully passed the entrance exam.
Graduating from college is a happy moment.

w|lulusan.text: Ruang redaksi itu menerima dua lulusan jurnalistik sebagai wartawan magang.
w|lulusan.en: The newsroom took on two journalism graduates as intern reporters.
w|lulusan.ko: 편집국은 언론학과 졸업생 둘을 수습기자로 받았어요.

w|lulusan.text: Perpustakaan itu membuka lowongan untuk lulusan ilmu perpustakaan.
w|lulusan.en: The library has an opening for library science graduates.
w|lulusan.ko: 그 도서관은 문헌정보학 졸업생을 뽑고 있어요.

w|lumayan.en: His exam result was pretty good.

w|lumayan.text: Restoran itu lumayan ramai malam ini.
w|lumayan.en: That restaurant is fairly busy tonight.
w|lumayan.ko: 그 식당은 오늘 밤 꽤 붐벼.

w|lumbung.text: Bayu menyimpan gabah di lumbung desa yang berdiri di pinggir hutan.
w|lumbung.en: Bayu stores unhulled rice in the village granary at the edge of the forest.
w|lumbung.ko: 바유는 숲 가장자리에 있는 마을 곳간에 벼를 보관해요.

w|lumbung.text: Rute maraton yang diikuti Intan melewati lumbung padi tua di pinggir desa.
w|lumbung.en: The marathon route Intan ran passed an old rice granary at the edge of the village.
w|lumbung.ko: 인탄이 뛴 마라톤 코스는 마을 어귀의 오래된 쌀 곳간을 지나갔어요.

w|lumpuh.text: Setelah suntikan bius, separuh wajah Agus terasa lumpuh.
w|lumpuh.en: After the anaesthetic injection, half of Agus's face felt numb.
w|lumpuh.ko: 마취 주사를 맞자 아구스의 얼굴 반쪽이 마비된 느낌이었어요.

w|lumpuh.text: Kakek yang dulu tinggal di rumah itu lumpuh sejak terjatuh dari tangga.
w|lumpuh.en: The grandfather who used to live in the house was paralysed after falling down the stairs.
w|lumpuh.ko: 그 집에 살던 할아버지는 계단에서 떨어진 뒤로 몸이 마비됐어요.

w|lumpur.text: Kaki Dimas penuh lumpur setelah seharian di sawah.
w|lumpur.en: Dimas's feet were covered in mud after a whole day in the rice field.
w|lumpur.ko: 논에서 하루 종일 일한 뒤 디마스의 발은 진흙투성이였어요.

w|lumpur.text: Sepatu Putri kena lumpur di jalan menuju halte.
w|lumpur.en: Putri's shoes got muddy on the way to the bus stop.
w|lumpur.ko: 정류장 가는 길에 푸트리의 신발에 진흙이 묻었어요.

w|lunak.text: Hati Rina mulai lunak setelah Budi menunjukkan bukti.
w|lunak.en: Rina's heart began to soften after Budi showed the evidence.
w|lunak.ko: 부디가 증거를 보여 주자 리나의 마음이 누그러지기 시작했어요.

w|lunak.text: Kasur lama Siti sudah terlalu lunak, jadi dia tinggalkan saja.
w|lunak.en: Siti's old mattress had gotten too soft, so she just left it behind.
w|lunak.ko: 시티의 옛 매트리스는 너무 물렁해져서 그냥 두고 왔어요.

w|luput.text: Retakan kecil di tiang itu tidak luput dari mata Andi.
w|luput.en: The small crack in the pillar did not escape Andi's eye.
w|luput.ko: 기둥의 작은 금도 안디의 눈을 피하지 못했어요.

w|luput.text: Tidak ada satu nama pun yang luput dari ingatan Dewi malam itu.
w|luput.en: Not a single name slipped Dewi's memory that night.
w|luput.ko: 그날 밤 데위는 이름 하나도 잊지 않고 다 기억했어요.

w|lurus.text: Lurus saja sampai lampu merah berikutnya.
w|lurus.en: Just go straight until the next traffic light.

w|lusa.text: Prakiraan cuaca bilang hujan baru berhenti lusa.
w|lusa.en: The weather forecast says the rain won't stop until the day after tomorrow.

w|lusa.text: Tukang listrik bilang bisa datang ke rumah Putri lusa.
w|lusa.en: The electrician said he could come to Putri's house the day after tomorrow.
w|lusa.ko: 전기 기사는 모레 푸트리네 집에 올 수 있다고 했어요.

w|lusin.text: Fajar memesan dua lusin kue lapis untuk dibawa pulang keluarganya.
w|lusin.en: Fajar ordered two dozen layer cakes for his family to take home.
w|lusin.ko: 파자르는 가족들이 가져갈 층층 케이크를 두 다스 주문했어요.

w|lusin.text: Untuk rapat pagi, redaktur membeli selusin donat untuk seluruh tim.
w|lusin.en: For the morning meeting, the editor bought a dozen doughnuts for the whole team.
w|lusin.ko: 아침 회의를 위해 편집장은 팀 전체에 도넛 한 다스를 샀어요.

w|lusinan.text: Perpustakaan sekolah baru menerima lusinan buku sumbangan, dan Budi membantu menyusunnya.
w|lusinan.en: The school library just received dozens of donated books, and Budi helped shelve them.
w|lusinan.ko: 학교 도서관에 기증 책이 수십 권 들어와서 버디가 정리를 도왔어요.

w|lusinan.text: Setiap pergantian musim, Siti membeli lusinan bibit cabai untuk kebunnya.
w|lusinan.en: At every change of season, Siti buys dozens of chili seedlings for her garden.
w|lusinan.ko: 계절이 바뀔 때마다 시티는 텃밭에 심을 고추 모종을 수십 개 사요.

w|lutut.text: Anak kecil di ruang tunggu duduk memeluk lutut sambil menangis.
w|lutut.en: The little child in the waiting room sat hugging his knees and crying.
w|lutut.ko: 대기실 꼬마가 무릎을 끌어안고 앉아 울고 있었어요.

w|lutut.text: Wati berlutut di lantai, lalu memakai bantalan untuk melindungi lutut saat mengampelas.
w|lutut.en: Wati knelt on the floor and used pads to protect her knees while sanding.
w|lutut.ko: 와티는 바닥에 꿇어앉아 사포질할 때 무릎을 보호하려고 패드를 댔어요.

w|mabuk.en: He was drunk after the party.
Don't get drunk on the street.

w|mabuk-mabukan.text: Fajar menasihati seorang pembeli muda supaya berhenti mabuk-mabukan demi kesehatan hati.
w|mabuk-mabukan.en: Fajar advised a young customer to stop binge drinking for the sake of his liver.
w|mabuk-mabukan.ko: 파자르는 젊은 손님에게 간 건강을 위해 술독에 빠져 지내지 말라고 충고했어요.

w|mabuk-mabukan.text: Rekan baru itu menolak ajakan mabuk-mabukan setelah acara kantor.
w|mabuk-mabukan.en: The new coworker turned down the invitation to go out drinking after the office event.
w|mabuk-mabukan.ko: 새 동료는 회사 행사 뒤 술 마시러 가자는 제안을 거절했어요.

w|macam.en: There are all kinds of choices.
What kind of thing is that?

w|macam-macam.text: Dia membawa macam-macam oleh-oleh dari desa.
w|macam-macam.en: She brought all sorts of souvenirs from the village.

w|macam-macam.text: Macam-macam alasan dibuat hanya untuk menghindari kerja.
w|macam-macam.en: All sorts of excuses were made just to avoid work.

w|macan.text: Pemandu bercerita bahwa dulu macan tutul pernah terlihat di hutan dekat pantai.
w|macan.en: The guide said that leopards were once seen in the forest near the beach.
w|macan.ko: 가이드는 예전에 바닷가 근처 숲에서 표범이 목격된 적이 있다고 했어요.

w|macan.text: Anak tetangga Ayu suka memakai kaus bergambar macan.
w|macan.en: Ayu's neighbor's child likes to wear a T-shirt with a tiger on it.
w|macan.ko: 아유네 이웃 아이는 호랑이 그림 티셔츠를 즐겨 입어요.

w|macet.text: Jalan tol menuju Bandung sangat macet karena libur panjang.
w|macet.en: The toll road to Bandung was very jammed because of the long holiday.
w|macet.ko: 연휴라서 반둥으로 가는 고속도로가 몹시 막혔어요.

w|macet.text: Wati terlambat masuk kerja karena jalan di depan mal macet total.
w|macet.en: Wati was late for work because the road in front of the mall was completely jammed.
w|macet.ko: 쇼핑몰 앞 도로가 완전히 막혀서 와티는 지각했어요.

w|madu.text: Teh hangat lebih enak dengan madu.
w|madu.en: Warm tea tastes better with honey.
w|madu.ko: 따뜻한 차는 꿀을 넣으면 더 맛있어.

w|madu.en: Natural honey is good for the throat.

w|mafia.text: Di televisi ruang tunggu, berita membahas penangkapan anggota mafia narkoba.
w|mafia.en: On the waiting room TV, the news covered the arrest of drug mafia members.
w|mafia.ko: 대기실 텔레비전 뉴스에서 마약 조직원 체포 소식이 나왔어요.

w|mafia.text: Teman-teman menjuluki Dewi dan dua sahabatnya "mafia tembakan tiga angka".
w|mafia.en: Friends nicknamed Dewi and her two best friends "the three-pointer mafia."
w|mafia.ko: 친구들은 데위와 단짝 둘을 '삼점슛 마피아'라고 불러요.

w|magang.text: Tahun lalu Bayu magang tiga bulan di pabrik tekstil ini.
w|magang.en: Last year Bayu interned for three months at this textile factory.
w|magang.ko: 작년에 바유는 이 섬유 공장에서 석 달 동안 인턴을 했어요.

w|magang.text: Intan pernah magang di bagian informasi bandara waktu kuliah.
w|magang.en: Intan once interned at the airport information desk when she was at university.
w|magang.ko: 인탄은 대학 시절에 공항 안내 데스크에서 인턴을 한 적이 있어요.

w|magis.text: Pertunjukan sulap di acara ulang tahun kota terasa magis bagi anak Fajar.
w|magis.en: The magic show at the city's anniversary event felt magical to Fajar's child.
w|magis.ko: 시 기념일 행사의 마술 공연은 파자르의 아이에게 정말 신비롭게 느껴졌어요.

w|magis.text: Lestari menggambarkan senja di pantai dekat rumahnya sebagai sesuatu yang magis.
w|magis.en: Lestari described the sunset at the beach near her home as something magical.
w|magis.ko: 레스타리는 집 근처 해변의 노을을 마법 같은 것이라고 묘사했어요.

w|magnet.text: Daftar piket redaksi ditempel di kulkas dengan magnet kecil.
w|magnet.en: The newsroom duty roster is stuck to the fridge with a small magnet.
w|magnet.ko: 편집국 당번표가 작은 자석으로 냉장고에 붙어 있어요.

w|magnet.text: Pengeras suara ponsel itu rusak karena magnet di dalamnya lepas.
w|magnet.en: The phone's speaker is broken because the magnet inside came loose.
w|magnet.ko: 안에 있는 자석이 떨어져서 그 휴대폰 스피커가 고장 났어요.

w|magnetik.text: Agus memakai kompas magnetik saat menuntun pendaki di tengah kabut.
w|magnetik.en: Agus uses a magnetic compass when leading hikers through the fog.
w|magnetik.ko: 아구스는 안개 속에서 등산객을 안내할 때 자석 나침반을 써요.

w|magnetik.text: Wati bercerita bahwa pintu kulkas penuh hiasan magnetik dari berbagai kota.
w|magnetik.en: Wati wrote that her fridge door is covered with magnetic souvenirs from many cities.
w|magnetik.ko: 와티는 냉장고 문이 여러 도시에서 산 자석 장식으로 가득하다고 썼어요.

w|mahal.en: That house price is too expensive.
This concert ticket is so expensive.

w|mahasiswa.text: Mahasiswa itu belajar di perpustakaan setiap hari.
w|mahasiswa.en: That university student studies in the library every day.

w|mahasiswa.text: Banyak mahasiswa ikut seminar pagi ini.
w|mahasiswa.en: Many university students joined this morning's seminar.
w|mahasiswa.ko: 많은 대학생이 오늘 아침 세미나에 참석했어.

w|mahasiswi.text: Rumah kos di sebelah Andi dihuni beberapa mahasiswi kedokteran.
w|mahasiswi.en: The boarding house next to Andi's is home to several female medical students.
w|mahasiswi.ko: 안디네 옆 하숙집에는 의대 여학생 몇 명이 살아요.

w|mahasiswi.text: Seorang mahasiswi konservatori membantu Dewi mengajar kelas biola.
w|mahasiswi.en: A female conservatory student helps Dewi teach the violin class.
w|mahasiswi.ko: 음악원 여대생 한 명이 데위의 바이올린 수업을 도와요.

w|mahir.text: Teman sebangku Budi sudah mahir bermain gitar sejak SMP.
w|mahir.en: Budi's deskmate has been good at playing guitar since junior high.
w|mahir.ko: 부디의 짝은 중학교 때부터 기타를 잘 쳤어요.

w|mahir.text: Rudi sekarang mahir berbahasa Jepang karena lama bekerja di pabrik mobil.
w|mahir.en: Rudi is now fluent in Japanese after working at a car factory for a long time.
w|mahir.ko: 루디는 자동차 공장에서 오래 일해서 이제 일본어를 능숙하게 해요.

w|mahkamah.text: Untuk skripsinya, Andi membaca putusan-putusan Mahkamah Konstitusi di ruang arsip hukum.
w|mahkamah.en: For his thesis, Andi read rulings of the Constitutional Court in the law archive room.
w|mahkamah.ko: 안디는 졸업 논문을 위해 법률 자료실에서 헌법재판소 판결문을 읽었어요.

w|mahkamah.text: Rumah baru Dewi berada tidak jauh dari gedung mahkamah agung.
w|mahkamah.en: Dewi's new house is not far from the supreme court building.
w|mahkamah.ko: 데위의 새집은 대법원 건물에서 멀지 않아요.

w|mahkota.en: That golden crown is so beautiful.
The king wore a crown at the ceremony.

w|mainan.text: Mainan baru itu membuat anak tersenyum.
w|mainan.en: That new toy made the child smile.
w|mainan.ko: 그 새 장난감이 아이를 웃게 했어.

w|mainan.en: He tidied up the toys before bed.

w|majalah.en: The new fashion magazine is already out.

w|majalah.text: Dia membaca majalah di ruang tunggu.
w|majalah.en: She is reading a magazine in the waiting room.

w|majelis.text: Adegan rapat majelis kerajaan dibuat panjang agar penonton merasakan ketegangannya.
w|majelis.en: The royal council meeting scene was made long so the audience would feel the tension.
w|majelis.ko: 왕실 회의 장면은 관객이 긴장감을 느끼도록 길게 만들었어요.

w|majelis.text: Ayu membaca berita tentang sidang majelis yang membahas tarif angkutan umum.
w|majelis.en: Ayu read news about an assembly session discussing public transport fares.
w|majelis.ko: 아유는 대중교통 요금을 논의하는 의회 회의 기사를 읽었어요.

w|majikan.text: Ibu Bayu dulu bekerja sebagai pembantu, dan majikannya sangat baik.
w|majikan.en: Bayu's mother used to work as a housemaid, and her employer was very kind.
w|majikan.ko: 바유의 어머니는 예전에 가사도우미로 일했는데 고용주가 아주 친절했어요.

w|majikan.text: Di ruang kedatangan, seorang pekerja rumah tangga dijemput oleh majikan barunya.
w|majikan.en: In the arrivals hall, a domestic worker was picked up by her new employer.
w|majikan.ko: 도착 홀에서 한 가사도우미가 새 고용주의 마중을 받았어요.

w|maka.en: In that case, then I'll join.

w|makam.text: Mereka mengunjungi makam nenek setiap tahun.
w|makam.en: They visit grandmother's grave every year.

w|makam.text: Makam tua itu berada di bukit hijau.
w|makam.en: That old tomb sits on a green hill.
w|makam.ko: 그 오래된 무덤은 푸른 언덕에 있어.

w|makasih.text: Dia hanya bilang makasih lalu pergi.
w|makasih.en: He just said thanks and then left.

w|makelar.text: Rudi membeli daging sapi lewat makelar di pasar karena lebih murah.
w|makelar.en: Rudi buys beef through a middleman at the market because it's cheaper.
w|makelar.ko: 루디는 더 싸서 시장 중개인을 통해 소고기를 사요.

w|makelar.text: Seorang makelar barang antik sering membeli borongan dari lapak Rina.
w|makelar.en: An antiques dealer often buys in bulk from Rina's stall.
w|makelar.ko: 골동품 중개상 한 명이 리나의 노점에서 자주 통째로 사 가요.

w|makin.en: The weather gets colder toward night.

w|makin.text: Dia makin percaya diri setelah latihan.
w|makin.en: He became more confident after practice.
w|makin.ko: 연습 후에 그는 더 자신감이 생겼어.

w|maklumat.text: Di ruang sejarah, Dimas memajang salinan maklumat raja yang ditulis di daun lontar.
w|maklumat.en: In the history room, Dimas displayed a copy of a royal proclamation written on palm leaves.
w|maklumat.ko: 디마스는 역사관에 야자잎에 쓴 왕의 포고문 사본을 전시했어요.

w|maklumat.text: Manajemen menempelkan maklumat tentang jam buka selama libur panjang.
w|maklumat.en: Management posted a notice about opening hours during the long holiday.
w|maklumat.ko: 경영진이 긴 연휴 동안의 영업시간 공지를 붙였어요.

w|makmur.text: Kata Rudi, kampung itu kini makmur dan angka pencurian sudah jauh berkurang.
w|makmur.en: According to Rudi, the village is now prosperous and the number of thefts has dropped a lot.
w|makmur.ko: 루디 말로는 그 마을이 이제 잘살게 되었고 도난 건수도 크게 줄었대요.

w|makmur.text: Desa yang dilewati rute itu tampak makmur, dengan rumah-rumah yang rapi dan sawah yang hijau.
w|makmur.en: The village along the route looked prosperous, with tidy houses and green rice fields.
w|makmur.ko: 코스가 지나는 마을은 집들이 깔끔하고 논이 푸르러 넉넉해 보였어요.

w|maksimal.text: Kecepatan maksimal mesin itu hanya boleh dipakai saat ada pengawas.
w|maksimal.en: The machine's maximum speed may only be used when a supervisor is present.
w|maksimal.ko: 그 기계의 최고 속도는 감독관이 있을 때만 쓸 수 있어요.

w|maksimal.text: Putri berjanji akan berusaha maksimal untuk datang ke pernikahan Sari.
w|maksimal.en: Putri promises to do her best to come to Sari's wedding.
w|maksimal.ko: 푸트리는 사리의 결혼식에 가려고 최대한 애쓰겠다고 약속해요.

w|maksimum.text: Ruang rawat inap klinik itu punya kapasitas maksimum sepuluh ekor.
w|maksimum.en: The clinic's inpatient ward has a maximum capacity of ten animals.
w|maksimum.ko: 그 병원 입원실은 최대 열 마리까지 받을 수 있어요.

w|maksimum.text: Jembatan gantung di desa itu punya beban maksimum lima orang sekaligus.
w|maksimum.en: The village's suspension bridge has a maximum load of five people at once.
w|maksimum.ko: 그 마을 출렁다리는 한 번에 최대 다섯 명까지 건널 수 있어요.

w|malah.en: He left without saying anything instead.
w|malah.ko: 그는 오히려 말도 없이 가 버렸어.

w|malah.en: I asked for help and got scolded instead.

w|malahan.text: Kucing itu tidak takut disuntik, malahan mendengkur di meja periksa.
w|malahan.en: The cat wasn't afraid of the injection; in fact, it purred on the exam table.
w|malahan.ko: 그 고양이는 주사를 무서워하기는커녕 진료대 위에서 골골거렸어요.

w|malahan.text: Hujan tidak membuat Siti berhenti memetik teh, malahan Siti bekerja lebih cepat.
w|malahan.en: The rain didn't stop Siti picking tea; if anything, she worked faster.
w|malahan.ko: 비가 와도 시티는 찻잎 따기를 멈추지 않았고, 오히려 더 빨리 일했어요.

w|malaikat.text: Malaikat dalam dongeng itu sangat baik hati.
w|malaikat.en: The angel in that fairy tale is very kind.
w|malaikat.ko: 그 동화 속 천사는 정말 마음씨가 좋아.

w|malaikat.text: Dia percaya ada malaikat yang menjaganya.
w|malaikat.en: She believes an angel is watching over her.
w|malaikat.ko: 그녀는 자신을 지키는 천사가 있다고 믿어.

w|malang.en: That poor child lost his toy.
His luck really is unfortunate today.

w|malapetaka.text: Kisah drama itu dimulai dengan malapetaka banjir besar yang menenggelamkan desa.
w|malapetaka.en: The play's story begins with the catastrophe of a great flood that drowned a village.
w|malapetaka.ko: 그 연극은 마을을 삼킨 큰 홍수라는 재앙으로 시작해요.

w|malapetaka.text: Kebakaran pasar tahun lalu menjadi malapetaka bagi banyak pedagang, termasuk Ayu.
w|malapetaka.en: Last year's market fire was a disaster for many traders, including Ayu.
w|malapetaka.ko: 작년 시장 화재는 아유를 포함한 많은 상인들에게 재앙이었어요.

w|malas.text: Poster di dinding klinik menjelaskan bahwa depresi juga bisa membuat orang malas merawat gigi.
w|malas.en: A poster on the clinic wall explains that depression can also make people neglect their teeth.
w|malas.ko: 치과 벽 포스터에는 우울증 때문에 이 관리를 소홀히 할 수도 있다고 쓰여 있어요.

w|malas.text: Tukang yang malas itu akhirnya diganti oleh Wati.
w|malas.en: Wati eventually replaced the lazy builder.
w|malas.ko: 와티는 결국 그 게으른 인부를 바꿨어요.

w|maling.text: Bayu menulis berita tentang maling ayam yang tertangkap warga pada dini hari.
w|maling.en: Bayu wrote a story about a chicken thief caught by residents in the early hours.
w|maling.ko: 바유는 새벽에 주민들에게 잡힌 닭 도둑 기사를 썼어요.

w|maling.text: Paket Intan hilang dari teras dan tetangganya curiga ada maling.
w|maling.en: Intan's package disappeared from the porch and her neighbor suspected a thief.
w|maling.ko: 인탄의 택배가 현관에서 사라져서 이웃은 도둑을 의심했어요.

w|malu.en: Too shy to ask, you'll get lost.

w|mamalia.text: Kelelawar yang tinggal di lumbung Budi termasuk mamalia.
w|mamalia.en: The bats living in Budi's barn are mammals.

w|mamalia.text: Siti menjelaskan kepada pelayan baru bahwa paus adalah mamalia, bukan ikan.
w|mamalia.en: Siti explained to the new waiter that whales are mammals, not fish.
w|mamalia.ko: 시티는 새 종업원에게 고래가 물고기가 아니라 포유류라고 설명했어요.

w|mampir.text: Mampir sebentar ke rumah nenek, yuk.
w|mampir.en: Let's drop by grandma's house for a bit.

w|mampir.text: Dia mampir membeli kopi di jalan.
w|mampir.en: He dropped by to buy coffee on the way.

w|manajemen.text: Pihak manajemen restoran memutuskan untuk menutup dapur setiap hari Senin.
w|manajemen.en: The restaurant management decided to close the kitchen every Monday.
w|manajemen.ko: 식당 경영진은 매주 월요일에 주방을 닫기로 했어요.

w|manajemen.text: Lestari ikut kursus manajemen usaha kecil supaya lapaknya lebih teratur.
w|manajemen.en: Lestari took a small business management course so her stall would be better organized.
w|manajemen.ko: 레스타리는 노점을 더 체계적으로 꾸리려고 소상공인 경영 강좌를 들었어요.

w|manajer.text: Manajer toko memeriksa stok setiap pagi.
w|manajer.en: The store manager checks stock every morning.
w|manajer.ko: 가게 매니저가 매일 아침 재고를 확인해.

w|manajer.en: We spoke with the project manager.

w|mandi.en: That child is taking a bath.

w|mandiri.text: Fajar dan istrinya ingin hidup mandiri dan tidak tinggal bersama orang tua.
w|mandiri.en: Fajar and his wife want to live independently and not with their parents.
w|mandiri.ko: 파자르 부부는 부모님과 함께 살지 않고 독립해서 살고 싶어 해요.

w|mandiri.text: Lestari menulis artikel tentang koperasi desa yang membuat warga lebih mandiri.
w|mandiri.en: Lestari wrote an article about a village cooperative that made residents more self-reliant.
w|mandiri.ko: 레스타리는 주민들을 더 자립적으로 만든 마을 협동조합에 대한 기사를 썼어요.

w|mangkuk.text: Andi menuang adonan ke dalam mangkuk besar sambil mendengarkan instruktur.
w|mangkuk.en: Andi poured the batter into a big bowl while listening to the instructor.
w|mangkuk.ko: 안디는 강사 말을 들으면서 반죽을 큰 그릇에 부었어요.

w|mangkuk.text: Dewi menyimpan surat-surat dari Rani di sebuah mangkuk keramik tua di atas meja.
w|mangkuk.en: Dewi keeps the letters from Rani in an old ceramic bowl on the table.
w|mangkuk.ko: 데위는 라니에게 받은 편지들을 탁자 위 낡은 도자기 그릇에 넣어 둬요.

w|maniak.text: Sepupu Fajar adalah maniak fotografi yang memotret setiap detail dekorasi pernikahan.
w|maniak.en: Fajar's cousin is a photography maniac who photographed every detail of the wedding decorations.
w|maniak.ko: 파자르의 사촌은 결혼식 장식을 하나하나 다 찍는 사진광이에요.

w|maniak.text: Rekan Lestari adalah maniak sepak bola yang hafal skor pertandingan sejak puluhan tahun lalu.
w|maniak.en: Lestari's coworker is a football maniac who remembers match scores from decades ago.
w|maniak.ko: 레스타리의 동료는 수십 년 전 경기 점수까지 외우는 축구광이에요.

w|manisan.text: Agus menaburkan manisan kulit jeruk di atas roti Natal.
w|manisan.en: Agus sprinkled candied orange peel over the Christmas bread.
w|manisan.ko: 아구스는 크리스마스 빵 위에 설탕에 절인 오렌지 껍질을 뿌렸어요.

w|manisan.text: Wati membawa manisan mangga dari kampung untuk rekan satu tim.
w|manisan.en: Wati brought candied mango from her hometown for her teammates.
w|manisan.ko: 와티는 팀원들에게 주려고 고향에서 망고 절임을 가져왔어요.

w|manja.text: Keponakan Fajar yang manja menangis karena ingin duduk di pelaminan.
w|manja.en: Fajar's spoiled niece cried because she wanted to sit on the wedding dais.
w|manja.ko: 응석받이인 파자르의 조카가 신랑 신부 자리에 앉고 싶다며 울었어요.

w|manja.text: Kucing Lestari jadi manja dan selalu minta dipeluk saat udara dingin.
w|manja.en: Lestari's cat gets clingy and always wants to be held when it's cold.
w|manja.ko: 레스타리의 고양이는 날이 추우면 응석을 부리며 늘 안아 달라고 해요.

w|mantap.text: Suara Andi terdengar mantap saat memimpin upacara.
w|mantap.en: Andi's voice sounded steady and confident when he led the ceremony.
w|mantap.ko: 의식을 진행할 때 안디의 목소리는 힘 있고 안정적이었어요.

w|mantap.text: Setelah berdiskusi dengan keluarga, keputusan pasien untuk dioperasi sudah mantap.
w|mantap.en: After talking with the family, the patient's decision to have surgery was firm.
w|mantap.ko: 가족과 이야기한 뒤 환자는 수술을 받기로 마음을 굳혔어요.

w|mantel.text: Seorang ibu datang dengan anjing kecil yang memakai mantel rajut.
w|mantel.en: A woman came in with a little dog wearing a knitted coat.
w|mantel.ko: 한 여성이 뜨개 외투를 입은 작은 강아지를 데리고 왔어요.

w|mantel.text: Putri menggantung mantel di dekat pintu sebelum masuk ruang steril.
w|mantel.en: Putri hung her coat by the door before entering the sterile room.
w|mantel.ko: 푸트리는 무균실에 들어가기 전에 외투를 문 옆에 걸었어요.

w|mantra.en: He recited a spell before starting.

w|manual.text: Di museum transportasi, Rudi melihat mesin cetak manual yang diputar dengan tangan.
w|manual.en: At the transport museum, Rudi saw a manual printing press that was turned by hand.
w|manual.ko: 교통 박물관에서 루디는 손으로 돌리는 수동 인쇄기를 봤어요.

w|manual.text: Rina masih memakai timbangan manual karena lebih dipercaya pembeli.
w|manual.en: Rina still uses a manual scale because shoppers trust it more.
w|manual.ko: 리나는 손님들이 더 믿어서 아직도 수동 저울을 써요.

w|manusia.en: He's still just an ordinary person.

w|manusiawi.text: Penonton terharu melihat sisi manusiawi tokoh raja yang kejam itu.
w|manusiawi.en: The audience was moved to see the human side of the cruel king character.
w|manusiawi.ko: 관객들은 잔인한 왕 캐릭터의 인간적인 면을 보고 감동했어요.

w|manusiawi.text: Ayu selalu memberi utang kepada tetangga yang kesusahan karena menurutnya itu manusiawi.
w|manusiawi.en: Ayu always gives credit to neighbors in need because she thinks it's the humane thing to do.
w|manusiawi.ko: 아유는 형편이 어려운 이웃에게 늘 외상을 줘요. 그게 사람다운 일이라고 생각하거든요.

w|manuver.text: Fajar menilai langkah wali kota itu hanya manuver politik menjelang pemilu.
w|manuver.en: Fajar considered the mayor's move just a political maneuver ahead of the election.
w|manuver.ko: 파자르는 시장의 그 조치가 선거를 앞둔 정치적 술수일 뿐이라고 봤어요.

w|manuver.text: Lestari menulis bahwa memarkir mobil di gang sempit butuh manuver yang hebat.
w|manuver.en: Lestari wrote that parking a car in a narrow alley takes some impressive maneuvering.
w|manuver.ko: 레스타리는 좁은 골목에 차를 대려면 대단한 기술이 필요하다고 썼어요.

w|maraton.text: Andi meminjam buku panduan latihan karena ingin ikut maraton bulan depan.
w|maraton.en: Andi borrowed a training guide because he wants to run the marathon next month.
w|maraton.ko: 안디는 다음 달 마라톤에 나가고 싶어서 훈련 안내서를 빌렸어요.

w|maraton.text: Dewi bilang mengemas seisi rumah itu seperti lari maraton tanpa garis akhir.
w|maraton.en: Dewi said packing up the whole house was like running a marathon with no finish line.
w|maraton.ko: 데위는 집 전체를 싸는 게 끝없는 마라톤 같다고 했어요.

w|maret.text: Budi biasanya memanen padi pada bulan Maret.
w|maret.en: Budi usually harvests his rice in March.

w|maret.text: Kru film tiba di lokasi pada awal bulan Maret.
w|maret.en: The film crew arrived at the location at the beginning of March.
w|maret.ko: 영화 제작진은 삼월 초에 촬영지에 도착했어요.

w|marinir.text: Marinir berlatih di pantai setiap pagi.
w|marinir.en: The marines train on the beach every morning.

w|marinir.text: Seorang marinir menjaga pos di pelabuhan.
w|marinir.en: A marine guarded the post at the harbor.
w|marinir.ko: 해병 한 명이 항구 초소를 지켰어.

w|markas.text: Markas tim ada di lantai atas.
w|markas.en: The team headquarters is on the upper floor.

w|markas.text: Mereka kembali ke markas setelah misi.
w|markas.en: They returned to headquarters after the mission.

w|marsekal.text: Fajar menyambut seorang marsekal purnawirawan yang datang ke peresmian monumen.
w|marsekal.en: Fajar welcomed a retired marshal who came to the monument's inauguration.
w|marsekal.ko: 파자르는 기념비 제막식에 온 퇴역 원수를 맞이했어요.

w|marsekal.text: Unit di sebelah Lestari dulu milik seorang marsekal yang sudah pensiun.
w|marsekal.en: The unit next to Lestari's used to belong to a retired marshal.
w|marsekal.ko: 레스타리 옆집은 예전에 퇴역한 원수의 집이었어요.

w|martir.text: Andi membaca biografi seorang martir yang dihormati dalam sejarah gereja.
w|martir.en: Andi read the biography of a martyr honored in church history.
w|martir.ko: 안디는 교회 역사에서 존경받는 순교자의 전기를 읽었어요.

w|martir.text: Dewi bercanda bahwa ia merasa seperti martir karena mengangkat semua kardus sendirian.
w|martir.en: Dewi joked that she felt like a martyr for carrying all the boxes by herself.
w|martir.ko: 데위는 상자를 혼자 다 나르느라 순교자가 된 기분이라고 농담했어요.

w|masak.en: She likes to cook for her family.
w|masak.ko: 그녀는 가족을 위해 요리하는 걸 좋아해.

w|masak.text: Masak nasi dulu sebelum tamu datang.
w|masak.en: Cook the rice first before the guests arrive.
w|masak.ko: 손님이 오기 전에 밥을 먼저 해.

w|masakan.text: Istri Fajar suka bereksperimen dengan masakan Padang di rumah.
w|masakan.en: Fajar's wife likes experimenting with Padang cooking at home.
w|masakan.ko: 파자르의 아내는 집에서 파당 요리를 이것저것 시도해 보는 걸 좋아해요.

w|masakan.text: Lestari rindu masakan ibunya selama latihan di luar kota.
w|masakan.en: Lestari missed her mother's cooking while training out of town.
w|masakan.ko: 레스타리는 타지에서 훈련하는 동안 엄마 요리가 그리웠어요.

w|masih.en: Are you still at the office?

w|masing-masing.en: They each brought their own bag.

w|masjid.text: Setiap Jumat, Budi dan teman-temannya salat bersama di masjid dekat sekolah.
w|masjid.en: Every Friday, Budi and his friends pray together at the mosque near the school.
w|masjid.ko: 매주 금요일 버디와 친구들은 학교 근처 모스크에서 함께 기도해요.

w|masjid.text: Atap masjid di kampung Siti bocor setiap awal musim hujan.
w|masjid.en: The roof of the mosque in Siti's village leaks at the start of every rainy season.
w|masjid.ko: 시티네 마을 모스크 지붕은 우기가 시작될 때마다 새요.

w|masker.text: Saat flu, Bayu memakai masker kalau tetap datang ke gym.
w|masker.en: When he has the flu, Bayu wears a mask if he still comes to the gym.
w|masker.ko: 독감에 걸렸을 때 바유는 그래도 헬스장에 오면 마스크를 써요.

w|masker.text: Pelayan di dapur selalu memakai masker dan sarung tangan.
w|masker.en: The kitchen staff always wear masks and gloves.
w|masker.ko: 주방 직원들은 늘 마스크와 장갑을 껴요.

w|maskot.text: Di pintu masuk, maskot museum berupa badak kecil selalu diajak berfoto oleh anak-anak.
w|maskot.en: At the entrance, children always pose for photos with the museum's little rhino mascot.
w|maskot.ko: 입구에서 아이들은 늘 작은 코뿔소 모양의 박물관 마스코트와 사진을 찍어요.

w|maskot.text: Toko memasang maskot beruang besar di depan lift untuk musim liburan.
w|maskot.en: The store put a big bear mascot in front of the elevator for the holiday season.
w|maskot.ko: 매장은 연휴 시즌을 맞아 엘리베이터 앞에 큰 곰 마스코트를 세웠어요.

w|massa.text: Ratusan massa berkumpul di depan gedung pengadilan menunggu putusan.
w|massa.en: Hundreds of people gathered in front of the courthouse waiting for the verdict.
w|massa.ko: 수백 명의 군중이 판결을 기다리며 법원 앞에 모였어요.

w|massa.text: Lestari menutup warung lebih awal karena massa suporter sepak bola akan lewat.
w|massa.en: Lestari closed the shop early because a crowd of football fans was going to pass by.
w|massa.ko: 축구 응원단 무리가 지나갈 예정이라 레스타리는 가게를 일찍 닫았어요.

w|massal.text: Sekolah Eko ikut senam massal di alun-alun kota.
w|massal.en: Eko's school joined a mass exercise session in the town square.
w|massal.ko: 에코의 학교는 시내 광장에서 열린 단체 체조에 참가했어요.

w|massal.text: Kelas seni Ayu ikut membuat mural massal di tembok pasar.
w|massal.en: Ayu's art class took part in making a mass mural on the market wall.
w|massal.ko: 아유의 미술반은 시장 벽에 여럿이 함께 그리는 벽화 작업에 참여했어요.

w|masuk.en: I haven't gone in to work yet.

w|masukan.en: Input from customers is very useful.

w|masukan.text: Tim menerima masukan untuk memperbaiki desain.
w|masukan.en: The team received feedback to improve the design.

w|masyarakat.en: The community agrees with that plan.

w|mata.en: My eyes have hurt since morning.
Close your eyes for a moment.

w|mata-mata.text: Mata-mata itu berhasil menyelinap ke markas.
w|mata-mata.en: That spy managed to sneak into the headquarters.
Movies about spies are always thrilling.

w|matahari.en: The sun rises in the east.
Don't look at the sun directly.

w|matang.text: Fajar menunggu sampai pisang di raknya benar-benar matang untuk dibuat bolu.
w|matang.en: Fajar waits until the bananas on his shelf are fully ripe to make sponge cake.
w|matang.ko: 파자르는 선반의 바나나가 완전히 익을 때까지 기다렸다가 카스텔라를 만들어요.

w|matang.text: Pisang yang dibawa Lestari ke lomba sudah matang dan manis.
w|matang.en: The bananas Lestari brought to the race were ripe and sweet.
w|matang.ko: 레스타리가 대회에 가져간 바나나는 잘 익고 달았어요.

w|matematika.en: Mathematics makes him think more logically.
w|matematika.ko: 수학이 그를 더 논리적으로 생각하게 해.

w|matematika.en: She tutors her sibling on math problems.
w|matematika.ko: 그녀는 동생에게 수학 문제를 가르쳐 줘.

w|materi.text: Fajar menyiapkan materi pembelaan sampai larut malam.
w|materi.en: Fajar prepared the defence material until late at night.

w|materi.text: Mahasiswa sering memfotokopi materi kuliah di warung Lestari.
w|materi.en: Students often photocopy lecture materials at Lestari's shop.
w|materi.ko: 대학생들은 레스타리 가게에서 강의 자료를 자주 복사해요.

w|mati-matian.text: Dulu Dimas belajar mati-matian untuk ujian apoteker.
w|mati-matian.en: Dimas studied like crazy for the pharmacist exam.
w|mati-matian.ko: 디마스는 예전에 약사 시험을 위해 죽어라 공부했어요.

w|mati-matian.text: Putri mati-matian mempertahankan jendela kayu asli rumah itu.
w|mati-matian.en: Putri fought hard to keep the house's original wooden windows.
w|mati-matian.ko: 푸트리는 그 집의 원래 나무 창문을 지키려고 기를 썼어요.

w|maut.text: Perkara kecelakaan maut di jalan tol itu akhirnya disidangkan.
w|maut.en: The case of the fatal accident on the toll road finally went to trial.
w|maut.ko: 고속도로 사망 사고 사건이 마침내 재판에 넘겨졌어요.

w|maut.text: Sambil minum kopi, Pak Darto bercerita soal tikungan maut dekat pasar.
w|maut.en: Over coffee, Mr Darto talks about the deadly bend near the market.
w|maut.ko: 다르토 아저씨는 커피를 마시며 시장 근처의 죽음의 커브 이야기를 해요.

w|mawar.text: Ibu Dimas merawat mawar merah di pagar depan.
w|mawar.en: Dimas's mother looks after the red roses by the front fence.
w|mawar.ko: 디마스의 어머니는 앞 울타리의 빨간 장미를 돌봐요.

w|mawar.text: Pulang kerja, Putri membeli seikat mawar untuk ulang tahun ibunya.
w|mawar.en: After work, Putri bought a bunch of roses for her mother's birthday.
w|mawar.ko: 퇴근길에 푸트리는 어머니 생신 선물로 장미 한 다발을 샀어요.

w|mayat.en: They found a body in the river.

w|mayoritas.text: Dalam pemungutan suara, mayoritas teman sekelas Budi memilih karyawisata ke kebun binatang.
w|mayoritas.en: The majority of Budi's classmates voted for a field trip to the zoo.
w|mayoritas.ko: 버디네 반 친구 대부분이 동물원 견학을 골랐어요.

w|mayoritas.text: Di kampung Siti, mayoritas petani menanam padi begitu hujan pertama turun.
w|mayoritas.en: Most farmers in Siti's village plant rice as soon as the first rain falls.
w|mayoritas.ko: 시티네 마을 농부 대부분은 첫 비가 내리면 바로 벼를 심어요.

w|medali.text: Medali emas digantung di leher juara.
w|medali.en: The gold medal was hung around the champion's neck.

w|medali.text: Dia menyimpan medali di lemari kaca.
w|medali.en: She keeps the medal in a glass cabinet.

w|medan.text: Medan perang itu sudah lama ditinggalkan.
w|medan.en: That battlefield has long been abandoned.

w|medan.text: Mereka menavigasi medan yang sulit sekali.
w|medan.ko: 그들은 아주 험한 지형을 헤쳐 나갔어.

w|media.text: Berita tersebar cepat lewat media sosial.
w|media.en: News spreads fast through social media.

w|medis.text: Medis saja yang boleh masuk ruang itu.
w|medis.en: Only medical staff may enter that room.
w|medis.ko: 의료진만 그 방에 들어갈 수 있어.

w|megah.text: Stasiun peninggalan zaman Belanda itu masih terlihat megah sampai sekarang.
w|megah.en: The station from the Dutch colonial era still looks grand today.
w|megah.ko: 네덜란드 시절에 지어진 그 역은 지금도 웅장해 보여요.

w|megah.text: Kantor baru tim Putri tidak megah, tapi nyaman dan dekat stasiun.
w|megah.en: Putri's team's new office isn't grand, but it's comfortable and close to the station.
w|megah.ko: 푸트리 팀의 새 사무실은 웅장하진 않지만 편하고 역에서 가까워요.

w|mei.text: Cuaca di bulan mei biasanya cerah.
w|mei.en: The weather in May is usually clear.

w|meja.en: Put the book on the table.

w|mekanik.text: Budi menulis tentang mekanik bengkel yang memperbaiki ambulans desa secara gratis.
w|mekanik.en: Budi wrote about a workshop mechanic who repairs the village ambulance for free.
w|mekanik.ko: 부디는 마을 구급차를 무료로 고쳐 주는 정비소 정비사에 대해 썼어요.

w|mekanik.text: Buku panduan mesin motor paling sering dipinjam oleh para mekanik muda.
w|mekanik.en: Motorbike engine manuals are borrowed most often by young mechanics.
w|mekanik.ko: 오토바이 엔진 안내서는 젊은 정비사들이 가장 자주 빌려 가요.

w|mekanisme.text: Fajar menjelaskan mekanisme subsidi pupuk dengan bahasa sederhana.
w|mekanisme.en: Fajar explained how the fertilizer subsidy mechanism works in simple language.
w|mekanisme.ko: 파자르는 비료 보조금 구조를 쉬운 말로 설명했어요.

w|mekanisme.text: Montir menjelaskan kepada Lestari mekanisme rem yang mulai aus.
w|mekanisme.en: The mechanic explained to Lestari how the worn brake mechanism works.
w|mekanisme.ko: 정비사가 레스타리에게 닳기 시작한 브레이크 장치에 대해 설명했어요.

w|mekar.text: Bunga teratai di rawa dekat sungai mekar setiap pagi.
w|mekar.en: The lotus flowers in the swamp near the river bloom every morning.
w|mekar.ko: 강 근처 늪의 연꽃이 아침마다 피어나요.

w|mekar.text: Anggrek di jendela apotek mekar tepat saat Wati berulang tahun.
w|mekar.en: The orchid on the pharmacy window bloomed right on Wati's birthday.
w|mekar.ko: 약국 창가의 난초가 마침 와티 생일에 꽃을 피웠어요.

w|melacak.en: The police started tracking the thief's trail.

w|melacak.text: Melacak paket hilang butuh waktu lama.
w|melacak.en: Tracking a lost package takes a long time.
w|melacak.ko: 분실된 택배를 추적하는 데 시간이 오래 걸려.

w|melahap.text: Saat istirahat sidang, Agus melahap sebungkus nasi di kantin pengadilan.
w|melahap.en: During the court recess, Agus wolfed down a pack of rice at the courthouse canteen.
w|melahap.ko: 휴정 시간에 아구스는 법원 매점에서 밥 한 봉지를 허겁지겁 먹었어요.

w|melahap.text: Anak-anak itu melahap ayam goreng sampai tidak ada yang tersisa.
w|melahap.en: The children devoured the fried chicken until nothing was left.

w|melahirkan.text: Ibu itu akan melahirkan sebentar lagi.
w|melahirkan.en: That mother will give birth soon.

w|melahirkan.text: Ide baru bisa melahirkan perubahan besar.
w|melahirkan.en: A new idea can give birth to big change.
w|melahirkan.ko: 새 아이디어가 큰 변화를 낳을 수 있어.

w|melainkan.text: Dimas tidak malas, melainkan kurang tidur karena membantu orang tuanya.
w|melainkan.en: Dimas isn't lazy; rather, he's short on sleep because he helps his parents.
w|melainkan.ko: 디마스는 게으른 게 아니라 부모님을 돕느라 잠이 부족한 거예요.

w|melainkan.text: Pelanggan itu tidak memesan nasi, melainkan mi goreng spesial buatan Putri.
w|melainkan.en: That customer didn't order rice but Putri's special fried noodles instead.
w|melainkan.ko: 그 손님은 밥이 아니라 푸트리가 만든 특제 볶음면을 주문했어요.

w|melaju.text: Mobil ambulans hewan melaju cepat membawa anjing yang tertabrak.
w|melaju.en: The animal ambulance sped along carrying a dog that had been hit by a car.
w|melaju.ko: 동물 구급차가 차에 치인 개를 싣고 빠르게 달렸어요.

w|melaju.text: Motor Putri melaju pelan di jalan kampus yang licin.
w|melaju.en: Putri's motorbike moved slowly along the slippery campus road.
w|melaju.ko: 푸트리의 오토바이가 미끄러운 캠퍼스 길을 천천히 달렸어요.

w|melaksanakan.text: Sekolah Budi melaksanakan upacara bendera setiap hari Senin.
w|melaksanakan.en: Budi's school holds a flag ceremony every Monday.
w|melaksanakan.ko: 부디의 학교는 매주 월요일에 국기 게양식을 해요.

w|melaksanakan.text: Panitia melaksanakan reuni di aula sekolah lama mereka.
w|melaksanakan.en: The committee held the reunion in the hall of their old school.
w|melaksanakan.ko: 준비위원회는 옛 학교 강당에서 동창회를 열었어요.

w|melalui.en: He came in through the window.

w|melamar.text: Adik Bayu melamar kerja di bagian pengemasan.
w|melamar.en: Bayu's younger brother applied for a job in the packing section.

w|melamar.text: Teman Intan pernah melamar jadi pramugari di maskapai itu.
w|melamar.en: Intan's friend once applied to be a flight attendant at that airline.
w|melamar.ko: 인탄의 친구는 그 항공사 승무원에 지원한 적이 있어요.

w|melambai.text: Pasien cilik itu melambai kepada Budi dari jendela mobil saat pulang.
w|melambai.en: The young patient waved to Budi from the car window on the way home.
w|melambai.ko: 꼬마 환자는 퇴원하면서 차창 밖으로 부디에게 손을 흔들었어요.

w|melambai.text: Siti melambai kepada keluarganya dari balik kaca pemeriksaan.
w|melambai.en: Siti waved to her family from behind the security glass.
w|melambai.ko: 시티는 검색대 유리 너머로 가족에게 손을 흔들었어요.

w|melambaikan.text: Budi melambaikan tangan kepada adiknya dari jendela kelas.
w|melambaikan.en: Budi waved to his little sister from the classroom window.
w|melambaikan.ko: 부디는 교실 창문에서 동생에게 손을 흔들었어요.

w|melambaikan.text: Siti melambaikan tiket kepada sepupunya dari balik kaca.
w|melambaikan.en: Siti waved her ticket at her cousin from behind the glass.
w|melambaikan.ko: 시티는 유리 너머에서 사촌에게 표를 흔들어 보였어요.

w|melambangkan.text: Logo baru redaksi melambangkan kebebasan pers.
w|melambangkan.en: The newsroom's new logo symbolizes freedom of the press.
w|melambangkan.ko: 편집국의 새 로고는 언론 자유를 상징해요.

w|melambangkan.text: Dewi menggantung lukisan pohon yang melambangkan awal baru.
w|melambangkan.en: Dewi hung a painting of a tree that symbolizes a new beginning.
w|melambangkan.ko: 데위는 새 출발을 상징하는 나무 그림을 걸었어요.

w|melambat.text: Mobil pengantin melambat saat melewati rumah-rumah tetangga yang melambaikan tangan.
w|melambat.en: The bridal car slowed down as it passed the neighbors' houses, where people were waving.
w|melambat.ko: 웨딩카는 손을 흔드는 이웃집들을 지나며 속도를 줄였어요.

w|melambat.text: Menjelang tengah malam, pekerjaan di ruang redaksi mulai melambat.
w|melambat.en: Toward midnight, work in the newsroom began to slow down.
w|melambat.ko: 자정이 다가오자 편집국 업무가 느려지기 시작했어요.

w|melambung.text: Biaya renovasi melambung karena harga semen naik tiba-tiba.
w|melambung.en: The renovation costs soared because cement prices suddenly went up.

w|melambung.text: Harga tiket kereta melambung menjelang libur Lebaran.
w|melambung.en: Train ticket prices soar ahead of the Eid holiday.
w|melambung.ko: 르바란 연휴를 앞두고 기차표 값이 치솟아요.

w|melampaui.text: Nilai ujian Andi kali ini melampaui target yang dia buat sendiri.
w|melampaui.en: Andi's exam score this time exceeded the target he set himself.
w|melampaui.ko: 이번에 안디의 시험 점수는 스스로 세운 목표를 넘었어요.

w|melampaui.text: Jumlah pasien demam berdarah bulan ini melampaui perkiraan rumah sakit.
w|melampaui.en: The number of dengue patients this month exceeded the hospital's estimate.
w|melampaui.ko: 이번 달 뎅기열 환자 수가 병원 예상을 넘었어요.

w|melampiaskan.text: Kalau sedang kesal, Eko melampiaskan emosinya dengan berenang jauh ke tengah.
w|melampiaskan.en: When he's upset, Eko vents his feelings by swimming far out.
w|melampiaskan.ko: 속상할 때면 에코는 멀리 헤엄쳐 나가며 감정을 풀어요.

w|melampiaskan.text: Ayu biasa melampiaskan stres dengan mengunyah es batu, kebiasaan yang dilarang dokternya.
w|melampiaskan.en: Ayu usually relieves stress by chewing ice cubes, a habit her dentist forbade.
w|melampiaskan.ko: 아유는 얼음을 씹으며 스트레스를 푸는 버릇이 있는데, 의사가 하지 말라고 했어요.

w|melamun.text: Rudi menegur petugas jaga yang melamun di meja depan.
w|melamun.en: Rudi scolded the duty officer who was daydreaming at the front desk.
w|melamun.ko: 루디는 안내 데스크에서 멍하니 있던 당직 경찰을 나무랐어요.

w|melamun.text: Rina melihat seekor burung beo yang seperti melamun di dalam kandang.
w|melamun.en: Rina saw a parrot that seemed to be daydreaming in its cage.
w|melamun.ko: 리나는 새장 안에서 멍하니 있는 듯한 앵무새를 봤어요.

w|melancarkan.text: Bayu membawa kue untuk melancarkan perkenalan dengan tim.
w|melancarkan.en: Bayu brought cake to smooth his introduction to the team.
w|melancarkan.ko: 바유는 팀과 인사를 순조롭게 나누려고 케이크를 가져왔어요.

w|melancarkan.text: Intan melancarkan pukulan cepat ke samsak.
w|melancarkan.en: Intan threw quick punches at the punching bag.

w|melanda.text: Rasa gugup sempat melanda Andi saat ujian praktik dimulai.
w|melanda.en: A wave of nerves hit Andi when the practical exam began.
w|melanda.ko: 실기 시험이 시작되자 안디는 잠깐 긴장감에 휩싸였어요.

w|melanda.text: Rani bercerita bahwa banjir sempat melanda desanya bulan lalu.
w|melanda.en: Rani wrote that a flood hit her village last month.
w|melanda.ko: 라니는 지난달 마을에 홍수가 났었다고 썼어요.

w|melanggar.en: Breaking a promise made her disappointed.

w|melangkah.text: Dia berani melangkah ke masa depan.
w|melangkah.en: She dares to step into the future.
w|melangkah.ko: 그녀는 용감하게 미래로 한 걸음 나아가.

w|melangkahi.text: Agus tidak mau melangkahi pemilik toko dalam urusan harga.
w|melangkahi.en: Agus doesn't want to go over the shop owner's head on pricing.
w|melangkahi.ko: 아구스는 가격 문제에서 가게 주인을 건너뛰고 결정하고 싶지 않아요.

w|melangkahi.text: Wati tidak suka jika manajer produk melangkahi tim dalam mengambil keputusan.
w|melangkahi.en: Wati doesn't like it when the product manager bypasses the team in making decisions.
w|melangkahi.ko: 와티는 제품 관리자가 팀을 건너뛰고 결정하는 걸 싫어해요.

w|melanjutkan.en: She wants to continue her studies.

w|melapisi.text: Atas permintaan Fajar, petugas melapisi lantai aula dengan karpet baru.
w|melapisi.en: At Fajar's request, the workers covered the hall floor with new carpet.
w|melapisi.ko: 파자르의 요청으로 직원들이 강당 바닥에 새 카펫을 깔았어요.

w|melapisi.text: Lestari melapisi rak dapur dengan kertas kontak bermotif bunga.
w|melapisi.en: Lestari lined the kitchen shelves with flowered contact paper.
w|melapisi.ko: 레스타리는 부엌 선반에 꽃무늬 시트지를 붙였어요.

w|melapor.text: Saksi wajib melapor ke kantor polisi.
w|melapor.en: The witness must report to the police station.

w|melapor.text: Dia akan melapor jika menemukan masalah.
w|melapor.en: She will report if she finds a problem.

w|melaporkan.text: Polisi meminta warga melaporkan kejadian itu.
w|melaporkan.en: The police asked residents to report the incident.
w|melaporkan.ko: 경찰이 주민들에게 그 일을 신고하라고 했어.

w|melaporkan.en: I will report the results tomorrow.

w|melarang.text: Sekolah melarang siswa membawa ponsel ke dalam kelas.
w|melarang.en: The school forbids students from bringing phones into the classroom.
w|melarang.ko: 학교는 학생들이 교실에 휴대폰을 가져오는 걸 금지해요.

w|melarang.text: Dokter melarang pasien itu makan makanan pedas selama seminggu.
w|melarang.en: The doctor forbade the patient from eating spicy food for a week.
w|melarang.ko: 의사는 그 환자에게 일주일 동안 매운 음식을 먹지 말라고 했어요.

w|melarikan.en: They made off with the stolen goods.

w|melatih.text: Pelatih itu melatih tim setiap sore.
w|melatih.en: That coach trains the team every afternoon.
w|melatih.ko: 그 코치가 매일 오후에 팀을 훈련시켜.

w|melatih.text: Dia melatih diri untuk lari maraton.
w|melatih.en: She trains herself for a marathon run.

w|melayang.text: Pikiran Eko melayang ke kampung halaman saat menulis berita mudik.
w|melayang.en: Eko's thoughts drifted to his hometown while he wrote about the holiday exodus.
w|melayang.ko: 귀성 기사를 쓰면서 에코의 마음은 고향으로 날아갔어요.

w|melayang.text: Sekrup kecil itu melayang dari meja dan hilang di bawah rak.
w|melayang.en: The tiny screw flew off the table and disappeared under the shelf.
w|melayang.ko: 작은 나사가 탁자에서 튀어 나가 선반 밑으로 사라졌어요.

w|melayani.en: That waiter kindly serves the guests.

w|melebar.text: Kata Bayu, sungai itu melebar di dekat muara dan arusnya melambat.
w|melebar.en: According to Bayu, the river widens near the estuary and the current slows down.
w|melebar.ko: 바유 말로는 그 강이 하구 근처에서 넓어지고 물살이 느려져요.

w|melebar.text: Setelah tikungan itu jalan melebar, jadi Intan mulai menyalip pelari lain.
w|melebar.en: After the bend the road widened, so Intan began passing other runners.
w|melebar.ko: 그 모퉁이를 지나자 길이 넓어져서 인탄은 다른 주자들을 추월하기 시작했어요.

w|melebih-lebihkan.text: Teman-teman Budi suka melebih-lebihkan cerita tentang hantu di toilet sekolah.
w|melebih-lebihkan.en: Budi's friends like to exaggerate stories about the ghost in the school toilet.
w|melebih-lebihkan.ko: 버디의 친구들은 학교 화장실 귀신 이야기를 부풀리는 걸 좋아해요.

w|melebih-lebihkan.text: Siti merasa berita di televisi suka melebih-lebihkan bahaya musim hujan.
w|melebih-lebihkan.en: Siti feels the TV news tends to exaggerate the dangers of the rainy season.
w|melebih-lebihkan.ko: 시티는 텔레비전 뉴스가 우기의 위험을 부풀린다고 느껴요.

w|melecehkan.text: Lakon itu bercerita tentang pekerja yang berani melawan atasan yang melecehkan karyawan.
w|melecehkan.en: The play tells of a worker who dares to stand up to a boss who harasses employees.
w|melecehkan.ko: 그 연극은 직원들을 괴롭히는 상사에게 맞서는 노동자 이야기예요.

w|melecehkan.text: Kepala desa mengingatkan bahwa melecehkan pendatang adalah perbuatan yang memalukan.
w|melecehkan.en: The village head reminds everyone that harassing newcomers is a shameful act.
w|melecehkan.ko: 이장은 외지인을 괴롭히는 건 부끄러운 짓이라고 일깨워요.

w|meledak.text: Ban mobil itu meledak di jalan.
w|meledak.en: That car tire exploded on the road.
His anger exploded when he heard the news.

w|meledakkan.text: Mereka mencoba meledakkan balon besar itu.
w|meledakkan.en: They tried to pop that big balloon.
w|meledakkan.ko: 그들은 그 큰 풍선을 터뜨리려 했어.

w|meledakkan.text: Jangan meledakkan petasan di dekat rumah.
w|meledakkan.en: Don't set off firecrackers near the house.

w|melegakan.text: Bagi Rudi, mendengar kakaknya tertawa lagi sungguh melegakan.
w|melegakan.en: For Rudi, hearing his sister laugh again was a real relief.
w|melegakan.ko: 루디에게는 누나가 다시 웃는 소리를 듣는 게 정말 안심이 됐어요.

w|melegakan.text: Angin laut yang sejuk terasa melegakan setelah perjalanan panjang.
w|melegakan.en: The cool sea breeze felt refreshing after the long journey.
w|melegakan.ko: 긴 여행 끝에 시원한 바닷바람이 한결 숨통을 틔워 줬어요.

w|melekat.text: Aroma melati masih melekat di baju Fajar sampai malam.
w|melekat.en: The scent of jasmine still clung to Fajar's clothes until night.
w|melekat.ko: 재스민 향이 밤까지 파자르의 옷에 배어 있었어요.

w|melekat.text: Lumpur melekat di sepatu Lestari setiap kali ia pulang dari sawah.
w|melekat.en: Mud sticks to Lestari's shoes every time she comes back from the rice field.
w|melekat.ko: 논에서 돌아올 때마다 레스타리의 신발에 진흙이 들러붙어요.

w|melelahkan.text: Latihan sampai tengah malam memang melelahkan, tapi Bayu menikmatinya.
w|melelahkan.en: Rehearsing until midnight is exhausting, but Bayu enjoys it.
w|melelahkan.ko: 자정까지 하는 연습은 정말 힘들지만 바유는 그걸 즐겨요.

w|melelahkan.text: Perjalanan pulang-pergi kantor setiap hari cukup melelahkan bagi Intan.
w|melelahkan.en: The daily commute to and from the office is quite tiring for Intan.
w|melelahkan.ko: 매일 출퇴근하는 길이 인탄에게는 꽤 피곤해요.

w|meleleh.text: Mentega di meja dapur cepat meleleh karena panas kompor.
w|meleleh.en: The butter on the kitchen counter melts quickly from the stove's heat.
w|meleleh.ko: 주방 조리대 위 버터가 가스레인지 열 때문에 금방 녹아요.

w|meleleh.text: Lilin aroma di lapak Lestari mulai meleleh karena terkena matahari siang.
w|meleleh.en: The scented candles at Lestari's stall started melting in the midday sun.
w|meleleh.ko: 레스타리 노점의 향초가 한낮 햇볕에 녹기 시작했어요.

w|melemah.text: Menjelang tengah malam, suara musik mulai melemah karena pemainnya kelelahan.
w|melemah.en: Toward midnight, the music started to fade because the players were exhausted.
w|melemah.ko: 자정이 가까워지자 연주자들이 지쳐서 음악 소리가 약해졌어요.

w|melemah.text: Sinyal internet di kantor redaksi melemah setiap kali hujan deras.
w|melemah.en: The internet signal at the newsroom weakens every time it rains hard.
w|melemah.ko: 폭우가 올 때마다 편집국 인터넷 신호가 약해져요.

w|melemahkan.text: Bayu takut hujan deras akan melemahkan tanah di tepi jurang.
w|melemahkan.en: Bayu feared the heavy rain would weaken the soil at the edge of the ravine.
w|melemahkan.ko: 바유는 폭우가 낭떠러지 가장자리의 흙을 약하게 할까 봐 걱정했어요.

w|melemahkan.text: Guru bilang terlalu banyak warna gelap bisa melemahkan kesan ceria lukisan Intan.
w|melemahkan.en: The teacher said too many dark colors could weaken the cheerful feel of Intan's painting.
w|melemahkan.ko: 선생님은 어두운 색이 너무 많으면 인탄 그림의 밝은 느낌이 약해질 수 있다고 했어요.

w|melempar.text: Dia melempar bola ke arah keranjang.
w|melempar.en: He throws the ball toward the basket.

w|melempar.text: Melempar sampah ke sungai sangat merusak.
w|melempar.en: Throwing trash into the river is very damaging.
w|melempar.ko: 강에 쓰레기를 던지는 건 아주 해로워.

w|melemparkan.text: Dia melemparkan bola ke arah temannya.
w|melemparkan.en: He threw the ball toward his friend.
Don't throw trash into the river.

w|melengkapi.text: Eko melengkapi koleksi kerangnya dengan satu kerang berwarna ungu.
w|melengkapi.en: Eko completed his shell collection with one purple shell.
w|melengkapi.ko: 에코는 보라색 조개껍데기 하나로 자기 조개 수집을 완성했어요.

w|melengkapi.text: Tetangga Ayu melengkapi rumahnya dengan kamera keamanan.
w|melengkapi.en: Ayu's neighbor equipped his house with security cameras.
w|melengkapi.ko: 아유의 이웃은 집에 보안 카메라를 갖췄어요.

w|melengking.text: Ketel di dapur Eko melengking ketika air mendidih.
w|melengking.en: The kettle in Eko's kitchen shrieks when the water boils.
w|melengking.ko: 에코네 주방 주전자는 물이 끓으면 삐 하고 날카롭게 울려요.

w|melengking.text: Suara jangkrik melengking di malam kemarau yang panas, membuat Ayu sulit tidur.
w|melengking.en: Crickets shrilled on the hot dry-season night, making it hard for Ayu to sleep.
w|melengking.ko: 더운 건기 밤에 귀뚜라미가 날카롭게 울어서 아유는 잠들기 어려웠어요.

w|melengkung.text: Andi mengganti besi yang melengkung karena tertimpa batu.
w|melengkung.en: Andi replaced the iron bar that had bent after a rock fell on it.
w|melengkung.ko: 안디는 돌에 깔려 휜 쇠막대를 바꿨어요.

w|melengkung.text: Dewi menunjuk jembatan kayu melengkung di taman tempat mereka dulu berfoto.
w|melengkung.en: Dewi pointed to the curved wooden bridge in the park where they used to take photos.
w|melengkung.ko: 데위는 예전에 사진을 찍던 공원의 굽은 나무다리를 가리켰어요.

w|melenyapkan.text: Penghapus papan tulis yang baru bisa melenyapkan coretan spidol dalam sekali usap.
w|melenyapkan.en: The new board eraser can wipe away marker scribbles in one swipe.
w|melenyapkan.ko: 새 칠판지우개는 한 번만 문질러도 마커 낙서를 없애요.

w|melenyapkan.text: Rina menyemprotkan cairan khusus untuk melenyapkan bau apek di lemari dapur.
w|melenyapkan.en: Rina sprayed a special liquid to get rid of the musty smell in the kitchen cabinet.
w|melenyapkan.ko: 리나는 부엌 찬장의 퀴퀴한 냄새를 없애려고 전용 세정제를 뿌렸어요.

w|melepas.en: Take off your shoes at the door.

w|melepaskan.en: He tried to release the rope.
I have to let everything go.

w|meleset.text: Perkiraan Eko soal hasil pemilihan ketua kampung ternyata meleset.
w|meleset.en: Eko's prediction about the result of the village head election turned out to be wrong.
w|meleset.ko: 마을 이장 선거 결과에 대한 에코의 예상은 빗나갔어요.

w|meleset.text: Obeng Ayu meleset dan menggores sedikit bodi ponsel.
w|meleset.en: Ayu's screwdriver slipped and slightly scratched the phone's body.
w|meleset.ko: 아유의 드라이버가 미끄러져서 휴대폰 몸체가 조금 긁혔어요.

w|meletakkan.en: Put the book on the table.
She put the bag on the floor.

w|meletus.text: Kakek Agus masih ingat saat gunung itu meletus puluhan tahun lalu.
w|meletus.en: Agus's grandfather still remembers when the mountain erupted decades ago.
w|meletus.ko: 아구스의 할아버지는 수십 년 전 그 산이 폭발했던 때를 아직 기억해요.

w|meletus.text: Wati bertanya apakah sahabatnya aman setelah gunung di dekat kota itu meletus.
w|meletus.en: Wati asked whether her friend was safe after the mountain near that town erupted.
w|meletus.ko: 와티는 그 도시 근처 산이 폭발한 뒤 친구가 무사한지 물었어요.

w|melewati.en: We passed through that small village.
Going through hard times made me strong.

w|melewatkan.text: Aku tidak mau melewatkan kesempatan ini.
w|melewatkan.en: I don't want to miss this chance.
Missing the train made him angry.

w|melibatkan.text: Jangan melibatkan anak dalam konflik orang dewasa.
w|melibatkan.en: Don't involve children in adult conflicts.

w|melihat-lihat.text: Kalau Bayu datang ke Bandung, Rudi ingin mengajaknya melihat-lihat toko buku tua.
w|melihat-lihat.en: If Bayu comes to Bandung, Rudi wants to take him browsing in old bookshops.
w|melihat-lihat.ko: 바유가 반둥에 오면 루디는 함께 헌책방을 둘러보고 싶어요.

w|melihat-lihat.text: Calon investor datang ke kantor untuk melihat-lihat cara tim bekerja.
w|melihat-lihat.en: A potential investor came to the office to look around at how the team works.
w|melihat-lihat.ko: 예비 투자자가 팀이 일하는 모습을 둘러보러 사무실에 왔어요.

w|melindungi.en: That hat protects from the sun.

w|melingkar.text: Para wartawan berdiri melingkar di depan pintu ruang sidang sambil menunggu putusan.
w|melingkar.en: The reporters stood in a circle in front of the courtroom door waiting for the verdict.
w|melingkar.ko: 기자들은 판결을 기다리며 법정 문 앞에 둥글게 서 있었어요.

w|melingkar.text: Satu keluarga besar duduk melingkar di meja bundar dekat jendela.
w|melingkar.en: A big family sat in a circle at the round table near the window.

w|melintas.text: Rudi melihat seekor rusa melintas di jalan saat pulang dari peternakan.
w|melintas.en: Rudi saw a deer cross the road on his way back from the farm.
w|melintas.ko: 루디는 농장에서 돌아오는 길에 사슴 한 마리가 길을 건너는 걸 봤어요.

w|melintas.text: Rina melambai setiap kali truk sayur melintas di depan rumahnya.
w|melintas.en: Rina waves every time the vegetable truck passes in front of her house.
w|melintas.ko: 리나는 채소 트럭이 집 앞을 지나갈 때마다 손을 흔들어요.

w|melintasi.text: Pesawat melintasi langit di atas kota.
w|melintasi.en: The plane crossed the sky above the city.

w|melipat.text: Rudi melipat surat laporan itu dengan rapi sebelum memasukkannya ke dalam map.
w|melipat.en: Rudi folded the report letter neatly before putting it into the folder.
w|melipat.ko: 루디는 보고서를 깔끔하게 접어서 서류철에 넣었어요.

w|melipat.text: Rina melipat ujung nomor dadanya supaya tidak berkibar tertiup angin.
w|melipat.en: Rina folded the corner of her race bib so it wouldn't flap in the wind.
w|melipat.ko: 리나는 배번표 끝이 바람에 펄럭이지 않게 접었어요.

w|meliput.text: Seorang wartawan datang meliput pembangunan jembatan yang diawasi Andi.
w|meliput.en: A journalist came to cover the construction of the bridge Andi supervises.
w|meliput.ko: 기자 한 명이 안디가 감독하는 다리 공사를 취재하러 왔어요.

w|meliput.text: Dulu Dewi bercita-cita menjadi wartawan yang meliput olimpiade.
w|meliput.en: Dewi used to dream of becoming a journalist covering the Olympics.
w|meliput.ko: 데위는 예전에 올림픽을 취재하는 기자가 되는 게 꿈이었어요.

w|meliputi.text: Tugas Eko di pantai meliputi mengawasi perenang dan memasang bendera peringatan.
w|meliputi.en: Eko's duties on the beach include watching swimmers and putting up warning flags.
w|meliputi.ko: 해변에서 에코가 하는 일에는 수영객을 지켜보고 경고 깃발을 다는 것이 포함돼요.

w|meliputi.text: Biaya perawatan Ayu sudah meliputi pembersihan karang gigi dan tambalan.
w|meliputi.en: Ayu's treatment cost already covers scaling and a filling.
w|meliputi.ko: 아유의 치료비에는 스케일링과 충전 치료가 이미 포함돼 있어요.

w|melirik.text: Rina melirik Budi dengan malu waktu uangnya ditemukan.
w|melirik.en: Rina glanced at Budi sheepishly when her money was found.
w|melirik.ko: 돈을 찾았을 때 리나는 부끄러운 듯 부디를 힐끗 봤어요.

w|melirik.text: Siti melirik jam dan sadar truknya sudah terlambat.
w|melirik.en: Siti glanced at the clock and realized the truck was already late.
w|melirik.ko: 시티는 시계를 힐끗 보고 트럭이 이미 늦었다는 걸 알았어요.

w|melodi.text: Budi bersiul mengikuti melodi lagu sekolah yang diputar di pengeras suara.
w|melodi.en: Budi whistled along to the melody of the school song playing over the loudspeaker.
w|melodi.ko: 버디는 스피커에서 나오는 교가 선율을 따라 휘파람을 불었어요.

w|melodi.text: Suara rintik hujan di atap seng terdengar seperti melodi bagi Siti.
w|melodi.en: The sound of raindrops on the tin roof sounds like a melody to Siti.
w|melodi.ko: 양철 지붕에 떨어지는 빗소리가 시티에게는 선율처럼 들려요.

w|melolong.text: Anjing tetangga Agus melolong setiap kali ada sirene lewat.
w|melolong.en: Agus's neighbor's dog howls every time a siren goes by.
w|melolong.ko: 아구스네 이웃집 개는 사이렌이 지나갈 때마다 울부짖어요.

w|melolong.text: Anjing di gang belakang melolong saat Wati menutup rumah makan malam-malam.
w|melolong.en: A dog in the back alley howled as Wati closed the restaurant late at night.
