w|melolong.ko: 와티가 밤늦게 식당 문을 닫을 때 뒷골목 개가 울부짖었어요.

w|meloloskan.text: Pemimpin redaksi akhirnya meloloskan tulisan Bayu untuk halaman depan.
w|meloloskan.en: The editor-in-chief finally approved Bayu's piece for the front page.
w|meloloskan.ko: 편집장은 결국 바유의 글을 일면에 싣기로 통과시켰어요.

w|meloloskan.text: Petugas bea cukai akhirnya meloloskan paket Intan yang dikirim dari luar negeri.
w|meloloskan.en: Customs officers finally cleared Intan's package that had been sent from abroad.
w|meloloskan.ko: 세관 직원이 마침내 해외에서 온 인탄의 택배를 통과시켰어요.

w|melompat.text: Kucing itu melompat ke atas meja.
w|melompat.en: That cat jumped onto the table.
Jumping too high made him fall.

w|melompati.text: Pagi itu Dimas melompati genangan air di depan gedung kantor.
w|melompati.en: That morning Dimas jumped over a puddle in front of the office building.
w|melompati.ko: 그날 아침 디마스는 회사 건물 앞 물웅덩이를 뛰어넘었어요.

w|melompati.text: Seorang anak melompati tali pembatas antrean di depan Putri.
w|melompati.en: A child jumped over the queue rope in front of Putri.
w|melompati.ko: 한 아이가 푸트리 앞의 줄 서기용 줄을 뛰어넘었어요.

w|meloncat.text: Seekor kucing meloncat ke atas tumpukan kardus di gudang pabrik.
w|meloncat.en: A cat jumped onto a pile of cardboard boxes in the factory warehouse.
w|meloncat.ko: 고양이 한 마리가 공장 창고의 상자 더미 위로 뛰어올랐어요.

w|meloncat.text: Putri ingat dulu mereka suka meloncat ke sungai di belakang sekolah.
w|meloncat.en: Putri remembers how they used to love jumping into the river behind the school.
w|meloncat.ko: 푸트리는 예전에 학교 뒤 강으로 뛰어들기를 좋아했던 걸 기억해요.

w|meluangkan.text: Pak Guru selalu meluangkan waktu untuk menjawab pertanyaan Rudi sepulang sekolah.
w|meluangkan.en: The teacher always makes time to answer Rudi's questions after school.
w|meluangkan.ko: 선생님은 방과 후에 루디의 질문에 답해 주려고 늘 시간을 내요.

w|meluangkan.text: Teman-teman Rina meluangkan hari Minggu untuk membantu mengangkat kardus.
w|meluangkan.en: Rina's friends set aside their Sunday to help carry boxes.
w|meluangkan.ko: 리나의 친구들은 상자 나르는 걸 도우려고 일요일을 비워 줬어요.

w|melucu.text: Fajar suka melucu supaya pasien anak tidak takut minum obat.
w|melucu.en: Fajar likes to joke around so that young patients aren't afraid to take medicine.
w|melucu.ko: 파자르는 어린 환자들이 약 먹기를 무서워하지 않게 농담을 잘해요.

w|melucu.text: Rekan baru Lestari pandai melucu sehingga rapat pagi jadi santai.
w|melucu.en: Lestari's new coworker is good at cracking jokes, so the morning meeting feels relaxed.
w|melucu.ko: 레스타리의 새 동료가 농담을 잘해서 아침 회의 분위기가 편해졌어요.

w|melucuti.text: Bayu melucuti sampul plastik yang menempel di buku tua itu dengan hati-hati.
w|melucuti.en: Bayu carefully stripped off the plastic cover stuck to the old book.
w|melucuti.ko: 바유는 오래된 책에 붙은 비닐 표지를 조심스럽게 벗겨 냈어요.

w|melucuti.text: Saat malam tiba, perias pelan-pelan melucuti hiasan kepala Intan yang berat.
w|melucuti.en: When night came, the makeup artist slowly took off Intan's heavy headdress.
w|melucuti.ko: 밤이 되자 메이크업 담당이 인탄의 무거운 머리 장식을 천천히 벗겨 냈어요.

w|meludah.text: Petugas teater menegur penonton yang meludah sembarangan di tangga gedung.
w|meludah.en: The theater staff scolded an audience member who spat carelessly on the building's stairs.
w|meludah.ko: 극장 직원이 건물 계단에 함부로 침을 뱉은 관객을 꾸짖었어요.

w|meludah.text: Ayu menegur anak-anak yang meludah ke sungai di bawah desa.
w|meludah.en: Ayu scolds the children who spit into the river below the village.
w|meludah.ko: 아유는 마을 아래 강에 침을 뱉는 아이들을 꾸짖어요.

w|melukai.ko: 그의 말은 기분을 다치게 할 수 있어.

w|melukai.en: Falling off the bike hurt his knee.

w|melukis.text: Di pojok kreatif, anak-anak boleh melukis di atas kain batik putih.
w|melukis.en: In the creative corner, children may paint on white batik cloth.
w|melukis.ko: 체험 코너에서 아이들은 흰 바틱 천에 그림을 그릴 수 있어요.

w|melukis.text: Anak Rina suka melukis kardus bekas di belakang kios sambil menunggu ibunya.
w|melukis.en: Rina's child likes painting on old cardboard behind the stall while waiting for her mother.
w|melukis.ko: 리나의 아이는 엄마를 기다리며 가게 뒤에서 헌 상자에 그림 그리는 걸 좋아해요.

w|melulu.text: Istri Budi mengeluh karena Budi mengurus sapi melulu.
w|melulu.en: Budi's wife complains because Budi does nothing but look after the cows.
w|melulu.ko: 부디의 아내는 부디가 맨날 소만 돌본다고 투덜대요.

w|melulu.text: Pelanggan itu memesan nasi goreng melulu setiap kali datang ke restoran Siti.
w|melulu.en: That customer orders nothing but fried rice every time he comes to Siti's restaurant.
w|melulu.ko: 그 손님은 시티의 식당에 올 때마다 맨날 볶음밥만 시켜요.

w|melumpuhkan.text: Banjir besar tahun lalu sempat melumpuhkan jalan utama ke desa Budi.
w|melumpuhkan.en: Last year's big flood paralyzed the main road to Budi's village for a while.
w|melumpuhkan.ko: 작년 큰 홍수 때문에 부디네 마을로 가는 큰길이 한동안 마비됐어요.

w|melumpuhkan.text: Pemadaman listrik sempat melumpuhkan syuting selama dua jam.
w|melumpuhkan.en: A power outage halted the shoot for two hours.
w|melumpuhkan.ko: 정전 때문에 촬영이 두 시간 동안 멈췄어요.

w|melunasi.text: Bayu berjanji akan melunasi sisa harga lemari itu minggu depan.
w|melunasi.en: Bayu promised to pay off the rest of the cupboard's price next week.
w|melunasi.ko: 바유는 다음 주에 그 장롱 값 나머지를 다 갚겠다고 약속했어요.

w|melunasi.text: Intan dan suaminya baru selesai melunasi biaya gedung seminggu sebelum hari H.
w|melunasi.en: Intan and her husband only finished paying off the venue a week before the big day.
w|melunasi.ko: 인탄 부부는 결혼식 일주일 전에야 식장 비용을 다 치렀어요.

w|meluncur.text: Bola kertas Andi meluncur dari meja dan jatuh di dekat kaki guru.
w|meluncur.en: Andi's paper ball slid off the desk and landed near the teacher's feet.
w|meluncur.ko: 안디의 종이 공이 책상에서 미끄러져 선생님 발 근처에 떨어졌어요.

w|meluncur.text: Brankar itu meluncur cepat di lorong menuju ruang operasi.
w|meluncur.en: The stretcher glided quickly down the corridor to the operating room.
w|meluncur.ko: 이동 침대가 수술실로 가는 복도를 빠르게 미끄러져 갔어요.

w|meluncurkan.text: Bulan depan Fajar akan meluncurkan roti rasa durian.
w|meluncurkan.en: Next month Fajar will launch a durian-flavored bread.
w|meluncurkan.ko: 다음 달 파자르는 두리안 맛 빵을 출시해요.

w|meluncurkan.text: Sponsor lomba meluncurkan sepatu lari baru di area pameran.
w|meluncurkan.en: The race sponsor launched new running shoes in the exhibition area.
w|meluncurkan.ko: 대회 후원사가 전시장에서 새 러닝화를 출시했어요.

w|meluruskan.text: Andi membantu meluruskan kesalahpahaman antara Rina dan bagian keuangan.
w|meluruskan.en: Andi helped clear up a misunderstanding between Rina and the finance department.
w|meluruskan.ko: 안디는 리나와 재무팀 사이의 오해를 푸는 걸 도왔어요.

w|meluruskan.text: Dewi meluruskan tirai kamar sebelum tamu VIP datang.
w|meluruskan.en: Dewi straightened the room curtains before the VIP guest arrived.
w|meluruskan.ko: 데위는 VIP 손님이 오기 전에 방 커튼을 반듯하게 폈어요.

w|memaafkan.en: It's hard for him to forgive people.
w|memaafkan.ko: 그는 사람을 잘 용서 못 해.

w|memacu.text: Sopir itu memacu mobil pengantin agar tidak terlambat ke gedung.
w|memacu.en: The driver sped up the bridal car so as not to be late to the venue.
w|memacu.ko: 운전기사는 식장에 늦지 않으려고 웨딩카를 몰아붙였어요.

w|memacu.text: Para petani memacu pekerjaan mereka sebelum hujan pertama turun.
w|memacu.en: The farmers hurried their work before the first rain fell.
w|memacu.ko: 농부들은 첫비가 내리기 전에 일을 서둘렀어요.

w|memadai.text: Lahan parkir hotel kecil itu kurang memadai saat akhir pekan.
w|memadai.en: The small hotel's parking area isn't adequate on weekends.
w|memadai.ko: 그 작은 호텔의 주차 공간은 주말이면 부족해요.

w|memadai.text: Saluran air di kompleks Rina tidak memadai untuk hujan sederas itu.
w|memadai.en: The drainage in Rina's housing complex isn't adequate for rain that heavy.
w|memadai.ko: 리나네 단지의 배수로는 그렇게 센 비를 감당하기에 부족해요.

w|memadamkan.text: Dalam latihan kebakaran, Rudi belajar cara memadamkan api kecil dengan alat pemadam.
w|memadamkan.en: In the fire drill, Rudi learned how to put out a small fire with an extinguisher.
w|memadamkan.ko: 소방 훈련에서 루디는 소화기로 작은 불을 끄는 법을 배웠어요.

w|memadamkan.text: Sebelum meninggalkan rumah lama, Rina memadamkan semua lampu dan mencabut kabel.
w|memadamkan.en: Before leaving the old house, Rina turned off all the lights and unplugged the cables.
w|memadamkan.ko: 예전 집을 떠나기 전에 리나는 불을 다 끄고 플러그를 뽑았어요.

w|memahami.en: He finds the lesson hard to understand.
I'm trying to understand her feelings.

w|memahat.text: Pada hari libur, Budi suka memahat kayu untuk melepas penat.
w|memahat.en: On his days off, Budi likes to carve wood to unwind.
w|memahat.ko: 쉬는 날이면 부디는 피로를 풀려고 나무를 조각해요.

w|memahat.text: Di terminal, seorang seniman sedang memahat patung kayu, dan Siti berhenti untuk menonton.
w|memahat.en: In the terminal, an artist was carving a wooden statue, and Siti stopped to watch.
w|memahat.ko: 터미널에서 한 예술가가 나무 조각상을 깎고 있어서 시티는 멈춰서 구경했어요.

w|memainkan.text: Dia bisa memainkan piano dengan indah.
w|memainkan.en: She can play the piano beautifully.
w|memainkan.ko: 그녀는 피아노를 아름답게 칠 수 있어.

w|memainkan.text: Memainkan peran itu menuntut latihan keras.
w|memainkan.en: Playing that role demands hard practice.
w|memainkan.ko: 그 역할을 연기하려면 혹독한 연습이 필요해.

w|memajang.text: Rudi memajang sertifikat lomba masak di dinding dapur.
w|memajang.en: Rudi displays his cooking competition certificate on the kitchen wall.
w|memajang.ko: 루디는 요리 대회 상장을 주방 벽에 걸어 두었어요.

w|memajang.text: Rina memajang radio-radio antik di rak paling depan.
w|memajang.en: Rina displays antique radios on the front shelf.
w|memajang.ko: 리나는 골동품 라디오들을 맨 앞 선반에 진열해요.

w|memajukan.text: Andi memajukan jadwal pengecoran karena cuaca sedang cerah.
w|memajukan.en: Andi moved the concrete pouring schedule forward because the weather was clear.
w|memajukan.ko: 날씨가 맑아서 안디는 콘크리트 타설 일정을 앞당겼어요.

w|memajukan.text: Panitia memajukan jam acara agar Dewi dan teman dari luar kota bisa pulang lebih awal.
w|memajukan.en: The committee moved the event earlier so Dewi and friends from out of town could go home sooner.
w|memajukan.ko: 위원회는 데위와 다른 도시에서 온 친구들이 일찍 돌아갈 수 있게 행사 시간을 앞당겼어요.

w|memakaikan.text: Eko memakaikan jaket tebal kepada adiknya yang menggigil.
w|memakaikan.en: Eko put a thick jacket on his shivering little brother.
w|memakaikan.ko: 에코는 떨고 있는 동생에게 두꺼운 재킷을 입혀 줬어요.

w|memakaikan.text: Seorang relawan memakaikan medali ke leher Ayu di garis finis.
w|memakaikan.en: A volunteer put the medal around Ayu's neck at the finish line.
w|memakaikan.ko: 결승선에서 자원봉사자가 아유 목에 메달을 걸어 줬어요.

w|memakan.en: This project takes a long time.

w|memaki.text: Seorang warga yang marah sempat memaki petugas, tetapi Fajar tetap menjawab dengan tenang.
w|memaki.en: An angry resident swore at the staff, but Fajar kept answering calmly.
w|memaki.ko: 화가 난 주민이 직원에게 욕을 했지만 파자르는 침착하게 대답했어요.

w|memaki.text: Lestari menulis bahwa sopir angkot di kotanya suka memaki kalau jalan macet.
w|memaki.en: Lestari wrote that the minibus drivers in her town like to swear when the roads are jammed.
w|memaki.ko: 레스타리는 자기 동네 미니버스 기사들이 길이 막히면 욕을 잘한다고 썼어요.

w|memaksakan.text: Dimas tidak mau memaksakan operasi kalau pemiliknya belum siap.
w|memaksakan.en: Dimas doesn't want to force an operation if the owner isn't ready.
w|memaksakan.ko: 디마스는 주인이 준비되지 않았으면 수술을 강요하고 싶지 않아요.

w|memaksakan.text: Profesor Hadi tidak suka memaksakan pendapatnya kepada mahasiswa.
w|memaksakan.en: Professor Hadi doesn't like to force his opinions on students.
w|memaksakan.ko: 하디 교수는 학생들에게 자기 의견을 강요하는 걸 싫어해요.

w|memaku.text: Bayu memaku lagi papan jembatan kayu yang mulai longgar.
w|memaku.en: Bayu nailed down the loose boards of the wooden bridge again.
w|memaku.ko: 바유는 헐거워진 나무다리 판자에 다시 못을 박았어요.

w|memaku.text: Petugas memaku papan penunjuk arah di tiang, tetapi Intan tetap hampir salah belok.
w|memaku.en: The crew nailed direction signs to the poles, but Intan still nearly took a wrong turn.
w|memaku.ko: 직원들이 기둥에 방향 표지판을 박아 놓았지만 인탄은 그래도 길을 잘못 들 뻔했어요.

w|memalsukan.text: Agus membaca berita tentang sindikat yang memalsukan tiket kapal.
w|memalsukan.en: Agus read news about a syndicate that forged ship tickets.
w|memalsukan.ko: 아구스는 배표를 위조한 조직에 관한 기사를 읽었어요.

w|memalsukan.text: Satpam menangkap seseorang yang memalsukan kupon diskon.
w|memalsukan.en: The security guard caught someone who had forged discount coupons.
w|memalsukan.ko: 경비원이 할인 쿠폰을 위조한 사람을 붙잡았어요.

w|memamerkan.text: Pabrik itu memamerkan mesin barunya kepada para tamu dari dinas perindustrian.
w|memamerkan.en: The factory showed off its new machine to guests from the industry office.
w|memamerkan.ko: 그 공장은 산업청에서 온 손님들에게 새 기계를 자랑했어요.

w|memamerkan.text: Dalam suratnya, Sari memamerkan kebun tomat yang ia tanam sendiri.
w|memamerkan.en: In her letter, Sari shows off the tomato garden she planted herself.
w|memamerkan.ko: 편지에서 사리는 직접 가꾼 토마토 밭을 자랑해요.

w|memanah.text: Saat festival desa, para pemuda berlomba memanah sasaran jerami.
w|memanah.en: At the village festival, the young men compete shooting arrows at straw targets.
w|memanah.ko: 마을 축제 때 청년들은 짚 과녁에 활쏘기 시합을 해요.

w|memanah.text: Saat acara keluarga pabrik, Ayu ikut lomba memanah.
w|memanah.en: At the factory family day, Ayu entered the archery contest.
w|memanah.ko: 공장 가족 행사 때 아유는 활쏘기 대회에 나갔어요.

w|memanas.text: Suasana di apotek memanas ketika pelanggan menuntut obat tanpa resep, tetapi Dimas tetap sabar.
w|memanas.en: Things heated up at the pharmacy when a customer demanded medicine without a prescription, but Dimas stayed patient.
w|memanas.ko: 손님이 처방전 없이 약을 달라고 우기면서 약국 분위기가 험악해졌지만 디마스는 침착했어요.

w|memanas.text: Udara di loteng memanas pada siang hari, jadi Putri bekerja di sana pagi-pagi.
w|memanas.en: The air in the attic heats up at midday, so Putri works up there early in the morning.
w|memanas.ko: 낮에는 다락이 뜨거워져서 푸트리는 아침 일찍 거기서 일해요.

w|memanaskan.text: Sebelum menggoreng, Andi memanaskan minyak sampai benar-benar panas.
w|memanaskan.en: Before frying, Andi heats the oil until it's really hot.
w|memanaskan.ko: 안디는 튀기기 전에 기름을 충분히 뜨겁게 달궈요.

w|memanaskan.text: Dewi menulis bahwa sekarang ia cukup memanaskan makanan beku untuk makan malam.
w|memanaskan.en: Dewi wrote that these days she just heats up frozen food for dinner.
w|memanaskan.ko: 데위는 요즘 저녁으로 냉동식품을 데워 먹는 게 다라고 썼어요.

w|memancarkan.text: Lampu hias di teras rumah Andi memancarkan cahaya hangat setiap malam.
w|memancarkan.en: The decorative lights on Andi's porch give off a warm glow every night.
w|memancarkan.ko: 안디네 현관의 장식등은 밤마다 따뜻한 빛을 내요.

w|memancarkan.text: Dewi kagum melihat batu permata yang memancarkan warna ungu di bawah lampu.
w|memancarkan.en: Dewi was amazed to see a gemstone glowing purple under the light.
w|memancarkan.ko: 데위는 조명 아래에서 보랏빛을 내는 보석을 보고 감탄했어요.

w|memancing.text: Mereka pergi memancing di sungai pagi-pagi.
w|memancing.en: They went fishing in the river early in the morning.
w|memancing.ko: 그들은 이른 아침에 강에서 낚시하러 갔어.

w|memancing.text: Ayah suka memancing di akhir pekan.
w|memancing.en: Dad likes fishing on the weekend.

w|memandang.en: She quietly gazed at the evening sky.

w|memandang.text: Mereka memandang masa depan dengan harapan.
w|memandang.en: They look at the future with hope.

w|memandangi.text: Bayu memandangi pantulan dirinya di cermin sambil memeriksa posisi tubuh.
w|memandangi.en: Bayu stares at his reflection in the mirror while checking his posture.
w|memandangi.ko: 바유는 자세를 확인하며 거울 속 자기 모습을 바라봐요.

w|memandangi.text: Anak Intan memandangi akuarium besar di sudut restoran.
w|memandangi.en: Intan's child gazes at the big aquarium in the corner of the restaurant.
w|memandangi.ko: 인탄의 아이는 식당 구석의 큰 수족관을 바라봐요.

w|memandikan.text: Andi membantu tetangga memandikan anjing besar mereka di halaman.
w|memandikan.en: Andi helped the neighbors bathe their big dog in the yard.
w|memandikan.ko: 안디는 이웃이 마당에서 큰 개를 씻기는 걸 도왔어요.

w|memandikan.text: Pagi ini Dewi terlambat mengajar karena harus memandikan bayi dulu.
w|memandikan.en: This morning Dewi was late for class because she had to bathe the baby first.
w|memandikan.ko: 오늘 아침 데위는 아기를 먼저 씻겨야 해서 수업에 늦었어요.

w|memandu.text: Petugas layanan pelanggan memandu Fajar langkah demi langkah untuk mengajukan retur.
w|memandu.en: The customer service agent guided Fajar step by step to request a return.
w|memandu.ko: 고객센터 직원이 파자르에게 반품 신청 방법을 하나하나 안내했어요.

w|memandu.text: Asisten guru memandu peserta mengenal bumbu-bumbu dapur.
w|memandu.en: The teaching assistant guided the participants in getting to know kitchen spices.
w|memandu.ko: 보조 강사가 참가자들에게 부엌 양념을 하나하나 소개했어요.

w|memanen.text: Setiap kemarau, Bayu memanen madu hutan bersama warga desa.
w|memanen.en: Every dry season, Bayu harvests wild forest honey with the villagers.
w|memanen.ko: 건기마다 바유는 마을 사람들과 함께 야생 꿀을 채취해요.

w|memanen.text: Setelah berbulan-bulan berlatih, Intan akhirnya memanen hasil berupa rekor pribadi.
w|memanen.en: After months of training, Intan finally reaped the reward in the form of a personal best.
w|memanen.ko: 몇 달 동안 훈련한 끝에 인탄은 마침내 개인 최고 기록이라는 결실을 거두었어요.

w|memanfaatkan.en: He is good at making use of free time.
Let's take advantage of this opportunity.

w|memanggang.text: Andi baru pertama kali memanggang roti dengan oven besar milik sekolah masak.
w|memanggang.en: It was Andi's first time baking bread in the cooking school's big oven.
w|memanggang.ko: 안디는 요리 학교의 큰 오븐으로 빵을 처음 구워 봤어요.

w|memanggang.text: Rani menulis bahwa sekarang ia suka memanggang kue setiap akhir pekan.
w|memanggang.en: Rani wrote that she now likes baking cakes every weekend.
w|memanggang.ko: 라니는 요즘 주말마다 케이크 굽는 게 좋다고 썼어요.

w|memanggilkan.text: Eko memanggilkan mantri desa untuk nenek yang sedang demam.
w|memanggilkan.en: Eko called the village health worker for his grandmother, who had a fever.
w|memanggilkan.ko: 에코는 열이 나는 할머니를 위해 마을 보건 요원을 불러 줬어요.

w|memanggilkan.text: Ayu memanggilkan teknisi karena ban berjalan tiba-tiba berhenti.
w|memanggilkan.en: Ayu called a technician over because the conveyor belt suddenly stopped.
w|memanggilkan.ko: 컨베이어 벨트가 갑자기 멈춰서 아유가 기술자를 불러 줬어요.

w|memangkas.text: Budi bilang perusahaan tempat Budi bekerja sedang memangkas jumlah karyawan.
w|memangkas.en: Budi says the company he works for is cutting staff numbers.
w|memangkas.ko: 부디는 다니는 회사가 직원 수를 줄이고 있다고 했어요.

w|memangkas.text: Siti memangkas pagar tanaman yang menjorok ke halaman tetangga.
w|memangkas.en: Siti trimmed the hedge that was sticking out into the neighbor's yard.
w|memangkas.ko: 시티는 이웃집 마당으로 삐져나온 생울타리를 다듬었어요.

w|memangsa.text: Di ruang rapat, Rina menonton video tentang singa yang memangsa rusa.
w|memangsa.en: In the meeting room, Rina watched a video of a lion preying on a deer.
w|memangsa.ko: 회의실에서 리나는 사자가 사슴을 사냥하는 영상을 봤어요.

w|memangsa.text: Di televisi lobi diputar film dokumenter tentang ular yang memangsa tikus.
w|memangsa.en: A documentary about snakes preying on mice was playing on the lobby TV.
w|memangsa.ko: 로비 텔레비전에서는 뱀이 쥐를 잡아먹는 다큐멘터리가 나오고 있었어요.

w|memanipulasi.text: Rina menolak memanipulasi angka penjualan meskipun diminta atasannya.
w|memanipulasi.en: Rina refused to manipulate the sales figures even though her boss asked her to.
w|memanipulasi.ko: 리나는 상사가 시켜도 판매 수치를 조작하지 않았어요.

w|memanipulasi.text: Dewi curiga seorang tamu mencoba memanipulasi tagihan kamarnya.
w|memanipulasi.en: Dewi suspected a guest was trying to manipulate his room bill.
w|memanipulasi.ko: 데위는 한 손님이 객실 요금을 조작하려 한다고 의심했어요.

w|memanjakan.text: Dalam drama itu, sang raja terlalu memanjakan putranya sampai lupa tugas.
w|memanjakan.en: In the play, the king spoils his son so much that he forgets his duties.
w|memanjakan.ko: 그 연극에서 왕은 아들을 너무 응석받이로 키워 자기 임무를 잊어요.

w|memanjakan.text: Nenek Ayu suka memanjakan cucu-cucunya dengan kue singkong.
w|memanjakan.en: Ayu's grandmother likes to spoil her grandchildren with cassava cakes.
w|memanjakan.ko: 아유의 할머니는 손주들에게 카사바 과자를 해 주며 귀여워해요.

w|memanjat.text: Petugas menegur anak yang mencoba memanjat replika candi.
w|memanjat.en: The staff scolded a child who tried to climb the temple replica.
w|memanjat.ko: 직원이 사원 모형에 기어오르려던 아이를 나무랐어요.

w|memanjat.text: Anak-anak memanjat tumpukan karung beras di gudang pasar.
w|memanjat.en: The children climbed the stack of rice sacks in the market warehouse.
w|memanjat.ko: 아이들이 시장 창고의 쌀자루 더미 위로 기어올랐어요.

w|memantau.text: Penjaga pantai memantau perenang dari menara kayu.
w|memantau.en: The lifeguard watches the swimmers from a wooden tower.
w|memantau.ko: 해변 안전요원은 나무 망루에서 수영객들을 지켜봐요.

w|memantau.text: Ayu meminta Bu Sri memantau rumahnya selama dia mudik.
w|memantau.en: Ayu asked Mrs. Sri to keep an eye on her house while she went home for the holiday.
w|memantau.ko: 아유는 고향에 가 있는 동안 집을 봐 달라고 스리 아주머니께 부탁했어요.

w|memantul.text: Teriakan Eko memantul dari tebing di seberang lembah.
w|memantul.en: Eko's shout bounced off the cliff across the valley.
w|memantul.ko: 에코의 외침이 골짜기 건너편 절벽에 부딪혀 되돌아왔어요.

w|memantul.text: Cahaya lampu memantul dari lantai pabrik yang baru dipel.
w|memantul.en: The light reflected off the freshly mopped factory floor.
w|memantul.ko: 막 닦은 공장 바닥에 불빛이 반사됐어요.

w|memapah.text: Agus memapah nenek tetangga yang terpeleset di tangga.
w|memapah.en: Agus helped the elderly neighbor who had slipped on the stairs walk.
w|memapah.ko: 아구스는 계단에서 미끄러진 이웃 할머니를 부축했어요.

w|memapah.text: Wati memapah tamu lansia yang kesulitan menaiki tangga.
w|memapah.en: Wati helped an elderly guest who was having trouble climbing the stairs.
w|memapah.ko: 와티는 계단을 오르기 힘들어하는 노인 손님을 부축했어요.

w|memar.text: Ada memar kecil di kaki anjing itu setelah terjatuh dari tangga.
w|memar.en: There was a small bruise on the dog's leg after it fell down the stairs.
w|memar.ko: 계단에서 떨어진 뒤 그 강아지 다리에 작은 멍이 생겼어요.

w|memar.text: Putri mendapat memar di lengan karena terbentur lemari besi.
w|memar.en: Putri got a bruise on her arm from bumping into the metal cabinet.
w|memar.ko: 푸트리는 철제 캐비닛에 부딪혀서 팔에 멍이 들었어요.

w|memarahi.text: Ibu Agus memarahi Agus lewat telepon karena dia lupa mengabari.
w|memarahi.en: Agus's mother scolded Agus over the phone because he forgot to send news.
w|memarahi.ko: 아구스의 어머니는 아구스가 연락을 깜빡해서 전화로 꾸짖었어요.

w|memarahi.text: Manajer memarahi Wati karena rak pakaian belum dirapikan.
w|memarahi.en: The manager scolded Wati because the clothing racks hadn't been tidied.
w|memarahi.ko: 매니저는 옷걸이 진열대를 정리하지 않았다고 와티를 꾸짖었어요.

w|memarkir.text: Bayu kesulitan memarkir mobil di jalan sempit dekat pasar.
w|memarkir.en: Bayu had trouble parking the car on the narrow road near the market.
w|memarkir.ko: 바유는 시장 근처 좁은 길에 차를 대느라 애먹었어요.

w|memarkir.text: Intan terlambat ke kelas lukis karena susah memarkir motornya.
w|memarkir.en: Intan was late to painting class because it was hard to park her scooter.
w|memarkir.ko: 인탄은 오토바이를 대기 힘들어서 미술 수업에 늦었어요.

w|memasak.text: Ibu sedang memasak sayur di dapur.
w|memasak.en: Mom is cooking vegetables in the kitchen.
He is learning to cook a simple recipe.

w|memasang.text: Teknisi sedang memasang kamera di dinding.
w|memasang.en: The technician is installing a camera on the wall.

w|memasang.text: Ayah akan memasang lampu baru malam ini.
w|memasang.en: Dad will install a new lamp tonight.
w|memasang.ko: 아빠가 오늘 밤 새 전등을 달 거야.

w|memasangkan.text: Rudi membantu memasangkan kalung di leher kakaknya sebagai tanda damai.
w|memasangkan.en: Rudi helped fasten a necklace around his sister's neck as a sign of peace.
w|memasangkan.ko: 루디는 화해의 표시로 누나 목에 목걸이를 걸어 줬어요.

w|memasangkan.text: Pemandu selam membantu memasangkan tabung oksigen di punggung Rina.
w|memasangkan.en: The dive guide helped fit the oxygen tank onto Rina's back.
w|memasangkan.ko: 다이빙 가이드가 리나 등에 산소통을 메어 줬어요.

w|memastikan.en: Please make sure the door is locked.
I want to confirm the schedule.

w|memasuki.en: We will enter the next stage.

w|memasukkan.en: Please insert the key into the hole.

w|memasukkan.text: Dia lupa memasukkan nama di formulir.
w|memasukkan.en: He forgot to enter his name on the form.
w|memasukkan.ko: 그는 양식에 이름을 넣는 걸 잊었어.

w|memata-matai.text: Eko bercanda bahwa burung camar itu seperti sedang memata-matai makanannya.
w|memata-matai.en: Eko joked that the seagull seemed to be spying on his food.
w|memata-matai.ko: 에코는 갈매기가 자기 음식을 엿보는 것 같다고 농담했어요.

w|memata-matai.text: Ayu merasa tidak enak karena tetangga di depan seperti memata-matai rumahnya.
w|memata-matai.en: Ayu felt uneasy because the neighbor across the street seemed to be spying on her house.
w|memata-matai.ko: 앞집 이웃이 집을 엿보는 것 같아서 아유는 마음이 불편했어요.

w|mematahkan.en: Strong wind broke the tree branch.

w|mematikan.en: Please turn off the light before sleeping.
Turning off the machine made the room quiet.

w|mematuhi.text: Semua tamu wajib mematuhi aturan berpakaian rapi di balai kota.
w|mematuhi.en: All visitors must follow the neat dress code at city hall.
w|mematuhi.ko: 시청에 오는 모든 방문객은 단정한 복장 규정을 지켜야 해요.

w|mematuhi.text: Murid-murid harus mematuhi aturan untuk tidak makan di ruang piano.
w|mematuhi.en: The students must obey the rule against eating in the piano room.
w|mematuhi.ko: 학생들은 피아노실에서 먹지 말라는 규칙을 지켜야 해요.

w|membacakan.text: Setiap pagi, Bayu membacakan target hari itu di depan para buruh.
w|membacakan.en: Every morning, Bayu reads out the day's target in front of the workers.
w|membacakan.ko: 매일 아침 바유는 노동자들 앞에서 그날 목표를 읽어 줘요.

w|membacakan.text: Pramugari membacakan petunjuk keselamatan sebelum pesawat lepas landas.
w|membacakan.en: The flight attendant read out the safety instructions before take-off.
w|membacakan.ko: 승무원이 이륙 전에 안전 수칙을 읽어 줬어요.

w|membagi.text: Bu Rina membagi kelas menjadi empat kelompok diskusi.
w|membagi.en: Ms. Rina divided the class into four discussion groups.
w|membagi.ko: 리나 선생님은 반을 토론 모둠 네 개로 나눴어요.

w|membagi.text: Siti membagi tugas mengepak dengan kedua adiknya.
w|membagi.en: Siti split the packing work with her two younger siblings.
w|membagi.ko: 시티는 짐 싸는 일을 두 동생과 나눴어요.

w|membagikan.text: Pengelola gedung membagikan masker gratis kepada semua penghuni.
w|membagikan.en: The building management handed out free masks to all residents.
w|membagikan.ko: 건물 관리소는 입주민 모두에게 마스크를 무료로 나눠 줬어요.

w|membagikan.text: Petugas membagikan selimut kepada penumpang kereta malam.
w|membagikan.en: The staff handed out blankets to the night-train passengers.
w|membagikan.ko: 승무원이 야간열차 승객들에게 담요를 나눠 줬어요.

w|membahagiakan.text: Bagi Andi, menemukan buku langka di rak paling bawah sungguh membahagiakan.
w|membahagiakan.en: For Andi, finding a rare book on the bottom shelf is truly delightful.
w|membahagiakan.ko: 안디에게는 맨 아래 칸에서 희귀한 책을 찾는 게 정말 행복한 일이에요.

w|membahagiakan.text: Bisa tinggal dekat orang tua lagi sangat membahagiakan bagi Dewi.
w|membahagiakan.en: Being able to live near her parents again makes Dewi very happy.
w|membahagiakan.ko: 다시 부모님 가까이 살 수 있어서 데위는 정말 행복해요.

w|membahas.en: They are discussing the travel plan.

w|membahas.text: Guru akan membahas soal sulit itu.
w|membahas.en: The teacher will go over that hard problem.
w|membahas.ko: 선생님이 그 어려운 문제를 다룰 거야.

w|membahayakan.ko: 짙은 연기는 건강을 해칠 수 있어.

w|membahayakan.text: Jangan membahayakan orang lain di jalan.
w|membahayakan.en: Don't endanger other people on the road.
w|membahayakan.ko: 길에서 다른 사람을 위험에 빠뜨리지 마.

w|membaik.en: The weather improved after the storm passed.

w|membajak.text: Paman Rudi biasanya membajak sawah, tapi hari itu dia memakai jas rapi.
w|membajak.en: Rudi's uncle usually plows the rice fields, but that day he wore a neat suit.
w|membajak.ko: 루디의 삼촌은 평소엔 논을 갈지만 그날은 단정한 양복을 입었어요.

w|membajak.text: Rina melaporkan bahwa peretas membajak akun media sosial pemerintah daerah.
w|membajak.en: Rina reported that hackers hijacked the local government's social media account.
w|membajak.ko: 리나는 해커들이 지방 정부 SNS 계정을 해킹했다고 보도했어요.

w|membalas.en: He forgot to reply to your message.
w|membalas.ko: 그는 네 메시지에 답하는 걸 잊었어.

w|membalas.en: Repaying kindness is a good attitude.

w|membalik.text: Waktu ujian mulai, semua murid membalik kertas soal bersama-sama.
w|membalik.en: When the exam began, all the students turned over their question papers together.
w|membalik.ko: 시험이 시작되자 학생들이 다 같이 문제지를 뒤집었어요.

w|membalik.text: Ayu membalik telur dadar di wajan dengan hati-hati.
w|membalik.en: Ayu carefully flipped the omelet in the pan.

w|membalikkan.text: Agus harus membalikkan mobil karena jembatan di depan sedang diperbaiki.
w|membalikkan.en: Agus had to turn the car around because the bridge ahead was under repair.
w|membalikkan.ko: 앞의 다리를 고치는 중이라 아구스는 차를 돌려야 했어요.

w|membalikkan.text: Wati membalikkan papan tanda di pintu dari "Buka" menjadi "Tutup".
w|membalikkan.en: Wati flipped the sign on the door from "Open" to "Closed".
w|membalikkan.ko: 와티는 문에 걸린 팻말을 '영업 중'에서 '영업 끝'으로 뒤집었어요.

w|membandingkan.text: Jangan membandingkan dirimu dengan orang lain.

w|membandingkan.ko: 가격을 비교하면 돈을 아낄 수 있어.

w|membanggakan.text: Ayah pengantin wanita membanggakan putrinya yang baru lulus jadi dokter.
w|membanggakan.en: The bride's father proudly talked about his daughter, who just qualified as a doctor.
w|membanggakan.ko: 신부 아버지는 막 의사가 된 딸을 자랑했어요.

w|membanggakan.text: Kota itu membanggakan pasar terapungnya, dan Rina menulis liputan khusus tentangnya.
w|membanggakan.en: The city is proud of its floating market, and Rina wrote a special report about it.
w|membanggakan.ko: 그 도시는 수상 시장을 자랑하고, 리나는 그에 대한 특집 기사를 썼어요.

w|membangkitkan.text: Lagu pembuka drama itu membangkitkan kenangan masa kecil Bayu.
w|membangkitkan.en: The play's opening song brought back Bayu's childhood memories.
w|membangkitkan.ko: 그 연극의 첫 곡이 바유의 어린 시절 기억을 불러일으켰어요.

w|membangkitkan.text: Rapat pagi ini membangkitkan semangat tim Intan setelah proyek gagal.
w|membangkitkan.en: This morning's meeting lifted the spirits of Intan's team after the failed project.
w|membangkitkan.ko: 오늘 아침 회의가 프로젝트 실패 뒤 인탄 팀의 사기를 끌어올렸어요.

w|membangunkan.en: Mother woke her child before dawn.

w|membangunkan.text: Jangan membangunkan bayi yang sedang tidur.
w|membangunkan.en: Don't wake a baby who is sleeping.

w|membanjiri.text: Komentar pembaca membanjiri kolom berita Fajar sejak siang.
w|membanjiri.en: Readers' comments have been flooding Fajar's news column since midday.
w|membanjiri.ko: 낮부터 파자르의 기사에 독자 댓글이 쏟아졌어요.

w|membanjiri.text: Wisatawan sudah membanjiri pantai saat Lestari tiba sore itu.
w|membanjiri.en: Tourists had already flooded the beach when Lestari arrived that afternoon.
w|membanjiri.ko: 레스타리가 그날 오후에 도착했을 때 해변엔 이미 관광객이 넘쳐났어요.

w|membantah.text: Penjual itu membantah tuduhan Fajar bahwa barangnya palsu.
w|membantah.en: The seller denied Fajar's accusation that the goods were fake.
w|membantah.ko: 판매자는 물건이 가짜라는 파자르의 주장을 부인했어요.

w|membantah.text: Lestari tidak berani membantah guru yang bilang adonannya terlalu encer.
w|membantah.en: Lestari didn't dare argue with the teacher who said her batter was too runny.
w|membantah.ko: 레스타리는 반죽이 너무 묽다는 선생님 말에 감히 반박하지 못했어요.

w|membantai.text: Rudi baru selesai membaca novel sejarah tentang pasukan yang membantai penduduk satu desa.
w|membantai.en: Rudi just finished reading a historical novel about troops who massacred the people of a village.
w|membantai.ko: 루디는 한 마을 주민을 학살한 군대에 관한 역사 소설을 막 다 읽었어요.

w|membantai.text: Dalam gim buatan tim Rina, pemain harus membantai pasukan zombi untuk naik level.
w|membantai.en: In the game made by Rina's team, players must slaughter zombie hordes to level up.
w|membantai.ko: 리나 팀이 만든 게임에서는 레벨을 올리려면 좀비 무리를 물리쳐야 해요.

w|membanting.text: Pelayan katering tidak sengaja membanting pintu dapur saat membawa nampan.
w|membanting.en: A catering waiter accidentally slammed the kitchen door while carrying a tray.
w|membanting.ko: 출장 요리 직원이 쟁반을 들고 가다 실수로 부엌문을 쾅 닫았어요.

w|membanting.text: Angin kencang membanting jendela kamar Lestari di tengah malam.
w|membanting.en: A strong wind slammed Lestari's bedroom window in the middle of the night.
w|membanting.ko: 한밤중에 거센 바람이 레스타리 방 창문을 쾅 닫았어요.

w|membaptis.text: Teman Bayu membaptis mobil tua itu dengan nama "Si Kuning".
w|membaptis.en: Bayu's friend christened the old car "Yellow".
w|membaptis.ko: 바유의 친구는 그 낡은 차에 '노랑이'라는 이름을 붙였어요.

w|membaptis.text: Intan mengamati lukisan kuno tentang seorang nabi yang membaptis orang di sungai.
w|membaptis.en: Intan studied an ancient painting of a prophet baptizing people in a river.
w|membaptis.ko: 인탄은 한 예언자가 강에서 사람들에게 세례를 주는 옛 그림을 살펴봤어요.

w|membara.text: Semangat Andi membara ketika timnya masuk final cerdas cermat.
w|membara.en: Andi's spirit was ablaze when his team reached the quiz final.
w|membara.ko: 팀이 퀴즈 대회 결승에 오르자 안디의 열정이 불타올랐어요.

w|membara.text: Arang di panggangan Dewi sudah membara dan siap dipakai.
w|membara.en: The charcoal in Dewi's grill was glowing and ready to use.
w|membara.ko: 데위의 그릴 숯이 벌겋게 달아올라 쓸 준비가 됐어요.

w|membasahi.text: Embun pagi membasahi sepatu Budi saat dia melintasi rumput.
w|membasahi.en: The morning dew soaked Budi's shoes as he crossed the grass.
w|membasahi.ko: 풀밭을 지나는 동안 아침 이슬에 부디의 신발이 젖었어요.

w|membasahi.text: Keringat membasahi dahi Siti di depan wajan yang panas.
w|membasahi.en: Sweat soaked Siti's forehead in front of the hot wok.
w|membasahi.ko: 뜨거운 웍 앞에서 시티의 이마가 땀에 젖었어요.

w|membasmi.text: Sekolah masak itu rutin memanggil petugas untuk membasmi semut di gudang tepung.
w|membasmi.en: The cooking school regularly calls in someone to get rid of ants in the flour storeroom.
w|membasmi.ko: 그 요리 학교는 밀가루 창고의 개미를 없애려고 정기적으로 업체를 불러요.

w|membasmi.text: Rani menulis bahwa warga desanya bergotong royong membasmi hama tikus di sawah.
w|membasmi.en: Rani wrote that her villagers worked together to wipe out the rats in the rice fields.
w|membasmi.ko: 라니는 마을 사람들이 힘을 모아 논의 쥐를 없앴다고 썼어요.

w|membasuh.text: Tamu diminta membasuh kaki di pancuran sebelum masuk kolam renang.
w|membasuh.en: Guests are asked to rinse their feet at the shower before entering the pool.
w|membasuh.ko: 손님들은 수영장에 들어가기 전에 샤워기에서 발을 씻어야 해요.

w|membasuh.text: Setelah kehujanan di sawah, Rina membasuh kaki yang penuh lumpur.
w|membasuh.en: After getting caught in the rain in the rice field, Rina washed her muddy feet.
w|membasuh.ko: 논에서 비를 맞은 뒤 리나는 진흙투성이 발을 씻었어요.

w|membatalkan.en: They canceled the meeting because of rain.
Canceling an order must be done quickly.

w|membatasi.text: Sekolah Rudi membatasi pemakaian ponsel hanya saat jam istirahat.
w|membatasi.en: Rudi's school limits phone use to break time only.
w|membatasi.ko: 루디의 학교는 휴대폰 사용을 쉬는 시간에만 허락해요.

w|membatasi.text: Rina membatasi barang bawaan supaya cukup satu truk saja.
w|membatasi.en: Rina limited the belongings so that one truck would be enough.
w|membatasi.ko: 리나는 트럭 한 대에 다 들어가도록 짐을 줄였어요.

w|membawa.en: Don't forget to bring a raincoat.

w|membawakan.en: Hosting the show makes him nervous.
w|membawakan.ko: 사회를 보는 일이 그를 긴장하게 해.

w|membebani.text: Rudi tidak mau masalah ini terus membebani pikiran orang tuanya.
w|membebani.en: Rudi doesn't want this problem to keep weighing on his parents' minds.
w|membebani.ko: 루디는 이 일이 계속 부모님 마음에 짐이 되는 걸 원하지 않아요.

w|membebani.text: Rina tidak mau membebani temannya, jadi Rina membawa tas sendiri.
w|membebani.en: Rina didn't want to burden her friend, so she carried her own bag.
w|membebani.ko: 리나는 친구에게 짐이 되기 싫어서 가방을 직접 들었어요.

w|membebaskan.en: The judge decided to free the defendant.

w|membebaskan.ko: 운동이 마음을 자유롭게 해 줄 수 있어.

w|membeberkan.text: Dalam rapat, Bayu membeberkan data penjualan yang mengejutkan.
w|membeberkan.en: In the meeting, Bayu laid out some surprising sales figures.
w|membeberkan.ko: 회의에서 바유는 놀라운 판매 자료를 낱낱이 공개했어요.

w|membeberkan.text: Intan membeberkan rahasia pola makan yang membuat tubuh tetap bugar.
w|membeberkan.en: Intan revealed the eating habits that keep her body fit.
w|membeberkan.ko: 인탄은 몸을 탄탄하게 유지하는 식단 비결을 털어놨어요.

w|membedah.text: Waktu kuliah, Dimas belajar membedah katak di laboratorium.
w|membedah.en: At university, Dimas learned to dissect frogs in the lab.
w|membedah.ko: 디마스는 대학 시절 실험실에서 개구리 해부를 배웠어요.

w|membedah.text: Putri dan tukang listrik membedah denah lama rumah sebelum mulai bekerja.
w|membedah.en: Putri and the electrician pored over the old floor plan before starting work.
w|membedah.ko: 푸트리와 전기 기사는 일을 시작하기 전에 옛 평면도를 꼼꼼히 뜯어봤어요.

w|membedakan.text: Dulu guru mereka susah membedakan Rudi dan Bayu karena potongan rambut mereka sama.
w|membedakan.en: Their teacher used to have trouble telling Rudi and Bayu apart because they had the same haircut.
w|membedakan.ko: 예전에 선생님은 머리 모양이 같아서 루디와 바유를 잘 구별하지 못했어요.

w|membedakan.text: Banyak pengguna sulit membedakan versi gratis dan versi berbayar.
w|membedakan.en: Many users find it hard to tell the free version from the paid version.
w|membedakan.ko: 많은 사용자가 무료 버전과 유료 버전을 잘 구별하지 못해요.

w|membeku.text: Pendingin ruangan perpustakaan terlalu dingin sampai jari Dimas rasanya membeku.
w|membeku.en: The library's air conditioning is so cold that Dimas's fingers feel frozen.
w|membeku.ko: 도서관 에어컨이 너무 세서 디마스는 손가락이 얼어붙는 것 같았어요.

w|membeku.text: Es teh yang Putri beli di stasiun membeku karena disimpan dekat pendingin.
w|membeku.en: The iced tea Putri bought at the station froze because it was kept near the cooler.
w|membeku.ko: 푸트리가 역에서 산 아이스티는 냉방기 옆에 둬서 얼어 버렸어요.

w|membekukan.text: Bank sentral membekukan rekening perusahaan itu, dan Budi segera menulis beritanya.
w|membekukan.en: The central bank froze the company's accounts, and Budi quickly wrote the story.
w|membekukan.ko: 중앙은행이 그 회사 계좌를 동결하자 부디는 곧바로 기사를 썼어요.

w|membekukan.text: Perpustakaan membekukan kartu anggota yang belum mengembalikan buku setahun.
w|membekukan.en: The library freezes the membership cards of people who haven't returned books for a year.
w|membekukan.ko: 도서관은 일 년 동안 책을 반납하지 않은 회원의 카드를 정지해요.

w|membela.text: Dia selalu membela adiknya di sekolah.
w|membela.en: He always defends his little sibling at school.
w|membela.ko: 그는 학교에서 늘 동생을 지켜 줘.

w|membela.text: Pengacara itu membela klien dengan baik.
w|membela.en: That lawyer defended the client well.

w|membelah.text: Bayu membelah semangka besar untuk dibagi dengan tetangga.
w|membelah.en: Bayu split a big watermelon to share with his neighbors.
w|membelah.ko: 바유는 이웃과 나눠 먹으려고 큰 수박을 갈랐어요.

w|membelah.text: Jalur kereta itu membelah sawah hijau yang luas.
w|membelah.en: The railway cuts through wide green rice fields.
w|membelah.ko: 그 철길은 넓고 푸른 논 사이를 가로질러요.

w|membelikan.ko: 아빠가 내게 새 신발을 사 주셨어.

w|membelikan.text: Dia ingin membelikan hadiah untuk ibunya.
w|membelikan.en: She wants to buy a gift for her mother.
w|membelikan.ko: 그는 엄마에게 선물을 사 주고 싶어 해.

w|membelot.text: Label di samping lukisan bercerita tentang seorang jenderal yang membelot ke pihak lawan.
w|membelot.en: The label beside the painting tells of a general who defected to the enemy side.
w|membelot.ko: 그림 옆 설명판에는 적군 편으로 넘어간 장군 이야기가 적혀 있어요.

w|membelot.text: Kabarnya manajer kosmetik membelot ke toko pesaing di seberang jalan.
w|membelot.en: Word is the cosmetics manager defected to the rival store across the street.
w|membelot.ko: 화장품 매니저가 길 건너 경쟁 매장으로 넘어갔다는 소문이에요.

w|membenarkan.text: Eko membenarkan letak payungnya supaya tidak terbang ditiup angin.
w|membenarkan.en: Eko adjusted the position of his umbrella so the wind wouldn't blow it away.
w|membenarkan.ko: 에코는 바람에 날아가지 않게 파라솔 위치를 바로잡았어요.

w|membenarkan.text: Bu Sri membenarkan cerita Ayu tentang kucing yang hilang.
w|membenarkan.en: Mrs. Sri confirmed Ayu's story about the missing cat.
w|membenarkan.ko: 스리 아주머니는 잃어버린 고양이에 관한 아유의 이야기가 맞다고 했어요.

w|membengkak.text: Pergelangan kaki Bayu membengkak setelah salah mendarat dari lompatan.
w|membengkak.en: Bayu's ankle swelled after he landed badly from a jump.
w|membengkak.ko: 바유는 점프 후 잘못 착지해서 발목이 부었어요.

w|membengkak.text: Bibir Intan sedikit membengkak setelah makan udang, jadi ia berhenti makan.
w|membengkak.en: Intan's lips swelled a little after eating shrimp, so she stopped eating.
w|membengkak.ko: 인탄은 새우를 먹고 입술이 살짝 부어서 그만 먹었어요.

w|membentak.text: Agus tidak pernah membentak karyawan, bahkan saat oven rusak.
w|membentak.en: Agus never snaps at his staff, even when the oven breaks down.
w|membentak.ko: 아구스는 오븐이 고장 나도 직원들에게 절대 소리치지 않아요.

w|membentak.text: Wati menyesal pernah membentak programmer junior saat panik.
w|membentak.en: Wati regrets having snapped at a junior programmer when she panicked.
w|membentak.ko: 와티는 당황해서 신입 프로그래머에게 소리친 걸 후회해요.

w|membentuk.en: They formed a new study group.

w|membenturkan.text: Seorang pengunjung tak sengaja membenturkan tas ke kaca vitrin.
w|membenturkan.en: A visitor accidentally bumped a bag against the display case glass.
w|membenturkan.ko: 한 방문객이 실수로 가방을 진열장 유리에 부딪쳤어요.

w|membenturkan.text: Anak kecil itu membenturkan troli ke rak gelas, untung tidak ada yang pecah.
w|membenturkan.en: The little kid bumped the cart into the glassware shelf, but luckily nothing broke.
w|membenturkan.ko: 꼬마가 카트를 유리컵 선반에 부딪쳤는데 다행히 깨진 건 없었어요.

w|memberatkan.text: Bayu mengurangi isi ransel agar tidak memberatkan langkah di jalur hutan.
w|memberatkan.en: Bayu lightened his backpack so it wouldn't weigh him down on the forest trail.
w|memberatkan.ko: 바유는 숲길에서 발걸음이 무겁지 않게 배낭 짐을 줄였어요.

w|memberatkan.text: Sepatu baru itu ternyata memberatkan kaki Intan di kilometer terakhir.
w|memberatkan.en: Those new shoes turned out to weigh down Intan's legs in the last kilometer.
w|memberatkan.ko: 그 새 신발 때문에 인탄은 마지막 일 킬로미터에서 다리가 무거웠어요.

w|membereskan.text: Dia sedang membereskan kamar sebelum tamu datang.
w|membereskan.en: She is tidying the room before guests arrive.
w|membereskan.ko: 손님 오기 전에 방을 정리하고 있어.

w|membereskan.en: Dad helps clear the dining table.

w|memberhentikan.text: Perusahaan tidak boleh memberhentikan pekerja tanpa pesangon.
w|memberhentikan.en: A company may not dismiss workers without severance pay.
w|memberhentikan.ko: 회사는 퇴직금 없이 노동자를 해고하면 안 돼요.

w|memberhentikan.text: Sari menulis bahwa kantornya terpaksa memberhentikan banyak karyawan tahun ini.
w|memberhentikan.en: Sari writes that her office had to let go of many employees this year.
w|memberhentikan.ko: 사리는 올해 회사가 어쩔 수 없이 직원을 많이 내보냈다고 썼어요.

w|memberitahukan.text: Guru akan memberitahukan jadwal ujian besok.
w|memberitahukan.en: The teacher will inform them of tomorrow's exam schedule.
w|memberitahukan.ko: 선생님이 내일 시험 일정을 알려 줄 거야.

w|memberitahukan.text: Tolong memberitahukan hasilnya kepada saya nanti.
w|memberitahukan.en: Please let me know the result later.

w|memberitakan.text: Koran lokal memberitakan pasar loak tempat Agus berjualan sebagai tujuan wisata baru.
w|memberitakan.en: The local paper reported on the flea market where Agus sells as a new tourist spot.
w|memberitakan.ko: 지역 신문은 아구스가 장사하는 벼룩시장을 새 관광지로 소개했어요.

w|memberitakan.text: Televisi memberitakan bahwa musim hujan tahun ini datang lebih awal, dan Wati segera membeli jas hujan.
w|memberitakan.en: The TV reported that this year's rainy season came early, and Wati quickly bought a raincoat.
w|memberitakan.ko: TV에서 올해 우기가 일찍 온다고 보도하자 와티는 곧바로 비옷을 샀어요.

w|memberkati.en: The religious leader blessed the newlyweds.

w|memberkati.text: Orang tua memberkati anak sebelum pergi.
w|memberkati.en: The parents blessed the child before leaving.

w|memberlakukan.text: Kantor Budi mulai memberlakukan aturan kerja dari rumah.
w|memberlakukan.en: Budi's office has started enforcing a work-from-home policy.
w|memberlakukan.ko: 부디의 회사는 재택근무 규정을 시행하기 시작했어요.

w|memberlakukan.text: Pengurus RT memberlakukan iuran keamanan baru mulai bulan depan.
w|memberlakukan.en: The neighborhood committee is putting a new security fee into effect starting next month.
w|memberlakukan.ko: 반 운영진은 다음 달부터 새 경비비를 시행해요.

w|memberontak.text: Waktu remaja, Fajar sempat memberontak dan menolak meneruskan warung orang tuanya.
w|memberontak.en: As a teenager, Fajar rebelled for a while and refused to take over his parents' food stall.
w|memberontak.ko: 파자르는 십 대 때 반항하며 부모님의 밥집을 물려받지 않겠다고 했어요.

w|memberontak.text: Lestari mengincar novel tua tentang rakyat yang memberontak melawan raja.
w|memberontak.en: Lestari has her eye on an old novel about people who rebel against a king.
w|memberontak.ko: 레스타리는 왕에게 맞서 들고일어난 백성 이야기를 담은 옛 소설을 노리고 있어요.

w|membesar.text: Adonan roti Andi membesar dua kali lipat setelah didiamkan satu jam.
w|membesar.en: Andi's bread dough doubled in size after resting for an hour.
w|membesar.ko: 안디의 빵 반죽은 한 시간 두었더니 두 배로 부풀었어요.

w|membesar.text: Rani bercerita bahwa usaha kue kecilnya mulai membesar sejak tahun lalu.
w|membesar.en: Rani wrote that her small cake business has been growing since last year.
w|membesar.ko: 라니는 작은 케이크 장사가 작년부터 커지기 시작했다고 썼어요.

w|membesarkan.text: Orang tuanya bekerja keras membesarkan anak-anak.
w|membesarkan.en: His parents worked hard to raise the children.
She wants to grow her family business.

w|membetulkan.text: Seorang teknisi membetulkan AC gerbong yang tiba-tiba mati.
w|membetulkan.en: A technician fixed the carriage's air conditioner, which had suddenly stopped.
w|membetulkan.ko: 기술자 한 명이 갑자기 꺼진 객차 에어컨을 고쳤어요.

w|membetulkan.text: Putri lembur sampai malam untuk membetulkan kode yang membuat aplikasi sering macet.
w|membetulkan.en: Putri worked late into the night to fix the code that made the app freeze often.
w|membetulkan.ko: 푸트리는 앱이 자주 멈추게 하는 코드를 고치느라 밤늦게까지 야근했어요.

w|membiarkan.ko: 난 이걸 그냥 둘 수 없어.

w|membiasakan.text: Eko membiasakan diri pemanasan suara selama setengah jam sebelum naik panggung.
w|membiasakan.en: Eko has made a habit of warming up his voice for half an hour before going on stage.
w|membiasakan.ko: 에코는 무대에 오르기 전에 30분 동안 발성 연습을 하는 습관을 들였어요.

w|membiasakan.text: Ayu ingin membiasakan anaknya membantu menghitung uang kembalian.
w|membiasakan.en: Ayu wants to get her child used to helping count the change.
w|membiasakan.ko: 아유는 아이가 거스름돈 세는 걸 돕는 데 익숙해지게 하고 싶어요.

w|membiayai.text: Dari hasil jual-beli barang bekas, Bayu bisa membiayai kuliahnya sendiri.
w|membiayai.en: From buying and selling secondhand goods, Bayu can pay for his own college.
w|membiayai.ko: 중고 물건을 사고팔아서 바유는 대학 학비를 스스로 대요.

w|membiayai.text: Orang tua Intan membiayai seluruh pesta tanpa berutang.
w|membiayai.en: Intan's parents paid for the whole party without borrowing money.
w|membiayai.ko: 인탄의 부모님은 빚지지 않고 잔치 비용을 전부 댔어요.

w|membidik.text: Toko itu membidik anak muda dengan iklan di media sosial.
w|membidik.en: That shop targets young people with ads on social media.
w|membidik.ko: 그 가게는 소셜 미디어 광고로 젊은 층을 겨냥해요.

w|membidik.text: Sekolah masak itu membidik ibu rumah tangga yang ingin berjualan dari rumah.
w|membidik.en: That cooking school targets housewives who want to sell food from home.
w|membidik.ko: 그 요리 학교는 집에서 장사하고 싶은 주부들을 겨냥해요.

w|membimbing.text: Kakak Fajar membimbing dia memilih laptop yang sesuai untuk kuliah.
w|membimbing.en: Fajar's older brother guided him in choosing a laptop suitable for college.
w|membimbing.ko: 파자르의 형이 대학 공부에 맞는 노트북을 고르도록 도와줬어요.

w|membimbing.text: Koki tamu itu dengan sabar membimbing Lestari menghias kue.
w|membimbing.en: The guest chef patiently guided Lestari in decorating the cake.
w|membimbing.ko: 초대 요리사는 레스타리가 케이크를 장식하도록 차분히 지도했어요.

w|membina.text: Sutradara teater itu sudah lama membina aktor-aktor muda dari kampung sekitar.
w|membina.en: The theater director has long been nurturing young actors from the surrounding villages.
w|membina.ko: 그 연극 연출가는 오래전부터 주변 마을의 젊은 배우들을 키워 왔어요.

w|membina.text: Kondektur kereta itu senang membina anak-anak magang yang baru bekerja.
w|membina.en: The train conductor enjoys mentoring the new trainees.
w|membina.ko: 그 열차 차장은 새로 일하는 수습생들을 가르치는 걸 좋아해요.

w|membingungkan.ko: 그 안내가 많은 참가자를 헷갈리게 했어.

w|membingungkan.en: This math problem is so confusing.

w|membintangi.text: Agus pernah membintangi iklan toko roti di televisi lokal.
w|membintangi.en: Agus once starred in a bakery commercial on local television.
w|membintangi.ko: 아구스는 지역 방송 빵집 광고에 출연한 적이 있어요.

w|membintangi.text: Seorang aktor muda membintangi video promosi aplikasi Wati.
w|membintangi.en: A young actor starred in the promo video for Wati's app.
w|membintangi.ko: 젊은 배우가 와티의 앱 홍보 영상에 출연했어요.

w|membius.text: Dalam video IPA, Eko melihat dokter hewan membius harimau sebelum memeriksanya.
w|membius.en: In a science video, Eko saw a vet sedate a tiger before examining it.
w|membius.ko: 과학 영상에서 에코는 수의사가 호랑이를 검사하기 전에 마취하는 걸 봤어요.

w|membius.text: Lukisan laut karya Ayu seolah membius semua orang yang melihatnya.
w|membius.en: Ayu's seascape seemed to enchant everyone who saw it.
w|membius.ko: 아유의 바다 그림은 보는 사람 모두를 홀리는 듯했어요.

w|memblokir.text: Pohon tumbang memblokir jalan menuju pantai setelah hujan angin.
w|memblokir.en: A fallen tree blocked the road to the beach after the storm.
w|memblokir.ko: 비바람이 지난 뒤 쓰러진 나무가 해변 가는 길을 막았어요.

w|memblokir.text: Mobil tamu Pak Hasan memblokir pintu garasi rumah Ayu.
w|memblokir.en: Mr. Hasan's guest's car blocked Ayu's garage door.
w|memblokir.ko: 하산 씨 손님의 차가 아유네 차고 문을 막았어요.

w|membobol.text: Seminggu sebelum pesta, pencuri sempat membobol rumah Fajar dan mengambil cincin kawin.
w|membobol.en: A week before the party, a thief broke into Fajar's house and took the wedding ring.
w|membobol.ko: 잔치 일주일 전에 도둑이 파자르의 집을 털어 결혼반지를 가져갔어요.

w|membobol.text: Lestari menulis berita tentang peretas yang membobol data ribuan pelanggan bank.
w|membobol.en: Lestari wrote a story about hackers who breached the data of thousands of bank customers.
w|membobol.ko: 레스타리는 수천 명의 은행 고객 정보를 턴 해커들에 대한 기사를 썼어요.

w|membocorkan.text: Rina marah karena mengira Budi membocorkan rahasianya kepada Ayah.
w|membocorkan.en: Rina was angry because she thought Budi had leaked her secret to Dad.
w|membocorkan.ko: 리나는 부디가 아빠에게 자기 비밀을 흘렸다고 생각해서 화가 났어요.

w|membocorkan.text: Adik Siti tidak sengaja membocorkan rencana pesta syukuran rumah baru.
w|membocorkan.en: Siti's younger brother accidentally let slip the plan for the housewarming party.
w|membocorkan.ko: 시티의 동생이 실수로 집들이 잔치 계획을 흘려 버렸어요.

w|membodohi.text: Rina tidak mudah dibodohi oleh penjual yang menawarkan barang palsu.
w|membodohi.en: Rina isn't easily fooled by salespeople offering fake goods.
w|membodohi.ko: 리나는 가짜 물건을 파는 사람에게 쉽게 속지 않아요.

w|membodohi.text: Seorang penipu mencoba membodohi resepsionis dengan kartu kredit palsu.
w|membodohi.en: A con man tried to fool the receptionist with a fake credit card.
w|membodohi.ko: 한 사기꾼이 가짜 신용카드로 프런트 직원을 속이려 했어요.

w|membohongi.text: Narasumber itu ketahuan membohongi wartawan soal angka penjualan.
w|membohongi.en: The source was caught lying to the journalists about the sales figures.
w|membohongi.ko: 그 취재원은 판매 수치를 두고 기자들을 속인 게 들통났어요.

w|membohongi.text: Ayu tidak mau membohongi pelanggan soal suku cadang yang dipakai.
w|membohongi.en: Ayu doesn't want to lie to customers about the spare parts she uses.
w|membohongi.ko: 아유는 어떤 부품을 쓰는지 손님을 속이고 싶지 않아요.

w|membolehkan.text: Dimas tidak membolehkan pemilik masuk ke ruang operasi.
w|membolehkan.en: Dimas does not allow owners to enter the operating room.
w|membolehkan.ko: 디마스는 주인이 수술실에 들어오지 못하게 해요.

w|membolehkan.text: Aturan lab tidak membolehkan siapa pun makan di dekat meja kerja.
w|membolehkan.en: The lab rules don't allow anyone to eat near the workbench.
w|membolehkan.ko: 실험실 규칙상 누구도 작업대 근처에서 음식을 먹을 수 없어요.

w|membolos.text: Waktu kecil, Agus pernah membolos sekolah untuk memancing di sungai.
w|membolos.en: As a child, Agus once skipped school to go fishing in the river.
w|membolos.ko: 아구스는 어릴 때 학교를 빼먹고 강에 낚시하러 간 적이 있어요.

w|membolos.text: Seorang siswa membolos dan duduk lama di apotek sambil main ponsel.
w|membolos.en: A student skipped school and sat in the pharmacy for a long time playing on his phone.
w|membolos.ko: 한 학생이 학교를 빼먹고 약국에 오래 앉아 휴대폰을 했어요.

w|membongkar.text: Fajar berhasil membongkar kebohongan saksi lewat satu pertanyaan sederhana.
w|membongkar.en: Fajar managed to expose the witness's lie with one simple question.
w|membongkar.ko: 파자르는 간단한 질문 하나로 증인의 거짓말을 밝혀냈어요.

w|membongkar.text: Pagi-pagi Lestari membongkar kardus baru berisi sabun cuci.
w|membongkar.en: Early in the morning Lestari unpacked a new box of laundry soap.
w|membongkar.ko: 레스타리는 아침 일찍 세탁 비누가 든 새 상자를 풀었어요.

w|memborgol.text: Dalam adegan penangkapan, polisi memborgol tokoh yang diperankan Eko.
w|memborgol.en: In the arrest scene, the police handcuff the character Eko plays.
w|memborgol.ko: 체포 장면에서 경찰이 에코가 맡은 인물에게 수갑을 채워요.

w|memborgol.text: Di berita, Ayu melihat polisi memborgol pencuri yang membobol toko di kampung sebelah.
w|memborgol.en: On the news, Ayu saw police handcuff the thief who broke into a shop in the next village.
w|memborgol.ko: 뉴스에서 아유는 옆 마을 가게를 턴 도둑에게 경찰이 수갑을 채우는 걸 봤어요.

w|membosankan.text: Film itu membosankan dari awal sampai akhir.
w|membosankan.en: That movie is boring from start to finish.

w|membran.text: Fajar menjelaskan cara kerja obat yang bisa menembus membran sel.
w|membran.en: Fajar explained how a drug that can pass through the cell membrane works.
w|membran.ko: 파자르는 세포막을 통과하는 약이 어떻게 작용하는지 설명했어요.

w|membran.text: Rekan baru di laboratorium itu meneliti membran penyaring air.
w|membran.en: The new coworker in the lab researches water-filtering membranes.
w|membran.ko: 실험실의 새 동료는 물 거르는 막을 연구해요.

w|membual.text: Teman Andi suka membual bahwa dia sudah membaca semua buku di rak itu.
w|membual.en: Andi's friend likes to brag that he has read every book on that shelf.
w|membual.ko: 안디의 친구는 그 책장의 책을 다 읽었다고 허풍 떠는 걸 좋아해요.

w|membual.text: Rekan kerja Dewi sering membual soal kenalannya di kantor pusat.
w|membual.en: Dewi's coworker often boasts about his connections at headquarters.
w|membual.ko: 디위의 동료는 본사에 아는 사람이 있다고 자주 허풍을 떨어요.

w|membuatkan.text: Ibu membuatkan kue cokelat untuk anaknya.
w|membuatkan.en: Mother made chocolate cake for her child.
w|membuatkan.ko: 엄마가 아이를 위해 초콜릿 케이크를 만들어 줬어.

w|membuatkan.text: Dia membuatkan teh hangat untuk tamu.
w|membuatkan.en: She made warm tea for the guest.
w|membuatkan.ko: 그는 손님을 위해 따뜻한 차를 타 줬어.

w|membubarkan.text: Budi mengenang saat guru membubarkan klub teater mereka di sekolah.
w|membubarkan.en: Budi recalls when the teacher disbanded their theater club at school.
w|membubarkan.ko: 부디는 선생님이 학교 연극부를 해체했던 때를 떠올려요.

w|membubarkan.text: Polisi membubarkan kerumunan penonton yang menghalangi jalur lari.
w|membubarkan.en: The police dispersed the crowd of spectators blocking the running route.
w|membubarkan.ko: 경찰은 달리기 코스를 막은 구경꾼 무리를 해산시켰어요.

w|membujuk.text: Bayu berhasil membujuk atasannya untuk menambah kipas di ruang jahit.
w|membujuk.en: Bayu managed to persuade his boss to add fans in the sewing room.
w|membujuk.ko: 바유는 상사를 설득해서 재봉실에 선풍기를 더 놓게 했어요.

w|membujuk.text: Seorang ibu membujuk anaknya yang menangis di antrean imigrasi.
w|membujuk.en: A mother coaxed her crying child in the immigration queue.
w|membujuk.ko: 한 엄마가 출입국 심사 줄에서 우는 아이를 달랬어요.

w|membukakan.text: Seorang petugas membukakan pintu gerbong untuk penumpang yang membawa kursi roda.
w|membukakan.en: An attendant opened the carriage door for a passenger with a wheelchair.
w|membukakan.ko: 직원 한 명이 휠체어를 가진 승객을 위해 객차 문을 열어 줬어요.

w|membukakan.text: Pertemuan dengan investor itu membukakan jalan bagi Putri untuk membuka kantor kedua.
w|membukakan.en: The meeting with the investor opened the way for Putri to open a second office.
w|membukakan.ko: 그 투자자와의 만남이 푸트리가 두 번째 사무실을 여는 길을 열어 줬어요.

w|membungkam.text: Suara gamelan yang keras berhasil membungkam obrolan para tamu.
w|membungkam.en: The loud gamelan music managed to silence the guests' chatter.
w|membungkam.ko: 커다란 가믈란 소리에 손님들의 수다가 뚝 그쳤어요.

w|membungkam.text: Lestari menolak upaya pejabat itu untuk membungkam media dengan ancaman.
w|membungkam.en: Lestari refused that official's attempt to silence the media with threats.
w|membungkam.ko: 레스타리는 협박으로 언론의 입을 막으려는 그 공무원의 시도를 거부했어요.

w|membungkuk.text: Rudi membungkuk untuk mengangkat karung semen dengan hati-hati.
w|membungkuk.en: Rudi bent down to lift the cement sack carefully.
w|membungkuk.ko: 루디는 시멘트 포대를 조심스럽게 들려고 허리를 굽혔어요.

w|membungkuk.text: Rina sedikit membungkuk saat bersalaman dengan direktur.
w|membungkuk.en: Rina bowed slightly when she shook hands with the director.
w|membungkuk.ko: 리나는 이사와 악수할 때 살짝 고개를 숙였어요.

w|membungkus.text: Fajar membungkus kue tart itu dengan kotak dan pita merah.
w|membungkus.en: Fajar wrapped the cake in a box with a red ribbon.
w|membungkus.ko: 파자르는 그 케이크를 상자에 담고 빨간 리본으로 포장했어요.

w|membungkus.text: Ibu Lestari membungkus nasi kuning untuk dibawa ke lokasi lomba.
w|membungkus.en: Lestari's mother packed yellow rice to bring to the race venue.
w|membungkus.ko: 레스타리의 어머니는 대회장에 가져갈 노란 밥을 쌌어요.

w|membuntuti.text: Bayu merasa ada orang asing yang membuntuti dia sampai ke lobi.
w|membuntuti.en: Bayu felt that a stranger was following him all the way to the lobby.
w|membuntuti.ko: 바유는 낯선 사람이 로비까지 자기를 따라온 것 같았어요.

w|membuntuti.text: Intan pindah gerbong karena merasa ada pria yang membuntuti dia.
w|membuntuti.en: Intan switched carriages because she felt a man was following her.
w|membuntuti.ko: 인탄은 어떤 남자가 따라오는 것 같아서 다른 칸으로 옮겼어요.

w|membunuh.en: I don't want to kill animals.

w|membunyikan.text: Sopir bus di belakang terus membunyikan klakson karena Agus berjalan pelan.
w|membunyikan.en: The bus driver behind kept honking because Agus was driving slowly.
w|membunyikan.ko: 아구스가 천천히 달리자 뒤의 버스 기사가 계속 경적을 울렸어요.

w|membunyikan.text: Petugas keamanan membunyikan alarm latihan kebakaran pukul sepuluh pagi.
w|membunyikan.en: The security officer sounded the fire-drill alarm at ten in the morning.
w|membunyikan.ko: 경비원이 오전 열 시에 화재 훈련 경보를 울렸어요.

w|memburu.text: Mereka memburu rusa di hutan lebat.
w|memburu.en: They hunt deer in the dense forest.
Police are hunting the fleeing suspect.

w|memburuk.text: Memburuknya hubungan mereka membuat tim goyah.
w|memburuk.en: Their worsening relationship made the team unsteady.

w|membusuk.text: Pisang di dalam tas Budi sudah membusuk karena lupa dimakan seminggu.
w|membusuk.en: The banana in Budi's bag had rotted because he forgot to eat it for a week.
w|membusuk.ko: 부디 가방 속 바나나는 일주일 동안 잊고 안 먹어서 썩어 버렸어요.

w|membusuk.text: Siti lupa mengosongkan kulkas, jadi sayurannya membusuk selama perjalanan.
w|membusuk.en: Siti forgot to empty the fridge, so the vegetables rotted during the trip.
w|membusuk.ko: 시티가 냉장고 비우는 걸 깜빡해서 가는 동안 채소가 썩었어요.

w|membutakan.text: Uap panas dari panci sempat membutakan kacamata Andi beberapa detik.
w|membutakan.en: The hot steam from the pot briefly fogged up Andi's glasses for a few seconds.
w|membutakan.ko: 냄비에서 나온 뜨거운 김 때문에 안디의 안경이 몇 초 동안 뿌옇게 됐어요.

w|membutakan.text: Dewi menulis bahwa cahaya lampu kendaraan di malam hari sering membutakan matanya.
w|membutakan.en: Dewi wrote that car headlights at night often blind her.
w|membutakan.ko: 데위는 밤에 차 불빛 때문에 자주 눈이 부시다고 썼어요.

w|memecah.text: Suara petir memecah keheningan malam di rumah Dimas.
w|memecah.en: The sound of thunder broke the silence of the night at Dimas's house.
w|memecah.ko: 천둥소리가 디마스네 집의 밤 고요를 깼어요.

w|memecah.text: Tukang memakai palu besar untuk memecah ubin lama di kamar mandi.
w|memecah.en: The workman used a big hammer to break up the old bathroom tiles.
w|memecah.ko: 인부는 큰 망치로 욕실의 낡은 타일을 깼어요.

w|memecahkan.en: She managed to solve that puzzle.

w|memecat.en: The company decided to fire some employees.

w|memecat.text: Memecat orang tanpa alasan itu tidak adil.
w|memecat.en: Firing people without reason is unfair.
w|memecat.ko: 이유 없이 사람을 해고하는 건 불공정해.

w|memedulikan.text: Rombongan turis itu tidak memedulikan tanda dilarang memotret dengan lampu kilat.
w|memedulikan.en: The tour group ignored the sign forbidding flash photography.
w|memedulikan.ko: 그 관광객 무리는 플래시 촬영 금지 표지판을 신경 쓰지 않았어요.

w|memedulikan.text: Putri terlalu fokus pada dialognya sampai tidak memedulikan hujan gerimis.
w|memedulikan.en: Putri was so focused on her lines that she didn't mind the drizzle.
w|memedulikan.ko: 푸트리는 대사에 너무 집중해서 이슬비도 신경 쓰지 않았어요.

w|memegang.en: Please hold this for a moment.

w|memegangi.text: Adik Fajar memegangi ekor kebaya pengantin agar tidak terinjak tamu.
w|memegangi.en: Fajar's younger sibling held the train of the bride's kebaya so guests wouldn't step on it.
w|memegangi.ko: 파자르의 동생은 손님들이 밟지 않도록 신부 크바야 자락을 잡아 줬어요.

w|memegangi.text: Sambil memegangi kopi panas, Lestari membaca ulang naskah sebelum dicetak.
w|memegangi.en: Holding a hot coffee, Lestari reread the draft before it went to print.
w|memegangi.ko: 뜨거운 커피를 손에 든 채 레스타리는 인쇄 전에 원고를 다시 읽었어요.

w|memejamkan.text: Agus memejamkan mata dan mendengarkan suara air terjun.
w|memejamkan.en: Agus closed his eyes and listened to the sound of the waterfall.
w|memejamkan.ko: 아구스는 눈을 감고 폭포 소리를 들었어요.

w|memejamkan.text: Sebelum menulis, Wati memejamkan mata dan membayangkan wajah sahabatnya.
w|memejamkan.en: Before writing, Wati closed her eyes and pictured her friend's face.
w|memejamkan.ko: 와티는 편지를 쓰기 전에 눈을 감고 친구 얼굴을 떠올렸어요.

w|memelihara.text: Fajar memesan akuarium kecil karena ingin memelihara ikan cupang.
w|memelihara.en: Fajar ordered a small aquarium because he wants to keep betta fish.
w|memelihara.ko: 파자르는 베타를 기르고 싶어서 작은 어항을 주문했어요.

w|memelihara.text: Guru masak itu memelihara ragi sendiri untuk membuat roti.
w|memelihara.en: The cooking teacher keeps her own yeast starter for making bread.
w|memelihara.ko: 요리 선생님은 빵을 만들려고 효모 종균을 직접 길러요.

w|memeluk.text: Mereka saling memeluk setelah lama berpisah.
w|memeluk.en: They hugged each other after a long separation.

w|memenangi.text: Museum kecil ini pernah memenangi penghargaan desain pameran terbaik.
w|memenangi.en: This small museum once won an award for best exhibition design.
w|memenangi.ko: 이 작은 박물관은 최우수 전시 디자인상을 받은 적이 있어요.

w|memenangi.text: Tim Putri memenangi lomba penjualan terbanyak bulan ini.
w|memenangi.en: Putri's team won this month's top sales contest.
w|memenangi.ko: 푸트리 팀이 이번 달 판매왕 대회에서 이겼어요.

w|memenangkan.en: They managed to win the match.
She wants to win the grand prize.

w|memengaruhi.text: Cuaca mendung bisa memengaruhi suasana hati Dimas seharian.
w|memengaruhi.en: Cloudy weather can affect Dimas's mood all day.
w|memengaruhi.ko: 흐린 날씨는 하루 종일 디마스의 기분에 영향을 줄 수 있어요.

w|memengaruhi.text: Kelembapan udara bisa memengaruhi kekuatan kayu di rumah itu.
w|memengaruhi.en: Humidity can affect the strength of the wood in that house.
w|memengaruhi.ko: 습도는 그 집 나무의 강도에 영향을 줄 수 있어요.

w|memenjarakan.text: Budi merasa seperti tersangka, padahal polisi pun tidak bisa memenjarakan orang tanpa bukti.
w|memenjarakan.en: Budi felt like a suspect, even though even the police can't jail someone without evidence.
w|memenjarakan.ko: 부디는 용의자가 된 기분이었어요. 경찰도 증거 없이는 사람을 가둘 수 없는데 말이에요.

w|memenjarakan.text: Siti menemukan novel lama tentang raja yang memenjarakan saudaranya sendiri.
w|memenjarakan.en: Siti found an old novel about a king who imprisoned his own brother.
w|memenjarakan.ko: 시티는 자기 형제를 감옥에 가둔 왕 이야기가 담긴 옛 소설을 찾았어요.

w|mementingkan.text: Pemimpin yang baik tidak mementingkan diri sendiri, kata Fajar kepada pegawai magang.
w|mementingkan.en: A good leader doesn't put himself first, Fajar told the interns.
w|mementingkan.ko: 좋은 지도자는 자기만 생각하지 않는다고 파자르가 인턴들에게 말했어요.

w|mementingkan.text: Lestari bilang ia sekarang lebih mementingkan kesehatan daripada karier.
w|mementingkan.en: Lestari said she now cares more about her health than her career.
w|mementingkan.ko: 레스타리는 이제 경력보다 건강을 더 중요하게 생각한다고 했어요.

w|memenuhi.text: Dia berusaha memenuhi janji kepada temannya.
w|memenuhi.en: He tried to fulfill his promise to his friend.

w|memerah.text: Wajah Agus memerah ketika ketahuan lupa membawa dompet.
w|memerah.en: Agus's face turned red when he was caught having forgotten his wallet.
w|memerah.ko: 지갑을 깜빡한 게 들통나자 아구스의 얼굴이 빨개졌어요.

w|memerah.text: Daun-daun di taman kota mulai memerah, dan Wati sibuk memotretnya.
w|memerah.en: The leaves in the city park began to turn red, and Wati was busy photographing them.
w|memerah.ko: 도시 공원의 나뭇잎이 붉어지기 시작하자 와티는 사진 찍느라 바빴어요.

w|memerangi.text: Kakak Rudi, seorang dokter, bercerita tentang program desa untuk memerangi demam berdarah.
w|memerangi.en: Rudi's older sister, a doctor, talked about the village program to fight dengue fever.
w|memerangi.ko: 의사인 루디의 누나는 뎅기열과 싸우는 마을 사업 이야기를 했어요.

w|memerangi.text: Koran itu menjalankan kampanye untuk memerangi berita bohong.
w|memerangi.en: The newspaper runs a campaign to combat fake news.
w|memerangi.ko: 그 신문사는 가짜 뉴스와 싸우는 캠페인을 벌여요.

w|memerankan.text: Bayu menemukan poster film lama tempat aktor favoritnya memerankan seorang bajak laut.
w|memerankan.en: Bayu found an old movie poster in which his favorite actor plays a pirate.
w|memerankan.ko: 바유는 좋아하는 배우가 해적 역을 맡은 옛 영화 포스터를 찾았어요.

w|memerankan.text: Dalam acara hiburan, sepupu Intan memerankan raja dan ratu dalam drama singkat.
w|memerankan.en: During the entertainment, Intan's cousins played a king and queen in a short skit.
w|memerankan.ko: 여흥 시간에 인탄의 사촌들이 짧은 촌극에서 왕과 왕비 역을 맡았어요.

w|memeras.text: Rina memeras jeruk nipis ke dalam teh hangatnya.
w|memeras.en: Rina squeezed lime into her warm tea.
w|memeras.ko: 리나는 따뜻한 차에 라임을 짜 넣었어요.

w|memeras.text: Di film yang Dewi tonton, penjahat memeras pemilik hotel dengan foto rahasia.
w|memeras.en: In the film Dewi watched, a criminal blackmailed the hotel owner with secret photos.
w|memeras.ko: 데위가 본 영화에서 악당이 비밀 사진으로 호텔 주인을 협박했어요.

w|memercayai.text: Bayu memercayai tetangganya untuk menyiram tanaman selama dia pergi.
w|memercayai.en: Bayu trusts his neighbor to water his plants while he's away.
w|memercayai.ko: 바유는 집을 비우는 동안 이웃에게 화분에 물 주는 일을 믿고 맡겨요.

w|memercayai.text: Intan tidak langsung memercayai cerita penumpang yang mengaku kehilangan dompet.
w|memercayai.en: Intan didn't immediately believe the passenger who claimed to have lost his wallet.
w|memercayai.ko: 인탄은 지갑을 잃어버렸다는 승객의 말을 바로 믿지 않았어요.

w|memergoki.text: Andi memergoki anak tetangga memetik mangga dari pohonnya.
w|memergoki.en: Andi caught the neighbor's kid picking mangoes from his tree.
w|memergoki.ko: 안디는 이웃집 아이가 자기 나무에서 망고를 따는 걸 들켰어요.

w|memergoki.text: Petugas memergoki pengunjung yang memotret dengan lampu kilat di dekat Dewi.
w|memergoki.en: The staff caught a visitor near Dewi taking photos with a flash.
w|memergoki.ko: 직원은 데위 근처에서 플래시를 터뜨려 사진을 찍던 관람객을 적발했어요.

w|memeriksa.en: The doctor will examine you first.

w|memerintah.en: The king ruled the country fairly.

w|memerintah.text: Bos memerintah staf untuk segera pergi.
w|memerintah.en: The boss ordered the staff to leave immediately.

w|memerintahkan.en: The captain ordered the crew to retreat.
Mom ordered us to clean the room.

w|memerlukan.text: Proyek ini memerlukan waktu yang panjang.
w|memerlukan.en: This project needs a long time.
Needing help doesn't mean you're weak.

w|memesan.en: We ordered food through an app.

w|memesan.text: Dia memesan kamar di hotel itu.
w|memesan.en: He booked a room at that hotel.

w|memesankan.text: Andi memesankan nasi kotak untuk wartawan yang lembur.
w|memesankan.en: Andi ordered boxed rice meals for the reporters working late.
w|memesankan.ko: 안디는 야근하는 기자들을 위해 도시락을 주문해 줬어요.

w|memesankan.text: Dewi memesankan jasa angkut barang lewat aplikasi.
w|memesankan.en: Dewi booked a moving service through an app.
w|memesankan.ko: 데위는 앱으로 이삿짐 운반 서비스를 예약해 줬어요.

w|memetakan.text: Petugas desa membantu Budi memetakan batas tanah warisan keluarga.
w|memetakan.en: A village official helped Budi map the boundaries of the family's inherited land.
w|memetakan.ko: 마을 직원이 부디를 도와 집안에서 물려받은 땅의 경계를 지도로 그렸어요.

w|memetakan.text: Siti memetakan alur kerja dapur agar para koki tidak saling bertabrakan.
w|memetakan.en: Siti mapped out the kitchen workflow so the cooks wouldn't bump into each other.
w|memetakan.ko: 시티는 요리사들이 서로 부딪치지 않게 주방 동선을 정리했어요.

w|memetik.text: Saat singgah di desa, Dimas ikut petani memetik teh di kebun.
w|memetik.en: While stopping at a village, Dimas joined the farmers picking tea in the garden.
w|memetik.ko: 마을에 들렀을 때 디마스는 농부들과 함께 밭에서 찻잎을 땄어요.

w|memetik.text: Setelah kerja keras setahun, tim Putri akhirnya memetik hasilnya.
w|memetik.en: After a year of hard work, Putri's team finally reaped the rewards.
w|memetik.ko: 1년 동안 고생한 끝에 푸트리의 팀은 드디어 결실을 거뒀어요.

w|memfitnah.text: Dimas kesal karena tetangga memfitnah dirinya menyumbat selokan.
w|memfitnah.en: Dimas was upset because a neighbor falsely accused him of clogging the drain.
w|memfitnah.ko: 이웃이 자기가 도랑을 막았다고 모함해서 디마스는 속상했어요.

w|memfitnah.text: Seorang kerabat jauh memfitnah Putri ingin menjual rumah warisan itu diam-diam.
w|memfitnah.en: A distant relative falsely claimed Putri wanted to secretly sell the inherited house.
w|memfitnah.ko: 먼 친척 하나가 푸트리가 물려받은 집을 몰래 팔려 한다고 모함했어요.

w|memfokuskan.text: Agus memasang lampu meja untuk memfokuskan cahaya ke meja kerjanya.
w|memfokuskan.en: Agus put in a desk lamp to focus light on his work desk.
w|memfokuskan.ko: 아구스는 책상에 빛을 모으려고 스탠드를 달았어요.

w|memfokuskan.text: Saat musim hujan, Wati memfokuskan waktunya untuk menulis di rumah.
w|memfokuskan.en: During the rainy season, Wati focuses her time on writing at home.
w|memfokuskan.ko: 우기에는 와티가 집에서 글 쓰는 데 시간을 쏟아요.

w|memfoto.text: Rudi memfoto luka di kaki kambing untuk dikirim ke rekan dokternya.
w|memfoto.en: Rudi photographed the wound on the goat's leg to send to a fellow vet.
w|memfoto.ko: 루디는 동료 수의사에게 보내려고 염소 다리의 상처를 사진으로 찍었어요.

w|memfoto.text: Rina memfoto matahari terbit dari puncak bukit dekat desanya.
w|memfoto.en: Rina photographed the sunrise from the hilltop near her village.
w|memfoto.ko: 리나는 마을 근처 언덕 꼭대기에서 해돋이를 찍었어요.

w|memicu.text: Suara ponsel yang keras memicu teguran dari pustakawan.
w|memicu.en: A loud phone ringing triggered a reprimand from the librarian.
w|memicu.ko: 휴대폰 소리가 크게 울리자 사서가 주의를 줬어요.

w|memicu.text: Pohon tumbang di atas rel memicu keterlambatan semua kereta pagi itu.
w|memicu.en: A tree that fell on the tracks caused delays to all the trains that morning.
w|memicu.ko: 선로에 쓰러진 나무 때문에 그날 아침 기차가 모두 늦어졌어요.

w|memihak.text: Guru yang baik tidak memihak murid yang pintar saja.
w|memihak.en: A good teacher doesn't favor only the clever students.
w|memihak.ko: 좋은 선생님은 똑똑한 학생 편만 들지 않아요.

w|memihak.text: Saat sepupu-sepupunya berebut kembang api, Dewi tidak mau memihak.
w|memihak.en: When her cousins fought over the fireworks, Dewi didn't want to take sides.
w|memihak.ko: 사촌들이 불꽃놀이 폭죽을 두고 다툴 때 데위는 누구 편도 들지 않으려 했어요.

w|memijat.text: Dimas mengajari pemilik cara memijat kaki anjing tua yang kaku.
w|memijat.en: Dimas taught the owner how to massage the old dog's stiff legs.
w|memijat.ko: 디마스는 주인에게 늙은 개의 뻣뻣한 다리를 주무르는 법을 가르쳐 줬어요.

w|memijat.text: Setelah berdiri seharian, Putri minta adiknya memijat bahunya.
w|memijat.en: After standing all day, Putri asked her younger sibling to massage her shoulders.
w|memijat.ko: 하루 종일 서 있었던 푸트리는 동생에게 어깨를 주물러 달라고 했어요.

w|memikat.text: Rudi mencoba memikat hati kakaknya lagi dengan membawakan martabak kesukaannya.
w|memikat.en: Rudi tried to win his sister over again by bringing her favorite martabak.
w|memikat.ko: 루디는 누나가 좋아하는 마르타박을 사 와서 누나 마음을 다시 사려고 했어요.

w|memikat.text: Matahari terbenam di teluk itu selalu berhasil memikat para fotografer.
w|memikat.en: The sunset over that bay always manages to captivate photographers.
w|memikat.ko: 그 만의 해넘이는 늘 사진가들을 사로잡아요.

w|memikirkan.en: Stop thinking about that all the time.
I'm thinking about a new plan.

w|memikul.text: Bayu memikul dua jeriken air dari sungai ke perkemahan.
w|memikul.en: Bayu carried two jerry cans of water on his shoulders from the river to the camp.
w|memikul.ko: 바유는 물통 두 개를 어깨에 메고 강에서 야영지까지 날랐어요.

w|memikul.text: Intan merasa memikul harapan seluruh klub larinya.
w|memikul.en: Intan feels she carries the hopes of her whole running club.
w|memikul.ko: 인탄은 러닝 클럽 전체의 기대를 짊어진 기분이에요.

w|memiliki.ko: 그 사람은 집을 두 채 가지고 있어.

w|memiliki.en: That company has a lot of branches.

w|memimpikan.text: Sudah lama Fajar memimpikan sepeda balap, dan akhirnya dia memesannya.
w|memimpikan.en: Fajar had long dreamed of a racing bike, and finally he ordered one.
w|memimpikan.ko: 파자르는 오랫동안 경주용 자전거를 꿈꿨는데 드디어 주문했어요.

w|memimpikan.text: Lestari memimpikan toko kue kecil di dekat rumahnya.
w|memimpikan.en: Lestari dreams of a small cake shop near her house.
w|memimpikan.ko: 레스타리는 집 근처에 작은 케이크 가게를 여는 꿈을 꿔요.

w|memindahkan.text: Mereka memindahkan meja ke sudut ruangan.
w|memindahkan.en: They moved the table to the corner of the room.

w|memindahkan.text: Tolong memindahkan tas itu ke mobil.
w|memindahkan.en: Please move that bag to the car.

w|memindai.text: Petugas gudang memindai kode barang sebelum kotak dimuat ke truk.
w|memindai.en: Warehouse staff scan the item codes before the boxes are loaded onto the truck.
w|memindai.ko: 창고 직원은 상자를 트럭에 싣기 전에 물품 코드를 스캔해요.

w|memindai.text: Putri memindai foto-foto lama mereka dan menyelipkan salinannya di amplop.
w|memindai.en: Putri scans their old photos and slips the copies into the envelope.
w|memindai.ko: 푸트리는 둘의 옛 사진을 스캔해서 사본을 봉투에 넣어요.

w|meminjam.en: May I borrow your pencil for a moment?

w|meminjam.text: Dia sering meminjam buku dari perpustakaan.
w|meminjam.en: She often borrows books from the library.

w|meminjamkan.text: Andi meminjamkan payung kepada Rina karena hujan turun saat pulang.
w|meminjamkan.en: Andi lent Rina his umbrella because it rained when they were going home.
w|meminjamkan.ko: 퇴근할 때 비가 와서 안디가 리나에게 우산을 빌려줬어요.

w|meminjamkan.text: Dewi meminjamkan pengisi daya ponsel kepada tamu yang lupa membawanya.
w|meminjamkan.en: Dewi lent a phone charger to a guest who forgot to bring one.
w|meminjamkan.ko: 데위는 충전기를 깜빡한 손님에게 휴대폰 충전기를 빌려줬어요.

w|meminum.en: The doctor advises drinking lots of water.
Taking medicine on time is important.

w|memisahkan.text: Guru membantu memisahkan dua siswa yang bertengkar.
w|memisahkan.en: The teacher helped separate two students who were fighting.
w|memisahkan.ko: 선생님이 싸우는 두 학생을 떼어 놓았어.

w|memisahkan.text: Mesin ini bisa memisahkan biji dari kulitnya.
w|memisahkan.en: This machine can separate the seed from its husk.
w|memisahkan.ko: 이 기계는 씨앗과 껍질을 분리할 수 있어.

w|memodifikasi.text: Pelatih memodifikasi program latihan Bayu karena lututnya belum pulih.
w|memodifikasi.en: The trainer modified Bayu's training program because his knee hasn't recovered yet.
w|memodifikasi.ko: 트레이너는 바유의 무릎이 아직 낫지 않아 운동 프로그램을 바꿨어요.

w|memodifikasi.text: Koki bersedia memodifikasi resep supaya tidak terlalu pedas untuk anak-anak.
w|memodifikasi.en: The chef is willing to modify the recipe so it isn't too spicy for children.
w|memodifikasi.ko: 요리사는 아이들에게 너무 맵지 않게 레시피를 바꿔 줄 수 있어요.

w|memompa.text: Budi memompa bola basket yang kempis sebelum jam olahraga.
w|memompa.en: Budi pumped up the flat basketball before PE.
w|memompa.ko: 부디는 체육 시간 전에 바람 빠진 농구공에 바람을 넣었어요.

w|memompa.text: Siti melihat petugas memompa ban troli bandara yang kempis.
w|memompa.en: Siti saw a worker pumping up the flat tire of an airport cart.
w|memompa.ko: 시티는 직원이 공항 카트의 바람 빠진 바퀴에 바람을 넣는 걸 봤어요.

w|memonitor.text: Perawat memonitor napas kucing itu sepanjang malam.
w|memonitor.en: The nurse monitored the cat's breathing all night.

w|memonitor.text: Sebuah kamera memonitor suhu inkubator selama akhir pekan.
w|memonitor.en: A camera monitors the incubator's temperature over the weekend.
w|memonitor.ko: 카메라가 주말 동안 배양기 온도를 감시해요.

w|memonopoli.text: Andi menyelidiki perusahaan yang dituduh memonopoli impor gula.
w|memonopoli.en: Andi is investigating a company accused of monopolizing sugar imports.
w|memonopoli.ko: 안디는 설탕 수입을 독점했다는 의혹을 받는 회사를 취재하고 있어요.

w|memonopoli.text: Adik Dewi memonopoli kamar paling besar di rumah baru.
w|memonopoli.en: Dewi's younger sibling has monopolized the biggest room in the new house.
w|memonopoli.ko: 데위 동생이 새 집에서 제일 큰 방을 독차지했어요.

w|memori.text: Memori lama muncul saat melihat foto itu.
w|memori.en: Old memories appeared when seeing that photo.
w|memori.ko: 그 사진을 보자 옛 기억이 떠올랐어.

w|memori.text: Komputer butuh memori tambahan untuk aplikasi.
w|memori.en: The computer needs extra memory for the app.
w|memori.ko: 컴퓨터는 그 앱에 추가 메모리가 필요해.

w|memotivasi.text: Cerita kakek tentang hutan yang dulu lebat memotivasi Agus menanam pohon.
w|memotivasi.en: Grandpa's stories about the once-dense forest motivated Agus to plant trees.
w|memotivasi.ko: 예전에 울창했던 숲 이야기를 해 준 할아버지 덕분에 아구스는 나무를 심기로 했어요.

w|memotivasi.text: Wati ingin memotivasi pasien diabetes supaya rajin memeriksa gula darah.
w|memotivasi.en: Wati wants to motivate diabetes patients to check their blood sugar regularly.
w|memotivasi.ko: 와티는 당뇨 환자들이 혈당을 꾸준히 재도록 북돋우고 싶어요.

w|memotret.text: Eko memotret matahari terbenam dari atas batu karang.
w|memotret.en: Eko photographed the sunset from on top of a rock.
w|memotret.ko: 에코는 바위 위에서 해 지는 모습을 찍었어요.

w|memotret.text: Ayu memotret bunga kamboja di halaman tetangga untuk dikirim ke ibunya.
w|memotret.en: Ayu photographed the frangipani flowers in the neighbor's yard to send to her mother.
w|memotret.ko: 아유는 어머니께 보내려고 이웃집 마당의 프랜지파니 꽃을 찍었어요.

w|mempekerjakan.text: Kontraktor itu mempekerjakan banyak warga sekitar sebagai tukang.
w|mempekerjakan.en: The contractor hires many local residents as builders.
w|mempekerjakan.ko: 그 시공사는 주변 주민들을 인부로 많이 고용해요.

w|mempekerjakan.text: Perusahaan itu mempekerjakan Rina setelah tiga kali wawancara.
w|mempekerjakan.en: The company hired Rina after three interviews.
w|mempekerjakan.ko: 그 회사는 면접을 세 번 본 뒤 리나를 채용했어요.

w|mempelai.text: Seorang penyair membacakan puisi cinta untuk kedua mempelai.
w|mempelai.en: A poet recited a love poem for the bride and groom.
w|mempelai.ko: 한 시인이 신랑 신부를 위해 사랑 시를 낭송했어요.

w|mempelai.text: Lestari menghadiri pernikahan sepupunya dan memotret kedua mempelai di bawah gerimis.
w|mempelai.en: Lestari attended her cousin's wedding and photographed the bride and groom in the drizzle.
w|mempelai.ko: 레스타리는 사촌 결혼식에 가서 이슬비 속 신랑 신부를 찍었어요.

w|mempengaruhi.ko: 날씨가 기분에 영향을 줄 수 있어.
광고가 종종 구매자 선택에 영향을 줘.

w|memperbaiki.en: We have to fix this mistake.

w|memperbarui.text: Rudi memperbarui catatan vaksin semua pasiennya setiap bulan.
w|memperbarui.en: Rudi updates the vaccination records of all his patients every month.
w|memperbarui.ko: 루디는 매달 모든 환자의 예방접종 기록을 갱신해요.

w|memperbarui.text: Rina membantu ayahnya memperbarui atap ijuk rumah mereka.
w|memperbarui.en: Rina helped her father renew the palm-fiber roof of their house.
w|memperbarui.ko: 리나는 아빠를 도와 집의 야자섬유 지붕을 새로 이었어요.

w|memperbesar.text: Andi ingin memperbesar jendela ruang tamu agar lebih terang.
w|memperbesar.en: Andi wants to enlarge the living room window to make it brighter.
w|memperbesar.ko: 안디는 거실을 더 밝게 하려고 창문을 넓히고 싶어 해요.

w|memperbesar.text: Dewi memperbesar foto sawah di ponselnya untuk melihat petani di kejauhan.
w|memperbesar.en: Dewi zooms in on the photo of the rice fields on her phone to see the farmers in the distance.
w|memperbesar.ko: 데위는 멀리 있는 농부들을 보려고 휴대폰 속 논 사진을 확대해요.

w|memperbolehkan.text: Guru olahraga tidak memperbolehkan murid main bola di dalam kelas.
w|memperbolehkan.en: The PE teacher doesn't allow students to play ball inside the classroom.
w|memperbolehkan.ko: 체육 선생님은 학생들이 교실 안에서 공놀이하는 걸 허락하지 않아요.

w|memperbolehkan.text: Selama liburan, ibu Ayu memperbolehkan anak-anak tidur lebih malam.
w|memperbolehkan.en: During the holiday, Ayu's mother lets the kids go to bed later.
w|memperbolehkan.ko: 방학 동안 아유의 어머니는 아이들이 더 늦게 자도 되게 해 줘요.

w|memperbudak.text: Drama malam ini bercerita tentang tuan tanah yang memperbudak para petani.
w|memperbudak.en: Tonight's play is about a landlord who enslaves the farmers.
w|memperbudak.ko: 오늘 밤 연극은 농민들을 노예처럼 부리는 지주 이야기예요.

w|memperbudak.text: Ayu membaca novel sejarah tentang kerajaan yang memperbudak penduduk pulau.
w|memperbudak.en: Ayu read a historical novel about a kingdom that enslaved the island's people.
w|memperbudak.ko: 아유는 섬 주민들을 노예로 삼은 왕국에 관한 역사 소설을 읽었어요.

w|memperburuk.text: Eko tahu menambah minyak hanya akan memperburuk gorengan yang sudah lembek.
w|memperburuk.en: Eko knows that adding more oil will only make the soggy fritters worse.
w|memperburuk.ko: 에코는 기름을 더 넣으면 눅눅해진 튀김이 더 망가질 뿐이라는 걸 알아요.

w|memperburuk.text: Hujan deras memperburuk jalan berlubang di depan rumah Ayu.
w|memperburuk.en: The heavy rain made the potholed road in front of Ayu's house even worse.
w|memperburuk.ko: 폭우 때문에 아유네 집 앞 패인 길이 더 나빠졌어요.

w|mempercayakan.text: Wali kelas mempercayakan kunci laboratorium kepada Andi.
w|mempercayakan.en: The homeroom teacher entrusted Andi with the laboratory key.
w|mempercayakan.ko: 담임 선생님은 실험실 열쇠를 안디에게 맡겼어요.

w|mempercayakan.text: Ibu mempercayakan urusan dekorasi sepenuhnya kepada Dewi.
w|mempercayakan.en: Mom entrusted the decorating entirely to Dewi.
w|mempercayakan.ko: 엄마는 장식하는 일을 전부 데위에게 맡겼어요.

w|mempercepat.text: Rina membuat tabel baru yang mempercepat pembuatan laporan bulanan.
w|mempercepat.en: Rina made a new spreadsheet that speeds up the monthly reports.
w|mempercepat.ko: 리나는 월간 보고서 작성을 빠르게 해 주는 새 표를 만들었어요.

w|mempercepat.text: Hotel memasang mesin baru untuk mempercepat proses check-in.
