w|mempercepat.en: The hotel installed a new machine to speed up check-in.
w|mempercepat.ko: 호텔은 체크인을 빠르게 하려고 새 기계를 들여놓았어요.

w|memperdebatkan.text: Warga desa memperdebatkan rencana jalan baru di rumah Agus.
w|memperdebatkan.en: The villagers debated the plan for a new road at Agus's house.
w|memperdebatkan.ko: 마을 사람들은 아구스의 집에서 새 도로 계획을 두고 토론했어요.

w|memperdebatkan.text: Wati mengingat masa ketika mereka memperdebatkan judul lagu sampai larut malam.
w|memperdebatkan.en: Wati remembered the days when they would argue about song titles late into the night.
w|memperdebatkan.ko: 와티는 둘이 밤늦게까지 노래 제목을 두고 다투던 시절을 떠올렸어요.

w|memperebutkan.text: Pameran ini menampilkan dua kerajaan yang memperebutkan jalur dagang rempah.
w|memperebutkan.en: This exhibition features two kingdoms that fought over the spice trade route.
w|memperebutkan.ko: 이 전시는 향신료 무역로를 두고 다툰 두 왕국을 보여 줘요.

w|memperebutkan.text: Para pramuniaga memperebutkan posisi dekat pintu karena paling ramai.
w|memperebutkan.en: The salespeople compete for the spot near the door because it's the busiest.
w|memperebutkan.ko: 판매원들은 손님이 제일 많은 문 근처 자리를 서로 차지하려고 해요.

w|mempergunakan.text: Budi mempergunakan waktu libur untuk menulis surat panjang.
w|mempergunakan.en: Budi used his day off to write a long letter.
w|mempergunakan.ko: 부디는 쉬는 날을 이용해 긴 편지를 썼어요.

w|mempergunakan.text: Siti mempergunakan halaman belakang untuk kebun bersama tetangga.
w|mempergunakan.en: Siti uses her backyard as a shared garden with the neighbors.
w|mempergunakan.ko: 시티는 뒷마당을 이웃들과 함께 쓰는 텃밭으로 활용해요.

w|memperhatikan.en: Please pay attention to the road.
The teacher told us to pay attention.

w|memperhitungkan.text: Bayu lupa memperhitungkan macet, jadi dia terlambat ke konferensi pers.
w|memperhitungkan.en: Bayu forgot to factor in traffic, so he was late for the press conference.
w|memperhitungkan.ko: 바유는 교통 체증을 계산에 넣지 않아서 기자회견에 늦었어요.

w|memperhitungkan.text: Sebelum meluncur, Intan harus memperhitungkan biaya server untuk setahun.
w|memperhitungkan.en: Before launching, Intan had to calculate server costs for a year.
w|memperhitungkan.ko: 출시 전에 인탄은 일 년 치 서버 비용을 따져 봐야 했어요.

w|memperingati.text: Perpustakaan memperingati hari buku dengan pameran naskah kuno, dan Andi datang paling awal.
w|memperingati.en: The library marked Book Day with an exhibition of ancient manuscripts, and Andi came first.
w|memperingati.ko: 도서관은 책의 날을 기념해 고문서 전시를 열었고, 안디가 제일 먼저 왔어요.

w|memperingati.text: Dewi dan suaminya memperingati ulang tahun pernikahan di tengah tumpukan kardus.
w|memperingati.en: Dewi and her husband celebrated their wedding anniversary among piles of boxes.
w|memperingati.ko: 데위 부부는 상자 더미 속에서 결혼기념일을 기념했어요.

w|memperingatkan.text: Guru memperingatkan siswa tentang bahaya api.
w|memperingatkan.en: The teacher warned students about fire danger.
Warning a friend is a form of care.

w|memperjelas.text: Eko meminta nelayan memperjelas jam berangkat perahu besok pagi.
w|memperjelas.en: Eko asked the fisherman to make clear what time the boat leaves tomorrow morning.
w|memperjelas.ko: 에코는 어부에게 내일 아침 배가 몇 시에 떠나는지 분명히 말해 달라고 했어요.

w|memperjelas.text: Ayu menulis pesan di grup warga untuk memperjelas jadwal ronda.
w|memperjelas.en: Ayu wrote a message in the residents' group to clarify the night-watch schedule.
w|memperjelas.ko: 아유는 야간 순찰 일정을 분명히 하려고 주민 단체방에 글을 남겼어요.

w|memperjuangkan.text: Dimas ikut memperjuangkan aturan yang melarang penelantaran hewan peliharaan.
w|memperjuangkan.en: Dimas joined the fight for a rule banning the abandonment of pets.
w|memperjuangkan.ko: 디마스는 반려동물 유기를 금지하는 규정을 위해 함께 힘썼어요.

w|memperjuangkan.text: Putri terus memperjuangkan dana tambahan untuk proyek vaksin timnya.
w|memperjuangkan.en: Putri keeps fighting for extra funding for her team's vaccine project.
w|memperjuangkan.ko: 푸트리는 팀의 백신 사업을 위해 추가 예산을 얻으려고 계속 애쓰고 있어요.

w|memperkenalkan.text: Guru memperkenalkan siswa baru ke kelas.
w|memperkenalkan.en: The teacher introduced the new student to the class.
She wants to introduce the newest product.
w|memperkenalkan.ko: 그는 최신 제품을 소개하고 싶어 해.

w|memperkirakan.text: Manajer memperkirakan pesanan akan naik menjelang Lebaran.
w|memperkirakan.en: The manager estimates orders will rise ahead of Eid.
w|memperkirakan.ko: 관리자는 르바란을 앞두고 주문이 늘 거라고 예상해요.

w|memperkirakan.text: Pilot memperkirakan pesawat akan mendarat dua puluh menit lebih awal.
w|memperkirakan.en: The pilot estimated the plane would land twenty minutes early.
w|memperkirakan.ko: 기장은 비행기가 이십 분 일찍 착륙할 거라고 예상했어요.

w|memperkuat.text: Latihan setiap sore memperkuat kerja sama tim basket Rudi.
w|memperkuat.en: Practice every afternoon strengthens the teamwork of Rudi's basketball team.
w|memperkuat.ko: 매일 오후 연습이 루디네 농구팀의 팀워크를 탄탄하게 해요.

w|memperkuat.text: Tukang memasang besi tambahan untuk memperkuat atap teras rumah Rina.
w|memperkuat.en: The builder added extra iron to strengthen the porch roof of Rina's house.
w|memperkuat.ko: 일꾼이 리나네 테라스 지붕을 튼튼하게 하려고 철근을 덧댔어요.

w|memperlakukan.text: Guru itu memperlakukan semua siswa dengan adil.
w|memperlakukan.en: That teacher treats all students fairly.
w|memperlakukan.ko: 그 선생님은 모든 학생을 공정하게 대해.

w|memperlambat.text: Obat kumur itu bisa memperlambat pertumbuhan karang gigi.
w|memperlambat.en: That mouthwash can slow down the build-up of tartar.
w|memperlambat.ko: 그 구강 청결제는 치석이 생기는 걸 늦출 수 있어요.

w|memperlambat.text: Hujan berhari-hari memperlambat pekerjaan memasang atap baru.
w|memperlambat.en: Days of rain slowed down the work on the new roof.
w|memperlambat.ko: 며칠 동안 내린 비 때문에 새 지붕 공사가 더뎌졌어요.

w|memperlihatkan.text: Budi memperlihatkan hasil gambarnya kepada wali kelas.
w|memperlihatkan.en: Budi showed his drawing to his homeroom teacher.
w|memperlihatkan.ko: 부디는 자기 그림을 담임 선생님께 보여 드렸어요.

w|memperlihatkan.text: Pemilik rumah memperlihatkan letak meteran listrik kepada Siti.
w|memperlihatkan.en: The landlord showed Siti where the electricity meter is.
w|memperlihatkan.ko: 집주인이 시티에게 전기 계량기 위치를 보여 줬어요.

w|memperluas.text: Pemilik berencana memperluas dapur supaya bisa menerima pesanan katering besar.
w|memperluas.en: The owner plans to expand the kitchen so it can take large catering orders.
w|memperluas.ko: 주인은 큰 케이터링 주문을 받으려고 주방을 넓힐 계획이에요.

w|memperluas.text: Panitia ingin memperluas area pasar sampai ke lapangan parkir.
w|memperluas.en: The organizers want to extend the market area into the parking lot.
w|memperluas.ko: 주최 측은 시장 구역을 주차장까지 넓히고 싶어 해요.

w|mempermainkan.en: Don't toy with other people's feelings.
They played with the rules just to win.

w|mempermalukan.text: Hakim mengingatkan pengacara agar tidak mempermalukan saksi di depan umum.
w|mempermalukan.en: The judge reminded the lawyer not to humiliate the witness in public.
w|mempermalukan.ko: 판사는 변호사에게 증인을 공개적으로 망신 주지 말라고 주의를 줬어요.

w|mempermalukan.text: Lestari tidak mau mempermalukan pelanggan yang lupa membawa dompet.
w|mempermalukan.en: Lestari doesn't want to embarrass customers who forget their wallets.
w|mempermalukan.ko: 레스타리는 지갑을 깜빡한 손님을 창피하게 만들고 싶지 않아요.

w|mempermasalahkan.text: Pelanggan itu mempermasalahkan ukuran porsi, lalu Eko menambah nasi.
w|mempermasalahkan.en: The customer complained about the portion size, so Eko added more rice.
w|mempermasalahkan.ko: 그 손님이 양이 적다고 따지자 에코는 밥을 더 줬어요.

w|mempermasalahkan.text: Ibu Ayu mempermasalahkan jemuran yang tidak kunjung kering.
w|mempermasalahkan.en: Ayu's mother complained about the laundry that never seemed to dry.
w|mempermasalahkan.ko: 아유의 어머니는 빨래가 도무지 마르지 않는다고 불평했어요.

w|memperoleh.en: She managed to obtain a full scholarship.
w|memperoleh.ko: 그녀는 전액 장학금을 얻는 데 성공했어.

w|memperoleh.en: Our team obtained a narrow victory.

w|memperpanjang.text: Andi datang ke meja petugas untuk memperpanjang masa pinjam novelnya.
w|memperpanjang.en: Andi went to the desk to extend the loan period on his novel.
w|memperpanjang.ko: 안디는 소설 대출 기간을 연장하려고 데스크에 갔어요.

w|memperpanjang.text: Perusahaan setuju memperpanjang kontrak kerja Dewi selama dua tahun lagi.
w|memperpanjang.en: The company agreed to extend Dewi's employment contract for two more years.
w|memperpanjang.ko: 회사는 디위의 근로 계약을 이 년 더 연장하기로 했어요.

w|mempersembahkan.text: Saat pesta panen, para penari mempersembahkan tarian untuk Dewi Sri.
w|mempersembahkan.en: At the harvest festival, the dancers performed a dance in honor of Dewi Sri.
w|mempersembahkan.ko: 추수 잔치 때 무용수들은 데위 스리에게 춤을 바쳤어요.

w|mempersembahkan.text: Siti mempersembahkan perannya di film ini untuk almarhum ayahnya.
w|mempersembahkan.en: Siti dedicated her role in this film to her late father.
w|mempersembahkan.ko: 시티는 이 영화의 배역을 돌아가신 아버지께 바쳤어요.

w|mempersempit.text: Bayu membantu mempersempit pilihan nama produk baru.
w|mempersempit.en: Bayu helped narrow down the options for the new product name.
w|mempersempit.ko: 바유는 새 제품 이름 후보를 좁히는 걸 도왔어요.

w|mempersempit.text: Intan mempersempit jarak tangan saat melakukan push-up.
w|mempersempit.en: Intan narrows the distance between her hands when doing push-ups.
w|mempersempit.ko: 인탄은 팔굽혀펴기를 할 때 손 간격을 좁혀요.

w|mempersenjatai.text: Sebelum bicara dengan kakaknya, Rudi mempersenjatai diri dengan bukti obrolan di ponsel.
w|mempersenjatai.en: Before talking to his sister, Rudi armed himself with chat screenshots on his phone.
w|mempersenjatai.ko: 루디는 누나와 얘기하기 전에 휴대폰 대화 기록을 증거로 챙겼어요.

w|mempersenjatai.text: Menurut pemandu museum, raja di pesisir itu dulu mempersenjatai kapal-kapalnya untuk melawan bajak laut.
w|mempersenjatai.en: According to the museum guide, the coastal king once armed his ships to fight pirates.
w|mempersenjatai.ko: 박물관 해설사에 따르면 그 해안의 왕은 예전에 해적과 싸우려고 배들을 무장시켰대요.

w|mempersiapkan.en: They prepared the documents for the meeting.

w|mempersilakan.text: Kakak Rudi akhirnya membuka pintu dan mempersilakan Rudi masuk.
w|mempersilakan.en: Rudi's sister finally opened the door and invited him in.
w|mempersilakan.ko: 루디의 누나는 마침내 문을 열고 루디에게 들어오라고 했어요.

w|mempersilakan.text: Pemilik warung mempersilakan Rina duduk di kursi yang menghadap laut.
w|mempersilakan.en: The stall owner invited Rina to sit in the chair facing the sea.
w|mempersilakan.ko: 가게 주인은 리나에게 바다가 보이는 자리에 앉으라고 했어요.

w|mempersulit.text: Kompor yang rusak mempersulit Eko menyiapkan pesanan malam.
w|mempersulit.en: The broken stove made it harder for Eko to prepare the evening orders.
w|mempersulit.ko: 고장 난 화구 때문에 에코는 저녁 주문을 준비하기가 힘들었어요.

w|mempersulit.text: Banjir mempersulit Ayu berangkat ke kampus.
w|mempersulit.en: The flood made it hard for Ayu to get to campus.
w|mempersulit.ko: 홍수 때문에 아유는 학교에 가기가 힘들었어요.

w|mempertahankan.en: The team tries to maintain the score lead.
Preserving family tradition matters to him.
w|mempertahankan.ko: 가족 전통을 지키는 게 그에게 중요해.

w|mempertanyakan.text: Pengawas mempertanyakan kualitas pasir yang dikirim kemarin.
w|mempertanyakan.en: The supervisor questioned the quality of the sand delivered yesterday.
w|mempertanyakan.ko: 감독관은 어제 들어온 모래의 품질을 문제 삼았어요.

w|mempertanyakan.text: Rina mulai mempertanyakan keputusannya pindah kerja saat melihat tumpukan tugas.
w|mempertanyakan.en: Rina began to question her decision to change jobs when she saw the pile of tasks.
w|mempertanyakan.ko: 리나는 쌓인 업무를 보고 이직한 결정을 되묻기 시작했어요.

w|mempertaruhkan.en: He risked his career for honesty.
Risking one's life is not a wise choice.
w|mempertaruhkan.ko: 목숨을 거는 건 현명한 선택이 아니야.

w|mempertemukan.text: Acara arisan kantor mempertemukan Fajar dengan teman lama dari divisi lain.
w|mempertemukan.en: The office savings club event brought Fajar together with an old friend from another division.
w|mempertemukan.ko: 회사 계모임 덕분에 파자르는 다른 부서의 옛 친구를 다시 만났어요.

w|mempertemukan.text: Aplikasi Lestari mempertemukan pemilik kos dengan mahasiswa yang mencari kamar.
w|mempertemukan.en: Lestari's app connects boarding house owners with students looking for rooms.
w|mempertemukan.ko: 레스타리의 앱은 하숙집 주인과 방을 찾는 대학생을 이어 줘요.

w|mempertimbangkan.text: Kami mempertimbangkan semua usulan dengan saksama.

w|mempertimbangkan.en: Considering the risks is very important.
w|mempertimbangkan.ko: 위험을 따져 보는 건 아주 중요해.

w|mempesona.en: Agus's smile looked dazzling after his teeth were whitened.
w|mempesona.ko: 미백을 하고 나니 아구스의 미소가 눈부셨어요.

w|mempesona.text: Lantai ubin motif lama di ruang tengah terlihat mempesona setelah dicuci.
w|mempesona.en: The old patterned floor tiles in the main room looked stunning after being washed.
w|mempesona.ko: 가운데 방의 옛 무늬 타일 바닥은 닦고 나니 눈부시게 예뻤어요.

w|memprediksi.en: Rudi joked that Bayu used to be able to predict the exam scores of the whole class.
w|memprediksi.ko: 루디는 바유가 예전에 반 친구들 시험 점수를 다 맞히곤 했다고 농담했어요.

w|memprediksi.text: Rina memakai data tahun lalu untuk memprediksi jumlah pengguna bulan depan.
w|memprediksi.en: Rina used last year's data to predict next month's number of users.
w|memprediksi.ko: 리나는 작년 자료로 다음 달 사용자 수를 예측했어요.

w|memproduksi.text: Setiap hari pabrik itu memproduksi ribuan potong kemeja.
w|memproduksi.en: Every day the factory produces thousands of shirts.
w|memproduksi.ko: 그 공장은 날마다 셔츠 수천 벌을 생산해요.

w|memproduksi.text: Perusahaan Intan memproduksi makanan ringan yang dijual di bandara.
w|memproduksi.en: Intan's company produces snacks that are sold at the airport.
w|memproduksi.ko: 인탄의 회사는 공항에서 파는 과자를 생산해요.

w|memprogram.en: The tech team programs the news site so the headline changes every hour.
w|memprogram.ko: 기술 팀은 주요 제목이 매시간 바뀌도록 뉴스 사이트를 프로그래밍해요.

w|memprogram.text: Siti belajar memprogram mesin peminjaman agar buku bisa dipinjam tanpa antre.
w|memprogram.en: Siti is learning to program the checkout machine so books can be borrowed without queuing.
w|memprogram.ko: 시티는 줄 서지 않고 책을 빌릴 수 있게 대출기 프로그래밍을 배우고 있어요.

w|mempromosikan.text: Restoran meminta seorang penyanyi lokal mempromosikan menu nasi goreng terbaru.
w|mempromosikan.en: The restaurant asked a local singer to promote the newest fried rice dish.
w|mempromosikan.ko: 식당은 동네 가수에게 새 볶음밥 메뉴를 홍보해 달라고 부탁했어요.

w|mempromosikan.text: Lestari mempromosikan lapaknya lewat grup media sosial warga kompleks.
w|mempromosikan.en: Lestari promotes her stall through the neighborhood social media group.
w|mempromosikan.ko: 레스타리는 동네 SNS 모임에서 자기 노점을 홍보해요.

w|memproses.text: Bagian iklan butuh dua hari untuk memproses pesanan iklan baris.
w|memproses.en: The ads department needs two days to process classified ad orders.
w|memproses.ko: 광고부는 줄 광고 주문을 처리하는 데 이틀이 걸려요.

w|memproses.text: Server baru bisa memproses ribuan pembayaran setiap menit.
w|memproses.en: The new server can process thousands of payments every minute.
w|memproses.ko: 새 서버는 매분 수천 건의 결제를 처리할 수 있어요.

w|memprovokasi.text: Eko menegur pemuda yang sengaja memprovokasi nelayan dengan mengebut di dekat jaring.
w|memprovokasi.en: Eko scolded a young man who was deliberately provoking the fishermen by speeding near their nets.
w|memprovokasi.ko: 에코는 그물 근처에서 일부러 과속하며 어부들을 자극한 청년을 나무랐어요.

w|memprovokasi.text: Dokter berkata bahwa makanan terlalu dingin bisa memprovokasi rasa ngilu di gigi Ayu.
w|memprovokasi.en: The dentist said very cold food could trigger the aching in Ayu's teeth.
w|memprovokasi.ko: 의사는 너무 찬 음식이 아유의 이 시림을 일으킬 수 있다고 했어요.

w|mempublikasikan.text: Klinik itu mempublikasikan jadwal vaksin gratis di media sosialnya.
w|mempublikasikan.en: The clinic published the free vaccination schedule on its social media.
w|mempublikasikan.ko: 그 병원은 무료 예방접종 일정을 소셜 미디어에 올렸어요.

w|mempublikasikan.en: A photographer published a photo of Siti's vegetable garden in a travel magazine.
w|mempublikasikan.ko: 한 사진작가가 시티의 채소밭 사진을 여행 잡지에 실었어요.

w|memuakkan.text: Budi menulis bahwa kemacetan ibu kota sungguh memuakkan.
w|memuakkan.en: Budi wrote that the capital's traffic jams are truly sickening.
w|memuakkan.ko: 부디는 수도의 교통 체증이 정말 지긋지긋하다고 썼어요.

w|memuakkan.text: Bau sampah dari rumah kosong di ujung gang benar-benar memuakkan.
w|memuakkan.en: The smell of garbage from the empty house at the end of the alley is truly disgusting.
w|memuakkan.ko: 골목 끝 빈집에서 나는 쓰레기 냄새가 정말 역겨워요.

w|memuaskan.text: Sutradara bilang hasil gladi resik kemarin cukup memuaskan.
w|memuaskan.en: The director said yesterday's dress rehearsal was quite satisfying.
w|memuaskan.ko: 연출가는 어제 리허설 결과가 꽤 만족스러웠다고 했어요.

w|memuaskan.text: Manajer bilang laporan bulanan Intan sangat memuaskan.
w|memuaskan.en: The manager said Intan's monthly report was very satisfying.
w|memuaskan.ko: 매니저는 인탄의 월간 보고서가 아주 만족스럽다고 했어요.

w|memuat.text: Para buruh memuat karung kain ke atas truk sejak pagi.
w|memuat.en: The workers have been loading sacks of cloth onto the truck since morning.
w|memuat.ko: 노동자들은 아침부터 천 자루를 트럭에 싣고 있어요.

w|memuat.text: Petugas bandara memuat koper-koper ke bagasi pesawat.
w|memuat.en: Airport staff loaded the suitcases into the plane's hold.
w|memuat.ko: 공항 직원들이 여행 가방을 비행기 화물칸에 실었어요.

w|memudar.en: Little by little, Rina's annoyance faded.

w|memudar.text: Cat dinding kamar mulai memudar, jadi Siti berencana mengecat ulang.
w|memudar.en: The bedroom wall paint is starting to fade, so Siti plans to repaint.
w|memudar.ko: 방 벽 페인트가 바래기 시작해서 시티는 다시 칠할 계획이에요.

w|memuja.text: Remaja di lantai empat sangat memuja penyanyi pop dari Korea.
w|memuja.en: The teenager on the fourth floor adores a pop singer from Korea.
w|memuja.ko: 사 층의 십 대는 한국 팝 가수를 무척 좋아해요.

w|memuja.text: Intan duduk di dekat rombongan pemuda yang memuja band rock lokal.
w|memuja.en: Intan sat near a group of young men who idolize a local rock band.
w|memuja.ko: 인탄은 지역 록밴드를 숭배하는 청년 무리 근처에 앉았어요.

w|memuji.text: Guru kesenian memuji gambar Eko di depan seluruh kelas.
w|memuji.en: The art teacher praised Eko's drawing in front of the whole class.
w|memuji.ko: 미술 선생님이 반 전체 앞에서 에코의 그림을 칭찬했어요.

w|memuji.text: Semua orang memuji masakan ibu Ayu saat makan malam.
w|memuji.en: Everyone praised Ayu's mother's cooking at dinner.
w|memuji.ko: 저녁 식사 때 모두 아유 어머니의 요리를 칭찬했어요.

w|memukuli.text: Di kelas sejarah, Andi membaca kisah tentara kolonial yang memukuli para petani.
w|memukuli.en: In history class, Andi read about colonial soldiers beating the farmers.
w|memukuli.ko: 안디는 역사 시간에 식민지 군인들이 농민들을 때린 이야기를 읽었어요.

w|memukuli.text: Menurut berita, korban dirawat di sini setelah sekelompok orang memukuli dia di jalan.
w|memukuli.en: According to the news, the victim was treated here after a group of people beat him in the street.
w|memukuli.ko: 뉴스에 따르면 피해자는 길에서 여러 사람에게 맞은 뒤 이곳에서 치료를 받았어요.

w|memulai.en: Starting a new business needs capital.

w|memulangkan.text: Panitia menyewa bus untuk memulangkan tamu dari luar kota.
w|memulangkan.en: The committee rented a bus to take out-of-town guests back home.
w|memulangkan.ko: 준비위원회는 타지 하객들을 집에 데려다줄 버스를 빌렸어요.

w|memulangkan.text: Pemerintah daerah memulangkan pengungsi banjir setelah air surut.
w|memulangkan.en: The local government sent the flood evacuees home after the water receded.
w|memulangkan.ko: 지방 정부는 물이 빠진 뒤 수재민들을 집으로 돌려보냈어요.

w|memulihkan.text: Kelinci itu butuh dua minggu untuk memulihkan tenaga setelah operasi.
w|memulihkan.en: The rabbit needed two weeks to recover its strength after surgery.
w|memulihkan.ko: 토끼는 수술 뒤 기운을 되찾는 데 두 주가 걸렸어요.

w|memulihkan.text: Teknisi butuh sehari penuh untuk memulihkan data yang terhapus.
w|memulihkan.en: The technician needed a whole day to recover the deleted data.
w|memulihkan.ko: 기술자가 지워진 데이터를 복구하는 데 꼬박 하루가 걸렸어요.

w|memunculkan.text: Kesalahan kecil Eko malah memunculkan resep baru yang laris.
w|memunculkan.en: Eko's small mistake actually gave rise to a new best-selling recipe.
w|memunculkan.ko: 에코의 작은 실수가 오히려 잘 팔리는 새 요리를 탄생시켰어요.

w|memunculkan.text: Hujan pertama memunculkan bau tanah yang disukai Ayu.
w|memunculkan.en: The first rain brings out the earthy smell that Ayu loves.
w|memunculkan.ko: 첫비가 오면 아유가 좋아하는 흙냄새가 올라와요.

w|memundurkan.text: Redaktur memundurkan tenggat berita utama sampai jam sembilan malam.
w|memundurkan.en: The editor pushed back the deadline for the lead story to nine at night.
w|memundurkan.ko: 편집자는 머리기사 마감을 밤 아홉 시로 미뤘어요.

w|memundurkan.text: Dewi memundurkan mobil boks pelan-pelan ke depan pagar.
w|memundurkan.en: Dewi slowly backed the box truck up to the front gate.
w|memundurkan.ko: 데위는 탑차를 천천히 후진해 대문 앞에 댔어요.

w|memungkinkan.text: Teknologi memungkinkan kita belajar dari rumah.
w|memungkinkan.en: Technology allows us to study from home.
w|memungkinkan.ko: 기술이 집에서 공부할 수 있게 해 줘.

w|memungkinkan.en: Good weather makes a safe trip possible.
w|memungkinkan.ko: 좋은 날씨가 안전한 여행을 가능하게 해.

w|memungut.text: Bayu memungut sampah plastik di pantai sebelum meninggalkan tempat itu.
w|memungut.en: Bayu picked up plastic trash on the beach before leaving.
w|memungut.ko: 바유는 그곳을 떠나기 전에 해변의 플라스틱 쓰레기를 주웠어요.

w|memungut.text: Intan memungut daun-daun kering di taman untuk dijadikan kolase.
w|memungut.en: Intan picked up dry leaves in the park to make a collage.
w|memungut.ko: 인탄은 콜라주를 만들려고 공원에서 마른 잎을 주웠어요.

w|memuntahkan.text: Keran tua di dapur Agus memuntahkan air berwarna cokelat.
w|memuntahkan.en: The old tap in Agus's kitchen spat out brown water.
w|memuntahkan.ko: 아구스네 부엌의 낡은 수도꼭지에서 갈색 물이 쏟아져 나왔어요.

w|memuntahkan.text: Wati menonton berita tentang gunung yang memuntahkan abu di awal musim kemarau.
w|memuntahkan.en: Wati watched news about a volcano spewing ash at the start of the dry season.
w|memuntahkan.ko: 와티는 건기 초에 화산이 재를 뿜어낸다는 뉴스를 봤어요.

w|memusnahkan.text: Petugas pertanian memusnahkan tanaman yang terserang hama wereng.
w|memusnahkan.en: Agricultural officers destroyed plants that were attacked by planthoppers.
w|memusnahkan.ko: 농업 담당자들이 멸구 피해를 입은 작물을 없앴어요.

w|memusnahkan.text: Dalam cerita film itu, seorang raja jahat ingin memusnahkan seluruh desa.
w|memusnahkan.en: In the film's story, an evil king wants to wipe out the entire village.
w|memusnahkan.ko: 그 영화 이야기에서 악한 왕은 마을 전체를 없애려고 해요.

w|memutar.text: Dia memutar kunci di lubang pintu.
w|memutar.en: He turned the key in the door lock.
Please turn the radio volume a little.

w|memutilasi.text: Kritikus menulis bahwa sutradara baru itu memutilasi naskah klasik sampai kehilangan maknanya.
w|memutilasi.en: The critic wrote that the new director butchered the classic script until it lost its meaning.
w|memutilasi.ko: 평론가는 새 연출가가 고전 대본을 마구 잘라 내서 뜻을 잃게 했다고 썼어요.

w|memutilasi.text: Penumpang di depan Ayu membaca berita tentang polisi yang menangkap pelaku yang memutilasi korbannya.
w|memutilasi.en: The passenger in front of Ayu was reading news about police arresting a suspect who had dismembered his victim.
w|memutilasi.ko: 아유 앞자리 승객은 피해자를 토막 낸 범인을 경찰이 잡았다는 뉴스를 읽고 있었어요.

w|memutus.text: Banjir sempat memutus jalan menuju desa, jadi Bayu menunggu di warung.
w|memutus.en: The flood briefly cut off the road to the village, so Bayu waited at a food stall.
w|memutus.ko: 홍수로 마을 가는 길이 잠시 끊겨서 바유는 노점에서 기다렸어요.

w|memutus.text: Intan memutus benang yang menggantung di bingkai lukisannya.
w|memutus.en: Intan snapped the thread hanging from her painting's frame.
w|memutus.ko: 인탄은 그림 액자에 매달린 실을 끊었어요.

w|memverifikasi.text: Petugas taman nasional memverifikasi izin berkemah Eko di pos jaga.
w|memverifikasi.en: The national park officer verified Eko's camping permit at the guard post.
w|memverifikasi.ko: 국립공원 직원이 초소에서 에코의 캠핑 허가증을 확인했어요.

w|memverifikasi.text: Panitia memverifikasi catatan waktu Ayu lewat cip di nomor dadanya.
w|memverifikasi.en: The organizers verified Ayu's finishing time through the chip on her bib.
w|memverifikasi.ko: 주최 측은 아유의 배번에 달린 칩으로 기록을 확인했어요.

w|menabrak.en: That car almost hit the fence.
w|menabrak.ko: 그 차가 거의 울타리를 들이받을 뻔했어.

w|menabrak.en: Don't bump into the table while walking.

w|menabung.text: Rudi menabung berbulan-bulan untuk membeli alat rontgen bekas bagi kliniknya.
w|menabung.en: Rudi saved for months to buy a used X-ray machine for his clinic.
w|menabung.ko: 루디는 병원에 쓸 중고 엑스레이 기계를 사려고 몇 달 동안 돈을 모았어요.

w|menabung.text: Rina menabung dari hasil menjual sayur untuk membeli sepatu sekolah.
w|menabung.en: Rina saves money from selling vegetables to buy school shoes.
w|menabung.ko: 리나는 채소를 판 돈을 모아 학교 신발을 사려고 해요.

w|menafsirkan.text: Budi belajar menafsirkan hasil rekam jantung dari dokter senior.
w|menafsirkan.en: Budi is learning to interpret ECG results from a senior doctor.
w|menafsirkan.ko: 부디는 선배 의사에게 심전도 결과를 해석하는 법을 배워요.

w|menafsirkan.text: Siti kesulitan menafsirkan papan jadwal yang penuh singkatan.
w|menafsirkan.en: Siti had trouble making sense of the departure board full of abbreviations.
w|menafsirkan.ko: 시티는 약어로 가득한 출발 안내판을 해석하느라 애를 먹었어요.

w|menagih.text: Pemilik lapak sebelah datang untuk menagih utang kepada Agus.
w|menagih.en: The owner of the next stall came to collect a debt from Agus.
w|menagih.ko: 옆 노점 주인이 아구스에게 빚을 받으러 왔어요.

w|menagih.text: Pemilik kos datang menagih uang sewa ketika Wati sedang menjemur kasur setelah hujan.
w|menagih.en: The landlord came to collect the rent while Wati was airing her mattress after the rain.
w|menagih.ko: 와티가 비 그친 뒤 매트리스를 말리고 있을 때 하숙집 주인이 방세를 받으러 왔어요.

w|menahan.en: Try holding your breath a moment.
He can barely hold back his anger.

w|menaiki.text: Penonton menaiki tangga sempit menuju balkon teater.
w|menaiki.en: The audience climbed the narrow stairs to the theatre balcony.
w|menaiki.ko: 관객들이 좁은 계단을 올라 극장 발코니로 갔어요.

w|menaiki.text: Intan menaiki lift ke lantai sepuluh sambil membawa kopi.
w|menaiki.en: Intan took the lift up to the tenth floor carrying her coffee.
w|menaiki.ko: 인탄은 커피를 들고 엘리베이터를 타고 십 층으로 올라갔어요.

w|menaikkan.text: Koran tempat Eko bekerja terpaksa menaikkan harga langganan bulan ini.
w|menaikkan.en: The newspaper where Eko works had to raise the subscription price this month.
w|menaikkan.ko: 에코가 일하는 신문사는 이번 달 구독료를 올릴 수밖에 없었어요.

w|menaikkan.text: Pemasok menaikkan harga layar sentuh, jadi ongkos servis ikut naik.
w|menaikkan.en: The supplier raised the price of touchscreens, so the service fee went up too.
w|menaikkan.ko: 공급업자가 터치스크린 값을 올려서 수리비도 같이 올랐어요.

w|menaklukkan.text: Hari itu Agus akhirnya berhasil menaklukkan rasa takutnya pada bor gigi.
w|menaklukkan.en: That day Agus finally managed to conquer his fear of the dental drill.
w|menaklukkan.ko: 그날 아구스는 마침내 치과 드릴에 대한 두려움을 이겨 냈어요.

w|menaklukkan.text: Wati akhirnya bisa menaklukkan pintu macet yang tidak terbuka selama bertahun-tahun.
w|menaklukkan.en: Wati finally managed to conquer the stuck door that hadn't opened for years.
w|menaklukkan.ko: 와티는 몇 년 동안 안 열리던 꽉 낀 문을 드디어 열어 냈어요.

w|menakuti.en: That sound frightened the little children.

w|menakuti.text: Menakuti hewan bukan permainan yang lucu.
w|menakuti.en: Scaring animals is not a funny game.
w|menakuti.ko: 동물을 겁주는 건 재미있는 놀이가 아니야.

w|menakutkan.en: The sounds at night are scary.

w|menamai.text: Waktu kecil, Budi yang menamai kucing mereka Si Belang.
w|menamai.en: When he was little, it was Budi who named their cat Si Belang.
w|menamai.ko: 어렸을 때 고양이에게 시블랑이라는 이름을 붙인 건 부디였어요.

w|menamai.text: Anak Siti menamai rumah baru mereka Istana Kecil.
w|menamai.en: Siti's child named their new house the Little Palace.
w|menamai.ko: 시티의 아이는 새집에 '작은 궁전'이라는 이름을 붙였어요.

w|menamakan.text: Anak tetangga menamakan kucing liar di parkiran itu Si Belang.
w|menamakan.en: The neighbor's child named the stray cat in the parking lot Spotty.
w|menamakan.ko: 이웃 아이는 주차장의 길고양이에게 얼룩이라는 이름을 붙였어요.

w|menamakan.text: Orang Belanda dulu menamakan stasiun itu dengan nama sebuah sungai.
w|menamakan.en: The Dutch once named that station after a river.
w|menamakan.ko: 예전에 네덜란드 사람들이 그 역에 강 이름을 붙였어요.

w|menambah.en: Please add just a little sugar.
Gaining more experience helps her career.
w|menambah.ko: 경험을 더하는 게 그녀의 경력에 도움이 돼.

w|menambahkan.text: Dia menambahkan gula ke dalam kopi.
w|menambahkan.en: She added sugar to the coffee.

w|menambahkan.text: Penulis menambahkan bab baru di novelnya.
w|menambahkan.en: The writer added a new chapter to his novel.

w|menampakkan.text: Setelah seminggu dirawat, pasien itu mulai menampakkan tanda pemulihan, kata Budi.
w|menampakkan.en: After a week in the hospital, the patient began to show signs of recovery, Budi said.
w|menampakkan.ko: 부디 말로는 그 환자가 입원 일주일 만에 회복 기미를 보이기 시작했어요.

w|menampakkan.text: Matahari mulai menampakkan diri ketika pesawat Siti mendarat.
w|menampakkan.en: The sun began to show itself as Siti's plane landed.
w|menampakkan.ko: 시티가 탄 비행기가 착륙할 때 해가 모습을 드러내기 시작했어요.

w|menampar.text: Di sinetron yang diputar di toko, seorang ibu menampar menantunya.
w|menampar.en: In the soap opera playing in the shop, a mother slapped her daughter-in-law.
w|menampar.ko: 가게에서 틀어 놓은 드라마에서 한 어머니가 며느리 뺨을 때렸어요.

w|menampar.text: Angin dingin pagi itu seperti menampar wajah para pelari.
w|menampar.en: The cold morning wind felt like it was slapping the runners' faces.
w|menampar.ko: 그날 아침 찬 바람이 달리기 선수들의 얼굴을 때리는 것 같았어요.

w|menampilkan.text: Koran daerah menampilkan foto Dimas dengan hasil panen semangka.
w|menampilkan.en: The local newspaper ran a photo of Dimas with his watermelon harvest.
w|menampilkan.ko: 지역 신문에 수박을 수확한 디마스의 사진이 실렸어요.

w|menampilkan.text: Poster di kamar Putri menampilkan tebing tinggi di tepi laut.
w|menampilkan.en: The poster in Putri's room shows a tall cliff by the sea.
w|menampilkan.ko: 푸트리 방의 포스터에는 바닷가의 높은 절벽이 담겨 있어요.

w|menampung.text: Saat banjir, rumah Andi yang bertingkat menampung beberapa keluarga tetangga.
w|menampung.en: During the flood, Andi's two-story house took in several neighboring families.
w|menampung.ko: 홍수 때 2층인 안디네 집은 이웃 몇 가족을 받아 줬어요.

w|menampung.text: Gudang bawah tanah museum menampung ribuan benda yang belum dipamerkan.
w|menampung.en: The museum's basement storage holds thousands of items not yet on display.
w|menampung.ko: 박물관 지하 수장고에는 아직 전시되지 않은 물건이 수천 점 있어요.

w|menanam.text: Musim ini Dimas mau menanam jagung di ladang sebelah rumah.
w|menanam.en: This season Dimas wants to plant corn in the field next to the house.
w|menanam.ko: 이번 철에 디마스는 집 옆 밭에 옥수수를 심으려고 해요.

w|menanam.text: Hari Minggu nanti, Putri ingin menanam cabai di pot.
w|menanam.en: This Sunday, Putri wants to plant chilies in pots.
w|menanam.ko: 이번 일요일에 푸트리는 화분에 고추를 심고 싶어 해요.

w|menanamkan.text: Guru teater Eko berusaha menanamkan disiplin sejak latihan pertama.
w|menanamkan.en: Eko's drama teacher tries to instill discipline from the very first rehearsal.
w|menanamkan.ko: 에코의 연극 선생님은 첫 연습부터 규율을 심어 주려고 애써요.

w|menanamkan.text: Ayah Ayu menanamkan kejujuran dalam berdagang sejak ia masih kecil.
w|menanamkan.en: Ayu's father instilled honesty in trading in her from when she was little.
w|menanamkan.ko: 아유의 아버지는 어릴 때부터 장사에서의 정직함을 심어 주셨어요.

w|menancap.text: Rudi menemukan paku yang menancap di ban mobil patroli.
w|menancap.en: Rudi found a nail stuck in the patrol car's tire.
w|menancap.ko: 루디는 순찰차 타이어에 박힌 못을 발견했어요.

w|menancap.text: Rina mencabut duri yang menancap di kaki anjing.
w|menancap.en: Rina pulled out the thorn stuck in the dog's paw.
w|menancap.ko: 리나는 개 발에 박힌 가시를 뽑았어요.

w|menancapkan.text: Fajar menancapkan paku payung untuk memasang jadwal rapat di papan pengumuman.
w|menancapkan.en: Fajar pushed in a thumbtack to put the meeting schedule on the notice board.
w|menancapkan.ko: 파자르는 압정을 꽂아 회의 일정표를 게시판에 붙였어요.

w|menancapkan.text: Lestari menancapkan bendera kecil di peta untuk setiap kota yang memakai aplikasinya.
w|menancapkan.en: Lestari sticks a little flag in the map for every city that uses her app.
w|menancapkan.ko: 레스타리는 자기 앱을 쓰는 도시마다 지도에 작은 깃발을 꽂아요.

w|menandai.text: Eko menandai halaman penting di buku catatannya dengan stabilo kuning.
w|menandai.en: Eko marked the important pages in his notebook with a yellow highlighter.
w|menandai.ko: 에코는 공책의 중요한 쪽을 노란 형광펜으로 표시했어요.

w|menandai.text: Ayu menandai tanggal ulang tahun nenek di kalender dapur.
w|menandai.en: Ayu marked grandma's birthday on the kitchen calendar.
w|menandai.ko: 아유는 부엌 달력에 할머니 생신을 표시했어요.

w|menandakan.text: Lampu merah di atas pintu loket menandakan ada warga yang sedang menunggu dilayani.
w|menandakan.en: The red light above the counter door signals that a resident is waiting to be served.
w|menandakan.ko: 창구 문 위의 빨간 불은 주민이 응대를 기다리고 있다는 뜻이에요.

w|menandakan.text: Bunyi peluit panjang menandakan lomba maraton sudah dimulai.
w|menandakan.en: The long whistle signals that the marathon has begun.
w|menandakan.ko: 길게 울리는 호루라기 소리는 마라톤이 시작됐다는 신호예요.

w|menandatangani.text: Dia menandatangani kontrak di meja kayu.
w|menandatangani.en: She signed the contract on the wooden desk.

w|menandatangani.text: Menandatangani surat itu adalah langkah terakhir.
w|menandatangani.en: Signing that letter is the final step.
w|menandatangani.ko: 그 편지에 서명하는 게 마지막 단계야.

w|menanggalkan.text: Fajar menanggalkan jas resminya begitu upacara di halaman balai kota selesai.
w|menanggalkan.en: Fajar took off his formal jacket as soon as the ceremony in the city hall courtyard was over.
w|menanggalkan.ko: 시청 마당의 행사가 끝나자마자 파자르는 정장 재킷을 벗었어요.

w|menanggalkan.text: Lestari menulis bahwa ia sudah menanggalkan kebiasaan lamanya menunda-nunda pekerjaan.
w|menanggalkan.en: Lestari wrote that she had shed her old habit of putting things off.
w|menanggalkan.ko: 레스타리는 일을 미루던 옛 버릇을 버렸다고 썼어요.

w|menanggapi.text: Agus menanggapi pesan ibunya dengan foto pemandangan gunung.
w|menanggapi.en: Agus responded to his mother's message with a photo of the mountain view.
w|menanggapi.ko: 아구스는 어머니의 메시지에 산 풍경 사진으로 답했어요.

w|menanggapi.text: Wati menanggapi keluhan pelanggan dengan senyum dan nada tenang.
w|menanggapi.en: Wati responded to the customer's complaint with a smile and a calm tone.
w|menanggapi.ko: 와티는 손님의 불평에 미소와 차분한 말투로 응했어요.

w|menangguhkan.text: Kepala sekolah menangguhkan kegiatan ekstrakurikuler selama ujian akhir, dan Budi terpaksa libur latihan band.
w|menangguhkan.en: The principal suspended extracurricular activities during final exams, so Budi had to skip band practice.
w|menangguhkan.ko: 교장 선생님이 기말시험 동안 방과 후 활동을 중단해서 버디는 밴드 연습을 쉬어야 했어요.

w|menangguhkan.text: Siti menangguhkan rencana mengecat rumah sampai musim kemarau datang.
w|menangguhkan.en: Siti put off her plan to paint the house until the dry season comes.
w|menangguhkan.ko: 시티는 건기가 올 때까지 집 칠하는 계획을 미뤘어요.

w|menanggung.text: Pemerintah kota akan menanggung biaya perbaikan rumah warga yang terkena banjir.
w|menanggung.en: The city government will cover the repair costs for residents' houses hit by the flood.
w|menanggung.ko: 시 정부가 홍수 피해를 입은 주민들의 집수리 비용을 부담하기로 했어요.

w|menanggung.text: Orang tua Wati menanggung biaya les karena mereka percaya pada bakatnya.
w|menanggung.en: Wati's parents cover the lesson fees because they believe in her talent.
w|menanggung.ko: 와티 부모님은 딸의 재능을 믿어서 레슨비를 대 주세요.

w|menangisi.text: Di bangku pengunjung, seorang ibu menangisi nasib anaknya yang sedang diadili.
w|menangisi.en: In the gallery, a mother wept over the fate of her son who was on trial.
w|menangisi.ko: 방청석에서 한 어머니가 재판받는 아들의 처지를 생각하며 울었어요.

w|menangisi.text: Adik Wati menangisi es krimnya yang jatuh ke lantai.
w|menangisi.en: Wati's little brother cried over his ice cream that fell on the floor.
w|menangisi.ko: 와티의 동생은 바닥에 떨어진 아이스크림 때문에 울었어요.

w|menangkap.en: The police managed to catch the thief.
I tried to catch the ball.

w|menantang.text: Soal ini menantang bahkan untuk ahli.
Dia menantang lawannya untuk duel adil.
w|menantang.en: He challenged his opponent to a fair duel.

w|menanti.text: Rudi masih menanti balasan Bayu dengan sabar.
w|menanti.en: Rudi is still patiently waiting for Bayu's reply.
w|menanti.ko: 루디는 아직도 바유의 답장을 참을성 있게 기다리고 있어요.

w|menanti.text: Seluruh tim menanti pengumuman hasil kompetisi startup dengan gugup.
w|menanti.en: The whole team nervously awaited the announcement of the startup competition results.
w|menanti.ko: 팀 전체가 스타트업 대회 결과 발표를 초조하게 기다렸어요.

w|menantikan.text: Agus sangat menantikan sate kambing di warung langganan ayahnya.
w|menantikan.en: Agus was really looking forward to goat satay at his father's favorite stall.
w|menantikan.ko: 아구스는 아버지 단골 가게의 염소 사테를 정말 기대했어요.

w|menantikan.text: Wati sudah lama menantikan cuti tahunan bulan depan.
w|menantikan.en: Wati has long been looking forward to her annual leave next month.
w|menantikan.ko: 와티는 다음 달 연차를 오래전부터 기다려 왔어요.

w|menantu.text: Ibu Rina berharap punya menantu yang sabar dan rajin.
w|menantu.en: Rina's mother hopes to have a patient and hardworking son-in-law.
w|menantu.ko: 리나의 어머니는 참을성 있고 성실한 사위를 바라요.

w|menantu.text: Pemilik hotel menyerahkan urusan restoran kepada menantu laki-lakinya.
w|menantu.en: The hotel owner handed the restaurant business over to his son-in-law.
w|menantu.ko: 호텔 주인은 식당 운영을 사위에게 맡겼어요.

w|menanyai.text: Petugas dinas kesehatan menanyai Fajar soal kebersihan dapurnya.
w|menanyai.en: The health office inspector questioned Fajar about the cleanliness of his kitchen.
w|menanyai.ko: 보건소 직원이 파자르에게 주방 위생에 대해 이것저것 물었어요.

w|menanyai.text: Setelah menang, wartawan menanyai Lestari tentang rahasia latihannya.
w|menanyai.en: After she won, reporters asked Lestari about the secret of her training.
w|menanyai.ko: 우승한 뒤 기자들이 레스타리에게 훈련 비결을 물었어요.

w|menanyakan.en: He asked for directions to the station.

w|menara.en: That tower can be seen from afar.
We climbed to the top of the tower.

w|menargetkan.text: Bulan ini Bayu menargetkan bisa lari lima kilometer tanpa berhenti.
w|menargetkan.en: This month Bayu aims to be able to run five kilometers without stopping.
w|menargetkan.ko: 이번 달 바유는 쉬지 않고 오 킬로미터 달리기를 목표로 해요.

w|menargetkan.text: Restoran keluarga itu menargetkan pelanggan yang datang bersama anak kecil.
w|menargetkan.en: The family restaurant targets customers who come with small children.
w|menargetkan.ko: 그 패밀리 레스토랑은 어린아이를 데리고 오는 손님을 겨냥해요.

w|menaruh.en: Put the keys on the table.

w|menata.text: Eko menata batu-batu di sekeliling tempat api supaya aman.
w|menata.en: Eko arranged stones around the fire spot to keep it safe.
w|menata.ko: 에코는 안전하도록 불 피울 자리 둘레에 돌을 놓았어요.

w|menata.text: Ayu menata perlengkapan lari di atas kasur malam sebelum lomba.
w|menata.en: Ayu laid out her running gear on the bed the night before the race.
w|menata.ko: 아유는 대회 전날 밤 침대 위에 달리기 장비를 가지런히 놓았어요.

w|menatap.en: She stared at me without blinking.
w|menatap.ko: 그녀는 눈도 깜빡이지 않고 나를 응시했어.

w|menatap.en: Gazing at the sky calms me.

w|menawan.text: Polwan di meja depan punya senyum menawan yang membuat Andi lebih tenang.
w|menawan.en: The policewoman at the front desk had a charming smile that made Andi calmer.
w|menawan.ko: 안내 데스크 여경의 매력적인 미소 덕분에 안디는 마음이 놓였어요.

w|menawan.text: Gerakan menipu Dewi di bawah ring sungguh menawan.
w|menawan.en: Dewi's feint under the basket is truly captivating.
w|menawan.ko: 골 밑에서 데위가 하는 페인트 동작은 정말 멋져요.

w|menawar.text: Di aplikasi itu Fajar tidak bisa menawar seperti di pasar.
w|menawar.en: In that app Fajar can't haggle like he can at the market.
w|menawar.ko: 그 앱에서는 파자르가 시장에서처럼 값을 깎을 수 없어요.

w|menawar.text: Sebelum kelas, Lestari menawar harga cabai di pasar dekat sekolah masak.
w|menawar.en: Before class, Lestari haggled over the price of chilies at the market near the cooking school.
w|menawar.ko: 수업 전에 레스타리는 요리 학교 근처 시장에서 고추 값을 흥정했어요.

w|menawari.text: Pelayan berkeliling menawari tamu es buah dan kue lapis.
w|menawari.en: The waiters went around offering guests fruit ice and layer cake.
w|menawari.ko: 직원들이 돌아다니며 하객들에게 과일 빙수와 층층 떡을 권했어요.

w|menawari.text: Tetangga Lestari menawari dia bibit cabai untuk ditanam di awal musim hujan.
w|menawari.en: Lestari's neighbor offered her chili seedlings to plant at the start of the rainy season.
w|menawari.ko: 레스타리의 이웃이 우기 초에 심으라고 고추 모종을 권했어요.

w|menayangkan.text: Stasiun televisi lokal menayangkan liputan tentang Eko yang menyelamatkan seorang turis.
w|menayangkan.en: A local TV station aired a report about Eko rescuing a tourist.
w|menayangkan.ko: 지역 방송국이 관광객을 구한 에코에 대한 보도를 내보냈어요.

w|menayangkan.text: Televisi di ruang tunggu menayangkan film dokumenter tentang burung yang bermigrasi, dan Ayu menontonnya sambil menunggu.
w|menayangkan.en: The TV in the waiting room was showing a documentary about migrating birds, and Ayu watched it while waiting.
w|menayangkan.ko: 대기실 텔레비전에서 철새 다큐멘터리가 나오고 있어서 아유는 기다리며 봤어요.

w|mencabut.text: Petugas mencabut kartu anggota Dimas sementara karena denda belum dibayar.
w|mencabut.en: The staff temporarily revoked Dimas's membership card because the fine hadn't been paid.
w|mencabut.ko: 연체료를 안 내서 직원이 디마스의 회원증을 잠시 정지시켰어요.

w|mencabut.text: Putri mencabut pengisi daya dari stopkontak sebelum turun.
w|mencabut.en: Putri unplugged the charger from the socket before getting off.
w|mencabut.ko: 푸트리는 내리기 전에 콘센트에서 충전기를 뽑았어요.

w|mencair.text: Es krim Eko cepat mencair di bawah matahari siang.
w|mencair.en: Eko's ice cream melted quickly under the midday sun.
w|mencair.ko: 에코의 아이스크림은 한낮의 햇볕에 금방 녹았어요.

w|mencair.text: Mentega yang dibawa Ayu sudah mencair sebelum sampai di rumah tetangga.
w|mencair.en: The butter Ayu brought had melted before she reached the neighbor's house.
w|mencair.ko: 아유가 가져간 버터는 이웃집에 닿기도 전에 녹아 버렸어요.

w|mencakup.text: Paket perlengkapan sewaan Eko mencakup tenda, matras, dan lampu senter.
w|mencakup.en: Eko's rented gear package includes a tent, a mat, and a flashlight.
w|mencakup.ko: 에코가 빌린 장비 세트에는 텐트, 매트, 손전등이 들어 있어요.

w|mencakup.text: Biaya pendaftaran Ayu sudah mencakup kaus, medali, dan asuransi.
w|mencakup.en: Ayu's registration fee already includes a shirt, a medal, and insurance.
w|mencakup.ko: 아유의 참가비에는 티셔츠, 메달, 보험이 이미 포함돼 있어요.

w|mencalonkan.text: Menurut sumber Bayu, partai itu akan mencalonkan seorang guru sebagai wali kota.
w|mencalonkan.en: According to Bayu's source, the party will nominate a teacher for mayor.
w|mencalonkan.ko: 바유의 취재원에 따르면 그 정당은 교사 한 명을 시장 후보로 내세울 거래요.

w|mencalonkan.text: Toko daring tempat Intan berbelanja mencalonkan diri untuk penghargaan layanan terbaik.
w|mencalonkan.en: The online shop where Intan buys things put itself forward for a best-service award.
w|mencalonkan.ko: 인탄이 쇼핑하는 온라인 가게가 최우수 서비스 상 후보로 나섰어요.

w|mencambuk.text: Di pelajaran sejarah, Dimas membaca bahwa dulu tuan tanah biasa mencambuk pekerjanya.
w|mencambuk.en: In history class, Dimas read that landowners used to whip their workers.
w|mencambuk.ko: 역사 시간에 디마스는 옛날 지주들이 일꾼을 채찍질하곤 했다는 걸 읽었어요.

w|mencambuk.text: Ayah Putri bercerita bahwa kusir dulu mencambuk kudanya terlalu keras.
w|mencambuk.en: Putri's father told how coachmen used to whip their horses too hard.
w|mencambuk.ko: 푸트리의 아빠는 옛날 마부들이 말을 너무 세게 채찍질했다고 이야기했어요.

w|mencampakkan.text: Bayu kesal karena ada penghuni yang mencampakkan sampah di tangga darurat.
w|mencampakkan.en: Bayu was annoyed because a resident dumped trash in the emergency stairwell.
w|mencampakkan.ko: 바유는 누군가 비상계단에 쓰레기를 버려서 화가 났어요.

w|mencampakkan.text: Penumpang di sebelah Intan bercerita bahwa pacarnya mencampakkan dia lewat pesan singkat.
w|mencampakkan.en: The passenger next to Intan said her boyfriend dumped her by text message.
w|mencampakkan.ko: 인탄 옆자리 승객은 남자친구가 문자로 자기를 차 버렸다고 이야기했어요.

w|mencampur.en: Mom is mixing the cake batter.
Don't mix two medicines at once.
w|mencampur.ko: 약 두 가지를 한꺼번에 섞지 마.

w|mencampuri.text: Mandor meminta pemilik rumah tidak mencampuri urusan teknis para tukang.
w|mencampuri.en: The foreman asked the homeowner not to interfere in the workers' technical matters.
w|mencampuri.ko: 현장 반장은 집주인에게 인부들의 기술적인 일에 끼어들지 말라고 부탁했어요.

w|mencampuri.text: Wati tidak suka kalau keluarganya mencampuri pilihan belanjanya.
w|mencampuri.en: Wati doesn't like it when her family interferes with her shopping choices.
w|mencampuri.ko: 와티는 가족이 자기 쇼핑에 참견하는 걸 싫어해요.

w|mencari-cari.text: Dimas mencari-cari ruang keramik, tetapi malah masuk ke ruang lukisan.
w|mencari-cari.en: Dimas searched all over for the ceramics room but ended up in the painting room.
w|mencari-cari.ko: 디마스는 도자기 전시실을 한참 찾다가 엉뚱하게 회화 전시실로 들어갔어요.

w|mencari-cari.text: Putri mencari-cari naskahnya yang terselip di antara tumpukan kostum.
w|mencari-cari.en: Putri hunted for her script, which had slipped in among the pile of costumes.
w|mencari-cari.ko: 푸트리는 의상 더미 사이에 끼어 버린 대본을 이리저리 찾았어요.

w|mencarikan.text: Pustakawan sekolah membantu mencarikan buku sejarah untuk Eko.
w|mencarikan.en: The school librarian helped find a history book for Eko.
w|mencarikan.ko: 학교 사서가 에코에게 역사책을 찾아 줬어요.

w|mencarikan.text: Ayah Ayu mencarikan kaset lama yang mau didengar nenek.
w|mencarikan.en: Ayu's father looked for the old cassette that grandma wanted to hear.
w|mencarikan.ko: 아유의 아버지는 할머니가 듣고 싶어 하시는 옛날 카세트를 찾아 드렸어요.

w|mencatat.text: Sekretaris kelas mencatat nama siswa yang tidak membawa buku.
w|mencatat.en: The class secretary wrote down the names of students who didn't bring their books.
w|mencatat.ko: 반 서기가 책을 안 가져온 학생들의 이름을 적었어요.

w|mencatat.text: Perawat Dewi mencatat suhu tubuh pasien di lembar observasi.
w|mencatat.en: Nurse Dewi recorded the patient's body temperature on the observation sheet.
w|mencatat.ko: 간호사 데위는 환자의 체온을 관찰 기록지에 적었어요.

w|mencegah.ko: 손 씻기는 병을 막을 수 있어.

w|mencegat.text: Seorang pedagang mencegat Bayu di pintu masuk dan menawarkan jam tangan palsu.
w|mencegat.en: A trader stopped Bayu at the entrance and offered him a fake watch.
w|mencegat.ko: 한 상인이 입구에서 바유를 가로막고 가짜 시계를 권했어요.

w|mencegat.text: Dalam tradisi keluarga Intan, adik-adik mencegat rombongan pengantin pria di depan pintu dan meminta uang tebusan.
w|mencegat.en: In Intan's family tradition, the younger siblings block the groom's party at the door and ask for a ransom.
w|mencegat.ko: 인탄네 집안 전통에서는 동생들이 문 앞에서 신랑 일행을 가로막고 몸값을 요구해요.

w|mencekik.text: Andi dan Rina membaca berita tentang pencuri yang mencekik penjaga toko, lalu tertangkap polisi.
w|mencekik.en: Andi and Rina read a news story about a thief who choked a shopkeeper and was then caught by the police.
w|mencekik.ko: 안디와 리나는 가게 주인의 목을 조른 도둑이 경찰에 잡혔다는 기사를 읽었어요.

w|mencekik.text: Dewi memperingatkan tamu bahwa dasi yang terlalu ketat bisa terasa mencekik.
w|mencekik.en: Dewi warned a guest that a tie that's too tight can feel choking.
w|mencekik.ko: 데위는 손님에게 넥타이를 너무 꽉 매면 숨이 막힐 수 있다고 일러 줬어요.

w|mencela.text: Eko tidak pernah mencela tamu dari kota yang kelelahan mendaki.
w|mencela.en: Eko never mocks visitors from the city who get worn out on the climb.
w|mencela.ko: 에코는 산을 오르다 지친 도시 손님들을 한 번도 흉본 적이 없어요.

w|mencela.text: Mandor itu suka mencela hasil kerja orang lain tanpa memberi solusi.
w|mencela.en: That foreman likes to criticize other people's work without offering solutions.
w|mencela.ko: 그 반장은 해결책도 없이 남의 작업을 깎아내리길 좋아해요.

w|mencelupkan.text: Budi rindu mencelupkan pisang goreng ke kopi bersama Rudi di warung.
w|mencelupkan.en: Budi misses dipping fried bananas into coffee with Rudi at the food stall.
w|mencelupkan.ko: 부디는 루디와 노점에서 바나나 튀김을 커피에 찍어 먹던 때가 그리워요.

w|mencelupkan.text: Siti mencelupkan kain ke pewarna batik bersama tetangga.
w|mencelupkan.en: Siti dipped cloth into batik dye together with the neighbors.
w|mencelupkan.ko: 시티는 이웃들과 함께 천을 바틱 염료에 담갔어요.

w|mencemaskan.text: Kesehatan ibunya yang menurun sangat mencemaskan Rudi akhir-akhir ini.
w|mencemaskan.en: His mother's declining health has been worrying Rudi a lot lately.
w|mencemaskan.ko: 요즘 어머니의 건강이 나빠져서 루디는 무척 걱정돼요.

w|mencemaskan.text: Lonjakan pengguna yang mendadak sempat mencemaskan tim server.
w|mencemaskan.en: The sudden surge of users worried the server team for a while.
w|mencemaskan.ko: 갑자기 늘어난 사용자 때문에 서버팀이 한동안 걱정했어요.

w|mencemooh.text: Dulu teman-teman mencemooh Eko yang ingin jadi koki.
w|mencemooh.en: His friends used to scoff at Eko for wanting to become a chef.
w|mencemooh.ko: 예전에 친구들은 요리사가 되고 싶다는 에코를 비웃었어요.

w|mencemooh.text: Adik Ayu mencemooh payung besar yang Ayu bawa di hari cerah.
w|mencemooh.en: Ayu's younger sibling mocked the big umbrella Ayu carried on a sunny day.
w|mencemooh.ko: 아유의 동생은 맑은 날 큰 우산을 들고 나간 아유를 비웃었어요.

w|menceraikan.text: Dalam film yang ditonton Rudi, seorang suami menceraikan istrinya demi warisan seekor kuda pacu.
w|menceraikan.en: In the film Rudi watched, a husband divorces his wife over the inheritance of a racehorse.
w|menceraikan.ko: 루디가 본 영화에서 한 남편은 경주마 유산 때문에 아내와 이혼해요.

w|menceraikan.text: Dalam cerita rakyat yang diceritakan nenek Rina, seorang raja menceraikan permaisurinya karena fitnah.
w|menceraikan.en: In the folk tale Rina's grandmother tells, a king divorces his queen because of slander.
w|menceraikan.ko: 리나의 할머니가 들려주는 민담에서 한 왕은 모함 때문에 왕비와 이혼해요.

w|mencerminkan.text: Menurut Bayu, isi surat pembaca mencerminkan keresahan warga kota.
w|mencerminkan.en: According to Bayu, the letters to the editor reflect the unease of the city's residents.
w|mencerminkan.ko: 바유는 독자 투고가 시민들의 불안을 보여 준다고 생각해요.

w|mencerminkan.text: Danau di kaki gunung mencerminkan langit biru di atas desa Intan.
w|mencerminkan.en: The lake at the foot of the mountain reflects the blue sky above Intan's village.
w|mencerminkan.ko: 산기슭의 호수가 인탄네 마을 위 푸른 하늘을 비춰요.

w|mencerna.text: Andi butuh waktu untuk mencerna kabar bahwa tetangga terbaiknya akan pindah.
w|mencerna.en: Andi needed time to take in the news that his best neighbor was moving away.
w|mencerna.ko: 안디는 가장 친한 이웃이 이사 간다는 소식을 받아들이는 데 시간이 걸렸어요.

w|mencerna.text: Murid-murid butuh waktu untuk mencerna teori harmoni yang Dewi ajarkan.
w|mencerna.en: The students need time to digest the harmony theory Dewi teaches.
w|mencerna.ko: 학생들은 데위가 가르치는 화성학을 소화하는 데 시간이 걸려요.

w|mencetak.text: Mesin itu bisa mencetak dokumen berwarna.
w|mencetak.en: That machine can print color documents.
w|mencetak.ko: 그 기계는 컬러 문서를 인쇄할 수 있어.

w|mencetak.text: Dia berhasil mencetak gol di babak akhir.
w|mencetak.en: He managed to score a goal in the final period.
w|mencetak.ko: 그는 마지막 시간에 골을 넣는 데 성공했어.

w|mencicipi.text: Ibu di lantai tujuh meminta Bayu mencicipi kue lapis buatannya.
w|mencicipi.en: The woman on the seventh floor asked Bayu to taste the layer cake she made.
w|mencicipi.ko: 칠 층 아주머니가 바유에게 직접 만든 레이어 케이크를 맛보라고 했어요.

w|mencicipi.text: Intan turun sebentar di Cirebon untuk mencicipi empal gentong.
w|mencicipi.en: Intan got off briefly in Cirebon to taste empal gentong.
w|mencicipi.ko: 인탄은 치르본에서 잠깐 내려 엠팔 근통을 맛봤어요.

w|mencipta.text: Budi senang mencipta alat-alat sederhana dari bahan bekas.
w|mencipta.en: Budi enjoys creating simple tools from scrap materials.
w|mencipta.ko: 부디는 버려진 재료로 간단한 도구를 만들어 내는 걸 좋아해요.

w|mencipta.text: Siti suka mencipta resep baru dari bahan sisa.
w|mencipta.en: Siti likes creating new recipes from leftover ingredients.
w|mencipta.ko: 시티는 남은 재료로 새 조리법을 만들어 내는 걸 좋아해요.

w|mencium.en: He doesn't want to kiss the hand.

w|mencocokkan.text: Eko mencocokkan nama di daftar dengan wajah peserta lomba renang.
w|mencocokkan.en: Eko matched the names on the list with the faces of the swimming race participants.
w|mencocokkan.ko: 에코는 명단의 이름을 수영 대회 참가자들의 얼굴과 맞춰 봤어요.

w|mencocokkan.text: Petugas pendaftaran mencocokkan data kartu asuransi Ayu dengan KTP-nya.
w|mencocokkan.en: The receptionist matched the details on Ayu's insurance card with her ID card.
w|mencocokkan.ko: 접수 직원이 아유의 보험 카드 정보를 신분증과 대조했어요.

w|mencolok.text: Para pekerja memakai rompi oranye yang mencolok agar mudah terlihat.
w|mencolok.en: The workers wear bright orange vests so they are easy to see.
w|mencolok.ko: 노동자들은 눈에 잘 띄도록 화려한 주황색 조끼를 입어요.

w|mencolok.text: Putri memakai tinta ungu yang mencolok supaya Sari langsung tahu surat itu darinya.
w|mencolok.en: Putri uses striking purple ink so Sari knows right away the letter is from her.
w|mencolok.ko: 푸트리는 사리가 바로 알아보도록 눈에 띄는 보라색 잉크를 써요.

w|mencopot.text: Dimas mencopot label harga yang masih menempel di kursi barunya.
w|mencopot.en: Dimas peeled off the price tag still stuck to his new chair.
w|mencopot.ko: 디마스는 새 의자에 아직 붙어 있던 가격표를 떼어 냈어요.

w|mencopot.text: Di pemeriksaan keamanan, Putri harus mencopot ikat pinggang dan jam tangannya.
w|mencopot.en: At the security check, Putri had to take off her belt and watch.
w|mencopot.ko: 보안 검색대에서 푸트리는 벨트와 손목시계를 풀어야 했어요.

w|mencoret.text: Agus mencoret nama warga yang sudah membayar iuran air.
w|mencoret.en: Agus crossed out the names of residents who had paid the water fee.
w|mencoret.ko: 아구스는 물값을 낸 주민의 이름을 줄을 그어 지웠어요.

w|mencoret.text: Wati mencoret beberapa kalimat sebelum menyalin surat itu dengan rapi.
w|mencoret.en: Wati crossed out a few sentences before copying the letter out neatly.
w|mencoret.ko: 와티는 편지를 깨끗이 옮겨 쓰기 전에 몇 문장을 지웠어요.

w|mencuci.text: Dia sedang mencuci piring di dapur.
w|mencuci.en: She is washing dishes in the kitchen.

w|mencuci.text: Aku mencuci baju setiap akhir pekan.

w|mencukur.text: Sebelum musim panas tiba, Budi mencukur bulu domba-dombanya.
w|mencukur.en: Before the hot season arrives, Budi shears his sheep.
w|mencukur.ko: 더운 철이 오기 전에 부디는 양털을 깎아요.

w|mencukur.text: Untuk peran tentara, lawan main Siti harus mencukur rambutnya sampai pendek sekali.
w|mencukur.en: For the role of a soldier, Siti's co-star had to shave his hair very short.
w|mencukur.ko: 군인 역할 때문에 시티의 상대 배우는 머리를 아주 짧게 밀어야 했어요.

w|menculik.text: Mereka mencoba menculik tokoh penting itu.
w|menculik.en: They tried to kidnap that important figure.
w|menculik.ko: 그들은 그 중요 인물을 납치하려 했어.

w|menculik.en: Kidnapping people is a serious crime.

w|mencumbu.text: Dalam adegan romantis itu, sang pangeran mencumbu putri dengan puisi dan bunga mawar.
w|mencumbu.en: In that romantic scene, the prince wooed the princess with poems and roses.
w|mencumbu.ko: 그 낭만적인 장면에서 왕자는 시와 장미로 공주에게 사랑을 속삭였어요.

w|mencumbu.text: Di gerbong sebelah, seorang pemuda mencumbu kekasihnya dengan rayuan sampai penumpang lain tersenyum.
w|mencumbu.en: In the next carriage, a young man sweet-talked his girlfriend until the other passengers smiled.
w|mencumbu.ko: 옆 칸에서 한 청년이 여자 친구에게 달콤한 말을 속삭여서 다른 승객들이 웃었어요.

w|mencurahkan.text: Agus mencurahkan seluruh tenaga untuk memperbaiki jalan setapak desa.
w|mencurahkan.en: Agus poured all his energy into repairing the village footpath.
w|mencurahkan.ko: 아구스는 마을 오솔길을 고치는 데 온 힘을 쏟았어요.

w|mencurahkan.text: Wati mencurahkan isi hati dalam surat panjang untuk sahabat lama.
w|mencurahkan.en: Wati poured out her heart in a long letter to her old friend.
w|mencurahkan.ko: 와티는 옛 친구에게 쓰는 긴 편지에 속마음을 다 털어놓았어요.

w|mencurangi.text: Laporan Bayu membongkar cara pedagang itu mencurangi timbangan di pasar.
w|mencurangi.en: Bayu's report exposed how the trader rigged the scales at the market.
w|mencurangi.ko: 바유의 기사는 그 상인이 시장에서 저울을 속이던 방법을 밝혀냈어요.

w|mencurangi.text: Penjual nakal itu mencurangi pembeli dengan mengirim barang bekas.
w|mencurangi.en: The dishonest seller cheated buyers by sending used goods.
w|mencurangi.ko: 그 못된 판매자는 중고 물건을 보내 구매자들을 속였어요.

w|mencurigai.text: Fajar mulai mencurigai ada tikus di gudang tepung.
w|mencurigai.en: Fajar began to suspect there were mice in the flour storeroom.
w|mencurigai.ko: 파자르는 밀가루 창고에 쥐가 있는 것 같다고 의심하기 시작했어요.

w|mencurigai.text: Panitia mencurigai ada peserta yang naik ojek di tengah rute.
w|mencurigai.en: The organizers suspected a participant took a motorbike taxi in the middle of the route.
w|mencurigai.ko: 주최 측은 한 참가자가 코스 중간에 오토바이 택시를 탔다고 의심했어요.

w|mencurigakan.text: Paketan itu terlihat mencurigakan di sudut.
w|mencurigakan.en: That package looked suspicious in the corner.
His behavior has been suspicious since last night.

w|mendadak.text: Mendadak hujan turun deras di luar.
Dia pergi mendadak tanpa bilang apa-apa.
w|mendadak.en: He left suddenly without saying anything.
w|mendadak.ko: 그는 아무 말도 없이 갑자기 떠났어.

w|mendaftar.text: Pada hari pertama sekolah, Budi mendaftar klub robotik.
w|mendaftar.en: On the first day of school, Budi signed up for the robotics club.
w|mendaftar.ko: 개학 첫날 부디는 로봇 동아리에 가입 신청을 했어요.

w|mendaftar.text: Setelah pindah, Siti harus mendaftar ke ketua RT sebagai warga baru.
w|mendaftar.en: After moving, Siti had to register with the neighborhood head as a new resident.
w|mendaftar.ko: 이사한 뒤 시티는 새 주민으로 동네 반장에게 등록해야 했어요.

w|mendaftarkan.text: Agus mendaftarkan diri sebagai relawan penanaman bakau di muara.
w|mendaftarkan.en: Agus signed himself up as a volunteer for mangrove planting at the estuary.
w|mendaftarkan.ko: 아구스는 강어귀 맹그로브 심기 자원봉사자로 신청했어요.

w|mendaftarkan.text: Wati mendaftarkan apoteknya ke program obat murah pemerintah.
w|mendaftarkan.en: Wati registered her pharmacy in the government's affordable medicine program.
w|mendaftarkan.ko: 와티는 약국을 정부 저가 약 사업에 등록했어요.

w|mendahului.text: Kereta cepat itu mendahului kereta Dimas di jalur sebelah.
w|mendahului.en: The express train overtook Dimas's train on the next track.
w|mendahului.ko: 고속 열차가 옆 선로에서 디마스의 기차를 앞질렀어요.

w|mendahului.text: Aplikasi pesaing berhasil mendahului tim Putri meluncurkan fitur yang sama.
w|mendahului.en: A rival app managed to beat Putri's team to launching the same feature.
w|mendahului.ko: 경쟁 앱이 같은 기능을 푸트리 팀보다 먼저 출시했어요.

w|mendaki.text: Di musim kemarau, Dimas harus mendaki bukit untuk mengambil air dari mata air.
w|mendaki.en: In the dry season, Dimas has to climb the hill to fetch water from the spring.
w|mendaki.ko: 건기에는 디마스가 샘물을 길으러 언덕을 올라가야 해요.

w|mendaki.text: Rekan kerja Putri baru pulang dari liburan mendaki gunung.
w|mendaki.en: Putri's coworker just got back from a mountain-climbing holiday.
w|mendaki.ko: 푸트리의 동료는 등산 휴가에서 막 돌아왔어요.

w|mendakwa.text: Dalam simulasi sidang, Budi berperan sebagai jaksa yang mendakwa seorang pencuri.
w|mendakwa.en: In the mock trial, Budi played a prosecutor charging a thief.
w|mendakwa.ko: 모의재판에서 부디는 도둑을 기소하는 검사 역할을 맡았어요.

w|mendakwa.text: Di ruang tunggu, Siti menonton berita jaksa yang mendakwa pemilik agen perjalanan palsu.
w|mendakwa.en: In the waiting lounge, Siti watched news of a prosecutor charging the owner of a fake travel agency.
w|mendakwa.ko: 대기실에서 시티는 가짜 여행사 사장을 기소한 검사에 관한 뉴스를 봤어요.

w|mendalam.text: Penyidik melakukan pemeriksaan mendalam terhadap saksi kecelakaan.
w|mendalam.en: The investigator carried out an in-depth questioning of the accident witness.
w|mendalam.ko: 수사관이 사고 목격자를 깊이 있게 조사했어요.

w|mendalam.text: Pelatih memberi analisis mendalam setelah tim kalah tipis semalam.
w|mendalam.en: The coach gave an in-depth analysis after the team's narrow loss last night.
w|mendalam.ko: 어젯밤 아깝게 진 뒤 코치가 자세한 분석을 해 줬어요.

w|mendambakan.text: Bayu sudah lama mendambakan rumah kecil di tepi sungai.
w|mendambakan.en: Bayu has long dreamed of a small house on the riverbank.
w|mendambakan.ko: 바유는 오래전부터 강가의 작은 집을 꿈꿔 왔어요.

w|mendambakan.text: Sejak remaja, Intan mendambakan medali finis maraton pertamanya.
w|mendambakan.en: Since she was a teenager, Intan has longed for her first marathon finisher's medal.
w|mendambakan.ko: 인탄은 십 대 때부터 첫 마라톤 완주 메달을 간절히 바랐어요.

w|mendampingi.text: Seorang pemandu lokal mendampingi Rudi selama pendakian ke puncak.
w|mendampingi.en: A local guide accompanied Rudi throughout the climb to the summit.
w|mendampingi.ko: 현지 가이드 한 명이 정상까지 오르는 내내 루디와 함께했어요.

w|mendampingi.text: Ibu Rina ikut mendampingi adik Rina yang masih SMP.
w|mendampingi.en: Rina's mother came along to accompany Rina's younger sibling, who is still in middle school.
w|mendampingi.ko: 리나의 엄마는 아직 중학생인 리나 동생을 데리고 함께 왔어요.

w|mendanai.text: Pemerintah daerah mendanai pembangunan jembatan yang sedang dikerjakan Agus.
w|mendanai.en: The local government is funding the bridge Agus is working on.
w|mendanai.ko: 아구스가 짓고 있는 다리는 지방 정부가 자금을 대요.

w|mendanai.text: Usaha kue Wati didanai dari tabungannya sendiri, jadi ia membeli bahan secara daring dengan hemat.
w|mendanai.en: Wati's cake business is funded from her own savings, so she buys ingredients online frugally.
w|mendanai.ko: 와티의 케이크 사업은 자기 저축으로 꾸려서 재료를 온라인으로 알뜰하게 사요.

w|mendapati.text: Pagi itu Agus mendapati pintu kelasnya masih terkunci.
w|mendapati.en: That morning Agus found his classroom door still locked.
w|mendapati.ko: 그날 아침 아구스는 교실 문이 아직 잠겨 있는 걸 알게 됐어요.

w|mendapati.text: Wati mendapati loker nomor favoritnya sudah dipakai orang lain.
w|mendapati.en: Wati found that her favorite locker was already taken by someone else.
w|mendapati.ko: 와티는 자기가 좋아하는 번호의 사물함을 이미 다른 사람이 쓰고 있다는 걸 알았어요.

w|mendarat.text: Helikopter itu mendarat di lapangan terbuka.
w|mendarat.en: That helicopter landed in the open field.

w|mendaratkan.text: Lestari menulis bahwa suaminya kini bekerja sebagai pilot dan baru belajar mendaratkan pesawat besar.
w|mendaratkan.en: Lestari wrote that her husband now works as a pilot and is just learning to land large planes.
w|mendaratkan.ko: 레스타리는 남편이 이제 조종사로 일하며 큰 비행기를 착륙시키는 법을 배우고 있다고 썼어요.

w|mendaratkan.text: Bayu menulis berita tentang pilot yang berhasil mendaratkan pesawat di tengah badai.
w|mendaratkan.en: Bayu wrote a story about a pilot who managed to land a plane in the middle of a storm.
w|mendaratkan.ko: 바유는 폭풍 속에서 비행기를 무사히 착륙시킨 조종사에 대한 기사를 썼어요.

w|mendasar.text: Andi dan Pak RT punya perbedaan pendapat yang mendasar soal parkir di gang.
w|mendasar.en: Andi and the neighborhood head have a fundamental disagreement about parking in the alley.
w|mendasar.ko: 안디와 반장님은 골목 주차 문제에 대해 근본적으로 생각이 달라요.

w|mendasar.text: Dewi mengajarkan teknik mendasar seperti posisi jari dan cara bernapas.
w|mendasar.en: Dewi teaches basic techniques like finger position and breathing.
w|mendasar.ko: 데위는 손가락 위치와 호흡법 같은 기본기를 가르쳐요.

w|mendatang.text: Badan cuaca memperkirakan musim hujan akan datang dalam minggu-minggu mendatang.
w|mendatang.en: The weather agency predicts the rainy season will arrive in the coming weeks.
w|mendatang.ko: 기상청은 앞으로 몇 주 안에 우기가 올 거라고 내다봤어요.

w|mendatang.text: Putri berencana mengganti semua jendela tahun mendatang.
w|mendatang.en: Putri plans to replace all the windows next year.
w|mendatang.ko: 푸트리는 내년에 창문을 전부 갈 계획이에요.

w|mendatangi.text: Mereka mendatangi kantor untuk meminta bantuan.
w|mendatangi.en: They went to the office to ask for help.

w|mendatangi.text: Polisi akan mendatangi lokasi kejadian nanti.
w|mendatangi.en: The police will go to the scene later.

w|mendatangkan.text: Api unggun yang terlalu besar bisa mendatangkan masalah kalau angin bertiup kencang.
w|mendatangkan.en: A campfire that is too big can bring trouble if the wind blows hard.
w|mendatangkan.ko: 모닥불이 너무 크면 바람이 세게 불 때 문제가 생길 수 있어요.

w|mendatangkan.text: Panitia konser mendatangkan band tamu dari luar kota.
w|mendatangkan.en: The concert organizers brought in a guest band from out of town.
w|mendatangkan.ko: 공연 주최 측은 다른 도시에서 게스트 밴드를 불러왔어요.

w|mendaur ulang.text: Agus mengajari anak-anak desa cara mendaur ulang botol plastik.
w|mendaur ulang.en: Agus taught the village children how to recycle plastic bottles.
w|mendaur ulang.ko: 아구스는 마을 아이들에게 플라스틱 병을 재활용하는 법을 가르쳤어요.

w|mendaur ulang.text: Wati menulis di atas kertas yang dia buat dengan mendaur ulang koran bekas.
w|mendaur ulang.en: Wati wrote on paper she made by recycling old newspapers.
w|mendaur ulang.ko: 와티는 헌 신문을 재활용해 직접 만든 종이에 편지를 썼어요.

w|mendayung.text: Budi teringat liburan ketika mereka mendayung perahu berdua di danau.
w|mendayung.en: Budi remembered the holiday when the two of them rowed a boat on the lake.
w|mendayung.ko: 부디는 둘이 호수에서 배를 저었던 휴가가 떠올랐어요.

w|mendayung.text: Di dekat rumah baru ada danau, dan Siti ingin belajar mendayung di sana.
w|mendayung.en: There's a lake near the new house, and Siti wants to learn to row there.
w|mendayung.ko: 새집 근처에 호수가 있어서 시티는 거기서 노 젓기를 배우고 싶어 해요.

w|mendefinisikan.text: Guru meminta Budi mendefinisikan kata "demokrasi" dengan bahasanya sendiri.
w|mendefinisikan.en: The teacher asked Budi to define the word "democracy" in his own words.
w|mendefinisikan.ko: 선생님은 버디에게 "민주주의"라는 말을 자기 말로 정의해 보라고 했어요.

w|mendefinisikan.text: Siti sulit mendefinisikan bau tanah basah, tapi ia selalu merindukannya.
w|mendefinisikan.en: Siti finds it hard to define the smell of wet earth, but she always misses it.
w|mendefinisikan.ko: 시티는 젖은 흙냄새를 말로 정의하긴 어렵지만 늘 그리워해요.

w|mendekat.en: Just come closer if you're scared.

w|mendekatkan.text: Budi mendekatkan ember air ke anak sapi yang kehausan.
w|mendekatkan.en: Budi moved the bucket of water closer to the thirsty calf.
w|mendekatkan.ko: 부디는 목마른 송아지 쪽으로 물통을 가까이 놓아 줬어요.

w|mendekatkan.text: Siti mendekatkan hidung ke panci untuk mencium aroma kaldu.
w|mendekatkan.en: Siti brought her nose close to the pot to smell the broth.
w|mendekatkan.ko: 시티는 육수 냄새를 맡으려고 냄비에 코를 가까이 댔어요.

w|mendekorasi.text: Agus menghabiskan akhir pekan mendekorasi unit barunya di lantai tujuh.
w|mendekorasi.en: Agus spent the weekend decorating his new unit on the seventh floor.
w|mendekorasi.ko: 아구스는 주말 내내 칠 층의 새집을 꾸몄어요.

w|mendekorasi.text: Menjelang akhir tahun, Wati mendekorasi jendela dengan daun kering dan lampu kecil.
w|mendekorasi.en: Toward the end of the year, Wati decorates the windows with dried leaves and small lights.
w|mendekorasi.ko: 연말이 다가오면 와티는 마른 잎과 작은 전구로 창문을 꾸며요.

w|mendengkur.text: Kucing pemilik sekolah masak mendengkur di dekat jendela dapur.
w|mendengkur.en: The cooking school owner's cat purred near the kitchen window.
w|mendengkur.ko: 요리 학교 주인의 고양이가 부엌 창가에서 골골거렸어요.

w|mendengkur.text: Dewi bercerita bahwa suaminya mendengkur keras setiap malam.
w|mendengkur.en: Dewi wrote that her husband snores loudly every night.
w|mendengkur.ko: 데위는 남편이 밤마다 코를 크게 곤다고 썼어요.

w|menderita.en: He suffered for a long time.
I don't want to suffer again.

w|menderu.text: Angin gunung menderu sepanjang malam di atas atap rumah Eko.
w|menderu.en: The mountain wind roared all night over the roof of Eko's house.
w|menderu.ko: 산바람이 밤새 에코네 지붕 위에서 윙윙 몰아쳤어요.

w|menderu.text: Mesin-mesin besar menderu sejak sif pagi dimulai.
w|menderu.en: The big machines have been roaring since the morning shift began.
w|menderu.ko: 오전 근무가 시작된 뒤로 큰 기계들이 굉음을 내고 있어요.

w|mendesah.text: Pemilik kucing itu mendesah lega ketika hasil tesnya bagus.
w|mendesah.en: The cat's owner sighed with relief when the test results were good.
w|mendesah.ko: 검사 결과가 좋자 고양이 주인은 안도의 한숨을 쉬었어요.

w|mendesah.text: Putri mendesah panjang ketika percobaannya gagal untuk ketiga kali.
w|mendesah.en: Putri let out a long sigh when her experiment failed for the third time.
w|mendesah.ko: 실험이 세 번째로 실패하자 푸트리는 길게 한숨을 쉬었어요.

w|mendesain.text: Tim grafis diminta mendesain halaman depan yang lebih segar untuk edisi Minggu.
w|mendesain.en: The graphics team was asked to design a fresher front page for the Sunday edition.
w|mendesain.ko: 그래픽팀은 일요판을 위해 더 산뜻한 첫 면을 디자인해 달라는 요청을 받았어요.

w|mendesain.text: Sahabat Lestari yang suka menggambar mendesain stiker untuk mobil mereka.
w|mendesain.en: Lestari's best friend, who loves drawing, designed stickers for their car.
w|mendesain.ko: 그림 그리기를 좋아하는 레스타리의 친구가 차에 붙일 스티커를 디자인했어요.

w|mendesak.text: Masalah ini mendesak dan perlu diselesaikan.
w|mendesak.en: This problem is urgent and needs to be solved.

w|mendesak.text: Dia mendesak agar rapat dimulai segera.
w|mendesak.en: He urged that the meeting start immediately.

w|mendesis.text: Tablet vitamin itu mendesis ketika Dimas memasukkannya ke dalam air.
w|mendesis.en: The vitamin tablet fizzed when Dimas dropped it into water.
w|mendesis.ko: 디마스가 비타민 알약을 물에 넣자 쉬익 하고 거품이 일었어요.

w|mendesis.text: Pipa air mendesis saat Putri membuka keran untuk pertama kali.
w|mendesis.en: The water pipe hissed when Putri turned on the tap for the first time.
w|mendesis.ko: 푸트리가 처음 수도꼭지를 틀자 수도관이 쉭쉭 소리를 냈어요.

w|mendeteksi.text: Rudi ingat ibu Bayu bisa mendeteksi kebohongan anaknya hanya dari nada suara.
w|mendeteksi.en: Rudi remembers that Bayu's mother could detect her son's lies just from his tone of voice.
w|mendeteksi.ko: 루디는 바유의 어머니가 목소리만 듣고도 아들의 거짓말을 알아챘던 걸 기억해요.

w|mendeteksi.text: Sistem baru itu bisa mendeteksi transaksi palsu dalam hitungan detik.
w|mendeteksi.en: The new system can detect fake transactions within seconds.
w|mendeteksi.ko: 새 시스템은 가짜 거래를 몇 초 만에 잡아낼 수 있어요.

w|mendiagnosis.text: Rudi butuh hasil tes darah sebelum mendiagnosis penyakit kelinci itu.
w|mendiagnosis.en: Rudi needs the blood test results before diagnosing the rabbit's illness.
w|mendiagnosis.ko: 루디는 토끼의 병을 진단하기 전에 혈액 검사 결과가 필요해요.

w|mendiagnosis.text: Dokter dari kota datang untuk mendiagnosis penyakit kulit yang dialami anak-anak desa Rina.
w|mendiagnosis.en: A doctor from the city came to diagnose the skin disease affecting children in Rina's village.
w|mendiagnosis.ko: 도시에서 온 의사가 리나네 마을 아이들의 피부병을 진단하러 왔어요.

w|mendiang.text: Andi masih merawat pohon mangga yang ditanam mendiang Pak Harun.
w|mendiang.en: Andi still takes care of the mango tree planted by the late Pak Harun.
w|mendiang.ko: 안디는 지금도 고(故) 하룬 씨가 심은 망고나무를 돌봐요.

w|mendiang.text: Piano tua di kelas Dewi adalah peninggalan mendiang pendiri sekolah.
w|mendiang.en: The old piano in Dewi's classroom was left by the school's late founder.
w|mendiang.ko: 데위 교실의 낡은 피아노는 돌아가신 학교 설립자가 남긴 거예요.

w|mendidih.text: Andi memasukkan mi setelah air di panci mendidih.
w|mendidih.en: Andi put the noodles in after the water in the pot came to a boil.
w|mendidih.ko: 안디는 냄비 물이 끓은 뒤에 면을 넣었어요.

w|mendidih.text: Dewi menunggu air mendidih untuk teh sambil membaca ulang surat Rani.
w|mendidih.en: Dewi waited for the water to boil for tea while rereading Rani's letter.
w|mendidih.ko: 데위는 차 끓일 물이 끓기를 기다리며 라니의 편지를 다시 읽었어요.

w|mendidik.text: Andi bilang mendidik anak ternyata lebih sulit dari mengajar di kelas.
w|mendidik.en: Andi says raising a child turns out to be harder than teaching in a classroom.
w|mendidik.ko: 안디는 아이를 키우는 게 교실에서 가르치는 것보다 어렵다고 해요.

w|mendidik.text: Siti ingin mendidik murid-muridnya agar suka berolahraga sejak kecil.
w|mendidik.en: Siti wants to teach her students to love exercise from a young age.
w|mendidik.ko: 시티는 학생들이 어릴 때부터 운동을 좋아하도록 가르치고 싶어 해요.

w|mendinginkan.text: Budi membasahi handuk untuk mendinginkan tubuh anjing yang kepanasan.
w|mendinginkan.en: Budi wet a towel to cool down the overheated dog's body.
w|mendinginkan.ko: 부디는 더위 먹은 개의 몸을 식히려고 수건을 적셨어요.

w|mendinginkan.text: Angin sore yang sejuk cepat mendinginkan roti yang baru dipanggang Siti.
w|mendinginkan.en: The cool evening breeze quickly cooled the bread Siti had just baked.
w|mendinginkan.ko: 시원한 저녁 바람이 시티가 막 구운 빵을 금세 식혔어요.

w|mendirikan.text: Para siswa sepakat mendirikan klub robotik di sekolah.
w|mendirikan.en: The students agreed to set up a robotics club at school.
w|mendirikan.ko: 학생들은 학교에 로봇 동아리를 만들기로 뜻을 모았어요.

w|mendirikan.text: Yayasan itu berencana mendirikan klinik gratis di desa terpencil.
w|mendirikan.en: The foundation plans to set up a free clinic in a remote village.
w|mendirikan.ko: 그 재단은 외딴 마을에 무료 진료소를 세울 계획이에요.

w|mendiskusikan.text: Para petani mendiskusikan jadwal tanam di balai desa.
w|mendiskusikan.en: The farmers discussed the planting schedule at the village hall.
w|mendiskusikan.ko: 농부들은 마을 회관에서 모내기 일정을 의논했어요.

w|mendiskusikan.text: Siti dan sutradara mendiskusikan cara memerankan tokoh ibu yang keras.
w|mendiskusikan.en: Siti and the director discussed how to play the strict mother character.
w|mendiskusikan.ko: 시티와 감독은 엄격한 어머니 역을 어떻게 연기할지 의논했어요.

w|mendistribusikan.text: Agen koran mendistribusikan edisi pagi sebelum matahari terbit.
w|mendistribusikan.en: The newspaper agents distribute the morning edition before sunrise.
w|mendistribusikan.ko: 신문 보급소는 해 뜨기 전에 조간을 배포해요.

w|mendistribusikan.text: Dewi mendistribusikan kunci cadangan kepada setiap anggota keluarga.
w|mendistribusikan.en: Dewi handed out spare keys to every family member.
w|mendistribusikan.ko: 데위는 가족 모두에게 여분 열쇠를 나눠 줬어요.

w|mendoakan.text: Nenek menelepon dan bilang dia selalu mendoakan Budi dan Rina supaya akur.
w|mendoakan.en: Grandma called and said she always prays for Budi and Rina to get along.
w|mendoakan.ko: 할머니가 전화해서 부디와 리나가 사이좋게 지내길 늘 기도한다고 하셨어요.

w|mendoakan.text: Tetangga lama memeluk Siti dan mendoakan semoga betah di rumah baru.
w|mendoakan.en: Her old neighbor hugged Siti and wished her happiness in the new house.
w|mendoakan.ko: 예전 이웃은 시티를 안아 주며 새집에서 잘 지내길 빌어 줬어요.

w|mendobrak.text: Petugas keamanan terpaksa mendobrak pintu ruang ganti yang macet.
w|mendobrak.en: The security guard had to break down the jammed locker room door.
w|mendobrak.ko: 경비원은 고장 나서 안 열리는 탈의실 문을 부수고 열어야 했어요.

w|mendobrak.text: Pemilik restoran itu berani mendobrak tradisi dengan menyajikan rendang versi vegetarian.
w|mendobrak.en: The restaurant owner dared to break with tradition by serving a vegetarian rendang.
w|mendobrak.ko: 그 식당 주인은 채식 른당을 내놓으며 과감하게 전통을 깼어요.

w|mendokumentasikan.text: Fajar mendokumentasikan setiap obat keras yang keluar dari apotek.
w|mendokumentasikan.en: Fajar documents every prescription-only drug that leaves the pharmacy.
w|mendokumentasikan.ko: 파자르는 약국에서 나가는 전문 의약품을 하나하나 기록해요.

w|mendokumentasikan.text: Lestari meminta rekan baru mendokumentasikan setiap langkah pekerjaan.
w|mendokumentasikan.en: Lestari asked the new coworker to document every step of the work.
w|mendokumentasikan.ko: 레스타리는 새 동료에게 작업 단계를 하나하나 기록해 달라고 했어요.

w|mendominasi.text: Pohon pinus mendominasi hutan di sekitar perkemahan.
w|mendominasi.en: Pine trees dominate the forest around the campsite.
w|mendominasi.ko: 야영지 주변 숲은 소나무가 대부분을 차지해요.

w|mendominasi.text: Suara drum mendominasi lagu pembuka sampai vokalnya hampir tidak terdengar.
w|mendominasi.en: The drums dominated the opening song so much that the vocals were barely audible.
w|mendominasi.ko: 첫 곡에서 드럼 소리가 너무 커서 보컬이 거의 들리지 않았어요.

w|mendorong.text: Dia mendorong pintu yang berat itu.
Mendorong mobil mogok butuh tenaga besar.
w|mendorong.en: Pushing a stalled car takes a lot of strength.
w|mendorong.ko: 고장난 차를 밀려면 큰 힘이 필요해.

w|menduduki.text: Eko berhasil menduduki peringkat pertama di kelasnya.
w|menduduki.en: Eko managed to take first place in his class.

w|menduduki.text: Lukisan Ayu menduduki dinding utama ruang pameran sekolah.
w|menduduki.en: Ayu's painting took up the main wall of the school exhibition room.
w|menduduki.ko: 아유의 그림이 학교 전시실 중앙 벽을 차지했어요.

w|menduga.en: The police suspect there is another witness.

w|mendukung.en: Supporting her is the right choice.

w|menebak.text: Coba menebak apa yang ada di dalam kotak.
w|menebak.en: Try to guess what is inside the box.
w|menebak.ko: 상자 안에 뭐가 있는지 맞춰 봐.

w|menebak.text: Dia pintar menebak pikiran orang lain.
w|menebak.en: She is good at guessing other people's thoughts.

w|menebang.text: Bayu melarang siapa pun menebang pohon di sepanjang tepi sungai.
w|menebang.en: Bayu forbids anyone to cut down trees along the riverbank.
w|menebang.ko: 바유는 누구도 강가의 나무를 베지 못하게 해요.

w|menebang.text: Sehari sebelum lomba, petugas menebang dahan yang patah di rute yang akan dilalui Intan.
w|menebang.en: The day before the race, workers cut down broken branches on the route Intan would run.
w|menebang.ko: 경기 하루 전, 직원들이 인탄이 지나갈 코스의 부러진 가지를 잘라 냈어요.

w|menebus.text: Andi berusaha menebus nilai jeleknya dengan ikut ujian perbaikan.
w|menebus.en: Andi tried to make up for his bad grade by taking the resit.
w|menebus.ko: 안디는 재시험을 봐서 나쁜 점수를 만회하려고 했어요.

w|menebus.text: Keluarga pasien antre di apotek untuk menebus resep dokter.
w|menebus.en: The patients' families queued at the pharmacy to fill the doctor's prescriptions.
w|menebus.ko: 환자 가족들이 처방전 약을 받으려고 약국에 줄을 섰어요.

w|menegakkan.text: Dalam editorialnya, Budi meminta pemerintah menegakkan aturan soal parkir liar.
w|menegakkan.en: In his editorial, Budi asked the government to enforce the rules on illegal parking.
w|menegakkan.ko: 부디는 사설에서 정부에 불법 주차 규정을 제대로 집행하라고 요구했어요.

w|menegakkan.text: Siti berusaha menegakkan aturan tidak boleh makan di ruang baca.
w|menegakkan.en: Siti tries to enforce the no-eating rule in the reading room.
w|menegakkan.ko: 시티는 열람실 음식 금지 규칙을 지키게 하려고 애써요.

w|menegangkan.text: Budi menulis tentang wawancara kerja yang sangat menegangkan.
w|menegangkan.en: Budi wrote about a very nerve-racking job interview.
w|menegangkan.ko: 부디는 몹시 긴장됐던 취업 면접 이야기를 썼어요.

w|menegangkan.text: Rapat RT soal parkir mobil berlangsung menegangkan.
w|menegangkan.en: The neighborhood meeting about car parking was tense.
w|menegangkan.ko: 주차 문제를 다룬 반상회는 긴장감이 넘쳤어요.

w|menegaskan.text: Kepala koki menegaskan bahwa semua orang wajib memakai penutup rambut.
w|menegaskan.en: The head chef made it clear that everyone must wear a hairnet.
w|menegaskan.ko: 주방장은 모두 반드시 머리망을 써야 한다고 못 박았어요.

w|menegaskan.text: Penjual itu menegaskan bahwa vas biru di mejanya asli buatan tangan.
w|menegaskan.en: The seller insisted that the blue vase on his table is genuinely handmade.
w|menegaskan.ko: 그 상인은 자기 테이블의 파란 꽃병이 진짜 수제품이라고 강조했어요.

w|meneguk.text: Andi meneguk kopi dingin sambil mengetik berita.
w|meneguk.en: Andi gulped down cold coffee while typing up the story.
w|meneguk.ko: 안디는 기사를 치면서 식은 커피를 들이켰어요.

w|meneguk.text: Dewi meneguk air dingin setelah mengangkat kardus terakhir.
w|meneguk.en: Dewi gulped cold water after carrying the last box.
w|meneguk.ko: 데위는 마지막 상자를 옮긴 뒤 찬물을 벌컥벌컥 마셨어요.

w|menekan.text: Dia menekan tombol darurat dengan cepat.
w|menekan.en: He pressed the emergency button quickly.
Suppressing feelings only worsens the situation.

w|menekankan.text: Dalam rapat anggaran, Fajar menekankan pentingnya keterbukaan kepada warga.
w|menekankan.en: In the budget meeting, Fajar stressed the importance of openness to residents.
w|menekankan.ko: 예산 회의에서 파자르는 주민에게 투명하게 공개하는 것이 중요하다고 강조했어요.

w|menekankan.text: Rapat penghuni menekankan pentingnya memilah sampah, jadi Lestari menyiapkan dua tempat sampah.
w|menekankan.en: The residents' meeting stressed sorting trash, so Lestari set out two bins.
w|menekankan.ko: 입주자 회의에서 분리수거를 강조해서 레스타리는 쓰레기통을 두 개 놓았어요.

w|menekuk.text: Andi menekuk kertas naskah lalu menyelipkan kertas itu ke saku.
w|menekuk.en: Andi folded the script paper and slipped it into his pocket.
w|menekuk.ko: 안디는 원고 종이를 접어 주머니에 넣었어요.

w|menekuk.text: Dewi menekuk kardus bekas agar mudah dibuang.
w|menekuk.en: Dewi folded the used boxes flat so they'd be easy to throw away.
w|menekuk.ko: 데위는 버리기 쉽게 다 쓴 상자를 접었어요.

w|menelan.text: Proyek jalan layang itu menelan biaya jauh lebih besar dari rencana.
w|menelan.en: The flyover project swallowed far more money than planned.
w|menelan.ko: 그 고가도로 사업은 계획보다 훨씬 많은 돈을 잡아먹었어요.

w|menelan.text: Sebelum bernyanyi, Wati menelan sesendok madu untuk melegakan tenggorokan.
w|menelan.en: Before singing, Wati swallows a spoonful of honey to soothe her throat.
w|menelan.ko: 노래하기 전에 와티는 목을 풀려고 꿀 한 숟가락을 삼켜요.

w|menelantarkan.text: Eko sedih melihat ada orang yang menelantarkan anak kucing di dekat dermaga.
w|menelantarkan.en: Eko was sad to see that someone had abandoned a kitten near the pier.
w|menelantarkan.ko: 에코는 누군가 부두 근처에 새끼 고양이를 버린 걸 보고 슬펐어요.

w|menelantarkan.text: Dokter mengingatkan Ayu agar tidak menelantarkan gigi susu anaknya.
w|menelantarkan.en: The dentist reminded Ayu not to neglect her child's baby teeth.
w|menelantarkan.ko: 의사는 아이의 젖니를 방치하지 말라고 아유에게 일렀어요.

w|meneliti.text: Tim Bayu sedang meneliti penyebab mesin jahit sering macet.
w|meneliti.en: Bayu's team is investigating why the sewing machines keep jamming.
w|meneliti.ko: 바유의 팀은 재봉틀이 자꾸 멈추는 원인을 조사하고 있어요.

w|meneliti.text: Penumpang di sebelah Intan adalah dosen yang meneliti terumbu karang.
w|meneliti.en: The passenger next to Intan is a lecturer who researches coral reefs.
w|meneliti.ko: 인탄 옆자리 승객은 산호초를 연구하는 교수예요.

w|menelusuri.text: Untuk tugas sejarah, Eko menelusuri silsilah keluarganya sampai ke kakek buyut.
w|menelusuri.en: For a history assignment, Eko traced his family tree back to his great-grandfather.
w|menelusuri.ko: 역사 과제로 에코는 증조할아버지까지 가계도를 거슬러 올라가 봤어요.

w|menelusuri.text: Ayu menelusuri garis sketsa dengan pensil sebelum mewarnai.
w|menelusuri.en: Ayu traced the sketch lines with a pencil before coloring.
w|menelusuri.ko: 아유는 색칠하기 전에 연필로 스케치 선을 따라 그렸어요.

w|menemani.en: His mother always keeps him company when he is ill.
w|menemani.ko: 어머니가 아플 때 늘 곁에 있어 줘.

w|menemani.text: Bolehkah saya menemani Anda ke stasiun?
w|menemani.en: May I accompany you to the station?

w|menembakkan.text: Fajar menembakkan krim dari kantong segitiga ke atas kue ulang tahun.
w|menembakkan.en: Fajar piped cream from the piping bag onto the birthday cake.
w|menembakkan.ko: 파자르는 짤주머니로 생일 케이크 위에 크림을 짜 올렸어요.

w|menembakkan.text: Wali kota menembakkan pistol tanda lomba dimulai.
w|menembakkan.en: The mayor fired the pistol to signal the start of the race.
w|menembakkan.ko: 시장이 경기 시작을 알리는 총을 쐈어요.

w|menembus.en: Sunlight pierced through a gap in the curtains.

w|menembus.text: Peluru itu menembus sasaran dengan tepat.
w|menembus.en: The bullet penetrated the target precisely.

w|menempa.text: Redaktur bilang pengalaman di lapangan akan menempa Fajar jadi wartawan tangguh.
w|menempa.en: The editor said field experience would forge Fajar into a tough reporter.
w|menempa.ko: 편집장은 현장 경험이 파자르를 강한 기자로 단련시킬 거라고 했어요.
