w|menempa.text: Lestari menonton seorang pandai besi menempa parang di sebuah desa kecil.
w|menempa.en: Lestari watched a blacksmith forge a machete in a small village.
w|menempa.ko: 레스타리는 작은 마을에서 대장장이가 칼을 벼리는 모습을 구경했어요.

w|menempati.text: Tahun ini kelas Dimas menempati ruangan baru di lantai dua.
w|menempati.en: This year Dimas's class occupies a new room on the second floor.
w|menempati.ko: 올해 디마스네 반은 이 층의 새 교실을 써요.

w|menempati.text: Rombongan arisan menempati meja panjang di dekat jendela.
w|menempati.en: A social gathering group took the long table near the window.
w|menempati.ko: 계 모임 일행이 창가의 긴 테이블에 자리를 잡았어요.

w|menempatkan.en: Please put the book on the shelf.

w|menempatkan.text: Dia menempatkan anaknya di sekolah itu.
w|menempatkan.en: She enrolled her child at that school.

w|menempel.text: Jadwal tenggat berita menempel di dinding dekat meja Eko.
w|menempel.en: The news deadline schedule is stuck on the wall near Eko's desk.
w|menempel.ko: 기사 마감표가 에코 책상 옆 벽에 붙어 있어요.

w|menempel.text: Stiker harga menempel terlalu kuat di belakang casing ponsel.
w|menempel.en: The price sticker is stuck too firmly on the back of the phone case.
w|menempel.ko: 가격 스티커가 휴대폰 케이스 뒤에 너무 단단히 붙어 있어요.

w|menempelkan.text: Fajar menempelkan foto-foto masa kecil mereka di dinding pintu masuk.
w|menempelkan.en: Fajar stuck photos from their childhood on the entrance wall.
w|menempelkan.ko: 파자르는 입구 벽에 두 사람의 어린 시절 사진을 붙였어요.

w|menempelkan.text: Lestari menempelkan kalender musim tanam di dinding dapur.
w|menempelkan.en: Lestari sticks a planting-season calendar on the kitchen wall.
w|menempelkan.ko: 레스타리는 부엌 벽에 파종 달력을 붙여요.

w|menempuh.text: Setiap hari Fajar menempuh perjalanan satu jam naik motor ke restoran.
w|menempuh.en: Every day Fajar makes an hour-long motorbike trip to the restaurant.
w|menempuh.ko: 파자르는 매일 오토바이로 한 시간을 달려 식당에 가요.

w|menempuh.text: Banyak pengunjung menempuh perjalanan jauh demi pasar loak yang hanya buka hari Minggu.
w|menempuh.en: Many visitors travel a long way for the flea market that only opens on Sundays.
w|menempuh.ko: 많은 방문객이 일요일에만 여는 벼룩시장을 찾아 먼 길을 와요.

w|menemui.en: I want to see the boss first.

w|menenangkan.en: Soft music helps calm the mind.

w|menenangkan.text: Ibu berusaha menenangkan bayi yang menangis.
w|menenangkan.en: Mother tries to soothe the crying baby.

w|menendang.en: The player kicked the ball toward the goal.

w|menendang.text: Menendang pintu bukan solusi yang baik.
w|menendang.en: Kicking the door is not a good solution.
w|menendang.ko: 문을 차는 건 좋은 해결책이 아니야.

w|menengah.text: Perusahaan tempat Andi bekerja termasuk usaha menengah di kota itu.
w|menengah.en: The company where Andi works is one of the mid-sized businesses in the city.
w|menengah.ko: 안디가 일하는 회사는 그 도시의 중견 기업에 속해요.

w|menengah.text: Kebanyakan tamu hotel itu berasal dari kalangan menengah.
w|menengah.en: Most of that hotel's guests are from the middle class.

w|menenggelamkan.text: Di buku sejarah, Agus membaca tentang badai yang menenggelamkan kapal dagang besar.
w|menenggelamkan.en: In his history book, Agus read about a storm that sank a large merchant ship.
w|menenggelamkan.ko: 아구스는 역사책에서 큰 상선을 가라앉힌 폭풍에 대해 읽었어요.

w|menenggelamkan.text: Adik Wati suka menenggelamkan bebek karet lalu melepaskannya lagi.
w|menenggelamkan.en: Wati's little brother likes sinking the rubber duck and then letting it go again.
w|menenggelamkan.ko: 와티의 동생은 고무 오리를 물에 눌러 가라앉혔다가 다시 놓는 걸 좋아해요.

w|menentang.text: Mereka menentang kebijakan yang tidak adil.

w|menentang.en: Don't go against workplace safety rules.

w|menentu.text: Cuaca yang tidak menentu membuat banyak orang datang membeli obat flu.
w|menentu.en: The unpredictable weather has many people coming in to buy flu medicine.
w|menentu.ko: 날씨가 오락가락해서 감기약을 사러 오는 사람이 많아요.

w|menentu.text: Jadwal kerja rekan baru masih tidak menentu selama masa percobaan.
w|menentu.en: The new coworker's work schedule is still irregular during the probation period.
w|menentu.ko: 수습 기간 동안 새 동료의 근무 일정은 아직 들쭉날쭉해요.

w|menentukan.text: Kamu harus menentukan pilihan hari ini.
w|menentukan.en: You must decide on a choice today.

w|menepati.text: Wali kelas memuji Andi karena selalu menepati tenggat tugas.
w|menepati.en: The homeroom teacher praised Andi for always meeting assignment deadlines.
w|menepati.ko: 담임 선생님은 과제 마감을 늘 지키는 안디를 칭찬했어요.

w|menepati.text: Dewi selalu menepati janji untuk mengecek pasien setiap dua jam.
w|menepati.en: Dewi always keeps her promise to check on patients every two hours.
w|menepati.ko: 데위는 두 시간마다 환자를 살피겠다는 약속을 늘 지켜요.

w|menepi.text: Bus sekolah menepi supaya Andi dan teman-temannya bisa turun dengan aman.
w|menepi.en: The school bus pulled over so Andi and his friends could get off safely.
w|menepi.ko: 스쿨버스가 길가에 섰고 안디와 친구들은 안전하게 내렸어요.

w|menepi.text: Dewi menepi sebentar untuk membeli terompet dari pedagang di pinggir jalan.
w|menepi.en: Dewi pulled over briefly to buy a party horn from a roadside seller.
w|menepi.ko: 데위는 길가 상인에게 나팔을 사려고 잠깐 차를 세웠어요.

w|menerangi.text: Lampu kecil di lorong menerangi wajah kakak Rudi yang sembap.
w|menerangi.en: The small hallway light lit up Rudi's sister's puffy face.
w|menerangi.ko: 복도의 작은 등이 루디 누나의 부은 얼굴을 비췄어요.

w|menerangi.text: Bulan purnama menerangi jalan setapak menuju penginapan Rina.
w|menerangi.en: The full moon lit the path to Rina's guesthouse.
w|menerangi.ko: 보름달이 리나의 숙소로 가는 오솔길을 비췄어요.

w|menerapkan.text: Pengelola mulai menerapkan aturan baru soal jam berkunjung tamu.
w|menerapkan.en: The management began applying new rules about guest visiting hours.
w|menerapkan.ko: 관리소는 손님 방문 시간에 관한 새 규칙을 적용하기 시작했어요.

w|menerapkan.text: Perusahaan kereta menerapkan sistem tiket elektronik sejak tahun lalu.
w|menerapkan.en: The railway company has used an electronic ticket system since last year.
w|menerapkan.ko: 철도 회사는 작년부터 전자 승차권 제도를 시행하고 있어요.

w|menerbangkan.text: Saat istirahat, Bayu menerbangkan drone kecil di halaman pabrik.
w|menerbangkan.en: During the break, Bayu flew a small drone in the factory yard.
w|menerbangkan.ko: 쉬는 시간에 바유는 공장 마당에서 작은 드론을 날렸어요.

w|menerbangkan.text: Pilot itu sudah sepuluh tahun menerbangkan pesawat penumpang.
w|menerbangkan.en: That pilot has been flying passenger planes for ten years.
w|menerbangkan.ko: 그 기장은 십 년째 여객기를 몰고 있어요.

w|menerbitkan.text: Rina bercita-cita menerbitkan novel tentang kakak-beradik.
w|menerbitkan.en: Rina dreams of publishing a novel about siblings.
w|menerbitkan.ko: 리나의 꿈은 형제자매 이야기를 담은 소설을 내는 거예요.

w|menerbitkan.text: Kelurahan baru menerbitkan surat domisili Siti dalam dua hari.
w|menerbitkan.en: The new village office issued Siti's residence letter in two days.
w|menerbitkan.ko: 새 동사무소는 이틀 만에 시티의 거주 증명서를 발급했어요.

w|meneriaki.text: Seorang ayah meneriaki anaknya yang berlari-lari di ruang pameran.
w|meneriaki.en: A father shouted at his child who was running around in the exhibition room.
w|meneriaki.ko: 한 아버지가 전시실에서 뛰어다니는 아이에게 소리쳤어요.

w|meneriaki.text: Dalam adegan pasar, Putri harus meneriaki pencopet yang membawa lari dompetnya.
w|meneriaki.en: In the market scene, Putri has to shout at the pickpocket running off with her wallet.
w|meneriaki.ko: 시장 장면에서 푸트리는 지갑을 들고 달아나는 소매치기에게 소리쳐야 해요.

w|meneriakkan.text: Para karyawan meneriakkan nama Fajar ketika ia memenangkan lomba karaoke kantor.
w|meneriakkan.en: The employees shouted Fajar's name when he won the office karaoke contest.
w|meneriakkan.ko: 파자르가 회사 노래자랑에서 이기자 직원들이 그의 이름을 외쳤어요.

w|meneriakkan.text: Tim Lestari meneriakkan yel-yel ketika aplikasi mereka masuk daftar terpopuler.
w|meneriakkan.en: Lestari's team chanted cheers when their app made the most-popular list.
w|meneriakkan.ko: 앱이 인기 순위에 오르자 레스타리 팀은 응원 구호를 외쳤어요.

w|menerjang.text: Dulu banjir besar menerjang kota dan merusak sebagian arsip museum.
w|menerjang.en: Long ago a huge flood swept through the city and damaged part of the museum's archive.
w|menerjang.ko: 예전에 큰 홍수가 도시를 덮쳐 박물관 기록물 일부가 망가졌어요.

w|menerjang.text: Begitu pintu dibuka, ratusan pembeli menerjang masuk ke area obral.
w|menerjang.en: As soon as the doors opened, hundreds of shoppers charged into the sale area.
w|menerjang.ko: 문이 열리자마자 수백 명의 손님이 세일 코너로 돌진했어요.

w|menerjemahkan.text: Dimas membantu menerjemahkan petunjuk pupuk yang berbahasa Inggris untuk ayahnya.
w|menerjemahkan.en: Dimas helped translate the English instructions on the fertilizer for his father.
w|menerjemahkan.ko: 디마스는 아버지를 위해 영어로 된 비료 설명서를 번역해 드렸어요.

w|menerjemahkan.text: Di kantor, tugas Putri hari ini adalah menerjemahkan surat dari klien.
w|menerjemahkan.en: At the office, Putri's task today is translating a letter from a client.
w|menerjemahkan.ko: 오늘 사무실에서 푸트리가 할 일은 고객의 편지를 번역하는 거예요.

w|menerobos.en: He pushed through the crowd toward the stage.
Cutting through a line is considered rude.

w|menertawakan.text: Tetangga menertawakan Budi yang memakai jas hujan padahal langit cerah.
w|menertawakan.en: The neighbors laughed at Budi for wearing a raincoat even though the sky was clear.
w|menertawakan.ko: 하늘이 맑은데 비옷을 입은 부디를 이웃들이 놀렸어요.

w|menertawakan.text: Semua kru menertawakan Siti yang lupa dialog di adegan lucu itu.
w|menertawakan.en: The whole crew laughed at Siti when she forgot her lines in that funny scene.
w|menertawakan.ko: 그 코믹 장면에서 시티가 대사를 잊자 제작진이 다 웃었어요.

w|meneruskan.en: She decided to continue her studies.

w|menetap.text: Mereka memutuskan menetap di kota kecil itu.
w|menetap.en: They decided to settle in that small town.
w|menetap.ko: 그들은 그 작은 도시에 정착하기로 했어.

w|menetap.text: Menetap di luar negeri mengubah hidupnya.

w|menetapkan.text: Rapat redaksi menetapkan berita utama untuk edisi hari Minggu.
w|menetapkan.en: The editorial meeting decided the lead story for the Sunday edition.
w|menetapkan.ko: 편집 회의에서 일요일 판 머리기사를 정했어요.

w|menetapkan.text: Ayu menetapkan garansi satu bulan untuk setiap penggantian baterai.
w|menetapkan.en: Ayu set a one-month warranty for every battery replacement.
w|menetapkan.ko: 아유는 배터리 교체마다 한 달 보증을 정해 뒀어요.

w|menetas.text: Telur ayam di kandang Budi akhirnya menetas pagi ini.
w|menetas.en: The chicken eggs in Budi's coop finally hatched this morning.
w|menetas.ko: 부디네 닭장의 달걀이 오늘 아침 드디어 부화했어요.

w|menetas.text: Siti bercanda kepada pelayan bahwa telur dari supermarket tidak akan pernah menetas.
w|menetas.en: Siti joked to the waiter that eggs from the supermarket would never hatch.
w|menetas.ko: 시티는 종업원에게 마트 달걀은 절대 부화하지 않는다고 농담했어요.

w|menetes.text: Botol sirup yang dipesan Fajar bocor, dan isinya menetes dari kardus.
w|menetes.en: The syrup bottle Fajar ordered leaked, and its contents were dripping from the box.
w|menetes.ko: 파자르가 주문한 시럽 병이 새서 상자에서 내용물이 뚝뚝 떨어졌어요.

w|menetes.text: Lestari menunggu sampai minyak berhenti menetes dari pisang goreng.
w|menetes.en: Lestari waited until the oil stopped dripping from the fried bananas.
w|menetes.ko: 레스타리는 바나나 튀김에서 기름이 그만 떨어질 때까지 기다렸어요.

w|meneteskan.text: Bu Sari meneteskan air mata saat Andi mengembalikan dompet yang hilang.
w|meneteskan.en: Bu Sari shed tears when Andi returned the lost wallet.
w|meneteskan.ko: 안디가 잃어버린 지갑을 돌려주자 사리 씨는 눈물을 흘렸어요.

w|meneteskan.text: Dewi meneteskan minyak katup ke trompet yang macet.
w|meneteskan.en: Dewi put a few drops of valve oil on the stuck trumpet.
w|meneteskan.ko: 데위는 뻑뻑한 트럼펫에 밸브 오일을 몇 방울 떨어뜨렸어요.

w|menewaskan.text: Di museum stasiun, Dimas membaca tentang kecelakaan kereta lama yang menewaskan puluhan orang.
w|menewaskan.en: At the station museum, Dimas read about an old train accident that killed dozens of people.
w|menewaskan.ko: 역 박물관에서 디마스는 수십 명이 숨진 옛 열차 사고에 대해 읽었어요.

w|menewaskan.text: Saat rapat, Putri menyebut film tentang gempa yang menewaskan ribuan orang sebagai alasan membuat aplikasi peringatan dini.
w|menewaskan.en: In the meeting, Putri cited a film about an earthquake that killed thousands as the reason for building an early-warning app.
w|menewaskan.ko: 회의에서 푸트리는 수천 명이 숨진 지진에 관한 영화를 조기 경보 앱을 만드는 이유로 들었어요.

w|mengabaikan.en: Ignoring a small problem can be dangerous.
w|mengabaikan.ko: 작은 문제를 무시하면 위험할 수 있어.

w|mengabari.text: Kepala desa mengabari warga lewat pengeras suara bahwa air sungai naik.
w|mengabari.en: The village head informed residents over the loudspeaker that the river was rising.
w|mengabari.ko: 이장이 확성기로 주민들에게 강물이 불고 있다고 알렸어요.

w|mengabari.text: Manajer Siti mengabari bahwa jadwal wawancara diundur.
w|mengabari.en: Siti's manager let her know that the interview schedule was postponed.
w|mengabari.ko: 시티의 매니저가 인터뷰 일정이 미뤄졌다고 알려 줬어요.

w|mengabarkan.text: Teman Dimas mengabarkan bahwa sungai di desanya mulai meluap.
w|mengabarkan.en: Dimas's friend reported that the river in his village had started to overflow.
w|mengabarkan.ko: 디마스의 친구는 자기 마을 강이 넘치기 시작했다고 알려 왔어요.

w|mengabarkan.text: Putri mengabarkan kemajuan renovasi kepada keluarganya lewat foto.
w|mengabarkan.en: Putri updated her family on the renovation's progress through photos.
w|mengabarkan.ko: 푸트리는 사진으로 가족에게 수리 진행 상황을 알렸어요.

w|mengabdi.text: Budi menulis kisah bidan yang mengabdi di desa terpencil selama puluhan tahun.
w|mengabdi.en: Budi wrote the story of a midwife who has served a remote village for decades.
w|mengabdi.ko: 부디는 외딴 마을에서 수십 년간 헌신한 조산사 이야기를 썼어요.

w|mengabdi.text: Siti sudah mengabdi di perpustakaan itu sejak masih muda.
w|mengabdi.en: Siti has devoted herself to that library since she was young.
w|mengabdi.ko: 시티는 젊을 때부터 그 도서관에서 헌신해 왔어요.

w|mengabdikan.text: Fajar sudah mengabdikan hidupnya untuk pelayanan publik di balai kota.
w|mengabdikan.en: Fajar has devoted his life to public service at city hall.
w|mengabdikan.ko: 파자르는 시청에서 공공 서비스에 평생을 바쳐 왔어요.

w|mengabdikan.text: Pak Joko telah mengabdikan diri sebagai satpam di gedung Lestari selama dua puluh tahun.
w|mengabdikan.en: Pak Joko has devoted himself to being a security guard at Lestari's building for twenty years.
w|mengabdikan.ko: 조코 씨는 레스타리의 건물에서 이십 년 동안 경비원으로 헌신해 왔어요.

w|mengabulkan.text: Ayah akhirnya mengabulkan permintaan Rina untuk punya kamar sendiri.
w|mengabulkan.en: Dad finally granted Rina's request to have her own room.
w|mengabulkan.ko: 아빠는 결국 방을 따로 쓰고 싶다는 리나의 부탁을 들어줬어요.

w|mengabulkan.text: Pemilik rumah mengabulkan permintaan Siti untuk pindah lebih awal.
w|mengabulkan.en: The landlord granted Siti's request to move in early.
w|mengabulkan.ko: 집주인은 일찍 이사 들어오겠다는 시티의 부탁을 들어줬어요.

w|mengacau.text: Hujan deras sempat mengacau jadwal perjalanan Agus.
w|mengacau.en: Heavy rain messed up Agus's travel schedule.
w|mengacau.ko: 폭우 때문에 아구스의 여행 일정이 엉망이 됐어요.

w|mengacau.text: Sekelompok remaja mengacau di area permainan sampai satpam datang.
w|mengacau.en: A group of teenagers caused trouble in the play area until security came.
w|mengacau.ko: 십 대 무리가 놀이 구역에서 소란을 피우다가 경비원이 왔어요.

w|mengacaukan.text: Jangan mengacaukan meja yang sudah rapi.
w|mengacaukan.en: Don't mess up the table that's already tidy.

w|mengacaukan.text: Mengacaukan rencana membuat semua orang kesal.
w|mengacaukan.en: Ruining the plan made everyone annoyed.

w|mengacu.text: Label koleksi di museum itu mengacu pada catatan para peneliti zaman dulu.
w|mengacu.en: The collection labels in the museum refer to the notes of researchers from long ago.
w|mengacu.ko: 그 박물관의 소장품 설명은 옛 연구자들의 기록을 따르고 있어요.

w|mengacu.text: Kostum para pemain mengacu pada foto-foto keluarga dari masa lalu.
w|mengacu.en: The actors' costumes are based on family photos from the past.

w|mengacuhkan.text: Beberapa perenang tidak mengacuhkan bendera merah yang dipasang Eko.
w|mengacuhkan.en: Some swimmers ignored the red flag Eko had put up.
w|mengacuhkan.ko: 몇몇 수영객은 에코가 꽂은 빨간 깃발을 무시했어요.

w|mengacuhkan.text: Selama ini Ayu tidak mengacuhkan gusinya yang sering berdarah.
w|mengacuhkan.en: All this time Ayu had ignored her gums, which often bled.
w|mengacuhkan.ko: 아유는 그동안 자주 피가 나는 잇몸을 신경 쓰지 않았어요.

w|mengada-ada.text: Menurut Eko, cerita tentang harimau di hutan itu cuma mengada-ada.
w|mengada-ada.en: According to Eko, the story about a tiger in that forest is just made up.
w|mengada-ada.ko: 에코 말로는 그 숲에 호랑이가 있다는 얘기는 그냥 지어낸 거래요.

w|mengada-ada.text: Alasan pemasok soal keterlambatan barang terdengar mengada-ada bagi Ayu.
w|mengada-ada.en: The supplier's excuse for the late delivery sounded made up to Ayu.
w|mengada-ada.ko: 납품이 늦은 데 대한 공급업체의 핑계가 아유에게는 지어낸 말처럼 들렸어요.

w|mengadakan.en: The school will hold a farewell party.

w|mengadakan.text: Mengadakan rapat malam ini agak sulit.
w|mengadakan.en: Holding a meeting tonight is a bit hard.
w|mengadakan.ko: 오늘 밤에 회의를 여는 건 좀 힘들어.

w|mengadili.text: Dalam sidang semu, Dimas berperan sebagai hakim yang mengadili kasus pencurian.
w|mengadili.en: In the mock trial, Dimas played the judge trying a theft case.
w|mengadili.ko: 모의 재판에서 디마스는 절도 사건을 재판하는 판사 역을 맡았어요.

w|mengadili.text: Putri merasa tidak adil kalau pelanggan langsung mengadili restorannya dari satu ulasan.
w|mengadili.en: Putri feels it's unfair when customers judge her restaurant from a single review.
w|mengadili.ko: 푸트리는 손님들이 리뷰 하나로 식당을 판단하는 게 억울해요.

w|mengadopsi.text: Fajar mengadopsi resep roti Jerman lalu menyesuaikannya dengan selera lokal.
w|mengadopsi.en: Fajar adopted a German bread recipe and adjusted it to local taste.
w|mengadopsi.ko: 파자르는 독일 빵 레시피를 들여와서 현지 입맛에 맞게 바꿨어요.

w|mengadopsi.text: Klub lari Lestari mengadopsi metode latihan dari pelatih Kenya.
w|mengadopsi.en: Lestari's running club adopted a training method from a Kenyan coach.
w|mengadopsi.ko: 레스타리의 달리기 동호회는 케냐 코치의 훈련법을 도입했어요.

w|mengadu.text: Rudi tidak suka mengadu ke guru setiap kali temannya berbuat iseng.
w|mengadu.en: Rudi doesn't like to tell on his friends to the teacher every time they play a prank.
w|mengadu.ko: 루디는 친구가 장난칠 때마다 선생님께 이르는 걸 싫어해요.

w|mengadu.text: Anak bungsu Rina mengadu bahwa kakaknya mengambil kamar yang paling besar.
w|mengadu.en: Rina's youngest complained that his older brother took the biggest room.
w|mengadu.ko: 리나의 막내는 형이 제일 큰 방을 차지했다고 일렀어요.

w|mengaduk.text: Penjual wedang jahe mengaduk minumannya sambil mengobrol dengan Agus.
w|mengaduk.en: The ginger drink seller stirred his drink while chatting with Agus.
w|mengaduk.ko: 생강차 장수는 아구스와 이야기하며 음료를 저었어요.

w|mengaduk.text: Wati mengaduk bubur kacang hijau sambil mendengar hujan pertama jatuh.
w|mengaduk.en: Wati stirred the mung bean porridge while listening to the first rain fall.
w|mengaduk.ko: 와티는 첫비 소리를 들으며 녹두죽을 저었어요.

w|mengadukan.text: Rudi mengadukan keran yang bocor kepada pemilik restoran.
w|mengadukan.en: Rudi complained to the restaurant owner about the leaking tap.
w|mengadukan.ko: 루디는 물이 새는 수도꼭지 문제를 식당 주인에게 알렸어요.

w|mengadukan.text: Rina mengadukan pedagang yang curang timbangan kepada pengelola pasar.
w|mengadukan.en: Rina reported the trader who cheated on the scales to the market management.
w|mengadukan.ko: 리나는 저울을 속인 상인을 시장 관리소에 고발했어요.

w|mengagetkan.text: Suara buku jatuh dari rak atas sempat mengagetkan Andi.
w|mengagetkan.en: The sound of a book falling from the top shelf startled Andi.
w|mengagetkan.ko: 맨 위 책장에서 책이 떨어지는 소리에 안디는 깜짝 놀랐어요.

w|mengagetkan.text: Kabar pengunduran diri direktur mengagetkan semua karyawan, termasuk Dewi.
w|mengagetkan.en: The news of the director's resignation shocked all the staff, including Dewi.
w|mengagetkan.ko: 이사의 사임 소식에 디위를 포함한 모든 직원이 놀랐어요.

w|mengagumi.text: Para murid mengagumi lukisan dinding karya kakak kelas mereka.
w|mengagumi.en: The pupils admired the mural made by their seniors.
w|mengagumi.ko: 학생들은 선배들이 그린 벽화를 보고 감탄했어요.

w|mengagumi.text: Banyak alumni mengagumi kesuksesan Siti sebagai dokter.
w|mengagumi.en: Many alumni admire Siti's success as a doctor.
w|mengagumi.ko: 많은 동문이 의사로 성공한 시티를 대단하게 여겨요.

w|mengagumkan.en: That child's talent is so amazing.

w|mengaitkan.text: Andi mengaitkan tali jemuran di antara dua tiang di halaman.
w|mengaitkan.en: Andi hooks the clothesline between two poles in the yard.
w|mengaitkan.ko: 안디는 마당의 두 기둥 사이에 빨랫줄을 걸어요.

w|mengaitkan.text: Petugas mengaitkan gerbong tambahan di belakang kereta.
w|mengaitkan.en: The crew coupled an extra carriage to the back of the train.
w|mengaitkan.ko: 직원들이 열차 뒤에 객차를 하나 더 연결했어요.

w|mengajar.text: Ibu mengajar matematika di sekolah dasar.
w|mengajar.en: Mother teaches math at the elementary school.

w|mengajarkan.en: Mom taught me how to cook.
w|mengajarkan.ko: 엄마가 나에게 요리하는 법을 가르쳐 주셨어.

w|mengajarkan.en: Teaching a child patience takes time.
w|mengajarkan.ko: 아이에게 인내를 가르치는 데는 시간이 걸려.

w|mengajukan.text: Dia mengajukan pertanyaan di akhir rapat.
w|mengajukan.en: He raised a question at the end of the meeting.
They submitted a new project proposal.

w|mengakhiri.en: They decided to end the meeting.

w|mengakibatkan.text: Andi membaca bahwa letusan gunung itu mengakibatkan desa-desa sekitar ditinggalkan.
w|mengakibatkan.en: Andi read that the volcanic eruption caused the surrounding villages to be abandoned.
w|mengakibatkan.ko: 안디는 그 화산 폭발로 주변 마을들이 버려졌다는 걸 읽었어요.

w|mengakibatkan.text: Kesalahan satu angka di tabel mengakibatkan laporan Dewi harus dicetak ulang.
w|mengakibatkan.en: A single wrong number in the table meant Dewi's report had to be reprinted.
w|mengakibatkan.ko: 표의 숫자 하나가 틀려서 디위의 보고서를 다시 인쇄해야 했어요.

w|mengakomodasi.text: Museum menambah jalur landai agar bisa mengakomodasi pengunjung berkursi roda.
w|mengakomodasi.en: The museum added ramps so it could accommodate visitors in wheelchairs.
w|mengakomodasi.ko: 박물관은 휠체어 방문객을 수용할 수 있도록 경사로를 더 놓았어요.

w|mengakomodasi.text: Toko memperpanjang jam buka untuk mengakomodasi pembeli yang pulang kerja malam.
w|mengakomodasi.en: The store extended its opening hours to accommodate shoppers who finish work late.
w|mengakomodasi.ko: 매장은 밤늦게 퇴근하는 손님을 위해 영업시간을 늘렸어요.

w|mengakses.text: Fajar meminta izin untuk mengakses rekaman kamera dari gedung itu.
w|mengakses.en: Fajar asked for permission to access the camera footage from that building.
w|mengakses.ko: 파자르는 그 건물의 카메라 영상에 접근할 수 있게 허가를 요청했어요.

w|mengakses.text: Lestari belajar mengakses aplikasi pembayaran digital dari anaknya.
w|mengakses.en: Lestari learned how to access the digital payment app from her child.
w|mengakses.ko: 레스타리는 아이에게서 디지털 결제 앱 쓰는 법을 배웠어요.

w|mengaktifkan.text: Resepsionis meminta Agus mengaktifkan notifikasi untuk pengingat jadwal kontrol.
w|mengaktifkan.en: The receptionist asked Agus to turn on notifications for appointment reminders.
w|mengaktifkan.ko: 접수 직원은 아구스에게 재진 알림을 받도록 알림을 켜 달라고 했어요.

w|mengaktifkan.text: Teknisi datang untuk mengaktifkan kembali sambungan listrik rumah tua itu.
w|mengaktifkan.en: A technician came to reconnect the old house's electricity supply.
w|mengaktifkan.ko: 기술자가 와서 그 낡은 집의 전기를 다시 연결했어요.

w|mengaku.en: He finally admitted that he had lied.
The suspect confessed in front of the investigator.

w|mengakuisisi.text: Sebuah grup restoran besar berencana mengakuisisi tempat kerja Rudi.
w|mengakuisisi.en: A large restaurant group plans to acquire the place where Rudi works.
w|mengakuisisi.ko: 대형 외식 그룹이 루디가 일하는 식당을 인수할 계획이에요.

w|mengakuisisi.text: Rina bercanda ingin mengakuisisi seluruh koleksi piringan hitam di pasar itu.
w|mengakuisisi.en: Rina joked that she wants to acquire every vinyl record in the market.
w|mengakuisisi.ko: 리나는 그 시장의 레코드판을 전부 사들이고 싶다고 농담했어요.

w|mengalah.text: Bayu memilih mengalah dan membiarkan anggota lain memakai alat itu lebih dulu.
w|mengalah.en: Bayu chose to give way and let another member use the machine first.
w|mengalah.ko: 바유는 양보하고 다른 회원이 그 기구를 먼저 쓰게 했어요.

w|mengalah.text: Intan mengalah dan membiarkan adiknya memilih menu penutup.
w|mengalah.en: Intan gave in and let her younger sibling choose the dessert.
w|mengalah.ko: 인탄은 양보하고 동생이 디저트를 고르게 했어요.

w|mengalahkan.en: He managed to overcome his fear.

w|mengalami.text: Mengalami kegagalan adalah bagian dari belajar.
w|mengalami.en: Experiencing failure is part of learning.

w|mengalihkan.text: Dia mencoba mengalihkan perhatian dari topik itu.
w|mengalihkan.en: He tried to divert attention from that topic.
w|mengalihkan.ko: 그는 그 화제에서 관심을 돌리려 했어.

w|mengalihkan.text: Musik dapat mengalihkan rasa cemas sebentar.
w|mengalihkan.en: Music can divert anxiety for a while.
w|mengalihkan.ko: 음악이 잠시 불안을 달래 줄 수 있어.

w|mengalir.text: Air sungai mengalir deras setelah hujan.
w|mengalir.en: The river water flows hard after the rain.

w|mengamankan.text: Eko langsung mengamankan rekaman wawancara di dua tempat penyimpanan.
w|mengamankan.en: Eko immediately secured the interview recording in two storage places.
w|mengamankan.ko: 에코는 인터뷰 녹음을 바로 두 군데에 안전하게 저장했어요.

w|mengamankan.text: Sebelum memperbaiki, Ayu mengamankan data pelanggan ke laptop.
w|mengamankan.en: Before repairing, Ayu backs up the customer's data to a laptop.
w|mengamankan.ko: 아유는 수리하기 전에 손님 데이터를 노트북에 안전하게 옮겨 둬요.

w|mengamati.text: Dimas suka mengamati orang-orang yang tertidur di ruang baca.
w|mengamati.en: Dimas likes watching the people who fall asleep in the reading room.
w|mengamati.ko: 디마스는 열람실에서 조는 사람들을 구경하는 걸 좋아해요.

w|mengamati.text: Dari jendela, Putri mengamati gunung yang perlahan tertutup kabut.
w|mengamati.en: From the window, Putri watched the mountain slowly being covered in mist.
w|mengamati.ko: 푸트리는 창밖으로 산이 천천히 안개에 덮이는 걸 지켜봤어요.

w|mengambang.text: Rapat itu panjang, tapi keputusannya masih mengambang.
w|mengambang.en: The meeting was long, but the decision is still up in the air.

w|mengambang.text: Daun-daun kering tampak mengambang di kolam renang hotel pagi itu.
w|mengambang.en: Dry leaves could be seen floating in the hotel pool that morning.
w|mengambang.ko: 그날 아침 호텔 수영장에 마른 잎들이 떠 있었어요.

w|mengambilkan.text: Pegawai Fajar mengambilkan roti cokelat untuk nenek yang tidak bisa menjangkau rak.
w|mengambilkan.en: Fajar's employee fetched the chocolate bread for a grandmother who couldn't reach the shelf.
w|mengambilkan.ko: 파자르의 직원이 선반에 손이 안 닿는 할머니에게 초콜릿 빵을 꺼내 드렸어요.

w|mengambilkan.text: Adik Lestari mengambilkan handuk dan botol air untuknya di garis finis.
w|mengambilkan.en: Lestari's younger sibling fetched a towel and a water bottle for her at the finish line.
w|mengambilkan.ko: 레스타리의 동생이 결승선에서 수건과 물병을 가져다줬어요.

w|mengampuni.text: Dalam drama kelas, Eko berperan sebagai raja yang mengampuni seorang pencuri.
w|mengampuni.en: In the class play, Eko played a king who pardons a thief.
w|mengampuni.ko: 반 연극에서 에코는 도둑을 용서하는 왕 역할을 맡았어요.

w|mengampuni.text: Nenek bilang kepada Ayu bahwa kita harus belajar mengampuni orang lain.
w|mengampuni.en: Grandma told Ayu that we have to learn to forgive others.
w|mengampuni.ko: 할머니는 아유에게 다른 사람을 용서하는 법을 배워야 한다고 했어요.

w|mengamuk.text: Di novel yang dibaca Andi, seekor gajah mengamuk dan merusak kebun warga.
w|mengamuk.en: In the novel Andi was reading, an elephant went on a rampage and wrecked villagers' gardens.
w|mengamuk.ko: 안디가 읽은 소설에서 코끼리 한 마리가 날뛰며 마을 밭을 망가뜨렸어요.

w|mengamuk.text: Seorang pelanggan mengamuk di meja resepsionis karena pesanannya hilang.
w|mengamuk.en: A customer flew into a rage at the reception desk because his order was lost.
w|mengamuk.ko: 주문이 사라지자 손님 한 명이 안내 데스크에서 난동을 부렸어요.

w|menganalisis.text: Bagian mutu menganalisis contoh kain sebelum dikirim ke pembeli.
w|menganalisis.en: The quality department analyzes fabric samples before they are sent to the buyer.
w|menganalisis.ko: 품질 부서는 원단 견본을 바이어에게 보내기 전에 분석해요.

w|menganalisis.text: Teman sebangku Intan sedang menganalisis data penjualan di tabletnya.
w|menganalisis.en: Intan's seatmate was analyzing sales data on his tablet.
w|menganalisis.ko: 인탄 옆자리 사람은 태블릿으로 판매 자료를 분석하고 있었어요.

w|mengancam.en: A big storm threatens that coast.

w|mengandalkan.text: Tim ini mengandalkan kerja sama yang erat.
w|mengandalkan.en: This team relies on close cooperation.
Don't just rely on luck alone.

w|mengandung.en: This drink contains a lot of sugar.
w|mengandung.ko: 이 음료는 설탕이 많이 들어 있어.

w|mengandung.en: That letter contains a secret message.
w|mengandung.ko: 그 편지에는 비밀 메시지가 담겨 있어.

w|mengangguk.text: Pemimpin redaksi mengangguk setuju setelah membaca judul usulan Andi.
w|mengangguk.en: The editor-in-chief nodded in agreement after reading Andi's proposed headline.
w|mengangguk.ko: 편집장은 안디가 제안한 제목을 읽고 고개를 끄덕였어요.

w|mengangguk.text: Dewi mengangguk saat sopir truk bertanya apakah lemari boleh dibaringkan.
w|mengangguk.en: Dewi nodded when the truck driver asked if the wardrobe could be laid down.
w|mengangguk.ko: 트럭 기사가 옷장을 눕혀도 되냐고 묻자 데위는 고개를 끄덕였어요.

w|menganggur.text: Banyak tukang di desa Andi menganggur sejak proyek jalan selesai.
w|menganggur.en: Many builders in Andi's village have been out of work since the road project ended.
w|menganggur.ko: 도로 공사가 끝난 뒤로 안디네 마을의 많은 일꾼들이 놀고 있어요.

w|menganggur.text: Dewi memberi semangat kepada teman yang sedang menganggur.
w|menganggur.en: Dewi encouraged a friend who is currently unemployed.
w|menganggur.ko: 데위는 지금 일자리가 없는 친구에게 힘을 북돋아 줬어요.

w|mengangkut.text: Kapal itu mengangkut mobil, motor, dan ratusan penumpang setiap hari.
w|mengangkut.en: That ship carries cars, motorbikes and hundreds of passengers every day.
w|mengangkut.ko: 그 배는 매일 자동차와 오토바이, 승객 수백 명을 실어 날라요.

w|mengangkut.text: Truk besar mengangkut barang baru ke gudang mal setiap Senin.
w|mengangkut.en: A big truck carries new goods to the mall warehouse every Monday.
w|mengangkut.ko: 큰 트럭이 월요일마다 새 물건을 쇼핑몰 창고로 실어 와요.

w|menganiaya.text: Agus menegur seorang pria yang menganiaya kucing liar di dekat pasar.
w|menganiaya.en: Agus confronted a man who was abusing a stray cat near the market.
w|menganiaya.ko: 아구스는 시장 근처에서 길고양이를 괴롭히던 남자를 나무랐어요.

w|menganiaya.text: Wati membaca berita tentang orang yang menganiaya hewan ternak saat musim kering, lalu melapor ke dinas.
w|menganiaya.en: Wati read news about someone abusing livestock in the dry season, then reported it to the authorities.
w|menganiaya.ko: 와티는 건기에 가축을 학대한 사람에 관한 뉴스를 읽고 관청에 신고했어요.

w|menganjurkan.text: Rudi menganjurkan tamu membawa jaket untuk tur ke gunung.
w|menganjurkan.en: Rudi recommended that the guests bring a jacket for the mountain tour.
w|menganjurkan.ko: 루디는 산 투어에 재킷을 챙겨 가라고 손님들에게 권했어요.

w|menganjurkan.text: Dokter menganjurkan Rina minum lebih banyak air selama musim panas.
w|menganjurkan.en: The doctor advised Rina to drink more water during the hot season.
w|menganjurkan.ko: 의사는 리나에게 더운 철에는 물을 더 많이 마시라고 권했어요.

w|mengantar.en: He delivered the package to the office.

w|mengantarkan.text: Seorang satpam mengantarkan nenek itu ke loket pembuatan KTP.
w|mengantarkan.en: A security guard took the grandmother to the ID card counter.
w|mengantarkan.ko: 경비원이 할머니를 신분증 발급 창구까지 모셔다 드렸어요.

w|mengantarkan.text: Setiap Sabtu, ayah Wati mengantarkan dia ke sekolah musik naik motor.
w|mengantarkan.en: Every Saturday, Wati's father takes her to music school by motorbike.
w|mengantarkan.ko: 토요일마다 와티 아빠가 오토바이로 와티를 음악 학원에 데려다줘요.

w|mengantisipasi.text: Untuk mengantisipasi keterlambatan, Dimas membawa bekal makanan yang cukup.
w|mengantisipasi.en: To anticipate delays, Dimas brought enough food for the trip.
w|mengantisipasi.ko: 연착에 대비해서 디마스는 먹을 것을 넉넉히 챙겼어요.

w|mengantisipasi.text: Putri menambah server untuk mengantisipasi lonjakan pengguna saat promo.
w|mengantisipasi.en: Putri added servers to anticipate the surge of users during the promo.
w|mengantisipasi.ko: 푸트리는 프로모션 때 사용자가 몰릴 것에 대비해 서버를 늘렸어요.

w|mengantre.text: Setiap pagi, para penghuni mengantre lift di lobi.
w|mengantre.en: Every morning, residents queue for the elevator in the lobby.
w|mengantre.ko: 매일 아침 주민들은 로비에서 엘리베이터를 기다리며 줄을 서요.

w|mengantre.text: Saat kemarau panjang, Wati ikut mengantre air bersih di balai desa.
w|mengantre.en: During the long drought, Wati queued for clean water at the village hall.
w|mengantre.ko: 긴 가뭄 때 와티도 마을 회관에서 깨끗한 물을 받으려고 줄을 섰어요.

w|mengantuk.text: Bayu sering mengantuk kalau latihan terlalu pagi.
w|mengantuk.en: Bayu often feels sleepy when he trains too early in the morning.
w|mengantuk.ko: 바유는 너무 이른 아침에 운동하면 자주 졸려요.

w|mengantuk.text: Setelah makan siang yang besar, kakek Intan mulai mengantuk di kursinya.
w|mengantuk.en: After a big lunch, Intan's grandfather starts to get drowsy in his chair.
w|mengantuk.ko: 푸짐한 점심 뒤 인탄의 할아버지는 의자에서 졸기 시작해요.

w|mengapung.text: Dalam adegan laut, perahu kertas dibuat seolah-olah mengapung di atas panggung.
w|mengapung.en: In the sea scene, a paper boat was made to look as if it were floating on stage.
w|mengapung.ko: 바다 장면에서 종이배가 무대 위에 떠 있는 것처럼 연출됐어요.

w|mengapung.text: Waktu banjir datang, kardus mi instan di toko Ayu sampai mengapung di lantai.
w|mengapung.en: When the flood came, the boxes of instant noodles in Ayu's shop were floating on the floor.
w|mengapung.ko: 홍수가 났을 때 아유 가게의 라면 상자들이 바닥에 둥둥 떴어요.

w|mengarah.en: The ship heads toward the northern port.

w|mengarah.text: Mengarah ke timur, jalan menjadi sepi.
w|mengarah.en: Heading east, the road becomes quiet.

w|mengarahkan.text: Petugas mengarahkan pengunjung ke pintu keluar karena museum hampir tutup.
w|mengarahkan.en: The staff directed visitors to the exit because the museum was about to close.
w|mengarahkan.ko: 박물관이 곧 문을 닫아서 직원이 관람객들을 출구로 안내했어요.

w|mengarahkan.text: Tukang parkir mengarahkan mobil Rina ke tempat yang masih kosong.
w|mengarahkan.en: The parking attendant guided Rina's car to a spot that was still empty.
w|mengarahkan.ko: 주차 요원이 리나의 차를 빈자리로 안내했어요.

w|mengarang.text: Untuk tugas bahasa, Eko harus mengarang cerita pendek tentang desanya.
w|mengarang.en: For a language assignment, Eko has to write a short story about his village.
w|mengarang.ko: 국어 숙제로 에코는 자기 마을에 관한 짧은 이야기를 지어야 해요.

w|mengarang.text: Sore itu, Ayu mencoba mengarang lagu dengan gitar ayahnya.
w|mengarang.en: That afternoon, Ayu tried composing a song on her father's guitar.
w|mengarang.ko: 그날 오후 아유는 아버지 기타로 노래를 지어 보았어요.

w|mengartikan.text: Budi belajar mengartikan gerakan ekor kucing yang sedang kesal.
w|mengartikan.en: Budi is learning to interpret the tail movements of an annoyed cat.
w|mengartikan.ko: 부디는 짜증 난 고양이의 꼬리 움직임을 해석하는 법을 배우고 있어요.

w|mengartikan.text: Siti masih kesulitan mengartikan bahasa daerah yang dipakai kakek dari kampung sebelah.
w|mengartikan.en: Siti still struggles to understand the local language used by the old man from the next village.
w|mengartikan.ko: 시티는 이웃 마을 할아버지가 쓰는 사투리를 아직도 알아듣기 힘들어요.

w|mengasah.text: Agus mengasah pisau dapur di balkon setiap akhir pekan.
w|mengasah.en: Agus sharpens his kitchen knives on the balcony every weekend.

w|mengasah.text: Setiap pagi Wati mengasah pisau sebelum memotong daging.
w|mengasah.en: Every morning Wati sharpens the knives before cutting the meat.
w|mengasah.ko: 와티는 매일 아침 고기를 썰기 전에 칼을 갈아요.

w|mengasihani.text: Rudi tidak mau dikasihani, jadi Rudi minta orang tuanya tidak mengasihani dirinya di depan kakak.
w|mengasihani.en: Rudi didn't want pity, so he asked his parents not to feel sorry for him in front of his sister.
w|mengasihani.ko: 루디는 동정받기 싫어서 부모님께 누나 앞에서 자기를 불쌍히 여기지 말라고 했어요.

w|mengasihani.text: Rina mengasihani penyu yang tersangkut jaring plastik di pinggir pantai.
w|mengasihani.en: Rina felt sorry for the turtle caught in a plastic net at the water's edge.
w|mengasihani.ko: 리나는 해변에서 플라스틱 그물에 걸린 거북이가 불쌍했어요.

w|mengasihi.text: Budi tahu ibu Andi mengasihi semua teman anaknya seperti anak sendiri.
w|mengasihi.en: Budi knows Andi's mother loves all her son's friends like her own children.
w|mengasihi.ko: 부디는 안디의 어머니가 아들 친구들을 모두 친자식처럼 아낀다는 걸 알아요.

w|mengasihi.text: Siti mengasihi ibunya yang selalu menunggu di garis akhir.
w|mengasihi.en: Siti loves her mother, who always waits at the finish line.
w|mengasihi.ko: 시티는 늘 결승선에서 기다려 주는 어머니를 사랑해요.

w|mengasingkan.text: Agus tidak mau mengasingkan diri, jadi Agus ikut grup obrolan warga.
w|mengasingkan.en: Agus didn't want to isolate himself, so he joined the residents' group chat.
w|mengasingkan.ko: 아구스는 혼자 고립되기 싫어서 주민 단톡방에 들어갔어요.

w|mengasingkan.text: Hujan berhari-hari sempat mengasingkan desa Wati dari kota karena jembatan terputus.
w|mengasingkan.en: Days of rain cut Wati's village off from the town because the bridge was washed out.
w|mengasingkan.ko: 며칠 내린 비로 다리가 끊겨 와티네 마을이 도시와 단절됐어요.

w|mengasuh.text: Fajar membelikan mainan untuk keponakan yang dia bantu mengasuh setiap Sabtu.
w|mengasuh.en: Fajar bought toys for the nephew he helps look after every Saturday.
w|mengasuh.ko: 파자르는 토요일마다 돌봐 주는 조카에게 장난감을 사 줬어요.

w|mengasuh.text: Lestari ikut kelas pada pagi hari karena sore dia harus mengasuh adiknya.
w|mengasuh.en: Lestari takes the morning class because in the afternoon she has to look after her younger sibling.
w|mengasuh.ko: 레스타리는 오후에 동생을 돌봐야 해서 오전 수업을 들어요.

w|mengasumsikan.text: Petugas perpustakaan mengasumsikan Andi mahasiswa karena dia membawa buku tebal.
w|mengasumsikan.en: The librarian assumed Andi was a university student because he was carrying thick books.
w|mengasumsikan.ko: 사서는 안디가 두꺼운 책을 들고 있어서 대학생인 줄 알았어요.

w|mengasumsikan.text: Dewi mengasumsikan rapat dimulai jam sembilan, padahal sudah dimajukan.
w|mengasumsikan.en: Dewi assumed the meeting started at nine, but it had been moved earlier.
w|mengasumsikan.ko: 디위는 회의가 아홉 시에 시작하는 줄 알았는데 이미 앞당겨졌어요.

w|mengatasi.en: We have to overcome this problem.

w|mengaum.text: Budi menulis tentang singa yang mengaum keras saat Budi berkunjung ke kebun binatang.
w|mengaum.en: Budi wrote about a lion that roared loudly when he visited the zoo.
w|mengaum.ko: 부디는 동물원에 갔을 때 사자가 크게 포효했던 이야기를 썼어요.

w|mengaum.text: Anak Pak Darto berpura-pura mengaum seperti harimau di depan rumah Siti.
w|mengaum.en: Mr. Darto's son pretended to roar like a tiger in front of Siti's house.
w|mengaum.ko: 다르토 아저씨 아들이 시티네 집 앞에서 호랑이처럼 어흥 하는 흉내를 냈어요.

w|mengawal.text: Kurir itu sudah biasa mengawal paket mahal sampai ke tangan penerima.
w|mengawal.en: That courier is used to escorting expensive parcels right into the recipient's hands.
w|mengawal.ko: 그 택배 기사는 비싼 택배를 받는 사람 손에 전달할 때까지 지키는 데 익숙해요.

w|mengawal.text: Dua petugas mengawal koki terkenal yang datang sebagai tamu kelas.
w|mengawal.en: Two staff members escorted the famous chef who came as a guest of the class.
w|mengawal.ko: 직원 두 명이 수업에 초대 손님으로 온 유명 요리사를 수행했어요.

w|mengawali.text: Budi selalu mengawali shift dengan membaca catatan semua pasien.
w|mengawali.en: Budi always starts his shift by reading every patient's notes.
w|mengawali.ko: 부디는 늘 모든 환자의 기록을 읽는 것으로 근무를 시작해요.

w|mengawali.text: Siti mengawali liburan dengan secangkir kopi di kafe bandara.
w|mengawali.en: Siti kicked off her vacation with a cup of coffee at the airport café.
w|mengawali.ko: 시티는 공항 카페에서 커피 한 잔으로 휴가를 시작했어요.

w|mengawasi.en: The police are watching this area.
Please watch my little sibling for a bit.

w|mengayuh.text: Setiap Sabtu, Andi mengayuh sepeda ke perpustakaan di ujung jalan.
w|mengayuh.en: Every Saturday, Andi pedals his bike to the library at the end of the road.
w|mengayuh.ko: 매주 토요일 안디는 길 끝 도서관까지 자전거를 타고 가요.

w|mengayuh.text: Adik Dewi mengayuh sepedanya sendiri ke rumah baru yang hanya dua blok jauhnya.
w|mengayuh.en: Dewi's little brother pedaled his own bike to the new house, just two blocks away.
w|mengayuh.ko: 데위의 남동생은 두 블록 떨어진 새집까지 자기 자전거를 타고 갔어요.

w|mengayun.text: Saat acara golf kantor, Bayu mengayun tongkat dengan canggung.
w|mengayun.en: At the office golf outing, Bayu swung the club awkwardly.
w|mengayun.ko: 회사 골프 행사에서 바유는 어색하게 골프채를 휘둘렀어요.

w|mengayun.text: Intan mengayun kettlebell dengan gerakan pinggul yang kuat.
w|mengayun.en: Intan swings the kettlebell with a strong hip movement.
w|mengayun.ko: 인탄은 엉덩이 힘을 써서 케틀벨을 휘둘러요.

w|mengayunkan.text: Penjual palu itu mengayunkan barang dagangannya untuk menunjukkan bahwa gagangnya kuat.
w|mengayunkan.en: The hammer seller swung his goods to show that the handle was sturdy.
w|mengayunkan.ko: 망치 장수는 손잡이가 튼튼하다는 걸 보여 주려고 물건을 휘둘렀어요.

w|mengayunkan.text: Anak-anak kecil mengayunkan kaki mereka dari kursi sambil menunggu makanan.
w|mengayunkan.en: The little kids swung their legs from their chairs while waiting for food.
w|mengayunkan.ko: 아이들은 음식을 기다리며 의자에 앉아 다리를 흔들었어요.

w|mengebor.text: Tukang sedang mengebor dinding apotek untuk memasang rak baru.
w|mengebor.en: A handyman is drilling into the pharmacy wall to put up new shelves.
w|mengebor.ko: 목수가 새 선반을 달려고 약국 벽에 구멍을 뚫고 있어요.

w|mengebor.text: Rekan baru Lestari dulu bekerja mengebor sumur minyak di lepas pantai.
w|mengebor.en: Lestari's new coworker used to work drilling offshore oil wells.
w|mengebor.ko: 레스타리의 새 동료는 예전에 해상 유정을 시추하는 일을 했어요.

w|mengebut.text: Bayu menolak mengebut walaupun jalan tol sedang sepi.
w|mengebut.en: Bayu refused to speed even though the toll road was empty.

w|mengebut.text: Intan terpaksa mengebut naik motor karena kelas sudah hampir mulai.
w|mengebut.en: Intan had to race on her scooter because class was about to start.
w|mengebut.ko: 수업이 곧 시작해서 인탄은 오토바이를 급하게 몰아야 했어요.

w|mengecat.text: Agus minta izin pengelola sebelum mengecat dinding kamarnya warna hijau.
w|mengecat.en: Agus asked management for permission before painting his bedroom wall green.
w|mengecat.ko: 아구스는 방 벽을 초록색으로 칠하기 전에 관리실에 허락을 받았어요.

w|mengecat.text: Wati mengecat pagar rumah sebelum musim hujan datang.
w|mengecat.en: Wati painted the house fence before the rainy season came.
w|mengecat.ko: 와티는 우기가 오기 전에 집 울타리를 칠했어요.

w|mengecek.text: Agus mengecek ulang daftar undangan sebelum acara pelantikan.
w|mengecek.en: Agus double-checked the guest list before the inauguration ceremony.
w|mengecek.ko: 아구스는 취임식 전에 초대 명단을 다시 확인했어요.

w|mengecek.text: Sebelum tampil, Wati mengecek senar biolanya satu per satu.
w|mengecek.en: Before performing, Wati checks her violin strings one by one.
w|mengecek.ko: 공연 전에 와티는 바이올린 줄을 하나씩 확인해요.

w|mengecewakan.en: Those exam results are very disappointing.
Disappointing his parents made him sad.

w|mengecilkan.text: Saat malam mulai dingin, Dimas mengecilkan kipas angin di kamarnya.
w|mengecilkan.en: When the nights start getting cold, Dimas turns down the fan in his room.
w|mengecilkan.ko: 밤이 쌀쌀해지면 디마스는 방 선풍기를 약하게 줄여요.

w|mengecilkan.text: Putri memutuskan mengecilkan ukuran dapur supaya ruang makan lebih luas.
w|mengecilkan.en: Putri decided to make the kitchen smaller so the dining room would be bigger.
w|mengecilkan.ko: 푸트리는 식당을 넓히려고 부엌을 줄이기로 했어요.

w|mengedipkan.text: Agus mengedipkan mata kepada anak tetangga yang sedang menunggu lift.
w|mengedipkan.en: Agus winked at the neighbor's kid who was waiting for the elevator.
w|mengedipkan.ko: 아구스는 엘리베이터를 기다리던 이웃집 아이에게 윙크했어요.

w|mengedipkan.text: Wati mengedipkan mata kepada pelayan baru sebagai tanda semuanya beres.
w|mengedipkan.en: Wati winked at the new waiter as a sign that everything was fine.
w|mengedipkan.ko: 와티는 다 괜찮다는 뜻으로 새 종업원에게 윙크했어요.

w|mengedit.text: Malam itu Agus mengedit jadwal kerja minggu depan di laptopnya.
w|mengedit.en: That night Agus edited next week's work schedule on his laptop.
w|mengedit.ko: 그날 밤 아구스는 노트북으로 다음 주 작업 일정을 수정했어요.

w|mengedit.text: Wati sempat mengedit alamat pengiriman karena salah menulis nomor rumah.
w|mengedit.en: Wati had to edit the delivery address because she wrote the wrong house number.
w|mengedit.ko: 와티는 집 번호를 잘못 써서 배송 주소를 고쳐야 했어요.

w|mengeja.text: Di kelas bahasa Inggris, Agus disuruh mengeja nama lengkapnya dengan huruf Inggris.
w|mengeja.en: In English class, Agus was told to spell his full name using English letters.
w|mengeja.ko: 영어 시간에 아구스는 자기 이름을 영어 알파벳으로 철자를 불러 보라는 말을 들었어요.

w|mengeja.text: Penjaga loket meminta Wati mengeja namanya untuk kartu anggota.
w|mengeja.en: The ticket clerk asked Wati to spell her name for the membership card.
w|mengeja.ko: 매표소 직원은 회원 카드를 만들려고 와티에게 이름 철자를 불러 달라고 했어요.

w|mengejar.en: The police are chasing the thief.
That dog is chasing the ball.

w|mengejek.text: Anak muda itu dibawa ke kantor polisi karena mengejek petugas parkir sampai terjadi perkelahian.
w|mengejek.en: The young man was taken to the police station because he mocked a parking attendant until a fight broke out.
w|mengejek.ko: 그 청년은 주차 요원을 놀리다가 싸움이 나서 경찰서로 연행됐어요.

w|mengejek.text: Suporter lawan mengejek Dewi setiap kali dia memegang bola.
w|mengejek.en: The opposing fans jeered at Dewi every time she had the ball.
w|mengejek.ko: 상대 팀 응원단은 데위가 공을 잡을 때마다 야유했어요.

w|mengejutkan.text: Hasil ujian itu mengejutkan semua orang.

w|mengeksekusi.text: Bayu bertugas mengeksekusi rencana produksi yang dibuat manajer.
w|mengeksekusi.en: Bayu's job is to carry out the production plan the manager makes.
w|mengeksekusi.ko: 바유는 관리자가 짠 생산 계획을 실행하는 일을 맡아요.

w|mengeksekusi.text: Dalam novel yang dibaca Intan, raja memerintahkan pengawal untuk mengeksekusi pengkhianat.
w|mengeksekusi.en: In the novel Intan is reading, the king orders the guards to execute the traitor.
w|mengeksekusi.ko: 인탄이 읽는 소설에서 왕은 호위병들에게 배신자를 처형하라고 명령해요.

w|mengeksploitasi.text: Eko khawatir ada pihak yang ingin mengeksploitasi terumbu karang di teluk itu.
w|mengeksploitasi.en: Eko worried that some parties wanted to exploit the coral reef in that bay.
w|mengeksploitasi.ko: 에코는 누군가 그 만의 산호초를 마구 이용하려 할까 봐 걱정했어요.

w|mengeksploitasi.text: Menurut dokter, ada klinik nakal yang mengeksploitasi rasa takut pasien demi untung, dan Ayu setuju.
w|mengeksploitasi.en: According to the dentist, some shady clinics exploit patients' fear for profit, and Ayu agreed.
w|mengeksploitasi.ko: 의사 말로는 환자의 두려움을 이용해 돈을 버는 질 나쁜 병원도 있다는데, 아유도 동의했어요.

w|mengeksplorasi.text: Tim penyidik ingin mengeksplorasi rekaman kamera dari toko-toko di sekitar lokasi kejadian.
w|mengeksplorasi.en: The investigation team wants to explore the camera footage from the shops around the scene.
w|mengeksplorasi.ko: 수사팀은 사건 현장 주변 가게들의 카메라 영상을 살펴보고 싶어 해요.

w|mengeksplorasi.text: Setiap akhir pekan Rina suka mengeksplorasi rute lari baru di pinggiran kota.
w|mengeksplorasi.en: Every weekend Rina likes to explore new running routes on the outskirts of the city.
w|mengeksplorasi.ko: 리나는 주말마다 도시 외곽에서 새 달리기 코스를 찾아다니는 걸 좋아해요.

w|mengekspos.text: Majalah sekolah Budi berani mengekspos masalah kantin yang kotor.
w|mengekspos.en: Budi's school magazine dared to expose the problem of the dirty canteen.
w|mengekspos.ko: 부디네 학교 잡지는 더러운 매점 문제를 과감히 폭로했어요.

w|mengekspos.text: Siti sengaja tidak mengekspos dokumen pribadinya di kamera ponsel.
w|mengekspos.en: Siti deliberately avoided exposing her personal documents to her phone camera.
w|mengekspos.ko: 시티는 개인 서류가 휴대폰 카메라에 찍히지 않게 조심했어요.

w|mengekspresikan.text: Di rapat pertama, Dimas belum berani mengekspresikan pendapatnya.
w|mengekspresikan.en: At his first meeting, Dimas didn't yet dare to express his opinion.
w|mengekspresikan.ko: 첫 회의에서 디마스는 아직 자기 의견을 말할 용기가 없었어요.

w|mengekspresikan.text: Putri sulit mengekspresikan rasa lega setelah pesawatnya mendarat dengan selamat.
w|mengekspresikan.en: Putri found it hard to express her relief after her plane landed safely.
w|mengekspresikan.ko: 비행기가 무사히 착륙하자 푸트리는 안도감을 말로 표현하기 어려웠어요.

w|mengekstrak.text: Andi mengekstrak data ukuran dari gambar kerja ke lembar kerja.
w|mengekstrak.en: Andi extracted the measurements from the working drawings into a spreadsheet.
w|mengekstrak.ko: 안디는 시공 도면에서 치수 자료를 뽑아 표로 옮겼어요.

w|mengekstrak.text: Dewi mengekstrak foto-foto dari video lama untuk dibuat album.
w|mengekstrak.en: Dewi extracted photos from old videos to make an album.
w|mengekstrak.ko: 데위는 옛 영상에서 사진을 뽑아 앨범을 만들었어요.

w|mengelabui.text: Dalam lakon itu, Eko berperan sebagai pedagang licik yang mengelabui raja.
w|mengelabui.en: In the play, Eko plays a cunning merchant who tricks the king.
w|mengelabui.ko: 그 연극에서 에코는 왕을 속이는 교활한 상인 역을 맡았어요.

w|mengelabui.text: Seorang calo mencoba mengelabui Ayu dengan menjual tiket palsu di stasiun.
w|mengelabui.en: A scalper tried to trick Ayu by selling her a fake ticket at the station.
w|mengelabui.ko: 한 암표상이 역에서 가짜 표를 팔아 아유를 속이려 했어요.

w|mengelak.text: Kucing itu terus mengelak setiap kali Rudi mencoba memberinya obat.
w|mengelak.en: The cat kept dodging every time Rudi tried to give it medicine.
w|mengelak.ko: 루디가 약을 먹이려 할 때마다 고양이는 계속 피했어요.

w|mengelak.text: Adik Rina selalu mengelak saat ditanya siapa yang memetik stroberi di kebun.
w|mengelak.en: Rina's little brother always dodges the question of who picked the strawberries in the garden.
w|mengelak.ko: 리나의 동생은 밭에서 누가 딸기를 땄냐고 물으면 늘 말을 돌려요.

w|mengelilingi.text: Para penari mengelilingi Bayu di tengah panggung.
w|mengelilingi.en: The dancers surrounded Bayu in the middle of the stage.

w|mengelilingi.text: Rekan-rekan mengelilingi meja Intan untuk merayakan ulang tahunnya.
w|mengelilingi.en: Her colleagues gathered around Intan's desk to celebrate her birthday.
w|mengelilingi.ko: 동료들이 인탄의 생일을 축하하려고 책상 주위에 모였어요.

w|mengeliminasi.text: Fajar merancang antrean daring untuk mengeliminasi calo di loket pelayanan.
w|mengeliminasi.en: Fajar designed an online queue to eliminate scalpers at the service counter.
w|mengeliminasi.ko: 파자르는 민원 창구의 브로커를 없애려고 온라인 대기 시스템을 만들었어요.

w|mengeliminasi.text: Lestari memasang penyaring air untuk mengeliminasi bau kaporit dari keran.
w|mengeliminasi.en: Lestari installed a water filter to eliminate the chlorine smell from the tap.
w|mengeliminasi.ko: 레스타리는 수돗물의 소독약 냄새를 없애려고 정수 필터를 달았어요.

w|mengelola.text: Sekarang Bayu dipercaya mengelola gudang bahan baku.
w|mengelola.en: Now Bayu is trusted to manage the raw materials warehouse.
w|mengelola.ko: 이제 바유는 원자재 창고 관리를 맡고 있어요.

w|mengelola.text: Kakak Intan mengelola toko oleh-oleh di terminal kedatangan.
w|mengelola.en: Intan's older sister runs a souvenir shop in the arrivals terminal.
w|mengelola.ko: 인탄의 언니는 도착 터미널에서 기념품 가게를 운영해요.

w|mengeluarkan.en: He took money out of his wallet.

w|mengeluh.en: He complained about the hot weather.

w|mengemas.text: Budi membantu Rina mengemas barang-barang untuk pindah ke kamar baru.
w|mengemas.en: Budi helped Rina pack her things to move into the new room.
w|mengemas.ko: 부디는 리나가 새 방으로 옮길 짐을 싸는 걸 도와줬어요.

w|mengemas.text: Siti mengemas piring-piring dengan koran bekas.
w|mengemas.en: Siti packed the plates with old newspapers.

w|mengemasi.text: Bel berbunyi, dan Agus cepat-cepat mengemasi buku-bukunya.
w|mengemasi.en: The bell rang, and Agus quickly packed up his books.
w|mengemasi.ko: 종이 울리자 아구스는 서둘러 책을 챙겼어요.

w|mengemasi.text: Selesai latihan, Wati mengemasi kacamata renang dan handuknya.
w|mengemasi.en: After practice, Wati packed up her goggles and towel.
w|mengemasi.ko: 연습이 끝나고 와티는 물안경과 수건을 챙겼어요.

w|mengembalikan.en: He forgot to return the money.

w|mengembangkan.text: Perusahaan mengembangkan produk baru tahun ini.
w|mengembangkan.en: The company is developing a new product this year.
That child is developing his painting talent.
w|mengembangkan.ko: 그 아이는 그림 재능을 키우고 있어.

w|mengembara.text: Kakek Bayu dulu suka mengembara dari satu kota ke kota lain.
w|mengembara.en: Bayu's grandfather used to love wandering from one town to another.
w|mengembara.ko: 바유의 할아버지는 예전에 이 도시 저 도시로 떠도는 걸 좋아했어요.

w|mengembara.text: Intan terinspirasi oleh cerita seorang pelukis yang mengembara ke seluruh nusantara.
w|mengembara.en: Intan was inspired by the story of a painter who wandered all over the archipelago.
w|mengembara.ko: 인탄은 온 군도를 떠돌아다닌 한 화가의 이야기에 영감을 받았어요.

w|mengemis.text: Seekor monyet duduk di dekat tenda seolah-olah sedang mengemis makanan dari Rudi.
w|mengemis.en: A monkey sat near the tent as if begging Rudi for food.
w|mengemis.ko: 원숭이 한 마리가 루디에게 먹을 걸 구걸하듯 텐트 옆에 앉아 있었어요.

w|mengemis.text: Seorang pria di luar stadion mengemis tiket kepada setiap penonton yang lewat.
w|mengemis.en: A man outside the stadium begged every passing fan for a ticket.
w|mengemis.ko: 경기장 밖에서 한 남자가 지나가는 관객마다 표를 달라고 애원했어요.

w|mengemudi.text: Dia belajar mengemudi di akhir pekan.
w|mengemudi.en: He learns to drive on the weekend.

w|mengemudikan.text: Agus dan Dodi bergantian mengemudikan mobil setiap tiga jam.
w|mengemudikan.en: Agus and Dodi took turns driving the car every three hours.
w|mengemudikan.ko: 아구스와 도디는 세 시간마다 번갈아 운전했어요.

w|mengemudikan.text: Kakak Wati bekerja mengemudikan bus antarkota.
w|mengemudikan.en: Wati's older brother works driving an intercity bus.

w|mengenai.en: There is news about that project.

w|mengenai.text: Mengenai hal itu, aku belum tahu.
w|mengenai.en: Regarding that, I don't know yet.

w|mengenakan.en: He is wearing a blue jacket.

w|mengenal.text: Aku ingin mengenal kamu lebih dekat.
w|mengenal.en: I want to get to know you better.

w|mengenal.text: Dia tidak mengenal siapa pun di sini.

w|mengenali.en: I almost didn't recognize his face.
Recognizing those warning signs is important.
w|mengenali.ko: 그 위험 신호를 알아보는 게 중요해.

w|mengenalkan.text: Penyuluh pertanian mengenalkan bibit padi yang tahan kering kepada Budi.
w|mengenalkan.en: The agricultural extension officer introduced Budi to a drought-resistant rice seed.
w|mengenalkan.ko: 농업 지도원이 부디에게 가뭄에 강한 볍씨를 소개했어요.

w|mengenalkan.text: Sutradara mengenalkan Siti kepada penata kostum yang baru.
w|mengenalkan.en: The director introduced Siti to the new costume designer.
w|mengenalkan.ko: 감독이 시티에게 새 의상 담당자를 소개했어요.

w|mengenang.text: Fajar membeli bingkai foto untuk mengenang perjalanan bersama ayahnya.
w|mengenang.en: Fajar bought a photo frame to remember a trip with his father.
w|mengenang.ko: 파자르는 아버지와 함께한 여행을 추억하려고 사진 액자를 샀어요.

w|mengenang.text: Lestari membuat opor ayam untuk mengenang masakan almarhumah neneknya.
w|mengenang.en: Lestari made chicken opor in memory of her late grandmother's cooking.
w|mengenang.ko: 레스타리는 돌아가신 할머니의 음식을 추억하며 오포르 아얌을 만들었어요.

w|mengencani.text: Eko mulai mengencani gadis penjual es kelapa di ujung pantai.
w|mengencani.en: Eko started dating the girl who sells coconut ice at the end of the beach.
w|mengencani.ko: 에코는 해변 끝에서 코코넛 음료를 파는 아가씨와 사귀기 시작했어요.

w|mengencani.text: Bu Sri senang anaknya mengencani pemuda yang tinggal di gang sebelah.
w|mengencani.en: Mrs. Sri is happy that her daughter is dating a young man from the next alley.
w|mengencani.ko: 스리 아주머니는 딸이 옆 골목 청년과 사귀어서 기뻐해요.

w|mengencingi.text: Kucing tetangga sering mengencingi pot bunga di teras Andi.
w|mengencingi.en: The neighbor's cat often pees on the flower pots on Andi's porch.
w|mengencingi.ko: 이웃집 고양이가 안디네 현관 화분에 자주 오줌을 싸요.

w|mengencingi.text: Anak anjing Dewi mengencingi karpet di ruang latihan.
w|mengencingi.en: Dewi's puppy peed on the carpet in the practice room.
w|mengencingi.ko: 데위의 강아지가 연습실 카펫에 오줌을 쌌어요.

w|mengendalikan.en: He tries to control his emotions.

w|mengendalikan.text: Mengendalikan mobil di jalan licin sulit.
w|mengendalikan.en: Controlling a car on a slippery road is hard.

w|mengendarai.text: Dia mengendarai sepeda motor ke pasar.
w|mengendarai.en: She rides a motorcycle to the market.

w|mengendus.text: Anjing penjaga proyek mengendus tas Andi di gerbang.
w|mengendus.en: The site's guard dog sniffed Andi's bag at the gate.
w|mengendus.ko: 현장 경비견이 정문에서 안디의 가방 냄새를 맡았어요.

w|mengendus.text: Dewi mengendus aroma sate dari dapur restoran dan langsung lapar.
w|mengendus.en: Dewi caught the smell of satay from the restaurant kitchen and instantly got hungry.
w|mengendus.ko: 데위는 식당 주방에서 나는 사테 냄새를 맡고 금세 배가 고파졌어요.

w|mengepak.text: Eko mengepak kopi hasil panen ke dalam karung goni.
w|mengepak.en: Eko packed the harvested coffee into burlap sacks.
w|mengepak.ko: 에코는 수확한 커피를 마대 자루에 담았어요.

w|mengepak.text: Ayu mengepak kardus berisi sabun ke atas palet.
w|mengepak.en: Ayu packed boxes of soap onto the pallet.
w|mengepak.ko: 아유는 비누가 든 상자를 팔레트 위에 포장해 쌓았어요.

w|mengepung.text: Begitu Agus berhenti, anak-anak desa langsung mengepung mobilnya karena penasaran.
w|mengepung.en: As soon as Agus stopped, the village kids surrounded his car out of curiosity.
w|mengepung.ko: 아구스가 차를 세우자마자 마을 아이들이 궁금해서 차를 둘러쌌어요.

w|mengepung.text: Saat obral dibuka, para pembeli langsung mengepung rak sepatu.
w|mengepung.en: When the sale opened, shoppers immediately swarmed the shoe racks.
w|mengepung.ko: 세일이 시작되자 손님들이 곧바로 신발 진열대를 에워쌌어요.

w|mengerahkan.text: Tim SAR mengerahkan tiga perahu untuk mencari perenang yang hilang.
w|mengerahkan.en: The rescue team deployed three boats to search for the missing swimmer.
w|mengerahkan.ko: 구조대는 실종된 수영객을 찾으려고 보트 세 척을 동원했어요.

w|mengerahkan.text: Ketua RT mengerahkan warga untuk kerja bakti membersihkan selokan.
w|mengerahkan.en: The neighborhood head mobilized residents for a community clean-up of the gutters.
w|mengerahkan.ko: 반장은 주민들을 모아 도랑 청소 공동 작업을 했어요.

w|mengerang.text: Seorang buruh mengerang kesakitan karena tangannya terjepit, lalu segera dibawa ke klinik.
w|mengerang.en: A worker groaned in pain after his hand got caught, and was quickly taken to the clinic.
w|mengerang.ko: 한 노동자가 손이 끼어 신음했고 곧바로 의무실로 옮겨졌어요.

w|mengerang.text: Penumpang di belakang Intan mengerang karena telinganya sakit saat pesawat turun.
w|mengerang.en: The passenger behind Intan groaned because his ears hurt as the plane descended.
w|mengerang.ko: 비행기가 내려갈 때 인탄 뒷자리 승객이 귀가 아파서 신음했어요.

w|mengeras.text: Agus menunggu semen di lantai balkon mengeras sebelum memasang pot.
w|mengeras.en: Agus waited for the cement on the balcony floor to harden before putting down pots.
w|mengeras.ko: 아구스는 발코니 바닥 시멘트가 굳기를 기다렸다가 화분을 놓았어요.

w|mengeras.text: Wati menunggu agar-agar mengeras di kulkas sebelum dipotong.
w|mengeras.en: Wati waits for the agar jelly to set in the fridge before cutting it.
w|mengeras.ko: 와티는 한천 젤리가 냉장고에서 굳기를 기다렸다가 잘라요.

w|mengerikan.text: Mengerikan sekali cerita yang dia ceritakan.
w|mengerikan.en: The story he told was so terrifying.

w|mengering.text: Kalau hujan tidak turun minggu ini, kolam ikan Budi bisa mengering.
w|mengering.en: If it doesn't rain this week, Budi's fish pond could dry up.
w|mengering.ko: 이번 주에 비가 안 오면 부디의 물고기 연못이 마를 수도 있어요.

w|mengering.text: Siti menutup adonan dengan kain basah agar tidak mengering.
w|mengering.en: Siti covered the dough with a damp cloth so it wouldn't dry out.
w|mengering.ko: 시티는 반죽이 마르지 않게 젖은 천으로 덮었어요.

w|mengeringkan.text: Bayu mengeringkan rambut dengan handuk sebelum pulang.
w|mengeringkan.en: Bayu dries his hair with a towel before going home.
w|mengeringkan.ko: 바유는 집에 가기 전에 수건으로 머리를 말려요.

w|mengeringkan.text: Pelayan mengeringkan gelas-gelas dengan lap bersih sebelum ditata.
w|mengeringkan.en: The waiter dries the glasses with a clean cloth before setting them out.
w|mengeringkan.ko: 종업원은 유리컵을 놓기 전에 깨끗한 행주로 닦아 말려요.

w|mengerjai.text: Teman-teman pengantin pria mengerjai pengantin pria dengan menyembunyikan kunci mobilnya.
w|mengerjai.en: The groom's friends pranked him by hiding his car keys.
w|mengerjai.ko: 신랑 친구들은 차 열쇠를 숨겨서 신랑을 골탕 먹였어요.

w|mengerjai.text: Rekan kerja Rina mengerjai Rina dengan mengganti foto profilnya di sistem kantor.
w|mengerjai.en: Rina's coworker pranked Rina by changing her profile photo in the office system.
w|mengerjai.ko: 리나의 동료가 회사 시스템의 리나 프로필 사진을 바꿔서 리나를 골탕 먹였어요.

w|mengesampingkan.text: Demi melihat matahari terbit, Dimas rela mengesampingkan rasa kantuknya.
w|mengesampingkan.en: To see the sunrise, Dimas was willing to set aside his sleepiness.
w|mengesampingkan.ko: 일출을 보려고 디마스는 졸음을 기꺼이 뒤로 미뤘어요.

w|mengesampingkan.text: Untuk sementara, Putri harus mengesampingkan fitur baru dan fokus memperbaiki bug.
w|mengesampingkan.en: For now, Putri has to set aside new features and focus on fixing bugs.
w|mengesampingkan.ko: 당분간 푸트리는 새 기능은 미뤄 두고 버그 수정에 집중해야 해요.

w|mengesankan.en: His performance really impressed all the audience.
His exam results impressed the teachers.
w|mengesankan.ko: 그의 시험 결과가 선생님들을 놀라게 했어.

w|mengetahui.en: I want to know the truth.

w|mengetik.text: Bayu sedang mengetik laporan kantor ketika listrik gedung padam.
w|mengetik.en: Bayu was typing an office report when the building's power went out.
w|mengetik.ko: 바유가 회사 보고서를 타자 치고 있을 때 건물 전기가 나갔어요.

w|mengetik.text: Intan mengetik pesan untuk ibunya bahwa keretanya terlambat.
w|mengetik.en: Intan typed a message to her mother saying her train was late.
w|mengetik.ko: 인탄은 기차가 늦는다고 어머니께 문자를 쳤어요.

w|mengetuk.en: She knocked on the door gently.
Don't tap the table during the meeting.

w|mengevakuasi.text: Saat hujan deras turun, panitia mengevakuasi tamu dari tenda ke dalam rumah.
w|mengevakuasi.en: When heavy rain fell, the organizers moved the guests from the tent into the house.
w|mengevakuasi.ko: 폭우가 쏟아지자 진행 팀은 손님들을 천막에서 집 안으로 대피시켰어요.

w|mengevakuasi.text: Rina melaporkan bahwa tim SAR mengevakuasi warga dengan perahu karet.
w|mengevakuasi.en: Rina reported that the rescue team evacuated residents by rubber boat.
w|mengevakuasi.ko: 리나는 구조대가 고무보트로 주민들을 대피시켰다고 보도했어요.

w|mengevaluasi.text: Setiap akhir bulan, redaktur mengevaluasi jumlah pembaca setiap artikel Budi.
w|mengevaluasi.en: At the end of every month, the editor evaluates the readership of each of Budi's articles.
w|mengevaluasi.ko: 매달 말 편집자는 부디의 기사마다 독자 수를 평가해요.

w|mengevaluasi.text: Kepala perpustakaan mengevaluasi koleksi buku anak setiap enam bulan.
w|mengevaluasi.en: The head librarian evaluates the children's book collection every six months.
w|mengevaluasi.ko: 도서관장은 육 개월마다 어린이 도서를 평가해요.

w|menggabungkan.text: Dimas berencana menggabungkan kliniknya dengan toko makanan hewan di sebelah.
w|menggabungkan.en: Dimas plans to merge his clinic with the pet food shop next door.
w|menggabungkan.ko: 디마스는 병원을 옆집 반려동물 사료 가게와 합칠 계획이에요.

w|menggabungkan.text: Putri menggabungkan dua larutan itu di dalam tabung reaksi.
w|menggabungkan.en: Putri combined the two solutions in a test tube.
w|menggabungkan.ko: 푸트리는 두 용액을 시험관 안에서 섞었어요.

w|menggagalkan.text: Polisi berhasil menggagalkan penyelundupan satwa, dan Budi mendapat bahan berita.
w|menggagalkan.en: The police managed to foil an animal smuggling attempt, and Budi got material for a story.
w|menggagalkan.ko: 경찰이 동물 밀수를 막아 내자 부디는 기삿거리를 얻었어요.

w|menggagalkan.text: Hujan deras hampir menggagalkan acara bedah buku di taman perpustakaan.
w|menggagalkan.en: Heavy rain nearly ruined the book discussion event in the library garden.
w|menggagalkan.ko: 폭우 때문에 도서관 정원의 책 토론회가 하마터면 무산될 뻔했어요.

w|menggairahkan.text: Musik keroncong dari lapak sebelah menggairahkan suasana pagi bagi Agus.
w|menggairahkan.en: The keroncong music from the next stall livened up the morning for Agus.
w|menggairahkan.ko: 옆 노점의 끄론총 음악이 아구스의 아침 분위기를 들뜨게 했어요.

w|menggairahkan.text: Udara sejuk di awal musim hujan menggairahkan Wati untuk mulai berkebun lagi.
w|menggairahkan.en: The cool air at the start of the rainy season made Wati eager to start gardening again.
w|menggairahkan.ko: 우기 초입의 시원한 공기에 와티는 다시 텃밭 가꾸기에 의욕이 생겼어요.

w|menggaji.text: Perusahaan itu menggaji karyawannya tepat waktu setiap akhir bulan.
w|menggaji.en: The company pays its employees on time at the end of every month.
w|menggaji.ko: 그 회사는 매달 말에 직원들 월급을 제때 줘요.

w|menggaji.text: Perusahaan kecil itu belum mampu menggaji programmer senior.
w|menggaji.en: The small company can't yet afford to pay a senior programmer.
w|menggaji.ko: 그 작은 회사는 아직 선임 개발자에게 월급을 줄 형편이 안 돼요.

w|menggali.text: Mereka menggali lubang di kebun belakang.
w|menggali.en: They are digging a hole in the backyard garden.
w|menggali.ko: 그들은 뒷마당 텃밭에 구덩이를 파고 있어.

w|menggali.en: Digging into family history moved her deeply.

w|menggambar.text: Anak itu suka menggambar di buku catatan.
w|menggambar.en: That child likes to draw in a notebook.
w|menggambar.ko: 그 아이는 공책에 그림 그리기를 좋아해.

w|menggambar.text: Dia belajar menggambar wajah dengan pensil.
w|menggambar.en: She is learning to draw faces with a pencil.
w|menggambar.ko: 그는 연필로 얼굴 그리는 법을 배워.

w|menggambarkan.text: Dia mencoba menggambarkan perasaan yang rumit.
w|menggambarkan.en: She tried to describe those complicated feelings.
w|menggambarkan.ko: 그녀는 그 복잡한 감정을 묘사하려 했어.

w|menggandakan.text: Rudi menggandakan persediaan air karena rute besok jauh lebih panjang.
w|menggandakan.en: Rudi doubled his water supply because tomorrow's route is much longer.
w|menggandakan.ko: 내일 코스가 훨씬 길어서 루디는 물을 두 배로 챙겼어요.

w|menggandakan.text: Promotor menggandakan jumlah petugas keamanan untuk konser malam ini.
w|menggandakan.en: The promoter doubled the number of security staff for tonight's concert.
w|menggandakan.ko: 기획사는 오늘 밤 공연을 위해 경호 인력을 두 배로 늘렸어요.

w|mengganggu.en: Sorry, I don't want to disturb you.

w|mengganggu.text: Mengganggu orang lain itu tidak sopan.

w|menggantikan.text: Dia akan menggantikan manajer yang cuti.
w|menggantikan.en: She will replace the manager who is on leave.
w|menggantikan.ko: 그녀가 휴가 중인 매니저를 대신할 거야.

w|menggantikan.text: Susu bisa menggantikan krim dalam resep ini.
w|menggantikan.en: Milk can replace cream in this recipe.
w|menggantikan.ko: 이 레시피에서 우유가 크림을 대신할 수 있어.

w|menggantung.en: They hang lamps from the ceiling.

w|menggantung.text: Jaket itu menggantung di belakang pintu.
w|menggantung.en: That jacket hangs behind the door.
w|menggantung.ko: 그 재킷이 문 뒤에 걸려 있어.

w|menggantungkan.text: Budi menggantungkan kantong infus baru di tiang samping ranjang.
w|menggantungkan.en: Budi hung a new IV bag on the pole beside the bed.
w|menggantungkan.ko: 부디는 침대 옆 거치대에 새 수액 주머니를 걸었어요.

w|menggantungkan.text: Siti menggantungkan tas kecil di pegangan koper agar tangan tetap bebas.
w|menggantungkan.en: Siti hung her small bag on the suitcase handle to keep her hands free.
w|menggantungkan.ko: 시티는 손이 자유롭도록 작은 가방을 캐리어 손잡이에 걸었어요.

w|menggapai.text: Dimas berjinjit untuk menggapai brosur di rak paling atas.
w|menggapai.en: Dimas stood on tiptoe to reach the brochure on the top shelf.
w|menggapai.ko: 디마스는 맨 위 칸 안내 책자를 잡으려고 발끝을 들었어요.

w|menggapai.text: Dalam adegan itu, Putri harus menggapai tangan lawan mainnya yang hampir jatuh dari tebing.
w|menggapai.en: In that scene, Putri has to reach for the hand of her co-star who is about to fall off a cliff.
w|menggapai.ko: 그 장면에서 푸트리는 절벽에서 떨어지려는 상대 배우의 손을 잡아야 해요.

w|menggaruk.text: Anjing itu tidak berhenti menggaruk telinganya, jadi Rudi memeriksa kutunya.
w|menggaruk.en: The dog wouldn't stop scratching its ear, so Rudi checked it for fleas.
w|menggaruk.ko: 개가 귀를 계속 긁어서 루디는 벼룩이 있는지 살펴봤어요.

w|menggaruk.text: Rina menggaruk lengannya yang digigit serangga di kebun teh.
w|menggaruk.en: Rina scratched her arm where an insect had bitten her in the tea garden.
w|menggaruk.ko: 리나는 차밭에서 벌레에 물린 팔을 긁었어요.

w|menggelar.text: Warga menggelar tikar di jalan untuk syukuran, dan Andi membawa nasi kuning.
w|menggelar.en: The residents spread mats on the street for a thanksgiving meal, and Andi brought yellow rice.
w|menggelar.ko: 주민들이 감사 잔치를 하려고 길에 돗자리를 깔았고 안디는 노란 밥을 가져왔어요.

w|menggelar.text: Sekolah musik Dewi menggelar resital akhir tahun di gedung kesenian.
w|menggelar.en: Dewi's music school holds a year-end recital at the arts center.
w|menggelar.ko: 데위의 음악 학교는 예술 회관에서 연말 발표회를 열어요.

w|menggeledah.text: Petugas pelabuhan menggeledah kapal yang dicurigai membawa ikan ilegal.
w|menggeledah.en: Port officers searched a boat suspected of carrying illegal fish.
w|menggeledah.ko: 항구 직원들이 불법 생선을 실었다고 의심되는 배를 수색했어요.

w|menggeledah.text: Polisi menggeledah rumah kosong di ujung gang setelah ada laporan pencurian.
w|menggeledah.en: The police searched the empty house at the end of the alley after a theft report.
w|menggeledah.ko: 도난 신고가 들어온 뒤 경찰이 골목 끝 빈집을 수색했어요.

w|menggelikan.text: Budi menulis kisah menggelikan tentang kucingnya yang tidur di dalam kardus surat.
w|menggelikan.en: Budi writes a funny story about his cat sleeping in the letter box.
w|menggelikan.ko: 부디는 편지 상자 안에서 자는 고양이에 관한 우스운 이야기를 써요.

w|menggelikan.text: Seorang pelari memakai kostum pisang yang menggelikan.
w|menggelikan.en: One runner wore a ridiculous banana costume.
w|menggelikan.ko: 한 주자가 우스꽝스러운 바나나 옷을 입었어요.

w|menggelitik.text: Judul berita yang aneh itu menggelitik rasa ingin tahu Bayu.
w|menggelitik.en: That strange news headline tickled Bayu's curiosity.
w|menggelitik.ko: 그 이상한 기사 제목이 바유의 호기심을 자극했어요.

w|menggelitik.text: Iklan diskon besar-besaran itu menggelitik Intan untuk membuka aplikasi belanja lagi.
w|menggelitik.en: The big discount ad tempted Intan to open the shopping app again.
w|menggelitik.ko: 대폭 할인 광고에 끌려 인탄은 쇼핑 앱을 또 열었어요.

w|menggema.text: Suara Dimas menggema di ruang rapat yang masih kosong.
w|menggema.en: Dimas's voice echoed in the still-empty meeting room.
w|menggema.ko: 아직 텅 빈 회의실에 디마스의 목소리가 울렸어요.

w|menggema.text: Pengumuman keberangkatan menggema di seluruh terminal saat Putri tiba.
w|menggema.en: The departure announcement echoed through the whole terminal as Putri arrived.
w|menggema.ko: 푸트리가 도착했을 때 출발 안내 방송이 터미널 전체에 울려 퍼졌어요.

w|menggemaskan.text: Rudi mengirim foto anak kucing yang menggemaskan untuk mencairkan suasana dengan kakaknya.
w|menggemaskan.en: Rudi sent a photo of an adorable kitten to break the ice with his sister.
w|menggemaskan.ko: 루디는 누나와 분위기를 풀려고 귀여운 새끼 고양이 사진을 보냈어요.

w|menggemaskan.text: Rina tertawa melihat anak anjing menggemaskan yang mengejar ombak.
w|menggemaskan.en: Rina laughed at the adorable puppy chasing the waves.
w|menggemaskan.ko: 리나는 파도를 쫓는 귀여운 강아지를 보고 웃었어요.

w|menggendong.text: Fajar mencari gendongan bayi untuk kakaknya yang sering menggendong anak ke pasar.
w|menggendong.en: Fajar looked for a baby carrier for his sister, who often carries her child to the market.
w|menggendong.ko: 파자르는 아이를 자주 안고 시장에 가는 누나에게 줄 아기띠를 찾았어요.

w|menggendong.text: Seorang peserta datang sambil menggendong bayinya yang sedang tidur.
w|menggendong.en: A participant arrived carrying her sleeping baby.
w|menggendong.ko: 한 참가자가 잠든 아기를 안고 왔어요.

w|menggenggam.text: Saat wawancara, nenek penjual jamu itu menggenggam tangan Bayu erat-erat.
w|menggenggam.en: During the interview, the herbal drink seller grandma held Bayu's hand tightly.
w|menggenggam.ko: 인터뷰하는 동안 자무 파는 할머니가 바유의 손을 꼭 잡았어요.

w|menggenggam.text: Intan menggenggam ponselnya erat-erat saat menunggu kabar dari investor.
w|menggenggam.en: Intan clutched her phone tightly while waiting for news from the investors.
w|menggenggam.ko: 인탄은 투자자 소식을 기다리며 휴대폰을 꼭 쥐고 있었어요.

w|menggerakkan.text: Satu motor listrik cukup untuk menggerakkan seluruh ban berjalan.
w|menggerakkan.en: One electric motor is enough to drive the whole conveyor belt.
w|menggerakkan.ko: 전기 모터 하나면 컨베이어 벨트 전체를 돌리기에 충분해요.

w|menggerakkan.text: Petugas menggerakkan tangga menuju pintu pesawat.
w|menggerakkan.en: The staff moved the stairs up to the plane's door.
w|menggerakkan.ko: 직원들이 계단을 비행기 문 쪽으로 옮겼어요.

w|menggeram.text: Kucing liar di belakang dapur menggeram saat Fajar membuang sisa ikan.
w|menggeram.en: The stray cat behind the kitchen growled when Fajar threw out the fish scraps.
w|menggeram.ko: 파자르가 생선 찌꺼기를 버릴 때 주방 뒤 길고양이가 으르렁거렸어요.

w|menggeram.text: Anjing penjaga lapak sebelah menggeram setiap kali ada orang memegang dagangan.
w|menggeram.en: The guard dog at the next stall growls whenever someone touches the goods.
w|menggeram.ko: 옆 노점 경비견은 누가 물건을 만질 때마다 으르렁거려요.

w|menggertak.text: Tokoh preman dalam drama itu menggertak pedagang kecil di pasar.
w|menggertak.en: The thug character in the play intimidates small traders at the market.
w|menggertak.ko: 그 연극의 깡패 역은 시장의 작은 상인들을 위협해요.

w|menggertak.text: Ayu tidak takut walau anak tetangga mencoba menggertak dia dengan cerita hantu.
w|menggertak.en: Ayu isn't scared even though the neighbor's kid tries to frighten her with ghost stories.
w|menggertak.ko: 이웃집 아이가 귀신 이야기로 겁을 주려 해도 아유는 무서워하지 않아요.

w|menggerutu.text: Warga yang menunggu lama mulai menggerutu, jadi Fajar membuka loket tambahan.
w|menggerutu.en: Residents who had waited a long time started grumbling, so Fajar opened an extra counter.
w|menggerutu.ko: 오래 기다린 주민들이 투덜대기 시작해서 파자르는 창구를 하나 더 열었어요.

w|menggerutu.text: Lestari mengaku masih suka menggerutu kalau harus bangun pagi.
w|menggerutu.en: Lestari admitted she still grumbles when she has to get up early.
w|menggerutu.ko: 레스타리는 아직도 일찍 일어나야 하면 투덜댄다고 털어놨어요.

w|menggigil.text: Pasien itu menggigil karena demam tinggi, lalu Budi menambah selimut.
w|menggigil.en: The patient was shivering with a high fever, so Budi added another blanket.
w|menggigil.ko: 환자가 고열로 덜덜 떨어서 부디가 담요를 한 장 더 덮어 줬어요.

w|menggigil.text: Siti menggigil di ruang tunggu karena AC terlalu dingin.
w|menggigil.en: Siti was shivering in the waiting lounge because the air conditioning was too cold.
w|menggigil.ko: 에어컨이 너무 세서 시티는 대합실에서 덜덜 떨었어요.

w|menggigit.en: That dog bit the old shoe.
Don't bite your nails when nervous.

w|menggiring.text: Ayah pelan-pelan menggiring pembicaraan Rudi dan kakaknya ke pokok masalah.
w|menggiring.en: Dad slowly steered Rudi and his sister's conversation to the heart of the problem.
w|menggiring.ko: 아빠는 루디와 누나의 대화를 천천히 문제의 핵심으로 이끌었어요.

w|menggiring.text: Anak-anak desa menggiring bola di pasir basah sambil berteriak gembira.
w|menggiring.en: The village kids dribbled a ball on the wet sand, shouting happily.
w|menggiring.ko: 마을 아이들이 젖은 모래 위에서 신나게 소리치며 공을 몰았어요.

w|menggoda.text: Bau kue menggoda semua orang di rumah.
w|menggoda.en: The smell of cake tempted everyone at home.
Don't tease your sibling until they get angry.

w|menggonggong.text: Anjing penjaga gedung tiba-tiba menggonggong saat adegan paling sunyi.
w|menggonggong.en: The building's guard dog suddenly barked during the quietest scene.
w|menggonggong.ko: 건물 경비견이 가장 조용한 장면에서 갑자기 짖었어요.

w|menggonggong.text: Anjing Ayu selalu menggonggong kalau ada orang asing masuk desa.
w|menggonggong.en: Ayu's dog always barks when a stranger enters the village.
w|menggonggong.ko: 아유의 개는 낯선 사람이 마을에 들어오면 늘 짖어요.

w|menggoreng.text: Ibu kantin sedang menggoreng tempe ketika Dimas datang untuk makan siang.
w|menggoreng.en: The canteen lady was frying tempeh when Dimas came for lunch.
w|menggoreng.ko: 디마스가 점심을 먹으러 왔을 때 식당 아주머니는 템페를 튀기고 있었어요.

w|menggoreng.text: Bau orang menggoreng kentang di restoran cepat saji tercium sampai ke kursi Putri.
w|menggoreng.en: The smell of fries being cooked at the fast-food restaurant reached Putri's seat.
w|menggoreng.ko: 패스트푸드점에서 감자 튀기는 냄새가 푸트리의 자리까지 풍겼어요.

w|menggores.text: Dimas memasang plester setelah pecahan botol menggores jari.
w|menggores.en: Dimas put on a plaster after a shard of glass scratched his finger.
w|menggores.ko: 디마스는 병 조각에 손가락이 긁힌 뒤 반창고를 붙였어요.

w|menggores.text: Putri berhati-hati agar tangga tidak menggores lantai kayu yang baru dipoles.
w|menggores.en: Putri was careful not to let the ladder scratch the freshly polished wooden floor.
w|menggores.ko: 푸트리는 새로 광낸 나무 바닥이 사다리에 긁히지 않게 조심했어요.

w|menggosok.text: Rudi teringat Bayu yang dulu suka menggosok sepatu sekolah sampai mengilap.
w|menggosok.en: Rudi remembered how Bayu used to polish his school shoes until they shone.
w|menggosok.ko: 루디는 바유가 예전에 학교 구두를 반짝일 때까지 닦곤 하던 게 떠올랐어요.

w|menggosok.text: Sebelum tamu penting datang, Pak Joko menggosok meja rapat sampai bersih.
w|menggosok.en: Before the important guests arrived, Mr. Joko scrubbed the meeting table clean.
w|menggosok.ko: 중요한 손님이 오기 전에 조코 씨가 회의 탁자를 깨끗이 닦았어요.

w|menggoyangkan.text: Angin malam menggoyangkan tenda Eko sampai berbunyi keras.
w|menggoyangkan.en: The night wind shook Eko's tent until it rattled loudly.

w|menggoyangkan.text: Ayu menggoyangkan pergelangan kaki untuk pemanasan sebelum start.
w|menggoyangkan.en: Ayu rolled her ankles to warm up before the start.
w|menggoyangkan.ko: 아유는 출발 전에 몸을 풀려고 발목을 돌렸어요.

w|menggugat.text: Di kantor hukum itu, Dimas ikut menyiapkan berkas untuk warga yang ingin menggugat sebuah pabrik.
w|menggugat.en: At the law firm, Dimas helped prepare files for residents who wanted to sue a factory.
w|menggugat.ko: 그 법률 사무소에서 디마스는 공장을 고소하려는 주민들의 서류 준비를 도왔어요.

w|menggugat.text: Putri mendengar seorang penumpang mengancam akan menggugat maskapai karena bagasinya hilang.
w|menggugat.en: Putri heard a passenger threaten to sue the airline because his luggage was lost.
w|menggugat.ko: 푸트리는 한 승객이 짐을 잃어버렸다며 항공사를 고소하겠다고 하는 걸 들었어요.

w|menggulingkan.text: Karena kesal, adik Rudi tidak sengaja menggulingkan gelas di meja makan.
w|menggulingkan.en: Out of frustration, Rudi's little brother accidentally knocked over a glass on the dining table.
w|menggulingkan.ko: 루디의 동생은 짜증이 나서 실수로 식탁 위 컵을 넘어뜨렸어요.

w|menggulingkan.text: Beberapa nelayan bersama-sama menggulingkan batang kayu untuk menurunkan perahu ke air.
w|menggulingkan.en: Several fishermen rolled logs together to get the boat down into the water.
w|menggulingkan.ko: 어부 몇 명이 함께 통나무를 굴려 배를 물에 띄웠어요.

w|menggulung.text: Setelah pesta, Rudi menggulung karpet merah yang dipakai di pintu masuk.
w|menggulung.en: After the party, Rudi rolled up the red carpet used at the entrance.
w|menggulung.ko: 잔치가 끝나고 루디는 입구에 깔았던 빨간 카펫을 말았어요.

w|menggulung.text: Rina menggulung koran edisi pertama dan menyimpannya sebagai kenang-kenangan.
w|menggulung.en: Rina rolled up the first-edition paper and kept it as a souvenir.
w|menggulung.ko: 리나는 창간호 신문을 말아서 기념으로 간직했어요.

w|mengguncang.text: Gempa kecil sempat mengguncang perkemahan saat Eko sedang tidur.
w|mengguncang.en: A small earthquake shook the campsite while Eko was asleep.
w|mengguncang.ko: 에코가 자는 동안 작은 지진이 캠프장을 흔들었어요.

w|mengguncang.text: Sorakan ribuan penonton seakan mengguncang garis finis.
w|mengguncang.en: The cheers of thousands of spectators seemed to shake the finish line.
w|mengguncang.ko: 수천 명 관중의 함성이 결승선을 뒤흔드는 것 같았어요.

w|menghabisi.text: Diorama itu menggambarkan pasukan kerajaan yang berusaha menghabisi para pemberontak.
w|menghabisi.en: The diorama shows royal troops trying to wipe out the rebels.
w|menghabisi.ko: 그 디오라마는 반란군을 몰살하려는 왕의 군대를 보여 줘요.

w|menghabisi.text: Rina memasang perangkap untuk menghabisi tikus yang merusak karung berasnya.
w|menghabisi.en: Rina set a trap to get rid of the rats damaging her rice sacks.
w|menghabisi.ko: 리나는 쌀자루를 망가뜨리는 쥐를 없애려고 덫을 놓았어요.

w|menghadang.text: Seekor angsa galak menghadang Rudi di halaman peternakan.
w|menghadang.en: A fierce goose blocked Rudi's way in the farmyard.
w|menghadang.ko: 사나운 거위 한 마리가 농장 마당에서 루디의 앞을 막아섰어요.

w|menghadang.text: Kabut tebal menghadang langkah Rina di jalan menuju sekolah.
w|menghadang.en: Thick fog blocked Rina's way on the road to school.
w|menghadang.ko: 짙은 안개가 학교 가는 길에서 리나의 앞을 가로막았어요.

w|menghadap.text: Agus dipanggil untuk menghadap kepala dinas pukul sepuluh pagi.
w|menghadap.en: Agus was summoned to see the head of the department at ten in the morning.
w|menghadap.ko: 아구스는 오전 열 시에 국장 앞에 불려 갔어요.

w|menghadap.text: Saat bermain cello, Wati duduk menghadap jendela.
w|menghadap.en: When she plays the cello, Wati sits facing the window.
w|menghadap.ko: 첼로를 켤 때 와티는 창문을 바라보고 앉아요.

w|menghadapi.en: We have to face the problem.
She's afraid to face the truth.

w|menghadiri.text: Dia akan menghadiri upacara di balai kota.
w|menghadiri.en: She will attend the ceremony at city hall.

w|menghadiri.text: Banyak orang menghadiri konser malam itu.
w|menghadiri.en: Many people attended the concert that night.
w|menghadiri.ko: 그날 밤 많은 사람이 콘서트에 갔어.

w|menghadirkan.text: Apotek tempat Dimas bekerja menghadirkan layanan antar obat untuk lansia.
w|menghadirkan.en: The pharmacy where Dimas works now offers medicine delivery for the elderly.
w|menghadirkan.ko: 디마스가 일하는 약국은 어르신을 위한 약 배달 서비스를 시작했어요.

w|menghadirkan.text: Putri ingin menghadirkan suasana hangat dengan lampu kuning di ruang tamu.
w|menghadirkan.en: Putri wants to create a warm atmosphere with yellow lights in the living room.
w|menghadirkan.ko: 푸트리는 거실에 노란 조명을 달아 따뜻한 분위기를 내고 싶어 해요.

w|menghafal.text: Rudi sampai menghafal kata-kata maaf yang ingin diucapkan kepada kakaknya.
w|menghafal.en: Rudi even memorized the apology he wanted to say to his sister.
w|menghafal.ko: 루디는 누나에게 할 사과의 말을 외우기까지 했어요.

w|menghafal.text: Anak pemilik penginapan menghafal nama-nama ikan dalam bahasa Inggris untuk tamu.
w|menghafal.en: The guesthouse owner's child memorized fish names in English for the guests.
w|menghafal.ko: 숙소 주인의 아이는 손님들을 위해 물고기 이름을 영어로 외웠어요.

w|menghajar.en: That thug tried to beat up the vendor.

w|menghajar.text: Menghajar lawan bukan cara yang baik.
w|menghajar.en: Beating up an opponent is not a good way.
w|menghajar.ko: 상대를 때리는 건 좋은 방법이 아니야.

w|menghakimi.text: Eko belajar untuk tidak menghakimi orang hanya dari penampilannya.
w|menghakimi.en: Eko learned not to judge people just by their appearance.
w|menghakimi.ko: 에코는 겉모습만 보고 사람을 판단하지 않는 법을 배웠어요.

w|menghakimi.text: Ayu tidak mau ikut menghakimi tetangga yang jarang keluar rumah.
w|menghakimi.en: Ayu doesn't want to join in judging the neighbor who rarely leaves the house.
w|menghakimi.ko: 아유는 집 밖에 잘 나오지 않는 이웃을 함께 흉보고 싶지 않아요.

w|menghalangi.en: A fallen tree is blocking the main road.

w|menghalangi.text: Menghalangi orang lain bukan sikap baik.
w|menghalangi.en: Blocking other people is not a good attitude.
w|menghalangi.ko: 다른 사람을 가로막는 건 좋은 태도가 아니야.
