w|menghambat.text: Genangan air setelah hujan menghambat pengunjung ke lapak Agus.
w|menghambat.en: The puddles after the rain kept visitors from reaching Agus's stall.
w|menghambat.ko: 비 온 뒤 물웅덩이 때문에 손님들이 아구스의 노점에 오기 힘들었어요.

w|menghambat.text: Hujan deras menghambat perjalanan Wati ke kantor pagi ini.
w|menghambat.en: Heavy rain held up Wati's trip to the office this morning.
w|menghambat.ko: 오늘 아침 폭우 때문에 와티의 출근길이 늦어졌어요.

w|menghampiri.text: Seorang anak kecil menghampiri Rudi dan meminta difoto bersama pengantin.
w|menghampiri.en: A small child came up to Rudi and asked to be photographed with the bride and groom.
w|menghampiri.ko: 꼬마 하나가 루디에게 다가와 신랑 신부와 사진을 찍어 달라고 했어요.

w|menghampiri.text: Setelah konferensi pers, Rina menghampiri menteri untuk bertanya satu hal lagi.
w|menghampiri.en: After the press conference, Rina approached the minister to ask one more question.
w|menghampiri.ko: 기자회견이 끝나고 리나는 한 가지를 더 물으려고 장관에게 다가갔어요.

w|menghangatkan.text: Perapian kecil itu cukup untuk menghangatkan ruang keluarga saat malam.
w|menghangatkan.en: The small fireplace is enough to warm the family room at night.
w|menghangatkan.ko: 그 작은 벽난로면 밤에 거실을 데우기에 충분해요.

w|menghangatkan.text: Dewi memesan teh panas untuk menghangatkan tangannya yang dingin.
w|menghangatkan.en: Dewi orders hot tea to warm her cold hands.
w|menghangatkan.ko: 데위는 찬 손을 녹이려고 뜨거운 차를 시켜요.

w|menghantam.text: Rudi juga bercerita bahwa ombak besar menghantam perahu nelayan di desanya minggu lalu.
w|menghantam.en: Rudi also told how big waves struck the fishing boats in his village last week.
w|menghantam.ko: 루디는 지난주 큰 파도가 마을 어선들을 덮쳤다는 이야기도 했어요.

w|menghantam.text: Krisis ekonomi menghantam banyak perusahaan rintisan kecil tahun ini.
w|menghantam.en: The economic crisis hit many small startups this year.
w|menghantam.ko: 올해 경제 위기가 작은 스타트업 여러 곳을 강타했어요.

w|menghantui.text: Kesalahan kecil di kantor lama masih menghantui pikiran Rina.
w|menghantui.en: A small mistake at her old office still haunts Rina's mind.
w|menghantui.ko: 예전 회사에서 한 작은 실수가 아직도 리나의 머릿속을 맴돌아요.

w|menghantui.text: Para pegawai suka bercerita tentang hantu yang konon menghantui lantai tiga.
w|menghantui.en: The staff like telling stories about a ghost that supposedly haunts the third floor.
w|menghantui.ko: 직원들은 삼 층에 귀신이 나온다는 이야기를 즐겨 해요.

w|menghapus.text: Dia menghapus catatan lama dari papan.
w|menghapus.en: He erased the old notes from the board.

w|menghapuskan.text: Sutradara memutuskan untuk menghapuskan satu adegan agar pertunjukan tidak terlalu panjang.
w|menghapuskan.en: The director decided to cut one scene so the show wouldn't be too long.
w|menghapuskan.ko: 감독은 공연이 너무 길지 않도록 장면 하나를 없애기로 했어요.

w|menghapuskan.text: Ayu berencana menghapuskan sistem utang karena banyak pelanggan lupa membayar.
w|menghapuskan.en: Ayu plans to do away with the credit system because many customers forget to pay.
w|menghapuskan.ko: 손님들이 자꾸 갚는 걸 잊어서 아유는 외상 제도를 없앨 생각이에요.

w|mengharap.text: Para petani di desa Dimas mengharap hujan turun minggu ini.
w|mengharap.en: The farmers in Dimas's village are hoping for rain this week.
w|mengharap.ko: 디마스네 마을 농부들은 이번 주에 비가 내리기를 바라고 있어요.

w|mengharap.text: Putri mengharap kabar baik dari perusahaan yang dia lamar.
w|mengharap.en: Putri is hoping for good news from the company she applied to.
w|mengharap.ko: 푸트리는 지원한 회사에서 좋은 소식이 오기를 바라고 있어요.

w|mengharapkan.en: We are hoping for good news.
Don't expect quick results too much.

w|mengharuskan.text: Aturan taman nasional mengharuskan Eko membawa pulang semua sampahnya.
w|mengharuskan.en: The national park rules require Eko to take all his trash back with him.
w|mengharuskan.ko: 국립공원 규칙상 에코는 쓰레기를 모두 가져가야 해요.

w|mengharuskan.text: Lomba itu mengharuskan setiap peserta menyerahkan surat keterangan sehat.
w|mengharuskan.en: The race requires every participant to submit a health certificate.
w|mengharuskan.ko: 그 대회는 참가자 모두에게 건강 진단서를 내라고 해요.

w|menghasilkan.en: That venture is starting to make money.

w|menghela.text: Agus menghela napas panjang ketika melihat sampah plastik tersangkut di batu.
w|menghela.en: Agus sighed deeply when he saw plastic trash caught on the rocks.
w|menghela.ko: 아구스는 바위에 걸린 플라스틱 쓰레기를 보고 긴 한숨을 쉬었어요.

w|menghela.text: Wati menghela napas lega setelah stok obat demam akhirnya datang.
w|menghela.en: Wati breathed a sigh of relief when the fever medicine stock finally arrived.
w|menghela.ko: 해열제 재고가 드디어 도착하자 와티는 안도의 한숨을 쉬었어요.

w|menghemat.text: Fajar sering belanja saat ada gratis ongkir supaya bisa menghemat uang.
w|menghemat.en: Fajar often shops when there's free shipping so he can save money.
w|menghemat.ko: 파자르는 돈을 아끼려고 무료 배송일 때 자주 쇼핑해요.

w|menghemat.text: Guru mengajari cara menghemat minyak saat menggoreng tahu.
w|menghemat.en: The teacher taught how to save oil when frying tofu.
w|menghemat.ko: 선생님은 두부를 튀길 때 기름을 아끼는 법을 가르쳐 줬어요.

w|menghembuskan.text: Budi menghembuskan napas lega setelah ujian matematika selesai.
w|menghembuskan.en: Budi let out a sigh of relief after the math exam ended.
w|menghembuskan.ko: 수학 시험이 끝나자 부디는 안도의 숨을 내쉬었어요.

w|menghembuskan.text: Siti menghembuskan napas panjang saat akhirnya duduk di kursi pesawat.
w|menghembuskan.en: Siti let out a long breath when she finally sat down in her plane seat.
w|menghembuskan.ko: 시티는 마침내 비행기 좌석에 앉자 긴 숨을 내쉬었어요.

w|menghentikan.en: He tried to stop the fight.

w|mengherankan.text: Yang mengherankan bagi Dimas, hampir semua orang di kantor itu memakai sandal.
w|mengherankan.en: What surprised Dimas was that almost everyone in that office wore sandals.
w|mengherankan.ko: 디마스가 놀란 건 그 사무실 사람들이 거의 다 샌들을 신는다는 거였어요.

w|mengherankan.text: Antrean imigrasi kosong pagi itu, hal yang cukup mengherankan bagi Putri.
w|mengherankan.en: The immigration queue was empty that morning, which Putri found rather surprising.
w|mengherankan.ko: 그날 아침 출입국 심사 줄이 텅 비어 있어서 푸트리는 꽤 놀랐어요.

w|menghias.text: Agus menghias kue ulang tahun dengan krim biru dan bintang gula.
w|menghias.en: Agus decorated the birthday cake with blue cream and sugar stars.
w|menghias.ko: 아구스는 생일 케이크를 파란 크림과 설탕 별로 장식했어요.

w|menghias.text: Tim Wati menghias kantor dengan balon untuk ulang tahun perusahaan.
w|menghias.en: Wati's team decorated the office with balloons for the company's anniversary.
w|menghias.ko: 와티의 팀은 회사 창립 기념일에 사무실을 풍선으로 꾸몄어요.

w|menghiasi.text: Foto karya Bayu menghiasi halaman depan koran edisi Minggu.
w|menghiasi.en: Bayu's photo graced the front page of the Sunday edition.
w|menghiasi.ko: 바유가 찍은 사진이 일요일 판 일 면을 장식했어요.

w|menghiasi.text: Intan menghiasi pintu rumahnya dengan janur untuk menyambut pesta panen.
w|menghiasi.en: Intan decorated her front door with young coconut leaves to welcome the harvest festival.
w|menghiasi.ko: 인탄은 추수 잔치를 맞아 어린 야자잎으로 집 문을 장식했어요.

w|menghibur.en: That clown is good at entertaining children.
w|menghibur.ko: 그 광대가 아이들을 잘 즐겁게 해.

w|menghibur.text: Teman datang menghibur setelah dia sedih.
w|menghibur.en: A friend came to cheer her up after she was sad.
w|menghibur.ko: 슬플 때 친구가 와서 위로해 줬어.

w|menghidupkan.text: Tolong menghidupkan lampu di ruang tamu.
w|menghidupkan.en: Please turn on the light in the living room.

w|menghidupkan.text: Mereka berhasil menghidupkan kembali mesin tua itu.
w|menghidupkan.en: They managed to revive that old machine.
w|menghidupkan.ko: 그들은 그 낡은 기계를 다시 살리는 데 성공했어.

w|menghilangkan.text: Obat ini membantu menghilangkan rasa sakit.
w|menghilangkan.en: This medicine helps eliminate the pain.
w|menghilangkan.ko: 이 약이 통증을 없애는 데 도와줘.

w|menghilangkan.text: Dia ingin menghilangkan jejak masa lalu.
w|menghilangkan.en: He wants to erase the traces of the past.

w|menghina.text: Jangan menghina orang yang sedang kesulitan.
w|menghina.en: Do not insult people who are struggling.
His words insulted his classmate's feelings.
w|menghina.ko: 그의 말이 반 친구의 기분을 상하게 했어.

w|menghindar.text: Wali kota berusaha menghindar dari wartawan yang menunggu di tangga depan.
w|menghindar.en: The mayor tried to avoid the reporters waiting on the front steps.
w|menghindar.ko: 시장은 앞 계단에서 기다리는 기자들을 피하려고 했어요.

w|menghindar.text: Wati tidak bisa menghindar lagi dari ujian piano bulan depan.
w|menghindar.en: Wati can't avoid next month's piano exam any longer.
w|menghindar.ko: 와티는 다음 달 피아노 시험을 더는 피할 수 없어요.

w|menghipnotis.text: Rina bercanda bahwa Budi pasti sudah menghipnotis Ibu supaya selalu dibela.
w|menghipnotis.en: Rina joked that Budi must have hypnotized Mom so she would always take his side.
w|menghipnotis.ko: 리나는 부디가 엄마를 최면에 걸어서 늘 편을 들게 만든 게 분명하다고 농담했어요.

w|menghipnotis.text: Pemandangan sawah dari jendela baru seolah menghipnotis Siti.
w|menghipnotis.en: The view of the rice fields from the new window seemed to hypnotize Siti.
w|menghipnotis.ko: 새 창문으로 보이는 논 풍경에 시티는 넋을 잃은 듯했어요.

w|menghiraukan.text: Pekerja yang menghiraukan aturan helm akan langsung ditegur mandor.
w|menghiraukan.en: Workers who ignore the helmet rule are reprimanded by the foreman immediately.
w|menghiraukan.ko: 안전모 규정을 무시하는 인부는 반장에게 바로 지적을 받아요.

w|menghiraukan.text: Penjual itu menghiraukan keluhan Wati sampai ia memberi ulasan bintang satu.
w|menghiraukan.en: The seller ignored Wati's complaint until she gave a one-star review.
w|menghiraukan.ko: 그 판매자는 와티가 별점 하나짜리 후기를 남길 때까지 불만을 무시했어요.

w|menghirup.text: Eko menghirup udara laut dalam-dalam sambil menutup mata.
w|menghirup.en: Eko breathed in the sea air deeply with his eyes closed.
w|menghirup.ko: 에코는 눈을 감고 바다 공기를 깊이 들이마셨어요.

w|menghirup.text: Ayu menghirup aroma rendang dari dapur Bu Sri.
w|menghirup.en: Ayu breathed in the smell of rendang from Mrs. Sri's kitchen.
w|menghirup.ko: 아유는 스리 아주머니 부엌에서 나는 른당 냄새를 들이마셨어요.

w|menghitung.en: That child is counting his money.
w|menghitung.ko: 그 아이는 자기 돈을 세고 있어.

w|menghubungi.en: It's hard to reach him now.

w|menghubungkan.text: Guru Eko memasang kabel untuk menghubungkan laptop dengan proyektor.
w|menghubungkan.en: Eko's teacher plugged in a cable to connect the laptop to the projector.
w|menghubungkan.ko: 에코의 선생님은 노트북을 프로젝터에 연결하려고 케이블을 꽂았어요.

w|menghubungkan.text: Kakak Ayu sibuk menghubungkan televisi baru ke internet.
w|menghubungkan.en: Ayu's older brother is busy connecting the new TV to the internet.
w|menghubungkan.ko: 아유의 오빠는 새 텔레비전을 인터넷에 연결하느라 바빠요.

w|menghukum.en: The judge will punish that offender.

w|menghukum.text: Menghukum anak dengan marah tidak membantu.
w|menghukum.en: Punishing a child in anger does not help.
w|menghukum.ko: 화나서 아이를 벌주는 건 도움이 안 돼.

w|menghuni.text: Kepiting kecil menghuni lubang-lubang di pasir dekat pos jaga Eko.
w|menghuni.en: Little crabs live in the holes in the sand near Eko's post.
w|menghuni.ko: 작은 게들이 에코의 초소 근처 모래 구멍에 살아요.

w|menghuni.text: Bakteri yang menghuni mulut bisa merusak gusi, jelas dokter kepada Ayu.
w|menghuni.en: The bacteria that live in the mouth can damage the gums, the dentist explained to Ayu.
w|menghuni.ko: 입안에 사는 세균이 잇몸을 상하게 할 수 있다고 의사가 아유에게 설명했어요.

w|mengidap.text: Anjing tua milik Pak Joko ternyata mengidap penyakit ginjal.
w|mengidap.en: Mr. Joko's old dog turned out to have kidney disease.
w|mengidap.ko: 조코 씨의 늙은 개는 알고 보니 신장병을 앓고 있었어요.

w|mengidap.text: Nenek Siti mengidap asma, jadi kabut pagi sering membuatnya sesak.
w|mengidap.en: Siti's grandmother has asthma, so the morning fog often makes her short of breath.
w|mengidap.ko: 시티의 할머니는 천식이 있어서 아침 안개에 자주 숨이 차요.

w|mengidentifikasi.text: Para ahli masih berusaha mengidentifikasi asal patung batu tanpa kepala itu.
w|mengidentifikasi.en: Experts are still trying to identify the origin of the headless stone statue.
w|mengidentifikasi.ko: 전문가들은 머리 없는 그 돌 조각상의 출처를 아직 밝히려 하고 있어요.

w|mengidentifikasi.text: Dengan sekali cium, Rina bisa mengidentifikasi beras wangi asli.
w|mengidentifikasi.en: With one sniff, Rina can identify genuine fragrant rice.
w|mengidentifikasi.ko: 리나는 냄새 한 번만 맡아도 진짜 향미를 알아봐요.

w|mengikat.text: Dia mengikat tali sepatu dengan rapat.

w|mengikat.en: Please tie the package before it is sent.

w|mengikatkan.text: Budi mengikatkan pita merah pada bungkusan hadiah untuk Rudi.
w|mengikatkan.en: Budi tied a red ribbon onto the gift package for Rudi.
w|mengikatkan.ko: 부디는 루디에게 보낼 선물 꾸러미에 빨간 리본을 묶었어요.

w|mengikatkan.text: Menjelang hari kemerdekaan, Siti mengikatkan bendera di tiang depan rumah.
w|mengikatkan.en: Ahead of Independence Day, Siti tied the flag to the pole in front of her house.
w|mengikatkan.ko: 독립기념일을 앞두고 시티는 집 앞 깃대에 국기를 달았어요.

w|mengilap.text: Foto mobil dinas yang mengilap itu menjadi bahan laporan Bayu tentang anggaran daerah.
w|mengilap.en: The photo of the shiny official car became material for Bayu's report on the regional budget.
w|mengilap.ko: 번쩍이는 관용차 사진이 바유의 지역 예산 기사 재료가 됐어요.

w|mengilap.text: Intan memesan sepatu kulit yang tampak mengilap di foto produk.
w|mengilap.en: Intan ordered leather shoes that looked shiny in the product photo.
w|mengilap.ko: 인탄은 상품 사진에서 반짝여 보이는 가죽 구두를 주문했어요.

w|mengimpor.text: Perusahaan tempat Fajar bekerja mengimpor mesin kopi dari luar negeri.
w|mengimpor.en: The company where Fajar works imports coffee machines from abroad.
w|mengimpor.ko: 파자르가 다니는 회사는 해외에서 커피 머신을 수입해요.

w|mengimpor.text: Pengguna bisa mengimpor kontak dari ponsel lama hanya dengan sekali klik.
w|mengimpor.en: Users can import contacts from their old phone with just one click.
w|mengimpor.ko: 사용자는 클릭 한 번으로 옛 휴대폰의 연락처를 가져올 수 있어요.

w|menginap.text: Kami akan menginap di hotel dekat pantai.
w|menginap.en: We will stay overnight at a hotel near the beach.
w|menginap.ko: 우리는 해변 근처 호텔에 묵을 거야.

w|menginap.text: Dia menginap di rumah teman semalam.
w|menginap.en: He stayed overnight at a friend's house last night.

w|mengincar.text: Dimas sudah lama mengincar buku resep yang selalu dipinjam orang.
w|mengincar.en: Dimas has long had his eye on a cookbook that someone always borrows.
w|mengincar.ko: 디마스는 늘 대출 중인 요리책을 오래전부터 노리고 있었어요.

w|mengincar.text: Pencopet biasanya mengincar penumpang yang tertidur di kereta malam.
w|mengincar.en: Pickpockets usually target passengers who fall asleep on night trains.
w|mengincar.ko: 소매치기는 보통 밤 기차에서 잠든 승객을 노려요.

w|mengindikasikan.text: Hasil tes gula darah mengindikasikan bahwa pembeli itu perlu ke dokter.
w|mengindikasikan.en: The blood sugar test indicated that the customer needed to see a doctor.
w|mengindikasikan.ko: 혈당 검사 결과는 그 손님이 병원에 가야 한다는 걸 보여 줬어요.

w|mengindikasikan.text: Raut wajah rekan baru mengindikasikan bahwa tugas itu terlalu berat.
w|mengindikasikan.en: The new coworker's expression indicated that the task was too heavy.
w|mengindikasikan.ko: 새 동료의 표정은 그 일이 너무 버겁다는 걸 보여 줬어요.

w|menginfeksi.text: Dimas menjelaskan bahwa jamur bisa menginfeksi kuku kaki.
w|menginfeksi.en: Dimas explained that fungus can infect the toenails.
w|menginfeksi.ko: 디마스는 곰팡이가 발톱을 감염시킬 수 있다고 설명했어요.

w|menginfeksi.text: Putri membersihkan luka di jari agar bakteri tidak menginfeksi luka itu.
w|menginfeksi.en: Putri cleaned the cut on her finger so bacteria wouldn't infect it.
w|menginfeksi.ko: 푸트리는 세균이 감염되지 않게 손가락 상처를 닦았어요.

w|menginformasikan.text: Pihak sekolah menginformasikan lewat pesan bahwa kelas besok dimulai lebih awal.
w|menginformasikan.en: The school notified everyone by message that tomorrow's class starts earlier.
w|menginformasikan.ko: 학교 측은 내일 수업이 더 일찍 시작한다고 메시지로 알렸어요.

w|menginformasikan.text: Dewi menginformasikan alamat barunya kepada Rani di akhir surat.
w|menginformasikan.en: Dewi gave Rani her new address at the end of the letter.
w|menginformasikan.ko: 데위는 편지 끝에 라니에게 새 주소를 알려 줬어요.

w|mengingat.en: It's hard to remember every detail.

w|mengingatkan.text: Ibu mengingatkan aku untuk membawa jaket.
w|mengingatkan.en: Mom reminded me to bring a jacket.

w|mengingatkan.text: Mengingatkan dia tentang janji itu penting.
w|mengingatkan.en: Reminding him about that promise is important.
w|mengingatkan.ko: 그 약속에 대해 그를 상기시키는 게 중요해.

w|mengingkari.text: Pemasok itu mengingkari janji, jadi Andi kekurangan besi beton.
w|mengingkari.en: The supplier broke his promise, so Andi ran short of rebar.
w|mengingkari.ko: 그 납품업자가 약속을 어겨서 안디는 철근이 모자랐어요.

w|mengingkari.text: Dewi menagih traktiran dari Rudi yang dulu mengingkari janji.
w|mengingkari.en: Dewi demanded the treat Rudi had promised long ago and never delivered.
w|mengingkari.ko: 데위는 예전에 약속을 어긴 루디에게 한턱내라고 졸랐어요.

w|menginjak.text: Rudi tidak sengaja menginjak paku dan langsung dibawa ke klinik.
w|menginjak.en: Rudi accidentally stepped on a nail and was taken straight to the clinic.
w|menginjak.ko: 루디는 실수로 못을 밟아서 바로 진료소에 실려 갔어요.

w|menginjak.text: Rina tidak sengaja menginjak kabel dan laptop rekannya hampir jatuh.
w|menginjak.en: Rina accidentally stepped on a cable and her colleague's laptop nearly fell.
w|menginjak.ko: 리나가 실수로 전선을 밟아서 동료의 노트북이 떨어질 뻔했어요.

w|menginjak-injak.text: Kerbau tetangga masuk ke kebun dan menginjak-injak bibit cabai Eko.
w|menginjak-injak.en: The neighbor's water buffalo got into the garden and trampled Eko's chili seedlings.
w|menginjak-injak.ko: 이웃집 물소가 밭에 들어와 에코의 고추 모종을 마구 짓밟았어요.

w|menginjak-injak.text: Seorang pekerja kesal sampai menginjak-injak kardus rusak di gudang.
w|menginjak-injak.en: A worker got so annoyed that he stomped all over a damaged box in the warehouse.
w|menginjak-injak.ko: 한 직원은 화가 나서 창고에 있던 망가진 상자를 마구 밟았어요.

w|menginjakkan.text: Turis itu baru pertama kali menginjakkan kaki di pantai berpasir hitam, kata Eko.
w|menginjakkan.en: That tourist had set foot on a black-sand beach for the first time, Eko said.
w|menginjakkan.ko: 그 관광객은 검은 모래 해변에 처음 발을 디뎠다고 에코가 말했어요.

w|menginjakkan.text: Sudah lima tahun Ayu tidak menginjakkan kaki di klinik gigi.
w|menginjakkan.en: Ayu hadn't set foot in a dental clinic for five years.
w|menginjakkan.ko: 아유는 오 년 동안 치과에 발을 들이지 않았어요.

w|menginspirasi.text: Liputan Budi tentang guru honorer menginspirasi banyak pembaca untuk berdonasi.
w|menginspirasi.en: Budi's coverage of contract teachers inspired many readers to donate.
w|menginspirasi.ko: 비정규직 교사에 관한 부디의 기사는 많은 독자가 기부하도록 영감을 줬어요.

w|menginspirasi.text: Siti ingin perpustakaan menginspirasi anak-anak untuk menulis cerita sendiri.
w|menginspirasi.en: Siti wants the library to inspire children to write their own stories.
w|menginspirasi.ko: 시티는 도서관이 아이들에게 직접 이야기를 쓰도록 영감을 주길 바라요.

w|mengintai.text: Wartawan foto itu mengintai dari seberang jalan, menunggu sang menteri keluar.
w|mengintai.en: The photojournalist lay in wait across the street, waiting for the minister to come out.
w|mengintai.ko: 그 사진기자는 장관이 나오기를 기다리며 길 건너편에서 지켜봤어요.

w|mengintai.text: Intan bercanda bahwa pesaing mereka pasti sedang mengintai fitur baru di aplikasi.
w|mengintai.en: Intan joked that their competitors must be spying on the app's new features.
w|mengintai.ko: 인탄은 경쟁사가 앱 새 기능을 엿보고 있을 거라고 농담했어요.

w|menginterogasi.text: Dalam berita di radio toko, polisi masih menginterogasi tersangka pencurian.
w|menginterogasi.en: In the news on the shop's radio, police were still interrogating the theft suspect.
w|menginterogasi.ko: 가게 라디오 뉴스에서는 경찰이 아직 절도 용의자를 조사하고 있다고 했어요.

w|menginterogasi.text: Di film yang ditonton Lestari semalam, detektif menginterogasi seorang pelari.
w|menginterogasi.en: In the film Lestari watched last night, a detective interrogated a runner.
w|menginterogasi.ko: 레스타리가 어젯밤 본 영화에서 형사가 한 달리기 선수를 심문했어요.

w|mengintimidasi.text: Anjing besar di ujung gang suka menggonggong untuk mengintimidasi tamu Andi.
w|mengintimidasi.en: The big dog at the end of the alley likes to bark to intimidate Andi's guests.
w|mengintimidasi.ko: 골목 끝 큰 개는 안디네 손님을 겁주려고 짖곤 해요.

w|mengintimidasi.text: Patung raksasa di pintu masuk dibuat untuk mengintimidasi musuh, kata pemandu kepada Dewi.
w|mengintimidasi.en: The giant statue at the entrance was made to intimidate enemies, the guide told Dewi.
w|mengintimidasi.ko: 입구의 거대한 석상은 적을 겁주려고 만든 거라고 가이드가 데위에게 말했어요.

w|mengintip.text: Beberapa siswa mengintip nilai ujian lewat jendela ruang guru.
w|mengintip.en: Some students peeked at the exam results through the staff room window.
w|mengintip.ko: 몇몇 학생이 교무실 창문으로 시험 점수를 몰래 엿봤어요.

w|mengintip.text: Siti mengintip daftar tamu untuk melihat apakah mantan ketua kelas datang.
w|mengintip.en: Siti peeked at the guest list to see whether the former class president was coming.
w|mengintip.ko: 시티는 전 반장이 오는지 보려고 방명록을 슬쩍 봤어요.

w|menginvestasikan.text: Perusahaan tempat Andi bekerja menginvestasikan banyak uang untuk alat berat baru.
w|menginvestasikan.en: The company Andi works for invested a lot of money in new heavy machinery.
w|menginvestasikan.ko: 안디가 일하는 회사는 새 중장비에 많은 돈을 투자했어요.

w|menginvestasikan.text: Dewi mendengar seorang teman menginvestasikan tabungan di kebun kopi.
w|menginvestasikan.en: Dewi heard that a friend had invested his savings in a coffee plantation.
w|menginvestasikan.ko: 데위는 한 친구가 저금을 커피 농장에 투자했다는 얘기를 들었어요.

w|mengira.en: I thought you had already left.
w|mengira.ko: 난 네가 이미 간 줄 알았어.

w|mengirim.en: He forgot to send the letter.

w|mengirimi.text: Setiap bulan Dimas mengirimi pemilik hewan pengingat jadwal vaksinasi.
w|mengirimi.en: Every month Dimas sends pet owners reminders of the vaccination schedule.
w|mengirimi.ko: 디마스는 매달 반려동물 주인들에게 예방접종 일정 알림을 보내요.

w|mengirimi.text: Putri mengirimi pembimbingnya hasil percobaan lewat surel.
w|mengirimi.en: Putri sent her supervisor the experiment results by email.
w|mengirimi.ko: 푸트리는 지도교수에게 실험 결과를 이메일로 보냈어요.

w|mengirimkan.text: Dia mengirimkan paket ke luar kota.
w|mengirimkan.en: She sent a package out of town.
The office will send official invitations.

w|mengiris.text: Ibu kantin mengiris semangka untuk Dimas dan teman-teman barunya.
w|mengiris.en: The canteen lady sliced a watermelon for Dimas and his new friends.
w|mengiris.ko: 식당 아주머니가 디마스와 새 동료들을 위해 수박을 썰어 줬어요.

w|mengiris.text: Di lounge bandara, seorang koki mengiris daging panggang untuk Putri.
w|mengiris.en: In the airport lounge, a chef sliced roast meat for Putri.
w|mengiris.ko: 공항 라운지에서 요리사가 푸트리에게 구운 고기를 썰어 줬어요.

w|mengisap.text: Asisten dokter memakai alat kecil untuk mengisap air liur Agus.
w|mengisap.en: The dental assistant used a small tool to suck up Agus's saliva.
w|mengisap.ko: 치과 보조원이 작은 기구로 아구스의 침을 빨아들였어요.

w|mengisap.text: Wati memakai mesin penyedot untuk mengisap debu dari celah lantai kayu.
w|mengisap.en: Wati used a vacuum to suck the dust out of the gaps in the wooden floor.
w|mengisap.ko: 와티는 청소기로 나무 바닥 틈의 먼지를 빨아들였어요.

w|mengisi.text: Tolong mengisi formulir ini dengan lengkap.
w|mengisi.en: Please fill out this form completely.

w|mengisi.text: Dia sedang mengisi botol dengan air dingin.
w|mengisi.en: She is filling the bottle with cold water.
w|mengisi.ko: 그는 병에 차가운 물을 채우고 있어.

w|mengisolasi.text: Saat wabah cacar air, sekolah Eko mengisolasi murid yang sakit di ruang UKS.
w|mengisolasi.en: During the chickenpox outbreak, Eko's school isolated sick students in the sick bay.
w|mengisolasi.ko: 수두가 돌 때 에코의 학교는 아픈 학생들을 보건실에 격리했어요.

w|mengisolasi.text: Ayu memakai selotip kertas untuk mengisolasi bagian kanvas yang tidak boleh terkena cat.
w|mengisolasi.en: Ayu used masking tape to isolate the part of the canvas that mustn't get paint on it.
w|mengisolasi.ko: 아유는 물감이 묻으면 안 되는 캔버스 부분을 마스킹 테이프로 막았어요.

w|mengitari.text: Mobil patroli Rudi mengitari kompleks perumahan itu beberapa kali sebelum kembali ke kantor.
w|mengitari.en: Rudi's patrol car circled the housing complex several times before returning to the station.
w|mengitari.ko: 루디의 순찰차는 그 주택 단지를 몇 바퀴 돈 뒤 경찰서로 돌아왔어요.

w|mengitari.text: Rute maraton tahun ini mengitari danau besar di tengah kota.
w|mengitari.en: This year's marathon route goes around the big lake in the middle of the city.
w|mengitari.ko: 올해 마라톤 코스는 도시 한가운데 큰 호수를 한 바퀴 돌아요.

w|mengizinkan.text: Ibu mengizinkan kami bermain di luar.
w|mengizinkan.en: Mom allowed us to play outside.

w|mengizinkan.text: Guru tidak mengizinkan HP di kelas.
w|mengizinkan.en: The teacher does not allow phones in class.
w|mengizinkan.ko: 선생님이 수업 중 폰을 허락하지 않아.

w|mengkhawatirkan.text: Kondisi jalan itu mengkhawatirkan para pengemudi.
w|mengkhawatirkan.en: That road condition worries the drivers.
His test result worried his parents.

w|mengkhianati.en: He will not betray his friends.

w|mengklaim.text: Seorang bapak mengklaim bahwa buku yang hilang itu sudah ia kembalikan.
w|mengklaim.en: A man claimed that he had already returned the missing book.
w|mengklaim.ko: 한 아저씨는 없어진 책을 이미 반납했다고 주장했어요.

w|mengklaim.text: Seorang penumpang mengklaim kursi Putri, padahal tiketnya untuk gerbong lain.
w|mengklaim.en: A passenger claimed Putri's seat, even though his ticket was for another carriage.
w|mengklaim.ko: 한 승객이 푸트리 자리를 자기 자리라고 우겼는데 표는 다른 칸 것이었어요.

w|mengklik.text: Di kantor proyek, Rudi mengklik tombol kirim untuk melaporkan kemajuan harian.
w|mengklik.en: At the site office, Rudi clicked the send button to report the daily progress.
w|mengklik.ko: 루디는 현장 사무실에서 전송 버튼을 눌러 그날 진척 상황을 보고했어요.

w|mengklik.text: Rina diminta mengklik tautan untuk mengaktifkan email kantornya.
w|mengklik.en: Rina was asked to click a link to activate her work email.
w|mengklik.ko: 리나는 회사 이메일을 활성화하려고 링크를 눌러 달라는 안내를 받았어요.

w|mengkritik.text: Eko tidak keberatan kalau penonton mengkritik naskah barunya.
w|mengkritik.en: Eko doesn't mind if the audience criticizes his new script.
w|mengkritik.ko: 에코는 관객이 새 대본을 비판해도 개의치 않아요.

w|mengkritik.text: Beberapa warga mengkritik kepala desa karena jalan menuju kebun belum diperbaiki.
w|mengkritik.en: Some residents criticized the village head because the road to the gardens hasn't been repaired.
w|mengkritik.ko: 몇몇 주민은 밭으로 가는 길을 아직 안 고쳤다고 이장을 비판했어요.

w|mengobati.text: Dimas sudah sepuluh tahun mengobati hewan di kota kecil itu.
w|mengobati.en: Dimas has been treating animals in that small town for ten years.
w|mengobati.ko: 디마스는 그 작은 도시에서 십 년째 동물을 치료하고 있어요.

w|mengobati.text: Tim Putri meneliti senyawa dari daun sirih untuk mengobati infeksi kulit.
w|mengobati.en: Putri's team is studying a compound from betel leaves to treat skin infections.
w|mengobati.ko: 푸트리 팀은 피부 감염을 치료하려고 구장잎 성분을 연구해요.

w|mengobrol.text: Waktu jam kosong, Budi dan Andi mengobrol di bangku belakang.
w|mengobrol.en: During a free period, Budi and Andi chatted in the back row.
w|mengobrol.ko: 자습 시간에 부디와 안디는 뒷자리에서 수다를 떨었어요.

w|mengobrol.text: Sambil istirahat, Siti mengobrol dengan ibu-ibu tetangga di teras.
w|mengobrol.en: While taking a break, Siti chatted with the neighborhood women on the porch.
w|mengobrol.ko: 쉬는 동안 시티는 테라스에서 이웃 아주머니들과 이야기를 나눴어요.

w|mengoceh.text: Adik kelas Dimas terus mengoceh tentang gim baru selama perjalanan pulang.
w|mengoceh.en: Dimas's junior kept chattering about a new game all the way home.
w|mengoceh.ko: 디마스의 후배는 집에 가는 내내 새 게임 이야기를 떠들었어요.

w|mengoceh.text: Burung beo di dekat kasir suka mengoceh setiap ada tamu masuk.
w|mengoceh.en: The parrot near the cashier likes to chatter whenever a guest comes in.
w|mengoceh.ko: 계산대 옆 앵무새는 손님이 들어올 때마다 재잘거려요.

w|mengocok.text: Di penginapan, teman Bayu mengocok kartu untuk main sampai larut malam.
w|mengocok.en: At the guesthouse, Bayu's friend shuffled the cards to play until late at night.
w|mengocok.ko: 숙소에서 바유의 친구가 밤늦게까지 놀려고 카드를 섞었어요.

w|mengocok.text: Sebelum dipakai, Intan mengocok botol tinta supaya warnanya rata.
w|mengocok.en: Before using it, Intan shook the ink bottle so the color would be even.
w|mengocok.ko: 인탄은 쓰기 전에 색이 고르게 섞이도록 잉크병을 흔들었어요.

w|mengolah.text: Andi meminjam buku tentang cara mengolah sampah dapur menjadi pupuk.
w|mengolah.en: Andi borrowed a book on how to turn kitchen waste into fertilizer.
w|mengolah.ko: 안디는 음식물 쓰레기를 비료로 만드는 법에 관한 책을 빌렸어요.

w|mengolah.text: Tugas Dewi adalah mengolah data penjualan menjadi grafik yang mudah dibaca.
w|mengolah.en: Dewi's job is to turn sales data into easy-to-read charts.
w|mengolah.ko: 디위의 일은 판매 자료를 보기 쉬운 그래프로 정리하는 거예요.

w|mengolok-olok.text: Andi menegur pekerja yang mengolok-olok rekan barunya.
w|mengolok-olok.en: Andi reprimanded the worker who was making fun of his new coworker.
w|mengolok-olok.ko: 안디는 새 동료를 놀리던 인부를 꾸짖었어요.

w|mengolok-olok.text: Teman-teman dulu sering mengolok-olok kacamata tebal Dewi.
w|mengolok-olok.en: Her friends used to make fun of Dewi's thick glasses.
w|mengolok-olok.ko: 친구들은 예전에 데위의 두꺼운 안경을 자주 놀렸어요.

w|mengomel.text: Redaktur senior itu suka mengomel kalau berita masuk terlambat.
w|mengomel.en: That senior editor likes to grumble when stories come in late.
w|mengomel.ko: 그 선임 편집자는 기사가 늦게 들어오면 투덜대곤 해요.

w|mengomel.text: Intan mengomel karena paketnya terlambat tiga hari.
w|mengomel.en: Intan grumbled because her package was three days late.

w|mengompol.text: Anak anjing itu mengompol di meja periksa karena takut pada Rudi.
w|mengompol.en: The puppy wet itself on the exam table because it was scared of Rudi.
w|mengompol.ko: 강아지가 루디를 무서워해서 진찰대 위에 오줌을 쌌어요.

w|mengompol.text: Adik bungsu Rina masih suka mengompol kalau malamnya terlalu dingin.
w|mengompol.en: Rina's youngest sibling still tends to wet the bed when the night is too cold.
w|mengompol.ko: 리나의 막내 동생은 밤이 너무 추우면 아직도 이불에 오줌을 싸요.

w|mengonfirmasi.text: Hasil laboratorium mengonfirmasi bahwa anjing itu terkena cacing jantung.
w|mengonfirmasi.en: The lab results confirmed that the dog had heartworm.
w|mengonfirmasi.ko: 검사 결과 그 개가 심장사상충에 걸린 게 확인됐어요.

w|mengonfirmasi.text: Putri menelepon pemasok untuk mengonfirmasi pengiriman bahan kimia.
w|mengonfirmasi.en: Putri called the supplier to confirm the chemical delivery.
w|mengonfirmasi.ko: 푸트리는 화학약품 배송을 확인하려고 공급업체에 전화했어요.

w|mengonsumsi.text: Nenek Fajar tidak boleh mengonsumsi makanan manis, jadi disiapkan menu khusus.
w|mengonsumsi.en: Fajar's grandmother can't eat sweet food, so a special menu was prepared.
w|mengonsumsi.ko: 파자르의 할머니는 단 음식을 드시면 안 돼서 특별 메뉴를 준비했어요.

w|mengonsumsi.text: Lestari menulis tentang bahaya mengonsumsi minuman berenergi secara berlebihan.
w|mengonsumsi.en: Lestari wrote about the dangers of consuming too many energy drinks.
w|mengonsumsi.ko: 레스타리는 에너지 음료를 지나치게 마시는 위험에 대해 썼어요.

w|mengontrol.text: Dia belajar mengontrol emosi saat stres.
w|mengontrol.en: She is learning to control emotions under stress.
w|mengontrol.ko: 그녀는 스트레스 속에서 감정을 조절하는 법을 배워.

w|mengontrol.text: Operator harus mengontrol mesin dengan teliti.
w|mengontrol.en: The operator must control the machine carefully.

w|mengoper.text: Anak-anak mengoper bola kepada Eko di sela-sela permainan voli pantai.
w|mengoper.en: The kids passed the ball to Eko during a game of beach volleyball.
w|mengoper.ko: 아이들이 비치발리볼 경기 중에 에코에게 공을 넘겼어요.

w|mengoper.text: Dokter mengoper alat kecil kepada perawat sambil terus bicara dengan Ayu.
w|mengoper.en: The dentist passed a small tool to the nurse while still talking to Ayu.
w|mengoper.ko: 의사는 아유와 계속 이야기하면서 작은 기구를 간호사에게 건넸어요.

w|mengoperasi.text: Dokter harus mengoperasi lutut pelatih Bayu setelah cedera saat bertanding.
w|mengoperasi.en: The doctor had to operate on Bayu's trainer's knee after an injury during a match.
w|mengoperasi.ko: 바유 트레이너는 시합 중 다친 무릎을 의사에게 수술받아야 했어요.

w|mengoperasi.text: Paman Intan bercerita bahwa dokter akan mengoperasi matanya bulan depan.
w|mengoperasi.en: Intan's uncle says the doctor will operate on his eye next month.
w|mengoperasi.ko: 인탄의 삼촌은 다음 달에 눈 수술을 받는다고 이야기해요.

w|mengoperasikan.text: Eko belajar mengoperasikan kompor gas portabel dari pemandu.
w|mengoperasikan.en: Eko learned how to operate the portable gas stove from the guide.
w|mengoperasikan.ko: 에코는 가이드에게 휴대용 가스버너 쓰는 법을 배웠어요.

w|mengoperasikan.text: Ayu belajar mengoperasikan jam tangan pintar untuk memantau detak jantung.
w|mengoperasikan.en: Ayu learned to operate her smartwatch to monitor her heart rate.
w|mengoperasikan.ko: 아유는 심박수를 보려고 스마트워치 쓰는 법을 배웠어요.

w|mengorbankan.text: Dia bersedia mengorbankan waktu untuk keluarga.
w|mengorbankan.en: She is willing to sacrifice time for family.
w|mengorbankan.ko: 그는 가족을 위해 시간을 희생할 준비가 돼 있어.

w|mengoreksi.text: Bu Guru mengoreksi PR Agus dengan tinta hijau.
w|mengoreksi.en: The teacher corrected Agus's homework in green ink.
w|mengoreksi.ko: 선생님은 아구스의 숙제를 초록 잉크로 고쳐 줬어요.

w|mengoreksi.text: Pelatih mengoreksi posisi tangan Wati saat gaya bebas.
w|mengoreksi.en: The coach corrected the position of Wati's hands in freestyle.
w|mengoreksi.ko: 코치는 자유형할 때 와티의 손 위치를 고쳐 줬어요.

w|mengosongkan.text: Sebelum musim hujan, Budi mengosongkan selokan dari sampah dan daun.
w|mengosongkan.en: Before the rainy season, Budi clears rubbish and leaves out of the gutter.
w|mengosongkan.ko: 우기가 오기 전에 부디는 도랑의 쓰레기와 낙엽을 치워요.

w|mengosongkan.text: Kru mengosongkan jalan selama satu jam untuk adegan kejar-kejaran.
w|mengosongkan.en: The crew cleared the street for an hour for the chase scene.
w|mengosongkan.ko: 제작진은 추격 장면을 위해 한 시간 동안 거리를 비웠어요.

w|mengotori.text: Eko meminta penonton tidak mengotori kursi dengan sisa makanan.
w|mengotori.en: Eko asks the audience not to dirty the seats with leftover food.
w|mengotori.ko: 에코는 관객들에게 남은 음식으로 좌석을 더럽히지 말라고 부탁해요.

w|mengotori.text: Warga desa sepakat tidak mengotori mata air dengan sampah plastik.
w|mengotori.en: The villagers agreed not to pollute the spring with plastic waste.
w|mengotori.ko: 마을 사람들은 샘물을 플라스틱 쓰레기로 더럽히지 않기로 했어요.

w|menguap.text: Rudi menguap berkali-kali karena menulis surat itu sampai tengah malam.
w|menguap.en: Rudi yawned again and again because he wrote the letter until midnight.
w|menguap.ko: 루디는 자정까지 편지를 쓰느라 몇 번이나 하품을 했어요.

w|menguap.text: Rina menguap di depan laptop setelah bekerja semalaman.
w|menguap.en: Rina yawned in front of her laptop after working all night.
w|menguap.ko: 리나는 밤새 일한 뒤 노트북 앞에서 하품했어요.

w|menguasai.text: Dia sudah menguasai bahasa asing itu.
w|menguasai.en: She has already mastered that foreign language.
The troops managed to take control of that city.
w|menguasai.ko: 부대가 그 도시를 장악하는 데 성공했어.

w|menguatkan.text: Tepuk tangan penonton menguatkan semangat para pemain baru.
w|menguatkan.en: The audience's applause boosted the new actors' spirits.
w|menguatkan.ko: 관객의 박수가 신인 배우들에게 힘을 북돋아 줬어요.

w|menguatkan.text: Warga menanam bambu untuk menguatkan tanah di lereng yang rawan longsor.
w|menguatkan.en: The villagers plant bamboo to strengthen the soil on slopes prone to landslides.
w|menguatkan.ko: 주민들은 산사태가 잦은 비탈의 흙을 다지려고 대나무를 심어요.

w|mengubah.en: He wants to change his life.

w|mengubur.text: Mereka akan mengubur hewan peliharaan di kebun.
w|mengubur.en: They will bury the pet in the garden.
Don't bury your feelings for too long.
w|mengubur.ko: 감정을 너무 오래 묻어 두지 마.

w|menguburkan.text: Di desa itu, Agus ikut warga menguburkan seorang kakek yang meninggal karena usia tua.
w|menguburkan.en: In that village, Agus joined the residents in burying an old man who died of old age.
w|menguburkan.ko: 그 마을에서 아구스는 노환으로 돌아가신 할아버지의 장례를 주민들과 함께 치렀어요.

w|menguburkan.text: Wati izin dua hari untuk menguburkan neneknya di desa.
w|menguburkan.en: Wati took two days off to bury her grandmother in her village.
w|menguburkan.ko: 와티는 고향에서 할머니 장례를 치르려고 이틀 휴가를 냈어요.

w|mengucap.text: Fajar mengucap terima kasih kepada timnya setelah proyek besar itu selesai.
w|mengucap.en: Fajar said thank you to his team after the big project was finished.
w|mengucap.ko: 큰 프로젝트가 끝난 뒤 파자르는 팀원들에게 고맙다고 말했어요.

w|mengucap.text: Sebelum rapat dengan investor, Lestari mengucap doa singkat dalam hati.
w|mengucap.en: Before the meeting with investors, Lestari said a short prayer to herself.
w|mengucap.ko: 투자자 회의 전에 레스타리는 속으로 짧게 기도했어요.

w|mengucapkan.text: Dia mengucapkan terima kasih dengan tulus.

w|mengucapkan.en: Saying that word made him nervous.

w|mengudara.text: Wawancara Fajar dengan wali kota akan mengudara di radio besok pagi.
w|mengudara.en: Fajar's interview with the mayor will air on the radio tomorrow morning.
w|mengudara.ko: 파자르의 시장 인터뷰는 내일 아침 라디오로 방송돼요.

w|mengudara.text: Lestari mendengarkan acara radio lokal yang baru saja mengudara.
w|mengudara.en: Lestari listened to a local radio show that had just gone on air.
w|mengudara.ko: 레스타리는 막 방송을 시작한 지역 라디오 프로그램을 들었어요.

w|menguji.text: Guru menguji pemahaman siswa hari ini.
w|menguji.en: The teacher tested the students' understanding today.

w|menguji.text: Mereka menguji mesin baru di pabrik.
w|menguji.en: They tested the new machine at the factory.

w|mengukir.text: Seorang perajin mengukir nama kedua pengantin di papan kayu jati.
w|mengukir.en: A craftsman carved the names of the bride and groom on a teak board.
w|mengukir.ko: 장인이 티크 나무판에 신랑 신부 이름을 새겼어요.

w|mengukir.text: Lestari mengukir inisial namanya di batang pohon mangga waktu kecil.
w|mengukir.en: As a child, Lestari carved her initials into the trunk of a mango tree.
w|mengukir.ko: 레스타리는 어릴 때 망고나무 줄기에 이름 머리글자를 새겼어요.

w|mengukur.text: Agus memakai aplikasi untuk mengukur jarak dari pantai ke penginapan.
w|mengukur.en: Agus used an app to measure the distance from the beach to the guesthouse.
w|mengukur.ko: 아구스는 앱으로 해변에서 숙소까지 거리를 쟀어요.

w|mengukur.text: Wati mengukur lingkar pinggang pelanggan sebelum memotong celana.
w|mengukur.en: Wati measured the customer's waist before shortening the trousers.
w|mengukur.ko: 와티는 바지를 줄이기 전에 손님의 허리둘레를 쟀어요.

w|mengulang.en: Can you repeat that once more?
I have to review this lesson.

w|mengulangi.text: Pelanggan senang dan berjanji akan mengulangi pesanan minggu depan.
w|mengulangi.en: The customer was happy and promised to repeat the order next week.
w|mengulangi.ko: 손님은 만족해서 다음 주에도 같은 주문을 하겠다고 했어요.

w|mengulangi.text: Lestari ingin mengulangi catatan waktu terbaiknya tahun lalu.
w|mengulangi.en: Lestari wants to repeat her best time from last year.
w|mengulangi.ko: 레스타리는 작년의 최고 기록을 다시 세우고 싶어 해요.

w|menguliti.text: Di dapur sekolah, Budi belajar menguliti bawang tanpa menangis.
w|menguliti.en: In the school kitchen, Budi learned to peel onions without crying.
w|menguliti.ko: 학교 조리실에서 부디는 울지 않고 양파 껍질 벗기는 법을 배웠어요.

w|menguliti.text: Siti membaca ulasan yang menguliti pelayanan buruk maskapai murah itu.
w|menguliti.en: Siti read a review that tore apart the budget airline's poor service.
w|menguliti.ko: 시티는 그 저가 항공사의 형편없는 서비스를 낱낱이 파헤친 후기를 읽었어요.

w|mengulurkan.text: Agus mengulurkan tangan untuk membantu adik kelas yang jatuh di lapangan.
w|mengulurkan.en: Agus held out his hand to help a younger student who fell on the field.
w|mengulurkan.ko: 아구스는 운동장에서 넘어진 후배를 도우려고 손을 내밀었어요.

w|mengulurkan.text: Penjaga kolam mengulurkan tongkat panjang kepada anak yang kelelahan di tengah kolam.
w|mengulurkan.en: The lifeguard held out a long pole to a child who was exhausted in the middle of the pool.
w|mengulurkan.ko: 안전요원은 수영장 한가운데서 지친 아이에게 긴 장대를 내밀었어요.

w|mengumpat.text: Pembeli itu mengumpat pelan ketika tahu resep dokter sudah kedaluwarsa.
w|mengumpat.en: The customer swore under his breath when he found out the prescription had expired.
w|mengumpat.ko: 그 손님은 처방전이 만료된 걸 알고 작게 욕을 했어요.

w|mengumpat.text: Lestari mengumpat dalam hati ketika komputer mati sebelum berkas tersimpan.
w|mengumpat.en: Lestari cursed inwardly when the computer died before the file was saved.
w|mengumpat.ko: 파일이 저장되기 전에 컴퓨터가 꺼지자 레스타리는 속으로 욕을 했어요.

w|mengumpulkan.en: Raising funds takes a long time.

w|mengumumkan.text: Sekolah akan mengumumkan hasil ujian besok.
w|mengumumkan.en: The school will announce the exam results tomorrow.
w|mengumumkan.ko: 학교가 내일 시험 결과를 발표할 거야.

w|mengumumkan.en: They announced the opening of a new store.

w|mengunci.en: Don't forget to lock the door at night.
w|mengunci.ko: 밤에 문 잠그는 걸 잊지 마.

w|mengunci.en: Locking the safe makes him calm.

w|mengundang.en: Inviting the neighbors is a good idea.

w|mengunduh.text: Dimas harus mengunduh banyak aplikasi kantor di laptop barunya.
w|mengunduh.en: Dimas had to download a lot of work apps onto his new laptop.
w|mengunduh.ko: 디마스는 새 노트북에 회사 앱을 잔뜩 내려받아야 했어요.

w|mengunduh.text: Putri mengunduh pas naik pesawat ke ponselnya sebelum berangkat ke bandara.
w|mengunduh.en: Putri downloaded her boarding pass to her phone before leaving for the airport.
w|mengunduh.ko: 푸트리는 공항에 가기 전에 탑승권을 휴대폰에 내려받았어요.

w|mengundurkan.text: Pemimpin redaksi memutuskan mengundurkan diri setelah dua puluh tahun bekerja di koran itu.
w|mengundurkan.en: The editor-in-chief decided to resign after twenty years at the newspaper.
w|mengundurkan.ko: 편집국장은 그 신문사에서 이십 년을 일한 끝에 물러나기로 했어요.

w|mengundurkan.text: Teknisi senior di toko Ayu mengundurkan diri karena ingin membuka usaha sendiri.
w|mengundurkan.en: The senior technician at Ayu's shop resigned because he wants to open his own business.
w|mengundurkan.ko: 아유 가게 선임 기술자는 자기 가게를 차리고 싶어서 그만뒀어요.

w|mengunggah.text: Kakak Rudi sempat mengunggah status sindiran yang membuat Rudi tersinggung.
w|mengunggah.en: Rudi's sister had posted a snide status that offended Rudi.
w|mengunggah.ko: 루디의 누나가 비꼬는 글을 올려서 루디는 기분이 상했어요.

w|mengunggah.text: Rina mengunggah video penyu kecil yang berjalan menuju laut.
w|mengunggah.en: Rina uploaded a video of baby turtles heading toward the sea.
w|mengunggah.ko: 리나는 아기 거북이들이 바다로 기어가는 영상을 올렸어요.

w|mengungkap.text: Petugas museum di Solo mengungkap sejarah keraton yang jarang diceritakan.
w|mengungkap.en: A museum officer in Solo revealed palace history that is rarely told.
w|mengungkap.ko: 솔로의 박물관 직원은 잘 알려지지 않은 왕궁 역사를 들려줬어요.

w|mengungkap.text: Rekaman kamera akhirnya mengungkap siapa yang mengambil dompet di ruang ganti.
w|mengungkap.en: The camera footage finally revealed who took the wallet in the fitting room.
w|mengungkap.ko: 카메라 영상으로 탈의실에서 지갑을 가져간 사람이 드디어 밝혀졌어요.

w|mengungkapkan.en: She dared to express her opinion.
w|mengungkapkan.ko: 그녀는 자기 의견을 말할 용기가 있었어.

w|mengungkapkan.text: Surat itu mengungkapkan rasa terima kasih.

w|mengungkit.text: Nelayan tua itu suka mengungkit badai besar yang pernah menghantam desa, kenang Eko.
w|mengungkit.en: The old fisherman likes to bring up the big storm that once hit the village, Eko recalled.
w|mengungkit.ko: 그 늙은 어부는 예전에 마을을 덮친 큰 폭풍 이야기를 자주 꺼낸다고 에코가 떠올렸어요.

w|mengungkit.text: Ayu malu ketika ibunya mengungkit kebiasaannya makan cokelat di depan dokter.
w|mengungkit.en: Ayu was embarrassed when her mother brought up her chocolate habit in front of the dentist.
w|mengungkit.ko: 엄마가 의사 앞에서 아유의 초콜릿 버릇을 꺼내자 아유는 창피했어요.

w|mengungsi.text: Saat banjir besar datang, ratusan warga mengungsi ke aula balai kota yang diurus Fajar.
w|mengungsi.en: When the big flood came, hundreds of residents took refuge in the city hall auditorium Fajar runs.
w|mengungsi.ko: 큰 홍수가 났을 때 주민 수백 명이 파자르가 관리하는 시청 강당으로 대피했어요.

w|mengungsi.text: Waktu listrik gedung padam berhari-hari, Lestari mengungsi ke rumah ibunya.
w|mengungsi.en: When the building's power was out for days, Lestari took refuge at her mother's house.
w|mengungsi.ko: 건물 전기가 며칠씩 나갔을 때 레스타리는 어머니 댁으로 피신했어요.

w|mengunjungi.text: Kami akan mengunjungi nenek minggu ini.
w|mengunjungi.en: We will visit grandma this week.
Visiting a museum is very educational.

w|menguntit.text: Bayu menulis kisah seorang penyanyi yang selama bertahun-tahun dikuntit penggemar fanatik.
w|menguntit.en: Bayu wrote about a singer who had been stalked by an obsessive fan for years.
w|menguntit.ko: 바유는 수년간 광적인 팬에게 스토킹을 당한 가수의 이야기를 썼어요.

w|menguntit.text: Intan merasa ada seekor anjing liar yang menguntit langkahnya di jalan setapak.
w|menguntit.en: Intan felt a stray dog was following her steps on the footpath.
w|menguntit.ko: 인탄은 오솔길에서 들개 한 마리가 자기 뒤를 몰래 따라오는 것 같았어요.

w|menguntungkan.text: Kontrak dengan pembeli dari luar negeri sangat menguntungkan pabrik.
w|menguntungkan.en: The contract with the overseas buyer is very profitable for the factory.
w|menguntungkan.ko: 해외 바이어와의 계약은 공장에 아주 이득이 돼요.

w|menguntungkan.text: Tiket promo itu sangat menguntungkan bagi Intan yang sering bepergian.
w|menguntungkan.en: That promo ticket is very advantageous for Intan, who travels often.
w|menguntungkan.ko: 그 특가 항공권은 자주 여행하는 인탄에게 아주 이득이에요.

w|mengunyah.text: Anjing tetangga suka mengunyah sandal yang ditaruh di depan pintu Bayu.
w|mengunyah.en: The neighbor's dog likes to chew the sandals left in front of Bayu's door.
w|mengunyah.ko: 이웃집 개는 바유 집 문 앞에 둔 슬리퍼를 즐겨 씹어요.

w|mengunyah.text: Anak kecil di kursi depan sibuk mengunyah permen karet.
w|mengunyah.en: The little child in the front seat was busy chewing gum.

w|menguping.text: Budi tertawa mengingat mereka pernah menguping rapat guru dari balik jendela.
w|menguping.en: Budi laughs remembering they once eavesdropped on a teachers' meeting from behind a window.
w|menguping.ko: 부디는 창문 뒤에서 교사 회의를 엿들었던 일을 떠올리며 웃어요.

w|menguping.text: Di bus menuju lokasi, Siti tidak sengaja menguping strategi pelari lain.
w|menguping.en: On the bus to the venue, Siti accidentally overheard another runner's strategy.
w|menguping.ko: 대회장 가는 버스에서 시티는 다른 주자의 작전을 우연히 엿들었어요.

w|menguraikan.text: Dalam tur pagi, Dimas menguraikan cara orang dulu membuat kain tenun.
w|menguraikan.en: On the morning tour, Dimas explained how people used to make woven cloth.
w|menguraikan.ko: 아침 투어에서 디마스는 옛사람들이 직물을 짜던 방법을 자세히 설명했어요.

w|menguraikan.text: Putri menguraikan perbedaan dua jenis kain kepada pembeli yang ragu.
w|menguraikan.en: Putri explained the difference between two kinds of fabric to a hesitant customer.
w|menguraikan.ko: 푸트리는 망설이는 손님에게 두 가지 천의 차이를 자세히 설명했어요.

w|mengurangi.text: Dia mencoba mengurangi gula dalam kopi.
w|mengurangi.en: He is trying to reduce sugar in his coffee.

w|mengurangi.ko: 운동이 스트레스를 줄이는 데 도움이 돼.

w|mengurung.text: Hujan deras mengurung para murid di dalam kelas sampai sore.
w|mengurung.en: Heavy rain kept the students stuck in the classroom until the afternoon.
w|mengurung.ko: 폭우 때문에 학생들은 오후까지 교실에 갇혀 있었어요.

w|mengurung.text: Ibu Ayu mengurung ayam di kandang karena mau hujan.
w|mengurung.en: Ayu's mother shut the chickens in the coop because it was about to rain.
w|mengurung.ko: 비가 올 것 같아서 아유의 어머니는 닭을 닭장에 가뒀어요.

w|mengurusi.text: Bu Ani mengurusi semua keluhan penghuni di kantor pengelola.
w|mengurusi.en: Mrs. Ani handles all residents' complaints at the management office.
w|mengurusi.ko: 아니 씨가 관리사무소에서 입주민 불만을 모두 처리해요.

w|mengurusi.text: Kondektur mengurusi penumpang yang salah naik kereta.
w|mengurusi.en: The conductor dealt with a passenger who had boarded the wrong train.
w|mengurusi.ko: 차장이 기차를 잘못 탄 승객을 처리했어요.

w|mengusahakan.text: Serikat pekerja mengusahakan kenaikan gaji untuk semua buruh.
w|mengusahakan.en: The workers' union is working to secure a pay rise for all workers.
w|mengusahakan.ko: 노동조합은 모든 노동자의 임금 인상을 위해 애쓰고 있어요.

w|mengusahakan.text: Maskapai mengusahakan kursi lain untuk Intan karena penerbangannya penuh.
w|mengusahakan.en: The airline tried to find another seat for Intan because her flight was full.
w|mengusahakan.ko: 비행기가 만석이라 항공사가 인탄에게 다른 좌석을 마련해 주려고 애썼어요.

w|mengusir.text: Mereka mencoba mengusir burung dari sawah.
w|mengusir.en: They try to drive birds from the rice field.
Driving away a rude guest feels hard.

w|mengusulkan.text: Andi mengusulkan agar kelas mereka menanam pohon di halaman sekolah.
w|mengusulkan.en: Andi proposed that their class plant trees in the schoolyard.
w|mengusulkan.ko: 안디는 반 친구들과 학교 마당에 나무를 심자고 제안했어요.

w|mengusulkan.text: Kakak Dewi mengusulkan acara bakar jagung di halaman belakang.
w|mengusulkan.en: Dewi's sister proposed grilling corn in the backyard.
w|mengusulkan.ko: 데위의 언니가 뒷마당에서 옥수수를 구워 먹자고 제안했어요.

w|mengutamakan.text: Sebagai penjaga pantai, Eko selalu mengutamakan keselamatan anak-anak.
w|mengutamakan.en: As a lifeguard, Eko always puts children's safety first.
w|mengutamakan.ko: 해변 구조대원으로서 에코는 언제나 아이들의 안전을 먼저 생각해요.

w|mengutamakan.text: Klinik gigi itu mengutamakan pasien yang datang dengan rasa sakit, jadi Ayu dipanggil lebih dulu.
w|mengutamakan.en: The dental clinic gives priority to patients in pain, so Ayu was called first.
w|mengutamakan.ko: 그 치과는 아픈 환자를 먼저 봐서 아유가 먼저 불렸어요.

w|mengutarakan.text: Andi mengutarakan kekhawatiran soal keselamatan kepada mandor.
w|mengutarakan.en: Andi voiced his safety concerns to the foreman.
w|mengutarakan.ko: 안디는 십장에게 안전 문제에 대한 걱정을 털어놓았어요.

w|mengutarakan.text: Akhirnya Dewi berani mengutarakan rasa terima kasih kepada guru lama mereka.
w|mengutarakan.en: Finally Dewi found the courage to express her gratitude to their old teacher.
w|mengutarakan.ko: 데위는 마침내 옛 선생님께 감사한 마음을 용기 내어 전했어요.

w|mengutip.text: Sutradara mengutip puisi lama di awal pertunjukan.
w|mengutip.en: The director quoted an old poem at the start of the show.
w|mengutip.ko: 연출가는 공연 첫머리에 옛 시를 인용했어요.

w|mengutip.text: Di rapat desa, Ayu mengutip nasihat kakeknya tentang menjaga hutan.
w|mengutip.en: At the village meeting, Ayu quotes her grandfather's advice on protecting the forest.
w|mengutip.ko: 마을 회의에서 아유는 숲을 지키라는 할아버지의 조언을 인용해요.

w|mengutuk.text: Di pelajaran sejarah, Eko membaca bahwa banyak negara mengutuk perang itu.
w|mengutuk.en: In history class, Eko read that many countries condemned that war.
w|mengutuk.ko: 역사 시간에 에코는 많은 나라가 그 전쟁을 규탄했다는 걸 읽었어요.

w|mengutuk.text: Di sinetron yang ditonton nenek Ayu, seorang ibu mengutuk anaknya jadi batu.
w|mengutuk.en: In the soap opera Ayu's grandmother watches, a mother curses her son into stone.
w|mengutuk.ko: 아유의 할머니가 보는 드라마에서 한 어머니가 아들을 돌로 변하게 저주해요.

w|mengutus.text: Dinas peternakan mengutus Dimas ke desa yang terkena wabah flu burung.
w|mengutus.en: The livestock agency sent Dimas to a village hit by a bird flu outbreak.
w|mengutus.ko: 축산청은 조류 독감이 번진 마을로 디마스를 파견했어요.

w|mengutus.text: Kampus mengutus Putri untuk presentasi di konferensi kimia.
w|mengutus.en: The university sent Putri to present at a chemistry conference.
w|mengutus.ko: 대학은 화학 학회에서 발표하도록 푸트리를 보냈어요.

w|menikah.en: She's not ready to marry yet.

w|menikahi.text: Dia akan menikahi kekasihnya tahun depan.
w|menikahi.en: He will marry his sweetheart next year.

w|menikahi.text: Menikahi orang yang dicintai adalah impiannya.
w|menikahi.en: Marrying the person he loves is his dream.
w|menikahi.ko: 사랑하는 사람과 결혼하는 게 그의 꿈이야.

w|menikahkan.text: Atasan Dimas bilang ia akan cuti seminggu untuk menikahkan anak sulungnya.
w|menikahkan.en: Dimas's boss said she would take a week off to marry off her eldest child.
w|menikahkan.ko: 디마스의 상사는 큰아이를 결혼시키려고 일주일 휴가를 낸다고 했어요.

w|menikahkan.text: Putri terbang pulang karena orang tuanya akan menikahkan kakaknya.
w|menikahkan.en: Putri flew home because her parents were marrying off her older sister.
w|menikahkan.ko: 부모님이 언니를 결혼시키셔서 푸트리는 비행기를 타고 집에 갔어요.

w|menikam.text: Rudi bilang berita tentang pria yang menikam tetangganya membuat warga kompleks resah.
w|menikam.en: Rudi said the news about a man who stabbed his neighbor has made the residents uneasy.
w|menikam.ko: 루디는 이웃을 칼로 찌른 남자에 관한 뉴스 때문에 동네 주민들이 불안해한다고 했어요.

w|menikam.text: Rina kecewa karena mantan rekannya menikam dari belakang dengan mencuri ide aplikasinya.
w|menikam.en: Rina was disappointed because her former partner stabbed her in the back by stealing her app idea.
w|menikam.ko: 리나는 예전 동업자가 앱 아이디어를 훔쳐 뒤통수를 쳐서 실망했어요.

w|menikmati.ko: 그는 아침 커피를 즐기는 걸 좋아해.

w|menilai.text: Guru mulai menilai tugas para siswa.
w|menilai.en: The teacher began to grade the students' work.

w|menilai.text: Jangan menilai orang dari penampilan saja.
w|menilai.en: Don't judge people by appearance alone.

w|menimbang.text: Budi masih menimbang tawaran kerja di luar pulau.
w|menimbang.en: Budi is still weighing a job offer on another island.
w|menimbang.ko: 부디는 다른 섬에서 온 일자리 제안을 아직 저울질하고 있어요.

w|menimbang.text: Bu Ani menimbang beras titipan Siti di warung depan rumah.
w|menimbang.en: Mrs. Ani weighed the rice Siti had ordered at the shop in front of her house.
w|menimbang.ko: 아니 아주머니는 집 앞 가게에서 시티가 부탁한 쌀의 무게를 달았어요.

w|menimbulkan.en: The noise caused complaints from the neighbors.
That decision caused a long debate.

w|menimpa.text: Waktu badai datang, sebatang pohon kelapa menimpa atap kandang Budi.
w|menimpa.en: When the storm came, a coconut tree fell onto the roof of Budi's shed.
w|menimpa.ko: 폭풍이 왔을 때 야자나무 한 그루가 부디네 외양간 지붕 위로 쓰러졌어요.

w|menimpa.text: Musibah yang menimpa tokoh Siti membuat penonton tes menangis.
w|menimpa.en: The misfortune that befell Siti's character made the test audience cry.
w|menimpa.ko: 시티가 맡은 인물에게 닥친 불행에 시사회 관객들이 울었어요.

w|menindas.text: Andi menegur anak-anak yang menindas bocah kecil di lapangan kompleks.
w|menindas.en: Andi scolded the kids who were bullying a little boy on the neighborhood field.
w|menindas.ko: 안디는 단지 운동장에서 꼬마를 괴롭히던 아이들을 꾸짖었어요.

w|menindas.text: Dewi tidak membiarkan murid senior menindas murid baru di ruang ganti.
w|menindas.en: Dewi doesn't let senior students bully new ones in the changing room.
w|menindas.ko: 데위는 선배 학생들이 탈의실에서 신입생을 괴롭히지 못하게 해요.

w|meninggal.en: My grandpa passed away last year.

w|meningkat.text: Jumlah pengunjung meningkat setiap musim panas.

w|meningkatkan.ko: 규칙적인 연습이 스태미나를 높일 수 있어.

w|meningkatkan.text: Meningkatkan kualitas produk jadi fokus kami.
w|meningkatkan.en: Improving product quality is our focus.
w|meningkatkan.ko: 제품 품질을 높이는 게 우리 초점이야.

w|meninjau.text: Andi bekerja di kantor dinas yang sering meninjau sekolah-sekolah desa.
w|meninjau.en: Andi works at a government office that often inspects village schools.
w|meninjau.ko: 안디는 마을 학교들을 자주 시찰하는 관청에서 일해요.

w|meninjau.text: Panitia meninjau rute lomba seminggu sebelum hari H.
w|meninjau.en: The organizers surveyed the race route a week before the big day.
w|meninjau.ko: 주최 측은 대회 일주일 전에 코스를 점검했어요.

w|meninju.text: Seorang saksi bilang pelaku meninju kaca etalase toko sampai retak.
w|meninju.en: A witness said the suspect punched the shop window until it cracked.
w|meninju.ko: 한 목격자는 범인이 가게 진열장 유리를 주먹으로 쳐서 금이 갔다고 했어요.

w|meninju.text: Setelah melewati garis finis, Rina meninju udara sambil tertawa lepas.
w|meninju.en: After crossing the finish line, Rina punched the air and laughed freely.
w|meninju.ko: 결승선을 지나자 리나는 허공에 주먹을 날리며 활짝 웃었어요.

w|menipis.text: Stok masker di apotek Dimas mulai menipis.
w|menipis.en: The stock of masks at Dimas's pharmacy is starting to run low.
w|menipis.ko: 디마스네 약국의 마스크 재고가 바닥나기 시작했어요.

w|menipis.text: Tabungan Putri menipis karena biaya renovasi.
w|menipis.en: Putri's savings are dwindling because of the renovation costs.
w|menipis.ko: 수리비 때문에 푸트리의 저축이 줄어들고 있어요.

w|menipu.text: Menipu orang lain akan berbalik padamu.
w|menipu.en: Deceiving others will come back to you.

w|meniru.text: Anak-anak tertawa saat Andi meniru gaya bicara kepala sekolah.
w|meniru.en: The kids laughed when Andi imitated the principal's way of speaking.
w|meniru.ko: 안디가 교장 선생님 말투를 흉내 내자 아이들이 웃었어요.

w|meniru.text: Anak kecil di bangsal anak suka meniru cara Dewi memakai stetoskop.
w|meniru.en: The little child on the children's ward likes to copy how Dewi uses a stethoscope.
w|meniru.ko: 소아 병동 꼬마는 데위가 청진기 쓰는 모습을 흉내 내는 걸 좋아해요.

w|menit.en: That trip is only ten minutes.

w|menitipkan.text: Bayu menitipkan kunci motor pada satpam kantor.
w|menitipkan.en: Bayu left his motorbike key with the office security guard.
w|menitipkan.ko: 바유는 오토바이 열쇠를 회사 경비원에게 맡겼어요.

w|menitipkan.text: Intan menitipkan tas di loker resepsionis.
w|menitipkan.en: Intan left her bag in the locker at the front desk.
w|menitipkan.ko: 인탄은 가방을 안내 데스크 사물함에 맡겼어요.

w|meniup.text: Di ruang alat musik, Rudi mencoba meniup seruling bambu tiruan.
w|meniup.en: In the musical instrument room, Rudi tried blowing a replica bamboo flute.
w|meniup.ko: 악기 전시실에서 루디는 대나무 피리 모형을 불어 봤어요.

w|meniup.text: Penjual kerupuk meniup plastik dulu sebelum mengisinya.
w|meniup.en: The cracker seller blows into the plastic bag before filling it.
w|meniup.ko: 과자 장수는 봉지를 채우기 전에 먼저 후 불어 벌려요.

w|menjabat.text: Pemimpin redaksi yang sekarang sudah menjabat selama delapan tahun.
w|menjabat.en: The current editor-in-chief has held the post for eight years.
w|menjabat.ko: 지금 편집장은 팔 년째 그 자리를 맡고 있어요.

w|menjabat.text: Ayah Siti pernah menjabat sebagai kepala perpustakaan provinsi.
w|menjabat.en: Siti's father once served as head of the provincial library.
w|menjabat.ko: 시티의 아버지는 한때 주립 도서관장을 지냈어요.

w|menjadi.en: They want to be a teacher.

w|menjadikan.text: Jangan menjadikan masalah kecil jadi besar.
w|menjadikan.en: Don't turn a small problem into a big one.

w|menjadwalkan.text: Sekretaris redaksi menjadwalkan wawancara Budi dengan gubernur hari Kamis.
w|menjadwalkan.en: The editorial secretary scheduled Budi's interview with the governor for Thursday.
w|menjadwalkan.ko: 편집국 비서가 부디의 주지사 인터뷰를 목요일로 잡았어요.

w|menjadwalkan.text: Siti menjadwalkan kelas mendongeng untuk anak-anak setiap Minggu pagi.
w|menjadwalkan.en: Siti scheduled a storytelling class for children every Sunday morning.
w|menjadwalkan.ko: 시티는 일요일 아침마다 어린이 동화 구연 수업을 잡았어요.

w|menjalani.en: He is going through tough training.

w|menjalani.text: Kita harus menjalani hidup dengan jujur.

w|menjalin.text: Budi berusaha menjalin hubungan baik dengan para pemilik hewan di sekitar klinik.
w|menjalin.en: Budi tries to build good relationships with pet owners around the clinic.
w|menjalin.ko: 부디는 병원 근처 반려동물 주인들과 좋은 관계를 맺으려고 애써요.

w|menjalin.text: Siti menjalin persahabatan dengan para pendaki yang sering mampir ke warungnya.
w|menjalin.en: Siti has built friendships with the hikers who often stop by her stall.
w|menjalin.ko: 시티는 가게에 자주 들르는 등산객들과 우정을 쌓았어요.

w|menjamin.en: The company guarantees the quality of its products.

w|menjangkau.text: Sinyal ponsel tidak bisa menjangkau perkemahan Rudi di balik bukit.
w|menjangkau.en: The phone signal can't reach Rudi's camp behind the hill.
w|menjangkau.ko: 휴대폰 신호가 언덕 너머 루디의 야영지까지 닿지 않아요.

w|menjangkau.text: Rina kagum karena suara penyanyi itu mampu menjangkau nada yang sangat tinggi.
w|menjangkau.en: Rina was amazed that the singer's voice could reach very high notes.
w|menjangkau.ko: 리나는 그 가수의 목소리가 아주 높은 음까지 닿아서 감탄했어요.

w|menjanjikan.text: Hasil uji coba itu menjanjikan untuk masa depan.
w|menjanjikan.en: Those test results are promising for the future.

w|menjanjikan.text: Pemain muda itu menjanjikan bakat yang besar.
w|menjanjikan.en: That young player shows great promise.
w|menjanjikan.ko: 그 젊은 선수는 큰 재능을 보여줘.

w|menjarah.text: Guru sejarah bercerita kepada Budi tentang tentara yang menjarah kota tua itu berabad-abad lalu.
w|menjarah.en: The history teacher told Budi about soldiers who looted the old city centuries ago.
w|menjarah.ko: 역사 선생님은 수백 년 전 그 옛 도시를 약탈한 군대 이야기를 부디에게 해 줬어요.

w|menjarah.text: Siti menonton film tentang perampok yang mencoba menjarah gudang kargo bandara.
w|menjarah.en: Siti watched a film about robbers trying to loot an airport cargo warehouse.
w|menjarah.ko: 시티는 공항 화물 창고를 털려는 강도들에 관한 영화를 봤어요.

w|menjatuhkan.en: Strong wind can knock down trees.
w|menjatuhkan.ko: 거센 바람이 나무를 쓰러뜨릴 수 있어.

w|menjauh.en: Please stay away from the fire.
He started to move away from the crowd.

w|menjauhi.text: Para pekerja disuruh menjauhi area di bawah derek.
w|menjauhi.en: The workers were told to stay away from the area under the crane.
w|menjauhi.ko: 인부들은 크레인 아래 구역에 가까이 가지 말라는 지시를 받았어요.

w|menjauhi.text: Rina berusaha menjauhi gosip kantor sejak hari pertama.
w|menjauhi.en: Rina tries to stay away from office gossip from day one.
w|menjauhi.ko: 리나는 첫날부터 사내 뒷말에서 멀리 있으려고 해요.

w|menjauhkan.text: Dia mencoba menjauhkan diri dari masalah.
w|menjauhkan.en: He tried to distance himself from trouble.
Mom kept the child away from the fire.

w|menjebak.en: The police managed to trap that thief.

w|menjebak.text: Jangan menjebak teman dengan pertanyaan sulit.
w|menjebak.en: Don't trap a friend with hard questions.
w|menjebak.ko: 어려운 질문으로 친구를 함정에 빠뜨리지 마.

w|menjelajah.text: Bayu ingin menjelajah desa-desa kecil yang tidak ada di brosur wisata.
w|menjelajah.en: Bayu wants to explore small villages that aren't in the tourist brochures.
w|menjelajah.ko: 바유는 관광 안내서에 없는 작은 마을들을 둘러보고 싶어요.

w|menjelajah.text: Di kelas ini, Intan bebas menjelajah berbagai teknik cat air.
w|menjelajah.en: In this class, Intan is free to explore various watercolor techniques.
w|menjelajah.ko: 이 수업에서 인탄은 여러 수채화 기법을 마음껏 탐구할 수 있어요.

w|menjelajahi.text: Dimas ingin menjelajahi Pulau Jawa dari ujung barat sampai ujung timur dengan kereta.
w|menjelajahi.en: Dimas wants to explore Java from the western tip to the eastern tip by train.
w|menjelajahi.ko: 디마스는 기차로 자바섬을 서쪽 끝에서 동쪽 끝까지 둘러보고 싶어 해요.

w|menjelajahi.text: Putri ingin menjelajahi peluang pasar di negara tetangga tahun depan.
w|menjelajahi.en: Putri wants to explore market opportunities in neighboring countries next year.
w|menjelajahi.ko: 푸트리는 내년에 이웃 나라 시장 기회를 탐색해 보고 싶어 해요.

w|menjelang.text: Dimas membeli payung baru yang lebih kuat menjelang musim hujan.
w|menjelang.en: Dimas bought a new, sturdier umbrella ahead of the rainy season.
w|menjelang.ko: 우기를 앞두고 디마스는 더 튼튼한 새 우산을 샀어요.

w|menjelang.text: Putri ingin rumah itu selesai menjelang ulang tahun neneknya.
w|menjelang.en: Putri wants the house finished before her grandmother's birthday.
w|menjelang.ko: 푸트리는 할머니 생신 전에 집이 다 고쳐지길 바라요.

w|menjelaskan.en: The teacher explained the lesson clearly.

w|menjemput.en: Dad will pick me up at school.
w|menjemput.ko: 아버지가 학교에서 나를 데리러 오실 거야.

w|menjemput.text: Menjemput tamu di bandara adalah tugasnya.
w|menjemput.en: Picking up guests at the airport is his job.
w|menjemput.ko: 공항에서 손님을 마중하는 게 그의 일이야.

w|menjengkelkan.en: That sound is very annoying to the ears.

w|menjengkelkan.text: Sikapnya menjengkelkan semua orang di ruangan.
w|menjengkelkan.en: His attitude annoyed everyone in the room.
w|menjengkelkan.ko: 그의 태도가 방 안 모두를 짜증나게 했어.

w|menjenguk.text: Setelah tutup, Andi menjenguk temannya di rumah sakit sambil membawa komik.
w|menjenguk.en: After closing time, Andi visited his friend in hospital, bringing comics.
w|menjenguk.ko: 도서관이 문을 닫은 뒤 안디는 만화책을 들고 병원에 있는 친구를 문병했어요.

w|menjenguk.text: Saat jam istirahat, Dewi dan timnya menjenguk rekan yang baru melahirkan.
w|menjenguk.en: During the lunch break, Dewi and her team visited a colleague who had just given birth.
w|menjenguk.ko: 점심시간에 디위와 팀원들은 막 출산한 동료를 찾아갔어요.

w|menjepit.text: Eko menjepit naskahnya dengan klip supaya halamannya tidak tercecer.
w|menjepit.en: Eko clipped his script together so the pages wouldn't scatter.
w|menjepit.ko: 에코는 대본 쪽이 흩어지지 않게 클립으로 집었어요.

w|menjepit.text: Ayu menjepit tiketnya di sela buku agar tidak hilang.
w|menjepit.en: Ayu tucked her ticket between the pages of her book so it wouldn't get lost.
w|menjepit.ko: 아유는 표를 잃어버리지 않게 책 사이에 끼웠어요.

w|menjerat.text: Andi menulis tentang sindikat penipuan yang menjerat ratusan korban.
w|menjerat.en: Andi wrote about a fraud ring that ensnared hundreds of victims.
w|menjerat.ko: 안디는 수백 명을 걸려들게 한 사기 조직에 대해 기사를 썼어요.

w|menjerat.text: Tali rafia yang berserakan hampir menjerat kaki Dewi.
w|menjerat.en: The scattered plastic string almost tangled around Dewi's feet.
w|menjerat.ko: 널려 있던 비닐 끈에 데위의 발이 걸릴 뻔했어요.

w|menjerit.text: Anak itu menjerit ketika melihat ular.
w|menjerit.en: That child screamed when seeing a snake.
w|menjerit.ko: 그 아이가 뱀을 보고 비명을 질렀어.

w|menjernihkan.text: Guru IPA mengajak Budi dan teman-temannya menjernihkan air kolam sekolah dengan saringan pasir.
w|menjernihkan.en: The science teacher had Budi and his classmates clear the school pond water with a sand filter.
w|menjernihkan.ko: 과학 선생님은 버디와 친구들에게 모래 필터로 학교 연못물을 맑게 해 보게 했어요.

w|menjernihkan.text: Hujan pertama setelah kemarau panjang seakan menjernihkan udara di kampung Siti.
w|menjernihkan.en: The first rain after the long dry season seemed to clear the air in Siti's village.
w|menjernihkan.ko: 긴 건기 뒤 첫 비가 시티네 마을 공기를 맑게 해 주는 것 같았어요.

w|menjilat.text: Di kantin, adik kelas Andi menjilat es krim yang hampir meleleh.
w|menjilat.en: In the canteen, Andi's junior licked an ice cream that was nearly melting.
w|menjilat.ko: 매점에서 안디의 후배가 거의 녹은 아이스크림을 핥아 먹었어요.

w|menjilat.text: Kucing Dewi menjilat sisa saus di piring yang belum dicuci.
w|menjilat.en: Dewi's cat licked the leftover sauce on an unwashed plate.
w|menjilat.ko: 데위의 고양이가 아직 안 씻은 접시의 남은 소스를 핥았어요.

w|menjinakkan.text: Andi berhasil menjinakkan kucing liar yang tinggal di gudang belakang.
w|menjinakkan.en: Andi managed to tame the stray cat living in the back shed.
w|menjinakkan.ko: 안디는 뒤 창고에 사는 길고양이를 길들이는 데 성공했어요.

w|menjinakkan.text: Dewi membaca novel tentang pawang yang menjinakkan harimau di hutan.
w|menjinakkan.en: Dewi reads a novel about a handler who tames tigers in the forest.
w|menjinakkan.ko: 데위는 숲에서 호랑이를 길들이는 조련사에 관한 소설을 읽어요.

w|menjual.text: Dia menjual buah di pasar pagi.
w|menjual.en: He sells fruit at the morning market.

w|menjual.text: Mereka menjual mobil lama minggu lalu.
w|menjual.en: They sold the old car last week.

w|menjuluki.text: Rekan-rekan Bayu menjulukinya "si kopi" karena ia minum kopi sepanjang hari.
w|menjuluki.en: Bayu's colleagues nicknamed him "the coffee guy" because he drinks coffee all day.
w|menjuluki.ko: 바유의 동료들은 하루 종일 커피를 마신다고 그를 "커피맨"이라고 불러요.

w|menjuluki.text: Orang-orang desa menjuluki Intan "si pemetik cepat" karena ia paling gesit memetik teh.
w|menjuluki.en: The villagers call Intan "the fast picker" because she's the quickest at picking tea.
w|menjuluki.ko: 마을 사람들은 차를 제일 빨리 딴다고 인탄을 "빠른 손"이라고 불러요.

w|menjumpai.text: Agus senang bisa menjumpai guru SD-nya di acara pameran sekolah.
w|menjumpai.en: Agus was happy to meet his elementary school teacher at the school fair.
w|menjumpai.ko: 아구스는 학교 전시회에서 초등학교 선생님을 만나서 반가웠어요.

w|menjumpai.text: Wati tidak menyangka akan menjumpai teman lamanya di kolam renang.
w|menjumpai.en: Wati didn't expect to run into an old friend at the swimming pool.
w|menjumpai.ko: 와티는 수영장에서 옛 친구를 만날 줄은 몰랐어요.

w|menodai.text: Menurut jaksa, perbuatan pejabat itu telah menodai kepercayaan masyarakat.
w|menodai.en: According to the prosecutor, the official's actions had tarnished public trust.
w|menodai.ko: 검사는 그 공무원의 행동이 국민의 신뢰를 더럽혔다고 했어요.

w|menodai.text: Kuah rendang menodai taplak meja putih yang baru dicuci.
w|menodai.en: The rendang sauce stained the freshly washed white tablecloth.
w|menodai.ko: 렌당 국물이 새로 빤 흰 식탁보를 더럽혔어요.

w|menodongkan.text: Dalam komik detektif itu, perampok menodongkan pistol mainan kepada kasir.
w|menodongkan.en: In that detective comic, a robber points a toy gun at the cashier.
w|menodongkan.ko: 그 탐정 만화에서 강도가 계산원에게 장난감 총을 겨눠요.

w|menodongkan.text: Dalam pelatihan keamanan, Dewi belajar apa yang harus dilakukan jika perampok menodongkan senjata.
w|menodongkan.en: In security training, Dewi learned what to do if a robber points a weapon.
w|menodongkan.ko: 보안 교육에서 디위는 강도가 무기를 겨누면 어떻게 해야 하는지 배웠어요.

w|menoleh.text: Dimas menoleh ketika mendengar suara langkah di belakangnya.
w|menoleh.en: Dimas turned his head when he heard footsteps behind him.
w|menoleh.ko: 디마스는 뒤에서 발소리가 들리자 고개를 돌렸어요.

w|menoleh.text: Sutradara meminta Putri menoleh perlahan ke arah kamera.
w|menoleh.en: The director asked Putri to turn her head slowly toward the camera.
w|menoleh.ko: 감독은 푸트리에게 카메라 쪽으로 천천히 고개를 돌리라고 했어요.

w|menoleransi.text: Hakim ketua tidak akan menoleransi keributan di dalam ruang sidang.
w|menoleransi.en: The presiding judge will not tolerate any commotion inside the courtroom.
w|menoleransi.ko: 재판장은 법정 안의 소란을 용납하지 않아요.

w|menoleransi.text: Wati bisa menoleransi anak-anak yang ribut, tetapi tidak bisa menerima pelanggan yang kasar.
w|menoleransi.en: Wati can tolerate noisy children, but she can't accept rude customers.
w|menoleransi.ko: 와티는 시끄러운 아이들은 참을 수 있지만 무례한 손님은 받아들일 수 없어요.

w|menonaktifkan.text: Agus menonaktifkan ponselnya supaya bisa menikmati suara hutan.
w|menonaktifkan.en: Agus switched off his phone so he could enjoy the sounds of the forest.
w|menonaktifkan.ko: 아구스는 숲 소리를 즐기려고 휴대폰을 꺼 두었어요.

w|menonaktifkan.text: Setiap malam, Wati menonaktifkan alarm pintu sebelum mengunci apotek.
w|menonaktifkan.en: Every night, Wati deactivates the door alarm before locking the pharmacy.
w|menonaktifkan.ko: 와티는 매일 밤 약국 문을 잠그기 전에 출입문 경보를 꺼요.

w|menonjol.text: Rumah Andi menonjol di gang itu karena catnya hijau terang.
w|menonjol.en: Andi's house stands out in the alley because of its bright green paint.
w|menonjol.ko: 안디네 집은 밝은 초록색이라 골목에서 눈에 띄어요.

w|menonjol.text: Di antara semua koleksi, topeng emas itulah yang paling menonjol menurut Dewi.
w|menonjol.en: Of all the collection, Dewi thought the golden mask stood out the most.
w|menonjol.ko: 데위가 보기에 모든 소장품 가운데 그 황금 가면이 가장 눈에 띄었어요.

w|menstabilkan.text: Eko memasang batu besar untuk menstabilkan tanah di pinggir ladang.
w|menstabilkan.en: Eko set big stones to stabilize the soil at the edge of the field.
w|menstabilkan.ko: 에코는 밭 가장자리 흙이 무너지지 않게 큰 돌을 놓았어요.

w|menstabilkan.text: Teknisi menambah alat untuk menstabilkan tegangan listrik di ruang produksi.
w|menstabilkan.en: The technicians added a device to stabilize the voltage in the production room.
w|menstabilkan.ko: 기술자들은 생산실 전압을 안정시키는 장치를 달았어요.

w|mental.text: Kesehatan mental sama pentingnya dengan tubuh.
w|mental.en: Mental health is as important as the body.

w|mental.text: Mental yang kuat membantu menghadapi tekanan.
w|mental.en: A strong mind helps face pressure.

w|mentari.text: Setiap pagi Eko menunggu mentari terbit dari balik pulau kecil di depan pantai.
w|mentari.en: Every morning Eko waits for the sun to rise from behind the small island off the beach.
w|mentari.ko: 에코는 매일 아침 해변 앞 작은 섬 뒤에서 해가 뜨기를 기다려요.

w|mentari.text: Cahaya mentari pagi masuk lewat jendela ruang tunggu dokter gigi tempat Ayu duduk.
w|mentari.en: The morning sunlight came through the window of the dentist's waiting room where Ayu sat.
w|mentari.ko: 아유가 앉아 있던 치과 대기실 창문으로 아침 햇살이 들어왔어요.

w|mentega.text: Croissant di toko Fajar dibuat dengan mentega asli, bukan margarin.
w|mentega.en: The croissants at Fajar's shop are made with real butter, not margarine.
w|mentega.ko: 파자르네 가게의 크루아상은 마가린이 아니라 진짜 버터로 만들어요.

w|mentega.text: Untuk sarapan, Lestari makan roti dengan sedikit mentega kacang.
w|mentega.en: For breakfast, Lestari ate bread with a little peanut butter.
w|mentega.ko: 레스타리는 아침으로 땅콩버터를 조금 바른 빵을 먹었어요.

w|menteri.en: The new minister was appointed yesterday.

w|mentraktir.text: Setelah gajian, Dimas mentraktir teman satu shift makan bakso.
w|mentraktir.en: After payday, Dimas treated his shift mates to meatball soup.
w|mentraktir.ko: 월급날이 지나자 디마스는 같은 조 동료들에게 바소를 샀어요.

w|mentraktir.text: Putri masih ingat waktu Sari mentraktir dia es campur sepulang sekolah.
w|mentraktir.en: Putri still remembers when Sari treated her to mixed shaved ice after school.
w|mentraktir.ko: 푸트리는 사리가 방과 후에 에스 참푸르를 사 줬던 때를 아직 기억해요.

w|mentransfer.text: Penjual itu tidak punya kembalian, jadi Agus mentransfer uangnya lewat ponsel.
w|mentransfer.en: The seller didn't have change, so Agus transferred the money by phone.
w|mentransfer.ko: 장수가 거스름돈이 없어서 아구스는 휴대폰으로 돈을 보냈어요.

w|mentransfer.text: Wati mentransfer uang ke ibunya untuk membeli bibit sebelum musim tanam.
w|mentransfer.en: Wati transferred money to her mother to buy seedlings before planting season.
w|mentransfer.ko: 와티는 파종철 전에 모종을 사라고 엄마에게 돈을 보냈어요.

w|menu.text: Bulan ini toko Fajar menambah menu roti tawar gandum.
w|menu.en: This month Fajar's shop added whole-wheat bread to the menu.
w|menu.ko: 이번 달 파자르네 가게는 통밀 식빵을 메뉴에 추가했어요.

w|menu.text: Hotel tempat Lestari menginap punya menu khusus untuk atlet.
w|menu.en: The hotel where Lestari stayed has a special menu for athletes.
w|menu.ko: 레스타리가 묵은 호텔에는 운동선수를 위한 특별 메뉴가 있어요.

w|menua.text: Andi sedih melihat tetangga-tetangga lama mulai menua.
w|menua.en: Andi is sad to see his longtime neighbors growing old.
w|menua.ko: 안디는 오랜 이웃들이 늙어 가는 걸 보며 마음이 아파요.

w|menua.text: Dewi ingin terus mengajar musik sampai menua.
w|menua.en: Dewi wants to keep teaching music until she grows old.
w|menua.ko: 데위는 늙을 때까지 계속 음악을 가르치고 싶어요.

w|menuang.text: Eko menuang saus kacang ke atas sate dengan hati-hati.
w|menuang.en: Eko carefully poured peanut sauce over the satay.
w|menuang.ko: 에코는 사테 위에 땅콩 소스를 조심스럽게 부었어요.

w|menuang.text: Ayu menuang teh jahe hangat di sore yang dingin.
w|menuang.en: Ayu poured warm ginger tea on a chilly afternoon.
w|menuang.ko: 아유는 쌀쌀한 오후에 따뜻한 생강차를 따랐어요.

w|menuangkan.text: Bayu menuangkan teh hangat ke gelas tetangganya yang mampir.
w|menuangkan.en: Bayu poured warm tea into the glass of the neighbor who dropped by.
w|menuangkan.ko: 바유는 들른 이웃의 잔에 따뜻한 차를 따랐어요.

w|menuangkan.text: Seorang bapak menuangkan kopi dari termos untuk Intan.
w|menuangkan.en: A man poured coffee from a thermos for Intan.
w|menuangkan.ko: 한 아저씨가 보온병에서 커피를 따라 인탄에게 줬어요.

w|menuduh.text: Jangan menuduh orang tanpa bukti kuat.
w|menuduh.en: Don't accuse people without strong evidence.
w|menuduh.ko: 확실한 증거 없이 남을 비난하지 마.

w|menuduh.en: He accused his friend of stealing his wallet.

w|menugaskan.text: Fajar menugaskan pegawai barunya untuk menjaga kasir.
w|menugaskan.en: Fajar assigned his new employee to look after the till.

w|menugaskan.text: Klub lari menugaskan Lestari untuk memimpin kelompok pemula.
w|menugaskan.en: The running club assigned Lestari to lead the beginners' group.
w|menugaskan.ko: 달리기 동호회는 레스타리에게 초보자 그룹을 이끄는 일을 맡겼어요.

w|menukar.text: Seorang penonton datang ke loket untuk menukar tiketnya ke jadwal besok.
w|menukar.en: An audience member came to the box office to exchange his ticket for tomorrow's show.
w|menukar.ko: 한 관객이 표를 내일 공연으로 바꾸려고 매표소에 왔어요.

w|menukar.text: Intan ingin menukar laptop lamanya dengan yang lebih ringan.
w|menukar.en: Intan wants to swap her old laptop for a lighter one.
w|menukar.ko: 인탄은 낡은 노트북을 더 가벼운 걸로 바꾸고 싶어요.

w|menular.text: Penyakit kulit bisa menular lewat handuk yang dipakai bergantian.
w|menular.en: Skin diseases can spread through towels that are shared.
w|menular.ko: 피부병은 돌려 쓰는 수건으로 옮을 수 있어요.

w|menular.text: Intan menyuruh anaknya cuci tangan supaya kuman tidak menular.
w|menular.en: Intan tells her child to wash his hands so germs don't spread.
w|menular.ko: 인탄은 세균이 옮지 않게 아이에게 손을 씻으라고 해요.

w|menuliskan.text: Eko lupa menuliskan namanya di lembar jawaban.
w|menuliskan.en: Eko forgot to write his name on the answer sheet.
w|menuliskan.ko: 에코는 답안지에 이름을 쓰는 걸 잊었어요.

w|menuliskan.text: Ayu menuliskan resep rendang nenek di buku kecilnya.
w|menuliskan.en: Ayu wrote grandma's rendang recipe in her little notebook.
w|menuliskan.ko: 아유는 할머니의 른당 요리법을 작은 수첩에 적었어요.

w|menumbuhkan.text: Ibu berharap pertengkaran ini bisa menumbuhkan rasa saling percaya antara Rudi dan kakaknya.
w|menumbuhkan.en: Mom hopes this fight can grow mutual trust between Rudi and his sister.
w|menumbuhkan.ko: 엄마는 이번 다툼이 루디와 누나 사이에 믿음을 키워 주길 바라요.

w|menumbuhkan.text: Komunitas pecinta laut itu berusaha menumbuhkan kembali terumbu karang yang rusak.
w|menumbuhkan.en: The ocean lovers' group is working to regrow the damaged coral reef.
w|menumbuhkan.ko: 그 바다 애호가 모임은 망가진 산호초를 다시 키우려고 애쓰고 있어요.

w|menumbuk.text: Budi teringat ibu Rudi yang dulu menumbuk padi di halaman rumah.
w|menumbuk.en: Budi remembered Rudi's mother pounding rice in the front yard long ago.
w|menumbuk.ko: 부디는 루디 어머니가 예전에 마당에서 벼를 찧던 모습이 떠올랐어요.

w|menumbuk.text: Bu Ani menumbuk bumbu rendang di teras sambil mengobrol dengan Siti.
w|menumbuk.en: Mrs. Ani pounded rendang spices on the porch while chatting with Siti.
w|menumbuk.ko: 아니 아주머니는 테라스에서 시티와 수다를 떨며 른당 양념을 빻았어요.

w|menumpahkan.text: Rudi tidak sengaja menumpahkan kopi ke kertas surat yang pertama.
w|menumpahkan.en: Rudi accidentally spilled coffee on the first sheet of the letter.
w|menumpahkan.ko: 루디는 실수로 편지 첫 장에 커피를 쏟았어요.

w|menumpahkan.text: Seorang programmer menumpahkan teh ke papan ketik tepat sebelum rapat.
w|menumpahkan.en: A programmer spilled tea on the keyboard just before the meeting.
w|menumpahkan.ko: 한 프로그래머가 회의 직전에 키보드에 차를 쏟았어요.

w|menumpang.text: Waktu kecil, Dimas sering menumpang truk paman untuk pergi ke kota.
w|menumpang.en: As a child, Dimas often rode along in his uncle's truck to go to town.
w|menumpang.ko: 어릴 때 디마스는 시내에 가려고 삼촌 트럭을 자주 얻어 탔어요.

w|menumpang.text: Selama setahun, perusahaan Putri menumpang di ruang kerja bersama milik temannya.
w|menumpang.en: For a year, Putri's company squatted in a coworking space owned by her friend.
w|menumpang.ko: 1년 동안 푸트리의 회사는 친구가 운영하는 공유 오피스에 얹혀 지냈어요.

w|menumpuk.text: Kado-kado dari tamu menumpuk di meja dekat pelaminan.
w|menumpuk.en: Gifts from the guests piled up on the table near the wedding dais.
w|menumpuk.ko: 손님들 선물이 신랑 신부 단상 옆 탁자에 수북이 쌓였어요.

w|menumpuk.text: Email dari pembaca menumpuk di kotak masuk Lestari setelah artikelnya terbit.
w|menumpuk.en: Emails from readers piled up in Lestari's inbox after her article came out.
w|menumpuk.ko: 기사가 나간 뒤 레스타리의 받은편지함에 독자 메일이 쌓였어요.

w|menunda.text: Dimas menunda pengembalian buku karena belum selesai membacanya.
w|menunda.en: Dimas put off returning the book because he hadn't finished reading it.
w|menunda.ko: 디마스는 책을 다 못 읽어서 반납을 미뤘어요.

w|menunda.text: Karena hujan deras, petugas menunda keberangkatan kereta satu jam.
w|menunda.en: Because of heavy rain, the staff delayed the train's departure by an hour.
w|menunda.ko: 폭우 때문에 직원들이 기차 출발을 한 시간 늦췄어요.

w|menunduk.en: He bowed his head when apologizing.
That player bowed his head to respect the referee.
w|menunduk.ko: 그 선수가 심판에게 고개를 숙여 인사했어.

w|menundukkan.text: Saat peregangan, Bayu menundukkan kepala sampai dagunya hampir menyentuh dada.
w|menundukkan.en: During stretching, Bayu bows his head until his chin almost touches his chest.
w|menundukkan.ko: 스트레칭할 때 바유는 턱이 가슴에 닿을 만큼 고개를 숙여요.

w|menundukkan.text: Sebelum makan, seluruh keluarga Intan menundukkan kepala untuk berdoa.
w|menundukkan.en: Before eating, Intan's whole family bows their heads to pray.
w|menundukkan.ko: 밥 먹기 전에 인탄 가족은 모두 고개를 숙여 기도해요.

w|menunggang.text: Untuk liputan festival, Bayu sempat menunggang kuda bersama para penari.
w|menunggang.en: For the festival story, Bayu even rode a horse with the dancers.
w|menunggang.ko: 축제 취재 때 바유는 무용수들과 함께 말을 타기까지 했어요.

w|menunggang.text: Adik Intan senang menunggang kerbau ke sawah bersama kakek.
w|menunggang.en: Intan's little brother loves riding the water buffalo to the rice field with Grandpa.
w|menunggang.ko: 인탄의 남동생은 할아버지와 물소를 타고 논에 가는 걸 좋아해요.

w|menunggangi.text: Menurut kesaksian Agus, pelaku kabur sambil menunggangi motor tanpa pelat nomor.
w|menunggangi.en: According to Agus's testimony, the culprit fled riding a motorbike without a license plate.
w|menunggangi.ko: 아구스의 증언에 따르면 범인은 번호판 없는 오토바이를 타고 달아났어요.

w|menunggangi.text: Di taman bermain restoran, seorang anak sedang menunggangi kuda-kudaan kayu.
w|menunggangi.en: In the restaurant's playground, a child is riding a wooden toy horse.
w|menunggangi.ko: 식당 놀이터에서 한 아이가 나무 말을 타고 있어요.

w|menunjuk.text: Pemandu menunjuk peta tua yang menunjukkan jalur perdagangan rempah.
w|menunjuk.en: The guide pointed to an old map showing the spice trade routes.
w|menunjuk.ko: 안내원이 향신료 무역로가 그려진 옛 지도를 가리켰어요.

w|menunjuk.text: Pembeli itu menunjuk mangga paling besar di keranjang Rina.
w|menunjuk.en: The shopper pointed at the biggest mango in Rina's basket.
w|menunjuk.ko: 손님이 리나 바구니에서 제일 큰 망고를 가리켰어요.

w|menuntaskan.text: Rudi harus menuntaskan laporan tamu sebelum pergantian sif.
w|menuntaskan.en: Rudi has to finish the guest report before the shift change.
w|menuntaskan.ko: 루디는 교대 시간 전에 손님 보고서를 끝내야 해요.

w|menuntaskan.text: Rina ingin menuntaskan pengecatan atap sebelum hujan pertama turun.
w|menuntaskan.en: Rina wants to finish painting the roof before the first rain falls.
w|menuntaskan.ko: 리나는 첫 비가 오기 전에 지붕 칠을 끝내고 싶어 해요.

w|menuntun.text: Fajar menuntun ayahnya yang sudah tua masuk ke toko.
w|menuntun.en: Fajar guided his elderly father into the shop.
w|menuntun.ko: 파자르는 연로한 아버지를 부축해 가게 안으로 모셨어요.

w|menuntun.text: Seorang relawan menuntun pelari tunanetra sampai garis finis.
w|menuntun.en: A volunteer guided a blind runner all the way to the finish line.
w|menuntun.ko: 한 자원봉사자가 시각장애인 선수를 결승선까지 이끌었어요.

w|menuntut.text: Pekerja menuntut kenaikan gaji yang adil.

w|menurun.text: Penjualan toko itu menurun bulan ini.
w|menurun.en: That store's sales declined this month.
w|menurun.ko: 그 가게 매출이 이번 달에 줄었어.

w|menurun.en: The decline in interest caused the event to be canceled.

w|menuruni.text: Fajar dan Rina perlahan menuruni tangga sambil disambut tepuk tangan.
w|menuruni.en: Fajar and Rina slowly walked down the stairs, greeted by applause.
w|menuruni.ko: 파자르와 리나가 박수를 받으며 천천히 계단을 내려왔어요.

w|menuruni.text: Kabut tebal perlahan menuruni lereng bukit di awal musim dingin.
w|menuruni.en: Thick fog slowly descends the hillside at the start of the cool season.
w|menuruni.ko: 서늘한 철이 시작되면 짙은 안개가 천천히 언덕을 타고 내려와요.

w|menurunkan.en: The government wants to lower food prices.
