w|menurunkan.ko: 정부가 식량 가격을 낮추고 싶어 해.

w|menurunkan.en: Please turn down the volume of that music.
w|menurunkan.ko: 그 음악 볼륨을 좀 낮춰 줘.

w|menurut.en: According to the doctor, just rest.

w|menuruti.text: Rina selalu menuruti aturan kantor, termasuk soal jam masuk.
w|menuruti.en: Rina always follows the office rules, including about arrival times.
w|menuruti.ko: 리나는 출근 시간을 포함해 회사 규칙을 늘 지켜요.

w|menuruti.text: Dewi berusaha menuruti permintaan tamu, asalkan masih masuk akal.
w|menuruti.en: Dewi tries to go along with guests' requests, as long as they're reasonable.
w|menuruti.ko: 데위는 손님 요청이 합리적이기만 하면 들어주려고 해요.

w|menusuk.text: Jarum itu menusuk jarinya tanpa sengaja.
w|menusuk.en: The needle accidentally pierced his finger.
Popping the balloon made the children laugh.

w|menutupi.en: He tried to cover up his mistake.
Clouds are covering the sun this morning.

w|menyabotase.text: Hujan deras seolah menyabotase rencana piknik Dimas setiap akhir pekan.
w|menyabotase.en: The heavy rain seemed to sabotage Dimas's picnic plans every weekend.
w|menyabotase.ko: 폭우가 주말마다 디마스의 소풍 계획을 망치는 것 같았어요.

w|menyabotase.text: Tikus di loteng seolah menyabotase kabel yang baru dipasang Putri.
w|menyabotase.en: The rats in the attic seemed to be sabotaging the cables Putri had just installed.
w|menyabotase.ko: 다락방 쥐들이 푸트리가 막 깐 전선을 망가뜨리는 것 같았어요.

w|menyadap.text: Di pelajaran sejarah, Eko membaca bahwa mata-mata dulu menyadap telepon pejabat musuh.
w|menyadap.en: In history class, Eko read that spies used to tap enemy officials' phones.
w|menyadap.ko: 역사 시간에 에코는 옛날 스파이들이 적국 관리의 전화를 도청했다는 걸 읽었어요.

w|menyadap.text: Dalam kelas melukis, Ayu belajar cara menyadap getah karet untuk membuat cat alami.
w|menyadap.en: In painting class, Ayu learned how to tap rubber sap to make natural paint.
w|menyadap.ko: 그림 수업에서 아유는 천연 물감을 만들려고 고무나무 수액 받는 법을 배웠어요.

w|menyadarkan.text: Nilai ulangan yang jelek menyadarkan Budi bahwa ia harus belajar lebih rajin.
w|menyadarkan.en: The bad test score made Budi realize he had to study harder.
w|menyadarkan.ko: 나쁜 시험 점수에 버디는 더 열심히 공부해야 한다는 걸 깨달았어요.

w|menyadarkan.text: Banjir tahun lalu menyadarkan Siti pentingnya membersihkan selokan sebelum musim hujan.
w|menyadarkan.en: Last year's flood made Siti realize how important it is to clean the drains before the rainy season.
w|menyadarkan.ko: 작년 홍수로 시티는 우기 전에 도랑을 치우는 게 얼마나 중요한지 깨달았어요.

w|menyajikan.text: Bayu menyajikan nasi goreng untuk teman-teman yang datang ke unitnya.
w|menyajikan.en: Bayu served fried rice to the friends who came to his unit.
w|menyajikan.ko: 바유는 집에 놀러 온 친구들에게 나시고렝을 대접했어요.

w|menyajikan.text: Gerbong restoran menyajikan nasi rames dan teh manis.
w|menyajikan.en: The dining car serves mixed rice and sweet tea.
w|menyajikan.ko: 식당칸에서는 나시 라메스와 단 차를 팔아요.

w|menyaksikan.en: We watched the match until the end.

w|menyaksikan.text: Dia menyaksikan kejadian itu dari balkon.
w|menyaksikan.en: He witnessed the incident from the balcony.

w|menyala.text: Lampu jalan mulai menyala saat senja.
w|menyala.en: The street lights start to turn on at dusk.
The lit campfire warms the night.

w|menyalahgunakan.text: Agus curiga ada orang yang menyalahgunakan nama pasar itu untuk berjualan daring.
w|menyalahgunakan.en: Agus suspects someone is misusing the market's name to sell online.
w|menyalahgunakan.ko: 아구스는 누군가 그 시장 이름을 도용해 온라인에서 장사한다고 의심해요.

w|menyalahgunakan.text: Wati kesal pada pedagang yang menyalahgunakan musim banjir untuk menaikkan harga air galon.
w|menyalahgunakan.en: Wati is annoyed at traders who exploit the flood season to raise the price of bottled water.
w|menyalahgunakan.ko: 와티는 홍수철을 틈타 생수 값을 올리는 장사꾼들에게 화가 나요.

w|menyalahkan.en: Blaming the weather doesn't solve the problem.
w|menyalahkan.ko: 날씨 탓을 해도 문제가 해결되지 않아.

w|menyalakan.text: Dia menyalakan lilin di ruang gelap.
w|menyalakan.en: She lit a candle in the dark room.
Turning on the stove needs a little care.
w|menyalakan.ko: 가스레인지를 켤 때는 조금 조심해야 해.

w|menyalin.text: Budi menyalin pesan-pesan lama dari ponselnya sebagai bukti.
w|menyalin.en: Budi copied old messages from his phone as evidence.
w|menyalin.ko: 부디는 증거로 휴대폰에서 예전 메시지들을 옮겨 적었어요.

w|menyalin.text: Siti menyalin alamat baru di buku kecil supaya tidak lupa.
w|menyalin.en: Siti copied the new address into a small notebook so she wouldn't forget.
w|menyalin.ko: 시티는 잊지 않으려고 새 주소를 작은 수첩에 옮겨 적었어요.

w|menyalurkan.text: Rudi menyalurkan makanan sumbangan warga ke tempat penampungan hewan.
w|menyalurkan.en: Rudi distributes food donated by residents to the animal shelter.
w|menyalurkan.ko: 루디는 주민들이 기부한 사료를 동물 보호소에 전달해요.

w|menyalurkan.text: Kepala desa menyalurkan bantuan beras kepada keluarga Rina setelah longsor.
w|menyalurkan.en: The village head distributed rice aid to Rina's family after the landslide.
w|menyalurkan.ko: 산사태 뒤 이장님이 리나네 가족에게 쌀 지원을 전달했어요.

w|menyamakan.text: Fajar berusaha menyamakan format laporan dari semua kantor kelurahan.
w|menyamakan.en: Fajar tried to standardize the report format from all the neighborhood offices.
w|menyamakan.ko: 파자르는 모든 동사무소의 보고서 양식을 똑같이 맞추려고 애썼어요.

w|menyamakan.text: Lestari menulis bahwa tidak adil menyamakan hidup di desa dengan hidup di kota besar.
w|menyamakan.en: Lestari wrote that it isn't fair to compare village life with life in a big city.
w|menyamakan.ko: 레스타리는 시골 생활을 대도시 생활과 똑같이 보는 건 공평하지 않다고 썼어요.

w|menyamar.en: That agent disguised himself as a merchant.

w|menyamar.text: Dia suka menyamar di pesta kostum.
w|menyamar.en: She likes to disguise herself at costume parties.
w|menyamar.ko: 그녀는 코스튬 파티에서 변장하는 걸 좋아해.

w|menyamarkan.text: Agus menyamarkan rasa bayam dalam roti hijau untuk anak-anak.
w|menyamarkan.en: Agus disguises the taste of spinach in green bread for kids.
w|menyamarkan.ko: 아구스는 아이들용 초록 빵에서 시금치 맛이 안 나게 감춰요.

w|menyamarkan.text: Wati menyamarkan data pengguna sebelum dipakai untuk pengujian.
w|menyamarkan.en: Wati masks user data before it's used for testing.
w|menyamarkan.ko: 와티는 테스트에 쓰기 전에 사용자 데이터를 가려요.

w|menyambar.text: Seorang pencopet menyambar dompet seorang pengunjung di tengah keramaian.
w|menyambar.en: A pickpocket snatched a visitor's wallet in the middle of the crowd.
w|menyambar.ko: 소매치기가 인파 속에서 한 방문객의 지갑을 낚아챘어요.

w|menyambar.text: Fotografer itu cepat menyambar momen saat Intan tertawa lepas.
w|menyambar.en: The photographer quickly caught the moment Intan burst out laughing.
w|menyambar.ko: 사진사는 인탄이 활짝 웃는 순간을 재빨리 잡아냈어요.

w|menyambung.text: Rudi menyambung tali tenda yang putus dengan simpul yang kuat.
w|menyambung.en: Rudi joined the broken tent rope with a strong knot.
w|menyambung.ko: 루디는 끊어진 텐트 줄을 튼튼한 매듭으로 이었어요.

w|menyambung.text: Penyanyi itu langsung menyambung ke lagu berikutnya tanpa jeda.
w|menyambung.en: The singer went straight into the next song without a break.
w|menyambung.ko: 그 가수는 쉬지 않고 바로 다음 곡으로 이어 갔어요.

w|menyambut.text: Mereka menyambut tamu dengan senyum hangat.
w|menyambut.en: They welcomed the guests with warm smiles.

w|menyambut.text: Sekolah menyambut siswa baru di aula.
w|menyambut.en: The school welcomed new students in the hall.

w|menyampaikan.en: He delivered a message to his friend.
The teacher delivered the material clearly.

w|menyandera.text: Di radio, Bayu mendengar berita kelompok bersenjata yang menyandera awak kapal di luar negeri.
w|menyandera.en: On the radio, Bayu heard news of an armed group holding a ship's crew hostage abroad.
w|menyandera.ko: 바유는 라디오에서 해외에서 무장 단체가 선원들을 인질로 잡았다는 뉴스를 들었어요.

w|menyandera.text: Intan pernah membaca novel tentang perompak yang menyandera seorang pelukis terkenal.
w|menyandera.en: Intan once read a novel about pirates who held a famous painter hostage.
w|menyandera.ko: 인탄은 해적들이 유명한 화가를 인질로 잡는 소설을 읽은 적이 있어요.

w|menyangka.en: I thought she had already gone home.
w|menyangka.ko: 나는 그가 이미 집에 간 줄 알았어.

w|menyangkal.text: Jangan menyangkal fakta yang sudah jelas.
w|menyangkal.en: Don't deny facts that are already clear.

w|menyangkut.text: Pertengkaran Budi dan Rina menyangkut uang tabungan yang hilang dari laci.
w|menyangkut.en: Budi and Rina's quarrel concerned savings that went missing from a drawer.
w|menyangkut.ko: 부디와 리나의 싸움은 서랍에서 사라진 저금과 관련된 거였어요.

w|menyangkut.text: Urusan surat pindah menyangkut kantor kelurahan lama dan yang baru.
w|menyangkut.en: The moving paperwork involves both the old and the new village office.
w|menyangkut.ko: 전입 서류 일은 예전 동사무소와 새 동사무소 둘 다 관련돼 있어요.

w|menyanjung.text: Para tamu terus menyanjung pidato wali kota, tetapi Fajar tetap mencatat keluhan warga.
w|menyanjung.en: The guests kept praising the mayor's speech, but Fajar kept noting down residents' complaints.
w|menyanjung.ko: 손님들은 시장의 연설을 계속 치켜세웠지만 파자르는 주민들의 불만을 꼼꼼히 적었어요.

w|menyanjung.text: Bu Rina sering menyanjung masakan Lestari di depan tetangga lain.
w|menyanjung.en: Bu Rina often praises Lestari's cooking in front of the other neighbors.
w|menyanjung.ko: 리나 씨는 다른 이웃들 앞에서 레스타리의 요리를 자주 칭찬해요.

w|menyanyi.text: Dia suka menyanyi di kamar mandi.
w|menyanyi.en: She likes to sing in the bathroom.

w|menyanyi.text: Mereka menyanyi bersama di atas panggung.
w|menyanyi.en: They sang together on the stage.

w|menyanyikan.en: The choir sang the national anthem.

w|menyanyikan.text: Dia suka menyanyikan lagu lama di rumah.
w|menyanyikan.en: She likes to sing old songs at home.
w|menyanyikan.ko: 그는 집에서 옛 노래를 부르길 좋아해.

w|menyapa.text: Usai pertunjukan, Bayu menyapa penonton di lobi satu per satu.
w|menyapa.en: After the show, Bayu greeted the audience in the lobby one by one.
w|menyapa.ko: 공연이 끝나고 바유는 로비에서 관객들에게 하나하나 인사했어요.

w|menyapa.text: Setiap pagi Intan menyapa satpam di lobi dengan senyum.
w|menyapa.en: Every morning Intan greets the security guard in the lobby with a smile.
w|menyapa.ko: 인탄은 매일 아침 로비 경비원에게 웃으며 인사해요.

w|menyapu.text: Setiap pagi petugas kebersihan menyapu lobi sebelum penghuni turun.
w|menyapu.en: Every morning the cleaner sweeps the lobby before the residents come down.
w|menyapu.ko: 아침마다 청소원이 입주민들이 내려오기 전에 로비를 쓸어요.

w|menyapu.text: Petugas kereta menyapu remah-remah makanan di lorong gerbong.
w|menyapu.en: The train attendant swept up food crumbs in the carriage aisle.
w|menyapu.ko: 열차 승무원이 객차 통로의 음식 부스러기를 쓸었어요.

w|menyarankan.text: Saya menyarankan Anda datang lebih awal.

w|menyaring.text: Penjual kopi menyaring ampas sebelum menuangkan kopi untuk Agus.
w|menyaring.en: The coffee seller strained the grounds before pouring coffee for Agus.
w|menyaring.ko: 커피 장수는 아구스에게 커피를 따르기 전에 찌꺼기를 걸러 냈어요.

w|menyaring.text: Wati menyaring air hujan sebelum dipakai menyiram tanaman.
w|menyaring.en: Wati filters rainwater before using it to water the plants.
w|menyaring.ko: 와티는 빗물을 걸러서 화분에 물을 줘요.

w|menyatu.text: Musik gamelan dan lagu pop menyatu dengan indah di pesta itu.
w|menyatu.en: Gamelan music and pop songs blended beautifully at the party.
w|menyatu.ko: 그 잔치에서 가믈란 음악과 팝송이 아름답게 어우러졌어요.

w|menyatu.text: Bagi Rina, menulis dan memotret sudah menyatu menjadi satu pekerjaan.
w|menyatu.en: For Rina, writing and taking photos have merged into one job.
w|menyatu.ko: 리나에게 글쓰기와 사진 찍기는 이미 한 가지 일이 됐어요.

w|menyatukan.text: Klub buku itu menyatukan pembaca dari berbagai usia.
w|menyatukan.en: The book club brings together readers of all ages.
w|menyatukan.ko: 그 독서 모임은 여러 나이대 독자들을 하나로 모아요.

w|menyatukan.text: Rel kereta ini dulu dibangun untuk menyatukan kota-kota di pulau Jawa.
w|menyatukan.en: This railway was built long ago to connect the cities of Java.
w|menyatukan.ko: 이 철도는 예전에 자바섬 도시들을 하나로 잇기 위해 놓였어요.

w|menyayangi.en: She really cherishes her little sibling.

w|menyayangi.text: Menyayangi hewan peliharaan butuh tanggung jawab.

w|menyebar.text: Asap mulai menyebar ke seluruh ruangan.
w|menyebar.en: Smoke began to spread through the whole room.

w|menyebar.text: Menyebar kabar bohong akan merugikan banyak orang.
w|menyebar.en: Spreading false news will harm many people.
w|menyebar.ko: 거짓 소문을 퍼뜨리면 많은 사람이 피해를 봐.

w|menyebarkan.text: Jangan menyebarkan rumor yang belum jelas.
w|menyebarkan.en: Do not spread rumors that are still unclear.
w|menyebarkan.ko: 아직 확실하지 않은 소문을 퍼뜨리지 마.

w|menyebarkan.text: Angin menyebarkan bau bunga ke seluruh taman.
w|menyebarkan.en: The wind spread the flower scent across the park.

w|menyeberang.text: Agus berhenti sebentar karena ada rombongan anak sekolah yang mau menyeberang.
w|menyeberang.en: Agus stopped for a moment because a group of schoolchildren wanted to cross.
w|menyeberang.ko: 학생들이 길을 건너려고 해서 아구스는 잠깐 멈췄어요.

w|menyeberang.text: Wati harus menyeberang jalan besar untuk sampai ke halte bus.
w|menyeberang.en: Wati has to cross a big road to get to the bus stop.
w|menyeberang.ko: 와티는 버스 정류장에 가려면 큰길을 건너야 해요.

w|menyeberangi.text: Agus naik feri untuk menyeberangi Selat Sunda menuju Lampung.
w|menyeberangi.en: Agus took a ferry to cross the Sunda Strait to Lampung.
w|menyeberangi.ko: 아구스는 람풍으로 가려고 페리를 타고 순다 해협을 건넜어요.

w|menyeberangi.text: Wati takut menyeberangi jembatan penyeberangan yang licin saat hujan.
w|menyeberangi.en: Wati is afraid of crossing the slippery footbridge when it rains.
w|menyeberangi.ko: 와티는 비 올 때 미끄러운 육교를 건너는 게 무서워요.

w|menyebutkan.ko: 세부 사항을 말하면 우리가 이해하기 쉬워.

w|menyediakan.text: Hotel menyediakan sarapan gratis setiap pagi.
w|menyediakan.en: The hotel provides free breakfast every morning.
w|menyediakan.ko: 호텔이 매일 아침 무료 조식을 제공해.

w|menyediakan.text: Mereka menyediakan kursi untuk tamu lanjut usia.
w|menyediakan.en: They provide seats for elderly guests.
w|menyediakan.ko: 그들은 고령 손님을 위해 의자를 마련해.

w|menyedot.text: Pompa air dipakai untuk menyedot genangan di lubang fondasi.
w|menyedot.en: A water pump is used to suck out the pooled water in the foundation pit.
w|menyedot.ko: 기초 구덩이에 고인 물을 빼내는 데 양수기를 써요.

w|menyedot.text: Wati membeli penyedot debu kecil, tapi alat itu terlalu lemah untuk menyedot bulu kucing.
w|menyedot.en: Wati bought a small vacuum cleaner, but it's too weak to suck up cat hair.
w|menyedot.ko: 와티는 작은 청소기를 샀지만 고양이 털을 빨아들이기엔 너무 약해요.

w|menyegarkan.text: Air sungai yang dingin menyegarkan badan Agus setelah seharian di ladang.
w|menyegarkan.en: The cold river water refreshed Agus's body after a whole day in the field.
w|menyegarkan.ko: 하루 종일 밭일을 한 뒤 차가운 강물이 아구스의 몸을 시원하게 했어요.

w|menyegarkan.text: Wati menyemprotkan pengharum ruangan yang menyegarkan udara apotek.
w|menyegarkan.en: Wati sprays an air freshener that freshens the pharmacy air.
w|menyegarkan.ko: 와티는 약국 공기를 상쾌하게 하는 방향제를 뿌려요.

w|menyegel.text: Petugas menyegel pabrik yang membuang limbah ke sungai.
w|menyegel.en: Officials sealed off the factory that dumped waste into the river.
w|menyegel.ko: 당국이 강에 폐수를 버린 공장을 봉쇄했어요.

w|menyegel.text: Petugas dinas kesehatan menyegel lemari berisi obat palsu di apotek seberang.
w|menyegel.en: Health officials sealed a cabinet of fake medicine at the pharmacy across the street.
w|menyegel.ko: 보건 당국이 맞은편 약국의 가짜 약 진열장을 봉인했어요.

w|menyeimbangkan.text: Rudi berusaha menyeimbangkan tugas malam dengan waktu untuk keluarga.
w|menyeimbangkan.en: Rudi tries to balance night shifts with time for his family.
w|menyeimbangkan.ko: 루디는 야간 근무와 가족과 보내는 시간 사이에서 균형을 잡으려고 애써요.

w|menyeimbangkan.text: Rina menyeimbangkan pakan anjing tua itu antara daging dan sayur.
w|menyeimbangkan.en: Rina balanced the old dog's food between meat and vegetables.
w|menyeimbangkan.ko: 리나는 그 늙은 개의 사료를 고기와 채소로 균형 있게 맞췄어요.

w|menyekap.text: Rudi menonton berita tentang perampok yang menyekap pegawai sebuah restoran di kota lain.
w|menyekap.en: Rudi watched the news about robbers who held a restaurant's staff captive in another city.
w|menyekap.ko: 루디는 다른 도시에서 강도들이 식당 직원들을 감금했다는 뉴스를 봤어요.

w|menyekap.text: Rina membeli novel detektif lawas tentang penculik yang menyekap seorang pewaris.
w|menyekap.en: Rina bought an old detective novel about kidnappers who hold an heir captive.
w|menyekap.ko: 리나는 납치범들이 상속자를 감금하는 내용의 옛 탐정 소설을 샀어요.

w|menyelam.text: Untuk liputan terumbu karang, Eko ikut menyelam bersama para peneliti.
w|menyelam.en: For the coral reef story, Eko went diving with the researchers.
w|menyelam.ko: 산호초 취재를 위해 에코는 연구원들과 함께 잠수했어요.

w|menyelam.text: Pelanggan itu bilang ponselnya ikut menyelam ke kolam renang bersama dia.
w|menyelam.en: The customer said his phone went diving into the swimming pool with him.
w|menyelam.ko: 그 손님은 휴대폰이 자기랑 같이 수영장에 잠수했다고 했어요.

w|menyelamatkan.en: He managed to save that child.

w|menyelenggarakan.text: Bulan depan museum kota akan menyelenggarakan pameran tentang perdagangan rempah.
w|menyelenggarakan.en: Next month the city museum will hold an exhibition on the spice trade.
w|menyelenggarakan.ko: 다음 달 시립 박물관이 향신료 무역 전시회를 열어요.

w|menyelenggarakan.text: Rumah produksi itu akan menyelenggarakan audisi terbuka untuk pemain anak-anak.
w|menyelenggarakan.en: The production company will hold open auditions for child actors.
w|menyelenggarakan.ko: 그 제작사는 아역 배우 공개 오디션을 열 거예요.

w|menyelesaikan.en: He managed to finish his task.

w|menyelidiki.text: Polisi mulai menyelidiki kasus pencurian itu.
w|menyelidiki.en: The police began investigating that theft case.
w|menyelidiki.ko: 경찰이 그 절도 사건을 조사하기 시작했어.

w|menyelidiki.en: They investigated the cause of the house fire.

w|menyelimuti.text: Kabut asap menyelimuti kota ketika Bayu berangkat ke kantor redaksi pagi itu.
w|menyelimuti.en: Smog blanketed the city when Bayu left for the newsroom that morning.
w|menyelimuti.ko: 그날 아침 바유가 편집국으로 출발할 때 연무가 도시를 뒤덮었어요.

w|menyelimuti.text: Setiap pagi kabut tebal menyelimuti kebun teh di belakang rumah Intan.
w|menyelimuti.en: Every morning thick fog blankets the tea garden behind Intan's house.
w|menyelimuti.ko: 매일 아침 짙은 안개가 인탄의 집 뒤 차밭을 뒤덮어요.

w|menyelinap.en: That cat slipped into the kitchen.
He tried to sneak away unnoticed.

w|menyelipkan.text: Andi menyelipkan pembatas buku di halaman terakhir yang ia baca.
w|menyelipkan.en: Andi slipped a bookmark into the last page he had read.
w|menyelipkan.ko: 안디는 마지막으로 읽은 쪽에 책갈피를 끼웠어요.

w|menyelipkan.text: Dewi menyelipkan surat perpisahan di bawah pintu tetangganya sebelum pindah.
w|menyelipkan.en: Dewi slipped a farewell note under her neighbor's door before moving.
w|menyelipkan.ko: 데위는 이사 가기 전에 이웃집 문 아래로 작별 편지를 밀어 넣었어요.

w|menyelundupkan.text: Budi ingat Andi pernah menyelundupkan kucing ke asrama sekolah.
w|menyelundupkan.en: Budi remembers Andi once smuggled a cat into the school dormitory.
w|menyelundupkan.ko: 부디는 안디가 학교 기숙사에 고양이를 몰래 들여왔던 걸 기억해요.

w|menyelundupkan.text: Seorang peserta ketahuan menyelundupkan sepeda ke dalam rute lomba.
w|menyelundupkan.en: A participant was caught sneaking a bicycle onto the race route.
w|menyelundupkan.ko: 한 참가자가 대회 코스에 자전거를 몰래 들여온 게 들통났어요.

w|menyeluruh.text: Sebelum operasi, Dimas melakukan pemeriksaan menyeluruh pada anjing itu.
w|menyeluruh.en: Before the operation, Dimas gave the dog a thorough examination.
w|menyeluruh.ko: 수술 전에 디마스는 그 개를 꼼꼼히 진찰했어요.

w|menyeluruh.text: Kepala lab meminta evaluasi menyeluruh setelah sampel tertukar.
w|menyeluruh.en: The lab head asked for a thorough review after the samples were mixed up.
w|menyeluruh.ko: 시료가 뒤바뀐 뒤 연구실장은 전면 점검을 요구했어요.

w|menyemangati.text: Pemandu museum menyemangati anak-anak agar berani bertanya tentang benda kuno.
w|menyemangati.en: The museum guide encouraged the children to be brave and ask about the ancient objects.
w|menyemangati.ko: 박물관 안내원은 아이들이 옛 물건에 대해 용기 내어 질문하도록 북돋아 줬어요.

w|menyemangati.text: Sutradara menyemangati Putri sebelum adegan menangis yang sulit itu.
w|menyemangati.en: The director encouraged Putri before that difficult crying scene.
w|menyemangati.ko: 감독은 어려운 우는 장면 전에 푸트리를 격려했어요.

w|menyembah.text: Dalang menceritakan rakyat yang menyembah raja mereka seperti dewa.
w|menyembah.en: The puppet master told of people who worshipped their king like a god.
w|menyembah.ko: 인형극 연출가는 왕을 신처럼 섬기는 백성 이야기를 들려줬어요.

w|menyembah.text: Rina menulis tentang situs kuno tempat orang dulu menyembah matahari.
w|menyembah.en: Rina wrote about an ancient site where people once worshipped the sun.
w|menyembah.ko: 리나는 옛사람들이 해를 숭배하던 고대 유적에 대해 썼어요.

w|menyembelih.text: Warga menyembelih seekor kambing untuk syukuran panen.
w|menyembelih.en: The villagers slaughtered a goat for the harvest thanksgiving.
w|menyembelih.ko: 주민들은 추수 감사 잔치를 위해 염소 한 마리를 잡았어요.

w|menyembelih.text: Ayu pernah meninjau pabrik daging yang menyembelih sapi di bawah pengawasan dokter hewan.
w|menyembelih.en: Ayu once inspected a meat plant that slaughters cattle under a vet's supervision.
w|menyembelih.ko: 아유는 수의사 감독 아래 소를 도축하는 육가공 공장을 점검한 적이 있어요.

w|menyembuhkan.en: This medicine can cure a fever.
w|menyembuhkan.ko: 이 약이 열을 나을 수 있어.

w|menyembuhkan.en: Time helps heal a broken heart.

w|menyemprot.text: Ombak besar menyemprot wajah Eko saat ia berdiri di ujung dermaga.
w|menyemprot.en: A big wave sprayed Eko's face as he stood at the end of the pier.
w|menyemprot.ko: 부두 끝에 서 있던 에코의 얼굴에 큰 파도가 물보라를 뿌렸어요.

w|menyemprot.text: Perawat menyemprot gigi Ayu dengan air dingin sebelum dokter mulai bekerja.
w|menyemprot.en: The nurse sprayed Ayu's teeth with cold water before the dentist started.
w|menyemprot.ko: 의사가 치료를 시작하기 전에 간호사가 아유의 이에 찬물을 뿌렸어요.

w|menyemprotkan.text: Bayu menyemprotkan pewangi ruangan di sekitar meja baru.
w|menyemprotkan.en: Bayu sprayed air freshener around his new desk.
w|menyemprotkan.ko: 바유는 새 책상 주변에 방향제를 뿌렸어요.

w|menyemprotkan.text: Intan menyemprotkan cairan pembersih ke matras setelah dipakai.
w|menyemprotkan.en: Intan sprays cleaning fluid onto the mat after it's been used.
w|menyemprotkan.ko: 인탄은 쓰고 난 매트에 세정제를 뿌려요.

w|menyempurnakan.text: Agus menambahkan lampu gantung kecil untuk menyempurnakan tampilan dapurnya.
w|menyempurnakan.en: Agus added a small pendant lamp to perfect the look of his kitchen.
w|menyempurnakan.ko: 아구스는 부엌 모습을 완성하려고 작은 펜던트 조명을 달았어요.

w|menyempurnakan.text: Wati menambahkan bantal tebal untuk menyempurnakan sudut baca di musim hujan.
w|menyempurnakan.en: Wati added thick cushions to complete her reading nook for the rainy season.
w|menyempurnakan.ko: 와티는 우기용 독서 구석을 완성하려고 두툼한 쿠션을 더했어요.

w|menyendiri.text: Di hari hujan, Dimas suka menyendiri di loteng sambil membaca.
w|menyendiri.en: On rainy days, Dimas likes to be alone in the attic reading.
w|menyendiri.ko: 비 오는 날이면 디마스는 다락방에서 혼자 책 읽는 걸 좋아해요.

w|menyendiri.text: Saat lelah, Putri suka menyendiri di beranda belakang rumah tua itu.
w|menyendiri.en: When she's tired, Putri likes to be alone on the old house's back veranda.
w|menyendiri.ko: 지치면 푸트리는 그 낡은 집 뒤 베란다에서 혼자 있는 걸 좋아해요.

w|menyengat.text: Seekor tawon menyengat tangan Rudi saat dia mengangkat tumpeng.
w|menyengat.en: A wasp stung Rudi's hand when he lifted the tumpeng rice cone.
w|menyengat.ko: 루디가 뚬뻥을 들어 올릴 때 말벌이 손을 쏘았어요.

w|menyengat.text: Bau sampah yang menyengat membuat Rina menulis berita tentang tempat pembuangan liar.
w|menyengat.en: The pungent smell of garbage led Rina to write a story about an illegal dump.
w|menyengat.ko: 코를 찌르는 쓰레기 냄새 때문에 리나는 불법 쓰레기장 기사를 썼어요.

w|menyepakati.text: Bayu dan penjual akhirnya menyepakati harga untuk kursi rotan itu.
w|menyepakati.en: Bayu and the seller finally agreed on a price for the rattan chair.
w|menyepakati.ko: 바유와 판매자는 마침내 그 등나무 의자 가격에 합의했어요.

w|menyepakati.text: Kedua keluarga menyepakati tanggal pernikahan setelah tiga kali bertemu.
w|menyepakati.en: The two families agreed on the wedding date after meeting three times.
w|menyepakati.ko: 양가는 세 번 만난 뒤에 결혼 날짜를 정했어요.

w|menyerah.en: Don't give up just like that.
Giving up is not an option for me.

w|menyerahkan.en: He handed the keys to me.

w|menyeramkan.text: Film itu sangat menyeramkan bagi anak kecil.
w|menyeramkan.en: That film is very scary for little kids.
The sound in the attic sounded eerie.

w|menyerap.text: Budi menulis bahwa sawah membantu menyerap air hujan dan mencegah banjir.
w|menyerap.en: Budi wrote that rice fields help absorb rainwater and prevent floods.
w|menyerap.ko: 부디는 논이 빗물을 흡수해 홍수를 막는 데 도움이 된다고 썼어요.

w|menyerap.text: Siti membuka jendela supaya kertas buku tua tidak menyerap terlalu banyak lembap.
w|menyerap.en: Siti opens the windows so old book pages don't absorb too much damp.
w|menyerap.ko: 시티는 오래된 책장이 습기를 너무 빨아들이지 않게 창문을 열어요.

w|menyerbu.text: Begitu mendengar teriakan, Ibu langsung menyerbu masuk ke kamar Rina.
w|menyerbu.en: As soon as she heard the shouting, Mom stormed into Rina's room.
w|menyerbu.ko: 고함 소리를 듣자마자 엄마가 리나 방으로 뛰어 들어왔어요.

w|menyerbu.text: Semut menyerbu kardus berisi gula yang lupa ditutup Siti.
w|menyerbu.en: Ants swarmed the box of sugar that Siti forgot to close.
w|menyerbu.ko: 시티가 깜빡 안 닫은 설탕 상자에 개미가 몰려들었어요.

w|menyeret.text: Dua petugas menyeret kursi tambahan ke depan untuk para saksi.
w|menyeret.en: Two officers dragged extra chairs to the front for the witnesses.
w|menyeret.ko: 직원 두 명이 증인들을 위해 의자를 더 앞으로 끌어왔어요.

w|menyeret.text: Seorang bapak menyeret karung beras ke depan warung.
w|menyeret.en: A man dragged a sack of rice to the front of the shop.
w|menyeret.ko: 한 아저씨가 쌀 포대를 가게 앞까지 끌고 왔어요.

w|menyergap.text: Rasa kantuk menyergap Budi setelah jaga malam di klinik.
w|menyergap.en: Drowsiness overcame Budi after the night shift at the clinic.
w|menyergap.ko: 병원에서 밤샘 근무를 한 뒤 부디에게 졸음이 덮쳐 왔어요.

w|menyergap.text: Hawa dingin langsung menyergap Siti begitu pintu rumah dibuka.
w|menyergap.en: The cold air hit Siti as soon as the front door was opened.
w|menyergap.ko: 문을 열자마자 찬 공기가 시티를 덮쳤어요.

w|menyertai.text: Kabut tipis selalu menyertai pagi di lembah tempat Agus tinggal.
w|menyertai.en: A thin mist always accompanies the mornings in the valley where Agus lives.
w|menyertai.ko: 아구스가 사는 골짜기의 아침엔 늘 옅은 안개가 끼어요.

w|menyertai.text: Wati selalu menyertai setiap obat dengan catatan aturan pakai yang jelas.
w|menyertai.en: Wati always includes clear dosage notes with every medicine.
w|menyertai.ko: 와티는 약마다 늘 알기 쉬운 복용법 메모를 함께 붙여 줘요.

w|menyertakan.text: Saat menjual beras, Budi selalu menyertakan nota yang rapi.
w|menyertakan.en: When he sells rice, Budi always includes a neat receipt.
w|menyertakan.ko: 부디는 쌀을 팔 때 항상 깔끔한 영수증을 같이 넣어요.

w|menyertakan.text: Siti selalu menyertakan daftar bahan dalam setiap resep yang dia bagikan.
w|menyertakan.en: Siti always includes a list of ingredients in every recipe she shares.
w|menyertakan.ko: 시티는 나눠 주는 조리법마다 꼭 재료 목록을 같이 적어요.

w|menyerupai.text: Dari jauh, gedung apartemen itu menyerupai kotak korek api raksasa.
w|menyerupai.en: From afar, the apartment building looks like a giant matchbox.
w|menyerupai.ko: 멀리서 보면 그 아파트 건물은 거대한 성냥갑 같아요.

w|menyerupai.text: Awan gelap sore itu menyerupai gumpalan kapas kotor.
w|menyerupai.en: The dark clouds that afternoon looked like clumps of dirty cotton.
w|menyerupai.ko: 그날 오후 먹구름은 더러운 솜뭉치 같았어요.

w|menyesali.text: Menyesali masa lalu tidak mengubah apa pun.
w|menyesali.en: Regretting the past does not change anything.

w|menyesalkan.text: Kepala desa menyesalkan penebangan pohon di lereng atas.
w|menyesalkan.en: The village head regretted the tree felling on the upper slopes.

w|menyesalkan.text: Direktur menyesalkan kecelakaan kecil di lini perakitan minggu lalu.
w|menyesalkan.en: The director expressed regret over the minor accident on the assembly line last week.
w|menyesalkan.ko: 사장은 지난주 조립 라인에서 난 작은 사고를 유감스러워했어요.

w|menyesatkan.text: Rudi mengingatkan warga agar tidak menyebarkan kabar yang menyesatkan.
w|menyesatkan.en: Rudi reminded residents not to spread misleading news.
w|menyesatkan.ko: 루디는 주민들에게 잘못된 소문을 퍼뜨리지 말라고 당부했어요.

w|menyesatkan.text: Rina bilang informasi di internet soal makanan kucing sering menyesatkan.
w|menyesatkan.en: Rina says information online about cat food is often misleading.
w|menyesatkan.ko: 리나는 인터넷에 있는 고양이 사료 정보가 잘못된 경우가 많다고 해요.

w|menyesuaikan.text: Hakim meminta para saksi menyesuaikan jadwal dengan sidang berikutnya.
w|menyesuaikan.en: The judge asked the witnesses to adjust their schedules to the next hearing.
w|menyesuaikan.ko: 판사는 증인들에게 다음 재판에 맞춰 일정을 조정해 달라고 했어요.

w|menyesuaikan.text: Lestari menyesuaikan harga gula setelah harga dari pemasok naik.
w|menyesuaikan.en: Lestari adjusted the price of sugar after the supplier's price went up.
w|menyesuaikan.ko: 레스타리는 납품 가격이 오르자 설탕 값을 조정했어요.

w|menyetel.text: Setiap pagi petugas jaga menyetel radio ke saluran informasi lalu lintas.
w|menyetel.en: Every morning the officer on duty tunes the radio to the traffic information channel.
w|menyetel.ko: 매일 아침 당직 경찰관은 라디오를 교통 정보 채널에 맞춰요.

w|menyetel.text: Rina menyetel jam tangannya agar berbunyi setiap kali ia menempuh satu kilometer.
w|menyetel.en: Rina set her watch to beep every time she covers one kilometer.
w|menyetel.ko: 리나는 일 킬로미터를 달릴 때마다 울리도록 손목시계를 맞췄어요.

w|menyetir.en: Dad is driving toward the office.

w|menyetir.text: Dia belajar menyetir di lapangan kosong.
w|menyetir.en: She is learning to drive in an empty lot.

w|menyetrum.text: Dimas memperbaiki lemari pendingin obat dengan hati-hati karena kabelnya bisa menyetrum.
w|menyetrum.en: Dimas repaired the medicine fridge carefully because its wiring could give a shock.
w|menyetrum.ko: 디마스는 전선에 감전될 수 있어서 약 냉장고를 조심스럽게 고쳤어요.

w|menyetrum.text: Kabel tua di dapur sempat menyetrum Putri saat dia memasang lampu.
w|menyetrum.en: The old wiring in the kitchen gave Putri a shock while she was installing a light.
w|menyetrum.ko: 푸트리는 부엌에 등을 달다가 낡은 전선에 감전될 뻔했어요.

w|menyetujui.en: The boss finally approved the team's proposal.

w|menyetujui.text: Orang tua tidak menyetujui rencana itu.
w|menyetujui.en: The parents did not approve that plan.

w|menyewa.text: Kami akan menyewa mobil untuk liburan.
w|menyewa.en: We will rent a car for the holiday.
w|menyewa.ko: 우리는 휴가를 위해 차를 빌릴 거야.

w|menyewa.text: Menyewa kamar di sini cukup murah.
w|menyewa.en: Renting a room here is fairly cheap.
w|menyewa.ko: 여기서 방을 빌리는 건 꽤 싸.

w|menyewakan.text: Sekolah masak itu juga menyewakan dapurnya untuk acara ulang tahun.
w|menyewakan.en: The cooking school also rents out its kitchen for birthday parties.
w|menyewakan.ko: 그 요리 학교는 생일 파티용으로 부엌을 빌려주기도 해요.

w|menyewakan.text: Rani sekarang menyewakan kamar kosong di rumahnya untuk mahasiswa.
w|menyewakan.en: Rani now rents out the empty room in her house to university students.
w|menyewakan.ko: 라니는 지금 집의 빈방을 대학생에게 세놓아요.

w|menyia-nyiakan.text: Dimas bilang jangan menyia-nyiakan obat dengan memberikannya tanpa resep.
w|menyia-nyiakan.en: Dimas said not to waste medicine by giving it without a prescription.
w|menyia-nyiakan.ko: 디마스는 처방 없이 약을 줘서 낭비하지 말라고 했어요.

w|menyia-nyiakan.text: Putri tidak mau menyia-nyiakan kesempatan magang di laboratorium itu.
w|menyia-nyiakan.en: Putri doesn't want to waste the chance to intern at that laboratory.
w|menyia-nyiakan.ko: 푸트리는 그 연구소에서 인턴을 할 기회를 놓치고 싶지 않아요.

w|menyiapkan.en: We have to prepare those documents.

w|menyibukkan.text: Bayu menyibukkan diri dengan membaca dokumen lama perusahaan.
w|menyibukkan.en: Bayu kept himself busy reading the company's old documents.
w|menyibukkan.ko: 바유는 회사의 옛 문서를 읽으며 바쁘게 지냈어요.

w|menyibukkan.text: Sejak putus cinta, Intan menyibukkan diri dengan latihan setiap sore.
w|menyibukkan.en: Since her breakup, Intan has kept herself busy working out every afternoon.
w|menyibukkan.ko: 이별한 뒤로 인탄은 매일 오후 운동하며 바쁘게 지내요.

w|menyimpan.en: He keeps money in the bank.

w|menyimpang.text: Pelatih menegur Bayu karena gerakan punggungnya menyimpang dari posisi yang benar.
w|menyimpang.en: The trainer corrected Bayu because his back movement strayed from the correct position.
w|menyimpang.ko: 바유의 허리 동작이 바른 자세에서 벗어나서 트레이너가 지적했어요.

w|menyimpang.text: Obrolan keluarga Intan sering menyimpang dari topik awal ke cerita masa kecil.
w|menyimpang.en: Intan's family conversations often drift from the original topic to childhood stories.
w|menyimpang.ko: 인탄 가족의 대화는 처음 주제에서 자주 어린 시절 이야기로 새요.

w|menyimpulkan.text: Dari peta, Agus menyimpulkan bahwa jalan lewat gunung lebih cepat.
w|menyimpulkan.en: From the map, Agus concluded that the mountain road was faster.
w|menyimpulkan.ko: 지도를 보고 아구스는 산길이 더 빠르다고 결론 내렸어요.

w|menyimpulkan.text: Dari laporan penjualan, Wati menyimpulkan bahwa sepatu putih paling laris.
w|menyimpulkan.en: From the sales report, Wati concluded that white shoes sell best.
w|menyimpulkan.ko: 판매 보고서를 보고 와티는 흰 신발이 가장 잘 팔린다고 결론 내렸어요.

w|menyinari.text: Matahari pagi menyinari bangsal anak tempat Budi bertugas.
w|menyinari.en: The morning sun shone on the children's ward where Budi works.
w|menyinari.ko: 아침 햇살이 부디가 근무하는 소아 병동을 비췄어요.

w|menyinari.text: Cahaya senja menyinari landasan saat Siti menunggu panggilan naik pesawat.
w|menyinari.en: The evening light shone on the runway as Siti waited for the boarding call.
w|menyinari.ko: 시티가 탑승 안내를 기다리는 동안 노을빛이 활주로를 비췄어요.

w|menyinggung.text: Rudi tidak bermaksud menyinggung arsitek saat mengkritik desain tangga.
w|menyinggung.en: Rudi didn't mean to offend the architect when he criticised the stair design.
w|menyinggung.ko: 루디는 계단 설계를 지적할 때 건축가 기분을 상하게 할 생각은 없었어요.

w|menyinggung.text: Rina takut menyinggung rekan kerja kalau terlalu banyak bertanya.
w|menyinggung.en: Rina is afraid of offending her coworkers if she asks too many questions.
w|menyinggung.ko: 리나는 질문을 너무 많이 하면 동료들 기분을 상하게 할까 봐 걱정이에요.

w|menyingkir.en: Please step aside from that path.
He got out of the way as soon as the police came.

w|menyingkirkan.en: Please get rid of those old items.
He wants to get rid of bad habits.

w|menyiram.text: Tiap sore Agus menyiram tanah proyek supaya debunya tidak beterbangan.
w|menyiram.en: Every afternoon Agus waters the site's ground so the dust doesn't fly around.
w|menyiram.ko: 아구스는 먼지가 날리지 않도록 매일 오후 현장 땅에 물을 뿌려요.

w|menyiram.text: Wati membeli selang baru untuk menyiram tanaman di teras.
w|menyiram.en: Wati bought a new hose to water the plants on the terrace.
w|menyiram.ko: 와티는 테라스 화분에 물을 주려고 새 호스를 샀어요.

w|menyiratkan.text: Senyum tipis pengelola gedung menyiratkan bahwa harga sewa akan naik.
w|menyiratkan.en: The building manager's thin smile hinted that the rent was going up.
w|menyiratkan.ko: 건물 관리인의 엷은 미소는 월세가 오를 거라는 걸 암시했어요.

w|menyiratkan.text: Piring yang kembali bersih menyiratkan bahwa tamu suka masakan Wati.
w|menyiratkan.en: Plates coming back clean suggest that the guests like Wati's cooking.
w|menyiratkan.ko: 깨끗하게 비워져 돌아온 접시는 손님들이 와티의 음식을 좋아한다는 뜻이에요.

w|menyisakan.text: Redaktur memangkas tulisan Budi dan hanya menyisakan tiga paragraf.
w|menyisakan.en: The editor cut Budi's piece down and left only three paragraphs.
w|menyisakan.ko: 편집자는 부디의 글을 줄여 세 단락만 남겼어요.

w|menyisakan.text: Rombongan pelajar itu hanya menyisakan dua buku sejarah di rak.
w|menyisakan.en: The group of students left only two history books on the shelf.
w|menyisakan.ko: 학생 단체가 다녀간 뒤 책장에는 역사책이 두 권만 남았어요.

w|menyisihkan.text: Andi menyisihkan sebagian gaji untuk membeli kamera baru.
w|menyisihkan.en: Andi sets aside part of his salary to buy a new camera.
w|menyisihkan.ko: 안디는 새 카메라를 사려고 월급 일부를 따로 모아요.

w|menyisihkan.text: Dewi menyisihkan baju lama untuk disumbangkan.
w|menyisihkan.en: Dewi set aside old clothes to donate.
w|menyisihkan.ko: 데위는 기부할 헌 옷을 따로 챙겨 뒀어요.

w|menyisir.text: Budi menyisir rambut dengan jari sebelum masuk ruang rapat.
w|menyisir.en: Budi combed his hair with his fingers before entering the meeting room.
w|menyisir.ko: 부디는 회의실에 들어가기 전에 손가락으로 머리를 빗었어요.

w|menyisir.text: Siti menyisir setiap rak untuk mencari kamus yang hilang.
w|menyisir.en: Siti combed through every shelf looking for the missing dictionary.
w|menyisir.ko: 시티는 없어진 사전을 찾으려고 책장을 샅샅이 뒤졌어요.

w|menyita.text: Petugas bea cukai menyita kain impor yang tidak punya izin.
w|menyita.en: Customs officers seized imported cloth that had no permit.
w|menyita.ko: 세관 직원이 허가 없는 수입 원단을 압수했어요.

w|menyita.text: Petugas menyita botol parfum besar dari tas kabin Intan.
w|menyita.en: The officer confiscated a large perfume bottle from Intan's cabin bag.
w|menyita.ko: 직원이 인탄의 기내 가방에서 큰 향수병을 압수했어요.

w|menyobek.text: Dengan kesal, Bayu menyobek naskah pertamanya dan mulai menulis ulang.
w|menyobek.en: Annoyed, Bayu tore up his first draft and started rewriting.
w|menyobek.ko: 짜증이 난 바유는 첫 원고를 찢고 다시 쓰기 시작했어요.

w|menyobek.text: Intan menyobek selembar kertas kalender untuk menulis daftar belanja ke pasar.
w|menyobek.en: Intan tore off a sheet of the calendar to write a shopping list for the market.
w|menyobek.ko: 인탄은 달력 한 장을 찢어 장 볼 목록을 적었어요.

w|menyuap.text: Rina pernah menolak seorang pemasok yang mencoba menyuap timnya.
w|menyuap.en: Rina once turned down a supplier who tried to bribe her team.
w|menyuap.ko: 리나는 자기 팀에 뇌물을 주려던 납품업자를 거절한 적이 있어요.

w|menyuap.text: Seorang tamu mencoba menyuap satpam supaya bisa parkir di depan lobi.
w|menyuap.en: A guest tried to bribe the security guard so he could park in front of the lobby.
w|menyuap.ko: 한 손님이 로비 앞에 주차하려고 경비원에게 뒷돈을 주려 했어요.

w|menyulitkan.text: Bulu kucing yang terlalu tebal menyulitkan Budi menemukan kutu.
w|menyulitkan.en: The cat's very thick fur made it hard for Budi to find the fleas.
w|menyulitkan.ko: 너무 두꺼운 고양이 털 때문에 부디는 벼룩을 찾기 힘들었어요.

w|menyulitkan.text: Jalan berlumpur menyulitkan Siti membawa sayur ke pasar.
w|menyulitkan.en: The muddy road made it hard for Siti to carry vegetables to the market.
w|menyulitkan.ko: 진흙길 때문에 시티는 채소를 시장에 가져가기가 힘들었어요.

w|menyumbang.text: Kesaksian Agus menyumbang banyak informasi baru bagi majelis hakim.
w|menyumbang.en: Agus's testimony contributed a lot of new information to the panel of judges.
w|menyumbang.ko: 아구스의 증언은 재판부에 새로운 정보를 많이 보탰어요.

w|menyumbang.text: Setiap bulan Wati menyumbang makanan untuk panti asuhan di ujung jalan.
w|menyumbang.en: Every month Wati donates food to the orphanage at the end of the street.
w|menyumbang.ko: 와티는 매달 길 끝 보육원에 음식을 기부해요.

w|menyumbangkan.text: Gym itu menyumbangkan alat-alat lama ke sekolah olahraga di desa.
w|menyumbangkan.en: The gym donated its old equipment to a sports school in the village.
w|menyumbangkan.ko: 그 헬스장은 낡은 기구를 시골의 체육 학교에 기증했어요.

w|menyumbangkan.text: Restoran itu menyumbangkan makanan sisa yang masih layak ke panti asuhan.
w|menyumbangkan.en: The restaurant donates leftover food that is still good to an orphanage.
w|menyumbangkan.ko: 그 식당은 아직 먹을 만한 남은 음식을 보육원에 기부해요.

w|menyuntik.text: Dimas menyuntik kambing itu dengan cepat sebelum hewan itu sempat berontak.
w|menyuntik.en: Dimas injected the goat quickly before the animal had a chance to struggle.
w|menyuntik.ko: 디마스는 염소가 버둥대기 전에 재빨리 주사를 놓았어요.

w|menyuntik.text: Asisten lab menyuntik tikus percobaan dengan cairan pewarna.
w|menyuntik.en: The lab assistant injected the test mice with a dye solution.
w|menyuntik.ko: 실험 조교가 실험용 쥐에게 염료 용액을 주사했어요.

w|menyuntikkan.text: Sebelum berangkat, perawat menyuntikkan vaksin tifus ke lengan Dimas.
w|menyuntikkan.en: Before he left, a nurse injected a typhoid vaccine into Dimas's arm.
w|menyuntikkan.ko: 떠나기 전에 간호사가 디마스의 팔에 장티푸스 백신을 놓았어요.

w|menyuntikkan.text: Seorang investor siap menyuntikkan dana besar ke perusahaan rintisan Putri.
w|menyuntikkan.en: An investor is ready to inject a large amount of money into Putri's startup.
w|menyuntikkan.ko: 한 투자자가 푸트리의 스타트업에 큰 자금을 투입할 준비가 돼 있어요.

w|menyuruh.en: Mom told me to clean the room.
Ordering other people around isn't a solution.

w|menyusahkan.text: Andi tidak mau menyusahkan ibunya, jadi dia berangkat sekolah naik sepeda sendiri.
w|menyusahkan.en: Andi didn't want to trouble his mother, so he rode his bike to school on his own.
w|menyusahkan.ko: 안디는 엄마를 번거롭게 하기 싫어서 혼자 자전거를 타고 학교에 갔어요.

w|menyusahkan.text: Hujan deras bisa menyusahkan rencana pesta di halaman, kata Dewi cemas.
w|menyusahkan.en: Heavy rain could spoil the plan for a party in the yard, Dewi said anxiously.
w|menyusahkan.ko: 폭우가 오면 마당 파티 계획이 곤란해질 수 있다고 데위가 걱정했어요.

w|menyusul.text: Andi datang lebih dulu, lalu istrinya menyusul membawa fotokopi KTP.
w|menyusul.en: Andi came first, and then his wife followed with a photocopy of his ID card.
w|menyusul.ko: 안디가 먼저 오고, 아내가 신분증 사본을 들고 뒤따라왔어요.

w|menyusul.text: Setelah tertinggal di babak pertama, tim Dewi mulai menyusul skor lawan.
w|menyusul.en: After falling behind in the first half, Dewi's team started catching up with the opponent's score.
w|menyusul.ko: 전반에 뒤졌던 데위네 팀은 상대 점수를 따라잡기 시작했어요.

w|menyusun.text: Para tukang menyusun bata merah dengan rapi untuk dinding belakang.
w|menyusun.en: The builders laid red bricks neatly for the back wall.
w|menyusun.ko: 인부들이 뒷벽에 쓸 붉은 벽돌을 가지런히 쌓았어요.

w|menyusun.text: Sore itu Rina menyusun daftar tugas untuk minggu pertamanya.
w|menyusun.en: That afternoon Rina put together a to-do list for her first week.
w|menyusun.ko: 그날 오후 리나는 첫 주에 할 일 목록을 정리했어요.

w|menyusup.text: Sisa makanan bisa menyusup ke celah gigi dan menyebabkan lubang.
w|menyusup.en: Food remains can get into the gaps between teeth and cause cavities.
w|menyusup.ko: 음식 찌꺼기가 이 틈에 끼어 들어가 충치를 만들 수 있어요.

w|menyusup.text: Air hujan menyusup lewat celah genteng dan membasahi plafon.
w|menyusup.en: Rainwater seeped through the gaps in the roof tiles and soaked the ceiling.
w|menyusup.ko: 빗물이 기와 틈으로 스며들어 천장을 적셨어요.

w|menyusuri.text: Dalam kegiatan alam, Agus menyusuri sungai kecil di belakang sekolah.
w|menyusuri.en: During the nature activity, Agus walked along the small river behind the school.
w|menyusuri.ko: 자연 체험 시간에 아구스는 학교 뒤 개울을 따라 걸었어요.

w|menyusuri.text: Wati berjalan pelan menyusuri tepi kolam yang licin.
w|menyusuri.en: Wati walked slowly along the slippery edge of the pool.
w|menyusuri.ko: 와티는 미끄러운 수영장 가장자리를 따라 천천히 걸었어요.

w|menyusut.text: Jumlah penonton teater itu sempat menyusut ketika harga tiket naik.
w|menyusut.en: The theater's audience numbers shrank for a while when ticket prices went up.
w|menyusut.ko: 표값이 오르자 그 극장 관객 수가 한동안 줄었어요.

w|menyusut.text: Air di sungai yang dilewati kereta sudah menyusut karena kemarau panjang.
w|menyusut.en: The water in the river the train passed had shrunk because of the long dry season.
w|menyusut.ko: 긴 가뭄 때문에 열차가 지나는 강의 물이 줄어 있었어요.

w|meracuni.text: Menurut berita, pabrik di kota lain ditutup karena limbahnya meracuni sungai.
w|meracuni.en: According to the news, a factory in another city was shut down because its waste poisoned the river.
w|meracuni.ko: 뉴스에 따르면 다른 도시의 한 공장은 폐수로 강을 오염시켜 문을 닫았대요.

w|meracuni.text: Intan menonton film tentang ratu yang berusaha meracuni musuhnya.
w|meracuni.en: Intan watched a film about a queen who tries to poison her enemy.
w|meracuni.ko: 인탄은 적을 독살하려는 여왕에 관한 영화를 봤어요.

w|meragukan.en: I doubt the truth of that news.

w|merah.en: That red flower is very pretty.
Red is the color of courage.

w|merahasiakan.text: Budi merahasiakan nilai ulangannya dari kakaknya.
w|merahasiakan.en: Budi kept his test score a secret from his older sibling.
w|merahasiakan.ko: 부디는 시험 점수를 형에게 비밀로 했어요.

w|merahasiakan.text: Siti merahasiakan alamat barunya supaya bisa memberi kejutan kepada teman-teman.
w|merahasiakan.en: Siti kept her new address secret so she could surprise her friends.
w|merahasiakan.ko: 시티는 친구들을 깜짝 놀라게 하려고 새 주소를 비밀로 했어요.

w|meraih.text: Dia meraih gelas di rak paling atas.
w|meraih.en: She reached for a glass on the top shelf.
w|meraih.ko: 그는 맨 위 선반의 컵을 집었어.

w|meraih.text: Tim itu meraih kemenangan di final.
w|meraih.en: That team achieved victory in the final.

w|merajut.text: Tetangga Agus yang sudah pensiun suka merajut syal di bangku lobi.
w|merajut.en: Agus's retired neighbor likes knitting scarves on the lobby bench.
w|merajut.ko: 아구스의 은퇴한 이웃은 로비 벤치에서 목도리 뜨는 걸 좋아해요.

w|merajut.text: Saat rumah makan sepi, Wati merajut taplak kecil untuk meja.
w|merajut.en: When the restaurant is quiet, Wati knits small tablecloths for the tables.
w|merajut.ko: 식당이 한가할 때 와티는 탁자에 깔 작은 식탁보를 떠요.

w|merak.text: Eko pernah melihat burung merak liar di hutan dekat desa.
w|merak.en: Eko once saw a wild peacock in the forest near the village.
w|merak.ko: 에코는 마을 근처 숲에서 야생 공작새를 본 적이 있어요.

w|merak.text: Pabrik tekstil itu terkenal dengan motif bulu merak pada kainnya.
w|merak.en: That textile factory is famous for the peacock-feather pattern on its fabric.
w|merak.ko: 그 섬유 공장은 공작 깃털 무늬 천으로 유명해요.

w|merakit.text: Rudi semalaman merakit lampu hias untuk gerbang rumah pengantin.
w|merakit.en: Rudi spent all night assembling decorative lights for the bride's house gate.
w|merakit.ko: 루디는 밤새 신부 집 대문에 달 장식 조명을 조립했어요.

w|merakit.text: Rina meliput bengkel kecil yang merakit sepeda listrik dari barang bekas.
w|merakit.en: Rina covered a small workshop that assembles electric bikes from used parts.
w|merakit.ko: 리나는 중고 부품으로 전기 자전거를 조립하는 작은 공방을 취재했어요.

w|meramal.text: Budi ingat seorang nenek pernah meramal bahwa Rudi akan jadi orang kaya.
w|meramal.en: Budi remembers an old woman once predicting that Rudi would become rich.
w|meramal.ko: 부디는 어떤 할머니가 루디는 부자가 될 거라고 점쳤던 걸 기억해요.

w|meramal.text: Bu Ani suka meramal cuaca hanya dengan melihat awan.
w|meramal.en: Mrs. Ani likes to forecast the weather just by looking at the clouds.
w|meramal.ko: 아니 아주머니는 구름만 보고 날씨를 점치길 좋아해요.

w|meramalkan.text: Pedagang buku itu meramalkan harga komik lama akan naik beberapa tahun lagi.
w|meramalkan.en: The book dealer predicts that old comics will go up in price in a few years.
w|meramalkan.ko: 그 책 장수는 몇 년 뒤면 옛날 만화책 값이 오를 거라고 내다봐요.

w|meramalkan.text: Nenek Intan meramalkan hujan tidak akan turun pada hari pernikahan cucunya.
w|meramalkan.en: Intan's grandmother predicted that it wouldn't rain on her granddaughter's wedding day.
w|meramalkan.ko: 인탄의 할머니는 손녀 결혼식 날에는 비가 오지 않을 거라고 장담했어요.

w|merampas.text: Ombak besar merampas sandal Eko yang tertinggal di pinggir air.
w|merampas.en: A big wave snatched away the sandals Eko had left at the water's edge.
w|merampas.ko: 큰 파도가 물가에 두고 온 에코의 샌들을 휩쓸어 갔어요.

w|merampas.text: Ayu membaca berita tentang preman yang merampas ponsel di jalan dekat rumahnya.
w|merampas.en: Ayu read news about a thug who snatched a phone on the street near her house.
w|merampas.ko: 아유는 집 근처 길에서 깡패가 휴대폰을 빼앗았다는 기사를 읽었어요.

w|merampok.text: Pencuri itu mencoba merampok toko kecil.
w|merampok.en: That thief tried to rob a small shop.
w|merampok.ko: 그 도둑이 작은 가게를 털려 했어.

w|merampok.text: Mereka tidak akan merampok orang lain.
w|merampok.en: They will not rob other people.
w|merampok.ko: 그들은 다른 사람을 강도질하지 않을 거야.

w|merana.text: Budi bercerita tentang pohon mangga di sekolah lama yang kini merana tak terurus.
w|merana.en: Budi wrote about the mango tree at their old school that now languishes uncared for.
w|merana.ko: 부디는 옛 학교의 망고나무가 지금은 돌보는 이 없이 시들어 간다고 전했어요.

w|merana.text: Tanaman Siti merana karena tertutup bayangan pagar tetangga.
w|merana.en: Siti's plants are wilting because the neighbor's fence casts a shadow over them.
w|merana.ko: 이웃집 담장 그늘에 가려서 시티의 화초가 시들시들해요.

w|merancang.text: Para siswa kelas sebelas sedang merancang kostum untuk pentas seni.
w|merancang.en: The eleventh-grade students are designing costumes for the arts show.
w|merancang.ko: 고등학교 이 학년 학생들이 예술제 의상을 디자인하고 있어요.

w|merancang.text: Siti dan Rudi merancang acara reuni ini sejak tiga bulan lalu.
w|merancang.en: Siti and Rudi have been planning this reunion since three months ago.
w|merancang.ko: 시티와 루디는 석 달 전부터 이번 동창회를 계획했어요.

w|merangkak.text: Lalu lintas merangkak pelan, jadi Eko terlambat tiba di lokasi kebakaran.
w|merangkak.en: Traffic crawled along slowly, so Eko arrived late at the fire scene.
w|merangkak.ko: 차가 엉금엉금 기어가는 바람에 에코는 화재 현장에 늦게 도착했어요.

w|merangkak.text: Bayi pelanggan merangkak di lantai toko sementara ibunya menunggu.
w|merangkak.en: The customer's baby crawled on the shop floor while the mother waited.
w|merangkak.ko: 손님 아기가 엄마를 기다리는 동안 가게 바닥을 기어다녔어요.

w|merangkul.text: Pak Budi merangkul Dimas dan mengenalkannya kepada seluruh tim.
w|merangkul.en: Mr. Budi put his arm around Dimas and introduced him to the whole team.
w|merangkul.ko: 부디 씨는 디마스의 어깨를 감싸며 팀 전체에 소개했어요.

w|merangkul.text: Di pintu kedatangan, ayah Putri langsung merangkul putrinya erat-erat.
w|merangkul.en: At the arrivals door, Putri's father immediately hugged his daughter tight.
w|merangkul.ko: 입국장 문에서 푸트리의 아빠는 딸을 바로 꼭 끌어안았어요.

w|merangsang.text: Agus memangkas cabang tua untuk merangsang tumbuhnya tunas baru.
w|merangsang.en: Agus pruned the old branches to stimulate the growth of new shoots.
w|merangsang.ko: 아구스는 새순이 돋도록 오래된 가지를 쳐 냈어요.

w|merangsang.text: Wati percaya menulis surat dengan tangan bisa merangsang ingatan lama.
w|merangsang.en: Wati believes that writing letters by hand can stir up old memories.
w|merangsang.ko: 와티는 손으로 편지를 쓰면 옛 기억이 되살아난다고 믿어요.

w|merapat.text: Menjelang senja, perahu Bayu merapat ke dermaga kayu.
w|merapat.en: Toward dusk, Bayu's boat pulled up to the wooden pier.
w|merapat.ko: 해 질 무렵 바유의 배가 나무 선착장에 닿았어요.

w|merapat.text: Para pelari merapat ke garis start ketika panitia mulai menghitung mundur, termasuk Intan.
w|merapat.en: The runners, Intan among them, pressed up to the starting line as the organizers began the countdown.
w|merapat.ko: 주최 측이 카운트다운을 시작하자 인탄을 비롯한 주자들이 출발선으로 바짝 모였어요.

w|merapikan.text: Sebelum tirai dibuka, Eko merapikan kostum para pemain.
w|merapikan.en: Before the curtain opens, Eko tidies the actors' costumes.
w|merapikan.ko: 막이 오르기 전에 에코는 배우들의 의상을 매만져요.

w|merapikan.text: Setiap pagi Ayu merapikan tumpukan kayu bakar di samping rumah.
w|merapikan.en: Every morning Ayu tidies the pile of firewood beside the house.
w|merapikan.ko: 아유는 매일 아침 집 옆의 장작 더미를 정리해요.

w|merasuki.text: Rudi menulis bahwa rasa rindu seperti merasuki pikirannya setiap musim hujan.
w|merasuki.en: Rudi wrote that longing seems to take over his mind every rainy season.
w|merasuki.ko: 루디는 우기마다 그리움이 마음을 사로잡는 것 같다고 썼어요.

w|merasuki.text: Ide membuat aplikasi sendiri seolah merasuki Rina sejak kuliah.
w|merasuki.en: The idea of making her own app seems to have possessed Rina since university.
w|merasuki.ko: 자기만의 앱을 만들겠다는 생각이 대학 때부터 리나를 사로잡은 것 같아요.

w|meratakan.text: Petugas panggung meratakan pasir di lantai sebelum adegan gurun dimulai.
w|meratakan.en: The stagehand leveled the sand on the floor before the desert scene began.
w|meratakan.ko: 무대 담당은 사막 장면이 시작되기 전에 바닥의 모래를 고르게 폈어요.

w|meratakan.text: Dari jendela, Ayu melihat alat berat yang sedang meratakan tanah untuk jalur baru.
w|meratakan.en: From the window, Ayu saw heavy machinery leveling the ground for a new line.
w|meratakan.ko: 아유는 창밖으로 새 노선을 위해 땅을 고르는 중장비를 봤어요.

w|meraung.text: Alarm kebakaran kantor tiba-tiba meraung saat latihan evakuasi.
w|meraung.en: The office fire alarm suddenly wailed during the evacuation drill.
w|meraung.ko: 대피 훈련 중에 회사 화재경보기가 갑자기 울부짖듯 울렸어요.

w|meraung.text: Di luar jendela kantor Lestari, sirene ambulans meraung di tengah kemacetan.
w|meraung.en: Outside Lestari's office window, an ambulance siren wailed in the middle of the traffic jam.
w|meraung.ko: 레스타리 사무실 창밖에서 구급차 사이렌이 꽉 막힌 길 한가운데서 울려 댔어요.

w|merawat.text: Dia suka merawat tanaman di balkon.
w|merawat.en: She likes tending plants on the balcony.
w|merawat.ko: 그는 베란다 식물을 가꾸는 걸 좋아해.

w|merawat.text: Perawat itu merawat pasien dengan sabar.
w|merawat.en: That nurse cares for patients patiently.
w|merawat.ko: 그 간호사가 환자를 참을성 있게 돌봐.

w|merayakan.text: Kami merayakan ulang tahunnya di rumah.
w|merayakan.en: We celebrated her birthday at home.

w|merayap.text: Seekor cicak merayap di dinding ruang tunggu klinik.
w|merayap.en: A gecko crept along the wall of the clinic's waiting room.
w|merayap.ko: 도마뱀 한 마리가 병원 대기실 벽을 기어갔어요.

w|merayap.text: Kabut pagi pelan-pelan merayap turun dari puncak menuju rumah Siti.
w|merayap.en: The morning fog slowly crept down from the peak toward Siti's house.
w|merayap.ko: 아침 안개가 산꼭대기에서 시티네 집 쪽으로 천천히 기어 내려왔어요.

w|merayu.text: Penjual mesin itu terus merayu Bayu supaya membeli model paling mahal.
w|merayu.en: The machine salesman kept sweet-talking Bayu into buying the most expensive model.
w|merayu.ko: 그 기계 판매원은 바유에게 가장 비싼 모델을 사라고 계속 꼬드겼어요.

w|merayu.text: Adik Intan merayu ibunya supaya dibelikan mainan di toko bandara.
w|merayu.en: Intan's little brother sweet-talked their mother into buying him a toy at the airport shop.
w|merayu.ko: 인탄의 동생은 공항 가게에서 장난감을 사 달라고 엄마를 졸랐어요.

w|mercusuar.text: Rudi menyarankan tamu berjalan sore ke mercusuar di ujung tanjung.
w|mercusuar.en: Rudi suggested the guests take an evening walk to the lighthouse at the tip of the cape.
w|mercusuar.ko: 루디는 손님들에게 저녁에 곶 끝 등대까지 걸어가 보라고 권했어요.

w|mercusuar.text: Kabut tebal pagi itu membuat cahaya mercusuar hampir tak terlihat.
w|mercusuar.en: The thick fog that morning made the lighthouse beam almost invisible.
w|mercusuar.ko: 그날 아침 짙은 안개 때문에 등대 불빛이 거의 보이지 않았어요.

w|merdeka.text: Setiap tujuh belas Agustus, Fajar membantu menghias balai kota untuk merayakan hari merdeka.
w|merdeka.en: Every seventeenth of August, Fajar helps decorate city hall to celebrate Independence Day.
w|merdeka.ko: 매년 팔월 십칠일이면 파자르는 독립기념일을 축하하려고 시청 장식을 도와요.

w|merdeka.text: Lestari menulis bahwa kakeknya dulu ikut berjuang agar negeri ini merdeka.
w|merdeka.en: Lestari wrote that her grandfather had once fought for this country's independence.
w|merdeka.ko: 레스타리는 할아버지가 예전에 이 나라의 독립을 위해 싸우셨다고 썼어요.

w|merebus.text: Instruktur mengajari Andi merebus telur supaya kuningnya tetap lembut.
w|merebus.en: The instructor taught Andi to boil eggs so the yolks stay soft.
w|merebus.ko: 강사는 안디에게 노른자가 부드럽게 남도록 달걀 삶는 법을 가르쳤어요.

w|merebus.text: Dewi ingat ibunya selalu merebus jagung setiap kali Rani menginap.
w|merebus.en: Dewi remembers her mother always boiled corn whenever Rani stayed over.
w|merebus.ko: 데위는 라니가 자고 갈 때마다 어머니가 옥수수를 삶아 주셨던 걸 기억해요.

w|merebut.text: Mereka mencoba merebut kembali kota itu.
w|merebut.en: They tried to seize the city back.

w|merebut.text: Anak itu merebut mainan dari adiknya.
w|merebut.en: That child snatched the toy from his sibling.

w|mereda.text: Bayu menunggu hujan mereda di bawah tenda pedagang buku.
w|mereda.en: Bayu waited for the rain to ease off under the book seller's tent.
w|mereda.ko: 바유는 책 장수의 천막 아래에서 비가 그치기를 기다렸어요.

w|mereda.text: Untungnya, hujan mulai mereda tepat sebelum tamu berdatangan.
w|mereda.en: Luckily, the rain started to ease just before the guests arrived.
w|mereda.ko: 다행히 손님들이 오기 직전에 비가 잦아들기 시작했어요.

w|meredakan.text: Rudi minum teh jahe untuk meredakan tenggorokan setelah seharian berteriak di dapur.
w|meredakan.en: Rudi drank ginger tea to soothe his throat after shouting in the kitchen all day.
w|meredakan.ko: 루디는 하루 종일 주방에서 소리를 지른 뒤 목을 달래려고 생강차를 마셨어요.

w|meredakan.text: Rina membeli wedang jahe hangat untuk meredakan masuk angin.
w|meredakan.en: Rina bought a warm ginger drink to ease her chill.
w|meredakan.ko: 리나는 으슬으슬한 몸을 달래려고 따뜻한 생강차를 샀어요.

w|meredup.text: Lampu jalan di depan rumah Andi mulai meredup menjelang tengah malam.
w|meredup.en: The streetlight in front of Andi's house starts to dim toward midnight.
w|meredup.ko: 안디네 집 앞 가로등은 자정 무렵이면 흐려지기 시작해요.

w|meredup.text: Lampu panggung meredup, lalu murid-murid Dewi mulai memainkan lagu pembuka.
w|meredup.en: The stage lights dimmed, and Dewi's students began playing the opening piece.
w|meredup.ko: 무대 조명이 어두워지자 데위의 학생들이 첫 곡을 연주하기 시작했어요.

w|meregangkan.text: Setiap pagi Agus meregangkan badan sambil melihat matahari terbit.
w|meregangkan.en: Every morning Agus stretches while watching the sunrise.
w|meregangkan.ko: 아구스는 매일 아침 해돋이를 보며 몸을 풀어요.

w|meregangkan.text: Selepas jam makan siang, Wati meregangkan punggung di belakang dapur.
w|meregangkan.en: After the lunch rush, Wati stretches her back behind the kitchen.
w|meregangkan.ko: 점심시간이 지나면 와티는 주방 뒤에서 허리를 펴요.

w|merek.text: Bayu tidak peduli merek, yang penting jaketnya masih bagus.
w|merek.en: Bayu doesn't care about the brand; what matters is that the jacket is still in good shape.
w|merek.ko: 바유는 상표는 상관없고 재킷 상태만 좋으면 돼요.

w|merek.text: Intan memilih sepatu pengantin dari merek lokal yang dibuat dengan tangan.
w|merek.en: Intan chose bridal shoes from a local brand that makes them by hand.
w|merek.ko: 인탄은 손으로 만드는 국내 브랜드의 웨딩 슈즈를 골랐어요.

w|merekam.text: Mereka merekam wawancara di studio kecil.
w|merekam.en: They are recording the interview in a small studio.
w|merekam.ko: 그들은 작은 스튜디오에서 인터뷰를 녹음하고 있어.

w|merekomendasikan.text: Teman kantor Fajar merekomendasikan toko daring yang jual barang elektronik murah.
w|merekomendasikan.en: Fajar's office friend recommended an online shop that sells cheap electronics.
w|merekomendasikan.ko: 파자르의 회사 친구가 싼 전자제품을 파는 온라인 가게를 추천했어요.

w|merekomendasikan.text: Guru merekomendasikan gula aren untuk kolak supaya rasanya lebih harum.
w|merekomendasikan.en: The teacher recommended palm sugar for the kolak so it would taste more fragrant.
w|merekomendasikan.ko: 선생님은 콜락에 야자당을 넣으면 향이 더 좋다고 권했어요.

w|merekrut.text: Pabrik sedang merekrut tiga puluh penjahit untuk musim ramai.
w|merekrut.en: The factory is recruiting thirty tailors for the busy season.
w|merekrut.ko: 공장은 바쁜 철을 맞아 재봉사 서른 명을 뽑고 있어요.

w|merekrut.text: Maskapai itu sedang merekrut pilot muda lewat program beasiswa.
w|merekrut.en: The airline is recruiting young pilots through a scholarship program.
w|merekrut.ko: 그 항공사는 장학 프로그램으로 젊은 조종사를 뽑고 있어요.

w|merelakan.text: Budi belajar merelakan masa lalu dan memaafkan sahabatnya.
w|merelakan.en: Budi is learning to let go of the past and forgive his friend.
w|merelakan.ko: 부디는 지난 일을 내려놓고 친구를 용서하는 법을 배우고 있어요.

w|merelakan.text: Karena cedera, Siti harus merelakan kesempatan ikut lomba di luar kota.
w|merelakan.en: Because of an injury, Siti had to give up the chance to race out of town.
w|merelakan.ko: 부상 때문에 시티는 다른 도시 대회에 나갈 기회를 포기해야 했어요.

w|meremas.text: Andi meremas kertas undangan arisan dengan gemas karena salah tanggal.
w|meremas.en: Andi crumpled the gathering invitation in frustration because the date was wrong.
w|meremas.ko: 날짜가 틀려서 안디는 계모임 초대장을 답답한 마음에 구겨 버렸어요.

w|meremas.text: Dewi meremas brosur di tangannya karena gugup sebelum memandu tur pertamanya.
w|meremas.en: Dewi squeezed the brochure in her hand nervously before leading her first tour.
w|meremas.ko: 데위는 첫 투어 안내를 앞두고 긴장해서 손에 든 안내 책자를 꽉 쥐었어요.

w|meremehkan.text: Pak Agus mengingatkan Andi agar tidak meremehkan pesan penipuan di ponsel.
w|meremehkan.en: Mr. Agus reminded Andi not to underestimate scam messages on his phone.
w|meremehkan.ko: 아구스 경관은 안디에게 휴대폰 사기 문자를 가볍게 보지 말라고 했어요.

w|meremehkan.text: Lawan meremehkan tim Dewi, padahal akhirnya mereka kalah jauh.
w|meremehkan.en: The opponents underestimated Dewi's team, but in the end they lost by a wide margin.
w|meremehkan.ko: 상대 팀은 데위네 팀을 얕봤는데 결국 크게 졌어요.

w|merencanakan.en: We are planning a trip to the mountain.

w|merencanakan.text: Dia suka merencanakan semuanya jauh-jauh hari.
w|merencanakan.en: She likes to plan everything far in advance.
w|merencanakan.ko: 그는 모든 걸 미리미리 계획하는 걸 좋아해.

w|merendahkan.text: Fajar kesal karena ada penjual yang merendahkan pembeli di kolom komentar.
w|merendahkan.en: Fajar was annoyed because a seller belittled a buyer in the comments.
w|merendahkan.ko: 파자르는 한 판매자가 댓글 창에서 구매자를 깔보는 걸 보고 짜증이 났어요.

w|merendahkan.text: Guru yang baik tidak pernah merendahkan masakan peserta yang gagal.
w|merendahkan.en: A good teacher never belittles a participant's failed dish.
w|merendahkan.ko: 좋은 선생님은 참가자가 망친 요리를 절대 깔보지 않아요.

w|merendam.text: Andi merendam baju kotor semalaman sebelum mencucinya besok pagi.
w|merendam.en: Andi soaks dirty clothes overnight before washing them the next morning.
w|merendam.ko: 안디는 빨래를 밤새 물에 담가 뒀다가 다음 날 아침에 빨아요.

w|merendam.text: Dewi merendam corong klarinet dalam air hangat agar mudah dibersihkan.
w|merendam.en: Dewi soaks the clarinet mouthpiece in warm water so it's easy to clean.
w|merendam.ko: 데위는 클라리넷 마우스피스를 쉽게 닦으려고 따뜻한 물에 담가 둬요.

w|merengek.text: Anak Dimas merengek minta ikut setiap kali ayahnya berangkat ke pabrik.
w|merengek.en: Dimas's child whines to come along every time his father leaves for the factory.
w|merengek.ko: 디마스의 아이는 아빠가 공장에 갈 때마다 따라가겠다고 칭얼대요.

w|merengek.text: Putri tertawa membaca cerita tentang anak Sari yang merengek minta kucing.
w|merengek.en: Putri laughs reading the story about Sari's child whining for a cat.
w|merengek.ko: 푸트리는 고양이를 사 달라고 조르는 사리 아이 이야기를 읽고 웃어요.

w|merenggut.text: Seorang warga bercerita bahwa banjir bandang pernah merenggut banyak rumah di lembah itu.
w|merenggut.en: A local resident told how a flash flood once swept away many houses in that valley.
w|merenggut.ko: 한 주민은 예전에 돌발 홍수가 그 골짜기의 집을 많이 앗아 갔다고 말했어요.

w|merenggut.text: Seorang pencopet merenggut tas seorang ibu di eskalator.
w|merenggut.en: A pickpocket snatched a woman's bag on the escalator.
w|merenggut.ko: 소매치기가 에스컬레이터에서 한 여성의 가방을 낚아챘어요.

w|merenovasi.text: Pengelola berencana merenovasi lobi apartemen tahun depan.
w|merenovasi.en: The management plans to renovate the apartment lobby next year.
w|merenovasi.ko: 관리실은 내년에 아파트 로비를 리모델링할 계획이에요.

w|merenovasi.text: Wati ingin merenovasi atap rumah sebelum musim hujan berikutnya.
w|merenovasi.en: Wati wants to renovate the roof before the next rainy season.
w|merenovasi.ko: 와티는 다음 우기 전에 지붕을 고치고 싶어 해요.

w|merenungkan.text: Setelah pertunjukan, Eko duduk sendirian di panggung sambil merenungkan perannya.
w|merenungkan.en: After the show, Eko sat alone on the stage reflecting on his role.
w|merenungkan.ko: 공연이 끝난 뒤 에코는 무대에 혼자 앉아 자기 배역을 곱씹었어요.

w|merenungkan.text: Sambil memandang sawah dari jendela, Ayu merenungkan keputusannya pindah kota.
w|merenungkan.en: Looking at the rice fields from the window, Ayu reflected on her decision to move cities.
w|merenungkan.ko: 창밖 논을 바라보며 아유는 이사하기로 한 결정을 곰곰이 생각했어요.

w|merepotkan.text: Agus tidak mau merepotkan pamannya, jadi dia menginap di hotel kecil.
w|merepotkan.en: Agus didn't want to trouble his uncle, so he stayed at a small hotel.
w|merepotkan.ko: 아구스는 삼촌에게 폐를 끼치기 싫어서 작은 호텔에 묵었어요.

w|merepotkan.text: Wati sabar menghadapi pembeli yang suka merepotkan pegawai.
w|merepotkan.en: Wati is patient with customers who like to give staff a hard time.
w|merepotkan.ko: 와티는 직원을 귀찮게 하는 손님도 참을성 있게 대해요.

w|mereproduksi.text: Agus berusaha mereproduksi rasa roti buatan almarhumah ibunya.
w|mereproduksi.en: Agus is trying to reproduce the taste of his late mother's bread.
w|mereproduksi.ko: 아구스는 돌아가신 어머니가 만들던 빵 맛을 그대로 되살리려고 애써요.

w|mereproduksi.text: Wati mencoba mereproduksi galat yang dilaporkan pengguna.
w|mereproduksi.en: Wati is trying to reproduce the bug users reported.
w|mereproduksi.ko: 와티는 사용자가 신고한 오류를 재현해 보고 있어요.

w|meretas.text: Anak Budi membaca berita tentang orang yang meretas situs badan cuaca.
w|meretas.en: Budi's son read a news story about someone who hacked the weather agency's website.
w|meretas.ko: 부디의 아들은 누군가 기상청 사이트를 해킹했다는 기사를 읽었어요.

w|meretas.text: Dalam film itu, tokoh adik Siti adalah remaja yang pandai meretas komputer.
w|meretas.en: In the film, the character of Siti's younger brother is a teenager who is good at hacking computers.
w|meretas.ko: 그 영화에서 시티의 동생 역은 컴퓨터 해킹을 잘하는 십 대예요.

w|merevisi.text: Andi merevisi paragraf pembuka sampai tiga kali.
w|merevisi.en: Andi revised the opening paragraph three times.
w|merevisi.ko: 안디는 첫 문단을 세 번이나 고쳐 썼어요.

w|merevisi.text: Dewi merevisi daftar barang setelah sadar banyak kardus belum diberi label.
w|merevisi.en: Dewi revised the inventory after realizing many boxes hadn't been labeled.
w|merevisi.ko: 데위는 라벨이 안 붙은 상자가 많다는 걸 알고 물품 목록을 고쳤어요.

w|meriah.text: Andi menggambarkan pesta panen di desanya yang meriah.
w|meriah.en: Andi describes the lively harvest festival in his village.
w|meriah.ko: 안디는 마을의 떠들썩한 추수 잔치를 묘사해요.

w|meriah.text: Suasana di garis akhir sangat meriah dengan musik dan sorakan.
w|meriah.en: The atmosphere at the finish line was very festive with music and cheering.
w|meriah.ko: 결승선 분위기는 음악과 환호로 아주 떠들썩했어요.

w|meriam.text: Di halaman kantor polisi ada meriam tua peninggalan zaman penjajahan.
w|meriam.en: In the yard of the police station there is an old cannon from the colonial era.
w|meriam.ko: 경찰서 마당에는 식민지 시대에 남은 낡은 대포가 있어요.

w|meriam.text: Tembakan tiga angka Dewi melesat seperti peluru meriam.
w|meriam.en: Dewi's three-point shot flew like a cannonball.

w|merias.text: Para perempuan desa merias pengantin di tepi sungai, dan Bayu memotret mereka.
w|merias.en: The village women did the bride's makeup by the river, and Bayu took photos of them.
w|merias.ko: 마을 여자들이 강가에서 신부 화장을 해 주었고 바유는 그 모습을 사진에 담았어요.

w|merias.text: Intan sempat merias wajah tipis-tipis sebelum foto bersama di garis finis.
w|merias.en: Intan put on a bit of light makeup before the group photo at the finish line.
w|merias.ko: 인탄은 결승선에서 단체 사진을 찍기 전에 살짝 화장을 했어요.

w|merilis.text: Bulan ini pabrik merilis katalog kain motif batik yang baru.
w|merilis.en: This month the factory released a new catalogue of batik-pattern fabrics.
w|merilis.ko: 이번 달 공장은 바틱 무늬 원단 신제품 카탈로그를 냈어요.

w|merilis.text: Penyanyi favorit Intan baru merilis album dan kebetulan satu pesawat dengannya.
w|merilis.en: Intan's favorite singer just released an album and happened to be on the same plane.
w|merilis.ko: 인탄이 좋아하는 가수가 막 앨범을 냈는데 우연히 같은 비행기를 탔어요.

w|merinding.text: Rudi merinding membaca pesan panjang yang ditulis kakaknya tengah malam.
w|merinding.en: Rudi got goosebumps reading the long message his sister wrote at midnight.
w|merinding.ko: 루디는 누나가 한밤중에 쓴 긴 메시지를 읽고 소름이 돋았어요.

w|merinding.text: Rina merinding ketika air laut yang dingin menyentuh kakinya.
w|merinding.en: Rina got goosebumps when the cold seawater touched her feet.
w|merinding.ko: 차가운 바닷물이 발에 닿자 리나는 소름이 돋았어요.

w|meringankan.text: Kompres hangat bisa meringankan nyeri sendi pada anjing tua.
w|meringankan.en: A warm compress can ease joint pain in old dogs.
w|meringankan.ko: 따뜻한 찜질은 늙은 개의 관절 통증을 덜어 줄 수 있어요.

w|meringankan.text: Kerja bakti warga sangat meringankan beban Siti setelah atap rumahnya bocor.
w|meringankan.en: The villagers' communal work greatly eased Siti's burden after her roof leaked.
w|meringankan.ko: 주민들의 공동 작업 덕분에 지붕이 샌 뒤 시티의 짐이 크게 덜어졌어요.

w|meringkuk.text: Seorang anak meringkuk di kursi tunggu karena sakit perut.
w|meringkuk.en: A child curled up on the waiting chair with a stomachache.
w|meringkuk.ko: 한 아이가 배가 아파서 대기 의자에 웅크리고 있었어요.

w|meringkuk.text: Saat lembur, rekan baru itu tertidur meringkuk di sofa kantor.
w|meringkuk.en: While working overtime, the new coworker fell asleep curled up on the office sofa.
w|meringkuk.ko: 야근하던 새 동료는 사무실 소파에 웅크린 채 잠들었어요.

w|merintih.text: Bayu menulis kisah seekor anjing yang merintih di bawah reruntuhan rumah setelah banjir.
w|merintih.en: Bayu wrote the story of a dog whimpering under the ruins of a house after the flood.
w|merintih.ko: 바유는 홍수 뒤 무너진 집 아래에서 낑낑대던 개 이야기를 썼어요.

w|merintih.text: Kucing Intan merintih di depan pintu sampai paket makanannya datang.
w|merintih.en: Intan's cat whined at the door until its food delivery arrived.
w|merintih.ko: 인탄의 고양이는 사료 택배가 올 때까지 문 앞에서 낑낑댔어요.

w|merkuri.text: Eko ikut menolak penambang emas yang memakai merkuri di sungai.
w|merkuri.en: Eko joined in opposing the gold miners who use mercury in the river.
w|merkuri.ko: 에코는 강에서 수은을 쓰는 금 채굴꾼들에 반대하는 데 동참했어요.

w|merkuri.text: Lampu neon bekas yang berisi merkuri dikumpulkan Ayu di wadah khusus.
w|merkuri.en: Ayu collects used fluorescent tubes containing mercury in a special container.
w|merkuri.ko: 아유는 수은이 든 다 쓴 형광등을 전용 통에 모아요.

w|merobek.text: Dia merobek surat lama tanpa membaca.
w|merobek.en: He tore up the old letter without reading it.
w|merobek.ko: 그는 읽지도 않고 낡은 편지를 찢었어.

w|merobohkan.text: Pemerintah kota berencana merobohkan bangunan pasar lama dan membangun yang baru.
w|merobohkan.en: The city government plans to tear down the old market building and build a new one.
w|merobohkan.ko: 시 당국은 옛 시장 건물을 허물고 새로 지을 계획이에요.

w|merobohkan.text: Angin kencang sempat merobohkan tenda dekorasi sehari sebelum pernikahan Intan.
w|merobohkan.en: A strong wind knocked down the decoration tent the day before Intan's wedding.
w|merobohkan.ko: 인탄의 결혼식 전날 강풍에 장식 천막이 쓰러졌어요.

w|merokok.en: Smoking is prohibited inside the building.
w|merokok.ko: 건물 안에서는 담배를 피우면 안 돼.

w|merpati.text: Kakek Agus memelihara burung merpati di pondok dekat hutan.
w|merpati.en: Agus's grandfather keeps pigeons in a hut near the forest.
w|merpati.ko: 아구스의 할아버지는 숲 근처 오두막에서 비둘기를 길러요.

w|merpati.text: Di alun-alun depan apotek, anak-anak memberi makan burung merpati.
w|merpati.en: In the square in front of the pharmacy, children feed the pigeons.
w|merpati.ko: 약국 앞 광장에서 아이들이 비둘기에게 모이를 줘요.

w|mertua.text: Rina sedang belajar memasak rendang supaya disukai calon mertua.
w|mertua.en: Rina is learning to cook rendang so her future in-laws will like her.
w|mertua.ko: 리나는 예비 시부모님 마음에 들려고 른당 만드는 법을 배우고 있어요.

w|mertua.text: Dewi memesan kamar untuk mertua kakaknya yang datang dari Makassar.
w|mertua.en: Dewi booked a room for her sister's in-laws who came from Makassar.
w|mertua.ko: 데위는 마카사르에서 오는 언니의 시부모님 방을 예약했어요.

w|merugikan.text: Kata Bu Guru, mencontek hanya merugikan diri sendiri.
w|merugikan.en: The teacher said cheating only harms yourself.

w|merugikan.text: Pegawai yang sering datang terlambat bisa merugikan restoran Putri.
w|merugikan.en: Staff who often come late can hurt Putri's restaurant.
w|merugikan.ko: 자주 늦는 직원은 푸트리네 식당에 손해를 끼칠 수 있어요.

w|merujuk.text: Pengacara Agus merujuk pada putusan lama yang mirip dengan kasus ini.
w|merujuk.en: Agus's lawyer referred to an old ruling similar to this case.
w|merujuk.ko: 아구스의 변호사는 이 사건과 비슷한 옛 판결을 근거로 들었어요.

w|merujuk.text: Resep sambal di restoran itu merujuk pada catatan tulisan tangan nenek Wati.
w|merujuk.en: The chili sauce recipe at the restaurant is based on Wati's grandmother's handwritten notes.
w|merujuk.ko: 그 식당의 삼발 소스 조리법은 와티 할머니의 손 글씨 메모를 따른 거예요.

w|merunduk.text: Dia merunduk agar tidak terkena cabang pohon.
w|merunduk.en: He ducked so he would not hit the tree branch.
w|merunduk.ko: 그는 나뭇가지에 안 걸리려고 몸을 숙였어.

w|merunduk.text: Merunduk di balik meja membuatnya aman.
w|merunduk.en: Ducking behind the table kept her safe.
w|merunduk.ko: 탁자 뒤에 몸을 숙여서 그녀는 안전했어.

w|meruntuhkan.text: Pemerintah kota berencana meruntuhkan gedung bioskop tua, dan Bayu meliput protes warga.
w|meruntuhkan.en: The city government plans to tear down the old cinema building, and Bayu covered the residents' protest.
w|meruntuhkan.ko: 시 정부가 옛 극장 건물을 허물 계획이라 바유는 주민 시위를 취재했어요.

w|meruntuhkan.text: Hujan berhari-hari hampir meruntuhkan jembatan bambu menuju rumah Intan.
w|meruntuhkan.en: Days of rain almost brought down the bamboo bridge to Intan's house.
w|meruntuhkan.ko: 며칠 동안 내린 비에 인탄의 집으로 가는 대나무 다리가 무너질 뻔했어요.

w|meski.en: Even though tired, he kept working.
I came even though it poured.

w|meskipun.en: Even though it was raining, he still came.
She kept smiling even though she was tired.

w|mesti.en: You must go home before dark.

w|mesti.text: Kita mesti jujur satu sama lain.
w|mesti.en: We must be honest with each other.

w|metafora.text: Andi menandai setiap metafora dalam puisi yang ia pelajari untuk ujian.
w|metafora.en: Andi marked every metaphor in the poem he was studying for the exam.
w|metafora.ko: 안디는 시험을 위해 공부하는 시에서 은유마다 표시했어요.

w|metafora.text: Dewi bilang pindah rumah adalah metafora untuk memulai hidup baru.
w|metafora.en: Dewi said moving house is a metaphor for starting a new life.
w|metafora.ko: 데위는 이사가 새 삶을 시작하는 것의 은유라고 했어요.

w|meter.en: That table is two meters long.
The water meter at home is broken.

w|metode.text: Guru menjelaskan metode belajar yang lebih mudah.
w|metode.en: The teacher explained an easier learning method.
w|metode.ko: 선생님이 더 쉬운 학습 방법을 설명했어.

w|metode.text: Metode ini sudah dipakai di banyak sekolah.
w|metode.en: This method is already used in many schools.
w|metode.ko: 이 방법은 이미 많은 학교에서 쓰여.

w|mewah.en: That luxury hotel faces the sea.
Luxurious does not always mean comfortable.

w|mewakili.text: Dia akan mewakili sekolah di kompetisi itu.
w|mewakili.en: She will represent the school in that competition.
w|mewakili.ko: 그는 그 대회에서 학교를 대표할 거야.

w|mewakili.text: Pengacara itu mewakili klien dengan baik.
w|mewakili.en: That lawyer represents the client well.

w|mewarisi.text: Eko mewarisi bakat menggambar dari ayahnya.
w|mewarisi.en: Eko inherited his drawing talent from his father.

w|mewarisi.text: Ayu mewarisi kotak kuas tua milik neneknya yang dulu pelukis batik.
w|mewarisi.en: Ayu inherited an old box of brushes from her grandmother, who was a batik painter.
w|mewarisi.ko: 아유는 바틱 화가였던 할머니의 오래된 붓 상자를 물려받았어요.

w|mewariskan.text: Instruktur itu ingin mewariskan resep rendang keluarganya kepada murid-murid.
w|mewariskan.en: The instructor wants to pass down her family's rendang recipe to her students.
w|mewariskan.ko: 그 강사는 집안의 른당 요리법을 학생들에게 물려주고 싶어 해요.

w|mewariskan.text: Nenek Dewi ingin mewariskan kalung emasnya kepada cucu perempuan pertama.
w|mewariskan.en: Dewi's grandmother wants to pass down her gold necklace to her first granddaughter.
w|mewariskan.ko: 데위의 할머니는 금목걸이를 첫 손녀에게 물려주고 싶어 하세요.

w|mewarnai.text: Bunga matahari mewarnai ladang Budi dengan kuning cerah.
w|mewarnai.en: Sunflowers color Budi's field bright yellow.
w|mewarnai.ko: 해바라기가 부디의 밭을 밝은 노란색으로 물들여요.

w|mewarnai.text: Siti mewarnai adonan kue lapis dengan daun suji.
w|mewarnai.en: Siti colors the layer cake batter with suji leaves.
w|mewarnai.ko: 시티는 수지 잎으로 층층 케이크 반죽에 색을 내요.

w|mewawancarai.text: Wartawan lokal mewawancarai Bayu tentang kondisi kerja di pabrik.
w|mewawancarai.en: A local journalist interviewed Bayu about working conditions at the factory.
w|mewawancarai.ko: 지역 기자가 공장 근무 환경에 대해 바유를 인터뷰했어요.

w|mewawancarai.text: Seorang reporter mewawancarai Intan tentang keterlambatan penerbangan.
w|mewawancarai.en: A reporter interviewed Intan about the flight delay.
w|mewawancarai.ko: 한 기자가 항공편 지연에 대해 인탄을 인터뷰했어요.

w|mewujudkan.text: Agus bekerja keras untuk mewujudkan taman bermain di setiap kelurahan.
w|mewujudkan.en: Agus works hard to make a playground in every urban ward a reality.
w|mewujudkan.ko: 아구스는 동마다 놀이터를 만들려고 열심히 일해요.

w|mewujudkan.text: Wati berlatih setiap hari untuk mewujudkan mimpinya bermain di orkestra.
w|mewujudkan.en: Wati practices every day to make her dream of playing in an orchestra come true.
w|mewujudkan.ko: 와티는 오케스트라에서 연주하는 꿈을 이루려고 매일 연습해요.

w|meyakini.text: Orang tua di desa Budi meyakini suara katak adalah tanda hujan akan turun.
w|meyakini.en: Elders in Budi's village believe the sound of frogs is a sign that rain is coming.
w|meyakini.ko: 부디네 마을 어르신들은 개구리 소리가 비 올 징조라고 믿어요.

w|meyakini.text: Siti meyakini film ini akan disukai penonton muda.
w|meyakini.en: Siti is convinced this film will be liked by young audiences.
w|meyakini.ko: 시티는 이 영화가 젊은 관객에게 사랑받을 거라고 믿어요.

w|meyakinkan.en: He managed to convince the team.

w|mie.text: Saat istirahat siang, Fajar makan mie ayam di warung sebelah.
w|mie.en: At lunch break, Fajar eats chicken noodles at the stall next door.
w|mie.ko: 점심시간에 파자르는 옆 노점에서 닭고기 국수를 먹어요.

w|mie.text: Lestari menghindari mie instan selama masa latihan.
w|mie.en: Lestari avoids instant noodles during training.

w|mikir.text: Andi bilang kepada wartawan magang, "Jangan kebanyakan mikir, tulis saja dulu."
w|mikir.en: Andi told the intern reporter, "Don't overthink it, just write it first."
w|mikir.ko: 안디는 수습기자에게 "너무 생각만 하지 말고 일단 써 봐"라고 했어요.

w|mikir.text: Dewi masih mikir mau menaruh sofa di mana.
w|mikir.en: Dewi is still thinking about where to put the sofa.
w|mikir.ko: 데위는 소파를 어디에 둘지 아직 고민 중이에요.

w|mikro.text: Bayu memasang turbin air skala mikro untuk menerangi pondoknya.
w|mikro.en: Bayu installed a micro-scale water turbine to light up his hut.
w|mikro.ko: 바유는 오두막에 불을 밝히려고 초소형 수력 터빈을 설치했어요.

w|mikro.text: Pelatih menyarankan Intan menyusun target mikro untuk setiap minggu latihan.
w|mikro.en: The coach suggested Intan set micro goals for each week of training.
w|mikro.ko: 코치는 인탄에게 훈련 주마다 작은 목표를 세우라고 권했어요.

w|mikrofon.text: Sebelum tirai dibuka, kru memasang mikrofon kecil di kerah baju Eko.
w|mikrofon.en: Before the curtain opened, the crew attached a small microphone to Eko's collar.
w|mikrofon.ko: 막이 오르기 전에 스태프가 에코의 옷깃에 작은 마이크를 달았어요.

w|mikrofon.text: Anak-anak suka meminjam mikrofon mainan yang dijual di toko Ayu.
w|mikrofon.en: The kids like to borrow the toy microphone sold in Ayu's shop.
w|mikrofon.ko: 아이들은 아유 가게에서 파는 장난감 마이크를 빌려 놀기 좋아해요.

w|miliar.text: Investasi itu bernilai beberapa miliar rupiah.
w|miliar.en: That investment is worth several billion rupiah.

w|miliar.text: Miliar orang menonton siaran langsung itu.
w|miliar.en: Billions of people watched that live broadcast.

w|miliaran.text: Dalam drama itu, si pedagang serakah bermimpi punya harta miliaran rupiah.
w|miliaran.en: In the play, the greedy merchant dreams of having billions of rupiah.
w|miliaran.ko: 그 연극에서 욕심 많은 상인은 수십억 루피아의 재산을 꿈꿔요.

w|miliaran.text: Ayu heran ada orang yang mau menghabiskan miliaran rupiah hanya untuk membangun minimarket.
w|miliaran.en: Ayu is amazed that people would spend billions of rupiah just to build a minimarket.
w|miliaran.ko: 아유는 편의점 하나 짓는 데 수십억 루피아를 쓰는 사람들이 신기해요.

w|milik.en: That house belongs to his family.

w|milimeter.text: Tukang memperbaiki pintu kamar yang bergeser beberapa milimeter.
w|milimeter.en: The handyman fixed a room door that had shifted a few millimeters.
w|milimeter.ko: 수리공이 몇 밀리미터 틀어진 객실 문을 고쳤어요.

w|milimeter.text: Stasiun cuaca mencatat curah hujan lebih dari seratus milimeter semalam.
w|milimeter.en: The weather station recorded over a hundred millimeters of rainfall overnight.
w|milimeter.ko: 기상 관측소는 밤사이 강우량이 백 밀리미터를 넘었다고 기록했어요.

w|milisi.text: Kasus ini melibatkan kelompok milisi yang menguasai sebuah desa di perbatasan.
w|milisi.en: This case involves a militia group that took control of a village near the border.
w|milisi.ko: 이 사건에는 국경 근처 마을을 장악한 민병대가 얽혀 있어요.

w|milisi.text: Kakek Wati sering bercerita tentang masa ketika milisi desa menjaga jalan di depan warungnya.
w|milisi.en: Wati's grandfather often talks about the time when the village militia guarded the road in front of his stall.
w|milisi.ko: 와티 할아버지는 마을 민병대가 가게 앞길을 지키던 시절 이야기를 자주 해요.

w|militer.en: The military is ready to move.

w|mimpi.text: Aku punya mimpi aneh tadi malam.
w|mimpi.en: I had a weird dream last night.

w|minggir.en: Move aside for a sec, okay?

w|minoritas.text: Artikel Bayu tentang hak kelompok minoritas mendapat banyak tanggapan pembaca.
w|minoritas.en: Bayu's article on the rights of minority groups got many responses from readers.
w|minoritas.ko: 소수 집단의 권리에 관한 바유의 기사에 독자 반응이 많았어요.

w|minoritas.text: Intan sengaja membeli kain dari perajin kelompok minoritas di daerah terpencil.
w|minoritas.en: Intan deliberately bought cloth from minority-group artisans in a remote area.
w|minoritas.ko: 인탄은 일부러 외딴 지역 소수 민족 장인에게서 천을 샀어요.

w|minuman.en: What drink do you want to order?

w|minyak.en: Add a little oil to the pan.
The cooking oil is almost gone.

w|miring.text: Pagar rumah Andi sudah miring setelah ditabrak motor tetangga.
w|miring.en: Andi's fence has been leaning since a neighbor's motorbike crashed into it.
w|miring.ko: 이웃의 오토바이가 들이받은 뒤로 안디네 담장이 기울어졌어요.

w|miring.text: Dewi memberi tahu petugas bahwa salah satu bingkai lukisan terpasang miring.
w|miring.en: Dewi told the staff that one of the picture frames was hanging crooked.
w|miring.ko: 데위는 직원에게 그림 액자 하나가 비뚤게 걸려 있다고 알려 줬어요.

w|mirip.en: Your face looks like your mom's.

w|misalkan.text: Budi berpikir, misalkan panen gagal, dia masih punya sedikit tabungan.
w|misalkan.en: Budi thought that, suppose the harvest failed, he would still have a little savings.
w|misalkan.ko: 부디는 만약 수확을 망치더라도 아직 저축이 조금 있다고 생각했어요.

w|misalkan.text: Siti bertanya kepada koki baru, misalkan santan habis, apa penggantinya?
w|misalkan.en: Siti asked the new cook: suppose the coconut milk runs out, what's the substitute?
w|misalkan.ko: 시티는 새 요리사에게 코코넛 밀크가 떨어지면 뭘로 대신하냐고 물었어요.

w|misalnya.text: Ambil buah, misalnya apel atau pisang.
w|misalnya.en: Take fruit, for example an apple or a banana.
w|misalnya.ko: 과일 좀 먹어, 예를 들면 사과나 바나나.

w|misalnya.text: Misalnya kamu terlambat, telepon saja dulu.
w|misalnya.en: For example if you are late, just call first.
w|misalnya.ko: 예를 들어 늦으면 먼저 전화만 해.

w|misi.en: We finished carrying out the mission.

w|misil.text: Di pelajaran sejarah, Agus membaca tentang perlombaan misil di masa Perang Dingin.
w|misil.en: In history class, Agus read about the missile race during the Cold War.
w|misil.ko: 역사 시간에 아구스는 냉전 시대 미사일 경쟁에 대해 읽었어요.

w|misil.text: Adik Wati punya pistol air berbentuk misil yang bisa menembak jauh.
w|misil.en: Wati's brother has a missile-shaped water gun that shoots far.
w|misil.ko: 와티의 동생은 멀리 쏘는 미사일 모양 물총을 갖고 있어요.
