w|miskin.text: Keluarga miskin itu tetap saling mendukung.
w|miskin.en: That poor family still supports each other.
w|miskin.ko: 그 가난한 가족은 그래도 서로 도와.

w|miskin.text: Dia tumbuh di lingkungan yang miskin.
w|miskin.en: He grew up in a poor environment.

w|misteri.text: Misteri itu belum terpecahkan sampai sekarang.
w|misteri.en: That mystery has not been solved until now.
This mystery film makes me curious.
w|misteri.ko: 이 미스터리 영화가 나를 궁금하게 해.

w|misterius.en: A mysterious sound came from the attic.

w|misterius.text: Dia menerima surat misterius tadi malam.
w|misterius.en: She received a mysterious letter last night.
w|misterius.ko: 그는 어젯밤 수수께끼 같은 편지를 받았어.

w|mistis.text: Terdakwa mengaku menipu korban dengan menjual benda yang katanya punya kekuatan mistis.
w|mistis.en: The defendant admitted to cheating the victim by selling an object he claimed had mystical powers.
w|mistis.ko: 피고인은 신비한 힘이 있다는 물건을 팔아 피해자를 속였다고 인정했어요.

w|mistis.text: Lukisan hutan berkabut di dinding restoran memberi suasana agak mistis.
w|mistis.en: The painting of a misty forest on the restaurant wall gives a somewhat mystical feel.
w|mistis.ko: 식당 벽의 안개 낀 숲 그림이 조금 신비한 분위기를 줘요.

w|mitologi.text: Di dinding ruang tamu kantor polisi tergantung lukisan tokoh mitologi yang memegang tombak.
w|mitologi.en: On the wall of the police station's guest room hangs a painting of a mythological figure holding a spear.
w|mitologi.ko: 경찰서 응접실 벽에는 창을 든 신화 속 인물 그림이 걸려 있어요.

w|mitologi.text: Nama lomba itu diambil dari kisah mitologi tentang pelari yang membawa kabar kemenangan.
w|mitologi.en: The race's name comes from a myth about a runner who carried news of victory.
w|mitologi.ko: 그 대회 이름은 승리 소식을 전한 주자에 관한 신화에서 따왔어요.

w|mitos.text: Dimas membaca kumpulan mitos dari seluruh Nusantara.
w|mitos.en: Dimas read a collection of myths from across the archipelago.
w|mitos.ko: 디마스는 누산타라 곳곳의 신화 모음집을 읽었어요.

w|mitos.text: Penjaga warung di stasiun bercerita tentang mitos hantu di terowongan tua.
w|mitos.en: The stall keeper at the station told a myth about a ghost in the old tunnel.
w|mitos.ko: 역 매점 주인은 옛 터널에 귀신이 있다는 전설을 들려줬어요.

w|mitra.text: Perusahaan mencari mitra bisnis di luar negeri.
w|mitra.en: The company is seeking a business partner abroad.
w|mitra.ko: 회사는 해외에서 사업 파트너를 찾고 있어.

w|mitra.text: Mitra barunya sangat andal dan jujur.
w|mitra.en: His new partner is very reliable and honest.
w|mitra.ko: 그의 새 파트너는 매우 믿을 만하고 정직해.

w|mobil.en: I go to the office by car.

w|modal.text: Fajar menulis tentang pedagang kecil yang kesulitan mencari modal usaha.
w|modal.en: Fajar wrote about small traders who struggle to find business capital.
w|modal.ko: 파자르는 사업 자금을 구하기 힘든 소상인들에 대해 기사를 썼어요.

w|modal.text: Lestari mampir ke kedai milik anak muda yang mengumpulkan modal dari menjual kue.
w|modal.en: Lestari stopped by a shop run by a young man who raised capital by selling cakes.
w|modal.ko: 레스타리는 과자를 팔아 자금을 모은 청년의 가게에 들렀어요.

w|mode.text: Andi lupa menyalakan mode senyap, jadi ponselnya berbunyi di tengah ujian.
w|mode.en: Andi forgot to turn on silent mode, so his phone rang in the middle of the exam.
w|mode.ko: 안디가 무음 모드를 안 켜서 시험 중에 휴대폰이 울렸어요.

w|mode.text: Dewi mengubah ponselnya ke mode getar sebelum masuk bangsal.
w|mode.en: Dewi switched her phone to vibrate mode before entering the ward.
w|mode.ko: 데위는 병동에 들어가기 전에 휴대폰을 진동 모드로 바꿨어요.

w|model.en: That new model is very elegant.

w|model.text: Dia bekerja sebagai model di kota ini.
w|model.en: She works as a model in this city.

w|modern.text: Gedung modern itu berdiri di pusat kota.
w|modern.en: That modern building stands in the city center.
w|modern.ko: 그 현대적인 건물이 도심에 서 있어.

w|modern.text: Desain dapur ini terasa sangat modern.
w|modern.en: This kitchen design feels very modern.

w|modul.text: Andi mengikuti pelatihan keselamatan kerja dengan modul yang tebal.
w|modul.en: Andi took a work safety training course with a thick module.
w|modul.ko: 안디는 두꺼운 교재로 산업 안전 교육을 받았어요.

w|modul.text: Dewi masih ingat modul bahasa Inggris yang dulu dia pinjam dari Rina.
w|modul.en: Dewi still remembers the English module she once borrowed from Rina.
w|modul.ko: 데위는 예전에 리나에게 빌렸던 영어 교재를 아직 기억해요.

w|mogok.text: Pekerja di pabrik sebelah mogok selama tiga hari menuntut kenaikan upah.
w|mogok.en: Workers at the factory next door went on strike for three days demanding a raise.
w|mogok.ko: 옆 공장 노동자들이 임금 인상을 요구하며 사흘 동안 파업했어요.

w|mogok.text: Putri bercerita bahwa motornya mogok di tengah hujan minggu lalu.
w|mogok.en: Putri tells how her motorbike broke down in the rain last week.
w|mogok.ko: 푸트리는 지난주 빗속에서 오토바이가 멈춰 버린 이야기를 해요.

w|molekul.text: Sambil menyeduh kopi, Dimas menjelaskan kepada Rudi bahwa molekul air bergerak lebih cepat saat dipanaskan.
w|molekul.en: While brewing coffee, Dimas explained to Rudi that water molecules move faster when heated.
w|molekul.ko: 커피를 내리면서 디마스는 루디에게 물 분자가 데워지면 더 빨리 움직인다고 설명했어요.

w|molekul.text: Rina merasa setiap molekul di tubuhnya ikut bergetar saat bas berdentum.
w|molekul.en: Rina felt every molecule in her body vibrate when the bass boomed.
w|molekul.ko: 베이스가 쿵쿵 울릴 때 리나는 몸의 분자 하나하나가 같이 떨리는 것 같았어요.

w|momen.en: That moment will always be remembered.

w|momen.text: Tunggu momen yang tepat untuk bicara.
w|momen.en: Wait for the right moment to speak.

w|monster.en: That child is afraid of monsters.
The monster in that movie is terrifying.

w|montir.text: Eko memanggil montir untuk memperbaiki mobil pengantar makanan.
w|montir.en: Eko called a mechanic to fix the food delivery van.
w|montir.ko: 에코는 음식 배달 차를 고치려고 정비사를 불렀어요.

w|montir.text: Ayu membawa motor ke montir karena mesin mogok setelah menerobos banjir.
w|montir.en: Ayu took her motorbike to a mechanic because the engine died after riding through a flood.
w|montir.ko: 아유는 홍수를 뚫고 달린 뒤 엔진이 꺼져서 오토바이를 정비사에게 맡겼어요.

w|monumen.text: Dari jendela kamar, tamu bisa melihat monumen di tengah alun-alun.
w|monumen.en: From the room window, guests can see the monument in the middle of the square.
w|monumen.ko: 객실 창문으로 손님들은 광장 한가운데 있는 기념비를 볼 수 있어요.

w|monumen.text: Daun-daun kering menumpuk di sekitar monumen taman kota saat kemarau.
w|monumen.en: Dry leaves pile up around the monument in the city park during the dry season.
w|monumen.ko: 건기에는 시립 공원 기념비 주변에 마른 잎이 수북이 쌓여요.

w|monyet.en: That monkey climbed a tall tree.
The kids laughed watching the monkey.

w|moralitas.text: Tajuk rencana edisi Sabtu membahas moralitas para pejabat publik.
w|moralitas.en: The Saturday edition's editorial discusses the morality of public officials.
w|moralitas.ko: 토요일 판 사설은 공직자들의 도덕성을 다뤄요.

w|moralitas.text: Intan sering membaca diskusi tentang moralitas belanja barang tiruan.
w|moralitas.en: Intan often reads discussions about the morality of buying counterfeit goods.
w|moralitas.ko: 인탄은 가품을 사는 것의 도덕성에 관한 토론을 자주 읽어요.

w|morfin.text: Rudi menjelaskan bahwa morfin hanya dipakai untuk hewan yang sangat kesakitan.
w|morfin.en: Rudi explained that morphine is only used for animals in severe pain.
w|morfin.ko: 루디는 모르핀이 아주 심하게 아픈 동물에게만 쓰인다고 설명했어요.

w|morfin.text: Dokter puskesmas menjelaskan kepada Rina bahwa morfin hanya diberikan di rumah sakit besar.
w|morfin.en: The health-center doctor explained to Rina that morphine is only given at big hospitals.
w|morfin.ko: 보건소 의사는 리나에게 모르핀은 큰 병원에서만 준다고 설명했어요.

w|motel.text: Mereka bermalam di motel dekat jalan tol.
w|motel.en: They stayed overnight at a motel near the highway.
w|motel.ko: 그들은 고속도로 근처 모텔에서 하룻밤을 냈어.

w|motel.text: Motel itu bersih meski harganya murah.
w|motel.en: That motel is clean even though the price is low.

w|motif.text: Dinding aula balai kota dihiasi motif batik khas daerah.
w|motif.en: The walls of the city hall auditorium are decorated with the region's distinctive batik motifs.
w|motif.ko: 시청 강당 벽은 지역 고유의 바틱 무늬로 꾸며져 있어요.

w|motif.text: Lagu ciptaan Wati dibangun dari motif melodi sederhana yang diulang-ulang.
w|motif.en: The song Wati wrote is built on a simple melodic motif that repeats.
w|motif.ko: 와티가 만든 곡은 반복되는 단순한 선율 동기로 이루어져 있어요.

w|motor.text: Motor itu mogok di tengah jalan.
w|motor.en: That motorcycle broke down in the middle of the road.
w|motor.ko: 그 오토바이가 길 한가운데서 고장 났어.

w|motor.en: He goes to work by motorcycle.

w|muak.text: Aku sudah muak dengan alasan yang sama.
w|muak.en: I'm already sick of the same excuses.

w|muak.text: Dia merasa muak setelah makan terlalu banyak.
w|muak.en: He felt sick after eating too much.
w|muak.ko: 그는 너무 많이 먹은 뒤 속이 메스껐어.

w|mual.text: Bayu merasa mual karena minum susu protein terlalu cepat.
w|mual.en: Bayu felt nauseous from drinking his protein shake too fast.
w|mual.ko: 바유는 단백질 셰이크를 너무 빨리 마셔서 속이 메스꺼웠어요.

w|mual.text: Adik Intan merasa mual setelah mencium bau durian dari meja sebelah.
w|mual.en: Intan's younger sibling felt nauseous after smelling durian from the next table.
w|mual.ko: 인탄의 동생은 옆 테이블의 두리안 냄새를 맡고 속이 메스꺼웠어요.

w|muatan.text: Gerbong di belakang Dimas penuh muatan pupuk untuk petani.
w|muatan.en: The carriage behind Dimas was full of a load of fertilizer for farmers.
w|muatan.ko: 디마스 뒤 칸은 농민들에게 갈 비료 짐으로 가득했어요.

w|muatan.text: Sistem Putri bisa menghitung muatan truk agar tidak melebihi batas jalan.
w|muatan.en: Putri's system can calculate a truck's load so it doesn't exceed the road limit.
w|muatan.ko: 푸트리의 시스템은 트럭 적재량이 도로 한도를 넘지 않도록 계산할 수 있어요.

w|mudah-mudahan.text: Eko berharap mudah-mudahan nilai rapornya naik semester ini.
w|mudah-mudahan.en: Eko hopes his report card grades will go up this semester.
w|mudah-mudahan.ko: 에코는 이번 학기 성적이 오르기를 바라요.

w|mudah-mudahan.text: Kata Ayu, mudah-mudahan lukisannya terpilih untuk pameran bulan depan.
w|mudah-mudahan.en: Ayu said she hopes her painting will be chosen for next month's exhibition.
w|mudah-mudahan.ko: 아유는 다음 달 전시회에 자기 그림이 뽑혔으면 좋겠다고 했어요.

w|muka.text: Muka anak itu berseri setelah mendapat hadiah.
w|muka.en: That child's face lit up after getting a gift.
w|muka.ko: 그 아이 얼굴이 선물을 받고 환해졌어.

w|muka.en: She washed her face before sleeping.

w|mukjizat.text: Kata sutradara, pertunjukan bisa selesai tepat waktu itu sudah mukjizat.
w|mukjizat.en: The director said it was a miracle the show finished on time.
w|mukjizat.ko: 감독은 공연이 제시간에 끝난 것만 해도 기적이라고 말했어요.

w|mukjizat.text: Bisa bertahan di dekat minimarket besar terasa seperti mukjizat bagi toko Ayu.
w|mukjizat.en: Surviving near a big minimarket feels like a miracle for Ayu's shop.
w|mukjizat.ko: 큰 편의점 근처에서 버티는 게 아유의 가게에는 기적처럼 느껴져요.

w|mulus.text: Operasi pengangkatan tumor kecil pada anjing itu berjalan mulus.
w|mulus.en: The operation to remove a small tumor from the dog went smoothly.
w|mulus.ko: 그 개의 작은 종양 제거 수술은 순조롭게 끝났어요.

w|mulus.text: Jalan menuju desa Siti sekarang sudah mulus setelah diaspal.
w|mulus.en: The road to Siti's village is now smooth after being paved.
w|mulus.ko: 시티네 마을로 가는 길은 포장된 뒤로 이제 매끈해요.

w|mulut.en: Shut your mouth for a moment.
His mouth was full of food.

w|mumi.text: Bayu meliput pameran museum yang menampilkan mumi dari zaman kuno.
w|mumi.en: Bayu covered a museum exhibition displaying a mummy from ancient times.
w|mumi.ko: 바유는 고대 미라를 선보이는 박물관 전시를 취재했어요.

w|mumi.text: Kakek Intan bercerita tentang film lama yang menampilkan mumi hidup kembali.
w|mumi.en: Intan's grandfather talked about an old film in which a mummy comes back to life.
w|mumi.ko: 인탄의 할아버지는 미라가 되살아나는 옛날 영화 이야기를 하셨어요.

w|munafik.text: Andi kesal dengan tetangga munafik yang memuji di depan tetapi bergosip di belakang.
w|munafik.en: Andi is annoyed by the two-faced neighbor who praises people to their faces but gossips behind their backs.
w|munafik.ko: 안디는 앞에서는 칭찬하고 뒤에서는 험담하는 위선적인 이웃에게 짜증이 나요.

w|munafik.text: Dalam pameran wayang, Dewi melihat tokoh munafik yang selalu berganti pihak.
w|munafik.en: In the puppet exhibition, Dewi saw a two-faced character who always switches sides.
w|munafik.ko: 와양 전시에서 데위는 늘 편을 바꾸는 위선적인 인물을 봤어요.

w|muncul.en: A new problem showed up again.

w|mundur.en: That car is backing up slowly.
We'd better step back for now.

w|mungil.text: Ruang kerja Fajar di balai kota mungil, tapi jendelanya menghadap alun-alun.
w|mungil.en: Fajar's office at city hall is tiny, but its window faces the town square.
w|mungil.ko: 시청에 있는 파자르의 사무실은 작지만 창문이 광장을 향해 있어요.

w|mungil.text: Lestari menyelipkan foto rumah mungil yang baru ia tempati bersama keluarganya.
w|mungil.en: Lestari slipped in a photo of the tiny house she had just moved into with her family.
w|mungil.ko: 레스타리는 가족과 새로 살게 된 작은 집 사진을 편지에 끼워 넣었어요.

w|mungkin.ko: 아마 그 사람 깜빡한 것 같아.

w|muntah.text: Anak itu muntah setelah makan terlalu cepat.
w|muntah.en: That child threw up after eating too fast.
w|muntah.ko: 그 아이는 너무 빨리 먹은 뒤 토했어.

w|muntah.text: Dia merasa ingin muntah di mobil.
w|muntah.en: He felt like throwing up in the car.
w|muntah.ko: 그는 차 안에서 토할 것 같았어.

w|murah.text: Harga buah di pasar sangat murah.
w|murah.en: Fruit prices at the market are very cheap.

w|murah.text: Tiket pesawat hari ini lebih murah.

w|murahan.text: Tas murahan itu cepat rusak setelah dipakai.
w|murahan.en: That cheap bag broke quickly after use.
w|murahan.ko: 그 싸구려 가방은 쓰고 나서 금방 망가졌어.

w|murahan.text: Murahan bukan berarti kualitasnya selalu buruk.
w|murahan.en: Cheap does not always mean the quality is bad.
w|murahan.ko: 싸구려라고 해서 품질이 항상 나쁜 건 아니야.

w|murid.text: Murid baru duduk di bangku depan.
w|murid.en: The new student sat in the front seat.
The teacher helps students who struggle.

w|murka.text: Rudi takut menghadapi murka kakaknya kalau kebenaran itu terungkap.
w|murka.en: Rudi was afraid of facing his sister's fury if the truth came out.
w|murka.ko: 루디는 진실이 드러나면 누나가 크게 화낼까 봐 두려웠어요.

w|murka.text: Dalam legenda setempat, badai besar adalah tanda murka penguasa laut.
w|murka.en: In the local legend, a great storm is a sign of the sea ruler's wrath.
w|murka.ko: 그 지역 전설에서 큰 폭풍은 바다 지배자의 분노를 뜻해요.

w|murni.text: Air murni dari gunung rasanya segar.
w|murni.en: Pure water from the mountain tastes fresh.
w|murni.ko: 산에서 온 맑은 물은 맛이 신선해.

w|murni.en: His intention is purely to help a friend.
w|murni.ko: 그의 의도는 순전히 친구를 돕는 거야.

w|murung.text: Wajah Dimas tidak lagi murung setelah rekan-rekannya mengajaknya makan siang bersama.
w|murung.en: Dimas no longer looked gloomy after his coworkers invited him to lunch.
w|murung.ko: 동료들이 점심을 같이 먹자고 하자 디마스의 얼굴은 더 이상 우울하지 않았어요.

w|murung.text: Putri melihat seorang anak kecil murung di ruang tunggu karena pesawatnya terlambat.
w|murung.en: Putri saw a little child sulking in the waiting room because the plane was late.
w|murung.ko: 푸트리는 비행기가 늦어서 대기실에서 시무룩한 어린아이를 봤어요.

w|musang.text: Seekor musang mencuri pisang dari tas makanan Eko tengah malam.
w|musang.en: A civet stole bananas from Eko's food bag in the middle of the night.
w|musang.ko: 한밤중에 사향고양이 한 마리가 에코의 음식 가방에서 바나나를 훔쳐 갔어요.

w|musang.text: Ayu melihat seekor musang menyeberang jalan saat latihan subuh.
w|musang.en: Ayu saw a civet crossing the road during her dawn training.
w|musang.ko: 아유는 새벽 훈련 중에 사향고양이가 길을 건너는 걸 봤어요.

w|museum.text: Museum itu tutup setiap hari Senin.
w|museum.en: That museum is closed every Monday.
We visited a modern art museum.

w|musibah.text: Waktu musibah banjir melanda, kantor polisi itu dijadikan tempat pengungsian sementara.
w|musibah.en: When the flood disaster struck, the police station was turned into a temporary shelter.
w|musibah.ko: 홍수 재난이 났을 때 그 경찰서는 임시 대피소가 되었어요.

w|musibah.text: Panitia menyiapkan beberapa ambulans untuk berjaga-jaga kalau terjadi musibah di jalan.
w|musibah.en: The organizers prepared several ambulances just in case an accident happened on the road.
w|musibah.ko: 주최 측은 길에서 사고가 날 경우에 대비해 구급차 몇 대를 준비했어요.

w|musik.en: She has studied music since childhood.

w|musikal.text: Andi menemukan naskah lama sebuah musikal di bagian seni pertunjukan.
w|musikal.en: Andi found an old script of a musical in the performing arts section.
w|musikal.ko: 안디는 공연 예술 코너에서 오래된 뮤지컬 대본을 찾았어요.

w|musikal.text: Sambil mengemas barang, Dewi menyanyikan lagu dari musikal kesukaannya.
w|musikal.en: While packing, Dewi sang songs from her favorite musical.
w|musikal.ko: 짐을 싸면서 데위는 좋아하는 뮤지컬 노래를 불렀어요.

w|musisi.text: Seorang musisi muda memainkan biola di pintu masuk gedung resepsi.
w|musisi.en: A young musician plays the violin at the entrance of the reception hall.
w|musisi.ko: 젊은 음악가가 피로연장 입구에서 바이올린을 연주해요.

w|musisi.text: Seorang musisi jalanan bernyanyi di bawah pohon flamboyan yang mulai berbunga.
w|musisi.en: A street musician sings under a flame tree that is starting to bloom.
w|musisi.ko: 거리 음악가가 꽃이 피기 시작한 봉황목 아래에서 노래해요.

w|muslihat.text: Budi tertawa karena muslihat temannya untuk menghindari piket ketahuan guru.
w|muslihat.en: Budi laughed because his friend's trick to dodge cleaning duty was caught by the teacher.
w|muslihat.ko: 청소 당번을 피하려던 친구의 꼼수가 선생님께 들켜서 부디는 웃었어요.

w|muslihat.text: Siti tidak tertipu muslihat calo tiket di depan terminal.
w|muslihat.en: Siti didn't fall for the ticket scalper's trick in front of the terminal.
w|muslihat.ko: 시티는 터미널 앞 암표상의 속임수에 넘어가지 않았어요.

w|musnah.text: Andi membaca bahwa banyak naskah kuno musnah dalam kebakaran besar abad lalu.
w|musnah.en: Andi read that many ancient manuscripts were destroyed in a great fire last century.
w|musnah.ko: 안디는 지난 세기 대화재로 고문서가 많이 사라졌다는 걸 읽었어요.

w|musnah.text: Dewi takut semua data proyek musnah karena hard disk-nya rusak.
w|musnah.en: Dewi feared all the project data was lost because her hard disk broke.
w|musnah.ko: 디위는 하드 디스크가 고장 나서 프로젝트 자료가 다 날아갈까 봐 걱정했어요.

w|mustahil.text: Mustahil menyelesaikan semua pekerjaan malam ini.
w|mustahil.en: It's impossible to finish all the work tonight.
w|mustahil.ko: 오늘 밤 모든 일을 끝내는 건 불가능해.

w|mustahil.text: Bagi dia, tidak ada yang mustahil.

w|musuh.en: The enemy has approached the border.
Don't treat him as an enemy.

w|mutan.text: Dimas menggambar komik tentang mutan berkulit hijau yang bisa terbang.
w|mutan.en: Dimas drew a comic about a green-skinned mutant who can fly.
w|mutan.ko: 디마스는 날 수 있는 초록 피부 돌연변이가 나오는 만화를 그렸어요.

w|mutan.text: Anak Putri bilang tomat raksasa di dapur seperti mutan dari film.
w|mutan.en: Putri's child said the giant tomato in the kitchen looked like a mutant from a movie.
w|mutan.ko: 푸트리의 아이는 부엌에 있는 거대한 토마토가 영화 속 돌연변이 같다고 했어요.

w|mutiara.text: Bayu curiga kalung mutiara murah itu sebenarnya imitasi.
w|mutiara.en: Bayu suspects the cheap pearl necklace is actually a fake.
w|mutiara.ko: 바유는 그 싼 진주 목걸이가 사실 모조품일 거라고 의심해요.

w|mutiara.text: Hiasan rambut Intan dihiasi mutiara kecil yang berkilau di bawah lampu.
w|mutiara.en: Intan's hair ornament was decorated with small pearls that sparkled under the lights.
w|mutiara.ko: 인탄의 머리 장식에는 조명 아래 반짝이는 작은 진주들이 달려 있었어요.

w|mutlak.text: Di gym itu, aturan memakai sepatu olahraga bersifat mutlak.
w|mutlak.en: At that gym, the rule about wearing sports shoes is absolute.
w|mutlak.ko: 그 헬스장에서는 운동화 착용 규칙이 절대적이에요.

w|mutlak.text: Di keluarga Intan, keputusan nenek soal tempat makan itu mutlak.
w|mutlak.en: In Intan's family, grandmother's decision on where to eat is final.
w|mutlak.ko: 인탄네 집에서는 어디서 먹을지에 대한 할머니의 결정이 절대적이에요.

w|nabi.text: Pentas musim ini mengangkat kisah seorang nabi dari kitab kuno.
w|nabi.en: This season's production tells the story of a prophet from an ancient scripture.
w|nabi.ko: 이번 시즌 공연은 옛 경전에 나오는 한 예언자의 이야기를 다뤄요.

w|nabi.text: Kantor Intan tutup pada hari peringatan kelahiran nabi.
w|nabi.en: Intan's office is closed on the holiday marking the Prophet's birth.
w|nabi.ko: 인탄의 회사는 예언자 탄생 기념일에 쉬어요.

w|nada.en: The tone of her voice sounded very angry.
w|nada.ko: 목소리 톤이 아주 화난 것처럼 들렸어.

w|nada.text: Dia menurunkan nada saat berbicara di rapat.
w|nada.en: He lowered his tone when speaking in the meeting.
w|nada.ko: 그는 회의에서 말할 때 톤을 낮췄어.

w|nadi.text: Dimas meraba nadi di paha dalam anjing itu untuk memastikan jantungnya kuat.
w|nadi.en: Dimas felt the pulse on the dog's inner thigh to make sure its heart was strong.
w|nadi.ko: 디마스는 개의 심장이 튼튼한지 확인하려고 허벅지 안쪽 맥을 짚었어요.

w|nadi.text: Jam pintar itu mengukur nadi Putri selama dia berlari pagi.
w|nadi.en: The smartwatch measures Putri's pulse while she goes for her morning run.
w|nadi.ko: 스마트워치가 푸트리가 아침 달리기를 하는 동안 맥박을 재요.

w|nafkah.text: Fajar mewawancarai nelayan yang tetap mencari nafkah di tengah cuaca buruk.
w|nafkah.en: Fajar interviewed fishermen who keep earning a living despite the bad weather.
w|nafkah.ko: 파자르는 궂은 날씨에도 생계를 꾸리는 어부들을 인터뷰했어요.

w|nafkah.text: Lestari membeli keripik dari seorang ibu yang mencari nafkah di pinggir jalan.
w|nafkah.en: Lestari bought chips from a woman who makes her living by the roadside.
w|nafkah.ko: 레스타리는 길가에서 생계를 꾸리는 아주머니에게서 칩을 샀어요.

w|nafsu.text: Andi menunggu lama sampai kehilangan nafsu makan.
w|nafsu.en: Andi waited so long that he lost his appetite.
w|nafsu.ko: 안디는 너무 오래 기다리다가 입맛을 잃었어요.

w|nafsu.text: Setelah latihan berat, nafsu makan Dewi jadi besar sekali.
w|nafsu.en: After a hard practice, Dewi's appetite gets huge.
w|nafsu.ko: 힘든 연습이 끝나면 데위는 식욕이 엄청 늘어요.

w|naga.text: Naga dalam legenda itu menjaga harta karun.
w|naga.en: The dragon in that legend guards the treasure.
The children drew a red dragon.

w|naif.text: Rudi agak naif karena mengira semua tamu datang tanpa diundang.
w|naif.en: Rudi is a bit naive for thinking all the guests came without being invited.
w|naif.ko: 루디는 손님들이 다 초대 없이 온 줄 알 만큼 좀 순진해요.

w|naif.text: Redaktur menganggap judul Rina terlalu naif untuk berita politik.
w|naif.en: The editor thought Rina's headline was too naive for a political story.
w|naif.ko: 편집자는 리나의 제목이 정치 기사로는 너무 순진하다고 봤어요.

w|nakal.text: Anak itu sangat nakal hari ini.
w|nakal.en: That child is very naughty today.
His behavior in class was so naughty.

w|naksir.text: Kakak Rudi mengira Rudi naksir sahabatnya, padahal Rudi cuma membantu tugas kuliah.
w|naksir.en: Rudi's sister thought Rudi had a crush on her best friend, but he was only helping with coursework.
w|naksir.ko: 루디의 누나는 루디가 자기 절친을 좋아한다고 생각했지만, 루디는 과제만 도와줬을 뿐이에요.

w|naksir.text: Teman Rina naksir pemuda penjaga pantai yang selalu menyapa mereka.
w|naksir.en: Rina's friend has a crush on the young lifeguard who always greets them.
w|naksir.ko: 리나의 친구는 늘 인사해 주는 젊은 안전요원에게 반했어요.

w|naluri.text: Sebagai kakak, Budi punya naluri untuk melindungi adiknya, Rina.
w|naluri.en: As the older brother, Budi has an instinct to protect his younger sister, Rina.
w|naluri.ko: 오빠로서 부디는 동생 리나를 지키려는 본능이 있어요.

w|naluri.text: Kucing Siti punya naluri untuk bersembunyi setiap kali ada kardus baru.
w|naluri.en: Siti's cat has an instinct to hide every time there's a new cardboard box.
w|naluri.ko: 시티의 고양이는 새 상자가 생길 때마다 숨는 본능이 있어요.

w|namun.en: I want to join, but I'm busy.

w|napas.en: His breath is still ragged after running.
w|napas.ko: 달린 뒤에도 숨이 아직 가빠져 있어.

w|napas.en: Take a deep breath before speaking.

w|napi.text: Andi membaca memoar seorang mantan napi yang kini menjadi guru.
w|napi.en: Andi read the memoir of a former convict who is now a teacher.
w|napi.ko: 안디는 지금은 교사가 된 전과자의 회고록을 읽었어요.

w|napi.text: Perusahaan Dewi ikut program yang memberi pekerjaan kepada mantan napi.
w|napi.en: Dewi's company joined a program that gives jobs to former inmates.
w|napi.ko: 디위의 회사는 출소자에게 일자리를 주는 프로그램에 참여했어요.

w|narapidana.text: Seorang mantan narapidana datang ke sekolah Agus untuk berbagi kisah hidupnya.
w|narapidana.en: A former prisoner came to Agus's school to share his life story.
w|narapidana.ko: 전과자 한 분이 아구스의 학교에 와서 자기 인생 이야기를 들려줬어요.

w|narapidana.text: Wati menonton film tentang narapidana yang melarikan diri lewat saluran air.
w|narapidana.en: Wati watched a film about a prisoner who escaped through a water channel.
w|narapidana.ko: 와티는 수로로 탈출한 죄수 이야기를 담은 영화를 봤어요.

w|narator.text: Video pelatihan untuk pegawai baru diisi suara narator yang tenang.
w|narator.en: The training video for new employees is voiced by a calm narrator.
w|narator.ko: 신입 직원 교육 영상에는 차분한 내레이터 목소리가 들어가 있어요.

w|narator.text: Film di pesawat itu diawali suara narator yang bercerita tentang laut.
w|narator.en: The in-flight film began with a narrator's voice talking about the sea.
w|narator.ko: 기내 영화는 바다 이야기를 하는 내레이터 목소리로 시작했어요.

w|narkoba.text: Narkoba merusak masa depan anak muda.
Polisi menyita narkoba dalam jumlah besar.
w|narkoba.en: The police seized a large amount of drugs.

w|narkotika.text: Beberapa obat bius di klinik termasuk golongan narkotika dan disimpan di lemari terkunci.
w|narkotika.en: Some anesthetics at the clinic are classed as narcotics and kept in a locked cabinet.
w|narkotika.ko: 병원의 일부 마취제는 마약류로 분류돼 잠긴 장에 보관돼요.

w|narkotika.text: Siti membaca berita bahwa polisi menemukan ladang tanaman narkotika di hutan dekat perbatasan.
w|narkotika.en: Siti read a news story that police had found a field of narcotic plants in a forest near the border.
w|narkotika.ko: 시티는 경찰이 국경 근처 숲에서 마약 식물 밭을 찾아냈다는 기사를 읽었어요.

w|nasi.text: Pagi-pagi, Fajar sarapan nasi uduk sebelum menyalakan oven.
w|nasi.en: Early in the morning, Fajar has coconut rice for breakfast before turning on the oven.
w|nasi.ko: 이른 아침 파자르는 오븐을 켜기 전에 코코넛 밥으로 아침을 먹어요.

w|nasi.text: Pagi hari lomba, Lestari cuma makan sedikit nasi dan telur rebus.
w|nasi.en: On race morning, Lestari only ate a little rice and a boiled egg.
w|nasi.ko: 대회 날 아침 레스타리는 밥 조금과 삶은 달걀만 먹었어요.

w|nasib.en: Fate brought them to meet again.

w|nasihat.text: Bu Lestari memberi Dimas nasihat untuk membaca sedikit tapi setiap hari.
w|nasihat.en: Mrs. Lestari advised Dimas to read a little but every day.
w|nasihat.ko: 레스타리 씨는 디마스에게 조금씩이라도 매일 읽으라고 조언했어요.

w|nasihat.text: Seorang kakek di sebelah Putri memberi nasihat tentang cara menawar di pasar Yogyakarta.
w|nasihat.en: An old man next to Putri gave her advice on how to bargain at the markets in Yogyakarta.
w|nasihat.ko: 푸트리 옆자리 할아버지가 족자카르타 시장에서 값 깎는 요령을 알려 줬어요.

w|nasional.text: Tim nasional menang dengan skor tipis.
w|nasional.en: The national team won by a narrow score.

w|naskah.text: Bayu membantu produser itu menyusun naskah wawancara dengan para buruh.
w|naskah.en: Bayu helped the producer put together the script for interviews with the workers.
w|naskah.ko: 바유는 그 프로듀서가 노동자 인터뷰 대본을 짜는 걸 도왔어요.

w|naskah.text: Intan membaca ulang naskah presentasinya selama penerbangan.
w|naskah.en: Intan reread her presentation script during the flight.
w|naskah.ko: 인탄은 비행하는 동안 발표 원고를 다시 읽었어요.

w|navigasi.text: Sinyal hilang, jadi aplikasi navigasi di ponsel Bayu tidak bisa dipakai.
w|navigasi.en: The signal dropped, so the navigation app on Bayu's phone stopped working.
w|navigasi.ko: 신호가 끊겨서 바유의 휴대폰 내비게이션 앱을 쓸 수 없었어요.

w|navigasi.text: Intan meniru gaya peta navigasi kuno untuk latar belakang lukisannya.
w|navigasi.en: Intan copied the style of ancient navigation charts for her painting's background.
w|navigasi.ko: 인탄은 그림 배경에 옛 항해 지도의 화풍을 따라 했어요.

w|negatif.en: His attitude today is so negative.

w|negosiasi.text: Setelah negosiasi panjang, kepala sekolah setuju menambah jam ekstrakurikuler.
w|negosiasi.en: After long negotiations, the principal agreed to add more extracurricular hours.
w|negosiasi.ko: 긴 협상 끝에 교장 선생님은 방과 후 활동 시간을 늘리기로 했어요.

w|negosiasi.text: Serikat perawat sedang melakukan negosiasi gaji dengan pihak rumah sakit.
w|negosiasi.en: The nurses' union is negotiating salaries with the hospital management.
w|negosiasi.ko: 간호사 노조가 병원 측과 임금 협상을 하고 있어요.

w|nekat.text: Andi menegur anak tetangga yang nekat memanjat tiang listrik.
w|nekat.en: Andi scolded the neighbor's kid who recklessly climbed an electricity pole.
w|nekat.ko: 안디는 무모하게 전봇대에 올라간 이웃집 아이를 나무랐어요.

w|nekat.text: Dewi membaca kisah pelaut nekat yang menyeberangi samudra dengan perahu kecil.
w|nekat.en: Dewi read the story of a daring sailor who crossed the ocean in a small boat.
w|nekat.ko: 데위는 작은 배로 대양을 건넌 무모한 선원의 이야기를 읽었어요.

w|nelayan.text: Setiap subuh, Fajar membeli udang langsung dari nelayan di pelabuhan.
w|nelayan.en: Every dawn, Fajar buys shrimp straight from the fishermen at the harbor.
w|nelayan.ko: 파자르는 매일 새벽 항구에서 어부들에게 직접 새우를 사요.

w|nelayan.text: Jaring tua milik seorang nelayan dijual murah untuk hiasan kafe.
w|nelayan.en: A fisherman's old net is being sold cheap as café decor.
w|nelayan.ko: 어느 어부의 낡은 그물이 카페 장식용으로 싸게 팔려요.

w|neraka.en: Hell is described as extremely hot.

w|netral.text: Saat dua tetangga saling menuduh, Rudi berusaha tetap netral dan mendengarkan keduanya.
w|netral.en: When the two neighbors accused each other, Rudi tried to stay neutral and listen to both.
w|netral.ko: 두 이웃이 서로 탓할 때 루디는 중립을 지키며 둘 다의 말을 들으려 했어요.

w|netral.text: Rina memilih kaus berwarna netral seperti abu-abu supaya cocok dengan celana apa saja.
w|netral.en: Rina chose a neutral-colored shirt like gray so it would go with any shorts.
w|netral.ko: 리나는 어떤 바지와도 어울리도록 회색 같은 무난한 색 티셔츠를 골랐어요.

w|ngawur.text: Kata Dimas, tebakan pengunjung soal umur patung itu agak ngawur.
w|ngawur.en: According to Dimas, the visitor's guess about the statue's age was a bit wild.
w|ngawur.ko: 디마스 말로는 그 방문객이 조각상 나이를 짐작한 게 좀 엉터리였대요.

w|ngawur.text: Label harga di rak itu ngawur, jadi Putri mencetak ulang semuanya.
w|ngawur.en: The price labels on that shelf were all wrong, so Putri reprinted them all.
w|ngawur.ko: 그 선반의 가격표가 엉망이라 푸트리가 전부 다시 뽑았어요.

w|ngengat.text: Lampu teras rumah Eko selalu dikerubungi ngengat pada malam hari.
w|ngengat.en: The porch light at Eko's house is always swarmed by moths at night.
w|ngengat.ko: 에코네 현관 불빛에는 밤마다 나방이 몰려들어요.

w|ngengat.text: Gudang kain itu disemprot rutin supaya tidak ada ngengat.
w|ngengat.en: The fabric warehouse is sprayed regularly so there are no moths.
w|ngengat.ko: 그 원단 창고는 나방이 생기지 않게 정기적으로 약을 뿌려요.

w|nggak.en: He said he doesn't want to join.

w|ngobrol.text: Mari kita ngobrol sebentar di kafe.
w|ngobrol.en: Let's chat for a bit at the cafe.

w|ngobrol.text: Mereka suka ngobrol sampai larut malam.
w|ngobrol.en: They like chatting until late at night.
w|ngobrol.ko: 그들은 밤늦게까지 수다 떠는 걸 좋아해.

w|niat.text: Tahun ini Budi punya niat untuk ikut olimpiade sains.
w|niat.en: This year Budi intends to take part in the science olympiad.
w|niat.ko: 올해 부디는 과학 올림피아드에 나가려는 마음을 먹었어요.

w|niat.text: Sudah lama Siti punya niat pindah ke rumah yang lebih dekat dengan kantor.
w|niat.en: Siti had long intended to move to a house closer to her office.
w|niat.ko: 시티는 오래전부터 회사와 가까운 집으로 이사할 생각이었어요.

w|nih.text: Nih, ambil kunci cadangan dari aku.
w|nih.en: Here, take the spare key from me.

w|nih.text: Coba lihat nih, ada surat untukmu.
w|nih.en: Look here, there's a letter for you.
w|nih.ko: 자 봐, 너한테 온 편지가 있어.

w|nihil.text: Hasil pemeriksaan sidik jari di gagang pintu ternyata nihil.
w|nihil.en: The fingerprint check on the door handle turned up nothing.
w|nihil.ko: 문손잡이 지문 감식 결과는 아무것도 나오지 않았어요.

w|nihil.text: Peluang Rina untuk menjadi juara memang nihil, tetapi ia tetap ingin sampai di garis finis.
w|nihil.en: Rina's chance of winning was practically zero, but she still wanted to reach the finish line.
w|nihil.ko: 리나가 우승할 가능성은 사실상 없었지만 그래도 결승선까지 가고 싶었어요.

w|nikmat.text: Gorengan di kantin sekolah paling nikmat dimakan selagi hangat.
w|nikmat.en: The fried snacks at the school canteen taste best while still warm.
w|nikmat.ko: 학교 매점 튀김은 따뜻할 때 먹어야 제일 맛있어요.

w|nikmat.text: Setelah dua hari puasa sebelum operasi, bubur ayam terasa sangat nikmat bagi pasien itu.
w|nikmat.en: After two days of fasting before surgery, chicken porridge tasted wonderful to the patient.
w|nikmat.ko: 수술 전 이틀을 굶은 그 환자에게 닭죽은 정말 맛있었어요.

w|nilai.en: His exam score is very satisfying.

w|nilai.text: Guru mengumumkan nilai di akhir semester.
w|nilai.en: The teacher announces grades at the end of the semester.

w|noda.text: Andi menemukan noda air di langit-langit kamar tengah.
w|noda.en: Andi found a water stain on the ceiling of the middle room.
w|noda.ko: 안디는 가운데 방 천장에서 물 얼룩을 발견했어요.

w|noda.text: Dewi menumpahkan kopi dan meninggalkan noda cokelat di celananya.
w|noda.en: Dewi spilled coffee and left a brown stain on her trousers.
w|noda.ko: 데위는 커피를 쏟아서 바지에 갈색 얼룩이 생겼어요.

w|nol.text: Skor tim kami masih nol sampai akhir.
w|nol.en: Our team's score stayed at zero until the end.

w|nol.text: Nol kesalahan adalah target hari ini.

w|nona.en: That young lady is very pretty.

w|nongkrong.text: Sepulang sekolah, Dimas dan teman-temannya suka nongkrong di warung dekat gerbang.
w|nongkrong.en: After school, Dimas and his friends like hanging out at the stall near the gate.
w|nongkrong.ko: 방과 후에 디마스와 친구들은 교문 근처 가게에서 어울려 노는 걸 좋아해요.

w|nongkrong.text: Anak-anak muda suka nongkrong di restoran keluarga Putri karena wifinya kencang.
w|nongkrong.en: Young people like hanging out at Putri's family restaurant because the wifi is fast.
w|nongkrong.ko: 와이파이가 빨라서 젊은이들이 푸트리네 가족 식당에서 어울려 놀아요.

w|norak.text: Rekan Bayu menertawakan dasi bermotif buah yang menurutnya norak.
w|norak.en: Bayu's colleague laughed at his fruit-patterned tie, which she thought was tacky.
w|norak.ko: 바유의 동료는 과일 무늬 넥타이가 촌스럽다며 웃었어요.

w|norak.text: Intan mengembalikan tas yang ternyata warnanya norak, tidak seperti di foto.
w|norak.en: Intan returned the bag, whose color turned out to be garish, not like in the photo.
w|norak.ko: 인탄은 색이 사진과 달리 촌스러운 가방을 반품했어요.

w|novel.text: Dimas selalu memilih novel yang tebal untuk dibaca saat liburan.
w|novel.en: Dimas always chooses a thick novel to read during the holidays.
w|novel.ko: 디마스는 방학 때 읽을 책으로 늘 두꺼운 소설을 골라요.

w|novel.text: Selama perjalanan panjang itu, Putri menghabiskan sebuah novel misteri.
w|novel.en: During the long journey, Putri finished a mystery novel.
w|novel.ko: 긴 여행 동안 푸트리는 추리 소설 한 권을 다 읽었어요.

w|november.text: Bulan November tahun lalu, angin kencang merobohkan pohon di depan rumah Budi.
w|november.en: Last November, strong winds knocked down the tree in front of Budi's house.
w|november.ko: 작년 십일월에 강풍이 부디네 집 앞 나무를 쓰러뜨렸어요.

w|november.text: Siti berharap film itu bisa selesai disunting bulan November.
w|november.en: Siti hopes the film can finish editing in November.
w|november.ko: 시티는 영화 편집이 십일월에 끝나기를 바라요.

w|nuklir.en: Nuclear issues became a topic of international debate.
w|nuklir.ko: 핵 문제가 국제 토론 주제가 됐어.

w|nuklir.text: Mereka membahas energi nuklir dengan hati-hati.

w|nurani.text: Rudi bilang hati nurani menyuruhnya meminta maaf kepada Bayu.
w|nurani.en: Rudi said his conscience told him to apologize to Bayu.
w|nurani.ko: 루디는 양심이 바유에게 사과하라고 했다고 말했어요.

w|nurani.text: Rina menolak menjual data pengguna karena tidak sesuai dengan hati nurani.
w|nurani.en: Rina refused to sell user data because it went against her conscience.
w|nurani.ko: 리나는 양심에 어긋나서 사용자 데이터를 팔기를 거절했어요.

w|nyali.text: Agus butuh nyali besar untuk menyampaikan kritik langsung kepada wali kota.
w|nyali.en: Agus needed a lot of nerve to voice criticism directly to the mayor.
w|nyali.ko: 아구스가 시장에게 직접 비판을 전하려면 큰 배짱이 필요했어요.

w|nyali.text: Wati akhirnya punya nyali untuk bernyanyi solo di depan seluruh sekolah.
w|nyali.en: Wati finally has the nerve to sing solo in front of the whole school.
w|nyali.ko: 와티는 마침내 학교 전체 앞에서 독창할 용기가 생겼어요.

w|nyamuk.text: Rudi lupa membawa obat nyamuk, jadi tangannya penuh bentol.
w|nyamuk.en: Rudi forgot to bring mosquito repellent, so his arms were covered in bites.
w|nyamuk.ko: 루디는 모기약을 깜빡해서 팔이 물린 자국투성이였어요.

w|nyamuk.text: Konser di lapangan terbuka itu penuh nyamuk, jadi Rina membawa minyak kayu putih.
w|nyamuk.en: The open-field concert was full of mosquitoes, so Rina brought eucalyptus oil.
w|nyamuk.ko: 야외 공연장에 모기가 많아서 리나는 유칼립투스 오일을 가져갔어요.

w|nyanyian.text: Agus hafal nyanyian daerah yang diajarkan guru seni budaya.
w|nyanyian.en: Agus has memorized the regional song taught by the arts teacher.
w|nyanyian.ko: 아구스는 예술 선생님이 가르쳐 준 지방 노래를 외웠어요.

w|nyanyian.text: Dari kolam anak terdengar nyanyian riang sekelompok anak TK.
w|nyanyian.en: From the kids' pool came the cheerful singing of a group of kindergartners.
w|nyanyian.ko: 어린이 풀에서 유치원생들의 신나는 노랫소리가 들려왔어요.

w|nyaris.text: Nyaris saja mobil itu menabrak pohon.
w|nyaris.en: That car almost hit a tree.
w|nyaris.ko: 그 차가 하마터면 나무를 칠 뻔했어.

w|nyaris.text: Dia nyaris terlambat ke rapat pagi.
w|nyaris.en: He almost arrived late to the morning meeting.
w|nyaris.ko: 그는 아침 회의에 하마터면 늦을 뻔했어.

w|nyawa.en: Life is more precious than money.

w|nyenyak.text: Bayi tidur nyenyak di samping ibunya.
w|nyenyak.en: The baby slept soundly beside his mother.

w|nyenyak.text: Setelah olahraga dia tidur lebih nyenyak.
w|nyenyak.en: After exercise he slept more soundly.
w|nyenyak.ko: 운동 뒤에 그는 더 깊이 잤어.

w|nyeri.text: Rudi memberi obat pereda nyeri kepada kuda yang kakinya bengkak.
w|nyeri.en: Rudi gave pain relief to the horse with a swollen leg.
w|nyeri.ko: 루디는 다리가 부은 말에게 진통제를 줬어요.

w|nyeri.text: Rina merasakan nyeri di lutut setelah mendaki jalan setapak yang curam.
w|nyeri.en: Rina felt pain in her knee after climbing the steep footpath.
w|nyeri.ko: 리나는 가파른 오솔길을 오른 뒤 무릎에 통증을 느꼈어요.

w|nyonya.en: Please call the lady of the house.

w|obat-obatan.text: Lemari di ruang belakang penuh dengan obat-obatan untuk hewan.
w|obat-obatan.en: The cabinet in the back room is full of medicines for animals.

w|obat-obatan.text: Rak di gudang lab berisi obat-obatan yang sudah kedaluwarsa.
w|obat-obatan.en: The shelf in the lab storeroom holds medicines that have expired.
w|obat-obatan.ko: 실험실 창고 선반에는 유통기한이 지난 약들이 있어요.

w|objek.text: Dalam pelajaran fisika, Andi mengamati objek kecil lewat mikroskop.
w|objek.en: In physics class, Andi observed a tiny object through a microscope.
w|objek.ko: 안디는 물리 시간에 현미경으로 작은 물체를 관찰했어요.

w|objek.text: Dokter menemukan objek logam kecil di perut anak itu lewat rontgen.
w|objek.en: The doctor found a small metal object in the child's stomach on the X-ray.
w|objek.ko: 의사는 엑스레이로 그 아이 배 속에서 작은 금속 물체를 찾았어요.

w|obligasi.text: Fajar menulis tentang harga obligasi negara yang naik minggu ini.
w|obligasi.en: Fajar wrote about government bond prices rising this week.
w|obligasi.ko: 파자르는 이번 주에 오른 국채 가격에 대해 기사를 썼어요.

w|obligasi.text: Lestari mendengarkan siniar tentang obligasi ritel sambil menyetir.
w|obligasi.en: Lestari listened to a podcast about retail bonds while driving.
w|obligasi.ko: 레스타리는 운전하면서 개인용 채권에 관한 팟캐스트를 들었어요.

w|obor.text: Saat acara tujuh belasan, warga apartemen berjalan membawa obor di halaman.
w|obor.en: During the Independence Day event, the apartment residents walked around the courtyard carrying torches.
w|obor.ko: 독립기념일 행사 때 아파트 주민들은 마당에서 횃불을 들고 걸었어요.

w|obor.text: Saat malam takbiran, anak-anak di kampung Wati berkeliling membawa obor.
w|obor.en: On the eve of Eid, the children in Wati's neighborhood went around carrying torches.
w|obor.ko: 르바란 전날 밤 와티네 동네 아이들은 횃불을 들고 돌아다녔어요.

w|obrolan.text: Saat guru masuk, obrolan Andi dan teman sebangkunya langsung terhenti.
w|obrolan.en: Andi's chat with his deskmate stopped when the teacher came in.
w|obrolan.ko: 선생님이 들어오자 안디와 짝의 수다가 뚝 멈췄어요.

w|obrolan.text: Pasien itu jadi tidak terlalu cemas berkat obrolan ringan dengan perawat.
w|obrolan.en: A light chat with the nurse made the patient less anxious.
w|obrolan.ko: 간호사와 가볍게 나눈 이야기 덕분에 환자가 덜 불안해했어요.

w|observasi.text: Mahasiswa magang melakukan observasi di dapur Eko selama sebulan.
w|observasi.en: An intern did observation in Eko's kitchen for a month.
w|observasi.ko: 실습생이 한 달 동안 에코의 주방에서 관찰 실습을 했어요.

w|observasi.text: Ayu mencatat hasil observasi cuaca setiap hari untuk tugas kuliah.
w|observasi.en: Ayu records her daily weather observations for a class assignment.
w|observasi.ko: 아유는 수업 과제로 매일 날씨 관찰 결과를 적어요.

w|obsesi.text: Andi bercerita bahwa memancing kini menjadi obsesi barunya.
w|obsesi.en: Andi says fishing has become his new obsession.
w|obsesi.ko: 안디는 낚시가 새 집착 대상이 됐다고 해요.

w|obsesi.text: Pelatih mengingatkan Siti agar target waktu tidak menjadi obsesi.
w|obsesi.en: The coach reminds Siti not to let her time goal become an obsession.
w|obsesi.ko: 코치는 시티에게 기록 목표에 집착하지 말라고 일러요.

w|ocehan.text: Rudi tidak menanggapi ocehan pria mabuk di ruang tahanan sepanjang malam.
w|ocehan.en: Rudi didn't respond to the drunk man's babbling in the holding cell all night.
w|ocehan.ko: 루디는 밤새 유치장에서 취한 남자가 떠드는 말에 대꾸하지 않았어요.

w|ocehan.text: Rina tertawa mendengar ocehan pelari di sebelahnya tentang sepatu barunya yang kekecilan.
w|ocehan.en: Rina laughed at the chatter of the runner next to her about his new shoes being too small.
w|ocehan.ko: 리나는 옆 주자가 새 운동화가 작다고 떠드는 소리에 웃었어요.

w|oksigen.text: Oksigen penting bagi semua makhluk hidup.
w|oksigen.en: Oxygen is important for all living beings.

w|oksigen.text: Pasien membutuhkan oksigen tambahan di rumah sakit.
w|oksigen.en: The patient needs extra oxygen at the hospital.

w|oktober.text: Biasanya hujan mulai sering turun di bulan Oktober.
w|oktober.en: Usually the rain starts falling often in October.
w|oktober.ko: 보통 시월이 되면 비가 자주 내리기 시작해요.

w|oktober.text: Siti mulai latihan dialog sejak bulan Oktober tahun lalu.
w|oktober.en: Siti started rehearsing her lines in October last year.
w|oktober.ko: 시티는 작년 시월부터 대사 연습을 시작했어요.

w|olahraga.text: Olahraga ringan membuat tubuh lebih sehat.
w|olahraga.en: Light exercise makes the body healthier.
w|olahraga.ko: 가벼운 운동이 몸을 더 건강하게 해.

w|oleh.en: This letter was written by Dad.
He was praised by his teacher.

w|oli.text: Sopir hotel mengganti oli mobil jemputan setiap bulan.
w|oli.en: The hotel driver changes the oil in the shuttle car every month.
w|oli.ko: 호텔 기사는 매달 픽업 차량의 엔진 오일을 갈아요.

w|oli.text: Sebelum musim hujan, Rina mengganti oli motor di bengkel dekat rumah.
w|oli.en: Before the rainy season, Rina changed her motorbike's oil at the garage near her house.
w|oli.ko: 리나는 우기 전에 집 근처 정비소에서 오토바이 오일을 갈았어요.

w|olimpiade.text: Rudi lolos ke olimpiade matematika tingkat provinsi.
w|olimpiade.en: Rudi qualified for the provincial mathematics olympiad.
w|olimpiade.ko: 루디는 주 단위 수학 올림피아드에 진출했어요.

w|olimpiade.text: Rina menemukan medali olimpiade sains milik kakaknya di gudang.
w|olimpiade.en: Rina found her brother's science olympiad medal in the storeroom.
w|olimpiade.ko: 리나는 창고에서 오빠의 과학 올림피아드 메달을 찾았어요.

w|ombak.text: Sungai itu bermuara di pantai yang ombak besarnya terdengar dari desa Agus.
w|ombak.en: The river flows out to a beach whose big waves can be heard from Agus's village.
w|ombak.ko: 그 강은 큰 파도 소리가 아구스네 마을까지 들리는 해변으로 흘러가요.

w|ombak.text: Pelanggan yang mabuk laut karena ombak tinggi datang membeli obat jahe.
w|ombak.en: A customer seasick from the high waves came to buy ginger medicine.
w|ombak.ko: 높은 파도에 뱃멀미를 한 손님이 생강 약을 사러 왔어요.

w|omongan.text: Agus tidak terlalu peduli dengan omongan teman-teman soal potongan rambutnya.
w|omongan.en: Agus doesn't care much about his friends' talk about his haircut.
w|omongan.ko: 아구스는 머리 모양을 두고 친구들이 하는 말에 별로 신경 쓰지 않아요.

w|omongan.text: Wati tidak percaya pada omongan bahwa berenang setelah makan pasti membuat kram.
w|omongan.en: Wati doesn't believe the talk that swimming after eating always causes cramps.
w|omongan.ko: 와티는 밥 먹고 수영하면 꼭 쥐가 난다는 말을 안 믿어요.

w|onar.text: Satpam mengeluarkan dua remaja yang membuat onar di ruang pameran.
w|onar.en: The guard removed two teenagers who were causing trouble in the exhibition room.
w|onar.ko: 경비원은 전시실에서 소란을 피운 십 대 두 명을 내보냈어요.

w|onar.text: Polisi membubarkan sekelompok pemuda yang membuat onar di dekat lokasi syuting.
w|onar.en: The police broke up a group of young men causing a disturbance near the film set.
w|onar.ko: 경찰이 촬영장 근처에서 소란을 피운 젊은이 무리를 해산시켰어요.

w|ongkos.text: Agus kaget karena ongkos kirim lemari tua itu lebih mahal dari harganya.
w|ongkos.en: Agus was shocked that the shipping cost for the old cupboard was more than its price.
w|ongkos.ko: 아구스는 낡은 장롱 배송비가 물건값보다 비싸서 깜짝 놀랐어요.

w|ongkos.text: Wati mengeluh karena ongkos angkot naik setiap musim banjir.
w|ongkos.en: Wati complains because minibus fares go up every flood season.
w|ongkos.ko: 와티는 홍수철마다 미니버스 요금이 올라서 불평해요.

w|online.text: Kelas hari ini diadakan secara online.
Dia belanja online hampir setiap minggu.
w|online.en: She shops online almost every week.

w|operasional.text: Fajar menyusun laporan biaya operasional kantor untuk rapat besok.
w|operasional.en: Fajar is putting together a report on the office's operating costs for tomorrow's meeting.
w|operasional.ko: 파자르는 내일 회의에 낼 사무실 운영비 보고서를 정리하고 있어요.

w|operasional.text: Lestari harus memangkas biaya operasional supaya perusahaan bisa bertahan setahun lagi.
w|operasional.en: Lestari has to cut operating costs so the company can survive another year.
w|operasional.ko: 레스타리는 회사가 일 년 더 버티도록 운영비를 줄여야 해요.

w|operator.text: Ayah Andi bekerja sebagai operator alat berat di proyek jalan tol.
w|operator.en: Andi's father works as a heavy equipment operator on a toll road project.
w|operator.ko: 안디의 아버지는 고속도로 공사 현장에서 중장비 기사로 일해요.

w|operator.text: Panggilan itu disambungkan oleh operator telepon rumah sakit ke bagian darurat.
w|operator.en: The hospital switchboard operator put the call through to emergency.

w|opini.text: Fajar membaca opini warga di kolom surat pembaca setiap pagi.
w|opini.en: Fajar reads residents' opinions in the letters column every morning.
w|opini.ko: 파자르는 매일 아침 독자 투고란에 실린 주민 의견을 읽어요.

w|opini.text: Lestari meminta opini sahabatnya tentang rencananya kuliah lagi.
w|opini.en: Lestari asked her friend's opinion about her plan to go back to university.
w|opini.ko: 레스타리는 다시 대학에 가려는 계획에 대해 친구의 의견을 물었어요.

w|oposisi.text: Dalam drama politik itu, Eko memerankan tokoh oposisi yang selalu membantah perdana menteri.
w|oposisi.en: In the political drama, Eko plays an opposition figure who always argues against the prime minister.
w|oposisi.ko: 그 정치극에서 에코는 늘 총리에게 반박하는 야당 인물을 연기해요.

w|oposisi.text: Dua penumpang berdebat seru tentang partai oposisi yang baru menang pemilu.
w|oposisi.en: Two passengers argued heatedly about the opposition party that had just won the election.
w|oposisi.ko: 두 승객이 막 선거에서 이긴 야당을 두고 열띤 논쟁을 벌였어요.

w|opsi.text: Bayu hanya punya dua opsi: menyeberang sungai atau berjalan memutar.
w|opsi.en: Bayu had only two options: cross the river or walk the long way around.
w|opsi.ko: 바유에게는 선택지가 두 개뿐이었어요. 강을 건너거나 빙 돌아가거나요.

w|opsi.text: Intan memilih opsi setengah maraton karena cederanya belum pulih.
w|opsi.en: Intan chose the half-marathon option because her injury hadn't healed yet.
w|opsi.ko: 인탄은 부상이 아직 다 낫지 않아서 하프 마라톤을 선택했어요.

w|optimis.text: Ibu tetap optimis bahwa Rudi dan kakaknya akan berbaikan sebelum lebaran.
w|optimis.en: Mom stays optimistic that Rudi and his sister will make up before Eid.
w|optimis.ko: 엄마는 루디와 누나가 명절 전에 화해할 거라고 낙관해요.

w|optimis.text: Para nelayan tetap optimis meski ombak sedang tinggi.
w|optimis.en: The fishermen stay optimistic even though the waves are high.

w|orang.en: There are a lot of people here.

w|orangtua.en: My parents live in the village.

w|orangtua.text: Anak itu sangat dekat dengan orangtua.
w|orangtua.en: That child is very close to their parents.

w|oranye.text: Langit berubah oranye ketika Eko menutup pos jaganya sore itu.
w|oranye.en: The sky turned orange as Eko closed his lifeguard post that evening.
w|oranye.ko: 그날 저녁 에코가 감시 초소를 닫을 때 하늘이 주황빛으로 물들었어요.

w|oranye.text: Sikat gigi baru yang diberikan perawat kepada Ayu berwarna oranye.
w|oranye.en: The new toothbrush the nurse gave Ayu was orange.
w|oranye.ko: 간호사가 아유에게 준 새 칫솔은 주황색이었어요.

w|organ.text: Dokter gigi bilang infeksi gusi bisa memengaruhi organ lain seperti jantung.
w|organ.en: The dentist said a gum infection can affect other organs like the heart.
w|organ.ko: 치과 의사는 잇몸 염증이 심장 같은 다른 장기에도 영향을 줄 수 있다고 했어요.

w|organ.text: Di ruang tamu ada organ tua peninggalan nenek yang tidak bisa berbunyi lagi.
w|organ.en: In the living room there's an old organ left by grandmother that no longer plays.
w|organ.ko: 거실에는 할머니가 남긴, 이제 소리가 안 나는 낡은 오르간이 있어요.

w|organik.text: Sayuran untuk kelas ini dipasok dari kebun organik di pinggir kota.
w|organik.en: The vegetables for this class are supplied by an organic farm on the edge of town.
w|organik.ko: 이 수업 채소는 도시 외곽의 유기농 농장에서 들어와요.

w|organik.text: Rani sekarang bekerja di pertanian organik dan mengirim foto sawahnya kepada Dewi.
w|organik.en: Rani now works on an organic farm and sent Dewi photos of her rice fields.
w|organik.ko: 라니는 지금 유기농 농장에서 일하고 데위에게 논 사진을 보냈어요.

w|organisme.text: Eko menunjukkan organisme kecil yang hidup di genangan air dekat tenda.
w|organisme.en: Eko pointed out tiny organisms living in a puddle near the tent.
w|organisme.ko: 에코는 텐트 옆 물웅덩이에 사는 작은 생물들을 보여 줬어요.

w|organisme.text: Pelatih Ayu bilang tubuh manusia adalah organisme yang bisa beradaptasi dengan latihan keras.
w|organisme.en: Ayu's coach said the human body is an organism that can adapt to hard training.
w|organisme.ko: 아유의 코치는 사람 몸이 힘든 훈련에 적응할 수 있는 유기체라고 했어요.

w|orkestra.text: Sekolah Budi mengundang orkestra kota untuk konser di aula.
w|orkestra.en: Budi's school invited the city orchestra to give a concert in the hall.
w|orkestra.ko: 부디네 학교는 강당 공연에 시립 오케스트라를 초청했어요.

w|orkestra.text: Siti satu penerbangan dengan anggota orkestra yang membawa biola.
w|orkestra.en: Siti was on the same flight as orchestra members carrying violins.
w|orkestra.ko: 시티는 바이올린을 든 오케스트라 단원들과 같은 비행기를 탔어요.

w|otak.en: The human brain is very complex.

w|otomatis.text: Sistem menyimpan data secara otomatis setiap malam.
w|otomatis.en: The system saves data automatically every night.
w|otomatis.ko: 시스템이 매일 밤 데이터를 자동으로 저장해.

w|otopsi.text: Di ruang ganti, dua anggota gym membahas film detektif tentang hasil otopsi yang dipalsukan.
w|otopsi.en: In the locker room, two gym members discuss a detective film about a faked autopsy result.
w|otopsi.ko: 탈의실에서 헬스장 회원 둘이 조작된 부검 결과를 다룬 탐정 영화 이야기를 해요.

w|otopsi.text: Sambil makan, paman Intan menceritakan novel misteri tentang dokter yang melakukan otopsi.
w|otopsi.en: While eating, Intan's uncle describes a mystery novel about a doctor who performs an autopsy.
w|otopsi.ko: 인탄의 삼촌은 밥을 먹으며 부검하는 의사가 나오는 추리 소설 이야기를 해요.

w|otorisasi.text: Rudi butuh otorisasi manajer sebelum memesan bahan dalam jumlah besar.
w|otorisasi.en: Rudi needs the manager's authorization before ordering ingredients in bulk.
w|otorisasi.ko: 루디는 재료를 대량으로 주문하기 전에 매니저의 승인이 필요해요.

w|otorisasi.text: Rina harus mendapat otorisasi pengelola pasar untuk memperluas lapak.
w|otorisasi.en: Rina has to get the market management's authorization to expand her stall.
w|otorisasi.ko: 리나는 노점을 넓히려면 시장 관리소의 허가를 받아야 해요.

w|otoritas.text: Sekolah Andi harus mendapat izin dari otoritas pendidikan sebelum membuka kelas baru.
w|otoritas.en: Andi's school must get permission from the education authority before opening a new class.
w|otoritas.ko: 안디의 학교는 새 반을 열기 전에 교육 당국의 허가를 받아야 해요.

w|otoritas.text: Karena otoritas kota melarang pesta kembang api di dekat bandara, Dewi memilih taman lain.
w|otoritas.en: Because the city authority banned fireworks near the airport, Dewi chose a different park.
w|otoritas.ko: 시 당국이 공항 근처 불꽃놀이를 금지해서 데위는 다른 공원을 골랐어요.

w|otot.text: Otot kakinya sakit setelah berlari jauh.
w|otot.en: His leg muscles hurt after running far.
w|otot.ko: 멀리 뛴 뒤 다리 근육이 아팠어.

w|overdosis.text: Rudi menjelaskan cara mencegah overdosis obat cacing pada anak anjing.
w|overdosis.en: Rudi explained how to prevent an overdose of deworming medicine in puppies.
w|overdosis.ko: 루디는 강아지 구충제 과다 복용을 막는 방법을 설명했어요.

w|overdosis.text: Penyuluh kesehatan mengingatkan warga desa Rina tentang bahaya overdosis obat warung.
w|overdosis.en: The health educator reminded Rina's villagers about the danger of overdosing on over-the-counter drugs.
w|overdosis.ko: 보건 교육 담당자는 리나네 마을 사람들에게 가게 약 과다 복용의 위험을 일깨웠어요.

w|pabrik.en: He works at a textile factory.

w|pacaran.text: Mereka sudah pacaran selama dua tahun.
w|pacaran.en: They have been dating for two years.

w|pacaran.ko: 몰래 연애하는 게 그를 스트레스받게 했어.

w|pacuan.text: Minggu ini Bayu meliput pacuan kuda tradisional di dataran tinggi.
w|pacuan.en: This week Bayu is covering a traditional horse race in the highlands.
w|pacuan.ko: 이번 주 바유는 고원에서 열리는 전통 경마를 취재해요.

w|pacuan.text: Adik Intan memesan mainan kuda dan lintasan pacuan mini lewat aplikasi.
w|pacuan.en: Intan's younger sibling ordered a toy horse and a mini racetrack through the app.
w|pacuan.ko: 인탄의 동생은 앱으로 장난감 말과 작은 경주로를 주문했어요.

w|padahal.text: Dia bilang sibuk, padahal sedang istirahat.
w|padahal.en: He said he was busy, even though he was resting.

w|padahal.text: Padahal hujan deras, mereka tetap berangkat.
w|padahal.en: Even though it poured, they still left.

w|padam.text: Listrik di sekolah Agus padam saat ujian berlangsung.
w|padam.en: The electricity at Agus's school went out during the exam.

w|padam.text: Lampu kolam renang tiba-tiba padam ketika Wati masih di dalam air.
w|padam.en: The pool lights suddenly went out while Wati was still in the water.
w|padam.ko: 와티가 아직 물속에 있을 때 수영장 불이 갑자기 꺼졌어요.

w|padang.en: The green field of grass stretched wide.

w|padang.text: Kuda berlari bebas di padang terbuka.
w|padang.en: Horses ran freely in the open field.

w|padat.text: Jadwal Bayu minggu ini sangat padat karena ada tiga pertunjukan.
w|padat.en: Bayu's schedule this week is very packed because there are three shows.
w|padat.ko: 이번 주에 공연이 세 번이나 있어서 바유의 일정이 아주 빡빡해요.

w|padat.text: Jalan menuju kantor Intan selalu padat pada jam berangkat kerja.
w|padat.en: The road to Intan's office is always congested at rush hour.
w|padat.ko: 인탄 회사로 가는 길은 출근 시간마다 늘 막혀요.

w|paduan.text: Andi ikut paduan suara sekolah karena suaranya cukup bagus.
w|paduan.en: Andi joined the school choir because his voice is pretty good.
w|paduan.ko: 안디는 목소리가 꽤 좋아서 학교 합창단에 들어갔어요.

w|paduan.text: Dewi menyukai paduan warna emas dan merah untuk hiasan meja.
w|paduan.en: Dewi likes the combination of gold and red for the table decorations.
w|paduan.ko: 데위는 식탁 장식에 금색과 빨간색 조합을 좋아해요.

w|pagar.text: Pagar kayu itu baru dicat putih.
w|pagar.en: That wooden fence was newly painted white.
w|pagar.ko: 그 나무 울타리가 새로 하얗게 칠해졌어.

w|pagar.en: The dog jumped over the fence behind the house.

w|pagi.en: This morning the air is cool.

w|paha.text: Pelatih menyuruh Bayu melatih otot paha dengan squat.
w|paha.en: The trainer told Bayu to train his thigh muscles with squats.
w|paha.ko: 트레이너는 바유에게 스쿼트로 허벅지 근육을 단련하라고 했어요.

w|paha.text: Anak Intan memilih ayam goreng bagian paha karena dagingnya empuk.
w|paha.en: Intan's child picks the fried chicken thigh because the meat is tender.
w|paha.ko: 인탄의 아이는 살이 연해서 닭다리 튀김을 골라요.

w|paham.en: Do you get what I mean?

w|pahit.text: Andi kaget karena saus buatannya terasa pahit akibat bawang putihnya gosong.
w|pahit.en: Andi was surprised that his sauce tasted bitter because the garlic had burned.
w|pahit.ko: 안디는 마늘이 타서 소스가 쓴맛이 나 깜짝 놀랐어요.

w|pahit.text: Dewi mengaku kopi tanpa gula masih terlalu pahit baginya.
w|pahit.en: Dewi admitted that coffee without sugar is still too bitter for her.
w|pahit.ko: 데위는 설탕 없는 커피가 아직 너무 쓰다고 털어놨어요.

w|pai.text: Kulit pai buatan Andi retak karena adonannya terlalu kering.
w|pai.en: The crust of Andi's pie cracked because the dough was too dry.
w|pai.ko: 반죽이 너무 말라서 안디가 만든 파이 껍질이 갈라졌어요.

w|pai.text: Dewi bercerita tentang pai apel pertama yang ia buat untuk ulang tahun ibunya.
w|pai.en: Dewi wrote about the first apple pie she made for her mother's birthday.
w|pai.ko: 데위는 어머니 생신에 처음 만든 사과 파이 얘기를 썼어요.

w|pajak.text: Dia membayar pajak sebelum batas waktu.
w|pajak.en: He paid the tax before the deadline.
The annual tax must be paid soon.

w|pakar.text: Kantor Fajar mengundang seorang pakar pajak untuk menjelaskan aturan baru.
w|pakar.en: Fajar's office invited a tax expert to explain the new regulations.
w|pakar.ko: 파자르의 회사는 새 규정을 설명하려고 세무 전문가를 초청했어요.

w|pakar.text: Lestari meminta saran dari pakar keamanan siber sebelum aplikasinya dirilis.
w|pakar.en: Lestari asked a cybersecurity expert for advice before her app was released.
w|pakar.ko: 레스타리는 앱을 내놓기 전에 사이버 보안 전문가에게 조언을 구했어요.

w|paket.text: Paket itu sampai di rumah pagi ini.
w|paket.en: That package arrived at home this morning.
w|paket.ko: 그 소포가 오늘 아침 집에 도착했어.

w|paket.text: Aku menunggu paket dari toko online.
w|paket.en: I'm waiting for a package from the online store.
w|paket.ko: 온라인 가게에서 온 소포를 기다리고 있어.

w|paksa.text: Jangan paksa anak jika dia takut.
w|paksa.en: Don't force the child if he is scared.

w|paksaan.text: Eko ikut drama ini atas kemauannya sendiri, bukan karena paksaan orang tua.
w|paksaan.en: Eko joined this play of his own free will, not because his parents forced him.
w|paksaan.ko: 에코는 부모님의 강요가 아니라 스스로 원해서 이 연극에 참여했어요.

w|paksaan.text: Ayu memilih naik kereta tanpa paksaan siapa pun, karena ia memang suka perjalanan panjang.
w|paksaan.en: Ayu chose to take the train without anyone forcing her, because she really likes long journeys.
w|paksaan.ko: 아유는 누가 시켜서가 아니라 긴 여행을 좋아해서 기차를 골랐어요.

w|paku.text: Andi mencabut paku berkarat dari papan pintu yang lapuk.
w|paku.en: Andi pulled rusty nails out of the rotten door board.
w|paku.ko: 안디는 썩은 문짝에서 녹슨 못을 뽑았어요.

w|paku.text: Rok Dewi tersangkut paku kecil yang mencuat dari kursi kayu di stasiun.
w|paku.en: Dewi's skirt caught on a small nail sticking out of a wooden bench at the station.
w|paku.ko: 데위의 치마가 역 나무 의자에 튀어나온 작은 못에 걸렸어요.

w|palang.text: Rudi menggantung panci-panci di palang besi di atas kompor.
w|palang.en: Rudi hangs the pots on the iron bar above the stove.
w|palang.ko: 루디는 냄비들을 화구 위 쇠막대에 걸어 둬요.

w|palang.text: Rina menggantung baju-baju bekas di palang kayu di depan lapak.
w|palang.en: Rina hangs secondhand clothes on a wooden rail in front of her stall.
w|palang.ko: 리나는 노점 앞 나무 봉에 헌 옷들을 걸어요.

w|palu.text: Eko meminjam palu dari nelayan untuk memperbaiki pintu pondok.
w|palu.en: Eko borrowed a hammer from a fisherman to fix the hut door.
w|palu.ko: 에코는 오두막 문을 고치려고 어부에게 망치를 빌렸어요.

w|palu.text: Suara palu dari rumah sebelah membangunkan Ayu pagi-pagi.
w|palu.en: The sound of a hammer from next door woke Ayu up early in the morning.
w|palu.ko: 옆집에서 들리는 망치 소리에 아유는 아침 일찍 깼어요.

w|paman.en: I'm staying at my uncle's house.

w|pamer.text: Sepupu Agus suka pamer ikan besar hasil pancingannya di media sosial.
w|pamer.en: Agus's cousin likes to show off the big fish he catches on social media.
w|pamer.ko: 아구스의 사촌은 낚은 큰 물고기를 SNS에 자랑하는 걸 좋아해요.

w|pamer.text: Wati tidak suka pelanggan yang pamer tahu semua obat dari internet.
w|pamer.en: Wati doesn't like customers who show off knowing every medicine from the internet.
w|pamer.ko: 와티는 인터넷에서 본 걸로 약을 다 아는 척 뽐내는 손님이 싫어요.

w|pameran.text: Sekolah mengadakan pameran karya siswa di aula.
w|pameran.en: The school held an exhibition of student work in the hall.
w|pameran.ko: 학교가 강당에서 학생 작품 전시회를 열었어요.

w|pameran.text: Panitia memasang pameran foto masa sekolah di sepanjang koridor.
w|pameran.en: The committee set up an exhibition of school-day photos along the corridor.
w|pameran.ko: 준비위원회는 복도를 따라 학창 시절 사진 전시를 꾸몄어요.

w|pamit.text: Sebelum berangkat ke kota, Budi pamit kepada para tetangga.
w|pamit.en: Before leaving for the city, Budi said goodbye to the neighbors.
w|pamit.ko: 도시로 떠나기 전에 부디는 이웃들에게 작별 인사를 했어요.

w|pamit.text: Pelayan muda itu pamit pulang lebih awal kepada Siti karena ibunya sakit.
w|pamit.en: The young waiter asked Siti's leave to go home early because his mother was ill.
w|pamit.ko: 젊은 종업원은 어머니가 아파서 시티에게 일찍 들어가겠다고 인사했어요.

w|pamrih.text: Para relawan museum bekerja tanpa pamrih setiap akhir pekan.
w|pamrih.en: The museum volunteers work selflessly every weekend.
w|pamrih.ko: 박물관 자원봉사자들은 주말마다 대가 없이 일해요.

w|pamrih.text: Putri bermain di film kecil itu tanpa pamrih karena ceritanya bagus.
w|pamrih.en: Putri acted in that small film without expecting anything in return because the story was good.
w|pamrih.ko: 푸트리는 이야기가 좋아서 그 작은 영화에 대가를 바라지 않고 출연했어요.

w|panah.en: The arrow shot toward the target.

w|panah.text: Dia menarik tali busur dan melepaskan panah.
w|panah.en: He drew the bowstring and released an arrow.

w|panas.en: The weather is so hot today.

w|pancaran.text: Budi menikmati pancaran matahari pagi di atas pematang.
w|pancaran.en: Budi enjoyed the glow of the morning sun on the paddy dike.
w|pancaran.ko: 부디는 논두렁 위에서 아침 햇살을 즐겼어요.

w|pancaran.text: Siti menghindari pancaran uap panas dari panci presto.
w|pancaran.en: Siti avoided the jet of hot steam from the pressure cooker.
w|pancaran.ko: 시티는 압력솥에서 뿜어 나오는 뜨거운 김을 피했어요.

w|panci.text: Agus menawar panci tembaga yang masih mengkilap.
w|panci.en: Agus haggled over a copper pot that was still shiny.
w|panci.ko: 아구스는 아직 반짝이는 구리 냄비 값을 흥정했어요.

w|panci.text: Wati merebus sup jagung dalam panci besar ketika udara mulai dingin.
w|panci.en: Wati boils corn soup in a big pot when the air starts to get cold.
w|panci.ko: 날이 쌀쌀해지기 시작하면 와티는 큰 냄비에 옥수수 수프를 끓여요.

w|pandai.text: Pandai sekali dia menjawab pertanyaan sulit.
w|pandai.en: She is so clever at answering hard questions.
w|pandai.ko: 어려운 질문에 답하는 게 정말 능숙해.

w|pandai.en: That child is good at playing the piano.

w|pandang.text: Dari sini pandang ke laut sangat indah.
w|pandang.en: From here the view of the sea is very beautiful.

w|pandang.text: Pandang pertamanya terhadap proyek itu negatif.
w|pandang.en: His first view of that project was negative.

w|pandangan.text: Kami berbeda pandangan soal isu itu.
w|pandangan.en: We have different views on that issue.
w|pandangan.ko: 우리는 그 문제에 대해 견해가 달라.

w|panduan.text: Setiap murid baru menerima buku panduan berisi peraturan sekolah.
w|panduan.en: Every new student receives a handbook containing the school rules.
w|panduan.ko: 신입생은 모두 학교 규칙이 담긴 안내 책자를 받아요.

w|panduan.text: Rina membaca buku panduan merakit lemari dari toko mebel.
w|panduan.en: Rina read the wardrobe assembly guide from the furniture store.
w|panduan.ko: 리나는 가구점에서 받은 옷장 조립 설명서를 읽었어요.

w|panen.text: Setelah panen, keluarga Agus mengadakan syukuran di tepi hutan.
w|panen.en: After the harvest, Agus's family held a thanksgiving meal at the edge of the forest.
w|panen.ko: 추수가 끝나고 아구스네 가족은 숲 가장자리에서 감사 잔치를 열었어요.

w|panen.text: Saat musim panen, banyak petani datang membeli salep untuk tangan yang lecet.
w|panen.en: During harvest season, many farmers come to buy ointment for chafed hands.
w|panen.ko: 추수철이면 손이 까진 농부들이 연고를 사러 많이 와요.

w|panggang.text: Ibu membuat ayam panggang untuk makan malam.
w|panggang.en: Mom made roast chicken for dinner.
Toast the bread until it turns brown.

w|panggung.text: Penyanyi naik ke panggung dengan tenang.
w|panggung.en: The singer stepped onto the stage calmly.
That stage is decorated with beautiful lights.
w|panggung.ko: 그 무대는 예쁜 조명으로 꾸며져 있어.

w|pangkalan.en: That military base is tightly guarded.
w|pangkalan.ko: 그 군사 기지는 厳重히 경비돼.

w|pangkalan.text: Kapal kembali ke pangkalan setelah misi.
w|pangkalan.en: The ship returned to base after the mission.

w|pangkat.text: Di dapur itu, pangkat Fajar masih juru masak junior.
w|pangkat.en: In that kitchen, Fajar's rank is still junior cook.
w|pangkat.ko: 그 주방에서 파자르의 직급은 아직 막내 요리사예요.

w|pangkat.text: Lencana pangkat tentara zaman dulu dijual bersama seragamnya di ujung pasar.
w|pangkat.en: Old army rank badges are sold along with uniforms at the end of the market.
w|pangkat.ko: 시장 끝에서는 옛 군대 계급장이 군복과 함께 팔려요.

w|pangkuan.text: Kucing kecil itu tertidur di pangkuan Rudi setelah diberi suntikan.
w|pangkuan.en: The little cat fell asleep on Rudi's lap after getting its shot.
w|pangkuan.ko: 작은 고양이는 주사를 맞고 루디의 무릎에서 잠들었어요.

w|pangkuan.text: Adik Rina tertidur di pangkuan nenek sambil mendengar dongeng.
w|pangkuan.en: Rina's little sister fell asleep on her grandmother's lap listening to a story.
w|pangkuan.ko: 리나의 동생은 옛날이야기를 듣다가 할머니 무릎에서 잠들었어요.

w|panglima.text: Untuk tugas sejarah, Dimas menulis biografi seorang panglima perang kemerdekaan.
w|panglima.en: For a history assignment, Dimas wrote a biography of a commander in the war of independence.
w|panglima.ko: 역사 과제로 디마스는 독립 전쟁 사령관의 전기를 썼어요.

w|panglima.text: Kakek Putri adalah juru masak pribadi seorang panglima tentara pada masa muda.
w|panglima.en: In his youth, Putri's grandfather was the personal cook of an army commander.
w|panglima.ko: 푸트리의 할아버지는 젊었을 때 한 군 사령관의 전속 요리사였어요.

w|panik.en: Don't panic when an earthquake hits.

w|panitia.text: Andi mengonfirmasi jadwal konferensi pers kepada panitia.
w|panitia.en: Andi confirmed the press conference schedule with the organizing committee.
w|panitia.ko: 안디는 기자회견 일정을 주최 측에 확인했어요.

w|panitia.text: Dewi dulu panitia arisan di kompleks lama, jadi acara pamitan berlangsung ramai.
w|panitia.en: Dewi used to organize the savings group in the old complex, so her farewell was lively.
w|panitia.ko: 데위는 옛 단지에서 계모임 총무였던 터라 작별 모임이 북적였어요.

w|pantai.en: We're going to the beach tomorrow.

w|pantang.text: Bagi Fajar, menerima uang pelicin adalah hal yang pantang.
w|pantang.en: For Fajar, accepting a bribe is strictly off-limits.
w|pantang.ko: 파자르에게 뒷돈을 받는 것은 절대 안 되는 일이에요.

w|pantang.text: Lestari pantang tidur sebelum semua piring kotor dicuci.
w|pantang.en: Lestari never goes to bed before all the dirty dishes are washed.
w|pantang.ko: 레스타리는 설거지를 다 끝내기 전에는 절대 자지 않아요.

w|pantas.en: She deserves to get a gift.

w|panti.text: Mereka menyumbang ke panti asuhan setempat.
w|panti.en: They donated to the local orphanage.

w|panti.text: Panti lansia itu butuh lebih banyak relawan.
w|panti.en: That nursing home needs more volunteers.

w|pantulan.text: Bayu memotret pantulan pepohonan di permukaan sungai yang tenang.
w|pantulan.en: Bayu photographed the reflection of the trees on the calm river surface.
w|pantulan.ko: 바유는 잔잔한 강물에 비친 나무들의 그림자를 사진으로 찍었어요.

w|pantulan.text: Intan melihat pantulan dirinya di kaca toko dan memperbaiki postur.
w|pantulan.en: Intan saw her reflection in a shop window and fixed her posture.
w|pantulan.ko: 인탄은 가게 유리에 비친 자기 모습을 보고 자세를 고쳤어요.

w|papa.text: Papa pulang kerja lebih awal hari ini.
w|papa.en: Dad came home from work earlier today.
w|papa.ko: 아빠가 오늘 일을 일찍 마치고 왔어.

w|papa.text: Aku menelepon papa untuk minta saran.
w|papa.en: I called dad to ask for advice.

w|papan.en: The teacher writes notes on the board.

w|papan.text: Papan itu sudah retak di tengah.
w|papan.en: That board is already cracked in the middle.

w|parah.en: His condition is getting worse today.
The damage after the storm was so severe.

w|paralel.text: Fajar menyusun rak dengan dua lorong paralel supaya pembeli tidak berdesakan.
w|paralel.en: Fajar arranged the shelves in two parallel aisles so customers wouldn't crowd together.
w|paralel.ko: 파자르는 손님들이 붐비지 않게 선반을 평행한 통로 두 줄로 배치했어요.

w|paralel.text: Lestari dan rekan baru mengerjakan dua proyek paralel.
w|paralel.en: Lestari and the new coworker are working on two parallel projects.
w|paralel.ko: 레스타리와 새 동료는 두 프로젝트를 동시에 진행하고 있어요.

w|paramedis.text: Rudi dibantu seorang paramedis veteriner yang sudah berpengalaman.
w|paramedis.en: Rudi is assisted by an experienced veterinary paramedic.
w|paramedis.ko: 루디는 경험 많은 수의 보조원의 도움을 받아요.

w|paramedis.text: Rina bercita-cita menjadi paramedis supaya bisa menolong warga desanya.
w|paramedis.en: Rina dreams of becoming a paramedic so she can help her villagers.
w|paramedis.ko: 리나는 마을 사람들을 도울 수 있게 응급구조사가 되고 싶어요.

w|parasit.text: Agus melihat tanaman parasit menempel di batang pohon tua.
w|parasit.en: Agus saw a parasitic plant clinging to the trunk of an old tree.
w|parasit.ko: 아구스는 고목 줄기에 붙어 있는 기생 식물을 봤어요.

w|parasit.text: Wati memberikan obat cacing untuk anak yang terkena parasit usus.
w|parasit.en: Wati gave deworming medicine for a child with an intestinal parasite.
w|parasit.ko: 와티는 장 기생충에 걸린 아이에게 구충제를 줬어요.

w|parasut.text: Dari jendela kereta, Dimas melihat orang terjun dengan parasut di atas pantai.
w|parasut.en: From the train window, Dimas saw people skydiving with parachutes over the beach.
w|parasut.ko: 기차 창밖으로 디마스는 해변 위에서 낙하산을 타고 내려오는 사람들을 봤어요.

w|parasut.text: Dalam presentasi, Putri menyebut cadangan data sebagai parasut kalau server tiba-tiba rusak.
w|parasut.en: In the presentation, Putri called data backups a parachute in case the server suddenly breaks.
w|parasut.ko: 발표에서 푸트리는 데이터 백업을 서버가 갑자기 고장 날 때의 낙하산이라고 불렀어요.

w|parfum.text: Bayu menemukan botol parfum antik berbentuk burung di sebuah lapak.
w|parfum.en: Bayu found an antique bird-shaped perfume bottle at one of the stalls.
w|parfum.ko: 바유는 한 노점에서 새 모양의 골동품 향수병을 찾았어요.

w|parfum.text: Aroma parfum melati Intan tercium sampai ke ujung ruangan.
w|parfum.en: The scent of Intan's jasmine perfume could be smelled all the way to the end of the room.
w|parfum.ko: 인탄의 재스민 향수 냄새가 방 끝까지 퍼졌어요.

w|parit.text: Air hujan semalam mengalir deras di parit sekitar tenda Rudi.
w|parit.en: Last night's rainwater rushed through the ditch around Rudi's tent.
w|parit.ko: 어젯밤 빗물이 루디의 텐트 주위 도랑으로 세차게 흘렀어요.

w|parit.text: Hujan deras membuat parit di sekitar lapangan konser meluap.
w|parit.en: Heavy rain made the ditch around the concert field overflow.
w|parit.ko: 폭우 때문에 공연장 주변 도랑이 넘쳤어요.

w|parkir.text: Parkir di sini hanya untuk pelanggan.
w|parkir.en: Parking here is only for customers.

w|parkir.text: Sulit mencari tempat parkir sore ini.
w|parkir.en: It is hard to find a parking spot this afternoon.
w|parkir.ko: 오늘 오후에는 주차 자리를 찾기 힘들어.

w|parkiran.text: Rudi membantu seorang tamu mencari mobil di parkiran bawah tanah.
w|parkiran.en: Rudi helped a guest find his car in the underground parking lot.
w|parkiran.ko: 루디는 지하 주차장에서 손님이 차를 찾는 걸 도와줬어요.

w|parkiran.text: Air hujan menggenang di parkiran kantor Rina sampai setinggi mata kaki.
w|parkiran.en: Rainwater pooled ankle-deep in the parking lot at Rina's office.
w|parkiran.ko: 리나 회사 주차장에 빗물이 발목까지 찼어요.

w|parlemen.text: Bayu harus menunggu di gedung parlemen sampai sidang selesai malam hari.
w|parlemen.en: Bayu had to wait in the parliament building until the session ended at night.
w|parlemen.ko: 바유는 회의가 밤에 끝날 때까지 국회 건물에서 기다려야 했어요.

w|parlemen.text: Intan diundang ke parlemen untuk berbicara tentang perlindungan data pribadi.
w|parlemen.en: Intan was invited to parliament to talk about personal data protection.
w|parlemen.ko: 인탄은 개인 정보 보호에 관해 발표하러 국회에 초대받았어요.

w|partai.en: That party won the local election.

w|partikel.text: Sinar matahari pagi membuat partikel debu di hutan terlihat berkilau.
w|partikel.en: The morning sunlight makes the dust particles in the forest glitter.
w|partikel.ko: 아침 햇살에 숲속 먼지 알갱이가 반짝여 보여요.

w|partikel.text: Wati menyarankan masker untuk melindungi diri dari partikel asap kebakaran hutan.
w|partikel.en: Wati recommends masks to protect against smoke particles from forest fires.
w|partikel.ko: 와티는 산불 연기 입자를 막으려면 마스크를 쓰라고 권해요.

w|partner.text: Rudi sudah sepuluh tahun bekerja bersama partner yang sama di lapangan.
w|partner.en: Rudi has worked with the same partner on site for ten years.
w|partner.ko: 루디는 현장에서 같은 동료와 십 년째 함께 일해요.

w|partner.text: Manajer memperkenalkan Rina kepada partner bisnis dari Singapura.
w|partner.en: The manager introduced Rina to a business partner from Singapore.
w|partner.ko: 매니저가 싱가포르에서 온 사업 파트너에게 리나를 소개했어요.

w|paruh.text: Budi bekerja paruh waktu di toko buku dekat sekolah.
w|paruh.en: Budi works part-time at a bookshop near the school.
w|paruh.ko: 부디는 학교 근처 서점에서 아르바이트를 해요.

w|paruh.text: Sebagian besar teman Siti kini sudah memasuki usia paruh baya.
w|paruh.en: Most of Siti's friends are now entering middle age.
w|paruh.ko: 시티의 친구들은 대부분 이제 중년에 접어들었어요.

w|pas.en: His arrival time was exactly right.

w|pasal.text: Di pelajaran PKn, Eko menghafal pasal pertama undang-undang dasar.
w|pasal.en: In civics class, Eko memorized the first article of the constitution.
w|pasal.ko: 시민 교육 시간에 에코는 헌법 제일 조를 외웠어요.

w|pasal.text: Ayu membaca pasal tentang hak cipta sebelum menjual lukisannya.
w|pasal.en: Ayu read the article on copyright before selling her painting.
w|pasal.ko: 아유는 그림을 팔기 전에 저작권 조항을 읽었어요.

w|pasar.en: The traditional market is busy every morning.

w|pasar.text: Ibu belanja sayur di pasar dekat rumah.
w|pasar.en: Mom buys vegetables at the market near home.
w|pasar.ko: 엄마는 집 근처 시장에서 채소를 사.

w|pascasarjana.text: Adik Rudi sedang menempuh pendidikan pascasarjana di bidang ilmu pangan.
w|pascasarjana.en: Rudi's younger sibling is doing a postgraduate degree in food science.
w|pascasarjana.ko: 루디의 동생은 식품과학 대학원 과정을 밟고 있어요.

w|pascasarjana.text: Rina menjual buku-buku kuliah pascasarjana milik kakaknya.
w|pascasarjana.en: Rina is selling her older sibling's postgraduate textbooks.

w|pasien.text: Pasien itu menunggu giliran di ruang tunggu.
w|pasien.en: That patient is waiting for his turn in the waiting room.
The doctor examines the patient carefully.

w|pasir.text: Pasir pantai terasa hangat di kaki.
w|pasir.en: The beach sand feels warm on the feet.
The wind blew sand into my face.
w|pasir.ko: 바람이 모래를 내 얼굴로 날려 보냈어.

w|pasokan.text: Pedagang piringan hitam itu bilang pasokan dari luar kota sedang sedikit.
w|pasokan.en: The record dealer said the supply from out of town was low at the moment.
w|pasokan.ko: 레코드 판매상은 지금 외지에서 들어오는 물량이 적다고 했어요.

w|pasokan.text: Gara-gara hujan, pasokan bunga segar untuk dekorasi pernikahan Intan terlambat datang.
w|pasokan.en: Because of the rain, the supply of fresh flowers for Intan's wedding decorations arrived late.
w|pasokan.ko: 비 때문에 인탄 결혼식 장식용 생화 공급이 늦어졌어요.

w|paspor.text: Agus bersyukur tidak perlu membawa paspor karena perjalanannya masih di dalam negeri.
w|paspor.en: Agus was glad he didn't need a passport because his trip was within the country.
w|paspor.ko: 아구스는 국내 여행이라 여권이 필요 없어서 다행이라고 생각했어요.

w|paspor.text: Seorang turis meninggalkan paspor di meja kasir, jadi Wati segera menyimpannya.
w|paspor.en: A tourist left a passport at the checkout counter, so Wati kept it safe right away.
w|paspor.ko: 한 관광객이 계산대에 여권을 두고 가서 와티가 바로 보관했어요.

w|patah.en: His arm broke after he fell.
That pencil snapped in the middle.

w|paten.text: Alat penyangga buatan Andi ternyata sudah punya paten dari perusahaan lain.
w|paten.en: It turned out the support tool Andi made was already patented by another company.
w|paten.ko: 안디가 만든 지지대는 알고 보니 다른 회사가 이미 특허를 갖고 있었어요.

w|paten.text: Teman Dewi yang insinyur baru saja mendapat paten untuk alat penyaring air.
w|paten.en: Dewi's engineer friend just got a patent for a water filter.
w|paten.ko: 엔지니어인 데위의 친구는 얼마 전 정수 장치로 특허를 받았어요.

w|patroli.en: Night patrol keeps the area safe.

w|patroli.text: Polisi melakukan patroli di pusat kota.

w|patuh.text: Rudi selalu patuh pada aturan memakai helm di lokasi proyek.
w|patuh.en: Rudi always obeys the rule of wearing a helmet on site.
w|patuh.ko: 루디는 현장에서 안전모를 쓰라는 규칙을 늘 지켜요.

w|patuh.text: Rina berusaha patuh pada aturan kantor meski belum hafal semuanya.
w|patuh.en: Rina tries to follow the office rules even though she hasn't memorised them all.
w|patuh.ko: 리나는 아직 다 외우진 못했지만 회사 규칙을 잘 지키려고 해요.

w|patung.text: Patung di taman itu sangat indah.
w|patung.en: The statue in that park is very beautiful.
They cleaned the statue in the square.

w|patut.text: Museum kecil di kota Rudi patut dikunjungi karena tiketnya murah dan koleksinya lengkap.
w|patut.en: The small museum in Rudi's town is worth visiting because tickets are cheap and the collection is complete.
w|patut.ko: 루디네 동네 작은 박물관은 표가 싸고 소장품이 많아서 가 볼 만해요.

w|patut.text: Harga murah di pasar ini memang patut disyukuri.
w|patut.en: The low prices at this market really are something to be grateful for.
w|patut.ko: 이 시장의 싼 물가는 정말 감사할 일이에요.

w|paus.text: Dari perahu, Eko melihat seekor paus muncul ke permukaan laut.
w|paus.en: From the boat, Eko saw a whale come up to the surface of the sea.
w|paus.ko: 에코는 배 위에서 고래 한 마리가 수면 위로 올라오는 걸 봤어요.

w|paus.text: Anak tetangga Ayu sedang membuat tugas tentang paus biru.
w|paus.en: Ayu's neighbor's child is doing an assignment about the blue whale.
w|paus.ko: 아유네 이웃 아이는 대왕고래에 관한 숙제를 하고 있어요.

w|pawai.text: Rudi bertugas mengatur lalu lintas saat pawai hari kemerdekaan.
w|pawai.en: Rudi was on duty directing traffic during the Independence Day parade.
w|pawai.ko: 루디는 독립기념일 행진 때 교통정리를 맡았어요.

w|pawai.text: Rina merawat kuda yang kelelahan setelah ikut pawai budaya.
w|pawai.en: Rina treated a horse that was exhausted after taking part in a cultural parade.
w|pawai.ko: 리나는 문화 행진에 참가하고 지친 말을 돌봤어요.

w|payah.en: That team's performance was really poor.
I feel awful after staying up late.
w|payah.ko: 밤을 새고 나니 몸이 너무 안 좋아.

w|payudara.text: Dimas menemukan benjolan di dekat payudara anjing betina tua itu dan menyarankan pemeriksaan lanjut.
w|payudara.en: Dimas found a lump near the old female dog's breast and recommended further tests.
w|payudara.ko: 디마스는 늙은 암캐의 유선 근처에서 혹을 발견하고 추가 검사를 권했어요.

w|payudara.text: Laboratorium itu terkenal dengan penelitian kanker payudara.
w|payudara.en: That laboratory is known for its breast cancer research.

w|payung.text: Budi pernah meminjam payung Rina tanpa izin, dan itu juga jadi masalah.
w|payung.en: Budi once borrowed Rina's umbrella without asking, and that became a problem too.
w|payung.ko: 부디는 리나의 우산을 허락 없이 빌린 적이 있는데, 그것도 문제가 됐어요.

w|payung.text: Siti hampir lupa membawa payung waktu hujan turun di hari pindahan.
w|payung.en: Siti almost forgot to bring an umbrella when it rained on moving day.
w|payung.ko: 이삿날 비가 왔는데 시티는 하마터면 우산을 깜빡할 뻔했어요.

w|pebisnis.text: Pemilik gedung itu seorang pebisnis muda yang sering datang menengok Andi.
w|pebisnis.en: The building's owner is a young businessman who often drops by to see Andi.
w|pebisnis.ko: 그 건물 주인은 안디를 자주 보러 오는 젊은 사업가예요.

w|pebisnis.text: Dewi mengobrol dengan seorang pebisnis yang dulu ketua kelas mereka.
w|pebisnis.en: Dewi chatted with a businessman who used to be their class president.
w|pebisnis.ko: 데위는 예전에 반장이었던 사업가와 이야기를 나눴어요.

w|pecah.text: Gelas itu pecah di lantai dapur.
w|pecah.en: That glass broke on the kitchen floor.
The window broke because of strong wind.

w|pecahan.text: Di lantai kamar Rina ada pecahan celengan tanah liat.
w|pecahan.en: On the floor of Rina's room were pieces of a clay piggy bank.
w|pecahan.ko: 리나 방바닥에 흙 저금통 조각이 있었어요.

w|pecahan.text: Siti menyapu pecahan gelas yang jatuh dari kardus.
w|pecahan.en: Siti swept up the shards of a glass that fell out of a box.
w|pecahan.ko: 시티는 상자에서 떨어진 유리잔 조각을 쓸어 담았어요.

w|pecandu.text: Pecandu kopi itu minum terlalu banyak.
w|pecandu.en: That coffee addict drinks too much.
w|pecandu.ko: 그 커피 중독자는 너무 많이 마셔.

w|pecandu.text: Dia bukan pecandu game seperti dulu.
w|pecandu.en: He is not a game addict like before.

w|pecinta.text: Pengantin wanita adalah pecinta kucing, jadi kue pernikahannya berbentuk kucing.
w|pecinta.en: The bride is a cat lover, so the wedding cake was shaped like a cat.
w|pecinta.ko: 신부가 고양이를 좋아해서 웨딩 케이크가 고양이 모양이었어요.

w|pecinta.text: Komunitas pecinta buku mengundang Rina untuk menulis tentang kegiatan mereka.
w|pecinta.en: A community of book lovers invited Rina to write about their activities.
w|pecinta.ko: 책 애호가 모임이 리나에게 자기들 활동에 대한 기사를 써 달라고 했어요.

w|pecundang.text: Pecundang itu menolak bersalaman setelah kalah.
w|pecundang.en: That loser refused to shake hands after losing.
w|pecundang.ko: 그 패자는 진 뒤에 악수를 거절했어.

w|pecundang.text: Jangan panggil dia pecundang begitu saja.
w|pecundang.en: Don't just call him a loser like that.

w|pedagang.text: Pedagang pasar datang sejak dini hari.
w|pedagang.en: Market merchants arrive from early morning.

w|pedagang.text: Dia lahir dari keluarga pedagang kecil.
w|pedagang.en: He was born into a small merchant family.

w|pedalaman.text: Bayu tumbuh besar di sebuah kampung di pedalaman Kalimantan.
w|pedalaman.en: Bayu grew up in a village deep in the interior of Kalimantan.
w|pedalaman.ko: 바유는 칼리만탄 오지의 한 마을에서 자랐어요.

w|pedalaman.text: Intan pernah ikut lomba lari lintas alam di pedalaman Papua.
w|pedalaman.en: Intan once took part in a cross-country race in the interior of Papua.
w|pedalaman.ko: 인탄은 파푸아 오지에서 열린 크로스컨트리 대회에 나간 적이 있어요.

w|pedas.text: Roti abon pedas jadi andalan baru di etalase Fajar.
w|pedas.en: Spicy shredded-beef bread is the new star in Fajar's display case.
w|pedas.ko: 매운 고기 플로스 빵이 파자르네 진열장의 새 간판 메뉴예요.

w|pedas.text: Lestari tidak makan sambal yang terlalu pedas sebelum lari.
w|pedas.en: Lestari doesn't eat chili sauce that's too spicy before running.
w|pedas.ko: 레스타리는 달리기 전에 너무 매운 삼발은 먹지 않아요.

w|pedesaan.text: Rudi suka berkemah karena udara pedesaan jauh lebih bersih daripada udara kota.
w|pedesaan.en: Rudi likes camping because the countryside air is much cleaner than city air.
w|pedesaan.ko: 루디는 시골 공기가 도시 공기보다 훨씬 깨끗해서 캠핑을 좋아해요.

w|pedesaan.text: Banyak lagu band itu bercerita tentang kehidupan sederhana di pedesaan.
w|pedesaan.en: Many of the band's songs are about simple life in the countryside.
