w|pedesaan.ko: 그 밴드의 노래 중 상당수가 시골의 소박한 삶에 관한 거예요.

w|pedoman.text: Setiap aktor baru menerima buku pedoman tentang aturan di belakang panggung.
w|pedoman.en: Every new actor receives a guidebook on backstage rules.
w|pedoman.ko: 새 배우는 모두 무대 뒤 규칙을 담은 지침서를 받아요.

w|pedoman.text: Ayu membaca pedoman keselamatan yang ditempel di dinding gerbong.
w|pedoman.en: Ayu read the safety guidelines posted on the carriage wall.
w|pedoman.ko: 아유는 객차 벽에 붙은 안전 수칙을 읽었어요.

w|pegangan.text: Pegangan pintu itu longgar dan goyah.
w|pegangan.en: That door handle is loose and wobbly.
The little child gripped mother's handhold.

w|pegawai.text: Pegawai bank melayani nasabah dengan ramah.
w|pegawai.en: The bank employee serves customers kindly.

w|pegawai.text: Beberapa pegawai bekerja lembur malam ini.
w|pegawai.en: Several employees are working overtime tonight.

w|pegulat.text: Untuk rubrik olahraga, Bayu menulis profil seorang pegulat yang juga guru matematika.
w|pegulat.en: For the sports section, Bayu wrote a profile of a wrestler who is also a math teacher.
w|pegulat.ko: 바유는 스포츠면에 수학 교사이기도 한 레슬링 선수의 인물 기사를 썼어요.

w|pegulat.text: Di pesta panen, dua pegulat dari desa tetangga bertanding di depan Intan dan teman-temannya.
w|pegulat.en: At the harvest festival, two wrestlers from the neighboring village competed in front of Intan and her friends.
w|pegulat.ko: 추수 잔치에서 이웃 마을 씨름꾼 두 명이 인탄과 친구들 앞에서 겨뤘어요.

w|pegunungan.en: Those mountains are covered in morning mist.
w|pegunungan.ko: 그 산맥이 아침 안개에 덮여 있어.

w|pegunungan.text: Kami berkemah di pegunungan selama akhir pekan.
w|pegunungan.en: We camped in the mountains over the weekend.

w|pejabat.en: A local official visited the affected village.
An official gave a brief statement.

w|pejalan kaki.text: Hotel itu berada di jalan khusus pejalan kaki dekat pasar lama.
w|pejalan kaki.en: The hotel is on a pedestrian-only street near the old market.
w|pejalan kaki.ko: 그 호텔은 옛 시장 근처 보행자 전용 거리에 있어요.

w|pejalan kaki.text: Saat hujan deras, trotoar menjadi licin dan berbahaya bagi pejalan kaki.
w|pejalan kaki.en: In heavy rain, the sidewalks become slippery and dangerous for pedestrians.
w|pejalan kaki.ko: 비가 많이 오면 인도가 미끄러워서 보행자에게 위험해요.

w|pejantan.text: Warga desa patungan membeli sapi pejantan yang kuat.
w|pejantan.en: The villagers pooled money to buy a strong breeding bull.
w|pejantan.ko: 마을 사람들은 돈을 모아 튼튼한 씨수소를 샀어요.

w|pejantan.text: Pabrik pakan tempat Ayu bekerja membuat makanan khusus untuk ayam pejantan.
w|pejantan.en: The feed factory where Ayu works makes special food for roosters.
w|pejantan.ko: 아유가 일하는 사료 공장은 수탉 전용 사료를 만들어요.

w|pejuang.text: Pejuang itu membela hak masyarakat miskin.
w|pejuang.en: That fighter defends the rights of the poor.
w|pejuang.ko: 그 투사가 가난한 사람들의 권리를 지켜.

w|pejuang.en: He is remembered as a freedom fighter.

w|peka.text: Bayu cukup peka terhadap suasana hati rekan kerja.
w|peka.en: Bayu is quite sensitive to his coworkers' moods.
w|peka.ko: 바유는 동료들의 기분을 꽤 잘 알아차려요.

w|peka.text: Intan peka terhadap tanda kelelahan pada anggota baru.
w|peka.en: Intan is quick to notice signs of fatigue in new members.
w|peka.ko: 인탄은 신규 회원이 지친 기색을 금방 알아차려요.

w|pekan.en: This week is full of activities.

w|pekerja.text: Pekerja pabrik pulang sebelum matahari terbenam.
w|pekerja.en: The factory workers went home before sunset.
w|pekerja.ko: 공장 노동자들이 해 지기 전에 퇴근했어.

w|pekerja.en: Every worker gets a lunch break.

w|pekerjaan.en: She's looking for a new job.

w|pelabuhan.en: The harbor is busy in the morning.

w|pelabuhan.text: Kapal besar berlabuh di pelabuhan itu.
w|pelabuhan.en: A large ship docked at that harbor.

w|pelacak.text: Berkat alat pelacak di ponselnya, motor Andi yang hilang cepat ditemukan.
w|pelacak.en: Thanks to the tracker on his phone, Andi's missing motorbike was found quickly.
w|pelacak.ko: 휴대폰의 추적 장치 덕분에 잃어버린 안디의 오토바이를 금방 찾았어요.

w|pelacak.text: Jam tangan pelacak detak jantung membantu Dewi mengatur tenaga.
w|pelacak.en: A heart-rate tracking watch helps Dewi pace her energy.
w|pelacak.ko: 심박 추적 시계 덕분에 데위는 체력을 조절해요.

w|pelacakan.text: Sistem pelacakan buku memberi tahu Andi bahwa novelnya ada di cabang lain.
w|pelacakan.en: The book tracking system told Andi that his novel was at another branch.
w|pelacakan.ko: 도서 추적 시스템이 안디에게 그 소설이 다른 분관에 있다고 알려 줬어요.

w|pelacakan.text: Dewi memakai aplikasi pelacakan untuk memantau paket yang dikirim ke klien.
w|pelacakan.en: Dewi uses a tracking app to monitor packages sent to clients.
w|pelacakan.ko: 디위는 고객에게 보낸 택배를 확인하려고 배송 추적 앱을 써요.

w|pelacuran.text: Naskah lama itu mengkritik pelacuran anak di kota pelabuhan pada masa kolonial.
w|pelacuran.en: That old script criticizes child prostitution in port cities during the colonial era.
w|pelacuran.ko: 그 옛 대본은 식민지 시대 항구 도시의 아동 성매매를 비판해요.

w|pelacuran.text: Ayu mendengar siaran radio tentang upaya pemerintah memberantas pelacuran di kota besar.
w|pelacuran.en: Ayu heard a radio broadcast about the government's efforts to stamp out prostitution in big cities.
w|pelacuran.ko: 아유는 대도시 성매매를 뿌리 뽑으려는 정부 노력에 관한 라디오 방송을 들었어요.

w|pelajar.text: Beberapa pelajar SMK datang magang di proyek Rudi.
w|pelajar.en: Some vocational school students came to do an internship on Rudi's project.
w|pelajar.ko: 직업고 학생 몇 명이 루디의 현장에 실습하러 왔어요.

w|pelajar.text: Waktu masih pelajar, Rina pernah magang di perusahaan ini.
w|pelajar.en: When she was still a student, Rina once interned at this company.
w|pelajar.ko: 리나는 학생 시절에 이 회사에서 인턴을 한 적이 있어요.

w|pelajaran.text: Pelajaran hari ini tentang sejarah dunia.
w|pelajaran.en: Today's lesson is about world history.

w|pelajaran.text: Dia belajar dari pelajaran pahit itu.
w|pelajaran.en: He learned from that bitter lesson.

w|pelaku.en: The perpetrator has been caught by the police.

w|pelamar.text: Siang ini Rudi mewawancarai pelamar posisi tukang cuci piring.
w|pelamar.en: This afternoon Rudi is interviewing applicants for the dishwasher position.
w|pelamar.ko: 오늘 오후 루디는 설거지 담당 지원자들을 면접해요.

w|pelamar.text: Rina menempel pengumuman bahwa lapak kecil itu mencari pelamar untuk jaga akhir pekan.
w|pelamar.en: Rina put up a notice that the little stall was looking for applicants to work weekends.
w|pelamar.ko: 리나는 그 작은 노점에서 주말 아르바이트 지원자를 찾는다는 공지를 붙였어요.

w|pelan.text: Bicara pelan agar bayi tidak bangun.
w|pelan.en: Speak softly so the baby doesn't wake.

w|pelan.text: Mobil itu melaju pelan di jalan basah.
w|pelan.en: That car drove slowly on the wet road.
w|pelan.ko: 그 차가 젖은 길에서 천천히 달렸어.

w|pelan-pelan.en: Speak slowly so I can understand.
Just go slowly, the road is slippery.

w|pelanggan.text: Pelanggan menunggu di meja dekat jendela.
w|pelanggan.en: A customer is waiting at the table by the window.

w|pelanggan.text: Toko itu melayani pelanggan dengan ramah.

w|pelanggar.text: Fajar mencatat nama setiap pelanggar aturan parkir di halaman balai kota.
w|pelanggar.en: Fajar writes down the name of every parking violator in the city hall yard.
w|pelanggar.ko: 파자르는 시청 마당에서 주차 규칙을 어긴 사람의 이름을 모두 적어요.

w|pelanggar.text: Satpam mencatat setiap pelanggar jam tenang di buku khusus, cerita Lestari.
w|pelanggar.en: The guard records every quiet-hours violator in a special book, Lestari says.
w|pelanggar.ko: 레스타리 말로는 경비원이 조용한 시간을 어긴 사람을 모두 따로 장부에 적어요.

w|pelanggaran.text: Pelanggaran lalu lintas didenda dengan tegas.
Wasit mencatat pelanggaran di menit akhir.
w|pelanggaran.en: The referee noted a foul in the final minute.

w|pelangi.text: Setelah hujan reda, Agus melihat pelangi melengkung di atas sungai.
w|pelangi.en: After the rain stopped, Agus saw a rainbow arching over the river.
w|pelangi.ko: 비가 그친 뒤 아구스는 강 위에 걸린 무지개를 봤어요.

w|pelangi.text: Wati memasang stiker pelangi di pintu ruang tunggu anak.
w|pelangi.en: Wati put a rainbow sticker on the door of the children's waiting room.
w|pelangi.ko: 와티는 어린이 대기실 문에 무지개 스티커를 붙였어요.

w|pelari.text: Bayu mewawancarai pelari termuda di maraton kota, yang baru berumur enam belas tahun.
w|pelari.en: Bayu interviewed the youngest runner in the city marathon, who is only sixteen.
w|pelari.ko: 바유는 겨우 열여섯 살인 시 마라톤 최연소 주자를 인터뷰했어요.

w|pelari.text: Intan merancang aplikasi yang mencatat jarak tempuh para pelari pemula.
w|pelari.en: Intan designed an app that records distances for beginner runners.
w|pelari.ko: 인탄은 초보 달리기 선수들의 거리를 기록하는 앱을 설계했어요.

w|pelarian.text: Eko pernah menulis kisah pelarian seorang tahanan yang akhirnya menyerahkan diri.
w|pelarian.en: Eko once wrote about the escape of a prisoner who eventually turned himself in.
w|pelarian.ko: 에코는 결국 자수한 탈옥수의 도주 이야기를 쓴 적이 있어요.

w|pelarian.text: Kucing toko Ayu suka bersembunyi di laci, seolah sedang dalam pelarian.
w|pelarian.en: The cat at Ayu's shop likes to hide in the drawer, as if it's on the run.
w|pelarian.ko: 아유 가게 고양이는 도망자처럼 서랍에 숨는 걸 좋아해요.

w|pelatih.text: Pelatih kami datang lebih awal hari ini.
Dia bekerja sebagai pelatih sepak bola.
w|pelatih.en: He works as a soccer coach.

w|pelatihan.text: Tim mengikuti pelatihan intensif minggu ini.
w|pelatihan.en: The team is doing intensive training this week.
w|pelatihan.ko: 팀이 이번 주에 집중 훈련을 받아.

w|pelatuk.text: Pemandu menunjukkan bagian pelatuk pada senapan kuno di ruang sejarah.
w|pelatuk.en: The guide pointed out the trigger on the antique rifle in the history room.
w|pelatuk.ko: 안내원이 역사 전시실의 옛 소총에서 방아쇠 부분을 보여 줬어요.

w|pelatuk.text: Di pasar burung, Rina melihat seekor burung pelatuk di dalam sangkar bambu.
w|pelatuk.en: At the bird market, Rina saw a woodpecker in a bamboo cage.
w|pelatuk.ko: 새 시장에서 리나는 대나무 새장 안의 딱따구리를 봤어요.

w|pelaut.text: Kakek Fajar dulu pelaut, makanya Fajar pandai mengolah ikan laut.
w|pelaut.en: Fajar's grandfather was a sailor, which is why Fajar is good at preparing sea fish.
w|pelaut.ko: 파자르의 할아버지는 뱃사람이었어요. 그래서 파자르는 바닷고기를 잘 손질해요.

w|pelaut.text: Seorang mantan pelaut menjual kompas kuningan dan teropong di pasar loak.
w|pelaut.en: A former sailor sells a brass compass and binoculars at the flea market.
w|pelaut.ko: 전직 뱃사람이 벼룩시장에서 놋쇠 나침반과 망원경을 팔아요.

w|pelawak.text: Kata rekan-rekan, gaya bicara Bayu lucu seperti pelawak di acara televisi.
w|pelawak.en: The coworkers say Bayu talks as funnily as a comedian on a TV show.
w|pelawak.ko: 동료들 말로는 바유 말투가 TV 개그맨처럼 웃기대요.

w|pelawak.text: Seorang pelawak terkenal ternyata rutin berlatih di gym tempat Intan bekerja.
w|pelawak.en: A well-known comedian turns out to work out regularly at the gym where Intan works.
w|pelawak.ko: 유명한 개그맨이 인탄이 일하는 헬스장에서 꾸준히 운동한대요.

w|pelayan.text: Pelayan itu membawa menu dengan cepat.
w|pelayan.en: The waiter brought the menu quickly.

w|pelayan.text: Dia bekerja sebagai pelayan di kafe.
w|pelayan.en: She works as a server at a cafe.

w|pelayanan.text: Pelayanan di restoran itu sangat ramah.
w|pelayanan.en: The service at that restaurant is very friendly.

w|pelayanan.text: Mereka meningkatkan pelayanan pelanggan tahun ini.
w|pelayanan.en: They are improving customer service this year.

w|pelayaran.text: Banyak tamu menginap semalam di hotel sebelum pelayaran ke pulau.
w|pelayaran.en: Many guests stay a night at the hotel before the voyage to the island.
w|pelayaran.ko: 많은 손님이 섬으로 가는 항해 전에 호텔에서 하룻밤 묵어요.

w|pelayaran.text: Gelombang tinggi membuat semua pelayaran ke pulau dihentikan sementara.
w|pelayaran.en: High waves have temporarily halted all sailings to the island.
w|pelayaran.ko: 높은 파도 때문에 섬으로 가는 모든 운항이 잠시 중단됐어요.

w|pelecehan.text: Sekolah Eko mengadakan seminar tentang cara melaporkan pelecehan di media sosial.
w|pelecehan.en: Eko's school held a seminar on how to report harassment on social media.
w|pelecehan.ko: 에코의 학교는 소셜 미디어 괴롭힘을 신고하는 방법에 대한 세미나를 열었어요.

w|pelecehan.text: Guru seni mengingatkan bahwa mengejek karya teman bisa termasuk pelecehan.
w|pelecehan.en: The art teacher reminded the class that mocking a classmate's work can count as harassment.
w|pelecehan.ko: 미술 선생님은 친구 작품을 비웃는 것도 괴롭힘이 될 수 있다고 일깨웠어요.

w|peledak.en: The expert disabled the explosive carefully.

w|peledak.text: Peledak itu ditemukan di dekat gudang.
w|peledak.en: That explosive was found near the warehouse.

w|peledakan.text: Foto hitam putih itu merekam peledakan jembatan pada masa perang.
w|peledakan.en: That black-and-white photo captures the blowing up of a bridge during the war.
w|peledakan.ko: 그 흑백 사진에는 전쟁 때 다리를 폭파하는 장면이 담겨 있어요.

w|peledakan.text: Putri membaca berita tentang peledakan gedung tua yang akan diganti mal baru.
w|peledakan.en: Putri read news about the demolition blast of an old building to be replaced by a new mall.
w|peledakan.ko: 푸트리는 새 쇼핑몰이 들어설 낡은 건물을 폭파 해체한다는 기사를 읽었어요.

w|pelempar.text: Hari ini pelempar batu yang memecahkan kaca bus itu akhirnya duduk di kursi terdakwa.
w|pelempar.en: Today the stone thrower who smashed the bus window finally sat in the defendant's chair.
w|pelempar.ko: 오늘 버스 유리창에 돌을 던져 깬 사람이 마침내 피고인석에 앉았어요.

w|pelempar.text: Anak Wati adalah pelempar terbaik di tim bisbol sekolahnya.
w|pelempar.en: Wati's son is the best pitcher on his school baseball team.
w|pelempar.ko: 와티의 아들은 학교 야구팀에서 제일 잘 던지는 투수예요.

w|pelepasan.text: Sore itu Rudi mengurus pelepasan seorang tahanan yang uang jaminannya sudah dibayar.
w|pelepasan.en: That afternoon Rudi handled the release of a detainee whose bail had been paid.
w|pelepasan.ko: 그날 오후 루디는 보석금이 납부된 수감자의 석방 절차를 처리했어요.

w|pelepasan.text: Acara dibuka dengan pelepasan balon warna-warni di dekat garis start.
w|pelepasan.en: The event opened with the release of colorful balloons near the starting line.
w|pelepasan.ko: 행사는 출발선 근처에서 알록달록한 풍선을 날리며 시작됐어요.

w|peleton.text: Saat upacara, Budi berdiri di barisan depan peleton kelasnya.
w|peleton.en: During the ceremony, Budi stood in the front row of his class platoon.
w|peleton.ko: 의식 때 부디는 자기 반 소대의 맨 앞줄에 섰어요.

w|peleton.text: Satu peleton tentara berbaris rapi di depan Siti menuju pesawat militer.
w|peleton.en: A platoon of soldiers marched neatly past Siti toward a military plane.
w|peleton.ko: 군인 한 소대가 시티 앞을 지나 군용기로 줄 맞춰 걸어갔어요.

w|peliharaan.text: Gugatan itu berawal dari anjing peliharaan tetangga yang sering menggonggong.
w|peliharaan.en: The lawsuit began with a neighbour's pet dog that barked a lot.
w|peliharaan.ko: 그 소송은 자주 짖는 이웃집 반려견에서 시작됐어요.

w|peliharaan.text: Selain sembako, Lestari juga menjual makanan untuk hewan peliharaan.
w|peliharaan.en: Besides groceries, Lestari also sells pet food.
w|peliharaan.ko: 레스타리는 생필품 말고도 반려동물 사료도 팔아요.

w|pelik.text: Dimas menghadapi masalah pelik ketika dua resep dokter saling bertentangan.
w|pelik.en: Dimas faced a tricky problem when two doctors' prescriptions contradicted each other.
w|pelik.ko: 디마스는 두 의사의 처방이 서로 어긋나서 골치 아픈 문제를 맞았어요.

w|pelik.text: Masalah paling pelik bagi Putri adalah pipa air yang bocor di dalam tembok.
w|pelik.en: The trickiest problem for Putri is a water pipe leaking inside the wall.
w|pelik.ko: 푸트리에게 가장 골치 아픈 문제는 벽 속에서 새는 수도관이에요.

w|pelindung.en: Knee pads protect players from injury.

w|pelindung.text: Dia memakai pelindung wajah saat bekerja.
w|pelindung.en: He wears a face protector at work.
w|pelindung.ko: 그는 일할 때 얼굴 보호구를 써.

w|pelit.text: Andi tidak menyangka tetangga yang kaya itu ternyata pelit sekali.
w|pelit.en: Andi didn't expect the wealthy neighbor to turn out so stingy.
w|pelit.ko: 안디는 그 부자 이웃이 그렇게 인색할 줄 몰랐어요.

w|pelit.text: Dewi tertawa membaca kisah saudagar pelit dalam pameran cerita rakyat.
w|pelit.en: Dewi laughed reading the tale of a stingy merchant in the folklore exhibition.
w|pelit.ko: 데위는 민담 전시에서 인색한 상인 이야기를 읽고 웃었어요.

w|peluang.text: Ini peluang bagus untuk belajar lebih banyak.
w|peluang.en: This is a good chance to learn more.

w|peluang.ko: 그 황금 같은 기회를 놓치지 마.

w|peluit.text: Guru olahraga meniup peluit, dan Dimas langsung berlari.
w|peluit.en: The PE teacher blew the whistle, and Dimas immediately started running.
w|peluit.ko: 체육 선생님이 호루라기를 불자 디마스는 바로 달렸어요.

w|peluit.text: Juru parkir meniup peluit untuk membantu mobil tamu Putri keluar.
w|peluit.en: The parking attendant blew a whistle to help Putri's guests' car get out.
w|peluit.ko: 주차 요원이 호루라기를 불어 푸트리네 손님 차가 빠져나가게 도와줬어요.

w|pelukan.en: That warm hug calmed her child.

w|pelukan.text: Dia memberi pelukan singkat sebelum pergi.
w|pelukan.en: He gave a brief hug before leaving.
w|pelukan.ko: 그는 떠나기 전에 짧게 안아 주었어.

w|pelukis.text: Seorang pelukis jalanan membuat lukisan wajah pengantin dalam waktu satu jam.
w|pelukis.en: A street painter made a portrait of the bride and groom in an hour.
w|pelukis.ko: 거리 화가 한 명이 한 시간 만에 신랑 신부 얼굴을 그렸어요.

w|pelukis.text: Lestari mewawancarai seorang pelukis tua yang masih berkarya di usia delapan puluh.
w|pelukis.en: Lestari interviewed an old painter who is still working at eighty.
w|pelukis.ko: 레스타리는 여든에도 여전히 작품 활동을 하는 노화가를 인터뷰했어요.

w|peluncur.text: Di halaman belakang museum dipajang peluncur roket tua yang sudah berkarat.
w|peluncur.en: In the museum's backyard an old rusty rocket launcher is on display.
w|peluncur.ko: 박물관 뒷마당에는 녹슨 낡은 로켓 발사대가 전시돼 있어요.

w|peluncur.text: Tim efek khusus membuat peluncur kembang api dari pipa paralon.
w|peluncur.en: The special effects team made a fireworks launcher out of PVC pipes.
w|peluncur.ko: 특수 효과 팀이 PVC 관으로 폭죽 발사대를 만들었어요.

w|peluncuran.text: Rudi datang untuk melihat peluncuran buku tentang sejarah kota.
w|peluncuran.en: Rudi came to see the launch of a book about the city's history.
w|peluncuran.ko: 루디는 도시 역사에 관한 책 출간 행사를 보러 왔어요.

w|peluncuran.text: Rina ikut meramaikan peluncuran aplikasi belanja pasar tradisional.
w|peluncuran.en: Rina joined in the launch of a traditional-market shopping app.
w|peluncuran.ko: 리나도 전통시장 장보기 앱 출시 행사에 참여했어요.

w|pemabuk.text: Dalam novel itu, ayah tokoh utama adalah seorang pemabuk yang akhirnya berubah.
w|pemabuk.en: In the novel, the main character's father is a drunkard who eventually changes.
w|pemabuk.ko: 그 소설에서 주인공 아버지는 결국 달라지는 술꾼이에요.

w|pemabuk.text: Petugas keamanan menurunkan seorang pemabuk yang membuat keributan di gerbong.
w|pemabuk.en: Security staff removed a drunk who was making a commotion in the carriage.
w|pemabuk.ko: 보안 요원이 칸에서 소란을 피운 술 취한 사람을 내리게 했어요.

w|pemadam.text: Pemadam kebakaran datang dalam hitungan menit.
Tim pemadam berhasil memadamkan api besar.
w|pemadam.en: The firefighting team managed to put out the big fire.

w|pemadaman.text: Ada pemadaman listrik bergilir di gedung Agus malam ini.
w|pemadaman.en: There's a rolling power cut in Agus's building tonight.
w|pemadaman.ko: 오늘 밤 아구스네 건물에 순환 정전이 있어요.

w|pemadaman.text: Saat terjadi pemadaman listrik, Wati tetap melayani tamu dengan cahaya lilin.
w|pemadaman.en: During the power outage, Wati kept serving guests by candlelight.
w|pemadaman.ko: 정전이 됐을 때도 와티는 촛불을 켜고 손님을 받았어요.

w|pemahaman.text: Setelah les tambahan, pemahaman Eko tentang pecahan meningkat.
w|pemahaman.en: After extra lessons, Eko's understanding of fractions improved.
w|pemahaman.ko: 보충 수업을 듣고 나서 에코의 분수 이해가 좋아졌어요.

w|pemahaman.text: Guru seni ingin murid punya pemahaman dasar tentang cahaya dan bayangan, termasuk Ayu.
w|pemahaman.en: The art teacher wants students, Ayu included, to have a basic understanding of light and shadow.
w|pemahaman.ko: 미술 선생님은 아유를 비롯한 학생들이 빛과 그림자를 기본적으로 이해하길 바라요.

w|pemain.en: That new player is really good.
All the players are ready on the field.

w|pemakaman.en: The funeral was held in a solemn atmosphere.

w|pemakaman.text: Banyak orang datang ke pemakaman itu.
w|pemakaman.en: Many people came to that funeral.

w|pemakan.text: Pemandu bercerita bahwa harimau, pemakan daging terbesar di pulau itu, hampir punah.
w|pemakan.en: The guide said that the tiger, the biggest meat-eater on the island, is nearly extinct.
w|pemakan.ko: 가이드는 그 섬에서 가장 큰 육식 동물인 호랑이가 거의 멸종했다고 이야기했어요.

w|pemakan.text: Di sela lagu, vokalis bercerita bahwa drummer mereka pemakan segala, dari sambal sampai durian.
w|pemakan.en: Between songs, the vocalist said their drummer eats everything, from chili sauce to durian.
w|pemakan.ko: 노래 사이에 보컬은 자기네 드러머가 삼발부터 두리안까지 뭐든 먹는다고 이야기했어요.

w|pemalas.text: Waktu kecil, Fajar sering disebut pemalas karena susah bangun pagi.
w|pemalas.en: As a kid, Fajar was often called lazy because he had trouble waking up early.
w|pemalas.ko: 어릴 때 파자르는 아침에 잘 못 일어나서 게으름뱅이라는 소리를 자주 들었어요.

w|pemalas.text: Redaktur Lestari tidak suka pemalas yang selalu menyerahkan tulisan terlambat.
w|pemalas.en: Lestari's editor doesn't like lazy people who always hand in their stories late.
w|pemalas.ko: 레스타리의 편집장은 늘 기사를 늦게 내는 게으른 사람을 싫어해요.

w|pemalsuan.text: Pria itu didakwa melakukan pemalsuan tanda tangan di surat jual beli tanah.
w|pemalsuan.en: The man was charged with forging a signature on a land sale document.
w|pemalsuan.ko: 그 남자는 토지 매매 계약서의 서명을 위조한 혐의로 기소됐어요.

w|pemalsuan.text: Wati melaporkan pemalsuan nota yang dilakukan seorang pemasok ke polisi.
w|pemalsuan.en: Wati reported a supplier's forging of receipts to the police.
w|pemalsuan.ko: 와티는 한 공급업자가 영수증을 위조한 일을 경찰에 신고했어요.

w|pemalu.text: Adik Fajar yang pemalu bersembunyi di balik tirai saat tamu berdatangan.
w|pemalu.en: Fajar's shy younger sibling hides behind the curtain as the guests arrive.
w|pemalu.ko: 수줍음 많은 파자르의 동생은 손님들이 오자 커튼 뒤에 숨어요.

w|pemalu.text: Lestari dulu anak pemalu yang lebih suka melihat hujan dari jendela.
w|pemalu.en: Lestari used to be a shy child who preferred watching the rain from the window.
w|pemalu.ko: 레스타리는 창밖으로 비 구경하기를 더 좋아하던 수줍은 아이였어요.

w|pemanah.text: Bayu mewawancarai seorang pemanah muda yang baru pulang membawa medali emas.
w|pemanah.en: Bayu interviewed a young archer who had just come home with a gold medal.
w|pemanah.ko: 바유는 금메달을 따고 막 돌아온 젊은 양궁 선수를 인터뷰했어요.

w|pemanah.text: Untuk iklan aplikasi, tim memakai gambar pemanah yang sedang membidik sasaran.
w|pemanah.en: For the app ad, the team used an image of an archer aiming at a target.
w|pemanah.ko: 앱 광고에 팀은 과녁을 겨누는 궁수 그림을 썼어요.

w|pemanas.text: Agus memanggil teknisi karena pemanas air di kamar mandinya mati.
w|pemanas.en: Agus called a technician because the water heater in his bathroom stopped working.
w|pemanas.ko: 아구스는 욕실 온수기가 고장 나서 기사를 불렀어요.

w|pemanas.text: Saat berlibur ke daerah sejuk, Wati menyalakan pemanas ruangan di kamar hotel.
w|pemanas.en: On holiday in a cool region, Wati turned on the room heater in the hotel room.
w|pemanas.ko: 서늘한 지역으로 휴가 갔을 때 와티는 호텔 방 난방기를 켰어요.

w|pemanasan.text: Rak buku tentang pemanasan global ada di dekat tangga.
w|pemanasan.en: The shelf of books about global warming is near the stairs.
w|pemanasan.ko: 지구 온난화에 관한 책장은 계단 옆에 있어요.

w|pemanasan.text: Masinis melakukan pemanasan mesin sebelum kereta meninggalkan depo.
w|pemanasan.en: The driver warmed up the engine before the train left the depot.
w|pemanasan.ko: 기관사는 기차가 차량기지를 떠나기 전에 엔진을 예열했어요.

w|pemancar.text: Eko merakit pemancar radio sederhana untuk lomba sains.
w|pemancar.en: Eko built a simple radio transmitter for the science fair.
w|pemancar.ko: 에코는 과학 대회에 낼 간단한 라디오 송신기를 만들었어요.

w|pemancar.text: Dari jendela kelas seni, Ayu bisa melihat menara pemancar televisi.
w|pemancar.en: From the art room window, Ayu can see the television transmitter tower.
w|pemancar.ko: 미술실 창문으로 아유는 텔레비전 송신탑을 볼 수 있어요.

w|pemandangan.text: Pemandangan dari bukit itu indah sekali.
w|pemandangan.en: The view from that hill is so beautiful.
w|pemandangan.ko: 그 언덕에서 본 경치가 정말 아름다워.

w|pemandangan.text: Kami menikmati pemandangan laut saat matahari terbenam.
w|pemandangan.en: We enjoyed the sea view at sunset.
w|pemandangan.ko: 우리는 해질 때 바다 경치를 즐겼어.

w|pemandu.text: Di Dieng, Agus menyewa pemandu lokal untuk naik ke bukit saat subuh.
w|pemandu.en: In Dieng, Agus hired a local guide to climb the hill at dawn.
w|pemandu.ko: 디엥에서 아구스는 새벽에 언덕에 오르려고 현지 가이드를 고용했어요.

w|pemandu.text: Wati jadi pemandu bagi karyawan baru yang belum hafal letak tiap lantai.
w|pemandu.en: Wati became the guide for new staff who hadn't yet memorized each floor.
w|pemandu.ko: 와티는 아직 층마다 위치를 모르는 신입 직원들의 안내자가 됐어요.

w|pemangsa.text: Budi memasang jaring agar ayam-ayamnya aman dari pemangsa.
w|pemangsa.en: Budi put up a net so his chickens would be safe from predators.
w|pemangsa.ko: 부디는 닭들이 포식자에게서 안전하도록 그물을 쳤어요.

w|pemangsa.text: Kucing dapur itu pemangsa tikus yang andal, jadi Siti membiarkannya tinggal.
w|pemangsa.en: That kitchen cat is a reliable hunter of mice, so Siti lets it stay.
w|pemangsa.ko: 그 주방 고양이는 쥐를 잘 잡아서 시티가 그냥 지내게 둬요.

w|pemarah.text: Paman Fajar yang biasanya pemarah hari ini terus tersenyum.
w|pemarah.en: Fajar's uncle, usually hot-tempered, kept smiling today.
w|pemarah.ko: 평소 화를 잘 내는 파자르의 삼촌이 오늘은 내내 웃어요.

w|pemarah.text: Udara panas membuat sopir angkot menjadi pemarah di jalan.
w|pemarah.en: The hot air makes minibus drivers short-tempered on the road.
w|pemarah.ko: 더운 날씨에 미니버스 기사들이 길에서 짜증을 잘 내요.

w|pemasaran.text: Bagian pemasaran ingin artikel Fajar dipromosikan di media sosial.
w|pemasaran.en: The marketing department wants Fajar's article promoted on social media.
w|pemasaran.ko: 마케팅 부서는 파자르의 기사를 소셜 미디어에서 홍보하고 싶어 해요.

w|pemasaran.text: Lestari melihat baliho pemasaran perumahan baru di sepanjang jalan tol.
w|pemasaran.en: Lestari saw marketing billboards for new housing all along the toll road.
w|pemasaran.ko: 레스타리는 고속도로를 따라 새 주택단지 홍보 광고판을 봤어요.

w|pemasok.text: Eko menelepon pemasok sayur karena tomat belum datang.
w|pemasok.en: Eko called the vegetable supplier because the tomatoes hadn't arrived.
w|pemasok.ko: 토마토가 아직 안 와서 에코는 채소 납품업체에 전화했어요.

w|pemasok.text: Menurut pemasok buah langganan Ayu, musim mangga baru mulai bulan depan.
w|pemasok.en: According to Ayu's regular fruit supplier, mango season only starts next month.
w|pemasok.ko: 아유가 늘 과일을 사는 납품업자 말로는 망고 철이 다음 달에야 시작된대요.

w|pembaca.text: Kisah cinta Fajar dimuat di blog yang punya banyak pembaca setia.
w|pembaca.en: Fajar's love story was posted on a blog with many loyal readers.
w|pembaca.ko: 파자르의 사랑 이야기는 충성 독자가 많은 블로그에 실렸어요.

w|pembaca.text: Kolom cuaca di koran lokal disukai banyak pembaca, termasuk Lestari.
w|pembaca.en: The weather column in the local paper is liked by many readers, including Lestari.
w|pembaca.ko: 지역 신문의 날씨 칸은 레스타리를 비롯해 많은 독자가 좋아해요.

w|pembacaan.text: Semua orang berdiri saat pembacaan putusan dimulai.
w|pembacaan.en: Everyone stood up when the reading of the verdict began.

w|pembacaan.text: Setiap Jumat malam ada pembacaan puisi kecil di lantai atas restoran Wati.
w|pembacaan.en: Every Friday night there is a small poetry reading upstairs at Wati's restaurant.
w|pembacaan.ko: 매주 금요일 밤 와티네 식당 위층에서 작은 시 낭송회가 열려요.

w|pembagian.text: Wali kelas mengumumkan pembagian kelompok untuk proyek sains, dan Budi satu kelompok dengan sahabatnya.
w|pembagian.en: The homeroom teacher announced the group assignments for the science project, and Budi was in the same group as his best friend.
w|pembagian.ko: 담임 선생님이 과학 프로젝트 조 편성을 발표했는데, 버디는 단짝과 같은 조가 됐어요.

w|pembagian.text: Saat kemarau, pembagian air bersih di desa Siti diatur bergiliran.
w|pembagian.en: In the dry season, the distribution of clean water in Siti's village is done in turns.
w|pembagian.ko: 건기에는 시티네 마을의 깨끗한 물 배분이 순번제로 이루어져요.

w|pembajak.text: Museum bahari itu menyimpan bendera kapal pembajak yang pernah menguasai selat.
w|pembajak.en: The maritime museum keeps the flag of a pirate ship that once ruled the strait.
w|pembajak.ko: 그 해양 박물관에는 한때 해협을 장악했던 해적선의 깃발이 있어요.

w|pembajak.text: Lawan main Putri berperan sebagai pembajak pesawat yang akhirnya menyerah.
w|pembajak.en: Putri's co-star plays an airplane hijacker who eventually surrenders.
w|pembajak.ko: 푸트리의 상대 배우는 결국 항복하는 비행기 납치범 역을 맡았어요.

w|pembajakan.text: Kasus pembajakan truk bahan pangan itu langsung menjadi sorotan media lokal.
w|pembajakan.en: The case of the hijacked food truck immediately drew the spotlight of the local media.
w|pembajakan.ko: 식료품 트럭 탈취 사건은 곧바로 지역 언론의 주목을 받았어요.

w|pembajakan.text: Panitia melaporkan pembajakan akun media sosial lomba yang dipakai untuk menjual tiket palsu.
w|pembajakan.en: The organizers reported the hijacking of the race's social media account, which was used to sell fake tickets.
w|pembajakan.ko: 주최 측은 대회 SNS 계정이 해킹당해 가짜 표를 파는 데 쓰였다고 신고했어요.

w|pembakar.text: Polisi masih mencari pembakar gudang arsip yang terbakar bulan lalu, kata Fajar.
w|pembakar.en: Police are still looking for the arsonist behind last month's archive warehouse fire, Fajar said.
w|pembakar.ko: 파자르 말로는 경찰이 지난달 불탄 기록 창고의 방화범을 아직 찾고 있어요.

w|pembakar.text: Lestari membersihkan pembakar kompor gas yang tersumbat minyak.
w|pembakar.en: Lestari cleaned the gas stove burner that was clogged with grease.
w|pembakar.ko: 레스타리는 기름때로 막힌 가스레인지 버너를 청소했어요.

w|pembakaran.text: Pak Guru melarang pembakaran sampah di halaman belakang sekolah Agus.
w|pembakaran.en: The teacher banned burning trash in the backyard of Agus's school.
w|pembakaran.ko: 선생님은 아구스 학교 뒷마당에서 쓰레기 태우는 걸 금지했어요.

w|pembakaran.text: Saat berenang, Wati merasa tubuhnya bekerja seperti mesin pembakaran lemak.
w|pembakaran.en: While swimming, Wati feels her body working like a fat-burning machine.
w|pembakaran.ko: 수영할 때 와티는 몸이 지방을 태우는 기계처럼 움직인다고 느껴요.

w|pembalap.text: Sepupu Andi, seorang pembalap sepeda, datang ke sekolah untuk berbagi cerita.
w|pembalap.en: Andi's cousin, a cycling racer, came to the school to share his story.
w|pembalap.ko: 자전거 선수인 안디의 사촌이 학교에 와서 이야기를 들려줬어요.

w|pembalap.text: Di televisi, Dewi menonton pembalap mobil melintas di lomba akhir tahun.
w|pembalap.en: On TV, Dewi watched race car drivers zoom past in the year-end race.
w|pembalap.ko: 데위는 텔레비전에서 연말 경주에 나선 카레이서들이 달리는 걸 봤어요.

w|pembalasan.text: Hakim menegaskan bahwa hukum bukan alat pembalasan.
w|pembalasan.en: The judge stressed that the law is not a tool for revenge.
w|pembalasan.ko: 판사는 법이 복수의 수단이 아니라고 강조했어요.

w|pembalasan.text: Lestari memilih diam karena baginya pembalasan hanya membuang tenaga.
w|pembalasan.en: Lestari chose to stay quiet because to her, revenge is just a waste of energy.
w|pembalasan.ko: 레스타리는 복수는 힘만 빼는 일이라 생각해서 그냥 가만히 있었어요.

w|pembangkit.text: Pabrik itu punya pembangkit listrik sendiri di belakang gedung utama.
w|pembangkit.en: The factory has its own power plant behind the main building.
w|pembangkit.ko: 그 공장은 본관 뒤에 자체 발전소가 있어요.

w|pembangkit.text: Kota tempat Sari tinggal sekarang dekat dengan pembangkit listrik tenaga angin.
w|pembangkit.en: The town where Sari now lives is near a wind power plant.
w|pembangkit.ko: 사리가 지금 사는 도시는 풍력 발전소 근처예요.

w|pembangunan.text: Ayah Budi dulu bekerja di proyek pembangunan jalan tol.
w|pembangunan.en: Budi's dad used to work on a toll road construction project.
w|pembangunan.ko: 부디의 아빠는 예전에 고속도로 건설 현장에서 일했어요.

w|pembangunan.text: Di dekat rumah baru Siti sedang ada pembangunan pasar.
w|pembangunan.en: A market is being built near Siti's new house.
w|pembangunan.ko: 시티의 새집 근처에서는 시장을 짓고 있어요.

w|pembantaian.text: Guru sejarah menjelaskan pembantaian itu dengan tenang dan hati-hati.
w|pembantaian.en: The history teacher explained the massacre calmly and carefully.
w|pembantaian.ko: 역사 선생님은 그 학살에 대해 차분하고 조심스럽게 설명했어요.

w|pembantaian.text: Kakek Ayu pernah melihat monumen untuk korban pembantaian di masa penjajahan.
w|pembantaian.en: Ayu's grandfather once saw a monument to the victims of a massacre in colonial times.
w|pembantaian.ko: 아유의 할아버지는 식민지 시대 학살 희생자를 기리는 기념비를 본 적이 있어요.

w|pembantu.text: Pembantu rumah tangga membersihkan dapur pagi ini.
w|pembantu.en: The household helper cleaned the kitchen this morning.
w|pembantu.ko: 가사 도우미가 오늘 아침 부엌을 청소했어.

w|pembantu.text: Dia bekerja sebagai pembantu di toko itu.
w|pembantu.en: He works as an assistant at that shop.

w|pembasmi.text: Pengelola gedung memanggil jasa pembasmi rayap minggu lalu.
w|pembasmi.en: The building manager called in a termite exterminator last week.
w|pembasmi.ko: 건물 관리인이 지난주에 흰개미 방역 업체를 불렀어요.

w|pembasmi.text: Wati menyimpan pembasmi serangga jauh dari bahan makanan.
w|pembasmi.en: Wati keeps the insecticide well away from the food ingredients.
w|pembasmi.ko: 와티는 살충제를 식재료와 멀리 떨어진 곳에 둬요.

w|pembatalan.text: Rudi menjelaskan aturan pembatalan kepada tamu yang masih ragu.
w|pembatalan.en: Rudi explained the cancellation policy to a guest who was still unsure.
w|pembatalan.ko: 루디는 아직 망설이는 손님에게 취소 규정을 설명했어요.

w|pembatalan.text: Badai membuat maskapai mengumumkan pembatalan beberapa penerbangan.
w|pembatalan.en: The storm led the airline to announce the cancellation of several flights.
w|pembatalan.ko: 폭풍 때문에 항공사가 여러 항공편의 결항을 발표했어요.

w|pembatas.text: Andi dan tetangganya sepakat menanam bambu sebagai pembatas halaman.
w|pembatas.en: Andi and his neighbor agreed to plant bamboo as a boundary between their yards.
w|pembatas.ko: 안디와 이웃은 마당 경계로 대나무를 심기로 했어요.

w|pembatas.text: Petugas meminta Dewi tidak melewati tali pembatas di depan lukisan.
w|pembatas.en: The staff asked Dewi not to cross the barrier rope in front of the painting.
w|pembatas.ko: 직원은 데위에게 그림 앞 차단 줄을 넘지 말라고 했어요.

w|pembatasan.text: Rudi menjelaskan pembatasan jam masuk kota untuk truk besar.
w|pembatasan.en: Rudi explained the restricted hours for large trucks entering the city.
w|pembatasan.ko: 루디는 대형 트럭의 도심 진입 시간 제한을 설명했어요.

w|pembatasan.text: Rina menyarankan pembatasan camilan untuk kucing yang gemuk.
w|pembatasan.en: Rina recommended limiting treats for the overweight cat.
w|pembatasan.ko: 리나는 살찐 고양이에게 간식을 줄이라고 권했어요.

w|pembawa.text: Polisi mencari pembawa tas hitam yang tertinggal di halte.
w|pembawa.en: The police are looking for the person who carried the black bag left at the bus stop.
w|pembawa.ko: 경찰은 정류장에 두고 간 검은 가방의 주인을 찾고 있어요.

w|pembawa.text: Sebagai pembawa bendera tim, Dewi berjalan paling depan saat pembukaan turnamen.
w|pembawa.en: As the team's flag bearer, Dewi walked at the front at the tournament's opening.
w|pembawa.ko: 팀 기수인 데위는 대회 개막식에서 맨 앞에 서서 걸었어요.

w|pembayaran.text: Klinik Dimas sekarang menerima pembayaran lewat aplikasi.
w|pembayaran.en: Dimas's clinic now accepts payment through an app.
w|pembayaran.ko: 디마스의 동물병원은 이제 앱으로 결제를 받아요.

w|pembayaran.text: Putri mengurus pembayaran alat-alat baru untuk laboratorium.
w|pembayaran.en: Putri handled the payment for the lab's new equipment.
w|pembayaran.ko: 푸트리는 실험실 새 장비 대금 지급을 맡았어요.

w|pembebasan.text: Di kelas sejarah, Andi belajar tentang perjuangan pembebasan dari penjajahan.
w|pembebasan.en: In history class, Andi learned about the struggle for liberation from colonial rule.
w|pembebasan.ko: 안디는 역사 시간에 식민 지배에서 벗어나려는 독립 투쟁을 배웠어요.

w|pembebasan.text: Pasien itu dirawat di sini setelah pembebasan para sandera kemarin.
w|pembebasan.en: The patient was treated here after yesterday's release of the hostages.
w|pembebasan.ko: 그 환자는 어제 인질들이 풀려난 뒤 이곳에서 치료를 받았어요.

w|pembedahan.text: Budi menyiapkan semua alat untuk pembedahan pagi ini.
w|pembedahan.en: Budi prepared all the instruments for this morning's surgery.
w|pembedahan.ko: 부디는 오늘 아침 수술에 쓸 기구를 모두 준비했어요.

w|pembedahan.text: Siti terbang ke kota lain untuk menemani pembedahan lutut ayahnya.
w|pembedahan.en: Siti flew to another city to be with her father for his knee surgery.
w|pembedahan.ko: 시티는 아버지의 무릎 수술 때 곁에 있으려고 다른 도시로 날아갔어요.

w|pembekuan.text: Berita utama hari ini membahas pembekuan izin usaha tambang.
w|pembekuan.en: Today's top story covers the suspension of mining business permits.
w|pembekuan.ko: 오늘 머리기사는 광산 사업 허가 동결을 다뤄요.

w|pembekuan.text: Dewi mengurus pembekuan sementara langganan internet di rumah lama.
w|pembekuan.en: Dewi arranged a temporary suspension of the internet subscription at the old house.
w|pembekuan.ko: 데위는 옛집 인터넷 서비스를 일시 정지해 두었어요.

w|pembela.text: Di tim sepak bola sekolah, Dimas bermain sebagai pembela.
w|pembela.en: On the school football team, Dimas plays as a defender.

w|pembela.text: Pelanggan setia menjadi pembela restoran Putri ketika ada ulasan jahat di internet.
w|pembela.en: Loyal customers defended Putri's restaurant when there was a nasty review online.
w|pembela.ko: 인터넷에 악성 리뷰가 올라오자 단골들이 푸트리네 식당 편을 들어 줬어요.

w|pembelaan.text: Dalam lomba debat, pembelaan Andi membuat juri terkesan.
w|pembelaan.en: In the debate contest, Andi's defense impressed the judges.
w|pembelaan.ko: 토론 대회에서 안디의 반론은 심사위원들에게 깊은 인상을 남겼어요.

w|pembelaan.text: Dewi tersenyum mendengar pembelaan adiknya yang memecahkan pot.
w|pembelaan.en: Dewi smiled hearing the excuse from her brother who broke the pot.
w|pembelaan.ko: 화분을 깬 동생의 변명을 듣고 데위는 웃었어요.

w|pembelajaran.text: Kesalahan pertama Rudi di dapur menjadi pembelajaran yang berharga.
w|pembelajaran.en: Rudi's first mistake in the kitchen became a valuable lesson.
w|pembelajaran.ko: 주방에서 한 루디의 첫 실수는 값진 배움이 됐어요.

w|pembelajaran.text: Menurut Rina, setiap tawar-menawar adalah pembelajaran.
w|pembelajaran.en: According to Rina, every bargaining session is a learning experience.

w|pembeli.text: Banyak pembeli memberi bintang lima untuk toko daring itu.
w|pembeli.en: Many buyers gave that online shop five stars.
w|pembeli.ko: 많은 구매자가 그 온라인 가게에 별 다섯 개를 줬어요.

w|pembeli.text: Lestari bermimpi kue buatannya suatu hari punya banyak pembeli.
w|pembeli.en: Lestari dreams that one day her cakes will have lots of buyers.
w|pembeli.ko: 레스타리는 언젠가 자기가 만든 케이크를 사는 사람이 많아지기를 꿈꿔요.

w|pembelian.text: Agus menyimpan struk pembelian kamera tua itu di dompetnya.
w|pembelian.en: Agus kept the receipt for the old camera purchase in his wallet.
w|pembelian.ko: 아구스는 낡은 카메라를 산 영수증을 지갑에 넣어 뒀어요.

w|pembelian.text: Wati menunda pembelian payung baru sampai musim hujan benar-benar datang.
w|pembelian.en: Wati put off buying a new umbrella until the rainy season really arrived.
w|pembelian.ko: 와티는 우기가 정말 올 때까지 새 우산 사는 걸 미뤘어요.

w|pembelot.text: Fajar sedang membaca novel sejarah tentang seorang pembelot pada masa perang.
w|pembelot.en: Fajar is reading a historical novel about a defector during the war.
w|pembelot.ko: 파자르는 전쟁 시기의 한 망명자에 관한 역사 소설을 읽고 있어요.

w|pembelot.text: Novel yang dibaca Lestari berkisah tentang seorang pembelot yang menyeberangi perbatasan.
w|pembelot.en: The novel Lestari is reading tells of a defector who crosses the border.
w|pembelot.ko: 레스타리가 읽는 소설은 국경을 넘는 한 망명자의 이야기예요.

w|pembentukan.text: Rudi ikut rapat tentang pembentukan unit patroli sepeda.
w|pembentukan.en: Rudi joined a meeting about forming a bicycle patrol unit.
w|pembentukan.ko: 루디는 자전거 순찰대를 만드는 일에 관한 회의에 참석했어요.

w|pembentukan.text: Rina menjelaskan pembentukan gigi pada anak anjing kepada pemiliknya.
w|pembentukan.en: Rina explained to the owner how a puppy's teeth form.
w|pembentukan.ko: 리나는 주인에게 강아지 이빨이 어떻게 자라는지 설명했어요.

w|pemberani.text: Pemberani itu menolong orang yang tenggelam.
w|pemberani.en: That brave person helped someone who was drowning.
w|pemberani.ko: 그 용감한 사람이 익사할 뻔한 이를 도왔어.

w|pemberani.text: Dia dikenal sebagai pemberani di desanya.
w|pemberani.en: He is known as a brave person in his village.

w|pemberhentian.text: Kabar pemberhentian puluhan pekerja membuat suasana pabrik tegang.
w|pemberhentian.en: News of dozens of workers being laid off made the mood at the factory tense.
w|pemberhentian.ko: 노동자 수십 명이 해고된다는 소식에 공장 분위기가 팽팽해졌어요.

w|pemberhentian.text: Putri menulis surat itu di halte, di pemberhentian terakhir bus kota.
w|pemberhentian.en: Putri writes the letter at the bus shelter, at the last stop of the city bus.
w|pemberhentian.ko: 푸트리는 시내버스 종점 정류장에서 그 편지를 써요.

w|pemberi.text: Andi selalu jadi pemberi kabar pertama kalau ada tetangga yang sakit.
w|pemberi.en: Andi is always the first to pass on the news when a neighbor is sick.
w|pemberi.ko: 이웃이 아프면 늘 안디가 제일 먼저 소식을 전해요.

w|pemberi.text: Sekolah musik tempat Dewi mengajar berterima kasih kepada para pemberi beasiswa.
w|pemberi.en: The music school where Dewi teaches thanked the scholarship donors.
w|pemberi.ko: 데위가 가르치는 음악 학교는 장학금 후원자들에게 감사를 전했어요.

w|pemberian.text: Jam tangan Agus adalah pemberian kakeknya saat dia masuk SMA.
w|pemberian.en: Agus's watch was a gift from his grandfather when he started high school.
w|pemberian.ko: 아구스의 손목시계는 고등학교에 들어갈 때 할아버지가 주신 거예요.

w|pemberian.text: Baju renang Wati yang biru adalah pemberian bibinya.
w|pemberian.en: Wati's blue swimsuit was a gift from her aunt.
w|pemberian.ko: 와티의 파란 수영복은 이모가 준 선물이에요.

w|pemberitahuan.text: Pagi ini Fajar baru menerima pemberitahuan bahwa sidang ditunda.
w|pemberitahuan.en: This morning Fajar only just received notice that the hearing had been postponed.
w|pemberitahuan.ko: 파자르는 오늘 아침에야 재판이 연기됐다는 통지를 받았어요.

w|pemberitahuan.text: Lestari menempelkan pemberitahuan di pintu bahwa warung tutup hari Minggu.
w|pemberitahuan.en: Lestari stuck a notice on the door saying the shop is closed on Sunday.
w|pemberitahuan.ko: 레스타리는 일요일에 가게가 쉰다는 안내문을 문에 붙였어요.

w|pemberontak.en: The rebels attacked a post at the border.
The army chased the rebels into the forest.

w|pemberontakan.text: Di lobi balai kota terpajang lukisan tentang pemberontakan rakyat melawan penjajah.
w|pemberontakan.en: In the city hall lobby hangs a painting of the people's uprising against the colonizers.
w|pemberontakan.ko: 시청 로비에는 식민 지배자에 맞선 민중 봉기를 그린 그림이 걸려 있어요.

w|pemberontakan.text: Wati sedang mempelajari lagu perjuangan tentang pemberontakan petani zaman dulu.
w|pemberontakan.en: Wati is learning a struggle song about a farmers' rebellion long ago.
w|pemberontakan.ko: 와티는 옛날 농민 봉기를 노래한 투쟁가를 배우고 있어요.

w|pembersih.text: Andi membeli cairan pembersih khusus untuk menghilangkan jamur di keramik.
w|pembersih.en: Andi bought a special cleaning liquid to remove mold from the tiles.
w|pembersih.ko: 안디는 타일의 곰팡이를 없애려고 전용 세정제를 샀어요.

w|pembersih.text: Petugas pembersih menyapu lantai gerbong setiap kali kereta berhenti lama.
w|pembersih.en: A cleaner sweeps the carriage floor every time the train stops for a long time.
w|pembersih.ko: 열차가 오래 설 때마다 청소원이 객차 바닥을 쓸어요.

w|pembersihan.text: Butuh seminggu penuh untuk pembersihan gudang yang sudah lama tidak dibuka.
w|pembersihan.en: It took a full week to clean out the storeroom that hadn't been opened in years.
w|pembersihan.ko: 오랫동안 안 열었던 창고를 치우는 데 꼬박 일주일이 걸렸어요.

w|pembersihan.text: Petugas melakukan pembersihan gerbong di stasiun akhir sebelum kereta berangkat lagi.
w|pembersihan.en: Staff clean the carriages at the last station before the train departs again.
w|pembersihan.ko: 직원들은 열차가 다시 출발하기 전 종착역에서 객차를 청소해요.

w|pembicara.text: Baru seminggu bekerja, Bayu sudah diminta menjadi pembicara di rapat bulanan.
w|pembicara.en: After just a week on the job, Bayu was asked to be a speaker at the monthly meeting.
w|pembicara.ko: 일한 지 겨우 일주일 만에 바유는 월례 회의 발표자를 맡게 됐어요.

w|pembicara.text: Gym itu mengundang pembicara tentang gizi untuk anggota baru.
w|pembicara.en: The gym invited a speaker on nutrition for new members.
w|pembicara.ko: 그 헬스장은 신규 회원을 위해 영양 강연자를 초대했어요.

w|pembicaraan.en: That discussion went on for a long time.
I quietly listened to their conversation.
w|pembicaraan.ko: 난 그들의 대화를 가만히 듣고 있었어.

w|pembimbing.text: Wartawan senior menjadi pembimbing Andi di tahun pertama.
w|pembimbing.en: A senior reporter was Andi's mentor in his first year.
w|pembimbing.ko: 선배 기자가 첫해 안디의 지도 선배였어요.

w|pembimbing.text: Dosen pembimbing Dewi mengirim ucapan selamat atas rumah baru.
w|pembimbing.en: Dewi's academic advisor sent congratulations on the new house.
w|pembimbing.ko: 데위의 지도 교수님이 새 집 축하 인사를 보냈어요.

w|pembom.text: Dimas berdiri lama di depan model pesawat pembom dari masa perang.
w|pembom.en: Dimas stood for a long time in front of a model wartime bomber plane.
w|pembom.ko: 디마스는 전쟁 때 폭격기 모형 앞에 오래 서 있었어요.

w|pembom.text: Film perang itu membutuhkan suara pesawat pembom yang terbang rendah.
w|pembom.en: That war film needs the sound of a bomber plane flying low.
w|pembom.ko: 그 전쟁 영화에는 낮게 나는 폭격기 소리가 필요해요.

w|pemboman.text: Lakon perang itu diawali suara pemboman yang membuat penonton terkejut.
w|pemboman.en: The war play opens with the sound of bombing that startles the audience.
w|pemboman.ko: 그 전쟁극은 관객을 놀라게 하는 폭격 소리로 시작해요.

w|pemboman.text: Kakek Ayu masih ingat suara pemboman di lembah saat perang dulu.
w|pemboman.en: Ayu's grandfather still remembers the sound of bombing in the valley during the war long ago.
w|pemboman.ko: 아유의 할아버지는 옛 전쟁 때 골짜기에 울리던 폭격 소리를 아직 기억해요.

w|pembuangan.text: Fajar memesan pipa baru karena saluran pembuangan di dapurnya bocor.
w|pembuangan.en: Fajar ordered a new pipe because the drain in his kitchen was leaking.
w|pembuangan.ko: 파자르는 부엌 배수관이 새서 새 파이프를 주문했어요.

w|pembuangan.text: Lemak bekas tidak boleh dibuang ke saluran pembuangan, kata guru.
w|pembuangan.en: Used fat must not be poured into the drain, the teacher said.
w|pembuangan.ko: 선생님은 쓴 기름을 배수구에 버리면 안 된다고 했어요.

w|pembuat.text: Pembuat film itu terkenal di seluruh dunia.
w|pembuat.en: That filmmaker is famous around the world.
w|pembuat.ko: 그 영화 제작자는 전 세계에 유명해.

w|pembuat.text: Dia adalah pembuat roti terbaik di kota.
w|pembuat.en: He is the best bread maker in town.
w|pembuat.ko: 그는 이 도시에서 최고의 빵 만드는 사람이야.

w|pembuatan.text: Budi menulis berita tentang pembuatan jalan tol yang terus tertunda.
w|pembuatan.en: Budi wrote about the construction of a toll road that keeps being delayed.
w|pembuatan.ko: 부디는 계속 늦어지는 고속도로 건설에 대한 기사를 썼어요.

w|pembuatan.text: Siti mengajak anak-anak ikut pembuatan buku cerita dari kertas bekas.
w|pembuatan.en: Siti invited the children to join in making storybooks from scrap paper.
w|pembuatan.ko: 시티는 아이들에게 폐지로 동화책 만들기를 같이 하자고 했어요.

w|pembuka.text: Andi mencari pembuka kaleng untuk membuka cat yang baru dibeli.
w|pembuka.en: Andi looks for a can opener to open the newly bought paint.
w|pembuka.ko: 안디는 새로 산 페인트를 따려고 깡통 따개를 찾아요.

w|pembuka.text: Pramugari kereta meminjamkan pembuka botol kepada Dewi.
w|pembuka.en: The train attendant lent Dewi a bottle opener.

w|pembukaan.text: Agus menyiapkan pidato untuk pembukaan festival kota.
w|pembukaan.en: Agus prepared a speech for the opening of the city festival.
w|pembukaan.ko: 아구스는 도시 축제 개막 연설을 준비했어요.

w|pembukaan.text: Wati diminta memainkan lagu pembukaan pada resital akhir tahun.
w|pembukaan.en: Wati was asked to play the opening piece at the year-end recital.
w|pembukaan.ko: 와티는 연말 발표회에서 첫 곡을 연주하게 됐어요.

w|pembukuan.text: Istri Rudi membantu pembukuan restoran setiap akhir bulan.
w|pembukuan.en: Rudi's wife helps with the restaurant's bookkeeping at the end of every month.
w|pembukuan.ko: 루디의 아내는 매달 말 식당 장부 정리를 도와요.

w|pembukuan.text: Rina mencatat pembukuan lapak di buku tulis kecil.
w|pembukuan.en: Rina keeps the stall's accounts in a small notebook.
w|pembukuan.ko: 리나는 작은 공책에 노점 장부를 적어요.

w|pembuluh.text: Olahraga rutin membantu menjaga kesehatan pembuluh darah.
w|pembuluh.en: Regular exercise helps keep the blood vessels healthy.
w|pembuluh.ko: 꾸준한 운동은 혈관 건강을 지키는 데 도움이 돼요.

w|pembuluh.text: Kata dokter, makanan terlalu asin bisa merusak pembuluh darah kakek Intan.
w|pembuluh.en: The doctor said overly salty food could damage the blood vessels of Intan's grandfather.
w|pembuluh.ko: 의사는 너무 짠 음식이 인탄 할아버지의 혈관을 상하게 할 수 있다고 했어요.

w|pembunuh.en: The killer is still on the run.
The police are looking for that killer.

w|pembunuhan.text: Polisi sedang menyelidiki kasus pembunuhan itu.
w|pembunuhan.en: The police are investigating that murder case.
w|pembunuhan.ko: 경찰이 그 살인 사건을 조사 중이야.

w|pembunuhan.text: Berita pembunuhan itu mengejutkan semua orang.
w|pembunuhan.ko: 그 살인 소식은 모두를 충격에 빠뜨렸어.

w|pemburu.text: Pemburu itu menunggu diam di balik semak.
w|pemburu.en: That hunter waited quietly behind the bushes.
w|pemburu.ko: 그 사냥꾼은 덤불 뒤에서 조용히 기다렸어.

w|pemburu.text: Seekor rusa lari dari pemburu di hutan.
w|pemburu.en: A deer ran from the hunter in the forest.
w|pemburu.ko: 사슴 한 마리가 숲속 사냥꾼에게서 달아났어.

w|pemecah.text: Dimas memakai alat pemecah tablet untuk membagi obat anak.
w|pemecah.en: Dimas uses a pill splitter to divide children's medicine.
w|pemecah.ko: 디마스는 알약 분할기로 어린이 약을 나눠요.

w|pemecah.text: Putri menyewa mesin pemecah beton untuk membongkar lantai lama.
w|pemecah.en: Putri rented a concrete breaker to tear up the old floor.
w|pemecah.ko: 푸트리는 옛 바닥을 뜯으려고 콘크리트 파쇄기를 빌렸어요.

w|pemegang.text: Rudi bertugas sebagai pemegang cincin selama akad nikah.
w|pemegang.en: Rudi had the job of ring bearer during the marriage ceremony.
w|pemegang.ko: 루디는 혼인 서약 동안 반지를 들고 있는 역할을 맡았어요.

w|pemegang.text: Rina mewawancarai pemegang saham terbesar pabrik gula itu.
w|pemegang.en: Rina interviewed the largest shareholder of the sugar factory.
w|pemegang.ko: 리나는 그 설탕 공장의 최대 주주를 인터뷰했어요.

w|pemeliharaan.text: Pengelola apartemen menagih biaya pemeliharaan setiap bulan.
w|pemeliharaan.en: The apartment management charges a maintenance fee every month.
w|pemeliharaan.ko: 아파트 관리 사무소는 매달 관리비를 걷어요.

w|pemeliharaan.text: Wati menyisihkan uang untuk pemeliharaan dapur setiap tahun.
w|pemeliharaan.en: Wati sets aside money for kitchen maintenance every year.
w|pemeliharaan.ko: 와티는 해마다 주방 유지 보수를 위해 돈을 따로 모아요.

w|pemenang.en: The winner will get a big prize.
Who was the winner of that match?

w|pemeran.text: Fajar menyewa pemeran badut untuk menghibur anak-anak di pesta pernikahannya.
w|pemeran.en: Fajar hired a clown performer to entertain the children at his wedding party.
w|pemeran.ko: 파자르는 결혼식 파티에서 아이들을 즐겁게 해 줄 광대 공연자를 불렀어요.

w|pemeran.text: Lestari mewawancarai pemeran utama film yang sedang ramai dibicarakan.
w|pemeran.en: Lestari interviewed the lead actor of the film everyone is talking about.
w|pemeran.ko: 레스타리는 요즘 화제인 영화의 주연 배우를 인터뷰했어요.

w|pemerasan.text: Guru BK menjelaskan bahwa meminta uang dengan ancaman termasuk pemerasan.
w|pemerasan.en: The counselor explained that demanding money with threats counts as extortion.
w|pemerasan.ko: 상담 선생님은 협박해서 돈을 뜯는 건 갈취라고 설명했어요.

w|pemerasan.text: Putri melaporkan kasus pemerasan oleh preman ke polisi.
w|pemerasan.en: Putri reported the extortion by thugs to the police.

w|pemeriksa.text: Andi menemani pemeriksa bangunan berkeliling lantai atas.
w|pemeriksa.en: Andi accompanied the building inspector around the upper floor.
w|pemeriksa.ko: 안디는 건물 검사관과 함께 위층을 둘러봤어요.

w|pemeriksa.text: Rina, sahabat Dewi, kini bekerja sebagai pemeriksa pajak.
w|pemeriksa.en: Rina, Dewi's best friend, now works as a tax auditor.
w|pemeriksa.ko: 데위의 단짝 리나는 지금 세무 조사관으로 일해요.

w|pemeriksaan.en: Health checkups are held every year.
The checkup results come out tomorrow morning.

w|pemerintah.en: The government issued a new regulation.

w|pemerintahan.en: The new government focuses on education.
The system of government is being reformed.

w|pemerkosa.text: Di akhir drama ruang sidang itu, hakim menjatuhkan hukuman berat kepada pemerkosa yang diadili.
w|pemerkosa.en: At the end of the courtroom drama, the judge hands a heavy sentence to the rapist on trial.
w|pemerkosa.ko: 그 법정극 마지막에 판사는 재판받는 강간범에게 중형을 선고해요.

w|pemerkosa.text: Koran di toko Ayu memberitakan bahwa pemerkosa yang buron itu akhirnya ditangkap polisi.
w|pemerkosa.en: The newspaper at Ayu's shop reported that the fugitive rapist was finally caught by police.
w|pemerkosa.ko: 아유 가게의 신문에 도주 중이던 강간범이 마침내 경찰에 잡혔다는 기사가 났어요.

w|pemesanan.text: Sistem pemesanan kamar sempat bermasalah tadi malam.
w|pemesanan.en: The room booking system had problems last night.
w|pemesanan.ko: 어젯밤에 객실 예약 시스템에 문제가 좀 있었어요.

w|pemesanan.text: Menjelang musim liburan, pemesanan tiket kereta melonjak tajam.
w|pemesanan.en: As the holiday season approaches, train ticket bookings jump sharply.
w|pemesanan.ko: 휴가철이 다가오면 기차표 예매가 크게 늘어요.

w|pemicu.text: Kata Bu Guru, ejekan kecil bisa jadi pemicu perkelahian antarmurid.
w|pemicu.en: The teacher said small teasing can trigger fights between students.
w|pemicu.ko: 선생님은 작은 놀림이 학생들 사이 싸움의 불씨가 될 수 있다고 했어요.

w|pemicu.text: Petasan sering jadi pemicu kebakaran di malam tahun baru, jadi Dewi melarangnya.
w|pemicu.en: Firecrackers often cause fires on New Year's Eve, so Dewi banned them.
w|pemicu.ko: 폭죽은 새해 전날 밤 화재의 원인이 되기 쉬워서 데위는 금지했어요.

w|pemikiran.en: His thinking is very deep and clear.

w|pemikiran.text: Kami menghargai setiap pemikiran yang berbeda.
w|pemikiran.en: We value every different way of thinking.
w|pemikiran.ko: 우리는 서로 다른 생각을 모두 존중해.

w|pemilih.text: Drama satire itu menyindir politikus yang hanya mendekati pemilih menjelang pemilu.
w|pemilih.en: The satirical play mocks politicians who only approach voters right before elections.
w|pemilih.ko: 그 풍자극은 선거 직전에만 유권자에게 다가가는 정치인을 비꼬아요.

w|pemilih.text: Menjelang pemilu, para pemilih sering membicarakan calon kepala desa di toko Ayu.
w|pemilih.en: Before the election, voters often discuss the village head candidates in Ayu's shop.
w|pemilih.ko: 선거를 앞두고 유권자들은 아유의 가게에서 이장 후보들 이야기를 자주 해요.

w|pemilihan.text: Pemilihan ketua kelas digelar siang ini.
w|pemilihan.en: The class president election is held this afternoon.

w|pemilihan.text: Hasil pemilihan diumumkan di papan pengumuman.
w|pemilihan.en: The election results were posted on the notice board.

w|pemilu.text: Menjelang pemilu, aplikasi belanja itu penuh iklan bendera dan stiker.
w|pemilu.en: Ahead of the election, that shopping app was full of ads for flags and stickers.
w|pemilu.ko: 선거를 앞두고 그 쇼핑 앱은 깃발과 스티커 광고로 가득했어요.

w|pemilu.text: Kelas masak diliburkan pada hari pemilu supaya semua bisa memilih.
w|pemilu.en: The cooking class was cancelled on election day so everyone could vote.
w|pemilu.ko: 선거일에는 모두 투표할 수 있게 요리 수업이 쉬었어요.

w|pemindahan.text: Pergantian babak membutuhkan pemindahan dekorasi yang cepat oleh kru panggung.
w|pemindahan.en: Changing acts requires the stage crew to move the sets quickly.
w|pemindahan.ko: 막이 바뀔 때는 무대 스태프가 세트를 빨리 옮겨야 해요.

w|pemindahan.text: Penjualan Ayu naik setelah pemindahan rak minuman ke dekat pintu.
w|pemindahan.en: Ayu's sales went up after the drinks shelf was moved near the door.
w|pemindahan.ko: 음료 진열대를 문 가까이 옮긴 뒤 아유의 매출이 올랐어요.

w|pemindai.text: Mesin pemindai di kantor rusak, jadi Fajar memotret dokumen dengan ponsel.
w|pemindai.en: The office scanner was broken, so Fajar photographed the documents with his phone.
w|pemindai.ko: 사무실 스캐너가 고장 나서 파자르는 휴대폰으로 문서를 찍었어요.

w|pemindai.text: Petugas gerbang tol memeriksa kartu Lestari dengan pemindai baru.
w|pemindai.en: The toll gate officer checked Lestari's card with a new scanner.
w|pemindai.ko: 톨게이트 직원이 새 스캐너로 레스타리의 카드를 확인했어요.

w|pemindaian.text: Andi meminta pemindaian dinding untuk mencari pipa yang tersembunyi.
w|pemindaian.en: Andi requested a scan of the wall to look for hidden pipes.
w|pemindaian.ko: 안디는 숨은 배관을 찾으려고 벽 스캔을 요청했어요.

w|pemindaian.text: Dewi membawa hasil pemindaian foto-foto lama dari zaman sekolah.
w|pemindaian.en: Dewi brought scanned copies of old photos from their school days.
w|pemindaian.ko: 데위는 학창 시절 옛 사진을 스캔한 파일을 가져왔어요.

w|peminum.text: Bayu bukan peminum kopi, jadi selalu membawa teh ke kantor.
w|peminum.en: Bayu isn't a coffee drinker, so he always brings tea to the office.
w|peminum.ko: 바유는 커피를 안 마셔서 늘 차를 회사에 가져와요.

w|peminum.text: Dulu Intan seorang peminum soda berat sebelum rajin ke gym.
w|peminum.en: Intan used to be a heavy soda drinker before she started going to the gym regularly.
w|peminum.ko: 인탄은 헬스장에 꾸준히 다니기 전엔 탄산음료를 엄청 마셨어요.

w|pemirsa.text: Pernikahan Fajar disiarkan langsung lewat internet untuk kerabat yang tidak bisa datang, dan pemirsa terus mengirim ucapan selamat.
w|pemirsa.en: Fajar's wedding was streamed live online for relatives who couldn't come, and viewers kept sending congratulations.
w|pemirsa.ko: 파자르의 결혼식은 오지 못한 친척들을 위해 인터넷으로 생중계됐고, 시청자들이 계속 축하 메시지를 보냈어요.

w|pemirsa.text: Penyiar berita malam itu menyapa pemirsa dengan senyum lebar.
w|pemirsa.en: The evening news anchor greeted viewers with a big smile.
w|pemirsa.ko: 저녁 뉴스 앵커가 환한 미소로 시청자들에게 인사했어요.

w|pemisahan.text: Petugas melakukan pemisahan antara barang bukti dan barang pribadi milik tersangka.
w|pemisahan.en: The officers separated the evidence from the suspect's personal belongings.
w|pemisahan.ko: 경찰관들은 증거물과 피의자의 개인 소지품을 따로 나눴어요.

w|pemisahan.text: Panitia membuat pemisahan jalur antara pelari maraton penuh dan setengah maraton.
w|pemisahan.en: The organizers separated the lanes for full marathon and half marathon runners.
w|pemisahan.ko: 주최 측은 풀코스 주자와 하프 마라톤 주자의 길을 나눴어요.

w|pemogokan.text: Andi meliput pemogokan buruh pelabuhan sejak subuh.
w|pemogokan.en: Andi has been covering the dockworkers' strike since dawn.
w|pemogokan.ko: 안디는 새벽부터 항만 노동자 파업을 취재하고 있어요.

w|pemogokan.text: Pindahan Dewi tertunda karena pemogokan sopir truk.
w|pemogokan.en: Dewi's move was delayed because of a truck drivers' strike.
w|pemogokan.ko: 트럭 기사 파업 때문에 데위의 이사가 미뤄졌어요.

w|pemotong.text: Tukang kebun gedung mendorong mesin pemotong rumput di taman belakang.
w|pemotong.en: The building's gardener pushed the lawn mower in the back garden.
w|pemotong.ko: 건물 정원사가 뒷마당에서 잔디 깎는 기계를 밀었어요.

w|pemotong.text: Wati meminjam pemotong dahan untuk merapikan pohon mangga sebelum angin kencang datang.
w|pemotong.en: Wati borrowed a branch cutter to trim the mango tree before the strong winds came.
w|pemotong.ko: 와티는 강풍이 오기 전에 망고나무를 다듬으려고 가지치기 가위를 빌렸어요.

w|pemotongan.text: Gara-gara pemotongan anggaran, Agus harus mencari bahan yang lebih murah.
w|pemotongan.en: Because of budget cuts, Agus has to find cheaper materials.
w|pemotongan.ko: 예산 삭감 때문에 아구스는 더 싼 자재를 찾아야 해요.

w|pemotongan.text: Wati baru sadar ada pemotongan biaya ongkir saat memakai kode promo.
w|pemotongan.en: Wati only realized there was a shipping discount when she used the promo code.
w|pemotongan.ko: 와티는 프로모 코드를 쓰고 나서야 배송비가 깎인 걸 알았어요.

w|pemotretan.text: Rudi ikut sesi pemotretan untuk kalender kantor polisi tahun depan.
w|pemotretan.en: Rudi took part in the photo shoot for next year's police station calendar.
w|pemotretan.ko: 루디는 내년 경찰서 달력에 쓸 사진 촬영에 참여했어요.

w|pemotretan.text: Seusai lomba, Rina ikut pemotretan bersama teman-teman klub larinya.
w|pemotretan.en: After the race, Rina joined a photo shoot with her running club friends.
w|pemotretan.ko: 경기가 끝나고 리나는 달리기 동호회 친구들과 사진 촬영을 했어요.

w|pemuda.en: That young man helped the grandmother cross.
w|pemuda.ko: 그 청년이 할머니의 길 건너기를 도와줬어.

w|pemuda.text: Banyak pemuda bergabung dalam kegiatan desa.
w|pemuda.en: Many youths joined the village activities.

w|pemujaan.text: Andi meneliti tradisi pemujaan leluhur di berbagai suku untuk tugas kuliahnya.
w|pemujaan.en: Andi researched traditions of ancestor worship among various ethnic groups for his college assignment.
w|pemujaan.ko: 안디는 대학 과제로 여러 종족의 조상 숭배 전통을 조사했어요.

w|pemujaan.text: Di loteng rumah baru, Dewi menemukan buku tua tentang pemujaan dewi padi.
w|pemujaan.en: In the attic of the new house, Dewi found an old book about the worship of the rice goddess.
w|pemujaan.ko: 데위는 새집 다락에서 벼의 여신 숭배에 관한 오래된 책을 찾았어요.

w|pemukul.text: Dalam pertandingan kasti, Rudi menjadi pemukul terakhir timnya.
w|pemukul.en: In the rounders match, Rudi was his team's last batter.
w|pemukul.ko: 카스티 경기에서 루디는 팀의 마지막 타자였어요.

w|pemukul.text: Rina memakai pemukul kasur dari rotan untuk membersihkan karpet lama.
w|pemukul.en: Rina used a rattan carpet beater to clean the old rug.
w|pemukul.ko: 리나는 등나무 먼지떨이로 오래된 카펫을 털었어요.

w|pemukulan.text: Rekaman kamera jalan menjadi bukti utama dalam kasus pemukulan sopir angkot.
w|pemukulan.en: Street camera footage became the main evidence in the case of the minibus driver's beating.
w|pemukulan.ko: 거리 카메라 영상이 미니버스 기사 폭행 사건의 핵심 증거가 됐어요.

w|pemukulan.text: Para tamu terkejut melihat berita pemukulan wasit di televisi restoran.
w|pemukulan.en: The guests were shocked to see news of a referee being beaten on the restaurant TV.
w|pemukulan.ko: 손님들은 식당 텔레비전에서 심판 폭행 소식을 보고 놀랐어요.

w|pemula.text: Wartawan pemula di koran itu biasanya ditugaskan meliput berita kriminal kecil.
w|pemula.en: Beginner reporters at that paper are usually assigned to cover minor crime news.
w|pemula.ko: 그 신문사 신입 기자는 보통 작은 사건 기사를 맡아요.

w|pemula.text: Ayu mengajari teknisi pemula cara membuka casing tanpa merusak klip.
w|pemula.en: Ayu teaches beginner technicians how to open a case without breaking the clips.
w|pemula.ko: 아유는 초보 기술자에게 걸쇠를 부러뜨리지 않고 케이스 여는 법을 가르쳐요.

w|pemulihan.text: Setelah operasi, Bayu mengikuti program pemulihan khusus di gym.
w|pemulihan.en: After surgery, Bayu followed a special recovery program at the gym.
w|pemulihan.ko: 수술 후 바유는 헬스장에서 특별 회복 프로그램을 받았어요.

w|pemulihan.text: Makan malam itu merayakan pemulihan ayah Intan setelah lama sakit.
w|pemulihan.en: The dinner celebrates the recovery of Intan's father after a long illness.
w|pemulihan.ko: 그 저녁 식사는 오래 아팠던 인탄 아버지의 회복을 축하하는 자리예요.

w|pemungutan.text: Polisi sedang menyelidiki pemungutan liar terhadap sopir truk di pelabuhan.
w|pemungutan.en: The police are investigating illegal levies on truck drivers at the port.
w|pemungutan.ko: 경찰은 항구에서 트럭 기사들에게 걷는 불법 징수를 조사하고 있어요.

w|pemungutan.text: Panitia mengadakan pemungutan suara untuk memilih desain kaus lomba tahun depan.
w|pemungutan.en: The organizers held a vote to choose next year's race shirt design.
w|pemungutan.ko: 주최 측은 내년 대회 티셔츠 디자인을 고르려고 투표를 했어요.

w|pemusnah.text: Dalam drama fiksi ilmiah itu, para ilmuwan berlomba menghentikan senjata pemusnah dari luar angkasa.
w|pemusnah.en: In that science-fiction play, the scientists race to stop a weapon of destruction from outer space.
w|pemusnah.ko: 그 공상 과학 연극에서 과학자들은 우주에서 온 파괴 무기를 막으려고 서둘러요.

w|pemusnah.text: Di stasiun, Ayu melihat poster film tentang senjata pemusnah massal.
w|pemusnah.en: At the station, Ayu saw a poster for a film about weapons of mass destruction.
w|pemusnah.ko: 아유는 역에서 대량 살상 무기에 관한 영화 포스터를 봤어요.

w|pemusnahan.text: Babak kedua menggambarkan pemusnahan kampung oleh pasukan penjajah.
w|pemusnahan.en: The second act depicts the destruction of a village by colonial troops.
w|pemusnahan.ko: 이막은 침략군이 마을을 없애 버리는 장면을 그려요.

w|pemusnahan.text: Kereta melewati pabrik tempat pemusnahan barang selundupan dilakukan setiap tahun.
w|pemusnahan.en: The train passed the factory where smuggled goods are destroyed every year.
w|pemusnahan.ko: 열차는 해마다 밀수품을 폐기하는 공장 옆을 지나갔어요.

w|pemutar.text: Agus masih menyimpan pemutar piringan hitam milik ayahnya.
w|pemutar.en: Agus still keeps his father's record player.
w|pemutar.ko: 아구스는 아직도 아버지의 레코드플레이어를 간직하고 있어요.

w|pemutar.text: Lagu-lagu lama mengalun dari pemutar musik di sudut rumah makan.
w|pemutar.en: Old songs drift from the music player in the corner of the restaurant.
w|pemutar.ko: 식당 구석의 음악 플레이어에서 옛 노래가 흘러나와요.

w|pena.text: Dia menulis catatan dengan pena biru.
w|pena.en: She wrote notes with a blue pen.

w|pena.text: Pena itu kehabisan tinta di tengah ujian.
w|pena.en: That pen ran out of ink mid-exam.
w|pena.ko: 그 펜은 시험 도중에 잉크가 떨어졌어.

w|penahan.text: Dimas memperhatikan tali penahan yang menjaga pengunjung tetap jauh dari patung.
w|penahan.en: Dimas noticed the barrier rope that keeps visitors away from the statue.
w|penahan.ko: 디마스는 관람객이 조각상에 가까이 가지 못하게 막는 줄을 눈여겨봤어요.

w|penahan.text: Kru memasang balok penahan supaya dinding set tidak roboh.
w|penahan.en: The crew put up a support beam so the set wall wouldn't fall down.
w|penahan.ko: 스태프들은 세트 벽이 무너지지 않게 버팀목을 댔어요.

w|penahanan.text: Fajar mengajukan keberatan atas penahanan kliennya yang terlalu lama.
w|penahanan.en: Fajar objected to his client's overly long detention.
w|penahanan.ko: 파자르는 의뢰인의 구금이 너무 길다며 이의를 제기했어요.

w|penahanan.text: Lestari membaca berita tentang penahanan seorang pejabat di koran yang dijualnya.
w|penahanan.en: Lestari read news about an official's detention in a newspaper she sells.
w|penahanan.ko: 레스타리는 자기가 파는 신문에서 한 공무원이 구금됐다는 기사를 읽었어요.

w|penakluk.text: Patung perunggu di tengah aula menggambarkan seorang penakluk yang menunggang kuda.
w|penakluk.en: The bronze statue in the middle of the hall depicts a conqueror on horseback.
w|penakluk.ko: 홀 한가운데 청동상은 말을 탄 정복자를 나타내요.

w|penakluk.text: Putri memerankan istri seorang penakluk yang kesepian di istana.
w|penakluk.en: Putri plays the lonely wife of a conqueror in the palace.
w|penakluk.ko: 푸트리는 궁전에서 외롭게 지내는 정복자의 아내 역을 맡았어요.

w|penakut.text: Rudi dicap penakut oleh sepupunya karena tidak berani berpidato di depan tamu.
w|penakut.en: Rudi was called a coward by his cousins because he didn't dare give a speech in front of the guests.
w|penakut.ko: 루디는 손님들 앞에서 연설할 엄두를 못 내서 사촌들에게 겁쟁이 소리를 들었어요.

w|penakut.text: Dulu Rina penakut, tetapi sekarang dia berani meliput di daerah banjir.
w|penakut.en: Rina used to be a scaredy-cat, but now she dares to report from flooded areas.
w|penakut.ko: 리나는 예전엔 겁쟁이였지만 이제는 홍수 지역 취재도 해요.

w|penalti.text: Saat jaga malam, Rudi menonton tendangan penalti di televisi pos jaga.
w|penalti.en: On night duty, Rudi watched the penalty kick on the guard post's TV.
w|penalti.ko: 야간 근무 중에 루디는 초소 텔레비전으로 페널티킥을 봤어요.

w|penalti.text: Rina menonton adu penalti di ponsel sambil menunggu hasil tes darah.
w|penalti.en: Rina watched the penalty shootout on her phone while waiting for the blood test results.
w|penalti.ko: 리나는 혈액 검사 결과를 기다리며 휴대폰으로 승부차기를 봤어요.

w|penambang.text: Ayah Eko dulu seorang penambang timah sebelum membuka warung makan.
w|penambang.en: Eko's father was a tin miner before opening a small eatery.
w|penambang.ko: 에코의 아버지는 작은 밥집을 열기 전에 주석 광부였어요.

w|penambang.text: Ayu menonton berita tentang penambang pasir yang berhenti bekerja karena sungai meluap.
w|penambang.en: Ayu watched news about sand miners who stopped working because the river overflowed.
w|penambang.ko: 아유는 강이 넘쳐 일을 멈춘 모래 채취꾼들에 관한 뉴스를 봤어요.

w|penampakan.text: Ada cerita tentang penampakan hantu di toilet lama sekolah Dimas.
w|penampakan.en: There's a story about a ghost sighting in the old toilet at Dimas's school.
w|penampakan.ko: 디마스 학교 옛 화장실에서 귀신을 봤다는 이야기가 있어요.

w|penampakan.text: Pelanggan bercerita tentang penampakan bayangan aneh di gudang restoran, tapi Putri hanya tertawa.
w|penampakan.en: A customer talked about a strange shadow sighting in the restaurant storeroom, but Putri just laughed.
w|penampakan.ko: 손님이 식당 창고에서 이상한 그림자를 봤다고 했지만 푸트리는 그냥 웃었어요.

w|penampilan.en: Their first performance was very impressive.
She took care of her appearance before the interview.
w|penampilan.ko: 그는 면접 전에 외모를 신경 썼어.

w|penampungan.text: Kelas Rudi mengumpulkan pakaian bekas untuk penampungan korban banjir.
w|penampungan.en: Rudi's class collected used clothes for the flood victims' shelter.
w|penampungan.ko: 루디네 반은 수재민 대피소에 보낼 헌 옷을 모았어요.

w|penampungan.text: Kucing liar yang sering datang akhirnya Rina antar ke penampungan hewan.
w|penampungan.en: Rina finally took the stray cat that often came by to an animal shelter.
w|penampungan.ko: 자주 찾아오던 길고양이를 리나는 결국 동물 보호소에 데려다줬어요.

w|penanda.text: Budi menempelkan kertas kuning sebagai penanda halaman penting di bukunya.
w|penanda.en: Budi stuck yellow paper in his book as a marker for important pages.
w|penanda.ko: 부디는 책의 중요한 쪽에 노란 종이를 붙여 표시했어요.

w|penanda.text: Siti mengikat pita merah sebagai penanda kopernya.
w|penanda.en: Siti tied a red ribbon as a marker on her suitcase.
w|penanda.ko: 시티는 자기 캐리어를 알아보려고 빨간 리본을 묶었어요.

w|penanganan.text: Rudi mengikuti pelatihan penanganan makanan yang higienis.
w|penanganan.en: Rudi attended training on hygienic food handling.
w|penanganan.ko: 루디는 위생적인 식품 취급 교육을 받았어요.

w|penanganan.text: Keramik kuno itu butuh penanganan hati-hati, jadi Rina membungkus dengan koran tebal.
w|penanganan.en: The ancient ceramic needs careful handling, so Rina wrapped it in thick newspaper.
w|penanganan.ko: 그 옛 도자기는 조심히 다뤄야 해서 리나는 두꺼운 신문지로 감쌌어요.

w|penangkal.text: Rudi selalu menyimpan serum penangkal bisa ular di lemari pendingin.
w|penangkal.en: Rudi always keeps snake antivenom serum in the refrigerator.
w|penangkal.ko: 루디는 늘 뱀독 해독 혈청을 냉장고에 보관해요.

w|penangkal.text: Nenek Rina percaya daun sirih adalah penangkal masuk angin yang ampuh.
w|penangkal.en: Rina's grandmother believes betel leaf is a powerful remedy against colds.
w|penangkal.ko: 리나의 할머니는 구장 잎이 감기를 막는 데 아주 좋다고 믿어요.

w|penangkap.text: Di buku tentang serangga, Andi melihat gambar laba-laba sebagai penangkap nyamuk alami.
w|penangkap.en: In a book about insects, Andi saw a picture of a spider as a natural mosquito catcher.
w|penangkap.ko: 곤충 책에서 안디는 천연 모기 사냥꾼인 거미 그림을 봤어요.

w|penangkap.text: Dewi menemukan alat penangkap tikus tua di gudang rumah barunya.
w|penangkap.en: Dewi found an old mousetrap in the storeroom of her new house.
w|penangkap.ko: 데위는 새집 창고에서 오래된 쥐덫을 찾았어요.

w|penangkapan.en: The arrest of the suspect was made at dawn.
News of that arrest spread quickly.

w|penantang.text: Dalam turnamen catur kantor, Bayu menjadi penantang juara bertahan.
w|penantang.en: In the office chess tournament, Bayu became the challenger to the reigning champion.
w|penantang.ko: 회사 체스 대회에서 바유는 디펜딩 챔피언의 도전자가 됐어요.

w|penantang.text: Intan menjadi penantang juara lomba lari di gym itu.
w|penantang.en: Intan became the challenger to the running champion at that gym.
w|penantang.ko: 인탄은 그 헬스장 달리기 챔피언의 도전자가 됐어요.

w|penari.text: Banyak penari tampil di panggung malam ini.
w|penari.en: Many dancers performed on stage tonight.
w|penari.ko: 오늘 밤 무대에 무용수가 많이 나왔어.

w|penasaran.en: Curiosity made him open that box.
w|penasaran.ko: 호기심 때문에 그가 그 상자를 열었어.

w|penasihat.text: Pemilik restoran menyewa seorang penasihat keuangan agar biaya bahan tidak membengkak.
w|penasihat.en: The restaurant owner hired a financial adviser so ingredient costs wouldn't balloon.
w|penasihat.ko: 식당 주인은 재료비가 불어나지 않도록 재무 자문가를 고용했어요.

w|penasihat.text: Pak Darto, penasihat panitia pasar loak, mengatur letak setiap lapak.
w|penasihat.en: Mr. Darto, the flea market committee's adviser, arranges where each stall goes.
w|penasihat.ko: 벼룩시장 위원회 고문인 다르토 씨가 노점 자리를 정해요.

w|penata.text: Andi bekerja sama dengan penata taman untuk halaman depan gedung.
w|penata.en: Andi works with a landscaper on the building's front yard.
w|penata.ko: 안디는 건물 앞마당 일로 조경사와 함께 일해요.

w|penata.text: Rina sekarang bekerja sebagai penata rambut, dan Dewi langsung minta nomor teleponnya.
w|penata.en: Rina now works as a hairstylist, and Dewi immediately asked for her number.
w|penata.ko: 리나가 지금 미용사로 일한다고 해서 데위는 바로 전화번호를 물었어요.

w|penawar.text: Dokter mencari penawar untuk racun itu.
w|penawar.en: The doctor looked for an antidote to that poison.

w|penawar.text: Penawar rasa takut adalah pengalaman nyata.
w|penawar.en: The antidote to fear is real experience.

w|penawaran.text: Penawaran spesial berlaku hingga akhir bulan.
w|penawaran.en: The special offer is valid until the end of the month.

w|penawaran.text: Mereka menolak penawaran dari perusahaan asing.
w|penawaran.en: They rejected the offer from the foreign company.

w|pencapaian.text: Penghargaan koki muda adalah pencapaian terbesar Eko sejauh ini.
w|pencapaian.en: The young chef award is Eko's biggest achievement so far.
w|pencapaian.ko: 젊은 요리사상은 지금까지 에코가 이룬 가장 큰 성과예요.

w|pencapaian.text: Bagi Ayu, menanam sayur yang bertahan sepanjang kemarau adalah sebuah pencapaian.
w|pencapaian.en: For Ayu, growing vegetables that survive the whole dry season is an achievement.
w|pencapaian.ko: 아유에게는 건기 내내 버티는 채소를 키운 것이 하나의 성과예요.

w|pencari.text: Saat itu Budi masih pencari kerja dan sering di rumah seharian.
w|pencari.en: At the time Budi was still a job seeker and was often home all day.
w|pencari.ko: 그때 부디는 아직 구직자라서 하루 종일 집에 있을 때가 많았어요.

w|pencari.text: Rumah lama Siti kini diincar banyak pencari kos karena dekat kampus.
w|pencari.en: Siti's old house is now sought after by many room hunters because it's near campus.
w|pencari.ko: 시티의 예전 집은 캠퍼스와 가까워서 지금 하숙방을 찾는 사람들이 많이 노려요.

w|pencarian.en: The search for victims is still ongoing.
The search results appeared on the screen.

w|pencegahan.text: Pemanasan yang cukup adalah cara pencegahan cedera paling mudah.
w|pencegahan.en: Proper warming up is the easiest way to prevent injury.
w|pencegahan.ko: 충분한 준비 운동이 부상을 막는 가장 쉬운 방법이에요.

w|pencegahan.text: Restoran itu memasang poster tentang pencegahan demam berdarah di dekat kasir.
w|pencegahan.en: The restaurant put up a poster about dengue prevention near the cashier.
w|pencegahan.ko: 그 식당은 계산대 옆에 뎅기열 예방 포스터를 붙였어요.

w|pencerahan.text: Bagi Eko, teater bisa membawa pencerahan bagi masyarakat.
w|pencerahan.en: For Eko, theater can bring enlightenment to society.
w|pencerahan.ko: 에코에게 연극은 사회에 깨달음을 줄 수 있는 것이에요.

w|pencerahan.text: Penyuluh pertanian membawa pencerahan soal cara menanam kopi yang lebih baik.
w|pencerahan.en: The agricultural extension worker brought new insight on better ways to grow coffee.
w|pencerahan.ko: 농업 지도사가 커피를 더 잘 기르는 방법에 대해 새로운 깨우침을 줬어요.

w|pencernaan.text: Fajar menyarankan probiotik untuk membantu pencernaan.
w|pencernaan.en: Fajar recommended probiotics to help with digestion.

w|pencernaan.text: Rekan baru itu membawa yoghurt setiap hari demi pencernaan yang lancar.
w|pencernaan.en: The new coworker brings yogurt every day for smooth digestion.
w|pencernaan.ko: 새 동료는 소화가 잘되라고 매일 요구르트를 가져와요.

w|pencipta.text: Lagu yang dinyanyikan di pelaminan itu ternyata karya pencipta lagu dari desa Rudi.
w|pencipta.en: The song sung at the wedding dais turned out to be by a songwriter from Rudi's village.
w|pencipta.ko: 신랑 신부 단상에서 부른 노래는 알고 보니 루디네 마을 작곡가의 곡이었어요.

w|pencipta.text: Rina mewawancarai pencipta aplikasi belajar mengaji yang sedang naik daun.
w|pencipta.en: Rina interviewed the creator of a Quran-reading app that's growing in popularity.
w|pencipta.ko: 리나는 요즘 뜨는 꾸란 읽기 앱의 개발자를 인터뷰했어요.

w|penciptaan.text: Budi membaca tentang penciptaan alfabet dalam buku perpustakaan.
w|penciptaan.en: Budi read about the creation of the alphabet in a library book.
w|penciptaan.ko: 부디는 도서관 책에서 알파벳이 만들어진 과정에 대해 읽었어요.

w|penciptaan.text: Di pesawat, Siti menonton dokumenter tentang penciptaan pesawat terbang pertama.
w|penciptaan.en: On the plane, Siti watched a documentary about the creation of the first airplane.
w|penciptaan.ko: 시티는 기내에서 최초의 비행기가 만들어진 과정에 관한 다큐멘터리를 봤어요.

w|pencuci.text: Agus akhirnya membeli mesin pencuci piring karena malas mencuci sendiri.
w|pencuci.en: Agus finally bought a dishwasher because he's too lazy to wash dishes himself.
w|pencuci.ko: 아구스는 설거지가 귀찮아서 결국 식기세척기를 샀어요.

w|pencuci.text: Wati membeli sabun pencuci baju khusus agar pakaian tidak bau apak saat musim hujan.
w|pencuci.en: Wati bought a special laundry detergent so clothes don't smell musty in the rainy season.
w|pencuci.ko: 와티는 우기에 옷에서 쿰쿰한 냄새가 나지 않게 전용 세탁 세제를 샀어요.

w|pencucian.text: Budi bertugas di bagian pencucian piring saat acara bazar sekolah.
w|pencucian.en: Budi was on dishwashing duty during the school bazaar.
w|pencucian.ko: 학교 바자회 때 부디는 설거지 담당이었어요.

w|pencucian.text: Siti membaca berita penangkapan pelaku pencucian uang di bandara.
w|pencucian.en: Siti read news about the arrest of a money launderer at the airport.
w|pencucian.ko: 시티는 공항에서 돈세탁범이 체포됐다는 뉴스를 읽었어요.

w|penculik.text: Fajar baru saja membeli film detektif tentang polisi yang mengejar penculik anak.
w|penculik.en: Fajar just bought a detective film about police chasing a child kidnapper.
w|penculik.ko: 파자르는 아이 납치범을 쫓는 경찰 이야기의 형사 영화를 막 샀어요.

w|penculik.text: Sambil mengaduk adonan, para peserta membahas film tentang penculik yang ditangkap polisi.
w|penculik.en: While stirring the batter, the participants discussed a film about a kidnapper caught by the police.
w|penculik.ko: 참가자들은 반죽을 저으며 경찰에 잡힌 납치범 영화 이야기를 했어요.

w|penculikan.en: That kidnapping shocked the entire city.
w|penculikan.ko: 그 납치 사건이 도시 전체를 놀라게 했어.

w|penculikan.text: Polisi mengungkap kasus penculikan dengan cepat.
w|penculikan.en: The police uncovered the kidnapping case quickly.

w|pencuri.text: Pencuri itu lari masuk gang sempit.
w|pencuri.en: That thief ran into a narrow alley.

w|pencuri.text: Tetangga melihat pencuri di belakang rumah.
w|pencuri.en: The neighbor saw a thief behind the house.

w|pencurian.text: Pencurian di toko itu terjadi tadi malam.
w|pencurian.en: The theft at that store happened last night.
Police are investigating the bicycle theft case.
w|pencurian.ko: 경찰이 자전거 절도 사건을 수사 중이야.

w|pendaftaran.text: Agus mengurus pendaftaran pekerja baru di kantor proyek setiap Senin pagi.
w|pendaftaran.en: Agus handles new worker registration at the site office every Monday morning.
w|pendaftaran.ko: 아구스는 매주 월요일 아침 현장 사무실에서 새 인부 등록을 처리해요.

w|pendaftaran.text: Proses pendaftaran akun baru di toko itu cuma butuh nomor ponsel.
w|pendaftaran.en: Registering a new account at that store only needs a phone number.
w|pendaftaran.ko: 그 가게의 새 계정 가입은 휴대폰 번호만 있으면 돼요.

w|pendamping.text: Di hari pertama, Andi ditunjuk menjadi pendamping Rina selama masa percobaan.
w|pendamping.en: On the first day, Andi was appointed to be Rina's mentor during her probation period.
w|pendamping.ko: 첫날 안디는 수습 기간 동안 리나를 돌보는 담당자로 지정됐어요.

w|pendamping.text: Pengantin wanita datang ke hotel bersama pendamping yang membawakan gaunnya.
w|pendamping.en: The bride came to the hotel with an attendant who carried her gown.
w|pendamping.ko: 신부는 드레스를 들어 주는 들러리와 함께 호텔에 왔어요.

w|pendanaan.text: Rudi sedang mencari pendanaan untuk membuka dapur sendiri.
w|pendanaan.en: Rudi is looking for funding to open his own kitchen.
w|pendanaan.ko: 루디는 자기 주방을 열 자금을 구하고 있어요.

w|pendanaan.text: Rina tidak butuh pendanaan besar untuk membuka lapak di pasar loak.
w|pendanaan.en: Rina didn't need big funding to open a stall at the flea market.
w|pendanaan.ko: 리나는 벼룩시장에 노점을 여는 데 큰 자금이 필요하지 않았어요.

w|pendapatan.text: Tahun ini pendapatan pabrik naik karena pesanan ekspor bertambah.
w|pendapatan.en: This year the factory's income rose because export orders increased.
w|pendapatan.ko: 올해는 수출 주문이 늘어서 공장 수입이 올랐어요.

w|pendapatan.text: Sari bercerita bahwa pendapatan warung kopinya mulai stabil.
w|pendapatan.en: Sari says the income from her coffee stall is starting to stabilize.
w|pendapatan.ko: 사리는 커피 가게 수입이 안정되기 시작했다고 전해요.

w|pendarahan.text: Dokter menekan gusi Agus dengan kapas untuk menghentikan pendarahan.
w|pendarahan.en: The doctor pressed Agus's gum with cotton to stop the bleeding.
w|pendarahan.ko: 의사는 피를 멈추려고 아구스의 잇몸을 솜으로 눌렀어요.

w|pendarahan.text: Wati mengikat jarinya kuat-kuat untuk menghentikan pendarahan setelah teriris gergaji.
w|pendarahan.en: Wati bound her finger tightly to stop the bleeding after cutting it on the saw.
w|pendarahan.ko: 와티는 톱에 손가락을 베인 뒤 피를 멈추려고 꽉 묶었어요.

w|pendaratan.text: Agus melihat pesawat kecil melakukan pendaratan di landasan dekat pantai.
w|pendaratan.en: Agus watched a small plane make a landing on the strip near the beach.
w|pendaratan.ko: 아구스는 작은 비행기가 해변 근처 활주로에 착륙하는 걸 봤어요.

w|pendaratan.text: Toko buku di lantai dua menjual novel tentang pendaratan manusia di bulan.
w|pendaratan.en: The bookstore on the second floor sells a novel about humans landing on the moon.
w|pendaratan.ko: 이 층 서점에서 인류의 달 착륙에 관한 소설을 팔아요.

w|pendatang.text: Banyak tamu adalah pendatang yang sudah lama tinggal di kampung Fajar.
w|pendatang.en: Many of the guests are newcomers who have long lived in Fajar's village.
w|pendatang.ko: 하객 중 상당수는 파자르네 마을에 오래 산 외지 출신이에요.

w|pendatang.text: Setiap musim panen, banyak pendatang datang ke desa Lestari untuk bekerja di kebun.
w|pendatang.en: Every harvest season, many newcomers come to Lestari's village to work in the orchards.
w|pendatang.ko: 수확철마다 많은 외지인이 과수원에서 일하려고 레스타리네 마을에 와요.

w|pendek.en: That short story is very interesting.
His hair is short after being cut yesterday.

w|pendekar.text: Penari silat di pernikahan itu berdandan seperti pendekar dari cerita lama.
w|pendekar.en: The silat dancer at the wedding was dressed like a warrior from an old tale.
w|pendekar.ko: 결혼식의 실랏 무용수는 옛이야기 속 무사처럼 차려입었어요.

w|pendekar.text: Rina meliput festival film tentang pendekar silat dari Sumatra.
w|pendekar.en: Rina covered a film festival about silat warriors from Sumatra.
w|pendekar.ko: 리나는 수마트라 실랏 무사들을 다룬 영화제를 취재했어요.

w|pendekatan.text: Kepala koki punya pendekatan sederhana: bahan segar dan bumbu secukupnya.
w|pendekatan.en: The head chef has a simple approach: fresh ingredients and just enough seasoning.
w|pendekatan.ko: 주방장의 방식은 간단해요. 신선한 재료에 양념은 알맞게.

w|pendekatan.text: Lestari punya pendekatan sendiri saat menawar: tersenyum dulu, baru tanya harga.
w|pendekatan.en: Lestari has her own approach to bargaining: smile first, then ask the price.
w|pendekatan.ko: 레스타리는 흥정할 때 나름의 방식이 있어요. 먼저 웃고, 그다음 값을 물어요.

w|pendengar.text: Andi menjadi pendengar setia ketika tetangganya mengeluh soal pekerjaan.
w|pendengar.en: Andi is a loyal listener when his neighbor complains about work.
w|pendengar.ko: 이웃이 일 이야기로 하소연할 때 안디는 늘 귀 기울여 들어 줘요.

w|pendengar.text: Dewi menjadi pendengar dalam diskusi kurator tentang seni modern.
w|pendengar.en: Dewi was a listener at the curators' discussion on modern art.
w|pendengar.ko: 데위는 현대 미술에 관한 큐레이터 토론을 청중으로 들었어요.
