w|pendengaran.text: Kucing putih bermata biru kadang punya masalah pendengaran sejak lahir.
w|pendengaran.en: White cats with blue eyes sometimes have hearing problems from birth.
w|pendengaran.ko: 파란 눈의 흰 고양이는 가끔 태어날 때부터 청각 문제가 있어요.

w|pendengaran.text: Kakek Siti sudah kurang pendengaran, jadi Siti harus bicara keras.
w|pendengaran.en: Siti's grandfather is hard of hearing, so Siti has to speak loudly.
w|pendengaran.ko: 시티의 할아버지는 귀가 어두워서 시티가 크게 말해야 해요.

w|penderita.text: Dimas menyiapkan alat cek gula darah untuk penderita diabetes.
w|penderita.en: Dimas prepares blood sugar meters for people with diabetes.
w|penderita.ko: 디마스는 당뇨 환자를 위한 혈당 측정기를 준비해 둬요.

w|penderita.text: Putri, penderita alergi debu, selalu bersin saat membongkar lemari.
w|penderita.en: Putri, who has a dust allergy, always sneezes when she clears out the cupboards.
w|penderita.ko: 먼지 알레르기가 있는 푸트리는 장롱을 정리할 때마다 재채기를 해요.

w|penderitaan.en: He told of the suffering of childhood.

w|penderitaan.ko: 그 고통이 그녀를 더 강하게 만들었어.

w|pendeta.en: The pastor gave a short sermon.

w|pendiam.text: Fajar yang biasanya pendiam ternyata bisa berpidato dengan lancar.
w|pendiam.en: Fajar, who is usually quiet, turned out to give a speech smoothly.
w|pendiam.ko: 평소 말수가 적은 파자르가 알고 보니 연설을 술술 잘했어요.

w|pendiam.text: Narasumber Lestari adalah pria pendiam yang hanya mau bicara lewat pesan singkat.
w|pendiam.en: Lestari's source is a quiet man who will only talk by text message.
w|pendiam.ko: 레스타리의 취재원은 문자로만 이야기하려는 말수 적은 남자예요.

w|pendidikan.en: The child's education is their family's priority.

w|pendidikan.text: Sistem pendidikan sedang diperbarui tahun ini.
w|pendidikan.en: The education system is being updated this year.

w|pendingin.text: Andi memasang pendingin ruangan di kamar tidur utama.
w|pendingin.en: Andi installed an air conditioner in the main bedroom.

w|pendingin.text: Udara dari pendingin di gerbong ekonomi terlalu dingin, jadi Dewi memakai jaket.
w|pendingin.en: The air from the air conditioner in the economy carriage is too cold, so Dewi wears a jacket.
w|pendingin.ko: 일반칸 냉방이 너무 세서 데위는 재킷을 입어요.

w|pendiri.text: Foto pendiri perusahaan tergantung di ruang rapat pabrik.
w|pendiri.en: A photo of the company's founder hangs in the factory meeting room.
w|pendiri.ko: 회사 창립자의 사진이 공장 회의실에 걸려 있어요.

w|pendiri.text: Putri kini menjadi salah satu pendiri klub buku kecil di kampungnya.
w|pendiri.en: Putri is now one of the founders of a small book club in her village.
w|pendiri.ko: 푸트리는 이제 동네 작은 독서 모임의 창립자 중 한 명이에요.

w|pendirian.text: Di lantai dua museum ada foto-foto pendirian kota pada masa lampau.
w|pendirian.en: On the museum's second floor there are photos of the city's founding long ago.
w|pendirian.ko: 박물관 이 층에는 옛날 도시가 세워질 때의 사진들이 있어요.

w|pendirian.text: Putri dikenal punya pendirian kuat dan menolak adegan yang menurutnya berlebihan.
w|pendirian.en: Putri is known for having firm principles and refuses scenes she thinks are excessive.
w|pendirian.ko: 푸트리는 소신이 뚜렷해서 지나치다고 생각하는 장면은 거절하는 걸로 알려져 있어요.

w|pendorong.text: Menurut Bayu, harga bahan pokok adalah pendorong utama keluhan warga.
w|pendorong.en: According to Bayu, staple food prices are the main driver of residents' complaints.
w|pendorong.ko: 바유가 보기에 생필품 가격이 주민 불만의 주된 원인이에요.

w|pendorong.text: Menurut Intan, rasa penasaran adalah pendorong terbaik untuk belajar coding.
w|pendorong.en: According to Intan, curiosity is the best motivator for learning to code.
w|pendorong.ko: 인탄은 호기심이 코딩을 배우는 가장 좋은 원동력이라고 해요.

w|pendosa.text: Andi menyukai novel tentang seorang pendosa yang akhirnya menebus kesalahannya.
w|pendosa.en: Andi likes the novel about a sinner who finally atones for his wrongs.
w|pendosa.ko: 안디는 결국 죄를 씻는 죄인에 관한 소설을 좋아해요.

w|pendosa.text: Dewi tertawa saat menemukan buku cerita lama berjudul "Si Pendosa dan Malaikat" di gudang.
w|pendosa.en: Dewi laughed when she found an old storybook titled "The Sinner and the Angel" in the storeroom.
w|pendosa.ko: 데위는 창고에서 "죄인과 천사"라는 옛 동화책을 찾고 웃었어요.

w|penduduk.en: The residents of that village are very friendly.

w|pendukung.text: Para pendukung tim sekolah memenuhi tribun sambil bernyanyi.
w|pendukung.en: The school team's supporters filled the stands, singing.
w|pendukung.ko: 학교 팀 응원단이 노래를 부르며 관중석을 가득 채웠어요.

w|pendukung.text: Keluarga adalah pendukung utama pasien selama masa pemulihan.
w|pendukung.en: Family is a patient's main source of support during recovery.
w|pendukung.ko: 회복하는 동안 가족이 환자의 가장 큰 버팀목이에요.

w|penebusan.text: Andi membaca novel tentang penebusan seorang ayah yang dulu meninggalkan keluarganya.
w|penebusan.en: Andi read a novel about the redemption of a father who once left his family.
w|penebusan.ko: 안디는 가족을 떠났던 아버지의 속죄를 다룬 소설을 읽었어요.

w|penebusan.text: Teman kantor Dewi bilang lembur akhir pekan ini adalah penebusan karena dia terlambat menyerahkan laporan.
w|penebusan.en: Dewi's coworker said working this weekend is his way of making up for submitting the report late.
w|penebusan.ko: 디위의 동료는 보고서를 늦게 낸 걸 만회하려고 이번 주말에 일한다고 했어요.

w|penegak.text: Seorang penegak hukum datang ke sekolah Agus untuk menjelaskan bahaya narkoba.
w|penegak.en: A law enforcement officer came to Agus's school to explain the dangers of drugs.
w|penegak.ko: 경찰관 한 분이 아구스의 학교에 와서 마약의 위험을 설명했어요.

w|penegak.text: Wati menghargai pelatih yang menjadi penegak disiplin di kolam renang.
w|penegak.en: Wati appreciates the coach who enforces discipline at the pool.
w|penegak.ko: 와티는 수영장에서 규율을 잡아 주는 코치를 고맙게 여겨요.

w|penegakan.text: Drama itu menunjukkan betapa sulitnya penegakan hukum di desa terpencil.
w|penegakan.en: The play shows how hard law enforcement is in a remote village.
w|penegakan.ko: 그 연극은 외딴 마을에서 법을 집행하기가 얼마나 어려운지 보여 줘요.

w|penegakan.text: Petugas stasiun meningkatkan penegakan aturan dilarang merokok di peron.
w|penegakan.en: Station staff stepped up enforcement of the no-smoking rule on the platform.
w|penegakan.ko: 역무원들은 승강장 금연 규칙 단속을 강화했어요.

w|peneliti.text: Beberapa peneliti dari kampus datang ke lokasi untuk menguji kekuatan beton.
w|peneliti.en: Several researchers from the university came to the site to test the concrete's strength.
w|peneliti.ko: 대학 연구원 몇 명이 콘크리트 강도를 시험하러 현장에 왔어요.

w|peneliti.text: Krim wajah yang dibeli Wati katanya dikembangkan oleh peneliti kulit.
w|peneliti.en: The face cream Wati bought is said to have been developed by skin researchers.
w|peneliti.ko: 와티가 산 얼굴 크림은 피부 연구자들이 개발했다고 해요.

w|penelitian.en: She leads research in the laboratory.

w|penembak.text: Penembak jitu itu menang dalam pertandingan.
w|penembak.en: That sharpshooter won in the match.

w|penembak.text: Seorang penembak berdiri di garis start.
w|penembak.en: A shooter stood at the starting line.
w|penembak.ko: 사수 한 명이 출발선에 서 있었어.

w|penembakan.text: Wali kota menyampaikan duka atas penembakan yang terjadi di kota tetangga.
w|penembakan.en: The mayor expressed condolences over the shooting that took place in the neighboring city.
w|penembakan.ko: 시장은 이웃 도시에서 일어난 총격 사건에 애도를 표했어요.

w|penembakan.text: Kelas sejarah musik membahas lagu yang ditulis untuk mengenang korban penembakan di sebuah kota.
w|penembakan.en: The music history class discussed a song written in memory of the victims of a shooting in a city.
w|penembakan.ko: 음악사 수업에서는 어느 도시의 총격 사건 희생자를 기리며 쓴 곡을 다뤘어요.

w|penempatan.text: Andi menunggu kabar penempatan sebagai koresponden di luar negeri.
w|penempatan.en: Andi is waiting for news of his posting as a foreign correspondent.
w|penempatan.ko: 안디는 해외 특파원 발령 소식을 기다리고 있어요.

w|penempatan.text: Dewi bingung soal penempatan rak buku di ruang tamu.
w|penempatan.en: Dewi can't decide on the placement of the bookshelf in the living room.
w|penempatan.ko: 데위는 거실 책장 배치를 두고 고민이에요.

w|penemu.text: Tetangga Andi yang suka mengutak-atik barang bermimpi jadi penemu terkenal.
w|penemu.en: Andi's neighbor who loves tinkering dreams of becoming a famous inventor.
w|penemu.ko: 물건 만지작거리길 좋아하는 안디의 이웃은 유명한 발명가가 되는 꿈을 꿔요.

w|penemu.text: Dewi membaca biografi penemu mesin cetak di ruang sejarah teknologi.
w|penemu.en: Dewi read the biography of the inventor of the printing press in the technology history room.
w|penemu.ko: 데위는 기술사 전시실에서 인쇄기 발명가의 전기를 읽었어요.

w|penemuan.text: Penemuan ilmiah itu mengubah banyak industri.
w|penemuan.en: That scientific discovery changed many industries.
w|penemuan.ko: 그 과학적 발견이 많은 산업을 바꿨어.

w|penemuan.en: The museum displayed the discovery of an ancient artifact.

w|penenang.text: Bagi Bayu, berenang sore hari adalah penenang setelah kerja seharian.
w|penenang.en: For Bayu, an afternoon swim is a calming break after a full day of work.
w|penenang.ko: 바유에게 오후 수영은 하루 종일 일한 뒤의 진정제예요.

w|penenang.text: Teh jahe hangat menjadi penenang bagi perut Intan yang kembung.
w|penenang.en: Warm ginger tea soothes Intan's bloated stomach.
w|penenang.ko: 따뜻한 생강차가 더부룩한 인탄의 배를 달래 줘요.

w|penerbangan.en: Our flight was delayed last night.
She canceled the flight to Bali.

w|penerbit.text: Seorang penerbit menawari Eko untuk menulis buku resep.
w|penerbit.en: A publisher offered Eko the chance to write a cookbook.
w|penerbit.ko: 한 출판사가 에코에게 요리책을 써 보자고 제안했어요.

w|penerbit.text: Ayu mengirim kumpulan puisi tentang musim kepada sebuah penerbit kecil.
w|penerbit.en: Ayu sent a collection of poems about the seasons to a small publisher.
w|penerbit.ko: 아유는 계절에 관한 시 모음을 작은 출판사에 보냈어요.

w|penerima.text: Nama penerima undangan ditulis tangan oleh ibu Fajar satu per satu.
w|penerima.en: Fajar's mother hand-wrote the name of each invitation recipient one by one.
w|penerima.ko: 파자르의 어머니가 청첩장 받는 사람 이름을 하나하나 손으로 썼어요.

w|penerima.text: Lestari menjadi penerima beasiswa tepat saat musim kemarau dimulai.
w|penerima.en: Lestari became a scholarship recipient right as the dry season began.
w|penerima.ko: 레스타리는 건기가 막 시작될 때 장학금을 받게 됐어요.

w|penerimaan.text: Hari ini pengumuman penerimaan murid baru dipasang di papan sekolah Dimas.
w|penerimaan.en: Today the new student admission announcement was posted on the board at Dimas's school.
w|penerimaan.ko: 오늘 디마스 학교 게시판에 신입생 합격 발표가 붙었어요.

w|penerimaan.text: Putri senang dengan penerimaan pelanggan terhadap menu barunya.
w|penerimaan.en: Putri is happy with how customers received her new menu.
w|penerimaan.ko: 푸트리는 새 메뉴에 대한 손님들의 반응에 기뻐해요.

w|penerjemah.en: That translator is fluent in Japanese.
We need a translator for the meeting.

w|penerus.text: Tetangga Andi berharap putranya menjadi penerus usaha bengkel keluarga.
w|penerus.en: Andi's neighbor hopes his son will take over the family repair shop.
w|penerus.ko: 안디의 이웃은 아들이 가족 정비소를 이어받길 바라요.

w|penerus.text: Dewi ingin menjadi penerus kurator senior yang sebentar lagi pensiun.
w|penerus.en: Dewi wants to succeed the senior curator who is retiring soon.
w|penerus.ko: 데위는 곧 은퇴하는 선임 큐레이터의 뒤를 잇고 싶어요.

w|pengabdian.text: Kantor memberi penghargaan kepada Fajar atas pengabdian selama sepuluh tahun.
w|pengabdian.en: The office gave Fajar an award for ten years of dedicated service.
w|pengabdian.ko: 회사는 십 년 동안 헌신한 파자르에게 상을 줬어요.

w|pengabdian.text: Lestari berterima kasih atas pengabdian tim pertama yang mau bekerja tanpa gaji besar.
w|pengabdian.en: Lestari is grateful for the dedication of the first team who were willing to work without big salaries.
w|pengabdian.ko: 레스타리는 큰 월급 없이도 일해 준 첫 팀의 헌신에 고마워해요.

w|pengacau.text: Satpam gedung mengusir seorang pengacau yang mabuk dari ruang resepsi.
w|pengacau.en: The building security guard threw a drunk troublemaker out of the reception hall.
w|pengacau.ko: 건물 경비원이 술에 취한 난동꾼을 피로연장에서 내쫓았어요.

w|pengacau.text: Beberapa pengacau menyusup ke demo damai itu, menurut laporan Lestari.
w|pengacau.en: According to Lestari's report, several troublemakers infiltrated the peaceful protest.
w|pengacau.ko: 레스타리의 기사에 따르면 몇몇 난동꾼이 평화 시위에 섞여 들었어요.

w|pengagum.text: Bayu adalah pengagum berat karya desainer senior di kantor itu.
w|pengagum.en: Bayu is a big admirer of the senior designer's work at that office.
w|pengagum.ko: 바유는 그 회사 선임 디자이너 작품의 열렬한 팬이에요.

w|pengagum.text: Intan punya banyak pengagum di kelas zumba.
w|pengagum.en: Intan has many admirers in the Zumba class.

w|pengajar.text: Andi mewawancarai pengajar sukarela di daerah terpencil.
w|pengajar.en: Andi interviewed volunteer teachers in remote areas.
w|pengajar.ko: 안디는 외딴 지역의 자원봉사 교사들을 인터뷰했어요.

w|pengajar.text: Tetangga baru Dewi ternyata pengajar di sekolah dasar dekat situ.
w|pengajar.en: Dewi's new neighbor turns out to be a teacher at the nearby elementary school.
w|pengajar.ko: 알고 보니 데위의 새 이웃은 근처 초등학교 교사예요.

w|pengakuan.text: Dia mendapat pengakuan atas kerja kerasnya.
w|pengakuan.en: She received recognition for her hard work.

w|pengalaman.en: She has a lot of work experience.

w|pengalih.text: Budi sengaja menjatuhkan pensil sebagai pengalih perhatian supaya temannya bisa masuk kelas diam-diam.
w|pengalih.en: Budi deliberately dropped his pencil as a distraction so his friend could sneak into class.
w|pengalih.ko: 버디는 친구가 몰래 교실에 들어올 수 있게 일부러 연필을 떨어뜨려 주의를 돌렸어요.

w|pengalih.text: Suami Siti membuat saluran pengalih air supaya halaman mereka tidak tergenang.
w|pengalih.en: Siti's husband built a water diversion channel so their yard wouldn't flood.
w|pengalih.ko: 시티의 남편은 마당이 잠기지 않게 물길을 돌리는 도랑을 만들었어요.

w|pengalihan.text: Karena ada perbaikan jalan, ada pengalihan rute bus sekolah Agus.
w|pengalihan.en: Because of road repairs, there's a diversion of Agus's school bus route.
w|pengalihan.ko: 도로 공사 때문에 아구스의 스쿨버스 노선이 우회해요.

w|pengalihan.text: Karena ada pengalihan jadwal latihan, Wati harus datang lebih pagi.
w|pengalihan.en: Because practice was rescheduled, Wati has to come earlier in the morning.
w|pengalihan.ko: 연습 일정이 바뀌어서 와티는 더 일찍 와야 해요.

w|pengaman.en: Install the door safety lock before sleeping.

w|pengaman.text: Pengaman helm itu harus dikencangkan rapi.
w|pengaman.en: That helmet strap must be fastened neatly.
w|pengaman.ko: 그 헬멧 고정끈은 단정히 조여야 해.

w|pengamanan.text: Untuk pentas besar itu, teater menambah pengamanan di setiap pintu masuk.
w|pengamanan.en: For that big show, the theater increased security at every entrance.
w|pengamanan.ko: 그 큰 공연을 위해 극장은 출입구마다 경비를 늘렸어요.

w|pengamanan.text: Sejak ada kamera, toko Ayu tidak perlu pengamanan tambahan di malam hari.
w|pengamanan.en: Since the cameras were installed, Ayu's shop doesn't need extra security at night.
w|pengamanan.ko: 카메라를 단 뒤로 아유의 가게는 밤에 경비를 더 둘 필요가 없어요.

w|pengamat.text: Di rapat pertama, Bayu memilih menjadi pengamat dulu sebelum berpendapat.
w|pengamat.en: At his first meeting, Bayu chose to be an observer before giving his opinion.
w|pengamat.ko: 첫 회의에서 바유는 의견을 내기 전에 먼저 지켜보기로 했어요.

w|pengamat.text: Pelatih Intan adalah pengamat yang jeli terhadap postur tubuh.
w|pengamat.en: Intan's trainer is a sharp observer of body posture.
w|pengamat.ko: 인탄의 트레이너는 자세를 예리하게 살피는 사람이에요.

w|pengamatan.text: Menurut pengamatan Budi, pembaca lebih suka berita pendek di ponsel.
w|pengamatan.en: From Budi's observation, readers prefer short news on their phones.
w|pengamatan.ko: 부디가 관찰해 보니 독자들은 휴대폰으로 짧은 기사를 더 좋아해요.

w|pengamatan.text: Dari pengamatan Siti, anak-anak paling ramai datang setelah jam sekolah.
w|pengamatan.en: From Siti's observation, children come in the biggest numbers after school.
w|pengamatan.ko: 시티가 지켜보니 아이들은 방과 후에 가장 많이 와요.

w|pengambilan.text: Koran itu meliput pengambilan sumpah wali kota yang baru.
w|pengambilan.en: The paper covered the swearing-in of the new mayor.
w|pengambilan.ko: 그 신문은 새 시장의 취임 선서를 보도했어요.

w|pengambilan.text: Setiap pengambilan keputusan besar di startup itu dilakukan bersama-sama.
w|pengambilan.en: Every major decision at the startup is made together.
w|pengambilan.ko: 그 스타트업에서 큰 결정은 모두 함께 내려요.

w|pengampunan.text: Novel yang dipinjam Dimas bercerita tentang seorang ayah yang memohon pengampunan dari anaknya.
w|pengampunan.en: The novel Dimas borrowed tells of a father who begs his child for forgiveness.
w|pengampunan.ko: 디마스가 빌린 소설은 아들에게 용서를 비는 아버지 이야기예요.

w|pengampunan.text: Lewat pesan singkat, Putri meminta pengampunan dari sahabatnya karena lupa ulang tahunnya.
w|pengampunan.en: By text message, Putri asked her best friend for forgiveness for forgetting her birthday.
w|pengampunan.ko: 푸트리는 단짝 생일을 깜빡해서 문자로 용서를 빌었어요.

w|pengangguran.text: Proyek jalan tol ini membuka lapangan kerja dan mengurangi pengangguran di desa sekitar.
w|pengangguran.en: This toll road project creates jobs and reduces unemployment in the nearby villages.
w|pengangguran.ko: 이 고속도로 공사는 일자리를 만들어 주변 마을의 실업을 줄여요.

w|pengangguran.text: Saat menunggu paket, Wati membaca berita tentang angka pengangguran yang turun.
w|pengangguran.en: While waiting for her package, Wati read news about the falling unemployment rate.
w|pengangguran.ko: 택배를 기다리면서 와티는 실업률이 떨어졌다는 기사를 읽었어요.

w|pengangkatan.text: Redaksi memberitakan pengangkatan direktur baru rumah sakit daerah.
w|pengangkatan.en: The newsroom reported the appointment of a new director at the regional hospital.
w|pengangkatan.ko: 편집국은 지역 병원 새 원장 임명 소식을 보도했어요.

w|pengangkatan.text: Butuh empat orang untuk pengangkatan lemari jati ke lantai atas.
w|pengangkatan.en: It took four people to lift the teak wardrobe to the upper floor.
w|pengangkatan.ko: 티크 옷장을 위층으로 올리는 데 네 사람이 필요했어요.

w|penganiayaan.text: Drama itu diangkat dari berita penganiayaan pekerja rumah tangga yang menghebohkan kota.
w|penganiayaan.en: The play was adapted from a news story about the abuse of a domestic worker that shocked the city.
w|penganiayaan.ko: 그 연극은 도시를 떠들썩하게 한 가사 노동자 학대 기사를 바탕으로 했어요.

w|penganiayaan.text: Berita di layar kereta melaporkan kasus penganiayaan hewan yang sedang diselidiki polisi.
w|penganiayaan.en: The news on the train screen reported an animal abuse case being investigated by police.
w|penganiayaan.ko: 열차 화면 뉴스에서 경찰이 조사 중인 동물 학대 사건을 보도했어요.

w|pengantar.text: Dimas membaca kata pengantar buku itu sebelum mulai bab pertama.
w|pengantar.en: Dimas read the book's foreword before starting the first chapter.
w|pengantar.ko: 디마스는 첫 장을 시작하기 전에 그 책의 머리말을 읽었어요.

w|pengantar.text: Putri merekrut seorang pengantar makanan untuk pesanan lewat aplikasi.
w|pengantar.en: Putri hired a food delivery rider for app orders.
w|pengantar.ko: 푸트리는 앱 주문 배달원을 한 명 뽑았어요.

w|pengantin.en: The newlyweds smiled on the wedding dais.
Guests surrounded the bride and groom after the ceremony.

w|penganut.text: Tokoh yang diperankan Eko adalah penganut ajaran lama yang menolak perubahan.
w|penganut.en: The character Eko plays is a follower of old teachings who rejects change.
w|penganut.ko: 에코가 맡은 인물은 변화를 거부하는 옛 가르침의 신봉자예요.

w|penganut.text: Di kursi sebelah, seorang penganut agama Buddha membaca buku doa dengan tenang.
w|penganut.en: In the next seat, a follower of Buddhism quietly read a prayer book.
w|penganut.ko: 옆자리에서 한 불교 신자가 조용히 기도서를 읽었어요.

w|pengarahan.text: Setiap pagi Andi memberi pengarahan singkat kepada para pekerja.
w|pengarahan.en: Every morning Andi gives the workers a short briefing.
w|pengarahan.ko: 안디는 매일 아침 인부들에게 짧게 작업 지시를 해요.

w|pengarahan.text: Panitia reuni memberi pengarahan singkat sebelum acara dimulai, dan Dewi mencatat urutannya.
w|pengarahan.en: The reunion committee gave a short briefing before the event started, and Dewi wrote down the order of events.
w|pengarahan.ko: 동창회 준비 위원들이 행사 전에 짧게 안내를 했고, 데위는 순서를 적어 뒀어요.

w|pengaruh.text: Pengaruh teman sangat kuat pada anak muda.
w|pengaruh.en: Friends' influence is very strong on young people.

w|pengaruh.text: Film itu punya pengaruh besar pada saya.
w|pengaruh.en: That film had a big influence on me.
w|pengaruh.ko: 그 영화가 나에게 큰 영향을 줬어.

w|pengasingan.text: Budi membaca kisah tokoh bangsa yang menulis buku di pengasingan.
w|pengasingan.en: Budi read the story of a national figure who wrote books in exile.
w|pengasingan.ko: 부디는 유배지에서 책을 쓴 민족 지도자의 이야기를 읽었어요.

w|pengasingan.text: Siti menonton film tentang raja yang pulang dari pengasingan dengan pesawat.
w|pengasingan.en: Siti watched a film about a king returning from exile by plane.
w|pengasingan.ko: 시티는 망명에서 비행기로 돌아오는 왕에 관한 영화를 봤어요.

w|pengasuh.text: Sebelum bekerja di kantor, Rina pernah jadi pengasuh anak di Jakarta.
w|pengasuh.en: Before working at the office, Rina was once a nanny in Jakarta.
w|pengasuh.ko: 리나는 회사에 오기 전에 자카르타에서 아이 돌보미로 일한 적이 있어요.

w|pengasuh.text: Seorang tamu datang bersama pengasuh yang menjaga bayinya.
w|pengasuh.en: A guest came with a nanny who looked after her baby.
w|pengasuh.ko: 한 손님이 아기를 돌보는 보모와 함께 왔어요.

w|pengatur.text: Fajar mencari tombol pengatur suhu karena ruang rapat terlalu dingin.
w|pengatur.en: Fajar looked for the thermostat because the meeting room was too cold.
w|pengatur.ko: 회의실이 너무 추워서 파자르는 온도 조절기를 찾았어요.

w|pengatur.text: Lestari menambahkan fitur pengatur jadwal minum obat untuk orang tua.
w|pengatur.en: Lestari added a medication scheduler feature for elderly people.
w|pengatur.ko: 레스타리는 어르신들을 위한 약 먹을 시간 관리 기능을 넣었어요.

w|pengaturan.text: Andi bertugas mengurus pengaturan kursi untuk acara wisuda.
w|pengaturan.en: Andi is in charge of the seating arrangement for the graduation ceremony.

w|pengaturan.text: Dewi mengubah pengaturan monitor jantung agar alarmnya lebih keras.
w|pengaturan.en: Dewi changed the heart monitor settings so the alarm would be louder.
w|pengaturan.ko: 데위는 경보음이 더 크게 울리도록 심장 모니터 설정을 바꿨어요.

w|pengawal.text: Pengawal berdiri di depan pintu utama.
w|pengawal.en: The guard stood in front of the main door.
A guard escorted the guest inside.
w|pengawal.ko: 경호원 한 명이 손님을 안으로 안내했어.

w|pengawalan.text: Aktris terkenal itu datang ke teater dengan pengawalan ketat.
w|pengawalan.en: The famous actress came to the theater under tight escort.
w|pengawalan.ko: 그 유명 여배우는 삼엄한 경호를 받으며 극장에 왔어요.

w|pengawalan.text: Seorang menteri naik kereta yang sama dengan Ayu tanpa pengawalan berlebihan.
w|pengawalan.en: A minister rode the same train as Ayu without an excessive escort.
w|pengawalan.ko: 한 장관이 요란한 경호 없이 아유와 같은 열차를 탔어요.

w|pengawas.text: Pengawas memeriksa tiket di pintu masuk.
w|pengawas.en: The supervisor checked tickets at the entrance.

w|pengawas.text: Seorang pengawas berdiri di dekat kolam.
w|pengawas.en: A supervisor stood near the pool.
w|pengawas.ko: 감시원 한 명이 수영장 근처에 서 있었어.

w|pengawasan.text: Pengawasan ketat diterapkan di kawasan itu.
w|pengawasan.en: Strict supervision was applied in that area.

w|pengawasan.text: Anak kecil butuh pengawasan orang dewasa.

w|pengeboman.text: Drama sejarah itu menceritakan kehidupan warga kota setelah pengeboman saat perang.
w|pengeboman.en: The historical play tells of the townspeople's lives after the bombing during the war.
w|pengeboman.ko: 그 역사극은 전쟁 중 폭격 이후 마을 사람들의 삶을 이야기해요.

w|pengeboman.text: Ayu masih ingat cerita kakeknya tentang pengeboman kota pada masa perang.
w|pengeboman.en: Ayu still remembers her grandfather's stories about the bombing of the city during the war.
w|pengeboman.ko: 아유는 전쟁 때 도시가 폭격당했다는 할아버지 이야기를 아직 기억해요.

w|pengeboran.text: Suara pengeboran dari gedung sebelah membuat Eko sulit mendengar pesanan.
w|pengeboran.en: The noise of drilling from the building next door made it hard for Eko to hear the orders.
w|pengeboran.ko: 옆 건물에서 나는 드릴 소리 때문에 에코는 주문을 잘 못 들었어요.

w|pengeboran.text: Ayu membaca bahwa pengeboran sumur meningkat saat kemarau.
w|pengeboran.en: Ayu read that well drilling increases during the dry season.
w|pengeboran.ko: 아유는 건기에 우물 파는 일이 늘어난다는 글을 읽었어요.

w|pengecualian.text: Semua pemain wajib ikut latihan, tanpa pengecualian.
w|pengecualian.en: All cast members must attend rehearsal, without exception.
w|pengecualian.ko: 모든 배우는 예외 없이 연습에 참석해야 해요.

w|pengecualian.text: Biasanya cuti harus diajukan seminggu sebelumnya, tapi Intan mendapat pengecualian.
w|pengecualian.en: Leave usually has to be requested a week ahead, but Intan got an exception.
w|pengecualian.ko: 휴가는 보통 일주일 전에 신청해야 하지만 인탄은 예외를 받았어요.

w|pengecut.text: Pengecut itu lari dari tanggung jawab.

w|pengedar.text: Polisi datang ke sekolah Eko untuk menjelaskan bahaya pengedar narkoba.
w|pengedar.en: Police came to Eko's school to explain the danger of drug dealers.
w|pengedar.ko: 경찰이 에코네 학교에 와서 마약 밀매상의 위험을 설명했어요.

w|pengedar.text: Menurut berita televisi, polisi menangkap pengedar uang palsu di pasar.
w|pengedar.en: According to the TV news, police arrested a counterfeit money dealer at the market.
w|pengedar.ko: 텔레비전 뉴스에 따르면 경찰이 시장에서 위조지폐 유통업자를 붙잡았대요.

w|pengejaran.text: Eko suka adegan pengejaran mobil di film yang ditonton bersama teman kelasnya.
w|pengejaran.en: Eko liked the car chase scene in the film he watched with his classmates.
w|pengejaran.ko: 에코는 반 친구들과 본 영화에서 자동차 추격 장면이 좋았어요.

w|pengejaran.text: Lukisan Ayu menggambarkan pengejaran seekor kucing terhadap kupu-kupu.
w|pengejaran.en: Ayu's painting depicts a cat chasing a butterfly.
w|pengejaran.ko: 아유의 그림은 고양이가 나비를 쫓는 장면을 담고 있어요.

w|pengeluaran.text: Agus mencatat semua pengeluaran supaya tidak kalap belanja di pasar loak.
w|pengeluaran.en: Agus notes down all his spending so he won't go overboard at the flea market.
w|pengeluaran.ko: 아구스는 벼룩시장에서 충동구매하지 않으려고 쓴 돈을 다 적어요.

w|pengeluaran.text: Di musim hujan, pengeluaran Wati untuk ojek daring naik dua kali lipat.
w|pengeluaran.en: In the rainy season, Wati's spending on ride-hailing bikes doubles.
w|pengeluaran.ko: 우기에는 와티의 오토바이 택시 비용이 두 배로 늘어요.

w|pengembangan.text: Koran itu mengirim Budi ke pelatihan pengembangan jurnalisme data.
w|pengembangan.en: The paper sent Budi to a training on developing data journalism.
w|pengembangan.ko: 신문사는 부디를 데이터 저널리즘 역량 개발 연수에 보냈어요.

w|pengembangan.text: Siti mengusulkan pengembangan ruang komputer di lantai dua.
w|pengembangan.en: Siti proposed developing a computer room on the second floor.
w|pengembangan.ko: 시티는 이 층에 컴퓨터실을 만들자고 제안했어요.

w|pengembara.text: Dimas merasa seperti pengembara yang tidak punya tujuan pasti.
w|pengembara.en: Dimas felt like a wanderer with no fixed destination.
w|pengembara.ko: 디마스는 정해진 목적지 없는 방랑자가 된 기분이었어요.

w|pengembara.text: Salah satu programmer di tim Putri dulunya pengembara yang bekerja dari kafe ke kafe.
w|pengembara.en: One of the programmers on Putri's team used to be a wanderer who worked from café to café.
w|pengembara.ko: 푸트리 팀의 개발자 한 명은 예전에 카페를 옮겨 다니며 일하던 방랑자였어요.

w|pengemis.text: Sisa makanan pesta dibagikan Rudi kepada pengemis di dekat masjid.
w|pengemis.en: Rudi gave the leftover party food to a beggar near the mosque.
w|pengemis.ko: 루디는 잔치에서 남은 음식을 모스크 근처 걸인에게 나눠 줬어요.

w|pengemis.text: Rina meliput program pemerintah yang melatih pengemis menjadi tukang jahit.
w|pengemis.en: Rina covered a government program that trains beggars to become tailors.
w|pengemis.ko: 리나는 걸인들을 재봉사로 훈련시키는 정부 사업을 취재했어요.

w|pengemudi.text: Di warung kopi, pengemudi truk memberi tahu Agus jalan pintas ke pantai.
w|pengemudi.en: A truck driver at the coffee stall told Agus a shortcut to the beach.
w|pengemudi.ko: 커피 노점에 있던 트럭 기사가 아구스에게 해변으로 가는 지름길을 알려 줬어요.

w|pengemudi.text: Di pintu keluar, pengemudi ojek daring sudah menunggu Wati.
w|pengemudi.en: The online motorbike-taxi driver was already waiting for Wati at the exit.
w|pengemudi.ko: 온라인 오토바이 택시 기사가 출구에서 이미 와티를 기다리고 있었어요.

w|pengenalan.text: Sebelum pentas, ada pengenalan singkat tentang para pemain.
w|pengenalan.en: Before the show, there is a short introduction of the actors.
w|pengenalan.ko: 공연 전에 배우들을 짧게 소개하는 시간이 있어요.

w|pengenalan.text: Sekolah desa mengadakan masa pengenalan lingkungan untuk murid baru.
w|pengenalan.en: The village school holds an orientation period for new students.
w|pengenalan.ko: 마을 학교는 신입생을 위해 환경 적응 기간을 열어요.

w|pengendali.text: Bayu memeriksa panel pengendali mesin pewarna sebelum shift dimulai.
w|pengendali.en: Bayu checks the dyeing machine's control panel before the shift starts.
w|pengendali.ko: 바유는 교대 근무가 시작되기 전에 염색기 제어판을 점검해요.

w|pengendali.text: Dari jendela, Intan melihat menara pengendali lalu lintas udara.
w|pengendali.en: From the window, Intan saw the air traffic control tower.

w|pengendalian.text: Guru BK mengajarkan pengendalian emosi kepada Rudi dan teman-temannya.
w|pengendalian.en: The counselor teaches Rudi and his friends emotional control.
w|pengendalian.ko: 상담 선생님은 루디와 친구들에게 감정 조절을 가르쳐요.

w|pengendalian.text: Rumah baru Rina dekat kantor pengendalian banjir kota.
w|pengendalian.en: Rina's new house is near the city's flood control office.
w|pengendalian.ko: 리나의 새집은 시 홍수 관리 사무소 근처에 있어요.

w|pengendara.text: Bayu memberi jalan kepada pengendara motor yang membawa keranjang sayur.
w|pengendara.en: Bayu gave way to a motorcyclist carrying a basket of vegetables.
w|pengendara.ko: 바유는 채소 바구니를 실은 오토바이 운전자에게 길을 양보했어요.

w|pengendara.text: Intan melukis pengendara sepeda yang melintas di bawah hujan.
w|pengendara.en: Intan painted a cyclist passing by in the rain.
w|pengendara.ko: 인탄은 비 속을 지나가는 자전거 탄 사람을 그렸어요.

w|pengepungan.text: Sidang hari ini membahas peristiwa pengepungan gudang oleh warga yang marah.
w|pengepungan.en: Today's hearing dealt with the incident of angry residents besieging a warehouse.
w|pengepungan.ko: 오늘 재판에서는 화난 주민들이 창고를 둘러싼 사건을 다뤘어요.

w|pengepungan.text: Restoran Wati baru saja dipenuhi rombongan wisata, seperti sebuah pengepungan kecil.
w|pengepungan.en: Wati's restaurant was just filled by a tour group, like a small siege.
w|pengepungan.ko: 와티네 식당은 방금 관광객 무리로 가득 차서 작은 포위전 같았어요.

w|pengeras suara.text: Sebelum pertunjukan, pengeras suara meminta penonton mematikan ponsel.
w|pengeras suara.en: Before the show, the loudspeaker asked the audience to turn off their phones.
w|pengeras suara.ko: 공연 전에 확성기로 관객에게 휴대폰을 꺼 달라고 안내했어요.

w|pengeras suara.text: Suara dari pengeras suara mengumumkan bahwa kereta akan tiba di stasiun berikutnya.
w|pengeras suara.en: The voice from the loudspeaker announced that the train would arrive at the next station.
w|pengeras suara.ko: 확성기에서 다음 역에 곧 도착한다는 안내 방송이 나왔어요.

w|pengertian.text: Eko berterima kasih atas pengertian guru ketika dia terlambat karena banjir.
w|pengertian.en: Eko was grateful for the teacher's understanding when he was late because of a flood.
w|pengertian.ko: 홍수 때문에 늦었을 때 이해해 준 선생님께 에코는 고마워했어요.

w|pengertian.text: Guru seni menjelaskan pengertian perspektif dengan menggambar rel kereta.
w|pengertian.en: The art teacher explained the concept of perspective by drawing train tracks.
w|pengertian.ko: 미술 선생님은 기찻길을 그려서 원근법의 개념을 설명했어요.

w|pengetahuan.en: Knowledge about history is very valuable.

w|pengetahuan.text: Dia menambah pengetahuan dengan banyak membaca.
w|pengetahuan.en: She expands her knowledge by reading a lot.

w|penggabungan.text: Setelah penggabungan dua cabang, Rudi memimpin dapur yang jauh lebih besar.
w|penggabungan.en: After the merger of two branches, Rudi runs a much bigger kitchen.
w|penggabungan.ko: 두 지점이 합쳐진 뒤 루디는 훨씬 큰 주방을 이끌어요.

w|penggabungan.text: Setelah penggabungan dua pasar loak, lapak Rina pindah ke lapangan yang lebih luas.
w|penggabungan.en: After the two flea markets merged, Rina's stall moved to a bigger field.
w|penggabungan.ko: 벼룩시장 두 곳이 합쳐진 뒤 리나의 노점은 더 넓은 공터로 옮겼어요.

w|penggalangan.text: Perpustakaan mengadakan penggalangan dana untuk membeli buku anak, dan Andi ikut menyumbang.
w|penggalangan.en: The library held a fundraiser to buy children's books, and Andi donated too.
w|penggalangan.ko: 도서관이 어린이책을 사려고 모금 행사를 열었고, 안디도 기부했어요.

w|penggalangan.text: Warga kompleks baru Dewi sedang mengadakan penggalangan dana untuk memperbaiki pos ronda.
w|penggalangan.en: The residents of Dewi's new complex were holding a fundraiser to repair the security post.
w|penggalangan.ko: 데위가 새로 이사 간 단지 주민들은 경비 초소를 고치려고 모금을 하고 있었어요.

w|penggali.text: Andi mewawancarai penggali sumur yang menemukan koin kuno.
w|penggali.en: Andi interviewed the well digger who found ancient coins.
w|penggali.ko: 안디는 옛 동전을 발견한 우물 파는 인부를 인터뷰했어요.

w|penggali.text: Dewi memanggil penggali untuk membuat sumur resapan di halaman baru.
w|penggali.en: Dewi called in diggers to make a soakaway well in the new yard.
w|penggali.ko: 데위는 새 마당에 빗물 침투정을 만들려고 땅 파는 인부를 불렀어요.

w|penggalian.text: Gedung kantor sebelah sedang dalam tahap penggalian untuk membuat parkir bawah tanah.
w|penggalian.en: The office building next door is at the excavation stage for an underground car park.
w|penggalian.ko: 옆 사무실 건물은 지하 주차장을 만들려고 땅을 파는 중이에요.

w|penggalian.text: Aplikasi Lestari membantu tim arkeolog mencatat temuan dari lokasi penggalian.
w|penggalian.en: Lestari's app helps archaeology teams record finds from excavation sites.
w|penggalian.ko: 레스타리의 앱은 고고학 팀이 발굴 현장의 발견물을 기록하도록 도와요.

w|pengganggu.text: Fajar menyiapkan tenda supaya hujan tidak menjadi pengganggu acara.
w|pengganggu.en: Fajar set up a tent so the rain wouldn't disrupt the event.
w|pengganggu.ko: 파자르는 비가 행사를 방해하지 않도록 천막을 쳤어요.

w|pengganggu.text: Nyamuk adalah pengganggu utama di rumah Lestari setiap musim hujan.
w|pengganggu.en: Mosquitoes are the main nuisance in Lestari's house every rainy season.
w|pengganggu.ko: 모기는 우기마다 레스타리네 집의 가장 큰 골칫거리예요.

w|pengganti.text: Hari ini kelas Budi diajar oleh guru pengganti karena Bu Rina sakit.
w|pengganti.en: Today Budi's class was taught by a substitute teacher because Ms. Rina is sick.
w|pengganti.ko: 리나 선생님이 아파서 오늘 부디네 반은 대체 교사가 가르쳤어요.

w|pengganti.text: Karena kunci lama hilang, Siti memesan kunci pengganti dari tukang.
w|pengganti.en: Because the old key was lost, Siti ordered a replacement key from a locksmith.
w|pengganti.ko: 옛 열쇠를 잃어버려서 시티는 열쇠공에게 새 열쇠를 맞췄어요.

w|penggelapan.text: Bendahara koperasi itu diadili karena penggelapan uang anggota.
w|penggelapan.en: The cooperative's treasurer was put on trial for embezzling members' money.
w|penggelapan.ko: 그 협동조합 회계 담당자는 조합원 돈을 횡령해 재판을 받았어요.

w|penggelapan.text: Wati memecat kasir yang ketahuan melakukan penggelapan uang hasil penjualan.
w|penggelapan.en: Wati fired the cashier who was caught embezzling sales money.
w|penggelapan.ko: 와티는 매상 돈을 빼돌리다 들킨 계산원을 해고했어요.

w|penggeledahan.text: Berita di televisi tentang penggeledahan kantor dinas itu membuat Fajar kaget.
w|penggeledahan.en: The TV news about the search of that government office shocked Fajar.
w|penggeledahan.ko: 그 관청 압수 수색에 관한 텔레비전 뉴스에 파자르는 깜짝 놀랐어요.

w|penggeledahan.text: Lestari bercerita tentang film detektif yang adegan penggeledahannya sangat menegangkan.
w|penggeledahan.en: Lestari told her friend about a detective film whose search scene was very tense.
w|penggeledahan.ko: 레스타리는 수색 장면이 아주 긴장감 넘치는 탐정 영화 이야기를 했어요.

w|penggemar.en: Many fans waited at the door.
Loyal fans come to every concert.

w|pengguna.text: Video pernikahan Fajar ditonton banyak pengguna media sosial.
w|pengguna.en: Fajar's wedding video was watched by many social media users.
w|pengguna.ko: 파자르의 결혼식 영상은 소셜 미디어 사용자들이 많이 봤어요.

w|pengguna.text: Aplikasi cuaca itu membantu pengguna tahu kapan hujan akan turun.
w|pengguna.en: The weather app helps users know when it will rain.
w|pengguna.ko: 그 날씨 앱은 사용자가 언제 비가 올지 알 수 있게 도와줘요.

w|penggunaan.text: Guru TIK mengajari para siswa tentang penggunaan internet yang aman.
w|penggunaan.en: The IT teacher taught the students about safe internet use.
w|penggunaan.ko: 정보 선생님은 학생들에게 안전한 인터넷 사용법을 가르쳤어요.

w|penggunaan.text: Rumah sakit membatasi penggunaan ponsel di ruang ICU.
w|penggunaan.en: The hospital restricts phone use in the ICU.

w|penghakiman.text: Bayu menulis bahwa media sosial sering menjadi tempat penghakiman tanpa bukti.
w|penghakiman.en: Bayu wrote that social media often becomes a place of judgment without evidence.
w|penghakiman.ko: 바유는 소셜 미디어가 증거 없이 심판하는 곳이 되곤 한다고 썼어요.

w|penghakiman.text: Intan membaca kisah rakyat tentang hari penghakiman bagi raja yang serakah.
w|penghakiman.en: Intan read a folk tale about the day of judgment for a greedy king.
w|penghakiman.ko: 인탄은 욕심 많은 왕이 심판받는 날에 관한 민담을 읽었어요.

w|penghalang.text: Rasa malu sering jadi penghalang bagi Andi untuk bertanya di kelas.
w|penghalang.en: Shyness is often a barrier keeping Andi from asking questions in class.
w|penghalang.ko: 부끄러움 때문에 안디는 수업 시간에 질문을 잘 못 해요.

w|penghalang.text: Dewi memasang pagar bambu sebagai penghalang supaya anak-anak tidak dekat dengan api.
w|penghalang.en: Dewi set up a bamboo fence as a barrier so the kids stay away from the fire.
w|penghalang.ko: 데위는 아이들이 불 가까이 가지 않도록 대나무 울타리로 막아 뒀어요.

w|penghancur.text: Agus membuat miniatur kapal penghancur untuk pameran prakarya.
w|penghancur.en: Agus made a model destroyer ship for the crafts exhibition.
w|penghancur.ko: 아구스는 공작 전시회에 낼 구축함 모형을 만들었어요.

w|penghancur.text: Sepupu Wati bekerja sebagai pelaut di kapal penghancur angkatan laut.
w|penghancur.en: Wati's cousin works as a sailor on a navy destroyer.
w|penghancur.ko: 와티의 사촌은 해군 구축함에서 수병으로 일해요.

w|penghancuran.text: Warga menolak rencana penghancuran gedung teater tua itu.
w|penghancuran.en: Residents opposed the plan to demolish the old theater building.
w|penghancuran.ko: 주민들은 그 오래된 극장을 허무는 계획에 반대했어요.

w|penghancuran.text: Warga khawatir tambang baru akan menyebabkan penghancuran hutan di lereng gunung.
w|penghancuran.en: The villagers worry the new mine will cause the destruction of the forest on the mountain slope.
w|penghancuran.ko: 주민들은 새 광산 때문에 산비탈 숲이 파괴될까 걱정해요.

w|penghargaan.en: That award was given to the winner.

w|penghargaan.text: Dia menerima penghargaan atas kerja kerasnya.
w|penghargaan.en: He received an award for his hard work.
w|penghargaan.ko: 그는 열심히 일한 공로로 상을 받았어.

w|penghasilan.text: Banyak wartawan lepas mencari penghasilan tambahan dengan menulis untuk majalah.
w|penghasilan.en: Many freelance journalists look for extra income by writing for magazines.
w|penghasilan.ko: 많은 프리랜서 기자들이 잡지에 글을 써서 부수입을 찾아요.

w|penghasilan.text: Siti menambah penghasilan dengan mengajar membaca kepada anak tetangga.
w|penghasilan.en: Siti supplements her income by teaching the neighbors' children to read.
w|penghasilan.ko: 시티는 이웃 아이들에게 읽기를 가르치며 수입을 보태요.

w|penghilang.text: Dimas memberikan penghilang rasa nyeri untuk sakit gigi.
w|penghilang.en: Dimas gave out a painkiller for a toothache.

w|penghilang.text: Putri membeli cairan penghilang cat untuk membersihkan kusen jendela.
w|penghilang.en: Putri bought paint remover to clean the window frames.
w|penghilang.ko: 푸트리는 창틀을 닦으려고 페인트 제거제를 샀어요.

w|penghinaan.text: Warga itu menganggap pemotongan anggaran sekolah sebagai penghinaan bagi guru.
w|penghinaan.en: The resident saw the cut to the school budget as an insult to teachers.
w|penghinaan.ko: 그 주민은 학교 예산 삭감을 교사들에 대한 모욕으로 여겼어요.

w|penghinaan.text: Wati merasa komentar kasar juri itu seperti penghinaan.
w|penghinaan.en: Wati felt the judge's harsh comment was like an insult.
w|penghinaan.ko: 와티는 심사위원의 거친 평이 모욕처럼 느껴졌어요.

w|penghormatan.text: Murid-murid memberi penghormatan kepada bendera saat upacara hari Senin.
w|penghormatan.en: The students saluted the flag during the Monday ceremony.
w|penghormatan.ko: 학생들은 월요일 조회 때 국기에 경례했어요.

w|penghormatan.text: Rina mengajak tetangga makan bersama sebagai bentuk penghormatan kepada warga lama.
w|penghormatan.en: Rina invited the neighbors to eat together as a sign of respect to the long-time residents.
w|penghormatan.ko: 리나는 오래 산 주민들에게 예를 갖추려고 이웃들을 식사에 초대했어요.

w|penghubung.text: Rudi menjadi penghubung antara wali kelas dan orang tua murid.
w|penghubung.en: Rudi became the liaison between the homeroom teacher and the parents.
w|penghubung.ko: 루디는 담임 선생님과 학부모 사이 연락을 맡았어요.

w|penghubung.text: Kakak Rina menjadi penghubung dengan pemilik rumah karena Rina sedang di luar kota.
w|penghubung.en: Rina's brother acted as the go-between with the landlord because Rina was out of town.
w|penghubung.ko: 리나가 다른 도시에 가 있어서 오빠가 집주인과 연락을 맡았어요.

w|penghuni.text: Kata tetangga, penghuni lama rumah itu adalah seorang guru musik.
w|penghuni.en: The neighbors say the house's former occupant was a music teacher.
w|penghuni.ko: 이웃들 말로는 그 집의 옛 주인은 음악 선생님이었대요.

w|penghuni.text: Dewi mengirim kartu pos kepada penghuni baru rumah lamanya di Bandung.
w|penghuni.en: Dewi sends a postcard to the new residents of her old house in Bandung.
w|penghuni.ko: 데위는 반둥에 있는 옛집의 새 주인에게 엽서를 보내요.

w|pengikut.text: Kanal video Andi tentang soal matematika sudah punya ribuan pengikut.
w|pengikut.en: Andi's video channel about maths problems already has thousands of followers.
w|pengikut.ko: 수학 문제를 다루는 안디의 영상 채널은 벌써 팔로워가 수천 명이에요.

w|pengikut.text: Dewi membaca novel tentang seorang pemimpin sekte dan para pengikut setianya.
w|pengikut.en: Dewi read a novel about a cult leader and his loyal followers.
w|pengikut.ko: 데위는 한 사이비 교주와 충성스러운 추종자들에 관한 소설을 읽었어요.

w|penginapan.text: Dimas sudah memesan penginapan murah dekat stasiun tujuan.
w|penginapan.en: Dimas has already booked a cheap place to stay near the destination station.
w|penginapan.ko: 디마스는 도착역 근처에 싼 숙소를 이미 예약했어요.

w|penginapan.text: Klien pertama Putri adalah pemilik penginapan kecil di Bali.
w|penginapan.en: Putri's first client was the owner of a small guesthouse in Bali.
w|penginapan.ko: 푸트리의 첫 고객은 발리의 작은 숙소 주인이었어요.

w|pengingat.text: Ponsel Andi berbunyi sebagai pengingat bahwa buku harus kembali besok.
w|pengingat.en: Andi's phone beeped as a reminder that the book is due back tomorrow.
w|pengingat.ko: 안디의 휴대폰이 내일 책을 반납해야 한다고 알림을 울렸어요.

w|pengingat.text: Dewi menempelkan kertas pengingat di monitor supaya tidak lupa menelepon klien.
w|pengingat.en: Dewi stuck a reminder note on her monitor so she wouldn't forget to call the client.
w|pengingat.ko: 디위는 고객에게 전화하는 걸 잊지 않으려고 모니터에 메모를 붙였어요.

w|pengintai.text: Dalam permainan perang-perangan, Eko jadi pengintai di balik pohon.
w|pengintai.en: In the war game, Eko was the scout hiding behind a tree.
w|pengintai.ko: 전쟁놀이에서 에코는 나무 뒤에 숨은 정찰병을 맡았어요.

w|pengintai.text: Adik Ayu jadi pengintai yang mengawasi kapan kue keluar dari oven.
w|pengintai.en: Ayu's little brother became the lookout, watching for when the cake came out of the oven.
w|pengintai.ko: 아유의 동생은 케이크가 언제 오븐에서 나오는지 지켜보는 망꾼이 됐어요.

w|pengintaian.text: Eko menonton film perang tentang misi pengintaian di balik garis musuh.
w|pengintaian.en: Eko watched a war film about a reconnaissance mission behind enemy lines.
w|pengintaian.ko: 에코는 적진 뒤 정찰 임무를 다룬 전쟁 영화를 봤어요.

w|pengintaian.text: Ayu melukis pos pengintaian tua peninggalan perang di pinggir pantai.
w|pengintaian.en: Ayu painted an old wartime lookout post by the beach.
w|pengintaian.ko: 아유는 바닷가에 남은 전쟁 때 낡은 감시 초소를 그렸어요.

w|pengirim.text: Andi menerima paket dari pengirim yang tidak dikenal.
w|pengirim.en: Andi received a package from an unknown sender.
w|pengirim.ko: 안디는 모르는 사람이 보낸 택배를 받았어요.

w|pengirim.text: Dewi menerima karangan bunga, tetapi nama pengirim tidak tertulis di kartu.
w|pengirim.en: Dewi received a bouquet, but the sender's name wasn't written on the card.
w|pengirim.ko: 데위는 꽃다발을 받았지만 카드에 보낸 사람 이름이 없었어요.

w|pengiriman.en: Package delivery was delayed because of rain.
Track the shipment through the store site.

w|pengiring.text: Andi ikut menjadi pengiring pengantin di pernikahan anak tetangga.
w|pengiring.en: Andi was one of the groom's escorts at the neighbor's child's wedding.
w|pengiring.ko: 안디는 이웃집 자녀 결혼식에서 신랑 들러리를 섰어요.

w|pengiring.text: Setiap Sabtu, Dewi menjadi pengiring piano untuk paduan suara anak.
w|pengiring.en: Every Saturday, Dewi is the piano accompanist for the children's choir.
w|pengiring.ko: 토요일마다 데위는 어린이 합창단의 피아노 반주를 맡아요.

w|pengisap.text: Rudi membersihkan karpet ruang tunggu dengan pengisap debu.
w|pengisap.en: Rudi cleaned the waiting room carpet with a vacuum cleaner.

w|pengisap.text: Rina memakai alat pengisap lendir untuk membersihkan hidung anak anjing.
w|pengisap.en: Rina used a suction device to clear the puppy's nose of mucus.
w|pengisap.ko: 리나는 흡인기로 강아지 코의 콧물을 빼 줬어요.

w|pengisian.text: Rudi membantu seorang nenek dalam pengisian formulir laporan kehilangan.
w|pengisian.en: Rudi helped an old woman fill in the lost property report form.
w|pengisian.ko: 루디는 할머니 한 분이 분실 신고서를 작성하는 걸 도와드렸어요.

w|pengisian.text: Rina mengawasi pengisian tabung oksigen untuk ruang operasi.
w|pengisian.en: Rina oversaw the refilling of oxygen tanks for the operating room.
w|pengisian.ko: 리나는 수술실에 쓸 산소통 충전을 지켜봤어요.

w|pengkhianat.text: Tidak ada yang mau menjadi pengkhianat.
w|pengkhianat.en: Nobody wants to become a traitor.

w|pengkhianatan.text: Di kelas sastra, mereka membahas novel tentang pengkhianatan dua sahabat.
w|pengkhianatan.en: In literature class, they discussed a novel about a betrayal between two best friends.
w|pengkhianatan.ko: 문학 시간에 학생들은 두 단짝 사이의 배신을 다룬 소설을 이야기했어요.

w|pengkhianatan.text: Teman sekamar lama menganggap kepindahan mendadak Siti sebagai pengkhianatan.
w|pengkhianatan.en: Her old roommate saw Siti's sudden move as a betrayal.
w|pengkhianatan.ko: 예전 룸메이트는 시티가 갑자기 이사 간 걸 배신으로 여겼어요.

w|penglihatan.text: Penglihatan kakek mulai kabur belakangan ini.
w|penglihatan.en: Grandfather's vision has started to blur lately.

w|penglihatan.text: Dokter memeriksa penglihatan saya dengan teliti.
w|penglihatan.en: The doctor carefully checked my eyesight.

w|pengobatan.text: Pengobatan baru memberi harapan pada pasien.
w|pengobatan.en: The new treatment gives hope to patients.

w|pengobatan.ko: 그녀는 몇 주 동안 치료를 받았어.

w|pengorbanan.text: Pengorbanan orang tua sering tak terlihat.

w|pengorbanan.en: Success needs a sacrifice of time.

w|penguasa.en: The ruler issued a new rule.
The people demand a fairer ruler.

w|penguin.text: Anak Bayu bertanya apakah penguin bisa hidup di hutan tropis.
w|penguin.en: Bayu's child asked whether penguins can live in a tropical forest.
w|penguin.ko: 바유의 아이는 펭귄이 열대 숲에서도 살 수 있는지 물었어요.

w|penguin.text: Seorang peserta berkostum penguin berlari di depan Intan sepanjang rute.
w|penguin.en: A participant in a penguin costume ran ahead of Intan along the whole route.
w|penguin.ko: 펭귄 옷을 입은 참가자가 코스 내내 인탄 앞에서 달렸어요.

w|pengujian.text: Setiap sepatu melewati pengujian kekuatan sebelum dikemas.
w|pengujian.en: Every shoe goes through strength testing before it is packed.
w|pengujian.ko: 신발은 모두 포장 전에 내구성 시험을 거쳐요.

w|pengujian.text: Sari bekerja di laboratorium pengujian makanan di kotanya.
w|pengujian.en: Sari works at a food testing laboratory in her town.
w|pengujian.ko: 사리는 자기 도시의 식품 검사 연구소에서 일해요.

w|pengukur.text: Andi memotret alat pengukur curah hujan di stasiun cuaca.
w|pengukur.en: Andi photographed the rain gauge at the weather station.
w|pengukur.ko: 안디는 기상 관측소의 강우량 측정기를 사진에 담았어요.

w|pengukur.text: Dewi memakai alat pengukur laser untuk memastikan lemari muat di kamar.
w|pengukur.en: Dewi used a laser measuring tool to make sure the wardrobe would fit in the room.
w|pengukur.ko: 데위는 옷장이 방에 들어갈지 레이저 측정기로 확인했어요.

w|pengukuran.text: Andi menulis tentang pengukuran kualitas udara di ibu kota.
w|pengukuran.en: Andi wrote about air quality measurements in the capital.
w|pengukuran.ko: 안디는 수도의 대기질 측정에 관한 기사를 썼어요.

w|pengukuran.text: Tukang melakukan pengukuran jendela untuk memasang gorden baru.
w|pengukuran.en: The handyman took the window measurements to put up new curtains.
w|pengukuran.ko: 기사님이 새 커튼을 달려고 창문 치수를 쟀어요.

w|pengumpulan.text: Rudi melakukan pengumpulan barang bukti di tempat kejadian dengan sangat hati-hati.
w|pengumpulan.en: Rudi collected the evidence at the scene very carefully.
w|pengumpulan.ko: 루디는 현장에서 증거물을 아주 조심스럽게 수집했어요.

w|pengumpulan.text: Rina datang ke tempat pengumpulan paket lomba sehari sebelum acara.
w|pengumpulan.en: Rina came to the race pack collection point the day before the event.
w|pengumpulan.ko: 리나는 대회 전날 참가 물품 수령 장소에 갔어요.

w|pengumuman.text: Rudi mendengar pengumuman bahwa pertunjukan wayang akan dimulai sepuluh menit lagi.
w|pengumuman.en: Rudi heard an announcement that the shadow puppet show would start in ten minutes.
w|pengumuman.ko: 루디는 그림자 인형극이 십 분 뒤에 시작한다는 안내 방송을 들었어요.

w|pengumuman.text: Lewat pengeras suara, pengelola membuat pengumuman bahwa pasar tutup lebih awal.
w|pengumuman.en: Over the loudspeaker, the management announced that the market would close early.
w|pengumuman.ko: 관리소가 확성기로 시장이 일찍 문을 닫는다고 알렸어요.

w|penguncian.text: Bayu menulis tentang penguncian kota pada masa wabah beberapa tahun lalu.
w|penguncian.en: Bayu wrote about the city lockdown during the epidemic a few years ago.
w|penguncian.ko: 바유는 몇 년 전 전염병 때의 도시 봉쇄에 대해 썼어요.

w|penutup.en: She wrote the letter's closing carefully.

w|penutupan.text: Malam penutupan festival teater berlangsung meriah.
w|penutupan.en: The closing night of the theater festival was festive.

w|penutupan.text: Warga kecewa dengan penutupan jalan ke kota akibat longsor.
w|penutupan.en: The villagers were disappointed by the closure of the road to town due to a landslide.
w|penutupan.ko: 주민들은 산사태로 시내 가는 길이 막혀 실망했어요.

w|penyadap.text: Ayah Budi dulu bekerja sebagai penyadap karet sebelum menjadi guru.
w|penyadap.en: Budi's father used to work as a rubber tapper before becoming a teacher.
w|penyadap.ko: 버디의 아버지는 교사가 되기 전에 고무 수액 채취꾼으로 일하셨어요.

w|penyadap.text: Di musim hujan, para penyadap karet di desa Siti sering libur karena getah tercampur air.
w|penyadap.en: In the rainy season, the rubber tappers in Siti's village often take time off because the sap gets mixed with water.
w|penyadap.ko: 우기에는 고무 수액에 물이 섞여서 시티네 마을 채취꾼들이 자주 쉬어요.

w|penyair.text: Seorang penyair membacakan puisi cinta untuk kedua mempelai.
w|penyair.en: A poet recited a love poem for the bride and groom.
w|penyair.ko: 한 시인이 신랑 신부를 위해 사랑 시를 낭송했어요.

w|penyair.text: Lestari suka membaca puisi seorang penyair tentang hujan bulan Juni.
w|penyair.en: Lestari likes reading a poet's poem about June rain.
w|penyair.ko: 레스타리는 유월의 비에 관한 어느 시인의 시를 즐겨 읽어요.

w|penyalahgunaan.text: Andi membaca laporan tentang penyalahgunaan dana bantuan pendidikan.
w|penyalahgunaan.en: Andi read a report on the misuse of education aid funds.
w|penyalahgunaan.ko: 안디는 교육 지원금 유용에 관한 보고서를 읽었어요.

w|penyalahgunaan.text: Dewi mendengar di berita tentang penyalahgunaan izin bangunan di kompleks sebelah.
w|penyalahgunaan.en: Dewi heard on the news about the misuse of building permits in the neighboring complex.
w|penyalahgunaan.ko: 데위는 옆 단지 건축 허가 남용에 관한 뉴스를 들었어요.

w|penyamaran.text: Dalam drama kelas, Budi berperan sebagai detektif dalam penyamaran.
w|penyamaran.en: In the class play, Budi plays a detective in disguise.
w|penyamaran.ko: 반 연극에서 부디는 변장한 탐정 역을 맡았어요.

w|penyamaran.text: Salah satu alumni datang dengan penyamaran sebagai pelayan untuk mengejutkan teman-temannya.
w|penyamaran.en: One of the alumni came disguised as a waiter to surprise his friends.
w|penyamaran.ko: 동문 한 명이 친구들을 놀래 주려고 웨이터로 변장하고 왔어요.

w|penyambutan.text: Acara penyambutan tamu dari luar kota diadakan di halaman museum.
w|penyambutan.en: The welcoming event for guests from out of town was held in the museum courtyard.
w|penyambutan.ko: 외지 손님 환영 행사가 박물관 마당에서 열렸어요.

w|penyambutan.text: Kru menyiapkan penyambutan kecil dengan kue untuk aktor senior yang baru datang.
w|penyambutan.en: The crew prepared a small welcome with cake for the senior actor who had just arrived.
w|penyambutan.ko: 스태프들은 막 도착한 원로 배우를 위해 케이크로 작은 환영 자리를 마련했어요.

w|penyanderaan.text: Berita utama hari ini membahas penyanderaan kapal nelayan di perairan asing.
w|penyanderaan.en: Today's lead story covers the hostage-taking of a fishing boat in foreign waters.
w|penyanderaan.ko: 오늘 머리기사는 외국 해역에서 일어난 어선 인질 사건을 다뤄요.

w|penyanderaan.text: Sambil menunggu paket, Intan menonton film tentang penyanderaan di sebuah bank.
w|penyanderaan.en: While waiting for her package, Intan watched a film about a hostage situation at a bank.
w|penyanderaan.ko: 택배를 기다리며 인탄은 은행 인질극 영화를 봤어요.

w|penyangkalan.text: Fajar menerima surat penyangkalan dari kontraktor yang dituduh memperlambat proyek.
w|penyangkalan.en: Fajar received a letter of denial from the contractor accused of delaying the project.
w|penyangkalan.ko: 파자르는 공사를 지연시켰다는 의혹을 받은 시공사로부터 부인하는 편지를 받았어요.

w|penyangkalan.text: Lestari tertawa mendengar penyangkalan anaknya yang mulutnya masih belepotan cokelat.
w|penyangkalan.en: Lestari laughed at her child's denial, with chocolate still smeared around the child's mouth.
w|penyangkalan.ko: 레스타리는 입에 초콜릿을 잔뜩 묻힌 채 아니라고 우기는 아이를 보고 웃었어요.

w|penyanyi.en: That singer performed my favorite song.
w|penyanyi.ko: 그 가수가 내가 좋아하는 노래를 불렀어.

w|penyanyi.en: She wants to become a famous singer.

w|penyatuan.text: Kepala kantor polisi membahas penyatuan data warga agar laporan tidak tercatat dua kali.
w|penyatuan.en: The police chief discussed unifying residents' data so that reports aren't recorded twice.
w|penyatuan.ko: 경찰서장은 신고가 두 번 기록되지 않도록 주민 정보를 하나로 합치는 일을 논의했어요.

w|penyatuan.text: Panitia menyebut maraton ini sebagai lambang penyatuan warga dari berbagai kampung.
w|penyatuan.en: The organizers call this marathon a symbol of bringing together residents from many villages.
w|penyatuan.ko: 주최 측은 이 마라톤을 여러 마을 주민이 하나 되는 상징이라고 불러요.

w|penyayang.text: Rekan-rekan tahu Bayu orang yang penyayang karena sering bercerita tentang kucing peliharaan.
w|penyayang.en: The coworkers know Bayu is a loving person because he often talks about his pet cats.
w|penyayang.ko: 바유가 키우는 고양이 얘기를 자주 해서 동료들은 그가 정이 많은 사람이라는 걸 알아요.

w|penyayang.text: Pelatih Intan dikenal tegas tetapi penyayang.
w|penyayang.en: Intan's trainer is known for being strict but caring.
w|penyayang.ko: 인탄의 트레이너는 엄하지만 다정하기로 알려져 있어요.

w|penyebab.en: The cause of the accident is still being investigated by police.
w|penyebab.ko: 사고 원인은 아직 경찰이 조사 중이야.

w|penyebab.text: Stres menjadi penyebab utama sakit kepalanya.
w|penyebab.en: Stress became the main cause of her headache.

w|penyebaran.text: Lakon itu mengisahkan penyebaran kabar bohong di sebuah kampung kecil.
w|penyebaran.en: The play tells of the spread of a false rumor in a small village.
w|penyebaran.ko: 그 연극은 작은 마을에 거짓 소문이 퍼지는 이야기예요.

w|penyebaran.text: Petugas kesehatan berusaha mencegah penyebaran demam berdarah di desa.
w|penyebaran.en: Health workers are trying to prevent the spread of dengue fever in the village.
w|penyebaran.ko: 보건 요원들이 마을에 뎅기열이 퍼지는 걸 막으려고 애써요.

w|penyelam.text: Tetangga baru Andi adalah penyelam yang bekerja di proyek terumbu karang.
w|penyelam.en: Andi's new neighbor is a diver who works on a coral reef project.
w|penyelam.ko: 안디의 새 이웃은 산호초 사업에서 일하는 잠수부예요.

w|penyelam.text: Seorang penyelam menemukan guci di bangkai kapal itu, kata keterangan yang dibaca Dewi.
w|penyelam.en: A diver found the jar in that shipwreck, according to the caption Dewi read.
w|penyelam.ko: 데위가 읽은 설명에 따르면 한 잠수부가 그 난파선에서 항아리를 찾았대요.

w|penyelamat.text: Penyelamat itu menarik korban dari sungai.
w|penyelamat.en: That rescuer pulled the victim from the river.
He is considered the team's savior.

w|penyelamatan.text: Pak Agus menerima penghargaan atas penyelamatan anak yang hanyut di sungai.
w|penyelamatan.en: Mr. Agus received an award for rescuing a child swept away in the river.
w|penyelamatan.ko: 아구스 경관은 강에 떠내려간 아이를 구한 공로로 상을 받았어요.

w|penyelamatan.text: Blok Dewi di detik terakhir menjadi penyelamatan penting bagi tim.
w|penyelamatan.en: Dewi's block in the final seconds was an important save for the team.
w|penyelamatan.ko: 마지막 몇 초에 나온 데위의 블록이 팀을 살렸어요.

w|penyelesaian.text: Target penyelesaian gedung itu mundur dua bulan karena hujan terus-menerus.
w|penyelesaian.en: The target completion date for the building was pushed back two months because of constant rain.
w|penyelesaian.ko: 계속 내린 비 때문에 그 건물의 완공 목표가 두 달 늦춰졌어요.

w|penyelesaian.text: Wati menunggu penyelesaian keluhannya sebelum memesan lagi dari toko itu.
w|penyelesaian.en: Wati is waiting for her complaint to be resolved before ordering from that shop again.
w|penyelesaian.ko: 와티는 그 가게에서 다시 주문하기 전에 불만 처리가 끝나길 기다리고 있어요.

w|penyelidik.text: Budi bercita-cita menjadi penyelidik seperti tokoh di buku favoritnya.
w|penyelidik.en: Budi dreams of becoming an investigator like the character in his favorite book.
w|penyelidik.ko: 부디는 좋아하는 책 속 인물처럼 수사관이 되고 싶어요.

w|penyelidik.text: Penumpang di sebelah Siti ternyata seorang penyelidik asuransi.
w|penyelidik.en: The passenger next to Siti turned out to be an insurance investigator.
w|penyelidik.ko: 시티 옆자리 승객은 알고 보니 보험 조사관이었어요.

w|penyelidikan.en: The police opened a new investigation.

w|penyelundup.text: Dalam drama itu, Eko berperan sebagai penyelundup yang membawa barang lewat pelabuhan.
w|penyelundup.en: In the play, Eko plays a smuggler who brings goods through the port.
w|penyelundup.ko: 그 연극에서 에코는 항구로 물건을 몰래 들여오는 밀수꾼 역을 해요.

w|penyelundup.text: Berita di televisi toko Ayu melaporkan penyelundup narkoba yang tertangkap di pelabuhan.
w|penyelundup.en: The news on the TV in Ayu's shop reported a drug smuggler caught at the port.
w|penyelundup.ko: 아유 가게 TV 뉴스에서 항구에서 붙잡힌 마약 밀수범 소식을 전했어요.

w|penyelundupan.text: Untuk tugas kliping, Budi mengumpulkan berita tentang penyelundupan satwa langka.
w|penyelundupan.en: For his clippings assignment, Budi collected news articles about the smuggling of rare animals.
w|penyelundupan.ko: 스크랩 과제로 버디는 희귀 동물 밀수에 관한 기사를 모았어요.

w|penyelundupan.text: Siti membaca di koran bahwa penyelundupan kayu marak saat musim kemarau.
w|penyelundupan.en: Siti read in the paper that timber smuggling is rampant in the dry season.
w|penyelundupan.ko: 시티는 건기에 목재 밀수가 기승을 부린다는 기사를 읽었어요.

w|penyembuh.text: Para pemilik hewan di kota itu menganggap Rudi sebagai penyembuh yang sabar.
w|penyembuh.en: Pet owners in that town see Rudi as a patient healer.
w|penyembuh.ko: 그 도시의 반려동물 주인들은 루디를 참을성 있는 치료사로 여겨요.

w|penyembuh.text: Warga desa Rina masih percaya pada penyembuh tradisional di lereng gunung.
w|penyembuh.en: Rina's villagers still believe in the traditional healer on the mountain slope.
w|penyembuh.ko: 리나네 마을 사람들은 아직도 산비탈의 전통 치료사를 믿어요.

w|penyembuhan.text: Setelah cedera, Bayu menjalani proses penyembuhan selama dua bulan.
w|penyembuhan.en: After the injury, Bayu went through a two-month healing process.
w|penyembuhan.ko: 부상 후 바유는 두 달 동안 치료 과정을 거쳤어요.

w|penyembuhan.text: Keluarga Intan berdoa untuk penyembuhan paman yang masih dirawat.
w|penyembuhan.en: Intan's family prays for the recovery of the uncle who is still in hospital.
w|penyembuhan.ko: 인탄의 가족은 아직 입원 중인 삼촌이 낫기를 기도해요.

w|penyendiri.text: Andi jarang melihat tetangga penyendiri itu keluar rumah.
w|penyendiri.en: Andi rarely sees that reclusive neighbor leave the house.
w|penyendiri.ko: 안디는 그 혼자 지내는 이웃이 집 밖에 나오는 걸 거의 못 봐요.

w|penyendiri.text: Murid penyendiri itu baru berani bicara setelah Dewi mengajarinya main cello.
w|penyendiri.en: The loner student only dared to speak after Dewi taught him to play the cello.
w|penyendiri.ko: 혼자 지내던 그 학생은 데위에게 첼로를 배우고 나서야 말을 꺼냈어요.

w|penyerahan.text: Andi membaca arsip koran tentang penyerahan kedaulatan pada tahun-tahun awal kemerdekaan.
w|penyerahan.en: Andi read newspaper archives about the transfer of sovereignty in the early years of independence.
w|penyerahan.ko: 안디는 독립 초기 주권 이양에 관한 신문 기록을 읽었어요.

w|penyerahan.text: Acara penyerahan kunci rumah dari pemilik lama kepada Dewi berlangsung singkat.
w|penyerahan.en: The handover of the house keys from the previous owner to Dewi was brief.
w|penyerahan.ko: 이전 집주인이 데위에게 열쇠를 넘겨주는 일은 금방 끝났어요.

w|penyerang.text: Di tim sepak bola sekolah, Andi bermain sebagai penyerang.
w|penyerang.en: On the school football team, Andi plays as a striker.

w|penyerang.text: Adik Dewi pura-pura jadi penyerang dalam main bola di halaman.
w|penyerang.en: Dewi's brother pretended to be a striker in a football game in the yard.
w|penyerang.ko: 데위의 동생은 마당 공놀이에서 공격수 흉내를 냈어요.

w|penyerangan.en: That night attack shocked the residents.
w|penyerangan.ko: 그날 밤 공격이 주민들을 놀라게 했어.

w|penyerangan.en: The defense team was ready to face an assault.

w|penyerbuan.text: Fajar membaca arsip lama tentang penyerbuan benteng kota pada zaman kolonial.
w|penyerbuan.en: Fajar read old archives about the storming of the city fort in colonial times.
w|penyerbuan.ko: 파자르는 식민지 시대 도시 요새 습격에 관한 옛 기록을 읽었어요.

w|penyerbuan.text: Lestari menonton film dokumenter tentang penyerbuan pasukan sekutu di sebuah pantai.
w|penyerbuan.en: Lestari watched a documentary about an Allied assault on a beach.
w|penyerbuan.ko: 레스타리는 연합군의 해변 상륙 공격에 관한 다큐멘터리를 봤어요.

w|penyergapan.text: Novel perang yang dipinjam Andi dibuka dengan penyergapan di hutan.
w|penyergapan.en: The war novel Andi borrowed opens with an ambush in the forest.
w|penyergapan.ko: 안디가 빌린 전쟁 소설은 숲속 매복 장면으로 시작해요.

w|penyergapan.text: Dewi menonton film aksi tentang penyergapan kapal penyelundup setelah pulang kerja.
w|penyergapan.en: After work, Dewi watched an action film about an ambush on a smugglers' ship.
w|penyergapan.ko: 디위는 퇴근 후 밀수선 매복 작전을 다룬 액션 영화를 봤어요.

w|penyesalan.text: Ada sedikit penyesalan karena Rudi jarang membalas surat Bayu dulu.
w|penyesalan.en: There is a little regret because Rudi rarely answered Bayu's letters in the past.
w|penyesalan.ko: 루디가 예전에 바유의 편지에 거의 답하지 않아서 조금 후회가 남아요.

w|penyesalan.text: Rina tidak mau ada penyesalan, jadi dia menguji fitur itu sekali lagi.
w|penyesalan.en: Rina didn't want any regrets, so she tested the feature once more.
w|penyesalan.ko: 리나는 후회하고 싶지 않아서 그 기능을 한 번 더 시험했어요.

w|penyesuaian.text: Jadwal jaga Eko perlu penyesuaian selama musim liburan sekolah.
w|penyesuaian.en: Eko's duty schedule needs adjusting during the school holidays.
w|penyesuaian.ko: 학교 방학 동안에는 에코의 근무 일정을 조정해야 해요.

w|penyesuaian.text: Kawat gigi Ayu perlu penyesuaian setiap bulan.
w|penyesuaian.en: Ayu's braces need adjusting every month.
w|penyesuaian.ko: 아유의 치아 교정기는 매달 조정이 필요해요.

w|penyewa.text: Agus adalah penyewa paling lama di gedung apartemen itu.
w|penyewa.en: Agus is the longest-standing tenant in that apartment building.
w|penyewa.ko: 아구스는 그 아파트에서 가장 오래 산 세입자예요.

w|penyewa.text: Wati adalah penyewa ruko yang kini menjadi rumah makan keluarga.
w|penyewa.en: Wati is the tenant of the shophouse that is now a family restaurant.
w|penyewa.ko: 와티는 지금 가족 식당이 된 상가 건물의 세입자예요.

w|penyiar.text: Eko mendengarkan penyiar radio sambil memotong bawang.
w|penyiar.en: Eko listens to the radio announcer while chopping onions.
w|penyiar.ko: 에코는 양파를 썰면서 라디오 진행자 목소리를 들어요.

w|penyiar.text: Pagi itu seorang penyiar radio mengumumkan awal musim hujan saat Ayu bersiap ke kampus.
w|penyiar.en: That morning a radio announcer declared the start of the rainy season as Ayu got ready for campus.
w|penyiar.ko: 그날 아침 아유가 학교 갈 준비를 할 때 라디오 진행자가 우기가 시작됐다고 알렸어요.

w|penyiaran.text: Museum menyimpan mikrofon pertama dari stasiun penyiaran radio kota.
w|penyiaran.en: The museum keeps the first microphone from the city's radio broadcasting station.
w|penyiaran.ko: 박물관은 시 라디오 방송국의 첫 마이크를 보관하고 있어요.

w|penyiaran.text: Putri masuk ke ruang penyiaran untuk mengumumkan anak yang terpisah dari ibunya.
w|penyiaran.en: Putri went into the broadcast room to announce a child who had been separated from his mother.
w|penyiaran.ko: 푸트리는 엄마와 떨어진 아이를 안내 방송하려고 방송실에 들어갔어요.

w|penyidik.text: Eko memerankan seorang penyidik yang sabar dalam drama detektif itu.
w|penyidik.en: Eko plays a patient investigator in the detective play.
w|penyidik.ko: 에코는 그 탐정극에서 침착한 수사관 역을 맡았어요.

w|penyidik.text: Seorang penyidik datang ke toko Ayu untuk melihat rekaman kamera.
w|penyidik.en: An investigator came to Ayu's shop to look at the camera footage.
w|penyidik.ko: 수사관 한 명이 카메라 영상을 보러 아유의 가게에 왔어요.

w|penyihir.en: The children are afraid of the witch.

w|penyiksaan.text: Buku sejarah Andi membahas penyiksaan tahanan politik pada zaman penjajahan.
w|penyiksaan.en: Andi's history book discusses the torture of political prisoners during the colonial era.
w|penyiksaan.ko: 안디의 역사책은 식민지 시대 정치범 고문을 다뤄요.

w|penyiksaan.text: Dokter forensik menemukan bekas penyiksaan pada tubuh korban, menurut laporan polisi.
w|penyiksaan.en: According to the police report, the forensic doctor found signs of torture on the victim's body.
w|penyiksaan.ko: 경찰 보고서에 따르면 법의학 의사가 피해자 몸에서 고문 흔적을 발견했어요.

w|penyimpanan.text: Penyimpanan data di cloud sangat praktis.
w|penyimpanan.en: Data storage in the cloud is very practical.

w|penyimpanan.text: Ruang penyimpanan di gudang hampir penuh.
w|penyimpanan.en: The storage space in the warehouse is almost full.
w|penyimpanan.ko: 창고 보관 공간이 거의 가득 찼어.

w|penyimpangan.text: Tim audit menemukan penyimpangan kecil dalam laporan keuangan, dan Fajar diminta menjelaskan.
w|penyimpangan.en: The audit team found a small irregularity in the financial report, and Fajar was asked to explain.
w|penyimpangan.ko: 감사팀이 재무 보고서에서 작은 부정을 찾아내서 파자르가 설명해야 했어요.

w|penyimpangan.text: Lestari menulis bahwa guru mereka dulu tidak pernah menoleransi penyimpangan dari aturan kelas.
w|penyimpangan.en: Lestari wrote that their teacher never tolerated any deviation from the class rules.
w|penyimpangan.ko: 레스타리는 옛 선생님이 학급 규칙에서 벗어나는 걸 절대 봐주지 않으셨다고 썼어요.

w|penyitaan.text: Fajar ikut menyaksikan penyitaan barang dagangan liar di trotoar alun-alun.
w|penyitaan.en: Fajar was present for the seizure of unlicensed goods on the square's sidewalk.
w|penyitaan.ko: 파자르는 광장 인도에서 무허가 물건을 압수하는 현장에 함께 있었어요.

w|penyitaan.text: Lestari membaca surat edaran tentang penyitaan unit yang cicilannya menunggak.
w|penyitaan.en: Lestari read a notice about the seizure of units with overdue installments.
w|penyitaan.ko: 레스타리는 할부금이 밀린 집을 압류한다는 공지문을 읽었어요.

w|penyu.text: Bayu ikut melepas tukik penyu di muara sungai bersama anak-anak desa.
w|penyu.en: Bayu helped release baby sea turtles at the river mouth with the village kids.
w|penyu.ko: 바유는 마을 아이들과 함께 강어귀에서 새끼 바다거북을 풀어 주었어요.

w|penyu.text: Medali yang diterima Intan berbentuk penyu, lambang kota pantai itu.
w|penyu.en: The medal Intan received was shaped like a sea turtle, the symbol of that coastal town.
w|penyu.ko: 인탄이 받은 메달은 그 해안 도시의 상징인 바다거북 모양이었어요.

w|penyusup.text: Satpam sekolah menangkap seorang penyusup yang memanjat pagar belakang.
w|penyusup.en: The school security guard caught an intruder climbing the back fence.
w|penyusup.ko: 학교 경비원이 뒷담을 넘던 침입자를 붙잡았어요.

w|penyusup.text: Satpam rumah sakit memeriksa rekaman kamera setelah ada laporan penyusup di lantai tiga.
w|penyusup.en: Hospital security checked the camera footage after a report of an intruder on the third floor.
w|penyusup.ko: 삼 층에 침입자가 있다는 신고가 들어와 병원 경비원이 카메라 영상을 확인했어요.

w|pepatah.text: Bu Guru menulis pepatah “rajin pangkal pandai” di papan tulis kelas Agus.
w|pepatah.en: The teacher wrote the proverb "diligence is the root of cleverness" on the board in Agus's class.
w|pepatah.ko: 선생님은 아구스네 반 칠판에 "부지런함이 똑똑함의 뿌리"라는 속담을 썼어요.

w|pepatah.text: Pelatih Wati sering mengutip pepatah “sedikit demi sedikit, lama-lama menjadi bukit”.
w|pepatah.en: Wati's coach often quotes the proverb "little by little, it becomes a hill."
w|pepatah.ko: 와티의 코치는 "티끌 모아 태산"이라는 속담을 자주 인용해요.

w|peperangan.en: History records a long period of warfare.

w|pepohonan.text: Agus suka berjalan di bawah pepohonan rindang saat siang terik.
w|pepohonan.en: Agus likes walking under the shady trees in the blazing midday heat.
w|pepohonan.ko: 아구스는 땡볕이 드는 한낮에 우거진 나무 아래를 걷는 걸 좋아해요.

w|pepohonan.text: Apotek tempat Wati bekerja dikelilingi pepohonan, jadi udaranya sejuk.
w|pepohonan.en: The pharmacy where Wati works is surrounded by trees, so the air is cool.
w|pepohonan.ko: 와티가 일하는 약국은 나무로 둘러싸여 있어서 공기가 시원해요.

w|per.en: The ticket price is cheap per person.

w|per.text: Per hari dia minum banyak air.
w|per.en: Per day he drinks a lot of water.

w|perabotan.text: Semua perabotan di kantor baru Dimas masih terbungkus plastik.
w|perabotan.en: All the furniture in Dimas's new office was still wrapped in plastic.
w|perabotan.ko: 디마스의 새 사무실 가구는 전부 아직 비닐에 싸여 있었어요.

w|perabotan.text: Ruang tunggu itu baru direnovasi, dan Putri suka perabotan kayunya yang empuk.
w|perabotan.en: That waiting room had just been renovated, and Putri liked its comfy wooden furniture.
w|perabotan.ko: 그 대기실은 새로 고쳐서 푸트리는 푹신한 나무 가구가 마음에 들었어요.

w|peradaban.en: Ancient civilization left many relics behind.

w|peradaban.text: Buku itu membahas sejarah peradaban dunia.
w|peradaban.en: That book discusses the history of world civilization.

w|peradilan.text: Berkas kasus itu sudah Rudi serahkan ke lembaga peradilan.
w|peradilan.en: Rudi has already handed the case file over to the judiciary.
w|peradilan.ko: 루디는 그 사건 서류를 이미 사법 기관에 넘겼어요.

w|peradilan.text: Kasus penyiksaan hewan itu dibawa ke peradilan, dan Rina menjadi saksi ahli.
w|peradilan.en: The animal cruelty case was taken to court, and Rina served as an expert witness.
w|peradilan.ko: 그 동물 학대 사건은 재판에 넘겨졌고 리나가 전문가 증인으로 나섰어요.

w|perahu.en: A small boat is floating on the lake.
w|perahu.ko: 작은 배가 호수 위에 떠 있어.

w|perahu.en: The fisherman repairs the boat before sailing.

w|perairan.text: Agus dilarang memancing di perairan dekat bendungan karena arusnya deras.
w|perairan.en: Agus isn't allowed to fish in the waters near the dam because the current is strong.
w|perairan.ko: 아구스는 물살이 세서 댐 근처 물에서 낚시하면 안 돼요.

w|perairan.text: Wati menyarankan obat antimabuk kepada pelanggan yang akan menyeberangi perairan berombak.
w|perairan.en: Wati recommends seasickness pills to a customer about to cross choppy waters.
w|perairan.ko: 와티는 파도 높은 바다를 건널 손님에게 멀미약을 권했어요.

w|peralatan.en: The new kitchen equipment has arrived.
Bring all the hiking equipment tomorrow.

w|peramal.text: Bibi Rudi bercanda bahwa seorang peramal sudah menebak jodoh pengantin wanita.
w|peramal.en: Rudi's aunt joked that a fortune-teller had already guessed the bride's match.
w|peramal.ko: 루디의 이모는 점쟁이가 신부의 짝을 벌써 맞혔다고 농담했어요.

w|peramal.text: Rina menulis artikel ringan tentang peramal cuaca tradisional di desa nelayan.
w|peramal.en: Rina wrote a light article about traditional weather forecasters in a fishing village.
w|peramal.ko: 리나는 어촌의 전통 날씨 점쟁이에 대한 가벼운 기사를 썼어요.

w|perampok.en: That robber was successfully caught by the police.

w|perampok.text: Warga melaporkan perampok yang kabur ke hutan.
w|perampok.en: Residents reported a robber who fled into the forest.

w|perampokan.text: Perampokan itu terjadi di tengah malam.
w|perampokan.en: That robbery happened in the middle of the night.
The police are investigating the robbery case.

w|peran.text: Dia mendapat peran penting dalam film.
w|peran.en: She got an important role in the film.

w|peran.text: Setiap orang punya peran di tim.
w|peran.en: Everyone has a role on the team.

w|perancang.text: Rudi bekerja sama dengan perancang interior untuk merombak dapur.
w|perancang.en: Rudi worked with an interior designer to remodel the kitchen.
w|perancang.ko: 루디는 주방을 개조하려고 인테리어 디자이너와 함께 일했어요.

w|perancang.text: Seorang perancang busana sering datang ke lapak Rina mencari kain lawas.
w|perancang.en: A fashion designer often comes to Rina's stall looking for vintage fabric.
w|perancang.ko: 한 패션 디자이너가 옛날 천을 찾으러 리나의 노점에 자주 와요.

w|perangkap.en: A mouse trap was set in the kitchen.

w|perangkap.text: Hewan itu masuk perangkap tanpa sadar.
w|perangkap.en: That animal entered the trap without noticing.

w|perangkat.en: The technician repaired that broken device.

w|perantara.text: Seorang perantara menawarkan dokumen rahasia, tetapi Fajar menolaknya.
w|perantara.en: A middleman offered secret documents, but Fajar turned him down.
w|perantara.ko: 한 중개인이 비밀 문서를 내밀었지만 파자르는 거절했어요.

w|perantara.text: Lestari menyewa vila melalui perantara yang ia temukan di grup daring.
w|perantara.en: Lestari rented a villa through a middleman she found in an online group.
w|perantara.ko: 레스타리는 온라인 모임에서 찾은 중개인을 통해 빌라를 빌렸어요.

w|perapian.text: Agus iri melihat unit penthouse yang punya perapian listrik.
w|perapian.en: Agus is envious of the penthouse unit that has an electric fireplace.
w|perapian.ko: 아구스는 전기 벽난로가 있는 펜트하우스가 부러워요.

w|perapian.text: Saat menginap di vila pegunungan, Wati duduk dekat perapian karena malam sangat dingin.
w|perapian.en: While staying at a mountain villa, Wati sat near the fireplace because the night was very cold.
w|perapian.ko: 산속 별장에 묵을 때 밤이 너무 추워서 와티는 벽난로 옆에 앉았어요.

w|peraturan.text: Peraturan baru mulai berlaku bulan depan.
w|peraturan.en: The new rules take effect next month.

w|perawan.text: Hutan perawan itu masih belum dijelajahi.
w|perawan.en: That virgin forest has not yet been explored.

w|perawan.text: Pulau perawan tampak tenang dari kapal.
w|perawan.en: The untouched island looked calm from the ship.
w|perawan.ko: 손때 안 묻은 섬이 배에서 고요해 보였어.

w|perawat.en: The nurse checked the patient's blood pressure.

w|perawat.text: Dia ingin menjadi perawat yang baik.
w|perawat.en: She wants to become a good nurse.

w|perawatan.en: Wound care must be done sterilely.

w|perayaan.text: Perayaan ulang tahun diadakan di taman.
w|perayaan.en: The birthday celebration was held in the park.

w|perayaan.text: Seluruh desa ikut dalam perayaan panen.
w|perayaan.en: The whole village joined the harvest celebration.

w|perbaikan.text: Sayap timur museum ditutup sementara untuk perbaikan atap.
w|perbaikan.en: The museum's east wing is temporarily closed for roof repairs.
w|perbaikan.ko: 박물관 동관은 지붕 보수 때문에 잠시 문을 닫았어요.

w|perbaikan.text: Setelah perbaikan saluran air, los daging tidak lagi becek.
w|perbaikan.en: After the drainage repairs, the meat section is no longer muddy.
w|perbaikan.ko: 배수로를 고친 뒤로 정육 구역이 더 이상 질척거리지 않아요.

w|perban.text: Budi mengganti perban di kaki anjing itu dua kali sehari.
w|perban.en: Budi changes the bandage on that dog's leg twice a day.
w|perban.ko: 부디는 그 개 다리의 붕대를 하루에 두 번 갈아요.

w|perban.text: Siti selalu membawa perban di tasnya saat naik ke kebun teh.
w|perban.en: Siti always carries a bandage in her bag when she climbs up to the tea garden.
w|perban.ko: 시티는 차밭에 올라갈 때 늘 가방에 붕대를 넣고 다녀요.

w|perbandingan.text: Agus membuat perbandingan hasil panen kentang tahun ini dan tahun lalu.
w|perbandingan.en: Agus compared this year's potato harvest with last year's.
w|perbandingan.ko: 아구스는 올해와 작년 감자 수확량을 비교해 봤어요.

w|perbandingan.text: Wati membuat perbandingan lucu antara masa sekolah mereka dan masa sekarang.
w|perbandingan.en: Wati made a funny comparison between their school days and the present.
w|perbandingan.ko: 와티는 학창 시절과 지금을 재미있게 비교했어요.

w|perbankan.text: Andi ditugaskan meliput isu perbankan dan keuangan.
w|perbankan.en: Andi was assigned to cover banking and finance.
w|perbankan.ko: 안디는 은행과 금융 분야 취재를 맡았어요.

w|perbankan.text: Dewi harus mengubah alamat di semua layanan perbankan.
w|perbankan.en: Dewi has to update her address with all her banking services.
w|perbankan.ko: 데위는 모든 은행 서비스에서 주소를 바꿔야 해요.

w|perbatasan.text: Perbatasan itu dijaga ketat setiap malam.
w|perbatasan.en: That border is tightly guarded every night.
w|perbatasan.ko: 그 국경은 매일 밤 삼엄하게 지켜져.

w|perbatasan.text: Kami tiba di perbatasan sebelum matahari terbenam.
w|perbatasan.en: We arrived at the border before sunset.
w|perbatasan.ko: 우리는 해 지기 전에 국경에 도착했어.

w|perbedaan.en: There is a big difference between the two.
Differences of opinion are natural in discussion.

w|perbincangan.text: Andi terlibat perbincangan seru dengan pustakawan tentang novel favorit mereka.
w|perbincangan.en: Andi got into a lively conversation with the librarian about their favorite novels.
w|perbincangan.ko: 안디는 사서와 좋아하는 소설에 대해 신나게 이야기를 나눴어요.

w|perbincangan.text: Di tengah perbincangan dengan tetangga baru, Dewi tahu bahwa pasar ada di ujung gang.
w|perbincangan.en: In the middle of a chat with her new neighbor, Dewi learned that the market was at the end of the alley.
w|perbincangan.ko: 새 이웃과 이야기하다가 데위는 골목 끝에 시장이 있다는 걸 알았어요.

w|perbuatan.en: Good deeds will be remembered by people.

w|perbudakan.text: Edisi khusus koran itu membahas sejarah perbudakan di perkebunan zaman kolonial.
w|perbudakan.en: The paper's special edition discussed the history of slavery on colonial-era plantations.
w|perbudakan.ko: 그 신문 특별판은 식민지 시대 농장의 노예제 역사를 다뤘어요.

w|perbudakan.text: Intan membaca buku sejarah tentang penghapusan perbudakan di abad kesembilan belas.
w|perbudakan.en: Intan read a history book about the abolition of slavery in the nineteenth century.
w|perbudakan.ko: 인탄은 십구 세기 노예제 폐지에 관한 역사책을 읽었어요.

w|perburuan.text: Banyak orang berlomba dalam perburuan diskon setiap tanggal kembar.
w|perburuan.en: Many people compete in the hunt for discounts on every double-date sale.
w|perburuan.ko: 많은 사람이 날짜와 달이 같은 날마다 할인을 찾아 경쟁해요.

w|perburuan.text: Guru bercerita tentang tradisi perburuan rusa di desanya pada zaman dulu.
w|perburuan.en: The teacher talked about the old deer-hunting tradition in her village.
w|perburuan.ko: 선생님은 예전에 자기 마을에 있던 사슴 사냥 전통을 이야기했어요.

w|percakapan.en: Their conversation could be heard from outside.

w|percakapan.text: Kami menikmati percakapan panjang malam itu.
w|percakapan.en: We enjoyed a long conversation that night.
w|percakapan.ko: 우리는 그날 밤 긴 대화를 즐겼어.

w|percaya.en: It's hard to believe that news.

w|perceraian.text: Rina pernah menulis skripsi tentang dampak perceraian pada anak.
w|perceraian.en: Rina once wrote her thesis on the effects of divorce on children.
w|perceraian.ko: 리나는 이혼이 아이에게 미치는 영향에 관한 졸업 논문을 쓴 적이 있어요.

w|perceraian.text: Pengacara yang menginap di hotel itu sedang mengurus kasus perceraian artis.
w|perceraian.en: The lawyer staying at the hotel is handling a celebrity's divorce case.
w|perceraian.ko: 그 호텔에 묵는 변호사는 한 연예인의 이혼 사건을 맡고 있어요.

w|percikan.text: Rudi memperhatikan percikan api unggun yang terbang ke langit malam.
w|percikan.en: Rudi watched the sparks from the campfire fly up into the night sky.
w|percikan.ko: 루디는 모닥불 불티가 밤하늘로 날아오르는 걸 바라봤어요.

w|percikan.text: Rina berteriak kegirangan melihat percikan kembang api di akhir lagu.
w|percikan.en: Rina screamed with joy at the burst of fireworks at the end of the song.
w|percikan.ko: 리나는 노래 끝에 터지는 불꽃을 보고 신나서 소리를 질렀어요.

w|percintaan.text: Budi bercerita tentang kisah percintaan yang gagal di kota rantau.
w|percintaan.en: Budi told of a failed romance in the city where he now lives.
w|percintaan.ko: 부디는 타향에서 실패한 연애 이야기를 들려줬어요.

w|percintaan.text: Ibu-ibu di gang suka bergosip soal percintaan anak Pak Darto.
w|percintaan.en: The women in the alley love gossiping about Mr. Darto's son's love life.
w|percintaan.ko: 골목 아주머니들은 다르토 아저씨 아들의 연애사를 수군거리길 좋아해요.

w|percobaan.text: Percobaan ilmiah itu berhasil dengan baik.
Ini hanya percobaan pertama, jangan khawatir.
w|percobaan.en: This is only the first attempt, don't worry.
w|percobaan.ko: 이건 첫 시도일 뿐이니 걱정 마.

w|percuma.text: Kata dokter, sikat gigi keras-keras itu percuma kalau tidak pakai benang gigi.
w|percuma.en: The dentist said brushing hard is pointless if you don't floss.
w|percuma.ko: 의사는 치실을 안 쓰면 세게 양치해도 소용없다고 했어요.

w|percuma.text: Mengecat ulang tembok itu percuma kalau rembesan air belum diperbaiki.
w|percuma.en: Repainting the wall is pointless if the water seepage hasn't been fixed.
w|percuma.ko: 물이 새는 걸 고치지 않으면 벽을 다시 칠해도 소용없어요.

w|perdagangan.en: Trade between countries increased this year.

w|perdagangan.text: Dia bekerja di bidang perdagangan elektronik.

w|perdamaian.text: Mereka berjuang untuk perdamaian di dunia.
w|perdamaian.en: They fight for peace in the world.

w|perdamaian.text: Perdamaian dimulai dari hati yang terbuka.
w|perdamaian.en: Peace begins from an open heart.

w|perdana.en: Their premiere film was a big success.
The prime minister gave a short speech.

w|perdebatan.text: Setelah pertunjukan ada perdebatan seru antara penonton dan sutradara.
w|perdebatan.en: After the show there was a lively debate between the audience and the director.
w|perdebatan.ko: 공연이 끝난 뒤 관객과 연출가 사이에 뜨거운 토론이 있었어요.

w|perdebatan.text: Rapat desa diwarnai perdebatan soal letak pasar baru.
w|perdebatan.en: The village meeting was marked by debate over where to put the new market.
w|perdebatan.ko: 마을 회의에서는 새 시장 위치를 두고 논쟁이 벌어졌어요.

w|perebutan.text: Bayu melaporkan perebutan lahan parkir antara dua kelompok tukang ojek.
w|perebutan.en: Bayu reported on a struggle over parking space between two groups of motorbike taxi drivers.
w|perebutan.ko: 바유는 오토바이 택시 기사 두 무리의 주차 공간 다툼을 보도했어요.

w|perebutan.text: Saat diskon tengah malam, terjadi perebutan barang murah di antara ribuan pembeli.
w|perebutan.en: During the midnight sale, there was a scramble for cheap goods among thousands of buyers.
w|perebutan.ko: 자정 할인 때 수천 명의 구매자가 싼 물건을 서로 차지하려고 다퉜어요.

w|peregangan.text: Budi mengajak pasien melakukan peregangan ringan di tempat tidur.
w|peregangan.en: Budi got the patient to do some light stretching in bed.
w|peregangan.ko: 부디는 환자와 함께 침대에서 가벼운 스트레칭을 했어요.

w|peregangan.text: Siti melakukan peregangan di lorong ruang tunggu sebelum naik pesawat.
w|peregangan.en: Siti did some stretching in the lounge corridor before boarding.
w|peregangan.ko: 시티는 탑승 전에 대합실 통로에서 스트레칭을 했어요.
