w|rahang.text: Kakek Intan mengunyah pelan karena rahangnya sakit.
w|rahang.en: Intan's grandfather chews slowly because his jaw hurts.
w|rahang.ko: 인탄의 할아버지는 턱이 아파서 천천히 씹어요.

w|rahim.text: Dokter hewan menemukan kista kecil di rahim kucing betina milik Bu Rina.
w|rahim.en: The vet found a small cyst in the uterus of Mrs. Rina's female cat.
w|rahim.ko: 수의사는 리나 씨의 암고양이 자궁에서 작은 낭종을 발견했어요.

w|rahim.text: Bidan desa menjelaskan kepada Siti cara menjaga kesehatan rahim setelah melahirkan.
w|rahim.en: The village midwife explained to Siti how to keep the uterus healthy after giving birth.
w|rahim.ko: 마을 조산사는 시티에게 출산 뒤 자궁 건강을 지키는 법을 설명했어요.

w|rahmat.text: Kepala sekolah bilang hujan setelah kemarau panjang adalah rahmat bagi petani.
w|rahmat.en: The principal said rain after a long drought is a blessing for farmers.
w|rahmat.ko: 교장 선생님은 긴 가뭄 끝의 비는 농부들에게 축복이라고 했어요.

w|rahmat.text: Ayu menganggap bakat melukisnya sebagai rahmat yang harus dijaga.
w|rahmat.en: Ayu regards her painting talent as a blessing to be cherished.
w|rahmat.ko: 아유는 그림 재능을 소중히 지켜야 할 축복으로 여겨요.

w|rajin.text: Fajar dikenal rajin karena selalu datang paling pagi.
w|rajin.en: Fajar is known as hardworking because he always arrives earliest.
w|rajin.ko: 파자르는 늘 제일 일찍 와서 성실하다고 알려져 있어요.

w|rajin.text: Para programmer muda di kantor Lestari sangat rajin memperbaiki kesalahan kode.
w|rajin.en: The young programmers at Lestari's office are very diligent about fixing code bugs.
w|rajin.ko: 레스타리 회사의 젊은 개발자들은 코드 오류를 아주 부지런히 고쳐요.

w|rak.text: Di warung pinggir pantai, Eko mengambil sebotol air dari rak paling bawah.
w|rak.en: At the beachside stall, Eko took a bottle of water from the bottom shelf.
w|rak.ko: 바닷가 가게에서 에코는 맨 아래 선반에서 물 한 병을 꺼냈어요.

w|rak.text: Pak Hasan membantu Ayu memasang rak buku di dinding.
w|rak.en: Mr. Hasan helped Ayu mount a bookshelf on the wall.
w|rak.ko: 하산 씨가 아유를 도와 벽에 책장을 달았어요.

w|raksasa.text: Dalam dongeng ada raksasa yang marah.
w|raksasa.en: In the fairy tale there is an angry giant.
That giant guards the old bridge.

w|rakun.text: Agus membacakan buku anak tentang rakun yang suka mencuri makanan.
w|rakun.en: Agus read aloud a children's book about a raccoon that loves to steal food.
w|rakun.ko: 아구스는 음식을 훔치기 좋아하는 너구리 이야기 동화책을 읽어 줬어요.

w|rakun.text: Wati bercerita tentang rakun di kebun binatang yang membuat cucunya tertawa.
w|rakun.en: Wati wrote about a raccoon at the zoo that made her grandchild laugh.
w|rakun.ko: 와티는 손주를 웃게 한 동물원 너구리 이야기를 썼어요.

w|rakus.text: Bayu bercanda bahwa rekan yang menghabiskan kue sendirian itu rakus.
w|rakus.en: Bayu joked that the coworker who finished the cake alone was greedy.
w|rakus.ko: 바유는 케이크를 혼자 다 먹은 동료가 욕심쟁이라고 농담했어요.

w|rakus.text: Setelah latihan berat, Intan jadi rakus makan nasi.
w|rakus.en: After a hard workout, Intan gets greedy for rice.
w|rakus.ko: 힘든 운동 뒤에는 인탄이 밥을 게걸스럽게 먹어요.

w|rakyat.en: The government must listen to the people.

w|rakyat.text: Rakyat berhak mendapat layanan yang baik.
w|rakyat.en: The people have a right to good services.
w|rakyat.ko: 국민은 좋은 서비스를 받을 권리가 있어.

w|ramah.en: That new neighbor is very friendly.

w|ramah.text: Ramah kepada orang asing itu penting.

w|ramai.text: Pada hari Senin, ruang pelayanan selalu ramai oleh warga yang mengurus surat.
w|ramai.en: On Mondays, the service room is always busy with residents handling paperwork.
w|ramai.ko: 월요일마다 민원실은 서류를 처리하러 온 주민들로 붐벼요.

w|ramai.text: Tribun gedung olahraga ramai sekali saat Dewi masuk lapangan.
w|ramai.en: The sports hall stands were packed when Dewi entered the court.
w|ramai.ko: 데위가 코트에 들어서자 체육관 관중석이 떠들썩했어요.

w|ramalan.text: Koran itu masih memuat ramalan cuaca di halaman belakang.
w|ramalan.en: The newspaper still prints the weather forecast on the back page.
w|ramalan.ko: 그 신문은 아직도 뒷면에 일기 예보를 실어요.

w|ramalan.text: Ayu tidak percaya ramalan bintang di aplikasi, tapi tetap membacanya.
w|ramalan.en: Ayu doesn't believe the horoscope in the app, but she still reads it.
w|ramalan.ko: 아유는 앱 속 별자리 운세를 믿지 않지만 그래도 읽어 봐요.

w|rambut.en: Her hair is long and black.

w|rampasan.text: Beberapa benda di museum itu dulu merupakan barang rampasan perang.
w|rampasan.en: Some of the objects in that museum were once spoils of war.
w|rampasan.ko: 그 박물관의 몇몇 물건은 예전에 전쟁 약탈품이었어요.

w|rampasan.text: Adik Putri menyebut tas-tas belanja dari obral itu sebagai hasil rampasan.
w|rampasan.en: Putri's younger sibling called the shopping bags from the sale "the loot."
w|rampasan.ko: 푸트리 동생은 세일에서 산 쇼핑백들을 전리품이라고 불렀어요.

w|ramping.text: Seorang remaja bertanya soal obat diet, padahal badan remaja itu sudah ramping.
w|ramping.en: A teenager asked about diet pills even though she was already slim.
w|ramping.ko: 한 십 대가 이미 날씬한데도 다이어트 약을 물어봤어요.

w|ramping.text: Laptop rekan baru yang ramping langsung jadi bahan obrolan.
w|ramping.en: The new coworker's sleek laptop immediately became a topic of conversation.
w|ramping.ko: 새 동료의 얇은 노트북이 바로 이야깃거리가 됐어요.

w|ramuan.text: Di laci barang bukti ada botol ramuan yang dijual tanpa izin.
w|ramuan.en: In the evidence drawer there is a bottle of potion that was sold without a permit.
w|ramuan.ko: 증거품 서랍에는 허가 없이 팔린 약물 병이 있어요.

w|ramuan.text: Nenek Dewi selalu membawakan ramuan kunyit untuk memulihkan tenaga.
w|ramuan.en: Dewi's grandmother always brings a turmeric tonic to restore her energy.
w|ramuan.ko: 데위 할머니는 기운 차리라고 늘 강황 약차를 챙겨 주세요.

w|rancangan.text: Pemilik restoran menunjukkan rancangan dapur baru kepada Fajar dan para koki.
w|rancangan.en: The restaurant owner showed the new kitchen design to Fajar and the cooks.
w|rancangan.ko: 식당 주인이 파자르와 요리사들에게 새 주방 설계도를 보여 줬어요.

w|rancangan.text: Lestari membeli buku tua berisi rancangan rumah adat dari seorang kakek.
w|rancangan.en: Lestari bought an old book full of traditional house designs from an elderly man.
w|rancangan.ko: 레스타리는 한 할아버지에게서 전통 가옥 설계도가 담긴 옛날 책을 샀어요.

w|rangka.text: Di ruang biologi ada rangka manusia dari plastik.
w|rangka.en: There's a plastic human skeleton in the biology room.
w|rangka.ko: 생물실에는 플라스틱으로 된 사람 뼈대 모형이 있어요.

w|rangka.text: Reuni itu diadakan dalam rangka ulang tahun sekolah yang kelima puluh.
w|rangka.en: The reunion was held in celebration of the school's fiftieth anniversary.
w|rangka.ko: 그 동창회는 개교 오십 주년을 기념해 열렸어요.

w|rangkaian.text: Pemasangan atap adalah bagian terakhir dari rangkaian pekerjaan bulan ini.
w|rangkaian.en: Installing the roof is the last part of this month's series of work.
w|rangkaian.ko: 지붕 설치는 이번 달 일련의 작업 중 마지막 순서예요.

w|rangkaian.text: Wati memesan satu rangkaian bunga untuk ulang tahun ibunya.
w|rangkaian.en: Wati ordered a flower arrangement for her mother's birthday.
w|rangkaian.ko: 와티는 엄마 생일에 꽃다발 하나를 주문했어요.

w|ranjang.text: Ranjang baru itu terasa lebih nyaman.
w|ranjang.en: That new bed feels more comfortable.
w|ranjang.ko: 그 새 침대가 더 편안하게 느껴져.

w|ranjang.text: Dia merapikan ranjang sebelum pergi kerja.
w|ranjang.en: She made the bed before going to work.

w|ranjau.text: Di pelajaran sejarah, Rudi mendengar bahwa sisa ranjau perang masih ditemukan di beberapa negara.
w|ranjau.en: In history class, Rudi heard that leftover war mines are still found in some countries.
w|ranjau.ko: 역사 시간에 루디는 몇몇 나라에서 아직도 전쟁 때 묻힌 지뢰가 발견된다는 걸 들었어요.

w|ranjau.text: Kakek Rina, mantan tentara, pernah bertugas membersihkan ranjau di perbatasan.
w|ranjau.en: Rina's grandfather, a former soldier, once worked clearing mines at the border.
w|ranjau.ko: 군인이었던 리나의 할아버지는 국경에서 지뢰 제거 일을 하신 적이 있어요.

w|ransel.text: Dimas hanya membawa satu ransel kecil supaya mudah naik-turun kereta.
w|ransel.en: Dimas only brought one small backpack so it's easy to get on and off trains.
w|ransel.ko: 디마스는 기차를 타고 내리기 편하게 작은 배낭 하나만 가져왔어요.

w|ransel.text: Putri selalu membawa laptop di dalam ransel ke mana pun ia pergi.
w|ransel.en: Putri always carries her laptop in her backpack wherever she goes.
w|ransel.ko: 푸트리는 어디를 가든 배낭에 노트북을 넣고 다녀요.

w|rantai.text: Rantai sepeda itu putus di jalan.
w|rantai.en: The bicycle chain broke on the road.

w|rantai.text: Dia memakai rantai emas di lehernya.
w|rantai.en: She wore a gold chain around her neck.

w|rapat.text: Rapat dimulai tepat setelah makan siang.
w|rapat.en: The meeting starts right after lunch.

w|rapat.text: Kami membahas rencana di rapat kemarin.
w|rapat.en: We discussed the plan in yesterday's meeting.

w|rapi.text: Koleksi keris di lantai dua ditata sangat rapi dalam lemari kaca.
w|rapi.en: The keris collection on the second floor is arranged very neatly in glass cabinets.
w|rapi.ko: 이 층의 크리스 단검 소장품은 유리장 안에 아주 가지런히 놓여 있어요.

w|rapi.text: Lapak sayur Rina selalu rapi, jadi pembeli senang memilih.
w|rapi.en: Rina's vegetable stall is always tidy, so shoppers like choosing there.
w|rapi.ko: 리나의 채소 좌판은 늘 깔끔해서 손님들이 고르기 좋아해요.

w|rapuh.text: Rudi memegang kerangka fosil itu pelan-pelan karena sangat rapuh.
w|rapuh.en: Rudi held the fossil skeleton gently because it was very fragile.
w|rapuh.ko: 화석 뼈대가 아주 약해서 루디는 살살 들었어요.

w|rapuh.text: Kardus berisi gelas kaca itu ditandai rapuh oleh Rina.
w|rapuh.en: Rina marked the box of glassware as fragile.
w|rapuh.ko: 리나는 유리잔이 든 상자에 '깨지기 쉬움'이라고 표시했어요.

w|ras.text: Semua ras berhak mendapat perlakuan sama.
w|ras.ko: 모든 인종은 동등한 대우를 받을 권리가 있어.

w|ras.text: Ras anjing itu dikenal sangat setia.
w|ras.en: That dog breed is known to be very loyal.

w|rasional.text: Budi mencoba memberi saran yang rasional soal masalah keuangan Andi.
w|rasional.en: Budi tries to give rational advice on Andi's money problems.
w|rasional.ko: 부디는 안디의 돈 문제에 대해 합리적인 조언을 하려고 해요.

w|rasional.text: Siti membuat rencana latihan yang rasional supaya tidak cedera.
w|rasional.en: Siti made a rational training plan so as not to get injured.
w|rasional.ko: 시티는 다치지 않도록 합리적인 훈련 계획을 세웠어요.

w|rasis.text: Andi menemukan buku lama yang berisi gambar rasis dan menyerahkannya kepada petugas.
w|rasis.en: Andi found an old book containing racist drawings and handed it to the librarian.
w|rasis.ko: 안디는 인종차별적인 그림이 담긴 오래된 책을 발견하고 사서에게 건넸어요.

w|rasis.text: Kantor Dewi memecat karyawan yang mengirim lelucon rasis di grup kerja.
w|rasis.en: Dewi's office fired an employee who sent a racist joke in the work group chat.
w|rasis.ko: 디위의 회사는 업무 단톡방에 인종차별 농담을 보낸 직원을 해고했어요.

w|rata-rata.text: Jumlah perkara bulan ini jauh di atas rata-rata.
w|rata-rata.en: The number of cases this month is well above average.
w|rata-rata.ko: 이번 달 사건 수는 평균보다 훨씬 많아요.

w|rata-rata.text: Pendapatan warung Lestari bulan ini di bawah rata-rata.
w|rata-rata.en: Lestari's shop income this month is below average.
w|rata-rata.ko: 이번 달 레스타리 가게 수입은 평균보다 낮아요.

w|ratu.en: The queen spoke in the hall.
She was called a beauty queen.

w|ratus.text: Ada ratus pohon di kebun itu.
w|ratus.en: There are hundreds of trees in that garden.
w|ratus.ko: 그 정원에는 수백 그루의 나무가 있어.

w|ratus.text: Ratus orang antre di depan toko.
w|ratus.en: Hundreds of people lined up in front of the store.
w|ratus.ko: 수백 명이 가게 앞에 줄을 섰어.

w|ratusan.text: Ratusan orang antre di depan toko.
w|ratusan.en: Hundreds of people are lined up in front of the store.
w|ratusan.ko: 수백 명이 가게 앞에서 줄을 서 있어.

w|ratusan.en: He received hundreds of messages last night.
w|ratusan.ko: 그는 어젯밤 수백 개의 메시지를 받았어.

w|raut.text: Rekan-rekan melihat raut tegang di wajah Bayu sebelum presentasi.
w|raut.en: The coworkers saw a tense look on Bayu's face before the presentation.
w|raut.ko: 동료들은 발표 전 바유 얼굴에 서린 긴장한 기색을 봤어요.

w|raut.text: Intan bisa membaca raut lelah di wajah anggota baru.
w|raut.en: Intan can read the tired look on new members' faces.
w|raut.ko: 인탄은 신규 회원 얼굴에 드러난 피곤한 기색을 읽을 수 있어요.

w|rawa.text: Di balik bukit pasir ada rawa tempat burung bangau mencari makan.
w|rawa.en: Behind the sand dunes there is a swamp where herons look for food.
w|rawa.ko: 모래 언덕 너머에 백로가 먹이를 찾는 늪이 있어요.

w|rawa.text: Dulu kompleks rumah Ayu adalah rawa yang ditimbun tanah.
w|rawa.en: Ayu's housing complex used to be a swamp that was filled in with soil.
w|rawa.ko: 아유네 주택 단지는 예전에 흙으로 메운 늪이었어요.

w|raya.text: Jalan raya ramai pada jam sibuk.
w|raya.en: The main road is crowded at rush hour.

w|reaksi.text: Reaksi kimia itu menghasilkan gas baru.
w|reaksi.en: That chemical reaction produced a new gas.
w|reaksi.ko: 그 화학 반응이 새 기체를 만들었어.

w|reaksi.text: Reaksi penonton terhadap film itu hangat.
w|reaksi.en: The audience's reaction to that film was warm.
w|reaksi.ko: 그 영화에 대한 관객 반응이 뜨거웠어.

w|reaktor.text: Di pelajaran fisika, Agus belajar cara kerja reaktor nuklir.
w|reaktor.en: In physics class, Agus learned how a nuclear reactor works.
w|reaktor.ko: 물리 시간에 아구스는 원자로가 어떻게 작동하는지 배웠어요.

w|reaktor.text: Ayah Wati, seorang insinyur, bercerita tentang pendingin reaktor di tempat kerjanya.
w|reaktor.en: Wati's father, an engineer, talked about the reactor cooling system at his workplace.
w|reaktor.ko: 엔지니어인 와티의 아빠는 직장의 원자로 냉각 장치 이야기를 했어요.

w|realistis.text: Eko bilang target mendaki ke puncak dalam sehari tidak realistis.
w|realistis.en: Eko said the goal of climbing to the summit in one day wasn't realistic.
w|realistis.ko: 에코는 하루 만에 정상까지 오르는 목표는 현실적이지 않다고 했어요.

w|realistis.text: Pelatih membantu Ayu menetapkan target waktu yang realistis.
w|realistis.en: The coach helped Ayu set a realistic time goal.
w|realistis.ko: 코치는 아유가 현실적인 기록 목표를 세우도록 도와줬어요.

w|realitas.text: Setelah pesta, realitas datang: Rudi harus mencuci ratusan piring.
w|realitas.en: After the party, reality set in: Rudi had to wash hundreds of plates.
w|realitas.ko: 잔치가 끝나자 현실이 닥쳤어요. 루디는 접시 수백 개를 닦아야 했어요.

w|realitas.text: Rina ingin pembaca melihat realitas hidup buruh pelabuhan.
w|realitas.en: Rina wants readers to see the reality of dockworkers' lives.
w|realitas.ko: 리나는 독자들이 항만 노동자의 현실을 보길 바라요.

w|referensi.text: Dimas meminta surat referensi dari mandornya sebelum melamar ke tempat lain.
w|referensi.en: Dimas asked his foreman for a reference letter before applying elsewhere.
w|referensi.ko: 디마스는 다른 곳에 지원하기 전에 반장에게 추천서를 부탁했어요.

w|referensi.text: Sari meminta Putri menjadi referensi untuk lamaran kerjanya.
w|referensi.en: Sari asks Putri to be a reference for her job application.
w|referensi.ko: 사리는 푸트리에게 입사 지원서의 추천인이 되어 달라고 부탁해요.

w|refleks.text: Budi mengetuk lutut pasien dengan palu kecil untuk memeriksa refleks.
w|refleks.en: Budi tapped the patient's knee with a small hammer to check the reflexes.
w|refleks.ko: 부디는 작은 망치로 환자의 무릎을 두드려 반사 반응을 확인했어요.

w|refleks.text: Berkat refleks yang cepat, Siti berhasil menangkap koper yang jatuh dari troli.
w|refleks.en: Thanks to her quick reflexes, Siti caught the suitcase falling off the cart.
w|refleks.ko: 시티는 빠른 반사 신경 덕분에 카트에서 떨어지는 가방을 잡았어요.

w|refleksi.text: Surat terakhir Budi berisi refleksi tentang persahabatan yang bertahan puluhan tahun.
w|refleksi.en: Budi's latest letter contains reflections on a friendship that has lasted decades.
w|refleksi.ko: 부디의 최근 편지에는 수십 년 이어진 우정에 대한 성찰이 담겨 있어요.

w|refleksi.text: Siti melihat refleksi lampu jalan di genangan depan rumah.
w|refleksi.en: Siti saw the reflection of the streetlight in the puddle in front of the house.
w|refleksi.ko: 시티는 집 앞 물웅덩이에 비친 가로등 불빛을 봤어요.

w|regu.text: Eko masuk regu pramuka bersama tiga teman sekelasnya.
w|regu.en: Eko joined a scout troop with three of his classmates.
w|regu.ko: 에코는 같은 반 친구 셋과 함께 스카우트 조에 들어갔어요.

w|regu.text: Ayu dan sepupunya membuat dua regu untuk main bola di halaman.
w|regu.en: Ayu and her cousins made two teams to play football in the yard.
w|regu.ko: 아유와 사촌들은 마당에서 공을 차려고 두 팀으로 나눴어요.

w|rehabilitasi.text: Setelah operasi kaki, anjing itu menjalani rehabilitasi di klinik Rudi.
w|rehabilitasi.en: After leg surgery, the dog went through rehabilitation at Rudi's clinic.
w|rehabilitasi.ko: 다리 수술 후 그 개는 루디의 병원에서 재활을 받았어요.

w|rehabilitasi.text: Paman Rina menjalani rehabilitasi setelah jatuh dari pohon cengkih.
w|rehabilitasi.en: Rina's uncle went through rehabilitation after falling from a clove tree.
w|rehabilitasi.ko: 리나의 삼촌은 정향나무에서 떨어진 뒤 재활 치료를 받았어요.

w|reinkarnasi.text: Rubrik hiburan memuat ulasan film tentang seorang pemuda yang percaya pada reinkarnasi.
w|reinkarnasi.en: The entertainment section ran a review of a film about a young man who believes in reincarnation.
w|reinkarnasi.ko: 연예면에 환생을 믿는 청년에 관한 영화 평이 실렸어요.

w|reinkarnasi.text: Intan memesan novel tentang reinkarnasi seorang putri kerajaan.
w|reinkarnasi.en: Intan ordered a novel about the reincarnation of a royal princess.
w|reinkarnasi.ko: 인탄은 공주의 환생을 다룬 소설을 주문했어요.

w|rekaman.text: Kirim rekaman suara itu ke aku.

w|rekayasa.text: Seorang ahli rekayasa sipil menjelaskan kepada Fajar penyebab jembatan itu retak.
w|rekayasa.en: A civil engineering expert explained to Fajar why the bridge cracked.
w|rekayasa.ko: 토목공학 전문가가 파자르에게 다리에 금이 간 이유를 설명했어요.

w|rekayasa.text: Lestari kagum melihat hasil rekayasa jalan layang yang berkelok di antara bukit.
w|rekayasa.en: Lestari marveled at the engineering of the flyover winding between the hills.
w|rekayasa.ko: 레스타리는 언덕 사이로 굽이치는 고가도로의 공학 기술에 감탄했어요.

w|rekening.en: His bank account is almost empty.
She opened a new savings account.

w|rekomendasi.text: Agus memilih tukang listrik itu berdasarkan rekomendasi dari teman lamanya.
w|rekomendasi.en: Agus chose that electrician based on a recommendation from an old friend.
w|rekomendasi.ko: 아구스는 오랜 친구의 추천을 받아 그 전기 기술자를 골랐어요.

w|rekomendasi.text: Wati membeli lampu tidur berdasarkan rekomendasi dari seorang teman kantornya.
w|rekomendasi.en: Wati bought a bedside lamp based on a recommendation from a coworker.
w|rekomendasi.ko: 와티는 회사 동료의 추천을 받고 수면등을 샀어요.

w|rekor.text: Pelayanan KTP hari ini memecahkan rekor jumlah warga yang dilayani.
w|rekor.en: Today's ID card service broke the record for the number of residents served.
w|rekor.ko: 오늘 신분증 발급 창구는 처리한 주민 수 기록을 깼어요.

w|rekor.text: Murid itu memecahkan rekor sekolah sebagai pemain termuda di orkestra.
w|rekor.en: That student broke the school record as the youngest player in the orchestra.
w|rekor.ko: 그 학생은 오케스트라 최연소 단원으로 학원 기록을 깼어요.

w|rel.text: Kereta Dimas berhenti sebentar karena ada perbaikan rel di depan.
w|rel.en: Dimas's train stopped briefly because of track repairs ahead.
w|rel.ko: 앞쪽 선로 보수 때문에 디마스가 탄 기차가 잠깐 멈췄어요.

w|rel.text: Putri bilang proyek ini sudah di rel yang benar, tinggal dijalankan dengan konsisten.
w|rel.en: Putri says this project is on the right track; it just needs to be run consistently.
w|rel.ko: 푸트리는 이 프로젝트가 제 궤도에 올랐으니 꾸준히 밀고 나가기만 하면 된다고 해요.

w|rela.text: Dia rela menunggu lama demi tiket.
w|rela.en: She was willing to wait a long time for the ticket.
w|rela.ko: 그는 표를 위해 오래 기다릴 각오가 됐어.

w|rela.text: Rela berbagi adalah sikap yang baik.
w|rela.en: Being willing to share is a good attitude.

w|relatif.text: Musim kemarau tahun ini relatif lebih pendek daripada tahun lalu.
w|relatif.en: This year's dry season was relatively shorter than last year's.

w|relatif.text: Biaya memperbaiki rumah tua itu relatif murah karena Putri mengerjakan banyak hal sendiri.
w|relatif.en: Fixing up the old house was relatively cheap because Putri did a lot of the work herself.
w|relatif.ko: 푸트리가 많은 일을 직접 해서 낡은 집 수리비는 비교적 적게 들었어요.

w|relawan.text: Teman-teman Fajar datang sebagai relawan untuk menata kursi tamu.
w|relawan.en: Fajar's friends came as volunteers to arrange the guests' chairs.
w|relawan.ko: 파자르의 친구들이 하객 의자를 배치하러 자원봉사자로 왔어요.

w|relawan.text: Saat banjir datang, Lestari ikut menjadi relawan di dapur umum.
w|relawan.en: When the flood came, Lestari joined as a volunteer at the community kitchen.
w|relawan.ko: 홍수가 났을 때 레스타리는 공동 취사장에서 자원봉사를 했어요.

w|relevan.text: Redaktur meminta Bayu membuang kutipan yang tidak relevan dengan berita.
w|relevan.en: The editor asked Bayu to cut quotes that weren't relevant to the story.
w|relevan.ko: 편집자는 바유에게 기사와 관련 없는 인용을 빼라고 했어요.

w|relevan.text: Intan menghapus fitur yang tidak lagi relevan bagi pengguna.
w|relevan.en: Intan removed features that were no longer relevant to users.
w|relevan.ko: 인탄은 사용자에게 더는 쓸모없는 기능을 없앴어요.

w|religius.text: Bayu menulis tentang perayaan religius yang dihadiri ribuan orang di alun-alun.
w|religius.en: Bayu wrote about a religious celebration attended by thousands in the square.
w|religius.ko: 바유는 광장에서 수천 명이 참석한 종교 행사에 대해 썼어요.

w|religius.text: Ibu Intan memakai kebaya putih untuk acara religius di balai desa.
w|religius.en: Intan's mother wore a white kebaya for the religious event at the village hall.
w|religius.ko: 인탄의 엄마는 마을 회관의 종교 행사에 흰 크바야를 입었어요.

w|rem.text: Agus menginjak rem mendadak karena seekor kambing lewat.
w|rem.en: Agus slammed on the brakes because a goat crossed the road.
w|rem.ko: 염소 한 마리가 지나가서 아구스는 급브레이크를 밟았어요.

w|rem.text: Troli belanja itu punya rem supaya tidak meluncur di lantai miring.
w|rem.en: That shopping cart has a brake so it won't roll on the sloped floor.
w|rem.ko: 그 쇼핑 카트에는 경사진 바닥에서 미끄러지지 않게 브레이크가 있어요.

w|remaja.text: Remaja itu bergabung dengan klub seni.
w|remaja.en: That teenager joined the art club.

w|remeh.text: Bayu percaya tidak ada kabar yang terlalu remeh untuk diperiksa kebenarannya.
w|remeh.en: Bayu believes no news is too trivial to have its truth checked.
w|remeh.ko: 바유는 사실을 확인할 필요가 없을 만큼 사소한 소식은 없다고 믿어요.

w|remeh.text: Masalah kemasan yang penyok mungkin remeh, tetapi Intan tetap memberi nilai rendah.
w|remeh.en: A dented package may be a trivial problem, but Intan still gave a low rating.
w|remeh.ko: 포장이 찌그러진 건 사소한 문제일 수 있지만 인탄은 그래도 낮은 점수를 줬어요.

w|renang.en: The children are learning swimming in the pool.

w|renang.text: Renang pagi membuat tubuh lebih segar.
w|renang.en: Morning swimming makes the body fresher.
w|renang.ko: 아침 수영이 몸을 더 상쾌하게 해.

w|rentan.text: Kata guru olahraga, anak yang kurang tidur lebih rentan sakit.
w|rentan.en: The PE teacher said kids who don't sleep enough are more prone to getting sick.
w|rentan.ko: 체육 선생님은 잠이 부족한 아이가 더 쉽게 아프다고 했어요.

w|rentan.text: Putri menyimpan sayuran di kulkas karena mudah busuk dan rentan layu.
w|rentan.en: Putri keeps vegetables in the fridge because they spoil easily and are prone to wilting.
w|rentan.ko: 채소는 쉽게 상하고 시들기 쉬워서 푸트리는 냉장고에 보관해요.

w|rentang.text: Bayu mengukur rentang sayap elang yang terluka itu sebelum mengobatinya.
w|rentang.en: Bayu measured the wingspan of the injured eagle before treating it.
w|rentang.ko: 바유는 다친 독수리를 치료하기 전에 날개 길이를 쟀어요.

w|rentang.text: Intan menjaga detak jantung dalam rentang aman selama lomba.
w|rentang.en: Intan kept her heart rate within a safe range during the race.
w|rentang.ko: 인탄은 경기 내내 심박수를 안전한 범위 안에서 유지했어요.

w|reporter.text: Seorang reporter menunggu di depan gedung.
w|reporter.en: A reporter is waiting in front of the building.

w|repot.text: Rudi minta maaf karena terlalu repot dengan pekerjaan sampai lupa membalas.
w|repot.en: Rudi apologized for being so busy with work that he forgot to reply.
w|repot.ko: 루디는 일로 너무 바빠서 답장을 잊었다며 사과했어요.

w|repot.text: Ternyata mengurus izin usaha lebih repot daripada membuat aplikasinya.
w|repot.en: It turned out that getting a business permit was more of a hassle than building the app.
w|repot.ko: 알고 보니 사업 허가를 받는 게 앱을 만드는 것보다 더 번거로웠어요.

w|reptil.text: Agus pernah melihat reptil besar berbaring di batu dekat sungai.
w|reptil.en: Agus once saw a large reptile lying on a rock near the river.
w|reptil.ko: 아구스는 강가 바위 위에 누워 있는 큰 파충류를 본 적이 있어요.

w|reptil.text: Wati menulis bahwa anak bungsunya sekarang tergila-gila pada reptil.
w|reptil.en: Wati wrote that her youngest child is now crazy about reptiles.
w|reptil.ko: 와티는 막내가 요즘 파충류에 푹 빠졌다고 적었어요.

w|republik.text: Di kelas PKn, murid-murid belajar bahwa negara kita berbentuk republik.
w|republik.en: In civics class, the students learned that our country is a republic.
w|republik.ko: 시민 교육 시간에 학생들은 우리나라가 공화국이라는 걸 배웠어요.

w|republik.text: Di kardus buku, Siti menemukan buku sejarah tentang berdirinya republik ini.
w|republik.en: In a box of books, Siti found a history book about the founding of this republic.
w|republik.ko: 책 상자에서 시티는 이 공화국의 건국에 관한 역사책을 찾았어요.

w|reputasi.text: Sekolah Budi punya reputasi bagus di bidang olahraga.
w|reputasi.en: Budi's school has a good reputation in sports.
w|reputasi.ko: 부디네 학교는 운동 쪽으로 평판이 좋아요.

w|reputasi.text: Siti memilih jasa angkut yang punya reputasi baik di internet.
w|reputasi.en: Siti chose a moving service with a good reputation online.
w|reputasi.ko: 시티는 인터넷에서 평판이 좋은 이삿짐 업체를 골랐어요.

w|reruntuhan.text: Kelas Agus berkunjung ke reruntuhan candi untuk pelajaran sejarah.
w|reruntuhan.en: Agus's class visited the ruins of a temple for a history lesson.
w|reruntuhan.ko: 아구스네 반은 역사 수업으로 사원 유적에 견학을 갔어요.

w|reruntuhan.text: Kolam renang baru itu dibangun di atas reruntuhan gedung bioskop tua.
w|reruntuhan.en: The new pool was built on the ruins of an old cinema building.
w|reruntuhan.ko: 새 수영장은 옛 극장 건물 터 위에 지어졌어요.

w|resep.en: Mom shared her favorite cake recipe.

w|resep.text: Resep dokter harus ditebus di apotek.
w|resep.en: The doctor's prescription must be filled at the pharmacy.

w|resepsi.text: Budi dan teman-teman OSIS menyiapkan resepsi untuk menyambut tamu dari dinas pendidikan.
w|resepsi.en: Budi and his student council friends prepared a reception to welcome guests from the education office.
w|resepsi.ko: 버디와 학생회 친구들은 교육청 손님을 맞을 환영회를 준비했어요.

w|resepsi.text: Karena musim hujan, resepsi pernikahan keponakan Siti dipindah ke dalam gedung.
w|resepsi.en: Siti's niece's wedding reception was moved indoors because of the rainy season.
w|resepsi.ko: 우기라서 시티 조카의 결혼 피로연이 실내로 옮겨졌어요.

w|resepsionis.text: Andi menitipkan helm cadangan kepada resepsionis di kantor proyek.
w|resepsionis.en: Andi left the spare helmets with the receptionist at the site office.
w|resepsionis.ko: 안디는 여분 안전모를 현장 사무실 안내 직원에게 맡겼어요.

w|resepsionis.text: Dewi menanyakan letak ruang pesta kepada resepsionis hotel.
w|resepsionis.en: Dewi asked the hotel receptionist where the party room was.
w|resepsionis.ko: 데위는 호텔 안내 직원에게 연회장 위치를 물었어요.

w|reservasi.text: Rudi mengecek reservasi atas nama keluarga Santoso.
w|reservasi.en: Rudi checked the reservation under the name of the Santoso family.
w|reservasi.ko: 루디는 산토소 가족 이름으로 된 예약을 확인했어요.

w|reservasi.text: Rina membuat reservasi vila di Puncak untuk liburan musim kemarau.
w|reservasi.en: Rina made a villa reservation in Puncak for the dry-season holiday.
w|reservasi.ko: 리나는 건기 휴가를 위해 푼짝에 있는 빌라를 예약했어요.

w|resimen.text: Andi meneliti sejarah sebuah resimen kavaleri dari arsip perpustakaan.
w|resimen.en: Andi researched the history of a cavalry regiment from the library archives.
w|resimen.ko: 안디는 도서관 기록물로 어느 기병 연대의 역사를 조사했어요.

w|resimen.text: Kakek Dewi dulu bertugas di sebuah resimen artileri, dan fotonya dipajang di meja kerja Dewi.
w|resimen.en: Dewi's grandfather once served in an artillery regiment, and his photo is on Dewi's desk.
w|resimen.ko: 디위의 할아버지는 예전에 포병 연대에서 복무했고, 그 사진이 디위의 책상에 놓여 있어요.

w|resmi.text: Ini adalah surat resmi dari kantor.
w|resmi.en: This is an official letter from the office.
He was officially appointed as chair.

w|resolusi.text: Kedua pihak akhirnya sepakat mencari resolusi damai di luar pengadilan.
w|resolusi.en: Both sides finally agreed to seek a peaceful resolution outside court.
w|resolusi.ko: 양쪽은 결국 법정 밖에서 평화롭게 해결하기로 했어요.

w|resolusi.text: Pada awal tahun, resolusi Wati adalah menambah menu sayur untuk pelanggan.
w|resolusi.en: At the start of the year, Wati's resolution was to add more vegetable dishes for customers.
w|resolusi.ko: 새해 와티의 다짐은 손님들을 위해 채소 메뉴를 늘리는 거였어요.

w|respon.text: Berita tentang kenaikan harga beras mendapat respon besar dari pembaca.
w|respon.en: The story about rising rice prices got a big response from readers.
w|respon.ko: 쌀값 인상 기사에 독자들의 반응이 컸어요.

w|respon.text: Layar sentuh itu lambat memberi respon kalau jari pengguna basah.
w|respon.en: The touchscreen is slow to respond when the user's fingers are wet.
w|respon.ko: 그 터치스크린은 손가락이 젖어 있으면 반응이 느려요.

w|restoran.en: We had dinner at a restaurant.
That new restaurant is always crowded.

w|restu.text: Sebelum pentas perdana, Eko meminta restu orang tuanya.
w|restu.en: Before the premiere, Eko asked for his parents' blessing.
w|restu.ko: 첫 공연 전에 에코는 부모님께 축복을 청했어요.

w|restu.text: Ayu membuka toko kecil itu dengan restu ibunya.
w|restu.en: Ayu opened the little shop with her mother's blessing.
w|restu.ko: 아유는 엄마의 허락과 응원 속에 그 작은 가게를 열었어요.

w|retak.text: Kaca jendela kelas Budi retak terkena bola kemarin sore.
w|retak.en: The window in Budi's classroom cracked after being hit by a ball yesterday afternoon.
w|retak.ko: 어제 오후 공에 맞아 부디네 교실 유리창에 금이 갔어요.

w|retak.text: Siti tertawa melihat bangku kayu lama yang sudah retak di sana-sini.
w|retak.en: Siti laughed at the old wooden bench, cracked here and there.
w|retak.ko: 시티는 여기저기 금이 간 낡은 나무 벤치를 보고 웃었어요.

w|reuni.text: Alumni sekolah Rudi mengadakan reuni di aula tiap akhir tahun.
w|reuni.en: The alumni of Rudi's school hold a reunion in the hall at the end of each year.
w|reuni.ko: 루디 학교 졸업생들은 매년 연말 강당에서 동창회를 열어요.

w|reuni.text: Pindah ke kota lama membuat Rina bisa datang ke reuni SMA-nya.
w|reuni.en: Moving to her old town let Rina attend her high school reunion.
w|reuni.ko: 예전 동네로 이사한 덕분에 리나는 고등학교 동창회에 갈 수 있었어요.

w|revolusi.text: Ruang terakhir bercerita tentang revolusi dan perjuangan kemerdekaan.
w|revolusi.en: The last room tells the story of the revolution and the struggle for independence.
w|revolusi.ko: 마지막 전시실은 혁명과 독립 투쟁 이야기를 다뤄요.

w|revolusi.text: Pembayaran lewat kode QR membawa revolusi kecil di pasar Rina.
w|revolusi.en: Paying by QR code brought a small revolution to Rina's market.
w|revolusi.ko: QR 결제가 리나네 시장에 작은 혁명을 가져왔어요.

w|revolusioner.text: Para kritikus menyebut tata panggung drama itu revolusioner.
w|revolusioner.en: Critics called the play's stage design revolutionary.
w|revolusioner.ko: 비평가들은 그 연극의 무대 연출을 혁명적이라고 했어요.

w|revolusioner.text: Bagi Ayu, sistem bayar lewat ponsel adalah perubahan revolusioner untuk toko kecil.
w|revolusioner.en: For Ayu, paying by phone is a revolutionary change for small shops.
w|revolusioner.ko: 아유에게 휴대폰 결제는 작은 가게에 혁명적인 변화예요.

w|rewel.text: Bayu harus menghadapi klien rewel yang sering mengubah permintaan.
w|rewel.en: Bayu has to deal with a fussy client who keeps changing requests.
w|rewel.ko: 바유는 요구를 자주 바꾸는 까다로운 고객을 상대해야 해요.

w|rewel.text: Mesin lari di pojok sudah tua dan rewel.
w|rewel.en: The treadmill in the corner is old and temperamental.
w|rewel.ko: 구석에 있는 러닝머신은 낡아서 자꾸 말썽이에요.

w|rezim.text: Lakon itu menyindir rezim yang melarang rakyat bernyanyi di jalan.
w|rezim.en: The play satirizes a regime that bans people from singing in the streets.
w|rezim.ko: 그 연극은 사람들이 거리에서 노래하는 것을 금지한 정권을 풍자해요.

w|rezim.text: Nenek di sebelah Ayu bercerita tentang hidupnya di bawah rezim lama.
w|rezim.en: The grandmother next to Ayu talked about her life under the old regime.
w|rezim.ko: 아유 옆 할머니는 옛 정권 아래에서 살던 이야기를 해 줬어요.

w|riang.text: Surat Budi kali ini bernada riang karena baru naik jabatan.
w|riang.en: Budi's letter this time sounds cheerful because he just got a promotion.
w|riang.ko: 이번 부디의 편지는 막 승진해서인지 밝은 분위기예요.

w|riang.text: Suara riang anak-anak tetangga terdengar setiap sore.
w|riang.en: The cheerful voices of the neighbors' children can be heard every afternoon.
w|riang.ko: 매일 오후 이웃집 아이들의 즐거운 목소리가 들려요.

w|ribu.en: Thousands of spectators filled the stadium.
The price reaches several thousand rupiah.

w|ribuan.en: Thousands of people came to the concert.
There are thousands of stars in the sky.

w|ribut.text: Ayam-ayam Dimas jadi ribut setiap kali ada anjing lewat.
w|ribut.en: Dimas's chickens get noisy every time a dog walks by.
w|ribut.ko: 개가 지나갈 때마다 디마스네 닭들이 시끄러워져요.

w|ribut.text: Tetangga Putri ribut lagi soal tempat parkir.
w|ribut.en: Putri's neighbors are squabbling about parking again.
w|ribut.ko: 푸트리네 이웃들이 또 주차 자리 때문에 시끄럽게 다퉈요.

w|rileks.text: Setelah masalahnya selesai, Rudi akhirnya bisa duduk rileks di ruang tamu.
w|rileks.en: After the problem was sorted out, Rudi could finally sit relaxed in the living room.
w|rileks.ko: 문제가 풀린 뒤에야 루디는 거실에 편하게 앉을 수 있었어요.

w|rileks.text: Suara ombak membuat pikiran Rina jauh lebih rileks.
w|rileks.en: The sound of the waves made Rina's mind much more relaxed.
w|rileks.ko: 파도 소리에 리나의 마음이 훨씬 편안해졌어요.

w|rinci.text: Dimas mencatat jadwal kereta secara rinci di buku kecilnya.
w|rinci.en: Dimas wrote down the train schedule in detail in his little notebook.
w|rinci.ko: 디마스는 기차 시간표를 작은 수첩에 자세히 적었어요.

w|rinci.text: Putri meminta laporan bug yang rinci dari setiap penguji.
w|rinci.en: Putri asks every tester for detailed bug reports.
w|rinci.ko: 푸트리는 테스터마다 자세한 버그 보고서를 요구해요.

w|rincian.text: Penyidik meminta Andi menceritakan rincian kejadian dari awal.
w|rincian.en: The investigator asked Andi to tell the details of the incident from the beginning.
w|rincian.ko: 수사관은 안디에게 사건을 처음부터 자세히 말해 달라고 했어요.

w|rincian.text: Pelatih menuliskan rincian strategi di papan sebelum babak kedua.
w|rincian.en: The coach wrote the details of the strategy on the board before the second half.
w|rincian.ko: 코치가 후반 시작 전에 작전 내용을 보드에 자세히 적었어요.

w|rindu.text: Rindu itu terasa lebih kuat malam hari.

w|ringan.text: Tas ini sangat ringan untuk dibawa.
w|ringan.en: This bag is very light to carry.

w|ringan.text: Lukanya masih ringan dan cepat sembuh.
w|ringan.en: His wound is still mild and heals quickly.
w|ringan.ko: 상처가 아직 가벼워서 빨리 나을 거야.

w|rintangan.text: Dalam lomba lari halang, Eko melompati setiap rintangan dengan mulus.
w|rintangan.en: In the hurdle race, Eko cleared every obstacle smoothly.
w|rintangan.ko: 장애물 달리기에서 에코는 모든 장애물을 매끄럽게 넘었어요.

w|rintangan.text: Bagi Ayu, rintangan terbesar adalah menggambar tangan manusia.
w|rintangan.en: For Ayu, the biggest hurdle is drawing human hands.
w|rintangan.ko: 아유에게 가장 큰 고비는 사람 손을 그리는 거예요.

w|risau.text: Budi risau karena surat terakhir untuk Rudi belum juga dibalas.
w|risau.en: Budi is worried because his last letter to Rudi still hasn't been answered.
w|risau.ko: 부디는 루디에게 보낸 마지막 편지에 아직 답이 없어서 걱정이에요.

w|risau.text: Siti risau karena tetangga sebelah belum pulang sejak kemarin.
w|risau.en: Siti is worried because the next-door neighbor hasn't come home since yesterday.
w|risau.ko: 시티는 옆집 이웃이 어제부터 집에 안 들어와서 걱정이에요.

w|riset.text: Sebelum membuat menu baru, Fajar melakukan riset kecil tentang selera pelanggan.
w|riset.en: Before creating a new dish, Fajar does a little research on customers' tastes.
w|riset.ko: 새 메뉴를 만들기 전에 파자르는 손님 입맛을 간단히 조사해요.

w|riset.text: Seorang mahasiswa sedang melakukan riset tentang kebiasaan belanja di pasar loak.
w|riset.en: A university student is doing research on shopping habits at flea markets.
w|riset.ko: 한 대학생이 벼룩시장의 쇼핑 습관을 조사하고 있어요.

w|risiko.en: The risk of that investment is quite high.

w|risiko.text: Mereka memahami risiko sebelum mendaki gunung.
w|risiko.en: They understood the risk before climbing the mountain.
w|risiko.ko: 그들은 산을 오르기 전에 위험을 이해했어.

w|ritme.text: Rudi sudah terbiasa dengan ritme kerja yang berganti antara siang dan malam.
w|ritme.en: Rudi is used to a work rhythm that alternates between day and night.
w|ritme.ko: 루디는 낮과 밤을 오가는 근무 리듬에 익숙해졌어요.

w|ritme.text: Rina mendengarkan ritme detak jantung anjing itu dengan stetoskop.
w|ritme.en: Rina listened to the rhythm of the dog's heartbeat with a stethoscope.
w|ritme.ko: 리나는 청진기로 그 개의 심장 박동 리듬을 들었어요.

w|ritual.en: The morning ritual helps him stay calm.
w|ritual.ko: 아침 의식이 그를 차분하게 해 줘.

w|ritual.text: Desa itu masih menjaga ritual lama.
w|ritual.en: That village still keeps the old ritual.
w|ritual.ko: 그 마을은 여전히 옛 의식을 지켜.

w|riwayat.text: Rudi menulis riwayat hidup singkat untuk mendaftar jadi ketua OSIS.
w|riwayat.en: Rudi wrote a short résumé to apply for student council president.
w|riwayat.ko: 루디는 학생회장에 지원하려고 짧은 이력서를 썼어요.

w|riwayat.text: Rina menanyakan riwayat rumah itu kepada pemilik sebelumnya.
w|riwayat.en: Rina asked the previous owner about the house's history.
w|riwayat.ko: 리나는 전 주인에게 그 집의 내력을 물어봤어요.

w|roboh.text: Tenda lapak Agus hampir roboh tertiup angin siang itu.
w|roboh.en: Agus's stall tent almost collapsed in the wind that afternoon.
w|roboh.ko: 그날 오후 아구스의 노점 천막이 바람에 무너질 뻔했어요.

w|roboh.text: Pohon tua di depan rumah Wati roboh diterjang angin musim hujan.
w|roboh.en: The old tree in front of Wati's house fell in the rainy-season wind.
w|roboh.ko: 와티네 집 앞 고목이 우기 바람에 쓰러졌어요.

w|robot.text: Robot itu membersihkan lantai setiap pagi.
w|robot.en: That robot cleans the floor every morning.
w|robot.ko: 그 로봇이 매일 아침 바닥을 청소해.

w|robot.en: The kids were fascinated seeing the new robot.

w|roda.en: That bicycle wheel needs to be replaced.
The car stopped because a tire went flat.

w|roh.text: Mereka percaya ada roh di hutan itu.
w|roh.en: They believe there are spirits in that forest.
w|roh.ko: 그들은 그 숲에 영혼이 있다고 믿어.

w|rohani.text: Kantor Rudi mengadakan kegiatan rohani setiap Jumat pagi untuk para petugas.
w|rohani.en: Rudi's station holds a spiritual gathering for the officers every Friday morning.
w|rohani.ko: 루디가 일하는 서에서는 매주 금요일 아침 경찰관들을 위한 신앙 모임이 있어요.

w|rohani.text: Seorang pemilik anjing bercerita kepada Rina bahwa hewan peliharaan memberinya ketenangan rohani.
w|rohani.en: A dog owner told Rina that her pet gives her spiritual peace.
w|rohani.ko: 한 개 주인은 리나에게 반려동물이 마음의 평화를 준다고 말했어요.

w|rok.text: Ternyata uang itu terselip di saku rok sekolah Rina.
w|rok.en: It turned out the money was tucked in the pocket of Rina's school skirt.
w|rok.ko: 알고 보니 그 돈은 리나의 교복 치마 주머니에 끼어 있었어요.

w|rok.text: Saat membongkar lemari, Siti menemukan rok lama yang sudah tidak muat.
w|rok.en: While clearing out the wardrobe, Siti found an old skirt that no longer fits.
w|rok.ko: 옷장을 정리하다가 시티는 이제 안 맞는 옛날 치마를 찾았어요.

w|roket.text: Warga melaporkan anak-anak yang menyalakan petasan roket di dekat pom bensin.
w|roket.en: Residents reported children setting off rocket fireworks near the gas station.
w|roket.ko: 주민들이 주유소 근처에서 로켓 폭죽을 터뜨린 아이들을 신고했어요.

w|roket.text: Lari Dewi saat serangan balik secepat roket.
w|roket.en: Dewi's sprint on the counterattack is as fast as a rocket.
w|roket.ko: 속공 때 데위가 달리는 건 로켓처럼 빨라요.

w|rokok.en: He is trying to quit smoking cigarettes.

w|rokok.text: Rokok dilarang di dalam gedung ini.
w|rokok.en: Cigarettes are banned inside this building.

w|romantis.en: The atmosphere that night was very romantic.

w|romantis.text: Romantis sekali film yang mereka tonton.
w|romantis.en: The movie they watched is so romantic.

w|rombongan.text: Bayu bertemu rombongan pesepeda motor di rumah makan pinggir jalan.
w|rombongan.en: Bayu met a group of motorcyclists at a roadside restaurant.
w|rombongan.ko: 바유는 길가 식당에서 오토바이 여행 무리를 만났어요.

w|rombongan.text: Satu rombongan murid SD datang melihat pameran karya Intan.
w|rombongan.en: A group of elementary school students came to see Intan's exhibition.
w|rombongan.ko: 초등학생 한 무리가 인탄의 작품 전시를 보러 왔어요.

w|ronde.text: Tim itu menang di ronde terakhir pertandingan.
w|ronde.en: That team won in the final round of the match.
w|ronde.ko: 그 팀은 경기의 마지막 라운드에서 이겼어.

w|ronde.en: The second round felt more tense.

w|rongsokan.text: Halaman belakang penuh rongsokan yang ditinggalkan pemilik sebelumnya.
w|rongsokan.en: The backyard is full of junk left by the previous owner.
w|rongsokan.ko: 뒷마당은 이전 주인이 남긴 고물로 가득해요.

w|rongsokan.text: Di dekat rel ada tumpukan rongsokan gerbong yang sudah tidak terpakai.
w|rongsokan.en: Near the tracks there is a pile of scrapped carriages no longer in use.
w|rongsokan.ko: 선로 근처에 더는 안 쓰는 객차 고철 더미가 있어요.

w|roti.text: Roti ini masih hangat dari oven.
w|roti.en: This bread is still warm from the oven.
w|roti.ko: 이 빵은 오븐에서 나온 지 얼마 안 돼 따뜻해.

w|rubah.text: Tadi malam ada rubah yang mencuri dua ekor ayam dari kandang.
w|rubah.en: Last night a fox stole two chickens from the coop.
w|rubah.ko: 어젯밤 여우가 닭장에서 닭 두 마리를 훔쳐 갔어요.

w|rubah.text: Buku cerita adik Putri berkisah tentang rubah yang cerdik.
w|rubah.en: Putri's little sister's storybook is about a clever fox.
w|rubah.ko: 푸트리 동생의 동화책은 꾀 많은 여우 이야기예요.

w|rudal.text: Saat istirahat, televisi di ruang pegawai menayangkan berita uji coba rudal di luar negeri.
w|rudal.en: During the break, the TV in the staff room showed news of a missile test abroad.
w|rudal.ko: 쉬는 시간에 직원 휴게실 텔레비전에서 외국 미사일 시험 발사 뉴스가 나왔어요.

w|rudal.text: Melodi pembuka film perang itu bercerita tentang rudal yang melintas di langit malam.
w|rudal.en: The opening melody of the war film tells of a missile crossing the night sky.
w|rudal.ko: 그 전쟁 영화의 첫 선율은 밤하늘을 가로지르는 미사일을 그려요.

w|rugi.text: Pertunjukan hari Senin jarang ramai, tapi teater tidak mau rugi dengan membatalkannya.
w|rugi.en: Monday shows are rarely busy, but the theatre doesn't want to take a loss by cancelling them.
w|rugi.ko: 월요일 공연은 손님이 적지만 극장은 취소해서 손해 보고 싶지 않아요.

w|rugi.text: Intan tidak mau rugi waktu menunggu, jadi dia membalas email di ruang tunggu.
w|rugi.en: Intan didn't want to waste time waiting, so she answered emails in the waiting room.
w|rugi.ko: 인탄은 기다리는 시간을 버리기 싫어서 대기실에서 이메일에 답장했어요.

w|rumit.en: That teacher's explanation is so complicated.

w|rumor.text: Rumor itu menyebar cepat di kantor.
w|rumor.en: That rumor spread quickly in the office.
Don't believe a rumor without proof.

w|rumput.text: Rumput di taman masih basah oleh embun.
w|rumput.en: The grass in the park is still wet with dew.
w|rumput.ko: 공원 잔디가 아직 이슬에 젖어 있어.

w|rumput.text: Anak-anak bermain di atas rumput hijau.
w|rumput.en: The children played on the green grass.

w|rumus.text: Andi memakai rumus sederhana untuk menghitung kebutuhan pasir.
w|rumus.en: Andi uses a simple formula to calculate how much sand is needed.
w|rumus.ko: 안디는 간단한 공식으로 필요한 모래 양을 계산해요.

w|rumus.text: Dewi dan teman-teman tertawa mengingat rumus matematika yang dulu mereka hafalkan.
w|rumus.en: Dewi and her friends laughed remembering the math formulas they used to memorize.
w|rumus.ko: 데위와 친구들은 예전에 외우던 수학 공식을 떠올리며 웃었어요.

w|runtuh.text: Bangunan tua itu runtuh setelah gempa.
w|runtuh.en: That old building collapsed after the earthquake.
w|runtuh.ko: 그 낡은 건물이 지진 뒤에 무너졌어.

w|runtuh.text: Jembatan tua hampir runtuh setelah banjir.
w|runtuh.en: The old bridge almost collapsed after the flood.
w|runtuh.ko: 낡은 다리가 홍수 뒤 거의 무너질 뻔했어.

w|rupa.text: Eko kaget melihat rupa gedung sekolah lamanya yang sudah direnovasi.
w|rupa.en: Eko was surprised to see how his old school building looked after renovation.
w|rupa.ko: 에코는 리모델링한 옛 학교 건물 모습을 보고 놀랐어요.

w|rupa.text: Ayu mempelajari seni rupa di sanggar dekat rumahnya.
w|rupa.en: Ayu studies fine arts at a studio near her house.
w|rupa.ko: 아유는 집 근처 화실에서 미술을 배워요.

w|rupanya.en: Apparently he already went home earlier.
w|rupanya.ko: 알고 보니 그는 이미 먼저 집에 갔어.

w|rupanya.en: It seems I grabbed the wrong bag.

w|rusa.en: A deer jumped across the forest road.

w|rusa.text: Kami melihat rusa di kebun binatang.
w|rusa.en: We saw a deer at the zoo.

w|rusuk.text: Pelatih meminta Bayu bernapas dalam sampai tulang rusuk terasa mengembang.
w|rusuk.en: The trainer asked Bayu to breathe deeply until he could feel his ribs expand.
w|rusuk.ko: 트레이너는 바유에게 갈비뼈가 펴지는 게 느껴질 때까지 깊게 숨 쉬라고 했어요.

w|rusuk.text: Kakek Intan pernah patah tulang rusuk, jadi ia duduk pelan-pelan di kursi restoran.
w|rusuk.en: Intan's grandfather once broke a rib, so he sits down slowly on the restaurant chair.
w|rusuk.ko: 인탄의 할아버지는 갈비뼈가 부러진 적이 있어서 식당 의자에 천천히 앉아요.

w|rute.text: Rute baru lebih cepat dan aman.
w|rute.en: The new route is faster and safer.
The driver chose a quiet route.

w|rutin.text: Setiap pergantian musim, Dimas rutin memeriksa talang rumahnya.
w|rutin.en: At every change of season, Dimas routinely checks his house's gutters.
w|rutin.ko: 계절이 바뀔 때마다 디마스는 집 홈통을 꼬박꼬박 점검해요.

w|rutin.text: Putri menyewa tukang untuk perawatan rutin pada kayu-kayu rumah.
w|rutin.en: Putri hired a handyman for routine maintenance on the house's woodwork.
w|rutin.ko: 푸트리는 집 목재를 정기적으로 손보려고 목수를 불렀어요.

w|rutinitas.text: Pergantian musim mengubah rutinitas pagi Dimas.
w|rutinitas.en: The change of seasons altered Dimas's morning routine.
w|rutinitas.ko: 계절이 바뀌면서 디마스의 아침 일과가 달라졌어요.

w|rutinitas.text: Memperbaiki rumah tua kini sudah menjadi rutinitas akhir pekan Putri.
w|rutinitas.en: Fixing up the old house has now become Putri's weekend routine.
w|rutinitas.ko: 낡은 집 고치기는 이제 푸트리의 주말 일과가 됐어요.

w|saat.en: Don't go out while it's raining.

w|sabar.en: You must be patient waiting your turn.
Just be patient; the result will be good.

w|sabit.text: Bayu memotong rumput liar di tepi sungai dengan sabit.
w|sabit.en: Bayu cut the weeds along the riverbank with a sickle.

w|sabit.text: Bulan sabit masih terlihat ketika Intan tiba di garis start.
w|sabit.en: The crescent moon was still visible when Intan arrived at the starting line.
w|sabit.ko: 인탄이 출발선에 도착했을 때 초승달이 아직 보였어요.

w|sabtu.text: Sabtu pagi kami pergi ke pasar.
w|sabtu.en: On Saturday morning we went to the market.
The meeting is scheduled for Saturday.

w|sabuk.text: Sabuk itu terlalu longgar di pinggang.
w|sabuk.en: That belt is too loose at the waist.

w|sabun.text: Andi menggosok lantai dapur dengan air dan sabun sampai bersih.
w|sabun.en: Andi scrubbed the kitchen floor with soap and water until it was clean.
w|sabun.ko: 안디는 부엌 바닥을 물과 비누로 깨끗해질 때까지 문질렀어요.

w|sabun.text: Toilet kereta kehabisan sabun, jadi Dewi memakai tisu basah.
w|sabun.en: The train toilet ran out of soap, so Dewi used wet wipes.
w|sabun.ko: 열차 화장실에 비누가 떨어져서 데위는 물티슈를 썼어요.

w|sadis.text: Bayu bercanda bahwa jadwal latihan dari pelatihnya terasa sadis.
w|sadis.en: Bayu jokes that his trainer's workout schedule feels brutal.
w|sadis.ko: 바유는 트레이너의 운동 일정이 잔혹하게 느껴진다고 농담해요.

w|sadis.text: Anak Intan menyebut tokoh penyihir dalam film kartun itu sadis.
w|sadis.en: Intan's child calls the witch character in the cartoon cruel.
w|sadis.ko: 인탄의 아이는 그 만화 영화 속 마녀가 잔인하다고 말해요.

w|sah.text: Surat itu sudah sah menurut hukum.
w|sah.en: That letter is already valid according to the law.
Whether the agreement is valid is checked by a lawyer.

w|sahabat.en: A true friend always supports you.

w|saham.text: Dia menjual saham sebelum harga jatuh.
w|saham.en: He sold the shares before the price fell.
w|saham.ko: 그는 가격이 떨어지기 전에 주식을 팔았어.

w|saingan.text: Rudi baru tahu bahwa pengantin pria dulu saingan kakaknya dalam lomba lari.
w|saingan.en: Rudi just found out the groom used to be his brother's rival in running races.
w|saingan.ko: 루디는 신랑이 예전에 형의 달리기 경쟁자였다는 걸 이제야 알았어요.

w|saingan.text: Koran tempat Rina bekerja bersaing ketat dengan saingan dari kota sebelah.
w|saingan.en: The paper where Rina works competes fiercely with a rival from the neighboring city.
w|saingan.ko: 리나가 일하는 신문사는 옆 도시 경쟁지와 치열하게 겨뤄요.

w|sains.text: Menurut Rudi, membangun gedung tinggi itu soal sains, bukan sekadar tenaga.
w|sains.en: According to Rudi, building a tall building is about science, not just muscle.
w|sains.ko: 루디는 높은 건물을 짓는 건 힘이 아니라 과학이라고 말해요.

w|sains.text: Rina lulusan sains komputer dan langsung ditempatkan di tim data.
w|sains.en: Rina has a computer science degree and was placed straight in the data team.
w|sains.ko: 리나는 컴퓨터 과학을 전공해서 바로 데이터팀에 배치됐어요.

w|sajak.text: Setiap Minggu, koran tempat Bayu bekerja memuat sajak kiriman pembaca.
w|sajak.en: Every Sunday, the newspaper Bayu works for prints poems sent in by readers.
w|sajak.ko: 매주 일요일 바유가 일하는 신문에는 독자가 보낸 시가 실려요.

w|sajak.text: Intan menulis sajak tentang gunung dan kabut di buku hariannya.
w|sajak.en: Intan wrote a poem about the mountain and the mist in her diary.
w|sajak.ko: 인탄은 일기장에 산과 안개에 관한 시를 썼어요.

w|saklar.text: Agus meraba-raba dinding mencari saklar lampu di lorong yang gelap.
w|saklar.en: Agus felt along the wall for the light switch in the dark hallway.
w|saklar.ko: 아구스는 어두운 복도에서 전등 스위치를 찾으려고 벽을 더듬었어요.

w|saklar.text: Wati menekan saklar papan nama sebelum rumah makan dibuka.
w|saklar.en: Wati flips the switch for the signboard before the restaurant opens.
w|saklar.ko: 와티는 식당 문을 열기 전에 간판 스위치를 켜요.

w|sakral.text: Fajar memastikan upacara adat yang sakral itu tidak terganggu pengeras suara.
w|sakral.en: Fajar made sure the sacred traditional ceremony wasn't disturbed by loudspeakers.
w|sakral.ko: 파자르는 그 신성한 전통 의식이 확성기 소리에 방해받지 않게 했어요.

w|sakral.text: Bagi Lestari, makan malam bersama keluarga setiap Jumat itu sakral.
w|sakral.en: For Lestari, Friday family dinner is sacred.
w|sakral.ko: 레스타리에게 금요일마다 가족과 함께하는 저녁 식사는 신성한 일이에요.

w|saksama.text: Eko memeriksa peta secara saksama sebelum memilih jalur pulang.
w|saksama.en: Eko examined the map carefully before choosing the route back.
w|saksama.ko: 에코는 돌아갈 길을 고르기 전에 지도를 꼼꼼히 살폈어요.

w|saksama.text: Ayu membaca aturan lomba dengan saksama agar tidak didiskualifikasi.
w|saksama.en: Ayu read the race rules carefully so she wouldn't be disqualified.
w|saksama.ko: 아유는 실격당하지 않으려고 대회 규칙을 꼼꼼히 읽었어요.

w|sakti.text: Adik Budi percaya keris tua di museum sekolah itu sakti.
w|sakti.en: Budi's little brother believes the old kris in the school museum has magical powers.
w|sakti.ko: 부디의 동생은 학교 박물관의 오래된 크리스 단검에 신통력이 있다고 믿어요.

w|sakti.text: Di toko bandara, Siti membeli komik tentang pendekar sakti dari gunung.
w|sakti.en: At the airport shop, Siti bought a comic about a mighty warrior from the mountains.
w|sakti.ko: 시티는 공항 가게에서 산에서 온 신통력 있는 무사에 관한 만화를 샀어요.

w|saku.text: Dimas selalu menyimpan camilan anjing di saku jas dokternya.
w|saku.en: Dimas always keeps dog treats in the pocket of his doctor's coat.
w|saku.ko: 디마스는 늘 의사 가운 주머니에 강아지 간식을 넣어 다녀요.

w|saku.text: Putri selalu menyimpan pulpen dan buku catatan kecil di saku jas labnya.
w|saku.en: Putri always keeps a pen and a small notebook in her lab coat pocket.
w|saku.ko: 푸트리는 늘 실험복 주머니에 펜과 작은 수첩을 넣어 둬요.

w|salad.text: Untuk pelanggan yang diet, Fajar juga menjual salad buah dalam gelas.
w|salad.en: For customers on a diet, Fajar also sells fruit salad in cups.
w|salad.ko: 다이어트하는 손님을 위해 파자르는 컵에 담은 과일 샐러드도 팔아요.

w|salad.text: Makan siang Lestari biasanya salad ayam dengan sedikit minyak zaitun.
w|salad.en: Lestari's lunch is usually chicken salad with a little olive oil.
w|salad.ko: 레스타리의 점심은 보통 올리브유를 조금 뿌린 닭고기 샐러드예요.

w|salam.en: Warm greetings to the whole family.

w|salam.text: Dia mengirim salam lewat pesan singkat.
w|salam.en: She sent greetings via a short message.

w|saleh.text: Bayu menulis profil seorang kakek saleh yang mengajar mengaji anak-anak secara gratis.
w|saleh.en: Bayu wrote a profile of a devout old man who teaches children to recite the Quran for free.
w|saleh.ko: 바유는 아이들에게 무료로 꾸란 읽기를 가르치는 경건한 할아버지를 소개하는 글을 썼어요.

w|saleh.text: Intan membelikan sajadah baru untuk kakeknya yang saleh.
w|saleh.en: Intan bought a new prayer mat for her devout grandfather.
w|saleh.ko: 인탄은 신앙심 깊은 할아버지께 새 기도 매트를 사 드렸어요.

w|salib.text: Di pelajaran sejarah, kelas Eko melihat foto gereja tua dengan salib besar di atapnya.
w|salib.en: In history class, Eko's class looked at a photo of an old church with a big cross on its roof.
w|salib.ko: 역사 시간에 에코네 반은 지붕에 큰 십자가가 있는 오래된 교회 사진을 봤어요.

w|salib.text: Rumah tetangga Ayu dihias lampu dan salib kayu menjelang Natal.
w|salib.en: Ayu's neighbor's house was decorated with lights and a wooden cross ahead of Christmas.
w|salib.ko: 성탄절을 앞두고 아유네 이웃집은 전등과 나무 십자가로 장식됐어요.

w|salinan.text: Tolong kirim salinan dokumen itu ke saya.
w|salinan.en: Please send me a copy of that document.
w|salinan.ko: 그 서류 사본을 나한테 보내 줘.

w|salinan.text: Salinan kontrak sudah disimpan di laci.
w|salinan.en: A copy of the contract is already stored in the drawer.
w|salinan.ko: 계약서 사본은 이미 서랍에 넣어 뒀어.

w|saling.text: Saling percaya itu penting dalam hubungan.
w|saling.en: Trusting each other matters in a relationship.

w|salju.en: The children play in the snow.

w|saluran.text: Saluran air itu tersumbat daun kering.
w|saluran.en: That water channel is clogged with dry leaves.

w|saluran.text: Berita disiarkan di saluran televisi nasional.
w|saluran.en: The news was broadcast on a national TV channel.
w|saluran.ko: 그 뉴스는 전국 TV 채널에서 방송됐어.

w|salut.text: Budi salut pada Rudi yang berhasil membuka bengkel sendiri.
w|salut.en: Budi takes his hat off to Rudi for managing to open his own repair shop.
w|salut.ko: 부디는 자기 정비소를 차린 루디가 정말 대단하다고 느꼈어요.

w|salut.text: Siti salut pada Bu Ani yang merawat ibu mertua dengan sabar.
w|salut.en: Siti admires Mrs. Ani for patiently caring for her mother-in-law.
w|salut.ko: 시티는 시어머니를 묵묵히 모시는 아니 아주머니가 존경스러워요.

w|samaran.text: Di babak kedua, Eko muncul dengan nama samaran sebagai pedagang kain.
w|samaran.en: In the second act, Eko appears under an assumed name as a cloth merchant.
w|samaran.ko: 2막에서 에코는 가명을 쓴 옷감 장수로 등장해요.

w|samaran.text: Pelanggan setia Ayu memakai nama samaran saat memesan lewat grup chat.
w|samaran.en: Ayu's loyal customer uses a nickname when ordering through the group chat.
w|samaran.ko: 아유의 단골손님은 단톡방에서 주문할 때 별명을 써요.

w|sambil.en: She studies while listening to music.

w|sambil.text: Aku makan sambil menonton film pendek.
w|sambil.en: I eat while watching a short film.

w|sambungan.text: Di laboratorium komputer sekolah Agus, sambungan internet sering terputus.
w|sambungan.en: In the computer lab at Agus's school, the internet connection often drops.
w|sambungan.ko: 아구스 학교 컴퓨터실의 인터넷 연결이 자주 끊겨요.

w|sambungan.text: Pipa air bocor di sambungan dekat pancuran, jadi Wati melapor ke petugas.
w|sambungan.en: The water pipe leaked at a joint near the shower, so Wati reported it to the staff.
w|sambungan.ko: 샤워기 근처 배관 이음새에서 물이 새서 와티는 직원에게 알렸어요.

w|sambutan.text: Pidato Andi di upacara mendapat sambutan meriah dari para murid.
w|sambutan.en: Andi's speech at the ceremony got a warm reception from the students.
w|sambutan.ko: 행사에서 한 안디의 연설은 학생들에게 뜨거운 반응을 얻었어요.

w|sambutan.text: Dewi menyiapkan kata sambutan singkat untuk membuka acara keluarga.
w|sambutan.en: Dewi prepared a short welcome speech to open the family gathering.
w|sambutan.ko: 데위는 가족 모임을 열 짧은 인사말을 준비했어요.

w|sampah.en: Trash piled up in the corner.

w|sampai.en: The news hasn't reached us yet.

w|sampanye.text: Pasangan di unit sebelah membuka sampanye untuk merayakan ulang tahun pernikahan.
w|sampanye.en: The couple in the next unit opened champagne to celebrate their wedding anniversary.
w|sampanye.ko: 옆집 부부가 결혼기념일을 축하하려고 샴페인을 땄어요.

w|sampanye.text: Di kereta mewah itu, penumpang kelas utama mendapat segelas sampanye.
w|sampanye.en: On that luxury train, first-class passengers get a glass of champagne.
w|sampanye.ko: 그 호화 열차에서는 일등석 승객에게 샴페인 한 잔을 줘요.

w|sampel.en: The blood sample was taken to the laboratory.

w|sampel.text: Toko memberi sampel gratis kepada pembeli.
w|sampel.en: The store gave free samples to buyers.

w|samping.en: Sit beside me for a moment.
Beside the house there is a small garden.

w|sampingan.text: Selain mengawasi proyek, Andi punya kerja sampingan sebagai tukang servis AC.
w|sampingan.en: Besides supervising the project, Andi has a side job as an air conditioner repairman.
w|sampingan.ko: 안디는 현장 감독 말고도 에어컨 수리 부업을 해요.

w|sampingan.text: Dewi bercerita tentang usaha sampingan menjual kue lewat internet.
w|sampingan.en: Dewi talked about her side business selling cakes online.
w|sampingan.ko: 데위는 인터넷으로 케이크를 파는 부업 이야기를 했어요.

w|sampul.text: Agus menulis nama proyek di sampul depan buku catatannya.
w|sampul.en: Agus wrote the project name on the front cover of his notebook.
w|sampul.ko: 아구스는 공책 앞표지에 공사 이름을 적었어요.

w|sampul.text: Wati memesan sampul ponsel bergambar kucing yang lucu.
w|sampul.en: Wati ordered a phone case with a cute cat picture on it.
w|sampul.ko: 와티는 귀여운 고양이 그림이 있는 휴대폰 케이스를 주문했어요.

w|samudra.text: Dari puncak bukit, Rudi bisa melihat samudra biru di kejauhan.
w|samudra.en: From the hilltop, Rudi could see the blue ocean in the distance.
w|samudra.ko: 언덕 꼭대기에서 루디는 멀리 푸른 대양을 볼 수 있었어요.

w|samudra.text: Ribuan lampu ponsel membuat stadion terlihat seperti samudra cahaya.
w|samudra.en: Thousands of phone lights made the stadium look like an ocean of light.
w|samudra.ko: 수천 개의 휴대폰 불빛이 경기장을 빛의 바다처럼 보이게 했어요.

w|sandera.en: The hostage was finally freed safely.
The police managed to rescue that hostage.

w|sandi.text: Eko dan teman-temannya bermain mencari harta karun dengan kata sandi rahasia.
w|sandi.en: Eko and his friends played a treasure hunt with a secret password.
w|sandi.ko: 에코와 친구들은 비밀 암호로 보물찾기 놀이를 했어요.

w|sandi.text: Ayu lupa kata sandi Wi-Fi rumah, jadi dia bertanya kepada kakaknya.
w|sandi.en: Ayu forgot the home Wi-Fi password, so she asked her older brother.
w|sandi.ko: 아유는 집 와이파이 비밀번호를 잊어서 오빠에게 물어봤어요.

w|sang.en: He was praised as the hero.

w|sanggup.en: Are you able to finish this?

w|sanggup.text: Sanggup dia membawa kotak berat itu.
w|sanggup.en: He is able to carry that heavy box.
w|sanggup.ko: 그는 그 무거운 상자를 들 수 있어.

w|sangkar.text: Agus menggantung sangkar burung perkutut di teras rumah.
w|sangkar.en: Agus hung the dove's cage on the porch.
w|sangkar.ko: 아구스는 집 테라스에 비둘기 새장을 걸었어요.

w|sangkar.text: Wati menulis bahwa dia masih ingat burung kenari di sangkar kuning milik mereka dulu.
w|sangkar.en: Wati wrote that she still remembers the canary in the yellow cage they used to have.
w|sangkar.ko: 와티는 예전에 노란 새장에서 키우던 카나리아를 아직 기억한다고 썼어요.

w|sanksi.text: Fajar mengingatkan bahwa pegawai yang sering bolos akan mendapat sanksi.
w|sanksi.en: Fajar reminded everyone that staff who often skip work will face sanctions.
w|sanksi.ko: 파자르는 자주 무단결근하는 직원은 징계를 받는다고 상기시켰어요.

w|sanksi.text: Lestari pernah kena sanksi denda karena memarkir motor di jalur darurat.
w|sanksi.en: Lestari was once fined for parking her motorbike in the emergency lane.
w|sanksi.ko: 레스타리는 비상 통로에 오토바이를 세워서 벌금 처분을 받은 적이 있어요.

w|santai.en: Let's just take it easy today.

w|santun.text: Meski sedang marah, Budi tetap bicara dengan santun kepada adiknya.
w|santun.en: Even though he was angry, Budi still spoke politely to his sister.
w|santun.ko: 화가 났는데도 부디는 동생에게 공손하게 말했어요.

w|santun.text: Tetangga baru Siti sangat santun dan langsung menawarkan bantuan.
w|santun.en: Siti's new neighbor is very polite and immediately offered to help.
w|santun.ko: 시티의 새 이웃은 아주 예의 바르고 바로 도와주겠다고 했어요.

w|sapi.text: Sapi itu makan rumput di padang.
w|sapi.en: That cow is eating grass in the field.
w|sapi.ko: 그 소가 들판에서 풀을 먹고 있어.

w|saraf.en: A nerve in his hand got pinched for a while.

w|saraf.text: Dokter memeriksa saraf punggung pasien itu.
w|saraf.en: The doctor checked that patient's back nerves.
w|saraf.ko: 의사가 그 환자의 등 신경을 검사했어.

w|saran.en: The doctor's suggestion was very helpful.
w|saran.ko: 의사 선생님 말씀이 정말 도움이 됐어.

w|sarana.text: Rudi berkata kantornya butuh sarana yang lebih baik, seperti komputer dan mobil patroli baru.
w|sarana.en: Rudi said his station needs better facilities, like new computers and patrol cars.
w|sarana.ko: 루디는 경찰서에 새 컴퓨터와 순찰차 같은 더 나은 시설이 필요하다고 했어요.

w|sarana.text: Sejak ada maraton, kota itu punya sarana olahraga yang jauh lebih lengkap.
w|sarana.en: Since the marathon started, the city has had much better sports facilities.
w|sarana.ko: 마라톤이 생긴 뒤로 그 도시는 체육 시설이 훨씬 잘 갖춰졌어요.

w|sarang.text: Sarang burung ada di dahan tinggi.
w|sarang.en: The bird nest is on a high branch.
Bees guard the nest from disturbance.

w|sarapan.en: We have breakfast together in the kitchen.

w|sarjana.text: Fajar bekerja di dapur restoran setelah lulus sebagai sarjana tata boga.
w|sarjana.en: Fajar works in a restaurant kitchen after graduating with a degree in culinary arts.
w|sarjana.ko: 파자르는 조리학과를 졸업하고 식당 주방에서 일해요.

w|sarjana.text: Di lapak barang bekas, Lestari menemukan ijazah sarjana lama dalam bingkai kayu.
w|sarjana.en: At a secondhand stall, Lestari found an old bachelor's diploma in a wooden frame.
w|sarjana.ko: 중고 노점에서 레스타리는 나무 액자에 든 오래된 학사 학위증을 발견했어요.

w|sarung.text: Sarung tangan itu terlalu besar untuknya.
w|sarung.en: Those gloves are too big for him.

w|sarung.text: Kakek selalu memakai sarung di rumah.
w|sarung.en: Grandfather always wears a sarong at home.

w|sasaran.text: Anak panah mengenai sasaran dengan tepat.
w|sasaran.en: The arrow hit the target precisely.

w|sasaran.text: Sasaran utama proyek ini sudah jelas.
w|sasaran.en: The main target of this project is already clear.
w|sasaran.ko: 이 프로젝트의 주요 목표는 이미 분명해.

w|sastra.text: Andi paling betah duduk di bagian sastra dekat jendela.
w|sastra.en: Andi is most at home sitting in the literature section near the window.
w|sastra.ko: 안디는 창가 문학 코너에 앉아 있는 게 제일 편해요.

w|sastra.text: Dewi dulu kuliah sastra, tapi sekarang bekerja di bagian pemasaran.
w|sastra.en: Dewi studied literature at university, but now works in marketing.
w|sastra.ko: 디위는 대학에서 문학을 공부했지만 지금은 마케팅 부서에서 일해요.

w|satelit.text: Malam itu Eko melihat titik cahaya yang bergerak, mungkin sebuah satelit.
w|satelit.en: That night Eko saw a moving point of light, perhaps a satellite.
w|satelit.ko: 그날 밤 에코는 움직이는 빛 한 점을 봤는데, 아마 인공위성이었을 거예요.

w|satelit.text: Pak Hasan baru memasang antena parabola untuk menangkap siaran satelit.
w|satelit.en: Mr. Hasan just installed a satellite dish to pick up satellite broadcasts.
w|satelit.ko: 하산 씨는 위성 방송을 보려고 막 접시 안테나를 달았어요.

w|satpam.text: Setiap pagi satpam di lobi menyapa Fajar dengan senyum lebar.
w|satpam.en: Every morning the security guard in the lobby greets Fajar with a big smile.
w|satpam.ko: 매일 아침 로비 경비원이 활짝 웃으며 파자르에게 인사해요.

w|satpam.text: Gedung kantor bersama tempat Lestari bekerja dijaga satpam selama dua puluh empat jam.
w|satpam.en: The coworking building where Lestari works is guarded by security around the clock.
w|satpam.ko: 레스타리가 일하는 공유 오피스 건물은 경비원이 하루 종일 지켜요.

w|satuan.text: Aplikasi di ponsel Rudi mencatat jarak pendakian dalam satuan kilometer.
w|satuan.en: The app on Rudi's phone records the hiking distance in kilometers.
w|satuan.ko: 루디의 휴대폰 앱은 등산 거리를 킬로미터 단위로 기록해요.

w|satuan.text: Penjual di luar stadion menjual stiker band per satuan dengan harga murah.
w|satuan.en: Vendors outside the stadium sold band stickers individually at a low price.
w|satuan.ko: 경기장 밖 상인들은 밴드 스티커를 낱개로 싸게 팔았어요.

w|saudari.text: Saudari saya tinggal di pulau lain.
w|saudari.en: My sister lives on another island.
Please give my regards to your sister.

w|saus.text: Roti sosis di toko Fajar disajikan dengan saus tomat buatan sendiri.
w|saus.en: The sausage rolls at Fajar's shop are served with homemade tomato sauce.
w|saus.ko: 파자르네 가게의 소시지 빵은 직접 만든 토마토소스와 함께 나와요.

w|saus.text: Malam sebelum lomba, Lestari makan pasta dengan saus jamur.
w|saus.en: The night before the race, Lestari ate pasta with mushroom sauce.
w|saus.ko: 대회 전날 밤 레스타리는 버섯 소스 파스타를 먹었어요.

w|sawah.text: Setiap pagi Budi berjalan ke sawah sebelum matahari tinggi.
w|sawah.en: Every morning Budi walks to the rice field before the sun is high.
w|sawah.ko: 부디는 매일 아침 해가 높이 뜨기 전에 논으로 걸어가요.

w|sawah.text: Beras yang dimasak Siti dikirim langsung dari sawah di desa.
w|sawah.en: The rice Siti cooks is sent straight from paddy fields in the village.
w|sawah.ko: 시티가 짓는 쌀은 시골 논에서 바로 보내져요.

w|sayang.en: It's a shame he didn't come.

w|sayap.en: The bird flaps its wings strongly.
The plane's wings are checked before flying.

w|sayur.text: Agus membuat roti isi sayur untuk pelanggan vegetarian.
w|sayur.en: Agus makes vegetable-filled bread for vegetarian customers.
w|sayur.ko: 아구스는 채식하는 손님을 위해 채소 빵을 만들어요.

w|sayur.text: Wati selalu menambah porsi sayur saat makan di kantin kantor.
w|sayur.en: Wati always gets an extra serving of vegetables at the office canteen.
w|sayur.ko: 와티는 회사 구내식당에서 늘 채소를 더 담아요.

w|sayuran.text: Roti isi sayuran jadi pilihan favorit pegawai kantor di dekat toko Fajar.
w|sayuran.en: The vegetable sandwich is a favorite with office workers near Fajar's shop.
w|sayuran.ko: 채소 샌드위치는 파자르네 가게 근처 회사원들이 제일 좋아하는 메뉴예요.

w|sayuran.text: Ahli gizi menyarankan Lestari makan lebih banyak sayuran hijau.
w|sayuran.en: The nutritionist advised Lestari to eat more green vegetables.
w|sayuran.ko: 영양사는 레스타리에게 녹색 채소를 더 많이 먹으라고 권했어요.

w|seakan.text: Terdakwa diam saja, seakan tidak mendengar pertanyaan hakim.
w|seakan.en: The defendant stayed silent, as if he didn't hear the judge's question.
w|seakan.ko: 피고인은 판사의 질문을 못 들은 것처럼 가만히 있었어요.

w|seakan.text: Pembeli itu menatap rak kosong seakan tidak percaya mi instan sudah habis.
w|seakan.en: The customer stared at the empty shelf as if he couldn't believe the instant noodles were gone.
w|seakan.ko: 그 손님은 라면이 다 떨어진 게 믿기지 않는다는 듯 빈 선반을 바라봤어요.

w|seakan-akan.text: Bintang-bintang begitu terang, seakan-akan Eko bisa menyentuhnya.
w|seakan-akan.en: The stars were so bright, it was as if Eko could touch them.
w|seakan-akan.ko: 별이 너무 밝아서 에코는 손을 뻗으면 닿을 것만 같았어요.

w|seakan-akan.text: Di kilometer tiga puluh, Ayu merasa seakan-akan kakinya terbuat dari batu.
w|seakan-akan.en: At the thirtieth kilometer, Ayu felt as though her legs were made of stone.
w|seakan-akan.ko: 삼십 킬로미터 지점에서 아유는 다리가 돌로 된 것 같았어요.

w|seandainya.text: Seandainya aku tahu, aku akan datang.
w|seandainya.en: If only I had known, I would have come.

w|seandainya.text: Apa yang kau lakukan seandainya hujan deras?
w|seandainya.en: What would you do if it poured rain?
w|seandainya.ko: 폭우가 온다면 너는 뭘 할 거야?

w|sebab.en: Because of the rain, the match was postponed.

w|sebabnya.en: I know the reason she's angry.

w|sebagaimana.text: Kerjakan tugas sebagaimana yang diminta guru.
w|sebagaimana.en: Do the assignment as the teacher requested.

w|sebagaimana.text: Sebagaimana biasa, dia datang tepat waktu.
w|sebagaimana.en: As usual, he arrived on time.

w|sebagian.en: Some people have already gone home.
I only ate part of it.

w|sebaik.text: Lakukan sebaik mungkin dalam waktu singkat.
w|sebaik.en: Do it as well as possible in a short time.

w|sebaik.text: Sebaik apapun rencana, tetap butuh fleksibilitas.
w|sebaik.en: No matter how good the plan, flexibility is still needed.

w|sebaliknya.text: Sebaliknya, dia memilih tinggal di rumah.
w|sebaliknya.en: On the contrary, she chose to stay home.

w|sebaliknya.text: Aku mengira mudah, sebaliknya ternyata sulit.
w|sebaliknya.en: I thought it was easy; on the contrary it was hard.

w|sebanding.text: Menurut Rudi, matahari terbit di sini sebanding dengan perjalanan panjang yang melelahkan itu.
w|sebanding.en: Rudi thinks the sunrise here is worth the long, tiring journey.
w|sebanding.ko: 루디 생각에 여기 일출은 그 길고 힘든 여정만큼의 가치가 있어요.

w|sebanding.text: Rina kaget karena harga tiketnya sebanding dengan gajinya selama seminggu.
w|sebanding.en: Rina was shocked because the ticket price was equal to a week of her salary.
w|sebanding.ko: 리나는 티켓 값이 자기 일주일 월급과 맞먹어서 깜짝 놀랐어요.

w|sebanyak.en: He brought as many books as possible.

w|sebanyak.text: Sebanyak itu sudah cukup untuk hari ini.
w|sebanyak.en: That much is already enough for today.

w|sebatang.text: Saat istirahat, Fajar keluar ke balkon dan menyalakan sebatang rokok.
w|sebatang.en: During the break, Fajar went out to the balcony and lit a cigarette.
w|sebatang.ko: 쉬는 시간에 파자르는 발코니로 나가 담배 한 개비에 불을 붙였어요.

w|sebatang.text: Di meja Lestari selalu ada sebatang cokelat untuk menemaninya lembur.
w|sebatang.en: There is always a chocolate bar on Lestari's desk to keep her company during overtime.
w|sebatang.ko: 레스타리 책상에는 야근할 때 먹을 초콜릿 바가 늘 있어요.

w|sebegitu.text: Fajar tidak menyangka antrean pembuatan KTP bisa sebegitu panjang.
w|sebegitu.en: Fajar didn't expect the line for ID cards to be that long.
w|sebegitu.ko: 파자르는 신분증 발급 줄이 그렇게까지 길 줄은 몰랐어요.

w|sebegitu.text: Lestari heran kenapa tetangga sebelah bisa sebegitu berisik tengah malam.
w|sebegitu.en: Lestari wonders how the neighbor next door can be so noisy in the middle of the night.
w|sebegitu.ko: 레스타리는 옆집이 어떻게 한밤중에 그렇게까지 시끄러울 수 있는지 의아해요.

w|sebelah.en: That shop is next to the bank.
On the right side there's an exit.

w|sebelas.text: Latihan malam itu baru selesai pukul sebelas.
w|sebelas.en: That night's rehearsal didn't finish until eleven.
w|sebelas.ko: 그날 밤 연습은 열한 시가 되어서야 끝났어요.

w|sebelas.text: Toko Ayu tutup setiap malam pukul sebelas.
w|sebelas.en: Ayu's shop closes every night at eleven.
w|sebelas.ko: 아유의 가게는 매일 밤 열한 시에 문을 닫아요.

w|sebenarnya.text: Dimas sebenarnya ingin kuliah jurusan pertanian di kota.
w|sebenarnya.en: Dimas actually wants to study agriculture at a university in the city.
w|sebenarnya.ko: 디마스는 사실 도시에서 농학을 공부하고 싶어 해요.

w|sebenarnya.text: Putri sebenarnya lelah, tapi tetap datang ke acara temannya.
w|sebenarnya.en: Putri was actually tired, but she still went to her friend's event.
w|sebenarnya.ko: 푸트리는 사실 피곤했지만 그래도 친구 모임에 갔어요.

w|sebentar.en: I'll step out for a bit.

w|seberang.text: Toko baru ada di seberang jalan.
w|seberang.en: The new shop is across the street.
The other side of the river is still quiet.

w|seberapa.en: I don't know how bad it is.

w|seberat.text: Rudi menjelaskan bahwa hukuman untuk pelanggaran kecil tidak seberat yang dibayangkan warga.
w|seberat.en: Rudi explained that the penalty for minor offenses isn't as heavy as people imagine.
w|seberat.ko: 루디는 가벼운 위반의 처벌이 주민들이 생각하는 만큼 무겁지 않다고 설명했어요.

w|seberat.text: Anjing itu kini seberat karung beras, jadi Rina menyarankan diet.
w|seberat.en: That dog now weighs as much as a sack of rice, so Rina recommended a diet.
w|seberat.ko: 그 개는 이제 쌀 한 포대만큼 무거워서 리나가 다이어트를 권했어요.

w|sebesar.en: That stone is as big as a fist.

w|sebesar.text: Sebesar apa pun risiko, dia siap.
w|sebesar.en: No matter how big the risk, he is ready.

w|sebetulnya.text: Andi sebetulnya tidak suka makanan pedas, tapi tetap mencicipi sambal buatan temannya.
w|sebetulnya.en: Andi doesn't actually like spicy food, but he still tasted his friend's chili sauce.
w|sebetulnya.ko: 안디는 사실 매운 음식을 안 좋아하지만 친구가 만든 삼발을 맛봤어요.

w|sebetulnya.text: Dewi mengaku sebetulnya ia iri dengan kehidupan tenang Rani di desa.
w|sebetulnya.en: Dewi admitted she's actually envious of Rani's quiet life in the village.
w|sebetulnya.ko: 데위는 사실 라니의 조용한 시골 생활이 부럽다고 털어놨어요.

w|sebotol.text: Saat jam istirahat, Andi menghabiskan sebotol teh manis dingin.
w|sebotol.en: During break, Andi finished a bottle of cold sweet tea.
w|sebotol.ko: 쉬는 시간에 안디는 차가운 단 차 한 병을 다 마셨어요.

w|sebotol.text: Dewi memberi pasien itu sebotol air hangat untuk diminum pelan-pelan.
w|sebotol.en: Dewi gave the patient a bottle of warm water to sip slowly.
w|sebotol.ko: 데위는 그 환자에게 천천히 마시라고 따뜻한 물 한 병을 줬어요.

w|sebuah.en: There's a box on the table.

w|sebuah.ko: 그 사람이 책을 한 권 줬어.

w|sebulan.text: Dia tinggal di sini selama sebulan.
w|sebulan.en: He stayed here for a month.
w|sebulan.ko: 그는 여기서 한 달 동안 지냈어.

w|sebutan.text: Eko punya sebutan "profesor" karena selalu membawa banyak buku.
w|sebutan.en: Eko has the nickname "professor" because he always carries lots of books.
w|sebutan.ko: 에코는 늘 책을 많이 들고 다녀서 '교수'라는 별명이 있어요.

w|sebutan.text: Di keluarga Ayu, sebutan "Ucok" dipakai untuk anak laki-laki paling kecil.
w|sebutan.en: In Ayu's family, the name "Ucok" is used for the youngest boy.

w|secangkir.text: Dia minum secangkir kopi sebelum berangkat.
w|secangkir.en: He drank a cup of coffee before leaving.
w|secangkir.ko: 그는 출발 전에 커피 한 잔을 마셨어.

w|secangkir.text: Secangkir teh hangat menenangkan sore itu.
w|secangkir.en: A warm cup of tea soothed that afternoon.
w|secangkir.ko: 따뜻한 차 한 잔이 그 오후를 달래 주었어.

w|secantik.text: Tetangga Agus bilang ruang tamunya secantik foto di majalah.
w|secantik.en: Agus's neighbor said his living room was as pretty as a photo in a magazine.
w|secantik.ko: 아구스의 이웃은 그의 거실이 잡지 사진만큼 예쁘다고 했어요.

w|secantik.text: Menurut Wati, tidak ada pemandangan secantik sawah hijau setelah hujan pertama.
w|secantik.en: According to Wati, no view is as beautiful as green rice fields after the first rain.
w|secantik.ko: 와티는 첫비 뒤의 초록 논만큼 예쁜 풍경은 없다고 해요.

w|secepat.en: He ran as fast as lightning.

w|sedangkan.text: Dia datang pagi, sedangkan saya datang sore.
w|sedangkan.en: He arrived in the morning, whereas I arrived in the afternoon.
w|sedangkan.ko: 그는 아침에 왔고, 나는 오후에 왔어.

w|sedangkan.text: Sedangkan adiknya masih tidur di kamar.
w|sedangkan.en: Meanwhile his younger sibling was still sleeping in the room.
w|sedangkan.ko: 반면 동생은 아직 방에서 자고 있었어.

w|sedemikian.text: Hujan turun sedemikian deras sehingga Budi tidak bisa ke ladang.
w|sedemikian.en: The rain fell so heavily that Budi couldn't go to the field.
w|sedemikian.ko: 비가 너무 세게 와서 부디는 밭에 갈 수 없었어요.

w|sedemikian.text: Siti menata hidangan sedemikian rupa sehingga terlihat seperti lukisan.
w|sedemikian.en: Siti arranged the dish in such a way that it looked like a painting.

w|sedunia.text: Fajar bangga karena kopi dari daerah ini sudah terkenal sedunia.
w|sedunia.en: Fajar is proud that coffee from this region is now famous around the world.
w|sedunia.ko: 파자르는 이 지역 커피가 이제 세계적으로 유명해져서 자랑스러워요.

w|sedunia.text: Lestari yakin kucingnya adalah kucing paling malas sedunia.
w|sedunia.en: Lestari is sure her cat is the laziest cat in the world.
w|sedunia.ko: 레스타리는 자기 고양이가 세상에서 제일 게으른 고양이라고 확신해요.

w|seenaknya.text: Penumpang di sebelah Dimas menaruh kakinya seenaknya di kursi kosong.
w|seenaknya.en: The passenger next to Dimas carelessly put his feet on the empty seat.
w|seenaknya.ko: 디마스 옆 승객은 빈 좌석에 제멋대로 발을 올려놓았어요.

w|seenaknya.text: Putri tidak suka kalau ada programmer yang mengubah kode seenaknya tanpa diskusi.
w|seenaknya.en: Putri doesn't like it when a programmer changes code however they please without discussion.
w|seenaknya.ko: 푸트리는 개발자가 상의도 없이 코드를 제멋대로 바꾸는 걸 싫어해요.

w|segala.en: He's ready to face any risk.
w|segala.ko: 그는 어떤 위험이든 맞설 준비가 됐어.

w|segar.text: Udara pagi terasa segar di pegunungan.
w|segar.en: The morning air feels fresh in the mountains.

w|segar.text: Buah ini masih segar dan manis.
w|segar.en: This fruit is still fresh and sweet.

w|segel.text: Amplop berisi soal ujian masih ditutup dengan segel dari dinas pendidikan.
w|segel.en: The envelope with the exam questions was still closed with a seal from the education office.
w|segel.ko: 시험 문제가 든 봉투는 아직 교육청 봉인으로 닫혀 있었어요.

w|segel.text: Paket kiriman untuk Ayu datang dengan segel yang masih utuh.
w|segel.en: The package for Ayu arrived with its seal still intact.

w|segelas.text: Dia minum segelas air setelah olahraga.
w|segelas.en: He drank a glass of water after exercise.
w|segelas.ko: 그는 운동 뒤 물 한 잔을 마셨어.

w|segelas.text: Segelas teh hangat menenangkan sore itu.
w|segelas.en: A glass of warm tea soothed that afternoon.
w|segelas.ko: 따뜻한 차 한 잔이 그날 오후를 달래 줬어.

w|segenap.text: Kepala desa berterima kasih kepada Eko dan segenap relawan yang membersihkan pantai.
w|segenap.en: The village head thanked Eko and all the volunteers who cleaned the beach.
w|segenap.ko: 이장은 해변을 청소한 에코와 모든 자원봉사자에게 감사했어요.

w|segenap.text: Ayu berterima kasih kepada dokter dan segenap staf klinik atas kesabaran mereka.
w|segenap.en: Ayu thanked the dentist and the entire clinic staff for their patience.
w|segenap.ko: 아유는 의사와 병원 직원 모두에게 인내해 줘서 고맙다고 했어요.

w|segerombolan.text: Rudi mengusir segerombolan semut dari gudang gula.
w|segerombolan.en: Rudi chased a swarm of ants out of the sugar storeroom.
w|segerombolan.ko: 루디는 설탕 창고에서 개미 떼를 쫓아냈어요.

w|segerombolan.text: Rina dikerubungi segerombolan anak yang ingin melihat mainan kaleng.
w|segerombolan.en: Rina was swarmed by a gang of kids who wanted to see the tin toys.
w|segerombolan.ko: 양철 장난감을 보려는 아이들 한 무리가 리나를 에워쌌어요.

w|segi.text: Dari segi harga, obat generik jauh lebih murah.
w|segi.en: In terms of price, generic drugs are much cheaper.

w|segi.text: Dari segi pengalaman, rekan baru itu jauh lebih senior daripada Lestari.
w|segi.en: In terms of experience, the new coworker is far more senior than Lestari.
w|segi.ko: 경력 면에서는 새 동료가 레스타리보다 훨씬 선배예요.

w|segitiga.text: Fajar memotong roti lapis berbentuk segitiga untuk menu anak.
w|segitiga.en: Fajar cuts the sandwiches into triangles for the kids' menu.
w|segitiga.ko: 파자르는 어린이 메뉴용 샌드위치를 세모 모양으로 잘라요.

w|segitiga.text: Lestari membeli syal batik berbentuk segitiga dengan harga murah.
w|segitiga.en: Lestari bought a triangular batik scarf for a low price.
w|segitiga.ko: 레스타리는 세모난 바틱 스카프를 싸게 샀어요.

w|seharga.text: Fajar akhirnya membeli sepatu kulit seharga tiga ratus ribu rupiah.
w|seharga.en: Fajar finally bought leather shoes costing three hundred thousand rupiah.
w|seharga.ko: 파자르는 결국 삼십만 루피아짜리 가죽 구두를 샀어요.

w|seharga.text: Lestari membeli pisau koki seharga setengah juta untuk kelas itu.
w|seharga.en: Lestari bought a chef's knife costing half a million for that class.
w|seharga.ko: 레스타리는 그 수업을 위해 오십만 루피아짜리 요리용 칼을 샀어요.

w|sehari.en: Once a day I call my mother.

w|sehari-hari.text: Saat musim hujan, Dimas memakai sepatu bot dalam kegiatan sehari-hari.
w|sehari-hari.en: During the rainy season, Dimas wears boots for his daily activities.
w|sehari-hari.ko: 우기에는 디마스가 평소에 장화를 신고 다녀요.

w|sehari-hari.text: Putri ingin rumah tua itu nyaman dipakai sehari-hari, bukan cuma cantik.
w|sehari-hari.en: Putri wants the old house to be comfortable for everyday use, not just pretty.
w|sehari-hari.ko: 푸트리는 그 낡은 집이 예쁘기만 한 게 아니라 평소에 살기 편하길 바라요.

w|seharian.en: He worked all day without a break.
w|seharian.ko: 그는 쉬지 않고 하루 종일 일했어.

w|seharian.en: We walked around the beach all day.
w|seharian.ko: 우리는 해변에서 하루 종일 걸어 다녔어.

w|seharusnya.en: You should have said so first.
We should have arrived by now.

w|sehebat.text: Bayu belum pernah menemukan barang antik sehebat jam dinding itu.
w|sehebat.en: Bayu has never found an antique as great as that wall clock.
w|sehebat.ko: 바유는 그 벽시계만큼 대단한 골동품을 찾아본 적이 없어요.

w|sehebat.text: Menurut Intan, tidak ada penyanyi sehebat ayahnya saat menyanyikan lagu cinta.
w|sehebat.en: For Intan, no singer is as great as her father when he sings a love song.
w|sehebat.ko: 인탄에게는 사랑 노래를 부를 때 아버지만큼 대단한 가수가 없어요.

w|sehingga.en: He was late so he missed the bus.
So we had to wait a long time.

w|sehubungan.text: Fajar mengirim surat edaran sehubungan dengan perubahan jam layanan.
w|sehubungan.en: Fajar sent out a circular in connection with the change in service hours.
w|sehubungan.ko: 파자르는 업무 시간 변경과 관련해 공문을 보냈어요.

w|sehubungan.text: Pengelola menempel pengumuman sehubungan dengan pemadaman air besok, jadi Lestari mengisi ember.
w|sehubungan.en: The management posted a notice about tomorrow's water outage, so Lestari filled buckets.
w|sehubungan.ko: 관리실이 내일 단수와 관련해 공지를 붙여서 레스타리는 양동이에 물을 받아 뒀어요.

w|seimbang.text: Dimas mengatur beban di rak supaya seimbang dan tidak mudah roboh.
w|seimbang.en: Dimas arranges the load on the shelf so it is balanced and won't topple easily.
w|seimbang.ko: 디마스는 선반이 쉽게 무너지지 않도록 짐을 균형 있게 놓아요.

w|seimbang.text: Dalam suratnya, Putri bercerita sedang belajar hidup seimbang antara kerja dan istirahat.
w|seimbang.en: In her letter, Putri says she is learning to live with a balance between work and rest.
w|seimbang.ko: 편지에서 푸트리는 일과 쉼 사이에 균형 있게 사는 법을 배우는 중이라고 해요.

w|seiring.text: Andi makin akrab dengan teman sebangkunya seiring berjalannya waktu.
w|seiring.en: Andi grew closer to his deskmate as time went on.
w|seiring.ko: 시간이 지나면서 안디는 짝꿍과 점점 더 친해졌어요.

w|seiring.text: Tamu-tamu Dewi makin ramai seiring malam yang makin larut.
w|seiring.en: Dewi's guests grew livelier as the night grew later.
w|seiring.ko: 밤이 깊어 갈수록 데위의 손님들은 더 북적였어요.

w|seisi.text: Ketika Eko menangkap ikan besar, seisi kampung datang untuk melihat.
w|seisi.en: When Eko caught a big fish, the whole village came to see.
w|seisi.ko: 에코가 큰 물고기를 잡자 온 마을 사람들이 구경하러 왔어요.

w|seisi.text: Ayu menangis begitu keras sampai seisi ruang tunggu menoleh.
w|seisi.en: Ayu cried so loudly that everyone in the waiting room turned around.
w|seisi.ko: 아유가 너무 크게 울어서 대기실에 있던 모두가 돌아봤어요.

w|sejahtera.text: Rudi bermimpi semua warga di kampung halaman hidup sejahtera.
w|sejahtera.en: Rudi dreams that everyone in his home village will live in prosperity.
w|sejahtera.ko: 루디는 고향 마을 사람들이 모두 넉넉하게 사는 날을 꿈꿔요.

w|sejahtera.text: Rina ingin semua hewan di penampungan hidup sejahtera.
w|sejahtera.en: Rina wants all the animals in the shelter to live well.
w|sejahtera.ko: 리나는 보호소의 모든 동물이 잘 지내기를 바라요.

w|sejajar.text: Rak-rak buku di lantai dua tersusun sejajar seperti barisan tentara, kata Andi kagum.
w|sejajar.en: The bookshelves on the second floor are lined up parallel like rows of soldiers, Andi said admiringly.
w|sejajar.ko: 이 층 책장들이 군인 행렬처럼 나란히 서 있다고 안디가 감탄했어요.

w|sejajar.text: Dewi menyusun rak buku sejajar dengan jendela supaya ruangan terlihat lega.
w|sejajar.en: Dewi lined the bookshelf up parallel with the window so the room would look spacious.
w|sejajar.ko: 데위는 방이 넓어 보이게 책장을 창문과 나란히 놓았어요.

w|sejak.text: Aku tinggal di sini sejak kecil.
w|sejak.en: I've lived here since I was little.

w|sejalan.text: Usulan Fajar sejalan dengan rencana direktur untuk menghemat kertas.
