w|sejalan.en: Fajar's proposal is in line with the director's plan to save paper.
w|sejalan.ko: 파자르의 제안은 종이를 아끼려는 이사의 계획과 맞아요.

w|sejalan.text: Visi investor baru itu sejalan dengan mimpi Lestari membangun aplikasi untuk desa.
w|sejalan.en: The new investor's vision is in line with Lestari's dream of building apps for villages.
w|sejalan.ko: 새 투자자의 비전은 마을을 위한 앱을 만들겠다는 레스타리의 꿈과 맞아요.

w|sejam.text: Dia menunggu di halte hampir sejam.
w|sejam.en: He waited at the stop for almost an hour.
w|sejam.ko: 그는 정류장에서 거의 한 시간을 기다렸어.

w|sejam.en: An hour later the plane began to land.
w|sejam.ko: 한 시간 뒤 비행기가 착륙하기 시작했어.

w|sejarawan.text: Rudi mewawancarai seorang sejarawan kuliner untuk menghidupkan kembali resep kuno.
w|sejarawan.en: Rudi interviewed a food historian to revive an ancient recipe.
w|sejarawan.ko: 루디는 옛 요리법을 되살리려고 음식 역사학자를 인터뷰했어요.

w|sejarawan.text: Seorang sejarawan membeli peta tua dari Rina dengan harga tinggi.
w|sejarawan.en: A historian bought an old map from Rina at a high price.
w|sejarawan.ko: 한 역사학자가 리나에게서 옛 지도를 비싼 값에 샀어요.

w|sejati.en: His love for you is truly genuine.
w|sejati.ko: 너를 향한 그의 사랑은 정말 진실해.

w|sejauh.en: He walked as far as two kilometers.

w|sejenak.text: Dia berhenti sejenak untuk menarik napas.
w|sejenak.en: He paused for a moment to catch his breath.
For a moment he fell silent thinking of an answer.

w|sejenis.text: Tanaman sejenis tumbuh di tanah basah.
w|sejenis.en: Similar plants grow in wet soil.

w|sejenis.text: Dia mencari buku sejenis di toko.
w|sejenis.en: She looks for a similar book in the store.

w|sejujurnya.text: Sejujurnya aku tidak suka rencana itu.
w|sejujurnya.en: Honestly I don't like that plan.
w|sejujurnya.ko: 솔직히 난 그 계획이 마음에 안 들어.

w|sejujurnya.text: Sejujurnya dia memang lebih pantas menang.
w|sejujurnya.en: Honestly he really deserved to win more.
w|sejujurnya.ko: 솔직히 그가 이기는 게 더 맞아.

w|sejuk.text: Udara pagi di kebun Budi terasa sejuk dan segar.
w|sejuk.en: The morning air in Budi's garden feels cool and fresh.
w|sejuk.ko: 부디의 밭에 부는 아침 공기는 시원하고 상쾌해요.

w|sejuk.text: Siti menyimpan bawang di ruang yang sejuk dan gelap.
w|sejuk.en: Siti keeps the onions in a cool, dark room.
w|sejuk.ko: 시티는 양파를 서늘하고 어두운 곳에 보관해요.

w|sejumlah.text: Sejumlah orang antre di depan toko.
w|sejumlah.en: A number of people lined up in front of the shop.
w|sejumlah.ko: 가게 앞에 여러 사람이 줄을 섰어.

w|sejumlah.en: The police found a number of important pieces of evidence.
w|sejumlah.ko: 경찰이 중요한 증거를 여러 개 찾았어.

w|sejuta.text: Pemandangan sawah bertingkat itu membuat Dimas merasa sejuta kali lebih tenang.
w|sejuta.en: The view of the terraced rice fields made Dimas feel a million times calmer.
w|sejuta.ko: 계단식 논 풍경에 디마스는 백만 배는 더 마음이 편해졌어요.

w|sejuta.text: Tim Putri bermimpi aplikasinya diunduh sejuta orang sebelum akhir tahun.
w|sejuta.en: Putri's team dreams of their app being downloaded by a million people before the end of the year.
w|sejuta.ko: 푸트리의 팀은 연말 전에 앱 다운로드 백만 회를 꿈꿔요.

w|sekadar.text: Bagi Dimas, payung bukan sekadar alat, tapi teman setia di musim hujan.
w|sekadar.en: For Dimas, an umbrella isn't just a tool but a loyal companion in the rainy season.
w|sekadar.ko: 디마스에게 우산은 그냥 도구가 아니라 우기의 든든한 친구예요.

w|sekadar.text: Putri tidak ingin sekadar mengecat ulang, tapi juga memperkuat struktur rumah.
w|sekadar.en: Putri doesn't want to just repaint; she also wants to strengthen the house's structure.
w|sekadar.ko: 푸트리는 그냥 다시 칠하는 게 아니라 집 구조도 튼튼하게 하고 싶어요.

w|sekalian.text: Beli roti sekalian ambil susu di toko.
w|sekalian.en: Buy bread and grab milk at the store too.

w|sekalian.text: Ayo pulang sekalian mampir ke rumah nenek.
w|sekalian.en: Let's go home and stop by grandma's house too.

w|sekaligus.en: He finished two tasks at once.
w|sekaligus.ko: 그는 두 가지 일을 한꺼번에 끝냈어.

w|sekaligus.text: Sekaligus dia minta maaf dan berjanji.
w|sekaligus.en: At the same time he apologized and made a promise.

w|sekarat.en: The engine was dying after the long trip.
w|sekarat.ko: 긴 여정 뒤 엔진이 죽어 가고 있었어.

w|sekedar.en: This is merely a joke, don't be angry.

w|sekedar.text: Aku sekedar ingin membantu, bukan mengganggu.
w|sekedar.en: I merely want to help, not bother you.
w|sekedar.ko: 나는 단지 돕고 싶을 뿐이지, 방해하려는 게 아니야.

w|sekejap.text: Hujan deras itu hanya turun sekejap, lalu matahari muncul lagi.
w|sekejap.en: The heavy rain only fell for a moment, then the sun came out again.
w|sekejap.ko: 그 폭우는 잠깐 내리고 다시 해가 났어요.

w|sekejap.text: Matahari terbenam hanya sekejap, jadi kru harus bergerak cepat.
w|sekejap.en: The sunset only lasts a moment, so the crew has to move fast.
w|sekejap.ko: 해 지는 순간은 잠깐이라서 제작진은 빨리 움직여야 했어요.

w|sekelas.text: Ternyata Dimas bekerja bersama teman sekelas waktu SMK dulu.
w|sekelas.en: It turns out Dimas works with a former classmate from vocational school.
w|sekelas.ko: 알고 보니 디마스는 직업고 시절 같은 반 친구와 함께 일해요.

w|sekelas.text: Putri dan Sari sudah sekelas sejak kelas satu SD.
w|sekelas.en: Putri and Sari have been in the same class since first grade.
w|sekelas.ko: 푸트리와 사리는 초등학교 일 학년 때부터 같은 반이었어요.

w|sekeliling.text: Saat meliput demo, Eko selalu memperhatikan keadaan di sekeliling.
w|sekeliling.en: When covering a protest, Eko always pays attention to his surroundings.
w|sekeliling.ko: 시위를 취재할 때 에코는 늘 주변 상황을 살펴요.

w|sekeliling.text: Toko Ayu terkenal di sekeliling kampus karena murah dan cepat.
w|sekeliling.en: Ayu's shop is famous around the campus for being cheap and fast.
w|sekeliling.ko: 아유 가게는 싸고 빨라서 대학 주변에서 유명해요.

w|sekelompok.en: A group of students sat in the park.

w|sekelompok.text: Ada sekelompok burung di atas pohon.
w|sekelompok.en: There is a flock of birds in the tree.
w|sekelompok.ko: 나무 위에 새 한 무리가 있어.

w|seketika.text: Langit yang tadinya cerah seketika menjadi gelap di atas kepala Dimas.
w|seketika.en: The sky that had been clear instantly turned dark above Dimas's head.
w|seketika.ko: 맑던 하늘이 디마스 머리 위에서 순식간에 어두워졌어요.

w|seketika.text: Debu tebal seketika beterbangan saat Putri membuka lemari tua.
w|seketika.en: Thick dust instantly flew everywhere when Putri opened the old wardrobe.
w|seketika.ko: 푸트리가 낡은 옷장을 열자 두꺼운 먼지가 순식간에 날렸어요.

w|sekian.text: Wali kota menutup rapat dengan kalimat, "Baik, sekian dari saya, terima kasih."
w|sekian.en: The mayor closed the meeting with the words, "Well, that's all from me, thank you."
w|sekian.ko: 시장은 "제 말은 여기까지입니다, 감사합니다"라는 말로 회의를 마쳤어요.

w|sekian.text: Setelah sekian lama berlatih, akhirnya Wati bisa memainkan lagu itu tanpa salah.
w|sekian.en: After practicing for so long, Wati can finally play the song without mistakes.
w|sekian.ko: 그렇게 오래 연습한 끝에 와티는 마침내 그 곡을 틀리지 않고 쳐요.

w|sekilas.text: Kepala koki hanya mencicipi sekilas, lalu bilang sausnya kurang asin.
w|sekilas.en: The head chef only took a quick taste, then said the sauce wasn't salty enough.
w|sekilas.ko: 주방장은 살짝 맛만 보고 소스가 덜 짜다고 했어요.

w|sekilas.text: Cincin itu sekilas tampak seperti emas, padahal hanya kuningan.
w|sekilas.en: At a glance the ring looks like gold, but it's only brass.
w|sekilas.ko: 그 반지는 얼핏 금처럼 보이지만 사실 놋쇠예요.

w|sekoci.text: Tamu hotel ikut latihan naik sekoci sebelum tur ke pulau.
w|sekoci.en: The hotel guests took part in a lifeboat drill before the island tour.
w|sekoci.ko: 호텔 손님들은 섬 투어 전에 구명보트 타는 연습을 했어요.

w|sekoci.text: Saat banjir, warga memakai sekoci karet untuk mengungsikan para lansia.
w|sekoci.en: During the flood, residents used rubber dinghies to evacuate the elderly.
w|sekoci.ko: 홍수 때 주민들은 고무보트로 어르신들을 대피시켰어요.

w|sekolah.en: The kids are going to school.

w|sekop.text: Petugas gedung memakai sekop kecil untuk membersihkan pot tanaman di lobi.
w|sekop.en: The building staff used a small trowel to tidy the plant pots in the lobby.
w|sekop.ko: 건물 직원은 작은 삽으로 로비 화분을 정리했어요.

w|setara.en: In that old letter, Sari once wrote that men and women should be treated as equals.
w|setara.ko: 그 옛 편지에서 사리는 남자와 여자가 동등하게 여겨져야 한다고 썼어요.

w|setelah.en: After eating, we took a walk.

w|setelan.text: Ternyata setelan yang dipesan Fajar terlalu besar di bagian bahu.
w|setelan.en: The suit Fajar ordered turned out to be too big in the shoulders.
w|setelan.ko: 파자르가 주문한 정장은 어깨 부분이 너무 컸어요.

w|setelan.text: Peserta paling muda datang dengan setelan olahraga dan sepatu putih.
w|setelan.en: The youngest participant came in a tracksuit and white shoes.
w|setelan.ko: 가장 어린 참가자는 운동복 차림에 흰 운동화를 신고 왔어요.

w|setempat.text: Polisi setempat sudah hafal hampir semua warga di kampung itu.
w|setempat.en: The local police know almost everyone in that village by heart.
w|setempat.ko: 그 지역 경찰은 동네 사람들을 거의 다 알아요.

w|setempat.text: Koran setempat memuat foto Dewi saat melakukan lay-up.
w|setempat.en: The local newspaper ran a photo of Dewi doing a lay-up.
w|setempat.ko: 지역 신문에 데위가 레이업 슛을 하는 사진이 실렸어요.

w|setengah.en: Half an hour has already passed.
Half of them have already left.

w|seterusnya.text: Mulai hari ini dan seterusnya, Budi berjanji tidak akan terlambat lagi.
w|seterusnya.en: From today on, Budi promised he would never be late again.
w|seterusnya.ko: 부디는 오늘부터 앞으로 다시는 지각하지 않겠다고 약속했어요.

w|seterusnya.text: Siti mengusulkan reuni diadakan setiap lima tahun dan seterusnya.
w|seterusnya.en: Siti suggested holding the reunion every five years from now on.
w|seterusnya.ko: 시티는 앞으로 오 년마다 동창회를 열자고 제안했어요.

w|setetes.text: Bayu panik karena tangki bensinnya hampir kering, tinggal setetes.
w|setetes.en: Bayu panicked because his fuel tank was almost dry, down to the last drop.
w|setetes.ko: 기름이 거의 바닥나 한 방울밖에 안 남아서 바유는 당황했어요.

w|setetes.text: Intan menambahkan setetes air ke cat yang mulai mengering.
w|setetes.en: Intan added a drop of water to the paint that was starting to dry.
w|setetes.ko: 인탄은 마르기 시작한 물감에 물을 한 방울 더했어요.

w|setia.en: That dog is loyal to its owner.

w|setia.text: Dia tetap setia meski situasi sulit.
w|setia.en: She stayed faithful even in a hard situation.

w|setidaknya.en: You could at least say yes.

w|setimpal.text: Rudi yakin hukuman yang setimpal akan membuat pencuri motor itu jera.
w|setimpal.en: Rudi is sure that a fitting punishment will make the motorbike thief learn his lesson.
w|setimpal.ko: 루디는 마땅한 처벌을 받으면 그 오토바이 도둑이 다시는 안 그럴 거라고 믿어요.

w|setimpal.text: Latihan Rina selama berbulan-bulan akhirnya mendapat hasil yang setimpal.
w|setimpal.en: Rina's months of training finally paid off with a result that matched the effort.
w|setimpal.ko: 몇 달 동안의 리나의 훈련이 마침내 그만한 결과로 돌아왔어요.

w|setumpuk.text: Budi membawa setumpuk jerami ke kandang sapi.
w|setumpuk.en: Budi carried a pile of straw to the cow shed.
w|setumpuk.ko: 부디는 짚 한 더미를 외양간으로 날랐어요.

w|setumpuk.text: Ada setumpuk piring kotor di bak cuci ketika Siti datang.
w|setumpuk.en: There was a pile of dirty plates in the sink when Siti arrived.
w|setumpuk.ko: 시티가 왔을 때 개수대에 더러운 접시가 한 무더기 쌓여 있었어요.

w|seukuran.text: Barang bukti itu disimpan dalam kotak seukuran kardus sepatu.
w|seukuran.en: The evidence was kept in a box the size of a shoebox.
w|seukuran.ko: 그 증거물은 신발 상자만 한 상자에 보관됐어요.

w|seukuran.text: Martabak di restoran Wati disajikan seukuran piring besar.
w|seukuran.en: The martabak at Wati's restaurant is served as big as a large plate.
w|seukuran.ko: 와티네 식당의 마르타박은 큰 접시만 한 크기로 나와요.

w|seumur.text: Seumur hidup dia belum pergi jauh.
w|seumur.en: In his whole life he has never gone far.
w|seumur.ko: 평생 그는 멀리 가 본 적이 없어.

w|seumuran.text: Pengiring pengantin Fajar semuanya sepupu yang seumuran.
w|seumuran.en: Fajar's groomsmen are all cousins of the same age.

w|seumuran.text: Lestari dan rekan kerjanya seumuran, jadi mereka cepat akrab.
w|seumuran.en: Lestari and her coworker are the same age, so they quickly became close.

w|seusia.text: Kebanyakan tamu di pesta itu seusia dengan Fajar, teman-teman sekolahnya dulu.
w|seusia.en: Most of the guests at the party were Fajar's age, his old school friends.
w|seusia.ko: 잔치 손님 대부분은 파자르 또래인 옛 학교 친구들이었어요.

w|seusia.text: Pemimpin redaksi itu bangga karena banyak wartawannya seusia dengan anaknya.
w|seusia.en: The editor-in-chief is proud that many of his reporters are his children's age.
w|seusia.ko: 그 편집국장은 기자 중 많은 수가 자기 자녀 또래라는 게 뿌듯해요.

w|seutuhnya.text: Budi percaya pasien harus dirawat seutuhnya, tubuh dan pikiran.
w|seutuhnya.en: Budi believes patients should be cared for as a whole, body and mind.
w|seutuhnya.ko: 부디는 환자를 몸과 마음 모두 온전히 돌봐야 한다고 믿어요.

w|seutuhnya.text: Siti baru bisa santai seutuhnya setelah semua bagasi ditemukan.
w|seutuhnya.en: Siti could only fully relax once all her luggage had been found.
w|seutuhnya.ko: 시티는 짐을 모두 찾고 나서야 완전히 마음을 놓을 수 있었어요.

w|sewaktu.text: Dimas menemukan surat lama terselip di buku sewaktu membalik halaman.
w|sewaktu.en: Dimas found an old letter tucked in the book while turning the pages.
w|sewaktu.ko: 디마스는 책장을 넘기다가 책 사이에 끼인 옛 편지를 발견했어요.

w|sewaktu.text: Putri teringat masa kecilnya sewaktu kereta melewati sawah di desa neneknya.
w|sewaktu.en: Putri remembered her childhood when the train passed the rice fields in her grandmother's village.
w|sewaktu.ko: 기차가 할머니 마을 논을 지날 때 푸트리는 어린 시절이 떠올랐어요.

w|sia-sia.en: His effort was not in vain after all.

w|siaga.text: Petugas keamanan di ruang sidang tetap siaga sejak pagi.
w|siaga.en: The security officers in the courtroom have stayed on alert since morning.
w|siaga.ko: 법정 보안 요원들은 아침부터 계속 경계 태세를 유지했어요.

w|siaga.text: Saat musim hujan, Lestari selalu siaga menyediakan payung dan jas hujan.
w|siaga.en: In the rainy season, Lestari is always ready with umbrellas and raincoats.
w|siaga.ko: 우기에는 레스타리가 늘 우산과 우비를 준비해 둬요.

w|sial.text: Hari itu sungguh hari yang sial, tulis Rudi, karena dompetnya hilang di pasar.
w|sial.en: That day was a really unlucky day, Rudi wrote, because his wallet went missing at the market.
w|sial.ko: 그날은 정말 운 나쁜 날이었다고 루디는 썼어요, 시장에서 지갑을 잃어버렸거든요.

w|sial.text: Nasib sial menimpa tim itu ketika listrik padam tepat saat demo.
w|sial.en: Bad luck struck the team when the power went out right during the demo.
w|sial.ko: 시연하는 바로 그때 정전이 나서 팀에 불운이 닥쳤어요.

w|sianida.text: Kata Fajar, biji apel mengandung zat yang bisa berubah menjadi sianida.
w|sianida.en: According to Fajar, apple seeds contain a substance that can turn into cyanide.
w|sianida.ko: 파자르 말로는 사과 씨에 시안화물로 변할 수 있는 성분이 있대요.

w|sianida.text: Lestari dan rekan baru membahas novel detektif tentang racun sianida.
w|sianida.en: Lestari and the new coworker talked about a detective novel involving cyanide poison.
w|sianida.ko: 레스타리와 새 동료는 청산가리 독이 나오는 추리 소설 이야기를 나눴어요.

w|siaran.text: Siaran langsung pertandingan dimulai malam ini.
w|siaran.en: The live broadcast of the match starts tonight.
The radio played the morning news broadcast.

w|siasat.text: Rudi menyusun siasat untuk menangkap penipu daring.
w|siasat.en: Rudi worked out a plan to catch an online scammer.
w|siasat.ko: 루디는 온라인 사기꾼을 잡을 작전을 짰어요.

w|siasat.text: Rina punya siasat untuk memberi obat kepada kucing yang rewel, yaitu menyembunyikan pil di dalam ikan.
w|siasat.en: Rina has a trick for giving medicine to a fussy cat: hiding the pill inside fish.
w|siasat.ko: 리나는 까다로운 고양이에게 약을 먹이는 요령이 있는데, 알약을 생선 속에 숨기는 거예요.

w|sidang.en: The court hearing started this morning.

w|sidang.text: Mereka menghadiri sidang paripurna di gedung.
w|sidang.en: They attended the plenary session in the building.

w|sifat.text: Sifatnya yang baik membuat semua orang senang.
w|sifat.en: His kind nature makes everyone happy.
w|sifat.ko: 그의 좋은 성격이 모두를 기쁘게 해.

w|sifat.text: Dia punya sifat yang tenang dan sabar.
w|sifat.en: He has a calm and patient nature.
w|sifat.ko: 그는 차분하고 참을성 있는 성격을 가졌어.

w|signifikan.text: Budi melihat perubahan signifikan pada tulisan tangan Andi.
w|signifikan.en: Budi sees a significant change in Andi's handwriting.
w|signifikan.ko: 부디는 안디의 손글씨에서 큰 변화를 봐요.

w|signifikan.text: Catatan waktu Siti membaik secara signifikan setelah latihan rutin.
w|signifikan.en: Siti's time improved significantly after regular training.
w|signifikan.ko: 꾸준히 훈련한 뒤 시티의 기록이 크게 좋아졌어요.

w|sihir.en: That's not magic, just a trick.

w|sikap.text: Sikap dia berubah setelah mendapat kritik.
w|sikap.en: His attitude changed after getting criticism.
Watch your manners when meeting guests.

w|sikat.text: Andi memakai sikat kawat untuk mengikis cat lama di pagar.
w|sikat.en: Andi uses a wire brush to scrape the old paint off the fence.
w|sikat.ko: 안디는 철사 솔로 울타리의 오래된 페인트를 긁어내요.

w|sikat.text: Dewi lupa membawa sikat gigi untuk perjalanan semalam.
w|sikat.en: Dewi forgot to bring a toothbrush for the overnight trip.
w|sikat.ko: 데위는 하룻밤 여행에 칫솔 챙기는 걸 깜빡했어요.

w|siklus.text: Pemandu bercerita tentang siklus air: hujan turun, mengalir ke sungai, lalu menguap lagi.
w|siklus.en: The guide talked about the water cycle: rain falls, flows into rivers, then evaporates again.
w|siklus.ko: 가이드는 물의 순환에 대해 이야기했어요. 비가 내리고, 강으로 흐르고, 다시 증발한다고요.

w|siklus.text: Rina bercanda bahwa hidupnya mengikuti siklus menabung, beli tiket konser, lalu bokek lagi.
w|siklus.en: Rina jokes that her life follows a cycle of saving, buying concert tickets, then going broke again.
w|siklus.ko: 리나는 자기 삶이 저축하고, 공연 표 사고, 다시 빈털터리가 되는 순환이라고 농담해요.

w|siksaan.text: Drama sejarah itu menggambarkan siksaan yang dialami para tahanan zaman penjajahan.
w|siksaan.en: The historical drama depicts the torment prisoners suffered in colonial times.
w|siksaan.ko: 그 역사극은 식민지 시대 수감자들이 겪은 고통을 그려요.

w|siksaan.text: Bagi Ayu, mendaki jalan curam setiap hari bukan siksaan, melainkan olahraga.
w|siksaan.en: For Ayu, climbing the steep road every day isn't torture but exercise.
w|siksaan.ko: 아유에게 매일 가파른 길을 오르는 건 고문이 아니라 운동이에요.

w|siku.text: Dimas memberikan salep untuk siku yang memar.
w|siku.en: Dimas gave out an ointment for a bruised elbow.
w|siku.ko: 디마스는 멍든 팔꿈치에 바를 연고를 줬어요.

w|siku.text: Putri menggosok lantai kayu sampai siku lecet.
w|siku.en: Putri scrubbed the wooden floor until her elbow got scraped.
w|siku.ko: 푸트리는 팔꿈치가 까질 때까지 나무 바닥을 문질렀어요.

w|silang.text: Fajar selalu melakukan pemeriksaan silang pada setiap angka sebelum artikel terbit.
w|silang.en: Fajar always cross-checks every figure before an article is published.
w|silang.ko: 파자르는 기사가 나가기 전에 늘 모든 숫자를 교차 확인해요.

w|silang.text: Lestari bingung karena ada tanda silang merah di peta lama miliknya.
w|silang.en: Lestari was confused because there was a red cross mark on her old map.
w|silang.ko: 레스타리는 옛 지도에 빨간 X 표시가 있어서 어리둥절했어요.

w|siluman.en: Stories of spirits made the children afraid.

w|siluman.text: Siluman itu muncul dalam mimpi buruknya.
w|siluman.en: That spirit appeared in his nightmare.

w|simbol.en: The rose became a symbol of love.

w|simpanan.text: Bayu membeli sepeda tua itu dengan uang simpanan dari hasil kerja sampingan.
w|simpanan.en: Bayu bought the old bicycle with money he'd saved from a side job.
w|simpanan.ko: 바유는 부업으로 모은 돈으로 그 낡은 자전거를 샀어요.

w|simpanan.text: Ayah Intan memakai simpanan masa pensiunnya untuk menambah biaya pesta.
w|simpanan.en: Intan's father used his retirement savings to add to the party budget.
w|simpanan.ko: 인탄의 아버지는 노후 대비 저금을 헐어 잔치 비용에 보탰어요.

w|simpul.text: Kata Bayu, terminal bus itu menjadi simpul penting bagi pedagang dari desa-desa sekitar.
w|simpul.en: According to Bayu, the bus terminal has become an important hub for traders from nearby villages.
w|simpul.ko: 바유 말로는 그 버스 터미널이 주변 마을 상인들에게 중요한 연결점이 됐대요.

w|simpul.text: Intan butuh gunting karena paket itu diikat dengan simpul yang sangat kencang.
w|simpul.en: Intan needed scissors because the package was tied with a very tight knot.
w|simpul.ko: 택배가 아주 단단한 매듭으로 묶여 있어서 인탄은 가위가 필요했어요.

w|simulasi.text: Sebelum gedung dibangun, tim teknik menjalankan simulasi gempa di komputer.
w|simulasi.en: Before the building went up, the engineering team ran an earthquake simulation on the computer.
w|simulasi.ko: 건물을 짓기 전에 기술 팀은 컴퓨터로 지진 시뮬레이션을 돌렸어요.

w|simulasi.text: Sebelum membeli kacamata, Wati mencoba simulasi bingkai di wajahnya lewat kamera.
w|simulasi.en: Before buying glasses, Wati tried a frame simulation on her face using the camera.
w|simulasi.ko: 안경을 사기 전에 와티는 카메라로 얼굴에 테를 씌워 보는 시뮬레이션을 해 봤어요.

w|sinar.en: Sunlight comes in through the window.

w|sinar.text: Dia menutup mata dari sinar lampu.
w|sinar.en: She closed her eyes from the lamp light.

w|sindikat.text: Lakon detektif itu mengikuti polisi yang membongkar sindikat pencuri lukisan.
w|sindikat.en: The detective play follows a police officer who breaks up a painting theft syndicate.
w|sindikat.ko: 그 탐정 연극은 그림 도둑 조직을 소탕하는 경찰을 따라가요.

w|sindikat.text: Polisi kereta api berhasil menangkap anggota sindikat pencopet di gerbong ekonomi.
w|sindikat.en: The railway police managed to catch members of a pickpocket syndicate in the economy carriage.
w|sindikat.ko: 철도 경찰이 일반실에서 소매치기 조직원들을 붙잡았어요.

w|sindiran.text: Kartun di halaman opini itu berisi sindiran halus tentang jalan berlubang.
w|sindiran.en: The cartoon on the opinion page contains subtle satire about potholed roads.
w|sindiran.ko: 의견면 만화에는 구멍 난 도로를 슬쩍 꼬집는 풍자가 담겨 있어요.

w|sindiran.text: Ulasan Intan berisi sindiran tentang foto produk yang terlalu banyak diedit.
w|sindiran.en: Intan's review contained a jab at product photos that were edited too much.
w|sindiran.ko: 인탄의 후기에는 너무 보정한 상품 사진을 꼬집는 말이 들어 있었어요.

w|sindrom.text: Dimas membaca jurnal tentang sindrom kelelahan kronis.
w|sindrom.en: Dimas read a journal article about chronic fatigue syndrome.
w|sindrom.ko: 디마스는 만성 피로 증후군에 관한 학술지를 읽었어요.

w|sindrom.text: Putri bilang dia terkena sindrom "sekalian saja" setiap kali memperbaiki sesuatu.
w|sindrom.en: Putri says she gets "might as well" syndrome every time she fixes something.
w|sindrom.ko: 푸트리는 뭘 고칠 때마다 '하는 김에' 증후군이 생긴다고 해요.

w|singa.text: Singa itu berjalan perlahan di padang rumput.
w|singa.en: That lion walked slowly across the grassland.

w|singa.text: Anak-anak melihat singa di kebun binatang.
w|singa.en: The children saw a lion at the zoo.

w|singgah.text: Dimas berencana singgah sehari di Yogyakarta sebelum lanjut ke timur.
w|singgah.en: Dimas plans to stop over for a day in Yogyakarta before continuing east.
w|singgah.ko: 디마스는 동쪽으로 가기 전에 족자카르타에서 하루 들를 계획이에요.

w|singgah.text: Sebelum ke kantor, Putri biasa singgah di warung kopi dekat rumahnya.
w|singgah.en: On her way to the office, Putri usually stops by the coffee stall near her house.
w|singgah.ko: 출근길에 푸트리는 보통 집 근처 커피 가게에 들러요.

w|singgasana.text: Rudi bercanda bahwa kursi komandan yang besar itu seperti singgasana.
w|singgasana.en: Rudi joked that the commander's big chair looked like a throne.
w|singgasana.ko: 루디는 지휘관의 큰 의자가 왕좌 같다고 농담했어요.

w|singgasana.text: Kucing Persia itu duduk di keranjang seperti di atas singgasana, membuat Rina tersenyum.
w|singgasana.en: The Persian cat sat in its basket as if on a throne, making Rina smile.
w|singgasana.ko: 페르시안 고양이가 왕좌에 앉은 듯 바구니에 앉아 있어서 리나는 미소 지었어요.

w|singkat.en: His speech was brief but very clear.
Please just give a brief answer.

w|singkatan.text: Budi lupa apa singkatan dari OSIS saat ditanya guru.
w|singkatan.en: Budi forgot what OSIS stands for when the teacher asked him.
w|singkatan.ko: 선생님이 묻자 버디는 OSIS가 무엇의 약자인지 잊어버렸어요.

w|singkatan.text: Siti tidak tahu bahwa BMKG adalah singkatan dari badan cuaca nasional.
w|singkatan.en: Siti didn't know that BMKG is the abbreviation for the national weather agency.

w|spesies.text: Kebun Bu Sri punya puluhan spesies anggrek.

w|spesies.ko: 스리 아주머니네 정원에는 난초가 수십 종 있어요.

w|spesifik.text: Redaktur meminta Eko menulis judul yang lebih spesifik untuk berita banjir.
w|spesifik.en: The editor asked Eko to write a more specific headline for the flood story.
w|spesifik.ko: 편집장이 에코에게 홍수 기사 제목을 더 구체적으로 써 달라고 했어요.

w|spesifik.text: Ayu bertanya tentang kerusakan yang lebih spesifik sebelum memberi harga.
w|spesifik.en: Ayu asks about the problem more specifically before giving a price.
w|spesifik.ko: 아유는 견적을 내기 전에 고장 증상을 더 구체적으로 물어봐요.

w|spesifikasi.text: Rudi membaca spesifikasi oven baru sebelum memasangnya.
w|spesifikasi.en: Rudi read the specifications of the new oven before installing it.
w|spesifikasi.ko: 루디는 새 오븐을 설치하기 전에 사양을 읽었어요.

w|spesifikasi.text: Rina mencatat spesifikasi kamera tua itu sebelum menawarkan harga.
w|spesifikasi.en: Rina noted down the old camera's specs before offering a price.
w|spesifikasi.ko: 리나는 값을 부르기 전에 그 옛날 카메라의 사양을 적어 뒀어요.

w|spesimen.text: Petugas dinas kesehatan mengambil spesimen makanan dari dapur Rudi untuk diuji.
w|spesimen.en: Health officers took food samples from Rudi's kitchen for testing.
w|spesimen.ko: 보건소 직원들이 검사하려고 루디의 주방에서 음식 샘플을 가져갔어요.

w|spesimen.text: Rina menemukan kotak kaca berisi spesimen kupu-kupu yang diawetkan.
w|spesimen.en: Rina found a glass box containing preserved butterfly specimens.
w|spesimen.ko: 리나는 나비 표본이 든 유리 상자를 발견했어요.

w|spontan.text: Dimas spontan tertawa saat atasannya melucu di tengah rapat.
w|spontan.en: Dimas laughed spontaneously when his boss cracked a joke in the middle of the meeting.
w|spontan.ko: 상사가 회의 중에 농담을 하자 디마스는 저도 모르게 웃었어요.

w|spontan.text: Perjalanan Putri kali ini sangat spontan karena tiketnya baru dibeli tadi malam.
w|spontan.en: Putri's trip this time was very spontaneous, since she only bought the ticket last night.
w|spontan.ko: 이번 푸트리의 여행은 표를 어젯밤에야 사서 아주 즉흥적이었어요.

w|stabil.en: The patient's condition is already quite stable.

w|stabil.text: Meja itu harus tetap stabil saat dipakai.
w|stabil.en: That table must stay stable when used.
w|stabil.ko: 그 탁자는 쓸 때 흔들리지 않아야 해.

w|stabilitas.text: Fajar percaya stabilitas harga pangan penting bagi ketenangan warga.
w|stabilitas.en: Fajar believes stable food prices are important for residents' peace of mind.
w|stabilitas.ko: 파자르는 식료품 가격 안정이 주민들의 안심에 중요하다고 믿어요.

w|stabilitas.text: Lestari memilih apartemen ini karena stabilitas sinyal internet di sini bagus.
w|stabilitas.en: Lestari chose this apartment because the internet signal here is stable.
w|stabilitas.ko: 레스타리는 여기 인터넷 신호가 안정적이라서 이 아파트를 골랐어요.

w|stadion.text: Eko dan teman sekelasnya menonton final sepak bola pelajar di stadion kota.
w|stadion.en: Eko and his classmates watched the student football final at the city stadium.
w|stadion.ko: 에코와 반 친구들은 시 경기장에서 학생 축구 결승전을 봤어요.

w|stadion.text: Karya Ayu ikut dipamerkan di lorong stadion saat pekan olahraga daerah.
w|stadion.en: Ayu's work was also displayed in the stadium corridor during the regional sports week.
w|stadion.ko: 지역 체육 주간 동안 아유의 작품도 경기장 복도에 전시됐어요.

w|staf.text: Staf hotel menyambut tamu dengan ramah.
w|staf.en: The hotel staff welcomed guests warmly.

w|staf.text: Manajer memberi arahan kepada staf baru.
w|staf.en: The manager gave instructions to the new staff.

w|standar.text: Standar kualitas produk ini sangat tinggi.
w|standar.en: The quality standard of this product is very high.
w|standar.ko: 이 제품의 품질 기준이 아주 높아.

w|stasiun.en: The train station is already crowded.

w|stasiun.text: Kami menunggu di stasiun selama lama.
w|stasiun.en: We waited at the station for a long time.

w|statis.text: Menurut Agus, kehidupan di desa tidak statis karena selalu ada yang berubah setiap musim.
w|statis.en: According to Agus, village life isn't static because something always changes each season.
w|statis.ko: 아구스 말로는 계절마다 늘 뭔가 바뀌어서 마을 생활이 정체돼 있지 않대요.

w|statis.text: Wati mengaku hidup terasa statis sejak dia pensiun.
w|statis.en: Wati admitted that life has felt static since she retired.
w|statis.ko: 와티는 은퇴한 뒤로 삶이 정체된 느낌이라고 털어놓았어요.

w|statistik.text: Fajar menemukan bahwa data statistik dari kantor pemerintah belum diperbarui.
w|statistik.en: Fajar found that the statistical data from the government office hadn't been updated.
w|statistik.ko: 파자르는 정부 기관의 통계 자료가 아직 갱신되지 않았다는 걸 알게 됐어요.

w|statistik.text: Lestari membaca bahwa menurut statistik, jalur pantai paling ramai saat musim mudik.
w|statistik.en: Lestari read that, according to statistics, the coastal route is busiest during the holiday exodus.
w|statistik.ko: 레스타리는 통계상 해안 도로가 귀성철에 가장 붐빈다는 글을 읽었어요.

w|status.en: The delivery status has been updated.

w|status.text: Dia mengubah status hubungan di akunnya.
w|status.en: She changed her relationship status on her account.

w|stempel.text: Kata Andi, surat izin itu belum sah karena belum ada stempel dari kantor kecamatan.
w|stempel.en: According to Andi, the permit isn't valid yet because it doesn't have the district office's stamp.
w|stempel.ko: 안디 말로는 그 허가서에 아직 구청 도장이 없어서 효력이 없대요.

w|stempel.text: Dewi masih menyimpan rapor lama dengan stempel sekolah yang sudah pudar.
w|stempel.en: Dewi still keeps her old report card with the faded school stamp.
w|stempel.ko: 데위는 학교 도장이 바랜 옛 성적표를 아직 갖고 있어요.

w|stik.text: Andi melihat stik hoki tua dipajang di ruang koleksi olahraga perpustakaan.
w|stik.en: Andi saw an old hockey stick displayed in the library's sports collection room.
w|stik.ko: 안디는 도서관 스포츠 소장실에 전시된 낡은 하키 스틱을 봤어요.

w|stik.text: Dewi menemukan stik drum lama milik suaminya di kolong tempat tidur.
w|stik.en: Dewi found her husband's old drumsticks under the bed.
w|stik.ko: 데위는 침대 밑에서 남편의 낡은 드럼 스틱을 찾았어요.

w|strategi.en: The new marketing strategy increased sales.

w|strategi.text: Pelatih menjelaskan strategi pertandingan kepada tim.
w|strategi.en: The coach explained the match strategy to the team.

w|strategis.text: Lahan Budi berada di tempat yang strategis, dekat jalan menuju pasar.
w|strategis.en: Budi's land is in a strategic spot, near the road to the market.
w|strategis.ko: 부디의 땅은 시장으로 가는 길 근처, 좋은 자리에 있어요.

w|strategis.text: Siti menaruh rak bumbu di posisi strategis dekat kompor.
w|strategis.en: Siti put the spice rack in a strategic spot near the stove.
w|strategis.ko: 시티는 양념 선반을 가스레인지 옆 딱 좋은 자리에 뒀어요.

w|stres.en: Work stress made it hard for him to focus.

w|stres.ko: 가벼운 운동이 스트레스 줄이는 데 도와.

w|stroberi.text: Tart stroberi buatan Agus selalu habis sebelum siang.
w|stroberi.en: Agus's strawberry tarts always sell out before noon.
w|stroberi.ko: 아구스가 만든 딸기 타르트는 늘 점심 전에 다 팔려요.

w|stroberi.text: Wati memilih gambar stroberi sebagai logo aplikasi diet buatan tim.
w|stroberi.en: Wati chose a strawberry as the logo for the team's diet app.
w|stroberi.ko: 와티는 팀이 만든 다이어트 앱 로고로 딸기 그림을 골랐어요.

w|struktur.text: Pemandu menjelaskan struktur kerangka paus yang digantung di aula.
w|struktur.en: The guide explained the structure of the whale skeleton hanging in the hall.
w|struktur.ko: 안내원이 홀에 매달린 고래 뼈대의 구조를 설명했어요.

w|struktur.text: Rina mengeluhkan struktur tenda yang goyah setiap ada angin kencang.
w|struktur.en: Rina complains about the tent's structure, which wobbles whenever there's a strong wind.
w|struktur.ko: 리나는 바람만 세게 불면 흔들리는 천막 구조가 불만이에요.

w|studi.text: Tetangga Bayu adalah mahasiswa yang sedang menyelesaikan studi di bidang hukum.
w|studi.en: Bayu's neighbor is a student finishing his studies in law.
w|studi.ko: 바유의 이웃은 법학 공부를 마무리하고 있는 대학생이에요.

w|studi.text: Intan sedang dalam perjalanan ke Yogyakarta untuk melanjutkan studi.
w|studi.en: Intan was on her way to Yogyakarta to continue her studies.
w|studi.ko: 인탄은 공부를 계속하려고 족자카르타로 가는 길이었어요.

w|studio.text: Mereka merekam lagu di studio kecil itu.
w|studio.en: They recorded the song in that small studio.
w|studio.ko: 그들은 그 작은 스튜디오에서 노래를 녹음했어.

w|studio.text: Studio foto itu buka sampai malam.
w|studio.en: That photo studio is open until night.

w|suaka.text: Satu ruangan bercerita tentang para pengungsi yang mencari suaka di negeri seberang.
w|suaka.en: One room tells the story of refugees who sought asylum in a land across the sea.
w|suaka.ko: 한 전시실은 바다 건너 나라에서 망명을 구한 난민들의 이야기를 들려줘요.

w|suaka.text: Toko buku di lantai empat menjadi suaka kecil bagi Putri saat istirahat.
w|suaka.en: The bookshop on the fourth floor is a little refuge for Putri during her break.
w|suaka.ko: 4층 서점은 쉬는 시간 푸트리의 작은 피난처예요.

w|suami.en: She's waiting for her husband out front.

w|suar.text: Dari tebing, Bayu melihat menara suar berdiri di ujung tanjung.
w|suar.en: From the cliff, Bayu saw a lighthouse standing at the tip of the cape.
w|suar.ko: 절벽에서 바유는 곶 끝에 서 있는 등대를 봤어요.

w|suar.text: Untuk tugas melukis laut, Intan menambahkan cahaya suar di kejauhan.
w|suar.en: For the seascape assignment, Intan added a beacon light in the distance.
w|suar.ko: 바다 그리기 과제에서 인탄은 멀리 등댓불을 그려 넣었어요.

w|suasana.text: Suasana kafe itu tenang dan hangat.
w|suasana.en: The cafe's atmosphere is calm and warm.
They enjoy the beach atmosphere at night.

w|subjek.text: Dalam email itu, Agus menulis "Undangan rapat" di kolom subjek.
w|subjek.en: In the email, Agus wrote "Meeting invitation" in the subject field.
w|subjek.ko: 그 이메일에서 아구스는 제목 칸에 '회의 초대'라고 썼어요.

w|subjek.text: Dalam pelajaran bahasa, Wati belajar menemukan subjek kalimat pada lirik lagu.
w|subjek.en: In language class, Wati learned to find the subject of the sentence in song lyrics.
w|subjek.ko: 언어 수업에서 와티는 노래 가사에서 문장의 주어를 찾는 법을 배웠어요.

w|subuh.text: Saat musim kemarau, udara waktu subuh terasa sangat sejuk bagi Dimas.
w|subuh.en: In the dry season, the air at dawn feels very cool to Dimas.
w|subuh.ko: 건기에는 새벽 공기가 디마스에게 아주 시원하게 느껴져요.

w|subuh.text: Tukang bangunan sudah mulai bekerja di rumah Putri sejak subuh.
w|subuh.en: The builders had started working at Putri's house since dawn.
w|subuh.ko: 인부들은 새벽부터 푸트리네 집에서 일을 시작했어요.

w|subur.text: Ladang Budi tetap subur berkat pupuk kandang dari sapinya.
w|subur.en: Budi's field stays fertile thanks to manure from his cows.
w|subur.ko: 부디의 밭은 소똥 거름 덕분에 계속 비옥해요.

w|subur.text: Sayuran di dapur Siti datang dari petani di lembah yang subur.
w|subur.en: The vegetables in Siti's kitchen come from farmers in a fertile valley.
w|subur.ko: 시티의 주방 채소는 비옥한 골짜기의 농부들에게서 와요.

w|suci.text: Tempat suci itu dijaga dengan ketat.
w|suci.en: That sacred place is strictly guarded.

w|suci.text: Suci sekali niat di balik tindakannya.
w|suci.en: The intention behind his action is so pure.
w|suci.ko: 그 행동 뒤의 의도가 정말 순수해.

w|sudi.text: Budi berharap Rudi masih sudi memaafkan kesalahan lama.
w|sudi.en: Budi hopes Rudi is still willing to forgive an old mistake.
w|sudi.ko: 부디는 루디가 옛 잘못을 아직 용서해 줄 마음이 있기를 바라요.

w|sudi.text: Pak Darto tidak sudi meminjamkan tangga lagi setelah tangga itu rusak.
w|sudi.en: Mr. Darto refuses to lend his ladder again after it got broken.
w|sudi.ko: 다르토 아저씨는 사다리가 망가진 뒤로 다시는 빌려주려 하지 않아요.

w|sudut.text: Sudut ruangan itu gelap dan berdebu.
w|sudut.en: That corner of the room is dark and dusty.

w|sudut.text: Dia duduk di sudut kafe yang tenang.
w|sudut.en: She sat in a quiet corner of the cafe.

w|suhu.text: Suhu di luar sangat tinggi hari ini.
w|suhu.en: The temperature outside is very high today.
The nurse checked the patient's body temperature.

w|sukacita.text: Surat Andi penuh sukacita tentang pernikahannya.
w|sukacita.en: Andi's letter is full of joy about his marriage.
w|sukacita.ko: 안디의 편지는 결혼 이야기로 기쁨이 가득해요.

w|sukacita.text: Wajah para pelari yang baru menyelesaikan maraton pertama memancarkan sukacita.
w|sukacita.en: The faces of runners who had just finished their first marathon radiated joy.
w|sukacita.ko: 첫 마라톤을 막 마친 주자들 얼굴에서 기쁨이 빛났어요.

w|sukar.text: Menurut Andi, membuat adonan kue sus termasuk teknik yang paling sukar.
w|sukar.en: According to Andi, making choux pastry is one of the hardest techniques.
w|sukar.ko: 안디에 따르면 슈 반죽 만들기는 가장 어려운 기술 중 하나예요.

w|sukar.text: Dewi mengaku sukar menemukan teman sedekat Rani di kota baru.
w|sukar.en: Dewi admitted it's hard to find a friend as close as Rani in the new city.
w|sukar.ko: 데위는 새 도시에서 라니만큼 가까운 친구를 찾기 어렵다고 털어놨어요.

w|sukarela.text: Rudi ikut membersihkan kelas secara sukarela setiap Jumat.
w|sukarela.en: Rudi voluntarily helps clean the classroom every Friday.
w|sukarela.ko: 루디는 매주 금요일 자진해서 교실 청소를 도와요.

w|sukarela.text: Pemuda kampung datang secara sukarela untuk membantu Rina menurunkan lemari.
w|sukarela.en: Young men from the neighborhood came voluntarily to help Rina unload the wardrobe.
w|sukarela.ko: 동네 청년들이 자진해서 리나가 옷장 내리는 걸 도와주러 왔어요.

w|sukarelawan.text: Para sukarelawan dari karang taruna membantu menata kursi tamu.
w|sukarelawan.en: Volunteers from the youth group helped arrange the guests' chairs.
w|sukarelawan.ko: 청년회 자원봉사자들이 손님 의자를 정리하는 걸 도왔어요.

w|sukarelawan.text: Rina menulis tentang sukarelawan yang mengajar anak jalanan membaca.
w|sukarelawan.en: Rina wrote about volunteers who teach street children to read.
w|sukarelawan.ko: 리나는 거리 아이들에게 읽기를 가르치는 자원봉사자들에 대해 썼어요.

w|sukses.en: The project's success made the team proud.
w|sukses.ko: 그 프로젝트의 성공이 팀을 뿌듯하게 했어.

w|suku.text: Mereka berasal dari suku yang berbeda.

w|sulap.text: Terdakwa adalah pemain sulap yang dituduh menipu penontonnya.
w|sulap.en: The defendant is a magician accused of cheating his audience.
w|sulap.ko: 피고인은 관객을 속였다는 혐의를 받는 마술사예요.

w|sulap.text: Anak-anak suka membeli mainan sulap murah di warung Lestari.
w|sulap.en: Children like buying cheap magic-trick toys at Lestari's shop.
w|sulap.ko: 아이들은 레스타리 가게에서 싸구려 마술 장난감을 즐겨 사요.

w|sulit.en: It's hard for me to sleep.

w|sulung.text: Anak sulung tetangga Andi baru saja diterima di universitas.
w|sulung.en: The eldest child of Andi's neighbor has just been accepted to university.
w|sulung.ko: 안디 이웃의 맏이가 막 대학에 합격했어요.

w|sulung.text: Dewi adalah anak sulung yang selalu mengajak adik-adiknya ke museum.
w|sulung.en: Dewi is the eldest child and always takes her younger siblings to museums.
w|sulung.ko: 데위는 늘 동생들을 데리고 박물관에 가는 맏이예요.

w|sumbangan.text: Koran itu membuka dompet sumbangan untuk korban banjir.
w|sumbangan.en: The newspaper opened a donation fund for flood victims.
w|sumbangan.ko: 그 신문사는 홍수 피해자를 위한 성금 모금을 시작했어요.

w|sumbangan.text: Aplikasi buatan Intan membantu warga menyalurkan sumbangan ke masjid dan sekolah terdekat.
w|sumbangan.en: Intan's app helps residents channel donations to nearby mosques and schools.
w|sumbangan.ko: 인탄이 만든 앱은 주민들이 가까운 모스크와 학교에 기부금을 보내도록 도와요.

w|sumber.en: The source of the problem is here.

w|sumber.text: Sungai ini menjadi sumber air desa.
w|sumber.en: This river is the village's water source.

w|sumpah.text: Dia mengucapkan sumpah di depan hakim.
w|sumpah.en: He took an oath before the judge.
That oath must not be broken.

w|sumur.text: Rumah Nenek di desa masih punya sumur tempat Budi dan Rina dulu bermain.
w|sumur.en: Grandma's house in the village still has the well where Budi and Rina used to play.
w|sumur.ko: 시골 할머니 댁에는 부디와 리나가 어릴 때 놀던 우물이 아직 있어요.

w|sumur.text: Siti bertanya kepada tukang tentang kedalaman sumur di belakang rumah.
w|sumur.en: Siti asked the handyman about the depth of the well behind the house.
w|sumur.ko: 시티는 일꾼에게 집 뒤 우물의 깊이를 물어봤어요.

w|sungguh-sungguh.text: Dia belajar sungguh-sungguh untuk ujian akhir.
w|sungguh-sungguh.en: He studied seriously for the final exam.
Just be serious if you want to succeed.

w|sungguhan.en: Did he really say he wants to join?
This is a real problem, not a joke.

w|sungkan.text: Dimas masih sungkan bertanya kepada atasannya soal jam istirahat.
w|sungkan.en: Dimas still felt too shy to ask his boss about break times.
w|sungkan.ko: 디마스는 아직 상사에게 쉬는 시간을 묻기가 어색했어요.

w|sungkan.text: Putri sungkan membangunkan penumpang di sebelahnya untuk pergi ke toilet.
w|sungkan.en: Putri felt awkward waking the passenger next to her to go to the toilet.
w|sungkan.ko: 푸트리는 화장실에 가려고 옆 승객을 깨우기가 미안했어요.

w|suntikan.text: Anak anjing itu menangis waktu mendapat suntikan pertamanya.
w|suntikan.en: The puppy cried when it got its first injection.
w|suntikan.ko: 그 강아지는 첫 주사를 맞을 때 낑낑거렸어요.

w|suntikan.text: Peneliti memberikan suntikan protein kepada tikus kelompok kedua.
w|suntikan.en: The researchers gave the second group of mice a protein injection.
w|suntikan.ko: 연구자들은 두 번째 쥐 무리에게 단백질 주사를 놓았어요.

w|sunyi.text: Setelah semua tamu pulang, gedung pernikahan itu terasa sunyi.
w|sunyi.en: After all the guests went home, the wedding hall felt silent.
w|sunyi.ko: 손님들이 모두 돌아가자 결혼식장은 고요하게 느껴졌어요.

w|sunyi.text: Pada hari libur, ruang redaksi yang biasanya ramai jadi sunyi.
w|sunyi.en: On holidays, the usually busy newsroom becomes silent.

w|sup.text: Sup ayam hangat rasanya sangat enak.
w|sup.en: Warm chicken soup tastes really good.
w|sup.ko: 따뜻한 치킨 수프 맛이 정말 좋아.

w|sup.text: Ibu memasak sup sayuran untuk makan malam.
w|sup.en: Mom cooked vegetable soup for dinner.

w|supaya.text: Datang lebih awal supaya tidak terlambat.
w|supaya.en: Come earlier so you won't be late.
Close the door so it's not noisy.

w|supranatural.text: Bayu menolak menulis cerita supranatural tanpa bukti, meski pembacanya suka.
w|supranatural.en: Bayu refuses to write supernatural stories without evidence, even though readers like them.
w|supranatural.ko: 독자들이 좋아해도 바유는 증거 없는 초자연 이야기는 쓰지 않아요.

w|supranatural.text: Penduduk desa Intan percaya puncak gunung punya kekuatan supranatural.
w|supranatural.en: The people of Intan's village believe the mountain peak has supernatural power.
w|supranatural.ko: 인탄네 마을 사람들은 산꼭대기에 초자연적인 힘이 있다고 믿어요.

w|suram.text: Wajah Rudi tampak suram sejak kakaknya tidak membalas pesan.
w|suram.en: Rudi's face has looked gloomy since his older sister stopped replying to his messages.
w|suram.ko: 누나가 메시지에 답을 안 한 뒤로 루디의 얼굴이 어두워 보여요.

w|suram.text: Langit sore di pantai berubah suram sebelum hujan turun.
w|suram.en: The evening sky at the beach turned gloomy before the rain came.
w|suram.ko: 비가 오기 전 해변의 저녁 하늘이 어둑해졌어요.

w|surat.en: That letter hasn't been opened yet.

w|surel.text: Eko mengirim surel kepada pemilik restoran tentang menu baru.
w|surel.en: Eko sent an email to the restaurant owner about the new menu.
w|surel.ko: 에코는 식당 주인에게 새 메뉴에 관한 이메일을 보냈어요.

w|surel.text: Ayu menerima surel dari kampus tentang libur karena banjir.
w|surel.en: Ayu received an email from campus about classes being canceled because of flooding.
w|surel.ko: 아유는 홍수로 휴강한다는 학교 이메일을 받았어요.

w|surga.text: Surga ada di bawah kaki ibu.
w|surga.en: Heaven lies at a mother's feet.

w|surgawi.text: Paduan suara sekolah Budi menyanyikan lagu dengan suara yang hampir surgawi.
w|surgawi.en: Budi's school choir sang with a voice that was almost heavenly.
w|surgawi.ko: 버디네 학교 합창단은 거의 천상의 목소리로 노래했어요.

w|surgawi.text: Siti bilang langit senja di akhir kemarau berwarna hampir surgawi.
w|surgawi.en: Siti said the evening sky at the end of the dry season was almost heavenly in color.
w|surgawi.ko: 시티는 건기 끝 무렵 저녁 하늘빛이 거의 천상의 색이라고 했어요.

w|surut.text: Setelah banjir surut, Budi memeriksa tanaman jagung di ladang.
w|surut.en: After the flood receded, Budi checked the corn plants in the field.
w|surut.ko: 홍수가 빠진 뒤 부디는 밭의 옥수수를 살펴봤어요.

w|surut.text: Setelah jam makan siang, pesanan mulai surut dan Siti bisa duduk sebentar.
w|surut.en: After lunchtime, the orders start to die down and Siti can sit for a moment.
w|surut.ko: 점심시간이 지나면 주문이 줄어들어서 시티는 잠깐 앉을 수 있어요.

w|survei.text: Eko membaca hasil survei pelanggan tentang rasa sambal.
w|survei.en: Eko read the results of the customer survey about the sambal's taste.
w|survei.ko: 에코는 삼발 맛에 관한 손님 설문 결과를 읽었어요.

w|survei.text: Ayu ikut survei tentang kebiasaan warga menghadapi musim hujan.
w|survei.en: Ayu took part in a survey about how residents deal with the rainy season.
w|survei.ko: 아유는 주민들이 우기를 어떻게 나는지에 관한 설문에 참여했어요.

w|surya.text: Penginapan Eko memakai panel surya untuk memanaskan air.
w|surya.en: Eko's guesthouse uses solar panels to heat water.
w|surya.ko: 에코가 묵는 숙소는 태양광 패널로 물을 데워요.

w|surya.text: Atap rumah Pak Hasan sekarang dipenuhi panel tenaga surya.
w|surya.en: Mr. Hasan's roof is now covered with solar power panels.
w|surya.ko: 하산 씨네 지붕은 이제 태양광 패널로 덮여 있어요.

w|susah.text: Hidup di kota besar memang susah.
w|susah.en: Living in a big city is indeed hard.

w|suster.text: Suster itu merawat pasien dengan sabar.
w|suster.en: That nurse cares for patients patiently.
w|suster.ko: 그 간호사가 환자를 참을성 있게 돌봐.

w|suster.text: Dia bertanya kepada suster soal obat.
w|suster.en: He asked the nurse about the medicine.

w|susu.text: Susu hangat membantu bayi tidur nyenyak.
w|susu.en: Warm milk helps the baby sleep soundly.
w|susu.ko: 따뜻한 우유가 아기가 푹 자게 도와줘.

w|susu.text: Aku minum susu setiap pagi sebelum sekolah.
w|susu.en: I drink milk every morning before school.
w|susu.ko: 나는 학교 가기 전 매일 아침 우유를 마셔.

w|susunan.text: Eko mengubah susunan rak agar bahan yang sering dipakai mudah dijangkau.
w|susunan.en: Eko rearranged the shelves so frequently used ingredients are easy to reach.
w|susunan.ko: 에코는 자주 쓰는 재료를 꺼내기 쉽게 선반 배치를 바꿨어요.

w|susunan.text: Ayu mengganti susunan baju di lemari ketika musim berganti.
w|susunan.en: Ayu rearranges the clothes in her wardrobe when the season changes.
w|susunan.ko: 아유는 계절이 바뀌면 옷장 속 옷 배치를 바꿔요.

w|sutra.text: Bayu membeli syal sutra untuk ibunya dengan harga yang sangat murah.
w|sutra.en: Bayu bought a silk scarf for his mother at a very low price.
w|sutra.ko: 바유는 엄마에게 줄 실크 스카프를 아주 싸게 샀어요.

w|sutra.text: Selendang sutra yang dipakai Intan adalah warisan dari neneknya.
w|sutra.en: The silk shawl Intan wore was an heirloom from her grandmother.
w|sutra.ko: 인탄이 두른 실크 숄은 할머니에게서 물려받은 거예요.

w|sutradara.text: Seorang sutradara sedang mengambil gambar film dokumenter di aula museum.
w|sutradara.en: A film director is shooting a documentary in the museum hall.
w|sutradara.ko: 한 영화감독이 박물관 홀에서 다큐멘터리를 찍고 있어요.

w|sutradara.text: Kata pedagang sebelah, ada sutradara yang mencari pasar tradisional untuk lokasi syuting.
w|sutradara.en: According to the trader next door, a director is looking for a traditional market as a filming location.
w|sutradara.ko: 옆 가게 상인 말로는 영화감독이 촬영지로 쓸 전통시장을 찾고 있대요.

w|swasta.text: Gedung yang dibangun Rudi nanti akan menjadi rumah sakit swasta.
w|swasta.en: The building Rudi is working on will become a private hospital.
w|swasta.ko: 루디가 짓고 있는 건물은 나중에 사립 병원이 될 거예요.

w|swasta.text: Sebelumnya Rina bekerja di bank swasta selama tiga tahun.
w|swasta.en: Before this, Rina worked at a private bank for three years.
w|swasta.ko: 리나는 그전에 민간 은행에서 삼 년 일했어요.

w|syal.text: Agus membeli syal batik untuk dipakai di kereta yang dingin.
w|syal.en: Agus bought a batik scarf to wear on the cold train.
w|syal.ko: 아구스는 추운 기차에서 두르려고 바틱 스카프를 샀어요.

w|syal.text: Angin malam makin dingin, jadi Wati melilitkan syal di lehernya.
w|syal.en: The night wind got colder, so Wati wrapped a scarf around her neck.
w|syal.ko: 밤바람이 차가워져서 와티는 목에 스카프를 둘렀어요.

w|syarat.text: Syarat masuk sudah dijelaskan di papan.
w|syarat.en: The entry requirements are already explained on the board.
w|syarat.ko: 입학 조건이 이미 게시판에 적혀 있어.

w|syarat.en: One more condition must be met.

w|syok.text: Budi syok membaca kabar bahwa sekolah lama akan dibongkar.
w|syok.en: Budi was shocked to read that their old school would be torn down.
w|syok.ko: 부디는 옛 학교가 철거된다는 소식을 읽고 충격을 받았어요.

w|syok.text: Siti syok melihat pohon besar roboh menimpa pagar tetangga.
w|syok.en: Siti was shocked to see a big tree fall onto the neighbor's fence.
w|syok.ko: 시티는 큰 나무가 이웃집 담장 위로 쓰러진 걸 보고 깜짝 놀랐어요.

w|syukurlah.en: Thankfully the weather is clear today.

w|syuting.text: Mereka mulai syuting drama baru minggu ini.
w|syuting.en: They start filming a new drama this week.
w|syuting.ko: 그들은 이번 주에 새 드라마 촬영을 시작해.

w|syuting.text: Syuting di luar ruangan tertunda karena hujan.
w|syuting.en: The outdoor shoot was delayed because of rain.

w|taat.text: Penumpang kereta itu cukup taat pada larangan merokok di gerbong.
w|taat.en: The passengers on that train are quite obedient to the no-smoking rule in the carriages.
w|taat.ko: 그 기차 승객들은 객차 내 금연 규칙을 꽤 잘 지켜요.

w|taat.text: Tim Putri sangat taat pada jadwal rilis aplikasi setiap dua minggu.
w|taat.en: Putri's team sticks closely to the app release schedule every two weeks.
w|taat.ko: 푸트리의 팀은 2주마다 앱을 출시하는 일정을 아주 잘 지켜요.

w|tabel.text: Fajar memasukkan angka penjualan bulan lalu ke dalam tabel.
w|tabel.en: Fajar entered last month's sales figures into the table.
w|tabel.ko: 파자르는 지난달 판매 수치를 표에 넣었어요.

w|tabel.text: Lestari membuat tabel perbandingan harga layanan cloud dari beberapa penyedia.
w|tabel.en: Lestari made a table comparing cloud service prices from several providers.
w|tabel.ko: 레스타리는 여러 업체의 클라우드 요금을 비교하는 표를 만들었어요.

w|tabir.text: Liputan investigasi Andi akhirnya membuka tabir korupsi di dinas itu.
w|tabir.en: Andi's investigative report finally lifted the veil on corruption in that agency.
w|tabir.ko: 안디의 탐사 보도가 마침내 그 관청의 비리를 세상에 드러냈어요.

w|tabir.text: Dewi memasang tabir bambu di teras agar tidak silau.
w|tabir.en: Dewi put up a bamboo screen on the porch to block the glare.
w|tabir.ko: 데위는 눈부시지 않게 테라스에 대나무 발을 달았어요.

w|tabung.text: Di gudang kantor polisi tersimpan tabung pemadam kebakaran yang baru diisi ulang.
w|tabung.en: A freshly refilled fire extinguisher is stored in the police station's storeroom.
w|tabung.ko: 경찰서 창고에는 막 다시 채운 소화기가 보관돼 있어요.

w|tabung.text: Dewi selalu membawa tabung minum besar ke setiap latihan.
w|tabung.en: Dewi always brings a big water bottle to every practice.
w|tabung.ko: 데위는 연습 때마다 큰 물통을 꼭 챙겨 와요.

w|tabungan.text: Bayu menyisihkan sebagian tabungan khusus untuk berburu barang antik.
w|tabungan.en: Bayu sets aside part of his savings just for hunting antiques.
w|tabungan.ko: 바유는 골동품 사냥용으로 저축 일부를 따로 떼어 둬요.

w|tabungan.text: Intan dan tunangannya mengumpulkan tabungan selama dua tahun untuk pesta itu.
w|tabungan.en: Intan and her fiancé saved up for two years for the party.
w|tabungan.ko: 인탄과 약혼자는 그 잔치를 위해 2년 동안 돈을 모았어요.

w|tagihan.text: Tagihan listrik datang setiap awal bulan.
w|tagihan.en: The electricity bill comes at the start of each month.
w|tagihan.ko: 전기 요금 청구서가 매달 초에 와.

w|tagihan.text: Dia lupa membayar tagihan air kemarin.
w|tagihan.en: He forgot to pay the water bill yesterday.
w|tagihan.ko: 그는 어제 수도 요금을 깜빡하고 안 냈어.

w|tahanan.text: Tahanan itu dipindahkan ke sel lain.
w|tahanan.en: That prisoner was moved to another cell.
The lawyer visited the prisoner this morning.

w|tahap.text: Proyek ini masih di tahap awal.
w|tahap.en: This project is still in an early stage.

w|tahap.text: Tahap berikutnya membutuhkan lebih banyak waktu.
w|tahap.en: The next stage needs more time.
w|tahap.ko: 다음 단계는 더 많은 시간이 필요해.

w|tahta.text: Balai kota dibangun di atas tanah bekas istana, tempat tahta sultan dulu berdiri.
w|tahta.en: City hall was built on the grounds of a former palace, where the sultan's throne once stood.
w|tahta.ko: 시청은 옛날 술탄의 왕좌가 있던 궁궐 터에 지어졌어요.

w|tahta.text: Opera yang dipelajari kelas vokal berkisah tentang perebutan tahta kerajaan.
w|tahta.en: The opera the vocal class is studying tells of a struggle for the royal throne.
w|tahta.ko: 성악반에서 배우는 오페라는 왕좌를 둘러싼 다툼 이야기예요.

w|tahu.en: Who knows, they might have forgotten.

w|tahunan.text: Setiap habis panen, desa Budi mengadakan pesta tahunan.
w|tahunan.en: After every harvest, Budi's village holds an annual festival.
w|tahunan.ko: 추수가 끝날 때마다 부디네 마을은 해마다 잔치를 열어요.

w|tahunan.text: Film itu akan diputar di festival film tahunan di Yogyakarta.
w|tahunan.en: The film will be screened at the annual film festival in Yogyakarta.
w|tahunan.ko: 그 영화는 족자카르타에서 열리는 연례 영화제에서 상영돼요.

w|tajam.text: Pisau itu sangat tajam dan berbahaya.
w|tajam.en: That knife is very sharp and dangerous.
His gaze is sharp when he focuses.

w|tak.en: You don't have to drop me off.

w|takhayul.text: Guru IPA Budi menjelaskan bahwa banyak takhayul tentang gerhana tidak punya dasar ilmiah.
w|takhayul.en: Budi's science teacher explained that many superstitions about eclipses have no scientific basis.
w|takhayul.ko: 버디의 과학 선생님은 일식에 관한 미신 대부분이 과학적 근거가 없다고 설명했어요.

w|takhayul.text: Nenek Siti percaya takhayul bahwa hujan di siang bolong pertanda ada hajatan.
w|takhayul.en: Siti's grandmother believes the superstition that rain on a sunny afternoon means someone is holding a celebration.
w|takhayul.ko: 시티의 할머니는 대낮에 오는 비가 잔치가 있다는 징조라는 미신을 믿어요.

w|takhta.text: Andi membaca kisah pangeran yang menolak naik takhta.
w|takhta.en: Andi read the story of a prince who refused to ascend the throne.
w|takhta.ko: 안디는 왕위에 오르기를 거부한 왕자 이야기를 읽었어요.

w|takhta.text: Pemilik perusahaan bercanda bahwa takhta direktur belum siap dia lepaskan.
w|takhta.en: The company owner joked that he isn't ready to give up the director's throne yet.
w|takhta.ko: 회사 주인은 아직 사장 자리를 내줄 생각이 없다고 농담했어요.

w|taksi.text: Taksi kuning berhenti di depan hotel.
w|taksi.en: A yellow taxi stopped in front of the hotel.
We took a taxi to the station.

w|taktik.text: Pelatih menjelaskan taktik baru di papan tulis sebelum pertandingan.
w|taktik.en: The coach explained a new tactic on the whiteboard before the match.
w|taktik.ko: 코치는 경기 전에 칠판에 새 전술을 설명했어요.

w|taktik.text: Dewi punya taktik sendiri untuk menenangkan anak yang takut disuntik.
w|taktik.en: Dewi has her own tactic for calming children who are afraid of injections.
w|taktik.ko: 데위는 주사를 무서워하는 아이를 달래는 자기만의 요령이 있어요.

w|taktis.text: Pak Budi memberi Dimas beberapa saran taktis untuk menghadapi klien yang cerewet.
w|taktis.en: Mr. Budi gave Dimas some tactical advice for dealing with fussy clients.
w|taktis.ko: 부디 씨는 까다로운 고객을 상대하는 요령을 디마스에게 몇 가지 알려 줬어요.

w|taktis.text: Putri mengambil langkah taktis dengan check-in daring supaya tidak perlu antre.
w|taktis.en: Putri made a tactical move by checking in online so she wouldn't have to queue.
w|taktis.ko: 푸트리는 줄을 서지 않으려고 온라인 체크인을 하는 요령을 부렸어요.

w|tali.en: Tie the package with a strong rope.

w|tali.text: Tali itu putus karena terlalu berat.
w|tali.en: That rope broke because it was too heavy.

w|taman.en: That park is full of colorful flowers.

w|taman.text: Kami berjalan santai di taman kota.
w|taman.en: We took a leisurely walk in the city park.

w|tamat.text: Film itu baru tamat semalam di bioskop.
w|tamat.en: That movie just finished showing at the cinema last night.
w|tamat.ko: 그 영화는 어젯밤 영화관에서 막 끝났어.

w|tamat.en: Finishing school made him feel relieved.

w|tambahan.en: There is an extra fee for delivery.

w|tambang.text: Tambang batu bara itu sudah tutup lama.
w|tambang.en: That coal mine has been closed for a long time.

w|tambang.text: Pekerja masuk ke tambang setiap pagi.
w|tambang.en: Workers enter the mine every morning.

w|tameng.text: Bayu melihat foto polisi yang memegang tameng saat mengamankan demonstrasi.
w|tameng.en: Bayu looked at a photo of police holding shields while securing a demonstration.
w|tameng.ko: 바유는 시위 현장을 지키며 방패를 든 경찰 사진을 봤어요.

w|tameng.text: Intan memesan pelindung layar sebagai tameng agar ponsel barunya tidak tergores.
w|tameng.en: Intan ordered a screen protector as a shield so her new phone wouldn't get scratched.
w|tameng.ko: 인탄은 새 휴대폰이 긁히지 않도록 방패 삼아 화면 보호 필름을 주문했어요.

w|tampak.en: You can see the sea from here.

w|tampang.text: Melihat tampang Budi yang lesu, Rina mulai ragu.
w|tampang.en: Seeing Budi's weary face, Rina began to have doubts.
w|tampang.ko: 부디의 축 처진 얼굴을 보고 리나는 의심이 들기 시작했어요.

w|tampang.text: Meski tampang sopir truk itu galak, ternyata dia ramah sekali.
w|tampang.en: Although the truck driver looked fierce, he turned out to be very friendly.
w|tampang.ko: 트럭 기사님은 인상이 험했지만 알고 보니 아주 친절했어요.

w|tamparan.text: Kekalahan tim kota di final terasa seperti tamparan bagi para penggemar, tulis Bayu.
w|tamparan.en: The city team's defeat in the final felt like a slap in the face for the fans, Bayu wrote.
w|tamparan.ko: 결승에서 시 팀이 진 건 팬들에게 뺨을 맞은 것 같았다고 바유가 썼어요.

w|tamparan.text: Angin dingin pagi itu terasa seperti tamparan di pipi Intan.
w|tamparan.en: The cold wind that morning felt like a slap on Intan's cheek.
w|tamparan.ko: 그날 아침 찬 바람이 인탄의 뺨을 때리는 것 같았어요.

w|tampil.text: Dia akan tampil di panggung malam ini.
w|tampil.en: She will appear on stage tonight.
w|tampil.ko: 그녀는 오늘 밤 무대에 설 거야.

w|tampilan.text: Situs berita itu baru saja mengganti tampilan halaman depannya.
w|tampilan.en: The news site has just changed the look of its front page.
w|tampilan.ko: 그 뉴스 사이트는 방금 첫 화면 모양을 바꿨어요.

w|tampilan.text: Pelanggan meminta Ayu mengubah tampilan menu ponselnya ke bahasa Jawa.
w|tampilan.en: A customer asked Ayu to change the phone's menu display to Javanese.
w|tampilan.ko: 손님이 아유에게 휴대폰 메뉴 화면을 자바어로 바꿔 달라고 했어요.

w|tamu.en: There's a guest at the front.

w|tanaman.text: Dia merawat tanaman di balkon setiap hari.
w|tanaman.en: She cares for the plants on the balcony every day.

w|tanaman.text: Tanaman baru tumbuh cepat setelah hujan.
w|tanaman.en: The new plants grow fast after rain.
w|tanaman.ko: 새 식물이 비 온 뒤 빨리 자라.

w|tanda.en: That's a sign that he's angry.

w|tanda.text: Tanda panah itu menunjuk ke kanan.
w|tanda.en: That arrow sign points to the right.

w|tanda tangan.text: Eko memberi tanda tangan pada nota pengiriman dari kurir ikan.
w|tanda tangan.en: Eko signed the delivery note from the fish courier.
w|tanda tangan.ko: 에코는 생선 배달 기사의 납품서에 서명했어요.

w|tanda tangan.text: Ayu mengumpulkan tanda tangan warga untuk meminta perbaikan saluran air sebelum musim hujan.
w|tanda tangan.en: Ayu collected residents' signatures to request drain repairs before the rainy season.
w|tanda tangan.ko: 아유는 우기 전에 배수로를 고쳐 달라고 주민 서명을 모았어요.

w|tandingan.text: Dalam urusan tata kota, Fajar belum punya tandingan di kantor itu.
w|tandingan.en: When it comes to urban planning, Fajar has no match in that office yet.
w|tandingan.ko: 도시 계획에서는 그 사무실에 아직 파자르를 따라올 사람이 없어요.

w|tandingan.text: Menurut Lestari, rendang buatan Bu Rina tidak ada tandingan di seluruh gedung.
w|tandingan.en: According to Lestari, Bu Rina's rendang is unrivaled in the whole building.
w|tandingan.ko: 레스타리 말로는 리나 씨가 만든 른당은 건물 전체에서 따라올 게 없어요.

w|tandu.text: Budi dan seorang rekan mengangkat pasien ke atas tandu.
w|tandu.en: Budi and a colleague lifted the patient onto the stretcher.
w|tandu.ko: 부디와 동료 한 명이 환자를 들것 위로 옮겼어요.

w|tandu.text: Siti melihat petugas medis membawa tandu ke gerbang kedatangan.
w|tandu.en: Siti saw medics carrying a stretcher to the arrivals gate.
w|tandu.ko: 시티는 구급대원들이 들것을 들고 입국장으로 가는 걸 봤어요.

w|tanduk.text: Penjual cendera mata menawari Eko hiasan dari tanduk kerbau.
w|tanduk.en: A souvenir seller offered Eko an ornament made from buffalo horn.
w|tanduk.ko: 기념품 상인이 에코에게 물소 뿔로 만든 장식품을 권했어요.

w|tanduk.text: Kambing milik tetangga punya tanduk yang melengkung.
w|tanduk.en: The neighbor's goat has curved horns.

w|tandus.text: Lereng sebelah timur gunung itu tandus karena jarang hujan.
w|tandus.en: The eastern slope of that mountain is barren because it rarely rains.
w|tandus.ko: 그 산의 동쪽 비탈은 비가 드물어서 메말랐어요.

w|tandus.text: Pabrik itu dibangun di atas tanah tandus yang dulu tidak bisa ditanami.
w|tandus.en: The factory was built on barren land that couldn't be farmed before.
w|tandus.ko: 그 공장은 예전에 농사를 지을 수 없던 메마른 땅 위에 지어졌어요.

w|tangga.en: That wooden staircase is already rotten.
Be careful when going down the stairs.

w|tanggapan.text: Andi menulis surat ke pengelola perpustakaan dan menunggu tanggapan mereka.
w|tanggapan.en: Andi wrote a letter to the library management and is waiting for their response.
w|tanggapan.ko: 안디는 도서관 운영진에게 편지를 쓰고 답을 기다리고 있어요.

w|tanggapan.text: Dewi menunggu tanggapan klien tentang desain brosur yang baru.
w|tanggapan.en: Dewi is waiting for the client's response to the new brochure design.
w|tanggapan.ko: 디위는 새 브로슈어 디자인에 대한 고객 반응을 기다리고 있어요.

w|tangguh.en: He is a very tough person.

w|tangguh.text: Tim ini tangguh di bawah tekanan.
w|tangguh.en: This team is tough under pressure.

w|tanggung.text: Siapa yang akan tanggung biaya ini?

w|tanggung.en: I don't want to bear the risk.

w|tangisan.text: Rudi mendengar tangisan pelan dari balik pintu kamar kakaknya.
w|tangisan.en: Rudi heard quiet crying from behind his sister's bedroom door.
w|tangisan.ko: 루디는 누나 방문 너머로 조용히 우는 소리를 들었어요.

w|tangisan.text: Rina menoleh karena mendengar tangisan seorang bocah yang kehilangan sandal.
w|tangisan.en: Rina turned around because she heard the crying of a little kid who'd lost a sandal.
w|tangisan.ko: 리나는 샌들을 잃어버린 꼬마의 울음소리를 듣고 돌아봤어요.

w|tangkapan.text: Dalam drama komedi itu, nelayan memamerkan tangkapan ikan yang ternyata palsu.
w|tangkapan.en: In the comedy, a fisherman shows off a catch of fish that turns out to be fake.
w|tangkapan.ko: 그 코미디에서 어부는 알고 보니 가짜인 물고기를 자랑해요.

w|tangkapan.text: Paman Ayu pulang dari danau membawa tangkapan ikan mas yang besar.
w|tangkapan.en: Ayu's uncle came back from the lake with a big catch of carp.
w|tangkapan.ko: 아유의 삼촌은 호수에서 큰 잉어를 잡아 돌아왔어요.

w|tangki.text: Di lab kimia ada tangki air kecil untuk mencuci alat.
w|tangki.en: In the chemistry lab there is a small water tank for washing equipment.
w|tangki.ko: 화학 실험실에는 기구를 씻는 작은 물탱크가 있어요.

w|tangki.text: Siti mengecek tangki air di atap sebelum menandatangani kontrak sewa.
w|tangki.en: Siti checked the water tank on the roof before signing the lease.
w|tangki.ko: 시티는 임대 계약서에 서명하기 전에 지붕 위 물탱크를 확인했어요.

w|tantangan.en: A new challenge made him braver.
w|tantangan.ko: 새로운 도전이 그를 더 용감하게 만들었어.

w|tantangan.en: We are facing a difficult challenge.

w|tapak.text: Andi meliput penemuan tapak bekas candi di tengah sawah.
w|tapak.en: Andi covered the discovery of the site of an old temple in the middle of a rice field.
w|tapak.ko: 안디는 논 한가운데서 옛 사원 터가 발견된 일을 취재했어요.

w|tapak.text: Dewi melihat tapak sepatu berlumpur di lantai rumah baru.
w|tapak.en: Dewi saw muddy shoe prints on the floor of the new house.
w|tapak.ko: 데위는 새 집 바닥에 찍힌 진흙 신발 자국을 봤어요.

w|tapi.en: I want to, but I'm scared.

w|target.en: This month's target has been reached.

w|tari.text: Halaman budaya minggu ini membahas sanggar tari di pinggir kota.
w|tari.en: This week's culture page covers a dance studio on the edge of the city.
w|tari.ko: 이번 주 문화면은 도시 변두리의 무용 연습소를 다뤘어요.

w|tari.text: Pelanggan itu penari yang ponselnya penuh video latihan tari jaipong.
w|tari.en: That customer is a dancer whose phone is full of jaipong dance practice videos.
w|tari.ko: 그 손님은 자이퐁 춤 연습 영상으로 휴대폰이 꽉 찬 무용수예요.

w|tarian.en: That traditional dance is very graceful.
They are learning a dance for the festival.

w|taring.text: Eko menemukan tengkorak babi hutan dengan taring yang masih utuh.
w|taring.en: Eko found a wild boar skull with its tusks still intact.
w|taring.ko: 에코는 송곳니가 그대로 남은 멧돼지 두개골을 발견했어요.

w|taring.text: Kostum harimau seorang pelari lengkap dengan taring plastik yang lucu.
w|taring.en: One runner's tiger costume came complete with funny plastic fangs.
w|taring.ko: 한 주자의 호랑이 의상에는 우스꽝스러운 플라스틱 송곳니까지 달려 있었어요.

w|tas.en: I forgot to bring my bag.

w|tata.text: Mereka belajar tata cara upacara adat.
w|tata.en: They learned the order of the traditional ceremony.
w|tata.ko: 그들은 전통 의식의 진행 절차를 배웠어.

w|tata.text: Tata ruang kantor itu terasa lega.

w|tatanan.text: Menurut Bayu, media sosial telah mengubah tatanan cara orang membaca berita.
w|tatanan.en: According to Bayu, social media has changed the whole order of how people read news.
w|tatanan.ko: 바유는 SNS가 사람들이 뉴스를 읽는 질서를 바꿔 놓았다고 해요.

w|tatanan.text: Menurut Intan, belanja daring sudah mengubah tatanan hidup di kampungnya.
w|tatanan.en: According to Intan, online shopping has changed the order of life in her village.
w|tatanan.ko: 인탄은 온라인 쇼핑이 자기 마을의 생활 질서를 바꿔 놓았다고 해요.

w|tatapan.text: Kelas langsung hening karena tatapan tajam guru matematika.
w|tatapan.en: The maths teacher's sharp gaze made the class go quiet at once.
w|tatapan.ko: 수학 선생님의 날카로운 눈빛에 교실이 바로 조용해졌어요.

w|tatapan.text: Sang ibu terus melempar tatapan cemas ke pintu ruang operasi.
w|tatapan.en: The mother's anxious gaze never left the operating room door.
w|tatapan.ko: 어머니의 걱정스러운 눈길이 수술실 문에서 떨어지지 않았어요.

w|tato.en: The tattoo on his arm is shaped like a bird.

w|tato.text: Dia ingin menghapus tato lama itu.
w|tato.en: She wants to remove that old tattoo.
w|tato.ko: 그녀는 그 오래된 타투를 지우고 싶어 해.

w|tawa.text: Budi masih ingat tawa Andi yang keras di kantin sekolah.
w|tawa.en: Budi still remembers Andi's loud laugh in the school canteen.
w|tawa.ko: 부디는 학교 매점에서 울리던 안디의 큰 웃음소리를 아직 기억해요.

w|tawa.text: Suara tawa penonton membuat Siti lupa rasa lelahnya.
w|tawa.en: The sound of the spectators' laughter made Siti forget her tiredness.

w|tawanan.text: Di perpustakaan pengadilan, Fajar membaca arsip sidang lama tentang para tawanan perang.
w|tawanan.en: In the court library, Fajar read old trial archives about prisoners of war.
w|tawanan.ko: 파자르는 법원 도서관에서 전쟁 포로들에 관한 옛 재판 기록을 읽었어요.

w|tawanan.text: Novel tentang seorang tawanan yang kabur dari benteng laris di rak buku bekas Lestari.
w|tawanan.en: A novel about a prisoner escaping from a fortress sells well on Lestari's used-book shelf.
w|tawanan.ko: 요새에서 탈출한 포로 이야기를 다룬 소설이 레스타리의 헌책 선반에서 잘 팔려요.

w|tawaran.text: Tawaran spesial hanya berlaku hari ini.
w|tawaran.en: The special offer is only valid today.

w|tayang.text: Wawancara Fajar tentang anggaran kota akan tayang di televisi lokal malam ini.
w|tayang.en: Fajar's interview about the city budget will air on local television tonight.
w|tayang.ko: 시 예산에 관한 파자르의 인터뷰가 오늘 밤 지역 방송에 나가요.

w|tayang.text: Lestari tidak pernah melewatkan sinetron yang tayang setiap pukul delapan malam.
w|tayang.en: Lestari never misses the soap opera that airs every night at eight.
w|tayang.ko: 레스타리는 매일 밤 여덟 시에 하는 드라마를 한 번도 놓치지 않아요.

w|tayangan.text: Televisi di ruang tunggu sedang memutar tayangan berita tentang kemacetan di jalan tol.
w|tayangan.en: The television in the waiting room is showing a news broadcast about the traffic jam on the toll road.
w|tayangan.ko: 대기실 텔레비전에서는 고속도로 정체에 관한 뉴스가 나오고 있어요.

w|tayangan.text: Malam harinya Rina menonton tayangan ulang lomba di televisi untuk mencari dirinya sendiri.
w|tayangan.en: That night Rina watched the replay of the race on TV to look for herself.
w|tayangan.ko: 그날 밤 리나는 텔레비전에서 경기 재방송을 보며 자기 모습을 찾았어요.

w|teater.text: Klub drama memakai ruang serbaguna perpustakaan untuk latihan teater.
w|teater.en: The drama club uses the library's multipurpose room for theater practice.
w|teater.ko: 연극반은 도서관 다목적실에서 연극 연습을 해요.

w|teater.text: Putri sedang dalam perjalanan ke Jakarta untuk menonton pertunjukan teater.
w|teater.en: Putri is on her way to Jakarta to watch a theater performance.
w|teater.ko: 푸트리는 연극 공연을 보러 자카르타로 가는 길이에요.

w|tebakan.text: Rupanya tebakan Fajar benar, paketnya datang tepat sebelum hujan turun.
w|tebakan.en: Fajar's guess was right; the package came just before the rain started.
w|tebakan.ko: 파자르의 짐작대로 택배는 비가 오기 직전에 도착했어요.

w|tebakan.text: Guru menyuruh peserta menebak bumbu rahasia, dan tebakan Lestari paling dekat.
w|tebakan.en: The teacher asked the participants to guess the secret spice, and Lestari's guess was the closest.
w|tebakan.ko: 선생님이 비밀 양념을 맞혀 보라고 했는데 레스타리의 추측이 가장 가까웠어요.

w|tebal.text: Di meja Agus ada map tebal berisi usulan warga.
w|tebal.en: On Agus's desk there is a thick folder full of residents' proposals.
w|tebal.ko: 아구스 책상 위에는 주민 제안서가 든 두꺼운 서류철이 있어요.

w|tebal.text: Buku partitur Wati sudah tebal penuh catatan pensil.
w|tebal.en: Wati's sheet music book is thick with pencil notes.

w|tebing.text: Dari atas tebing di belakang desa, Dimas bisa melihat seluruh sawahnya.
w|tebing.en: From the top of the cliff behind the village, Dimas can see all his rice fields.
w|tebing.ko: 마을 뒤 절벽 위에서는 디마스가 자기 논 전체를 볼 수 있어요.

w|tebing.text: Poster di kamar Putri menampilkan tebing tinggi di tepi laut.
w|tebing.en: The poster in Putri's room shows a tall cliff by the sea.
w|tebing.ko: 푸트리 방의 포스터에는 바닷가의 높은 절벽이 담겨 있어요.

w|tebusan.text: Rudi membaca cerita detektif tentang penculik yang meminta uang tebusan.
w|tebusan.en: Rudi read a detective story about a kidnapper who demanded ransom money.
w|tebusan.ko: 루디는 몸값을 요구하는 납치범이 나오는 탐정 소설을 읽었어요.

w|tebusan.text: Rina menemukan novel lama tentang bajak laut yang menuntut tebusan emas.
w|tebusan.en: Rina found an old novel about pirates who demanded a ransom in gold.
w|tebusan.ko: 리나는 금으로 몸값을 요구하는 해적 이야기가 담긴 옛 소설을 찾았어요.

w|tega.text: Andi tidak tega melihat nenek yang kehilangan dompet menangis di ruang tunggu.
w|tega.en: Andi couldn't bear to see the grandmother who had lost her wallet crying in the waiting room.
w|tega.ko: 안디는 지갑을 잃어버린 할머니가 대기실에서 우는 걸 차마 볼 수 없었어요.

w|tega.text: Pelatih kok tega menyuruh Dewi lari keliling lapangan dua puluh kali.
w|tega.en: How could the coach have the heart to make Dewi run twenty laps around the court?
w|tega.ko: 코치님은 어떻게 데위한테 코트를 스무 바퀴나 돌라고 할 수 있어요?

w|tegak.text: Di foto halaman depan, tugu kota masih berdiri tegak setelah gempa.
w|tegak.en: In the front-page photo, the city monument still stands upright after the earthquake.
w|tegak.ko: 1면 사진 속 시의 기념탑은 지진 뒤에도 꼿꼿이 서 있어요.

w|tegak.text: Intan duduk tegak di depan investor dan mulai presentasi dengan tenang.
w|tegak.en: Intan sat up straight in front of the investors and calmly began her presentation.
w|tegak.ko: 인탄은 투자자들 앞에 꼿꼿이 앉아 차분하게 발표를 시작했어요.

w|tegang.en: The meeting atmosphere felt very tense.
Waiting tensely for the announcement made her restless.

w|tegar.text: Ibu Dimas menelepon dan berpesan agar Dimas tetap tegar kalau hari pertamanya berat.
w|tegar.en: Dimas's mother called and told him to stay strong if his first day was hard.
w|tegar.ko: 디마스의 엄마는 전화해서 첫날이 힘들어도 꿋꿋하게 버티라고 했어요.

w|tegar.text: Putri berusaha tegar saat melambaikan tangan kepada orang tuanya di pintu keberangkatan.
w|tegar.en: Putri tried to stay strong as she waved to her parents at the departure door.
w|tegar.ko: 출국장 문에서 부모님께 손을 흔들며 푸트리는 꿋꿋하려고 애썼어요.

w|tegas.text: Dokter gigi itu ramah tapi tegas soal larangan merokok setelah cabut gigi.
w|tegas.en: The dentist is friendly but firm about not smoking after an extraction.
w|tegas.ko: 그 치과 의사는 친절하지만 발치 후 금연에 대해선 단호해요.

w|tegas.text: Wati bersikap tegas kepada tukang yang sering datang terlambat.
w|tegas.en: Wati is firm with the builder who often comes late.
w|tegas.ko: 와티는 자주 늦는 인부에게 단호하게 대해요.

w|teguh.text: Agus tetap teguh menolak menaikkan sewa untuk penyewa unitnya.
w|teguh.en: Agus remained firm in refusing to raise the rent for his unit's tenant.
w|teguh.ko: 아구스는 세입자의 월세를 올리지 않겠다는 뜻을 굽히지 않았어요.

w|teguh.text: Pohon beringin tua di alun-alun tetap teguh berdiri meski badai datang setiap tahun.
w|teguh.en: The old banyan tree in the square stands firm even though storms come every year.
w|teguh.ko: 광장의 오래된 반얀나무는 해마다 폭풍이 와도 굳건히 서 있어요.

w|teka-teki.text: Setiap Jumat, guru Eko memberi teka-teki matematika di papan tulis.
w|teka-teki.en: Every Friday, Eko's teacher puts a math puzzle on the blackboard.
w|teka-teki.ko: 매주 금요일 에코의 선생님은 칠판에 수학 수수께끼를 내요.

w|teka-teki.text: Kakek Ayu mengisi teka-teki silang di koran setiap pagi.
w|teka-teki.en: Ayu's grandfather does the crossword in the newspaper every morning.
w|teka-teki.ko: 아유의 할아버지는 매일 아침 신문의 십자말풀이를 해요.

w|tekanan.en: His blood pressure rose because of stress.

w|tekanan.text: Dia bekerja di bawah tekanan tinggi.

w|teknik.en: His painting technique is very good.

w|teknik.text: Dia mempelajari teknik baru di kelas.
w|teknik.en: She is learning a new technique in class.

w|teknis.en: A technical problem delayed the show.

w|teknis.text: Tim teknis memperbaiki jaringan malam ini.
w|teknis.en: The technical team is fixing the network tonight.

w|teknisi.text: Sejak pagi, teknisi listrik memasang kabel di lantai dua.
w|teknisi.en: The electrician has been installing cables on the second floor since morning.
w|teknisi.ko: 전기 기술자가 아침부터 이 층에 전선을 깔고 있어요.

w|teknisi.text: Laptop Rina belum bisa menyala, jadi dia menunggu teknisi IT.
w|teknisi.en: Rina's laptop wouldn't turn on yet, so she waited for the IT technician.
w|teknisi.ko: 리나의 노트북이 켜지지 않아서 리나는 IT 기술자를 기다렸어요.

w|teks.text: Andi menunjukkan teks ancaman yang masuk ke ponselnya kepada penyidik.
w|teks.en: Andi showed the investigator the threatening text that came to his phone.
w|teks.ko: 안디는 휴대폰으로 온 협박 문자를 수사관에게 보여 줬어요.

w|teks.text: Pelatih mengirim teks berisi jadwal latihan ke grup tim.
w|teks.en: The coach sent a text with the practice schedule to the team group.
w|teks.ko: 코치가 팀 단톡방에 연습 일정을 문자로 보냈어요.

w|teladan.text: Bagi anak-anak di gang, Andi adalah teladan karena rajin membantu orang tua.
w|teladan.en: For the kids in the alley, Andi is a role model because he always helps the elderly.
w|teladan.ko: 골목 아이들에게 안디는 어르신들을 잘 도와서 본보기예요.

w|teladan.text: Dewi memberi penghargaan murid teladan kepada Rina yang tak pernah bolos latihan.
w|teladan.en: Dewi gave the model student award to Rina, who never skipped practice.
w|teladan.ko: 데위는 연습에 한 번도 빠지지 않은 리나에게 모범생 상을 줬어요.

w|telak.text: Tim dapur Eko menang telak dalam lomba memasak antarrestoran.
w|telak.en: Eko's kitchen team won decisively in the inter-restaurant cooking contest.
w|telak.ko: 에코의 주방 팀은 식당 대항 요리 대회에서 압승했어요.

w|telak.text: Ayu kalah telak dalam taruhan dengan adiknya soal kapan hujan pertama turun.
w|telak.en: Ayu lost badly in a bet with her sibling about when the first rain would fall.
w|telak.ko: 아유는 첫비가 언제 올지 동생과 내기했다가 완전히 졌어요.

w|telanjang.text: Bayi itu telanjang di bak mandi.
w|telanjang.en: That baby is naked in the bathtub.
Don't let the child go out naked.

w|telapak.text: Ada duri kecil yang menancap di telapak kaki anjing itu.
w|telapak.en: There was a small thorn stuck in the sole of that dog's paw.
w|telapak.ko: 그 개의 발바닥에 작은 가시가 박혀 있었어요.

w|telapak.text: Siti menghangatkan telapak tangan di dekat tungku kayu.
w|telapak.en: Siti warmed her palms near the wood stove.
w|telapak.ko: 시티는 나무 화덕 옆에서 손바닥을 녹였어요.

w|telat.text: Dia datang telat ke rapat pagi.
w|telat.en: He arrived late to the morning meeting.
Don't be late submitting your assignment.

w|telepati.text: Dimas bercanda dengan temannya bahwa mereka bisa berkomunikasi lewat telepati di ruang yang sunyi itu.
w|telepati.en: Dimas joked with his friend that they could communicate by telepathy in that silent room.
w|telepati.ko: 디마스는 그 조용한 전시실에서는 텔레파시로 대화하면 된다고 친구에게 농담했어요.

w|telepati.text: Dalam cerita itu, dua saudara kembar bisa saling bicara lewat telepati.
w|telepati.en: In that story, two twins can talk to each other through telepathy.
w|telepati.ko: 그 이야기에서 쌍둥이 둘은 텔레파시로 서로 이야기할 수 있어요.

w|teleportasi.text: Bayu bercanda bahwa ia butuh teleportasi untuk meliput dua acara di kota berbeda pada jam yang sama.
w|teleportasi.en: Bayu joked that he needed teleportation to cover two events in different cities at the same time.
w|teleportasi.ko: 바유는 같은 시간에 다른 도시 두 행사를 취재하려면 순간 이동이 필요하다고 농담했어요.

w|teleportasi.text: Kalau ada teleportasi, Intan tidak perlu menunggu paketnya selama seminggu.
w|teleportasi.en: If teleportation existed, Intan wouldn't have to wait a week for her package.
w|teleportasi.ko: 순간 이동이 있다면 인탄은 택배를 일주일씩 기다릴 필요가 없을 거예요.

w|teleskop.text: Rudi membawa teleskop kecil untuk mengamati bintang dari perkemahan.
w|teleskop.en: Rudi brought a small telescope to watch the stars from the campsite.
w|teleskop.ko: 루디는 야영지에서 별을 보려고 작은 망원경을 가져왔어요.

w|teleskop.text: Dari tribun belakang, Rina bercanda bahwa dia butuh teleskop untuk melihat penyanyinya.
w|teleskop.en: From the back stands, Rina joked that she needed a telescope to see the singer.
w|teleskop.ko: 뒤쪽 관람석에서 리나는 가수를 보려면 망원경이 필요하다고 농담했어요.

w|televisi.text: Televisi di ruang tamu sudah rusak.
w|televisi.en: The television in the living room is broken.

w|televisi.text: Anak-anak menonton televisi setelah makan malam.
w|televisi.en: The children watch television after dinner.

w|telinga.en: A cat's ears are very sharp.

w|teluk.text: Dari bukit itu kelihatan teluk kecil tempat perahu nelayan pulang.
w|teluk.en: From that hill you can see the small bay where the fishing boats come home.
w|teluk.ko: 그 언덕에서는 고깃배들이 돌아오는 작은 만이 보여요.

w|teluk.text: Di dinding kantor tergantung foto sebuah teluk yang indah.
w|teluk.en: A photo of a beautiful bay hangs on the office wall.
w|teluk.ko: 사무실 벽에 아름다운 만 사진이 걸려 있어요.

w|tembaga.text: Eko memasak air dengan panci tembaga milik kakeknya.
w|tembaga.en: Eko boiled water in his grandfather's copper pot.
w|tembaga.ko: 에코는 할아버지의 구리 냄비로 물을 끓였어요.

w|tembaga.text: Tahun lalu Ayu hanya mendapat medali berwarna tembaga.
w|tembaga.en: Last year Ayu only got a copper-colored medal.
w|tembaga.ko: 작년에 아유는 구릿빛 메달밖에 못 받았어요.

w|tembakan.en: We heard gunshots from far away.

w|tembakan.text: Tembakan itu membuat semua orang panik.

w|tembakau.text: Rudi memperingatkan bahwa asap tembakau juga berbahaya bagi kucing di rumah.
w|tembakau.en: Rudi warned that tobacco smoke is also harmful to cats at home.
w|tembakau.ko: 루디는 담배 연기가 집 고양이에게도 해롭다고 경고했어요.

w|tembakau.text: Banyak petani di desa Rina beralih dari tembakau ke kopi.
w|tembakau.en: Many farmers in Rina's village have switched from tobacco to coffee.
w|tembakau.ko: 리나네 마을의 많은 농부가 담배에서 커피로 작물을 바꿨어요.

w|tembok.en: That house wall was painted white.
The children drew on the school wall.

w|temperatur.text: Bayu mengukur temperatur air sungai setiap pagi sebelum sarapan.
w|temperatur.en: Bayu measures the river water temperature every morning before breakfast.
w|temperatur.ko: 바유는 매일 아침 식사 전에 강물 온도를 재요.

w|temperatur.text: Panitia memantau temperatur udara karena siang itu sangat panas bagi pelari seperti Intan.
w|temperatur.en: The organizers monitored the air temperature because that afternoon was very hot for runners like Intan.
w|temperatur.ko: 그날 낮은 인탄 같은 주자들에게 너무 더워서 주최 측이 기온을 지켜봤어요.

w|tempur.text: Pasukan itu siap tempur di perbatasan.
w|tempur.en: Those troops are ready for combat at the border.
w|tempur.ko: 그 부대는 국경에서 전투 준비가 되어 있어.

w|tempur.text: Tempur udara berlangsung singkat tapi sengit.
w|tempur.en: The air combat was brief but fierce.

w|temuan.text: Eko melaporkan temuan jejak tikus di gudang kepada manajer.
w|temuan.en: Eko reported finding signs of rats in the storeroom to the manager.
w|temuan.ko: 에코는 창고에서 쥐 흔적을 발견했다고 매니저에게 보고했어요.

w|temuan.text: Ayu membaca temuan ilmuwan bahwa musim kemarau kini makin panjang.
w|temuan.en: Ayu read scientists' findings that the dry season is getting longer.
w|temuan.ko: 아유는 건기가 점점 길어지고 있다는 과학자들의 연구 결과를 읽었어요.

w|tenaga.text: Tenaga listrik di desa sering putus.
w|tenaga.en: Electric power in the village often goes out.
He ran out of energy after running.

w|tenda.text: Agus memasang tenda di tepi danau sebelum matahari terbenam.
w|tenda.en: Agus set up the tent by the lake before sunset.
w|tenda.ko: 아구스는 해가 지기 전에 호숫가에 텐트를 쳤어요.

w|tenda.text: Bagian olahraga sedang memajang tenda untuk empat orang dengan harga diskon.
w|tenda.en: The sports section is displaying a four-person tent at a discount.
w|tenda.ko: 스포츠 코너에서 사인용 텐트를 할인가로 진열하고 있어요.

w|tendangan.text: Sayang, tendangan Andi membentur tiang gawang di menit terakhir.
w|tendangan.en: Unfortunately, Andi's kick hit the goalpost in the final minute.
w|tendangan.ko: 아쉽게도 마지막 순간 안디의 슛이 골대를 맞혔어요.

w|tendangan.text: Satu tendangan keras membuat bola menghantam pot bunga Dewi.
w|tendangan.en: One hard kick sent the ball crashing into Dewi's flowerpot.
w|tendangan.ko: 세게 찬 공 한 방에 데위의 화분이 맞았어요.

w|tengah.en: He's standing in the middle of the road.
In the middle of the night it poured.

w|tenggara.text: Bayu dan teman-temannya menuju pantai di sebelah tenggara pulau.
w|tenggara.en: Bayu and his friends headed for a beach on the southeast side of the island.
w|tenggara.ko: 바유와 친구들은 섬 남동쪽에 있는 해변으로 향했어요.

w|tenggara.text: Jendela di sisi tenggara kelas memberi cahaya pagi yang disukai Intan.
w|tenggara.en: The window on the southeast side of the classroom gives the morning light Intan loves.
w|tenggara.ko: 교실 남동쪽 창문으로 인탄이 좋아하는 아침 햇빛이 들어와요.

w|tenggelam.text: Kapal itu hampir tenggelam dalam badai.
w|tenggelam.en: That ship almost sank in the storm.
w|tenggelam.ko: 그 배가 폭풍 속에 거의 가라앉았어.

w|tenggelam.en: He was lost in his own thoughts.

w|tenggorokan.text: Dokter gigi juga melihat tenggorokan Agus yang tampak merah.
w|tenggorokan.en: The dentist also looked at Agus's throat, which looked red.
w|tenggorokan.ko: 치과 의사는 빨갛게 부은 아구스의 목구멍도 살펴봤어요.

w|tenggorokan.text: Debu semen membuat tenggorokan Wati terasa kering.
w|tenggorokan.en: The cement dust made Wati's throat feel dry.
w|tenggorokan.ko: 시멘트 가루 때문에 와티의 목이 칼칼했어요.

w|tengik.text: Agus membuang mentega yang sudah berbau tengik.
w|tengik.en: Agus threw out the butter that had gone rancid.

w|tengik.text: Wati mencium bau tengik dari minyak goreng di dapur kantor.
w|tengik.en: Wati smelled rancid cooking oil in the office kitchen.
w|tengik.ko: 와티는 사무실 탕비실 식용유에서 쩐내를 맡았어요.

w|tengkorak.text: Di ruang praktik ada model tengkorak untuk menjelaskan posisi gigi.
w|tengkorak.en: In the clinic there's a model skull for explaining the position of the teeth.
w|tengkorak.ko: 진료실에는 치아 위치를 설명하는 두개골 모형이 있어요.

w|tengkorak.text: Wati menemukan tengkorak burung kecil di loteng rumah tua itu.
w|tengkorak.en: Wati found a small bird skull in the attic of the old house.
w|tengkorak.ko: 와티는 그 낡은 집 다락방에서 작은 새의 두개골을 발견했어요.

w|tengok.text: “Coba tengok dulu di bawah kasurmu,” kata Budi kepada Rina.
