w|tengok.en: "Take a look under your mattress first," Budi said to Rina.
w|tengok.ko: "먼저 네 매트리스 밑을 좀 봐 봐." 부디가 리나에게 말했어요.

w|tengok.text: “Coba tengok pemandangan dari jendela ini,” kata Siti kepada suaminya.
w|tengok.en: "Take a look at the view from this window," Siti said to her husband.
w|tengok.ko: "이 창문 밖 풍경 좀 봐요." 시티가 남편에게 말했어요.

w|tenis.text: Eko ikut ekstrakurikuler tenis setiap Rabu sore.
w|tenis.en: Eko joins the tennis club every Wednesday afternoon.
w|tenis.ko: 에코는 매주 수요일 오후 테니스 동아리 활동을 해요.

w|tenis.text: Ayu melukis lapangan tenis kosong saat matahari terbenam.
w|tenis.en: Ayu painted an empty tennis court at sunset.
w|tenis.ko: 아유는 해 질 녘 텅 빈 테니스 코트를 그렸어요.

w|tentang.text: Aku tidak mau dengar tentang itu.
w|tentang.en: I don't want to hear about that.

w|tentara.ko: 그 군인들이 질서 있게 줄 섰어.

w|teoretis.text: Menurut Rudi, kursus perhotelan yang dulu diikutinya terlalu teoretis.
w|teoretis.en: According to Rudi, the hotel course he once took was too theoretical.
w|teoretis.ko: 루디는 예전에 들은 호텔 경영 강좌가 너무 이론적이었다고 해요.

w|teoretis.text: Secara teoretis musim hujan dimulai bulan Oktober, tetapi tahun ini datang terlambat.
w|teoretis.en: In theory the rainy season starts in October, but this year it came late.
w|teoretis.ko: 이론상으로는 우기가 시월에 시작하지만 올해는 늦게 왔어요.

w|teori.en: This theory is hard to understand.

w|tepi.text: Tepi sungai itu berbahaya saat hujan deras.
w|tepi.en: The riverbank is dangerous during heavy rain.

w|tepi.text: Dia duduk di tepi jendela membaca.
w|tepi.en: She sat at the edge of the window reading.

w|tepuk.text: Tepuk tangan penonton menggema di aula.
w|tepuk.en: The audience's applause echoed in the hall.

w|tepuk.text: Anak itu memberi tepuk semangat pada temannya.
w|tepuk.en: The child gave his friend an encouraging clap.
w|tepuk.ko: 그 아이가 친구에게 응원 박수를 보냈어.

w|tepung.text: Kantor baru Dimas ada di pabrik roti, jadi sore itu bajunya penuh tepung.
w|tepung.en: Dimas's new office is in a bread factory, so that afternoon his clothes were covered in flour.
w|tepung.ko: 디마스의 새 사무실은 빵 공장에 있어서 그날 오후 옷이 밀가루투성이였어요.

w|tepung.text: Petugas bertanya tentang bubuk putih di koper Putri, yang ternyata hanya tepung kue.
w|tepung.en: The officer asked about the white powder in Putri's suitcase, which turned out to be just cake flour.
w|tepung.ko: 직원이 푸트리 가방 속 흰 가루를 물었는데, 알고 보니 케이크용 밀가루였어요.

w|terampil.text: Kantor membutuhkan teknisi terampil untuk memperbaiki mesin fotokopi.
w|terampil.en: The office needs a skilled technician to fix the photocopier.
w|terampil.ko: 회사에는 복사기를 고칠 숙련된 기술자가 필요해요.

w|terampil.text: Programmer yang paling terampil di tim Lestari baru berumur dua puluh tahun.
w|terampil.en: The most skilled programmer on Lestari's team is only twenty years old.
w|terampil.ko: 레스타리 팀에서 가장 실력 좋은 개발자는 겨우 스무 살이에요.

w|terancam.text: Rumah-rumah di tepi sungai terancam longsor kalau proyek tidak memasang tembok penahan.
w|terancam.en: The houses on the riverbank are at risk of a landslide if the project doesn't build a retaining wall.
w|terancam.ko: 공사 측이 옹벽을 세우지 않으면 강가 집들이 산사태 위험에 놓여요.

w|terancam.text: Karena pandemi dulu, pekerjaan lama Rina sempat terancam hilang.
w|terancam.en: Because of the pandemic, Rina's old job was once at risk of disappearing.
w|terancam.ko: 예전 팬데믹 때 리나의 전 직장은 없어질 위기에 놓였었어요.

w|terang.text: Ruangan ini sangat terang di siang hari.
w|terang.en: This room is very bright during the day.

w|terang-terangan.text: Bayu terang-terangan menegur pemburu yang memasang jerat di hutan.
w|terang-terangan.en: Bayu openly scolded the hunter who set snares in the forest.
w|terang-terangan.ko: 바유는 숲에 덫을 놓은 사냥꾼을 대놓고 나무랐어요.

w|terang-terangan.text: Pelatih terang-terangan bilang bahwa Intan belum siap untuk maraton penuh.
w|terang-terangan.en: The coach said outright that Intan wasn't ready for a full marathon yet.
w|terang-terangan.ko: 코치는 인탄이 아직 풀코스 마라톤을 뛸 준비가 안 됐다고 대놓고 말했어요.

w|terangkat.text: Andi memastikan beban sudah terangkat dengan aman sebelum derek berputar.
w|terangkat.en: Andi made sure the load had been lifted safely before the crane turned.
w|terangkat.ko: 안디는 크레인이 돌기 전에 짐이 안전하게 들렸는지 확인했어요.

w|terangkat.text: Beban pikiran Dewi seperti terangkat setelah tertawa bersama teman lama.
w|terangkat.en: Dewi's worries felt lifted after laughing with old friends.
w|terangkat.ko: 옛 친구들과 웃고 나니 데위의 마음의 짐이 덜어진 것 같았어요.

w|terangsang.text: Aroma bawang goreng membuat selera makan Andi langsung terangsang.
w|terangsang.en: The smell of fried shallots immediately whetted Andi's appetite.
w|terangsang.ko: 튀긴 샬롯 냄새에 안디는 곧바로 입맛이 돌았어요.

w|terangsang.text: Rani menulis bahwa rasa ingin tahunya terangsang setelah membaca buku sejarah kiriman Dewi.
w|terangsang.en: Rani wrote that her curiosity was sparked after reading the history book Dewi sent.
w|terangsang.ko: 라니는 데위가 보낸 역사책을 읽고 호기심이 생겼다고 썼어요.

w|terapi.text: Terapi fisik membantunya pulih lebih cepat.
w|terapi.en: Physical therapy helped him recover faster.
w|terapi.ko: 물리 치료가 더 빨리 회복하게 도왔어.

w|terapi.text: Dia menjalani terapi bicara setiap minggu.
w|terapi.en: She undergoes speech therapy every week.

w|terapis.text: Klinik itu bekerja sama dengan seorang terapis hewan untuk anjing yang baru selesai operasi tulang.
w|terapis.en: The clinic works with an animal therapist for dogs that have just had bone surgery.
w|terapis.ko: 그 병원은 뼈 수술을 막 마친 개들을 위해 동물 치료사와 함께 일해요.

w|terapis.text: Seorang terapis datang ke desa setiap bulan untuk membantu warga yang sakit punggung.
w|terapis.en: A therapist comes to the village every month to help residents with back pain.
w|terapis.ko: 치료사 한 명이 매달 마을에 와서 허리 아픈 주민들을 도와요.

w|teras.text: Penghuni lantai dasar boleh memakai teras bersama untuk bersantai sore.
w|teras.en: Ground-floor residents may use the shared terrace to relax in the evening.
w|teras.ko: 일 층 주민들은 공용 테라스에서 저녁에 쉴 수 있어요.

w|teras.text: Wati suka duduk di teras sambil melihat hujan pertama turun.
w|teras.en: Wati likes sitting on the porch watching the first rain fall.
w|teras.ko: 와티는 테라스에 앉아 첫비가 내리는 걸 보는 걸 좋아해요.

w|teratai.text: Kolam di depan balai desa penuh dengan bunga teratai.
w|teratai.en: The pond in front of the village hall is full of lotus flowers.
w|teratai.ko: 마을 회관 앞 연못에는 연꽃이 가득해요.

w|teratai.text: Ayu menggambar motif teratai untuk kemasan sabun baru.
w|teratai.en: Ayu drew a lotus pattern for the new soap packaging.
w|teratai.ko: 아유는 새 비누 포장에 넣을 연꽃 무늬를 그렸어요.

w|teratas.text: Rudi menyimpan senter di kantong teratas ranselnya supaya mudah diambil.
w|teratas.en: Rudi keeps his flashlight in the top pocket of his backpack so it's easy to grab.
w|teratas.ko: 루디는 꺼내기 쉽게 손전등을 배낭 맨 위 주머니에 넣어 둬요.

w|teratas.text: Rina mendapat kursi di baris teratas tribun, jadi panggung terlihat sangat kecil.
w|teratas.en: Rina got a seat in the top row of the stands, so the stage looked tiny.
w|teratas.ko: 리나는 관람석 맨 윗줄 자리를 받아서 무대가 아주 작게 보였어요.

w|teratur.text: Kata wali kelas, Eko harus belajar lebih teratur, bukan semalam sebelum ujian.
w|teratur.en: The homeroom teacher said Eko should study more regularly, not the night before the exam.
w|teratur.ko: 담임 선생님은 에코에게 시험 전날 밤이 아니라 꾸준히 공부하라고 했어요.

w|teratur.text: Ayu menyusun tabung cat di mejanya dengan sangat teratur.
w|teratur.en: Ayu arranges the paint tubes on her desk very neatly.
w|teratur.ko: 아유는 책상 위 물감 튜브를 아주 가지런히 정리해요.

w|terbaik.en: This is the best choice for you.

w|terbakar.en: That house burned down last night.

w|terbalik.en: The image on the screen looks upside down.

w|terbalik.text: Terbalik arah membuat mereka tersesat sebentar.
w|terbalik.en: Going the wrong way made them get lost briefly.
w|terbalik.ko: 방향을 반대로 가니 잠깐 길을 잃었어.

w|terbang.en: The plane will take off soon.

w|terbangun.en: He woke up because of the thunder.

w|terbangun.text: Aku terbangun lebih awal dari biasanya.
w|terbangun.en: I woke up earlier than usual.

w|terbaring.text: Waktu demam, Agus hanya terbaring di ruang UKS sepanjang pagi.
w|terbaring.en: When he had a fever, Agus just lay in the school sick bay all morning.
w|terbaring.ko: 열이 났을 때 아구스는 아침 내내 보건실에 누워 있었어요.

w|terbaring.text: Wati terbaring di kursi santai sambil berjemur sebentar.
w|terbaring.en: Wati lay on the lounge chair, sunbathing for a while.
w|terbaring.ko: 와티는 선베드에 누워 잠깐 햇볕을 쬐었어요.

w|terbaru.text: Ini adalah berita terbaru dari kantor.
w|terbaru.en: This is the latest news from the office.
That newest model will be available soon.
w|terbaru.ko: 그 최신 모델이 곧 나올 거야.

w|terbatas.text: Kursi kosong sangat terbatas hari ini.
w|terbatas.en: Empty seats are very limited today.
Our time is limited before the deadline.
w|terbatas.ko: 마감 전에 우리 시간이 제한돼 있어.

w|terbawa.text: Penonton ikut terbawa suasana sampai ada yang menangis.
w|terbawa.en: The audience got carried away by the mood, and some even cried.
w|terbawa.ko: 관객들도 분위기에 빠져 우는 사람까지 있었어요.

w|terbawa.text: Sandal Ayu terbawa arus saat ia menyeberangi sungai kecil.
w|terbawa.en: Ayu's sandal was swept away by the current as she crossed the stream.
w|terbawa.ko: 아유가 개울을 건널 때 샌들이 물살에 떠내려갔어요.

w|terbayangkan.text: Bagi Agus, berdiri di ruang sidang sebagai saksi dulu sama sekali tidak terbayangkan.
w|terbayangkan.en: For Agus, standing in a courtroom as a witness was once completely unimaginable.
w|terbayangkan.ko: 아구스는 예전에는 법정에 증인으로 서는 일을 전혀 상상하지 못했어요.

w|terbayangkan.text: Dulu tidak terbayangkan bahwa warung kecil Wati akan menjadi restoran tiga lantai.
w|terbayangkan.en: It was once unimaginable that Wati's small stall would become a three-story restaurant.
w|terbayangkan.ko: 와티의 작은 가게가 삼층 식당이 될 줄은 예전엔 상상도 못 했어요.

w|terbebas.text: Setelah sistem antrean daring dipakai, warga terbebas dari antre berjam-jam, kata Fajar dengan bangga.
w|terbebas.en: After the online queue system was introduced, residents were freed from queuing for hours, Fajar said proudly.
w|terbebas.ko: 온라인 대기 시스템을 쓰고 나서 주민들이 몇 시간씩 줄 서는 일에서 벗어났다고 파자르가 자랑스럽게 말했어요.

w|terbebas.text: Lestari bercerita ia merasa terbebas setelah berhenti dari pekerjaan kantoran.
w|terbebas.en: Lestari said she felt free after quitting her office job.
w|terbebas.ko: 레스타리는 회사를 그만두고 나서 해방된 기분이라고 했어요.

w|terbelah.text: Roti sobek itu terbelah rapi di tangan Agus.
w|terbelah.en: The pull-apart bread split neatly in Agus's hands.
w|terbelah.ko: 아구스의 손에서 찢어 먹는 빵이 깔끔하게 갈라졌어요.

w|terbelah.text: Tim Wati terbelah dua soal desain logo baru.
w|terbelah.en: Wati's team was split in two over the new logo design.
w|terbelah.ko: 와티의 팀은 새 로고 디자인을 두고 둘로 갈렸어요.

w|terbelakang.text: Dulu desa Eko dianggap terbelakang karena belum punya listrik dan jalan aspal.
w|terbelakang.en: Eko's village used to be considered backward because it had no electricity or paved road.
w|terbelakang.ko: 에코의 마을은 예전에 전기도 포장도로도 없어서 낙후됐다고 여겨졌어요.

w|terbelakang.text: Dokter gigi Ayu pernah bertugas di daerah terbelakang yang belum punya klinik.
w|terbelakang.en: Ayu's dentist once worked in an underdeveloped area that had no clinic.
w|terbelakang.ko: 아유의 치과 의사는 병원이 없는 낙후된 지역에서 일한 적이 있어요.

w|terbenam.text: Andi baru pulang dari kantor polisi ketika matahari sudah terbenam.
w|terbenam.en: Andi only got home from the police station after the sun had set.
w|terbenam.ko: 안디는 해가 다 진 뒤에야 경찰서에서 돌아왔어요.

w|terbenam.text: Latihan sore selesai tepat saat matahari terbenam di balik gedung.
w|terbenam.en: Afternoon practice ended just as the sun set behind the building.
w|terbenam.ko: 오후 연습은 해가 건물 뒤로 넘어갈 때 딱 끝났어요.

w|terbentuk.text: Pemandu bilang gua di dekat perkemahan terbentuk dari batu kapur selama ribuan tahun.
w|terbentuk.en: The guide said the cave near the camp was formed from limestone over thousands of years.
w|terbentuk.ko: 가이드는 야영지 근처 동굴이 수천 년에 걸쳐 석회암으로 만들어졌다고 했어요.

w|terbentuk.text: Rina tahu bahwa band itu terbentuk ketika para anggotanya masih kuliah.
w|terbentuk.en: Rina knows the band was formed when its members were still in college.
w|terbentuk.ko: 리나는 그 밴드가 멤버들이 아직 대학생일 때 결성됐다는 걸 알아요.

w|terbentur.text: Kepala Eko terbentur tiang tenda saat ia bangun terburu-buru.
w|terbentur.en: Eko's head bumped against the tent pole when he got up in a hurry.
w|terbentur.ko: 에코는 급하게 일어나다가 텐트 기둥에 머리를 부딪쳤어요.

w|terbentur.text: Lutut Ayu terbentur pembatas jalan ketika ia tersandung di tikungan.
w|terbentur.en: Ayu's knee hit the road barrier when she tripped on a bend.
w|terbentur.ko: 아유는 모퉁이에서 발이 걸려 무릎을 도로 경계석에 부딪쳤어요.

w|terberat.text: Pindah rumah adalah keputusan terberat bagi Andi karena tetangganya begitu baik.
w|terberat.en: Moving was the hardest decision for Andi because his neighbors are so kind.
w|terberat.ko: 이웃들이 너무 좋아서 이사는 안디에게 가장 힘든 결정이었어요.

w|terberat.text: Kata Dewi, bagian terberat lagu itu adalah nada tinggi di akhir.
w|terberat.en: According to Dewi, the hardest part of that song is the high note at the end.
w|terberat.ko: 데위 말로는 그 노래에서 가장 어려운 부분은 끝의 고음이에요.

w|terbesar.en: This is the biggest store in town.

w|terbesar.ko: 그는 제일 큰 집을 갖고 있어.

w|terbiasa.en: I'm already used to waking up early.
w|terbiasa.ko: 난 벌써 일찍 일어나는 데 익숙해.

w|terbiasa.text: Dia belum terbiasa dengan cuaca dingin.
w|terbiasa.en: She is not used to the cold weather yet.
w|terbiasa.ko: 그녀는 아직 추운 날씨에 익숙하지 않아.

w|terbit.text: Matahari terbit lebih awal di musim panas.
w|terbit.en: The sun rises earlier in summer.

w|terbit.text: Buku barunya akan terbit bulan depan.
w|terbit.en: His new book will be published next month.
w|terbit.ko: 그의 새 책은 다음 달에 출간돼.

w|terbodoh.text: Lupa mengunci pagar adalah kesalahan terbodoh Andi minggu ini.
w|terbodoh.en: Forgetting to lock the gate was Andi's dumbest mistake this week.
w|terbodoh.ko: 대문 잠그는 걸 잊은 건 안디가 이번 주에 한 가장 바보 같은 실수였어요.

w|terbodoh.text: Dewi tertawa dan menyebut lupa membawa partitur sebagai kesalahan terbodoh hari itu.
w|terbodoh.en: Dewi laughed and called forgetting the sheet music the dumbest mistake of the day.
w|terbodoh.ko: 데위는 웃으면서 악보를 깜빡한 게 그날 가장 바보 같은 실수였다고 했어요.

w|terbongkar.text: Rencana kejutan untuk ulang tahun Bayu terbongkar karena temannya keceplosan.
w|terbongkar.en: The surprise plan for Bayu's birthday was exposed because his friend let it slip.
w|terbongkar.ko: 친구가 말실수하는 바람에 바유의 생일 깜짝 계획이 들통났어요.

w|terbongkar.text: Rahasia teknik gradasi Intan akhirnya terbongkar saat ia menunjukkan kuasnya.
w|terbongkar.en: The secret of Intan's gradient technique was finally revealed when she showed her brush.
w|terbongkar.ko: 인탄이 붓을 보여 주자 그라데이션 기법의 비밀이 마침내 드러났어요.

w|terbuang.text: Banyak tiket terbuang karena pertunjukan malam dibatalkan.
w|terbuang.en: Many tickets went to waste because the evening show was canceled.
w|terbuang.ko: 저녁 공연이 취소돼서 표가 많이 버려졌어요.

w|terbuang.text: Banyak sayur terbuang karena truk pengangkut tidak datang minggu ini.
w|terbuang.en: A lot of vegetables went to waste because the transport truck didn't come this week.
w|terbuang.ko: 이번 주에 운반 트럭이 안 와서 채소가 많이 버려졌어요.

w|terbuat.text: Meja ini terbuat dari kayu jati.
w|terbuat.en: This table is made of teak wood.

w|terbuat.text: Tas itu terbuat dari kulit asli.
w|terbuat.en: That bag is made of real leather.

w|terbukti.text: Kata Pak Hadi, rajin membaca terbukti meningkatkan nilai murid.
w|terbukti.en: According to Mr. Hadi, reading regularly has been proven to raise students' grades.
w|terbukti.ko: 하디 선생님 말로는 꾸준히 읽으면 성적이 오른다는 게 증명됐대요.

w|terbukti.text: Kardus bekas toko elektronik terbukti lebih kuat daripada kardus biasa.
w|terbukti.en: Boxes from the electronics store proved to be sturdier than ordinary boxes.
w|terbukti.ko: 전자제품 가게에서 얻은 상자가 보통 상자보다 튼튼하다는 게 드러났어요.

w|terbunuh.text: Menurut kabar desa, beberapa ekor kambing terbunuh oleh anjing liar minggu lalu.
w|terbunuh.en: According to village news, several goats were killed by wild dogs last week.
w|terbunuh.ko: 마을 소식에 따르면 지난주에 들개들 때문에 염소 몇 마리가 죽었대요.

w|terbunuh.text: Dalam novel yang dibaca Putri, seorang saksi terbunuh di bab pertama.
w|terbunuh.en: In the novel Putri is reading, a witness is killed in the first chapter.
w|terbunuh.ko: 푸트리가 읽는 소설에서는 첫 장에서 증인 한 명이 살해당해요.

w|terburu-buru.en: In a hurry, he left without his wallet.

w|terburuk.en: This is the worst day of my life.
We must avoid the worst-case scenario.

w|tercantik.text: Menurut Dimas, matahari terbenam di atas laut itu adalah pemandangan tercantik selama perjalanan.
w|tercantik.en: For Dimas, the sunset over the sea was the most beautiful sight of the trip.
w|tercantik.ko: 디마스에게는 바다 위 노을이 여행 중 가장 아름다운 풍경이었어요.

w|tercantik.text: Desainer tim memilih warna tercantik untuk ikon aplikasi yang baru.
w|tercantik.en: The team's designer picked the prettiest color for the new app icon.
w|tercantik.ko: 팀 디자이너가 새 앱 아이콘에 가장 예쁜 색을 골랐어요.

w|tercapai.text: Target nilai Budi semester ini akhirnya tercapai berkat belajar kelompok.
w|tercapai.en: Budi's grade target this semester was finally reached thanks to group study.
w|tercapai.ko: 이번 학기 버디의 성적 목표는 그룹 공부 덕분에 마침내 이루어졌어요.

w|tercapai.text: Harapan Siti untuk panen besar tercapai karena hujan datang tepat waktu.
w|tercapai.en: Siti's hope for a big harvest came true because the rain came right on time.
w|tercapai.ko: 비가 제때 와서 시티의 풍작 바람이 이루어졌어요.

w|tercatat.text: Semua bahan yang masuk ke gudang tercatat rapi di buku Agus.
w|tercatat.en: All the materials that come into the warehouse are neatly recorded in Agus's book.
w|tercatat.ko: 창고에 들어오는 자재는 모두 아구스의 장부에 깔끔하게 기록돼요.

w|tercatat.text: Semua pesanan Wati tercatat di riwayat belanja aplikasinya.
w|tercatat.en: All of Wati's orders are recorded in the app's purchase history.
w|tercatat.ko: 와티의 주문은 전부 앱 구매 내역에 기록돼 있어요.

w|tercekik.text: Dimas hampir tercekik karena tersedak permen saat tertawa di depan diorama.
w|tercekik.en: Dimas almost choked on a candy while laughing in front of the diorama.
w|tercekik.ko: 디마스는 디오라마 앞에서 웃다가 사탕이 걸려 숨이 막힐 뻔했어요.

w|tercekik.text: Leher Putri terasa seperti tercekik karena kerah kostumnya terlalu sempit.
w|tercekik.en: Putri's neck felt like it was being choked because her costume collar was too tight.
w|tercekik.ko: 의상 깃이 너무 좁아서 푸트리는 목이 졸리는 느낌이었어요.

w|tercemar.text: Bayu sedih karena sungai di bagian hilir sudah tercemar limbah pabrik.
w|tercemar.en: Bayu is sad because the river downstream is already polluted with factory waste.
w|tercemar.ko: 바유는 하류의 강이 이미 공장 폐수로 오염돼서 슬퍼요.

w|tercemar.text: Intan memakai masker saat latihan karena udara kota sedang tercemar asap.
w|tercemar.en: Intan wears a mask during training because the city air is polluted with smoke.
w|tercemar.ko: 도시 공기가 연기로 오염돼서 인탄은 훈련할 때 마스크를 써요.

w|tercepat.text: Budi menjadi pelari tercepat di lomba lari antarkelas.
w|tercepat.en: Budi was the fastest runner in the interclass race.
w|tercepat.ko: 부디는 반 대항 달리기에서 가장 빠른 선수였어요.

w|tercepat.text: Rudi masih bangga pernah menjadi perenang tercepat di angkatannya.
w|tercepat.en: Rudi is still proud of once being the fastest swimmer in his year.
w|tercepat.ko: 루디는 자기 학년에서 수영이 가장 빨랐던 걸 아직도 자랑스러워해요.

w|tercinta.text: Rudi menutup suratnya dengan kalimat "Untuk sahabatku tercinta, Bayu."
w|tercinta.en: Rudi closed his letter with the line "To my beloved friend, Bayu."
w|tercinta.ko: 루디는 "사랑하는 친구 바유에게"라는 말로 편지를 맺었어요.

w|tercinta.text: Rina mempersembahkan peluncuran aplikasi itu untuk almarhum kakeknya tercinta.
w|tercinta.en: Rina dedicated the app launch to her beloved late grandfather.
w|tercinta.ko: 리나는 앱 출시를 사랑하는 돌아가신 할아버지께 바쳤어요.

w|tercipta.text: Suasana haru tercipta ketika seluruh pemain menyanyi bersama di akhir pertunjukan.
w|tercipta.en: A moving atmosphere was created when all the actors sang together at the end of the show.
w|tercipta.ko: 공연 마지막에 배우들이 다 함께 노래하자 뭉클한 분위기가 생겼어요.

w|tercipta.text: Persahabatan Ayu dengan nenek di kursi sebelah tercipta hanya dalam satu perjalanan.
w|tercipta.en: Ayu's friendship with the grandmother in the next seat was formed in just one trip.
w|tercipta.ko: 아유와 옆자리 할머니의 우정은 단 한 번의 여행에서 생겼어요.

w|tercium.text: Aroma rendang buatan Rudi tercium sampai ke ruang makan.
w|tercium.en: The smell of Rudi's rendang reached all the way to the dining room.
w|tercium.ko: 루디가 만든 른당 냄새가 식당 홀까지 퍼졌어요.

w|tercium.text: Bau apak tercium dari peti tua yang dibuka Rina.
w|tercium.en: A musty smell came from the old chest Rina opened.
w|tercium.ko: 리나가 연 낡은 궤짝에서 퀴퀴한 냄새가 났어요.

w|terdaftar.text: Nomor pelat motor Andi tidak terdaftar di sistem, jadi petugas memeriksanya lagi.
w|terdaftar.en: Andi's motorbike plate number wasn't registered in the system, so the officer checked it again.
w|terdaftar.ko: 안디 오토바이 번호판이 시스템에 등록돼 있지 않아서 경찰이 다시 확인했어요.

w|terdaftar.text: Nama Dewi sudah terdaftar sebagai kapten untuk musim ini.
w|terdaftar.en: Dewi's name is already registered as captain for this season.
w|terdaftar.ko: 데위 이름은 이번 시즌 주장으로 이미 등록돼 있어요.

w|terdakwa.text: Satu ruang pameran menampilkan foto terdakwa dalam sidang bersejarah tahun lima puluhan.
w|terdakwa.en: One exhibition room shows photos of the defendant in a historic trial from the fifties.
w|terdakwa.ko: 한 전시실에는 오십 년대 역사적 재판의 피고인 사진이 걸려 있어요.

w|terdakwa.text: Para pedagang ramai membahas berita tentang terdakwa kasus pungutan liar di pasar.
w|terdakwa.en: The traders were busy discussing news about the defendant in the market's illegal levy case.
w|terdakwa.ko: 상인들은 시장 불법 징수 사건 피고인 소식으로 시끌벅적했어요.

w|terdalam.text: Kolam renang apartemen itu punya bagian terdalam sekitar dua meter.
w|terdalam.en: The apartment's swimming pool has a deepest section of about two meters.
w|terdalam.ko: 그 아파트 수영장의 가장 깊은 곳은 이 미터쯤 돼요.

w|terdalam.text: Wati bilang bulan Desember selalu menyentuh perasaan terdalam di hatinya.
w|terdalam.en: Wati says December always touches the deepest feelings in her heart.
w|terdalam.ko: 와티는 십이월이 늘 마음속 가장 깊은 감정을 건드린다고 해요.

w|terdampar.text: Andi pernah terdampar di pulau kecil karena kapal mogok, dan ia menceritakannya dengan lucu.
w|terdampar.en: Andi was once stranded on a small island when his boat broke down, and he tells it humorously.
w|terdampar.ko: 안디는 배가 고장 나서 작은 섬에 발이 묶인 적이 있는데 그 얘기를 재밌게 들려줘요.

w|terdampar.text: Saat hujan deras, beberapa pelari terdampar di halte menunggu hujan reda.
w|terdampar.en: When it poured, some runners got stuck at a bus shelter waiting for the rain to ease.
w|terdampar.ko: 비가 쏟아지자 몇몇 주자는 버스 정류장에 발이 묶여 비가 그치길 기다렸어요.

w|terdapat.text: Terdapat banyak toko di sepanjang jalan.
w|terdapat.en: There are many shops along the road.

w|terdapat.text: Di hutan itu terdapat pohon langka.
w|terdapat.en: In that forest there are rare trees.

w|terdekat.en: The nearest store is open until night.

w|terdekat.text: Rumah sakit terdekat hanya beberapa blok.
w|terdekat.en: The nearest hospital is only a few blocks away.
w|terdekat.ko: 가장 가까운 병원은 불과 몇 블록이야.

w|terdepan.text: Koran tempat Bayu bekerja ingin menjadi yang terdepan dalam berita daerah.
w|terdepan.en: The newspaper where Bayu works wants to be the leader in regional news.
w|terdepan.ko: 바유가 일하는 신문사는 지역 뉴스에서 앞서가고 싶어 해요.

w|terdepan.text: Toko itu mengklaim sebagai yang terdepan dalam pengiriman cepat di kota Intan.
w|terdepan.en: The shop claims to be the leader in fast delivery in Intan's city.
w|terdepan.ko: 그 가게는 인탄이 사는 도시에서 빠른 배송으로 앞서 있다고 해요.

w|terdeteksi.text: Gerbang perpustakaan berbunyi karena buku yang belum dipinjam Andi terdeteksi alarm.
w|terdeteksi.en: The library gate beeped because a book Andi hadn't checked out was detected by the alarm.
w|terdeteksi.ko: 안디가 대출하지 않은 책이 경보에 감지돼서 도서관 출입문이 울렸어요.

w|terdeteksi.text: Dewi kaget karena virus terdeteksi di laptop kantornya.
w|terdeteksi.en: Dewi was shocked because a virus was detected on her office laptop.
w|terdeteksi.ko: 디위는 회사 노트북에서 바이러스가 발견돼서 놀랐어요.

w|terdiam.text: Andi terdiam ketika tetangga bercerita tentang anaknya yang sakit keras.
w|terdiam.en: Andi fell silent when the neighbor talked about their seriously ill child.
w|terdiam.ko: 이웃이 중병에 걸린 아이 이야기를 하자 안디는 말을 잃었어요.

w|terdiam.text: Seluruh aula terdiam ketika murid kecil Dewi mulai bernyanyi.
w|terdiam.en: The whole hall fell silent when Dewi's young student began to sing.
w|terdiam.ko: 데위의 어린 제자가 노래를 시작하자 강당 전체가 조용해졌어요.

w|terdiri.text: Tim jaga malam di pabrik itu terdiri dari Dimas dan dua teknisi muda.
w|terdiri.en: The night shift team at the factory consists of Dimas and two young technicians.
w|terdiri.ko: 그 공장의 야간 근무 팀은 디마스와 젊은 기술자 두 명으로 이루어져 있어요.

w|terdiri.text: Surat Putri kali ini terdiri dari tiga halaman penuh cerita.
w|terdiri.en: Putri's letter this time consists of three pages full of stories.
w|terdiri.ko: 이번 푸트리의 편지는 이야기로 가득 찬 세 장으로 되어 있어요.

w|terekam.text: Pencurian vitamin di rak depan terekam kamera pengawas.
w|terekam.en: The theft of vitamins from the front shelf was caught on the security camera.
w|terekam.ko: 앞 선반의 비타민 도난이 감시 카메라에 찍혔어요.

w|terekam.text: Perkenalan rekan baru terekam dalam video rapat daring.
w|terekam.en: The new coworker's introduction was recorded in the online meeting video.
w|terekam.ko: 새 동료의 자기소개가 온라인 회의 영상에 녹화됐어요.

w|terelakkan.text: Agus tahu longsor kecil tak terelakkan kalau hujan turun berhari-hari.
w|terelakkan.en: Agus knows small landslides are unavoidable when it rains for days.
w|terelakkan.ko: 아구스는 비가 며칠씩 내리면 작은 산사태를 피할 수 없다는 걸 알아요.

w|terelakkan.text: Wati menulis bahwa perpisahan mereka dulu memang tak terelakkan.
w|terelakkan.en: Wati wrote that their parting back then had been unavoidable.
w|terelakkan.ko: 와티는 그때 둘의 이별은 어쩔 수 없었다고 썼어요.

w|terendah.text: Pengacara Agus meminta hukuman terendah karena kliennya baru pertama kali melanggar.
w|terendah.en: Agus's lawyer asked for the lowest sentence because it was his client's first offense.
w|terendah.ko: 아구스의 변호사는 의뢰인이 초범이라 가장 낮은 형을 요청했어요.

w|terendah.text: Wati selalu membandingkan harga di pasar dan memilih pemasok dengan harga terendah.
w|terendah.en: Wati always compares market prices and picks the supplier with the lowest price.
w|terendah.ko: 와티는 늘 시장 가격을 비교해서 가장 싼 공급처를 골라요.

w|terganggu.text: Dia terganggu oleh suara bising tetangga.
w|terganggu.en: He was disturbed by the neighbor's noisy sounds.

w|terganggu.text: Terganggu oleh pesan, dia menutup ponsel.
w|terganggu.en: Disturbed by messages, she turned off her phone.

w|tergantung.ko: 모든 건 네 결정에 달려 있어.

w|tergantung.text: Tergantung cuaca, kami bisa pergi atau tidak.
w|tergantung.en: Depending on the weather, we may or may not go.
w|tergantung.ko: 날씨에 따라 갈 수도 있고 안 갈 수도 있어.

w|tergeletak.text: Eko menemukan sebuah sandal tergeletak di atas pasir setelah air surut.
w|tergeletak.en: Eko found a sandal lying on the sand after the tide went out.
w|tergeletak.ko: 물이 빠진 뒤 에코는 모래 위에 놓인 샌들 한 짝을 발견했어요.

w|tergeletak.text: Majalah lama tergeletak di meja ruang tunggu, tapi Ayu terlalu gugup untuk membacanya.
w|tergeletak.en: Old magazines lay on the waiting-room table, but Ayu was too nervous to read them.
w|tergeletak.ko: 대기실 탁자에 오래된 잡지가 놓여 있었지만 아유는 너무 긴장해서 읽지 못했어요.

w|tergelincir.text: Lantai perpustakaan baru dipel, dan Andi hampir tergelincir di tangga.
w|tergelincir.en: The library floor had just been mopped, and Andi nearly slipped on the stairs.
w|tergelincir.ko: 도서관 바닥을 막 걸레질해서 안디는 계단에서 미끄러질 뻔했어요.

w|tergelincir.text: Saat hujan, seorang kurir tergelincir di lobi kantor Dewi.
w|tergelincir.en: When it rained, a courier slipped in the lobby of Dewi's office.
w|tergelincir.ko: 비가 올 때 택배 기사 한 명이 디위네 사무실 로비에서 미끄러졌어요.

w|tergesa-gesa.text: Karena bangun kesiangan, Fajar berangkat dengan tergesa-gesa ke tempat akad.
w|tergesa-gesa.en: Because he overslept, Fajar rushed off to the place of the marriage ceremony.
w|tergesa-gesa.ko: 늦잠을 자서 파자르는 서둘러 혼인 서약 장소로 갔어요.

w|tergesa-gesa.text: Lestari menulis artikel itu dengan tergesa-gesa karena tenggatnya tinggal satu jam.
w|tergesa-gesa.en: Lestari wrote the article in a hurry because the deadline was only an hour away.
w|tergesa-gesa.ko: 마감이 한 시간밖에 안 남아서 레스타리는 기사를 급하게 썼어요.

w|tergila-gila.text: Dalam suratnya, Budi mengaku dulu tergila-gila pada kakak kelas mereka.
w|tergila-gila.en: In his letter, Budi admits he was once crazy about their senior at school.
w|tergila-gila.ko: 부디는 편지에서 예전에 학교 선배에게 푹 빠졌었다고 털어놓아요.

w|tergila-gila.text: Sejak tahun lalu Siti tergila-gila pada lari jarak jauh.
w|tergila-gila.en: Since last year, Siti has been crazy about long-distance running.
w|tergila-gila.ko: 작년부터 시티는 장거리 달리기에 푹 빠졌어요.

w|tergoda.text: Eko sempat tergoda untuk berenang di sungai, tapi arusnya terlalu deras.
w|tergoda.en: Eko was tempted to swim in the river, but the current was too strong.
w|tergoda.ko: 에코는 강에서 수영하고 싶었지만 물살이 너무 셌어요.

w|tergoda.text: Ayu sempat tergoda untuk berhenti dan naik bus panitia.
w|tergoda.en: Ayu was tempted to stop and get on the organizers' bus.
w|tergoda.ko: 아유는 멈추고 주최 측 버스에 타고 싶은 유혹을 느꼈어요.

w|tergores.text: Tangan Dimas tergores ujung lemari arsip yang tajam.
w|tergores.en: Dimas's hand got scratched on the sharp corner of the filing cabinet.
w|tergores.ko: 디마스의 손이 서류함의 날카로운 모서리에 긁혔어요.

w|tergores.text: Koper baru Putri tergores saat keluar dari ban bagasi.
w|tergores.en: Putri's new suitcase got scratched as it came off the baggage belt.
w|tergores.ko: 푸트리의 새 가방이 수하물 벨트에서 나오다가 긁혔어요.

w|terguncang.text: Gedung apartemen itu sempat terguncang saat gempa kecil kemarin.
w|terguncang.en: The apartment building shook during the small earthquake yesterday.
w|terguncang.ko: 어제 작은 지진 때 그 아파트 건물이 잠시 흔들렸어요.

w|terguncang.text: Pohon kelapa di depan rumah Wati terguncang hebat diterpa angin badai.
w|terguncang.en: The coconut tree in front of Wati's house shook violently in the storm winds.
w|terguncang.ko: 와티네 집 앞 야자나무가 폭풍에 심하게 흔들렸어요.

w|terhadap.text: Terhadap masalah ini, kita harus hati-hati.
w|terhadap.en: Regarding this problem, we must be careful.
w|terhadap.ko: 이 문제에 대해 우리는 조심해야 해.

w|terhalang.text: Pintu darurat apotek terhalang kardus obat, jadi Fajar segera memindahkan kardus itu.
w|terhalang.en: The pharmacy's emergency exit was blocked by boxes of medicine, so Fajar moved them right away.
w|terhalang.ko: 약국 비상문이 약 상자에 막혀 있어서 파자르가 바로 옮겼어요.

w|terhalang.text: Pandangan Lestari ke papan tulis terhalang monitor besar.
w|terhalang.en: Lestari's view of the whiteboard is blocked by a big monitor.
w|terhalang.ko: 큰 모니터 때문에 레스타리는 화이트보드가 안 보여요.

w|terhapus.text: Tugas Budi terhapus dari laptop, jadi ia harus mengetik ulang semalaman.
w|terhapus.en: Budi's assignment was deleted from his laptop, so he had to retype it all night.
w|terhapus.ko: 버디의 과제가 노트북에서 지워져서 밤새 다시 타이핑해야 했어요.

w|terhapus.text: Jejak kaki di halaman rumah Siti terhapus oleh hujan semalam.
w|terhapus.en: The footprints in Siti's yard were washed away by last night's rain.
w|terhapus.ko: 시티네 마당의 발자국이 밤새 내린 비에 지워졌어요.

w|terhebat.en: That was the greatest moment in his career.
w|terhebat.ko: 그게 그의 경력에서 가장 위대한 순간이었어.

w|terhebat.text: Tim terhebat tahun ini meraih piala.
w|terhebat.en: This year's greatest team won the trophy.

w|terhenti.text: Pelajaran olahraga terhenti karena hujan, dan Budi kembali ke kelas dengan kecewa.
w|terhenti.en: PE class stopped because of the rain, and Budi went back to the classroom disappointed.
w|terhenti.ko: 비 때문에 체육 수업이 멈춰서 버디는 실망한 채 교실로 돌아갔어요.

w|terhenti.text: Begitu musim hujan tiba, pekerjaan menjemur padi di halaman rumah Siti terhenti.
w|terhenti.en: As soon as the rainy season arrived, the rice drying in Siti's yard came to a stop.
w|terhenti.ko: 우기가 오자마자 시티네 마당에서 벼를 말리는 일이 멈췄어요.

w|terhindar.text: Berkat pemeriksaan ulang, koran itu terhindar dari kesalahan nama narasumber.
w|terhindar.en: Thanks to double-checking, the paper avoided getting a source's name wrong.
w|terhindar.ko: 다시 확인한 덕분에 그 신문은 취재원 이름을 틀리는 실수를 피했어요.

w|terhindar.text: Dengan membandingkan ulasan, Intan terhindar dari penjual yang suka menipu.
w|terhindar.en: By comparing reviews, Intan avoided sellers who like to cheat.
w|terhindar.ko: 후기를 비교해 본 덕분에 인탄은 사기 치는 판매자를 피했어요.

w|terhitung.text: Jumlah tamu yang datang terhitung lebih dari lima ratus orang.
w|terhitung.en: The number of guests who came was counted at more than five hundred.
w|terhitung.ko: 온 하객 수는 오백 명이 넘는 것으로 집계됐어요.

w|terhitung.text: Musim hujan tahun ini terhitung lebih panjang dari biasanya.
w|terhitung.en: This year's rainy season is considered longer than usual.

w|terhormat.text: Tamu terhormat duduk di barisan depan.
w|terhormat.en: The honored guests sat in the front row.

w|terhormat.text: Beliau adalah tokoh terhormat di desa ini.
w|terhormat.en: He is a respected figure in this village.

w|terhubung.text: Terhubung ke jaringan membuat kerja lebih mudah.
w|terhubung.en: Being connected to the network makes work easier.

w|terhubung.text: Kedua kota itu terhubung oleh jembatan.
w|terhubung.en: Those two cities are connected by a bridge.
w|terhubung.ko: 그 두 도시는 다리로 이어져 있어.

w|teriakan.text: Dari ruang kerjanya, Agus bisa mendengar teriakan para demonstran di luar.
w|teriakan.en: From his office, Agus could hear the shouts of the protesters outside.
w|teriakan.ko: 아구스는 사무실에서 밖의 시위대 외침을 들을 수 있었어요.

w|teriakan.text: Dari ruang vokal terdengar teriakan latihan pemanasan suara.
w|teriakan.en: From the vocal room came the shouts of voice warm-up exercises.
w|teriakan.ko: 성악실에서 발성 연습하는 소리가 크게 들렸어요.

w|terik.text: Eko memetik kopi sebelum matahari terik.
w|terik.en: Eko picks coffee before the sun gets scorching.
w|terik.ko: 에코는 햇볕이 뜨거워지기 전에 커피를 따요.

w|terik.text: Siang itu panas terik membuat gudang pabrik terasa seperti oven.
w|terik.en: That afternoon the blazing heat made the factory warehouse feel like an oven.
w|terik.ko: 그날 오후 뙤약볕에 공장 창고가 오븐처럼 달아올랐어요.

w|terikat.text: Dia merasa terikat dengan janji itu.
w|terikat.en: She feels bound by that promise.
w|terikat.ko: 그는 그 약속에 묶여 있다고 느껴.

w|terikat.text: Tali itu terikat kuat di tiang.
w|terikat.en: That rope is tied tightly to the pole.
w|terikat.ko: 그 밧줄이 기둥에 단단히 묶여 있어.

w|terindah.text: Bagi Fajar, hari itu adalah hari terindah dalam hidupnya.
w|terindah.en: For Fajar, that day was the most beautiful day of his life.
w|terindah.ko: 파자르에게 그날은 인생에서 가장 아름다운 날이었어요.

w|terindah.text: Menurut Lestari, senja di akhir musim kemarau adalah pemandangan terindah di kampungnya.
w|terindah.en: According to Lestari, dusk at the end of the dry season is the most beautiful sight in her village.
w|terindah.ko: 레스타리는 건기 끝의 노을이 마을에서 가장 아름다운 풍경이라고 해요.

w|terinfeksi.en: Several computers were infected by a dangerous virus.

w|terinfeksi.text: Luka itu terinfeksi karena tidak dibersihkan.
w|terinfeksi.en: That wound got infected because it was not cleaned.

w|teringat.text: Saat ujian, Andi tiba-tiba teringat rumus yang diajarkan kakaknya.
w|teringat.en: During the exam, Andi suddenly remembered the formula his sister taught him.
w|teringat.ko: 시험 중에 안디는 누나가 가르쳐 준 공식이 갑자기 떠올랐어요.

w|teringat.text: Melihat kue nastar, Dewi teringat almarhumah neneknya.
w|teringat.en: Seeing the pineapple tarts, Dewi remembered her late grandmother.
w|teringat.ko: 파인애플 타르트를 보자 데위는 돌아가신 할머니가 생각났어요.

w|terinspirasi.text: Judul tulisan itu terinspirasi dari obrolan Fajar dengan tukang parkir.
w|terinspirasi.en: The headline was inspired by Fajar's chat with a parking attendant.
w|terinspirasi.ko: 그 기사 제목은 파자르가 주차 요원과 나눈 대화에서 영감을 받았어요.

w|terinspirasi.text: Lestari terinspirasi oleh hamparan sawah dan mulai menulis puisi di mobil.
w|terinspirasi.en: Lestari was inspired by the stretch of rice fields and started writing a poem in the car.
w|terinspirasi.ko: 레스타리는 펼쳐진 논에 영감을 받아 차 안에서 시를 쓰기 시작했어요.

w|terisi.text: Lembar jawaban Dimas sudah terisi semua sebelum waktu habis.
w|terisi.en: Dimas's answer sheet was completely filled in before time ran out.
w|terisi.ko: 시간이 끝나기 전에 디마스의 답안지가 다 채워졌어요.

w|terisi.text: Malam Minggu, semua meja di restoran Putri sudah terisi sejak jam tujuh.
w|terisi.en: On Saturday night, every table at Putri's restaurant was full from seven o'clock.
w|terisi.ko: 토요일 밤이면 푸트리네 식당 테이블은 일곱 시부터 다 차요.

w|terisolasi.text: Lapak kecil Agus agak terisolasi di pojok, jauh dari keramaian.
w|terisolasi.en: Agus's small stall is rather isolated in the corner, far from the crowd.
w|terisolasi.ko: 아구스의 작은 노점은 구석에 있어서 사람들 북적이는 데서 좀 떨어져 있어요.

w|terisolasi.text: Desa nenek Wati sempat terisolasi karena jalan tertutup banjir.
w|terisolasi.en: Wati's grandmother's village was briefly cut off because the road was flooded.
w|terisolasi.ko: 와티 할머니의 마을은 길이 물에 잠겨 한동안 고립됐어요.

w|terjadi.ko: 이런 일은 다시 안 생길 거야.

w|terjaga.text: Dia terjaga sepanjang malam karena khawatir.
w|terjaga.en: He stayed awake all night because of worry.
w|terjaga.ko: 그는 걱정 때문에 밤새 깨어 있었어.

w|terjaga.text: Terjaga dari mimpi buruk membuatnya gemetar.
w|terjaga.en: Waking from a nightmare made him tremble.

w|terjatuh.text: Dia terjatuh dari sepeda di jalan licin.
w|terjatuh.en: He fell off his bike on the slippery road.

w|terjatuh.text: Buku itu terjatuh dari rak yang tinggi.
w|terjatuh.en: That book fell from the high shelf.

w|terjawab.text: Pertanyaan Budi tentang kabar keluarga Andi akhirnya terjawab di surat ini.
w|terjawab.en: Budi's question about Andi's family was finally answered in this letter.
w|terjawab.ko: 안디 가족 소식에 대한 부디의 질문은 이 편지에서 마침내 답을 얻었어요.

w|terjawab.text: Rasa penasaran Siti tentang batas kemampuannya akhirnya terjawab hari itu.
w|terjawab.en: Siti's curiosity about the limits of her ability was finally answered that day.
w|terjawab.ko: 자기 능력의 한계가 궁금했던 시티는 그날 마침내 답을 얻었어요.

w|terjemahan.text: Perpustakaan baru menerima terjemahan karya sastra dari berbagai bahasa.
w|terjemahan.en: The library has just received translations of literary works from various languages.
w|terjemahan.ko: 도서관에 여러 언어에서 옮긴 문학 번역서가 새로 들어왔어요.

w|terjemahan.text: Papan pengumuman di stasiun dilengkapi terjemahan dalam bahasa Inggris.
w|terjemahan.en: The notice board at the station comes with an English translation.
w|terjemahan.ko: 역 안내판에는 영어 번역이 함께 적혀 있어요.

w|terjepit.text: Jari Budi terjepit pintu lemari kelas saat mengambil buku.
w|terjepit.en: Budi's finger got caught in the classroom cupboard door when he took out a book.
w|terjepit.ko: 부디는 책을 꺼내다가 교실 사물함 문에 손가락이 끼었어요.

w|terjepit.text: Syal Siti terjepit di ritsleting tasnya saat pemeriksaan keamanan.
w|terjepit.en: Siti's scarf got caught in her bag's zipper during the security check.
w|terjepit.ko: 보안 검색 때 시티의 스카프가 가방 지퍼에 끼었어요.

w|terjual.text: Mesin tik yang diincar Bayu ternyata sudah terjual sejak pagi.
w|terjual.en: The typewriter Bayu had his eye on had already been sold that morning.
w|terjual.ko: 바유가 노리던 타자기는 알고 보니 아침에 이미 팔렸어요.

w|terjual.text: Sisa kain kebaya Intan dijadikan dompet kecil dan terjual habis di bazar keluarga.
w|terjual.en: The leftover fabric from Intan's kebaya was made into small purses that sold out at the family bazaar.
w|terjual.ko: 인탄의 크바야를 만들고 남은 천으로 작은 지갑을 만들었더니 가족 바자회에서 다 팔렸어요.

w|terjun.text: Atlet itu siap terjun dari menara tinggi.
w|terjun.en: That athlete is ready to dive from the high tower.
w|terjun.ko: 그 선수가 높은 타워에서 뛰어내릴 준비됐어.

w|terjun.text: Dia memutuskan terjun ke dunia bisnis.
w|terjun.en: He decided to jump into the business world.

w|terkait.text: Masalah ini terkait dengan kebijakan baru.
w|terkait.en: This issue is related to the new policy.
w|terkait.ko: 이 문제는 새 정책과 관련돼 있어.

w|terkait.text: Dokumen terkait sudah dikirim ke kantor.
w|terkait.en: The related documents have been sent to the office.

w|terkaya.text: Menurut data yang dibaca Fajar, kecamatan terkaya di kota ini justru punya taman paling sedikit.
w|terkaya.en: According to the data Fajar read, the wealthiest district in the city actually has the fewest parks.
w|terkaya.ko: 파자르가 본 자료에 따르면 이 도시에서 가장 부유한 구가 오히려 공원이 제일 적어요.

w|terkaya.text: Lestari bercanda bahwa ia mungkin bukan orang terkaya, tapi punya sahabat terbaik.
w|terkaya.en: Lestari joked that she might not be the richest person, but she has the best friend.
w|terkaya.ko: 레스타리는 자기가 제일 부자는 아니어도 최고의 친구가 있다고 농담했어요.

w|terkecil.text: Sebagai karyawan baru, Dimas mendapat meja terkecil di pojok ruangan.
w|terkecil.en: As the new employee, Dimas got the smallest desk in the corner of the room.
w|terkecil.ko: 신입이라 디마스는 방구석의 가장 작은 책상을 받았어요.

w|terkecil.text: Putri memilih koper terkecil yang masih muat di kabin.
w|terkecil.en: Putri chose the smallest suitcase that would still fit in the cabin.
w|terkecil.ko: 푸트리는 기내에 들어가는 가장 작은 가방을 골랐어요.

w|terkejut.en: I was surprised to hear that news.

w|terkemuka.text: Kakak Rudi baru diterima magang di sebuah firma hukum terkemuka.
w|terkemuka.en: Rudi's sister was just accepted for an internship at a prominent law firm.
w|terkemuka.ko: 루디의 누나는 유명한 법률 사무소에 인턴으로 막 붙었어요.

w|terkemuka.text: Pantai itu pernah diulas oleh majalah wisata terkemuka.
w|terkemuka.en: That beach was once reviewed by a leading travel magazine.
w|terkemuka.ko: 그 해변은 유명한 여행 잡지에 소개된 적이 있어요.

w|terkena.text: Dia terkena hujan di perjalanan pulang.
w|terkena.en: He got caught in the rain on the way home.
w|terkena.ko: 그는 집에 가는 길에 비를 맞았어.

w|terkena.en: Getting hit by the ball made his cheek turn red.

w|terkendali.text: Rudi menulis bahwa keadaan keuangannya sekarang sudah lebih terkendali.
w|terkendali.en: Rudi wrote that his finances are now more under control.
w|terkendali.ko: 루디는 이제 형편이 좀 더 안정됐다고 썼어요.

w|terkendali.text: Setelah diperbaiki, pemakaian memori aplikasi itu sudah terkendali.
w|terkendali.en: After the fix, the app's memory usage is under control.
w|terkendali.ko: 고친 뒤로 앱의 메모리 사용량이 안정됐어요.

w|terkepung.text: Hotel itu sempat terkepung banjir sehingga tamu tidak bisa keluar.
w|terkepung.en: The hotel was surrounded by floodwater for a while, so the guests couldn't go out.
w|terkepung.ko: 그 호텔은 한동안 물에 갇혀서 손님들이 밖에 나갈 수 없었어요.

w|terkepung.text: Desa Rina sempat terkepung asap kebakaran hutan saat kemarau panjang.
w|terkepung.en: Rina's village was once engulfed by smoke from forest fires during a long dry season.
w|terkepung.ko: 긴 건기에 리나네 마을이 산불 연기에 휩싸인 적이 있어요.

w|terkesan.en: Guests are impressed by the staff's kindness.

w|terkesan.text: Terkesan sekali dia mendengar pidato itu.
w|terkesan.en: He was so impressed hearing that speech.
w|terkesan.ko: 그 연설을 듣고 그는 정말 감명받았어.

w|terkilir.text: Fajar memberikan salep untuk pergelangan kaki yang terkilir.
w|terkilir.en: Fajar gave an ointment for the sprained ankle.
w|terkilir.ko: 파자르는 삔 발목에 바를 연고를 줬어요.

w|terkilir.text: Rekan baru Lestari datang pincang karena kaki terkilir saat main futsal.
w|terkilir.en: Lestari's new coworker came in limping after spraining an ankle playing futsal.
w|terkilir.ko: 레스타리의 새 동료는 풋살을 하다 발을 삐어서 절뚝이며 왔어요.

w|terkirim.text: Kue tart pesanan pelanggan sudah terkirim, jadi Agus bisa istirahat sebentar.
w|terkirim.en: The customer's tart has been delivered, so Agus can rest for a bit.
w|terkirim.ko: 손님이 주문한 타르트가 배달돼서 아구스는 잠깐 쉴 수 있어요.

w|terkirim.text: Notifikasi gagal terkirim ke ribuan pengguna, dan Wati langsung memeriksa server.
w|terkirim.en: Notifications failed to reach thousands of users, and Wati immediately checked the server.
w|terkirim.ko: 알림이 수천 명에게 전송되지 않자 와티는 바로 서버를 확인했어요.

w|terkontaminasi.text: Rudi memakai sarung tangan agar barang bukti tidak terkontaminasi.
w|terkontaminasi.en: Rudi wears gloves so the evidence doesn't get contaminated.
w|terkontaminasi.ko: 루디는 증거물이 오염되지 않게 장갑을 껴요.

w|terkontaminasi.text: Rina membuang perban yang sudah terkontaminasi darah.
w|terkontaminasi.en: Rina threw away the bandages contaminated with blood.

w|terkuat.text: Dia adalah pemain terkuat di tim itu.
w|terkuat.en: He is the strongest player on that team.
w|terkuat.ko: 그는 그 팀에서 가장 강한 선수야.

w|terkuat.en: Being the strongest does not always mean winning.
w|terkuat.ko: 가장 강하다고 해서 항상 이기는 건 아니야.

w|terkubur.text: Kelas Rudi menemukan kapsul waktu yang terkubur di halaman sekolah sejak lama.
w|terkubur.en: Rudi's class found a time capsule that had long been buried in the schoolyard.
w|terkubur.ko: 루디네 반은 오래전 학교 마당에 묻혀 있던 타임캡슐을 찾았어요.

w|terkubur.text: Saat menggali kebun, Rina menemukan kelereng tua yang terkubur di tanah.
w|terkubur.en: While digging the garden, Rina found old marbles buried in the soil.
w|terkubur.ko: 정원을 파다가 리나는 땅에 묻혀 있던 오래된 구슬을 찾았어요.

w|terkunci.en: His room door is locked from inside.

w|terkunci.text: Teleponku terkunci dan aku lupa kodenya.
w|terkunci.en: My phone is locked and I forgot the code.

w|terkurung.text: Andi menulis bahwa ia merasa terkurung di rumah selama musim hujan.
w|terkurung.en: Andi writes that he felt cooped up at home during the rainy season.
w|terkurung.ko: 안디는 우기 동안 집에 갇힌 기분이었다고 써요.

w|terkurung.text: Saat pandemi, Siti merasa terkurung karena tidak bisa berlari di luar.
w|terkurung.en: During the pandemic, Siti felt trapped because she couldn't run outside.
w|terkurung.ko: 팬데믹 때 시티는 밖에서 달릴 수 없어 갇힌 기분이었어요.

w|terkutuk.en: In the story, that forest is cursed.

w|terkutuk.text: Terkutuk sekali hari yang buruk ini.
w|terkutuk.en: This awful day feels so cursed.
w|terkutuk.ko: 이 재수 없는 날은 정말 저주받은 것 같아.

w|terlacak.text: Kambing Agus yang hilang akhirnya terlacak berkat jejak kaki di lumpur.
w|terlacak.en: Agus's missing goat was finally tracked down thanks to footprints in the mud.
w|terlacak.ko: 아구스의 잃어버린 염소는 진흙에 남은 발자국 덕분에 마침내 찾아냈어요.

w|terlacak.text: Surat Wati sempat hilang, tetapi akhirnya terlacak di kantor pos lain.
w|terlacak.en: Wati's letter went missing for a while, but it was eventually traced to another post office.
w|terlacak.ko: 와티의 편지는 한동안 사라졌지만 결국 다른 우체국에서 찾았어요.

w|terlahir.text: Bayi itu terlahir sehat tadi pagi.
w|terlahir.en: That baby was born healthy this morning.
w|terlahir.ko: 그 아기는 오늘 아침 건강하게 태어났어.

w|terlahir.text: Dia terlahir dengan bakat musik yang kuat.
w|terlahir.en: She was born with a strong musical talent.
w|terlahir.ko: 그는 강한 음악 재능을 갖고 태어났어.

w|terlanjur.text: Ketika Rudi tiba, pelaku sudah terlanjur kabur dengan motor.
w|terlanjur.en: When Rudi arrived, the culprit had already escaped on a motorbike.
w|terlanjur.ko: 루디가 도착했을 때 범인은 이미 오토바이를 타고 달아난 뒤였어요.

w|terlanjur.text: Rina sudah terlanjur menyiapkan obat sebelum pemilik kucing membatalkan janji.
w|terlanjur.en: Rina had already prepared the medicine before the cat's owner canceled the appointment.
w|terlanjur.ko: 고양이 주인이 예약을 취소하기 전에 리나는 이미 약을 준비해 버렸어요.

w|terlarang.text: Kamera dengan lampu kilat terlarang di ruang naskah kuno.
w|terlarang.en: Cameras with flash are forbidden in the ancient manuscript room.
w|terlarang.ko: 옛 필사본 전시실에서는 플래시 촬영이 금지예요.

w|terlarang.text: Menjual satwa liar dilindungi adalah kegiatan terlarang di pasar itu.
w|terlarang.en: Selling protected wild animals is a forbidden activity at that market.
w|terlarang.ko: 그 시장에서 보호 야생동물을 파는 건 금지된 일이에요.

w|terlatih.text: Menurut jaksa, anjing pelacak yang terlatih menemukan barang bukti di gudang.
w|terlatih.en: According to the prosecutor, a trained sniffer dog found the evidence in the warehouse.
w|terlatih.ko: 검사에 따르면 훈련된 탐지견이 창고에서 증거물을 찾아냈어요.

w|terlatih.text: Kucing Lestari sudah terlatih untuk tidak naik ke meja kasir.
w|terlatih.en: Lestari's cat has been trained not to climb onto the counter.
w|terlatih.ko: 레스타리의 고양이는 계산대에 올라가지 않도록 훈련돼 있어요.

w|terlebih.en: Moreover, the weather is bad right now.

w|terlebih.text: Dia lelah, terlebih setelah perjalanan jauh.
w|terlebih.en: He is tired, especially after a long trip.
w|terlebih.ko: 그는 피곤해, 특히 긴 여행 뒤에는 더.

w|terlempar.text: Ponsel Fajar terlempar ke bawah meja ketika ia tersandung kabel.
w|terlempar.en: Fajar's phone was flung under the desk when he tripped over a cable.
w|terlempar.ko: 파자르가 전선에 걸려 넘어지면서 휴대폰이 책상 밑으로 날아갔어요.

w|terlempar.text: Saat rapat daring, Lestari merasa seperti terlempar dari obrolan karena sinyalnya putus-putus.
w|terlempar.en: During the online meeting, Lestari felt like she'd been thrown out of the conversation because her signal kept cutting out.
w|terlempar.ko: 온라인 회의 때 신호가 자꾸 끊겨서 레스타리는 대화에서 튕겨 나간 기분이었어요.

w|terlepas.text: Kunci terlepas dari gantungan di tas.
w|terlepas.en: The key came loose from the hook on the bag.

w|terlepas.text: Terlepas dari kesalahan, dia tetap jujur.
w|terlepas.en: Apart from the mistake, he remained honest.

w|terletak.text: Perpustakaan sekolah terletak di lantai dua, dekat ruang guru.
w|terletak.en: The school library is located on the second floor, near the teachers' room.
w|terletak.ko: 학교 도서관은 교무실 근처 이 층에 있어요.

w|terletak.text: Rumah baru Siti terletak di ujung gang yang tenang.
w|terletak.en: Siti's new house is located at the end of a quiet alley.
w|terletak.ko: 시티의 새집은 조용한 골목 끝에 있어요.

w|terlewat.text: Pesanan roti tawar hampir terlewat karena Agus salah membaca catatan.
w|terlewat.en: An order for white bread was almost missed because Agus misread his notes.
w|terlewat.ko: 아구스가 메모를 잘못 읽어서 식빵 주문을 놓칠 뻔했어요.

w|terlewat.text: Wati memasang pengingat supaya tidak ada rapat yang terlewat.
w|terlewat.en: Wati sets reminders so no meeting gets missed.
w|terlewat.ko: 와티는 회의를 하나도 놓치지 않게 알림을 맞춰 둬요.

w|terlibat.en: Don't get involved in this problem.

w|terlindungi.text: Hakim memastikan identitas saksi kunci tetap terlindungi selama sidang berlangsung.
w|terlindungi.en: The judge made sure the key witness's identity stayed protected throughout the trial.
w|terlindungi.ko: 판사는 재판 내내 핵심 증인의 신원이 보호되도록 했어요.

w|terlindungi.text: Teras restoran keluarga Wati kini terlindungi dari hujan berkat atap kaca yang baru.
w|terlindungi.en: The terrace of Wati's family restaurant is now protected from the rain thanks to a new glass roof.
w|terlindungi.ko: 와티네 가족 식당 테라스는 새 유리 지붕 덕분에 이제 비를 피할 수 있어요.

w|terluka.en: His feelings were hurt by your words.

w|terlupakan.text: Saking sibuknya dapur, pesanan meja sudut sempat terlupakan.
w|terlupakan.en: The kitchen was so busy that the corner table's order was briefly forgotten.
w|terlupakan.ko: 주방이 너무 바빠서 구석 테이블 주문을 잠깐 잊어버렸어요.

w|terlupakan.text: Banyak mainan yang sudah lama terlupakan muncul lagi di pasar loak.
w|terlupakan.en: Many long-forgotten toys show up again at the flea market.
w|terlupakan.ko: 오랫동안 잊혔던 장난감들이 벼룩시장에 다시 나타나요.

w|termuda.text: Bayu adalah wartawan termuda di meja redaksi olahraga.
w|termuda.en: Bayu is the youngest reporter on the sports desk.

w|termuda.text: Intan adalah anak termuda di keluarganya dan paling sering membantu ibu di dapur.
w|termuda.en: Intan is the youngest child in her family and helps her mother in the kitchen the most.
w|termuda.ko: 인탄은 집안의 막내라 엄마의 부엌일을 가장 자주 도와요.

w|termudah.text: Jalan setapak lewat kebun teh adalah rute termudah menuju puncak.
w|termudah.en: The footpath through the tea garden is the easiest route to the summit.
w|termudah.ko: 차밭을 지나는 오솔길이 정상으로 가는 가장 쉬운 길이에요.

w|termudah.text: Ayu mencari cara termudah untuk merapikan gudang bahan baku.
w|termudah.en: Ayu is looking for the easiest way to tidy up the raw materials warehouse.
w|termudah.ko: 아유는 원자재 창고를 정리할 가장 쉬운 방법을 찾고 있어요.

w|ternak.text: Di tepi sungai, Agus menggiring ternak keluarganya ke padang rumput.
w|ternak.en: At the riverbank, Agus herds his family's livestock to the meadow.
w|ternak.ko: 강가에서 아구스는 집안 가축을 풀밭으로 몰고 가요.

w|ternak.text: Wati sering melayani peternak yang membeli vitamin untuk ternak mereka.
w|ternak.en: Wati often serves farmers who buy vitamins for their livestock.
w|ternak.ko: 와티는 가축 비타민을 사러 오는 축산 농가를 자주 응대해요.

w|ternilai.text: Bagi Eko, tepuk tangan penonton adalah hadiah yang tak ternilai.
w|ternilai.en: For Eko, the audience's applause is a priceless gift.
w|ternilai.ko: 에코에게 관객의 박수는 값을 매길 수 없는 선물이에요.

w|ternilai.text: Pemandangan matahari terbit dari jendela kereta itu tak ternilai bagi Ayu.
w|ternilai.en: The view of the sunrise from the train window was priceless to Ayu.
w|ternilai.ko: 열차 창밖으로 본 해돋이는 아유에게 무엇과도 바꿀 수 없었어요.

w|ternyata.en: It turns out he already knew.
w|ternyata.ko: 알고 보니 그는 이미 알고 있었어.

w|ternyata.en: I turned out to be wrong.

w|terobosan.text: Lantai beton cepat kering ini dianggap terobosan besar di dunia konstruksi.
w|terobosan.en: This quick-drying concrete floor is considered a big breakthrough in construction.
w|terobosan.ko: 이 빨리 마르는 콘크리트 바닥은 건설 업계의 큰 혁신으로 여겨져요.

w|terobosan.text: Fitur coba baju secara virtual ini dianggap terobosan oleh banyak pembeli.
w|terobosan.en: This virtual try-on feature is considered a breakthrough by many shoppers.
w|terobosan.ko: 이 가상 옷 입어 보기 기능을 많은 구매자가 혁신이라고 생각해요.

w|terobsesi.text: Dia terobsesi dengan koleksi perangko lama.
w|terobsesi.en: He is obsessed with his old stamp collection.

w|terobsesi.text: Remaja itu terobsesi bermain game sepanjang hari.
w|terobsesi.en: That teen is obsessed with playing games all day.
w|terobsesi.ko: 그 청소년이 하루 종일 게임에 집착해.

w|terompet.text: Di halaman perpustakaan, anak-anak berlatih meniup terompet untuk karnaval.
w|terompet.en: In the library yard, children practice blowing trumpets for the carnival.
w|terompet.ko: 도서관 마당에서 아이들이 축제에 쓸 트럼펫 부는 연습을 해요.

w|terompet.text: Di pesta ulang tahun kantor, seseorang meniup terompet kertas di belakang Dewi.
w|terompet.en: At the office anniversary party, someone blew a paper trumpet behind Dewi.
w|terompet.ko: 회사 창립 기념 파티에서 누군가 디위 뒤에서 종이 나팔을 불었어요.

w|teropong.text: Dengan teropong tua, Agus mengamati elang yang terbang di atas lembah.
w|teropong.en: With an old pair of binoculars, Agus watched an eagle flying over the valley.
w|teropong.ko: 아구스는 낡은 쌍안경으로 골짜기 위를 나는 독수리를 지켜봤어요.

w|teropong.text: Wati mengirim teropong kecil sebagai hadiah untuk sahabat yang suka mengamati burung.
w|teropong.en: Wati sent small binoculars as a gift to her friend who loves birdwatching.
w|teropong.ko: 와티는 새 관찰을 좋아하는 친구에게 작은 쌍안경을 선물로 보냈어요.

w|teror.text: Guru sejarah menjelaskan bagaimana teror bom pernah mengguncang ibu kota.
w|teror.en: The history teacher explained how a bombing once shook the capital.
w|teror.ko: 역사 선생님은 폭탄 테러가 한때 수도를 뒤흔든 일을 설명했어요.

w|teror.text: Dulu, ulangan matematika dadakan adalah teror bagi Siti dan teman-temannya.
w|teror.en: Back then, surprise maths quizzes were a terror for Siti and her friends.
w|teror.ko: 예전에 수학 쪽지 시험은 시티와 친구들에게 공포 그 자체였어요.

w|terorganisasi.text: Lemari arsip di meja Fajar sangat terorganisasi, setiap map punya label warna.
w|terorganisasi.en: The filing cabinet at Fajar's desk is very well organized, with a color label on every folder.
w|terorganisasi.ko: 파자르 책상의 서류함은 폴더마다 색 라벨이 붙어 있을 만큼 정리가 잘돼 있어요.

w|terorganisasi.text: Lestari ingin tim kecilnya tetap terorganisasi walaupun semua orang bekerja dari jauh.
w|terorganisasi.en: Lestari wants her small team to stay organized even though everyone works remotely.
w|terorganisasi.ko: 레스타리는 모두 원격으로 일해도 작은 팀이 체계적으로 움직이길 바라요.

w|teroris.en: That terrorist was caught at the border.

w|teroris.text: Berita tentang teroris membuat warga takut.
w|teroris.en: News about the terrorist made residents afraid.

w|terorisme.text: Bayu pernah meliput seminar tentang pencegahan terorisme di kampus.
w|terorisme.en: Bayu once covered a seminar on preventing terrorism at a university.
w|terorisme.ko: 바유는 대학에서 열린 테러 예방 세미나를 취재한 적이 있어요.

w|terorisme.text: Seorang klien meminta Intan membuat sistem keamanan untuk mendeteksi pendanaan terorisme.
w|terorisme.en: A client asked Intan to build a security system to detect terrorism financing.
w|terorisme.ko: 한 고객이 인탄에게 테러 자금을 잡아내는 보안 시스템을 만들어 달라고 했어요.

w|terowongan.en: That tunnel is dark and long.

w|terowongan.text: Kereta masuk ke terowongan dengan pelan.
w|terowongan.en: The train entered the tunnel slowly.

w|terpaksa.en: She was forced to cancel that trip.
w|terpaksa.ko: 그는 어쩔 수 없이 그 여행을 취소했어.

w|terpaksa.en: We had to wait because of the rain.
w|terpaksa.ko: 비 때문에 우리는 어쩔 수 없이 기다렸어.

w|terpaku.text: Budi terpaku di depan papan pengumuman saat melihat namanya di daftar juara.
w|terpaku.en: Budi stood frozen in front of the notice board when he saw his name on the winners' list.
w|terpaku.ko: 우승자 명단에서 자기 이름을 본 버디는 게시판 앞에 얼어붙은 듯 서 있었어요.

w|terpaku.text: Siti terpaku di jendela memandangi hujan pertama yang jatuh di kebunnya.
w|terpaku.en: Siti stood rooted at the window, watching the first rain fall on her garden.
w|terpaku.ko: 시티는 창가에 꼼짝 않고 서서 정원에 내리는 첫 비를 바라봤어요.

w|terpanas.text: Agustus adalah bulan terpanas, jadi kolam renang hotel selalu ramai.
w|terpanas.en: August is the hottest month, so the hotel pool is always crowded.
w|terpanas.ko: 팔월은 가장 더운 달이라 호텔 수영장이 늘 붐벼요.

w|terpanas.text: Berita pagi menyebut kemarin sebagai hari terpanas tahun ini.
w|terpanas.en: The morning news called yesterday the hottest day of the year.
w|terpanas.ko: 아침 뉴스에서 어제가 올해 가장 더운 날이었다고 했어요.

w|terpasang.text: Lampu hias sudah terpasang di sepanjang jalan menuju rumah Fajar.
w|terpasang.en: Decorative lights have been put up all along the road to Fajar's house.
w|terpasang.ko: 파자르네 집으로 가는 길을 따라 장식 조명이 설치돼 있어요.

w|terpasang.text: Talang air yang baru terpasang di rumah Lestari bekerja baik saat hujan pertama.
w|terpasang.en: The newly installed gutter on Lestari's house worked well during the first rain.
w|terpasang.ko: 레스타리네 집에 새로 단 빗물받이가 첫비 때 잘 작동했어요.

w|terpecahkan.text: Misteri kue yang selalu bantat akhirnya terpecahkan: Andi lupa memakai pengembang.
w|terpecahkan.en: The mystery of the cake that always came out dense was finally solved: Andi forgot the leavening.
w|terpecahkan.ko: 늘 떡처럼 되던 케이크의 수수께끼가 드디어 풀렸어요. 안디가 팽창제를 깜빡했던 거예요.

w|terpecahkan.text: Rani menulis bahwa teka-teki silang yang dikirim Dewi akhirnya terpecahkan juga.
w|terpecahkan.en: Rani wrote that the crossword Dewi sent had finally been solved.
w|terpecahkan.ko: 라니는 데위가 보낸 십자말풀이를 드디어 풀었다고 썼어요.

w|terpeleset.text: Seorang turis terpeleset di batu karang yang licin, dan Eko segera menolongnya.
w|terpeleset.en: A tourist slipped on the slippery rocks, and Eko quickly helped.
w|terpeleset.ko: 관광객이 미끄러운 바위에서 미끄러지자 에코가 바로 도와줬어요.

w|terpeleset.text: Lantai klinik baru dipel, dan Ayu hampir terpeleset di depan meja pendaftaran.
w|terpeleset.en: The clinic floor had just been mopped, and Ayu almost slipped in front of the reception desk.
w|terpeleset.ko: 병원 바닥을 막 닦아서 아유는 접수대 앞에서 미끄러질 뻔했어요.

w|terpencil.text: Stasiun kecil itu terletak di desa terpencil yang belum ada sinyal internet.
w|terpencil.en: The small station is in a remote village that still has no internet signal.
w|terpencil.ko: 그 작은 역은 아직 인터넷 신호도 없는 외딴 마을에 있어요.

w|terpencil.text: Tim Putri menguji aplikasi di desa terpencil yang sinyalnya lemah.
w|terpencil.en: Putri's team tested the app in a remote village with a weak signal.
w|terpencil.ko: 푸트리의 팀은 신호가 약한 외딴 마을에서 앱을 시험했어요.

w|terpengaruh.text: Redaktur meminta Budi tetap netral dan tidak terpengaruh oleh narasumber.
w|terpengaruh.en: The editor asked Budi to stay neutral and not be swayed by his sources.
w|terpengaruh.ko: 편집자는 부디에게 취재원에 휘둘리지 말고 중립을 지키라고 했어요.

w|terpengaruh.text: Gaya menulis Siti banyak terpengaruh oleh novel-novel lama di rak belakang.
w|terpengaruh.en: Siti's writing style is heavily influenced by the old novels on the back shelf.
w|terpengaruh.ko: 시티의 글솜씨는 뒤쪽 책장의 옛 소설들에서 많은 영향을 받았어요.

w|terpenting.en: The most important thing is mutual trust.
w|terpenting.ko: 가장 중요한 것은 서로 믿는 거야.

w|terpenting.en: Health is the most important thing for him.

w|terpenuhi.text: Rudi senang karena kebutuhan obat kliniknya akhirnya terpenuhi.
w|terpenuhi.en: Rudi is happy because his clinic's medicine needs have finally been met.
w|terpenuhi.ko: 루디는 병원에 필요한 약이 마침내 다 갖춰져서 기뻐요.

w|terpenuhi.text: Kebutuhan air bersih di desa Rina akhirnya terpenuhi berkat pipa baru.
w|terpenuhi.en: Clean water needs in Rina's village were finally met thanks to a new pipe.
w|terpenuhi.ko: 새 수도관 덕분에 리나네 마을의 깨끗한 물 문제가 마침내 해결됐어요.

w|terperangkap.text: Seekor kucing terperangkap di atap kantor polisi dan harus diturunkan dengan tangga.
w|terperangkap.en: A cat was trapped on the police station roof and had to be brought down with a ladder.
w|terperangkap.ko: 고양이 한 마리가 경찰서 지붕에 갇혀서 사다리로 내려 줘야 했어요.

w|terperangkap.text: Dewi sempat terperangkap di antara dua pemain bertahan sebelum mengoper bola.
w|terperangkap.en: Dewi was briefly trapped between two defenders before passing the ball.
w|terperangkap.ko: 데위는 수비수 둘 사이에 잠깐 갇혔다가 공을 패스했어요.

w|terpercaya.text: Agus hanya membeli besi dari pemasok terpercaya yang sudah lama dikenalnya.
w|terpercaya.en: Agus only buys steel from a trusted supplier he has known for years.
w|terpercaya.ko: 아구스는 오래 알고 지낸 믿을 만한 납품업체에서만 철근을 사요.

w|terpercaya.text: Wati hanya belanja di toko terpercaya yang punya banyak ulasan baik.
w|terpercaya.en: Wati only shops at trusted stores with lots of good reviews.
w|terpercaya.ko: 와티는 좋은 후기가 많은 믿을 만한 가게에서만 사요.

w|terpesona.text: Budi dulu terpesona oleh cara Andi bercerita tentang laut.
w|terpesona.en: Budi used to be captivated by the way Andi talked about the sea.
w|terpesona.ko: 부디는 예전에 안디가 바다 이야기를 하는 방식에 매료됐었어요.

w|terpesona.text: Siti terpesona oleh pemandangan matahari terbit di atas jembatan.
w|terpesona.en: Siti was mesmerized by the sunrise over the bridge.
w|terpesona.ko: 시티는 다리 위로 떠오르는 해에 넋을 잃었어요.

w|terpikir.text: Tidak pernah terpikir oleh Andi bahwa dia akan jadi ketua kelas.
w|terpikir.en: It never occurred to Andi that he would become class president.
w|terpikir.ko: 안디는 자기가 반장이 될 거라고는 생각도 못 했어요.

w|terpikir.text: Tahun ini terpikir oleh Dewi untuk mengundang tetangga baru.
w|terpikir.en: This year it occurred to Dewi to invite the new neighbors.
w|terpikir.ko: 올해 데위는 새 이웃을 초대하자는 생각이 들었어요.

w|terpikirkan.text: Akhir cerita yang mengejutkan itu tidak pernah terpikirkan oleh Eko sebelumnya.
w|terpikirkan.en: Eko had never thought of that surprising ending before.
w|terpikirkan.ko: 그 놀라운 결말은 에코가 전에는 생각도 못 했던 거예요.

w|terpikirkan.text: Ide berjualan es kopi tidak pernah terpikirkan oleh Ayu sebelum anaknya mengusulkan.
w|terpikirkan.en: The idea of selling iced coffee never occurred to Ayu until her child suggested it.
w|terpikirkan.ko: 아이스커피를 팔 생각은 아이가 제안하기 전까지 아유는 해 본 적이 없어요.

w|terpilih.en: He was chosen as class president.

w|terpilih.text: Kandidat itu terpilih dengan suara terbanyak.
w|terpilih.en: That candidate was elected with the most votes.

w|terpintar.text: Anak tetangga Agus dikenal sebagai murid terpintar di sekolah.
w|terpintar.en: Agus's neighbor's child is known as the smartest student in school.
w|terpintar.ko: 아구스네 이웃집 아이는 학교에서 가장 똑똑한 학생으로 알려져 있어요.

w|terpintar.text: Anak sulung Wati, murid terpintar di kelas, membantu menghitung uang di kasir.
w|terpintar.en: Wati's eldest child, the smartest student in class, helps count money at the cashier.
w|terpintar.ko: 반에서 가장 똑똑한 와티의 큰아이가 계산대에서 돈 세는 걸 도와요.

w|terpisah.text: Terpisah lama, mereka akhirnya bertemu lagi.
w|terpisah.en: Separated for a long time, they finally met again.
w|terpisah.ko: 오래 떨어져 있다 결국 다시 만났어.

w|terpisah.text: Kamar kami terpisah oleh dinding tipis.
w|terpisah.en: Our rooms are separated by a thin wall.
w|terpisah.ko: 우리 방은 얇은 벽으로 나뉘어 있어.

w|terpisahkan.text: Bagi Rudi, pisau dan talenan sudah menjadi bagian tak terpisahkan dari hidup.
w|terpisahkan.en: For Rudi, knives and cutting boards have become an inseparable part of life.
w|terpisahkan.ko: 루디에게 칼과 도마는 삶에서 떼려야 뗄 수 없는 일부가 됐어요.

w|terpisahkan.text: Bagi Rina, pasar loak sudah menjadi bagian tak terpisahkan dari akhir pekan.
w|terpisahkan.en: For Rina, the flea market has become an inseparable part of the weekend.
w|terpisahkan.ko: 리나에게 벼룩시장은 주말에서 떼려야 뗄 수 없는 일부가 됐어요.

w|terpojok.text: Kucing liar itu terpojok di garasi Andi dan mendesis keras.
w|terpojok.en: The stray cat was cornered in Andi's garage and hissed loudly.
w|terpojok.ko: 그 길고양이는 안디네 차고 구석에 몰려서 크게 하악질을 했어요.

w|terpojok.text: Dewi merasa terpojok ketika para orang tua mengeluhkan jadwal resital.
w|terpojok.en: Dewi felt cornered when the parents complained about the recital schedule.
w|terpojok.ko: 학부모들이 발표회 일정에 불만을 쏟아내자 데위는 궁지에 몰린 기분이었어요.

w|terpotong.text: Rekaman suara yang diputar di sidang itu terpotong di bagian yang paling penting.
w|terpotong.en: The audio recording played in court was cut off at the most important part.
w|terpotong.ko: 법정에서 튼 녹음은 가장 중요한 부분에서 끊겼어요.

w|terpotong.text: Kue lapis itu sudah terpotong rapi dan siap dibawa ke meja pelanggan.
w|terpotong.en: The layer cake was already neatly cut and ready to be taken to the customers' table.
w|terpotong.ko: 라피스 케이크는 이미 깔끔하게 잘려서 손님 식탁으로 갈 준비가 됐어요.

w|terpukul.text: Para petani sangat terpukul karena hujan es merusak tanaman cabai.
w|terpukul.en: The farmers were hit hard because hail destroyed the chili crops.
w|terpukul.ko: 우박이 고추밭을 망쳐서 농민들은 큰 타격을 입었어요.

w|terpukul.text: Putri sempat terpukul ketika tahu fondasi rumah itu retak parah.
w|terpukul.en: Putri was shaken when she learned the house's foundation was badly cracked.
w|terpukul.ko: 푸트리는 집 기초에 금이 심하게 간 걸 알고 큰 충격을 받았어요.

w|terpuruk.text: Agus pernah terpuruk ketika longsor merusak ladang keluarga.
w|terpuruk.en: Agus once hit rock bottom when a landslide destroyed the family's field.
w|terpuruk.ko: 산사태로 집안 밭이 망가졌을 때 아구스는 크게 좌절했었어요.

w|terpuruk.text: Wati menyemangati sahabatnya yang sedang terpuruk setelah kehilangan pekerjaan.
w|terpuruk.en: Wati encouraged her friend, who was at a low point after losing her job.
w|terpuruk.ko: 와티는 일자리를 잃고 힘들어하는 친구를 격려했어요.

w|terputus.text: Panggilan video dengan dokter sempat terputus karena sinyal lemah.
w|terputus.en: The video call with the doctor cut out because of a weak signal.
w|terputus.ko: 신호가 약해서 의사와의 영상 통화가 끊겼어요.

w|terputus.text: Aliran air ke rumah Wati terputus selama pipa diganti.
w|terputus.en: The water supply to Wati's house was cut off while the pipes were replaced.
w|terputus.ko: 배관을 바꾸는 동안 와티네 집 물이 끊겼어요.

w|tersadar.text: Andi tersadar bahwa kunci gudang tertinggal di mobil.
w|tersadar.en: Andi realized that the storeroom key had been left in the car.
w|tersadar.ko: 안디는 창고 열쇠를 차에 두고 왔다는 걸 깨달았어요.

w|tersadar.text: Melihat teman-teman yang sudah beruban, Dewi tersadar betapa cepat waktu berlalu.
w|tersadar.en: Seeing her friends with gray hair, Dewi realized how fast time had gone by.
w|tersadar.ko: 머리가 희끗해진 친구들을 보고 데위는 시간이 얼마나 빨리 지났는지 깨달았어요.

w|tersakiti.text: Dalam novel yang dibaca Andi, tokoh utamanya merasa tersakiti oleh sahabatnya sendiri.
w|tersakiti.en: In the novel Andi was reading, the main character felt hurt by his own best friend.
w|tersakiti.ko: 안디가 읽은 소설에서 주인공은 가장 친한 친구에게 상처를 받았어요.

w|tersakiti.text: Dewi sempat merasa tersakiti karena sahabatnya tidak datang membantu pindahan.
w|tersakiti.en: Dewi felt hurt for a while because her best friend didn't come to help with the move.
w|tersakiti.ko: 데위는 단짝이 이사를 도우러 오지 않아서 한동안 서운했어요.

w|tersambung.text: Kabel listrik di lantai tiga belum tersambung ke panel utama.
w|tersambung.en: The electrical cables on the third floor aren't connected to the main panel yet.
w|tersambung.ko: 3층 전선은 아직 메인 패널에 연결되지 않았어요.

w|tersambung.text: Begitu ponselnya tersambung ke wifi, Wati langsung membuka keranjang belanja.
w|tersambung.en: As soon as her phone connected to the wifi, Wati opened her shopping cart.
w|tersambung.ko: 휴대폰이 와이파이에 연결되자마자 와티는 바로 장바구니를 열었어요.

w|tersandung.text: Agus tersandung akar pohon saat berlari mengejar layangan.
w|tersandung.en: Agus tripped on a tree root while running after a kite.
w|tersandung.ko: 아구스는 연을 쫓아 달리다가 나무뿌리에 걸려 넘어졌어요.

w|tersandung.text: Seorang kakek tersandung di tangga apotek, dan Wati membantunya berdiri.
w|tersandung.en: An elderly man tripped on the pharmacy steps, and Wati helped him up.
w|tersandung.ko: 한 할아버지가 약국 계단에서 넘어지자 와티가 일으켜 드렸어요.

w|tersangka.en: The suspect was taken to the police station.
They arrested the suspect this morning.

w|tersangkut.text: Kerudung pengantin wanita tersangkut di hiasan bunga pelaminan.
w|tersangkut.en: The bride's veil got caught on the flower decorations of the wedding dais.
w|tersangkut.ko: 신부의 베일이 단상의 꽃 장식에 걸렸어요.

w|tersangkut.text: Mobil Rina tersangkut lumpur dalam perjalanan ke lokasi longsor.
w|tersangkut.en: Rina's car got stuck in the mud on the way to the landslide site.
w|tersangkut.ko: 리나의 차가 산사태 현장으로 가는 길에 진흙에 빠졌어요.

w|tersanjung.text: Budi merasa tersanjung karena Andi masih menyimpan semua suratnya.
w|tersanjung.en: Budi felt flattered that Andi still keeps all his letters.
w|tersanjung.ko: 안디가 자기 편지를 다 간직하고 있어서 부디는 우쭐한 기분이 들었어요.

w|tersanjung.text: Siti merasa tersanjung ketika wartawan meminta wawancara singkat.
w|tersanjung.en: Siti felt flattered when a reporter asked for a short interview.
w|tersanjung.ko: 기자가 짧은 인터뷰를 청하자 시티는 으쓱했어요.

w|tersayang.text: Rudi menitipkan salam untuk istri Bayu dan anak-anak tersayang.
w|tersayang.en: Rudi sent his regards to Bayu's wife and their dear children.
w|tersayang.ko: 루디는 바유의 아내와 사랑스러운 아이들에게 안부를 전해 달라고 했어요.

w|tersayang.text: Rina menelepon neneknya tersayang untuk mengabarkan bahwa kantornya dapat pendanaan.
w|tersayang.en: Rina called her dear grandmother to tell her that her company got funding.
w|tersayang.ko: 리나는 사랑하는 할머니께 전화해서 회사가 투자를 받았다고 알렸어요.

w|tersebar.text: Pecahan keramik kuno itu dulu tersebar di dasar laut sebelum diangkat penyelam.
w|tersebar.en: The ancient ceramic shards were once scattered on the seabed before divers brought them up.
w|tersebar.ko: 그 옛 도자기 조각들은 잠수부가 건져 올리기 전까지 바다 밑에 흩어져 있었어요.

w|tersebar.text: Kabar kenaikan harga bawang cepat tersebar dari kios ke kios.
w|tersebar.en: News of the rising onion prices spread quickly from stall to stall.
w|tersebar.ko: 양파 값이 오른다는 소식이 가게에서 가게로 금세 퍼졌어요.

w|tersedak.text: Budi tersedak kopi waktu melihat judul berita yang salah ketik.
w|tersedak.en: Budi choked on his coffee when he saw a headline with a typo.
w|tersedak.ko: 부디는 오타 난 제목을 보고 커피에 사레들렸어요.

w|tersedak.text: Seorang anak tersedak permen di ruang baca, dan Siti cepat menolongnya.
w|tersedak.en: A child choked on a candy in the reading room, and Siti quickly helped.
w|tersedak.ko: 한 아이가 열람실에서 사탕이 목에 걸리자 시티가 재빨리 도왔어요.

w|tersedia.text: Kursi kosong masih tersedia di barisan belakang.
w|tersedia.en: Empty seats are still available in the back row.

w|tersedia.text: Tersedia juga pilihan menu vegetarian hari ini.
w|tersedia.en: A vegetarian menu option is also available today.

w|terselesaikan.text: Masalah sampah plastik di pantai belum juga terselesaikan, keluh Eko.
w|terselesaikan.en: The problem of plastic waste on the beach still hasn't been solved, Eko complained.
w|terselesaikan.ko: 해변의 플라스틱 쓰레기 문제는 아직도 해결되지 않았다고 에코가 투덜거렸어요.

w|terselesaikan.text: Masalah gigi berlubang Ayu akhirnya terselesaikan dalam dua kali kunjungan.
w|terselesaikan.en: Ayu's cavity problem was finally solved in two visits.
w|terselesaikan.ko: 아유의 충치 문제는 두 번 방문해서 마침내 해결됐어요.

w|tersembunyi.text: Tersembunyi di balik pohon, dia mengintip.
w|tersembunyi.en: Hidden behind a tree, he peeked.

w|tersembunyi.text: Ada pintu tersembunyi di dinding itu.
w|tersembunyi.en: There is a hidden door in that wall.

w|tersendiri.text: Bau tanah setelah hujan pertama punya pesona tersendiri bagi Dimas.
w|tersendiri.en: The smell of earth after the first rain has a charm of its own for Dimas.
w|tersendiri.ko: 첫비가 온 뒤 흙냄새는 디마스에게 특별한 매력이 있어요.

w|tersendiri.text: Jendela kaca patri di ruang tamu punya keindahan tersendiri.
w|tersendiri.en: The stained-glass window in the living room has a beauty of its own.
w|tersendiri.ko: 거실의 스테인드글라스 창은 남다른 아름다움이 있어요.

w|tersentuh.text: Budi tersentuh membaca surat Andi yang ditulis dengan tangan gemetar.
w|tersentuh.en: Budi was moved reading Andi's letter, written with a trembling hand.
w|tersentuh.ko: 부디는 떨리는 손으로 쓴 안디의 편지를 읽고 뭉클했어요.

w|tersentuh.text: Siti tersentuh melihat seorang kakek yang tetap berlari sampai garis akhir.
w|tersentuh.en: Siti was moved to see an old man who kept running to the finish line.
w|tersentuh.ko: 시티는 결승선까지 계속 달리는 할아버지를 보고 뭉클했어요.

w|tersenyum.en: She smiled when she saw me.

w|terserah.text: "Mau jual sapi sekarang atau tahun depan, terserah Bapak saja," kata Dimas.
w|terserah.en: "Whether to sell the cow now or next year is up to you, Dad," said Dimas.
w|terserah.ko: "소를 지금 팔지 내년에 팔지는 아버지 마음대로 하세요." 디마스가 말했어요.

w|terserah.text: Putri bilang terserah temannya mau makan siang di mana.
w|terserah.en: Putri said it was up to her friend where they had lunch.
w|terserah.ko: 푸트리는 점심을 어디서 먹을지는 친구 마음대로 하라고 했어요.

w|tersesat.text: Kami tersesat di hutan yang gelap.
w|tersesat.en: We got lost in the dark forest.

w|tersesat.text: Anak itu tersesat di pusat perbelanjaan.
w|tersesat.en: That child got lost in the shopping mall.

w|tersiksa.text: Eko tersiksa semalaman karena digigit nyamuk di dalam tenda.
w|tersiksa.en: Eko suffered all night because he was bitten by mosquitoes in the tent.
w|tersiksa.ko: 에코는 텐트 안에서 모기에 물려 밤새 괴로웠어요.

w|tersiksa.text: Ayu merasa tersiksa di kilometer terakhir karena kakinya kram.
w|tersiksa.en: Ayu felt tortured in the last kilometer because her legs cramped.
w|tersiksa.ko: 아유는 마지막 일 킬로미터에서 다리에 쥐가 나 고통스러웠어요.

w|tersimpan.text: Foto pernikahan orang tua Fajar masih tersimpan rapi di album keluarga.
w|tersimpan.en: Fajar's parents' wedding photos are still neatly kept in the family album.
w|tersimpan.ko: 파자르 부모님의 결혼사진은 아직도 가족 앨범에 잘 보관돼 있어요.

w|tersimpan.text: Semua rekaman wawancara Lestari tersimpan di hard disk kantor.
w|tersimpan.en: All of Lestari's interview recordings are stored on the office hard drive.
w|tersimpan.ko: 레스타리의 인터뷰 녹음은 모두 사무실 하드 디스크에 저장돼 있어요.

w|tersinggung.text: Dia tersinggung oleh komentar kasar itu.
w|tersinggung.en: She was offended by that harsh comment.
w|tersinggung.ko: 그녀는 그 거친 말에 기분이 상했어.

w|tersinggung.text: Jangan mudah tersinggung soal candaan kecil.
w|tersinggung.en: Don't get easily offended by small jokes.
w|tersinggung.ko: 작은 농담에 쉽게 기분 상하지 마.

w|tersisa.en: Only a little rice is left.

w|tertabrak.text: Kucing yang tertabrak motor itu selamat berkat operasi cepat Rudi.
w|tertabrak.en: The cat that was hit by a motorbike survived thanks to Rudi's quick surgery.
w|tertabrak.ko: 오토바이에 치인 고양이는 루디의 빠른 수술 덕분에 살았어요.

w|tertabrak.text: Ayam Rina hampir tertabrak sepeda motor tukang sayur pagi tadi.
w|tertabrak.en: Rina's chicken was almost hit by the vegetable seller's motorbike this morning.
w|tertabrak.ko: 오늘 아침 리나의 닭이 채소 장수 오토바이에 치일 뻔했어요.

w|tertahan.text: Laporan Fajar sempat tertahan di meja redaktur karena butuh verifikasi.
w|tertahan.en: Fajar's report was held up on the editor's desk because it needed verification.
w|tertahan.ko: 파자르의 기사는 검증이 필요해서 편집장 책상에 잠시 묶여 있었어요.

w|tertahan.text: Mobil Lestari tertahan berjam-jam karena ada longsor kecil di depan.
w|tertahan.en: Lestari's car was stuck for hours because of a small landslide ahead.
w|tertahan.ko: 앞에 작은 산사태가 나서 레스타리의 차는 몇 시간 동안 멈춰 있었어요.

w|tertahankan.text: Panas siang itu hampir tidak tertahankan, jadi Eko berteduh di bawah pohon kelapa.
w|tertahankan.en: The midday heat was almost unbearable, so Eko took shelter under a coconut tree.
w|tertahankan.ko: 그날 낮 더위는 거의 견딜 수 없어서 에코는 야자나무 아래로 피했어요.

w|tertahankan.text: Rasa ngilu di gigi geraham Ayu sudah tidak tertahankan sejak semalam.
w|tertahankan.en: The aching in Ayu's molar had been unbearable since last night.
w|tertahankan.ko: 아유의 어금니 시린 통증은 어젯밤부터 견딜 수 없었어요.

w|tertanam.text: Rasa tanggung jawab sudah tertanam dalam diri Fajar sejak ia jadi ketua kelas.
w|tertanam.en: A sense of responsibility has been rooted in Fajar since he was class president.
w|tertanam.ko: 파자르에게는 반장 시절부터 책임감이 몸에 배어 있어요.

w|tertanam.text: Kenangan masa sekolah masih tertanam kuat di hati Lestari.
w|tertanam.en: Memories of their school days are still deeply rooted in Lestari's heart.
w|tertanam.ko: 학창 시절의 기억은 아직도 레스타리의 마음에 깊이 박혀 있어요.

w|tertekan.text: Rudi mengaku sempat merasa tertekan di tahun pertama kuliah.
w|tertekan.en: Rudi admitted he felt pressured in his first year of university.
w|tertekan.ko: 루디는 대학 첫해에 압박감을 느꼈다고 털어놓았어요.

w|tertekan.text: Tim pengembang merasa tertekan menjelang tenggat peluncuran.
w|tertekan.en: The development team felt under pressure as the launch deadline approached.
w|tertekan.ko: 출시 마감이 다가오자 개발팀은 압박감을 느꼈어요.

w|tertembak.text: Saksi itu hampir tertembak di kerumunan.
w|tertembak.en: That witness was nearly shot in the crowd.
w|tertembak.ko: 그 목격자는 군중 속에서 하마터면 총에 맞을 뻔했어.

w|tertembak.en: Being shot in the leg made him fall.

w|tertentu.text: Hanya orang tertentu yang boleh masuk.
Pada waktu tertentu dia terlihat sedih.
w|tertentu.en: At certain times he looks sad.

w|tertera.text: Rudi memeriksa tanggal kedaluwarsa yang tertera pada kemasan susu.
w|tertera.en: Rudi checked the expiry date printed on the milk carton.

w|tertera.text: Rina mencari tahun pembuatan yang tertera di bagian bawah cangkir.
w|tertera.en: Rina looked for the year of manufacture printed on the bottom of the cup.
w|tertera.ko: 리나는 컵 바닥에 찍힌 제조 연도를 찾았어요.

w|tertib.text: Rudi meminta antrean di loket SIM tetap tertib.
w|tertib.en: Rudi asked that the line at the driver's license counter stay orderly.
w|tertib.ko: 루디는 운전면허 창구 앞 줄이 질서를 지키도록 했어요.

w|tertib.text: Para pemilik hewan menunggu dengan tertib di ruang tunggu klinik Rina.
w|tertib.en: The pet owners waited in an orderly way in the waiting room of Rina's clinic.
w|tertib.ko: 반려동물 주인들은 리나네 병원 대기실에서 질서 있게 기다렸어요.

w|tertidur.text: Dia tertidur di kursi selama rapat.
w|tertidur.en: He fell asleep in the chair during the meeting.
w|tertidur.ko: 그는 회의 중에 의자에 잠들어 버렸어.

w|tertidur.text: Bayi itu akhirnya tertidur dengan tenang.
w|tertidur.en: The baby finally fell asleep peacefully.

w|tertinggal.en: His bag was left behind on the bus seat.
She feels left behind by her friends.

w|tertinggi.text: Gedung tertinggi di kota terlihat dari sini.
w|tertinggi.en: The tallest building in the city can be seen from here.
w|tertinggi.ko: 도시의 가장 높은 건물이 여기서 보여.

w|tertinggi.text: Dia mencapai skor tertinggi di kelas.
w|tertinggi.en: He got the highest score in class.
w|tertinggi.ko: 그는 반에서 가장 높은 점수를 받았어.

w|tertipu.text: Dimas merasa tertipu karena sampul buku itu jauh lebih menarik daripada isinya.
w|tertipu.en: Dimas felt fooled because the book's cover was far more appealing than its content.
w|tertipu.ko: 디마스는 책 표지가 내용보다 훨씬 그럴듯해서 속은 기분이었어요.

w|tertipu.text: Putri hampir tertipu calo yang menjual tiket palsu di depan stasiun.
w|tertipu.en: Putri was almost tricked by a tout selling fake tickets in front of the station.
w|tertipu.ko: 푸트리는 역 앞에서 가짜 표를 파는 암표상에게 속을 뻔했어요.

w|tertua.text: Pak Darmo adalah tukang tertua di proyek itu, umurnya hampir enam puluh.
w|tertua.en: Mr Darmo is the oldest builder on the site, almost sixty years old.
w|tertua.ko: 다르모 씨는 그 현장에서 가장 나이 많은 인부로 거의 예순이에요.

w|tertua.text: Bu Ani, karyawan tertua di kantor, mengajak Rina makan siang.
w|tertua.en: Mrs Ani, the oldest employee in the office, invited Rina to lunch.
w|tertua.ko: 회사에서 가장 오래된 직원인 아니 씨가 리나에게 점심을 같이 먹자고 했어요.

w|tertuju.text: Saat presentasi, semua mata tertuju pada grafik yang dibuat Fajar.
w|tertuju.en: During the presentation, all eyes were on the chart Fajar had made.
w|tertuju.ko: 발표 때 모든 눈이 파자르가 만든 그래프에 쏠렸어요.

w|tertuju.text: Perhatian Lestari tertuju pada keluhan pengguna yang masuk semalam.
w|tertuju.en: Lestari's attention was focused on the user complaints that came in overnight.
w|tertuju.ko: 레스타리의 관심은 밤사이 들어온 사용자 불만에 쏠려 있었어요.

w|tertular.text: Dimas memakai masker supaya tidak tertular flu dari pelanggan.
w|tertular.en: Dimas wears a mask so he doesn't catch the flu from customers.
w|tertular.ko: 디마스는 손님에게서 독감이 옮지 않도록 마스크를 써요.

w|tertular.text: Putri tertular semangat tetangga yang juga sedang merenovasi rumah.
w|tertular.en: Putri caught the enthusiasm of a neighbor who was also renovating.
w|tertular.ko: 푸트리는 같이 집을 고치는 이웃의 열정에 덩달아 신이 났어요.

w|tertulis.text: Tertulis jelas di papan pengumuman itu.
w|tertulis.en: It is clearly written on that notice board.

w|tertulis.text: Janji itu sudah tertulis di kontrak.
w|tertulis.en: That promise is already written in the contract.
w|tertulis.ko: 그 약속은 이미 계약서에 적혀 있어.

w|tertunda.text: Kelas memanggang roti minggu ini tertunda karena ovennya rusak.
w|tertunda.en: This week's bread-baking class was postponed because the oven broke.
w|tertunda.ko: 오븐이 고장 나서 이번 주 빵 굽기 수업이 미뤄졌어요.

w|tertunda.text: Rencana Dewi mengunjungi Rani tertunda lagi karena urusan kantor.
w|tertunda.en: Dewi's plan to visit Rani was postponed again because of work.
w|tertunda.ko: 라니를 찾아가려던 데위의 계획은 회사 일 때문에 또 미뤄졌어요.

w|tertusuk.text: Menurut catatan museum, prajurit itu gugur setelah dadanya tertusuk tombak.
w|tertusuk.en: According to the museum's records, the soldier died after his chest was pierced by a spear.
w|tertusuk.ko: 박물관 기록에 따르면 그 병사는 가슴이 창에 찔려 전사했어요.

w|tertusuk.text: Jari Putri tertusuk jarum ketika membantu menjahit kostumnya sendiri.
w|tertusuk.en: Putri's finger was pricked by a needle when she helped sew her own costume.
