w|tertusuk.ko: 푸트리는 자기 의상 바느질을 돕다가 바늘에 손가락을 찔렸어요.

w|tertutup.en: The shop door is still closed.
That road is closed for repairs.

w|terukir.text: Nama Bayu terukir di papan karyawan terbaik bulan ini.
w|terukir.en: Bayu's name is engraved on this month's best employee plaque.
w|terukir.ko: 바유의 이름이 이달의 우수 직원 명패에 새겨졌어요.

w|terukir.text: Kalimat penyemangat terukir di dinding kayu gym itu.
w|terukir.en: Motivational sayings are carved into the wooden wall of that gym.
w|terukir.ko: 그 헬스장 나무 벽에는 힘을 주는 문구가 새겨져 있어요.

w|terulang.text: Budi tidak ingin kejadian kucing kabur dari kandang terulang lagi.
w|terulang.en: Budi doesn't want the incident of a cat escaping from its cage to happen again.
w|terulang.ko: 부디는 고양이가 우리에서 탈출하는 일이 다시 일어나지 않기를 바라요.

w|terulang.text: Warga desa menanam pohon di lereng supaya longsor tidak terulang.
w|terulang.en: The villagers planted trees on the slope so the landslide wouldn't happen again.
w|terulang.ko: 주민들은 산사태가 되풀이되지 않도록 비탈에 나무를 심었어요.

w|terungkap.text: Akhirnya terungkap bahwa pencuri paket itu adalah kurir palsu.
w|terungkap.en: It was finally revealed that the parcel thief was a fake courier.
w|terungkap.ko: 결국 택배 도둑이 가짜 배달원이었다는 게 밝혀졌어요.

w|terungkap.text: Dalam novel yang dibaca Intan, identitas si pembunuh terungkap di dalam kereta.
w|terungkap.en: In the novel Intan was reading, the killer's identity was revealed on a train.
w|terungkap.ko: 인탄이 읽던 소설에서는 살인범의 정체가 기차 안에서 밝혀졌어요.

w|terus-menerus.text: Hujan turun terus-menerus sejak pagi sehingga Dimas batal bersepeda.
w|terus-menerus.en: It rained nonstop since the morning, so Dimas canceled his bike ride.
w|terus-menerus.ko: 아침부터 비가 쉬지 않고 와서 디마스는 자전거 타기를 취소했어요.

w|terus-menerus.text: Atap rumah tua itu bocor terus-menerus setiap kali hujan.
w|terus-menerus.en: The old house's roof leaks constantly whenever it rains.
w|terus-menerus.ko: 그 낡은 집 지붕은 비만 오면 계속 새요.

w|terus-terusan.text: Telepon di meja Dimas berdering terus-terusan sepanjang pagi.
w|terus-terusan.en: The phone on Dimas's desk kept ringing all morning.
w|terus-terusan.ko: 디마스 책상의 전화가 아침 내내 계속 울렸어요.

w|terus-terusan.text: Pengeras suara terus-terusan memanggil penumpang yang belum naik, dan Putri mulai cemas.
w|terus-terusan.en: The loudspeaker kept calling passengers who hadn't boarded, and Putri started to worry.
w|terus-terusan.ko: 스피커가 아직 탑승하지 않은 승객을 계속 불러서 푸트리는 불안해지기 시작했어요.

w|terwujud.text: Mimpi Andi untuk punya kartu anggota perpustakaan nasional akhirnya terwujud.
w|terwujud.en: Andi's dream of having a national library membership card finally came true.
w|terwujud.ko: 국립 도서관 회원증을 갖고 싶던 안디의 꿈이 마침내 이뤄졌어요.

w|terwujud.text: Rencana kantor untuk punya ruang menyusui akhirnya terwujud bulan ini.
w|terwujud.en: The office's plan to have a nursing room finally came true this month.
w|terwujud.ko: 사무실에 수유실을 만들려던 계획이 이번 달에 드디어 이뤄졌어요.

w|testis.text: Fajar membagikan brosur pemeriksaan kanker testis untuk pria muda.
w|testis.en: Fajar handed out brochures on testicular cancer screening for young men.
w|testis.ko: 파자르는 젊은 남성을 위한 고환암 검진 안내지를 나눠 줬어요.

w|testis.text: Rekan baru Lestari ikut lari amal untuk kampanye kesadaran kanker testis.
w|testis.en: Lestari's new coworker joined a charity run for testicular cancer awareness.
w|testis.ko: 레스타리의 새 동료는 고환암 인식 캠페인 자선 달리기에 참가했어요.

w|tetangga.en: The new neighbor is very friendly.

w|tetangga.text: Kami sering berbagi makanan dengan tetangga.
w|tetangga.en: We often share food with the neighbors.
w|tetangga.ko: 우리는 이웃과 자주 음식을 나눠 먹어.

w|tetapi.en: I want to go, but it's raining.

w|tetesan.text: Rudi menambahkan beberapa tetesan minyak wijen ke mi goreng.
w|tetesan.en: Rudi added a few drops of sesame oil to the fried noodles.
w|tetesan.ko: 루디는 볶음면에 참기름을 몇 방울 넣었어요.

w|tetesan.text: Rina menemukan bekas tetesan cat di meja kayu yang hendak dibeli.
w|tetesan.en: Rina found old drips of paint on the wooden table she was about to buy.
w|tetesan.ko: 리나는 사려던 나무 탁자에서 페인트 방울 자국을 발견했어요.

w|tetua.text: Sebelum akad dimulai, Fajar meminta restu dari para tetua keluarga.
w|tetua.en: Before the vows begin, Fajar asks for the blessing of the family elders.
w|tetua.ko: 혼인 서약 전에 파자르는 집안 어른들께 축복을 청해요.

w|tetua.text: Para tetua kampung bisa menebak datangnya musim kemarau dari arah angin.
w|tetua.en: The village elders can guess the coming dry season from the direction of the wind.
w|tetua.ko: 마을 원로들은 바람 방향으로 건기가 오는 걸 짐작해요.

w|tewas.text: Korban tewas dibawa ke rumah sakit.
w|tewas.en: The deceased victim was taken to the hospital.

w|tiada.text: Sejak kakeknya tiada, Dimas yang mengurus kebun kopi keluarga.
w|tiada.en: Since his grandfather passed away, Dimas has been the one looking after the family coffee garden.
w|tiada.ko: 할아버지가 돌아가신 뒤로 디마스가 집안 커피 농장을 돌보고 있어요.

w|tiada.text: Bagi Putri, tiada hari tanpa secangkir kopi.
w|tiada.en: For Putri, there's no day without a cup of coffee.
w|tiada.ko: 푸트리에게 커피 한 잔 없는 날은 없어요.

w|tiang.text: Bendera di tiang depan kantor polisi dikibarkan setiap pagi.
w|tiang.en: The flag on the pole in front of the police station is raised every morning.
w|tiang.ko: 경찰서 앞 깃대에는 매일 아침 깃발이 올라가요.

w|tiang.text: Bola Dewi memantul dari tiang ring dan keluar lapangan.
w|tiang.en: Dewi's ball bounced off the hoop's pole and went out of bounds.
w|tiang.ko: 데위가 던진 공이 골대 기둥을 맞고 코트 밖으로 나갔어요.

w|tiket.text: Tiket konser itu sudah habis terjual.
w|tiket.en: Those concert tickets are already sold out.

w|tiket.text: Aku kehilangan tiket kereta di jalan.
w|tiket.en: I lost my train ticket on the way.

w|tikungan.text: Bayu memperlambat mobil karena ada tikungan tajam di depan.
w|tikungan.en: Bayu slowed the car because there was a sharp bend ahead.
w|tikungan.ko: 앞에 급커브가 있어서 바유는 차 속도를 줄였어요.

w|tikungan.text: Intan melukis jalan pegunungan dengan banyak tikungan yang berliku.
w|tikungan.en: Intan painted a mountain road full of winding bends.
w|tikungan.ko: 인탄은 굽이굽이 커브가 많은 산길을 그렸어요.

w|tikus.text: Tikus lari bersembunyi di balik lemari.
w|tikus.en: The mouse ran to hide behind the cupboard.
The cat caught a mouse in the kitchen.

w|timah.text: Di dekat perkemahan, Eko melihat bekas tambang timah yang sudah ditutup.
w|timah.en: Near the campsite, Eko saw an old tin mine that has been closed.
w|timah.ko: 에코는 캠프장 근처에서 문 닫은 옛 주석 광산을 봤어요.

w|timah.text: Kota tempat Ayu berlari dulu terkenal sebagai pusat tambang timah.
w|timah.en: The town where Ayu ran used to be famous as a tin mining center.
w|timah.ko: 아유가 뛴 도시는 예전에 주석 광산 중심지로 유명했어요.

w|timbul.text: Bunyi aneh timbul dari mesin mobil Bayu setelah melewati jalan berbatu.
w|timbul.en: A strange noise came from Bayu's engine after driving over a rocky road.
w|timbul.ko: 돌길을 지나자 바유의 차 엔진에서 이상한 소리가 났어요.

w|timbul.text: Ide lukisan baru tiba-tiba timbul di kepala Intan saat menunggu hujan reda.
w|timbul.en: An idea for a new painting suddenly came to Intan while she waited for the rain to stop.
w|timbul.ko: 비가 그치길 기다리다가 인탄의 머릿속에 새 그림 아이디어가 떠올랐어요.

w|timur.en: The sun rises in the east.
His house is on the east side.

w|tingkat.en: He went up to the upper floor.

w|tingkatan.text: Drama itu menggambarkan tingkatan sosial di sebuah kerajaan kuno.
w|tingkatan.en: The play depicts the social hierarchy in an ancient kingdom.
w|tingkatan.ko: 그 연극은 고대 왕국의 사회 계층을 그려요.

w|tingkatan.text: Ayu menyusun beras di rak berdasarkan tingkatan harga, dari yang termurah.
w|tingkatan.en: Ayu arranges the rice on the shelf by price level, starting with the cheapest.
w|tingkatan.ko: 아유는 선반에 쌀을 가장 싼 것부터 가격대별로 정리해요.

w|tinju.text: Tinju adalah olahraga yang butuh latihan keras.
w|tinju.en: Boxing is a sport that needs hard training.

w|tinju.text: Dia belajar tinju di gym setiap minggu.
w|tinju.en: He learns boxing at the gym every week.

w|tip.text: Kakak kelas memberi Budi tip agar tidak gugup saat presentasi.
w|tip.en: A senior gave Budi tips on not getting nervous during presentations.
w|tip.ko: 선배가 부디에게 발표할 때 긴장하지 않는 요령을 알려 줬어요.

w|tip.text: Siti memberi tip besar kepada pelayan yang sudah membantu sampai malam.
w|tip.en: Siti gave a big tip to the waiters who had helped until late.
w|tip.ko: 시티는 밤늦게까지 도와준 종업원들에게 팁을 넉넉히 줬어요.

w|tipe.text: Tipe rambutnya cocok dengan gaya itu.
w|tipe.en: Her hair type suits that style.
w|tipe.ko: 그 머리 타입이 그 스타일과 잘 맞아.

w|tipe.text: Dia bukan tipe orang yang mudah marah.
w|tipe.en: He is not the type who gets angry easily.

w|tipis.text: Usul pembangunan pasar baru menang dengan selisih suara tipis.
w|tipis.en: The proposal to build a new market won by a narrow margin of votes.
w|tipis.ko: 새 시장 건설안은 근소한 표 차로 통과됐어요.

w|tipis.text: Senar paling tipis di gitar Wati putus saat latihan.
w|tipis.en: The thinnest string on Wati's guitar snapped during practice.
w|tipis.ko: 연습하다가 와티 기타의 가장 가는 줄이 끊어졌어요.

w|tipuan.text: Tipuan itu akhirnya terbongkar di pengadilan.
w|tipuan.en: That trick was finally exposed in court.

w|tipuan.text: Dia jatuh ke tipuan penawaran palsu.
w|tipuan.en: He fell for the trick of a fake offer.

w|tirai.text: Bayu menutup tirai supaya cahaya matahari sore tidak masuk.
w|tirai.en: Bayu closed the curtains so the afternoon sunlight wouldn't come in.
w|tirai.ko: 바유는 오후 햇빛이 들어오지 않게 커튼을 쳤어요.

w|tirai.text: Intan menarik tirai jendela untuk melihat matahari terbit.
w|tirai.en: Intan pulled back the window curtain to see the sunrise.
w|tirai.ko: 인탄은 해돋이를 보려고 창문 커튼을 걷었어요.

w|tiram.text: Agus pernah mencoba roti dengan saus tiram, tetapi pelanggan kurang suka.
w|tiram.en: Agus once tried bread with oyster sauce, but customers didn't care for it.
w|tiram.ko: 아구스는 굴소스를 넣은 빵을 만들어 봤지만 손님들이 별로 좋아하지 않았어요.

w|tiram.text: Wati alergi tiram, jadi berhati-hati saat makan malam dengan klien.
w|tiram.en: Wati is allergic to oysters, so she's careful at dinners with clients.
w|tiram.ko: 와티는 굴 알레르기가 있어서 고객과 저녁을 먹을 때 조심해요.

w|tirani.text: Pameran itu menjelaskan bagaimana rakyat melawan tirani raja yang kejam.
w|tirani.en: The exhibition explains how the people fought against a cruel king's tyranny.
w|tirani.ko: 그 전시는 백성들이 잔인한 왕의 폭정에 어떻게 맞섰는지 보여 줘요.

w|tirani.text: Film sejarah itu menggambarkan perlawanan rakyat terhadap tirani penguasa kolonial.
w|tirani.en: The historical film depicts the people's resistance to the tyranny of colonial rulers.
w|tirani.ko: 그 역사 영화는 식민 통치자의 폭정에 맞선 민중의 저항을 그려요.

w|tiri.text: Rina tinggal bersama ayah tiri yang sangat menyayanginya.
w|tiri.en: Rina lives with her stepfather, who loves her very much.
w|tiri.ko: 리나는 자기를 무척 아끼는 새아버지와 함께 살아요.

w|tiri.text: Seorang tamu datang bersama ibu tirinya untuk merayakan ulang tahun.
w|tiri.en: A guest came with her stepmother to celebrate a birthday.
w|tiri.ko: 한 손님이 새어머니와 함께 생일을 축하하러 왔어요.

w|tiruan.text: Andi membeli lampu gantung tiruan yang mirip barang antik.
w|tiruan.en: Andi bought an imitation chandelier that looks like an antique.
w|tiruan.ko: 안디는 골동품처럼 보이는 모조 샹들리에를 샀어요.

w|tiruan.text: Seorang pedagang di stasiun menjual jam tangan tiruan dengan harga murah.
w|tiruan.en: A vendor at the station sells imitation watches at low prices.
w|tiruan.ko: 역의 한 상인이 모조 손목시계를 싸게 팔아요.

w|tisu.text: Agus selalu menaruh sekotak tisu di meja dekat pintu masuk.
w|tisu.en: Agus always keeps a box of tissues on the table by the entrance.
w|tisu.ko: 아구스는 현관 옆 탁자에 늘 휴지 한 상자를 둬요.

w|tisu.text: Wati selalu menyelipkan tisu di saku karena sering bersin saat pergantian musim.
w|tisu.en: Wati always tucks tissues in her pocket because she often sneezes when the seasons change.
w|tisu.ko: 와티는 환절기에 재채기를 자주 해서 주머니에 늘 휴지를 넣어 다녀요.

w|titanium.text: Bayu membeli pisau lipat dari titanium untuk dibawa ke hutan.
w|titanium.en: Bayu bought a titanium folding knife to take into the forest.
w|titanium.ko: 바유는 숲에 가지고 갈 티타늄 접이식 칼을 샀어요.

w|titanium.text: Jam tangan lari Intan memakai bingkai titanium yang ringan.
w|titanium.en: Intan's running watch has a lightweight titanium case.
w|titanium.ko: 인탄의 러닝 시계는 가벼운 티타늄 케이스로 되어 있어요.

w|titip.text: Tetangga Dimas titip obat flu untuk ibunya yang sedang sakit.
w|titip.en: Dimas's neighbor asked him to set aside flu medicine for her sick mother.
w|titip.ko: 디마스의 이웃은 아픈 어머니께 드릴 감기약을 맡아 달라고 부탁했어요.

w|titip.text: Putri titip kunci rumah kepada tetangga selama tukang bekerja.
w|titip.en: Putri left the house key with a neighbor while the workers were on the job.
w|titip.ko: 푸트리는 일꾼들이 일하는 동안 이웃에게 집 열쇠를 맡겼어요.

w|toh.text: Budi bilang, toh uang itu akhirnya ketemu juga.
w|toh.en: Budi said that, after all, the money turned up in the end.
w|toh.ko: 부디는 어쨌든 그 돈은 결국 찾았잖아 하고 말했어요.

w|toh.text: Rumahnya memang kecil, tapi toh cukup untuk Siti sekeluarga.
w|toh.en: The house is small, but it's enough for Siti's family anyway.
w|toh.ko: 집이 작긴 하지만 어쨌든 시티네 식구한테는 충분해요.

w|toilet.text: Toilet umum di stasiun sedang dibersihkan.
w|toilet.en: The public toilet at the station is being cleaned.
The line at the toilet is very long.

w|toko.en: I bought bread at the shop.

w|tokoh.text: Di pernikahan sepupunya, Rudi bertemu tokoh kampung yang dulu mengajarinya mengaji.
w|tokoh.en: At his cousin's wedding, Rudi met a village figure who used to teach him to recite the Quran.
w|tokoh.ko: 사촌의 결혼식에서 루디는 어릴 때 꾸란 낭송을 가르쳐 준 마을 어른을 만났어요.

w|tokoh.text: Rina menulis profil tokoh perempuan yang mendirikan sekolah di desanya.
w|tokoh.en: Rina wrote a profile of a female figure who founded a school in her village.
w|tokoh.ko: 리나는 마을에 학교를 세운 여성 인물의 소개 기사를 썼어요.

w|tol.text: Dimas memilih naik kereta karena jalan tol sedang macet parah menjelang libur.
w|tol.en: Dimas chose the train because the toll road was badly jammed before the holiday.
w|tol.ko: 연휴를 앞두고 고속도로가 심하게 막혀서 디마스는 기차를 택했어요.

w|tol.text: Setiap pagi, Putri lewat jalan tol untuk sampai ke kantor tepat waktu.
w|tol.en: Every morning, Putri takes the toll road to get to the office on time.
w|tol.ko: 매일 아침 푸트리는 제시간에 출근하려고 고속도로를 타요.

w|toleransi.text: Diskusi di perpustakaan hari itu membahas toleransi antarumat beragama, dan Andi ikut bertanya.
w|toleransi.en: The discussion at the library that day was about interfaith tolerance, and Andi asked a question too.
w|toleransi.ko: 그날 도서관 토론 주제는 종교 간 관용이었고, 안디도 질문을 했어요.

w|toleransi.text: Tetangga baru Dewi menunjukkan toleransi besar meski truk pindahan menghalangi jalan seharian.
w|toleransi.en: Dewi's new neighbors showed great tolerance even though the moving truck blocked the road all day.
w|toleransi.ko: 이삿짐 트럭이 하루 종일 길을 막았는데도 데위의 새 이웃들은 너그럽게 참아 줬어요.

w|tomat.text: Andi mengiris tomat tipis-tipis untuk hiasan salad.
w|tomat.en: Andi sliced the tomatoes thinly to garnish the salad.
w|tomat.ko: 안디는 샐러드 장식용으로 토마토를 얇게 썰었어요.

w|tomat.text: Dalam suratnya, Dewi bilang tanaman tomat di balkonnya mulai berbuah.
w|tomat.en: In her letter, Dewi said the tomato plants on her balcony have started bearing fruit.
w|tomat.ko: 데위는 편지에 베란다의 토마토가 열매를 맺기 시작했다고 썼어요.

w|tombak.text: Dimas membaca buku bergambar tentang pemburu yang memakai tombak bambu.
w|tombak.en: Dimas read a picture book about a hunter who uses a bamboo spear.
w|tombak.ko: 디마스는 대나무 창을 쓰는 사냥꾼 그림책을 읽었어요.

w|tombak.text: Putri melihat patung prajurit membawa tombak di stasiun tua.
w|tombak.en: Putri saw a statue of a soldier carrying a spear at the old station.
w|tombak.ko: 푸트리는 오래된 역에서 창을 든 병사 동상을 봤어요.

w|tombol.en: Press the red button to stop.

w|tombol.ko: 그 버튼은 더 이상 안 돼.

w|ton.text: Kata Bu Lestari, berat seluruh buku di perpustakaan ini mungkin beberapa ton.
w|ton.en: According to Mrs. Lestari, all the books in this library probably weigh several tons.
w|ton.ko: 레스타리 씨 말로는 이 도서관 책을 다 합치면 몇 톤은 될 거래요.

w|ton.text: Kereta barang di jalur sebelah mengangkut ratusan ton batu bara.
w|ton.en: The freight train on the next track carries hundreds of tons of coal.
w|ton.ko: 옆 선로의 화물 열차는 석탄을 수백 톤 실어 날라요.

w|tong.text: Tong kayu itu penuh dengan air hujan.
w|tong.en: That wooden barrel was full of rainwater.

w|tong.text: Petani menyimpan beras di dalam tong.
w|tong.en: The farmer stored rice inside a barrel.

w|tongkat.text: Tongkat kayu itu membantu kakek berjalan.
w|tongkat.en: That wooden cane helps grandpa walk.
w|tongkat.ko: 그 나무 지팡이가 할아버지 걸음을 도와줘.

w|tongkat.text: Dia memegang tongkat saat mendaki bukit.
w|tongkat.en: He held a stick while climbing the hill.
w|tongkat.ko: 그는 언덕을 오를 때 막대를 잡았어.

w|tontonan.text: Drama itu menjadi tontonan favorit keluarga selama libur sekolah.
w|tontonan.en: The play became the family's favorite show during the school holidays.
w|tontonan.ko: 그 연극은 방학 동안 가족들이 가장 즐겨 보는 공연이 됐어요.

w|tontonan.text: Pertengkaran dua pelanggan di depan toko Ayu jadi tontonan warga sekitar.
w|tontonan.en: An argument between two customers in front of Ayu's shop became a spectacle for the neighbors.
w|tontonan.ko: 아유 가게 앞에서 손님 둘이 다툰 게 동네 사람들의 구경거리가 됐어요.

w|topan.text: Ramalan cuaca menyebutkan topan akan lewat dekat pantai, jadi Budi mengikat atap kandang.
w|topan.en: The forecast said a typhoon would pass near the coast, so Budi tied down the shed roof.
w|topan.ko: 일기 예보에서 태풍이 해안 근처를 지난다고 해서 부디는 우리 지붕을 묶었어요.

w|topan.text: Karena ada topan, kiriman ikan untuk dapur Siti terlambat dua hari.
w|topan.en: Because of a typhoon, the fish delivery for Siti's kitchen was two days late.
w|topan.ko: 태풍 때문에 시티의 주방에 올 생선 배송이 이틀 늦었어요.

w|topeng.en: That mask covered his whole face.
The children wore masks at the party.

w|topi.ko: 그 빨간 모자가 그에게 잘 어울려.

w|topi.text: Dia lupa membawa topi ke pantai.
w|topi.en: He forgot to bring a hat to the beach.
w|topi.ko: 그는 해변에 모자를 가져가는 걸 잊었어.

w|topik.text: Redaktur meminta Eko mencari topik yang dekat dengan kehidupan pembaca.
w|topik.en: The editor asked Eko to find a topic close to readers' lives.
w|topik.ko: 편집장은 에코에게 독자 생활과 가까운 주제를 찾아보라고 했어요.

w|topik.text: Ayu sering membuat video tentang topik perawatan baterai.
w|topik.en: Ayu often makes videos on the topic of battery care.
w|topik.ko: 아유는 배터리 관리를 주제로 영상을 자주 만들어요.

w|total.en: The total spend is written on the receipt.

w|tradisi.en: Family tradition is kept across generations.

w|tradisional.text: Andi belajar menari tarian tradisional untuk pentas sekolah.
w|tradisional.en: Andi is learning a traditional dance for the school show.
w|tradisional.ko: 안디는 학교 공연을 위해 전통 춤을 배우고 있어요.

w|tradisional.text: Keluarga Dewi selalu menyajikan kue tradisional di malam pergantian tahun.
w|tradisional.en: Dewi's family always serves traditional cakes on the night the year changes.
w|tradisional.ko: 데위네 가족은 해가 바뀌는 밤마다 전통 과자를 내놓아요.

w|tragedi.text: Dalam pelajaran sejarah, Budi membaca tentang tragedi kapal tenggelam zaman dulu.
w|tragedi.en: In history class, Budi read about a shipwreck tragedy from long ago.
w|tragedi.ko: 역사 시간에 부디는 옛날 배 침몰 비극에 대해 읽었어요.

w|tragedi.text: Bagi Siti, pecahnya piring warisan nenek adalah tragedi kecil hari itu.
w|tragedi.en: For Siti, breaking the plate she inherited from her grandmother was that day's small tragedy.
w|tragedi.ko: 시티에게는 할머니가 물려준 접시가 깨진 게 그날의 작은 비극이었어요.

w|tragis.text: Eko menulis laporan tentang kecelakaan tragis di jalan tol.
w|tragis.en: Eko wrote a report on a tragic accident on the toll road.
w|tragis.ko: 에코는 고속도로에서 난 비극적인 사고를 기사로 썼어요.

w|tragis.text: Bagi pelanggan itu, kehilangan semua foto pernikahan adalah kejadian tragis.
w|tragis.en: For that customer, losing all the wedding photos was a tragic event.
w|tragis.ko: 그 손님에게 결혼사진을 몽땅 잃은 건 비극이었어요.

w|traktir.text: Kalau masakanku dapat nilai terbaik, aku traktir kalian semua, kata Andi.
w|traktir.en: If my dish gets the best score, I'll treat you all, Andi said.
w|traktir.ko: 내 요리가 최고 점수를 받으면 다 한턱낼게, 하고 안디가 말했어요.

w|traktir.text: Dewi berjanji akan traktir Rani makan malam kalau Rani datang ke kotanya.
w|traktir.en: Dewi promised to treat Rani to dinner if Rani came to her city.
w|traktir.ko: 데위는 라니가 자기 도시에 오면 저녁을 사겠다고 약속했어요.

w|traktor.text: Kantor Fajar menjual suku cadang traktor kepada petani di berbagai daerah.
w|traktor.en: Fajar's office sells tractor spare parts to farmers in various regions.
w|traktor.ko: 파자르의 회사는 여러 지역 농민들에게 트랙터 부품을 팔아요.

w|traktor.text: Salah satu klien Lestari adalah koperasi petani yang menyewakan traktor.
w|traktor.en: One of Lestari's clients is a farmers' cooperative that rents out tractors.
w|traktor.ko: 레스타리의 고객 중 하나는 트랙터를 빌려주는 농민 협동조합이에요.

w|transaksi.text: Resepsionis memeriksa bukti transaksi sebelum memberikan obat kepada pemilik kucing.
w|transaksi.en: The receptionist checked the transaction receipt before giving the medicine to the cat's owner.
w|transaksi.ko: 접수원은 고양이 주인에게 약을 주기 전에 거래 영수증을 확인했어요.

w|transaksi.text: Bagian keuangan menolak transaksi itu karena tanda tangan kepala lab belum ada.
w|transaksi.en: The finance office rejected the transaction because the lab head's signature was missing.
w|transaksi.ko: 연구실장 서명이 없어서 재무팀이 그 거래를 거절했어요.

w|transfer.text: Honor pentas Bayu dibayar lewat transfer bank seminggu kemudian.
w|transfer.en: Bayu's performance fee was paid by bank transfer a week later.
w|transfer.ko: 바유의 공연 출연료는 일주일 뒤에 계좌 이체로 들어왔어요.

w|transfer.text: Gaji Intan masuk lewat transfer setiap tanggal dua puluh lima.
w|transfer.en: Intan's salary comes in by transfer on the twenty-fifth of every month.
w|transfer.ko: 인탄의 월급은 매달 이십오일에 이체로 들어와요.

w|transisi.text: Masa transisi dari musim hujan ke kemarau membuat Agus sibuk di ladang.
w|transisi.en: The transition from the rainy season to the dry season keeps Agus busy in the fields.
w|transisi.ko: 우기에서 건기로 넘어가는 시기에는 아구스가 밭에서 바빠요.

w|transisi.text: Wati menulis tentang transisi yang sulit dari desa ke kota besar.
w|transisi.en: Wati wrote about the hard transition from a village to a big city.
w|transisi.ko: 와티는 시골에서 대도시로 옮겨 가며 겪은 힘든 변화에 대해 썼어요.

w|transmisi.text: Guru fisika menjelaskan cara kerja transmisi sinyal radio.
w|transmisi.en: The physics teacher explained how radio signal transmission works.
w|transmisi.ko: 물리 선생님이 라디오 신호 전송 원리를 설명했어요.

w|transmisi.text: Mobil ayah Ayu harus masuk bengkel karena transmisinya rusak.
w|transmisi.en: Ayu's father's car had to go to the garage because its transmission broke.
w|transmisi.ko: 변속기가 고장 나서 아유 아버지의 차는 정비소에 가야 했어요.

w|transplantasi.text: Rudi membaca jurnal tentang transplantasi ginjal pada kucing.
w|transplantasi.en: Rudi read a journal article about kidney transplants in cats.
w|transplantasi.ko: 루디는 고양이 신장 이식에 관한 학술지를 읽었어요.

w|transplantasi.text: Rina membaca kisah pasien transplantasi hati yang kembali mendaki gunung.
w|transplantasi.en: Rina read the story of a liver transplant patient who went back to mountain climbing.
w|transplantasi.ko: 리나는 간이식 환자가 다시 산에 오르게 된 이야기를 읽었어요.

w|transportasi.text: Di desa terpencil itu, transportasi umum hanya ada dua kali sehari.
w|transportasi.en: In that remote village, public transportation only comes twice a day.
w|transportasi.ko: 그 외딴 마을에는 대중교통이 하루에 두 번밖에 없어요.

w|transportasi.text: Wati memilih bekerja di mal yang mudah dijangkau transportasi umum.
w|transportasi.en: Wati chose to work at a mall that is easy to reach by public transportation.
w|transportasi.ko: 와티는 대중교통으로 가기 쉬운 쇼핑몰에서 일하기로 했어요.

w|trauma.text: Agus punya trauma ke dokter gigi sejak dicabut giginya waktu kecil.
w|trauma.en: Agus has had a fear of dentists ever since he had a tooth pulled as a child.
w|trauma.ko: 아구스는 어릴 때 이를 뽑은 뒤로 치과에 대한 트라우마가 있어요.

w|trauma.text: Setelah atap ambruk tahun lalu, Wati masih punya sedikit trauma tiap hujan deras.
w|trauma.en: Since the roof collapsed last year, Wati still feels a little traumatised every time it pours.
w|trauma.ko: 작년에 지붕이 무너진 뒤로 와티는 비가 세게 올 때마다 아직 좀 겁이 나요.

w|tren.text: Agus melihat tren baru di kalangan pengacara muda yang memakai tablet di ruang sidang.
w|tren.en: Agus noticed a new trend among young lawyers using tablets in the courtroom.
w|tren.ko: 아구스는 젊은 변호사들이 법정에서 태블릿을 쓰는 새 유행을 봤어요.

w|tren.text: Wati mengikuti tren minuman boba supaya pelanggan muda mau datang.
w|tren.en: Wati followed the boba drink trend so young customers would come.
w|tren.ko: 와티는 젊은 손님들이 오도록 버블티 유행을 따라갔어요.

w|trik.en: His magic trick amazed the children.

w|trik.text: Ada trik sederhana untuk membuka kunci itu.
w|trik.en: There is a simple trick to open that lock.
w|trik.ko: 그 자물쇠를 여는 간단한 요령이 있어.

w|triliun.text: Fajar membaca bahwa industri obat di negeri ini bernilai ratusan triliun rupiah.
w|triliun.en: Fajar read that the drug industry in this country is worth hundreds of trillions of rupiah.
w|triliun.ko: 파자르는 이 나라 제약 산업 규모가 수백조 루피아라는 걸 읽었어요.

w|triliun.text: Rekan baru itu pernah mengurus proyek senilai satu triliun rupiah.
w|triliun.en: The new coworker once managed a project worth one trillion rupiah.
w|triliun.ko: 새 동료는 일조 루피아짜리 프로젝트를 맡은 적이 있어요.

w|tropis.text: Budi menanam buah-buahan tropis seperti nanas dan pepaya.
w|tropis.en: Budi grows tropical fruits like pineapple and papaya.
w|tropis.ko: 부디는 파인애플과 파파야 같은 열대 과일을 심어요.

w|tropis.text: Siti membuat es campur dengan aneka buah tropis.
w|tropis.en: Siti made es campur with all kinds of tropical fruit.
w|tropis.ko: 시티는 여러 열대 과일로 에스 짬뿌르를 만들었어요.

w|trotoar.text: Bayu berjalan di trotoar kota tua sambil mencari tempat makan.
w|trotoar.en: Bayu walked along the old town's sidewalk looking for a place to eat.
w|trotoar.ko: 바유는 구시가지 인도를 걸으며 먹을 곳을 찾았어요.

w|trotoar.text: Murid-murid menggambar mural di trotoar depan sanggar bersama Intan.
w|trotoar.en: The students painted a mural on the sidewalk in front of the studio with Intan.
w|trotoar.ko: 학생들은 인탄과 함께 화실 앞 인도에 벽화를 그렸어요.

w|truk.en: Load the goods onto the truck.

w|tua.en: That old book is still good.

w|tuas.text: Dimas menarik tuas di bawah kursi supaya posisi duduknya lebih tinggi.
w|tuas.en: Dimas pulled the lever under the chair to raise his seat.
w|tuas.ko: 디마스는 의자 아래 레버를 당겨 앉는 높이를 올렸어요.

w|tuas.text: Putri menekan tuas troli supaya rodanya bisa bergerak.
w|tuas.en: Putri pressed the trolley's lever so the wheels could move.
w|tuas.ko: 푸트리는 바퀴가 움직이도록 카트의 레버를 눌렀어요.

w|tubuh.en: Take good care of your body.

w|tuduhan.en: That accusation has not been proven true.
w|tuduhan.ko: 그 혐의는 아직 사실이 증명되지 않았어.

w|tuduhan.text: Dia menolak semua tuduhan dengan tegas.

w|tujuan.text: Apa tujuan kamu datang ke sini?
w|tujuan.en: What's your purpose in coming here?

w|tukang.en: Call a handyman to fix it.

w|tulang.text: Tulangnya patah saat jatuh dari tangga.
w|tulang.en: His bone broke when he fell from the stairs.
That dog is chewing a big bone.
w|tulang.ko: 그 개는 큰 뼈를 물어뜯고 있어.

w|tuli.text: Kakek Agus agak tuli, jadi dokter harus bicara keras.
w|tuli.en: Agus's grandfather is a bit deaf, so the doctor has to speak loudly.
w|tuli.ko: 아구스의 할아버지는 귀가 좀 어두워서 의사가 크게 말해야 해요.

w|tuli.text: Tetangga sebelah yang sudah tuli tidak terganggu suara palu dari rumah Wati.
w|tuli.en: The deaf neighbour next door isn't bothered by the hammering from Wati's house.
w|tuli.ko: 귀가 들리지 않는 옆집 이웃은 와티네 망치 소리에도 아무렇지 않아요.

w|tulisan.text: Tulisannya sangat rapi dan mudah dibaca.
w|tulisan.en: His handwriting is very neat and easy to read.
w|tulisan.ko: 그의 글씨가 아주 단정하고 읽기 쉬워.

w|tulisan.text: Aku suka membaca tulisan di dinding itu.
w|tulisan.en: I like reading the writing on that wall.
w|tulisan.ko: 난 그 벽에 적힌 글을 읽는 걸 좋아해.

w|tulus.text: Bu Lestari, pustakawan yang tulus, selalu membantu murid mencari buku.
w|tulus.en: Mrs. Lestari, a sincere librarian, always helps students find books.
w|tulus.ko: 마음씨 고운 사서 레스타리 씨는 늘 학생들이 책 찾는 걸 도와줘요.

w|tulus.text: Putri tersentuh oleh senyum tulus kondektur yang membantunya mengangkat koper.
w|tulus.en: Putri was touched by the sincere smile of the conductor who helped her lift her suitcase.
w|tulus.ko: 푸트리는 가방 드는 걸 도와준 차장의 진심 어린 미소에 감동했어요.

w|tumbang.text: Setelah lembur berhari-hari, Bayu akhirnya tumbang karena demam.
w|tumbang.en: After days of overtime, Bayu finally collapsed with a fever.
w|tumbang.ko: 며칠 동안 야근한 끝에 바유는 결국 열이 나서 쓰러졌어요.

w|tumbang.text: Seorang anggota baru hampir tumbang karena lupa sarapan.
w|tumbang.en: A new member nearly collapsed because she forgot to eat breakfast.
w|tumbang.ko: 한 신규 회원이 아침을 거르는 바람에 쓰러질 뻔했어요.

w|tumbuhan.text: Eko memotret tumbuhan paku raksasa di pinggir sungai.
w|tumbuhan.en: Eko photographed a giant fern on the riverbank.

w|tumbuhan.text: Jalur lari Ayu dipenuhi tumbuhan hijau di sepanjang taman kota.
w|tumbuhan.en: Ayu's running route is lined with green plants along the city park.
w|tumbuhan.ko: 아유의 달리기 길은 도시 공원을 따라 초록 식물로 가득해요.

w|tumit.text: Kuda itu terluka di bagian tumit, jadi Rudi membalutnya dengan hati-hati.
w|tumit.en: The horse was injured in the heel, so Rudi bandaged it carefully.
w|tumit.ko: 말이 뒤꿈치를 다쳐서 루디는 조심스럽게 붕대를 감았어요.

w|tumit.text: Sandal baru Rina terlalu keras sampai tumit kakinya lecet.
w|tumit.en: Rina's new sandals were so stiff that her heel got blistered.
w|tumit.ko: 리나의 새 샌들이 너무 딱딱해서 뒤꿈치가 까졌어요.

w|tumpah.text: Kopi Agus tumpah di karpet ketika kucingnya melompat ke meja.
w|tumpah.en: Agus's coffee spilled on the carpet when his cat jumped onto the table.
w|tumpah.ko: 고양이가 탁자에 뛰어올라서 아구스의 커피가 카펫에 쏟아졌어요.

w|tumpah.text: Air hujan tumpah dari talang yang penuh daun kering.
w|tumpah.en: Rainwater spilled over from the gutter full of dry leaves.
w|tumpah.ko: 마른 잎으로 꽉 찬 홈통에서 빗물이 넘쳐흘렀어요.

w|tumpangan.en: He asked for a ride to the station.
Free rides are available for students.

w|tumpukan.text: Di meja guru ada tumpukan buku tugas yang belum diperiksa.
w|tumpukan.en: On the teacher's desk there is a pile of homework books that haven't been checked yet.
w|tumpukan.ko: 선생님 책상 위에 아직 검사하지 않은 숙제 공책 더미가 있어요.

w|tumpukan.text: Siti tersandung tumpukan kardus di depan pintu.
w|tumpukan.en: Siti tripped over a pile of boxes in front of the door.
w|tumpukan.ko: 시티는 문 앞에 쌓인 상자 더미에 걸려 넘어질 뻔했어요.

w|tumpul.text: Pensil-pensil di meja Rudi sudah tumpul semua.
w|tumpul.en: The pencils on Rudi's desk have all gone blunt.
w|tumpul.ko: 루디 책상 위 연필은 다 뭉툭해졌어요.

w|tumpul.text: Rina mengganti gunting kuku yang sudah tumpul.
w|tumpul.en: Rina replaced the nail clippers that had gone dull.

w|tunai.text: Toko ini hanya menerima pembayaran tunai.
w|tunai.en: This shop only accepts cash payment.

w|tunangan.text: Tunangan saya akan datang minggu depan.
w|tunangan.en: My fiancé will come next week.
w|tunangan.ko: 내 약혼자가 다음 주에 올 거야.

w|tunangan.en: She introduced her fiancé to her family.

w|tunas.text: Bayu senang melihat tunas baru muncul dari tunggul pohon tua.
w|tunas.en: Bayu was glad to see a new shoot coming out of the old tree stump.
w|tunas.ko: 바유는 오래된 그루터기에서 새싹이 돋는 걸 보고 기뻤어요.

w|tunas.text: Pelatih menyebut Intan sebagai tunas baru dunia atletik daerah.
w|tunas.en: The coach called Intan a rising talent in the region's athletics scene.
w|tunas.ko: 코치는 인탄을 지역 육상계의 새싹이라고 불렀어요.

w|tunawisma.text: Sisa makanan pesta dibagikan kepada para tunawisma di dekat masjid.
w|tunawisma.en: The leftover party food was given to homeless people near the mosque.
w|tunawisma.ko: 잔치 음식 남은 것은 모스크 근처 노숙인들에게 나눠 줬어요.

w|tunawisma.text: Lestari menulis kisah para tunawisma yang tidur di bawah jembatan saat musim hujan.
w|tunawisma.en: Lestari wrote about the homeless people who sleep under bridges during the rainy season.
w|tunawisma.ko: 레스타리는 우기에 다리 밑에서 자는 노숙인들의 이야기를 썼어요.

w|tunggal.text: Tunggal itu berarti hanya satu orang.

w|tunjangan.text: Bulan ini semua karyawan mendapat tunjangan transportasi tambahan.
w|tunjangan.en: This month all employees received an extra transportation allowance.
w|tunjangan.ko: 이번 달 모든 직원이 교통 수당을 더 받았어요.

w|tunjangan.text: Selain gaji, perusahaan Lestari memberi tunjangan internet untuk karyawan yang bekerja dari rumah.
w|tunjangan.en: Besides salary, Lestari's company gives an internet allowance to employees working from home.
w|tunjangan.ko: 레스타리 회사는 월급 말고도 재택근무 직원에게 인터넷 수당을 줘요.

w|tuntutan.en: The workers' demands were presented to management.
The prosecutor filed charges in court.

w|tupai.text: Seekor tupai melompat dari pohon kelapa dan membawa lari pisang Agus.
w|tupai.en: A squirrel jumped from a coconut tree and ran off with Agus's banana.
w|tupai.ko: 다람쥐 한 마리가 야자나무에서 뛰어내려 아구스의 바나나를 물고 달아났어요.

w|tupai.text: Seorang anak datang ke apotek dengan tangan tergigit tupai peliharaannya.
w|tupai.en: A child came to the pharmacy with a hand bitten by his pet squirrel.
w|tupai.ko: 한 아이가 기르던 다람쥐에게 손을 물려서 약국에 왔어요.

w|tur.text: Tur kota dimulai dari alun-alun utama.
w|tur.en: The city tour started from the main square.

w|tur.text: Kami ikut tur museum bersama pemandu.
w|tur.en: We joined a museum tour with a guide.
w|tur.ko: 우리는 가이드와 함께 박물관 투어에 참여했어.

w|turis.text: Di gerbong makan, Dimas mengobrol dengan dua turis yang sedang belajar bahasa Indonesia.
w|turis.en: In the dining car, Dimas chatted with two tourists who were learning Indonesian.
w|turis.ko: 식당 칸에서 디마스는 인도네시아어를 배우는 관광객 두 명과 이야기를 나눴어요.

w|turis.text: Fitur terjemahan baru di aplikasi Putri sangat disukai para turis.
w|turis.en: The new translation feature in Putri's app is very popular with tourists.
w|turis.ko: 푸트리 앱의 새 번역 기능은 관광객들에게 인기가 많아요.

w|turnamen.text: Tim basket Andi lolos ke semifinal turnamen antarsekolah.
w|turnamen.en: Andi's basketball team made it to the semifinal of the interschool tournament.
w|turnamen.ko: 안디의 농구팀이 학교 대항 대회 준결승에 올랐어요.

w|turnamen.text: Di ruang istirahat, para perawat menonton siaran turnamen bulu tangkis.
w|turnamen.en: In the break room, the nurses watched a badminton tournament broadcast.
w|turnamen.ko: 휴게실에서 간호사들이 배드민턴 대회 중계를 봤어요.

w|turunan.text: Bayu ditugaskan memasarkan produk turunan dari minyak kelapa.
w|turunan.en: Bayu was assigned to market products derived from coconut oil.
w|turunan.ko: 바유는 코코넛 기름으로 만든 파생 제품을 홍보하는 일을 맡았어요.

w|turunan.text: Pelatih menjelaskan bahwa bentuk tubuh juga dipengaruhi faktor turunan.
w|turunan.en: The trainer explained that body shape is also influenced by hereditary factors.
w|turunan.ko: 트레이너는 체형이 유전적 요인의 영향도 받는다고 설명했어요.

w|turut.text: Dia turut serta dalam acara itu.
w|turut.en: He took part in that event.

w|tusukan.text: Anjing itu bahkan tidak merasakan tusukan jarum suntik dari Budi.
w|tusukan.en: The dog didn't even feel the prick of Budi's needle.
w|tusukan.ko: 그 개는 부디가 놓은 주삿바늘에 찔린 것도 느끼지 못했어요.

w|tusukan.text: Bekas tusukan duri di jari Siti masih terasa perih.
w|tusukan.en: The spot where a thorn pricked Siti's finger still stings.
w|tusukan.ko: 가시에 찔린 시티의 손가락 자리가 아직도 따끔해요.

w|ucapan.en: His words of thanks sounded sincere.

w|ucapan.text: Pilih ucapan yang sopan saat berbicara.
w|ucapan.en: Choose polite wording when you speak.

w|udang.text: Andi belajar mengupas udang dan membuang kotorannya dengan pisau kecil.
w|udang.en: Andi learned to peel shrimp and remove the vein with a small knife.
w|udang.ko: 안디는 작은 칼로 새우 껍질을 벗기고 내장을 빼는 법을 배웠어요.

w|udang.text: Dewi menceritakan kerupuk udang buatan neneknya yang selalu habis dalam sehari.
w|udang.en: Dewi wrote about her grandmother's shrimp crackers that were always gone within a day.
w|udang.ko: 데위는 늘 하루 만에 동나던 할머니표 새우 과자 얘기를 썼어요.

w|udara.en: The air this morning is very fresh.
They took the plane into the air.

w|uji.en: They performed a vehicle safety test.
The blood test is scheduled for tomorrow morning.
w|uji.ko: 혈액 검사는 내일 아침으로 잡혀 있어.

w|ujian.en: Tomorrow there is a math exam.

w|ujian.ko: 그 시험은 두 시간 동안 진행됐어.

w|ujung.en: The tip of that pencil is already dull.

w|ujung.text: Kami menunggu di ujung jalan besar.
w|ujung.en: We waited at the end of the main road.

w|ukiran.text: Fajar mengagumi ukiran kayu di pintu utama balai kota yang berumur seratus tahun lebih.
w|ukiran.en: Fajar admired the wood carving on the main door of city hall, which is over a hundred years old.
w|ukiran.ko: 파자르는 백 년이 넘은 시청 정문의 나무 조각에 감탄했어요.

w|ukiran.text: Lestari mengirimkan foto ukiran kayu buatan ayahnya bersama suratnya.
w|ukiran.en: Lestari sent a photo of a wood carving made by her father along with her letter.
w|ukiran.ko: 레스타리는 아버지가 만든 나무 조각품 사진을 편지와 함께 보냈어요.

w|ukuran.en: This shoe size is too small.
Choose the size that fits you.

w|ulah.text: Server redaksi mati gara-gara ulah tikus yang menggigit kabel.
w|ulah.en: The newsroom server went down because of a rat that chewed through a cable.
w|ulah.ko: 쥐가 케이블을 갉는 바람에 편집국 서버가 멈췄어요.

w|ulah.text: Layar ponsel retak karena ulah keponakan pelanggan yang suka melempar barang.
w|ulah.en: The phone screen cracked because of the antics of the customer's nephew, who likes to throw things.
w|ulah.ko: 물건 던지기 좋아하는 손님 조카 탓에 휴대폰 화면이 깨졌어요.

w|ular.en: That snake is crawling in the grass.
w|ular.ko: 그 뱀이 풀 속을 기어가고 있어.

w|ular.en: She is afraid of seeing snakes.

w|ulasan.text: Fajar menulis ulasan singkat tentang program kebersihan kota untuk buletin kantor.
w|ulasan.en: Fajar wrote a short review of the city's cleanliness program for the office bulletin.
w|ulasan.ko: 파자르는 사무실 소식지에 도시 청결 사업에 대한 짧은 평을 썼어요.

w|ulasan.text: Lestari menyertakan ulasan singkat tentang novel yang baru selesai ia baca.
w|ulasan.en: Lestari included a short review of the novel she had just finished reading.
w|ulasan.ko: 레스타리는 막 다 읽은 소설에 대한 짧은 평을 덧붙였어요.

w|ulat.text: Agus memungut ulat dari daun kol satu per satu.
w|ulat.en: Agus picked the caterpillars off the cabbage leaves one by one.
w|ulat.ko: 아구스는 양배추 잎에서 애벌레를 하나씩 떼어 냈어요.

w|ulat.text: Wati mengenang saat mereka memelihara ulat sampai menjadi kupu-kupu.
w|ulat.en: Wati recalled when they raised a caterpillar until it became a butterfly.
w|ulat.ko: 와티는 둘이 애벌레를 나비가 될 때까지 키우던 때를 떠올렸어요.

w|umat.text: Umat berkumpul di halaman tempat ibadah.
w|umat.en: The congregation gathered in the worship yard.
The leader spoke to the whole community of faith.

w|umpan.en: The fisherman put bait on the hook.

w|umpan.text: Umpan itu berhasil menarik ikan besar.
w|umpan.en: That bait succeeded in attracting a big fish.
w|umpan.ko: 그 미끼가 큰 물고기를 끌어들이는 데 성공했어.

w|undangan.en: The wedding invitation was sent last week.
She received an invitation to an official meeting.

w|unggul.text: Bibit padi unggul dari dinas pertanian tumbuh subur di sawah keluarga Agus.
w|unggul.en: The high-quality rice seedlings from the agriculture office grow well in Agus's family's paddy.
w|unggul.ko: 농업 사무소에서 받은 우량 볍씨가 아구스네 논에서 잘 자라요.

w|unggul.text: Apotek Wati unggul dalam pelayanan karena buka dua puluh empat jam.
w|unggul.en: Wati's pharmacy excels in service because it's open twenty-four hours.
w|unggul.ko: 와티의 약국은 이십사 시간 문을 열어서 서비스가 뛰어나요.

w|unggun.text: Eko dan teman-temannya bernyanyi di sekeliling api unggun sampai larut malam.
w|unggun.en: Eko and his friends sang around the campfire until late at night.
w|unggun.ko: 에코와 친구들은 밤늦게까지 모닥불 둘레에서 노래했어요.

w|unggun.text: Setelah lomba, para pelari berkumpul di sekitar api unggun di tepi pantai.
w|unggun.en: After the race, the runners gathered around a bonfire on the beach.
w|unggun.ko: 대회가 끝나고 주자들은 해변의 모닥불 둘레에 모였어요.

w|ungkapan.text: Bayu suka memakai ungkapan lama dalam judul beritanya.
w|ungkapan.en: Bayu likes to use old sayings in his headlines.
w|ungkapan.ko: 바유는 기사 제목에 옛 표현을 즐겨 써요.

w|ungkapan.text: Pesan galat di aplikasi itu ditulis dengan ungkapan yang ramah.
w|ungkapan.en: The app's error messages are written in friendly wording.
w|ungkapan.ko: 그 앱의 오류 메시지는 친절한 말투로 쓰여 있어요.

w|ungu.text: Budi selalu menandai berita penting dengan stabilo ungu.
w|ungu.en: Budi always marks important stories with a purple highlighter.
w|ungu.ko: 부디는 중요한 기사를 늘 보라색 형광펜으로 표시해요.

w|ungu.text: Rak buku anak di perpustakaan itu dicat ungu dan kuning.
w|ungu.en: The children's bookshelves in that library are painted purple and yellow.
w|ungu.ko: 그 도서관의 어린이 책장은 보라색과 노란색으로 칠해져 있어요.

w|unik.text: Gaya tulisannya sangat unik dan menarik.
w|unik.en: Her writing style is very unique and appealing.
That unique idea won the competition.

w|unit.text: Unit khusus dikirim ke lokasi kejadian.
w|unit.en: A special unit was sent to the scene.
Each unit has a different task.
w|unit.ko: 각 유닛은 서로 다른 임무를 가져.

w|universitas.text: Universitas itu terkenal di seluruh negeri.
w|universitas.en: That university is famous across the country.
My younger sibling entered university this year.

w|unjuk rasa.text: Rudi menjaga unjuk rasa mahasiswa agar berjalan damai.
w|unjuk rasa.en: Rudi kept watch over the student demonstration so it would stay peaceful.
w|unjuk rasa.ko: 루디는 대학생 시위가 평화롭게 진행되도록 지켰어요.

w|unjuk rasa.text: Rina ikut unjuk rasa damai menentang perdagangan satwa liar.
w|unjuk rasa.en: Rina joined a peaceful demonstration against the wildlife trade.
w|unjuk rasa.ko: 리나는 야생동물 거래에 반대하는 평화 시위에 참여했어요.

w|unsur.text: Kain songket pengantin memadukan unsur Melayu dan Jawa.
w|unsur.en: The bride's songket cloth combines Malay and Javanese elements.
w|unsur.ko: 신부의 송껫 천은 말레이와 자바 요소를 섞었어요.

w|unsur.text: Redaktur bilang tulisan Rina perlu unsur manusia, bukan hanya angka.
w|unsur.en: The editor said Rina's piece needs a human element, not just numbers.
w|unsur.ko: 편집자는 리나의 글에 숫자만이 아니라 사람 이야기가 필요하다고 했어요.

w|unta.text: Melihat hamparan pasir di tepi pantai, Rudi bercanda bahwa mereka seharusnya naik unta.
w|unta.en: Seeing the stretch of sand by the beach, Rudi joked that they should have ridden camels.
w|unta.ko: 해변의 넓은 모래밭을 보고 루디는 낙타를 타고 왔어야 했다고 농담했어요.

w|unta.text: Salah satu penari latar memakai kostum unta yang lucu.
w|unta.en: One of the backup dancers wore a funny camel costume.
w|unta.ko: 백댄서 중 한 명이 귀여운 낙타 의상을 입었어요.

w|untung.text: Untung saja kita membawa payung hari ini.
w|untung.en: Luckily we brought an umbrella today.

w|untung.text: Toko itu mendapat untung besar bulan ini.
w|untung.en: That store made a big profit this month.
w|untung.ko: 그 가게는 이번 달에 큰 이익을 냈어.

w|upacara.en: The wedding ceremony was held on the beach.
They attended the graduation ceremony together.

w|upah.text: Wartawan muda di ruang redaksi itu mengeluh upah mereka belum naik tiga tahun.
w|upah.en: The young reporters in that newsroom complain their wages haven't gone up in three years.
w|upah.ko: 그 편집국의 젊은 기자들은 삼 년째 급여가 오르지 않았다고 불평해요.

w|upah.text: Siti bekerja di perpustakaan kota dengan upah yang pas-pasan.
w|upah.en: Siti works at the city library for a modest wage.
w|upah.ko: 시티는 넉넉하지 않은 급여를 받으며 시립 도서관에서 일해요.

w|upaya.en: The rescue effort succeeded that night.

w|upaya.text: Setiap upaya kecil membawa perubahan nyata.
w|upaya.en: Every small effort brings real change.
w|upaya.ko: 작은 노력 하나하나가 진짜 변화를 가져와.

w|upeti.text: Dalam lakon sejarah itu, raja kecil harus mengirim upeti berupa emas ke kerajaan besar.
w|upeti.en: In the historical play, the minor king must send tribute in gold to the great kingdom.
w|upeti.ko: 그 사극에서 작은 왕은 큰 왕국에 금으로 조공을 바쳐야 해요.

w|upeti.text: Pemandu wisata di kereta bercerita tentang upeti yang dulu dibawa lewat jalur ini.
w|upeti.en: The tour guide on the train told about the tribute that used to be carried along this route.
w|upeti.ko: 열차 안 관광 안내원이 옛날 이 길로 실어 나르던 조공 이야기를 해 줬어요.

w|urat.text: Fajar menyarankan krim pereda nyeri untuk urat leher yang tegang.
w|urat.en: Fajar suggested a pain-relief cream for the tense muscles in the neck.
w|urat.ko: 파자르는 뭉친 목 근육에 바를 진통 크림을 권했어요.

w|urat.text: Lestari melihat urat di dahi manajer menegang saat rapat.
w|urat.en: Lestari saw the vein on the manager's forehead tense up during the meeting.
w|urat.ko: 레스타리는 회의 중에 매니저 이마에 핏대가 서는 걸 봤어요.

w|urutan.en: The seating order has already been set.

w|usah.text: Tetangga bilang kepada Dimas, "Tidak usah bawa cangkul, saya sudah punya dua."
w|usah.en: The neighbor told Dimas, "No need to bring a hoe, I already have two."
w|usah.ko: 이웃이 디마스에게 "괭이는 안 가져와도 돼, 나한테 두 개 있어."라고 했어요.

w|usah.text: Ibu Putri menelepon, "Tidak usah masak, Ibu bawa makanan."
w|usah.en: Putri's mother called: "No need to cook, I'm bringing food."
w|usah.ko: 푸트리의 어머니가 전화로 "밥 하지 마, 엄마가 음식 가져갈게."라고 했어요.

w|usaha.en: His small business is starting to grow.

w|usai.text: Sidang hari ini baru usai menjelang magrib.
w|usai.en: Today's hearing only ended around dusk.
w|usai.ko: 오늘 재판은 해 질 무렵에야 끝났어요.

w|usai.text: Lestari menghitung uang di dapur usai menutup warung.
w|usai.en: Lestari counts the money in the kitchen after closing the shop.
w|usai.ko: 레스타리는 가게 문을 닫은 뒤 부엌에서 돈을 세요.

w|usang.text: Banyak alat di gym kampung itu sudah usang tapi masih dipakai.
w|usang.en: Much of the equipment at the neighborhood gym is worn out but still used.
w|usang.ko: 그 동네 헬스장 기구는 상당수가 낡았지만 아직 쓰여요.

w|usang.text: Buku menu restoran itu sudah usang dan beberapa halamannya robek.
w|usang.en: The restaurant's menu book is worn out and some of its pages are torn.
w|usang.ko: 그 식당 메뉴판은 낡아서 몇 장이 찢어졌어요.

w|usia.text: Pada usia itu, dia sudah hebat.
w|usia.en: At that age, he was already great.

w|uskup.text: Seorang uskup tamu memberi sambutan di acara wisuda sekolah Dimas.
w|uskup.en: A visiting bishop gave a speech at Dimas's school graduation.
w|uskup.ko: 디마스 학교 졸업식에서 초청된 주교님이 축사를 했어요.

w|uskup.text: Seorang uskup dan rombongannya makan siang di restoran Putri setelah misa.
w|uskup.en: A bishop and his group had lunch at Putri's restaurant after mass.
w|uskup.ko: 주교님과 일행이 미사 후 푸트리네 식당에서 점심을 먹었어요.

w|usul.text: Redaktur menerima usul Bayu untuk membuat rubrik khusus tentang lingkungan.
w|usul.en: The editor accepted Bayu's proposal to create a special section on the environment.
w|usul.ko: 편집장은 환경 특집란을 만들자는 바유의 제안을 받아들였어요.

w|usul.text: Kepala desa menerima usul Intan untuk membuat jalur pendakian baru.
w|usul.en: The village head accepted Intan's suggestion to make a new hiking trail.
w|usul.ko: 이장은 새 등산로를 만들자는 인탄의 제안을 받아들였어요.

w|usulan.text: Dimas menulis usulan di buku tamu agar museum buka sampai malam.
w|usulan.en: Dimas wrote a suggestion in the guest book for the museum to stay open until evening.
w|usulan.ko: 디마스는 박물관을 밤까지 열어 달라는 제안을 방명록에 적었어요.

w|usulan.text: Sutradara menerima usulan Putri untuk mengganti akhir cerita.
w|usulan.en: The director accepted Putri's suggestion to change the ending of the story.
w|usulan.ko: 감독은 결말을 바꾸자는 푸트리의 제안을 받아들였어요.

w|usus.text: Dokter bilang usus Budi meradang karena dia sering telat makan.
w|usus.en: The doctor said Budi's intestines were inflamed because he often ate late.
w|usus.ko: 의사는 부디가 자주 끼니를 늦게 먹어서 장에 염증이 생겼다고 했어요.

w|usus.text: Malam pertama di rumah baru, Siti membeli sate usus dari warung dekat rumah.
w|usus.en: On the first night in the new house, Siti bought chicken intestine satay from a nearby stall.
w|usus.ko: 새집에서의 첫날 밤, 시티는 근처 가게에서 닭 내장 꼬치를 사 왔어요.

w|utama.en: The main road is very crowded.

w|utang.text: Fajar tidak mau belanja dengan cicilan karena takut punya utang.
w|utang.en: Fajar doesn't want to shop in installments because he's afraid of having debt.
w|utang.ko: 파자르는 빚이 생길까 봐 할부로 쇼핑하지 않으려고 해요.

w|utang.text: Lestari baru selesai membayar utang kursus memasak bulan lalu.
w|utang.en: Lestari just finished paying off her cooking course debt last month.
w|utang.ko: 레스타리는 지난달에야 요리 강좌 빚을 다 갚았어요.

w|utara.en: The wind comes from the north.
They live in the north of the city.

w|utuh.text: Kotak itu masih utuh setelah pengiriman jauh.
w|utuh.en: The box was still intact after the long delivery.
w|utuh.ko: 그 상자는 먼 배송 후에도  Intact 그대로였어.

w|utuh.text: Utuh atau tidak, dia tetap menyimpan barang itu.
w|utuh.en: Intact or not, she still kept that item.
w|utuh.ko: 온전하든 아니든 그녀는 그 물건을 계속 간직했어.

w|utusan.text: Seorang utusan dari kedutaan ikut hadir di ruang sidang.
w|utusan.en: An envoy from the embassy also attended the courtroom.
w|utusan.ko: 대사관에서 온 사절 한 명도 법정에 참석했어요.

w|utusan.text: Seorang utusan dari koperasi datang menawarkan pinjaman kepada Lestari.
w|utusan.en: A representative from the cooperative came to offer Lestari a loan.
w|utusan.ko: 협동조합에서 보낸 사람이 레스타리에게 대출을 제안하러 왔어요.

w|vaksin.text: Semua kucing di tempat penampungan itu sudah mendapat vaksin rabies.
w|vaksin.en: All the cats at that shelter have received the rabies vaccine.
w|vaksin.ko: 그 보호소의 고양이는 모두 광견병 백신을 맞았어요.

w|vaksin.text: Putri terus memperjuangkan dana tambahan untuk proyek vaksin timnya.
w|vaksin.en: Putri keeps fighting for extra funding for her team's vaccine project.
w|vaksin.ko: 푸트리는 팀의 백신 사업을 위해 추가 예산을 얻으려고 계속 애쓰고 있어요.

w|vampir.text: Vampir dalam cerita itu takut cahaya matahari.
w|vampir.en: The vampire in that story fears sunlight.

w|vampir.text: Anak-anak berpakaian seperti vampir di pesta.
w|vampir.en: The children dressed as vampires at the party.

w|ventilasi.text: Andi menambah ventilasi di kamar mandi supaya dindingnya tidak berjamur.
w|ventilasi.en: Andi added ventilation to the bathroom so the walls wouldn't get moldy.
w|ventilasi.ko: 안디는 벽에 곰팡이가 피지 않게 욕실에 환기구를 더 냈어요.

w|ventilasi.text: Gerbong tua itu tidak punya ventilasi yang baik, jadi udaranya pengap.
w|ventilasi.en: The old carriage has poor ventilation, so the air is stuffy.
w|ventilasi.ko: 그 낡은 객차는 환기가 잘 안 돼서 공기가 답답해요.

w|versi.en: The new version of the app is faster.

w|versi.text: Dia menonton versi film yang diperpanjang.
w|versi.en: He watched the extended version of the film.

w|vertikal.text: Andi menyusun foto dalam format vertikal untuk media sosial.
w|vertikal.en: Andi arranged the photos in vertical format for social media.
w|vertikal.ko: 안디는 소셜 미디어용으로 사진을 세로형으로 편집했어요.

w|vertikal.text: Dewi menyimpan piring secara vertikal supaya tidak pecah di jalan.
w|vertikal.en: Dewi packed the plates vertically so they wouldn't break on the way.
w|vertikal.ko: 데위는 가는 길에 깨지지 않도록 접시를 세로로 세워 쌌어요.

w|virus.en: His computer got infected by a dangerous virus.

w|visi.text: Dalam pidatonya, ketua pengadilan berbicara tentang visi peradilan yang bersih.
w|visi.en: In his speech, the head of the court spoke about a vision of a clean judiciary.
w|visi.ko: 법원장은 연설에서 깨끗한 사법부라는 비전을 이야기했어요.

w|visi.text: Lestari punya visi menjadikan warungnya sebuah minimarket kecil.
w|visi.en: Lestari has a vision of turning her shop into a small minimarket.
w|visi.ko: 레스타리는 가게를 작은 편의점으로 키우겠다는 비전이 있어요.

w|vokal.text: Bayu mewawancarai penyanyi muda dengan vokal yang kuat dari kota kecil.
w|vokal.en: Bayu interviewed a young singer with powerful vocals from a small town.
w|vokal.ko: 바유는 작은 도시 출신의 목소리가 힘찬 젊은 가수를 인터뷰했어요.

w|vokal.text: Intan membeli mikrofon kecil untuk latihan vokal di kamar.
w|vokal.en: Intan bought a small microphone for vocal practice in her room.
w|vokal.ko: 인탄은 방에서 발성 연습을 하려고 작은 마이크를 샀어요.

w|vonis.text: Fajar mengikuti berita tentang vonis hakim terhadap mantan pejabat kota.
w|vonis.en: Fajar followed the news about the judge's verdict on a former city official.
w|vonis.ko: 파자르는 전 시 공무원에 대한 판사의 판결 뉴스를 지켜봤어요.

w|vonis.text: Lestari lega setelah dokter memberi vonis bahwa ibunya hanya kelelahan.
w|vonis.en: Lestari was relieved when the doctor's verdict was that her mother was just exhausted.
w|vonis.ko: 의사가 어머니는 그냥 과로라고 진단하자 레스타리는 안심했어요.

w|wabah.text: Wabah flu menyebar cepat di musim hujan.
w|wabah.en: The flu outbreak spread fast in the rainy season.
The government tried to contain that outbreak.

w|wadah.text: Andi mengumpulkan sekrup dan baut di dalam wadah plastik.
w|wadah.en: Andi collects screws and bolts in a plastic container.
w|wadah.ko: 안디는 나사와 볼트를 플라스틱 통에 모아요.

w|wadah.text: Dewi membawa nasi goreng dalam wadah kaca dari rumah.
w|wadah.en: Dewi brought fried rice from home in a glass container.
w|wadah.ko: 데위는 집에서 볶음밥을 유리 그릇에 담아 왔어요.

w|wafat.text: Seluruh warga gang melayat ketika kakek Andi wafat bulan lalu.
w|wafat.en: The whole alley came to pay respects when Andi's grandfather passed away last month.
w|wafat.ko: 지난달 안디의 할아버지가 돌아가셨을 때 골목 주민 모두가 조문을 왔어요.

w|wafat.text: Dewi membaca bahwa sang pelukis wafat sebelum karya terakhirnya selesai.
w|wafat.en: Dewi read that the painter passed away before his last work was finished.
w|wafat.ko: 데위는 그 화가가 마지막 작품을 끝내기 전에 세상을 떠났다는 글을 읽었어요.

w|wahyu.text: Dalam pameran sejarah kota, Fajar membaca kisah tentang raja yang konon mendapat wahyu untuk membangun kota ini.
w|wahyu.en: At the city history exhibition, Fajar read the tale of a king who supposedly received a revelation to build this city.
w|wahyu.ko: 도시 역사 전시회에서 파자르는 이 도시를 세우라는 계시를 받았다는 왕의 이야기를 읽었어요.

w|wahyu.text: Lestari bercanda bahwa ide membuka toko kue datang kepadanya seperti wahyu.
w|wahyu.en: Lestari joked that the idea of opening a cake shop came to her like a revelation.
w|wahyu.ko: 레스타리는 케이크 가게를 열 생각이 계시처럼 떠올랐다고 농담했어요.

w|wajar.text: Wajar jika dia marah setelah menunggu lama.
w|wajar.en: It is reasonable if he is angry after waiting long.
w|wajar.ko: 오래 기다린 뒤 화내는 건 당연해.

w|wajar.text: Harga tiket itu masih wajar untuk konser.
w|wajar.en: That ticket price is still reasonable for a concert.
w|wajar.ko: 그 표 값은 콘서트치고 아직 괜찮아.

w|wakil.en: She became the deputy chair of the committee.

w|waktu.en: I was still little back then.

w|walau.en: Even though it rained, he still came.
She smiled even though she was sad.

w|wali.text: Rina harus izin pulang cepat untuk menghadiri rapat wali murid di sekolah anaknya.
w|wali.en: Rina had to leave early to attend a parents' meeting at her child's school.
w|wali.ko: 리나는 아이 학교의 학부모 회의에 가려고 일찍 퇴근해야 했어요.

w|wali.text: Seorang anak hilang di lobi, jadi Dewi segera mencari walinya.
w|wali.en: A child got lost in the lobby, so Dewi immediately looked for the child's guardian.
w|wali.ko: 아이가 로비에서 길을 잃어서 데위는 바로 보호자를 찾았어요.

w|walikota.en: The mayor visited the market in the morning.

w|walikota.text: Warga memilih walikota baru minggu lalu.
w|walikota.en: Residents chose a new mayor last week.

w|wangi.text: Bunga kemuning di pinggir hutan sangat wangi di malam hari.
w|wangi.en: The orange jasmine flowers at the forest's edge are very fragrant at night.
w|wangi.ko: 숲 가장자리의 꾸무닝 꽃은 밤에 향기가 아주 좋아요.

w|wangi.text: Minyak kayu putih di apotek itu wangi dan laris.
w|wangi.en: The eucalyptus oil at that pharmacy smells nice and sells well.
w|wangi.ko: 그 약국의 까유뿌띠 오일은 향이 좋아서 잘 팔려요.

w|waras.text: Pengacara itu mempertanyakan apakah terdakwa benar-benar waras saat kejadian.
w|waras.en: The lawyer questioned whether the defendant was really sane at the time of the incident.
w|waras.ko: 그 변호사는 피고인이 사건 당시 정말 제정신이었는지 의문을 제기했어요.

w|waras.text: Lestari bercanda bahwa orang waras tidak akan buka warung sampai tengah malam.
w|waras.en: Lestari jokes that no sane person would keep a shop open until midnight.
w|waras.ko: 레스타리는 제정신인 사람이라면 자정까지 가게를 열지 않을 거라며 농담해요.

w|warga.en: All residents are invited to the meeting.

w|waris.text: Lakon terbaru Eko berkisah tentang tiga saudara yang bertengkar soal harta waris.
w|waris.en: Eko's latest play is about three siblings who quarrel over an inheritance.
w|waris.ko: 에코의 새 연극은 유산 문제로 다투는 세 형제 이야기예요.

w|waris.text: Ayu adalah ahli waris sawah terasering milik kakeknya.
w|waris.en: Ayu is the heir to her grandfather's terraced rice fields.
w|waris.ko: 아유는 할아버지의 계단식 논을 물려받을 상속인이에요.

w|warisan.text: Andi melapor karena surat tanah warisan kakeknya dicuri.
w|warisan.en: Andi filed a report because the land deed he inherited from his grandfather was stolen.
w|warisan.ko: 안디는 할아버지에게 물려받은 토지 문서를 도둑맞아 신고했어요.

w|warisan.text: Sepatu basket Dewi adalah warisan dari kakaknya yang dulu juga pemain.
w|warisan.en: Dewi's basketball shoes are a hand-me-down from her older sister, who also used to play.
w|warisan.ko: 데위의 농구화는 예전에 선수였던 언니에게서 물려받은 거예요.

w|wartawan.en: The reporter asked about that incident.

w|wartawan.text: Banyak wartawan datang ke konferensi pers.
w|wartawan.en: Many journalists came to the press conference.

w|warung.text: Setiap pagi Agus menitipkan roti di warung kopi di ujung jalan.
w|warung.en: Every morning Agus leaves bread to be sold at the coffee stall at the end of the street.
w|warung.ko: 아구스는 매일 아침 길 끝 커피 노점에 빵을 맡겨 팔아요.

w|warung.text: Wati dan tim sering makan siang di warung padang depan kantor.
w|warung.en: Wati and the team often have lunch at the Padang food stall in front of the office.
w|warung.ko: 와티와 팀원들은 사무실 앞 파당 음식점에서 자주 점심을 먹어요.

w|wasiat.text: Dalam pelajaran sastra, Agus membaca cerita tentang wasiat seorang raja tua.
w|wasiat.en: In literature class, Agus read a story about an old king's will.
w|wasiat.ko: 문학 시간에 아구스는 늙은 왕의 유언에 관한 이야기를 읽었어요.

w|wasiat.text: Kolam renang itu dibangun dari tanah wasiat seorang dermawan desa.
w|wasiat.en: That pool was built on land left in the will of a village philanthropist.
w|wasiat.ko: 그 수영장은 마을의 한 독지가가 유언으로 남긴 땅에 지어졌어요.

w|wasit.text: Dalam pertandingan antarkelas, Budi ditunjuk menjadi wasit.
w|wasit.en: In the inter-class match, Budi was appointed referee.
w|wasit.ko: 반 대항 경기에서 부디가 심판으로 뽑혔어요.

w|wasit.text: Siti duduk bersebelahan dengan wasit sepak bola yang hendak memimpin pertandingan internasional.
w|wasit.en: Siti sat next to a football referee about to officiate an international match.
w|wasit.ko: 시티는 국제 경기 심판을 보러 가는 축구 심판 옆에 앉았어요.

w|waspada.en: Stay alert when crossing the road.

w|wastafel.text: Agus memanggil tukang karena wastafel dapur tersumbat.
w|wastafel.en: Agus called a repairman because the kitchen sink was clogged.
w|wastafel.ko: 부엌 개수대가 막혀서 아구스는 수리공을 불렀어요.

w|wastafel.text: Wati menaruh sabun cair di samping wastafel untuk tamu.
w|wastafel.en: Wati put liquid soap next to the sink for the guests.
w|wastafel.ko: 와티는 손님용 세면대 옆에 물비누를 놓았어요.

w|wawancara.text: Wawancara kerja berlangsung di ruang kedua.
w|wawancara.en: The job interview takes place in the second room.
w|wawancara.ko: 취업 면접은 두 번째 방에서 열려.

w|wawancara.en: She was nervous before an important interview.

w|wewenang.text: Hanya pemimpin redaksi yang punya wewenang menarik berita yang sudah terbit.
w|wewenang.en: Only the editor-in-chief has the authority to pull a story that's already been published.
w|wewenang.ko: 이미 나간 기사를 내릴 권한은 편집장에게만 있어요.

w|wewenang.text: Siti tidak punya wewenang untuk menghapus denda anggota.
w|wewenang.en: Siti doesn't have the authority to waive members' fines.
w|wewenang.ko: 시티에게는 회원 연체료를 없애 줄 권한이 없어요.

w|wilayah.text: Wilayah ini rawan banjir setiap musim hujan.
w|wilayah.en: This area is prone to flooding every rainy season.
They guard the security of the border region.

w|wisata.text: Banyak tempat wisata baru bermunculan di sepanjang jalur kereta selatan.
w|wisata.en: Many new tourist spots have sprung up along the southern railway line.
w|wisata.ko: 남부 철도 노선을 따라 새로운 관광지가 많이 생겼어요.

w|wisata.text: Aplikasi buatan Putri membantu orang mencari tempat wisata yang belum ramai.
w|wisata.en: The app Putri made helps people find tourist spots that aren't crowded yet.
w|wisata.ko: 푸트리가 만든 앱은 아직 붐비지 않는 관광지를 찾도록 도와줘요.

w|wisatawan.text: Musim liburan membuat hotel tempat Rudi bekerja penuh wisatawan.
w|wisatawan.en: The holiday season fills the hotel where Rudi works with tourists.
w|wisatawan.ko: 휴가철이면 루디가 일하는 호텔은 관광객으로 가득해요.

w|wisatawan.text: Saat kemarau, wisatawan mulai ramai mendaki gunung dekat rumah Rina.
w|wisatawan.en: In the dry season, tourists start flocking to climb the mountain near Rina's house.
w|wisatawan.ko: 건기가 되면 리나네 집 근처 산에 등산하는 관광객이 많아져요.

w|wiski.text: Seorang turis bertanya kepada Fajar apakah ada kue yang memakai wiski.
w|wiski.en: A tourist asked Fajar whether any of the cakes used whisky.
w|wiski.ko: 한 관광객이 파자르에게 위스키가 들어간 케이크가 있냐고 물었어요.

w|wiski.text: Pelatih mengingatkan Lestari bahwa wiski dan latihan berat tidak cocok.
w|wiski.en: The coach reminded Lestari that whisky and hard training don't mix.
w|wiski.ko: 코치는 레스타리에게 위스키와 힘든 훈련은 맞지 않는다고 일러 줬어요.

w|wisuda.text: Andi pernah melewatkan wisuda sendiri karena harus meliput banjir.
w|wisuda.en: Andi once missed his own graduation because he had to cover a flood.
w|wisuda.ko: 안디는 홍수를 취재하느라 자기 졸업식에 못 간 적이 있어요.

w|wisuda.text: Dewi menemukan foto wisuda yang terselip di antara buku lama.
w|wisuda.en: Dewi found a graduation photo tucked between old books.
w|wisuda.ko: 데위는 헌 책 사이에 끼어 있던 졸업 사진을 찾았어요.

w|wol.text: Agus mencoba sweter wol tebal yang dijual sangat murah.
w|wol.en: Agus tried on a thick wool sweater sold very cheaply.
w|wol.ko: 아구스는 아주 싸게 파는 두꺼운 울 스웨터를 입어 봤어요.

w|wol.text: Wati mengeluarkan selimut wol dari lemari ketika malam mulai dingin.
w|wol.en: Wati took the wool blanket out of the cupboard when the nights started getting cold.
w|wol.ko: 밤이 쌀쌀해지자 와티는 장롱에서 울 담요를 꺼냈어요.

w|wortel.text: Di pasar loak itu ada juga ibu yang menjual wortel dari kebunnya sendiri, kata Agus.
w|wortel.en: At that flea market there's also a woman selling carrots from her own garden, Agus said.
w|wortel.ko: 그 벼룩시장에는 자기 밭에서 키운 당근을 파는 아주머니도 있다고 아구스가 말했어요.

w|wortel.text: Musim kemarau ini membuat wortel di kebun Wati tumbuh kecil-kecil.
w|wortel.en: This dry season has made the carrots in Wati's garden grow small.
w|wortel.ko: 이번 건기 때문에 와티네 밭의 당근이 작게 자랐어요.

w|wujud.text: Di pelajaran IPA, Rudi belajar bahwa air bisa berubah wujud menjadi es atau uap.
w|wujud.en: In science class, Rudi learned that water can change form into ice or steam.
w|wujud.ko: 과학 시간에 루디는 물이 얼음이나 수증기로 모습을 바꿀 수 있다는 걸 배웠어요.

w|wujud.text: Rumah impian Rina akhirnya punya wujud nyata setelah bertahun-tahun menabung.
w|wujud.en: Rina's dream house finally took real shape after years of saving.
w|wujud.ko: 몇 년 동안 돈을 모은 끝에 리나의 꿈의 집이 마침내 현실이 됐어요.

w|yaitu.text: Ada tiga pilihan yaitu merah, biru, hijau.
w|yaitu.en: There are three choices, namely red, blue, green.
w|yaitu.ko: 선택지는 세 가지야, 바로 빨강, 파랑, 초록.

w|yaitu.en: That is the main reason he refused.
w|yaitu.ko: 그게 바로 그가 거절한 주된 이유야.

w|yakin.en: I'm sure you can do it.
She's not sure of the answer.

w|yatim.text: Rekan kerja baru Andi bercerita bahwa dia yatim sejak umur sepuluh tahun.
w|yatim.en: Andi's new coworker said he has been an orphan since he was ten.
w|yatim.ko: 안디의 새 동료는 열 살 때부터 고아였다고 이야기했어요.

w|yatim.text: Hotel tempat Dewi bekerja rutin menyumbang ke panti anak yatim.
w|yatim.en: The hotel where Dewi works regularly donates to an orphanage.
w|yatim.ko: 데위가 일하는 호텔은 정기적으로 고아원에 기부해요.

w|yayasan.text: Agus mendapat beasiswa dari sebuah yayasan pendidikan.
w|yayasan.en: Agus received a scholarship from an educational foundation.
w|yayasan.ko: 아구스는 한 교육 재단에서 장학금을 받았어요.

w|yayasan.text: Kolam itu dikelola sebuah yayasan yang membuka kelas renang gratis untuk anak yatim.
w|yayasan.en: The pool is run by a foundation that offers free swimming classes for orphans.
w|yayasan.ko: 그 수영장은 고아들에게 무료 수영 강습을 여는 재단이 운영해요.

w|yurisdiksi.text: Bayu menjelaskan dalam artikelnya bahwa kasus itu di luar yurisdiksi pengadilan daerah.
w|yurisdiksi.en: Bayu explained in his article that the case was outside the jurisdiction of the regional court.
w|yurisdiksi.ko: 바유는 기사에서 그 사건이 지방 법원의 관할 밖이라고 설명했어요.

w|yurisdiksi.text: Intan tidak tahu negara mana yang punya yurisdiksi atas toko daring dari luar negeri itu.
w|yurisdiksi.en: Intan doesn't know which country has jurisdiction over that foreign online shop.
w|yurisdiksi.ko: 인탄은 그 해외 온라인 가게가 어느 나라 관할인지 몰라요.

w|zaitun.text: Agus mengoleskan minyak zaitun di atas roti focaccia.
w|zaitun.en: Agus brushed olive oil over the focaccia.

w|zaitun.text: Wati memasak pasta dengan minyak zaitun untuk bekal kantor.
w|zaitun.en: Wati cooks pasta with olive oil for her office lunch.
w|zaitun.ko: 와티는 회사에 싸 갈 도시락으로 올리브유 파스타를 만들어요.

w|zaman.en: The present era is changing very fast.

w|zaman.text: Cerita itu berasal dari zaman dulu.
w|zaman.en: That story comes from an earlier era.

w|zat.text: Petugas lingkungan mengambil air sungai untuk memeriksa zat berbahaya dari pabrik.
w|zat.en: Environmental officers took river water to check for hazardous substances from the factory.
w|zat.ko: 환경 담당자들이 공장에서 나온 유해 물질을 검사하려고 강물을 떠 갔어요.

w|zat.text: Wati menjelaskan bahwa obat itu mengandung zat yang membuat mengantuk.
w|zat.en: Wati explained that the medicine contains a substance that causes drowsiness.
w|zat.ko: 와티는 그 약에 졸음을 일으키는 성분이 들어 있다고 설명했어요.

w|zona.en: The parking zone has been full since morning.

w|zona.text: Mereka memasuki zona aman setelah hujan.
w|zona.en: They entered the safe zone after the rain.
w|zona.ko: 비 뒤에 그들은 안전 구역에 들어갔어.
